And worship bringing good fortune is held on the twenty-first day.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśvanniyamitā caiṣā nityā kāmyā'pyataḥ parā ..
mātṛrūpā dayārūpā śaśvadrakṣaṇakāriṇī .. 85 ..
meaning:
शश्वन्नियमिता चैषा नित्या काम्याऽप्यतः परा ..
मातृरूपा दयारूपा शश्वद्रक्षणकारिणी .. 85 ..
text_mt:
This [worship] is constantly ordained as obligatory, and beyond that it is optional.
Embodying motherhood and compassion, she constantly provides protection,

sanskrit_iast:
jale sthale cāntarikṣe śiśūnāṃ svapnagocarā ..
pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devī maṅgalacaṇḍikā .. 86 ..
meaning:
जले स्थले चान्तरिक्षे शिशूनां स्वप्नगोचरा ..
प्रधानांशस्वरूपा या देवी मङ्गलचण्डिका .. 86 ..
text_mt:
Appearing to children in dreams on water, on land, and in the mid-air.
The goddess Maṅgalacaṇḍikā, whose nature is a primary portion [of Prakṛti],

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtermukhasaṃbhūtā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā ..
sṛṣṭau maṅgalarūpā ca saṃhāre koparūpiṇī .. 87 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतेर्मुखसंभूता सर्वमङ्गलदा सदा ..
सृष्टौ मङ्गलरूपा च संहारे कोपरूपिणी .. 87 ..
text_mt:
Was born from the mouth of Prakṛti, always bestowing all auspiciousness.
In creation she has the form of auspiciousness, and in destruction she takes the form of wrath;

sanskrit_iast:
tena maṅgalacaṇḍī sā paṇḍitaiḥ parikīrttitā ..
pratimaṅgalavāreṣu prativiśveṣu pūjitā .. 88 ..
meaning:
तेन मङ्गलचण्डी सा पण्डितैः परिकीर्त्तिता ..
प्रतिमङ्गलवारेषु प्रतिविश्वेषु पूजिता .. 88 ..
text_mt:
Therefore she is proclaimed as Maṅgalacaṇḍī by the learned.
She is worshipped on every Tuesday in every universe;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcopacārairbhaktyā ca yoṣidbhiḥ paripūjitā ..
putrapautradhanaiśvaryyayaśomaṅgaladāyinī ..89..
meaning:
पञ्चोपचारैर्भक्त्या च योषिद्भिः परिपूजिता ..
पुत्रपौत्रधनैश्वर्य्ययशोमङ्गलदायिनी ..89..
text_mt:
She is thoroughly worshipped by women with devotion and the five articles of offering.
She bestows sons, grandsons, wealth, sovereignty, fame, and auspiciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
śoka santāpapāpārttiduḥkhadāridryanāśinī..
parituṣṭā sarvavācchāpradātrī sarvayoṣitām ..2.1.90..
meaning:
शोक सन्तापपापार्त्तिदुःखदारिद्र्यनाशिनी..
परितुष्टा सर्ववाच्छाप्रदात्री सर्वयोषिताम् ..2.1.90..
text_mt:
She destroys sorrow, agony, suffering caused by sin, pain, and poverty.
When fully satisfied, she grants every wish of all women;

sanskrit_iast:
ruṣṭā kṣaṇena saṃhartuṃ śaktā viśvaṃ maheśvarī..
pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca kālī kamalalocanā .. 91 ..
meaning:
रुष्टा क्षणेन संहर्तुं शक्ता विश्वं महेश्वरी..
प्रधानांशस्वरूपा च काली कमललोचना .. 91 ..
text_mt:
When angered, that great goddess is capable of destroying the universe in an instant.
And lotus-eyed Kālī, whose nature is a primary portion [of Prakṛti],

sanskrit_iast:
durgālalāṭasaṃbhūtā raṇe śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ ..
durgārddhāṃśasvarūpā syādguṇaissā tejasā samā .. 92 ..
meaning:
दुर्गाललाटसंभूता रणे शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः ..
दुर्गार्द्धांशस्वरूपा स्याद्गुणैस्सा तेजसा समा .. 92 ..
text_mt:
Was born from the forehead of Durgā in the battle with Śumbha and Niśumbha.
She is the form of half the portion of Durgā, equal [to her] in qualities and splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭisūryyaprabhājuṣṭadivyasundaravigrahā ..
pradhānā sarvaśaktīnāṃ varā balavatī parā .. 93 ..
meaning:
कोटिसूर्य्यप्रभाजुष्टदिव्यसुन्दरविग्रहा ..
प्रधाना सर्वशक्तीनां वरा बलवती परा .. 93 ..
text_mt:
Endowed with a divinely beautiful form possessing the radiance of ten million suns,
She is the foremost among all powers, the excellent, powerful, supreme one.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhipradā devī paramā siddhiyoginī ..
kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇatulyā tejasā vikramairguṇaiḥ ..
kṛṣṇabhāvanayā śaśvatkṛṣṇavarṇā sanātanī .. 94 ..
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा देवी परमा सिद्धियोगिनी ..
कृष्णभक्ता कृष्णतुल्या तेजसा विक्रमैर्गुणैः ..
कृष्णभावनया शश्वत्कृष्णवर्णा सनातनी .. 94 ..
text_mt:
The goddess who bestows all perfections, the supreme master of yoga,
She is devoted to Kṛṣṇa, equal to Kṛṣṇa in splendour, valorous deeds, and qualities.
Through constant meditation on Kṛṣṇa, the eternal goddess is dark-complexioned.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ hartuṃ śaktā niḥśvāsamātrataḥ ..
raṇaṃ daityaiḥ samaṃ tasyāḥ krīḍayā lokarakṣayā .. 95 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं हर्तुं शक्ता निःश्वासमात्रतः ..
रणं दैत्यैः समं तस्याः क्रीडया लोकरक्षया .. 95 ..
text_mt:
She is capable of destroying the entire cosmic egg merely by her out-breath;
Her battle with the demons is [done] out of sport, for the protection of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca dātuṃ śaktā supūjitā ..
brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānā munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षांश्च दातुं शक्ता सुपूजिता ..
ब्रह्मादिभिः स्तूयमाना मुनिभिर्मनुभिर्नरैः .. 96 ..
text_mt:
When well worshipped, she is able to grant duty, wealth, pleasure, and liberation;
She is praised by Brahmā and the others, by sages, Manus, and mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca prakṛtiśca vasundharā ..
ādhārabhūtā sarveṣāṃ sarvasasyaprasūtikā .. 97 ..
meaning:
प्रधानांशस्वरूपा च प्रकृतिश्च वसुन्धरा ..
आधारभूता सर्वेषां सर्वसस्यप्रसूतिका .. 97 ..
text_mt:
And Vasundharā, the earth, whose nature is a primary portion of Prakṛti,
Is the foundation of all beings and the producer of all crops.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnākārā ratnagarbhā sarvaratnākarāśrayā ..
prajādibhiḥ prajeśaiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā .. 98 ..
meaning:
रत्नाकारा रत्नगर्भा सर्वरत्नाकराश्रया ..
प्रजादिभिः प्रजेशैश्च पूजिता वन्दिता सदा .. 98 ..
text_mt:
Having the form of gems, containing gems within her womb, she is the refuge of all mines of jewels;
She is always worshipped and praised by creatures and rulers of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopajīvyarūpā ca sarvasampadvidhāyinī ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ nirādhāraṃ carācaram ..99..
meaning:
सर्वोपजीव्यरूपा च सर्वसम्पद्विधायिनी ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वं निराधारं चराचरम् ..99..
text_mt:
She is the means of sustenance for all and the provider of all prosperity;
Without her, the entire world of moving and unmoving beings would have no support.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛteśca kalā yā yāstā nibodha munīśvara ..
yasya yasya ca yāḥ patnyastāḥ sarvā varṇayāmi te .. 2.1.100 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतेश्च कला या यास्ता निबोध मुनीश्वर ..
यस्य यस्य च याः पत्न्यस्ताः सर्वा वर्णयामि ते .. 2.1.100 ..
text_mt:
Now learn, O lord among sages, of those who are parts of Prakṛti;
I shall describe to you all those who are the wives of each [god].

sanskrit_iast:
svāhādevī vahnipatnī triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā ..
yayā vinā havirdattaṃ na grahītuṃ surāḥ kṣamāḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
स्वाहादेवी वह्निपत्नी त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजिता ..
यया विना हविर्दत्तं न ग्रहीतुं सुराः क्षमाः .. 101 ..
text_mt:
The goddess Svāhā, the wife of Fire, is worshipped in the three worlds;
Without her, the gods are unable to accept the oblation that has been offered.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca dīkṣā sarvatra pūjitā ..
yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvaṃ karma ca niṣphalam ..102..
meaning:
दक्षिणा यज्ञपत्नी च दीक्षा सर्वत्र पूजिता ..
यया विना च विश्वेषु सर्वं कर्म च निष्फलम् ..102..
text_mt:
Dakṣiṇā, the wife of Sacrifice, and Dīkṣā are worshipped everywhere;
Without her, every rite in the worlds is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
svadhā pitṝṇāṃ patnī ca munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ ..
pūjitā paitṛkaṃ dānaṃ niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā .. 103 ..
meaning:
स्वधा पितॄणां पत्नी च मुनिभिर्मनुभिर्नरैः ..
पूजिता पैतृकं दानं निष्फलं च यया विना .. 103 ..
text_mt:
Svadhā, the wife of the ancestors, is worshipped by sages, Manus, and men;
Without her, offerings to the ancestors are entirely fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
svastidevī vāyupatnī prati viśveṣu pūjitā ..
ādānaṃ ca pradānaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā .. 104 ..
meaning:
स्वस्तिदेवी वायुपत्नी प्रति विश्वेषु पूजिता ..
आदानं च प्रदानं च निष्फलं च यया विना .. 104 ..
text_mt:
The goddess Svasti, the wife of Wind, is worshipped in every universe;
Without her, receiving and giving are entirely fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭirgaṇapateḥ patnī pūjitā jagatītale ..
yayā vinā parikṣīṇāḥ pumāṃso yoṣito'pi ca .. 105 ..
meaning:
पुष्टिर्गणपतेः पत्नी पूजिता जगतीतले ..
यया विना परिक्षीणाः पुमांसो योषितोऽपि च .. 105 ..
text_mt:
Puṣṭi, the wife of the Lord of Gaṇas, is worshipped upon the surface of the earth;
Without her, both men and women become thoroughly emaciated.

sanskrit_iast:
anantapatnī tuṣṭiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā ..
yayā vinā na santuṣṭāḥ sarve lokāśca sarvataḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
अनन्तपत्नी तुष्टिश्च पूजिता वन्दिता सदा ..
यया विना न सन्तुष्टाः सर्वे लोकाश्च सर्वतः .. 106 ..
text_mt:
Tuṣṭi, the wife of Ananta, is always worshipped and praised;
Without her, none of the people everywhere find contentment.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānapatnī sampattiḥ pūjitā ca surairnaraiḥ ..
sarve lokā daridrāśca viśveṣu ca yayā vinā .. 107..
meaning:
ईशानपत्नी सम्पत्तिः पूजिता च सुरैर्नरैः ..
सर्वे लोका दरिद्राश्च विश्वेषु च यया विना .. 107..
text_mt:
Sampatti, the wife of Īśāna, is worshipped by gods and men;
Without her, all people in the worlds become impoverished.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtiḥ kapilapatnī ca sarvaiḥ sarvatra pūjitā ..
sarve lokā adhīrāssyurjagatsu ca yayā vinā.. 108 ..
meaning:
धृतिः कपिलपत्नी च सर्वैः सर्वत्र पूजिता ..
सर्वे लोका अधीरास्स्युर्जगत्सु च यया विना.. 108 ..
text_mt:
Dhṛti, the wife of Kapila, is worshipped by all everywhere;
Without her, all people in the worlds would be lacking patience.

sanskrit_iast:
yamapatnī kṣamā sādhvī suśīlā sarvapūjitā..
samunmattāśca rudrāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā .. 109 ..
meaning:
यमपत्नी क्षमा साध्वी सुशीला सर्वपूजिता..
समुन्मत्ताश्च रुद्राश्च सर्वे लोका यया विना .. 109 ..
text_mt:
Kṣamā, the devoted and virtuous wife of Yama, is worshipped by all;
Without her, all people would be utterly frenzied and wrathful.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kāmapatnī ratiḥ satī ..
kelikautukahīnāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā .. 2.1.110 ..
meaning:
क्रीडाधिष्ठातृदेवी सा कामपत्नी रतिः सती ..
केलिकौतुकहीनाश्च सर्वे लोका यया विना .. 2.1.110 ..
text_mt:
She is the presiding deity of erotic play, the chaste Rati, wife of Kāma;
Without her, all people would be devoid of amorous sport and amusement.

sanskrit_iast:
satyapatnī satī muktiḥ pūjitā jagatāṃ priyā ..
yayā vinā bhavelloko bandhutārahitaḥ sadā .. 111..
meaning:
सत्यपत्नी सती मुक्तिः पूजिता जगतां प्रिया ..
यया विना भवेल्लोको बन्धुतारहितः सदा .. 111..
text_mt:
The virtuous Mukti, wife of Satya, is worshipped and dear to the worlds;
Without her, the world would be forever devoid of kinship.

sanskrit_iast:
mohapatnī dayā sādhvī pūjitā ca jagatpriyā ..
sarve lokāśca sarvatra niṣṭhurāśca yayā vinā .. 112 ..
meaning:
मोहपत्नी दया साध्वी पूजिता च जगत्प्रिया ..
सर्वे लोकाश्च सर्वत्र निष्ठुराश्च यया विना .. 112 ..
text_mt:
The virtuous Dayā (Compassion) is the wife of Moha, worshipped and dear to the world;
without her all worlds and everyone everywhere would be cruel. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyapatnī pratiṣṭhā sā puṇyarūpā ca pūjitā ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtasamaṃ mune .. 113 ..
meaning:
पुण्यपत्नी प्रतिष्ठा सा पुण्यरूपा च पूजिता ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वं जीवन्मृतसमं मुने .. 113 ..
text_mt:
Pratiṣṭhā (Repute), having the form of merit, is the wife of Puṇya (Merit) and is worshipped;
without her, O sage, the entire world would be like the living dead. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
sukarmapatnī kīrtiśca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ yaśohīnaṃ mṛtaṃ yathā .. 114 ..
meaning:
सुकर्मपत्नी कीर्तिश्च धन्या मान्या च पूजिता ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वं यशोहीनं मृतं यथा .. 114 ..
text_mt:
Kīrti (Fame) is the wife of Sukarma (Good Action), fortunate, honoured, and worshipped;
without her the entire world would be devoid of renown, as if dead. // 114

sanskrit_iast:
kriyā udyogapatnī ca pūjitā sarvasaṅgatā ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnamiva nārada .. 115 ..
meaning:
क्रिया उद्योगपत्नी च पूजिता सर्वसङ्गता ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वमुच्छिन्नमिव नारद .. 115 ..
text_mt:
Kriyā (Action) is the wife of Udyoga (Effort), worshipped and present in all things;
without her, O Nārada, the entire world would be as if ruined. // 115

sanskrit_iast:
adharmapatnī mithyā sā sarvadhūrtaiśca pūjitā ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnaṃ vidhinirmitam .. 116 ..
meaning:
अधर्मपत्नी मिथ्या सा सर्वधूर्तैश्च पूजिता ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वमुच्छिन्नं विधिनिर्मितम् .. 116 ..
text_mt:
Mithyā (Falsehood) is the wife of Adharma (Unrighteousness), worshipped by all rogues;
without her, the entire world fashioned by the Creator would be destroyed. // 116

sanskrit_iast:
satye adarśanā yā ca tretāyāṃ sūkṣmarūpiṇī ..
arddhāvayavarūpā ca dvāpare saṃhṛtā hriyā .. 117 ..
meaning:
सत्ये अदर्शना या च त्रेतायां सूक्ष्मरूपिणी ..
अर्द्धावयवरूपा च द्वापरे संहृता ह्रिया .. 117 ..
text_mt:
She was invisible in the Satya age, had a subtle form in the Tretā age,
assumed half a body in the Dvāpara age, restrained by shame, // 117

sanskrit_iast:
kalau mahāpragalbhā ca sarvatra vyāptikāraṇāt ..
kapaṭena saha bhrātrā bhramatyeva gṛhe gṛhe .. 118 ..
meaning:
कलौ महाप्रगल्भा च सर्वत्र व्याप्तिकारणात् ..
कपटेन सह भ्रात्रा भ्रमत्येव गृहे गृहे .. 118 ..
text_mt:
and in the Kali age she is immensely bold, because of her pervasiveness everywhere;
together with her brother Kapaṭa (Deceit), she wanders from house to house. // 118

sanskrit_iast:
śāntirlajjā ca bhārye dve suśīlasya ca pūjite ..
yasyāṃ vinā jagatsarvamunmattamiva nārada .. 119 ..
meaning:
शान्तिर्लज्जा च भार्ये द्वे सुशीलस्य च पूजिते ..
यस्यां विना जगत्सर्वमुन्मत्तमिव नारद .. 119 ..
text_mt:
Śānti (Peace) and Lajjā (Modesty) are the two wives of Suśīla (Good Character), and they are worshipped;
without them, O Nārada, the entire world would be like one maddened. // 119

sanskrit_iast:
jñānasya tisro bhāryāśca buddhirmedhā smṛtistathā ..
yābhirvinā jagatsarvaṃ mūḍhaṃ mṛtasamaṃ sadā ..2.1.120..
meaning:
ज्ञानस्य तिस्रो भार्याश्च बुद्धिर्मेधा स्मृतिस्तथा ..
याभिर्विना जगत्सर्वं मूढं मृतसमं सदा ..2.1.120..
text_mt:
Jñāna (Knowledge) has three wives: Buddhi (Intellect), Medhā (Wisdom), and Smṛti (Memory);
without whom the entire world would always be foolish and like the dead. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttiśca dharmapatnī sā kāntirūpā manoharā ..
paramātmā ca viśvaughā nirādhārā yayā vinā .. 121 ..
meaning:
मूर्त्तिश्च धर्मपत्नी सा कान्तिरूपा मनोहरा ..
परमात्मा च विश्वौघा निराधारा यया विना .. 121 ..
text_mt:
Mūrti (Form) is the wife of Dharma, charming and having the form of radiance;
without her the Paramātman and the multitude of worlds would be without support. // 121

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra śobhārūpā ca lakṣmīrmūrtimatī satī ..
śrīrūpā mūrtirūpā ca mānyā dhanyā ca pūjitā..122..
meaning:
सर्वत्र शोभारूपा च लक्ष्मीर्मूर्तिमती सती ..
श्रीरूपा मूर्तिरूपा च मान्या धन्या च पूजिता..122..
text_mt:
Having the form of beauty everywhere, she is the virtuous Lakṣmī embodied;
having the form of Śrī and the form of physical presence, she is honoured, fortunate, and worshipped. // 122

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirudrapatnī ca nidrā yā siddhayoginām ..
sarvalokāḥ samācchannā māyāyogena rātriṣu .. 123 ..
meaning:
कालाग्निरुद्रपत्नी च निद्रा या सिद्धयोगिनाम् ..
सर्वलोकाः समाच्छन्ना मायायोगेन रात्रिषु .. 123 ..
text_mt:
Nidrā (Sleep), who belongs to perfected yogins, is the wife of Kālāgnirudra;
by her, through the union of Māyā, all worlds are covered at night. // 123

sanskrit_iast:
kālasya tisro bhāryyāśca sandhyā rātrirdināni ca ..
yābhirvinā vidhātrā ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate .. 124 ..
meaning:
कालस्य तिस्रो भार्य्याश्च सन्ध्या रात्रिर्दिनानि च ..
याभिर्विना विधात्रा च संख्यां कर्तुं न शक्यते .. 124 ..
text_mt:
Kāla (Time) has three wives: twilight, night, and days;
without them, the Creator cannot reckon [time]. // 124

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpipāse lobhabhāryye dhanye mānye ca pūjite ..
yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatkṣobhayuktaṃ cintitameva ca .. .. 125 ..
meaning:
क्षुत्पिपासे लोभभार्य्ये धन्ये मान्ये च पूजिते ..
याभ्यां व्याप्तं जगत्क्षोभयुक्तं चिन्तितमेव च .. .. 125 ..
text_mt:
Kṣudh (Hunger) and Pipāsā (Thirst) are the two wives of Lobha (Greed), fortunate, honoured, and worshipped;
pervaded by them, the world is filled with agitation and anxiety. // 125

sanskrit_iast:
prabhā ca dāhikā caiva dve bhārye tejasastathā ..
yābhyāṃ vinā jagatsraṣṭuṃ vidhātā ca na hīśvaraḥ .. 126 ..
meaning:
प्रभा च दाहिका चैव द्वे भार्ये तेजसस्तथा ..
याभ्यां विना जगत्स्रष्टुं विधाता च न हीश्वरः .. 126 ..
text_mt:
Prabhā (Radiance) and Dāhikā (Burning Power) are the two wives of Tejas (Heat);
without them, the Creator is not capable of creating the world. // 126

sanskrit_iast:
kālakanye mṛtyujare prajvarasya priye priye ..
yasyāṃ jagatsamucchinnaṃ vidhātrā nirmite vidhau .. 127 ..
meaning:
कालकन्ये मृत्युजरे प्रज्वरस्य प्रिये प्रिये ..
यस्यां जगत्समुच्छिन्नं विधात्रा निर्मिते विधौ .. 127 ..
text_mt:
Mṛtyu (Death) and Jarā (Old Age), the two daughters of Kāla, are the two beloveds of Prajvara (Fever);
through them the world is destroyed in the creation fashioned by the Creator. // 127

sanskrit_iast:
nidrākanyā ca tandrā sā prītiranyā sukhapriye..
yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vidhiputra vidhervidhau .. 128 ..
meaning:
निद्राकन्या च तन्द्रा सा प्रीतिरन्या सुखप्रिये..
याभ्यां व्याप्तं जगत्सर्वं विधिपुत्र विधेर्विधौ .. 128 ..
text_mt:
Tandrā (Sloth) is the daughter of Nidrā (Sleep), and another is Prīti (Affection), who loves happiness;
pervaded by both of them, O son of the Creator, is the entire world in the creation of the Creator. // 128

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyasya ca dve bhārye śraddhā bhaktiśca pūjite ..
yābhyāṃ śaśvajjagatsarvaṃ jīvanmuktamidaṃ mune .. 129 ..
meaning:
वैराग्यस्य च द्वे भार्ये श्रद्धा भक्तिश्च पूजिते ..
याभ्यां शश्वज्जगत्सर्वं जीवन्मुक्तमिदं मुने .. 129 ..
text_mt:
Śraddhā (Faith) and Bhakti (Devotion) are the two wives of Vairāgya (Dispassion), and are worshipped;
by both of them, O sage, this entire world is perpetually liberated while living. // 129

sanskrit_iast:
aditirdevamātā ca surabhiśca gavāṃ prasūḥ ..
ditiśca daityajananī kadrūśca vinatā danuḥ .. 2.1.130 ..
meaning:
अदितिर्देवमाता च सुरभिश्च गवां प्रसूः ..
दितिश्च दैत्यजननी कद्रूश्च विनता दनुः .. 2.1.130 ..
text_mt:
Aditi is the mother of the gods, and Surabhi is the mother of cows;
Diti is the mother of the Daityas, along with Kadrū, Vinatā, and Danu. // 130

sanskrit_iast:
upayuktāḥ sṛṣṭividhāvetāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ..
kalāścānyāḥ santi bahvyastāsu kāścinnibodha me .. .. 131 ..
meaning:
उपयुक्ताः सृष्टिविधावेताश्च प्रकृतेः कलाः ..
कलाश्चान्याः सन्ति बह्व्यस्तासु काश्चिन्निबोध मे .. .. 131 ..
text_mt:
These parts of Prakṛti are employed in the arrangement of creation;
and there are many other parts—hear some of them from me: // 131

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇī candrapatnī ca saṃjñā sūryasya kāminī ..
śatarūpā manorbhāryā śacīndrasya ca gehinī .. 132 ..
meaning:
रोहिणी चन्द्रपत्नी च संज्ञा सूर्यस्य कामिनी ..
शतरूपा मनोर्भार्या शचीन्द्रस्य च गेहिनी .. 132 ..
text_mt:
Rohiṇī is the wife of Candra, Saṃjñā is the beloved of Sūrya,
Śatarūpā is the wife of Manu, and Śacī is the wife of Indra. // 132

sanskrit_iast:
tārā bṛhaspaterbhāryyā vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī ..
ahalyā gautamastrī syādanasūyā'trikāminī .. 133 ..
meaning:
तारा बृहस्पतेर्भार्य्या वसिष्ठस्याप्यरुन्धती ..
अहल्या गौतमस्त्री स्यादनसूयाऽत्रिकामिनी .. 133 ..
text_mt:
Tārā is the wife of Bṛhaspati, and Arundhatī belongs to Vasiṣṭha;
Ahalyā is the wife of Gautama, and Anasūyā is the beloved of Atri. // 133

sanskrit_iast:
devahūtiḥ kardamasya prasūtirdakṣakāminī ..
pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā sā'mbikāprasūḥ .. 134 ..
meaning:
देवहूतिः कर्दमस्य प्रसूतिर्दक्षकामिनी ..
पितॄणां मानसी कन्या मेनका साऽम्बिकाप्रसूः .. 134 ..
text_mt:
Devahūti belongs to Kardama, Prasūti is the beloved of Dakṣa,
and Menakā, the mind-born daughter of the ancestors, is the mother of Ambikā. // 134

sanskrit_iast:
lopāmudrā tathā hūtiḥ kuberasya tu kāminī ..
varuṇānī yamastrī ca balervindhyāvalīti ca .. 135 ..
meaning:
लोपामुद्रा तथा हूतिः कुबेरस्य तु कामिनी ..
वरुणानी यमस्त्री च बलेर्विन्ध्यावलीति च .. 135 ..
text_mt:
So too Lopāmudrā, and Hūti the beloved of Kubera;
Varuṇānī, the wife of Yama, and Vindhyāvalī of Bali. // 135

sanskrit_iast:
kuntī ca damayantī ca yaśodā devakī satī ..
gāndhārī draupadī savyā sāvitrī satyavatpriyā .. .. 136 ..
meaning:
कुन्ती च दमयन्ती च यशोदा देवकी सती ..
गान्धारी द्रौपदी सव्या सावित्री सत्यवत्प्रिया .. .. 136 ..
text_mt:
Kuntī and Damayantī, Yaśodā and the virtuous Devakī,
Gāndhārī, Draupadī, Savyā, and Sāvitrī, the beloved of Satyavat. // 136

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī rādhāmātā kalāvatī ..
mandodarī ca kausalyā subhadrā kaikayī tathā .. 137 ..
meaning:
वृषभानुप्रिया साध्वी राधामाता कलावती ..
मन्दोदरी च कौसल्या सुभद्रा कैकयी तथा .. 137 ..
text_mt:
The virtuous Kalāvatī, mother of Rādhā and beloved of Vṛṣabhānu;
Mandodarī and Kausalyā, Subhadrā and Kaikeyī; // 137

sanskrit_iast:
revatī satyabhāmā ca kālindī lakṣmaṇā tathā ..
mitravindā nāgnajitī tathā jāmbavatī parā .. 138 ..
meaning:
रेवती सत्यभामा च कालिन्दी लक्ष्मणा तथा ..
मित्रविन्दा नाग्नजिती तथा जाम्बवती परा .. 138 ..
text_mt:
Revatī and Satyabhāmā, Kālindī and Lakṣmaṇā;
Mitravindā, Nāgnajitī, and the supreme Jāmbavatī. // 138

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇā rukmiṇī sītā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā ..
kalā yojanagandhā ca vyāsamātā mahāsatī .. 139 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मणा रुक्मिणी सीता स्वयं लक्ष्मीः प्रकीर्तिता ..
कला योजनगन्धा च व्यासमाता महासती .. 139 ..
text_mt:
Lakṣmaṇā, Rukmiṇī, and Sītā are celebrated as Lakṣmī herself;
and the great devoted wife Yojanagandhā, the mother of Vyāsa, is a part. // 139

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇaputrī tathoṣā ca citralekhā ca tatsakhī ..
prabhāvatī bhānumatī tathā māyāvatī satī ..2.1.140..
meaning:
बाणपुत्री तथोषा च चित्रलेखा च तत्सखी ..
प्रभावती भानुमती तथा मायावती सती ..2.1.140..
text_mt:
Uṣā, daughter of Bāṇa, and her friend Citralekhā;
Prabhāvatī, Bhānumatī, and the virtuous Māyāvatī; // 140

sanskrit_iast:
reṇukā ca bhṛgormātā halimātā ca rohiṇī..
ekānaṃśā ca durgā sā śrīkṛṣṇabhaginī satī .. 141 ..
meaning:
रेणुका च भृगोर्माता हलिमाता च रोहिणी..
एकानंशा च दुर्गा सा श्रीकृष्णभगिनी सती .. 141 ..
text_mt:
Reṇukā the mother of Bhṛgu's descendant, and Rohiṇī the mother of the Plough-bearer;
and the virtuous Ekānaṃśā, who is Durgā, the sister of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. // 141

sanskrit_iast:
bahvyaḥ santi kalāścaivaṃ prakṛtereva bhārate ..
yā yāśca grāmadevyastāḥ sarvāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ .. 142 ..
meaning:
बह्व्यः सन्ति कलाश्चैवं प्रकृतेरेव भारते ..
या याश्च ग्रामदेव्यस्ताः सर्वाश्च प्रकृतेः कलाः .. 142 ..
text_mt:
In this way there are many parts of Prakṛti in Bhārata.
All the village goddesses that exist are parts of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhūtāḥ prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ ..
yoṣitāmapamānena prakṛteśca parābhavaḥ .. 143 ..
meaning:
कलांशांशसमुद्भूताः प्रतिविश्वेषु योषितः ..
योषितामपमानेन प्रकृतेश्च पराभवः .. 143 ..
text_mt:
Women in every universe have arisen from subdivisions of her parts;
by insulting a woman, Prakṛti is disgraced.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇī pūjitā yena patiputravatī satī ..
prakṛtiḥ pūjitā tena vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ..144..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणी पूजिता येन पतिपुत्रवती सती ..
प्रकृतिः पूजिता तेन वस्त्रालङ्कारचन्दनैः..144..
text_mt:
He by whom a virtuous Brahmin woman having a husband and sons is worshipped
with garments, ornaments, and sandal paste, has worshipped Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ..
pūjitā yena viprasya prakṛtistena pūjitā..145..
meaning:
कुमारी चाष्टवर्षीया वस्त्रालङ्कारचन्दनैः..
पूजिता येन विप्रस्य प्रकृतिस्तेन पूजिता..145..
text_mt:
And an eight-year-old maiden of a Brahmin,
who is worshipped with garments, ornaments, and sandal paste—by him Prakṛti is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāḥ prakṛtisambhūtā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ..
sattvāṃśāścottamā jñeyāḥ suśīlāśca pativratāḥ ..146..
meaning:
सर्वाः प्रकृतिसम्भूता उत्तमाधममध्यमाः..
सत्त्वांशाश्चोत्तमा ज्ञेयाः सुशीलाश्च पतिव्रताः ..146..
text_mt:
All [women] are born of Prakṛti, [whether] best, lowest, or middling.
The portions of sattva should be known as the best: well-behaved and devoted wives;

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamā rajasaścāṃśāstāśca bhogyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ ..
sukhasambhogavatyaśca svakārye tatparāḥ sadā .. 147 ..
meaning:
मध्यमा रजसश्चांशास्ताश्च भोग्याः प्रकीर्त्तिताः ..
सुखसम्भोगवत्यश्च स्वकार्ये तत्पराः सदा .. 147 ..
text_mt:
the middling are portions of rajas, and they are declared to be seekers of enjoyment,
possessing pleasant delights and always intent on their own affairs;

sanskrit_iast:
adhamāstamasaścāṃśā ajñātakulasambhavāḥ ..
durmukhāḥ kulaṭā dhūrttāḥ svatantrāḥ kalahapriyāḥ..148..
meaning:
अधमास्तमसश्चांशा अज्ञातकुलसम्भवाः ..
दुर्मुखाः कुलटा धूर्त्ताः स्वतन्त्राः कलहप्रियाः..148..
text_mt:
the lowest are portions of tamas, born of unknown lineage,
foul-mouthed, unchaste, deceitful, headstrong, and fond of quarrels.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ kulaṭā yāśca svarge cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
prakṛtestamasaścāṃśāḥ puṃścalyaḥ parikīrttitāḥ .. 149 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां कुलटा याश्च स्वर्गे चाप्सरसां गणाः ..
प्रकृतेस्तमसश्चांशाः पुंश्चल्यः परिकीर्त्तिताः .. 149 ..
text_mt:
Those who are unchaste on earth, and the hosts of apsarases in heaven,
are portions of Prakṛti's tamas, proclaimed as promiscuous women.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛterbhedapañcakam ..
tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjitāḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate .. 2.1.150 ..
meaning:
एवं निगदितं सर्वं प्रकृतेर्भेदपञ्चकम् ..
ताः सर्वाः पूजिताः पृथ्व्यां पुण्यक्षेत्रे च भारते .. 2.1.150 ..
text_mt:
Thus the entire threefold-fivefold division of Prakṛti has been related;
all of them are worshipped on earth, in the sacred realm of Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitā surathenādau durgā durgārtināśinī ..
dvitīyā rāmacandreṇa rāvaṇasya vadhārthinā .. 151 ..
meaning:
पूजिता सुरथेनादौ दुर्गा दुर्गार्तिनाशिनी ..
द्वितीया रामचन्द्रेण रावणस्य वधार्थिना .. 151 ..
text_mt:
Durgā, the destroyer of distress, was first worshipped by Suratha;
secondly, by Rāmacandra wishing to slay Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpaścājjagatāṃ mātā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā ..
jātā''dau dakṣapatnyāṃ ca nihantuṃ daityadānavān .. 152 ..
meaning:
तत्पश्चाज्जगतां माता त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजिता ..
जाता'ऽदौ दक्षपत्न्यां च निहन्तुं दैत्यदानवान् .. 152 ..
text_mt:
After that, the Mother of the Worlds was worshipped in the three worlds.
She was born first from the wife of Dakṣa to destroy the Daityas and Dānavas;

sanskrit_iast:
tato dehaṃ parityajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā ..
jajñe himavataḥ patnyāṃ lebhe paśupatiṃ patim ..153..
meaning:
ततो देहं परित्यज्य यज्ञे भर्तुश्च निन्दया ..
जज्ञे हिमवतः पत्न्यां लेभे पशुपतिं पतिम् ..153..
text_mt:
then, having cast off her body at the sacrifice on account of the reviling of her husband,
she was born to the wife of Himavat and obtained Paśupati as her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ skando viṣṇukalodbhavaḥ ..
babhūvatustau tanayau paścāttasyāśca nārada ..154..
meaning:
गणेशश्च स्वयं कृष्णः स्कन्दो विष्णुकलोद्भवः ..
बभूवतुस्तौ तनयौ पश्चात्तस्याश्च नारद ..154..
text_mt:
Gaṇeśa, who is Kṛṣṇa himself, and Skanda, born from a part of Viṣṇu—
those two became her sons thereafter, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīrmaṅgalabhūpena prathame paripūjitā ..
triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścāddevatāmunimānavaiḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीर्मङ्गलभूपेन प्रथमे परिपूजिता ..
त्रिषु लोकेषु तत्पश्चाद्देवतामुनिमानवैः .. 155 ..
text_mt:
Lakṣmī was first thoroughly worshipped by King Maṅgala;
after that, in the three worlds by gods, sages, and men.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī prathamaṃ cāpi bhaktyā vai paripūjitā ..
tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ .. 156 ..
meaning:
सावित्री प्रथमं चापि भक्त्या वै परिपूजिता ..
तत्पश्चात्त्रिषु लोकेषु देवतामुनिमानवैः .. 156 ..
text_mt: Sāvitrī too was first thoroughly worshipped with devotion [by Brahmā];

sanskrit_iast:
ādau sarasvatī devī brahmaṇā paripūjitā ..
tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ .. 157 ..
meaning:
आदौ सरस्वती देवी ब्रह्मणा परिपूजिता ..
तत्पश्चात्त्रिषु लोकेषु देवतामुनिमानवैः .. 157 ..
text_mt: In the beginning the goddess Sarasvatī was thoroughly worshipped by Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ pūjitā rādhā goloke rāsamaṇḍale ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ kārttikasya kṛṣṇena paramātmanā .. 158 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं पूजिता राधा गोलोके रासमण्डले ..
पौर्णमास्यां कार्त्तिकस्य कृष्णेन परमात्मना .. 158 ..
text_mt:
Rādhā was first worshipped in Goloka in the circle of the rāsa-dance
on the full moon day of Kārttika by Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman;

sanskrit_iast:
gopikābhiśca gopaiśca bālikābhiśca bālakaiḥ ..
gavāṃ gaṇaiḥ suragaṇaistatpaścānmāyayā hareḥ .. 159 ..
meaning:
गोपिकाभिश्च गोपैश्च बालिकाभिश्च बालकैः ..
गवां गणैः सुरगणैस्तत्पश्चान्मायया हरेः .. 159 ..
text_mt:
and by the cowherd women, the cowherds, the girls, and the boys,
by herds of cattle, and by the hosts of gods through the māyā of Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
tadā brahmādibhirdevairmunibhirmanubhistathā.
puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā vanditā sadā..2.1.160..
meaning:
तदा ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवैर्मुनिभिर्मनुभिस्तथा.
पुष्पधूपादिभिर्भक्त्या पूजिता वन्दिता सदा..2.1.160..
text_mt:
then by the gods beginning with Brahmā, and by sages and Manus,
she was continually worshipped and praised with flowers, incense, and the like, with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ prathame devī suyajñena ca pūjitā..
śaṅkareṇopadiṣṭena puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate .. 161 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां प्रथमे देवी सुयज्ञेन च पूजिता..
शङ्करेणोपदिष्टेन पुण्यक्षेत्रे च भारते .. 161 ..
text_mt:
On earth the goddess was first worshipped by Suyajña,
instructed by Śaṅkara, in the sacred realm of Bhārata;

sanskrit_iast:
triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścādājñayā paramātmanaḥ ..
puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā munibhiḥ suraiḥ .. .. 162 ..
meaning:
त्रिषु लोकेषु तत्पश्चादाज्ञया परमात्मनः ..
पुष्पधूपादिभिर्भक्त्या पूजिता मुनिभिः सुरैः .. .. 162 ..
text_mt:
after that in the three worlds by the command of the Paramātman
she was worshipped with devotion with flowers, incense, and the like by sages and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kalā yā yāḥ susaṃbhūtāḥ pūjitāstāśca bhārate ..
pūjitā grāmadevyaśca grāme ca nagare mune .. 163 ..
meaning:
कला या याः सुसंभूताः पूजितास्ताश्च भारते ..
पूजिता ग्रामदेव्यश्च ग्रामे च नगरे मुने .. 163 ..
text_mt:
Whatever parts have been properly born are worshipped in Bhārata;
and the village goddesses are worshipped in village and city, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛteścaritaṃ śubham ..
yathāgamaṃ lakṣaṇañca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 164 ..
meaning:
एवं ते कथितं सर्वं प्रकृतेश्चरितं शुभम् ..
यथागमं लक्षणञ्च किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 164 ..
text_mt:
Thus all the auspicious conduct and characteristics of Prakṛti have been told to you
according to the scriptures. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
samāsena śrutaṃ sarvaṃ devīnāṃ caritaṃ vibho ..
vibodhanārthaṃ bodhasya vyāsato vaktumarhasi ..1..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
समासेन श्रुतं सर्वं देवीनां चरितं विभो ..
विबोधनार्थं बोधस्य व्यासतो वक्तुमर्हसि ..1..
title: adhyāyaḥ 02

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭerādyā sṛṣṭividhau kathamāvirbabhūva ha ..
kathaṃ vā pañcadhā bhūtā vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 2 ..
meaning:
सृष्टेराद्या सृष्टिविधौ कथमाविर्बभूव ह ..
कथं वा पञ्चधा भूता वद वेदविदां वर .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtā yā yāśca kalayā tayā triguṇayā bhave ..
vyāsena tāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam .. 3 ..
meaning:
भूता या याश्च कलया तया त्रिगुणया भवे ..
व्यासेन तासां चरितं श्रोतुमिच्छामि साम्प्रतम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ janmānukathanaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ param ..
stotraṃ kavacamaiśvaryyaṃ śauryaṃ varṇaya maṅgalam .. 4 ..
meaning:
तासां जन्मानुकथनं ध्यानं पूजाविधिं परम् ..
स्तोत्रं कवचमैश्वर्य्यं शौर्यं वर्णय मङ्गलम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
nityātmā ca nabho nityaṃ kālo nityo diśo yathā ..
viśveṣāṃ gokulaṃ nityaṃ nityo goloka eva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
नित्यात्मा च नभो नित्यं कालो नित्यो दिशो यथा ..
विश्वेषां गोकुलं नित्यं नित्यो गोलोक एव च .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadekadeśo vaikuṇṭho lambabhāgaḥ sa nityakaḥ ..
tathaiva prakṛtirnityā brahmalīnā sanātanī .. 6 ..
meaning:
तदेकदेशो वैकुण्ठो लम्बभागः स नित्यकः ..
तथैव प्रकृतिर्नित्या ब्रह्मलीना सनातनी .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yathā'gnau dāhikā candre padme śobhā prabhā ravau ..
śaśvadyuktā na bhinnā sā tathā prakṛtirātmani .. 7 ..
meaning:
यथाऽग्नौ दाहिका चन्द्रे पद्मे शोभा प्रभा रवौ ..
शश्वद्युक्ता न भिन्ना सा तथा प्रकृतिरात्मनि .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ..
vinā mṛdā kulālo hi ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ na hīśvaraḥ .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
विना स्वर्णं स्वर्णकारः कुण्डलं कर्तुमक्षमः ..
विना मृदा कुलालो हि घटं कर्तुं न हीश्वरः .. .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nahi kṣamastathā brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tayā vinā ..
sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā tayā syācchaktimānsadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
नहि क्षमस्तथा ब्रह्मा सृष्टिं स्रष्टुं तया विना ..
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपा सा तया स्याच्छक्तिमान्सदा .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryyavacanaḥ śak ca tiḥ parākramavācakaḥ ..
tatsvarūpā tayordātrī yā sā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā .. 2.2.10 ..
meaning:
ऐश्वर्य्यवचनः शक् च तिः पराक्रमवाचकः ..
तत्स्वरूपा तयोर्दात्री या सा शक्तिः प्रकीर्तिता .. 2.2.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
samṛddhibuddhisampattiyaśasāṃ vacano bhagaḥ ..
tena śaktirbhagavatī bhagarūpā ca sā sadā .. 11 ..
meaning:
समृद्धिबुद्धिसम्पत्तियशसां वचनो भगः ..
तेन शक्तिर्भगवती भगरूपा च सा सदा .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tayā yuktaḥ sadā''tmā ca bhagavāṃstena kathyate ..
sa ca svecchāmayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sākāraśca nirākṛtiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
तया युक्तः सदा'ऽत्मा च भगवांस्तेन कथ्यते ..
स च स्वेच्छामयः कृष्णः साकारश्च निराकृतिः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tejorūpaṃ nirākāraṃ dhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā ..
vadanti te paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram .. 13 ..
meaning:
तेजोरूपं निराकारं ध्यायन्ते योगिनः सदा ..
वदन्ति ते परं ब्रह्म परमात्मानमीश्वरम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyaṃ sarva draṣṭāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam ..
sarvadaṃ sarvarūpāntamarūpaṃ sarvapoṣakam.. 14 ..
meaning:
अदृश्यं सर्व द्रष्टारं सर्वज्ञं सर्वकारणम् ..
सर्वदं सर्वरूपान्तमरूपं सर्वपोषकम्.. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavāste na manyante tadbhaktāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ..
vadanti kasya tejaste iti tejasvinaṃ vinā ..15..
meaning:
वैष्णवास्ते न मन्यन्ते तद्भक्ताः सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः..
वदन्ति कस्य तेजस्ते इति तेजस्विनं विना ..15..

sanskrit_iast:
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ brahma tejasvinaṃ param..
svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam..16..
meaning:
तेजोमण्डलमध्यस्थं ब्रह्म तेजस्विनं परम्..
स्वेच्छामयं सर्वरूपं सर्वकारणकारणम्..16..

sanskrit_iast:
atīvasundaraṃ rūpaṃ bibhrataṃ sumanoharam ..
kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ parātparam ..17..
meaning:
अतीवसुन्दरं रूपं बिभ्रतं सुमनोहरम् ..
किशोरवयसं शान्तं सर्वकान्तं परात्परम् ..17..

sanskrit_iast:
navīnanīradābhāsaṃ rāsaikaśyāmasundaram ..
śaranmadhyāhnapadmaughaśobhāmocakalocanam .. 18 ..
meaning:
नवीननीरदाभासं रासैकश्यामसुन्दरम् ..
शरन्मध्याह्नपद्मौघशोभामोचकलोचनम् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
muktāsāramahāsvacchadantapaṅktimanoharam ..
mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ..19..
meaning:
मुक्तासारमहास्वच्छदन्तपङ्क्तिमनोहरम् ..
मयूरपुच्छचूडं च मालतीमाल्यमण्डितम् ..19..

sanskrit_iast:
sunāsaṃ sasmitaṃ śaśvadbhaktānugrahakārakam ..
jvaladagniviśuddhaikapītāṃśukasuśobhitam ..2.2.20..
meaning:
सुनासं सस्मितं शश्वद्भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ..
ज्वलदग्निविशुद्धैकपीतांशुकसुशोभितम् ..2.2.20..

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktiyutaṃ vibhum .. 21 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ..
सर्वाधारं च सर्वेशं सर्वशक्तियुतं विभुम् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ sarvaṃ svatantraṃ sarvamaṅgalam ..
paripūrṇatamaṃ siddhaṃ siddhi daṃ siddhikāraṇam .. 22 ..
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्य्यप्रदं सर्वं स्वतन्त्रं सर्वमङ्गलम् ..
परिपूर्णतमं सिद्धं सिद्धि दं सिद्धिकारणम् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvadevaṃrūpaṃ sanātanam ..
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param .. 23 ..
meaning:
ध्यायन्ते वैष्णवाः शश्वदेवंरूपं सनातनम् ..
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिशोकभीतिहरं परम् .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo vayasā yasya nimeṣa upacāryyate ..
sa cātmā paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो वयसा यस्य निमेष उपचार्य्यते ..
स चात्मा परमं ब्रह्म कृष्ण इत्यभिधीयते .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣistadbhaktivacano naśca taddāsyakārakaḥ ..
bhaktidāsyapradātā yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
कृषिस्तद्भक्तिवचनो नश्च तद्दास्यकारकः ..
भक्तिदास्यप्रदाता यः स कृष्णः परिकीर्तितः .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāro bījavācakaḥ ..
sarvabījaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate .. 26 ..
meaning:
कृषिश्च सर्ववचनो नकारो बीजवाचकः ..
सर्वबीजं परं ब्रह्म कृष्ण इत्यभिधीयते .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇā pāte kāle'tīte'pi nārada ..
yadguṇānāṃ nāsti nāśastatsamāno guṇena ca .. 27 ..
meaning:
असंख्यब्रह्मणा पाते कालेऽतीतेऽपि नारद ..
यद्गुणानां नास्ति नाशस्तत्समानो गुणेन च .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasṛṣṭyādau sisṛkṣustveka eva ca ..
sṛṣṭyunmukhastadaṃśena kālena preritaḥ prabhuḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
स कृष्णः सर्वसृष्ट्यादौ सिसृक्षुस्त्वेक एव च ..
सृष्ट्युन्मुखस्तदंशेन कालेन प्रेरितः प्रभुः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svecchāmayaḥ svecchayā ca dvidhārūpo babhūva ha ..
strīrūpā vāmabhāgāṃśāddakṣiṇāṃśaḥ pumānsmṛtaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स्वेच्छामयः स्वेच्छया च द्विधारूपो बभूव ह ..
स्त्रीरूपा वामभागांशाद्दक्षिणांशः पुमान्स्मृतः .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dadarśa mahākāmī kāmādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ ..
atīva kamanīyāṃ ca cārucampakasannibhām .. 2.2.30 ..
meaning:
तां ददर्श महाकामी कामाधारः सनातनः ..
अतीव कमनीयां च चारुचम्पकसन्निभाम् .. 2.2.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇendubimbasadṛśanitamvayugalāṃ parām ..
sucārukadalīstambhasadṛśaśroṇisundarīm .. 31 ..
meaning:
पूर्णेन्दुबिम्बसदृशनितम्वयुगलां पराम् ..
सुचारुकदलीस्तम्भसदृशश्रोणिसुन्दरीम् .. 31 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīyuktaśrīphalākārastanayugmamanoramām ..
puṣṭyā yuktāṃ sulalitāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्रीयुक्तश्रीफलाकारस्तनयुग्ममनोरमाम् ..
पुष्ट्या युक्तां सुललितां मध्यक्षीणां मनोहराम् .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atīva sundarīṃ śāntāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām ..
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 33 ..
meaning:
अतीव सुन्दरीं शान्तां सस्मितां वक्रलोचनाम् ..
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaśvaccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ pibantīṃ santataṃ mudā ..
kṛṣṇasya sundaramukhaṃ candrakoṭivinindakam .. 34 ..
meaning:
शश्वच्चक्षुश्चकोराभ्यां पिबन्तीं सन्ततं मुदा ..
कृष्णस्य सुन्दरमुखं चन्द्रकोटिविनिन्दकम् .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ..
samaṃ sindūrabinduṃ ca bhālamadhye ca bibhratīm .. 35 ..
meaning:
कस्तूरीबिन्दुभिः सार्द्धमधश्चन्दनबिन्दुना ..
समं सिन्दूरबिन्दुं च भालमध्ये च बिभ्रतीम् .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suvakrakabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ..
ratnendrasārahāraṃ ca dadhatīṃ kāntakāmukīm .. 36 ..
meaning:
सुवक्रकबरीभारं मालतीमाल्यभूषितम् ..
रत्नेन्द्रसारहारं च दधतीं कान्तकामुकीम् .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśobhāsamanvitām ..
gamane rājahaṃsīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭyā khañjanagañjanīm .. 37 ..
meaning:
कोटिचन्द्रप्रभाजुष्टपुष्टशोभासमन्विताम् ..
गमने राजहंसीं तां दृष्ट्या खञ्जनगञ्जनीम् .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atimātraṃ tayā sārddhaṃ rāseśo rāsamaṇḍale ..
rāsollāseṣu rahasi rāsakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha..38..
meaning:
अतिमात्रं तया सार्द्धं रासेशो रासमण्डले ..
रासोल्लासेषु रहसि रासक्रीडां चकार ह..38..

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprakāraśṛṃgāraṃ śṛṅgāro mūrttimāniva..
cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ..39..
meaning:
नानाप्रकारशृंगारं शृङ्गारो मूर्त्तिमानिव..
चकार सुखसम्भोगं यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः ..39..

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa ca pariśrāntastasyā yonau jagatpitā ..
cakāra vīryyādhānaṃ ca nityānandaḥ śubhakṣaṇe .. 2.2.40 ..
meaning:
ततः स च परिश्रान्तस्तस्या योनौ जगत्पिता ..
चकार वीर्य्याधानं च नित्यानन्दः शुभक्षणे .. 2.2.40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gātrato yoṣitastasyāḥ suratānte ca suvrata ..
nissasāra śramajalaṃ śrāntāyāstejasā hareḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
गात्रतो योषितस्तस्याः सुरतान्ते च सुव्रत ..
निस्ससार श्रमजलं श्रान्तायास्तेजसा हरेः .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsuratakhinnāyā niśvāsaśca babhūva ha ..
tadādhāraśramajalaṃ tatsarvaṃ viśvagolakam .. 42 ..
meaning:
महासुरतखिन्नाया निश्वासश्च बभूव ह ..
तदाधारश्रमजलं तत्सर्वं विश्वगोलकम् .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca niḥśvāsavāyuśca sarvādhāro babhūva ha ..
niśśvāsavāyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ ca bhaveṣu ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
स च निःश्वासवायुश्च सर्वाधारो बभूव ह ..
निश्श्वासवायुः सर्वेषां जीविनां च भवेषु च .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva mūrttimadvāyorvāmāṅgātprāṇavallabhā ..
tatpatnī sā ca tatputrāḥ prāṇāḥ pañca ca jīvinām .. 44 ..
meaning:
बभूव मूर्त्तिमद्वायोर्वामाङ्गात्प्राणवल्लभा ..
तत्पत्नी सा च तत्पुत्राः प्राणाः पञ्च च जीविनाम् .. 44 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścaivodāno vyāna eva ca ..
babhūvureva tatputrā adhaḥprāṇāśca pañca ca .. 45 ..
meaning:
प्राणोऽपानः समानश्चैवोदानो व्यान एव च ..
बभूवुरेव तत्पुत्रा अधःप्राणाश्च पञ्च च .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Prāṇa, Apāna, Samāna, Udāna, and Vyāna;
they became his sons, as well as the five lower vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
gharmatoyādhidevaśca babhūva varuṇo mahān ..
tadvāmāṅgācca tatpatnī varuṇānī babhūva sā .. 46 ..
meaning:
घर्मतोयाधिदेवश्च बभूव वरुणो महान् ..
तद्वामाङ्गाच्च तत्पत्नी वरुणानी बभूव सा .. 46 ..
text_mt:
And the presiding deity of the waters of sweat became the great Varuṇa;
and from his left side arose his wife, Varuṇānī.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā kṛṣṇaśaktiśca kṛṣṇādgarbhaṃ dadhāra ha ..
śatamanvantaraṃ yāvajjvalanto(tī?) brahmatejasā .. 47 ..
meaning:
अथ सा कृष्णशक्तिश्च कृष्णाद्गर्भं दधार ह ..
शतमन्वन्तरं यावज्ज्वलन्तो(ती?) ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 47 ..
text_mt:
Then she, the energy of Kṛṣṇa, bore the embryo from Kṛṣṇa,
blazing with the fiery splendor of Brahman for the duration of a hundred manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriyā ..
kṛṣṇasya saṅginī śaśvatkṛṣṇavakṣasthalasthitā .. 48 ..
meaning:
कृष्णप्राणाधिदेवी सा कृष्णप्राणाधिकप्रिया ..
कृष्णस्य सङ्गिनी शश्वत्कृष्णवक्षस्थलस्थिता .. 48 ..
text_mt:
She was the presiding goddess of Kṛṣṇa's life-breath, dearer to him than his own life,
the constant companion of Kṛṣṇa, residing upon Kṛṣṇa's chest.

sanskrit_iast:
śatamanvantarātīte kāle paramasundarī ..
suṣāvāṇḍaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ viśvādhārālayaṃ param .. 49 ..
meaning:
शतमन्वन्तरातीते काले परमसुन्दरी ..
सुषावाण्डं सुवर्णाभं विश्वाधारालयं परम् .. 49 ..
text_mt:
When a hundred manvantaras had passed, the exceedingly beautiful woman
brought forth an egg shining like gold, the supreme abode and receptacle of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā cāṇḍaṃ hi sā devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ..
utsasarja ca kopena tadaṇḍaṃ golake jale .. 2.2.50 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा चाण्डं हि सा देवी हृदयेन विदूयता ..
उत्ससर्ज च कोपेन तदण्डं गोलके जले .. 2.2.50 ..
text_mt:
Beholding that egg, that goddess, her heart burning [with grief],
cast that egg away into the waters in Goloka out of anger.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca tattyāgaṃ hāhākāraṃ cakāra da...
śaśāpa devīṃ deveśastatkṣaṇaṃ ca yathocitam .. 51 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णश्च तत्त्यागं हाहाकारं चकार द...
शशाप देवीं देवेशस्तत्क्षणं च यथोचितम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Seeing that abandonment, Kṛṣṇa cried out in lamentation;
the Lord of gods immediately cursed the goddess as was fitting:

sanskrit_iast:
yato'patyaṃ tvayā tyaktaṃ kopaśīle suniṣṭhure ..
bhava tvamanapatyā'pi cādyaprabhṛti niścitam .. 52 ..
meaning:
यतोऽपत्यं त्वया त्यक्तं कोपशीले सुनिष्ठुरे ..
भव त्वमनपत्याऽपि चाद्यप्रभृति निश्चितम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
"Since your offspring has been cast away by you, O wrathful, utterly cruel woman,
from this day forward, you shall certainly be childless as well!

sanskrit_iast:
yā yāstvadaṃśarūpāśca bhaviṣyanti surastriyaḥ ..
anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāstvatsamā nityayauvanāḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
या यास्त्वदंशरूपाश्च भविष्यन्ति सुरस्त्रियः ..
अनपत्याश्च ताः सर्वास्त्वत्समा नित्ययौवनाः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Whichever divine women shall arise as portions of you,
they all, like you, will be childless and endowed with eternal youth."

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devī jihvāgrātsahasā tataḥ ..
āvirbabhūva kanyaikā śuklavarṇā manoharā .. 54 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी जिह्वाग्रात्सहसा ततः ..
आविर्बभूव कन्यैका शुक्लवर्णा मनोहरा .. 54 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, suddenly from the tip of the goddess's tongue,
a charming maiden of white complexion manifested:

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastraparīdhānā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī ..
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā sarvaśāstrādhidevatā .. 55 ..
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधाना वीणापुस्तकधारिणी ..
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्या सर्वशास्त्राधिदेवता .. 55 ..
text_mt:
clothed in yellow garments, holding a vīṇā and a book,
richly adorned with jewel-ornaments, the presiding deity of all sacred scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kālāntare sā ca dvidhārūpā babhūva ha ..
vāmārddhāṅgā ca kamalā dakṣiṇārddhā ca rādhikā .. 56 ..
meaning:
अथ कालान्तरे सा च द्विधारूपा बभूव ह ..
वामार्द्धाङ्गा च कमला दक्षिणार्द्धा च राधिका .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Then, after a period of time, she assumed a twofold form:
the left half was Kamalā, and the right half was Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva ha ..
dakṣiṇārddhassyāddvibhujo vāmārddhaśca caturbhujaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णो द्विधारूपो बभूव ह ..
दक्षिणार्द्धस्स्याद्द्विभुजो वामार्द्धश्च चतुर्भुजः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, Kṛṣṇa assumed a twofold form:
the right half was two-armed, and the left half was four-armed.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vāṇīṃ śrīkṛṣṇastvamasya bhava kāminī..
atraiva māninī rādhā naiva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati .. 58 ..
meaning:
उवाच वाणीं श्रीकृष्णस्त्वमस्य भव कामिनी..
अत्रैव मानिनी राधा नैव भद्रं भविष्यति .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said to Vāṇī: "Become the beloved of this one;
here Rādhā is easily offended, and no good will come of it."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lakṣmīṃ saṃpradau tuṣṭo nārāyaṇāya vai ..
saṃjagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tābhyāṃ sārddhaṃ jagatpatiḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
एवं लक्ष्मीं संप्रदौ तुष्टो नारायणाय वै ..
संजगाम च वैकुण्ठं ताभ्यां सार्द्धं जगत्पतिः .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Thus, pleased, he gave Lakṣmī to Nārāyaṇa;
and the Lord of the Universe departed for Vaikuṇṭha with both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
anapatye ca te dve ca yato rādhāṃśasambhave..
nārāyaṇāṅgādabhavanpārṣadāśca caturbhujāḥ .. 2.2.60 ..
meaning:
अनपत्ये च ते द्वे च यतो राधांशसम्भवे..
नारायणाङ्गादभवन्पार्षदाश्च चतुर्भुजाः .. 2.2.60 ..
text_mt:
And those two were childless, since they originated from a portion of Rādhā.
From Nārāyaṇa's body arose four-armed attendants,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā vayasā rūpaguṇābhyāṃ ca samā hareḥ ..
babhūvuḥ kamalāṅgācca dāsīkoṭyaśca tatsamāḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
तेजसा वयसा रूपगुणाभ्यां च समा हरेः ..
बभूवुः कमलाङ्गाच्च दासीकोट्यश्च तत्समाः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
equal to Hari in splendor, age, form, and virtues.
And from Kamalā's body arose tens of millions of maidservants equal to her.

sanskrit_iast:
atha golokanāthasya lomāvivarato mune ..
āsannasaṃkhyagopāśca vayasā tejasā samāḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
अथ गोलोकनाथस्य लोमाविवरतो मुने ..
आसन्नसंख्यगोपाश्च वयसा तेजसा समाः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Then, O sage, from the pores of the hairs of the Lord of Goloka
arose countless cowherds, equal [to him] in age and splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpeṇa suguṇenaiva veṣādvā vikrameṇa ca ..
prāṇatulyāḥ priyāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pārṣadā vibhoḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
रूपेण सुगुणेनैव वेषाद्वा विक्रमेण च ..
प्राणतुल्याः प्रियाः सर्वे बभूवुः पार्षदा विभोः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
in beauty, in good qualities, in attire, and in prowess;
they all became attendants of the Lord, dear [to him] as his own life-breath.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāṅgalomakūpebhyo babhūvurgopakanyakāḥ ..
rādhātulyāśca sarvāstā nānyatulyāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
राधाङ्गलोमकूपेभ्यो बभूवुर्गोपकन्यकाः ..
राधातुल्याश्च सर्वास्ता नान्यतुल्याः प्रियंवदाः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
From the hair-pores of Rādhā's body arose cowherd maidens;
they were all equal to Rādhā, sweet-spoken, and equal to none other,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ ..
anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃsaḥ śāpena santatam .. 65 ..
meaning:
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्याः शश्वत्सुस्थिरयौवनाः ..
अनपत्याश्च ताः सर्वाः पुंसः शापेन सन्ततम् .. 65 ..
text_mt:
richly adorned with jewel-ornaments, endowed with constant and steady youth;
and they were all perpetually childless because of the Male's curse.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare vipra sahasā kṛṣṇadehataḥ ..
āvirbabhūva sā durgā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī .. 66 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्र सहसा कृष्णदेहतः ..
आविर्बभूव सा दुर्गा विष्णुमाया सनातनी .. 66 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, O twice-born one, suddenly from Kṛṣṇa's body
manifested Durgā, the eternal Māyā of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
devī nārāyaṇīśānā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ..
buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..67..
meaning:
देवी नारायणीशाना सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ..
बुद्ध्यधिष्ठातृदेवी सा कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..67..
text_mt:
The goddess Nārāyaṇī, the sovereign ruler, whose nature is all energies;
she is the presiding deity of the intellect of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
devīnāṃ bījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī..
paripūrṇatamā tejaḥsvarūpā triguṇātmikā .. 68 ..
meaning:
देवीनां बीजरूपा च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी..
परिपूर्णतमा तेजःस्वरूपा त्रिगुणात्मिका .. 68 ..
text_mt:
She is the seed-form of goddesses, the original Prakṛti, the supreme ruler,
the most complete, whose nature is fiery brilliance, consisting of the three gunas. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcanavarṇābhā sūryyakoṭisamaprabhā ..
īṣaddhāsaprasannāsyā sahasrabhujasaṃyutā .. 69 ..
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभा सूर्य्यकोटिसमप्रभा ..
ईषद्धासप्रसन्नास्या सहस्रभुजसंयुता .. 69 ..
text_mt: her face cheerful with a gentle smile, endowed with a thousand arms. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
nānāśastrāstranikaraṃ bibhratī sā trilocanā ..
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā .. 2.2.70 ..
meaning:
नानाशस्त्रास्त्रनिकरं बिभ्रती सा त्रिलोचना ..
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधाना रत्नभूषणभूषिता .. 2.2.70 ..
text_mt: Bearing a multitude of various weapons and missiles, she is three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ..
sarvaviśvasthitā lokā mohitā māyayā yayā .. 71 ..
meaning:
यस्याश्चांशांशकलया बभूवुः सर्वयोषितः ..
सर्वविश्वस्थिता लोका मोहिता मायया यया .. 71 ..
text_mt:
From a fraction of a portion of a part of her, all women came into being,
and the beings dwelling in all the universe are deluded by her māyā. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryyapradātrī ca kāmināṃ gṛhamedhinām ..
kṛṣṇabhakti pradātrī ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī .. 72 ..
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्य्यप्रदात्री च कामिनां गृहमेधिनाम् ..
कृष्णभक्ति प्रदात्री च वैष्णवानां च वैष्णवी .. 72 ..
text_mt:
She grants all prosperity to householders possessed of desire;
and the Vaiṣṇava goddess grants devotion to Kṛṣṇa to Vaiṣṇavas. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣadātrī sukhināṃ sukhadāyinī..
svargeṣu svargalakṣmīḥ sā gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣvasau.. ...73..
meaning:
मुमुक्षूणां मोक्षदात्री सुखिनां सुखदायिनी..
स्वर्गेषु स्वर्गलक्ष्मीः सा गृहलक्ष्मीर्गृहेष्वसौ.. ...73..
text_mt:
She grants liberation to seekers of liberation, and bestows happiness upon the happy;
she is the Lakṣmī of heaven in the heavens, and the Lakṣmī of the household in homes. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
tapasviṣu tapasyā ca śrīrūpā sā nṛpeṣu ca ..
yā cāgnau dāhikārūpā prabhārūpā ca bhāskare .. 74 ..
meaning:
तपस्विषु तपस्या च श्रीरूपा सा नृपेषु च ..
या चाग्नौ दाहिकारूपा प्रभारूपा च भास्करे .. 74 ..
text_mt:
She is asceticism in ascetics, and majesty in kings;
she is the power of burning in fire, and radiance in the sun. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmeṣu ca suśobhanā ..
sarvaśaktisvarūpā yā śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani .. 75 ..
meaning:
शोभास्वरूपा चन्द्रे च पद्मेषु च सुशोभना ..
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपा या श्रीकृष्णे परमात्मनि .. 75 ..
text_mt:
She is splendor in the moon, and exquisite beauty in lotuses;
she is the embodiment of all energies in Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
yayā ca śaktimānātmā yayā vai śaktimajjagat ..
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtamiva sthitam .. 76 ..
meaning:
यया च शक्तिमानात्मा यया वै शक्तिमज्जगत् ..
यया विना जगत्सर्वं जीवन्मृतमिव स्थितम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
By her the self possesses power; by her indeed the universe is empowered;
without her the whole universe remains as if dead while living. // 76

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca saṃsāravṛkṣasya bījarūpā sanātanī ..
sthitirūpā buddhirūpā phalarūpā ca nārada .. 77 ..
meaning:
या च संसारवृक्षस्य बीजरूपा सनातनी ..
स्थितिरूपा बुद्धिरूपा फलरूपा च नारद .. 77 ..
text_mt:
She is the eternal seed-form of the tree of worldly existence,
the form of maintenance, the form of intellect, and the form of the fruit, O Nārada! // 77

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpipāsā dayā śraddhā nidrā tandrā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ..
śāntirlajjātuṣṭipuṣṭibhrāntikāntyādirūpiṇī .. 78 ..
meaning:
क्षुत्पिपासा दया श्रद्धा निद्रा तन्द्रा क्षमा धृतिः ..
शान्तिर्लज्जातुष्टिपुष्टिभ्रान्तिकान्त्यादिरूपिणी .. 78 ..
text_mt:
She embodies hunger, thirst, compassion, faith, sleep, drowsiness, forbearance, fortitude,
peace, modesty, contentment, nourishment, delusion, beauty, and more. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca saṃstūya sarveśaṃ tatpuraḥ samupasthitā ..
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyai pradadau rādhikeśvaraḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
सा च संस्तूय सर्वेशं तत्पुरः समुपस्थिता ..
रत्नसिंहासनं तस्यै प्रददौ राधिकेश्वरः .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Having praised the Lord of all, she stood before Him;
and the Lord of Rādhikā gave her a jeweled throne. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra sastrīkaśca caturmukhaḥ ..
padmanābho nābhipadmānnissasāra pumānmune .. 2.2.80 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र सस्त्रीकश्च चतुर्मुखः ..
पद्मनाभो नाभिपद्मान्निस्ससार पुमान्मुने .. 2.2.80 ..
text_mt:
Meanwhile, O sage, the four-faced male [Brahmā] emerged with his wife
from the navel-lotus of Padmanābha. // 2.2.80

sanskrit_iast:
kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāṃstapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
caturmukhastaṃ tuṣṭāva prajvalanbrahmatejasā .. 81 ..
meaning:
कमण्डलुधरः श्रीमांस्तपस्वी ज्ञानिनां वरः ..
चतुर्मुखस्तं तुष्टाव प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Holding a water-pot, glorious, an ascetic, the foremost among the wise,
the four-faced one, blazing with the splendour of Brahman, praised Him. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
sudatī sundarī śreṣṭhā śatacandrasamaprabhā ..
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā .. 82 ..
meaning:
सुदती सुन्दरी श्रेष्ठा शतचन्द्रसमप्रभा ..
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधाना रत्नभूषणभूषिता .. 82 ..
text_mt: She of lovely teeth, beautiful, supreme, radiant as a hundred moons,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye stutā vai sarvakāraṇam ..
uvāsa svāminā sārddha kṛṣṇasya purato mudā .. 83 ..
meaning:
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये स्तुता वै सर्वकारणम् ..
उवास स्वामिना सार्द्ध कृष्णस्य पुरतो मुदा .. 83 ..
text_mt:
[having] praised the Cause of all, upon a charming jeweled throne,
sat down joyfully with her husband before Kṛṣṇa. // 83

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ..
vāmārddhāṃgo mahādevo dakṣiṇo gopikāpatiḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णो द्विधारूपो बभूव सः ..
वामार्द्धांगो महादेवो दक्षिणो गोपिकापतिः .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Kṛṣṇa assumed a twofold form:
the left half of his body was Mahādeva, the right was the Lord of the gopīs. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ ..
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo vyāghracarmadharo haraḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशः शतकोटिरविप्रभः ..
त्रिशूलपट्टिशधरो व्याघ्रचर्मधरो हरः .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Resembling pure crystal, radiant as a hundred crore of suns,
bearing a trident and a sharp cleaver, clad in tiger skin, Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcanavarṇābha jaṭābhāradharaḥ paraḥ ..
bhasmabhūṣaṇagātraśca sasmitaścandraśekharaḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभ जटाभारधरः परः ..
भस्मभूषणगात्रश्च सस्मितश्चन्द्रशेखरः .. 86 ..
text_mt:
bearing a supreme mass of matted hair with the hue of molten gold,
his limbs adorned with ashes, smiling, with the moon on his crest,

sanskrit_iast:
digambaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sarpa bhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
bibhraddakṣiṇahastena ratnamālāṃ susaṃskṛtām .. 87 ..
meaning:
दिगम्बरो नीलकण्ठः सर्प भूषणभूषितः ..
बिभ्रद्दक्षिणहस्तेन रत्नमालां सुसंस्कृताम् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
sky-clad, blue-throated, adorned with serpents as ornaments,
holding a consecrated rosary of gems with his right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
prajapanpañcavaktreṇa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ..
satyasvarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram .. 88 ..
meaning:
प्रजपन्पञ्चवक्त्रेण ब्रह्मज्योतिः सनातनम् ..
सत्यस्वरूपं श्रीकृष्णं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
chanted with his five faces the eternal light of Brahman,
Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose nature is truth, the Paramātman, the supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ..
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param .. 89 ..
meaning:
कारणं कारणानां च सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गलम् ..
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिशोकभीतिहरं परम् .. 89 ..
text_mt: the Cause of causes, the most auspicious of all auspicious things,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūya mṛtyormṛtyuṃ taṃ jāto mṛtyuñjayābhidhaḥ ..
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa hareḥ puraḥ .. 2.2.90 ..
meaning:
संस्तूय मृत्योर्मृत्युं तं जातो मृत्युञ्जयाभिधः ..
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये समुवास हरेः पुरः .. 2.2.90 ..
text_mt:
Having praised Him who is the death of Death, he came to be called Mṛtyuñjaya [Conqueror of Death];
and he sat down upon a lovely jeweled throne before Hari. // 2.2.90

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
athāṇḍaṃ tajjale'tiṣṭhadyāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ..
tataḥ svakāle sahasā dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ..1..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
अथाण्डं तज्जलेऽतिष्ठद्यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः ..
ततः स्वकाले सहसा द्विधारूपो बभूव सः ..1..
title: Viśvabrahmāṇḍavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye śiśurekaśca śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ..
kṣaṇaṃ rorūyamāṇaśca sa śiśuḥ pīḍitaḥ kṣudhā..2..
meaning:
तन्मध्ये शिशुरेकश्च शतकोटिरविप्रभः..
क्षणं रोरूयमाणश्च स शिशुः पीडितः क्षुधा..2..

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛparityakto jalamadhye nirāśrayaḥ ..
naikabrahmāṇḍanātho yo dadarśordhvamanāthavat .. 3 ..
meaning:
पितृमातृपरित्यक्तो जलमध्ये निराश्रयः ..
नैकब्रह्माण्डनाथो यो ददर्शोर्ध्वमनाथवत् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlātsthūlatamaḥ so'pi nāmnā devo mahāvirāṭ ..
paramāṇuryathā sūkṣmātparaḥ sthūlāttathā'pyasau .. 4 ..
meaning:
स्थूलात्स्थूलतमः सोऽपि नाम्ना देवो महाविराट् ..
परमाणुर्यथा सूक्ष्मात्परः स्थूलात्तथाऽप्यसौ .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tejasāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśo'yaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
ādhāro'saṃkhyaviśvānāṃ mahāviṣṇussureśvaraḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तेजसां षोडशांशोऽयं कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..
आधारोऽसंख्यविश्वानां महाविष्णुस्सुरेश्वरः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ romakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca ..
adyāpi teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ ca kṛṣṇo vaktuṃ na hi kṣamaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं रोमकूपेषु विश्वानि निखिलानि च ..
अद्यापि तेषां संख्यां च कृष्णो वक्तुं न हि क्षमः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yathā'sti saṃkhyā rajasāṃ viśvānāṃ na kadācana ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tathā saṃkhyā na vidyate .. 7 ..
meaning:
यथाऽस्ति संख्या रजसां विश्वानां न कदाचन ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां तथा संख्या न विद्यते .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prativiśveṣu santyevaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
pātālādbrahmalokāntaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrttitam .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रतिविश्वेषु सन्त्येवं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
पातालाद्ब्रह्मलोकान्तं ब्रह्माण्डं परिकीर्त्तितम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tata ūrdhve ca vaikuṇṭho brahmāṇḍādbahireva saḥ ..
sa ca satyasvarūpaśca śaśvannārāyaṇo yathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
तत ऊर्ध्वे च वैकुण्ठो ब्रह्माण्डाद्बहिरेव सः ..
स च सत्यस्वरूपश्च शश्वन्नारायणो यथा .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhve golakaścaiva pañcāśatkoṭiyojanāt ..
nityaḥ satyasvarūpaśca yathā kṛṣṇastathāpyayam .. 2.3.10 ..
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वे गोलकश्चैव पञ्चाशत्कोटियोजनात् ..
नित्यः सत्यस्वरूपश्च यथा कृष्णस्तथाप्ययम् .. 2.3.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpamitā pṛthvī saptasāgarasaṃyutā ..
ekonapañcāśadupadvīpā'saṃkhyavanānvitā .. 11 ..
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपमिता पृथ्वी सप्तसागरसंयुता ..
एकोनपञ्चाशदुपद्वीपाऽसंख्यवनान्विता .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ sapta suvarlokā brahmalokasamanvitāḥ ..
pātālāni ca saptādhaścaivaṃ brahmāṇḍameva ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं सप्त सुवर्लोका ब्रह्मलोकसमन्विताः ..
पातालानि च सप्ताधश्चैवं ब्रह्माण्डमेव च .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ dharāyā bhūrloko bhuvarlokastataḥ paraḥ ..
svarlokastu tataḥ paścānmaharlokastato janaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं धराया भूर्लोको भुवर्लोकस्ततः परः ..
स्वर्लोकस्तु ततः पश्चान्महर्लोकस्ततो जनः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ parastapolokaḥ satyalokastataḥ paraḥ ..
tataḥ paro brahmalokastaptakāñcananirmitaḥ .. ..14 ..
meaning:
ततः परस्तपोलोकः सत्यलोकस्ततः परः ..
ततः परो ब्रह्मलोकस्तप्तकाञ्चननिर्मितः .. ..14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ tadbāhyābhyantara eva ca ..
tadvināśe vināśaśca sarveṣāmeva nārada .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं सर्वं कृत्रिमं तद्बाह्याभ्यन्तर एव च ..
तद्विनाशे विनाशश्च सर्वेषामेव नारद .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jalabududavatsarvaṃ viśvasaṃghamanityakam ..
nityau golokavaikuṇṭhau satyau śaśvadakṛtrimau .. 16 ..
meaning:
जलबुदुदवत्सर्वं विश्वसंघमनित्यकम् ..
नित्यौ गोलोकवैकुण्ठौ सत्यौ शश्वदकृत्रिमौ .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lomakūpe ca vidhyaṇḍaṃ pratyekaṃ tasya niścitam ..
eṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāti kṛṣṇo'nyasyāpi kā kathā .. 17 ..
meaning:
लोमकूपे च विध्यण्डं प्रत्येकं तस्य निश्चितम् ..
एषां संख्यां न जानाति कृष्णोऽन्यस्यापि का कथा .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ surāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyā sarvatra putraka .. 18 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं प्रतिविध्यण्डे ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
तिस्रः कोट्यः सुराणां च संख्या सर्वत्र पुत्रक .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
digīśāścaiva dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahādayaḥ ..
bhuvi varṇāśca catvāro'dho nāgāśca carācarāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
दिगीशाश्चैव दिक्पाला नक्षत्राणि ग्रहादयः ..
भुवि वर्णाश्च चत्वारोऽधो नागाश्च चराचराः .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atha kālena sa virāḍūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ ..
ḍimbhāntaraṃ ca śūnyaṃ ca na dvitīyaṃ kathaṃcana .. 2.3.20 ..
meaning:
अथ कालेन स विराडूर्ध्वं दृष्ट्वा पुनः पुनः ..
डिम्भान्तरं च शून्यं च न द्वितीयं कथंचन .. 2.3.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmavāpa kṣudyukto ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ paramapūruṣam .. 21 ..
meaning:
चिन्तामवाप क्षुद्युक्तो रुरोद च पुनः पुनः ..
ज्ञानं प्राप्य तदा दध्यौ कृष्णं परमपूरुषम् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato dadarśa tatraiva brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam ..
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam .. 22 ..
meaning:
ततो ददर्श तत्रैव ब्रह्म ज्योतिः सनातनम् ..
नवीननीरदश्यामं द्विभुजं पीतवाससम् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ..
jahāsa bālakastuṣṭo dṛṣṭvā janakamīśvaram .. 23 ..
meaning:
सस्मितं मुरलीहस्तं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ..
जहास बालकस्तुष्टो दृष्ट्वा जनकमीश्वरम् .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ tasmai dadau tuṣṭo vareśaḥ samayocitam..
matsamo jñānayuktaśva kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
वरं तस्मै ददौ तुष्टो वरेशः समयोचितम्..
मत्समो ज्ञानयुक्तश्व क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍāsaṃkhyanilayo bhava vatsa layāvadhi ..
niṣkāmo nirbhayaścaiva sarveṣāṃ varado varaḥ ..
rogamṛtyujarāśokapīḍādiparivarjitaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डासंख्यनिलयो भव वत्स लयावधि ..
निष्कामो निर्भयश्चैव सर्वेषां वरदो वरः ..
रोगमृत्युजराशोकपीडादिपरिवर्जितः .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā taddakṣakarṇe mahāmantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram ..
triḥ kṛtvā prajajāpādau vedāṅgamavaraṃ param .. 26 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तद्दक्षकर्णे महामन्त्रं षडक्षरम् ..
त्रिः कृत्वा प्रजजापादौ वेदाङ्गमवरं परम् .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ..
vahnijvālāntamiṣṭaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रणवादिचतुर्थ्यन्तं कृष्ण इत्यक्षरद्वयम् ..
वह्निज्वालान्तमिष्टं च सर्वविघ्नहरं परम् .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ dattvā tadāhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ..
śrūyatāṃ tadbrahmaputra nibodha kathayāmi te .. 28 ..
meaning:
मन्त्रं दत्त्वा तदाहारं कल्पयामास वै प्रभुः..
श्रूयतां तद्ब्रह्मपुत्र निबोध कथयामि ते .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prativiśveṣu naivedyaṃ dadyādvai vaiṣṇavo janaḥ ..
ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ viṣayiṇo viṣṇoḥ pañcadaśāsya vai .. 29 ..
meaning:
प्रतिविश्वेषु नैवेद्यं दद्याद्वै वैष्णवो जनः ..
षोडशांशं विषयिणो विष्णोः पञ्चदशास्य वै .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇasyātmanaścaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca ..
naivedyena ca kṛṣṇasya nahi kiñcitprayojanam .. 2.3.30 ..
meaning:
निर्गुणस्यात्मनश्चैव परिपूर्णतमस्य च ..
नैवेद्येन च कृष्णस्य नहि किञ्चित्प्रयोजनम् .. 2.3.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yaddadāti va naivedyaṃ yasmai devāya yo janaḥ ..
sa ca khādati tatsarvaṃ lakṣmīdṛṣṭyā punarbhavet .. 31 ..
meaning:
यद्ददाति व नैवेद्यं यस्मै देवाय यो जनः ..
स च खादति तत्सर्वं लक्ष्मीदृष्ट्या पुनर्भवेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
Whatever food-offering a person offers to whichever deity,
he eats all of that; by the glance of Lakṣmī it is replenished. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca mantraṃ varaṃ dattvā tamuvāca punarvibhuḥ ..
anyo varaḥ ka iṣṭaste taṃ me brūhi dadāmi te .. 32 ..
meaning:
तं च मन्त्रं वरं दत्त्वा तमुवाच पुनर्विभुः ..
अन्यो वरः क इष्टस्ते तं मे ब्रूहि ददामि ते .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Having given him that mantra and boon, the omnipresent Lord spoke to him again:
"What other boon is desired by you? Speak it to me; I grant it to you." // 32

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāvirāṭ ..
adanto bālakastatra vacanaṃ samayocitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच महाविराट् ..
अदन्तो बालकस्तत्र वचनं समयोचितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the word of Kṛṣṇa, the great Virāj,
the toothless child there, spoke words appropriate to the occasion. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvirāḍuvāca ..
varaṃ me tvatpadāmbhoje bhaktirbhavatu niścalā ..
santataṃ yāvadāyurme kṣaṇaṃ vā suciraṃ ca vā .. 34 ..
meaning:
महाविराडुवाच ..
वरं मे त्वत्पदाम्भोजे भक्तिर्भवतु निश्चला ..
सन्ततं यावदायुर्मे क्षणं वा सुचिरं च वा .. 34 ..
text_mt:
"May my boon be unswerving devotion to your lotus feet,
constantly, as long as my life lasts, whether for a moment or for a very long time." // 34

sanskrit_iast:
tvadbhaktiyukto yo loke jīvanmuktaḥ sa santatam ..
tvadbhaktihīno mūrkhaśca jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
त्वद्भक्तियुक्तो यो लोके जीवन्मुक्तः स सन्ततम् ..
त्वद्भक्तिहीनो मूर्खश्च जीवन्नपि मृतो हि सः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Whoever in the world is endowed with devotion to you is constantly liberated while alive;
and the fool who is devoid of devotion to you is indeed dead even while living.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tajjapena tapasā yajñena yajanena ca ..
vratenaivopavāsena puṇyatīrthaniṣevayā .. 36 ..
meaning:
किं तज्जपेन तपसा यज्ञेन यजनेन च ..
व्रतेनैवोपवासेन पुण्यतीर्थनिषेवया .. 36 ..
text_mt:
What is the use of his recitation, asceticism, sacrifice, and worship,
or indeed of his vows, fasting, and visiting sacred pilgrimage places?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnasya puṃsaḥ syājjīvanaṃ vṛthā ..
yenātmanā jīvitaśca tameva nahi manyate .. 37 ..
meaning:
कृष्णभक्तिविहीनस्य पुंसः स्याज्जीवनं वृथा ..
येनात्मना जीवितश्च तमेव नहि मन्यते .. 37 ..
text_mt:
The life of a man devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa is in vain;
he does not even acknowledge that very Self by which he is kept alive.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadātmā śarīre'sti tāvatsyācchaktisaṃyutaḥ ..
paścādyānti gate tasminna svatantrāśca śaktayaḥ ..38..
meaning:
यावदात्मा शरीरेऽस्ति तावत्स्याच्छक्तिसंयुतः ..
पश्चाद्यान्ति गते तस्मिन्न स्वतन्त्राश्च शक्तयः ..38..
text_mt:
As long as the Self is in the body, so long is it endowed with power;
after it departs, the powers, not being independent, leave as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca tvaṃ ca mahābhāga sarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ ..
svecchāmayaśca sarvādyo brahma jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
स च त्वं च महाभाग सर्वात्मा प्रकृतेः परः ..
स्वेच्छामयश्च सर्वाद्यो ब्रह्म ज्योतिः सनातनः .. 39 ..
text_mt:
And you, O fortunate one, are that Self of all, beyond Prakṛti,
embodied through your own will, the primeval source of all, Brahman, the eternal light.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bālakastatra virarāma ca nārada ..
uvāca kṛṣṇaḥ pratyuktiṃ madhurāṃ śrutisundarīm .. 2.3.40 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा बालकस्तत्र विरराम च नारद ..
उवाच कृष्णः प्रत्युक्तिं मधुरां श्रुतिसुन्दरीम् .. 2.3.40 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the child fell silent there, O Nārada.
Kṛṣṇa spoke a reply that was sweet and delightful to hear.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
suciraṃ susthiraṃ tiṣṭha yathā'haṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava ..
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte pātaste na bhaviṣyati .. 41 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
सुचिरं सुस्थिरं तिष्ठ यथाऽहं त्वं तथा भव ..
असंख्यब्रह्मणां पाते पातस्ते न भविष्यति .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Remain very long and very steady; become just as I am.
Even upon the fall of countless Brahmās, your fall shall not occur.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena pratividhyaṇḍe tvaṃ ca putra virāḍ bhava ..
tvannābhipadme brahmā ca viśvasraṣṭā bhaviṣyati .. 42 ..
meaning:
अंशेन प्रतिविध्यण्डे त्वं च पुत्र विराड् भव ..
त्वन्नाभिपद्मे ब्रह्मा च विश्वस्रष्टा भविष्यति .. 42 ..
text_mt:
By a portion, O son, become the Virāj in each cosmic egg;
and Brahmā, the creator of the universe, will appear in the lotus of your navel.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe brahmaṇaścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva tu ..
śivāṃśena bhaviṣyanti sṛṣṭisaṃcaraṇāya vai .. 43 ..
meaning:
ललाटे ब्रह्मणश्चैव रुद्राश्चैकादशैव तु ..
शिवांशेन भविष्यन्ति सृष्टिसंचरणाय वै .. 43 ..
text_mt:
And on the forehead of Brahmā the eleven Rudras
shall arise by a portion of Śiva to set the creation in motion.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirudrasteṣveko viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ ..
pātā viṣṇuśca viṣayī kṣudrāṃśena bhaviṣyati.. .. 44 ..
meaning:
कालाग्निरुद्रस्तेष्वेको विश्वसंहारकारकः ..
पाता विष्णुश्च विषयी क्षुद्रांशेन भविष्यति.. .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Among them, Kālāgnirudra will be the cause of the destruction of the universe,
and Viṣṇu, the protector engaged in worldly affairs, will arise by a small portion.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktiyuktaḥ satataṃ bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me ..
dhyānena kamanīyaṃ māṃ nityaṃ drakṣyasi niścitam .. 45 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्तियुक्तः सततं भविष्यसि वरेण मे ..
ध्यानेन कमनीयं मां नित्यं द्रक्ष्यसि निश्चितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
By my boon, you shall constantly be endowed with devotion to me;
through meditation you shall surely always behold me, who am desirable,

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ kamanīyāṃ ca mama vakṣaḥsthalasthitām ..
yāmi lokaṃ tiṣṭha vatsetyuktvā so'ntaradhīyata .. 46 ..
meaning:
मातरं कमनीयां च मम वक्षःस्थलस्थिताम् ..
यामि लोकं तिष्ठ वत्सेत्युक्त्वा सोऽन्तरधीयत .. 46 ..
text_mt:
and the desirable mother residing upon my chest.
Saying, “I am going to my world; stay, my child,” he vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā ca nākaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sa uvāca ha ..
sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭumīśaṃ ca saṃhartāraṃ ca tatkṣaṇam..47..
meaning:
गत्वा च नाकं ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं स उवाच ह ..
स्रष्टारं स्रष्टुमीशं च संहर्तारं च तत्क्षणम्..47..
text_mt:
And having gone to heaven, he spoke to Brahmā and Śaṅkara—
at that moment the Lord spoke to the creator to create, and to the destroyer [to destroy].

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ gaccha vatsa nābhipadmodbhavo bhava..
mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe kṣudrasya ca vidheḥ śṛṇu .. 48 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
सृष्टिं स्रष्टुं गच्छ वत्स नाभिपद्मोद्भवो भव..
महाविराड् लोमकूपे क्षुद्रस्य च विधेः शृणु .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Go, child, to create the creation; be born from the lotus of the navel.
Listen, O Brahmā, regarding the small [Virāj] in the hair-pore of the great Virāj.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha vatsa mahādeva brahmabhālodbhavo bhava ..
aṃśena ca mahābhāga svayaṃ ca suciraṃ tapaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
गच्छ वत्स महादेव ब्रह्मभालोद्भवो भव ..
अंशेन च महाभाग स्वयं च सुचिरं तपः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Go, child Mahādeva; be born from the forehead of Brahmā
by a portion, O fortunate one; and perform austerities yourself for a very long time.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma vidheḥ sutaḥ ..
jagāma natvā taṃ brahmā śivaśca śivadāyakaḥ .. 2.3.50 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथो विरराम विधेः सुतः ..
जगाम नत्वा तं ब्रह्मा शिवश्च शिवदायकः .. 2.3.50 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds fell silent, O son of Brahmā.
Having bowed to him, Brahmā departed, and so did Śiva, the giver of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe brahmāṇḍe golake jale ..
sa babhūva virāṭkṣudro virāḍaṃśena sāmpratam .. 51 ..
meaning:
महाविराड् लोमकूपे ब्रह्माण्डे गोलके जले ..
स बभूव विराट्क्षुद्रो विराडंशेन साम्प्रतम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
In a hair-pore of the great Virāj, in the cosmic egg, in the water of Goloka,
he then became the small Virāj by a portion of the Virāj.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmo yuvā pītavāsāḥ śayāno jalatalpake..
īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo viśvarūpī janārdanaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
श्यामो युवा पीतवासाः शयानो जलतल्पके..
ईषद्धासः प्रसन्नास्यो विश्वरूपी जनार्दनः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Dark-complexioned, youthful, clad in yellow garments, lying on a bed of water,
with a gentle smile and a serene face was Janārdana, whose form is the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tannābhikamale brahmā babhūva kamalodbhavaḥ ..
saṃbhūya padmadaṇḍaṃ ca babhrāma yugalakṣakam .. 53 ..
meaning:
तन्नाभिकमले ब्रह्मा बभूव कमलोद्भवः ..
संभूय पद्मदण्डं च बभ्राम युगलक्षकम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
In the lotus of his navel, Brahmā, the lotus-born, appeared.
Having come into being, he wandered through the stalk of the lotus for a hundred thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
nāntaṃ jagāma daṇḍasya padmanābhasya padmajaḥ ..
nābhijasya ca padmasya cintāmāpa pitāmahaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
नान्तं जगाम दण्डस्य पद्मनाभस्य पद्मजः ..
नाभिजस्य च पद्मस्य चिन्तामाप पितामहः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
The lotus-born did not reach the end of the stalk of Padmanābha;
and the grandfather fell into anxiety over the lotus born from the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
svasthānaṃ punarāgatya dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ..
tato dadarśa kṣudraṃ taṃ dhyātvā taddivyacakṣuṣā .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्वस्थानं पुनरागत्य दध्यौ कृष्णपदाम्बुजम् ..
ततो ददर्श क्षुद्रं तं ध्यात्वा तद्दिव्यचक्षुषा .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Returning to his own place, he meditated upon Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet;
having meditated with his divine eye, he then beheld that small [Virāj]

sanskrit_iast:
śayānaṃ jalatalpe ca brahmāṇḍapiṇḍamāvṛte ..
yallomakūpe brahmāṇḍaṃ taṃ ca tatparamīśvaram .. 56 ..
meaning:
शयानं जलतल्पे च ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डमावृते ..
यल्लोमकूपे ब्रह्माण्डं तं च तत्परमीश्वरम् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
lying on a bed of water enclosed by the mass of the cosmic egg,
in whose hair-pore was the cosmic egg; and he beheld that supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ cāpi golokaṃ gopagopīsamanvitam ..
taṃ saṃstūya varaṃ prāpa tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णं चापि गोलोकं गोपगोपीसमन्वितम् ..
तं संस्तूय वरं प्राप ततः सृष्टिं चकार सः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and also Goloka accompanied by cowherd men and cowherd women.
Having praised him, he obtained a boon and then performed the creation.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sanakādayaḥ ..
tato rudrāḥ kapālācca śivasyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
बभूवुर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः सनकादयः ..
ततो रुद्राः कपालाच्च शिवस्यैकादश स्मृताः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
The mind-born sons of Brahmā arose, Sanaka and the others;
then from the forehead of Brahmā the eleven Rudras of Śiva are recorded to have arisen.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva pātā viṣṇuśca vāme kṣudrasya pārśvataḥ ..
caturbhujaśca bhagavāñśvetadvīpanivāsakṛt .. 59 ..
meaning:
बभूव पाता विष्णुश्च वामे क्षुद्रस्य पार्श्वतः ..
चतुर्भुजश्च भगवाञ्श्वेतद्वीपनिवासकृत् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
And the protector Viṣṇu came into being from the left side of the small [Virāj]—
the four-armed Lord who makes his dwelling in Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrasya nābhipadme ca brahmā viśvaṃ sasarja saḥ ..
svargaṃ martyaṃ ca pātālaṃ trilokaṃ sacarācaram .. 2.3.60 ..
meaning:
क्षुद्रस्य नाभिपद्मे च ब्रह्मा विश्वं ससर्ज सः ..
स्वर्गं मर्त्यं च पातालं त्रिलोकं सचराचरम् .. 2.3.60 ..
text_mt:
And in the navel-lotus of the small [Virāj], Brahmā created the universe,
the three worlds—heaven, earth, and the underworld—together with the moving and unmoving.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvaṃ lomakūpe viśvaṃ pratyekameva ca ..
prativiśvaṃ kṣudravirāḍ brahma viṣṇuśivādayaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
एवं सर्वं लोमकूपे विश्वं प्रत्येकमेव च ..
प्रतिविश्वं क्षुद्रविराड् ब्रह्म विष्णुशिवादयः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
In this way, in every single hair-pore there is a whole universe;
in every universe there is a small Virāj, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kṛṣṇasaṅkīrttanaṃ śubham ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 62 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स कृष्णसङ्कीर्त्तनं शुभम् ..
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 62 ..
text_mt: Thus has been recounted, O child, the auspicious glorification of Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
śrutaṃ sarvamapūrvaṃ ca tvatprasādātsudhopamam ..
adhunā prakṛtīnāṃ ca vyāsaṃ varṇaya bho prabho .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
श्रुतं सर्वमपूर्वं च त्वत्प्रसादात्सुधोपमम् ..
अधुना प्रकृतीनां च व्यासं वर्णय भो प्रभो .. 1 ..
title: Sarasvatīkavacam

sanskrit_iast:
kasyāḥ pūjā kṛtā kena kathaṃ martye prakā śitā ..
kena vā pūjitā kā vā kena kā vā stutā mune ..2..
meaning:
कस्याः पूजा कृता केन कथं मर्त्ये प्रका शिता ..
केन वा पूजिता का वा केन का वा स्तुता मुने ..2..

sanskrit_iast:
kavacaṃ stotrakaṃ dhyānaṃ prabhāvaṃ caritaṃ śubham ..
kābhiḥ kābhyo varo dattastanme vyākhyātumarhasi .. 3 ..
meaning:
कवचं स्तोत्रकं ध्यानं प्रभावं चरितं शुभम् ..
काभिः काभ्यो वरो दत्तस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ..
sāvitrī vai sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā .. 4 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
गणेशजननी दुर्गा राधा लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती ..
सावित्री वै सृष्टिविधौ प्रकृतिः पञ्चधा स्मृता .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpūjyā prasiddhā ca prabhāvaḥ paramādbhutaḥ ..
sudhopamaṃ ca caritaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam .. 5 ..
meaning:
आसीत्पूज्या प्रसिद्धा च प्रभावः परमाद्भुतः ..
सुधोपमं च चरितं सर्वमङ्गलकारणम् .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtyaṃśāḥ kalā yāśca tāsāṃ ca caritaṃ śubham ..
sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रकृत्यंशाः कला याश्च तासां च चरितं शुभम् ..
सर्वं वक्ष्यामि ते ब्रह्मन्सावधानं निशामय .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇī vasundharā gaṅgā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalaca ṇḍikā ..
tulasī mānasī nidrā svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā .. 7 ..
meaning:
वाणी वसुन्धरा गङ्गा षष्ठी मङ्गलच ण्डिका ..
तुलसी मानसी निद्रा स्वधा स्वाहा च दक्षिणा .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast: tejasā matsamāstāśca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca .. 8 ..
meaning: तेजसा मत्समास्ताश्च रूपेण च गुणेन च .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣepamāsāṃ caritaṃ puṇyadaṃ atisundaram ..
jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca tacca vakṣyāmi sundaram .. 9 ..
meaning:
संक्षेपमासां चरितं पुण्यदं अतिसुन्दरम् ..
जीवकर्मविपाकं च तच्च वक्ष्यामि सुन्दरम् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
durgāyāścaiva rādhāyā vistīrṇaṃ caritaṃ mahat ..
tacca paścātpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepātkramataḥ śṛṇu .. 2.4.10 ..
meaning:
दुर्गायाश्चैव राधाया विस्तीर्णं चरितं महत् ..
तच्च पश्चात्प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपात्क्रमतः शृणु .. 2.4.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ādau sarasvatīpūjā śrīkṛṣṇena vinirmitā ..
yatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
आदौ सरस्वतीपूजा श्रीकृष्णेन विनिर्मिता ..
यत्प्रसादान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ मूर्खो भवति पण्डितः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbhūtā yadā devī vaktrataḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ..
iyeṣa kṛṣṇaṃ kāmena kāmukī kāmarūpiṇī .. 12 ..
meaning:
आविर्भूता यदा देवी वक्त्रतः कृष्णयोषितः ..
इयेष कृष्णं कामेन कामुकी कामरूपिणी .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvamātaram ..
tāmuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 13 ..
meaning:
स च विज्ञाय तद्भावं सर्वज्ञः सर्वमातरम् ..
तामुवाच हितं सत्यं परिणामसुखावहम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvi madaṃśaṃ ca caturbhujam ..
yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ sarvaguṇayuktaṃ ca matsamam .. 14 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
भज नारायणं साध्वि मदंशं च चतुर्भुजम् ..
युवानं सुन्दरं सर्वगुणयुक्तं च मत्समम् .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ taṃ kāmapūrakam ..
koṭikanda rpalāvaṇyaṃ līlānyakkṛtamanmatham .. 15 ..
meaning:
कामदं कामिनीनां च तासां तं कामपूरकम् ..
कोटिकन्द र्पलावण्यं लीलान्यक्कृतमन्मथम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kānte kāntaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā yadi sthātumihecchasi ..
tvatto balavatī rādhā na te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
meaning:
कान्ते कान्तं च मां कृत्वा यदि स्थातुमिहेच्छसि ..
त्वत्तो बलवती राधा न ते भद्रं भविष्यति .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yo yasmādbalavānvā'pi tato'nyaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ ..
kathaṃ parānsādhayati yadi svayamanīśvaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
यो यस्माद्बलवान्वाऽपि ततोऽन्यं रक्षितुं क्षमः ..
कथं परान्साधयति यदि स्वयमनीश्वरः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśassarvaśāstā'haṃ rādhāṃ rādhitumakṣamaḥ ..
tejasā matsamā sā ca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
सर्वेशस्सर्वशास्ताऽहं राधां राधितुमक्षमः ..
तेजसा मत्समा सा च रूपेण च गुणेन च .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ..
prāṇato'pi priyaḥ kutra keṣāṃ vā'sti ca kaścana .. 19 ..
meaning:
प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेवी सा प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं च कः क्षमः ..
प्राणतोऽपि प्रियः कुत्र केषां वाऽस्ति च कश्चन .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ bhadre gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
patiṃ tamīśvaraṃ kṛtvā modasva suciraṃ sukham .. 2.4.20 ..
meaning:
त्वं भद्रे गच्छ वैकुण्ठं तव भद्रं भविष्यति ..
पतिं तमीश्वरं कृत्वा मोदस्व सुचिरं सुखम् .. 2.4.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vivarjitā lobhamohakāmakopena hiṃsayā ..
tejasā tvatsamā lakṣmī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca .. 21 ..
meaning:
विवर्जिता लोभमोहकामकोपेन हिंसया ..
तेजसा त्वत्समा लक्ष्मी रूपेण च गुणेन च .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sārddhaṃ bhava prītyā sukhaṃ kālaṃ prayāsyati ..
gauravaṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ kariṣyati patirdvayoḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
तया सार्द्धं भव प्रीत्या सुखं कालं प्रयास्यति ..
गौरवं चापि तत्तुल्यं करिष्यति पतिर्द्वयोः .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prativiśveṣu te pūjāṃ mahatīṃ te mudā'nvitāḥ ..
māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambheṣu sundari .. 23 ..
meaning:
प्रतिविश्वेषु ते पूजां महतीं ते मुदाऽन्विताः ..
माघस्य शुक्लपञ्चम्यां विद्यारम्भेषु सुन्दरि .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mānavā manavo devā munīndrāśca mumukṣavaḥ ..
santaśca yoginaḥ siddhā nāgagandharvakiṃnarāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
मानवा मनवो देवा मुनीन्द्राश्च मुमुक्षवः ..
सन्तश्च योगिनः सिद्धा नागगन्धर्वकिंनराः .. 24 ..
