sanskrit_iast:
madvareṇa kariṣyanti kalpe kalpe yathāvidhi ..
bhaktiyuktāśca dattvā vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ..25..
meaning:
मद्वरेण करिष्यन्ति कल्पे कल्पे यथाविधि ..
भक्तियुक्ताश्च दत्त्वा वै चोपचारांश्च षोडश ..25..

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇvaśākhoktavidhinā dhyānena stavanena ca ..
jitendriyāḥ saṃyatāśca pustakeṣu ghaṭe'pi ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
काण्वशाखोक्तविधिना ध्यानेन स्तवनेन च ..
जितेन्द्रियाः संयताश्च पुस्तकेषु घटेऽपि च .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā suvarṇaguṭikāṃ gandhacandana carccitām ..
kavacaṃ te grahīṣyanti kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje .. 27 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा सुवर्णगुटिकां गन्धचन्दन चर्च्चिताम् ..
कवचं ते ग्रहीष्यन्ति कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे भुजे .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhiṣyanti ca vidvāṃsaḥ pūjākāle ca pūjite ..
ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ sarvapūjitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
पठिष्यन्ति च विद्वांसः पूजाकाले च पूजिते ..
इत्युक्त्वा पूजयामास तां देवीं सर्वपूजितः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatpūjanaṃ cakrurbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
anantaścāpi dharmaśca munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ ..29..
meaning:
ततस्तत्पूजनं चक्रुर्ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
अनन्तश्चापि धर्मश्च मुनीन्द्राः सनकादयः ..29..

sanskrit_iast:
sarve devāśca manavo nṛpā vā mānavādayaḥ ..
babhūva pūjitā nityā sarvalokaiḥ sarasvatī .. 2.4.30 ..
meaning:
सर्वे देवाश्च मनवो नृपा वा मानवादयः ..
बभूव पूजिता नित्या सर्वलोकैः सरस्वती .. 2.4.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
pūjāvidhānaṃ stavanaṃ dhyānaṃ kavacamīpsitam ..
pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ vā candanādikam .. 31 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
पूजाविधानं स्तवनं ध्यानं कवचमीप्सितम् ..
पूजोपयुक्तं नैवेद्यं पुष्पं वा चन्दनादिकम् .. 31 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vada vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ..
varddhate sāmprataṃ śaśvatkimidaṃ śrutisundaram .. 32 ..
meaning:
वद वेदविदां श्रेष्ठ श्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम ..
वर्द्धते साम्प्रतं शश्वत्किमिदं श्रुतिसुन्दरम् .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kāṇvaśākhoktapaddhatim ..
jaganmātuḥ sarasvatyāḥ pūjāvidhisamanvitām..33..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि काण्वशाखोक्तपद्धतिम् ..
जगन्मातुः सरस्वत्याः पूजाविधिसमन्विताम्..33..

sanskrit_iast:
māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambhadine'pi ca..
pūrve'hni saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā tatra syātsaṃyataḥ śuciḥ ..34..
meaning:
माघस्य शुक्लपञ्चम्यां विद्यारम्भदिनेऽपि च..
पूर्वेऽह्नि संयमं कृत्वा तत्र स्यात्संयतः शुचिः ..34..

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ..
saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca naivedyādibhireva ca..35..
meaning:
स्नात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा घटं संस्थाप्य भक्तितः..
संपूज्य देवषट्कं च नैवेद्यादिभिरेव च..35..

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām..
saṃpūjya saṃyato'gre ca tato'bhīṣṭaṃ prapūjayet .. 36 ..
meaning:
गणेशं च दिनेशं च वह्निं विष्णुं शिवं शिवाम्..
संपूज्य संयतोऽग्रे च ततोऽभीष्टं प्रपूजयेत् .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānena vakṣyamāṇena dhyātvā bāhyaghaṭe budhaḥ ..
dhyātvā punaḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraistāṃ pūjayedvratī ..37..
meaning:
ध्यानेन वक्ष्यमाणेन ध्यात्वा बाह्यघटे बुधः ..
ध्यात्वा पुनः षोडशोपचारैस्तां पूजयेद्व्रती ..37..

sanskrit_iast:
pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ yadyadvede nirūpitam ..
vakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ kiñcidyathā'dhītaṃ yathā''gamam .. 38 ..
meaning:
पूजोपयुक्तं नैवेद्यं यद्यद्वेदे निरूपितम् ..
वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं किञ्चिद्यथाऽधीतं यथा'ऽगमम् .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
navanītaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ lājāṃśca tilalaḍḍukān ..
ikṣumikṣurasaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ pakvaguḍaṃ madhu .. 39 ..
meaning:
नवनीतं दधि क्षीरं लाजांश्च तिललड्डुकान् ..
इक्षुमिक्षुरसं शुक्लवर्णं पक्वगुडं मधु .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ śukladhānyasyākṣatamakṣatam..
asvinnaśukladhānyasya pṛthukaṃ śuklamodakam .. 2.4.40 ..
meaning:
स्वस्तिकं शर्करां शुक्लधान्यस्याक्षतमक्षतम्..
अस्विन्नशुक्लधान्यस्य पृथुकं शुक्लमोदकम् .. 2.4.40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtasaindhavasaṃskārairhaviṣyairvyañjanaistathā ..
yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ piṣṭakaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛ tam .. 41 ..
meaning:
घृतसैन्धवसंस्कारैर्हविष्यैर्व्यञ्जनैस्तथा ..
यवगोधूमचूर्णानां पिष्टकं घृतसंस्कृ तम् .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭakaṃ svastikasyāpi pakvarambhāphalasya ca ..
paramānnaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam .. 42 ..
meaning:
पिष्टकं स्वस्तिकस्यापि पक्वरम्भाफलस्य च ..
परमान्नं च सघृतं मिष्टान्नं च सुधोपमम् .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārikelaṃ tadudakaṃ keśaraṃ mūlamārdrakam ..
pakvarambhāphalaṃ cāru śrīphalaṃ badarīphalam ..
kāladeśodbhavaṃ pakvaphalaṃ śuklaṃ susaṃskṛtam .. 43 ..
meaning:
नारिकेलं तदुदकं केशरं मूलमार्द्रकम् ..
पक्वरम्भाफलं चारु श्रीफलं बदरीफलम् ..
कालदेशोद्भवं पक्वफलं शुक्लं सुसंस्कृतम् .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhi śuklapuṣpaṃ ca gandhāḍhyaṃ śuklacandanam ..
navīnaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca sumanoharam ..
mālyaṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ muktāhīrādibhūṣaṇam ... .. 44 ..
meaning:
सुगन्धि शुक्लपुष्पं च गन्धाढ्यं शुक्लचन्दनम् ..
नवीनं शुक्लवस्त्रं च शङ्खं च सुमनोहरम् ..
माल्यं च शुक्लपुष्पाणां मुक्ताहीरादिभूषणम् ... .. 44 ..
text_mt:
fragrant white flowers, fragrant white sandalwood,
a fresh white cloth, a most charming conch shell,
a garland of white flowers, and ornaments of pearls, diamonds, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddṛṣṭaṃ ca śrutau dhyānaṃ praśastaṃ śrutisundaram ..
tannibodha mahābhāga bhramabhañjanakāraṇam .. 45 ..
meaning:
यद्दृष्टं च श्रुतौ ध्यानं प्रशस्तं श्रुतिसुन्दरम् ..
तन्निबोध महाभाग भ्रमभञ्जनकारणम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
The meditation seen in the Veda, highly praised and delightful to the ears,
which dispels delusion—understand that, O noble one:

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatīṃ śuklavarṇāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām ..
koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśrīyuktavigrahām .. 46 ..
meaning:
सरस्वतीं शुक्लवर्णां सस्मितां सुमनोहराम् ..
कोटिचन्द्रप्रभाजुष्टपुष्टश्रीयुक्तविग्रहाम् .. 46 ..
text_mt:
“White-complexioned Sarasvatī, smiling and most delightful,
whose form is endowed with full splendour, served by the lustre of ten million moons,

sanskrit_iast:
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām ..
ratnasārendra khacitavarabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 47 ..
meaning:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानां सस्मितां सुमनोहराम् ..
रत्नसारेन्द्र खचितवरभूषणभूषिताम् .. 47 ..
text_mt:
wearing garments purified by fire, smiling and most delightful,
adorned with excellent ornaments inlaid with the best of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
supūjitāṃ suragaṇairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ..
vande bhaktyā vanditā tāṃ munīndramanumānavaiḥ .. 48..
meaning:
सुपूजितां सुरगणैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिभिः ..
वन्दे भक्त्या वन्दिता तां मुनीन्द्रमनुमानवैः .. 48..
text_mt:
duly worshipped by the hosts of gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others—
I praise with devotion that goddess revered by the foremost munis, Manus, and men.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā ca mūlena sarvaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
saṃstūya kavacaṃ dhṛtvā praṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi .. 49 ..
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा च मूलेन सर्वं दत्त्वा विचक्षणः ..
संस्तूय कवचं धृत्वा प्रणमेद्दण्डवद्भुवि .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Having meditated thus, and having offered everything with the root mantra, the discerning worshipper,
having praised her and putting on the armour, should bow like a stick to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ syādiṣṭadevīyaṃ teṣāṃ nityaṃ śubhaṃ mune ..
vidyārambhe ca sarveṣāṃ varṣānte pañcamīdine .. 2.4.50 ..
meaning:
येषां स्यादिष्टदेवीयं तेषां नित्यं शुभं मुने ..
विद्यारम्भे च सर्वेषां वर्षान्ते पञ्चमीदिने .. 2.4.50 ..
text_mt:
For those whose chosen goddess she is, O muni, there is constant auspiciousness,
and for all people on the commencement of learning, and at the end of the year on the fifth day.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopayuktamūlaṃ ca vaidikāṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ ..
yeṣāṃ yadupadeśo vā teṣāṃ tanmūlameva ca ..
sarasvatī caturthyanto vahnijāyānta eva ca .. 51 ..
meaning:
सर्वोपयुक्तमूलं च वैदिकाष्टाक्षरः परः ..
येषां यदुपदेशो वा तेषां तन्मूलमेव च ..
सरस्वती चतुर्थ्यन्तो वह्निजायान्त एव च .. 51 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā ..
lakṣmīmāyādikaṃ caiva mantro'yaṃ kalpapādapaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
श्रीं ह्रीं सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा ..
लक्ष्मीमायादिकं चैव मन्त्रोऽयं कल्पपादपः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
‘Śrīṃ Hrīṃ Sarasvatyai Svāhā.’
This mantra, beginning with the seed syllables of Lakṣmī and Māyā, is a wish-fulfilling tree.

sanskrit_iast:
purā nārāyaṇaścemaṃ vālmīkāya kṛpānidhiḥ ..
pradadau jāhnavītīre puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate .. 53 ..
meaning:
पुरा नारायणश्चेमं वाल्मीकाय कृपानिधिः ..
प्रददौ जाह्नवीतीरे पुण्यक्षेत्रे च भारते .. 53 ..
text_mt:
In ancient times, Nārāyaṇa, the ocean of compassion, gave this
to Vālmīki on the bank of the Gaṅgā in the holy land of Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgurdadau ca śukrāya puṣkare sūryyaparvaṇi ..
candraparvaṇi mārīco dadau vākpataye mudā .. 54 ..
meaning:
भृगुर्ददौ च शुक्राय पुष्करे सूर्य्यपर्वणि ..
चन्द्रपर्वणि मारीचो ददौ वाक्पतये मुदा .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Bhṛgu gave it to Śukra at Puṣkara on a solar eclipse,
and on a lunar eclipse, Kaśyapa Mārīca joyfully gave it to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgave ca dadau tuṣṭo brahmā badarikāśrame ..
āstīkāya jaratkārurdadau kṣīrodasannidhau ..
vibhāṇḍako dadau merāvṛṣyaśṛṅgāya dhīmate .. 55 ..
meaning:
भृगवे च ददौ तुष्टो ब्रह्मा बदरिकाश्रमे ..
आस्तीकाय जरत्कारुर्ददौ क्षीरोदसन्निधौ ..
विभाण्डको ददौ मेरावृष्यशृङ्गाय धीमते .. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ kaṇādamunaye gautamāya dadau mune ..
sūryyaśca yājñavalkyāya tathā kātyāyanāya ca .. 56 ..
meaning:
शिवः कणादमुनये गौतमाय ददौ मुने ..
सूर्य्यश्च याज्ञवल्क्याय तथा कात्यायनाय च .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Śiva gave it to the sage Kaṇāda and to Gautama, O muni;
the Sun gave it to Yājñavalkya and also to Kātyāyana;

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaḥ pāṇinaye caiva bharadvājāya dhīmate ..
dadau śākaṭāyanāya sutale balisaṃsadi .. 57 ..
meaning:
शेषः पाणिनये चैव भरद्वाजाय धीमते ..
ददौ शाकटायनाय सुतले बलिसंसदि .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Śeṣa gave it to Pāṇini and to the wise Bharadvāja.
[Śeṣa] gave [it] to Śākaṭāyana in Sutala, in the assembly of Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
caturlakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ..
yadi syātsiddhamantro hi bṛhaspatisamo bhavet .. 58 ..
meaning:
चतुर्लक्षजपेनैव मन्त्रसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम् ..
यदि स्यात्सिद्धमन्त्रो हि बृहस्पतिसमो भवेत् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
By four hundred thousand recitations alone comes mastery of the mantra for men;
if one has mastered the mantra, one becomes equal to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacaṃ śṛṇu viprendra yaddattaṃ vidhinā purā ..
viśvaśreṣṭhaṃ viśvajayaṃ bhṛgave gandhamādane .. 59 ..
meaning:
कवचं शृणु विप्रेन्द्र यद्दत्तं विधिना पुरा ..
विश्वश्रेष्ठं विश्वजयं भृगवे गन्धमादने .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Hear, O best of Brahmins, the armour which was given formerly by Brahmā,
the best in the world, the world-conquering, to Bhṛgu on Mount Gandhamādana.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguruvāca ..
brahmanbrahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha brahma jñānaviśārada ..
sarvajña sarvajanaka sarvapūjakapūjita .. 2.4.60 ..
meaning:
भृगुरुवाच ..
ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठ ब्रह्म ज्ञानविशारद ..
सर्वज्ञ सर्वजनक सर्वपूजकपूजित .. 2.4.60 ..
text_mt:
O Brahmā, best among knowers of Brahman, skilled in the knowledge of Brahman,
all-knowing one, progenitor of all, worshipped by all worshippers,

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyāśca kavacaṃ brūhi viśvajayaṃ prabho ..
ayātayāmamantrāṇāṃ samūho yatra saṃyutaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
सरस्वत्याश्च कवचं ब्रूहि विश्वजयं प्रभो ..
अयातयाममन्त्राणां समूहो यत्र संयुतः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
tell the world-conquering armour of Sarasvatī, O lord,
in which a collection of potent mantras is joined together.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
śrutisāraṃ śrutisukhaṃ śrutyuktaṃ śrutipūjitam .. 62 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि कवचं सर्वकामदम् ..
श्रुतिसारं श्रुतिसुखं श्रुत्युक्तं श्रुतिपूजितम् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Listen, my child, I shall declare the armour that grants all desires,
the essence of the Vedas, pleasing to the ear, proclaimed in the Vedas, revered by the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ kṛṣṇena goloke mahyaṃ vṛndāvane vane ..
rāseśvareṇa vibhunā rāse vai rāsamaṇḍale .. 63 ..
meaning:
उक्तं कृष्णेन गोलोके मह्यं वृन्दावने वने ..
रासेश्वरेण विभुना रासे वै रासमण्डले .. 63 ..
text_mt:
spoken by Kṛṣṇa in Goloka to me in the forest of Vṛndāvana,
by the all-pervading Lord of the Rasa-dance, during the Rasa-dance in the circle of the Rasa.

sanskrit_iast:
atīva gopanīyaṃ ca kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ param ..
aśrutādbhutamantrāṇāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitam .. 64 ..
meaning:
अतीव गोपनीयं च कल्पवृक्षसमं परम् ..
अश्रुताद्भुतमन्त्राणां समूहैश्च समन्वितम् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
It is exceedingly secret, equal to a wish-fulfilling tree, supreme,
and endowed with collections of wonderful, unheard-of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmanbuddhimāṃśca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
yaddhṛtvā bhagavāñchukraḥ sarvadaityeṣu pūjitaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा पठनाद्ब्रह्मन्बुद्धिमांश्च बृहस्पतिः ..
यद्धृत्वा भगवाञ्छुक्रः सर्वदैत्येषु पूजितः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
By holding and reciting this, O Brahmin, Bṛhaspati became wise;
by holding this, the blessed Śukra was worshipped among all the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanāddhāraṇādvāggmī kavīndro vālmikī muniḥ ..
svāyambhuvo manuścaiva yaddhṛtvā sarvapūjitaḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
पठनाद्धारणाद्वाग्ग्मी कवीन्द्रो वाल्मिकी मुनिः ..
स्वायम्भुवो मनुश्चैव यद्धृत्वा सर्वपूजितः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
From reciting and holding it, the sage Vālmīki became eloquent, a lord of poets;
by holding it, Svāyambhuva Manu became worshipped by all.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇādo gautamaḥ kaṇvaḥ pāṇiniḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ..
granthaṃ cakāra yaddhṛtvā dakṣaḥ kātyāyanaḥ svayam .. 67 ..
meaning:
कणादो गौतमः कण्वः पाणिनिः शाकटायनः ..
ग्रन्थं चकार यद्धृत्वा दक्षः कात्यायनः स्वयम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
Kaṇāda, Gautama, Kaṇva, Pāṇini, Śākaṭāyana,
and the capable Kātyāyana himself composed treatises after holding it.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtvā vedavibhāgaṃ ca purāṇānyakhilāni ca ..
cakāra līlāmātreṇa kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam .. 68 ..
meaning:
धृत्वा वेदविभागं च पुराणान्यखिलानि च ..
चकार लीलामात्रेण कृष्णद्वैपायनः स्वयम् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Having held it, the division of the Vedas and all the Purāṇas
Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana himself produced as mere effortless play.

sanskrit_iast:
śātātapaśca saṃvartto vasiṣṭhaśca parāśaraḥ ..
yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādgranthaṃ yājñavalkyaścakāra saḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
शातातपश्च संवर्त्तो वसिष्ठश्च पराशरः ..
यद्धृत्वा पठनाद्ग्रन्थं याज्ञवल्क्यश्चकार सः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Śātātapa, Saṃvarta, Vasiṣṭha, and Parāśara,
and Yājñavalkya composed his treatise from holding and reciting it.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyaśṛṅgo bharadvājaścāstīko devalastathā ..
jaigīṣavyo'tha jābāli yaddhṛtvā sarva pūjitaḥ .. 2.4.70 ..
meaning:
ऋष्यशृङ्गो भरद्वाजश्चास्तीको देवलस्तथा ..
जैगीषव्योऽथ जाबालि यद्धृत्वा सर्व पूजितः .. 2.4.70 ..
text_mt:
Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Bharadvāja, Āstīka, and likewise Devala,
Jaigīṣavya, and Jābāli became revered by all after holding it.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacasyāsya viprendra ṛṣireṣa prajāpatiḥ ..
svayaṃ bṛhaspatiśchando devo rāseśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ..71..
meaning:
कवचस्यास्य विप्रेन्द्र ऋषिरेष प्रजापतिः ..
स्वयं बृहस्पतिश्छन्दो देवो रासेश्वरः प्रभुः ..71..
text_mt:
Of this armour, O best of Brahmins, Prajāpati is the ṛṣi,
the meter is Bṛhaspati himself, the deity is the Lord, the master of the Rasa-dance.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatattvaparijñāne sarvārthe'pi ca sādhane ..
kavitāsu ca sarvāsu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
सर्वतत्त्वपरिज्ञाने सर्वार्थेऽपि च साधने ..
कवितासु च सर्वासु विनियोगः प्रकीर्त्तितः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
In the thorough knowledge of all principles, in the accomplishment of all aims,
and in all poetical arts, the application is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā śiro me pātu sarvataḥ ..
śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā bhālaṃ me sarvadā'vatu .. 73 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा शिरो मे पातु सर्वतः ..
श्रीं वाग्देवतायै स्वाहा भालं मे सर्वदाऽवतु .. 73 ..
text_mt:
“Oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā” — may it protect my head on all sides;
“śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā” — may it always protect my forehead;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sarasvatyai svāheti śrotraṃ pātu nirantaram ..
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhāratyai svāhā netrayugmaṃ sadā'vatu .. 74 ..
meaning:
ओं सरस्वत्यै स्वाहेति श्रोत्रं पातु निरन्तरम् ..
ओं श्रीं ह्रीं भारत्यै स्वाहा नेत्रयुग्मं सदाऽवतु .. 74 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ sarasvatyai svāhā” — thus may it constantly protect my ear;
“oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhāratyai svāhā” — may it always protect my two eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā nāsāṃ me sarvato'vatu ..
hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā śrotraṃ sadā'vatu .. .. 75 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं वाग्वादिन्यै स्वाहा नासां मे सर्वतोऽवतु ..
ह्रीं विद्याधिष्ठातृदेव्यै स्वाहा श्रोत्रं सदाऽवतु .. .. 75 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā” — may it protect my nose on all sides;
“hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā” — may it always protect my ear;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai svāheti dantapaṃktīḥ sadā'vatu ..
aimityekākṣaro mantro mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu .. 76 ..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं ह्रीं ब्राह्म्यै स्वाहेति दन्तपंक्तीः सदाऽवतु ..
ऐमित्येकाक्षरो मन्त्रो मम कण्ठं सदाऽवतु .. 76 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai svāhā” — thus may it always protect my rows of teeth;
“aiṃ”, the single-syllabled mantra — may it always protect my throat;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ pātu me grīvāṃ skandhaṃ me śrīṃ sadā'vatu ..
śrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu .. 77 ..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं ह्रीं पातु मे ग्रीवां स्कन्धं मे श्रीं सदाऽवतु ..
श्रीं विद्याधिष्ठातृदेव्यै स्वाहा वक्षः सदाऽवतु .. 77 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ” — may it protect my neck; “śrīṃ” — may it always protect my shoulder;
“śrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā” — may it always protect my chest;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ vidyāsvarūpāyai svāhā me pātu nābhikām ..
oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ vāṇyai svāheti mama pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu .. 78 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं विद्यास्वरूपायै स्वाहा मे पातु नाभिकाम् ..
ओं ह्रीं ह्रीं वाण्यै स्वाहेति मम पृष्ठं सदाऽवतु .. 78 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ hrīṃ vidyāsvarūpāyai svāhā” — may it protect my navel;
“oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ vāṇyai svāhā” — thus may it always protect my back;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sarvavarṇātmikāyai pādayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai sarvāṅgaṃ me sadā'vatu..79..
meaning:
ओं सर्ववर्णात्मिकायै पादयुग्मं सदाऽवतु ..
ओं रागाधिष्ठातृदेव्यै सर्वाङ्गं मे सदाऽवतु..79..
text_mt:
[“oṃ sarvavarṇātmikāyai svāhā”] — may it always protect my two feet;
[“oṃ rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā”] — may it always protect all my limbs;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sarvakaṇṭhavāsinyai svāhā prācyāṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ hrīṃ jihvāpravāsinyai svāhā'gni diśi rakṣatu .. 2.4.80 ..
meaning:
ओं सर्वकण्ठवासिन्यै स्वाहा प्राच्यां सदाऽवतु ..
ओं ह्रीं जिह्वाप्रवासिन्यै स्वाहाऽग्नि दिशि रक्षतु .. 2.4.80 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ sarvakaṇṭhavāsinyai svāhā” — may it always protect in the east;
“oṃ hrīṃ jihvāpravāsinyai svāhā” — may it protect in the southeast;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarasvatyai budhajananyai svāhā ..
satataṃ mantrarājo'yaṃ dakṣiṇe māṃ sadā'vatu .. 81 ..
meaning:
ओं ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं सरस्वत्यै बुधजनन्यै स्वाहा ..
सततं मन्त्रराजोऽयं दक्षिणे मां सदाऽवतु .. 81 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarasvatyai budhajananyai svāhā” —
may this king of mantras always protect me in the south;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ tryakṣaro mantro nairṛtyāṃ me sadā'vatu ..
kavijihvāgravāsinyai svāhā māṃ vāruṇe'vatu .. 82 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं त्र्यक्षरो मन्त्रो नैरृत्यां मे सदाऽवतु ..
कविजिह्वाग्रवासिन्यै स्वाहा मां वारुणेऽवतु .. 82 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ”, the three-syllabled mantra — may it always protect me in the southwest;
[“oṃ] kavijihvāgravāsinyai svāhā” — may it protect me in the west;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sadambikāyai svāhā vāyavye māṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ gadyapadyavāsinyai svāhā māmuttare'vatu .. 83 ..
meaning:
ओं सदम्बिकायै स्वाहा वायव्ये मां सदाऽवतु ..
ओं गद्यपद्यवासिन्यै स्वाहा मामुत्तरेऽवतु .. 83 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ sadambikāyai svāhā” — may it always protect me in the northwest;
“oṃ gadyapadyavāsinyai svāhā” — may it protect me in the north;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sarvaśāstravāsinyai svāhaiśānyāṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ sarvapūjitāyai svāhā cordhvaṃ sadā'vatu .. 84 ..
meaning:
ओं सर्वशास्त्रवासिन्यै स्वाहैशान्यां सदाऽवतु ..
ओं सर्वपूजितायै स्वाहा चोर्ध्वं सदाऽवतु .. 84 ..
text_mt:
“oṃ sarvaśāstravāsinyai svāhā” — may it always protect in the northeast;
“oṃ sarvapūjitāyai svāhā” — may it always protect above;

sanskrit_iast:
aiṃ hrīṃ pustakavāsinyai svāhā'dho māṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ granthabījarūpāyai svāhā māṃ sarvato'vatu .. 85 ..
meaning:
ऐं ह्रीं पुस्तकवासिन्यै स्वाहाऽधो मां सदाऽवतु ..
ओं ग्रन्थबीजरूपायै स्वाहा मां सर्वतोऽवतु .. 85 ..
text_mt:
“aiṃ hrīṃ pustakavāsinyai svāhā” — may it always protect me below;
“oṃ granthabījarūpāyai svāhā” — may it protect me on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra sarvamantraughavigraham ..
idaṃ viśvajayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ brahmarūpakam .. 86 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं विप्र सर्वमन्त्रौघविग्रहम् ..
इदं विश्वजयं नाम कवचं ब्रह्मरूपकम् .. 86 ..
text_mt:
Thus to you has been spoken, O Brahmin, the embodiment of a multitude of all mantras,
This armour, named Viśvajaya ('Conqueror of the Universe'), has the nature of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātparvate gandhamādane ..
tava snehānmayā''khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit .. 87 ..
meaning:
पुरा श्रुतं धर्मवक्त्रात्पर्वते गन्धमादने ..
तव स्नेहान्मया'ऽख्यातं प्रवक्तव्यं न कस्यचित् .. 87 ..
text_mt: In ancient times it was heard from the mouth of Dharma on Mount Gandhamādana.

sanskrit_iast:
gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāra candanaiḥ ..
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau kavacaṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
गुरुमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्वस्त्रालङ्कार चन्दनैः ..
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ कवचं धारयेत्सुधीः .. 88 ..
text_mt: and bowed prostrate like a staff upon the ground, the wise person should put on the armour.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet ..
yadi syātsiddhakavaco bṛha spatisamo bhaveta .. 89 ..
meaning:
पञ्चलक्षजपेनैव सिद्धं तु कवचं भवेत् ..
यदि स्यात्सिद्धकवचो बृह स्पतिसमो भवेत .. 89 ..
text_mt:
By five hundred thousand repetitions alone the armour becomes mastered.
If one has mastered the armour, one becomes equal to Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvāgmī kavīndraśca trailokyavijayī bhavet ..
śaknoti sarvaṃ jetuṃ sa kavacasya prabhāvataḥ ..2.4.90..
meaning:
महावाग्मी कवीन्द्रश्च त्रैलोक्यविजयी भवेत् ..
शक्नोति सर्वं जेतुं स कवचस्य प्रभावतः ..2.4.90..
text_mt:
a great orator, an emperor of poets, and a conqueror of the three worlds;
he is able to conquer all by the power of the armour.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ te kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ kathitaṃ kavacaṃ mune..
stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ vai vandanaṃ tathā..91..
meaning:
इदं ते काण्वशाखोक्तं कथितं कवचं मुने..
स्तोत्रं पूजाविधानं च ध्यानं वै वन्दनं तथा..91..
text_mt:
This armour, spoken in the Kāṇva recension, has been recounted to you, O sage,
as well as the hymn of praise, the procedure of worship, the meditation, and the salutation.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
vāgdevatāyāḥ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvakāmadam ..
mahāmuniryājñavalkyo yena tuṣṭāva tāṃ purā..1..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
वाग्देवतायाः स्तवनं श्रूयतां सर्वकामदम् ..
महामुनिर्याज्ञवल्क्यो येन तुष्टाव तां पुरा..1..
title: Yājñavalkyoktavāṇīstavanam

sanskrit_iast:
guruśāpācca sa munirhatavidyo babhūva ha..
tadā''jagāma duḥkhārto ravisthānaṃ ca puṇyadam .. 2 ..
meaning:
गुरुशापाच्च स मुनिर्हतविद्यो बभूव ह..
तदा'ऽजगाम दुःखार्तो रविस्थानं च पुण्यदम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya tapasā sūryyaṃ koṇārke dṛṣṭigocare ..
tuṣṭāva sūryyaṃ śokena ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य तपसा सूर्य्यं कोणार्के दृष्टिगोचरे ..
तुष्टाव सूर्य्यं शोकेन रुरोद च पुनः पुनः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sūryyastaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa vedavedāṅgamīśvaraḥ ..
uvāca stuhi vāgdevīṃ bhaktyā ca smṛtihetave .. 4 ..
meaning:
सूर्य्यस्तं पाठयामास वेदवेदाङ्गमीश्वरः ..
उवाच स्तुहि वाग्देवीं भक्त्या च स्मृतिहेतवे .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tamityuktvā dīnanātho hyantarddhānaṃ jagāma saḥ ..
muniḥ snātvā ca tuṣṭāva bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..5..
meaning:
तमित्युक्त्वा दीननाथो ह्यन्तर्द्धानं जगाम सः ..
मुनिः स्नात्वा च तुष्टाव भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
yājñavalkya uvāca ..
kṛpāṃ kuru jaganmātarmāmevaṃ hatatejasam..
guruśāpātsmṛtibhraṣṭaṃ vidyāhīnaṃ ca duḥkhitam..6..
meaning:
याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच ..
कृपां कुरु जगन्मातर्मामेवं हततेजसम्..
गुरुशापात्स्मृतिभ्रष्टं विद्याहीनं च दुःखितम्..6..

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ dehi smṛtiṃ dehi vidyāṃ vidyādhidevate ..
pratiṣṭhāṃ kavitāṃ dehi śaktiṃ śiṣyaprabodhikām..7..
meaning:
ज्ञानं देहि स्मृतिं देहि विद्यां विद्याधिदेवते ..
प्रतिष्ठां कवितां देहि शक्तिं शिष्यप्रबोधिकाम्..7..

sanskrit_iast:
granthanirmitiśaktiṃ ca sacchiṣyaṃ supratiṣṭhitam ..
pratibhāṃ satsabhāyāṃ ca vicārakṣamatāṃ śubhām .. 8 ..
meaning:
ग्रन्थनिर्मितिशक्तिं च सच्छिष्यं सुप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
प्रतिभां सत्सभायां च विचारक्षमतां शुभाम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
luptāṃ sarvāṃ daivavaśānnavāṃ kuru punaḥ punaḥ ..
yathā'ṅkuraṃ janayati bhagavānyogamāyayā .. 9 ..
meaning:
लुप्तां सर्वां दैववशान्नवां कुरु पुनः पुनः ..
यथाऽङ्कुरं जनयति भगवान्योगमायया .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvarūpā paramā jyotīrūpā sanātanī ..
sarvavidyādhidevī yā tasyai vāṇye namo namaḥ .. 2.5.10 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वरूपा परमा ज्योतीरूपा सनातनी ..
सर्वविद्याधिदेवी या तस्यै वाण्ये नमो नमः .. 2.5.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ śaśvajjīvanmṛtaṃ sadā ..
jñānāghidevī yā tasyai sarasvatyai namo namaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
यया विना जगत्सर्वं शश्वज्जीवन्मृतं सदा ..
ज्ञानाघिदेवी या तस्यै सरस्वत्यै नमो नमः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ mūkamunmattavatsadā ..
vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā tasyai vāṇyai namo namaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
यया विना जगत्सर्वं मूकमुन्मत्तवत्सदा ..
वागधिष्ठातृदेवी या तस्यै वाण्यै नमो नमः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
himacandanakundendukumudāmbhoja sannibhā ..
varṇādhidevī yā tasyai cākṣarāyai namo namaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
हिमचन्दनकुन्देन्दुकुमुदाम्भोज सन्निभा ..
वर्णाधिदेवी या तस्यै चाक्षरायै नमो नमः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
visargabindumātrāṇāṃ yadadhiṣṭhānameva ca ..
itthaṃ tvaṃ gīyase sadbhirbhāratyai te namo namaḥ ..14..
meaning:
विसर्गबिन्दुमात्राणां यदधिष्ठानमेव च ..
इत्थं त्वं गीयसे सद्भिर्भारत्यै ते नमो नमः ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
yayā vinā'tra saṃkhyākṛtsaṃkhyāṃ karttuṃ na śaknute ..
kālasaṃkhyāsvarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
यया विनाऽत्र संख्याकृत्संख्यां कर्त्तुं न शक्नुते ..
कालसंख्यास्वरूपा या तस्यै देव्यै नमो नमः .. .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyāsvarūpā yā devī vyākhyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ..
bhramasiddhāntarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
व्याख्यास्वरूपा या देवी व्याख्याधिष्ठातृदेवता ..
भ्रमसिद्धान्तरूपा या तस्यै देव्यै नमो नमः .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtiśakti jñānaśakti buddhiśaktisvarūpiṇī ..
pratibhākalpanāśaktiryā ca tasyai namo namaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
स्मृतिशक्ति ज्ञानशक्ति बुद्धिशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ..
प्रतिभाकल्पनाशक्तिर्या च तस्यै नमो नमः .. 17 ..
text_mt: and who is the power of genius and imagination—to her, obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro brahmāṇaṃ jñānaṃ papraccha yatra vai ..
babhūva jaḍavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ karttumakṣamaḥ .. 18..
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो ब्रह्माणं ज्ञानं पप्रच्छ यत्र वै ..
बभूव जडवत्सोऽपि सिद्धान्तं कर्त्तुमक्षमः .. 18..
text_mt:
When indeed Sanatkumāra questioned Brahmā about knowledge,
he became as if inert, unable to establish the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā''jagāma bhagavānātmā śrīkṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ ..
uvāca sattamaṃ stotraṃ vāṇyā iti vidhiṃ tadā .. 19 ..
meaning:
तदा'ऽजगाम भगवानात्मा श्रीकृष्ण ईश्वरः ..
उवाच सत्तमं स्तोत्रं वाण्या इति विधिं तदा .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Then the blessed Lord, the Self, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the sovereign, came;
he then taught Vidhi this excellent hymn of praise to Vāṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca tuṣṭāva tāṃ brahmā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ ..
cakāra tatprasādena tadā siddhāntamuttamam .. 2.5.20 ..
meaning:
स च तुष्टाव तां ब्रह्मा चाज्ञया परमात्मनः ..
चकार तत्प्रसादेन तदा सिद्धान्तमुत्तमम् .. 2.5.20 ..
text_mt:
And Brahmā praised her by the command of the Paramātman;
by her grace, he then established the supreme conclusion.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā'pyanantaṃ papraccha jñānamekaṃ vasundharā ..
babhūva mūkavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ..21..
meaning:
यदाऽप्यनन्तं पप्रच्छ ज्ञानमेकं वसुन्धरा ..
बभूव मूकवत्सोऽपि सिद्धान्तं कर्तुमक्षमः ..21..
text_mt:
When also the earth asked Ananta a question concerning knowledge,
he too became as if dumb, unable to establish the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tvāṃ ca sa tuṣṭāva saṃtrastaḥ kaśyapājñayā..
tataścakāra siddhāntaṃ nirmalaṃ bhramabhañjanam .. 22 ..
meaning:
तदा त्वां च स तुष्टाव संत्रस्तः कश्यपाज्ञया..
ततश्चकार सिद्धान्तं निर्मलं भ्रमभञ्जनम् .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Then, terrified, by the command of Kaśyapa he praised you;
thereafter he established the spotless truth, shattering error.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsaḥ purāṇasūtraṃ ca samapṛcchata vālmikim ..
maunībhūtaḥ sa sasmāra tvāmeva jagadaṃbikām ..23..
meaning:
व्यासः पुराणसूत्रं च समपृच्छत वाल्मिकिम् ..
मौनीभूतः स सस्मार त्वामेव जगदंबिकाम् ..23..
text_mt:
Vyāsa asked Vālmīki about the thread of the Purāṇas;
becoming silent, he remembered only you, the Mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā cakāra siddhāntaṃ tvadvareṇa munīśvaraḥ ..
sa prāpa nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ pramādadhvaṃsakāraṇam ..24..
meaning:
तदा चकार सिद्धान्तं त्वद्वरेण मुनीश्वरः ..
स प्राप निर्मलं ज्ञानं प्रमादध्वंसकारणम् ..24..
text_mt:
Then, by your boon, the lord of sages established the conclusion;
he attained pure knowledge that destroys error.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇasūtraṃ śrutvā sa vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇakalodbhavaḥ..
tvāṃ siṣeve ca dadhyau ca śatavarṣaṃ ca puṣkare ..
tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya sa kavīndro babhūva ha ..25..
meaning:
पुराणसूत्रं श्रुत्वा स व्यासः कृष्णकलोद्भवः..
त्वां सिषेवे च दध्यौ च शतवर्षं च पुष्करे ..
तदा त्वत्तो वरं प्राप्य स कवीन्द्रो बभूव ह ..25..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vai vedabhāgaṃ ca purāṇāni cakāra ha ..
yadā mahendre papraccha tattvajñānaṃ śivā śivam .. 26 ..
meaning:
तदा वै वेदभागं च पुराणानि चकार ह ..
यदा महेन्द्रे पप्रच्छ तत्त्वज्ञानं शिवा शिवम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
then indeed he divided the Veda and composed the Purāṇas.
When Śivā asked Śiva on Mahendra about the knowledge of reality,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ tvāmeva saṃcintya tasyai jñānaṃ dadau vibhuḥ ..
papraccha śabdaśāstraṃ ca mahendraśca bṛhaspatim .. 27 ..
meaning:
क्षणं त्वामेव संचिन्त्य तस्यै ज्ञानं ददौ विभुः ..
पप्रच्छ शब्दशास्त्रं च महेन्द्रश्च बृहस्पतिम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
the all-pervading lord, having meditated upon you for an instant, imparted knowledge to her.
And Mahendra asked Bṛhaspati about the science of grammar;

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca sa tvāṃ dadhyau ca puṣkare ..
tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ..
uvāca śabdaśāstraṃ ca tadarthaṃ ca sureśvaram .. 28 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं च स त्वां दध्यौ च पुष्करे ..
तदा त्वत्तो वरं प्राप्य दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ..
उवाच शब्दशास्त्रं च तदर्थं च सुरेश्वरम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
he meditated on you at Puṣkara for a celestial thousand years.
Then, having obtained a boon from you, for a celestial thousand years
he expounded the science of grammar and its meaning to the lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpitāśca yaiḥ śiṣyā yairadhītaṃ munīśvaraiḥ ..
te ca tvāṃ parisaṃcintya pravarttante sureśvari .. 29 ..
meaning:
अध्यापिताश्च यैः शिष्या यैरधीतं मुनीश्वरैः ..
ते च त्वां परिसंचिन्त्य प्रवर्त्तन्ते सुरेश्वरि .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Those disciples who were taught, and those lords of sages who studied,
they proceed only after contemplating you, O queen of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ saṃstutā pūjitā ca munīndramanumānavaiḥ ..
daityendraiśca suraiścāpi brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ .. 2.5.30 ..
meaning:
त्वं संस्तुता पूजिता च मुनीन्द्रमनुमानवैः ..
दैत्येन्द्रैश्च सुरैश्चापि ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिभिः .. 2.5.30 ..
text_mt:
You are praised and worshipped by lords of sages, Manus, and men,
and by the lords of Daityas, by the gods, and by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
jaḍībhūtaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ pañcavaktraścaturmukhaḥ ..
yāṃ stotuṃ kimahaṃ staumi tāmekāsyena mānavaḥ ..31 ..
meaning:
जडीभूतः सहस्रास्यः पञ्चवक्त्रश्चतुर्मुखः ..
यां स्तोतुं किमहं स्तौमि तामेकास्येन मानवः ..31 ..
text_mt:
The thousand-faced one, the five-faced one, and the four-faced one are struck dumb;
how can I, a mere mortal with a single mouth, praise her whom [even they fail] to praise?

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā yājñavalkyaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..
praṇanāma nirāhāro ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र भगवानाजगाम ह ..
चतुर्भुजश्चतुर्भिश्च पार्षदैश्च चतुर्भुजैः .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatīṃ kare dhṛtvā vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ..
bodhayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvajñānaṃ purātanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
सरस्वतीं करे धृत्वा वासयामास वक्षसि ..
बोधयामास सर्वज्ञः सर्वज्ञानं पुरातनम् .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā rahasyaṃ tāsāṃ ca śāpasya kalahasya ca ..
uvāca duḥkhitāstāśca vākyaṃ sāmayikaṃ vibhuḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा रहस्यं तासां च शापस्य कलहस्य च ..
उवाच दुःखितास्ताश्च वाक्यं सामयिकं विभुः .. 44 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
lakṣmi tvaṃ kalayā gaccha dharmadhvajagṛhaṃ śubhe ..
ayonisambhavā bhūmau tasya kanyā bhaviṣyasi .. 45 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
लक्ष्मि त्वं कलया गच्छ धर्मध्वजगृहं शुभे ..
अयोनिसम्भवा भूमौ तस्य कन्या भविष्यसि .. 45 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva daivadoṣeṇa vṛkṣatvaṃ ca labhiṣyasi ..
madaṃśasyāsurasyaiva śaṅkhacūḍasya kāminī .. 46 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव दैवदोषेण वृक्षत्वं च लभिष्यसि ..
मदंशस्यासुरस्यैव शङ्खचूडस्य कामिनी .. 46 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvā paścācca matpatnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ..
trailokyapāvanī nāmnā tulasīti ca bhārate .. 47 ..
meaning:
भूत्वा पश्चाच्च मत्पत्नी भविष्यसि न संशयः ..
त्रैलोक्यपावनी नाम्ना तुलसीति च भारते .. 47 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalayā ca saridbhūtvā śīghraṃ gaccha varānane ..
bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpānnāmnā padmāvatī bhava .. 48 ..
meaning:
कलया च सरिद्भूत्वा शीघ्रं गच्छ वरानने ..
भारतं भारतीशापान्नाम्ना पद्मावती भव .. 48 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅge yāsyasi cāṃśena paścāttvaṃ viśvapāvanī ..
bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātpāpadāhāya dehinām .. 49 ..
meaning:
गङ्गे यास्यसि चांशेन पश्चात्त्वं विश्वपावनी ..
भारतं भारतीशापात्पापदाहाय देहिनाम् .. 49 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathasya tapasā tena nītā suduṣkarāt ..
nāmnā bhāgīrathī pūtā bhaviṣyasi mahītale .. 2.6.50 ..
meaning:
भगीरथस्य तपसा तेन नीता सुदुष्करात् ..
नाम्ना भागीरथी पूता भविष्यसि महीतले .. 2.6.50 ..

sanskrit_iast:
madaṃśasya samudrasya jāyā jāye mamājñayā ..
mattkalāṃśasya bhūpasya śantanośca sureśvari .. 51 ..
meaning:
मदंशस्य समुद्रस्य जाया जाये ममाज्ञया ..
मत्त्कलांशस्य भूपस्य शन्तनोश्च सुरेश्वरि .. 51 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāśāpena kalayā bhārataṃ gaccha bhārati ..
kalahasya phalaṃ bhuṅkṣva sapatnībhyāṃ sahācyute .. 52 ..
meaning:
गङ्गाशापेन कलया भारतं गच्छ भारति ..
कलहस्य फलं भुङ्क्ष्व सपत्नीभ्यां सहाच्युते .. 52 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ ca brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kāminī bhava ..
gaṅgā yātu śivasthānamatra padmaiva tiṣṭhatu .. 53 ..
meaning:
स्वयं च ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मणः कामिनी भव ..
गङ्गा यातु शिवस्थानमत्र पद्मैव तिष्ठतु .. 53 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śāntā c krodharahitā madbhaktā matsvarūpiṇī ..
mahāsādhvī mahābhāgā suśīlā dharmacāriṇī .. 54 ..
meaning:
शान्ता च् क्रोधरहिता मद्भक्ता मत्स्वरूपिणी ..
महासाध्वी महाभागा सुशीला धर्मचारिणी .. 54 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yadaṃśakalayā sarvā dharmiṣṭhāśca pativratāḥ ..
śāntarūpā suśīlāśca prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ.. 55 ..
meaning:
यदंशकलया सर्वा धर्मिष्ठाश्च पतिव्रताः ..
शान्तरूपा सुशीलाश्च प्रतिविश्वेषु योषितः.. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tisro bhāryyāstrayaḥ śyālāstrayo bhṛtyāśca bāndhavāḥ ..
dhruvaṃ vedaviruddhāśca na hyete maṅgalapradāḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
तिस्रो भार्य्यास्त्रयः श्यालास्त्रयो भृत्याश्च बान्धवाः ..
ध्रुवं वेदविरुद्धाश्च न ह्येते मङ्गलप्रदाः .. 56 ..

sanskrit_iast:
strī puṃvacca gṛhe yeṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ strīvaśaḥ pumān ..
niṣphalaṃ janma vai teṣāmaśubhaṃ ca pade pade .. 57 ..
meaning:
स्त्री पुंवच्च गृहे येषां गृहिणां स्त्रीवशः पुमान् ..
निष्फलं जन्म वै तेषामशुभं च पदे पदे .. 57 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā yasya strī kalahapriyā ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ gṛhādvaram .. 58 ..
meaning:
मुखदुष्टा योनिदुष्टा यस्य स्त्री कलहप्रिया ..
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं महारण्यं गृहाद्वरम् .. 58 ..

sanskrit_iast:
janānāṃ ca sthalānāṃ ca purāṇāṃ prāptireva ca ..
satataṃ sulabhā tatra na teṣāṃ tadgṛhe'pi ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
जनानां च स्थलानां च पुराणां प्राप्तिरेव च ..
सततं सुलभा तत्र न तेषां तद्गृहेऽपि च .. 59 ..
text_mt:
For encountering other people, places, and ancient lore
Is always easy there [in the world], but never in the house of such men.

sanskrit_iast:
varamagnau sthitirhiṃsrajantūnāṃ sannidhau sukham ..
tato'pi duḥkhaṃ puṃsāṃ ca duṣṭastrīsannidhau dhruvam .. 2.6.60 ..
meaning:
वरमग्नौ स्थितिर्हिंस्रजन्तूनां सन्निधौ सुखम् ..
ततोऽपि दुःखं पुंसां च दुष्टस्त्रीसन्निधौ ध्रुवम् .. 2.6.60 ..
text_mt:
Better is staying in fire; there is comfort even near ferocious beasts;
Far more sorrowful than that is the presence of a wicked wife for men, surely.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhijvālā viṣajvālā varaṃ puṃsāṃ varānane ..
duṣṭastrīṇāṃ mukhajvālā maraṇādatiricyate .. .. 61 ..
meaning:
व्याधिज्वाला विषज्वाला वरं पुंसां वरानने ..
दुष्टस्त्रीणां मुखज्वाला मरणादतिरिच्यते .. .. 61 ..
text_mt:
The torment of disease or the torment of poison is preferable for men, O fair-faced one;
The torment caused by the mouth of wicked women is worse than death.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsaśca strījitasyeha jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ dhruvam ..
yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet .. 62 ..
meaning:
पुंसश्च स्त्रीजितस्येह जीवितं निष्फलं ध्रुवम् ..
यदह्ना कुरुते कर्म न तस्य फलभाग्भवेत् .. 62 ..
text_mt: The life of a man conquered by a woman in this world is surely fruitless;

sanskrit_iast:
sa nindito'tra sarvatra paratra narakaṃ vrajet ..
yaśakīrtivihīno yo jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
स निन्दितोऽत्र सर्वत्र परत्र नरकं व्रजेत् ..
यशकीर्तिविहीनो यो जीवन्नपि मृतो हि सः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
He is reviled everywhere in this world, and in the next world he goes to hell.
He who is bereft of fame and glory is indeed dead though alive.

sanskrit_iast:
bahvīnāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ naikatra śreyasī sthitiḥ ..
ekabhāryyaḥ sukhī naiva bahubhāryyaḥ kadācana .. 64 ..
meaning:
बह्वीनां च सपत्नीनां नैकत्र श्रेयसी स्थितिः ..
एकभार्य्यः सुखी नैव बहुभार्य्यः कदाचन .. 64 ..
text_mt:
The staying together of many co-wives in one place is not beneficial;
A man with one wife is happy, never a man with many wives.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha gaṃge śivasthānaṃ brahmasthānaṃ sarasvati ..
atra tiṣṭhatu maddehe suśīlā kamalālayā ..65..
meaning:
गच्छ गंगे शिवस्थानं ब्रह्मस्थानं सरस्वति ..
अत्र तिष्ठतु मद्देहे सुशीला कमलालया ..65..
text_mt:
Go, O Gaṅgā, to the abode of Śiva; go, O Sarasvatī, to the abode of Brahmā;
Let the well-mannered Lakṣmī remain here in my body.

sanskrit_iast:
susādhyā yasya patnī ca suśīlā ca pativratā..
iha svargasukhaṃ tasya dharmamokṣau paratra ca..66..
meaning:
सुसाध्या यस्य पत्नी च सुशीला च पतिव्रता..
इह स्वर्गसुखं तस्य धर्ममोक्षौ परत्र च..66..
text_mt:
He whose wife is obedient, virtuous, and devoted to her husband,
Enjoys the bliss of heaven in this world, and attains righteousness and liberation in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā yasya patnī sa ca muktaḥ śuciḥ sukhī ..
jīvanmṛto'śucirduḥkhī duśśīlāpatireva yaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रता यस्य पत्नी स च मुक्तः शुचिः सुखी ..
जीवन्मृतोऽशुचिर्दुःखी दुश्शीलापतिरेव यः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
He whose wife is devoted to her husband is liberated, pure, and happy;
He who is the husband of an ill-mannered wife is living dead, impure, and miserable."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma ca nārada ..
atyuccai rurudurdevyaḥ samāliṅgya parasparam .. 68 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथो विरराम च नारद ..
अत्युच्चै रुरुदुर्देव्यः समालिङ्ग्य परस्परम् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, O Nārada, the Lord of the worlds fell silent.
Embracing each other, the goddesses wept very loudly.

sanskrit_iast:
tāśca sarvāḥ samālocya krameṇocuḥ sadīśvaram ..
kampitāḥ sāśrunetrāśca śokena ca bhayena ca .. 69 ..
meaning:
ताश्च सर्वाः समालोच्य क्रमेणोचुः सदीश्वरम् ..
कम्पिताः साश्रुनेत्राश्च शोकेन च भयेन च .. 69 ..
text_mt:
And all of them, having conferred together, spoke in turn to the eternal Lord,
Trembling, their eyes filled with tears through grief and fear.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyuvāca ..
prāyaścittaṃ dehi nātha duṣṭāyāṃ janmaśodhakam ..
satsvāminā parityaktāḥ kutra jīvanti kāḥ striyaḥ ..2.6.70..
meaning:
सरस्वत्युवाच ..
प्रायश्चित्तं देहि नाथ दुष्टायां जन्मशोधकम् ..
सत्स्वामिना परित्यक्ताः कुत्र जीवन्ति काः स्त्रियः ..2.6.70..
text_mt:
"O Lord, grant an expiation that purifies birth for a wicked woman like me.
Abandoned by a noble husband, where and how do women live?

sanskrit_iast:
dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi dhruvaṃ yogena bhārate ..
atyuccato nipatanaṃ prāptumarhati niścitam ..71..
meaning:
देहत्यागं करिष्यामि ध्रुवं योगेन भारते ..
अत्युच्चतो निपतनं प्राप्तुमर्हति निश्चितम् ..71..
text_mt:
I shall surely cast off my body through yoga in Bhārata.
A fall from the highest height is certainly what is destined to occur."

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgovāca ..
ahaṃ kenāparādhena tvayā tyaktā jagatpate ..
dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi nirdoṣāyā vadhaṃ labha .. 72 ..
meaning:
गंगोवाच ..
अहं केनापराधेन त्वया त्यक्ता जगत्पते ..
देहत्यागं करिष्यामि निर्दोषाया वधं लभ .. 72 ..
text_mt:
"For what fault have I been abandoned by you, O Lord of the universe?
I shall cast off my body; incur the sin of killing an innocent woman!"

sanskrit_iast:
nirdoṣakāminītyāgaṃ kurute yo jano bhave ..
sa yāti narakaṃ kalpaṃ kiṃ te sarveśvarasya vā .. 73 ..
meaning:
निर्दोषकामिनीत्यागं कुरुते यो जनो भवे ..
स याति नरकं कल्पं किं ते सर्वेश्वरस्य वा .. 73 ..
text_mt:
Whosoever in this world abandons a blameless beloved woman
goes to hell for a kalpa; what then of you, who are the Lord of all? .. 73 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīruvāca ..
nātha sattvasvarūpastvaṃ kopaḥ kathamaho tava ..
prasādaṃ kuru cāsmabhyaṃ sadīśasya kṣamā varā .. 74 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीरुवाच ..
नाथ सत्त्वस्वरूपस्त्वं कोपः कथमहो तव ..
प्रसादं कुरु चास्मभ्यं सदीशस्य क्षमा वरा .. 74 ..
text_mt:
"O Lord, your very nature is sattva; how, alas, can you have anger?
Grant your favour to us, for forgiveness is the best attribute of a true lord. .. 74 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādyāsyāmi kalayā yadi ..
katikālaṃ sthitistatra kadā drakṣyāmi te padam ..75..
meaning:
भारतं भारतीशापाद्यास्यामि कलया यदि ..
कतिकालं स्थितिस्तत्र कदा द्रक्ष्यामि ते पदम् ..75..
text_mt:
If by the curse of Bhāratī I must go to Bhārata with a part [of myself],
for how long shall I stay there, and when shall I behold your feet? .. 75 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dāsyanti pāpinaḥ pāpaṃ mahyaṃ snānāvagāhanāt ..
kena tasmādvimuktā'hamāgamiṣyāmi te padam..76..
meaning:
दास्यन्ति पापिनः पापं मह्यं स्नानावगाहनात् ..
केन तस्माद्विमुक्ताऽहमागमिष्यामि ते पदम्..76..
text_mt:
Sinners will pass their sins onto me from bathing and immersing themselves.
Freed from that by what means shall I return to your abode? .. 76 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalayā tulasīrūpā dharmadhvajasutā satī ..
bhūtvā kadā labhiṣyāmi tvatpādāmbujamacyuta .. 77 ..
meaning:
कलया तुलसीरूपा धर्मध्वजसुता सती ..
भूत्वा कदा लभिष्यामि त्वत्पादाम्बुजमच्युत .. 77 ..
text_mt:
When, having become through a part the virtuous daughter of Dharmadhvaja
in the form of Tulasī, shall I attain your lotus feet, O Acyuta? .. 77 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣarūpā bhaviṣyāmi tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ..
māmuddhariṣyasi kadā tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe .. 78 ..
meaning:
वृक्षरूपा भविष्यामि तदधिष्ठातृदेवता ..
मामुद्धरिष्यसि कदा तन्मे ब्रूहि कृपानिधे .. 78 ..
text_mt:
I shall become a tree, and its presiding deity;
when will you deliver me? Tell me that, O ocean of mercy! .. 78 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgā sarasvatīśāpādyadi yāsyati bhāratam ..
śāpena muktā pāpācca kadā tvāṃ vā labhiṣyati .. 79 ..
meaning:
गंगा सरस्वतीशापाद्यदि यास्यति भारतम् ..
शापेन मुक्ता पापाच्च कदा त्वां वा लभिष्यति .. 79 ..
text_mt:
If Gaṅgā, through the curse of Sarasvatī, goes to Bhārata,
when, freed from the curse and from sin, will she attain you? .. 79 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃgāśāpena sā vāṇī yadi yāsyati bhāratam ..
kadā śāpādvinirmucya labhiṣyati padaṃ tava .. 2.6.80 ..
meaning:
गंगाशापेन सा वाणी यदि यास्यति भारतम् ..
कदा शापाद्विनिर्मुच्य लभिष्यति पदं तव .. 2.6.80 ..
text_mt:
And if that Vāṇī, through Gaṅgā’s curse, goes to Bhārata,
when, completely freed from the curse, will she reach your realm? .. 80 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ vāṇīṃ brahmasadanaṃ gaṃgāṃ vā śivamandiram ..
gantuṃ vadasi he nātha tatkṣamasva ca te vacaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
तां वाणीं ब्रह्मसदनं गंगां वा शिवमन्दिरम् ..
गन्तुं वदसि हे नाथ तत्क्षमस्व च ते वचः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
You tell Vāṇī to go to the abode of Brahmā, and Gaṅgā to the dwelling of Śiva;
forgive that speech of yours, O Lord!" .. 81 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā kamalā kāntapadaṃ dhṛtvā nanāma ca ..
sukeśairveṣṭayitvā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ..82..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा कमला कान्तपदं धृत्वा ननाम च ..
सुकेशैर्वेष्टयित्वा च रुरोद च पुनः पुनः ..82..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Kamalā took hold of her beloved's feet and bowed down;
enfolding them with her beautiful hair, she wept again and again. .. 82 ..

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca padmanābhastāṃ prabhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi..
īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
उवाच पद्मनाभस्तां प्रभां कृत्वा स्ववक्षसि..
ईषद्धासः प्रसन्नास्यो भक्तानुग्रहकारकः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Padmanābha, drawing that radiant one to his chest,
with a gentle smile and a joyful face, bestowing grace upon his devotees, spoke. .. 83 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
tvadvākyamācariṣyāmi svavākyaṃ ca sureśvari ..
samatāṃ ca kariṣyāmi śṛṇu tatkramameva ca .. 84 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
त्वद्वाक्यमाचरिष्यामि स्ववाक्यं च सुरेश्वरि ..
समतां च करिष्यामि शृणु तत्क्रममेव च .. 84 ..
text_mt:
"I will carry out your word, and my own word as well, O queen of the gods;
and I will bring about harmony. Listen to the manner of it: .. 84 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhāratī yātu kalayā saridrūpā ca bhāratam ..
arddhāṃśā brahmasadanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe .. 85 ..
meaning:
भारती यातु कलया सरिद्रूपा च भारतम् ..
अर्द्धांशा ब्रह्मसदनं स्वयं तिष्ठतु मद्गृहे .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Let Bhāratī go to Bhārata with a part [of herself] in the form of a river;
with half a portion let her go to Brahmā's abode, and in her own person let her remain in my house. .. 85 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathena nītā sā gaṃgā yāsyati bhāratam ..
pūtaṃ kartuṃ tribhuvanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe .. 86 ..
meaning:
भगीरथेन नीता सा गंगा यास्यति भारतम् ..
पूतं कर्तुं त्रिभुवनं स्वयं तिष्ठतु मद्गृहे .. 86 ..
text_mt:
Brought by Bhagīratha, that Gaṅgā shall go to Bhārata
to purify the three worlds, yet in her own person let her remain in my house. .. 86 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva candramauleśca mauliṃ prāpsyati durlabham ..
tataḥ svabhāvataḥ pūtā'pyatipūtā bhaviṣyati .. 87 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव चन्द्रमौलेश्च मौलिं प्राप्स्यति दुर्लभम् ..
ततः स्वभावतः पूताऽप्यतिपूता भविष्यति .. 87 ..
text_mt:
Right there she will attain the crest of the moon-crested [Śiva], so hard to reach;
then, though pure by her very nature, she will become exceedingly pure. .. 87 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalāṃśāṃśena gaccha tvaṃ bhārate kamalodbhave ..
padmāvatī saridrūpā tulasīvṛkṣarūpiṇī .. 88 ..
meaning:
कलांशांशेन गच्छ त्वं भारते कमलोद्भवे ..
पद्मावती सरिद्रूपा तुलसीवृक्षरूपिणी .. 88 ..
text_mt:
Go you to Bhārata with a portion of a part, O lotus-born goddess,
in the form of the Padmāvatī river and in the form of the Tulasī tree. .. 88 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe ca mokṣaṇam ..
yuṣmākaṃ saritāṃ bhūyo madgṛhe cāgamiṣyatha .. .. 89 ..
meaning:
कलेः पञ्चसहस्रे च गते वर्षे च मोक्षणम् ..
युष्माकं सरितां भूयो मद्गृहे चागमिष्यथ .. .. 89 ..
text_mt:
When five thousand years of the Kali [age] have passed,
there will be release for you rivers, and you will come back to my house. .. 89 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sampadāṃ hetubhūtā ca vipattiḥ sarvadehinām ..
vinā vipattirmahimā keṣāṃ padme bhavedbhave .. 2.6.90 ..
meaning:
सम्पदां हेतुभूता च विपत्तिः सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
विना विपत्तिर्महिमा केषां पद्मे भवेद्भवे .. 2.6.90 ..
text_mt:
Adversity is the cause of all prosperity for all embodied beings;
without adversity, whose greatness could exist in the world, O Padmā? .. 90 ..

sanskrit_iast:
manmantropāsakānāṃ ca satāṃ snānāvagāhanāt ..
yuṣmākaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpātpāpisparśanahetukāt .. 91 ..
meaning:
मन्मन्त्रोपासकानां च सतां स्नानावगाहनात् ..
युष्माकं मोक्षणं पापात्पापिस्पर्शनहेतुकात् .. 91 ..
text_mt:
From the bathing and immersion of good men who worship my mantra,
there shall be release for you from the sin caused by the touch of sinners. .. 91 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni santyasaṃkhyāni sundari ..
bhaviṣyanti ca pūtāni madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 92 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सन्त्यसंख्यानि सुन्दरि ..
भविष्यन्ति च पूतानि मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 92 ..
text_mt:
The countless sacred bathing-places that exist on earth, O beautiful one,
shall become purified by the touch and sight of my devotees. .. 92 ..

sanskrit_iast:
manmantropāsakā bhaktā bhramante bhārate sati ..
pūtaṃ karttuṃ bhārataṃ ca supavitrāṃ vasundharām .. 93 ..
meaning:
मन्मन्त्रोपासका भक्ता भ्रमन्ते भारते सति ..
पूतं कर्त्तुं भारतं च सुपवित्रां वसुन्धराम् .. 93 ..
text_mt:
Devotees who worship my mantra wander through Bhārata, O virtuous lady,
to purify Bhārata and the most sacred earth. .. 93 ..

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktā yatra tiṣṭhanti pādaṃ prakṣālayanti ca ..
tatsthānaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ supavitraṃ bhaveddhruvam .. 94 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्ता यत्र तिष्ठन्ति पादं प्रक्षालयन्ति च ..
तत्स्थानं च महातीर्थं सुपवित्रं भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 94 ..
text_mt:
Wherever my devotees stay and wash their feet,
that place surely becomes a great sacred place, exceedingly pure. .. 94 ..

sanskrit_iast:
strīghno goghnaḥ kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ ..
jīvanmukto bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 95 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीघ्नो गोघ्नः कृतघ्नश्च ब्रह्मघ्नो गुरुतल्पगः ..
जीवन्मुक्तो भवेत्पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 95 ..
text_mt:
A slayer of a woman, a slayer of a cow, an ungrateful person, a slayer of a brahmin, one who violates the guru’s bed—
each becomes liberated while living and purified through the touch and sight of my devotee. .. 95 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīvihīnaśca sandhyāhīno'pi nāstikaḥ ..
vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 96 ..
meaning:
एकादशीविहीनश्च सन्ध्याहीनोऽपि नास्तिकः ..
वृषवाहो भवेत्पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 96 ..
text_mt: One who neglects the Ekādaśī, one who neglects the twilight prayers, even an atheist,

sanskrit_iast:
asijīvī maṣījīvī dhāvakaḥ śūdrayājakaḥ ..
vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 97 ..
meaning:
असिजीवी मषीजीवी धावकः शूद्रयाजकः ..
वृषवाहो भवेत्पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 97 ..
text_mt: One who lives by the sword, one who lives by ink, a courier, a priest for Śūdras,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāsaghātī mitraghno mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ..
nyāsahārī bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 98 ..
meaning:
विश्वासघाती मित्रघ्नो मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदायकः ..
न्यासहारी भवेत्पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 98 ..
text_mt:
A betrayer of trust, a slayer of a friend, a giver of false witness,
or a thief of deposits becomes purified by the touch and sight of my devotee. .. 98 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇagrasto vārddhuṣiko jārajaḥ puṃścalīpatiḥ ..
pūtaśca puṃścalīputro madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 99 ..
meaning:
ऋणग्रस्तो वार्द्धुषिको जारजः पुंश्चलीपतिः ..
पूतश्च पुंश्चलीपुत्रो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 99 ..
text_mt:
One burdened by debt, a usurer, an adulterine child, the husband of an unchaste woman,
and the son of an unchaste woman are purified by the touch and sight of my devotee. .. 99 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca devalo grāmayājakaḥ ..
adīkṣito bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 2.6.100 ..
meaning:
शूद्राणां सूपकारश्च देवलो ग्रामयाजकः ..
अदीक्षितो भवेत्पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 2.6.100 ..
text_mt:
A cook for Śūdras, an attendant of temple idols, a village priest,
or an uninitiated person becomes purified by the touch and sight of my devotee. .. 100 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthaghātakaścaiva madbhaktānāṃ ca nindakaḥ ..
aniveditabhojī ca pūto madbhaktadarśanāt .. 101 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थघातकश्चैव मद्भक्तानां च निन्दकः ..
अनिवेदितभोजी च पूतो मद्भक्तदर्शनात् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
One who cuts down a sacred fig tree, a reviler of my devotees,
and one who eats food unoffered [to God] is purified by the sight of my devotee. .. 101 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryyāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ sutām..
guroḥ kulaṃ ca bhaginīṃ vaṃśahīnaṃ ca bāndhavam .. 102 ..
meaning:
मातरं पितरं भार्य्यां भ्रातरं तनयं सुताम्..
गुरोः कुलं च भगिनीं वंशहीनं च बान्धवम् .. 102 ..
text_mt:
[Whoever does not maintain] mother, father, wife, brother, son, daughter,
the guru's family, sister, and a relative without offspring,

sanskrit_iast:
śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva yo na puṣṇāti nārada ..
sa mahāpātakī pūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 103..
meaning:
श्वश्रूं च श्वशुरं चैव यो न पुष्णाति नारद ..
स महापातकी पूतो मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 103..
text_mt:
or mother-in-law and father-in-law, O Nārada,
that great sinner becomes purified by the touch and sight of my devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
devadravyāpahārī ca vipradravyāpahārakaḥ ..
lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vikretā duhitustathā .. 104 ..
meaning:
देवद्रव्यापहारी च विप्रद्रव्यापहारकः ..
लाक्षालोहरसानां च विक्रेता दुहितुस्तथा .. 104 ..
text_mt:
He who steals the property of the gods, he who steals the property of Brahmins,
and the seller of lac, iron, liquids, or his own daughter;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakinaścaite śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ ..
bhaveyurete pūtāśca madbhaktasparśadarśanāt .. 105 ..
meaning:
महापातकिनश्चैते शूद्राणां शवदाहकाः ..
भवेयुरेते पूताश्च मद्भक्तस्पर्शदर्शनात् .. 105 ..
text_mt:
and these great sinners who cremate the corpses of Śūdras—
these would be purified by the touch and sight of my devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīruvāca ..
bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhaktānugrahakāraka ..
yeṣāṃ sandarśanasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā narādhamāḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीरुवाच ..
भक्तानां लक्षणं ब्रूहि भक्तानुग्रहकारक ..
येषां सन्दर्शनस्पर्शात्सद्यः पूता नराधमाः .. 106 ..
text_mt:
Tell me the characteristics of devotees, O granter of grace to devotees,
by the sight and touch of whom the lowest of men are instantly purified.

sanskrit_iast:
haribhaktivihīnāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ ..
svapraśaṃsāratā dhūrttāḥ śaṭhā vai sādhu nindakāḥ .. 107 ..
meaning:
हरिभक्तिविहीनाश्च महाहङ्कारसंयुताः ..
स्वप्रशंसारता धूर्त्ताः शठा वै साधु निन्दकाः .. 107 ..
text_mt:
Those devoid of devotion to Hari, possessed of great pride,
delighting in self-praise, rogues, deceitful ones, and revilers of the virtuous—

sanskrit_iast:
punanti sarvatīrthāni yeṣāṃ snānāvagāhanāt ..
yeṣāṃ ca pādarajasā pūtā pādodakānmahī .. 108 ..
meaning:
पुनन्ति सर्वतीर्थानि येषां स्नानावगाहनात् ..
येषां च पादरजसा पूता पादोदकान्मही .. 108 ..
text_mt:
all sacred fords are purified by their bathing and immersing,
and the earth is purified by the dust of their feet and by the water [washed from] their feet.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ sandarśanaṃ sparśaṃ devā vāñchanti bhārate ..
sarveṣāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ .. 109 ..
meaning:
येषां सन्दर्शनं स्पर्शं देवा वाञ्छन्ति भारते ..
सर्वेषां परमो लाभो वैष्णवानां समागमः .. 109 ..
text_mt:
In Bhārata the gods long for the sight and touch of them;
the company of Vaiṣṇavas is the supreme gain for all.

sanskrit_iast:
na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ..
te punantyurukālena viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho.. 2.6.110 ..
meaning:
न ह्यम्मयानि तीर्थानि न देवा मृच्छिलामयाः ..
ते पुनन्त्युरुकालेन विष्णुभक्ताः क्षणादहो.. 2.6.110 ..
text_mt: they purify over a long time, but devotees of Viṣṇu [purify] in an instant, ah!

sanskrit_iast:
sautiruvāca ..
mahālakṣmīvacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīkāntaśca sasmitaḥ..
nigūḍhatattvaṃ kathitumṛṣiśreṣṭhopacakrame .. 111 ..
meaning:
सौतिरुवाच ..
महालक्ष्मीवचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मीकान्तश्च सस्मितः..
निगूढतत्त्वं कथितुमृषिश्रेष्ठोपचक्रमे .. 111 ..
text_mt:
Having heard the words of Mahālakṣmī, the beloved of Lakṣmī, smiling,
began to speak of the profound truth, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhaṃ śrutipurāṇayoḥ ..
puṇyasvarūpaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktidam .. 112 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
भक्तानां लक्षणं लक्ष्मि गूढं श्रुतिपुराणयोः ..
पुण्यस्वरूपं पापघ्नं सुखदं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् .. 112 ..
text_mt:
The characteristic of devotees, O Lakṣmī, is secret in the Śruti and the Purāṇas;
it consists of merit, destroys sin, gives happiness, and bestows enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sārabhūtaṃ gopanīyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ khaleṣu ca ..
tvāṃ pavitrāṃ prāṇatulyāṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya .. 113 ..
meaning:
सारभूतं गोपनीयं न वक्तव्यं खलेषु च ..
त्वां पवित्रां प्राणतुल्यां कथयामि निशामय .. 113 ..
text_mt:
It is essential, to be concealed, and not to be spoken to the wicked.
To you, who are pure and equal to my life-breath, I shall speak; listen.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśedvaraḥ ..
vadanti vedavedāṅgāttaṃ pavitraṃ narottamam .. 114 ..
meaning:
गुरुवक्त्राद्विष्णुमन्त्रो यस्य कर्णे विशेद्वरः ..
वदन्ति वेदवेदाङ्गात्तं पवित्रं नरोत्तमम् .. 114 ..
text_mt:
In whose ear the excellent Viṣṇu mantra enters from the mouth of a guru,
from the Vedas and Vedāṅgas they declare him pure, the best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ pūtaṃ tajjanmamātrataḥ ..
svargasthaṃ narakasthaṃ vā muktiṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt .. 115 ..
meaning:
पुरुषाणां शतं पूर्वं पूतं तज्जन्ममात्रतः ..
स्वर्गस्थं नरकस्थं वा मुक्तिं प्राप्नोति तत्क्षणात् .. 115 ..
text_mt:
A hundred ancestors are purified by his mere birth;
whether residing in heaven or in hell, they attain liberation at that moment.

sanskrit_iast:
yaiḥ kaiścidyatra vā janma labdhaṃ yeṣu ca jaṃtuṣu ..
jīvanmuktāste ca pūtā yānti kāle hareḥ padam .. 116 ..
meaning:
यैः कैश्चिद्यत्र वा जन्म लब्धं येषु च जंतुषु ..
जीवन्मुक्तास्ते च पूता यान्ति काले हरेः पदम् .. 116 ..
text_mt:
By whomever, wherever, or in whichever creatures birth has been obtained,
they, liberated while living and purified, go in time to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktiyukto matpūjāniyukto madguṇānvitaḥ .. .
madguṇaślāghanīyaśca manniviṣṭaśca santatam .. 117 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्तियुक्तो मत्पूजानियुक्तो मद्गुणान्वितः .. .
मद्गुणश्लाघनीयश्च मन्निविष्टश्च सन्ततम् .. 117 ..
text_mt: Endowed with devotion to me, engaged in my worship, possessed of my qualities, / praising my qualities, and constantly absorbed in me;

sanskrit_iast:
madguṇaśrutimātreṇa sānandaḥ pulakānvitaḥ ..
sagadgadaḥ sāśrunetraḥ svātmavismṛtireva ca .. 118 ..
meaning:
मद्गुणश्रुतिमात्रेण सानन्दः पुलकान्वितः ..
सगद्गदः साश्रुनेत्रः स्वात्मविस्मृतिरेव च .. 118 ..
text_mt:
by the mere hearing of my qualities joyful, with bristling hair,
stammering, with tearful eyes, and having forgotten his own self;

sanskrit_iast:
na vāñchanti sukhaṃ muktiṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam ..
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tadvāñchā mama sevane .. 119 ..
meaning:
न वाञ्छन्ति सुखं मुक्तिं सालोक्यादि चतुष्टयम् ..
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा तद्वाञ्छा मम सेवने .. 119 ..
text_mt:
they do not desire pleasure, or liberation consisting of the fourfold [states] such as residence in the same realm,
or the status of Brahmā, or immortality; their desire is for service to me.

sanskrit_iast:
indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca devatvaṃ ca sudurlabham ..
svargarājyādibhogaṃ ca svapne'pi na hi vācchati .. 2.6.120 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रत्वं च मनुत्वं च देवत्वं च सुदुर्लभम् ..
स्वर्गराज्यादिभोगं च स्वप्नेऽपि न हि वाच्छति .. 2.6.120 ..
text_mt:
The status of Indra, the status of Manu, and godhood, which is very hard to obtain,
and the enjoyment of the heavenly kingdom and the like—he does not desire even in a dream.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍāni vinaśyanti devā brahmādayastathā ..
kalyāṇabhaktiyuktaśca madbhakto na praṇaśyati .. 121 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डानि विनश्यन्ति देवा ब्रह्मादयस्तथा ..
