meaning:
आशुतोषं प्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ..
विश्वनाथं विश्वरूपं विश्वबीजं च विश्वजम् .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viśvambharaṃ viśvavaraṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam ..
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca narakārṇavatāraṇam .. 27 ..
meaning:
विश्वम्भरं विश्ववरं विश्वसंहारकारणम् ..
कारणं कारणानां च नरकार्णवतारणम् .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jñānapradaṃ jñānabījaṃ jñānānandaṃ sanātanam ..
avaruhya vimānācca sa dṛṣṭvā dānaveśvaraḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानप्रदं ज्ञानबीजं ज्ञानानन्दं सनातनम् ..
अवरुह्य विमानाच्च स दृष्ट्वा दानवेश्वरः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhaktiyuktaḥ śirasā praṇanāma saḥ ..
vāmato bhadrakālīṃ ca skandaṃ tatpurataḥ sthitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
सर्वैः सार्द्धं भक्तियुक्तः शिरसा प्रणनाम सः ..
वामतो भद्रकालीं च स्कन्दं तत्पुरतः स्थितम् .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āśiṣaṃ ca dadau tasmai kālī skandaśca śaṅkaraḥ ..
uttasthurdānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ..2.18.30..
meaning:
आशिषं च ददौ तस्मै काली स्कन्दश्च शङ्करः ..
उत्तस्थुर्दानवं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे नन्दीश्वरादयः ..2.18.30..

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaṃ ca sambhāṣāṃ te cakustatra sāmpratam..
rājā kṛtvā ca sambhāṣāmuvāsa śivasannidhau ..31..
meaning:
परस्परं च सम्भाषां ते चकुस्तत्र साम्प्रतम्..
राजा कृत्वा च सम्भाषामुवास शिवसन्निधौ ..31..

sanskrit_iast: prasannātmā mahādevo bhagavāṃstamuvāca ha .. 32 ..
meaning: प्रसन्नात्मा महादेवो भगवांस्तमुवाच ह .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
vidhātā jagatāṃ brahmā pitā dharmasya dharmavit ..
marīcistasya putraśca vaiṣṇavaścāpi dhārmikaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
विधाता जगतां ब्रह्मा पिता धर्मस्य धर्मवित् ..
मरीचिस्तस्य पुत्रश्च वैष्णवश्चापि धार्मिकः .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapaścāpi tatputro dharmiṣṭhaśca prajāpatiḥ ..
dakṣaḥ prītyā dadau tasmai bhaktyā kanyāstrayodaśa .. 34 ..
meaning:
कश्यपश्चापि तत्पुत्रो धर्मिष्ठश्च प्रजापतिः ..
दक्षः प्रीत्या ददौ तस्मै भक्त्या कन्यास्त्रयोदश .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāsvekā ca danuḥ sādhvī tatsaubhāgyena varddhitā ..
catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrā dānavāstejasojjvalāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तास्वेका च दनुः साध्वी तत्सौभाग्येन वर्द्धिता ..
चत्वारिंशद्दनोः पुत्रा दानवास्तेजसोज्ज्वलाः .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
teṣveko vipracittiśca mahābalaparākramaḥ ..
tatputro dhārmiko dambho viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
तेष्वेको विप्रचित्तिश्च महाबलपराक्रमः ..
तत्पुत्रो धार्मिको दम्भो विष्णुभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ puṣkare lakṣavatsaram ..
śukācāryyaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
जजाप परमं मन्त्रं पुष्करे लक्षवत्सरम् ..
शुकाचार्य्यं गुरुं कृत्वा कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tvāṃ tanayaṃ prāpa paraṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam ..
purā tvaṃ pārṣado gopo gopeṣvaṣṭasu dhārmikaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
तदा त्वां तनयं प्राप परं कृष्णपरायणम् ..
पुरा त्वं पार्षदो गोपो गोपेष्वष्टसु धार्मिकः .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā rādhikāśāpādbhārate dānaveśvaraḥ ..
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ bhramaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
अधुना राधिकाशापाद्भारते दानवेश्वरः ..
आब्रह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं भ्रमं मेने च वैष्णवः .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikyaṃ harerapi ..
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sevanaṃ vinā..2.18.40..
meaning:
सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसारूप्यसामीप्यैक्यं हरेरपि ..
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति वैष्णवाः सेवनं विना..2.18.40..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tucchaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ..
indratvaṃ vā kuberatvaṃ na mene gaṇanāsu ca .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा तुच्छं मेने च वैष्णवः ..
इन्द्रत्वं वा कुबेरत्वं न मेने गणनासु च .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇabhaktasya te kiṃ vā devānāṃ viṣaye bhrame ..
dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ matprītiṃ kuru bhūmipa .. 42 ..
meaning:
कृष्णभक्तस्य ते किं वा देवानां विषये भ्रमे ..
देहि राज्यं च देवानां मत्प्रीतिं कुरु भूमिप .. 42 ..
text_mt:
For you, a devotee of Kṛṣṇa, what delusion is there regarding the realm of the gods?
Return the kingdom to the gods, and give me pleasure, O king. (42)

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ svarājye tvaṃ tiṣṭha devāssantu svake pade ..
alaṃ bhrātṛvirodhena sarve kaśyapavaṃśajāḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
सुखं स्वराज्ये त्वं तिष्ठ देवास्सन्तु स्वके पदे ..
अलं भ्रातृविरोधेन सर्वे कश्यपवंशजाः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Remain happily in your own kingdom; let the gods abide in their own stations.
Enough of enmity between brothers! All are born from Kaśyapa's lineage. (43)

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
jñātidrohasya pāpasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 44 ..
meaning:
यानि कानि च पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ..
ज्ञातिद्रोहस्य पापस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: do not equal a sixteenth part of the sin of treachery toward one's kin. (44)

sanskrit_iast:
svasampadāṃ ca hāniṃ ca yadi rājendra manyase ..
sarvāvasthāsu samatā keṣāṃ yāti ca sarvadā..45..
meaning:
स्वसम्पदां च हानिं च यदि राजेन्द्र मन्यसे ..
सर्वावस्थासु समता केषां याति च सर्वदा..45..
text_mt:
And if you consider [this] a loss of your own wealth, O king of kings,
for whom does constancy always endure throughout all conditions? (45)

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaśca tirobhāvo laye prākṛtike sati ..
āvirbhāvaḥ punastasya prabhavedīśvarecchayā.. .. 46 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणश्च तिरोभावो लये प्राकृतिके सति ..
आविर्भावः पुनस्तस्य प्रभवेदीश्वरेच्छया.. .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Even Brahmā undergoes disappearance when the cosmic dissolution occurs;
and his appearance arises again only by the will of the Supreme Lord. (46)

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ buddhiśca tapasā smṛtirlokasya niścitam ..
karoti sṛṣṭiṃ jñānena sraṣṭā so'pi krameṇa ca ..47..
meaning:
ज्ञानं बुद्धिश्च तपसा स्मृतिर्लोकस्य निश्चितम् ..
करोति सृष्टिं ज्ञानेन स्रष्टा सोऽपि क्रमेण च ..47..
text_mt:
Knowledge, intellect, and certainly the memory of the world [arise] through austerity;
and with knowledge that creator also brings forth creation in due order. (47)

sanskrit_iast:
paripūrṇatamo dharmaḥ satye satyāśrayaḥ sadā ..
so'pi tribhāgastretāyāṃ dvibhāgo dvāpare smṛtaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
परिपूर्णतमो धर्मः सत्ये सत्याश्रयः सदा ..
सोऽपि त्रिभागस्त्रेतायां द्विभागो द्वापरे स्मृतः .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Dharma is most complete in the Satya [age], always resting on truth;
it is remembered as three parts in Tretā, and two parts in Dvāpara. (48)

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhāgaḥ kaleḥ pūrve taddhrāsaśca krameṇa ca ..
kalāmātraṃ kaleḥ śeṣe kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā .. 49 ..
meaning:
एकभागः कलेः पूर्वे तद्ध्रासश्च क्रमेण च ..
कलामात्रं कलेः शेषे कुह्वां चन्द्रकला यथा .. 49 ..
text_mt:
It is one part at the beginning of Kali, and gradually suffers decline,
until only a single digit [remains] at the end of Kali, like the digit of the moon on the new moon night. (49)

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛktejo ravergrīṣme na tādṛkśiśire punaḥ ..
dine ca yādṛṅ madhyāhne sāyaṃprātarna tatsamam .. 2.18.50 ..
meaning:
यादृक्तेजो रवेर्ग्रीष्मे न तादृक्शिशिरे पुनः ..
दिने च यादृङ् मध्याह्ने सायंप्रातर्न तत्समम् .. 2.18.50 ..
text_mt:
Such splendour as the sun has in summer is not the same in winter;
and what it has at midday is not equalled at evening or at dawn. (50)

sanskrit_iast:
udayaṃ yāti kālena bālyatāṃ ca krameṇa ca ..
prakāṇḍatāṃ ca tatpaścātkāle'staṃ punareva saḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
उदयं याति कालेन बाल्यतां च क्रमेण च ..
प्रकाण्डतां च तत्पश्चात्कालेऽस्तं पुनरेव सः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
It attains rising in time, and childhood in due course,
and full maturity thereafter; and then, in time, it sets once more. (51)

sanskrit_iast:
dine pracchannatāṃ yāti kāle vai durdine ghane ..
rāhugraste kampitaśca punareva prasannatām .. 52 ..
meaning:
दिने प्रच्छन्नतां याति काले वै दुर्दिने घने ..
राहुग्रस्ते कम्पितश्च पुनरेव प्रसन्नताम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
It becomes concealed by day when time brings thick, foul weather;
and swallowed by Rāhu, it trembles, yet again attains clarity. (52)

sanskrit_iast:
paripūrṇatamaścandraḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yādṛśaḥ.. .
tādṛśo na bhavennityaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine ..53..
meaning:
परिपूर्णतमश्चन्द्रः पूर्णिमायां च यादृशः.. .
तादृशो न भवेन्नित्यं क्षयं याति दिनेदिने ..53..
text_mt: Just as the moon is most complete on the full moon night, / it cannot remain so constantly, but wanes day by day. (53)

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ sa puṣṭatāṃ yāti parakuhvā dinedine ..
sampadyuktaḥ śuklapakṣe kṛṣṇe mlānaśca yakṣmaṇā .. 54 ..
meaning:
पुनः स पुष्टतां याति परकुह्वा दिनेदिने ..
सम्पद्युक्तः शुक्लपक्षे कृष्णे म्लानश्च यक्ष्मणा .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Again it attains fullness day by day after the new moon;
endowed with prosperity in the bright fortnight, and faded by consumption in the dark fortnight. (54)

sanskrit_iast:
rāhugraste dine mlāno durdine nibiḍe ghane ..
kāle candro bhavecchuddho bhraṣṭaśrīḥ kālabhedake .. 55 ..
meaning:
राहुग्रस्ते दिने म्लानो दुर्दिने निबिडे घने ..
काले चन्द्रो भवेच्छुद्धो भ्रष्टश्रीः कालभेदके .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Faded by day when seized by Rāhu, or in thick, heavy foul weather;
in time the moon becomes pure, and at a shift of time its splendour is lost. (55)

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati baliścendro bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sutale'dhunā ..
kālena pṛthvī sasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā .. 56 ..
meaning:
भविष्यति बलिश्चेन्द्रो भ्रष्टश्रीः सुतलेऽधुना ..
कालेन पृथ्वी सस्याढ्या सर्वाधारा वसुन्धरा .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Bali, who will be Indra, is now stripped of fortune in Sutala.
In time the earth is rich with crops, the bearer of wealth that supports all; (56)

sanskrit_iast:
kāle jale nimagnā sā tirobhūtā vipadgatā ..
kāle naśyanti viśvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
काले जले निमग्ना सा तिरोभूता विपद्गता ..
काले नश्यन्ति विश्वानि प्रभवन्त्येव कालतः .. 97 ..
text_mt:
in time she is submerged in the waters, vanished, fallen into calamity.
In time the universes perish, and by time alone they arise. (57)

sanskrit_iast:
carācarāśca kālena naśyanti prabhavanti ca ..
īśvarasyaiva samatā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
चराचराश्च कालेन नश्यन्ति प्रभवन्ति च ..
ईश्वरस्यैव समता कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
The moving and unmoving things perish and arise through time;
only the Supreme Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, has constancy. (58)

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo yasmādasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam ..
adṛśyaṃ cāpi paśyāmi vāraṃ vāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ .. .. 59 ..
meaning:
अहं मृत्युञ्जयो यस्मादसंख्यं प्राकृतं लयम् ..
अदृश्यं चापि पश्यामि वारं वारं पुनः पुनः .. .. 59 ..
text_mt:
I am the conqueror of death because countless cosmic dissolutions,
invisible [to others], I witness time and time again. (59)

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca prakṛtirūpaśca sa eva puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sa cātmā sarvajīvaśca nānārūpadharaḥ paraḥ .. 2.18.60 ..
meaning:
स च प्रकृतिरूपश्च स एव पुरुषः स्मृतः ..
स चात्मा सर्वजीवश्च नानारूपधरः परः .. 2.18.60 ..
text_mt:
He is the embodiment of Prakṛti, and he is remembered as Puruṣa;
and he is the Self, every living being, the Supreme who assumes manifold forms. (60)

sanskrit_iast:
karoti satataṃ yo hi tannāmaguṇakīrttanam ..
kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ sa jayati janma rogaṃ jarāṃ bhayam .. 61 ..
meaning:
करोति सततं यो हि तन्नामगुणकीर्त्तनम् ..
कालं मृत्युं स जयति जन्म रोगं जरां भयम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Whoever constantly engages in chanting the praises of his names and qualities
conquers time, death, birth, disease, old age, and fear. (61)

sanskrit_iast:
sraṣṭā kṛto vidhistena pātā viṣṇuḥ kṛto bhave ..
ahaṃ kṛtaśca saṃharttā vayaṃ viṣayiṇo yataḥ ..62..
meaning:
स्रष्टा कृतो विधिस्तेन पाता विष्णुः कृतो भवे ..
अहं कृतश्च संहर्त्ता वयं विषयिणो यतः ..62..
text_mt:
By him Brahmā was made creator, and Viṣṇu was made protector in the world;
and I was made destroyer, since we are involved with active affairs. (62)

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirudraṃ saṃhāre niyujya viṣaye nṛpa ..
ahaṃ karomi satataṃ tannāmaguṇakīrttanam .. .. 63 ..
meaning:
कालाग्निरुद्रं संहारे नियुज्य विषये नृप ..
अहं करोमि सततं तन्नामगुणकीर्त्तनम् .. .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Having appointed the Kālāgnirudra in the affair of destruction, O king,
I constantly chant the praises of his names and qualities. (63)

sanskrit_iast:
tena mṛtyuñjayo'haṃ ca jñānenānena nirbhayaḥ ..
mṛtyurmatto bhayādyāti vainateyādivoragaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
तेन मृत्युञ्जयोऽहं च ज्ञानेनानेन निर्भयः ..
मृत्युर्मत्तो भयाद्याति वैनतेयादिवोरगः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, through this knowledge, I have conquered death and am free from fear;
death flees from me in terror, like a snake from the son of Vinatā. (64)

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa ca sarveśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ..
virarāmātha śarvaśca sabhāmadhye ca nārada .. 69 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स च सर्वेशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वभावनः ..
विररामाथ शर्वश्च सभामध्ये च नारद .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, that lord of all, all-knowing, the author of all beings,
Śarva then ceased in the midst of the assembly, O Nārada. (65)

sanskrit_iast:
rājā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ ..
uvāca suṃdaraṃ devaṃ paraṃ vinayapūrvakam .. 66 ..
meaning:
राजा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रशशंस पुनः पुनः ..
उवाच सुंदरं देवं परं विनयपूर्वकम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Having heard his speech, the king praised it again and again,
and spoke to the handsome god with utmost humility. (66)

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca ..
tvayā yatkathitaṃ nātha sarvaṃ satyaṃ ca nānṛtam ..
tathā'pi kiñcidyatsatyaṃ śrūyatāṃ mannivedanam .. 67 ..
meaning:
शंखचूड उवाच ..
त्वया यत्कथितं नाथ सर्वं सत्यं च नानृतम् ..
तथाऽपि किञ्चिद्यत्सत्यं श्रूयतां मन्निवेदनम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
All that was spoken by you, O master, is true and not false;
nevertheless, hear my submission, whatever truth there is in it. (67)

sanskrit_iast:
jñātidrohe mahatpāpaṃ tvayoktamadhunā trayam ..
gṛhītvā tasya sarvasvaṃ kutaḥ prasthāpito baliḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
ज्ञातिद्रोहे महत्पापं त्वयोक्तमधुना त्रयम् ..
गृहीत्वा तस्य सर्वस्वं कुतः प्रस्थापितो बलिः .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Just now you proclaimed that there is great sin in treachery toward kin;
why was Bali banished after having seized all that was his? (68)

sanskrit_iast:
mayā samuddhṛtaṃ sarvamaiśvaryyaṃ vikrameṇa ca ..
sutalācca samuddhartuṃ nālaṃ so'pi gadādharaḥ ..69 ..
meaning:
मया समुद्धृतं सर्वमैश्वर्य्यं विक्रमेण च ..
सुतलाच्च समुद्धर्तुं नालं सोऽपि गदाधरः ..69 ..
text_mt:
All this sovereignty was won by me through valour;
even that wielder of the mace is unable to deliver it from Sutala. (69)

sanskrit_iast:
sabhrātṛko hiraṇyākṣaḥ kathaṃ devaiśca hiṃsitaḥ ..
śumbhādayaścāsurā vai kathaṃ devairnipātitāḥ .. 2.18.70 ..
meaning:
सभ्रातृको हिरण्याक्षः कथं देवैश्च हिंसितः ..
शुम्भादयश्चासुरा वै कथं देवैर्निपातिताः .. 2.18.70 ..
text_mt:
Why was Hiraṇyākṣa along with his brother destroyed by the gods?
And how were the asuras such as Śumbha struck down by the gods? (70)

sanskrit_iast:
purā samudramathane pīyūṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ suraiḥ ..
kleśabhājo vayaṃ tatra taiḥ sarvaphalabhājanaiḥ.. .. 71 ..
meaning:
पुरा समुद्रमथने पीयूषं भक्षितं सुरैः ..
क्लेशभाजो वयं तत्र तैः सर्वफलभाजनैः.. .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Long ago, at the churning of the ocean, the nectar was consumed by the gods;
we endured the hardship there, while they enjoyed all the fruits. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍābhāṇḍamidaṃ viśvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
yadā dadāti yasmai sa tasyaiśvaryaṃ bhavettadā .. 72 ..
meaning:
क्रीडाभाण्डमिदं विश्वं कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..
यदा ददाति यस्मै स तस्यैश्वर्यं भवेत्तदा .. 72 ..
text_mt:
This universe is a plaything of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman;
when he gives [it] to whomsoever, dominion belongs to that one at that time. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavayorvādaḥ śaśvannaimittikaḥ sadā ..
parājayo jayasteṣāṃ kāle'smākaṃ krameṇa ca .. 73 ..
meaning:
देवदानवयोर्वादः शश्वन्नैमित्तिकः सदा ..
पराजयो जयस्तेषां कालेऽस्माकं क्रमेण च .. 73 ..
text_mt:
The dispute between gods and Dānavas is perpetual, constant, and occasioned [by time];
defeat and victory belong to them and to us in due course through time. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvayorvirodhe ca gamanaṃ niṣphalaṃ tava ..
sama sambandhinorbandhvorīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
तत्रावयोर्विरोधे च गमनं निष्फलं तव ..
सम सम्बन्धिनोर्बन्ध्वोरीश्वरस्य महात्मनः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, in our dispute, your intervention is fruitless,
for an impartial Lord, a high-souled relative and kinsman of both sides. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate mahatī lajjā sparddhā'smābhiḥ sahādhunā ..
tato'dhikā ca samare kīrtti hāniḥ parājaye .. 75 ..
meaning:
जायते महती लज्जा स्पर्द्धाऽस्माभिः सहाधुना ..
ततोऽधिका च समरे कीर्त्ति हानिः पराजये .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Great shame arises now from rivalry with us,
and even greater loss of fame in battle upon defeat." // 75

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhacūḍavacaḥ śrutvā prahasyāha trilocanaḥ ..
yathocitaṃ sumadhuramatyugraṃ dānaveśvaram .. 76 ..
meaning:
शंखचूडवचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्याह त्रिलोचनः ..
यथोचितं सुमधुरमत्युग्रं दानवेश्वरम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Hearing Śaṅkhacūḍa's words, the Three-eyed Lord laughed and said
to the extremely fierce lord of Dānavas what was fitting and very sweet: // 76

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
yuṣmābhiḥ saha yuddhaṃ me brahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ ..
kā lajjā mahatī rājannakīrtirvā parājaye .. 77 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
युष्माभिः सह युद्धं मे ब्रह्मवंशसमुद्भवैः ..
का लज्जा महती राजन्नकीर्तिर्वा पराजये .. 77 ..
text_mt:
"For me to battle with you who are born of the lineage of Brahmā—
what great shame can there be, O king, or what infamy in defeat? // 77

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhamādau harereva madhunā kaiṭabhena ca ..
hiraṇyakaśipoścaiva saha tenātmanā nṛpa .. 78 ..
meaning:
युद्धमादौ हरेरेव मधुना कैटभेन च ..
हिरण्यकशिपोश्चैव सह तेनात्मना नृप .. 78 ..
text_mt:
In the beginning, Hari himself fought with Madhu and Kaiṭabha,
and indeed with Hiraṇyakaśipu himself, O king; // 78

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣasya yuddhaṃ ca punastena gadābhṛtā ..
tripuraiḥ saha yuddhaṃ ca mayā cāpi purā kṛtam .. 79 ..
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षस्य युद्धं च पुनस्तेन गदाभृता ..
त्रिपुरैः सह युद्धं च मया चापि पुरा कृतम् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
and with Hiraṇyākṣa there was battle again by that wielder of the mace;
and battle with the Tripuras was also waged by me in the past. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvaryyāḥ sarvamātuḥ prakṛtyāśca babhūva ha ..
saha śumbhādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ samaraṃ paramādbhutam .. 2.18.80 ..
meaning:
सर्वेश्वर्य्याः सर्वमातुः प्रकृत्याश्च बभूव ह ..
सह शुम्भादिभिः पूर्वं समरं परमाद्भुतम् .. 2.18.80 ..
text_mt:
And of Prakṛti, the sovereign of all and mother of all,
there was formerly a most wonderful battle with Śumbha and the others. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
pārṣadapravarastvaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
ye ye hatāśca te daityā nahi ke'pi tvayā samāḥ.. 81 ..
meaning:
पार्षदप्रवरस्त्वं च कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..
ये ये हताश्च ते दैत्या नहि केऽपि त्वया समाः.. 81 ..
text_mt:
Moreover, you are an eminent attendant of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman;
whichever Daityas were slain, none of them were equal to you. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
kā lajjā mahatī rājanmama yuddhe tvayā saha ..
surāṇāṃ śaraṇasyaiva preṣitasya hareraho .. 82 ..
meaning:
का लज्जा महती राजन्मम युद्धे त्वया सह ..
सुराणां शरणस्यैव प्रेषितस्य हरेरहो .. 82 ..
text_mt:
What great shame can there be, O king, in my battling with you,
I who am indeed the refuge of the gods, sent by Hari, oh! // 82

sanskrit_iast:
dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ vāgvyaye kiṃ prayojanam ..
yuddhaṃ mā kuru matsārddhamiti me niścitaṃ vacaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
देहि राज्यं च देवानां वाग्व्यये किं प्रयोजनम् ..
युद्धं मा कुरु मत्सार्द्धमिति मे निश्चितं वचः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Give the kingdom back to the gods; what is the use of wasting words?
Do not wage war against me—this is my settled word." // 83

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra virarāma ca nārada ..
uttasthau śaṃkhacūḍaśca svāmānyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शंकरस्तत्र विरराम च नारद ..
उत्तस्थौ शंखचूडश्च स्वामान्यैः सह सत्वरः .. 84 ..
text_mt: and Śaṅkhacūḍa stood up quickly along with his ministers. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śivaṃ praṇamya śirasā dānavendraḥ pratāpavān ..
samāruroha yānaṃ ca svāmātyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
शिवं प्रणम्य शिरसा दानवेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ..
समारुरोह यानं च स्वामात्यैः सह सत्वरः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 19

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvuste ca saṃkṣubdhāḥ skandaśaktyā'rditāstadā ..
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha .. 2 ..
meaning:
बभूवुस्ते च संक्षुब्धाः स्कन्दशक्त्याऽर्दितास्तदा ..
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
skandasyopari tatraiva samare ca bhayaṅkare ..
skandasya samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadadbhutamulbaṇam .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्कन्दस्योपरि तत्रैव समरे च भयङ्करे ..
स्कन्दस्य समरं दृष्ट्वा महदद्भुतमुल्बणम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dānavānāṃ kṣayakaraṃ yathā prākṛtikaṃ layam ..
rājā vimānamāruhya śaravarṣaṃ cakāra ha .. 4 ..
meaning:
दानवानां क्षयकरं यथा प्राकृतिकं लयम् ..
राजा विमानमारुह्य शरवर्षं चकार ह .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭiśca ghanavṛṣṭiryathā tathā ..
mahānghorāndhakāraśca vahnyutthānaṃ babhūva ha .. 5 ..
meaning:
नृपस्य शरवृष्टिश्च घनवृष्टिर्यथा तथा ..
महान्घोरान्धकारश्च वह्न्युत्थानं बभूव ह .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
devāḥ pradudruvuścānye sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ..
ekākī kārttikeyastu tasthau samaramūrddhani .. 6 ..
meaning:
देवाः प्रदुद्रुवुश्चान्ये सर्वे नन्दीश्वरादयः ..
एकाकी कार्त्तिकेयस्तु तस्थौ समरमूर्द्धनि .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śilānāṃ śākhināṃ tathā ..
śaśvaccakāra vṛṣṭiṃ ca durvāhyāṃ ca bhayaṅkarīm .. 7 ..
meaning:
पर्वतानां च सर्पाणां शिलानां शाखिनां तथा ..
शश्वच्चकार वृष्टिं च दुर्वाह्यां च भयङ्करीम् .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭyā ca pracchannaḥ śivanandanaḥ .
nīradena ca sāndreṇa saṃcchanno bhāskaro yathā ..8..
meaning:
नृपस्य शरवृष्ट्या च प्रच्छन्नः शिवनन्दनः .
नीरदेन च सान्द्रेण संच्छन्नो भास्करो यथा ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
dhanusskandasya ciccheda durvahaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ..
babhañja ca rathaṃ divyaṃ ciccheda rathaghoṭakān .. 9 ..
meaning:
धनुस्स्कन्दस्य चिच्छेद दुर्वहं च भयङ्करम् ..
बभञ्ज च रथं दिव्यं चिच्छेद रथघोटकान् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mayūraṃ jarjjarībhūtaṃ divyāstreṇa cakāra saḥ ..
śaktiṃ cikṣepa sūryyābhāṃ tasya vakṣovibhedinīm .. 2.19.10 ..
meaning:
मयूरं जर्ज्जरीभूतं दिव्यास्त्रेण चकार सः ..
शक्तिं चिक्षेप सूर्य्याभां तस्य वक्षोविभेदिनीम् .. 2.19.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāṃ ca saṃprāpya cetanāmupalabhya saḥ ..
gṛhītvā'nyaddhanurdivyaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇunā purā .. 11 ..
meaning:
क्षणं मूर्छां च संप्राप्य चेतनामुपलभ्य सः ..
गृहीत्वाऽन्यद्धनुर्दिव्यं यद्दत्तं विष्णुना पुरा .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ yānamāruhya cāgnibhūḥ ..
śastramastraṃ gṛhītvā ca cakāra raṇamulbaṇam .. 12 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचितं यानमारुह्य चाग्निभूः ..
शस्त्रमस्त्रं गृहीत्वा च चकार रणमुल्बणम् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca prastarāṃstathā ..
sarvāṃściccheda kopena divyāstreṇa śivātmajaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
सर्पांश्च पर्वतांश्चैव वृक्षांश्च प्रस्तरांस्तथा ..
सर्वांश्चिच्छेद कोपेन दिव्यास्त्रेण शिवात्मजः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyaṃ vāruṇāstreṇa vārayāmāsa vai guhaḥ ..
rathaṃ dhanuśca ciccheda śaṃkhacūḍasya līlayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
आग्नेयं वारुणास्त्रेण वारयामास वै गुहः ..
रथं धनुश्च चिच्छेद शंखचूडस्य लीलया .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
savāhaṃ sārathiṃ caiva kirīṭaṃ mukuṭojjvalam ..
cikṣepa śaktimulkābhāṃ dānavendrasya vakṣasi .. 15 ..
meaning:
सवाहं सारथिं चैव किरीटं मुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ..
चिक्षेप शक्तिमुल्काभां दानवेन्द्रस्य वक्षसि .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rājopalabhya vai cetanāṃ punaḥ ..
āruhya vai yānamanyaṃ dhanurjagrāha satvaraḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छां संप्राप्य राजोपलभ्य वै चेतनां पुनः ..
आरुह्य वै यानमन्यं धनुर्जग्राह सत्वरः .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra śarajālaṃ ca māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ ..
guhaṃ cācchādya samare śarajālena nārada .. 17 ..
meaning:
चकार शरजालं च मायया मायिनां वरः ..
गुहं चाच्छाद्य समरे शरजालेन नारद .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha śaktimavyarthāṃ śatasūryyasamaprabhām ..
pralayāgniśikhārūpāṃ viṣṇorvai tejasā vṛtām .. 18 ..
meaning:
जग्राह शक्तिमव्यर्थां शतसूर्य्यसमप्रभाम् ..
प्रलयाग्निशिखारूपां विष्णोर्वै तेजसा वृताम् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa tāṃ ca kopena mahāvegena kārttike ..
papāta śaktistadgātre vahnirāśirivojjvalā .. 19 ..
meaning:
चिक्षेप तां च कोपेन महावेगेन कार्त्तिके ..
पपात शक्तिस्तद्गात्रे वह्निराशिरिवोज्ज्वला .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa śaktyā ca kārttikeyo mahābalaḥ ..
kālī gṛhītvā taṃ kroḍe nināya śivasannidhau .. 2.19.20 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छां संप्राप शक्त्या च कार्त्तिकेयो महाबलः ..
काली गृहीत्वा तं क्रोडे निनाय शिवसन्निधौ .. 2.19.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śivastaṃ darśanādeva jīvayāmāsa līlayā ..
dadau balamanantaṃ ca sa cottasthau pratāpavān .. 21 ..
meaning:
शिवस्तं दर्शनादेव जीवयामास लीलया ..
ददौ बलमनन्तं च स चोत्तस्थौ प्रतापवान् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ svasainyaṃ devāṃśca prerayāmāsa satvaraḥ..
dānavendraiḥ sasainyaiśca yuddhārambho babhūva ha .. 22 ..
meaning:
शिवः स्वसैन्यं देवांश्च प्रेरयामास सत्वरः..
दानवेन्द्रैः ससैन्यैश्च युद्धारम्भो बभूव ह .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ mahendro yuyudhe sārddhaṃ ca vṛṣaparvaṇā ..
bhāskaro yuyudhe vipracittinā saha satvaraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
स्वयं महेन्द्रो युयुधे सार्द्धं च वृषपर्वणा ..
भास्करो युयुधे विप्रचित्तिना सह सत्वरः .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dambhena saha candraśca cakāra samaraṃ param ..
kāleśvareṇa kālaśca gokarṇena hutāśanaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
दम्भेन सह चन्द्रश्च चकार समरं परम् ..
कालेश्वरेण कालश्च गोकर्णेन हुताशनः .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kuberaḥ kālakeyena viśvakarmā mayena ca ..
bhayaṅkareṇa mṛtyuśca saṃhāreṇa yamastathā .. 29 ..
meaning:
कुबेरः कालकेयेन विश्वकर्मा मयेन च ..
भयङ्करेण मृत्युश्च संहारेण यमस्तथा .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalaviṅkena varuṇaścañcalena samīraṇaḥ ..
budhaśca dhṛtapuṣṭena raktākṣeṇa śanaiścaraḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
कलविङ्केन वरुणश्चञ्चलेन समीरणः ..
बुधश्च धृतपुष्टेन रक्ताक्षेण शनैश्चरः .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jayanto ratnasāreṇa vasavo varcasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ..
aśvinau vai dīptimatā dhūmreṇa nalakūbaraḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
जयन्तो रत्नसारेण वसवो वर्चसां गणैः ..
अश्विनौ वै दीप्तिमता धूम्रेण नलकूबरः .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurddhareṇa dharmaśca maṇḍūkākṣeṇa maṅgalaḥ ..
śobhākareṇaiveśānaḥ piṭhareṇa ca manmathaḥ ..28..
meaning:
धनुर्द्धरेण धर्मश्च मण्डूकाक्षेण मङ्गलः ..
शोभाकरेणैवेशानः पिठरेण च मन्मथः ..28..

sanskrit_iast:
ulkāmukhena dhūmreṇa khaṅgenāpi dhvajena ca ..
kāṃcīmukhena piṇḍena dhūmreṇa saha nandinā .. 29 ..
meaning:
उल्कामुखेन धूम्रेण खङ्गेनापि ध्वजेन च ..
कांचीमुखेन पिण्डेन धूम्रेण सह नन्दिना .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viśvena ca palāśena cādityā yuyudhuḥ param ..
ekādaśa mahārudrāścaikādaśa bhayaṅkaraiḥ .. 2.19.30 ..
meaning:
विश्वेन च पलाशेन चादित्या युयुधुः परम् ..
एकादश महारुद्राश्चैकादश भयङ्करैः .. 2.19.30 ..
text_mt: with Viśva and Palāśa, the Ādityas fought greatly;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmārī ca yuyudhe cogradaṇḍādibhiḥ saha ..
nandīśvarādayaḥ sarve dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha .. 31 ..
meaning:
महामारी च युयुधे चोग्रदण्डादिभिः सह ..
नन्दीश्वरादयः सर्वे दानवानां गणैः सह .. 31 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhuśca mahadyuddhe pralaye ca bhayaṅkare ..
vaṭamūle ca śambhuśca tasthau kālyā sutena ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
युयुधुश्च महद्युद्धे प्रलये च भयङ्करे ..
वटमूले च शम्भुश्च तस्थौ काल्या सुतेन च .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarve ca yuyudhuḥ sainyasamūhāḥ satataṃ mune ..
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye koṭibhirdānavaiḥ saha .. 33 ..
meaning:
सर्वे च युयुधुः सैन्यसमूहाः सततं मुने ..
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये कोटिभिर्दानवैः सह .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
uvāsa śaṃkhacūḍaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
śaṅkarasya ca yodhāśca yuddhe sarve parājitāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
उवास शंखचूडश्च रत्नभूषणभूषितः ..
शङ्करस्य च योधाश्च युद्धे सर्वे पराजिताः .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca dudruvuḥ sarve bhītāśca kṣatavikṣatāḥ ..
cakāra kopaṃ skandaśca devebhyaścābhayaṃ dadau .. 39 ..
meaning:
देवाश्च दुद्रुवुः सर्वे भीताश्च क्षतविक्षताः ..
चकार कोपं स्कन्दश्च देवेभ्यश्चाभयं ददौ .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ ca svagaṇānāṃ vai varddhayāmāsa tejasā..
svayamekaśca yuyudhe dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha .. 36 ..
meaning:
बलं च स्वगणानां वै वर्द्धयामास तेजसा..
स्वयमेकश्च युयुधे दानवानां गणैः सह .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ samare sa jaghāna ha ..
kharparaṃ pātayāmāsa kālī kamalalocanā .. 37 ..
meaning:
अक्षौहिणीनां शतकं समरे स जघान ह ..
खर्परं पातयामास काली कमललोचना .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
papau raktaṃ dānavānāṃ kruddhā sā śatakharparam ..
daśalakṣaṃ gajendrāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca vājinām .. 38 ..
meaning:
पपौ रक्तं दानवानां क्रुद्धा सा शतखर्परम् ..
दशलक्षं गजेन्द्राणां शतलक्षं च वाजिनाम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: a million lordly elephants and ten million horses

sanskrit_iast:
samādāyaikahastena mukhe cikṣepa līlayā ..
kabandhānāṃ sahasraṃ ca nanartta samare mune .. 39 ..
meaning:
समादायैकहस्तेन मुखे चिक्षेप लीलया ..
कबन्धानां सहस्रं च ननर्त्त समरे मुने .. 39 ..
text_mt:
she took up with one hand and tossed playfully into her mouth.
And a thousand headless trunks danced in the battle, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
skandasya śarajālena dānavāḥ kṣatavikṣatāḥ ..
bhītāśca dudruvuḥ sarve mahābalaparākramāḥ .. 2.19.40 ..
meaning:
स्कन्दस्य शरजालेन दानवाः क्षतविक्षताः ..
भीताश्च दुद्रुवुः सर्वे महाबलपराक्रमाः .. 2.19.40 ..
text_mt:
Severely wounded by Skanda's network of arrows,
all the [Dānavas], though endowed with great strength and valor, fled in fear.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣaparvā vipracittirdambhaścāpi vikaṅkanaḥ ..
skandena sārddhaṃ yuyudhuste ca sarve krameṇa ca..41..
meaning:
वृषपर्वा विप्रचित्तिर्दम्भश्चापि विकङ्कनः ..
स्कन्देन सार्द्धं युयुधुस्ते च सर्वे क्रमेण च..41..
text_mt:
Vṛṣaparvan, Vipracitti, Dambha, and Vikaṅkana—
they all fought with Skanda one after another.

sanskrit_iast:
kālī jagāma samaramarakṣatkārttikaṃ śivaḥ ..
vīrāstāmanujagmuśca te ca nandīśvarādayaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
काली जगाम समरमरक्षत्कार्त्तिकं शिवः ..
वीरास्तामनुजग्मुश्च ते च नन्दीश्वरादयः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Kālī went to the battle, while Śiva protected Kārttikeya;
the heroes, Nandīśvara and the others, followed her,

sanskrit_iast:
sarve devāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ ..
rājyabhāṇḍāśca bahuśaḥ śatakoṭirbalāhakāḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
सर्वे देवाश्च गन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसकिन्नराः ..
राज्यभाण्डाश्च बहुशः शतकोटिर्बलाहकाः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
as did all the gods, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, Kinnaras,
numerous royal treasuries, and a hundred crore clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca gatvā ca saṃgrāmaṃ siṃhanādaṃ cakāra ha ..
devyā vai siṃhanādena prāpurmūrcchāṃ ca dānavāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
सा च गत्वा च संग्रामं सिंहनादं चकार ह ..
देव्या वै सिंहनादेन प्रापुर्मूर्च्छां च दानवाः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Having gone to the battlefield, she let out a lion-roar;
at the goddess's lion-roar, the Dānavas fainted.

sanskrit_iast:
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cakāra ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
hṛṣṭā papau ca mādhvīkaṃ nanartta raṇamūrddhani .. 45 ..
meaning:
अट्टाट्टहासमशिवं चकार च पुनः पुनः ..
हृष्टा पपौ च माध्वीकं ननर्त्त रणमूर्द्धनि .. 45 ..
text_mt:
She let out inauspicious, thunderous boisterous laughter again and again;
delighted, she drank wine and danced in the vanguard of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
ugradaṃṣṭrā cogracaṇḍā kauṭṭarī ca papau madhu ..
yoginīnāṃ ḍākinīnāṃ gaṇāḥ suragaṇādayaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
उग्रदंष्ट्रा चोग्रचण्डा कौट्टरी च पपौ मधु ..
योगिनीनां डाकिनीनां गणाः सुरगणादयः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Ugradaṃṣṭrā, Ugracaṇḍā, and Kauṭṭarī drank wine,
as did the hosts of yoginīs, ḍākinīs, and groups of gods. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kālīṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ śīghramājiṃ samāyayau ..
dānavāśca bhayaṃ prāpū rājā tebhyo'bhayaṃ dadau .. 47 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कालीं शङ्खचूडः शीघ्रमाजिं समाययौ ..
दानवाश्च भयं प्रापू राजा तेभ्योऽभयं ददौ .. 47 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Kālī, Śaṅkhacūḍa quickly arrived at the battle.
The Dānavas were seized with fear; the king gave them fearlessness. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
kālī cikṣepa cāgneyaṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ..
rājā nirvāpayāmāsa vāruṇena sa līlayā .. 48 ..
meaning:
काली चिक्षेप चाग्नेयं प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमम् ..
राजा निर्वापयामास वारुणेन स लीलया .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Kālī discharged the fire weapon, resembling the flames of the fire of cosmic dissolution;
the king extinguished it effortlessly with the water weapon. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa vāruṇaṃ sā ca tattīvraṃ mahadadbhutam ..
gāndharveṇa ca ciccheda dānavendraśca līlayā .. 49 ..
meaning:
चिक्षेप वारुणं सा च तत्तीव्रं महदद्भुतम् ..
गान्धर्वेण च चिच्छेद दानवेन्द्रश्च लीलया .. 49 ..
text_mt:
And she hurled the water weapon, fierce, great, and wondrous;
the lord of the Dānavas cut it down effortlessly with the Gāndharva weapon. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
māheśvaraṃ pracikṣepa kālī vahniśikhopamam ..
rājā jaghāna tacchīghraṃ vaiṣṇavena ca līlayā .. 2.19.50 ..
meaning:
माहेश्वरं प्रचिक्षेप काली वह्निशिखोपमम् ..
राजा जघान तच्छीघ्रं वैष्णवेन च लीलया .. 2.19.50 ..
text_mt:
Kālī hurled the Māheśvara weapon, resembling a flame of fire;
the king destroyed it swiftly and effortlessly with the Vaiṣṇava weapon. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇāstraṃ sā devī cikṣipe mantrapūrvakam ..
rājā nanāma taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāvaruhya rathādaho ..51..
meaning:
नारायणास्त्रं सा देवी चिक्षिपे मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ..
राजा ननाम तं दृष्ट्वा चावरुह्य रथादहो ..51..
text_mt:
The goddess hurled the Nārāyaṇa weapon, accompanied by mantras;
seeing it, the king descended from his chariot and bowed down—ah! // 51

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ jagāma tacchastraṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ..
papāta śaṅkhacūḍaśca bhaktyā vai daṇḍavadbhuvi ..
brahmāstraṃ sā ca cikṣepa yatnato mantrapūrvakam .. 52 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं जगाम तच्छस्त्रं प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमम् ..
पपात शङ्खचूडश्च भक्त्या वै दण्डवद्भुवि ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रं सा च चिक्षेप यत्नतो मन्त्रपूर्वकम् .. 52 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāstreṇa mahārāja nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra ha ..
cikṣepātīva divyāstraṃ sā devī mantrapūrvakam .. 53 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मास्त्रेण महाराज निर्वाणं च चकार ह ..
चिक्षेपातीव दिव्यास्त्रं सा देवी मन्त्रपूर्वकम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
with a Brahmā weapon, O great king, he indeed neutralized it.
That goddess hurled an exceedingly divine weapon, accompanied by mantras; // 53

sanskrit_iast:
rājā divyāstrajālena nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra ha ..
devī cikṣepa śaktiṃ ca yatnato yojanāyatām .. 54 ..
meaning:
राजा दिव्यास्त्रजालेन निर्वाणं च चकार ह ..
देवी चिक्षेप शक्तिं च यत्नतो योजनायताम् .. 54 ..
text_mt:
the king indeed neutralized it with a volley of divine weapons.
The goddess carefully hurled a spear a yojana in length; // 54

sanskrit_iast:
rājā tīkṣṇāstrajālena śatakhaṇḍaṃ cakāra ha ..
jagrāha mantrapūrvaṃ ca devī pāśupataṃ ruṣā .. 55 ..
meaning:
राजा तीक्ष्णास्त्रजालेन शतखण्डं चकार ह ..
जग्राह मन्त्रपूर्वं च देवी पाशुपतं रुषा .. 55 ..
text_mt:
the king indeed chopped it into a hundred pieces with a volley of sharp weapons.
Then, in fury, the goddess took up the Pāśupata weapon with a mantra; // 55

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣeptuṃ sā niṣiddhā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
mṛtyuḥ pāśupate nāsti nṛpasya ca mahātmanaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
निक्षेप्तुं सा निषिद्धा च वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ..
मृत्युः पाशुपते नास्ति नृपस्य च महात्मनः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
as she was about to discharge it, she was forbidden by a bodiless voice:
‘There is no death for the high-souled king by the Pāśupata weapon. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadastyeva kaṇṭhe'sya kavacaṃ hi hareriti ..
yāvatsatītvamastīha satyāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
यावदस्त्येव कण्ठेऽस्य कवचं हि हरेरिति ..
यावत्सतीत्वमस्तीह सत्याश्च नृपयोषितः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
As long as the armour of Hari remains upon his neck,
and as long as the chastity of the truthful queen endures in this world, // 57

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadasya jarā mṛtyurnāstīti brahmaṇo varaḥ ..
ityākarṇya mahākālī na taccikṣepa sā satī..58..
meaning:
तावदस्य जरा मृत्युर्नास्तीति ब्रह्मणो वरः ..
इत्याकर्ण्य महाकाली न तच्चिक्षेप सा सती..58..
text_mt:
so long does he have neither old age nor death: such is the boon of Brahmā.’
Hearing this, Mahākālī, the chaste goddess, did not discharge it. // 58

sanskrit_iast:
śatalakṣaṃ dānavānāmagrahīllīlayā krudhā..
attuṃ jagāma vegena śaṃkhacūḍaṃ bhayaṃkarī......
divyāstreṇa sutīkṣṇena vārayāmāsa dānavaḥ ..
khaṅgaṃ cikṣepa sā devī grīṣmasūryopamaṃ param ..2.19.60..
meaning:
शतलक्षं दानवानामग्रहील्लीलया क्रुधा..
अत्तुं जगाम वेगेन शंखचूडं भयंकरी......
दिव्यास्त्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन वारयामास दानवः ..
खङ्गं चिक्षेप सा देवी ग्रीष्मसूर्योपमं परम् ..2.19.60..
text_mt:
In anger, she effortlessly seized ten million Dānavas;
fearsome, she rushed swiftly to devour Śaṅkhacūḍa.
With a very sharp divine weapon, the Dānava warded her off.
The goddess hurled a sword, supreme, resembling the summer sun; // 60

sanskrit_iast:
divyāstrairdānavendro'yaṃ śatakhaṇḍaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
punarattuṃ mahādevī vegena ca jagāma tam .. 61 ..
meaning:
दिव्यास्त्रैर्दानवेन्द्रोऽयं शतखण्डं चकार सः ..
पुनरत्तुं महादेवी वेगेन च जगाम तम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
with divine weapons, that lord of Dānavas cut it into a hundred pieces.
Again, the great goddess rushed swiftly to devour him. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śrīmānvavṛdhe dānaveśvaraḥ ..
nivārayāmāsa ca tāṃ sarvasiddheśvaro varaḥ ..
vegena muṣṭinā kālī kopayuktā bhayaṃkarī ..62..
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धेश्वरः श्रीमान्ववृधे दानवेश्वरः ..
निवारयामास च तां सर्वसिद्धेश्वरो वरः ..
वेगेन मुष्टिना काली कोपयुक्ता भयंकरी ..62..

sanskrit_iast:
babhañjātha rathaṃ tasya cāhanatsārathiṃ satī ..
sā ca śūlaṃ ca cikṣepa pralayāgniśikhopamam .. 63 ..
meaning:
बभञ्जाथ रथं तस्य चाहनत्सारथिं सती ..
सा च शूलं च चिक्षेप प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमम् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
smashed his chariot and struck down his charioteer, the chaste goddess.
And she hurled a trident, resembling the flame of the fire of cosmic dissolution; // 63

sanskrit_iast:
vāmahastena jagrāha śaṃkhacūḍaśca līlayā ..
muṣṭyā jaghāna taṃ devī mahākopena vegataḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
वामहस्तेन जग्राह शंखचूडश्च लीलया ..
मुष्ट्या जघान तं देवी महाकोपेन वेगतः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkhacūḍa caught it effortlessly with his left hand.
In great anger, the goddess swiftly struck him with her fist. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
babhrāma vyathayā daityaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha ..
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pratāpavān .. 69 ..
meaning:
बभ्राम व्यथया दैत्यः क्षणं मूर्च्छामवाप ह ..
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य समुत्तस्थौ प्रतापवान् .. 69 ..
text_mt:
The Daitya reeled in pain and fell into a swoon for a moment;
regaining consciousness in an instant, the mighty one stood up. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
na cakre bāhuyuddhaṃ sa devyā saha nanāma tām ..
devyāścāstraṃ ca ciccheda cāgrahītsvena tejasā .. 66 ..
meaning:
न चक्रे बाहुयुद्धं स देव्या सह ननाम ताम् ..
देव्याश्चास्त्रं च चिच्छेद चाग्रहीत्स्वेन तेजसा .. 66 ..
text_mt:
He did not engage in hand-to-hand combat with the goddess, but bowed down to her;
he intercepted the weapon of the goddess and seized it by his own splendour. // 66

sanskrit_iast: nāstraṃ cikṣepa tāṃ bhaktyā mātṛbuddhyā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning: नास्त्रं चिक्षेप तां भक्त्या मातृबुद्ध्या च वैष्णवः .. 67 ..
text_mt: The Vaiṣṇava did not hurl any weapon at her, out of devotion, regarding her as a mother. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā dānavaṃ devī bhrāmayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ..
ūrdhvaṃ ca prerayāmāsa mahāvegena kopataḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा दानवं देवी भ्रामयित्वा पुनः पुनः ..
ऊर्ध्वं च प्रेरयामास महावेगेन कोपतः .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Seizing the Dānava, the goddess whirled him around again and again,
and hurled him upwards in fury with great force. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvātpapāta vegena śaṃkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān ..
nipatya ca samuttasthau sa natvā bhadrakālikām ..69..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वात्पपात वेगेन शंखचूडः प्रतापवान् ..
निपत्य च समुत्तस्थौ स नत्वा भद्रकालिकाम् ..69..
text_mt:
The mighty Śaṅkhacūḍa fell rapidly from aloft;
having fallen, he stood up and bowed to Bhadrakālī. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ vimānāgryaṃ manoharam ..
āruroha rathaṃ hṛṣṭo na viśrānto mahāraṇe .. . .. 2.19.70 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचितं विमानाग्र्यं मनोहरम् ..
आरुरोह रथं हृष्टो न विश्रान्तो महारणे .. . .. 2.19.70 ..
text_mt:
Inlaid with the finest gems, an excellent and delightful aerial car
—that chariot he mounted, joyful and untired in the great battle. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatajaṃ dānavānāṃ ca māṃsaṃ ca vipulaṃ kṣudhā ..
pītvā bhuktvā bhadrakālī yayau sā śaṃkarāntikam .. 71 ..
meaning:
क्षतजं दानवानां च मांसं च विपुलं क्षुधा ..
पीत्वा भुक्त्वा भद्रकाली ययौ सा शंकरान्तिकम् .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Drinking the blood of the Dānavas and consuming an abundance of their flesh in her hunger,
Bhadrakālī departed for the presence of Śaṅkara. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca raṇavṛttāntaṃ paurvāparyyaṃ yathākramam ..
śrutvā jahāsa śambhuśca dānavānāṃ vināśanam ..72..
meaning:
उवाच रणवृत्तान्तं पौर्वापर्य्यं यथाक्रमम् ..
श्रुत्वा जहास शम्भुश्च दानवानां विनाशनम् ..72..
text_mt:
She related the account of the battle from beginning to end in proper order;
hearing of the destruction of the Dānavas, Śambhu laughed. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ ca dānavendrāṇāmavaśiṣṭaṃ raṇe'dhunā ..
udvṛttaṃ bhūbhṛtā sārddhaṃ tadanyaṃ bhuktamīśvara ..73..
meaning:
लक्षं च दानवेन्द्राणामवशिष्टं रणेऽधुना ..
उद्वृत्तं भूभृता सार्द्धं तदन्यं भुक्तमीश्वर ..73..
text_mt:
‘Only one hundred thousand lords among Dānavas now remain on the battlefield;
surviving alongside their king, the rest were devoured, O Lord! // 73

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāme dānavendraṃ ca hantuṃ pāśupatena vai ..
avadhyastava rājeti vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī .. .. 74 ..
meaning:
संग्रामे दानवेन्द्रं च हन्तुं पाशुपतेन वै ..
अवध्यस्तव राजेति वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी .. .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, as I was about to slay the lord of Dānavas in battle with the Pāśupata weapon,
a bodiless voice said: “The king cannot be slain by you.” // 74

sanskrit_iast:
rājendraśca mahājñānī mahābalaparākramaḥ ..
na ca cikṣepa mayyastraṃ ciccheda mama sāyakam .. 75 ..
meaning:
राजेन्द्रश्च महाज्ञानी महाबलपराक्रमः ..
न च चिक्षेप मय्यस्त्रं चिच्छेद मम सायकम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
The sovereign king is of great wisdom, endowed with immense strength and valour.’
And he did not discharge a weapon at me; he merely cut down my arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śivastattvaṃ samākarṇya tattvajñānaviśāradaḥ ..
yayau svayaṃ ca samaraṃ svagaṇaiḥ saha nārada .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
शिवस्तत्त्वं समाकर्ण्य तत्त्वज्ञानविशारदः ..
ययौ स्वयं च समरं स्वगणैः सह नारद .. 1 ..
title: Śaṃkhaprastāvaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkhacūḍaḥ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānādavaruhya ca ..
nanāma parayā bhaktyā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi .. 2 ..
meaning:
शंखचूडः शिवं दृष्ट्वा विमानादवरुह्य च ..
ननाम परया भक्त्या दण्डवत्पतितो भुवि .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ praṇamya ca vegena vimānaṃ hyāruroha saḥ ..
tūrṇaṃ cakāra sannāhaṃ dhanurjagrāha durvaham .. 3 ..
meaning:
तं प्रणम्य च वेगेन विमानं ह्यारुरोह सः ..
तूर्णं चकार सन्नाहं धनुर्जग्राह दुर्वहम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śivadānavayoryuddhaṃ pūrṇamabdaṃ babhūva ha ..
na vai babhūvaturbrahmaṃstayorjayaparājayau .. 4 ..
meaning:
शिवदानवयोर्युद्धं पूर्णमब्दं बभूव ह ..
न वै बभूवतुर्ब्रह्मंस्तयोर्जयपराजयौ .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nyastaśastraśca bhagavānnyastaśastraśca dānavaḥ ..
rathasthaḥ śaṃkhacūḍaśca vṛṣastho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
न्यस्तशस्त्रश्च भगवान्न्यस्तशस्त्रश्च दानवः ..
रथस्थः शंखचूडश्च वृषस्थो वृषभध्वजः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dānavānāṃ ca śatakamudvṛttaṃ ca babhūva ha ..
raṇe ye mṛtāḥ śaṃbhorjīvayāmāsa tānvibhuḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
दानवानां च शतकमुद्वृत्तं च बभूव ह ..
रणे ये मृताः शंभोर्जीवयामास तान्विभुः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṇurmahāmāyo vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ..
āgatya ca raṇasthānamavocaddānaveśvaram..7..
meaning:
ततो विष्णुर्महामायो वृद्धब्राह्मणरूपधृक् ..
आगत्य च रणस्थानमवोचद्दानवेश्वरम्..7..

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhabrāhmaṇa uvāca ..
dehi bhikṣāṃ ca rājendra mahyaṃ viprāya sāmpratam ..
tvaṃ sarvasampadāṃ dātā yanme manasi vāñchitam .. 8 ..
meaning:
वृद्धब्राह्मण उवाच ..
देहि भिक्षां च राजेन्द्र मह्यं विप्राय साम्प्रतम् ..
त्वं सर्वसम्पदां दाता यन्मे मनसि वाञ्छितम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhārāya vṛddhāya tṛṣitāyāturāya ca ..
paścāttvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi puraḥ satyaṃ ca kurviti ..9..
meaning:
निराहाराय वृद्धाय तृषितायातुराय च ..
पश्चात्त्वां कथयिष्यामि पुरः सत्यं च कुर्विति ..9..

sanskrit_iast:
omityuvāca rājendraḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ..
kavacārthī janaścāhamityuvāca sa māyayā .. 2.20.10 ..
meaning:
ओमित्युवाच राजेन्द्रः प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः ..
कवचार्थी जनश्चाहमित्युवाच स मायया .. 2.20.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā dānavaśreṣṭho dadau kavacamuttamam ..
gṛhītvā kavacaṃ divyaṃ jagāma harireva ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा दानवश्रेष्ठो ददौ कवचमुत्तमम् ..
गृहीत्वा कवचं दिव्यं जगाम हरिरेव च .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa jagāma tulasīṃ prati ..
gatvā tasyāṃ māyayā ca vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 12 ..
meaning:
शङ्खचूडस्य रूपेण जगाम तुलसीं प्रति ..
गत्वा तस्यां मायया च वीर्य्याधानं चकार ह .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atha śambhurhareḥ śūlaṃ dānavārthaṃ samagrahīt ..
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaśatakaprabhamujjvalam .. 13 ..
meaning:
अथ शम्भुर्हरेः शूलं दानवार्थं समग्रहीत् ..
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्त्तण्डशतकप्रभमुज्ज्वलम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇādhiṣṭhitāgraṃ brahmādhiṣṭhitamadhyamam ..
śivādhiṣṭhitamūlaṃ ca kālādhiṣṭhitadhārakam ..14..
meaning:
नारायणाधिष्ठिताग्रं ब्रह्माधिष्ठितमध्यमम् ..
शिवाधिष्ठितमूलं च कालाधिष्ठितधारकम् ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
kiraṇāvalisaṃyuktaṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ..
durnivāryaṃ ca durdharṣamavyarthaṃ vairighātakam .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
किरणावलिसंयुक्तं प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमम् ..
दुर्निवार्यं च दुर्धर्षमव्यर्थं वैरिघातकम् .. .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā cakratulyaṃ ca sarvaśastravighātakam ..
śivakeśavayoranyad durvahaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram .. 16 ..
meaning:
तेजसा चक्रतुल्यं च सर्वशस्त्रविघातकम् ..
शिवकेशवयोरन्यद् दुर्वहं च भयंकरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: difficult to bear by any other than Śiva and Keśava, and terrifying,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanussahasraṃ dairghyeṇa vistṛtyā śatahastakam ..
sajīvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca nityarūpamanirmitam .. 17 ..
meaning:
धनुस्सहस्रं दैर्घ्येण विस्तृत्या शतहस्तकम् ..
सजीवं ब्रह्मरूपं च नित्यरूपमनिर्मितम् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
a thousand bows in length and a hundred cubits in width,
living, of the nature of Brahman, eternal, and uncreated,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhartuṃ sarvavidhyaṇḍamekadā daivalīlayā ..
cikṣepa ghūrṇanaṃ kṛtvā śaṃkhacūḍe ca nārada .. 18 ..
meaning:
संहर्तुं सर्वविध्यण्डमेकदा दैवलीलया ..
चिक्षेप घूर्णनं कृत्वा शंखचूडे च नारद .. 18 ..
text_mt:
capable of destroying all the cosmic eggs at once in divine sport.
Whirling it, O Nārada, he hurled it at Śaṅkhacūḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā cāpaṃ parityajya śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam ..
dhyānaṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ dhiyā .. ..19..
meaning:
राजा चापं परित्यज्य श्रीकृष्णचरणाम्बुजम् ..
ध्यानं चकार भक्त्या च कृत्वा योगासनं धिया .. ..19..
text_mt:
The king, abandoning his bow, with devotion meditating on the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
assumed a yogic posture in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā nyapataddānavopari ..
cakāra bhasmasāttaṃ ca sarathaṃ caiva līlayā .. 2.20.20 ..
meaning:
शूलं च भ्रमणं कृत्वा न्यपतद्दानवोपरि ..
चकार भस्मसात्तं च सरथं चैव लीलया .. 2.20.20 ..
text_mt:
Whirling through the air, the trident fell upon the Dānava,
and effortlessly reduced him, along with his chariot, to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā dhṛtvā divyarūpaṃ bālakaṃ gopaveṣakam ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..21..
meaning:
राजा धृत्वा दिव्यरूपं बालकं गोपवेषकम् ..
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ..21..
text_mt: Assuming a divine form as a young boy in cowherd attire,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnasubhūṣāḍhyagopakoṭibhirāvṛtam ..
golokādāgataṃ yānamāruhya tatpuraṃ yayau..22..
meaning:
नानारत्नसुभूषाढ्यगोपकोटिभिरावृतम् ..
गोलोकादागतं यानमारुह्य तत्पुरं ययौ..22..
text_mt:
surrounded by tens of millions of cowherds richly adorned with various gems,
the king mounted an aerial car that had come from Goloka and went to that realm.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā nanāma śirasā rādhāmādhavayormune ..
bhaktyā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ rāse vṛndāvane mune..
sudāmānaṃ tau ca dṛṣṭvā prasanna vadanekṣaṇau .. 23 ..
meaning:
गत्वा ननाम शिरसा राधामाधवयोर्मुने ..
भक्त्या तच्चरणाम्भोजं रासे वृन्दावने मुने..
सुदामानं तौ च दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्न वदनेक्षणौ .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Having gone there, he bowed his head, O sage, to Rādhā and Mādhava,
with devotion at their lotus feet in the circular dance in Vṛndāvana, O sage.
Seeing Sudāman, both of them, their faces and eyes serene,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā ca cakratuḥ kroḍe snehena parisaṃplutau ..
atha śūlaśca vegena prayayau śūlinaḥ karam .. 24 ..
meaning:
तदा च चक्रतुः क्रोडे स्नेहेन परिसंप्लुतौ ..
अथ शूलश्च वेगेन प्रययौ शूलिनः करम् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
then placed him on their laps, overflowing with affection.
Then the trident swiftly returned to the hand of the trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkarastena śūlena dānavasyāsthijālakam .. 25 ..
meaning: शङ्करस्तेन शूलेन दानवस्यास्थिजालकम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara, with that trident, the mass of bones of the Dānava,

sanskrit_iast:
premṇā ca prerayāmāsa lavaṇode ca sāgare ..
asthibhiḥ śaṃkhacūḍasya śaṃkhajātirbabhūva ha .. .. 26 ..
meaning:
प्रेम्णा च प्रेरयामास लवणोदे च सागरे ..
अस्थिभिः शंखचूडस्य शंखजातिर्बभूव ह .. .. 26 ..
text_mt:
lovingly cast into the ocean of salt water.
From the bones of Śaṅkhacūḍa arose the species of conches,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprakārarūpā ca śreṣṭhā pūtā surārcane ..
praśastaṃ śaṃkhatoyaṃ ca devānāṃ prītidaṃ param .. 27 ..
meaning:
नानाप्रकाररूपा च श्रेष्ठा पूता सुरार्चने ..
प्रशस्तं शंखतोयं च देवानां प्रीतिदं परम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
possessing various forms, excellent, and pure for the worship of the gods.
Water from a conch is praiseworthy, giving supreme pleasure to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthatoyasvarūpaṃ ca pavitraṃ śaṃkaraṃ vinā ..
śaṃkhaśabdo bhavedyatra tatra lakṣmīśca susthirā .. 28 ..
meaning:
तीर्थतोयस्वरूपं च पवित्रं शंकरं विना ..
शंखशब्दो भवेद्यत्र तत्र लक्ष्मीश्च सुस्थिरा .. 28 ..
text_mt:
possessing the nature of sacred water, purifying everywhere except for Śaṅkara.
Wherever the sound of a conch is heard, there Lakṣmī remains steadfast.

sanskrit_iast:
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yaḥ snātaḥ śaṃkhavāriṇā ..
śaṃkhaṃ hareradhiṣṭhānaṃ yatra śaṃkhastato hariḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु यः स्नातः शंखवारिणा ..
शंखं हरेरधिष्ठानं यत्र शंखस्ततो हरिः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
He has bathed in all holy waters who has bathed with conch-water.
The conch is the abode of Hari; where the conch is, there is Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva satataṃ lakṣmīrdūrībhūtamamaṅgalam ..
strīṇāṃ ca śaṃkhadhvanibhiḥ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
bhītā ruṣṭā yāti lakṣmīḥ sthalamanyaṃ sthalāttataḥ ..2.20.30..
meaning:
तत्रैव सततं लक्ष्मीर्दूरीभूतममङ्गलम् ..
स्त्रीणां च शंखध्वनिभिः शूद्राणां च विशेषतः ..
भीता रुष्टा याति लक्ष्मीः स्थलमन्यं स्थलात्ततः ..2.20.30..
text_mt:
Right there Lakṣmī is always present, and misfortune is cast far away.
At the sounds of conches [blown] by women, and especially by Śūdras,
Lakṣmī, frightened and angered, departs from that place to another place.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśca dānavaṃ hatvā śivalokaṃ jagāma saḥ..
prahṛṣṭo vṛṣamāruhya svagaṇaiśca samāvṛtaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
शिवश्च दानवं हत्वा शिवलोकं जगाम सः..
प्रहृष्टो वृषमारुह्य स्वगणैश्च समावृतः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
And Śiva, having slain the Dānava, went to Śivaloka,
greatly delighted, mounted upon his bull, and surrounded by his own attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
surāḥ svaviṣayaṃ prāpuḥ paramānandasaṃyutāḥ ..
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ .. .. 32 ..
meaning:
सुराः स्वविषयं प्रापुः परमानन्दसंयुताः ..
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे जगुर्गन्धर्वकिन्नराः .. .. 32 ..
text_mt:
The gods reached their own realms, filled with supreme joy.
Drums sounded in heaven, and Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śivasyopari santatam ..
praśaśaṃsuḥ surāstaṃ ca munīndrapravarādayaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
बभूव पुष्पवृष्टिश्च शिवस्योपरि सन्ततम् ..
प्रशशंसुः सुरास्तं च मुनीन्द्रप्रवरादयः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
And a constant shower of flowers fell upon Śiva;
the gods and the foremost great sages and others praised him.

meaning:
तुलसीतोयकणिकां मृत्युकाले च यो लभेत् ..
रत्नयानं समारुह्य वैकुण्ठं स प्रयाति च..2.21.50.
text_mt:
Whoever receives even a drop of Tulasī water at the time of death,
mounts a jewelled chariot and proceeds to Vaikuṇṭha. / On the full moon, on the new moon, on the twelfth day, at the sun's transit,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ ravisaṃkrame ..
tailābhyaṃge cāsnāte ca madhyāhne niśi sandhyayoḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
पूर्णिमायाममायां च द्वादश्यां रविसंक्रमे ..
तैलाभ्यंगे चास्नाते च मध्याह्ने निशि सन्ध्ययोः .. 51 ..
text_mt: during an oil massage, while unbathed, at midday, at night, and during the two twilights...

sanskrit_iast:
āśauce'śucikāle vā rātrivāsānvite narāḥ ..
tulasīṃ ye ca chindanti te chindanti hareḥ śiraḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
आशौचेऽशुचिकाले वा रात्रिवासान्विते नराः ..
तुलसीं ये च छिन्दन्ति ते छिन्दन्ति हरेः शिरः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
During ritual impurity, or at an impure time, or when wearing the clothes of the night, men
who pluck Tulasī cut off the head of Hari. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ tulasīpatraṃ śuddhaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sati ..
śrāddhe vrate vā dāne vā pratiṣṭhāyāṃ surārcane .. 53 ..
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं तुलसीपत्रं शुद्धं पर्युषितं सति ..
श्राद्धे व्रते वा दाने वा प्रतिष्ठायां सुरार्चने .. 53 ..
text_mt:
A Tulasī leaf, O virtuous woman, remains pure even when stale for three nights,
in an ancestral rite, a vow, a gift, a consecration, or in the worship of the gods. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
bhūgataṃ toyapatitaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇave sati ..
śuddhaṃ tu tula sīpatraṃ kṣālanādanyakarmaṇi ..54..
meaning:
भूगतं तोयपतितं यद्दत्तं विष्णवे सति ..
शुद्धं तु तुल सीपत्रं क्षालनादन्यकर्मणि ..54..
text_mt:
That which has fallen to the ground, or fallen into water, or has been offered to Viṣṇu, O virtuous woman—
the Tulasī leaf becomes pure for another ritual act after being washed. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣādhiṣṭhātrī devī yā goloke ca nirāmaye ..
kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ rahasi nityaṃ krīḍāṃ kariṣyati.55..
meaning:
वृक्षाधिष्ठात्री देवी या गोलोके च निरामये ..
कृष्णेन सार्द्धं रहसि नित्यं क्रीडां करिष्यति.55..
text_mt:
The goddess presiding over the plant, in disease-free Goloka,
shall constantly sporting with Kṛṣṇa in secret. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
nadyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā bhārate ca supuṇyadā ..
lavaṇodasya patnī ca madaṃśasya bhaviṣyati ..56..
meaning:
नद्यधिष्ठातृदेवी या भारते च सुपुण्यदा ..
लवणोदस्य पत्नी च मदंशस्य भविष्यति ..56..
text_mt:
And the goddess presiding over the river, bestowing great merit in Bhārata,
shall become the wife of the salt ocean, which is a portion of Me. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca svayaṃ mahāsādhvī vaikuṇṭhe mama sannidhau ..
ramāsamā ca rāse ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
त्वं च स्वयं महासाध्वी वैकुण्ठे मम सन्निधौ ..
रमासमा च रासे च भविष्यसि न संशयः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
And you yourself, highly chaste woman, in Vaikuṇṭha in my presence,
shall be equal to Ramā and in the rāsa-dance, without a doubt. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca śailarūpī ca gaṇḍakītīrasannidhau ..
adhiṣṭhānaṃ kari ṣyāmi bhārate tava śāpataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
अहं च शैलरूपी च गण्डकीतीरसन्निधौ ..
अधिष्ठानं करि ष्यामि भारते तव शापतः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
And I, in the form of a mountain, near the banks of the Gaṇḍakī
shall take up residence in Bhārata on account of your curse. // 58

sanskrit_iast:
vajrakīṭāśca kṛmayo vajradaṃṣṭrāśca tatra vai ..
tacchilākuhare cakraṃ kariṣyanti madīyakama..59..
meaning:
वज्रकीटाश्च कृमयो वज्रदंष्ट्राश्च तत्र वै ..
तच्छिलाकुहरे चक्रं करिष्यन्ति मदीयकम..59..
text_mt:
Vajrakīṭa worms with adamantine teeth indeed there
shall make My discus inside the cavity of that stone. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
ekadvāre catuścakraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidham ..2.21.60..
meaning:
एकद्वारे चतुश्चक्रं वनमालाविभूषितम् ..
नवीननीरदश्यामं लक्ष्मीनारायणाभिधम् ..2.21.60..
text_mt:
Having four discs at a single aperture, adorned with a forest garland,
dark like a fresh raincloud, it is named Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa. // 2.21.60

sanskrit_iast:
ekadvāre catuścakraṃ navīnanīradopamam..
lakṣmījanārdanaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā .. 61 ..
meaning:
एकद्वारे चतुश्चक्रं नवीननीरदोपमम्..
लक्ष्मीजनार्दनं ज्ञेयं रहितं वनमालया .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Having four discs at a single aperture, resembling a fresh raincloud,
and devoid of a forest garland, it is to be known as Lakṣmījanārdana. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
dvāradvaye catuścakraṃ goṣpadena samanvitam ..
raghunāthābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā .. .. 62 ..
meaning:
द्वारद्वये चतुश्चक्रं गोष्पदेन समन्वितम् ..
रघुनाथाभिधं ज्ञेयं रहितं वनमालया .. .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Having four discs across two apertures, accompanied by a cow-hoof print,
and devoid of a forest garland, it is to be known by the name Raghunātha. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca navīnajaladaprabham ..
dadhivāmanābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca sukhapradam .. 63 ..
meaning:
अतिक्षुद्रं द्विचक्रं च नवीनजलदप्रभम् ..
दधिवामनाभिधं ज्ञेयं गृहिणां च सुखप्रदम् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Extremely small, with two discs, possessing the lustre of a fresh raincloud,
named Dadhivāmana, it is to be known as bestowing happiness upon householders. // 63

sanskrit_iast:
atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca vanamā lāvibhūṣitam ..
vijñeyaṃ śrīdharaṃ devaṃ śrīpradaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā .. 64 ..
meaning:
अतिक्षुद्रं द्विचक्रं च वनमा लाविभूषितम् ..
विज्ञेयं श्रीधरं देवं श्रीप्रदं गृहिणां सदा .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Extremely small, with two discs, adorned with a forest garland,
is to be known as the deity Śrīdhara, always granting prosperity to householders. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ..
dvicakaṃ sphuṭamatyantaṃ jñeyaṃ dāmodarābhidham .. 65 ..
meaning:
स्थूलं च वर्तुलाकारं रहितं वनमालया ..
द्विचकं स्फुटमत्यन्तं ज्ञेयं दामोदराभिधम् .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Thick, circular in shape, devoid of a forest garland,
and with two very distinct discs, it is to be known by the name Dāmodara. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamaṃ vartulākāraṃ dvicakraṃ bāṇavikṣatam ..
raṇarāmābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ śaratūṇasamanvitam .. 66 ..
meaning:
मध्यमं वर्तुलाकारं द्विचक्रं बाणविक्षतम् ..
रणरामाभिधं ज्ञेयं शरतूणसमन्वितम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Medium-sized, circular in shape, with two discs, scarred by arrows,
and accompanied by an arrow-quiver, it is to be known by the name Raṇarāma. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamaṃ saptacakraṃ ca chatratūṇasamanvitam ..
rājarājeśvaraṃ jñeyaṃ rājasampatpradaṃ nṛṇām .. 67 ..
meaning:
मध्यमं सप्तचक्रं च छत्रतूणसमन्वितम् ..
राजराजेश्वरं ज्ञेयं राजसम्पत्प्रदं नृणाम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
Medium-sized, with seven discs, accompanied by an umbrella and quiver,
is to be known as Rājarājeśvara, granting royal fortune to men. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
dvisaptacakraṃ sthūlaṃ ca navīnajaladaprabham ..
anantākhyaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam .. 68 ..
meaning:
द्विसप्तचक्रं स्थूलं च नवीनजलदप्रभम् ..
अनन्ताख्यं च विज्ञेयं चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदम् .. 68 ..
text_mt:
With fourteen discs, thick, possessing the lustre of a fresh raincloud,
it is to be known by the name Ananta, bestowing the fruit of the four goals of life. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
cakrākāraṃ dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ jaladaprabham ..
sagoṣpadaṃ madhyamaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ madhusūda nam..69..
meaning:
चक्राकारं द्विचक्रं च सश्रीकं जलदप्रभम् ..
सगोष्पदं मध्यमं च विज्ञेयं मधुसूद नम्..69..
text_mt:
Discus-shaped, with two discs, splendid, possessing the lustre of a raincloud,
with a cow-hoof print, and medium-sized, it is to be known as Madhusūdana. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanaṃ caikacakraṃ guptacakraṃ gadādharam ..
dvicakraṃ hayavaktrābhaṃ hayagrīvaṃ prakīrttitam..2.21.70..
meaning:
सुदर्शनं चैकचक्रं गुप्तचक्रं गदाधरम् ..
द्विचक्रं हयवक्त्राभं हयग्रीवं प्रकीर्त्तितम्..2.21.70..
text_mt:
With a single disc it is Sudarśana; with a hidden disc, Gadādhara;
with two discs, having the appearance of a horse's face, it is declared to be Hayagrīva. // 2.21.70

sanskrit_iast:
atīva vistṛtāsyaṃ ca dvicakraṃ vikaṭaṃ sati ..
narasiṃhābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ sadyo vairāgyadaṃ nṛṇām .. 71 ..
meaning:
अतीव विस्तृतास्यं च द्विचक्रं विकटं सति ..
नरसिंहाभिधं ज्ञेयं सद्यो वैराग्यदं नृणाम् .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having a very wide mouth, two discs, and a terrifying [form], O virtuous woman,
it is to be known as Narasiṃha, quickly granting dispassion to men. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
dvicakraṃ vistṛtāsyaṃ ca vanamālāsamanvitam ..
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ vijñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sukhadaṃ sadā .. 72 ..
meaning:
द्विचक्रं विस्तृतास्यं च वनमालासमन्वितम् ..
लक्ष्मीनृसिंहं विज्ञेयं गृहिणां सुखदं सदा .. 72 ..
text_mt:
With two discs, a wide mouth, and accompanied by a forest garland,
it is to be known as Lakṣmīnṛsiṃha, always bestowing happiness upon householders. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
dvāradeśe dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ ca samaṃ sphuṭam ..
vāsudevaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 73 ..
meaning:
द्वारदेशे द्विचक्रं च सश्रीकं च समं स्फुटम् ..
वासुदेवं च विज्ञेयं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 73 ..
text_mt:
With two discs in the region of the aperture, splendid, even, and distinct,
it is to be known as Vāsudeva, granting the fruit of all desires. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnaṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ ca navīnanīradaprabham ..
suṣire cchidrabahulaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca sukhapradam .. 74 ..
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नं सूक्ष्मचक्रं च नवीननीरदप्रभम् ..
सुषिरे च्छिद्रबहुलं गृहिणां च सुखप्रदम् .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Pradyumna has subtle discs and possesses the lustre of a fresh raincloud,
with numerous perforations in its hollow, bestowing happiness upon householders. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
dve cakre caikalagne ca pṛṣṭhe yatra tu puṣkalam ..
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ sukhadaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā .. 75 ..
meaning:
द्वे चक्रे चैकलग्ने च पृष्ठे यत्र तु पुष्कलम् ..
संकर्षणं तु विज्ञेयं सुखदं गृहिणां सदा .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Where there are two conjoined discs and an abundance on the back,
that is to be known as Saṃkarṣaṇa, always bestowing happiness upon householders. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddhaṃ tu pītābhaṃ vartulaṃ cātiśobhanam ..
sukhapradaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ pravadanti manī ṣiṇaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
अनिरुद्धं तु पीताभं वर्तुलं चातिशोभनम् ..
सुखप्रदं गृहस्थानां प्रवदन्ति मनी षिणः .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Aniruddha is yellowish in lustre, circular, and extremely beautiful;
the wise declare it as bestowing happiness upon householders. // 76

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilā yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ ..
tatraiva lakṣmīrvasati sarvatīrthasamanvitā..77..
meaning:
शालग्रामशिला यत्र तत्र सन्निहितो हरिः ..
तत्रैव लक्ष्मीर्वसति सर्वतीर्थसमन्विता..77..
text_mt:
Wherever the Śāligrāma stone is, there Hari is present;
Lakṣmī resides right there, accompanied by all the sacred pilgrimage sites. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti śālagrāmaśilārccanāt .. 78 ..
meaning:
यानि कानि च पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ..
तानि सर्वाणि नश्यंति शालग्रामशिलार्च्चनात् .. 78 ..
text_mt: all of them perish from the worship of the Śāligrāma stone. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
chatrākāraṃ bhavedrājyaṃ vartule ca mahāśriyaḥ ..
duḥkhaṃ ca śakaṭākāre śūlāgre maraṇaṃ dhuvam .. 79 ..
meaning:
छत्राकारं भवेद्राज्यं वर्तुले च महाश्रियः ..
दुःखं च शकटाकारे शूलाग्रे मरणं धुवम् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
An umbrella shape brings sovereignty, and in a circular one is great prosperity;
in a cart shape is sorrow, and in a pike-tip shape is certain death. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
vikṛtāsye ca dāridryaṃ piṅgale hānireva ca ..
lagnacakre bhavedvyādhirvidīrṇe maraṇaṃ dhuvam .. 2.21.80 ..
meaning:
विकृतास्ये च दारिद्र्यं पिङ्गले हानिरेव च ..
लग्नचक्रे भवेद्व्याधिर्विदीर्णे मरणं धुवम् .. 2.21.80 ..
text_mt:
In a deformed mouth is poverty, and in a tawny one is loss indeed;
in joined discs there is disease, and in a cracked one is certain death. // 2.21.80

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ dānaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam ..
śālagrāmaśilāyāścaivādhiṣṭhānātpraśastakam .. 81 ..
meaning:
व्रतं दानं प्रतिष्ठा च श्राद्धं च देवपूजनम् ..
शालग्रामशिलायाश्चैवाधिष्ठानात्प्रशस्तकम् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
A vow, a gift, a consecration, an ancestral offering, and the worship of the gods
become praiseworthy indeed through the presence of the Śāligrāma stone. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ..
śālagrāmaśilātoyairyo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret .. 82 ..
meaning:
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षितः ..
शालग्रामशिलातोयैर्योऽभिषेकं समाचरेत् .. 82 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ prādakṣiṇye bhuvo yathā ..
sarvayajñeṣu tīrtheṣu vrateṣvanaśaneṣu ca .. 83 ..
meaning:
सर्वदानेषु यत्पुण्यं प्रादक्षिण्ये भुवो यथा ..
सर्वयज्ञेषु तीर्थेषु व्रतेष्वनशनेषु च .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Whatever merit is found in all donations, or in circumambulating the earth,
in all sacrifices, in sacred places, in vows, and in fasts— (83)

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sparśaṃ ca vāñchanti tīrthāni nikhilāni ca ..
jīvanmukto mahāpūto bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ..84..
meaning:
तस्य स्पर्शं च वाञ्छन्ति तीर्थानि निखिलानि च ..
जीवन्मुक्तो महापूतो भवेदेव न संशयः ..84..
text_mt: he indeed becomes liberated while living and exceedingly pure, there is no doubt. (84)

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ tapasāṃ karaṇe sati ..
tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nṛnaṃ śālagrāmaśilārcanāt .. 85 ..
meaning:
पाठे चतुर्णां वेदानां तपसां करणे सति ..
तत्पुण्यं लभते नृनं शालग्रामशिलार्चनात् .. 85 ..
text_mt:
[Whatever merit lies] in reciting the four Vedas, [or] in performing austerities,
that merit a mortal surely attains from the worship of a Śāligrāma stone. (85)

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yo naraḥ ..
surepsitaṃ prasādaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāharam ..86..
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलातोयं नित्यं भुङ्क्ते च यो नरः ..
सुरेप्सितं प्रसादं च जन्ममृत्युजराहरम् ..86..
text_mt:
And the man who daily partakes of the water of a Śāligrāma stone,
and the offering desired by the gods, which removes birth, death, and old age, (86)

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sparśaṃ ca vāñchanti tīrthāni nikhi lāni ca ..
jīvanmukto mahāpūto'pyante yāti hareḥ padam .. 87 ..
meaning:
तस्य स्पर्शं च वाञ्छन्ति तीर्थानि निखि लानि च ..
जीवन्मुक्तो महापूतोऽप्यन्ते याति हरेः पदम् .. 87 ..
text_mt: liberated while living and exceedingly pure, he goes to Hari's abode at the end. (87)

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva hariṇā sārddhamasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam ..
paśyatyeva hi dāsye ca nirmukto dāsyakarmaṇi .. 88 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
tatpādapadmarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ..

meaning:
तत्पादपद्मरजसा सद्यः पूता वसुन्धरा ..
पुंसां लक्षं तत्पितॄणां निस्तारस्तस्य जन्मनः .. 2.21.90 ..

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: And he who obtains the water of a Śāligrāma stone at the time of death,

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāṇamuktiṃ labhate karmabhogādvimucyate ..

He attains the liberation of nirvāṇa, is released from the experience of karma,

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāṃ dhṛtvā mithyāvādaṃ vadettu yaḥ..

meaning:
शालग्रामशिलां धृत्वा मिथ्यावादं वदेत्तु यः..

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāṃ spṛṣṭvā svīkāraṃ yo na pālayet ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
sadyastaddehajātā ca babhūva gaṇḍakī nadī ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: Those that remain on the land are known to be tawny from the heat of Hari."

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇībījapūrvaṃ daśākṣaram..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ vṛndāvanyai svāhā ..
anena kalpataruṇā mantrarājena nārada ..
pūjayecca vidhānena sarvasiddhiṃ labhennaraḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं ऐं वृन्दावन्यै स्वाहा ..
अनेन कल्पतरुणा मन्त्रराजेन नारद ..
पूजयेच्च विधानेन सर्वसिद्धिं लभेन्नरः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtadīpena dhūpena sinduracandanena ca ..
naivedyena ca puṣpeṇa copahāreṇa nārada..12..
meaning:
घृतदीपेन धूपेन सिन्दुरचन्दनेन च ..
नैवेद्येन च पुष्पेण चोपहारेण नारद..12..

sanskrit_iast:

प्रपन्ना चरणाम्भोजे जगाम शरणं शुभम्..13..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
वरं तस्यै ददौ विष्णुर्जगत्पूज्या भवेति च ..
अहं त्वां च धरिष्यामि स्वमूर्ध्नि वक्षसीति च .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tvāṃ dhārayiṣyanti svayaṃ mūrdhni surādayaḥ ..
ityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā ca prayayau svālayaṃ vibhuḥ..15..
meaning:
सर्वे त्वां धारयिष्यन्ति स्वयं मूर्ध्नि सुरादयः ..
इत्युक्त्वा तां गृहीत्वा च प्रययौ स्वालयं विभुः..15..

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ vā pūjāvidhikramam ..

meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
किं ध्यानं स्तवनं किं वा किं वा पूजाविधिक्रमम् ..
तुलस्याश्च महाभाग तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि..16..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca..
antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ ca gatvā ca tulasīvanam..

meaning:
नारायण उवाच..
अन्तर्हितायां तस्यां च गत्वा च तुलसीवनम्..
हरिः संपूज्य तुष्टाव तुलसीं विरहातुरः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
vṛndārūpāśca vṛkṣāśca yadaikatra bhavanti ca ..
vidurbudhāstena vṛndāṃ matpriyāṃ tāṃ bhajā myaham..18..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
वृन्दारूपाश्च वृक्षाश्च यदैकत्र भवन्ति च ..
विदुर्बुधास्तेन वृन्दां मत्प्रियां तां भजा म्यहम्..18..

sanskrit_iast:
purā babhūva yā devī hyādau vṛndāvane vane ..
tena vṛndāvanī khyātā tāṃ saubhāgyāṃ bhajāmyaham..19..
meaning:
पुरा बभूव या देवी ह्यादौ वृन्दावने वने ..
तेन वृन्दावनी ख्याता तां सौभाग्यां भजाम्यहम्..19..
text_mt: is therefore renowned as Vṛndāvanī; I worship that fortunate one. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu pūjitā yā nirantaram ..
tena viśvapūjitākhyāṃ jagatpūjyāṃ bhajāmyaham ..2.22.20..
meaning:
असंख्येषु च विश्वेषु पूजिता या निरन्तरम् ..
तेन विश्वपूजिताख्यां जगत्पूज्यां भजाम्यहम् ..2.22.20..
text_mt:
She who is continually worshipped in countless universes,
is named Viśvapūjitā for that reason; I worship her who is worshipped by the world. // 20

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
असंख्यानि च विश्वानि पवित्राणि यया सदा ..
तां विश्वपावनीं देवीं विरहेण स्मराम्यहम् ..21..
text_mt:
By whom countless universes are ever made pure,
that goddess Viśvapāvanī I remember in my separation. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
devā na tuṣṭāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ samūhena yayā vinā ..

meaning:
देवा न तुष्टाः पुष्पाणां समूहेन यया विना ..
तां पुष्पसारां शुद्धां च द्रष्टुमिच्छामि शोकतः..22..
text_mt:
Without whom the gods are not pleased by a multitude of flowers,
her, the essence of flowers, pure, I wish to see out of sorrow. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
viśve yatprāptimātreṇa bhaktyā''nando bhaveddhruvam..

meaning:
विश्वे यत्प्राप्तिमात्रेण भक्त्या'ऽनन्दो भवेद्ध्रुवम्..
नन्दिनी तेन विख्याता सा प्रीता भविता हि मे..23..
text_mt:
By merely obtaining whom in the universe joy truly arises through devotion,
she is therefore renowned as Nandinī; may she indeed be pleased with me! // 23

sanskrit_iast:
