What kind is indirect brahmahatyā or cow-slaughter?
Who is a forbidden woman for men, or who is one devoid of twilight prayers?

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitaḥ pumānko vā ko vā tīrthe pratigrahī ..
dvijaḥ ko vā grāmayājī ko vā vipraśca devalaḥ .. 147 ..
meaning:
अदीक्षितः पुमान्को वा को वा तीर्थे प्रतिग्रही ..
द्विजः को वा ग्रामयाजी को वा विप्रश्च देवलः .. 147 ..
text_mt:
Who is an uninitiated man, or who is an acceptor of gifts at a sacred place?
What twice-born is a sacrificer for an entire village, or what vipra is a temple priest?

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraḥ kaḥ pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 148 ..
meaning:
शूद्राणां सूपकारः कः प्रमत्तो वृषलीपतिः ..
एतेषां लक्षणं सर्वं वद वेदविदां वर .. 148 ..
text_mt:
Who is a cook for śūdras, or an infatuated husband of an outcaste woman?
Tell me all the characteristics of these, O best of Vedic knowers!

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca ..
śrīkṛṣṇe ca tadarccāyāṃ mṛnmayyāṃ prakṛtau tathā ..
śive ca śivaliṅge vā sūryye sūryyamaṇau tathā .. 149 ..
meaning:
यम उवाच ..
श्रीकृष्णे च तदर्च्चायां मृन्मय्यां प्रकृतौ तथा ..
शिवे च शिवलिङ्गे वा सूर्य्ये सूर्य्यमणौ तथा .. 149 ..
text_mt:
Toward Śrī Kṛṣṇa and his image, likewise toward earthen Prakṛti,
toward Śiva or a liṅga of Śiva, toward Sūrya or a sun-stone,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśe vā tadarccāyāmevaṃ sarvatra sundari ..
karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ..2.30.150..
meaning:
गणेशे वा तदर्च्चायामेवं सर्वत्र सुन्दरि ..
करोति भेदबुद्धिं यो ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः..2.30.150..
text_mt: or toward Gaṇeśa or his image—in this way everywhere, O beautiful one.

sanskrit_iast:
svagurau sveṣṭadeve vā janmadātari mātari..
karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ..151..
meaning:
स्वगुरौ स्वेष्टदेवे वा जन्मदातरि मातरि..
करोति भेदबुद्धिं यो ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः..151..
text_mt: Between one's guru or one's chosen deity, / and the father who gave birth and the mother,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇaveṣvanyabhakteṣu brāhmaṇeṣvitareṣu ca ..
karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 152 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवेष्वन्यभक्तेषु ब्राह्मणेष्वितरेषु च ..
करोति समतां यो हि ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 152 ..
text_mt: Between Vaiṣṇavas and other devotees, / and between brahmins and others,

sanskrit_iast:
yo mūḍho viṣṇunaivedye cānyanaivedyake tathā ..
hareḥ pādodakeṣvanyadevapādodake tathā ..
karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 153 ..
meaning:
यो मूढो विष्णुनैवेद्ये चान्यनैवेद्यके तथा ..
हरेः पादोदकेष्वन्यदेवपादोदके तथा ..
करोति समतां यो हि ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 153 ..
text_mt:
That fool who, between the food-offering of Viṣṇu and another's food-offering, / and likewise
between the foot-wash water of Hari and the foot-wash water of other gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvareśvare kṛṣṇe sarvakāraṇakāraṇe ..
sarvādye sarvadevānāṃ sevye sarvāntarātmani .. 154 ..
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरेश्वरे कृष्णे सर्वकारणकारणे ..
सर्वाद्ये सर्वदेवानां सेव्ये सर्वान्तरात्मनि .. 154 ..
text_mt:
With the Lord of all lords, Kṛṣṇa, the cause of all causes,
the first of all, to be served by all the gods, the inner Self of all,

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā'nekarūpe vā'pyeka eva hi nirguṇe ..
karotyanyena samatāṃ brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 155 ..
meaning:
माययाऽनेकरूपे वाऽप्येक एव हि निर्गुणे ..
करोत्यन्येन समतां ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 155 ..
text_mt:
having many forms through māyā, or indeed one alone and devoid of gunas—
whoever equates anyone else with him incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevārcanāṃ paurvāparāṃ vedavinirmitām ..
yaḥ karoti niṣedhaṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 156 ..
meaning:
पितृदेवार्चनां पौर्वापरां वेदविनिर्मिताम् ..
यः करोति निषेधं च ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 156 ..
text_mt:
The worship of the ancestors and the gods, traditional and established by the Veda—
whoever forbids it incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
ye nindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tanmantropāsakaṃ tathā ..
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te .. 157 ..
meaning:
ये निन्दन्ति हृषीकेशं तन्मन्त्रोपासकं तथा ..
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च ब्रह्महत्यां लभन्ति ते .. 157 ..
text_mt:
Those who revile Hṛṣīkeśa and the worshipper of his mantra,
and the purest of the pure, incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikaṃ priyam ..
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca jñānānandaṃ sanātanam .. 158..
meaning:
शिवं शिवस्वरूपं च कृष्णप्राणाधिकं प्रियम् ..
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च ज्ञानानन्दं सनातनम् .. 158..
text_mt:
Śiva, who is the very embodiment of auspiciousness, dearer than life to Kṛṣṇa,
the purest of the pure, the bliss of knowledge, the eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ savyamīśvaram..
ye nārcayanti nindanti brahmahatyāṃ labhaṃti te .. 159 ..
meaning:
प्रधानं वैष्णवानां च देवानां सव्यमीश्वरम्..
ये नार्चयन्ति निन्दन्ति ब्रह्महत्यां लभंति ते .. 159 ..
text_mt:
the foremost among the Vaiṣṇavas, the Lord auspicious among the gods—
those who do not worship him, but revile him, incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
ye viṣṇumāyāṃ nindanti viṣṇubhaktipradāṃ satīm ..
sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca prakṛtiṃ sarvamātaram .. 2.30.160 ..
meaning:
ये विष्णुमायां निन्दन्ति विष्णुभक्तिप्रदां सतीम् ..
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपां च प्रकृतिं सर्वमातरम् .. 2.30.160 ..
text_mt:
Those who revile Viṣṇu's māyā, the chaste goddess who bestows devotion to Viṣṇu,
who is the embodiment of all powers, Prakṛti, the mother of all,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevīsvarūpāṃ ca sarvādyāṃ sarvavanditām ..
sarvakāraṇarūpāṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te .. 161 ..
meaning:
सर्वदेवीस्वरूपां च सर्वाद्यां सर्ववन्दिताम् ..
सर्वकारणरूपां च ब्रह्महत्यां लभन्ति ते .. 161 ..
text_mt:
who is the embodiment of all goddesses, the primal one, praised by all,
and the embodiment of all causes—they incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ rāmanavamīṃ puṇyadāṃ parām ..
śivarātriṃ tathā caikādaśīṃ vāraṃ ravestathā .. 162 ..
meaning:
कृष्णजन्माष्टमीं रामनवमीं पुण्यदां पराम् ..
शिवरात्रिं तथा चैकादशीं वारं रवेस्तथा .. 162 ..
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa's Janmāṣṭamī, Rāmanavamī, which yields supreme merit,
Śivarātri, and likewise Ekādaśī, and the day of the Sun—

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaparvāṇi puṇyāni ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ ..
labhante brahmahatyāṃ te cāṇḍālādhikapāpinaḥ .. 163 ..
meaning:
पञ्चपर्वाणि पुण्यानि ये न कुर्वन्ति मानवाः ..
लभन्ते ब्रह्महत्यां ते चाण्डालाधिकपापिनः .. 163 ..
text_mt:
those mortals who do not observe these five meritorious sacred days,
being sinners worse than outcasts, incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
ambuvīcyāṃbukhanane jale śaucādikaṃ ca ye ..
kurvanti bhārate vatse brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te .. 164 ..
meaning:
अम्बुवीच्यांबुखनने जले शौचादिकं च ये ..
कुर्वन्ति भारते वत्से ब्रह्महत्यां लभन्ति ते .. 164 ..
text_mt:
Those who, during the days of the earth's impurity, in water-digging, or in water, / perform cleansing [of feces] and the like,
in Bhārata, O child, incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ ca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryyāṃ sutaṃ sutām ..
anāthānyo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 165 ..
meaning:
गुरुं च मातरं तातं साध्वीं भार्य्यां सुतं सुताम् ..
अनाथान्यो न पुष्णाति ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 165 ..
text_mt:
The guru, the mother, the father, a virtuous wife, a son, a daughter—
whoever does not support these when they are helpless incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāho yasya na bhavenna paśyati sutaṃ ca yaḥ ..
haribhaktivihīno yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 166 ..
meaning:
विवाहो यस्य न भवेन्न पश्यति सुतं च यः ..
हरिभक्तिविहीनो यो ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 166 ..
text_mt:
He who has no marriage, who does not behold a son,
and who is devoid of devotion to Hari, incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
hareranaivedyabhojī nityaṃ viṣṇuṃ na pūjayet ..
puṇyaṃ pārthivaliṃgaṃ vā brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 167 ..
meaning:
हरेरनैवेद्यभोजी नित्यं विष्णुं न पूजयेत् ..
पुण्यं पार्थिवलिंगं वा ब्रह्महत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 167 ..
text_mt:
He who eats what is not offered to Hari, and does not constantly worship Viṣṇu
or the sacred earthen liṅga, incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
āhāraṃ kurvatīṃ gāṃ ca pibantīṃ yo nivārayet ..
yāti goviprayormmadhye gohatyāṃ ca labhettu saḥ .. 168 ..
meaning:
आहारं कुर्वतीं गां च पिबन्तीं यो निवारयेत् ..
याति गोविप्रयोर्म्मध्ये गोहत्यां च लभेत्तु सः .. 168 ..
text_mt:
Whoever prevents a cow that is eating or drinking,
or steps between a cow and a brahmin, incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍairgāstāḍayenmūḍho yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ ..
dine dine gavāṃ hatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 169 ..
meaning:
दण्डैर्गास्ताडयेन्मूढो यो विप्रो वृषवाहकः ..
दिने दिने गवां हत्यां लभते नात्र संशयः .. 169 ..
text_mt:
The fool who strikes cows with sticks, and the brahmin who drives an ox,
incurs day after day the sin of killing cows; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti gobhya ucchiṣṭaṃ yojayedvṛṣavāhakam ..
bhojayedvṛṣavāhānnaṃ sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam.. .. 2.30.170..
meaning:
ददाति गोभ्य उच्छिष्टं योजयेद्वृषवाहकम् ..
भोजयेद्वृषवाहान्नं स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम्.. .. 2.30.170..
text_mt:
Whoever gives leftover food to cows, or employs an ox-driver,
or eats the food of an ox-driver, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣalīpatiṃ yājayedyo bhuṃkte'nnaṃ tasya yo naraḥ ..
gohatyāśatakaṃ so'pi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 171 ..
meaning:
वृषलीपतिं याजयेद्यो भुंक्तेऽन्नं तस्य यो नरः ..
गोहत्याशतकं सोऽपि लभते नात्र संशयः .. 171 ..
text_mt:
The person who performs sacrifices for the husband of an outcaste woman, or eats his food,
he too incurs the sin of killing a hundred cows; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaṃ dadāti vahnau ca gāśca pādena tāḍayet ..
gṛhaṃ viśedadhautāṃghriḥ snātvā govadhamāpnuyāt .. 172 ..
meaning:
पादं ददाति वह्नौ च गाश्च पादेन ताडयेत् ..
गृहं विशेदधौतांघ्रिः स्नात्वा गोवधमाप्नुयात् .. 172 ..
text_mt:
Whoever places his foot in fire, strikes cows with his foot,
or enters the house with unwashed feet after bathing, incurs the sin of cow-slaughter.

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhuṃkte snigdhapādena śete snigdhāṃghrireva ca ..
sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 173 ..
meaning:
यो भुंक्ते स्निग्धपादेन शेते स्निग्धांघ्रिरेव च ..
सूर्य्योदये च द्विर्भोजी स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 173 ..
text_mt:
Whoever eats with wet feet, or sleeps with wet feet,
and eats twice at sunrise, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte yonijīvī ca vai dvijaḥ ..
yastrisandhyāvihīnaśca sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam ..174..
meaning:
अवीरान्नं च यो भुंक्ते योनिजीवी च वै द्विजः ..
यस्त्रिसन्ध्याविहीनश्च स गोहत्यां लभेद् ध्रुवम् ..174..
text_mt:
Whoever eats the food of a woman without husband or son, or a twice-born who lives off women,
and whoever neglects the three daily twilight prayers, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṃśca parvakāle ca tithikāle ca devatām ..
na sevate'tithiṃ yo hi gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam .. 175 ..
meaning:
पितॄंश्च पर्वकाले च तिथिकाले च देवताम् ..
न सेवतेऽतिथिं यो हि गोहत्यां स लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 175 ..
text_mt:
Whoever does not honour the ancestors on the sacred day, the deity on the lunar day,
or a guest, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhartari ca kṛṣṇe ca bhedabuddhiṃ karoti yā ..
kaṭūktyā tāḍayetkāntaṃ sā gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ..176..
meaning:
स्वभर्तरि च कृष्णे च भेदबुद्धिं करोति या ..
कटूक्त्या ताडयेत्कान्तं सा गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् ..176..
text_mt:
A woman who sees a difference between her own husband and Kṛṣṇa,
or berates her beloved with harsh words, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
gomārgakhananaṃ kṛtvā vapate sasyameva ca ..
taḍāge vā tadūrdhvaṃ vā sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 177 ..
meaning:
गोमार्गखननं कृत्वा वपते सस्यमेव च ..
तडागे वा तदूर्ध्वं वा स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 177 ..
text_mt:
Having dug up the path of cows, whoever sows grain [there],
or in a pond or above it, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ govadhasya yaḥ karoti vyatikramam ..
arthalobhādathājñānātsa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 178 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं गोवधस्य यः करोति व्यतिक्रमम् ..
अर्थलोभादथाज्ञानात्स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 178 ..
text_mt:
Whoever perverts the penance for the slaughter of a cow,
whether through greed for wealth or out of ignorance, surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
rājake daivake yatnādgosvāmī gāṃ na pātayet ..
duḥkhaṃ dadāti yo mūḍho gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam ..179..
meaning:
राजके दैवके यत्नाद्गोस्वामी गां न पातयेत् ..
दुःखं ददाति यो मूढो गोहत्यां स लभेद्ध्रुवम् ..179..
text_mt:
A cow-owner should diligently not let a cow fall into trouble caused by the king or by fate;
the fool who inflicts suffering [on cows] surely incurs the sin of killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇinaṃ laṃghayedyo hi devārcāyāṃ rataṃ jalam ..
naivedyaṃ puṣpamannaṃ ca sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. ..2.30.180..
meaning:
प्राणिनं लंघयेद्यो हि देवार्चायां रतं जलम् ..
नैवेद्यं पुष्पमन्नं च स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. ..2.30.180..
text_mt:
Whoever steps over a living creature, or water devoted to the worship of a deity,
or food offering, flowers, and cooked food, he surely incurs [the sin of] killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśvannāstīti vādī yo mithyāvādī pratārakaḥ ..
devadveṣī gurudveṣī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 181 ..
meaning:
शश्वन्नास्तीति वादी यो मिथ्यावादी प्रतारकः ..
देवद्वेषी गुरुद्वेषी स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 181 ..
text_mt:
Whoever constantly says 'it is not,' who speaks untruth, who is a deceiver,
who hates the gods, who hates his guru—he surely incurs [the sin of] killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ sati ..
sambhramānna namedyo hi sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ..182..
meaning:
देवताप्रतिमां दृष्ट्वा गुरुं वा ब्राह्मणं सति ..
सम्भ्रमान्न नमेद्यो हि स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् ..182..
text_mt:
Having seen an image of a deity, a guru, or a brāhmaṇa, O virtuous woman,
he who does not bow in reverence surely incurs [the sin of] killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
na dadātyāśiṣaṃ kopātpraṇatāya ca yo dvijaḥ ..
vidyārthine ca vidyāṃ vai sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ..183..
meaning:
न ददात्याशिषं कोपात्प्रणताय च यो द्विजः ..
विद्यार्थिने च विद्यां वै स गोहत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् ..183..
text_mt:
And whatever twice-born man, out of anger, does not give a blessing to one who bows,
and [does not teach] knowledge to a seeker of knowledge, he surely incurs [the sin of] killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
gohatyā brahmahatyā ca kathitā cātideśikī ..
yathā śrutaṃ sūryyavaktrātkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 184 ..
meaning:
गोहत्या ब्रह्महत्या च कथिता चातिदेशिकी ..
यथा श्रुतं सूर्य्यवक्त्रात्किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 184 ..
text_mt:
Killing a cow and killing a brāhmaṇa have been declared by transference [of sin]
just as heard from the mouth of the Sun. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitryuvāca ..
vāstave cātideśe ca sambandhe pāpapuṇyayoḥ ..
nyūnādhike ca ko bhedastanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi .. 185 ..
meaning:
सावित्र्युवाच ..
वास्तवे चातिदेशे च सम्बन्धे पापपुण्ययोः ..
न्यूनाधिके च को भेदस्तन्मां व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 185 ..
text_mt:
"Regarding the connection between sin and merit, whether literal or transferred,
what is the distinction in terms of lesser and greater? You ought to explain that to me."

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca ..
kutrāpi vāstavaḥ śreṣṭho nyūno'tideśikassadā ..
kutrātideśikaḥ śreṣṭho vāstavo nyūna eva ca .. 186 ..
meaning:
यम उवाच ..
कुत्रापि वास्तवः श्रेष्ठो न्यूनोऽतिदेशिकस्सदा ..
कुत्रातिदेशिकः श्रेष्ठो वास्तवो न्यून एव च .. 186 ..
text_mt:
"In some cases the literal is greater and the transferred is always lesser;
in some cases the transferred is greater and the literal is indeed lesser.

sanskrit_iast:
kutra vā samatā sādhvi tayorvedapramāṇataḥ ..
karoti tatra nāsthāṃ yo guruhatyāṃ labhettu saḥ .. 187 ..
meaning:
कुत्र वा समता साध्वि तयोर्वेदप्रमाणतः ..
करोति तत्र नास्थां यो गुरुहत्यां लभेत्तु सः .. 187 ..
text_mt:
Or in some cases there is equality between the two, O virtuous woman, by the authority of the Veda.
He who places no faith in that incurs [the sin of] killing his guru.

sanskrit_iast:
purā paricite vipre vidyāmantrapradātari ..
gurau pitṛtvamāropādvastutaśśreṣṭha ucyate..188..
meaning:
पुरा परिचिते विप्रे विद्यामन्त्रप्रदातरि ..
गुरौ पितृत्वमारोपाद्वस्तुतश्श्रेष्ठ उच्यते..188..
text_mt:
With regard to a brāhmaṇa previously known who imparts knowledge and mantras,
by attributing fatherhood to the guru, he is called superior in reality.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇastathā..
vidyā mantrapradātā ca guruḥ pūjyaḥ śrutermataḥ .. 189 ..
meaning:
पितुः शतगुणा माता मातुः शतगुणस्तथा..
विद्या मन्त्रप्रदाता च गुरुः पूज्यः श्रुतेर्मतः .. 189 ..
text_mt:
A mother is a hundred times [greater than] a father, and a hundred times [greater than] a mother
is the guru who imparts knowledge and mantras, venerable according to the testimony of Vedic scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
guruto gurupatnī ca gaurave ca garīyasī ..
yatheṣṭaṃ devapatnī ca pūjyā cābhīṣṭadevatā.. .. 2.30.190 ..
meaning:
गुरुतो गुरुपत्नी च गौरवे च गरीयसी ..
यथेष्टं देवपत्नी च पूज्या चाभीष्टदेवता.. .. 2.30.190 ..
text_mt:
And the guru's wife is superior to the guru in dignity,
just as the wife of a god is worshipful as one's chosen deity according to one's wish.

sanskrit_iast:
vipraḥ śivasamo yaśca viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ ..
rājā''tideśikācchreṣṭho vāstavo guṇalakṣataḥ .. 191 ..
meaning:
विप्रः शिवसमो यश्च विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमः ..
राजा'ऽतिदेशिकाच्छ्रेष्ठो वास्तवो गुणलक्षतः .. 191 ..
text_mt:
A brāhmaṇa is equal to Śiva, and a king whose prowess is equal to Viṣṇu
is, by transferred status, greater; [yet] the literal [brāhmaṇa] is greater by a hundred thousand qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamaṃ toyaṃ sarve vyāsasamā dvijāḥ ..
grahaṇe sṛryyaśaśinoścātraiva samatā tayoḥ .. 192 ..
meaning:
सर्वं गङ्गासमं तोयं सर्वे व्याससमा द्विजाः ..
ग्रहणे सृर्य्यशशिनोश्चात्रैव समता तयोः .. 192 ..
text_mt:
All water is equal to the Gaṅgā; all twice-born are equal to Vyāsa
during an eclipse of the sun and the moon: precisely there lies their equality.

sanskrit_iast:
ātideśikahatyāyā vāstavaśca caturguṇaḥ ..
sammataḥ sarvavedānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. 193 ..
meaning:
आतिदेशिकहत्याया वास्तवश्च चतुर्गुणः ..
सम्मतः सर्ववेदानामित्याह कमलोद्भवः .. 193 ..
text_mt:
The literal killing is fourfold [in gravity] compared to a transferred killing;
this is approved by all the Vedas, as said by Brahmā, the lotus-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ātideśikahatyāyā bhedaśca kathitaḥ sati ..
yā yā'gamyā nṛṇāmeva nibodha kathayāmi te .. 194 ..
meaning:
आतिदेशिकहत्याया भेदश्च कथितः सति ..
या याऽगम्या नृणामेव निबोध कथयामि ते .. 194 ..
text_mt:
The distinction regarding transferred killing has been declared, O virtuous woman;
now learn which women are forbidden for men; I shall tell you.

sanskrit_iast:
svastrī gamyā ca sarveṣāmiti vede nirūpitā ..
agamyā ca tadanyā yā ceti vedavedo viduḥ .. 195 ..
meaning:
स्वस्त्री गम्या च सर्वेषामिति वेदे निरूपिता ..
अगम्या च तदन्या या चेति वेदवेदो विदुः .. 195 ..
text_mt:
One's own wife is approachable for all, as established in the Veda;
and any woman other than her is forbidden—so know the knowers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari ..
atyagamyāśca yā yā vai nibodha kathayāmi te .. 196 ..
meaning:
सामान्यं कथितं सर्वं विशेषं शृणु सुन्दरि ..
अत्यगम्याश्च या या वै निबोध कथयामि ते .. 196 ..
text_mt: whichever women are strictly forbidden, learn as I tell you:

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ viprapatnī ca viprāṇāṃ śūdrakāminī ..
atyagamyā'tinindyā ca loke vede pativrate .. 197 ..
meaning:
शूद्राणां विप्रपत्नी च विप्राणां शूद्रकामिनी ..
अत्यगम्याऽतिनिन्द्या च लोके वेदे पतिव्रते .. 197 ..
text_mt:
For Śūdras, the wife of a brāhmaṇa; and for brāhmaṇas, a Śūdra woman
is strictly forbidden and deeply censured in the world and in the Veda, O devoted wife.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdraścedbrāhmaṇīṃ gacchedbrahmahatyāśataṃ labhet ..
tatsamaṃ brāhmaṇī cāpi kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam .. 198 ..
meaning:
शूद्रश्चेद्ब्राह्मणीं गच्छेद्ब्रह्महत्याशतं लभेत् ..
तत्समं ब्राह्मणी चापि कुम्भीपाकं व्रजेद्ध्रुवम् .. 198 ..
text_mt:
If a Śūdra approaches a brāhmaṇa woman, he incurs a hundred [sins of] killing a brāhmaṇa,
and equal to that, the brāhmaṇa woman surely goes to Kumbhīpāka hell.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi śūdrāṃ vrajedvipro vṛṣalīpatireva saḥ ..
sa bhraṣṭo viprajāteśca caṇḍālātso 'dhamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 199 ..
meaning:
यदि शूद्रां व्रजेद्विप्रो वृषलीपतिरेव सः ..
स भ्रष्टो विप्रजातेश्च चण्डालात्सो ऽधमः स्मृतः .. 199 ..
text_mt:
If a brāhmaṇa approaches a Śūdra woman, he is indeed the husband of a Śūdrā;
fallen from the caste of brāhmaṇas, he is regarded as lower than a Caṇḍāla.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭhāsamaśca tatpiṃḍo mūtratulyaṃ ca tarpaṇam ..
tatpitṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pūjane tatsamaṃ sati .. 2.30.200 ..
meaning:
विष्ठासमश्च तत्पिंडो मूत्रतुल्यं च तर्पणम् ..
तत्पितॄणां सुराणां च पूजने तत्समं सति .. 2.30.200 ..
text_mt:
His funerary cake is equal to feces, and his libation is equal to urine;
in the worship of his ancestors and of the gods, [his offering] is equal to that, O virtuous woman.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ sandhyārcātapasā'rjitam ..
dvijasya vṛṣalībhogānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ .. 201 ..
meaning:
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं सन्ध्यार्चातपसाऽर्जितम् ..
द्विजस्य वृषलीभोगान्नश्यत्येव न संशयः .. 201 ..
text_mt:
Merit acquired over ten million births, earned through twilight worship and asceticism,
is utterly destroyed for a twice-born man by enjoying a Śūdra woman, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaśca surāpītī viḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
harivāsarabhojī ca kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam .. 202 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणश्च सुरापीती विड्भोजी वृषलीपतिः ..
हरिवासरभोजी च कुम्भीपाकं व्रजेद्ध्रुवम् .. 202 ..
text_mt:
A brāhmaṇa who drinks liquor, eats feces, is the husband of a Śūdrā,
and eats on the day of Hari [Ekādaśī], surely goes to Kumbhīpāka hell.

sanskrit_iast:
gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīmātaraṃ prasūm ..
sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ sati .. 203 ..
meaning:
गुरुपत्नीं राजपत्नीं सपत्नीमातरं प्रसूम् ..
सुतां पुत्रवधूं श्वश्रूं सगर्भां भगिनीं सति .. 203 ..
text_mt:
The guru's wife, a king's wife, a stepmother, one's own mother,
a daughter, a son's wife, a mother-in-law, a pregnant woman, a sister, O virtuous woman,

sanskrit_iast:
sodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ ca mātulānīṃ pitṛprasūm ..
mātuḥ prasūṃ tattvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām .. .. 204 ..
meaning:
सोदरभ्रातृजायां च मातुलानीं पितृप्रसूम् ..
मातुः प्रसूं तत्त्वसारं भगिनीं भ्रातृकन्यकाम् .. .. 204 ..
text_mt:
a full brother's wife, a maternal uncle's wife, a paternal grandmother,
a maternal grandmother, an essential sister, a brother's daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyāṃ ca śiṣyapatnīṃ ca bhagineyasya kāminīm ..
bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivāpyagamyāmāha padmajaḥ .. 205 ..
meaning:
शिष्यां च शिष्यपत्नीं च भगिनेयस्य कामिनीम् ..
भ्रातुः पुत्रप्रियां चैवाप्यगम्यामाह पद्मजः .. 205 ..
text_mt:
a female pupil, a pupil's wife, a sister's son's wife,
and a brother's son's beloved—these the lotus-born [Brahmā] declared forbidden.

sanskrit_iast:
etāsvekāmanekāṃ vā yo vrajenmānavo'dhamaḥ ..
svamātṛgāmī vedeṣu brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet .. 206 ..
meaning:
एतास्वेकामनेकां वा यो व्रजेन्मानवोऽधमः ..
स्वमातृगामी वेदेषु ब्रह्महत्याशतं लभेत् .. 206 ..
text_mt:
Whichever vile man approaches one or many of these
is an approacher of his own mother in the Vedas; he incurs a hundred [sins of] killing a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
akarmmārho'pi so'spṛśyo loke vede'ti ninditaḥ ..
sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca mahāpāpī sudustaram..207..
meaning:
अकर्म्मार्होऽपि सोऽस्पृश्यो लोके वेदेऽति निन्दितः ..
स याति कुम्भीपाकं च महापापी सुदुस्तरम्..207..
text_mt:
Unfit for sacred rites and untouchable, he is severely condemned in the world and in the Veda;
that great sinner goes to Kumbhīpāka hell, which is exceedingly difficult to cross.

sanskrit_iast:
karotyaśuddhāṃ sandhyāṃ ca sandhyāṃ vā na karoti yaḥ..
trisandhyāṃ varjayedyo vā sandhyāhīnaśca sa dvijaḥ ..208..
meaning:
करोत्यशुद्धां सन्ध्यां च सन्ध्यां वा न करोति यः..
त्रिसन्ध्यां वर्जयेद्यो वा सन्ध्याहीनश्च स द्विजः ..208..
text_mt:
He who performs the twilight worship impurely, or who does not perform the twilight worship,
or who abandons the three twilight prayers—that twice-born man is devoid of twilight worship.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā śaivaṃ śāktaṃ sauraṃ ca gāṇapam ..
yo'haṅkārānna gṛhṇāti mantraṃ so'dīkṣitaḥ smṛtaḥ ..209..
meaning:
वैष्णवं च तथा शैवं शाक्तं सौरं च गाणपम् ..
योऽहङ्कारान्न गृह्णाति मन्त्रं सोऽदीक्षितः स्मृतः ..209..
text_mt:
Whether Vaiṣṇava, Śaiva, Śākta, Saura, or Gāṇapa,
one who through egoism does not receive a mantra is remembered as uninitiated.

sanskrit_iast:
pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam ..
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī gaṅgāgarbhāntare vare .. 2.30.210 ..
meaning:
प्रवाहमवधिं कृत्वा यावद्धस्तचतुष्टयम् ..
तत्र नारायणः स्वामी गङ्गागर्भान्तरे वरे .. 2.30.210 ..
text_mt:
Taking the current as the boundary, as far as four cubits,
there, within the bed of the Gaṅgā, Nārāyaṇa is the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nārāyaṇakṣetre kurukṣetre hareḥ pade..
vārāṇasyāṃ badaryyāṃ ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame .. 211 ..
meaning:
तत्र नारायणक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे हरेः पदे..
वाराणस्यां बदर्य्यां च गङ्गासागरसंगमे .. 211 ..
text_mt:
There in Nārāyaṇa's sacred field, at Kurukṣetra, at the foot of Hari,
in Vārāṇasī, in Badarī, and at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkare bhāskarakṣetre prabhāse rāsamaṇḍale ..
haridvāre ca kedāre some badarapāvane .. 212 ..
meaning:
पुष्करे भास्करक्षेत्रे प्रभासे रासमण्डले ..
हरिद्वारे च केदारे सोमे बदरपावने .. 212 ..
text_mt:
at Puṣkara, the field of the sun, Prabhāsa, the Rāsa-circle,
at Haridvāra and Kedāra, at Soma, at pure Badara,

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatīnadītīre puṇye vṛndāvane vane ..
godāvaryāṃ ca kauśikyāṃ triveṇyāṃ ca himālaye .. 213 ..
meaning:
सरस्वतीनदीतीरे पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने ..
गोदावर्यां च कौशिक्यां त्रिवेण्यां च हिमालये .. 213 ..
text_mt:
on the bank of the river Sarasvatī, in the holy forest of Vṛndāvana,
at the Godāvarī, the Kauśikī, Triveṇī, and in the Himālaya—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣvanyatra ca yo dānaṃ pratigṛhṇāti kāmataḥ ..
sa ca tīrthapratigrāhī kumbhīpākaṃ prayāti ca .. 214 ..
meaning:
एष्वन्यत्र च यो दानं प्रतिगृह्णाति कामतः ..
स च तीर्थप्रतिग्राही कुम्भीपाकं प्रयाति च .. 214 ..
text_mt:
he who, driven by desire, accepts a gift in these places or elsewhere,
that receiver of gifts at sacred sites goes to Kumbhīpāka.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrātiriktayājī yo grāmayājī ca kīrttitaḥ ..
tathā devopajīvī yo devalaḥ parikīrttitaḥ .. 215 ..
meaning:
शूद्रातिरिक्तयाजी यो ग्रामयाजी च कीर्त्तितः ..
तथा देवोपजीवी यो देवलः परिकीर्त्तितः .. 215 ..
text_mt:
One who sacrifices for those lower than Śūdras is proclaimed a village priest;
and one who makes a living off an idol is proclaimed a temple attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrapākopajīvī yaḥ sūpakāra iti smṛtaḥ ..
sandhyāpūjāvihīnaśca pramattaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 216 ..
meaning:
शूद्रपाकोपजीवी यः सूपकार इति स्मृतः ..
सन्ध्यापूजाविहीनश्च प्रमत्तः पतितः स्मृतः .. 216 ..
text_mt:
He who lives by cooking for a Śūdra is remembered as a cook;
and lacking twilight prayers and worship, careless, he is considered fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ pūrvaprakaraṇe lakṣaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ ..
ete mahāpātakinaḥ kumbhīpākaṃ prayānti te .. 217 ..
meaning:
उक्तं पूर्वप्रकरणे लक्षणं वृषलीपतेः ..
एते महापातकिनः कुम्भीपाकं प्रयान्ति ते .. 217 ..
text_mt:
In the preceding section, the characteristics of the husband of an outcaste woman were stated.
These great sinners go to Kumbhīpāka.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃḍānyanyāni te yānti nibodha kathayāmi te .. 218 ..
iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvāde karmavipāke pāpinarakanirūpaṇaṃ śivaprāśastyaṃ brahmahatyādipadārthaparibhāṣānirūpaṇaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
कुंडान्यन्यानि ते यान्ति निबोध कथयामि ते .. 218 ..
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्त्ते महापुराणे द्वितीये प्रकृतिखण्डे नारदनारायणसंवादे सावित्र्युपाख्याने यमसावित्रीसंवादे कर्मविपाके पापिनरकनिरूपणं शिवप्राशस्त्यं ब्रह्महत्यादिपदार्थपरिभाषानिरूपणं नाम त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 30 ..
text_mt:
They go to other hell-pits as well; listen, and I shall tell you.
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Examination of Sinners' Hells in the Ripening of Karma, the Praise of Śiva, and the Definition of Meanings of Words such as the Murder of a Brahmin,' in the dialogue between Yama and Sāvitrī, in the Sāvitryupākhyāna, in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the second Prakṛtikhaṇḍa of the great Purāṇa, the holy Brahmavaivarta.

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca ..
harisevāṃ vinā sādhvi na labhetkarmakhaṇḍanam ..
śubhakarmma svargabījaṃ narakaṃ ca kukarmmataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
यम उवाच ..
हरिसेवां विना साध्वि न लभेत्कर्मखण्डनम् ..
शुभकर्म्म स्वर्गबीजं नरकं च कुकर्म्मतः .. 1 ..
title: Kuṇḍanirṇayaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte veśyānnaṃ ca pativrate ..
tāṃ vrajettu dvijo yo hi kālasūtraṃ prayāti saḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुंश्चल्यन्नं च यो भुंक्ते वेश्यान्नं च पतिव्रते ..
तां व्रजेत्तु द्विजो यो हि कालसूत्रं प्रयाति सः .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śatavarṣaṃ kālasūtre sthitvā śūdro bhaveddhruvam ..
tatra janmani rogī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddvijaḥ .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
शतवर्षं कालसूत्रे स्थित्वा शूद्रो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
तत्र जन्मनि रोगी च ततः शुद्धो भवेद्द्विजः .. .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā caikapatnī dvitīye kulaṭā smṛtā ..
tṛtīye dharṣiṇī jñeyā caturthe puṃścalī smṛtā .. 4 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रता चैकपत्नी द्वितीये कुलटा स्मृता ..
तृतीये धर्षिणी ज्ञेया चतुर्थे पुंश्चली स्मृता .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
veśyā ca pañcame ṣaṣṭhe yugmī ca parikīrtitā ..
ata ūrdhvaṃ mahāveśyā sā'spṛśyā sarvajātiṣu .. 5 ..
meaning:
वेश्या च पञ्चमे षष्ठे युग्मी च परिकीर्तिता ..
अत ऊर्ध्वं महावेश्या साऽस्पृश्या सर्वजातिषु .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yo dvijaḥ kulaṭāṃ gaccheddharṣiṇīṃ puṃścalīmapi ..
veśya yugmīṃ mahāveśyāmavaṭodaṃ prayāti saḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
यो द्विजः कुलटां गच्छेद्धर्षिणीं पुंश्चलीमपि ..
वेश्य युग्मीं महावेश्यामवटोदं प्रयाति सः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī caturguṇam ..
ṣaḍguṇaṃ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī guṇāṣṭakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
शताब्दं कुलटागामी धृष्टागामी चतुर्गुणम् ..
षड्गुणं पुंश्चलीगामी वेश्यागामी गुणाष्टकम् .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yugmīgāmī daśaguṇaṃ vasettatra na saṃśayaḥ ..
mahāveśyākāmukaśca tataḥ śataguṇaṃ vaset .. 8 ..
meaning:
युग्मीगामी दशगुणं वसेत्तत्र न संशयः ..
महावेश्याकामुकश्च ततः शतगुणं वसेत् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā hi sarvagāmī cetyevamāha pitāmahaḥ ..
tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṅkte yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ..9..
meaning:
तदा हि सर्वगामी चेत्येवमाह पितामहः ..
तत्रैव यातनां भुङ्क्ते यमदूतेन ताडितः ..9..

sanskrit_iast:
tittiriḥ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī ca vāyasaḥ..
kokilaḥ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī vṛkastathā .. 2.31.10 ..
meaning:
तित्तिरिः कुलटागामी धृष्टागामी च वायसः..
कोकिलः पुंश्चलीगामी वेश्यागामी वृकस्तथा .. 2.31.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yugmīgāmī sūkaraśca saptajanmasu bhārate ..
mahāveśyākāmukaśca śmaśāne śālmalistaruḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
युग्मीगामी सूकरश्च सप्तजन्मसु भारते ..
महावेश्याकामुकश्च श्मशाने शाल्मलिस्तरुः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhuṃkte jñānahīnaśca grahaṇe candrasūyyaryoḥ ..
aruntudaṃ sa yātyeva candramānābdameva ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
यो भुंक्ते ज्ञानहीनश्च ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूय्यर्योः ..
अरुन्तुदं स यात्येव चन्द्रमानाब्दमेव च .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavenmānavassyādudaravyādhisaṃyutaḥ ..
gulmayuktaśca kāṇaśca dantahīnastataḥ śuciḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेन्मानवस्स्यादुदरव्याधिसंयुतः ..
गुल्मयुक्तश्च काणश्च दन्तहीनस्ततः शुचिः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vākpradattāṃ hi kanyāṃ ca yaścānyasmai dadāti ca ..
sa vasetpāṃśubhoge ca tadbhojī ca śatābdakam ..14..
meaning:
वाक्प्रदत्तां हि कन्यां च यश्चान्यस्मै ददाति च ..
स वसेत्पांशुभोगे च तद्भोजी च शताब्दकम् ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
dattāpahārī yaḥ sādhvi pāśaveṣṭaṃ śatābdakam ..
nivaseccharaśayyāyāṃ yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ..15..
meaning:
दत्तापहारी यः साध्वि पाशवेष्टं शताब्दकम् ..
निवसेच्छरशय्यायां यमदूतेन ताडितः..15..

sanskrit_iast:
na pūjayedyo hi bhaktyā śivaliṅgaṃ ca pārthivam ..
sa yāti śūlinaḥ kopācchūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam .. 16 ..
meaning:
न पूजयेद्यो हि भक्त्या शिवलिङ्गं च पार्थिवम् ..
स याति शूलिनः कोपाच्छूलप्रोतं सुदारुणम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā śatābdaṃ tatraiva śvāpadaḥ saptajanmasu ..
tato bhaveddevalaśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
स्थित्वा शताब्दं तत्रैव श्वापदः सप्तजन्मसु ..
ततो भवेद्देवलश्च सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुचिः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
karoti daṇḍaṃ yo vipre yadbhayātkampate dvijaḥ ..
prakampane vasetso'pi vipralomābdameva ca ..18..
meaning:
करोति दण्डं यो विप्रे यद्भयात्कम्पते द्विजः ..
प्रकम्पने वसेत्सोऽपि विप्रलोमाब्दमेव च ..18..

sanskrit_iast:
prakopavadanā kopātsvāminaṃ yā ca paśyati ..
kaṭūktiṃ taṃ ca vadati yāti colkāmukhaṃ ca sā .. 19 ..
meaning:
प्रकोपवदना कोपात्स्वामिनं या च पश्यति ..
कटूक्तिं तं च वदति याति चोल्कामुखं च सा .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ulkāṃ dadāti vaktre ca satataṃ yamakiṅkaraḥ ..
daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam .. 2.31.20 ..
meaning:
उल्कां ददाति वक्त्रे च सततं यमकिङ्करः ..
दण्डेन ताडयेन्मूर्ध्नि तल्लोमाब्दप्रमाणकम् .. 2.31.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu ..
bhuktvā duḥkhaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ vyādhiṃ bhuktvā tataḥ śuciḥ ..21..
meaning:
ततो भवेन्मानवी च विधवा सप्तजन्मसु ..
भुक्त्वा दुःखं च वैधव्यं व्याधिं भुक्त्वा ततः शुचिः ..21..

sanskrit_iast:
yā brāhmaṇī śūdrabhogyā sā'ndhakūpaṃ prayāti ca..
taptaśaucodake dhvānte tadāhārā divāniśam .. 22 ..
meaning:
या ब्राह्मणी शूद्रभोग्या साऽन्धकूपं प्रयाति च..
तप्तशौचोदके ध्वान्ते तदाहारा दिवानिशम् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nivasedatisantaptā yamadūtena tāḍitā ..
śaucodake nimagnā ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 23 ..
meaning:
निवसेदतिसन्तप्ता यमदूतेन ताडिता ..
शौचोदके निमग्ना च यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kākī janmasahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkarī ..
kukkuṭī śatajanmāni śṛgālī saptajanmasu ..24..
meaning:
काकी जन्मसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि सूकरी ..
कुक्कुटी शतजन्मानि शृगाली सप्तजन्मसु ..24..
text_mt: [She becomes] a female crow for a thousand lifetimes, a sow for a hundred lifetimes,

sanskrit_iast:
pārāvatī saptajanau vānarī saptajanmasu ..
tato bhavetsā caṇḍālī sarvabhogyā ca bhārate..25..
meaning:
पारावती सप्तजनौ वानरी सप्तजन्मसु ..
ततो भवेत्सा चण्डाली सर्वभोग्या च भारते..25..

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavecca rajakī yakṣmagrastā ca puṃścalī..
tataḥ kuṣṭhayutā tailakārī śuddhā bhavettataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेच्च रजकी यक्ष्मग्रस्ता च पुंश्चली..
ततः कुष्ठयुता तैलकारी शुद्धा भवेत्ततः .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
veśyā vasedvedhane ca yugmī vai daṇḍatāḍane ..
jālabandhe mahāveśyā kulaṭā dehacūrṇake .. 27 ..
meaning:
वेश्या वसेद्वेधने च युग्मी वै दण्डताडने ..
जालबन्धे महावेश्या कुलटा देहचूर्णके .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svairiṇī dalane caiva dhṛṣṭā vai śoṣaṇe tathā ..
nivasedyātanāyuktā yamadūtena tāḍitā .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वैरिणी दलने चैव धृष्टा वै शोषणे तथा ..
निवसेद्यातनायुक्ता यमदूतेन ताडिता .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇaṃ tatra yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati..
tato bhavedviṭkṛmiśca varṣalakṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
विण्मूत्रभक्षणं तत्र यावन्मन्वन्तरं सति..
ततो भवेद्विट्कृमिश्च वर्षलक्षं ततः शुचिः .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchetkṣattriyāmapi kṣatriyaḥ ..
vaiśyo vaiśyāṃ ca śūdrāṃ ca śūdro vā'pi vrajedyadi .. 2.31.30 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणीं गच्छेत्क्षत्त्रियामपि क्षत्रियः ..
वैश्यो वैश्यां च शूद्रां च शूद्रो वाऽपि व्रजेद्यदि .. 2.31.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇaparadārī ca kaṣaṃ yāti tayā saha ..
bhuktvā kaṣāyataptodaṃ nivaseddvādaśābdakam .. 31 ..
meaning:
स्ववर्णपरदारी च कषं याति तया सह ..
भुक्त्वा कषायतप्तोदं निवसेद्द्वादशाब्दकम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
going to another's wife of his own caste, he goes with her to Kaṣa ('Rubbing').
Having consumed boiling astringent water, he dwells there for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vipro bhavecchuddhaścaivaṃ ca kṣatriyādayaḥ ..
yoṣitaścāpi śudhyantītyevamāha pitāmahaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
ततो विप्रो भवेच्छुद्धश्चैवं च क्षत्रियादयः ..
योषितश्चापि शुध्यन्तीत्येवमाह पितामहः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Then the Brahmin becomes pure, and likewise Kṣatriyas and the rest.
The women also become purified: so spoke the Grandfather (Brahmā).

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchedvaiśyo vā'pi pativrate ..
mātṛgāmī bhavetso'pi śūrpaṃ ca narakaṃ vrajet .. 33 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणीं गच्छेद्वैश्यो वाऽपि पतिव्रते ..
मातृगामी भवेत्सोऽपि शूर्पं च नरकं व्रजेत् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
If a Kṣatriya or a Vaiśya should approach a Brahmin woman, O devoted wife,
he becomes an incestuous violator of his mother, and goes to the hell Śūrpa ('Winnowing Basket').

sanskrit_iast:
śūrpākāraiśca kṛmibhirbrāhmaṇyā saha bhakṣitaḥ ..
prataptamūtrabhojī ca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
शूर्पाकारैश्च कृमिभिर्ब्राह्मण्या सह भक्षितः ..
प्रतप्तमूत्रभोजी च यमदूतेन ताडितः .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Eaten together with the Brahmin woman by worms shaped like winnowing baskets,
consuming scalding urine and beaten by Yama's messenger,

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṃkte yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
saptajanmasu vārāhaśchāgalaśca tataḥ śuciḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव यातनां भुंक्ते यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ..
सप्तजन्मसु वाराहश्छागलश्च ततः शुचिः .. 39 ..
text_mt:
he experiences torment right there for as long as fourteen Indras [rule].
For seven lifetimes [he becomes] a boar, and [then] a goat; after that, he is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
kare dhṛtvā ca tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ..
mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryyātsa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet .. 36 ..
meaning:
करे धृत्वा च तुलसीं प्रतिज्ञां यो न पालयेत् ..
मिथ्या वा शपथं कुर्य्यात्स च ज्वालामुखं व्रजेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Whoever, holding tulasī in his hand, does not keep a pledge,
or swears falsely, goes to Jvālāmukha ('Flame-mouth').

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātoyaṃ kare dhṛtvā pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ..
śilāṃ ca devapratimāṃ sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet .. 37 ..
meaning:
गङ्गातोयं करे धृत्वा प्रतिज्ञां यो न पालयेत् ..
शिलां च देवप्रतिमां स च ज्वालामुखं व्रजेत् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Whoever, holding Gaṅgā water in his hand, does not keep a pledge,
or [holding] a [Śāligrāma] stone or an image of a deity, goes to Jvālāmukha.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā ca dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ..
sthitvā devagṛhe vā'pi sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet .. 38 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा च दक्षिणं हस्तं प्रतिज्ञां यो न पालयेत् ..
स्थित्वा देवगृहे वाऽपि स च ज्वालामुखं व्रजेत् .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Whoever, having given his right hand, does not keep a pledge,
or having stood in a temple of God, goes to Jvālāmukha.

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇusamaṃ sati ..
na pālayetpratijñāṃ ca sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet .. 39 ..
meaning:
स्पृष्ट्वा च ब्राह्मणं गां च वह्निं विष्णुसमं सति ..
न पालयेत्प्रतिज्ञां च स च ज्वालामुखं व्रजेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Having touched a Brahmin, a cow, or fire, which is equal to Viṣṇu, O virtuous woman,
[whoever] does not keep a pledge goes to Jvālāmukha.

sanskrit_iast:
mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yo hi viśvāsaghātakaḥ ..
mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet .. 2.31.40 ..
meaning:
मित्रद्रोही कृतघ्नश्च यो हि विश्वासघातकः ..
मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदश्चैव स च ज्वालामुखं व्रजेत् .. 2.31.40 ..
text_mt:
One who betrays a friend, an ungrateful person, one who breaches trust,
and one who gives false testimony goes to Jvālāmukha.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tatra vasantyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
yathā'ṅgārapradagdhāśca yamadūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
एते तत्र वसन्त्येव यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ..
यथाऽङ्गारप्रदग्धाश्च यमदूतैश्च ताडिताः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
These indeed dwell there for as long as fourteen Indras [rule],
as if burned by hot coals and beaten by Yama's messengers.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālastulasīsparśī saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ..
mleccho gaṃgājalasparśī pañcajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 42..
meaning:
चण्डालस्तुलसीस्पर्शी सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुचिः ..
म्लेच्छो गंगाजलस्पर्शी पञ्चजन्मस्वतः शुचिः .. 42..
text_mt:
A Caṇḍāla who touches tulasī is purified after seven lifetimes.
A Mleccha who touches Gaṅgā water is purified after five lifetimes.

sanskrit_iast:
śilāsparśī viṭkṛmiśca saptajanmasu sundari ..
arccāsparśī vraṇakṛmissaptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
शिलास्पर्शी विट्कृमिश्च सप्तजन्मसु सुन्दरि ..
अर्च्चास्पर्शी व्रणकृमिस्सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुचिः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
One who touches a [Śāligrāma] stone [falsely becomes] a worm in excrement for seven lifetimes, O beautiful woman;
one who touches an image [becomes] a worm in a sore for seven lifetimes; after that, he is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastapradhātā ca sarpassyātsaptajanmasu ..
tato bhaveddhastahīno mānavaśca tataḥ śuciḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
दक्षहस्तप्रधाता च सर्पस्स्यात्सप्तजन्मसु ..
ततो भवेद्धस्तहीनो मानवश्च ततः शुचिः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
One who pledges with the right hand [and breaks it] becomes a serpent for seven lifetimes.
Then he becomes a handless human; after that, he is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāvādī devagṛhe devalaḥ saptajanmasu ..
viprādisparśakārī ca so'gradānī bhaveddhruvam .. 45 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यावादी देवगृहे देवलः सप्तजन्मसु ..
विप्रादिस्पर्शकारी च सोऽग्रदानी भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
A liar in a temple of God becomes an attendant priest (devala) for seven lifetimes;
and one who [swears falsely] touching a Brahmin and the like certainly becomes an agradānī priest.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavanti mūkāste badhirāśca trijanmasu ..
bhāryyāhīnā vaṃśahīnā buddhihīnāstataḥ śuciḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
ततो भवन्ति मूकास्ते बधिराश्च त्रिजन्मसु ..
भार्य्याहीना वंशहीना बुद्धिहीनास्ततः शुचिः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Then they become dumb and deaf for three lifetimes,
wifeless, lineless, and mindless; after that, [each is] pure.

sanskrit_iast:
mitradrohī ca na kulaḥ kṛtaghnaścāpi gaṇḍakaḥ ..
viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca saptajanmasu bhārate .. 47 ..
meaning:
मित्रद्रोही च न कुलः कृतघ्नश्चापि गण्डकः ..
विश्वासघाती व्याघ्रश्च सप्तजन्मसु भारते .. 47 ..
text_mt:
One who betrays a friend becomes a mongoose, an ungrateful person a rhinoceros,
and a breaker of trust becomes a tiger for seven lifetimes in Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva bhallūkaḥ saptajanmasu ..
pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānhanti cātmanaḥ .. '48 ..
nityakriyāvihīnaśca jaḍatvena yuto dvijaḥ ..
yasyānāsthā vedavākye mandaṃ hasati saṃtamam.. .. 49 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदश्चैव भल्लूकः सप्तजन्मसु ..
पूर्वान्सप्त परान्सप्त पुरुषान्हन्ति चात्मनः .. '48 ..
नित्यक्रियाविहीनश्च जडत्वेन युतो द्विजः ..
यस्यानास्था वेदवाक्ये मन्दं हसति संतमम्.. .. 49 ..
text_mt:
One who gives false testimony becomes a bear for seven lifetimes;
he destroys seven ancestors and seven descendants of his own.
A twice-born man devoid of daily duties and possessed of dullness,
who has no faith in the word of the Veda and laughs softly at an ascetic,

sanskrit_iast:
vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyapariniṃdakaḥ ..
jihme jihmo vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ ca himodake .. 2.31.50 ..
meaning:
व्रतोपवासहीनश्च सद्वाक्यपरिनिंदकः ..
जिह्मे जिह्मो वसेत्सोऽपि शताब्दं च हिमोदके .. 2.31.50 ..
text_mt:
devoid of vows and fasts, and a slanderer of good speech—
crooked, he lives in the Jihma pit in icy water for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
jalajaṃturbhavetso'pi śatajanmakrameṇa ca ..
tato nānāprakārā ca matsyajātistataḥ śuciḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
जलजंतुर्भवेत्सोऽपि शतजन्मक्रमेण च ..
ततो नानाप्रकारा च मत्स्यजातिस्ततः शुचिः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
He also becomes an aquatic animal successively for a hundred births.
After that, various species of fish; after that, he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vā dhanasyāpahāraṃ devābrahmaṇayoścaret ..
pātayitvā svapuruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān .. 52 ..
meaning:
यो वा धनस्यापहारं देवाब्रह्मणयोश्चरेत् ..
पातयित्वा स्वपुरुषान्दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Or whoever should commit theft of the wealth belonging to the gods and brāhmaṇas,
causing ten past and ten future generations of his men to fall,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ yāti ca dhūmāṃdhaṃ dhūmadhvāṃtasamanvitam ..
dhūmakliṣṭo dhūmabhojī vasettatra caturyugam .. .. 53 ..
meaning:
स्वयं याति च धूमांधं धूमध्वांतसमन्वितम् ..
धूमक्लिष्टो धूमभोजी वसेत्तत्र चतुर्युगम् .. .. 53 ..
text_mt:
he himself goes to the Dhūmāndha [pit], filled with the darkness of smoke.
Afflicted by smoke, consuming smoke, he dwells there for four yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mūṣakajātiśca śatajanmāni bhārate ..
tato nānāvidhāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ kṛmijātayaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
ततो मूषकजातिश्च शतजन्मानि भारते ..
ततो नानाविधाः पक्षिजातयः कृमिजातयः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Then [he is born in] the species of mice for a hundred births in Bhārata.
Then various species of birds, species of worms,

sanskrit_iast:
tato nānāvidhā vṛkṣajātayaśca tato naraḥ ..
bhāryāhīno vaṃśahīnaḥ śabaro vyādhisaṃyutaḥ.. 55 ..
meaning:
ततो नानाविधा वृक्षजातयश्च ततो नरः ..
भार्याहीनो वंशहीनः शबरो व्याधिसंयुतः.. 55 ..
text_mt:
then various species of trees, and then a human being:
deprived of a wife, childless, a hunter, afflicted with disease.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavetsvarṇakāraḥ suvarṇasya vaṇiktathā ..
tato yavanasevī ca brāhmaṇo gaṇakastataḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेत्स्वर्णकारः सुवर्णस्य वणिक्तथा ..
ततो यवनसेवी च ब्राह्मणो गणकस्ततः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Then he becomes a goldsmith, and likewise a merchant of gold;
then an attendant of Yavanas, and [then] an astrologer brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vipro daivajñopajīvī vaidyajīvī cikitsakaḥ ..
vyāpārī lohalākṣāde rasādervikrayī ca yaḥ .. .. 57 ..
meaning:
विप्रो दैवज्ञोपजीवी वैद्यजीवी चिकित्सकः ..
व्यापारी लोहलाक्षादे रसादेर्विक्रयी च यः .. .. 57 ..
text_mt:
A vipra making a living as an astrologer, earning a living as a physician, a healer,
a merchant of iron, lac, and the like, and one who sells liquids and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti nāgaveṣṭaṃ ca nāgairveṣṭita eva ca ..
vasetsvalomamānābdaṃ tatra vai nāgadaṃśitaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
स याति नागवेष्टं च नागैर्वेष्टित एव च ..
वसेत्स्वलोममानाब्दं तत्र वै नागदंशितः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
he goes to Nāgaveṣṭa, and indeed, enveloped by serpents,
bitten by serpents, he dwells there for as many years as the hairs of his body.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavetsa gaṇako vaidyo vai saptajanmasu ..
gopaśca karmmakāraśca śaṅkhakārastataḥ śuciḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेत्स गणको वैद्यो वै सप्तजन्मसु ..
गोपश्च कर्म्मकारश्च शङ्खकारस्ततः शुचिः .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Then he becomes that astrologer and physician for seven births,
and a cowherd, and a blacksmith, [and] a conch-worker; after that, he is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhāni ca kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate ..
anyāni cāprasiddhāni tatra kṣudrāṇi santi vai .. 2.31.60 ..
meaning:
प्रसिद्धानि च कुण्डानि कथितानि पतिव्रते ..
अन्यानि चाप्रसिद्धानि तत्र क्षुद्राणि सन्ति वै .. 2.31.60 ..
text_mt:
The well-known pits have been told to you, O devoted wife;
and there are indeed others there, unknown, small ones.

sanskrit_iast:
santi pātakinasteṣu svakarmaphalabhoginaḥ ..
bhramaṃti tāvatsaṃsāre kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ..61..
meaning:
सन्ति पातकिनस्तेषु स्वकर्मफलभोगिनः ..
भ्रमंति तावत्संसारे किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ..61..
text_mt:
The sinners are in them, experiencing the fruit of their own deeds;
they wander through saṃsāra for that long. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitryuvāca ..
dharmarāja mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga ..
nānāpurāṇetihāsapāñcarātrapradarśakaḥ ..1..
meaning:
सावित्र्युवाच ..
धर्मराज महाभाग वेदवेदाङ्गपारग ..
नानापुराणेतिहासपाञ्चरात्रप्रदर्शकः ..1..
title: adhyāyaḥ 32

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu sārabhūtaṃ yatsarveṣṭaṃ sarvasammatam ..
karmacchede bījarūpaṃ praśaṃsyaṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇām .. 2 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषु सारभूतं यत्सर्वेष्टं सर्वसम्मतम् ..
कर्मच्छेदे बीजरूपं प्रशंस्यं सुखदं नृणाम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yaśaḥpradaṃ dharmadaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam ..
yena yāmīṃ na te yāṃti yātanāṃ bhavaduḥkhadām .. 3 ..
meaning:
यशःप्रदं धर्मदं च सर्वमंगलमंगलम् ..
येन यामीं न ते यांति यातनां भवदुःखदाम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍāni ca na paśyanti tatra naiva pataṃti ca ..
na bhavedyena janmādi tatkarma vada suvrata .. 4 ..
meaning:
कुण्डानि च न पश्यन्ति तत्र नैव पतंति च ..
न भवेद्येन जन्मादि तत्कर्म वद सुव्रत .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kimākārāṇi kuṇḍāni kāni teṣāṃ matāni ca ..
kena rūpeṇa tatraiva sadā tiṣṭhaṃti pāpinaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
किमाकाराणि कुण्डानि कानि तेषां मतानि च ..
केन रूपेण तत्रैव सदा तिष्ठंति पापिनः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svadehe bhasmasādbhūte yāṃti lokāntaraṃ narāḥ ..
kena dehena vā bhogaṃ bhuñjate vā śubhāśubham .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्वदेहे भस्मसाद्भूते यांति लोकान्तरं नराः ..
केन देहेन वा भोगं भुञ्जते वा शुभाशुभम् .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suciraṃ kleśabhogena kathaṃ deho na naśyati ..
deho vā kiṃvidho brahmaṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi ..7..
meaning:
सुचिरं क्लेशभोगेन कथं देहो न नश्यति ..
देहो वा किंविधो ब्रह्मंस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ..7..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca .. sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājo hariṃ smaran ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe guruṃ natvā ca nārada.. 8 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच .. सावित्रीवचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो हरिं स्मरन् ..
कथां कथितुमारेभे गुरुं नत्वा च नारद.. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca ..
vatse caturṣu vedeṣu dharmo vai saṃhitāsu ca ..
purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu pāñcarātrādikeṣu ca .. 9 ..
meaning:
यम उवाच ..
वत्से चतुर्षु वेदेषु धर्मो वै संहितासु च ..
पुराणेष्वितिहासेषु पाञ्चरात्रादिकेषु च .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu vedāṃgeṣu ca suvrate ..
sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam .. 2.32.10 ..
meaning:
अन्येषु सर्वशास्त्रेषु वेदांगेषु च सुव्रते ..
सर्वेष्टं सारभूतं च मंगलं कृष्णसेवनम् .. 2.32.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
janmamṛtyujarārogaśokasantāpatāraṇam ..
sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca paramānandakāraṇam .. 11 ..
meaning:
जन्ममृत्युजरारोगशोकसन्तापतारणम् ..
सर्वमङ्गलरूपं च परमानन्दकारणम् .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam ..
bhaktivṛkṣāṃkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam ..12 ..
meaning:
कारणं सर्वसिद्धीनां नरकार्णवतारणम् ..
भक्तिवृक्षांकुरकरं कर्मवृक्षनिकृन्तनम् ..12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
golokamārgasopānamavināśipadapradam..
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubhe..13..
meaning:
गोलोकमार्गसोपानमविनाशिपदप्रदम्..
सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसारूप्यसामीप्यादिप्रदं शुभे..13..

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍāni yamadūtaṃ ca yamaṃ ca yamakiṅkarān ..
svapne'pi nahi paśyanti sati śrīkṛṣṇakiṅkarāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
कुण्डानि यमदूतं च यमं च यमकिङ्करान् ..
स्वप्नेऽपि नहि पश्यन्ति सति श्रीकृष्णकिङ्कराः .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
harivrataṃ ye kurvaṃti gṛhiṇaḥ karmabhoginaḥ ..
ye snāṃti haritīrthe ca nāśnanti harivāsare .. 15 ..
meaning:
हरिव्रतं ये कुर्वंति गृहिणः कर्मभोगिनः ..
ये स्नांति हरितीर्थे च नाश्नन्ति हरिवासरे .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamaṃti hariṃ nityaṃ haryyarcāṃ pūjayanti ca ..
na yānti te ca ghorāṃ ca mama saṃyamanīṃ purīm .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रणमंति हरिं नित्यं हर्य्यर्चां पूजयन्ति च ..
न यान्ति ते च घोरां च मम संयमनीं पुरीम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: they do not go to my terrible city of Saṃyamanī.

sanskrit_iast:
trisandhyapūtā viprāśca śuddhācārasamanvitāḥ ..
svadharmaniratāḥ śāntā na yānti yamamandiram .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्रिसन्ध्यपूता विप्राश्च शुद्धाचारसमन्विताः ..
स्वधर्मनिरताः शान्ता न यान्ति यममन्दिरम् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
And vipras purified by the three twilight prayers, endowed with pure conduct,
devoted to their own duty, peaceful, do not go to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
te svargabhogino'nye ca śuddhā devānyakiṃkarāḥ ..
yāntyāyānti ca martyaṃ ca svargaṃ ca nahi nirvṛtāḥ ..
nivṛttiṃ na hi lipsanti kṛṣṇasevāṃ vinā narāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
ते स्वर्गभोगिनोऽन्ये च शुद्धा देवान्यकिंकराः ..
यान्त्यायान्ति च मर्त्यं च स्वर्गं च नहि निर्वृताः ..
निवृत्तिं न हि लिप्सन्ति कृष्णसेवां विना नराः .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmmaniratāścāpi svadharmaviratāstathā ..
gacchanto martyalokaṃ ca durddharṣā yamakiṅkarāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
स्वधर्म्मनिरताश्चापि स्वधर्मविरतास्तथा ..
गच्छन्तो मर्त्यलोकं च दुर्द्धर्षा यमकिङ्कराः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Whether devoted to their own duty or turned away from their own duty,
as they go to the mortal world, the invincible messengers of Yama // 19

sanskrit_iast:
bhītāḥ kṛṣṇopāsakācca vainateyādivoragāḥ ..
svadūtaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca gacchantaṃ taṃ vadāmyaham .. 2.32.20 ..
meaning:
भीताः कृष्णोपासकाच्च वैनतेयादिवोरगाः ..
स्वदूतं पाशहस्तं च गच्छन्तं तं वदाम्यहम् .. 2.32.20 ..
text_mt:
are terrified of a worshipper of Kṛṣṇa, like serpents of Garuḍa.
To my messenger, going with noose in hand, I say: // 2.32.20

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyasīti ca sarvatra haribhaktāśramaṃ vinā ..
kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ nāmāni ca nikṛntanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
यास्यसीति च सर्वत्र हरिभक्ताश्रमं विना ..
कृष्णमन्त्रोपासकानां नामानि च निकृन्तनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
‘You may go everywhere, except to the hermitage of a devotee of Hari.’
And Citragupta, as if terrified, with the cups of his fingernails,

sanskrit_iast:
karoti nakharāñjalyā citraguptaśca bhītavat ..
madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā teṣāṃ ca kurute punaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
करोति नखराञ्जल्या चित्रगुप्तश्च भीतवत् ..
मधुपर्कादिकं ब्रह्मा तेषां च कुरुते पुनः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
erases the names of the worshippers of Kṛṣṇa's mantra.
Brahmā in turn offers the madhuparka and other homages to them. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
vilaṃghya brahmalokaṃ ca goloke gacchatāṃ satām ..
duritāni ca naśyanti teṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
विलंघ्य ब्रह्मलोकं च गोलोके गच्छतां सताम् ..
दुरितानि च नश्यन्ति तेषां संस्पर्शमात्रतः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
For the virtuous who bypass Brahmaloka and go to Goloka,
sins are destroyed by mere contact with them, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
yathā suprajvaladvahnau kāṣṭhāni ca tṛṇāni ca ..
prāpnoti mohaḥ saṃmohaṃ tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā'tibhītavat .. 24 ..
meaning:
यथा सुप्रज्वलद्वह्नौ काष्ठानि च तृणानि च ..
प्राप्नोति मोहः संमोहं तांश्च दृष्ट्वाऽतिभीतवत् .. 24 ..
text_mt:
just like pieces of wood and grass in a blazing fire.
Delusion becomes completely bewildered upon seeing them, filled with great dread. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaśca kāminaṃ yāti lobha krodhau tataḥ sati ..
mṛtyuḥ palāyate rogo jarā śoko bhayaṃ tathā .. 25 ..
meaning:
कामश्च कामिनं याति लोभ क्रोधौ ततः सति ..
मृत्युः पलायते रोगो जरा शोको भयं तथा .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Desire flees to one who has desire, and greed and anger depart from there, O virtuous woman;
death runs away, as do disease, old age, sorrow, and fear; // 25

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karmma harṣo bhogastathaiva ca ..
ye ye na yānti yāmīṃ ca kathitāste mayā sati .. 26 ..
meaning:
कालः शुभाशुभं कर्म्म हर्षो भोगस्तथैव च ..
ये ये न यान्ति यामीं च कथितास्ते मया सति .. 26 ..
text_mt:
so too time, good and evil karma, joy, and experience of pleasure.
Those who do not go to the city of Yama have been recounted by me, O virtuous woman. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu dehasya vivṛtiṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam ..
pṛthivī vāyurākāśaṃ tejastoyamiti sphuṭam .. 27 ..
meaning:
शृणु देहस्य विवृतिं कथयामि यथागमम् ..
पृथिवी वायुराकाशं तेजस्तोयमिति स्फुटम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Hear the explanation of the body; I shall tell it according to tradition:
earth, wind, space, fire, and water are clearly // 27

sanskrit_iast:
dehināṃ dehabījaṃ ca sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭividhau param ..
pṛthvyādipañcabhūtaiśca yo deho nirmito bhavet .. 28 ..
meaning:
देहिनां देहबीजं च स्रष्टुः सृष्टिविधौ परम् ..
पृथ्व्यादिपञ्चभूतैश्च यो देहो निर्मितो भवेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
the ultimate seed of the bodies of embodied beings in the Creator's scheme of creation.
The body that is formed from the five gross elements beginning with earth // 28

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛtrimo naśvaraśca bhasmasācca bhavediha ..
vṛddhāṅguṣṭhapramāṇena yo jīvaḥ puruṣākṛtiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स कृत्रिमो नश्वरश्च भस्मसाच्च भवेदिह ..
वृद्धाङ्गुष्ठप्रमाणेन यो जीवः पुरुषाकृतिः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
is artificial and perishable, and here turns to ashes.
The individual soul, the measure of a thumb, having human form, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
bibharti sūkṣmadehaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ bhogahetave ..
sa deho na bhavedbhasma jvaladagnau mamālaye .. 2.32.30 ..
meaning:
बिभर्ति सूक्ष्मदेहं च तद्रूपं भोगहेतवे ..
स देहो न भवेद्भस्म ज्वलदग्नौ ममालये .. 2.32.30 ..
text_mt:
bears a subtle body of that form for the sake of experiencing [retribution].
That body does not turn to ashes in the blazing fire in my abode; // 2.32.30

sanskrit_iast:
jalena naṣṭo deho vā prahāre suciraṃ kṛte ..
na śastre ca na cāstre ca sutīkṣṇe kaṇṭake tathā .. 31 ..
meaning:
जलेन नष्टो देहो वा प्रहारे सुचिरं कृते ..
न शस्त्रे च न चास्त्रे च सुतीक्ष्णे कण्टके तथा .. 31 ..
text_mt:
nor is that body destroyed by water, nor by blows inflicted for a very long time;
nor by edged weapons, nor by missiles, nor by exceedingly sharp thorns; // 31

sanskrit_iast:
