meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य तोयाञ्जलिभिर्मुखरागमलक्तकम् ..
विस्रस्तकबरीभारा मुक्तकेशी प्रकम्पिता .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavastraparīdhānā rūkṣā veṣādivarjitā ..
yayau yānāntikaṃ tūrṇaṃ priyālībhirnivāritā..13..
meaning:
शुक्लवस्त्रपरीधाना रूक्षा वेषादिवर्जिता ..
ययौ यानान्तिकं तूर्णं प्रियालीभिर्निवारिता..13..

sanskrit_iast:
ājuhāva sakhīsaṃghaṃ roṣavisphuritādharā ..
śaśvatkampānvitāṃgī sā gopībhiḥ parivāritā ..14..
meaning:
आजुहाव सखीसंघं रोषविस्फुरिताधरा ..
शश्वत्कम्पान्वितांगी सा गोपीभिः परिवारिता ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
tābhirbhaktyā yutābhiśca kātarābhiśca saṃstutā ..
āruroha rathaṃ divyamamūlyaṃ ratnanirmitam ..
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye tacchatayojanam ..15..
meaning:
ताभिर्भक्त्या युताभिश्च कातराभिश्च संस्तुता ..
आरुरोह रथं दिव्यममूल्यं रत्ननिर्मितम् ..
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं दैर्घ्ये तच्छतयोजनम् ..15..

sanskrit_iast:
sahasracakrayuktaṃ ca nānācitrasamanvitam ..
nānāvicitravasanaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kṣaumairvirājitam .. 16 ..
meaning:
सहस्रचक्रयुक्तं च नानाचित्रसमन्वितम् ..
नानाविचित्रवसनैः सूक्ष्मैः क्षौमैर्विराजितम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ pariśobhitam ..
maṇīndrajālamālābhaiḥ puṣpamālāsahasrakaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणदर्पणैः परिशोभितम् ..
मणीन्द्रजालमालाभैः पुष्पमालासहस्रकैः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sadratna kalaśairyuktaṃ ramyairmandirakoṭibhiḥ ..
trilakṣakoṭibhiḥ sārddha gopībhiśca priyālibhiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्न कलशैर्युक्तं रम्यैर्मन्दिरकोटिभिः ..
त्रिलक्षकोटिभिः सार्द्ध गोपीभिश्च प्रियालिभिः .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yayau rathena tenaiva sumanomālinā priye ..
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ gopaḥ sudāmā kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ययौ रथेन तेनैव सुमनोमालिना प्रिये ..
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं गोपः सुदामा कृष्णपार्षदः .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā sāvadhānaṃ gopaiḥ sārddhaṃ palāyitaḥ ..
bhayena kṛṣṇaḥ santrasto vihāya virajāṃ satīm .. 2.49.20 ..
meaning:
कृष्णं कृत्वा सावधानं गोपैः सार्द्धं पलायितः ..
भयेन कृष्णः सन्त्रस्तो विहाय विरजां सतीम् .. 2.49.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svapremamagnaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi tirodhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
sā satī samayaṃ jñātvā vicāryya svahṛdi krudhā .. 21 ..
meaning:
स्वप्रेममग्नः कृष्णोऽपि तिरोधानं चकार सः ..
सा सती समयं ज्ञात्वा विचार्य्य स्वहृदि क्रुधा .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāprakopabhītā ca prāṇāṃstatyāja tatkṣaṇam ..
virajāligaṇāstatra bhayavihvalakātarāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
राधाप्रकोपभीता च प्राणांस्तत्याज तत्क्षणम् ..
विरजालिगणास्तत्र भयविह्वलकातराः .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prayayuḥ śaraṇaṃ sādhvīṃ virajāṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ bhiyā ..
goloke sā saridrūpā jātā vai śailakanyake .. 23 ..
meaning:
प्रययुः शरणं साध्वीं विरजां तत्क्षणं भिया ..
गोलोके सा सरिद्रूपा जाता वै शैलकन्यके .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiyojanavistīrṇā dīrghe śataguṇā tathā ..
golokaṃ veṣṭayāmāsa parikheva manoharā .. 24 ..
meaning:
कोटियोजनविस्तीर्णा दीर्घे शतगुणा तथा ..
गोलोकं वेष्टयामास परिखेव मनोहरा .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvuḥ kṣudranadyaśca tadā'nyā gopya eva ca ..
sarvā nadyastadaṃśāśca prativiśveṣu sundari .. 25 ..
meaning:
बभूवुः क्षुद्रनद्यश्च तदाऽन्या गोप्य एव च ..
सर्वा नद्यस्तदंशाश्च प्रतिविश्वेषु सुन्दरि .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ime sapta samudrāśca virajānandanā bhuvi ..
athāgatya mahābhāgā rādhā rāseśvarī parā .. 26 ..
meaning:
इमे सप्त समुद्राश्च विरजानन्दना भुवि ..
अथागत्य महाभागा राधा रासेश्वरी परा .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭvā virajāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca punaryayau ..
jagāma kṛṣṇastāṃ rādhāṃ gopālairaṣṭabhiḥ saha .. 27 ..
meaning:
न दृष्ट्वा विरजां कृष्णं स्वगृहं च पुनर्ययौ ..
जगाम कृष्णस्तां राधां गोपालैरष्टभिः सह .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gopībhirdvāri yuktābhirvārito'pi punaḥ punaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca sā devī bhartsayāmāsa taṃ tadā .. 28 ..
meaning:
गोपीभिर्द्वारि युक्ताभिर्वारितोऽपि पुनः पुनः ..
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं च सा देवी भर्त्सयामास तं तदा .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sudāmā bhartsayāmāsa tāṃ tathā kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
kruddhā śaśāpa sā devī sudāmānaṃ sureśvarī .. 29 ..
meaning:
सुदामा भर्त्सयामास तां तथा कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
क्रुद्धा शशाप सा देवी सुदामानं सुरेश्वरी .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha tvamāsurīṃ yoniṃ gaccha dūramato drutam ..
śaśāpa tāṃ sudāmā ca tvamito gaccha bhāratam .. 2.49.30 ..
meaning:
गच्छ त्वमासुरीं योनिं गच्छ दूरमतो द्रुतम् ..
शशाप तां सुदामा च त्वमितो गच्छ भारतम् .. 2.49.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhava gopī gopakanyāmukhyābhiḥ svābhireva ca ..
tatra te kṛṣṇavicchedo bhaviṣyati śataṃ samāḥ .. ..31..
meaning:
भव गोपी गोपकन्यामुख्याभिः स्वाभिरेव च ..
तत्र ते कृष्णविच्छेदो भविष्यति शतं समाः .. ..31..

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhagavāṃśca kariṣyati ..
iti śaptvā sudāmā'sau praṇamya jananīṃ harim ..
sāśrunetro mohayuktastato gantuṃ samudyataḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
तत्र भारावतरणं भगवांश्च करिष्यति ..
इति शप्त्वा सुदामाऽसौ प्रणम्य जननीं हरिम् ..
साश्रुनेत्रो मोहयुक्तस्ततो गन्तुं समुद्यतः .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā jagāma tatpaścātsāśrunetrā'tivihvalā ..
vatsa kva yāsītyuccāryya putravicchedakātarā .. 33 ..
meaning:
राधा जगाम तत्पश्चात्साश्रुनेत्राऽतिविह्वला ..
वत्स क्व यासीत्युच्चार्य्य पुत्रविच्छेदकातरा .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa vidyayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
śīghraṃ saṃprāpsyasi sutaṃ mā rudastvaṃ varānane .. 34 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्तां बोधयामास विद्यया च कृपानिधिः ..
शीघ्रं संप्राप्स्यसि सुतं मा रुदस्त्वं वरानने .. 34 ..
text_mt: "You will soon regain your son; do not weep, O fair-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāsuraḥ śaṅkhacūḍo babhūva tulasīpatiḥ ..
macchūlabhinnakāyena golokaṃ vai jagāma saḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
स चासुरः शङ्खचूडो बभूव तुलसीपतिः ..
मच्छूलभिन्नकायेन गोलोकं वै जगाम सः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
And that asura became Śaṅkhacūḍa, the husband of Tulasī;
with his body pierced by my trident, he indeed went to Goloka.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā jagāma vārāhe gokulaṃ bhārataṃ satī ..
vṛṣabhānośca vaiśyasya sā ca kanyā babhūva ha .. 36 ..
meaning:
राधा जगाम वाराहे गोकुलं भारतं सती ..
वृषभानोश्च वैश्यस्य सा च कन्या बभूव ह .. 36 ..
text_mt:
In the Vārāha kalpa, the chaste Rādhā went to Gokula in Bhārata,
and she became the daughter of the vaiśya Vṛṣabhānu.

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisambhavā devī vāyugarbhā kalāvatī ..
suṣuve māyayā vāyuṃ sā tatrāvirbabhūva ha .. 37 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसम्भवा देवी वायुगर्भा कलावती ..
सुषुवे मायया वायुं सा तत्राविर्बभूव ह .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Not born from a womb, the goddess [entered] Kalāvatī's womb of wind;
through māyā she gave birth to the wind, and she indeed manifested there.

sanskrit_iast:
atīte dvādaśābde tu dṛṣṭvā tāṃ navayauvanām ..
sārdhaṃ rāyāṇavaiśyena tatsambandhaṃ cakāra saḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
अतीते द्वादशाब्दे तु दृष्ट्वा तां नवयौवनाम् ..
सार्धं रायाणवैश्येन तत्सम्बन्धं चकार सः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
When twelve years had passed, seeing her in fresh youth,
he made an alliance for her with the vaiśya Rāyāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāṃ saṃsthāpya tadgehe sā'ntarddhānamavāpa ha ..
babhūva tasya vaiśyasya vivāhaśchāyayā saha .. 39 ..
meaning:
छायां संस्थाप्य तद्गेहे साऽन्तर्द्धानमवाप ह ..
बभूव तस्य वैश्यस्य विवाहश्छायया सह .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Placing a shadow-form in his house, she indeed vanished;
that vaiśya's marriage took place with the shadow-form.

sanskrit_iast:
gate caturdaśābde tu kaṃsabhīteśchalena ca ..
jagāma gokulaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śiśurūpī jagatpatiḥ .. 2.49.40 ..
meaning:
गते चतुर्दशाब्दे तु कंसभीतेश्छलेन च ..
जगाम गोकुलं कृष्णः शिशुरूपी जगत्पतिः .. 2.49.40 ..
text_mt:
When the fourteenth year had passed, on the pretext of fear of Kaṃsa,
Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the Universe, in the form of an infant, went to Gokula.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamātā yaśodā yā rāyāṇastatsahodaraḥ ..
goloke gopakṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sambandhātkṛṣṇamātulaḥ..41..
meaning:
कृष्णमाता यशोदा या रायाणस्तत्सहोदरः ..
गोलोके गोपकृष्णांशः सम्बन्धात्कृष्णमातुलः..41..
text_mt:
She who was Kṛṣṇa's mother Yaśodā was the sister of Rāyāṇa;
in Goloka he was a portion of the cowherd Kṛṣṇa, and by marriage, Kṛṣṇa's maternal uncle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇena saha rādhāyāḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vidhinā jagatāṃ vidhiḥ..42..
meaning:
कृष्णेन सह राधायाः पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने ..
विवाहं कारयामास विधिना जगतां विधिः..42..
text_mt:
The Creator of the worlds duly performed the marriage
of Rādhā with Kṛṣṇa in the holy forest of Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ nahi paśyanti ballavāḥ..
svayaṃ rādhā hareḥ kroḍe chāyā rāyāṇamandire..43..
meaning:
स्वप्ने राधापदाम्भोजं नहि पश्यन्ति बल्लवाः..
स्वयं राधा हरेः क्रोडे छाया रायाणमन्दिरे..43..
text_mt: Rādhā herself was in Hari's embrace, while the shadow was in Rāyāṇa's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ..
rādhikācaraṇāmbhojadarśanārthī ca puṣkare ..44..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तेपे पुरा विधिः..
राधिकाचरणाम्भोजदर्शनार्थी च पुष्करे ..44..
text_mt: at Puṣkara, desiring the sight of Rādhikā's lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārāvataraṇe bhūmerbhārate nandagokule ..
dadarśa tatpadāmbhojaṃ tapasastatphalena ca.45..
meaning:
भारावतरणे भूमेर्भारते नन्दगोकुले ..
ददर्श तत्पदाम्भोजं तपसस्तत्फलेन च.45..
text_mt:
At the lifting of the burden of the earth in Bhārata, in Nanda's Gokula,
he saw her lotus feet as the fruit of that austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcitkālaṃ sa vai kṛṣṇaḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane ..
reme golokanāthaśca rādhayā saha bhārate.. 46 ..
meaning:
किञ्चित्कालं स वै कृष्णः पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने ..
रेमे गोलोकनाथश्च राधया सह भारते.. 46 ..
text_mt:
For some time indeed, in the holy forest of Vṛndāvana,
that Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Goloka, sported with Rādhā in Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sudāmaśāpena vicchedaśca babhūva ha ..
tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmeḥ kṛṣṇaścakāra saḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
ततः सुदामशापेन विच्छेदश्च बभूव ह ..
तत्र भारावतरणं भूमेः कृष्णश्चकार सः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
Then, because of Sudāman's curse, there occurred separation;
there Kṛṣṇa carried out the removal of the earth's burden.

sanskrit_iast:
śatābde samatīte tu tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ..
dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ sā rādhā sa ca tāṃ ca parasparam .. 48 ..
meaning:
शताब्दे समतीते तु तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगतः ..
ददर्श कृष्णं सा राधा स च तां च परस्परम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
When a hundred years had passed, on the occasion of a pilgrimage,
that Rādhā saw Kṛṣṇa, and he saw her, mutual [beholders].

sanskrit_iast:
tato jagāma golokaṃ rādhayā saha tattvavit ..
kalāvatī yaśodā ca paryagādrādhayā saha .. 49 ..
meaning:
ततो जगाम गोलोकं राधया सह तत्त्ववित् ..
कलावती यशोदा च पर्यगाद्राधया सह .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Then, knowing the true reality, he went to Goloka together with Rādhā;
Kalāvatī and Yaśodā followed along with Rādhā;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhānuśca nandaśca yayau golokamuttamam ..
sarve gopāśca gopyaśca yayustā yāḥ samāgatāḥ .. 2.49.50 ..
meaning:
वृषभानुश्च नन्दश्च ययौ गोलोकमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वे गोपाश्च गोप्यश्च ययुस्ता याः समागताः .. 2.49.50 ..
text_mt:
Vṛṣabhānu and Nanda went to the supreme Goloka;
all the cowherds and cowherd women who had assembled went [there].

sanskrit_iast:
chāyā gopāśca gopyaśca prāpurmuktiṃ ca sannidhau ..
remire tāśca tatraiva sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇena pārvati .. 51 ..
meaning:
छाया गोपाश्च गोप्यश्च प्रापुर्मुक्तिं च सन्निधौ ..
रेमिरे ताश्च तत्रैव सार्द्धं कृष्णेन पार्वति .. 51 ..
text_mt:
The shadow, the cowherds, and the cowherd women attained liberation in his presence;
and they sported right there with Kṛṣṇa, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭyaśca gopyo gopāśca tatsamāḥ ..
golokaṃ prayayurmuktāḥ sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena rādhayā .. 52 ..
meaning:
षट्त्रिंशल्लक्षकोट्यश्च गोप्यो गोपाश्च तत्समाः ..
गोलोकं प्रययुर्मुक्ताः सार्धं कृष्णेन राधया .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Thirty-six hundred billion cowherd women and as many cowherds,
liberated, went to Goloka together with Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
droṇaḥ prajāpatirnando yaśodā tatpriyā dharā ..
saṃprāpa pūrvatapasā paramātmānamīśvaram .. 53 ..
meaning:
द्रोणः प्रजापतिर्नन्दो यशोदा तत्प्रिया धरा ..
संप्राप पूर्वतपसा परमात्मानमीश्वरम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
The Prajāpati Droṇa was Nanda, and his beloved Dharā was Yaśodā;
by prior austerity they attained the Paramātman, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevaḥ kaśyapaśca devakī cāditiḥ satī ..
devamātā devapitā pratikalpe svabhāvataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
वसुदेवः कश्यपश्च देवकी चादितिः सती ..
देवमाता देवपिता प्रतिकल्पे स्वभावतः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Vasudeva was Kaśyapa, and the chaste Devakī was Aditi;
they are naturally the mother of the gods and the father of the gods in every kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā rādhāmātā kalāvatī ..
vasudāmāpi golokād vṛṣabhānuḥ samāyayau .. 55 ..
meaning:
पितॄणां मानसी कन्या राधामाता कलावती ..
वसुदामापि गोलोकाद् वृषभानुः समाययौ .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Rādhā's mother Kalāvatī was the mind-born daughter of the ancestors;
and Vasudāman came from Goloka as Vṛṣabhānu.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ durge rādhikākhyānamuttamam ..
sampatkaraṃ pāpaharaṃ putrapautravivardhanam .. 56 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं दुर्गे राधिकाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
सम्पत्करं पापहरं पुत्रपौत्रविवर्धनम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: which brings prosperity, destroys sin, and increases sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhārūpo dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ ..
caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam .. 57 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णश्च द्विधारूपो द्विभुजश्च चतुर्भुजः ..
चतुर्भुजश्च वैकुण्ठे गोलोके द्विभुजः स्वयम् .. 57 ..

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujasya patnī ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ..
gaṃgā ca tulasī caiva devyo nārāyaṇapriyāḥ ..58..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजस्य पत्नी च महालक्ष्मीः सरस्वती ..
गंगा च तुलसी चैव देव्यो नारायणप्रियाः ..58..
text_mt:
And the wives of the four-armed [form] are Mahālakṣmī, Sarasvatī,
Gaṅgā, and Tulasī—the goddesses dear to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇapatnī sā rādhā tadarddhāṅgasamudbhavā ..
tejasā vayasā sādhvī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णपत्नी सा राधा तदर्द्धाङ्गसमुद्भवा ..
तेजसा वयसा साध्वी रूपेण च गुणेन च .. 59 ..
text_mt:
That Rādhā is the wife of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, born from half of his body,
[equal to him] in splendour, age, virtue, form, and qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ vadedbudhaḥ ..
vyatikrame brahmahatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.49.60 ..
meaning:
आदौ राधां समुच्चार्य पश्चात्कृष्णं वदेद्बुधः ..
व्यतिक्रमे ब्रह्महत्यां लभते नात्र संशयः .. 2.49.60 ..
text_mt:
A wise man should utter 'Rādhā' first, and say 'Kṛṣṇa' afterwards;
in case of reversal, he incurs the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ..
cakāra pūjāṃ rādhāyāstatsambandhimahotsavam .. 61 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तिकीपूर्णिमायां च गोलोके रासमण्डले ..
चकार पूजां राधायास्तत्सम्बन्धिमहोत्सवम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
And on the full moon day of Kārttika, in Goloka, in the circle of the rāsa dance,
he performed the worship of Rādhā and a great festival in her honour.

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnaghuṭikāyāśca kṛtvā tatkavacaṃ hariḥ ..
dadhāra kaṇṭhe bāhau ca dakṣiṇe saha gopakaiḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नघुटिकायाश्च कृत्वा तत्कवचं हरिः ..
दधार कण्ठे बाहौ च दक्षिणे सह गोपकैः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Having enclosed her armour in an amulet of fine jewel, Hari
wore it on his neck and on his right arm, along with the cowherd boys.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dhyānaṃ ca bhaktyā ca stotrametaccakāra saḥ ..
rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ cakhāda madhusūdanaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा ध्यानं च भक्त्या च स्तोत्रमेतच्चकार सः ..
राधाचर्वितताम्बूलं चखाद मधुसूदनः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Having meditated with devotion, he composed this hymn of praise;
Madhusūdana chewed the betel that had been chewed by Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā pūjyā ca kṛṣṇasya tatpūjyo bhagavānprabhuḥ ..
parasparābhīṣṭadeve bhedakṛnnarakaṃ vrajet .. 64 ..
meaning:
राधा पूज्या च कृष्णस्य तत्पूज्यो भगवान्प्रभुः ..
परस्पराभीष्टदेवे भेदकृन्नरकं व्रजेत् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Rādhā is worshipful to Kṛṣṇa, and the sovereign Lord is worshipful to her;
one who makes a distinction between these two who are each other's chosen deities goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye pūjitā sā ca dharmeṇa brahmaṇā mayā ..
anantavāsukibhyāṃ ca raviṇā śaśinā purā .. 65 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये पूजिता सा च धर्मेण ब्रह्मणा मया ..
अनन्तवासुकिभ्यां च रविणा शशिना पुरा .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Secondly, she was worshipped by Dharma, by Brahmā, by me,
by Ananta and Vāsuki, by the sun, and by the moon in ancient times;

sanskrit_iast:
mahendreṇa ca rudraiśca manunā mānavena ca ..
surendraiśca munīndraiśca sarvaviśvaiśca pūjitā .. 66 ..
meaning:
महेन्द्रेण च रुद्रैश्च मनुना मानवेन च ..
सुरेन्द्रैश्च मुनीन्द्रैश्च सर्वविश्वैश्च पूजिता .. 66 ..
text_mt:
by Mahendra, by the Rudras, by Manu, and by humankind;
she was worshipped by the lords of the gods, the lords of sages, and all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye pūjitā sā ca saptadvīpeśvareṇa ca ..
bhārate ca suyajñena putrairmitrairmudā'nvitaiḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
तृतीये पूजिता सा च सप्तद्वीपेश्वरेण च ..
भारते च सुयज्ञेन पुत्रैर्मित्रैर्मुदाऽन्वितैः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
Thirdly, she was worshipped by the sovereign of the seven continents,
Suyajña in Bhārata, accompanied with joy by his sons and friends.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇenābhiśaptena devadoṣeṇa bhūbhṛtā ..
vyādhigrastena hastena duḥkhinā ca vidūyatā .. 68 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेनाभिशप्तेन देवदोषेण भूभृता ..
व्याधिग्रस्तेन हस्तेन दुःखिना च विदूयता .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Cursed by a brāhmaṇa due to an offense against a deity, that king,
afflicted by disease in his hand, miserable and tormenting himself,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpa rājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sa ca rādhāvareṇa ca ..
stotreṇa brahmadattena stutvā ca parameśvarīm .. 69 ..
meaning:
संप्राप राज्यं भ्रष्टश्रीः स च राधावरेण च ..
स्तोत्रेण ब्रह्मदत्तेन स्तुत्वा च परमेश्वरीम् .. 69 ..
text_mt:
bereft of his royal fortune, regained his kingdom through Rādhā's boon,
after praising the supreme goddess with the hymn of praise given by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe bāhau dadhāra saḥ ..
dhyātvā cakāra pūjāṃ ca puṣkare śatavatsarān .. 2.49.70 ..
meaning:
अभेद्यं कवचं तस्याः कण्ठे बाहौ दधार सः ..
ध्यात्वा चकार पूजां च पुष्करे शतवत्सरान् .. 2.49.70 ..
text_mt:
He wore her impenetrable armour on his neck and on his arm;
having meditated, he performed worship at Puṣkara for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
ante jagāma golokaṃ ratnayānena bhūmipaḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 71 ..
meaning:
अन्ते जगाम गोलोकं रत्नयानेन भूमिपः ..
इति ते कथितं सर्वं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 71 ..
text_mt: At the end, the king went to Goloka on a jewel chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
ko vā suyajño nṛpatiḥ kutra vaṃśe babhūva saḥ ..
kathaṃ viprābhiśaptaśca kathaṃ saṃprāpa rādhikām .. 1 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
को वा सुयज्ञो नृपतिः कुत्र वंशे बभूव सः ..
कथं विप्राभिशप्तश्च कथं संप्राप राधिकाम् .. 1 ..
title: Suyajñopākhyānam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanaśca kṛṣṇasya patnīṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjitām ..
kathaṃ viṇmūtradhārī ca siṣeve parameśvarīm .. 2 ..
meaning:
सर्वात्मनश्च कृष्णस्य पत्नीं श्रीकृष्णपूजिताम् ..
कथं विण्मूत्रधारी च सिषेवे परमेश्वरीम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ ..
yatpādāmbhojareṇūnāṃ labdhaye puṣkare vibhuḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तेपे पुरा विधिः ..
यत्पादाम्भोजरेणूनां लब्धये पुष्करे विभुः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ dadarśa tāṃ devo mahālakṣmīṃ purā satīm ..
durdarśāmapi yuṣmākaṃ dṛśyā sā'bhūtkathaṃ nṛṇām .. 4 ..
meaning:
कथं ददर्श तां देवो महालक्ष्मीं पुरा सतीम् ..
दुर्दर्शामपि युष्माकं दृश्या साऽभूत्कथं नृणाम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ trijagatāṃ dhātā tasmai tatkavacaṃ dadau ..
dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ stotraṃ tasyā vyākhyātumarhasi .. 5 ..
meaning:
कथं त्रिजगतां धाता तस्मै तत्कवचं ददौ ..
ध्यानं पूजाविधिं स्तोत्रं तस्या व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
svāyambhuvo manurdevi manūnāmādireva ca ..
brahmātmajastapasvī ca śatarūpāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ..6..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्देवि मनूनामादिरेव च ..
ब्रह्मात्मजस्तपस्वी च शतरूपापतिः प्रभुः ..6..

sanskrit_iast:
uttānapādastatputrastatputro dhruva eva ca ..
dhruvasya kīrtirvikhyātastrailokye śailakanyake ..7..
meaning:
उत्तानपादस्तत्पुत्रस्तत्पुत्रो ध्रुव एव च ..
ध्रुवस्य कीर्तिर्विख्यातस्त्रैलोक्ये शैलकन्यके ..7..

sanskrit_iast:
utkalastasya putraśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ..
sahasraṃ rājasūyānāṃ puṣkare sa cakāra ha .. 8 ..
meaning:
उत्कलस्तस्य पुत्रश्च नारायणपरायणः ..
सहस्रं राजसूयानां पुष्करे स चकार ह .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇi ratnapātrāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ..
amūlyaratnarāśīnāṃ sahasraṃ tejasā vṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
सर्वाणि रत्नपात्राणि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ..
अमूल्यरत्नराशीनां सहस्रं तेजसा वृतम् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rājā yajñānte sa mahotsave ..
dṛṣṭvā tacchobhanaṃ yajñaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ priye .. 2.50.10 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ राजा यज्ञान्ते स महोत्सवे ..
दृष्ट्वा तच्छोभनं यज्ञं विधाता जगतां प्रिये .. 2.50.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suyajñaṃ nāma nṛpatiṃ cakāra surasaṃsadi ..
sa ca rājā suyajñaśca manuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
सुयज्ञं नाम नृपतिं चकार सुरसंसदि ..
स च राजा सुयज्ञश्च मनुवंशसमुद्भवः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
annadātā ratnadātā dātā vai sarvasampadām ..
daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva ratnaśṛṅgaparicchadam .. 12 ..
meaning:
अन्नदाता रत्नदाता दाता वै सर्वसम्पदाम् ..
दशलक्षं गवां चैव रत्नशृङ्गपरिच्छदम् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ dadau sa viprebhyo mudāyuktaḥ sadakṣiṇam ..
gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ dadau nityaṃ mudā'nvitaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
नित्यं ददौ स विप्रेभ्यो मुदायुक्तः सदक्षिणम् ..
गवां द्वादशलक्षाणां ददौ नित्यं मुदाऽन्वितः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
supakvāni ca māṃsāni brāhmaṇebhyaśca pārvati ..
ṣaṭkoṭīrbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सुपक्वानि च मांसानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च पार्वति ..
षट्कोटीर्ब्राह्मणानां च भोजयामास नित्यशः .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
coṣyaiścarvyairlehyapeyairatitṛptaṃ dine dine ..
vipralakṣaṃ sūpakāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tatparam .. 15 ..
meaning:
चोष्यैश्चर्व्यैर्लेह्यपेयैरतितृप्तं दिने दिने ..
विप्रलक्षं सूपकारं भोजयामास तत्परम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇamannaṃ ca sūpāktaṃ sagavyaṃ māṃsavarjitam ..
viprā bhojanakāle ca manuvaṃśasamudbhavam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पूर्णमन्नं च सूपाक्तं सगव्यं मांसवर्जितम् ..
विप्रा भोजनकाले च मनुवंशसमुद्भवम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na tuṣṭuvuḥ suyajñaṃ ca tuṣṭuvustatpitṝṃśca te ..
dine suyajñayajñānte ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭayaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
न तुष्टुवुः सुयज्ञं च तुष्टुवुस्तत्पितॄंश्च ते ..
दिने सुयज्ञयज्ञान्ते षट्त्रिंशल्लक्षकोटयः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cakruḥ subhojanaṃ viprāścātitṛptāśca sundari ..
gṛhītāni ca ratnāni svagṛhaṃ voḍhumakṣamāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
चक्रुः सुभोजनं विप्राश्चातितृप्ताश्च सुन्दरि ..
गृहीतानि च रत्नानि स्वगृहं वोढुमक्षमाः .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣalebhyo daduḥ kiñcitkiñcitpathi ca tatyajuḥ ..
viprāṇāṃ bhojanānte ca viprānyebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
वृषलेभ्यो ददुः किञ्चित्किञ्चित्पथि च तत्यजुः ..
विप्राणां भोजनान्ते च विप्रान्येभ्यो ददौ नृपः .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyurvaritaṃ tatra cānnarāśisahasrakam ..
kṛtvā yajñaṃ mahābāhuḥ samuvāsa svasaṃsadi .. .. 2.50.20 ..
meaning:
तथाप्युर्वरितं तत्र चान्नराशिसहस्रकम् ..
कृत्वा यज्ञं महाबाहुः समुवास स्वसंसदि .. .. 2.50.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasārasaṃklṛptacchatrakoṭisamanvite ..
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye paṭṭavastraiḥ susaṃskṛte .. 21 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारसंक्लृप्तच्छत्रकोटिसमन्विते ..
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये पट्टवस्त्रैः सुसंस्कृते .. 21 ..
text_mt: upon a delightful jeweled throne, elegantly prepared with silken cloths,

sanskrit_iast:
candanādisusaṃsṛṣṭe ramye candanapallavaiḥ ..
śākhāyuktaiḥ pūrṇakumbhai rambhāvṛkṣaiśca śobhite .. 22 ..
meaning:
चन्दनादिसुसंसृष्टे रम्ये चन्दनपल्लवैः ..
शाखायुक्तैः पूर्णकुम्भै रम्भावृक्षैश्च शोभिते .. 22 ..
text_mt:
well-anointed with sandalwood and other perfumes, charming with sandalwood shoots,
adorned with full water-pitchers with leafy branches and with plantain trees,

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukastūrīvanasindūrasaṃskṛte ..
vasuvāsavacandrendrarudrāditya samanvite .. 23 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीवनसिन्दूरसंस्कृते ..
वसुवासवचन्द्रेन्द्ररुद्रादित्य समन्विते .. 23 ..
text_mt:
prepared with sandalwood, aloe, musk, and forest vermilion,
attended by the Vasus, Indra, the Moon, the Rudras, and the Ādityas,

sanskrit_iast:
munināradamanvādibrahmaviṣṇuśivānvite ..
etasminnantare tatra vipra ekaḥ samāyayau .. 24 ..
meaning:
मुनिनारदमन्वादिब्रह्मविष्णुशिवान्विते ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र विप्र एकः समाययौ .. 24 ..
text_mt:
attended by the sages Nārada, Manu and others, and by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.
In the meantime, a certain brāhmaṇa arrived there—

sanskrit_iast:
rūkṣo malinavāsāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ..
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca mālyacandanacarcitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
रूक्षो मलिनवासाश्च शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकः ..
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च माल्यचन्दनचर्चितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
rough, clad in soiled clothes, his throat, lips, and palate parched.
Sitting on the jeweled throne, anointed with garlands and sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
rājānamāśiṣaṃ cakre sasmitaḥ sampuṭāñjaliḥ ..
praṇanāma nṛpastaṃ ca nottasthau kiṃcideva hi ..26..
meaning:
राजानमाशिषं चक्रे सस्मितः सम्पुटाञ्जलिः ..
प्रणनाम नृपस्तं च नोत्तस्थौ किंचिदेव हि ..26..
text_mt:
the king was blessed by him with joined palms and a smile.
The king bowed down to him, but did not rise at all.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāsadaśca nottasthurjahasuḥ svalpameva ca ..
munibhyo'pi ca devebhyo namaskṛtya dvijottamaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
सभासदश्च नोत्तस्थुर्जहसुः स्वल्पमेव च ..
मुनिभ्योऽपि च देवेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
The members of the assembly also did not rise, and even laughed slightly.
Bowing to the sages and also to the gods, that best of the twice-born

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa nṛpatiṃ krodhāttatrātiṣṭhanniraṃkuśaḥ ..
gaccha dūramato rājyādbhraṣṭaśrīrbhava pāmara .. 28 ..
meaning:
शशाप नृपतिं क्रोधात्तत्रातिष्ठन्निरंकुशः ..
गच्छ दूरमतो राज्याद्भ्रष्टश्रीर्भव पामर .. 28 ..
text_mt:
cursed the king in anger, standing there unrestrained:
“Go far away from this realm; become one bereft of fortune, you wretch!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāciraṃ galatkuṣṭhī buddhihīno'pyupadrutaḥ ..
ityuktvā kampitaḥ krodhātsabhāsthāñchaptumudyataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
भवाचिरं गलत्कुष्ठी बुद्धिहीनोऽप्युपद्रुतः ..
इत्युक्त्वा कम्पितः क्रोधात्सभास्थाञ्छप्तुमुद्यतः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Soon become a rotting leper, senseless and afflicted!”
Having spoken thus, trembling with rage, he prepared to curse the attendees of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
ye yatra jahasuḥ sarve samuttasthuḥ sabhāsadaḥ ..
sarve cakruḥ praṇāmaṃ te krodhaṃ tatyāja vāḍavaḥ .. 2.50.30 ..
meaning:
ये यत्र जहसुः सर्वे समुत्तस्थुः सभासदः ..
सर्वे चक्रुः प्रणामं ते क्रोधं तत्याज वाडवः .. 2.50.30 ..
text_mt:
Those who had laughed all stood up in the assembly;
they all made obeisance, and the brāhmaṇa abandoned his anger.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyāgatya rājā taṃ ruroda bhayakātaraḥ ..
nissasāra sabhāmadhyāddhṛdayena vidūyatā .. 31 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्यागत्य राजा तं रुरोद भयकातरः ..
निस्ससार सभामध्याद्धृदयेन विदूयता .. 31 ..
text_mt:
Approaching and bowing down to him, the king wept, distressed with fear.
With an anguished heart, [the brāhmaṇa] went out from the midst of the assembly—

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo gūḍharūpī ca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ..
tatpaścānmunayaḥ sarve prayayurbhayakātarāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो गूढरूपी च प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा ..
तत्पश्चान्मुनयः सर्वे प्रययुर्भयकातराः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
a brāhmaṇa of disguised form, blazing with the splendour of Brahman.
Behind him, all the sages followed, distressed with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
he vipra tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti samuccāryya punaḥ punaḥ ..
pulahaśca pulastyaśca pracetā bhṛguraṃgirāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
हे विप्र तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति समुच्चार्य्य पुनः पुनः ..
पुलहश्च पुलस्त्यश्च प्रचेता भृगुरंगिराः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
calling out repeatedly: “O brāhmaṇa, stay, stay!”
Pulaha, Pulastya, Pracetas, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
marīciḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭhaḥ kratureva ca ..
śukro bṛhaspati ścaiva durvāsā lomaśastathā .. 34 ..
meaning:
मरीचिः कश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठः क्रतुरेव च ..
शुक्रो बृहस्पति श्चैव दुर्वासा लोमशस्तथा .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Marīci, Kaśyapa, Vasiṣṭha, Kratu,
Śukra, Bṛhaspati, Durvāsas, Lomaśa,

sanskrit_iast:
gautamaśca kaṇādaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kaṭhaḥ ..
pāṇinirjājaliścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
गौतमश्च कणादश्च कण्वः कात्यायनः कठः ..
पाणिनिर्जाजलिश्चैव ऋष्यशृंगो विभाण्डकः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Gautama, Kaṇāda, Kaṇva, Kātyāyana, Kaṭha,
Pāṇini, Jājali, Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Vibhāṇḍaka,

sanskrit_iast:
taittiriścāpyāpiśalirmārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ ..
sanakaśca sanandaśca voḍhuḥ pailaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
तैत्तिरिश्चाप्यापिशलिर्मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः ..
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च वोढुः पैलः सनातनः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Taittiri, Āpiśali, Mārkaṇḍeya of great austerity,
Sanaka, Sananda, Voḍhu, Paila, Sanātana,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavānnaranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
parāśaro jaratkāruḥ saṃvarttaḥ karabhastathā .. 37 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्नरनारायणावृषी ..
पराशरो जरत्कारुः संवर्त्तः करभस्तथा .. 37 ..
text_mt:
the blessed Sanatkumāra, the two sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa,
Parāśara, Jaratkāru, Saṃvarta, Karabha,

sanskrit_iast:
bharadvājaśca vālmīkiraurvaśca cyavanastathā ..
agastyo 'trirutathyaśca saṅkartā''stīka āsuriḥ .. 38..
meaning:
भरद्वाजश्च वाल्मीकिरौर्वश्च च्यवनस्तथा ..
अगस्त्यो ऽत्रिरुतथ्यश्च सङ्कर्ता'ऽस्तीक आसुरिः .. 38..

Bharadvāja, Vālmīki, Aurva, Cyavana,
Agastya, Atri, Utathya, Saṅkartā, Āstīka, Āsuri,

sanskrit_iast:
śilālirlāṅgaliścaiva śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ..
gargo vatsaḥ pañcaśikho jamadagniśca devalaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
शिलालिर्लाङ्गलिश्चैव शाकल्यः शाकटायनः ..
गर्गो वत्सः पञ्चशिखो जमदग्निश्च देवलः .. 39 ..

Śilālin, Lāṅgalin, Śākalya, Śākaṭāyana,
Garga, Vatsa, Pañcaśikha, Jamadagni, Devala,

sanskrit_iast:

śaktirdakṣaḥ kardamaśca praskannaḥ kapilastathā .. 2.50.40 ..
meaning:
जैगीषव्यो वामदेवो वालखिल्यादयस्तथा ..
शक्तिर्दक्षः कर्दमश्च प्रस्कन्नः कपिलस्तथा .. 2.50.40 ..
text_mt:
Jaigīṣavya, Vāmadeva, the Vālakhilyas and others,
Śakti, Dakṣa, Kardama, Praskanna, Kapila,

sanskrit_iast:

ete cānye ca munayaḥ pitaro'gnirharipriyā ..41..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रश्च कौत्सश्चाप्यृचीकोऽप्यघमर्षणः ..

text_mt:
Viśvāmitra, Kautsa, Ṛcīka, and Aghamarṣaṇa—
these and other sages, the ancestors, Agni, and those dear to Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālā devatāḥ sarvā vipraṃ paścātsamāyayuḥ..
brāhmaṇaṃ bodhayāmāsurvāsayāmāsurīśvari .. 42 ..
meaning:
दिक्पाला देवताः सर्वा विप्रं पश्चात्समाययुः..
ब्राह्मणं बोधयामासुर्वासयामासुरीश्वरि .. 42 ..
text_mt:
the guardians of the directions, and all the deities followed after the brāhmaṇa.
They consoled the brāhmaṇa and had him sit down, O sovereign lady;

sanskrit_iast: samūcustaṃ krameṇaiva nītiṃ nītiviśāradāḥ .. 43 ..
meaning: समूचुस्तं क्रमेणैव नीतिं नीतिविशारदाः .. 43 ..
text_mt: and, skilled in statecraft, they addressed prudent words to him in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpārvatyuvāca ..
kimūcurbrāhmaṇaṃ brahmanbrāhmaṇā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ..
nītijñā nītivacanaṃ tanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीपार्वत्युवाच ..
किमूचुर्ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मणः सुताः ..
नीतिज्ञा नीतिवचनं तन्मां व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 1 ..
title: Karmavipākaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
santoṣya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca stavena vinayena ca ..
krameṇa vaktumārebhe munisaṃgho varānane .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
सन्तोष्य तं ब्राह्मणं च स्तवेन विनयेन च ..
क्रमेण वक्तुमारेभे मुनिसंघो वरानने .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
