tvatpaścādāgatā lakṣmīḥ kīrttiḥ sattvaṃ yaśastathā ..
suśīlaṃ ca mahaiśvaryaṃ pitaro'gniḥ surāstathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच ..
त्वत्पश्चादागता लक्ष्मीः कीर्त्तिः सत्त्वं यशस्तथा ..
सुशीलं च महैश्वर्यं पितरोऽग्निः सुरास्तथा .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āgatā nṛpagehebhyaḥ kṛtvā bhraṣṭaśriyaṃ nṛpam ..
bhava tuṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭha cāśutoṣaśca vāḍavaḥ ..4..
meaning:
आगता नृपगेहेभ्यः कृत्वा भ्रष्टश्रियं नृपम् ..
भव तुष्टो द्विजश्रेष्ठ चाशुतोषश्च वाडवः ..4..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu hṛdayaṃ komalaṃ navanītavat ..
śuddhaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva mārjitaṃ tapasā mune .. 5 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां तु हृदयं कोमलं नवनीतवत् ..
शुद्धं सुनिर्मलं चैव मार्जितं तपसा मुने .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam ..
āśiṣaṃ kuru tasmai tvaṃ pavitrapadareṇunā ..6..
meaning:
क्षमस्वागच्छ विप्रेन्द्र शुद्धं कुरु नृपालयम् ..
आशिषं कुरु तस्मै त्वं पवित्रपदरेणुना ..6..

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguruvāca ..
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivarttate ..
pitarastasya devāśca vahniścaiva tathaiva ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
भृगुरुवाच ..
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिवर्त्तते ..
पितरस्तस्य देवाश्च वह्निश्चैव तथैव च .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti cātitherapratigrahāt..
kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam .. 8 ..
meaning:
निराशाः प्रतिगच्छन्ति चातिथेरप्रतिग्रहात्..
क्षमस्वागच्छ विप्रेन्द्र शुद्धं कुरु नृपालयम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
strīghnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brahmaghnairgurutalpagaiḥ ..
tulyadoṣo bhavatyetairyasyātithiranarcitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीघ्नैर्गोघ्नैः कृतघ्नैश्च ब्रह्मघ्नैर्गुरुतल्पगैः ..
तुल्यदोषो भवत्येतैर्यस्यातिथिरनर्चितः .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca ..
paśyanti ye vakradṛṣṭyā cātithiṃ gṛhamāgatam ..
dattvā svapāpaṃ tasmai tatpuṇyamādāya gacchati .. 2.51.10 ..
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच ..
पश्यन्ति ये वक्रदृष्ट्या चातिथिं गृहमागतम् ..
दत्त्वा स्वपापं तस्मै तत्पुण्यमादाय गच्छति .. 2.51.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamasva nṛpadoṣaṃ ca gaccha vatsa yathāsukham ..
rājā svakarmadoṣeṇa nottasthau tatkṣamāṃ kuru .. 11 ..
meaning:
क्षमस्व नृपदोषं च गच्छ वत्स यथासुखम् ..
राजा स्वकर्मदोषेण नोत्तस्थौ तत्क्षमां कुरु .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pulaha uvāca ..
rājaśriyā vidyayā vā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate ..
viprastrisandhyāhīno yaḥ śrīhīnaḥ kṣatriyo bhavet .. 12 ..
meaning:
पुलह उवाच ..
राजश्रिया विद्यया वा ब्राह्मणं योऽवमन्यते ..
विप्रस्त्रिसन्ध्याहीनो यः श्रीहीनः क्षत्रियो भवेत् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīvihīnaśca viṣṇunaivedyavañcitaḥ ..
kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam .. 13 ..
meaning:
एकादशीविहीनश्च विष्णुनैवेद्यवञ्चितः ..
क्षमस्वागच्छ विप्रेन्द्र शुद्धं कुरु नृपालयम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kraturuvāca..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā śūdra eva ca..
dīkṣāhīno bhavetso'pi brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate..14..
meaning:
क्रतुरुवाच..
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वाऽपि वैश्यो वा शूद्र एव च..
दीक्षाहीनो भवेत्सोऽपि ब्राह्मणं योऽवमन्यते..14..

sanskrit_iast:
dhanahīnaḥ putrahīno bhāryyāhīno bhaveddhruvam ..
kṣamasvāgaccha bhagavañchuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam .. 15 ..
meaning:
धनहीनः पुत्रहीनो भार्य्याहीनो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
क्षमस्वागच्छ भगवञ्छुद्धं कुरु नृपालयम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirā uvāca ..
jñānavānbrāhmaṇo bhūtvā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate..
vṛṣavāho bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu..16..
meaning:
अङ्गिरा उवाच ..
ज्ञानवान्ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा ब्राह्मणं योऽवमन्यते..
वृषवाहो भवेत्सोऽपि भारते सप्तजन्मसु..16..

sanskrit_iast:
marīciruvāca..
puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca devaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ gurum..
viṣṇubhaktivihīnaśca sa bhavedyo'vamanyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
मरीचिरुवाच..
पुण्यक्षेत्रे भारते च देवं च ब्राह्मणं गुरुम्..
विष्णुभक्तिविहीनश्च स भवेद्योऽवमन्यते .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapa uvāca ..
vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo'satyamavamanyate ..
viṣṇumantravihīnaśca tatpūjāvirato bhavet ..18..
meaning:
कश्यप उवाच ..
वैष्णवं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा योऽसत्यमवमन्यते ..
विष्णुमन्त्रविहीनश्च तत्पूजाविरतो भवेत् ..18..

sanskrit_iast:
pracetā uvāca ..
atithiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhyutthānaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
pitṛbhaktivihīnassyātsa bhavedbhārate bhuvi..19..
meaning:
प्रचेता उवाच ..
अतिथिं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा नाभ्युत्थानं करोति यः ..
पितृभक्तिविहीनस्स्यात्स भवेद्भारते भुवि..19..

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnoti kauñjarīṃ yoniṃ sa mūḍhaḥ saptajanmasu ..
śīghraṃ gaccha dvijaśreṣṭha rājñe dehyāśiṣaśśubhāḥ ..2.51.20..
meaning:
प्राप्नोति कौञ्जरीं योनिं स मूढः सप्तजन्मसु ..
शीघ्रं गच्छ द्विजश्रेष्ठ राज्ञे देह्याशिषश्शुभाः ..2.51.20..

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsā uvāca ..
guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā'pi devatāpratimāmapi ..
dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ na praṇametsa bhavetsūkaro bhuvi ..21..
meaning:
दुर्वासा उवाच ..
गुरुं वा ब्राह्मणं वाऽपि देवताप्रतिमामपि ..
दृष्ट्वा शीघ्रं न प्रणमेत्स भवेत्सूकरो भुवि ..21..

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāsākṣī ca bhavati tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ ..
kṣamasva sarvamasmākamātithyagrahaṇaṃ kuru .. 22 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यासाक्षी च भवति तथा विश्वासघातकः ..
क्षमस्व सर्वमस्माकमातिथ्यग्रहणं कुरु .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca ..
chalena kathito dharmo yuṣmābhirmunipuṅgavaiḥ ..
sarvaṃ kṛtvā ca vispaṣṭaṃ māṃ mūḍhaṃ bodhayantvaho .. 23 ..
meaning:
राजोवाच ..
छलेन कथितो धर्मो युष्माभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः ..
सर्वं कृत्वा च विस्पष्टं मां मूढं बोधयन्त्वहो .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
strīghnagoghnakṛtaghnānāṃ gurustrīgāmināṃ tathā ..
brahmaghnānāṃ ca ko doṣo brūta māṃ yogināṃ varāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीघ्नगोघ्नकृतघ्नानां गुरुस्त्रीगामिनां तथा ..
ब्रह्मघ्नानां च को दोषो ब्रूत मां योगिनां वराः .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca ..
kāmato govadhe rājanvarṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramennaraḥ ..
yavayāvakabhojī ca kareṇa ca jalaṃ pibet .. 25 ..
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच ..
कामतो गोवधे राजन्वर्षं तीर्थं भ्रमेन्नरः ..
यवयावकभोजी च करेण च जलं पिबेत् .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā dhenuśataṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadakṣiṇam ..
dattvā muñcati pāpācca bhojayitvā śataṃ dvijān .. 26 ..
meaning:
तदा धेनुशतं दिव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सदक्षिणम् ..
दत्त्वा मुञ्चति पापाच्च भोजयित्वा शतं द्विजान् .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścitte tu vai cīrṇe sarvapāpānna mucyate ..
pāpāvaśeṣādbhavati duḥkhī cāṇḍāla eva ca .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्ते तु वै चीर्णे सर्वपापान्न मुच्यते ..
पापावशेषाद्भवति दुःखी चाण्डाल एव च .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ātideśikahatyāyāṃ tadardhaṃ phalamaśnute ..
prāyaścittānukalpena sarvapāpānna mucyate.... 28 ..
meaning:
आतिदेशिकहत्यायां तदर्धं फलमश्नुते ..
प्रायश्चित्तानुकल्पेन सर्वपापान्न मुच्यते.... 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
gohatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ strīhatyāyāṃ bhaveddhruvam ..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kālasūtre vaseddhruvam .. 29 ..
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच ..
गोहत्याद्विगुणं पापं स्त्रीहत्यायां भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि कालसूत्रे वसेद्ध्रुवम् .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavenmahāpāpī sūkaraḥ saptajanmasu ..
tato bhavati sarpaśca saptajanmanyataḥ śuciḥ .. 2.51.30 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेन्महापापी सूकरः सप्तजन्मसु ..
ततो भवति सर्पश्च सप्तजन्मन्यतः शुचिः .. 2.51.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca ..
strīhatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyākṛto bhavet ..
lakṣavarṣaṃ mahāghore kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam.. 33 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच ..
स्त्रीहत्याद्विगुणं पापं ब्रह्महत्याकृतो भवेत् ..
लक्षवर्षं महाघोरे कुम्भीपाके वसेद्ध्रुवम्.. 33 ..
text_mt:
The sin of one who commits the murder of a Brahmin is twice that of killing a woman;
he surely resides in the terrible Kumbhīpāka for one hundred thousand years. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavenmahāpāpī viṣṭhākīṭaḥ śatābdakam..
tato bhavati sarpaśca saptajanmanyataḥ śuciḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेन्महापापी विष्ठाकीटः शताब्दकम्..
ततो भवति सर्पश्च सप्तजन्मन्यतः शुचिः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Then that great sinner becomes a worm in feces for a hundred years;

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca ..
doṣaḥ kṛtaghne rājendra brahmahatyācaturguṇaḥ ..
niṣkṛtirnāsti vedoktā kṛtaghnānāṃ ca niścitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
गौतम उवाच ..
दोषः कृतघ्ने राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्याचतुर्गुणः ..
निष्कृतिर्नास्ति वेदोक्ता कृतघ्नानां च निश्चितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
The fault of an ungrateful person, O king of kings, is four times that of murdering a Brahmin;
no expiation is declared in the Veda for the ungrateful, for certain. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca ..
lakṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ..
kṛtaghnaḥ katidhā proktaḥ keṣu ko doṣa eva ca..34..
meaning:
राजोवाच ..
लक्षणं च कृतघ्नानां वद वेदविदां वर ..
कृतघ्नः कतिधा प्रोक्तः केषु को दोष एव च..34..
text_mt:
Tell the characteristic of the ungrateful, O best of knowers of the Veda:
How many kinds of ungrateful person are spoken of, and what fault lies in which cases? // 34

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyaśṛṅga uvāca ..
kṛtaghnāḥ ṣoḍaśavidhāḥ sāmavede nirūpitāḥ ..
sarvaḥ pratyekadoṣeṇa pratyekaṃ phalamaśnute .. 35 ..
meaning:
ऋष्यशृङ्ग उवाच ..
कृतघ्नाः षोडशविधाः सामवेदे निरूपिताः ..
सर्वः प्रत्येकदोषेण प्रत्येकं फलमश्नुते .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Sixteen kinds of ungrateful person are defined in the Sāmaveda;
each one reaps the result according to their individual fault: // 35

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte satye ca puṇye ca svadharme tapasi sthite ..
pratijñāyāṃ ca dāne ca svagoṣṭhīparipālane .. 36 ..
meaning:
कृते सत्ये च पुण्ये च स्वधर्मे तपसि स्थिते ..
प्रतिज्ञायां च दाने च स्वगोष्ठीपरिपालने .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Regarding a benefit, truth, religious merit, one's own duty, steadfastness in austerity,
a vow, charity, protecting one's family group, // 36

sanskrit_iast:
gurukṛtye devakṛtye kāmyakṛtye dvijārcane ..
nityakṛtye ca viśvāse paradharmapradānayoḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
गुरुकृत्ये देवकृत्ये काम्यकृत्ये द्विजार्चने ..
नित्यकृत्ये च विश्वासे परधर्मप्रदानयोः .. 37 ..
text_mt:
duty to the teacher, duty to the gods, rites for desire, worship of the twice-born,
daily obligations, trust, and transmitting another's religious duty— // 37

sanskrit_iast:
etānyo hanti pāpiṣṭhaḥ sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ..
eteṣāṃ santi lokāśca tajjanma bhinnayoniṣu .. 38 ..
meaning:
एतान्यो हन्ति पापिष्ठः स कृतघ्न इति स्मृतः ..
एतेषां सन्ति लोकाश्च तज्जन्म भिन्नयोनिषु .. 38 ..
text_mt:
that most wicked person who destroys these is remembered as ungrateful.
There are hellish worlds for them, and birth in diverse wombs; // 38

sanskrit_iast:
yānyāṃśca narakāṃste ca yānti rājendra pāpinaḥ ..
te te ca narakāḥ santi yamaloke suniścitam ..39..
meaning:
यान्यांश्च नरकांस्ते च यान्ति राजेन्द्र पापिनः ..
ते ते च नरकाः सन्ति यमलोके सुनिश्चितम् ..39..
text_mt:
and the hells to which those sinners go, O king of kings,
those very hells indeed exist in the realm of Yama. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
suyajña uvāca..
ke kiṃ kṛtvā kṛtaghnāśca kāṃskāngacchanti rauravān ..
pratyekaṃ śrotumicchāmi vaktumarhasi me prabho.... 2.51.40 ..
meaning:
सुयज्ञ उवाच..
के किं कृत्वा कृतघ्नाश्च कांस्कान्गच्छन्ति रौरवान् ..
प्रत्येकं श्रोतुमिच्छामि वक्तुमर्हसि मे प्रभो.... 2.51.40 ..
text_mt:
Who, having done what, are the ungrateful, and to which Raurava hells do they go?
I desire to hear each one; please tell me, O lord. // 2.51.40

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyana uvāca ..
kṛtvā śapatharūpaṃ ca satyaṃ hanti na pālayet ..
sa kṛtaghnaḥ kālasūtre vasedeva caturyugam .. 41 ..
meaning:
कात्यायन उवाच ..
कृत्वा शपथरूपं च सत्यं हन्ति न पालयेत् ..
स कृतघ्नः कालसूत्रे वसेदेव चतुर्युगम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
He who, having made a truth in the form of an oath, violates it and does not uphold it,
that ungrateful person dwells in Kālasūtra for four yugas. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmasu kākaśca saptajanmasu pecakaḥ ..
tataḥ śūdro mahāvyādhiḥ saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मसु काकश्च सप्तजन्मसु पेचकः ..
ततः शूद्रो महाव्याधिः सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुचिः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
He becomes a crow for seven births and an owl for seven births;
then he becomes a Śūdra afflicted with severe disease, and after seven births he is purified. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsanandana uvāca ..
puṇyaṃ kṛtvā vadatyeva kīrtivarddhanahetunā ..
sa kṛtaghnastaptasūrmyāṃ vasatyeva yugatrayam .. 43 ..
meaning:
श्रीसनन्दन उवाच ..
पुण्यं कृत्वा वदत्येव कीर्तिवर्द्धनहेतुना ..
स कृतघ्नस्तप्तसूर्म्यां वसत्येव युगत्रयम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
He who, having performed a merit, proclaims it for the sake of increasing fame,
that ungrateful person resides in Taptasūrmī for three yugas. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
pañcajanmasu maṇḍūkastriṣu janmasu karkaṭaḥ ..
tadā mūko mahāvyādhirdaridraśca tataḥ śuciḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
पञ्चजन्मसु मण्डूकस्त्रिषु जन्मसु कर्कटः ..
तदा मूको महाव्याधिर्दरिद्रश्च ततः शुचिः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
He becomes a frog for five births and a crab for three births;
then a mute afflicted with severe disease and impoverished; after that he is purified. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca ..
svadharmaṃ hanti yo vipraḥ sandhyātrayavivarjitaḥ ..
atarpayaṃśca yaḥ snāti viṣṇunaivedyavarjitaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
सनातन उवाच ..
स्वधर्मं हन्ति यो विप्रः सन्ध्यात्रयविवर्जितः ..
अतर्पयंश्च यः स्नाति विष्णुनैवेद्यवर्जितः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
The Brahmin who abandons his own duty and is devoid of the three twilights,
and who bathes without offering libations, devoid of food offerings to Viṣṇu, // 45

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇupūjāvihīnaśca viṣṇumantravihīnakaḥ ..
ekādaśīvihīnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇajanmadine tadā .... 46 ..
meaning:
विष्णुपूजाविहीनश्च विष्णुमन्त्रविहीनकः ..
एकादशीविहीनः श्रीकृष्णजन्मदिने तदा .... 46 ..
text_mt:
devoid of Viṣṇu's worship and devoid of Viṣṇu's mantra,
neglectful of the eleventh-day fast and on the birthday of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
śivarātrau ca yo bhuṅkte śrīrāmanavamīdine ..
pitṛkṛtyādihīno yaḥ sa kṛtaghra iti smṛtaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
शिवरात्रौ च यो भुङ्क्ते श्रीरामनवमीदिने ..
पितृकृत्यादिहीनो यः स कृतघ्र इति स्मृतः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
and who eats on Śivarātri and on the day of Śrī Rāmanavamī,
and who neglects rites for the ancestors and the like, is remembered as ungrateful. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhīpāke vasatyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
tataścāṇḍālatāṃ yāti saptajanmasu niścitam .. 48 ..
meaning:
कुम्भीपाके वसत्येव यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ..
ततश्चाण्डालतां याति सप्तजन्मसु निश्चितम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
He dwells in Kumbhīpāka for as long as fourteen Indras reign;
then he surely becomes a cāṇḍāla for seven births. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
śatajanmani gṛdhraśca śatajanmani sūkaraḥ ..
tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
शतजन्मनि गृध्रश्च शतजन्मनि सूकरः ..
ततो भवेद्ब्राह्मणश्च शूद्राणां सूपकारकः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
He becomes a vulture for a hundred births and a boar for a hundred births;
then he becomes a Brahmin who is a cook for Śūdras. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavejjanma sapta brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ..
śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca bhavetsaptasu janmasu .... 2.51.50 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेज्जन्म सप्त ब्राह्मणो वृषवाहकः ..
शूद्राणां शवदाही च भवेत्सप्तसु जन्मसु .... 2.51.50 ..
text_mt:
Then for seven births he becomes a Brahmin who drives bullocks,
and for seven births he becomes a cremator of Śūdra corpses. // 2.51.50

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo bhūtvā saptajanau bhārate vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
bhuktvā svabhogaleśaṃ ca bhramitvā yāti rauravam .. 51 ..
meaning:
द्विजो भूत्वा सप्तजनौ भारते वृषलीपतिः ..
भुक्त्वा स्वभोगलेशं च भ्रमित्वा याति रौरवम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
having become a twice-born, a husband of a Śūdra woman for seven births in Bhārata,
and after experiencing a fraction of his retribution, wandering, he goes to Raurava.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punaḥ pāpayoniṃ narakaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
tato bhavedgardabhaśca mārjāraḥ pañcajanmasu .. 52 ..
meaning:
पुनः पुनः पापयोनिं नरकं च पुनः पुनः ..
ततो भवेद्गर्दभश्च मार्जारः पञ्चजन्मसु .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Again and again into a sinful womb, and into hell again and again;
then he becomes a donkey, and a cat for five births;

sanskrit_iast: pañcajanmasu maṇḍūko bhavecchuddhastataḥ kramāt..53..
meaning: पञ्चजन्मसु मण्डूको भवेच्छुद्धस्ततः क्रमात्..53..
text_mt: for five births a frog, and then in due course he becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast:
suyajña uvāca ..
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakaraṇe śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhane ..
śūdrānnabhojane vā'pi śūdrastrīgamane'pi ca..54..
meaning:
सुयज्ञ उवाच ..
शूद्राणां सूपकरणे शूद्राणां शवदाहने ..
शूद्रान्नभोजने वाऽपि शूद्रस्त्रीगमनेऽपि च..54..
text_mt:
In cooking for Śūdras, in burning the corpses of Śūdras,
or in eating the food of Śūdras, and also in having intercourse with a Śūdra woman,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ko doṣo vṛṣāṇāṃ vāhane tathā ..
etānsarvānsamālocya brūhi māṃ niścayaṃ mune .. 55 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां च को दोषो वृषाणां वाहने तथा ..
एतान्सर्वान्समालोच्य ब्रूहि मां निश्चयं मुने .. 55 ..
text_mt:
what is the fault for Brahmins, and likewise in driving bullocks?
Considering all these, tell me the definite truth, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśara uvāca ..
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca yo vipro jñānadurbalaḥ ..
asipatre vasatyeva yugānāmekasaptatiḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
पराशर उवाच ..
शूद्राणां सूपकारश्च यो विप्रो ज्ञानदुर्बलः ..
असिपत्रे वसत्येव युगानामेकसप्ततिः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
A Brahmin weak in knowledge who is a cook for Śūdras,
dwells in Asipatra for seventy-one yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavedgardabhaśca mūṣikaḥ saptajanmasu..
tailakīṭassaptajanmasvataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेद्गर्दभश्च मूषिकः सप्तजन्मसु..
तैलकीटस्सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुद्धो भवेन्नरः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Then he becomes a donkey, and a mouse for seven births;
an oil-bug for seven births; then that man becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast:
jaratkāruruvāca ..
bhṛtyadvārā svayaṃ vā'pi yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ ..
sa kṛtaghna iti khyātaḥ prasiddho bhārate nṛpa .. 58 ..
meaning:
जरत्कारुरुवाच ..
भृत्यद्वारा स्वयं वाऽपि यो विप्रो वृषवाहकः ..
स कृतघ्न इति ख्यातः प्रसिद्धो भारते नृप .. 58 ..
text_mt:
The Brahmin who drives a bullock, either through a servant or by himself,
is celebrated as an ungrateful man, notorious in Bhārata, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tannityaṃ vṛṣatāḍane ..
vṛṣapṛṣṭhe bhāradānātpāpaṃ taddviguṇaṃ bhaveta .. 59 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं तन्नित्यं वृषताडने ..
वृषपृष्ठे भारदानात्पापं तद्द्विगुणं भवेत .. 59 ..
text_mt:
His constant beating of the bullock brings sin equal to killing a Brahmin;
from placing a burden on the bullock's back, that sin becomes double.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryyātape vāhayedyaḥ kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣṭitaṃ vṛṣam ..
brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.51.60 ..
meaning:
सूर्य्यातपे वाहयेद्यः क्षुधितं तृष्टितं वृषम् ..
ब्रह्महत्याशतं पापं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 2.51.60 ..
text_mt:
He who drives a hungry, thirsty bullock in the heat of the sun,
incurs the sin of a hundred Brahmin-murders; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ viprāṇāṃ vṛṣavāhinām ..
nādhikāro bhavetteṣāṃ pitṛdevārcane nṛpa ..61 ..
meaning:
अन्नं विष्ठा जलं मूत्रं विप्राणां वृषवाहिनाम् ..
नाधिकारो भवेत्तेषां पितृदेवार्चने नृप ..61 ..
text_mt:
The food of Brahmins who drive bullocks is feces, their water is urine;
they have no entitlement in worshiping ancestors or gods, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
lālākuṇḍe vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ..
viṣṭhābhakṣyaṃ mūtrajalaṃ tatra tasya bhaveddhruvam .. 62 ..
meaning:
लालाकुण्डे वसत्येव यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ..
विष्ठाभक्ष्यं मूत्रजलं तत्र तस्य भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
He dwells in the Lālākuṇḍa pit as long as the moon and sun endure;
there his food will surely be feces, and his water urine.

sanskrit_iast:
trisandhyaṃ tāḍayettaṃ ca śūlena yamakiṅkaraḥ ..
ulkāṃ dadāti mukhataḥ sūcyā kṛntati santatam ..63..
meaning:
त्रिसन्ध्यं ताडयेत्तं च शूलेन यमकिङ्करः ..
उल्कां ददाति मुखतः सूच्या कृन्तति सन्ततम् ..63..
text_mt:
At the three junctures of the day, Yama's servant strikes him with a trident;
he thrusts a torch into his mouth and pierces him continually with a needle.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ..
tataḥ kākaḥ pañcajanmasvathaivaṃ baka eva ca .. 64 ..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां च कृमिर्भवेत् ..
ततः काकः पञ्चजन्मस्वथैवं बक एव च .. 64 ..
text_mt: then a crow for five births, and likewise a heron,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcajanmasu gṛdhraśca śṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu ..
tato daridraḥ śūdraśca mahāvyādhistataḥ śuciḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
पञ्चजन्मसु गृध्रश्च शृगालः सप्तजन्मसु ..
ततो दरिद्रः शूद्रश्च महाव्याधिस्ततः शुचिः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
and a vulture for five births, a jackal for seven births,
then an impoverished Śūdra afflicted with severe illness; then he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāradvāja uvāca ..
śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī yaḥ sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ..
vayaḥpramāṇāṃ rājendra brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 66 ..
meaning:
भारद्वाज उवाच ..
शूद्राणां शवदाही यः स कृतघ्न इति स्मृतः ..
वयःप्रमाणां राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
He who burns the corpses of Śūdras is considered an ungrateful man;
O best of kings, he surely incurs Brahmin-murder for the span of the [deceased person's] age.

sanskrit_iast:
tattulyayonibhramaṇāttattulyanarakācchuciḥ ..
yo doṣo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhane .. 67 ..
meaning:
तत्तुल्ययोनिभ्रमणात्तत्तुल्यनरकाच्छुचिः ..
यो दोषो ब्राह्मणानां च शूद्राणां शवदाहने .. 67 ..
text_mt:
From wandering through equivalent wombs and from equivalent hells, he becomes pure.
Whatever fault there is for Brahmins in burning the corpses of Śūdras,

sanskrit_iast: tāvadeva bhaveddoṣaḥ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojane .. 68 ..
meaning: तावदेव भवेद्दोषः शूद्रश्राद्धान्नभोजने .. 68 ..
text_mt: just so much fault is incurred in eating the funeral food of a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāṇḍaka uvāca ..
pitṛśrāddhe ca śūdrāṇāṃ bhuṅkte yo brāhmaṇo'dhamaḥ..
surāpītī brahmaghātī pitṛdevārcanādbahiḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
विभाण्डक उवाच ..
पितृश्राद्धे च शूद्राणां भुङ्क्ते यो ब्राह्मणोऽधमः..
सुरापीती ब्रह्मघाती पितृदेवार्चनाद्बहिः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
The vile Brahmin who eats at the ancestral funeral rite of Śūdras
is an imbiber of liquor, a killer of Brahmins, excluded from the worship of ancestors and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
yo doṣo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrastrīgamane nṛpa ..
ahaṃ vakṣyāmi vedoktaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ..2.51.70..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
यो दोषो ब्राह्मणानां च शूद्रस्त्रीगमने नृप ..
अहं वक्ष्यामि वेदोक्तं सावधानं निशामय ..2.51.70..
text_mt:
Whatever fault there is for Brahmins in having intercourse with a Śūdra woman, O king,
I shall state as proclaimed in the Vedas; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaghnānāṃ pradhānaśca yo vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
kṛmidaṃṣṭre vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa..71..
meaning:
कृतघ्नानां प्रधानश्च यो विप्रो वृषलीपतिः ..
कृमिदंष्ट्रे वसेत्सोऽपि यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश..71..
text_mt:
The Brahmin who is a husband of a Śūdra woman is the foremost among the ungrateful;
he dwells in Kṛmidaṃṣṭra as long as the fourteen Indras [rule].

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmibhakṣyo bhavedvipro vihvalo yamakiṅkaraiḥ ..
pratimāṃ tāṃ taptalauhīmāśleṣayati nityaśaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
कृमिभक्ष्यो भवेद्विप्रो विह्वलो यमकिङ्करैः ..
प्रतिमां तां तप्तलौहीमाश्लेषयति नित्यशः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Distressed by Yama's servants, that Brahmin becomes food for worms;
they continually force him to embrace a burning iron statue.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca puṃścalīyonau kṛmirbhavati niścitam ..
evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca tataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ..73..
meaning:
ततश्च पुंश्चलीयोनौ कृमिर्भवति निश्चितम् ..
एवं वर्षसहस्रं च ततः शूद्रस्ततः शुचिः..73..
text_mt:
And then he certainly becomes a worm in the vagina of an unchaste woman,
thus for a thousand years; then a Śūdra; then he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
suyajña uvāca..
anyeṣāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vada karmaphalaṃ mune..
ślāghyo me brāhmaśāpaśca kasya sampadvinā''padam .. 74 ..
meaning:
सुयज्ञ उवाच..
अन्येषां च कृतघ्नानां वद कर्मफलं मुने..
श्लाघ्यो मे ब्राह्मशापश्च कस्य सम्पद्विना'ऽपदम् .. 74 ..
text_mt:
And tell the fruit of deeds of other ungrateful persons, O sage.
A Brahmin's curse is praiseworthy for me; who has good fortune without adversity?

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ..
āgatāstu yato muktā madgehe munayaḥ surāḥ .. 75 ..
iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvi0 pra0 nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde nṛpamunisaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne
karmavipāko nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
धन्योऽहं कृतकृत्योऽहं सफलं जीवनं मम ..
आगतास्तु यतो मुक्ता मद्गेहे मुनयः सुराः .. 75 ..
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्त्ते महापुराणे द्वि0 प्र0 नारदनारायणसंवादान्तर्गतहरगौरीसंवादे नृपमुनिसंवादे राधोपाख्याने
कर्मविपाको नामैकपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
since liberated sages and gods have arrived at my home.
Thus ends the fifty-first chapter, entitled 'The Fruition of Karma', in the Rādhopākhyāna, in the dialogue between the king and the sages, in the dialogue between Hara and Gaurī, within the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the second [book], the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, of the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpārvatyuvāca ..
anyeṣāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ yadyatkarmaphalaṃ prabho ..
teṣāṃ kimūcurmunayo vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीपार्वत्युवाच ..
अन्येषां च कृतघ्नानां यद्यत्कर्मफलं प्रभो ..
तेषां किमूचुर्मुनयो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः .. 1 ..
title: Karmavipākaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmaheśvara uvāca ..
praśnaṃ kurvati rājendre sarveṣu muniṣu priye ..
tatra pravaktumārebhe ṛṣirnārāyaṇo mahān .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ..
प्रश्नं कुर्वति राजेन्द्रे सर्वेषु मुनिषु प्रिये ..
तत्र प्रवक्तुमारेभे ऋषिर्नारायणो महान् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ ..
sa kṛtaghna iti jñeyaḥ phalaṃ ca śṛṇu bhūmipa .. 3 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
स्वदत्तां परदत्तां वा ब्रह्मवृत्तिं हरेत्तु यः ..
स कृतघ्न इति ज्ञेयः फलं च शृणु भूमिप .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanto reṇavaḥ siktā viprāṇāṃ netrabindubhiḥ ..
tāvadvarṣasahasraṃ ca śūlapote sa tiṣṭhati .. 4 ..
meaning:
यावन्तो रेणवः सिक्ता विप्राणां नेत्रबिन्दुभिः ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्रं च शूलपोते स तिष्ठति .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taptāṅgāraṃ ca tadbhakṣyaṃ pānaṃ vai taptamūtrakam ..
taptāṅgāre ca śayanaṃ tāḍito yamakiṅkaraiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तप्ताङ्गारं च तद्भक्ष्यं पानं वै तप्तमूत्रकम् ..
तप्ताङ्गारे च शयनं ताडितो यमकिङ्करैः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadante ca mahāpāpī viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi devamānena bhārate .. 6 ..
meaning:
तदन्ते च महापापी विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः ..
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि देवमानेन भारते .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavedbhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīnaśca mānavaḥ ..
daridraḥ kṛpaṇo rogī śūdro nindyastataḥ śuciḥ ..7..
meaning:
ततो भवेद्भूमिहीनः प्रजाहीनश्च मानवः ..
दरिद्रः कृपणो रोगी शूद्रो निन्द्यस्ततः शुचिः ..7..

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
hanti yaḥ parakīrttiṃ ca svakīrttiṃ vā narādhamaḥ..
sa kṛtaghna iti khyātastatphalaṃ ca niśāmaya .. 8 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
हन्ति यः परकीर्त्तिं च स्वकीर्त्तिं वा नराधमः..
स कृतघ्न इति ख्यातस्तत्फलं च निशामय .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
andhakūpe vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa..
kīṭairnakulagṛdhraiśca bhakṣitaḥ satataṃ nṛpa .. 9 ..
meaning:
अन्धकूपे वसेत्सोऽपि यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश..
कीटैर्नकुलगृध्रैश्च भक्षितः सततं नृप .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taptakṣārodakaṃ pāpī nityaṃ pibati vai tataḥ ..
saptajanmasvataḥ sarpaḥ kākaḥ pañcasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 2.52.10 ..
meaning:
तप्तक्षारोदकं पापी नित्यं पिबति वै ततः ..
सप्तजन्मस्वतः सर्पः काकः पञ्चस्वतः शुचिः .. 2.52.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
devala uvāca ..
brahmasvaṃ vā gurusvaṃ vā devasvaṃ vā'pi yo haret ..
sa kṛtaghna iti jñeyo mahāpāpī ca bhārate ..11..
meaning:
देवल उवाच ..
ब्रह्मस्वं वा गुरुस्वं वा देवस्वं वाऽपि यो हरेत् ..
स कृतघ्न इति ज्ञेयो महापापी च भारते ..11..

sanskrit_iast:
avaṭode vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
tato bhavetsurāpī sa tataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
अवटोदे वसेत्सोऽपि यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ..
ततो भवेत्सुरापी स ततः शूद्रस्ततः शुचिः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jaigīṣavya uvāca ..
pitṛmātṛgurūṃścāpi bhaktihīno na pālayet ..
vācā'pi tāḍayettāṃśca sa kṛtaghra iti smṛtaḥ ..
vācā ca tāḍayennityaṃ svāminaṃ kulaṭā ca yā .. 13 ..
meaning:
जैगीषव्य उवाच ..
पितृमातृगुरूंश्चापि भक्तिहीनो न पालयेत् ..
वाचाऽपि ताडयेत्तांश्च स कृतघ्र इति स्मृतः ..
वाचा च ताडयेन्नित्यं स्वामिनं कुलटा च या .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sā kṛtaghnīti vikhyātā bhārate pāpinī varā ..
vahnikuṇḍaṃ mahāghoraṃ tau prayātassuniścitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
सा कृतघ्नीति विख्याता भारते पापिनी वरा ..
वह्निकुण्डं महाघोरं तौ प्रयातस्सुनिश्चितम् .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vahnau vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ..
tato bhavejjalaukāśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
तत्र वह्नौ वसत्येव यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ..
ततो भवेज्जलौकाश्च सप्तजन्मस्वतः शुचिः .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vālmīkiruvāca ..
yathā taruṣu vṛkṣatvaṃ sarvatra na jahāti ca ..
tathā kṛtaghnatā rājansarvapāpeṣu varttate .. 16 ..
meaning:
वाल्मीकिरुवाच ..
यथा तरुषु वृक्षत्वं सर्वत्र न जहाति च ..
तथा कृतघ्नता राजन्सर्वपापेषु वर्त्तते .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāsākṣyaṃ yo dadāti kāmātkrodhāttathā bhayāt ..
sabhāyāṃ pākṣikaṃ vakti sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यासाक्ष्यं यो ददाति कामात्क्रोधात्तथा भयात् ..
सभायां पाक्षिकं वक्ति स कृतघ्न इति स्मृतः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyamātraṃ cāpi rājanyo hanti sa kṛtaghnakaḥ ..
sarvatrāpi ca sarveṣāṃ puṇyahānau kṛtaghnatā .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुण्यमात्रं चापि राजन्यो हन्ति स कृतघ्नकः ..
सर्वत्रापि च सर्वेषां पुण्यहानौ कृतघ्नता .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāsākṣyaṃ pākṣikaṃ vā bhārate vakti yo nṛpa ..
yāvadindrasahasraṃ ca sarpakuṇḍe vaseddhruvam .. 19 ..
meaning:
मिथ्यासाक्ष्यं पाक्षिकं वा भारते वक्ति यो नृप ..
यावदिन्द्रसहस्रं च सर्पकुण्डे वसेद्ध्रुवम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
The man who gives false testimony or speaks with partiality in Bhārata, O king,
certainly dwells in the snake-pit hell for the span of a thousand Indras. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
santataṃ veṣṭitaḥ sarpairbhīto vai bhakṣitastathā ..
bhuṅkte ca sarvaviṇmūtraṃ yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ .. 2.52.20 ..
meaning:
सन्ततं वेष्टितः सर्पैर्भीतो वै भक्षितस्तथा ..
भुङ्क्ते च सर्वविण्मूत्रं यमदूतेन ताडितः .. 2.52.20 ..
text_mt:
Constantly entangled by snakes, terrified, and devoured,
he consumes all feces and urine, beaten by the messenger of Yama. // 2.52.20

sanskrit_iast:
kṛkalāso bhavettatra bhārate saptajanmasu ..
saptajanmasu maṇḍūkaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saptabhiḥ saha .. 21 ..
meaning:
कृकलासो भवेत्तत्र भारते सप्तजन्मसु ..
सप्तजन्मसु मण्डूकः पितृभिः सप्तभिः सह .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Then, in Bhārata, he becomes a chameleon for seven births,
and for seven births a frog, together with seven ancestors. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavedvai vṛkṣaśca mahāraṇye tu śālmaliḥ ..
tato bhavennaro mūkastataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेद्वै वृक्षश्च महारण्ये तु शाल्मलिः ..
ततो भवेन्नरो मूकस्ततः शूद्रस्ततः शुचिः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Then he becomes a silk-cotton tree in a great forest.
Then he becomes a mute man, then a śūdra, and after that, he becomes pure. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
āstīka uvāca ..
gurvaṅganānāṃ gamane mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ ..
narāṇāṃ mātṛgamane prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate .. 23 ..
meaning:
आस्तीक उवाच ..
गुर्वङ्गनानां गमने मातृगामी भवेन्नरः ..
नराणां मातृगमने प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते .. 23 ..
text_mt:
By approaching the wives of elders, a man becomes an incestuous violator of his mother.
For men who violate their mothers, no expiation exists. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
bhārate ca nṛpaśreṣṭa yo doṣo mātṛgāminām ..
brāhmaṇīgamane caiva śūdrāṇāṃ tāvadeva hi .. 24 ..
meaning:
भारते च नृपश्रेष्ट यो दोषो मातृगामिनाम् ..
ब्राह्मणीगमने चैव शूद्राणां तावदेव हि .. 24 ..
text_mt:
And whatever guilt falls in Bhārata upon those who violate their mothers, O best of kings,
the very same applies to śūdras who approach a brāhmaṇa woman. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyāstāvadeva syāddoṣaḥ śūdreṇa maithune ..
kanyānāṃ putrapatnīnāṃ śvaśrūṇāṃ gamane tathā .. 25 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्यास्तावदेव स्याद्दोषः शूद्रेण मैथुने ..
कन्यानां पुत्रपत्नीनां श्वश्रूणां गमने तथा .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Equal guilt belongs to a brāhmaṇa woman upon union with a śūdra.
Likewise, in approaching maidens, the wives of sons, mothers-in-law, // 25

sanskrit_iast:
sagarbhabhrātṛpatnīnā bhaginīnāṃ tathaiva ca ..
doṣaṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra yadāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सगर्भभ्रातृपत्नीना भगिनीनां तथैव च ..
दोषं वक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र यदाह कमलोद्भवः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
wives of uterine brothers, and sisters as well—
I will state the guilt, O king of kings, as spoken by the lotus-born [Brahmā]: // 26

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti mahāpāpī caitābhiḥ saha maithunam ..
jīvanmṛto bhavetso'pi caṇḍālo'spṛśya eva ca .. 27 ..
meaning:
यः करोति महापापी चैताभिः सह मैथुनम् ..
जीवन्मृतो भवेत्सोऽपि चण्डालोऽस्पृश्य एव च .. 27 ..
text_mt:
The great sinner who engages in sexual union with these women
becomes as one dead while alive, an untouchable caṇḍāla. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
nādhikāro bhavettasya sūryyamaṇḍaladarśane ..
śālagrāmaṃ tajjalaṃ ca tulasyāśca dalaṃ jalam .. 28 ..
meaning:
नाधिकारो भवेत्तस्य सूर्य्यमण्डलदर्शने ..
शालग्रामं तज्जलं च तुलस्याश्च दलं जलम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
He has no right even to look upon the disc of the sun.
The Śāligrāma and its water, the Tulasī leaf and water,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatīrthajalaṃ caiva viprapādodakaṃ tathā ..
spraṣṭuṃ ca naiva śaknoti viṭtulyaḥ pātakī naraḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
सर्वतीर्थजलं चैव विप्रपादोदकं तथा ..
स्प्रष्टुं च नैव शक्नोति विट्तुल्यः पातकी नरः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
the water of all holy places, and likewise water washed from a brāhmaṇa's feet—
a sinful man, equal to excrement, is not at all able to touch [them].

sanskrit_iast:
daivaṃ guruṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca namaskartuṃ na cārhati ..
viṣṭhādhikaṃ tadannaṃ ca jalaṃ mūtrādhikaṃ tathā .. 2.52.30 ..
meaning:
दैवं गुरुं ब्राह्मणं च नमस्कर्तुं न चार्हति ..
विष्ठाधिकं तदन्नं च जलं मूत्राधिकं तथा .. 2.52.30 ..
text_mt:
He does not deserve to pay homage to a deity, a guru, or a brāhmaṇa;
his food is worse than feces, and his water worse than urine.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāḥ pitaro viprā naiva gṛhṇanti bhārate ..
bhavettadaṅgavātena tīrthamaṅgāravāhanam .. 31 ..
meaning:
देवताः पितरो विप्रा नैव गृह्णन्ति भारते ..
भवेत्तदङ्गवातेन तीर्थमङ्गारवाहनम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
In Bhārata, the gods, ancestors, and brāhmaṇas never accept [anything from him].
By the wind from his body, a holy place would become a bearer of embers.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarātraṃ hyupavaseddaivasparśāttathā dvijaḥ ..
bhārakrāntā ca pṛthivī tadbhāraṃ voḍhumakṣamā .. 32 ..
meaning:
सप्तरात्रं ह्युपवसेद्दैवस्पर्शात्तथा द्विजः ..
भारक्रान्ता च पृथिवी तद्भारं वोढुमक्षमा .. 32 ..
text_mt:
If a twice-born touches [him] by chance, he must indeed fast for seven nights.
The earth is burdened and unable to bear his weight;

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāpātpatito deśaḥ kanyāvikrayiṇo yathā ..
tatsparśācca tadālāpācchayanāśrayabhojanāt .. 33 ..
meaning:
तत्पापात्पतितो देशः कन्याविक्रयिणो यथा ..
तत्स्पर्शाच्च तदालापाच्छयनाश्रयभोजनात् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
from his sin the land becomes fallen, just as [from that of] a seller of a daughter.
From touching him, talking with him, lying down, sheltering, or eating with him,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāṃ ca tatsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ..
kumbhīpāke vasetso'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam .. 34 ..
meaning:
नृणां च तत्समं पापं भवत्येव न संशयः ..
कुम्भीपाके वसेत्सोऽपि यावद्वै ब्रह्मणः शतम् .. 34 ..
text_mt:
men incur a sin equal to his; of this there is no doubt.
He lives in Kumbhīpāka for as long as a hundred lifetimes of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
divāniśaṃ bhramettatra cakrāvarttaṃ nirantaram ..
dagdho vā'gniśikhābhiśca yamadūtaiśca tāḍitaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
दिवानिशं भ्रमेत्तत्र चक्रावर्त्तं निरन्तरम् ..
दग्धो वाऽग्निशिखाभिश्च यमदूतैश्च ताडितः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Day and night he spins there ceaselessly in a whirlpool,
burned by flames of fire and beaten by the messengers of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nityaṃ mahāpāpī bhuṅkte nirayayātanām ..
viṣṭhāhāraśca sarvatra kumbhīpāke'tha pātitaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
एवं नित्यं महापापी भुङ्क्ते निरययातनाम् ..
विष्ठाहारश्च सर्वत्र कुम्भीपाकेऽथ पातितः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Thus the great sinner continually suffers the torments of hell,
cast down into Kumbhīpāka, feeding on feces everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
gate prākṛtike ghore mahati pralaye tathā ..
punaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ samārambhe tadvidho vā bhavetpunaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
गते प्राकृतिके घोरे महति प्रलये तथा ..
पुनः सृष्टेः समारम्भे तद्विधो वा भवेत्पुनः .. 37 ..
text_mt:
When the terrible, great cosmic dissolution of Prakṛti has passed,
at the beginning of a new creation, he is reborn in such a condition:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ..
tato bhavati caṇḍālo bhāryyāhīno napuṃsakaḥ ..38..
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां च कृमिर्भवेत् ..
ततो भवति चण्डालो भार्य्याहीनो नपुंसकः ..38..
text_mt: then he becomes a caṇḍāla, wifeless and a eunuch;

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmasu śuddhaśca galatkuṣṭhī napuṃsakaḥ ..
tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaścāpyandhaḥ kuṣṭhī napuṃsakaḥ..39..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मसु शुद्धश्च गलत्कुष्ठी नपुंसकः ..
ततो भवेद्ब्राह्मणश्चाप्यन्धः कुष्ठी नपुंसकः..39..
text_mt:
purified after seven births [as such], he becomes a eunuch suffering from rotting leprosy;
then he becomes a brāhmaṇa, yet blind, leprous, and a eunuch.

sanskrit_iast: labdhvaivaṃ sapta janmāni mahāpāpī bhavecchuciḥ .. 2.52.40 ..
meaning: लब्ध्वैवं सप्त जन्मानि महापापी भवेच्छुचिः .. 2.52.40 ..
text_mt: Only after obtaining seven such births does the great sinner become pure."

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamasmābhirvo yathāgamam ..
ebhistulyo bhaveddoṣo'pyatithīnāṃ parābhave..41..
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः..
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वमस्माभिर्वो यथागमम् ..
एभिस्तुल्यो भवेद्दोषोऽप्यतिथीनां पराभवे..41..
text_mt:
"Thus everything has been told to you by us in accordance with the scriptures; / an equal fault arises also from the mistreatment of guests.
Equal to these would be the sin in dishonouring guests. (41)

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmaṃ kuru viprendraṃ gṛhaṃ prāpaya niścitam ..
saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ yatnādgṛhītvā brāhmaṇāśiṣam ..42..
meaning:
प्रणामं कुरु विप्रेन्द्रं गृहं प्रापय निश्चितम् ..
संपूज्य ब्राह्मणं यत्नाद्गृहीत्वा ब्राह्मणाशिषम् ..42..
text_mt:
Bow down to the eminent brāhmaṇa, lead him to your home without fail,
worship the brāhmaṇa diligently, receive the brāhmaṇa's blessing,

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ gaccha mahārāja tapasyāṃ kuru satvaram..
brahmaśāpairvinirmuktaḥ punarevāgamiṣyasi..43..
meaning:
वनं गच्छ महाराज तपस्यां कुरु सत्वरम्..
ब्रह्मशापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः पुनरेवागमिष्यसि..43..
text_mt:
go to the forest, O great king, and quickly perform austerities;
freed from the brāhmaṇa's curse, you will return once again."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve yayustūrṇaṃ svamandiram..
surāścāpi ca rājāno bandhuvargāśca pārvati .. 44 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा मुनयः सर्वे ययुस्तूर्णं स्वमन्दिरम्..
सुराश्चापि च राजानो बन्धुवर्गाश्च पार्वति .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, all the sages quickly went to their own dwellings,
and the gods, the kings, and the circle of kinsmen [departed as well], O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpārvatyuvāca ..
gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu śrutvā karmaphalaṃ nṛṇām ..
kiṃ cakāra nṛpaśreṣṭho brahmaśāpena vihvalaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीपार्वत्युवाच ..
गतेषु मुनिसंघेषु श्रुत्वा कर्मफलं नृणाम् ..
किं चकार नृपश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मशापेन विह्वलः .. 1 ..
title: Pratyatithyupadeśaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
atithirbrāhmaṇo vā'pi kiṃ cakāra tadā prabho ..
jagāma nṛpagehaṃ vā na vā tadvaktumarhasi .. 2 ..
meaning:
अतिथिर्ब्राह्मणो वाऽपि किं चकार तदा प्रभो ..
जगाम नृपगेहं वा न वा तद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca ..
gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu nindāgrasto narādhipaḥ ..
preritaśca vasiṣṭhena dharmiṣṭhena purodhasā .... 3 ..
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच ..
गतेषु मुनिसंघेषु निन्दाग्रस्तो नराधिपः ..
प्रेरितश्च वसिष्ठेन धर्मिष्ठेन पुरोधसा .... 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau pādayorbrāhmaṇasya ca ..
tyaktvā manyuṃ dvijaśreṣṭho dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam .. 4 ..
meaning:
पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ पादयोर्ब्राह्मणस्य च ..
त्यक्त्वा मन्युं द्विजश्रेष्ठो ददौ तस्मै शुभाशिषम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sasmitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktamanyuṃ kṛpāmayam ..
uvāca nṛpatiśreṣṭhaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
सस्मितं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा त्यक्तमन्युं कृपामयम् ..
उवाच नृपतिश्रेष्ठः साश्रुनेत्रः कृताञ्जलिः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca ..
kutra vaṃśe bhavāñjātaḥ kiṃ nāma bhavataḥ prabho ..
kiṃnāmā vā'pi tadbrūhi kva vāsaḥ kathamāgataḥ ..6..
meaning:
राजोवाच ..
कुत्र वंशे भवाञ्जातः किं नाम भवतः प्रभो ..
किंनामा वाऽपि तद्ब्रूहि क्व वासः कथमागतः ..6..

sanskrit_iast:
viprarūpī svayaṃ viṣṇurgūḍhaḥ kapaṭamānuṣaḥ ..
sākṣātsa mūrtimānagniḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā .. 7 ..
meaning:
विप्ररूपी स्वयं विष्णुर्गूढः कपटमानुषः ..
साक्षात्स मूर्तिमानग्निः प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ko vā guruste bhagavanniṣṭadevaśca bhārate ..
tava veṣaḥ kathamayaṃ jñānapūrṇasya sāmpratam ..8..
meaning:
को वा गुरुस्ते भगवन्निष्टदेवश्च भारते ..
तव वेषः कथमयं ज्ञानपूर्णस्य साम्प्रतम् ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ nikhilamaiśvaryyaṃ kośameva ca ..
svabhṛtyaṃ kuru me putraṃ māṃ ca dāsīṃ striyaṃ mune .. 9 ..
meaning:
गृहाण राज्यं निखिलमैश्वर्य्यं कोशमेव च ..
स्वभृत्यं कुरु मे पुत्रं मां च दासीं स्त्रियं मुने .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saptasāgarasaṃyuktāṃ saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām ..
aṣṭādaśopadvīpāḍhyāṃ saśailavanaśobhitām .. 2.53.10 ..
meaning:
सप्तसागरसंयुक्तां सप्तद्वीपां वसुन्धराम् ..
अष्टादशोपद्वीपाढ्यां सशैलवनशोभिताम् .. 2.53.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mayā bhṛtyena śādhi tvaṃ rājendro bhava bhārate ..
ratnendrasārakhacite tiṣṭha siṃhāsane vare .... 11 ..
meaning:
मया भृत्येन शाधि त्वं राजेन्द्रो भव भारते ..
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचिते तिष्ठ सिंहासने वरे .... 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṅgavaḥ ..
uvāca paramaṃ tattvamajñātaṃ sarvadurlabham .. 12 ..
meaning:
नृपस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा जहास मुनिपुङ्गवः ..
उवाच परमं तत्त्वमज्ञातं सर्वदुर्लभम् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atithiruvāca ..
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putrastatputraḥ kaśyapaḥ svayam ..
kaśyapasya sutāḥ sarve prāptā devatvamīpsitam..13..
meaning:
अतिथिरुवाच ..
मरीचिर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तत्पुत्रः कश्यपः स्वयम् ..
कश्यपस्य सुताः सर्वे प्राप्ता देवत्वमीप्सितम्..13..

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu tvaṣṭā mahājñānī cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ..14..
meaning:
तेषु त्वष्टा महाज्ञानी चकार परमं तपः ..
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं च पुष्करे दुष्करं तपः..14..

sanskrit_iast:
siṣeve brāhmaṇārthaṃ ca devadevaṃ hariṃ param..
nārāyaṇādvaraṃ prāpa vipraṃ tejasvinaṃ sutam .. 15..
meaning:
सिषेवे ब्राह्मणार्थं च देवदेवं हरिं परम्..
नारायणाद्वरं प्राप विप्रं तेजस्विनं सुतम् .. 15..

sanskrit_iast:
tato babhūva tejasvī viśvarūpastapodhanaḥ..
purodhasaṃ cakārendro vākpatau taṃ krudhā gate..16..
meaning:
ततो बभूव तेजस्वी विश्वरूपस्तपोधनः..
पुरोधसं चकारेन्द्रो वाक्पतौ तं क्रुधा गते..16..

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahebhyo daityebhyo dattavantaṃ ghṛtāhutim ..
ciccheda taṃ śunāsīro brāhmaṇaṃ māturājñayā..17..
meaning:
मातामहेभ्यो दैत्येभ्यो दत्तवन्तं घृताहुतिम् ..
चिच्छेद तं शुनासीरो ब्राह्मणं मातुराज्ञया..17..

sanskrit_iast:
viśvarūpasya tanayo virūpo matpitā nṛpa ..
ahaṃ ca sutapā nāma virāgī kaśyapo dvijaḥ .. . 18..
meaning:
विश्वरूपस्य तनयो विरूपो मत्पिता नृप ..
अहं च सुतपा नाम विरागी कश्यपो द्विजः .. . 18..

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevo mama gururvidyājñānamanupradaḥ ..
abhīṣṭadevaḥ sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
महादेवो मम गुरुर्विद्याज्ञानमनुप्रदः ..
अभीष्टदेवः सर्वात्मा श्रीकृष्णः प्रकृतेः परः .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taccintayāmi pādābjaṃ na me vāñchā 'sti sampadi ..
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaṃ rādhikāpateḥ ..2.53.20..
meaning:
तच्चिन्तयामि पादाब्जं न मे वाञ्छा ऽस्ति सम्पदि ..
सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसारूप्यसामीप्यं राधिकापतेः ..2.53.20..

sanskrit_iast:
tena dattaṃ na gṛhṇāmi vinā tatsevanaṃ śubham ..
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā manye'haṃ jalabimbavat .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेन दत्तं न गृह्णामि विना तत्सेवनं शुभम् ..
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा मन्येऽहं जलबिम्बवत् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktivyavahitaṃ mithyābhramameva tu naśvaram ..
indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā sauratvaṃ vā narādhipa..22..
meaning:
भक्तिव्यवहितं मिथ्याभ्रममेव तु नश्वरम् ..
इन्द्रत्वं वा मनुत्वं वा सौरत्वं वा नराधिप..22..
text_mt: Whether the status of Indra, Manu, or the Sun, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
na manye jalarekheti nṛpatvaṃ kena gaṇyate ..
śrutvā suyajñayajñe te munīnāṃ gamanaṃ nṛpa .. 23 ..
meaning:
न मन्ये जलरेखेति नृपत्वं केन गण्यते ..
श्रुत्वा सुयज्ञयज्ञे ते मुनीनां गमनं नृप .. 23 ..
text_mt:
I do not deem it even a line drawn on water; who counts kingship?
Hearing of the sages' journey to your sacrifice, the Suyajña sacrifice, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
lālasāṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ te saṃprāpayitumāgataḥ ..
kevalānugṛhītastvaṃ nahi śapto mayā'dhunā..24..
meaning:
लालसां विष्णुभक्तिं ते संप्रापयितुमागतः ..
केवलानुगृहीतस्त्वं नहि शप्तो मयाऽधुना..24..
text_mt:
I have come to grant you an ardent longing for devotion to Viṣṇu.
You have received only grace; you have not been cursed by me now.

sanskrit_iast:
samuddhṛtaśca patito ghore nimne bhavārṇave ..
nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
समुद्धृतश्च पतितो घोरे निम्ने भवार्णवे ..
नह्यम्मयानि तीर्थानि न देवा मृच्छिलामयाः .. 29 ..
text_mt: You who had fallen into the terrible, deep ocean of mundane existence have been lifted up.

sanskrit_iast:
te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāśca darśanāt ..
rājannirgamyatāṃ gehāddehi rājyaṃ sutāya ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
ते पुनन्त्युरुकालेन कृष्णभक्ताश्च दर्शनात् ..
राजन्निर्गम्यतां गेहाद्देहि राज्यं सुताय च .. 26 ..
text_mt: O king, depart from your house and hand over the kingdom to your son.

sanskrit_iast:
putre nyasya priyāṃ sādhvīṃ gaccha vatsa vanaṃ drutam ..
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva bhūmipa .. 27 ..
meaning:
पुत्रे न्यस्य प्रियां साध्वीं गच्छ वत्स वनं द्रुतम् ..
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं मिथ्यैव भूमिप .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Entrusting your virtuous, beloved [wife] to your son, go quickly to the forest, my child.
From Brahmā down to a blade of grass, everything is indeed false, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja rādheśaṃ paramātmā namīśvaram ..
dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णं भज राधेशं परमात्मा नमीश्वरम् ..
ध्यानसाध्यं दुराराध्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिभिः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Rādhā, the Paramātman, the Lord,
attainable through meditation, difficult to worship even by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbhūtaistirobhūtaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ prakṛteḥ param ..
brahmā sraṣṭā hariḥ pātā haraḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
आविर्भूतैस्तिरोभूतैः प्राकृतैः प्रकृतेः परम् ..
ब्रह्मा स्रष्टा हरिः पाता हरः संहारकारकः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
who appear and disappear, being elemental, while he is beyond Prakṛti.
Brahmā is the creator, Hari is the protector, and Hara is the agent of destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālāśca digīśāśca bhramantyevāsya māyayā ..
yadājñayā vāti vāyuḥ sūryyo dinapatiḥ sadā.. .. 2.53.30 ..
meaning:
दिक्पालाश्च दिगीशाश्च भ्रमन्त्येवास्य मायया ..
यदाज्ञया वाति वायुः सूर्य्यो दिनपतिः सदा.. .. 2.53.30 ..
text_mt:
The guardians of the directions and the lords of the quarters wander solely through his Māyā.
By his command the wind blows, and the sun is always lord of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāpatiḥ śaśī śaśvatsasyasusnigdhatākaraḥ ..
kālena mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvaviśveṣu vai bhavet .. 31 ..
meaning:
निशापतिः शशी शश्वत्सस्यसुस्निग्धताकरः ..
कालेन मृत्युः सर्वेषां सर्वविश्वेषु वै भवेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
The moon is lord of the night, constantly making crops flourish and thrive.
By Time, death surely comes to everyone in all the universes.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle varṣati śakraśca dahatyagniśca kālataḥ..
bhītavadviśvaśāstā ca prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ..32..
meaning:
काले वर्षति शक्रश्च दहत्यग्निश्च कालतः..
भीतवद्विश्वशास्ता च प्रजासंयमनो यमः..32..
text_mt:
In time Indra pours rain, and through Time fire burns.
Like one afraid, Yama, the punisher of creatures, governs the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ saṃharate kāle kāle sṛjati pāti ca..
svadeśe vai samudraśca svadeśe vai vasundharā..33..
meaning:
कालः संहरते काले काले सृजति पाति च..
स्वदेशे वै समुद्रश्च स्वदेशे वै वसुन्धरा..33..
text_mt:
Time destroys in time, in time it creates and preserves.
In its own place lies the ocean, and in its own place lies the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
svadeśe parvatāścaiva svāḥ pātālāḥ svadeśataḥ..
svarlokāḥ sapta rājendra saptadvīpā vasundharā..34..
meaning:
स्वदेशे पर्वताश्चैव स्वाः पातालाः स्वदेशतः..
स्वर्लोकाः सप्त राजेन्द्र सप्तद्वीपा वसुन्धरा..34..
text_mt:
In their own places are the mountains, and their own are the netherworlds according to their place.
Seven are the heavenly worlds, O best of kings, and seven are the continents of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śailasāgarasaṃyuktāḥ pātālāḥ sapta caiva hi ..
brahmāṇḍamebhirlokaiśca ḍimbākāraṃ jalaplutam ..35..
meaning:
शैलसागरसंयुक्ताः पातालाः सप्त चैव हि ..
ब्रह्माण्डमेभिर्लोकैश्च डिम्बाकारं जलप्लुतम् ..35..
text_mt:
And seven indeed are the netherworlds, joined with mountains and oceans.
With these worlds the cosmic egg, shaped like an egg, is immersed in water.

sanskrit_iast:
santyeva pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
surā narāśca nāgāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ..36..
meaning:
सन्त्येव प्रतिविध्यण्डे ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
सुरा नराश्च नागाश्च गन्धर्वा राक्षसादयः ..36..
text_mt:
In every cosmic egg there exist Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others,
gods, humans, serpents, gandharvas, rākṣasas, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
āpātālādbrahmalokaparyyantaṃ ḍimbarūpakam ..
idameva tu vidhyaṇḍamuttamaṃ kṛtrimaṃ nṛpa .. 37 ..
meaning:
आपातालाद्ब्रह्मलोकपर्य्यन्तं डिम्बरूपकम् ..
इदमेव तु विध्यण्डमुत्तमं कृत्रिमं नृप .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Extending from the netherworld up to Brahmaloka, shaped like an egg,
this is indeed the egg of Brahmā, supreme and created, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhipadme virāḍviṣṇoḥ kṣudrasya jalaśāyinaḥ ..
sthitaṃ yathā padmabījaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca paṅkaje ..38..
meaning:
नाभिपद्मे विराड्विष्णोः क्षुद्रस्य जलशायिनः ..
स्थितं यथा पद्मबीजं कर्णिकायां च पङ्कजे ..38..
text_mt:
In the navel-lotus of the lesser Virāj Viṣṇu, who reclines on the water,
[it rests] just as a lotus seed is situated in the pericarp of a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ so'pi śayānassyājjalatalpe suviplute ..
dhyāyatyeva mahāyogī prākṛtaḥ prakṛteḥ param .. 39 ..
meaning:
एवं सोऽपि शयानस्स्याज्जलतल्पे सुविप्लुते ..
ध्यायत्येव महायोगी प्राकृतः प्रकृतेः परम् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Thus he too, reclining on a couch upon the flooded waters,
a great yogin, though material, meditates upon the One beyond Prakṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
kālabhītaśca kāleśaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram .. .
mahāviṣṇorlomakūpasādhāraḥ so'sti vistṛte ..
kūpeṣu lomnāṃ pratyekamevaṃ viśvāni santi vai .. 2.53.40 ..
meaning:
कालभीतश्च कालेशं कृष्णमात्मानमीश्वरम् .. .
महाविष्णोर्लोमकूपसाधारः सोऽस्ति विस्तृते ..
कूपेषु लोम्नां प्रत्येकमेवं विश्वानि सन्ति वै .. 2.53.40 ..
text_mt:
and, fearful of Time, upon the Lord of Time, Kṛṣṇa, the Self, the Lord.
He has his support in a pore of the skin of the vast Mahāviṣṇu.
In every single pore of the skin, such universes surely exist.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣṇorgātralomnāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca bhūmipa ..
saṃkhyāṃ karttuṃ na śaknoti kṛṣṇo'pyanyasya kā kathā ..41..
meaning:
महाविष्णोर्गात्रलोम्नां ब्रह्माण्डानां च भूमिप ..
संख्यां कर्त्तुं न शक्नोति कृष्णोऽप्यन्यस्य का कथा ..41..
text_mt:
Of the hairs on the body of Mahāviṣṇu, and of the cosmic eggs, O king,
even Kṛṣṇa is unable to reckon the number; what to say of anyone else?

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣṇuḥ prākṛtikaḥ so'pi ḍimbodbhavaḥ sadā..
bhavetkṛṣṇecchayā ḍimbaḥ prakṛtergarbhasambhavaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
महाविष्णुः प्राकृतिकः सोऽपि डिम्बोद्भवः सदा..
भवेत्कृष्णेच्छया डिम्बः प्रकृतेर्गर्भसम्भवः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Mahāviṣṇu is material; he also is perpetually born from an egg.
By the will of Kṛṣṇa, the egg arises from the womb of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhāro mahānviṣṇuḥ kālabhītaḥ sa śaṅkitaḥ ..
kāleśaṃ dhyāyati svairaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram .. 43 ..
meaning:
सर्वाधारो महान्विष्णुः कालभीतः स शङ्कितः ..
कालेशं ध्यायति स्वैरं कृष्णमात्मानमीश्वरम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Great Viṣṇu, the support of all, is afraid of Time and filled with doubt;
he meditates freely upon the Lord of Time, Kṛṣṇa, the Ātman, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ca sarvaviśvasthā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
mahānvirāṭ kṣudravirāṭ sarve prākṛtikāḥ sadā ..44.. .
meaning:
एवं च सर्वविश्वस्था ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
महान्विराट् क्षुद्रविराट् सर्वे प्राकृतिकाः सदा ..44.. .
text_mt:
And likewise Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the rest, who dwell within all universes,
the great Virāj and the small Virāj, are all perpetually material. / She, the goddess Mūlaprakṛti, who possesses the nature of the seed of all,

sanskrit_iast:
sā sarvabījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ..
kāle līnā ca kāleśe kṛṣṇe taṃ dhyāyati sma sā ..45..
meaning:
सा सर्वबीजरूपा च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ..
काले लीना च कालेशे कृष्णे तं ध्यायति स्म सा ..45..
text_mt: dissolves into Time, into the Lord of Time, Kṛṣṇa, and meditated upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarve kālabhītāḥ prakṛtiḥ prākṛtāstathā ..
āvirbhūtāstirobhūtāḥ kālena paramātmani ..46..
meaning:
एवं सर्वे कालभीताः प्रकृतिः प्राकृतास्तथा ..
आविर्भूतास्तिरोभूताः कालेन परमात्मनि ..46..
text_mt:
Thus, all are afraid of Time—Prakṛti and the material [beings] as well;
they appear and disappear in the Paramātman through Time.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mahājñānaṃ sudurlabham ..
śivena guruṇā dattaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ..47..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं महाज्ञानं सुदुर्लभम् ..
शिवेन गुरुणा दत्तं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ..47..
text_mt:
In this way, all this great wisdom, extremely difficult to obtain,
has been imparted, given by Śiva the guru. What further do you wish to hear?”

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca ..
kutrādhāro mahāviṣṇoḥ sarvādhārasya tasya ca ..
kālabhītasya kati ca kālamāyā munīśvara .. 1 ..
meaning:
राजोवाच ..
कुत्राधारो महाविष्णोः सर्वाधारस्य तस्य च ..
कालभीतस्य कति च कालमाया मुनीश्वर .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 54

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrasya katicitkālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtestathā ..
manorindrasya candrasya sūryyasyāyustathaiva ca .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gopā gopyaśca gāvaśca savatsāśca narādhipa ..
sarve līnāḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca prakṛtiḥ parameśvare...
mahāviṣṇau vilīnāśca te sarve kṣudraviṣṇavaḥ ..
mahāviṣṇuḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca sā caivaṃ paramātmani..95..
meaning:
गोपा गोप्यश्च गावश्च सवत्साश्च नराधिप ..
सर्वे लीनाः प्रकृत्यां च प्रकृतिः परमेश्वरे...
महाविष्णौ विलीनाश्च ते सर्वे क्षुद्रविष्णवः ..
महाविष्णुः प्रकृत्यां च सा चैवं परमात्मनि..95..

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiryoganidrā ca śrīkṛṣṇanayanadvaye ..
adhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāraivaṃ māyayā ceśvarecchayā..96..
meaning:
प्रकृतिर्योगनिद्रा च श्रीकृष्णनयनद्वये ..
अधिष्ठानं चकारैवं मायया चेश्वरेच्छया..96..

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtervāsaro yāvanmitaḥ kālaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ..
tāvadvṛndāvane nidrā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ..97..
meaning:
प्रकृतेर्वासरो यावन्मितः कालः प्रकीर्त्तितः ..
तावद्वृन्दावने निद्रा कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः..97..

sanskrit_iast:
amūlya ratnatalpe ca vahniśuddhāṃśukārcite ..
gandhacandanamālyaughavāyvādisurabhīkṛte .. 98 ..
meaning:
अमूल्य रत्नतल्पे च वह्निशुद्धांशुकार्चिते ..
गन्धचन्दनमाल्यौघवाय्वादिसुरभीकृते .. 98 ..

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prajāgare tasya sarvasṛṣṭirbhavetpunaḥ ..
evaṃ sarve prākṛtāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vinā .. 99 ..
meaning:
पुनः प्रजागरे तस्य सर्वसृष्टिर्भवेत्पुनः ..
एवं सर्वे प्राकृताश्च श्रीकृष्णं निर्गुणं विना .. 99 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadvandanaṃ tatsmaraṇaṃ tasya dhyānaṃ tadarcanam ..
kīrttanaṃ tadguṇānāṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam .. 2.54.100 ..
meaning:
तद्वन्दनं तत्स्मरणं तस्य ध्यानं तदर्चनम् ..
कीर्त्तनं तद्गुणानां च महापातकनाशनम् .. 2.54.100 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yadyanmṛtyuñjayācchrutam ..
yathāgamaṃ mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 101 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं यद्यन्मृत्युञ्जयाच्छ्रुतम् ..
यथागमं महाराज किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 101 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suyajña uvāca..
kālāgnirudro viśvānāṃ saṃharttā ca tamoguṇaḥ ..
brahmaṇo'nte vilīnaśca sattvaṃ mṛtyuñjaye śive ..102..
meaning:
सुयज्ञ उवाच..
कालाग्निरुद्रो विश्वानां संहर्त्ता च तमोगुणः ..
ब्रह्मणोऽन्ते विलीनश्च सत्त्वं मृत्युञ्जये शिवे ..102..

sanskrit_iast:
śivo līno nirguṇe ca śrīkṛṣṇe prākṛte laye ..
kathaṃ tava gurornāma mṛtyuñjaya iti śrutam ..103..
meaning:
शिवो लीनो निर्गुणे च श्रीकृष्णे प्राकृते लये ..
कथं तव गुरोर्नाम मृत्युञ्जय इति श्रुतम् ..103..

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ prasūrmahāviṣṇormūlaprakṛtirīśvarī..
asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni santi vai yasya lomasu .. 104 ..
meaning:
कथं प्रसूर्महाविष्णोर्मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी..
असंख्यानि च विश्वानि सन्ति वै यस्य लोमसु .. 104 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sutapā uvāca ..
brahmaṇo'nte mṛtyukanyā praṇaṣṭā jalabimbavat ..
saṃhartrī sarvalokānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ narādhipa .. 105 ..
meaning:
सुतपा उवाच ..
ब्रह्मणोऽन्ते मृत्युकन्या प्रणष्टा जलबिम्बवत् ..
संहर्त्री सर्वलोकानां ब्रह्मादीनां नराधिप .. 105 ..

sanskrit_iast:
katidhā mṛtyukanyānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ koṭiśo laye ..
kālena līnaḥ śambhuśca sattvarūpe ca nirguṇe . 106 ..
meaning:
कतिधा मृत्युकन्यानां ब्रह्मणां कोटिशो लये ..
कालेन लीनः शम्भुश्च सत्त्वरूपे च निर्गुणे . 106 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyukanyā jitā śaśvacchivena guruṇā mama ..
na mṛtyunā jitaḥ śambhuḥ kalpe kalpe śrutau śrutam .. 107 ..
meaning:
मृत्युकन्या जिता शश्वच्छिवेन गुरुणा मम ..
न मृत्युना जितः शम्भुः कल्पे कल्पे श्रुतौ श्रुतम् .. 107 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śambhurnārāyaṇasyaiva prakṛteśca narādhipa ..
nityānāṃ līnatā nitye tanmāyā na tu vāstavī .. 108 ..
meaning:
शम्भुर्नारायणस्यैव प्रकृतेश्च नराधिप ..
नित्यानां लीनता नित्ये तन्माया न तु वास्तवी .. 108 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ pumānnirguṇaśca kālena saguṇaḥ svayam ..
svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śambhurmāyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam .. 109 ..
meaning:
स्वयं पुमान्निर्गुणश्च कालेन सगुणः स्वयम् ..
स्वयं नारायणः शम्भुर्मायया प्रकृतिः स्वयम् .. 109 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṃśastatsamaḥ śaśvadyathā vahneḥ sphuliṅgavat ..
ye ye ca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā rudrādityādayastathā .. 2.54.110 ..
meaning:
तदंशस्तत्समः शश्वद्यथा वह्नेः स्फुलिङ्गवत् ..
ये ये च ब्रह्मणा सृष्टा रुद्रादित्यादयस्तथा .. 2.54.110 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe kalpe jitāste te naśvarā mṛtyukanyayā ..
na śivo brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ satyo nityaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
कल्पे कल्पे जितास्ते ते नश्वरा मृत्युकन्यया ..
न शिवो ब्रह्मणा सृष्टः सत्यो नित्यः सनातनः .. 111 ..

sanskrit_iast:
katidhā brahmaṇāṃ pāto yannimeṣaṇa bhūmipa ..
athādisarge śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca jagadguruḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
कतिधा ब्रह्मणां पातो यन्निमेषण भूमिप ..
अथादिसर्गे श्रीकृष्णः प्रकृत्यां च जगद्गुरुः .. 112 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca puṇye vṛndāvane vane ..
tadvāmāṃśasamudbhūtā rāse rāseśvarī parā .. 113 ..
meaning:
चकार वीर्याधानं च पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने ..
तद्वामांशसमुद्भूता रासे रासेश्वरी परा .. 113 ..

sanskrit_iast:
garbhaṃ dadhāra sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ..
tataḥ suṣāva sā ḍimbhaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 114 ..
meaning:
गर्भं दधार सा राधा यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः..
ततः सुषाव सा डिम्भं गोलोके रासमण्डले .. 114 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cukopa ḍimbhaṃ sā dṛṣṭvā hṛdayena vidūyatā ..
taḍḍimbhaṃ prerayāmāsa tadadho viśva golake .. 115 ..
meaning:
चुकोप डिम्भं सा दृष्ट्वा हृदयेन विदूयता ..
तड्डिम्भं प्रेरयामास तदधो विश्व गोलके .. 115 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā'patya mahādevī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa mahāyogena yogavit .. 116 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वाऽपत्य महादेवी रुरोद च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
कृष्णस्तां बोधयामास महायोगेन योगवित् .. 116 ..

sanskrit_iast: babhūva tasmāḍimbhācca sarvādhāro mahāvirāṭ .. 117 ..
meaning: बभूव तस्माडिम्भाच्च सर्वाधारो महाविराट् .. 117 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suyajña uvāca ..
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama ..
śāpo me vararūpaścāpyabhavadbhaktikāraṇam .. 118 ..
meaning:
सुयज्ञ उवाच ..
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवनं सार्थकं मम ..
शापो मे वररूपश्चाप्यभवद्भक्तिकारणम् .. 118 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhā harerbhaktiḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā ..
na tasyāśca samaṃ vipra vedoktaṃ bhaktipañcakam ..119..
meaning:
सुदुर्लभा हरेर्भक्तिः सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गला ..
न तस्याश्च समं विप्र वेदोक्तं भक्तिपञ्चकम् ..119..

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhaktirmama bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ..
sudurlabhā ca sarveṣāṃ tatkuruṣva mahāmune .. 2.54.120 ..
meaning:
यथा भक्तिर्मम भवेच्छ्रीकृष्णे परमात्मनि ..
सुदुर्लभा च सर्वेषां तत्कुरुष्व महामुने .. 2.54.120 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ..
te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāśca darśanāt .. 121 ..
meaning:
नह्यम्मयानि तीर्थानि न देवा मृच्छिलामयाः ..
ते पुनन्त्युरुकालेन कृष्णभक्ताश्च दर्शनात् .. 121 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dvijāterjātiruttamā ..
svadharmaniratāścaiva teṣu śreṣṭhaśca bhārate .. 122 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामाश्रमाणां च द्विजातेर्जातिरुत्तमा ..
स्वधर्मनिरताश्चैव तेषु श्रेष्ठश्च भारते .. 122 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
nityaṃ naivedyebhojī ca tataḥ śreṣṭho mahāñchuciḥ ..123..
meaning:
कृष्णमन्त्रोपासकश्च कृष्णभक्तिपरायणः ..
नित्यं नैवेद्येभोजी च ततः श्रेष्ठो महाञ्छुचिः ..123..

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ mahājñānārṇavaṃ param ..
saṃprāpya śivaśiṣyaṃ ca kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ mune .. 124 ..
meaning:
त्वां वैष्णवं द्विजश्रेष्ठं महाज्ञानार्णवं परम् ..
संप्राप्य शिवशिष्यं च कं यामि शरणं मुने .. 124 ..

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā'haṃ galatkuṣṭhī tava śāpānmahāmune ..
kathaṃ tapasyāmaśucirnādhikārī karomi ca .. 125 ..
meaning:
अधुनाऽहं गलत्कुष्ठी तव शापान्महामुने ..
कथं तपस्यामशुचिर्नाधिकारी करोमि च .. 125 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sutapā uvāca ..
haribhaktipradātrī sā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ..
sā ca yānanugṛhṇāti tebhyo bhaktiṃ dadāti ca .. 126 ..
meaning:
सुतपा उवाच ..
हरिभक्तिप्रदात्री सा विष्णुमाया सनातनी ..
सा च याननुगृह्णाति तेभ्यो भक्तिं ददाति च .. 126 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃśca māyā mohayati tebhyastāṃ na dadāti ca ..
karoti vañcanāṃ teṣāṃ naśvareṇa dhanena ca .. 127 ..
meaning:
यांश्च माया मोहयति तेभ्यस्तां न ददाति च ..
करोति वञ्चनां तेषां नश्वरेण धनेन च .. 127 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapremamayīṃ śaktiṃ prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ..
bhaja rādhāṃ nirguṇāṃ tāṃ pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām .. 128 ..
meaning:
कृष्णप्रेममयीं शक्तिं प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेवताम् ..
भज राधां निर्गुणां तां प्रदात्रीं सर्वसम्पदाम् .. 128 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ yāsyāsi golokaṃ tadanugrahasevayā ..
sā sevitā śrīkṛṣṇena sarvārādhyena pūjitā .. 129 ..
meaning:
शीघ्रं यास्यासि गोलोकं तदनुग्रहसेवया ..
सा सेविता श्रीकृष्णेन सर्वाराध्येन पूजिता .. 129 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ bhaktāḥ saṃsevya nirguṇam ..
sucireṇa ca golokaṃ prayānti bahujanmataḥ .. 2.54.130 ..
meaning:
ध्यानसाध्यं दुराराध्यं भक्ताः संसेव्य निर्गुणम् ..
सुचिरेण च गोलोकं प्रयान्ति बहुजन्मतः .. 2.54.130 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāmayīṃ ca saṃsevya bhaktā yāntyacireṇa vai ..
sā prasūśca mahāviṣṇoḥ sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī .. 131 ..
meaning:
कृपामयीं च संसेव्य भक्ता यान्त्यचिरेण वै ..
सा प्रसूश्च महाविष्णोः सर्वसम्पत्स्वरूपिणी .. 131 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sahasravarṣaparyyantaṃ viprapādodakaṃ piba ..
kāmadevasvarūpaśca rogahīno bhaviṣyasi ..132..
meaning:
सहस्रवर्षपर्य्यन्तं विप्रपादोदकं पिब ..
कामदेवस्वरूपश्च रोगहीनो भविष्यसि ..132..

sanskrit_iast:
viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ..
tāvatpuṣkarapatreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam .. 133 ..
meaning:
विप्रपादोदकक्लिन्ना यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी ..
तावत्पुष्करपत्रेषु पिबन्ति पितरो जलम् .. 133 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare ..
sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca .. 134 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि तानि तीर्थानि सागरे ..
सागरे यानि तीर्थानि विप्रपादेषु तानि च .. 134 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viprapādodakaṃ caiva pāpavyādhivināśanam ..
sarvatīrthodakasamaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham .. 135 ..
meaning:
विप्रपादोदकं चैव पापव्याधिविनाशनम् ..
सर्वतीर्थोदकसमं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शुभम् .. 135 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vipro mānavarūpī ca devadevo janārdanaḥ ..
vipreṇa dattaṃ dravyaṃ ca bhuñjate sarvadevatāḥ .. 136 ..
meaning:
विप्रो मानवरूपी च देवदेवो जनार्दनः ..
विप्रेण दत्तं द्रव्यं च भुञ्जते सर्वदेवताः .. 136 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā vipraśca gṛhītvā tasya pūjanam ..
jagāma gṛhamityuktvā tvāyāsye vatsarāntare .. 137 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा विप्रश्च गृहीत्वा तस्य पूजनम् ..
जगाम गृहमित्युक्त्वा त्वायास्ये वत्सरान्तरे .. 137 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā ca bubhuje rājā viprapādodakaṃ śive ..
viprāṃśca pūjayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa vatsaram .. 138 ..
meaning:
भक्त्या च बुभुजे राजा विप्रपादोदकं शिवे ..
विप्रांश्च पूजयामास भोजयामास वत्सरम् .. 138 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu nirmukto vyādhito nṛpaḥ ..
ājagāma muniśreṣṭhaḥ sutapāḥ kaśyapāgraṇīḥ .. 139 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु निर्मुक्तो व्याधितो नृपः ..
आजगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठः सुतपाः कश्यपाग्रणीः .. 139 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum ..
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ dadau tasmai nṛpāya saḥ .. 2.54.140 ..
meaning:
राधापूजाविधानं च स्तोत्रं च कवचं मनुम् ..
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं ददौ तस्मै नृपाय सः .. 2.54.140 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājannirgamyatāṃ śīghramityuktvā tapase muniḥ ..
jagāma svālayāddurgaṃ nirjagāma tvarannṛpaḥ .. 141 ..
meaning:
राजन्निर्गम्यतां शीघ्रमित्युक्त्वा तपसे मुनिः ..
जगाम स्वालयाद्दुर्गं निर्जगाम त्वरन्नृपः .. 141 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rurudurbāndhavāḥ sarve trirātraṃ śokamūrcchitāḥ ..

text_mt:
Śrī Pārvatī said:
While the mantra of Śrī Kṛṣṇa existed, and also those of your other lords,
why did the Vaiṣṇava king receive the mantra of Rādhā? (1)
What is the ritual, what is the meditation, what is the hymn of praise, and what is the armour?
What mantra did he give to the king? Speak to me of that method of worship. (2)
Śrī Maheśvara said:
When the king asked, "O brahmin, whom shall I worship? (3)
By worshipping whom, O sage, may I quickly reach Goloka?"—
to the king of kings who spoke thus, the best of brahmins replied: (4)
"By serving Him, you will attain His world after many births. (5)
Worship Rādhā, the presiding deity of His life-breath, higher than the highest;
by the grace of the merciful goddess, one quickly reaches His realm." (6)
Having spoken thus, he gave him the six-syllable mantra of Rādhikā:
"Oṃ Rādhā" in the dative case, ending with the wife of Agni [Svāhā]. (7)
Breath control, purification of the elements, the nyāsa of the mantra,
nyāsa of the hands and limbs, and the meditation exceedingly rare to all, (8)
the hymn of praise and the armour—these he taught him with devotion.
In that very order, the king repeated the supreme mantra. (9)
And the meditation declared in the Sāmaveda, the most auspicious of all auspicious things,
by which meditation Kṛṣṇa worshipped her of old: (10)
She whose complexion shines like a white campaka flower, radiant as ten million moons,
whose face is like the autumn full moon, whose eyes are like autumn lotuses, (11)
with beautiful hips and loins, with an excellent lower lip like a ripe bimba fruit, (12)
charming with rows of teeth resembling strings of pearls,
with a cheerful face smiling gently, bestowing grace upon her devotees, (13)
wearing garments purified by fire, adorned with necklaces of jewels, (14)
with armlets and bracelets of gems, adorned with jewelled anklets,
splendid with a wondrous pair of jewelled earrings, (15)
resplendent with cheeks mirroring the brilliance of the sun, (16)
adorned with a necklace set with priceless jewels,
blazing with a crown and diadem set with the essence of fine gems, (17)
