भद्रबीजं दुर्गमिदं कस्य सम्पद्विपद्विना .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca śunāsīro dūtānāṃ ca sahasrakam ..
tūrṇaṃ prasthāpa yāmāsa tatkarmanipuṇaṃ mune .. 34 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च शुनासीरो दूतानां च सहस्रकम् ..
तूर्णं प्रस्थाप यामास तत्कर्मनिपुणं मुने .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
te dūtā vai varṣaśataṃ yayurnirjanameva ca ..
sudurlaṃghyaṃ ca viśveṣu bhramitvā śakramāyayuḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
ते दूता वै वर्षशतं ययुर्निर्जनमेव च ..
सुदुर्लंघ्यं च विश्वेषु भ्रमित्वा शक्रमाययुः .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
candraṃ ca śukrabhavane taṃ prapannaṃ ca vijvaram ..
dṛṣṭvā satārakaṃ bhītaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram .. 36 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रं च शुक्रभवने तं प्रपन्नं च विज्वरम् ..
दृष्ट्वा सतारकं भीतं कथयामासुरीश्वरम् .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā śunāsīro natavaktro bṛhaspatim ..
uvāca śokasantapto hadayena vidūyatā .. 37 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा शुनासीरो नतवक्त्रो बृहस्पतिम् ..
उवाच शोकसन्तप्तो हदयेन विदूयता .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mahendra uvāca ..
śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham ..
bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati .. 38 ..
meaning:
महेन्द्र उवाच ..
शृणु नाथ प्रवक्ष्यामि परिणामसुखावहम् ..
भयं त्यज महाभाग सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā nahi jitaḥ śukro na mayā ditinandanaḥ ..
etadālocya candraśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ kavim ..39..
meaning:
त्वया नहि जितः शुक्रो न मया दितिनन्दनः ..
एतदालोच्य चन्द्रश्च जगाम शरणं कविम् ..39..

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha śīghraṃ brahmalokamasmābhiḥ sārddhameva ca ..
brahmaṇā saha yāsyāmaḥ kailāse śaṅkaraṃ vayam ..2.59.40 ..
meaning:
गच्छ शीघ्रं ब्रह्मलोकमस्माभिः सार्द्धमेव च ..
ब्रह्मणा सह यास्यामः कैलासे शङ्करं वयम् ..2.59.40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tu mahendraśca santapto guruṇā saha ..
jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca sukhadṛśyaṃ nirāmayam .. 41 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तु महेन्द्रश्च सन्तप्तो गुरुणा सह ..
जगाम ब्रह्मलोकं च सुखदृश्यं निरामयम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Mahendra, distressed, went with the guru
to Brahmaloka, pleasant to behold and free from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ nanāma guruṇā saha ..
provāca sarvavṛttāntaṃ devānāmīśvaraṃ param .. 42 ..
meaning:
तत्र दृष्ट्वा च ब्रह्माणं ननाम गुरुणा सह ..
प्रोवाच सर्ववृत्तान्तं देवानामीश्वरं परम् .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Brahmā there, he bowed together with the guru;
he related the entire matter to the supreme lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mahendravacanaṃ śrutvā hasitvā kamalodbhavaḥ ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
महेन्द्रवचनं श्रुत्वा हसित्वा कमलोद्भवः ..
हितं तथ्यं नीतिसारमुवाच विनयान्वितः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Hearing Mahendra's words, the lotus-born [Brahmā] laughed,
and, endowed with modesty, spoke beneficial, true, and essential counsel:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
yo dadāti parasmai ca duḥkhameva ca sarvataḥ ..
tasmai dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca śāstā kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
यो ददाति परस्मै च दुःखमेव च सर्वतः ..
तस्मै ददाति दुःखं च शास्ता कृष्णः सनातनः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
"He who gives suffering alone to another on all sides—
to him the punisher, eternal Kṛṣṇa, gives suffering in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ sraṣṭā ca sṛṣṭeśca pātā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
yathā rudraśca saṃharttā dadāti ca śivaṃ śivaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
अहं स्रष्टा च सृष्टेश्च पाता विष्णुः सनातनः ..
यथा रुद्रश्च संहर्त्ता ददाति च शिवं शिवः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
I am the creator of creation, and eternal Viṣṇu is its protector;
just as Rudra is the destroyer, Śiva bestows what is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
nirantaraṃ sarvasākṣī dharmo vai sarvakāraṇam ..
sarve devā viṣayiṇaḥ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
निरन्तरं सर्वसाक्षी धर्मो वै सर्वकारणम् ..
सर्वे देवा विषयिणः कृष्णाज्ञापरिपालकाः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Dharma is ever the witness of all, indeed the cause of everything.
All gods are involved in worldly affairs, abiding by Kṛṣṇa's command.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaśca jitendriyaḥ ..
trayaścāṃgirasaḥ putrā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च संवर्तश्च जितेन्द्रियः ..
त्रयश्चांगिरसः पुत्रा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati, Utathya, and Saṃvarta, whose senses are conquered,
are the three sons of Aṅgiras, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya na ca kiñciddadau guruḥ ..
sa babhūva tapasvī ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati ceśvaram .. 48 ..
meaning:
संवर्ताय कनिष्ठाय न च किञ्चिद्ददौ गुरुः ..
स बभूव तपस्वी च कृष्णं ध्यायति चेश्वरम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
The guru gave nothing to Saṃvarta, the youngest;
he became an ascetic and meditates upon the Lord, Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamasyotathyakasya satīṃ bhāryāṃ ca gurviṇīm ..
jahāra kāmatastāṃ ca bhrātṛjāyāmakāmukīm .. 49 ..
meaning:
मध्यमस्योतथ्यकस्य सतीं भार्यां च गुर्विणीम् ..
जहार कामतस्तां च भ्रातृजायामकामुकीम् .. 49 ..
text_mt:
The virtuous, pregnant wife of the middle one, Utathya—
out of lust he seized her, his brother's wife, though she did not desire it.

sanskrit_iast:
yo haredbhrātṛjāyāṃ ca kāmī kāmādakāmukīm ..
brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.59.50 ..
meaning:
यो हरेद्भ्रातृजायां च कामी कामादकामुकीम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रं च लभते नात्र संशयः .. 2.59.50 ..
text_mt:
A lustful man who, out of desire, seizes his brother's wife when she does not desire it,
incurs [the sin of] a thousand slayings of brahmins; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram ..
bhrātṛjāyāpahārī ca mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
स याति कुम्भीपाकं च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरम् ..
भ्रातृजायापहारी च मातृगामी भवेन्नरः .. 51 ..
text_mt: A man who abducts his brother's wife becomes one who violates his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttīryya pāpī ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi tatra sthitvā ca pātakī .. 52 ..
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य पापी च विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः ..
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि तत्र स्थित्वा च पातकी .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Having emerged from there, that sinner is born as a worm in excrement;
remaining there for thousands of crores of years, that sinner,

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavenmahāpāpī varṣakoṭisahasrakam ..
puṃścalīyonigarte ca kṛmiścaiva purandara .. .. 53 ..
meaning:
ततो भवेन्महापापी वर्षकोटिसहस्रकम् ..
पुंश्चलीयोनिगर्ते च कृमिश्चैव पुरन्दर .. .. 53 ..
text_mt:
thereafter that great sinner, for thousands of crores of years,
[becomes] a worm in the pit of a prostitute's womb, O Purandara.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni kukkuraḥ ..
bhrātṛjāyāpaharaṇācchatajanmāni sūkaraḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
गृध्रः कोटिसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि कुक्कुरः ..
भ्रातृजायापहरणाच्छतजन्मानि सूकरः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
For thousands of crores [of years] a vulture, for a hundred births a dog,
from abducting a brother's wife he becomes a boar for a hundred births.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti yo na dāyaṃ ca baliṣṭho durbalāya ca ..
sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram .. 95 ..
meaning:
ददाति यो न दायं च बलिष्ठो दुर्बलाय च ..
स याति कुम्भीपाकं च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: The strong one who does not give an inheritance to the weak,

sanskrit_iast:
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ..
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham .. 56 ..
meaning:
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ..
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् .. 56 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jagadguroḥ śivasyāpi guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ ..
jñātaṃ karotu vṛttāntamīśvaraṃ balināṃ varama .. 57 ..
meaning:
जगद्गुरोः शिवस्यापि गुरुपुत्रो बृहस्पतिः ..
ज्ञातं करोतु वृत्तान्तमीश्वरं बलिनां वरम .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati is the guru's son even of Śiva, the guru of the universe;
let him make the matter known to the Lord, the foremost of the mighty.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve samūhā devānāṃ sannaddhāśca savāhanāḥ ..
madhyasthā munayaścaiva santu vai narmadātaṭe .. 58 ..
meaning:
सर्वे समूहा देवानां सन्नद्धाश्च सवाहनाः ..
मध्यस्था मुनयश्चैव सन्तु वै नर्मदातटे .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Let all the hosts of gods, equipped with weapons and on their mounts,
and the neutral sages, be assembled on the bank of the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
paścādahaṃ ca yāsyāmi puṇyaṃ tannarmmadātaṭam ..
gurustadguruputro'pi śīghraṃ yātu śivālayam ..59..
meaning:
पश्चादहं च यास्यामि पुण्यं तन्नर्म्मदातटम् ..
गुरुस्तद्गुरुपुत्रोऽपि शीघ्रं यातु शिवालयम् ..59..
text_mt:
Afterwards I too shall go to that holy bank of the Narmadā.
Let the guru, that guru's son, go quickly to Śiva's abode."

sanskrit_iast:
mahendra uvāca ..
kathaṃ vā vedakarttuśca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ guroḥ ..
mṛtyuñjayasya śambhośca guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ .. 2.59.60 ..
meaning:
महेन्द्र उवाच ..
कथं वा वेदकर्त्तुश्च सिद्धानां योगिनां गुरोः ..
मृत्युञ्जयस्य शम्भोश्च गुरुपुत्रो बृहस्पतिः .. 2.59.60 ..
text_mt:
"How is Bṛhaspati the son of the guru of the maker of the Vedas,
the guru of accomplished adepts and yogins, Mṛtyuñjaya Śambhu?

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāstava putraśca tatputraśca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
tvatto jñānī mahādevaḥ kathaṃ śiṣyo guroḥ pituḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिरास्तव पुत्रश्च तत्पुत्रश्च बृहस्पतिः ..
त्वत्तो ज्ञानी महादेवः कथं शिष्यो गुरोः पितुः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras is your son, and his son is Bṛhaspati;
Mahādeva is wiser than you—how is he the disciple of the guru's father?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
katheyamatiguptā ca purāṇeṣu purandara ..
imāṃ purāpravṛttiṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya..62..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
कथेयमतिगुप्ता च पुराणेषु पुरन्दर ..
इमां पुराप्रवृत्तिं च कथयामि निशामय..62..
text_mt:
"This story is extremely secret in the Purāṇas, O Purandara.
I shall relate this ancient occurrence; listen.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtavatsā karmmadoṣādbhāryyā cāṅgirasaḥ purā ..
vrataṃ cakāra sā caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
मृतवत्सा कर्म्मदोषाद्भार्य्या चाङ्गिरसः पुरा ..
व्रतं चकार सा चैव कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, through the fault of karma, the wife of Aṅgiras had stillborn children;
she performed a vow dedicated to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ puṃsavanaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ cakāra sā ..
sanatkumāro bhagavānkārayāmāsa tāṃ vratam .. 64 ..
meaning:
व्रतं पुंसवनं नाम वर्षमेकं चकार सा ..
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्कारयामास तां व्रतम् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
She performed the vow named puṃsavana for one year;
the blessed Sanatkumāra made her observe that vow.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā''gatya ca golokātparamātmā kṛpāmayaḥ ..
svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
तदा'ऽगत्य च गोलोकात्परमात्मा कृपामयः ..
स्वेच्छामयं परं ब्रह्म भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Then, coming from Goloka, the compassionate Paramātman,
the supreme Brahman consisting of his own will, embodied to show grace to devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
suvratāṃ ca salakṣmīkāṃ tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
praṇatāṃ sāśrunetrāṃ ca vinītāṃ ca tayā stutaḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
सुव्रतां च सलक्ष्मीकां तामुवाच कृपानिधिः ..
प्रणतां साश्रुनेत्रां च विनीतां च तया स्तुतः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
the ocean of mercy spoke to her, the faithful observer of vows endowed with fortune,
who was bowed down, tearful-eyed, humble, and by whom he was praised.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
gṛhāṇedaṃ vrataphalaṃ mama tejassamanvitam ..
bhuṃkṣva madvarataḥ putri bhaviṣyati madaṃśataḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
गृहाणेदं व्रतफलं मम तेजस्समन्वितम् ..
भुंक्ष्व मद्वरतः पुत्रि भविष्यति मदंशतः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
"Accept this fruit of the vow, endowed with my splendor.
Consume it by my boon, daughter; from my portion there shall be born

sanskrit_iast:
patirguruśca devānāṃ mahatāṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
putraste bhavitā sādhvi madvareṇa bṛhaspatiḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
पतिर्गुरुश्च देवानां महतां ज्ञानिनां वरः ..
पुत्रस्ते भविता साध्वि मद्वरेण बृहस्पतिः .. 68 ..
text_mt:
the master and guru of the gods, the best of great wise men.
By my boon your son shall be Bṛhaspati, O virtuous woman.

sanskrit_iast:
madvareṇa bhavedyo hi sa ca madvaraputrakaḥ ..
tvadgarbhe mama putro'yaṃ cirajīvī bhaviṣyati .. 69 ..
meaning:
मद्वरेण भवेद्यो हि स च मद्वरपुत्रकः ..
त्वद्गर्भे मम पुत्रोऽयं चिरजीवी भविष्यति .. 69 ..
text_mt:
He who is born by my boon is indeed a son born of my boon.
In your womb this son of mine shall be long-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
varajo vīryyajaścaiva kṣetrajaḥ pālakastathā..
vidyāmantrasutau caiva gṛhītaḥ saptamaḥ sutaḥ .. 2.59.70 ..
meaning:
वरजो वीर्य्यजश्चैव क्षेत्रजः पालकस्तथा..
विद्यामन्त्रसुतौ चैव गृहीतः सप्तमः सुतः .. 2.59.70 ..
text_mt:
The son born of a boon, the son born of semen, the son born of the wife's womb, likewise the foster son,
and the two sons of knowledge and mantra, and an adopted son is the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā rādhikānāthaḥ svalokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇavaraputro'yaṃ jñānīśvaraguruḥ svayam ..
mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahājñānaṃ śivāya pradadau purā .. 71 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा राधिकानाथः स्वलोकं च जगाम सः ..
श्रीकृष्णवरपुत्रोऽयं ज्ञानीश्वरगुरुः स्वयम् ..
मृत्युञ्जयं महाज्ञानं शिवाय प्रददौ पुरा .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the lord of Rādhikā went to his own world.
This son born of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's boon, himself the teacher of the lord of the wise,
formerly imparted the great knowledge that conquers death to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapaścakre himālaye ..
svayogaṃ jñānamakhilaṃ tejassvāmasamaṃ param ..
svaśaktiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca svāṃśaṃ vai vāhanaṃ vṛṣam .. 72..
meaning:
दिव्यं वर्षत्रिलक्षं च तपश्चक्रे हिमालये ..
स्वयोगं ज्ञानमखिलं तेजस्स्वामसमं परम् ..
स्वशक्तिं विष्णुमायां च स्वांशं वै वाहनं वृषम् .. 72..
text_mt:
For three hundred thousand divine years [Śiva] performed austerities on the Himālayas.
His own yoga, all knowledge, supreme splendor equal to his own,
his own śakti, the māyā of Viṣṇu, his own portion indeed—his vehicle the bull,

sanskrit_iast:
svaśūlaṃ ca svakavacaṃ svamantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram ..
kṛpāmayaḥ stutastena śrīkṛṣṇaśca parātparaḥ ..
śivaloke śivā sā ca viṣṇumāyā śivapriyā ..73..
meaning:
स्वशूलं च स्वकवचं स्वमन्त्रं द्वादशाक्षरम् ..
कृपामयः स्तुतस्तेन श्रीकृष्णश्च परात्परः ..
शिवलोके शिवा सा च विष्णुमाया शिवप्रिया ..73..
text_mt:
his trident, his armour, his twelve-syllabled mantra—
the compassionate and higher-than-the-highest Śrī Kṛṣṇa was praised by him.
In Śivaloka she is Śivā, the māyā of Viṣṇu, beloved of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī ..
tejastu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī .. 74 ..
meaning:
शक्तिर्नारायणस्येयं सा'ऽविर्भूता सनातनी ..
तेजस्तु सर्वदेवानां सा'ऽविर्भूता सनातनी .. 74 ..
text_mt:
She, the eternal śakti of Nārāyaṇa, manifested herself;
as the splendor of all the gods, that eternal one manifested herself.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna daityanikaraṃ devebhyaḥ pradadau padam ..
kalpānte dakṣakanyā ca sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ satī .. 75 ..
meaning:
जघान दैत्यनिकरं देवेभ्यः प्रददौ पदम् ..
कल्पान्ते दक्षकन्या च सा मूलप्रकृतिः सती .. 75 ..
text_mt:
She slew the multitude of Daityas and granted sovereignty to the gods.
At the end of the kalpa, that primal Prakṛti became Satī, daughter of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛyajñe tanuṃ tyaktvā yogādvai siddhayoginī ..
babhūva śailakanyā sā sādhvī vai bhartṛnindayā ..76..
meaning:
पितृयज्ञे तनुं त्यक्त्वा योगाद्वै सिद्धयोगिनी ..
बभूव शैलकन्या सा साध्वी वै भर्तृनिन्दया ..76..
text_mt:
Having abandoned her body at her father's sacrifice through yoga, indeed an accomplished yoginī,
that chaste woman became the daughter of the Mountain on account of the reviling of her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
kālena kṛṣṇatapasā śaṅkaraṃ prāpa sundarī..
śrīkṛṣṇo hi guruḥ śambhoḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ.77..
meaning:
कालेन कृष्णतपसा शङ्करं प्राप सुन्दरी..
श्रीकृष्णो हि गुरुः शम्भोः परमात्मा परात्परः.77..
text_mt:
In time, through austerities to Kṛṣṇa, the beautiful woman obtained Śaṅkara.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa indeed is the guru of Śambhu, the Paramātman beyond the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya varaputro'yaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ..
ato hetoḥ suragururguruputraḥ śivasya ca .. 78 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्य वरपुत्रोऽयं स्वयमेव बृहस्पतिः ..
अतो हेतोः सुरगुरुर्गुरुपुत्रः शिवस्य च .. 78 ..
text_mt:
This Bṛhaspati is himself the son born of Kṛṣṇa's boon;
for this reason, the guru of the gods is the guru's son to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamatiguhyaṃ purātanam..
iti pradhānasambandhaḥ śrutaśca kathito mayā .. 79 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वमतिगुह्यं पुरातनम्..
इति प्रधानसम्बन्धः श्रुतश्च कथितो मया .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Thus all this very secret, ancient account has been told.
Thus the primary relationship has been heard and recounted by me.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṃparikamanyaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ..
durvāsā garuḍaścaiva śaṅkarāṃśaḥ pratāpavān .. 2.59.80 ..
meaning:
पारंपरिकमन्यं च कथयामि निशामय ..
दुर्वासा गरुडश्चैव शङ्करांशः प्रतापवान् .. 2.59.80 ..
text_mt:
I will tell another traditional one; listen:
Durvāsas and Garuḍa, the powerful one, are portions of Śaṅkara;

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyau cāṃgirasastau dvau guruputro'thavā tataḥ ..
prāṇādhikāyāṃ satyāṃ ca mṛtāyāṃ dakṣaśāpataḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
शिष्यौ चांगिरसस्तौ द्वौ गुरुपुत्रोऽथवा ततः ..
प्राणाधिकायां सत्यां च मृतायां दक्षशापतः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
and those two were pupils of Aṅgiras; thus [Bṛhaspati is] a guru's son from that [relation] too.
When Satī, who was dearer than life, died due to the curse of Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
svajñānaṃ svaṃ ca bhagavānvisasmāra svamohataḥ ..
smaraṇaṃ kārayāmāsa kṛṣṇena prerito'ṅgirāḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
स्वज्ञानं स्वं च भगवान्विसस्मार स्वमोहतः ..
स्मरणं कारयामास कृष्णेन प्रेरितोऽङ्गिराः .. 82 ..
text_mt:
the Lord forgot his own knowledge and himself through his own delusion.
Impelled by Kṛṣṇa, Aṅgiras made him remember.

sanskrit_iast:
ato hetorguruścaivaṃ matsutassyācchivasya saḥ ..
śīghraṃ gacchatu kailāsaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
अतो हेतोर्गुरुश्चैवं मत्सुतस्स्याच्छिवस्य सः ..
शीघ्रं गच्छतु कैलासं स्वयमेव बृहस्पतिः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
For this reason also my son would be the guru to Śiva.
Let Bṛhaspati himself go quickly to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ gaccha tatra sannaddhaḥ sadevo narmadātaṭam ..
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca nārada .. 84 ..
meaning:
त्वं गच्छ तत्र सन्नद्धः सदेवो नर्मदातटम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता विरराम च नारद .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Go you there fully prepared, together with the gods, to the bank of the Narmadā."
Having spoken thus, O Nārada, the creator of the worlds ceased.

sanskrit_iast: gururyayau ca kailāsaṃ mahendro narmadātaṭam .. 85 ..
meaning: गुरुर्ययौ च कैलासं महेन्द्रो नर्मदातटम् .. 85 ..
text_mt: The guru went to Kailāsa, and great Indra went to the bank of the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga ..
nipītaṃ ca mahākhyānaṃ tvanmukhenduvinisṛtam .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
नारायण महाभाग वेदवेदाङ्गपारग ..
निपीतं च महाख्यानं त्वन्मुखेन्दुविनिसृतम् .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 60

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā śrotumicchāmi kimuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
śivaṃ ca gatvā kailāsaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām .. 2 ..
meaning:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि किमुवाच बृहस्पतिः ..
शिवं च गत्वा कैलासं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jagatkartā vidhātā ca kiṃ vā taṃ pratyuvāca saḥ ..
etatsarvaṃ samālocya vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 3 ..
meaning:
जगत्कर्ता विधाता च किं वा तं प्रत्युवाच सः ..
एतत्सर्वं समालोच्य वद वेदविदां वर .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śīghraṃ gatvā ca kailāsaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ śaṃkaraṃ guruḥ ..
praṇamya tasthau purato lajjāvanatakandharaḥ .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
शीघ्रं गत्वा च कैलासं भ्रष्टश्रीः शंकरं गुरुः ..
प्रणम्य तस्थौ पुरतो लज्जावनतकन्धरः .. .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā gurusutaṃ śambhurudatiṣṭhatkuśāsanāt ..
āliṅganaṃ dadau tasmai śīghraṃ māṃgalikāśiṣaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा गुरुसुतं शम्भुरुदतिष्ठत्कुशासनात् ..
आलिङ्गनं ददौ तस्मै शीघ्रं मांगलिकाशिषः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svāsane vāsayitvā vai papraccha kuśalaṃ vacaḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhītaṃ taṃ lajjitaṃ śivaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्वासने वासयित्वा वै पप्रच्छ कुशलं वचः ..
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं भीतं तं लज्जितं शिवः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśaṅkara uvāca ..
kathamevaṃvidhastvaṃ ca duḥkhī malina vigrahaḥ ..
sāśrunetro lajjitaśca bhrātastatkāraṇaṃ vada .. 7 ..
meaning:
श्रीशङ्कर उवाच ..
कथमेवंविधस्त्वं च दुःखी मलिन विग्रहः ..
साश्रुनेत्रो लज्जितश्च भ्रातस्तत्कारणं वद .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā tapasyā hīnā te sandhyā hīnā'thavā mune ..
kiṃ vā śrīkṛṣṇasevā sā vihīnā daivadoṣataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
किं वा तपस्या हीना ते सन्ध्या हीनाऽथवा मुने ..
किं वा श्रीकृष्णसेवा सा विहीना दैवदोषतः .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā gurau bhaktihīno'bhīṣṭadeve'thavā gurau ..
kiṃ vā na rakṣituṃ śaktaḥ prapannaṃ śaraṇāgatam .. 9 ..
meaning:
किं वा गुरौ भक्तिहीनोऽभीष्टदेवेऽथवा गुरौ ..
किं वा न रक्षितुं शक्तः प्रपन्नं शरणागतम् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā'tithiste vimukhaḥ kiṃ vā poṣyā bubhukṣitāḥ ..
kiṃ vā svatantrā strī vā te kiṃ vā putro'vacaskaraḥ ..2.60.1 0..
meaning:
किं वाऽतिथिस्ते विमुखः किं वा पोष्या बुभुक्षिताः ..
किं वा स्वतन्त्रा स्त्री वा ते किं वा पुत्रोऽवचस्करः ..2.60.1 0..

sanskrit_iast:
suśāsito na śiṣyo vā kiṃ bhṛtyāścottarapradāḥ ..
kiṃ vā te vimukhā lakṣmīḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭo gurustava .. 11 ..
meaning:
सुशासितो न शिष्यो वा किं भृत्याश्चोत्तरप्रदाः ..
किं वा ते विमुखा लक्ष्मीः किं वा रुष्टो गुरुस्तव .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gariṣṭhaśca variṣṭhaśca śaśvatsantuṣṭa mānasa ..
gurustava vasiṣṭhaśca preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ satāmaho ..12..
meaning:
गरिष्ठश्च वरिष्ठश्च शश्वत्सन्तुष्ट मानस ..
गुरुस्तव वसिष्ठश्च प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठः सतामहो ..12..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā ruṣṭo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭāśca vāḍavāḥ ..
kiṃ vā ruṣṭā vaiṣṇavāśca kiṃ vā te prabalo ripuḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
किं वा रुष्टोऽभीष्टदेवः किं वा रुष्टाश्च वाडवाः ..
किं वा रुष्टा वैष्णवाश्च किं वा ते प्रबलो रिपुः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā te bandhuvicchedo vigraho balinā saha ..
kiṃ vā padaṃ paragrastaṃ kiṃ vā bandhudhanaṃ ca vā ..14..
meaning:
किं वा ते बन्धुविच्छेदो विग्रहो बलिना सह ..
किं वा पदं परग्रस्तं किं वा बन्धुधनं च वा ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
kena te vā kṛtā nindā khalairvā pāpibhirmune ..
kena vā tvaṃ parityakto bāndhavena priyeṇa vā..15..
meaning:
केन ते वा कृता निन्दा खलैर्वा पापिभिर्मुने ..
केन वा त्वं परित्यक्तो बान्धवेन प्रियेण वा..15..

sanskrit_iast:
bandhustyaktastvayā kiṃ vā vairāgyeṇa krudhā'thavā ..
kiṃ vā tīrthe nahi snātaṃ na dattaṃ puṇyavāsare..16..
meaning:
बन्धुस्त्यक्तस्त्वया किं वा वैराग्येण क्रुधाऽथवा ..
किं वा तीर्थे नहि स्नातं न दत्तं पुण्यवासरे..16..

sanskrit_iast:
gurunindā bandhunindā khalavaktrācchrutā'thavā ..
gurunindā hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
गुरुनिन्दा बन्धुनिन्दा खलवक्त्राच्छ्रुताऽथवा ..
गुरुनिन्दा हि साधूनां मरणादतिरिच्यते .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
asadvaṃśaprajātānāṃ khalānāṃ nindanaṃ tathā ..
dauśśīlyamevamasatāṃ śaśvannārakiṇāmiha .. 18 ..
meaning:
असद्वंशप्रजातानां खलानां निन्दनं तथा ..
दौश्शील्यमेवमसतां शश्वन्नारकिणामिह .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
parapraśaṃsakāḥ santaḥ puṇyavanto hi bhārate ..
śaśvanmaṅgalayuktāśca rājante manasā sadā .. 19 ..
meaning:
परप्रशंसकाः सन्तः पुण्यवन्तो हि भारते ..
शश्वन्मङ्गलयुक्ताश्च राजन्ते मनसा सदा .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
putre yaśasi toye ca samṛddhe ca parākrame ..
aiśvarye vā pratāpe ca prajābhūmidhaneṣu ca .. 2.60.20 ..
meaning:
पुत्रे यशसि तोये च समृद्धे च पराक्रमे ..
ऐश्वर्ये वा प्रतापे च प्रजाभूमिधनेषु च .. 2.60.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vacaneṣu ca buddhau ca svabhāve ca caritrataḥ ..
ācāre vyavahāre ca jāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām..21..
meaning:
वचनेषु च बुद्धौ च स्वभावे च चरित्रतः ..
आचारे व्यवहारे च जायते हृदयं नृणाम्..21..

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛgyeṣāṃ ca hadaye tādṛkteṣāṃ ca maṃgalam ..
yādṛgyeṣāṃ pūrvapuṇyaṃ tādṛkteṣāṃ ca mānasam .. 22 ..
meaning:
यादृग्येषां च हदये तादृक्तेषां च मंगलम् ..
यादृग्येषां पूर्वपुण्यं तादृक्तेषां च मानसम् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca mahādevo virarāma svasaṃsadi ..
tamuvāca mahāvaktā svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च महादेवो विरराम स्वसंसदि ..
तमुवाच महावक्ता स्वयमेव बृहस्पतिः .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca ..
akathyameva vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmi kimīśvara ..
lokāḥ karmavaśānnityaṃ nānājanmasu yatkṛtam .. 24 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच ..
अकथ्यमेव वृत्तान्तं कथयामि किमीश्वर ..
लोकाः कर्मवशान्नित्यं नानाजन्मसु यत्कृतम् .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte janturjanmani janmani ..
nahi naṣṭaṃ ca tatkarma vinā bhogācca bhārate .. 25 ..
meaning:
स्वकर्मणां फलं भुङ्क्ते जन्तुर्जन्मनि जन्मनि ..
नहि नष्टं च तत्कर्म विना भोगाच्च भारते .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śoko narāṇāṃ bhārate prabho ..
kecidvadanti hi bhavetsvakṛtena ca karmaṇā .. 25 ..
meaning:
सुखं दुःखं भयं शोको नराणां भारते प्रभो ..
केचिद्वदन्ति हि भवेत्स्वकृतेन च कर्मणा .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kecidvadanti daivena svabhāveneti kecana ..
trividhā gatayo hyasya vedavedāṅgapāraga .. 27 ..
meaning:
केचिद्वदन्ति दैवेन स्वभावेनेति केचन ..
त्रिविधा गतयो ह्यस्य वेदवेदाङ्गपारग .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ ca karmajanakaḥ karma vai daivakāraṇam ..
svabhāvo jāyate nṝṇāṃ svātmanaḥ pūrvakarmaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वयं च कर्मजनकः कर्म वै दैवकारणम् ..
स्वभावो जायते नॄणां स्वात्मनः पूर्वकर्मणः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jantūnāṃ pratijanmani ..
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ svātmanaśca prajāyate .. 29 ..
meaning:
स्वकर्मणां च सर्वेषां जन्तूनां प्रतिजन्मनि ..
सुखं दुःखं भयं शोकं स्वात्मनश्च प्रजायते .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaphalabhoktā ca jīvo hi saguṇaḥ sadā ..
ātmabhojayitā sākṣī nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ .. 2.60.30 ..
meaning:
स्वकर्मफलभोक्ता च जीवो हि सगुणः सदा ..
आत्मभोजयिता साक्षी निर्गुणः प्रकृतेः परः .. 2.60.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sa evātmā sarvasevyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca phalapradaḥ ..
sa vai sṛjati daivaṃ ca svabhāvaṃ karma caiva hi .. 33 ..
meaning:
स एवात्मा सर्वसेव्यः सर्वेषां च फलप्रदः ..
स वै सृजति दैवं च स्वभावं कर्म चैव हि .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā ca nṛṇāṃ lajjā praśaṃsā ca praphullatā ..
lajjābījaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tathā'pi kathayāmi te .. 32 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा च नृणां लज्जा प्रशंसा च प्रफुल्लता ..
लज्जाबीजं च वृत्तान्तं तथाऽपि कथयामि ते .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sarvavṛttāntamavocattaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ..
śrutvā babhūva namrāsyo gaurīśo lajjayā tadā ..33..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा सर्ववृत्तान्तमवोचत्तं बृहस्पतिः ..
श्रुत्वा बभूव नम्रास्यो गौरीशो लज्जया तदा ..33..

sanskrit_iast:
japamālā karādbhraṣṭā kopāviṣṭasya śūlinaḥ ..
babhūva sadyaḥkampaśca raktapaṃkajalocane..34..
meaning:
जपमाला कराद्भ्रष्टा कोपाविष्टस्य शूलिनः ..
बभूव सद्यःकम्पश्च रक्तपंकजलोचने..34..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhartturīśo rudrasya viṣṇoḥ pātuḥ sakhā śivaḥ ..
sraṣṭuḥ stutyaśca mānyaśca svātmanaḥ paramātmanaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
संहर्त्तुरीशो रुद्रस्य विष्णोः पातुः सखा शिवः ..
स्रष्टुः स्तुत्यश्च मान्यश्च स्वात्मनः परमात्मनः .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya prakṛtīśasya nārada ..
kopātpravaktumārebhe śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
निर्गुणस्य च कृष्णस्य प्रकृतीशस्य नारद ..
कोपात्प्रवक्तुमारेभे शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकः .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca ..
śivamastu ca sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmiha ..
avaiṣṇavānāmasatāmaśivaṃ ca pade pade .. 37 ..
meaning:
शिव उवाच ..
शिवमस्तु च साधूनां वैष्णवानां सतामिह ..
अवैष्णवानामसतामशिवं च पदे पदे .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti vaiṣṇavebhyaśca yo duḥkhaṃ susthito janaḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇastasya saṃharttā vighnastasya pade pade .. 38 ..
meaning:
ददाति वैष्णवेभ्यश्च यो दुःखं सुस्थितो जनः ..
श्रीकृष्णस्तस्य संहर्त्ता विघ्नस्तस्य पदे पदे .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
avaiṣṇavānāṃ hṛdayaṃ nahi śuddhaṃ sadāmalam ..
śrīkṛṣṇamantrasmaraṇaṃ manonairmalyakāraṇam .. 39 ..
meaning:
अवैष्णवानां हृदयं नहि शुद्धं सदामलम् ..
श्रीकृष्णमन्त्रस्मरणं मनोनैर्मल्यकारणम् .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhidyate hadayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ ..
viṣṇumantropāsanayā kṣīyate karma tannṛṇām .. 2.60.40 ..
meaning:
भिद्यते हदयग्रन्थिश्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः ..
विष्णुमन्त्रोपासनया क्षीयते कर्म तन्नृणाम् .. 2.60.40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aho śrīkṛṣṇadāsānāṃ kaḥ svabhāvaḥ sunirmalaḥ ..
hṛtabhāryyaṃ mūrcchitaśca na śaśāpa ripuṃ guruḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
अहो श्रीकृष्णदासानां कः स्वभावः सुनिर्मलः ..
हृतभार्य्यं मूर्च्छितश्च न शशाप रिपुं गुरुः .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gururyasya variṣṭhaśca krodhahīnaśca dhārmikaḥ ..
śataputraghnamapyenaṃ na śaśāpa ripuṃ muniḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
गुरुर्यस्य वरिष्ठश्च क्रोधहीनश्च धार्मिकः ..
शतपुत्रघ्नमप्येनं न शशाप रिपुं मुनिः .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
niśśvāsādvai suragurorbhrāturmama bṛhaspateḥ ..
bhasmībhūto nimeṣeṇa śatacandro bhaveddhruvam .. .. 43 ..
meaning:
निश्श्वासाद्वै सुरगुरोर्भ्रातुर्मम बृहस्पतेः ..
भस्मीभूतो निमेषेण शतचन्द्रो भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'pi taṃ no śaśāpa dharmmabhaṅgabhayena ca ..
tapasyā hīyate śaptuḥ kopāviṣṭasya nityaśaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
तथाऽपि तं नो शशाप धर्म्मभङ्गभयेन च ..
तपस्या हीयते शप्तुः कोपाविष्टस्य नित्यशः .. 44 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aho hyatrerasatputraḥ parastrīlubdhakaḥ śaṭhaḥ ..
tapasvino vaiṣṇavasya brahmaputrasya dhīmataḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
अहो ह्यत्रेरसत्पुत्रः परस्त्रीलुब्धकः शठः ..
तपस्विनो वैष्णवस्य ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य धीमतः .. 45 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dharmiṣṭhā brahmaṇaḥ putrā vaiṣṇavā brāhmaṇāstathā ..
keciddevā dvijā daityāḥ pautrāśca trividhā matāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
धर्मिष्ठा ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा वैष्णवा ब्राह्मणास्तथा ..
केचिद्देवा द्विजा दैत्याः पौत्राश्च त्रिविधा मताः .. 46 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ye sāttvikā brāhmaṇāste devā rājasikāstathā ..
daityāstāmasikā raudrā baliṣṭhāścoddhatāḥ sadā .. 47 ..
meaning:
ये सात्त्विका ब्राह्मणास्ते देवा राजसिकास्तथा ..
दैत्यास्तामसिका रौद्रा बलिष्ठाश्चोद्धताः सदा .. 47 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmaniratā viprā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ..
śaivāḥ śāktāśca te devā daityāḥ pūjāvivarjitāḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
स्वधर्मनिरता विप्रा नारायणपरायणाः ..
शैवाः शाक्ताश्च ते देवा दैत्याः पूजाविवर्जिताः .. 48 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣavo viṣṇubhaktā brāhmaṇā dāsyalipsavaḥ ..
aiśvaryyalipsavo devāścāsurāstāmasāstathā .. 49 ..
meaning:
मुमुक्षवो विष्णुभक्ता ब्राह्मणा दास्यलिप्सवः ..
ऐश्वर्य्यलिप्सवो देवाश्चासुरास्तामसास्तथा .. 49 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ svadharmaśca kṛṣṇasyārccanamīpsitam ..
niṣkāmānāṃ nirguṇasya parasya prakṛterapi .. 2.60.50 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां स्वधर्मश्च कृष्णस्यार्च्चनमीप्सितम् ..
निष्कामानां निर्गुणस्य परस्य प्रकृतेरपि .. 2.60.50 ..
text_mt: for those without desires, [the worship] of the one beyond the gunas, higher even than Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
ye brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāśca svatantrāḥ paramaṃ padam ..
yāntyanyopāsakāścānyaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca prākṛte laye .. 51 ..
meaning:
ये ब्राह्मणा वैष्णवाश्च स्वतन्त्राः परमं पदम् ..
यान्त्यन्योपासकाश्चान्यैः सार्द्धं च प्राकृते लये .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Those brāhmaṇas who are Vaiṣṇavas, independent, go to the supreme state;
those who worship others go along with the others at the dissolution of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sādhavo vaiṣṇavā yadi ..
viṣṇumantravihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco varaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
वर्णानां ब्राह्मणाः श्रेष्ठाः साधवो वैष्णवा यदि ..
विष्णुमन्त्रविहीनेभ्यो द्विजेभ्यः श्वपचो वरः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas are best among the classes, if they are virtuous Vaiṣṇavas;
an outcaste dog-cooker is better than twice-born men devoid of Viṣṇu's mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
paripakvā vipakvā vā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaśca te ..
satataṃ pāti tāṃścaiva viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam .. 53 ..
meaning:
परिपक्वा विपक्वा वा वैष्णवाः साधवश्च ते ..
सततं पाति तांश्चैव विष्णुचक्रं सुदर्शनम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Whether fully matured or unripe, those Vaiṣṇavas are virtuous;
the Sudarśana disc of Viṣṇu protects them constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vahnau śuṣkatṛṇaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavetsadā..
tathā pāpaṃ vaiṣṇaveṣu kāṣṭhānīva hutāśane .. 54 ..
meaning:
यथा वह्नौ शुष्कतृणं भस्मीभूतं भवेत्सदा..
तथा पापं वैष्णवेषु काष्ठानीव हुताशने .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Just as dry grass in a fire is always reduced to ashes,
so is sin in Vaiṣṇavas, like pieces of wood in fire.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe pravekṣyati ..
taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
गुरुवक्त्राद्विष्णुमन्त्रो यस्य कर्णे प्रवेक्ष्यति ..
तं वैष्णवं महापूतं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः .. 55 ..
text_mt: In whose ear the mantra of Viṣṇu enters from the mouth of a guru,

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsāṃ śataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ..
svasodarāṃśca jananīmuddharantyeva vaiṣṇavāḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
पुंसां शतं पितॄणां च शतं मातामहस्य च ..
स्वसोदरांश्च जननीमुद्धरन्त्येव वैष्णवाः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
A hundred men among the paternal ancestors and a hundred among the maternal grandfather's,
their own brothers and mother—Vaiṣṇavas surely deliver them all.

sanskrit_iast:
gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena piṇḍadāḥ piṇḍabhojinam ..
samuddharanti puṃsāṃ ca vaiṣṇavāśca śataṃ śatam ..97..
meaning:
गयायां पिण्डदानेन पिण्डदाः पिण्डभोजिनम् ..
समुद्धरन्ति पुंसां च वैष्णवाश्च शतं शतम् ..97..
text_mt:
By offering the funeral cake at Gayā, the givers of the cake [deliver] only the consumer of the cake;
whereas Vaiṣṇavas completely deliver hundreds upon hundreds of men.

sanskrit_iast:
mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ..
yamastasmānmahābhīto vainateyādivoragaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
मन्त्रग्रहणमात्रेण जीवन्मुक्तो भवेन्नरः ..
यमस्तस्मान्महाभीतो वैनतेयादिवोरगः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Yama is terrified of him, as a serpent is of Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
punantyeva hi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni ca bhārate ..
kṛṣṇamantropāsakāśca sparśamātreṇa vākpate .. 59 ..
meaning:
पुनन्त्येव हि तीर्थानि गङ्गादीनि च भारते ..
कृष्णमन्त्रोपासकाश्च स्पर्शमात्रेण वाक्पते .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, holy places such as the Gaṅgā in Bhārata
are purified by the worshippers of Kṛṣṇa's mantra by mere touch, O Lord of Speech.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpāni pāpināṃ tīrthe yāvanti prabhavanti ca ..
naśyanti tāni sarvāṇi vaiṣṇavasparśamātrataḥ .. 2.60.60 ..
meaning:
पापानि पापिनां तीर्थे यावन्ति प्रभवन्ति च ..
नश्यन्ति तानि सर्वाणि वैष्णवस्पर्शमात्रतः .. 2.60.60 ..
text_mt:
As many sins of sinners as are deposited in a holy place,
all of them are destroyed by the mere touch of a Vaiṣṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ rajasā pādapadmayoḥ ..
sadyo muktāḥ pātakebhyaḥ kṛtsnā pūtā vasundharā .. 61 ..
meaning:
कृष्णमन्त्रोपासकानां रजसा पादपद्मयोः ..
सद्यो मुक्ताः पातकेभ्यः कृत्स्ना पूता वसुन्धरा .. 61 ..
text_mt:
By the dust of the lotus-feet of worshippers of Kṛṣṇa's mantra,
men are instantly freed from sins, and the entire earth is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuśca pavano vahniḥ sūryyaḥ sarvaṃ punāti ca ..
ete pūtā vaiṣṇavānāṃ sparśamātreṇa līlayā .. 62 ..
meaning:
वायुश्च पवनो वह्निः सूर्य्यः सर्वं पुनाति च ..
एते पूता वैष्णवानां स्पर्शमात्रेण लीलया .. 62 ..
text_mt:
The wind, the purifier, fire, and the sun purify everything;
these are effortlessly purified by the mere touch of Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ brahmā ca śeṣaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmmaṇām ..
ete hṛṣṭāśca vāñchanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamam .. 63 ..
meaning:
अहं ब्रह्मा च शेषश्च धर्मः साक्षी च कर्म्मणाम् ..
एते हृष्टाश्च वाञ्छन्ति वैष्णवानां समागमम् .. 63 ..
text_mt:
I, Brahmā, Śeṣa, and Dharma, the witness of actions—
these, delighted, long for company with Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ karmānurūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhārate bhavet ..
na bhavettadvaiṣṇave ca siddhadhānye yathāṃ'kuram .. 64 ..
meaning:
फलं कर्मानुरूपेण सर्वेषां भारते भवेत् ..
न भवेत्तद्वैष्णवे च सिद्धधान्ये यथांऽकुरम् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
The fruit [of actions] comes to all in Bhārata in accordance with their karma.
That does not happen to a Vaiṣṇava, just as a sprout does not [grow] from boiled grain.

sanskrit_iast:
hanti teṣāṃ karma pūrvaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ..
kṛpayā svapadaṃ tebhyo dadātyeva kṛpānidhiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
हन्ति तेषां कर्म पूर्वं भक्तानां भक्तवत्सलः ..
कृपया स्वपदं तेभ्यो ददात्येव कृपानिधिः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
He who is affectionate to devotees destroys the past karma of those devotees;
out of compassion, the treasure of grace indeed grants them his own realm.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasvināṃ ca pravaraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhṛgunandanam ..
sa candro durbalo bhītaḥ śukraṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 66 ..
meaning:
तेजस्विनां च प्रवरं वैष्णवं भृगुनन्दनम् ..
स चन्द्रो दुर्बलो भीतः शुक्रं च शरणं ययौ .. 66 ..
text_mt:
The most distinguished among the radiant, the Vaiṣṇava son of Bhṛgu—
that Moon, weak and frightened, sought refuge with Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśano baliṣṭhaṃ ca śukraṃ jetuṃ na śaktimān ..
tathā'pi coddhariṣyāmi tārāṃ mantreṇa madguroḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
सुदर्शनो बलिष्ठं च शुक्रं जेतुं न शक्तिमान् ..
तथाऽपि चोद्धरिष्यामि तारां मन्त्रेण मद्गुरोः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
Even Sudarśana is not able to conquer the mighty Śukra.
Nevertheless, I will rescue Tārā by the mantra of my guru.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ..
suprasanne bhagavati patnīṃ prāpsyasi līlayā .. 68 ..
meaning:
भज सत्यं परं ब्रह्म कृष्णमात्मानमीश्वरम् ..
सुप्रसन्ने भगवति पत्नीं प्राप्स्यसि लीलया .. 68 ..
text_mt:
Worship Kṛṣṇa, the truth, the supreme Brahman, the Self, the Lord.
When the Blessed Lord is well pleased, you will effortlessly regain your wife.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ tasya pradāsyāmi bhrātaḥ kalpataruṃ param ..
koṭijanmāghanighnaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam ..69..
meaning:
मन्त्रं तस्य प्रदास्यामि भ्रातः कल्पतरुं परम् ..
कोटिजन्माघनिघ्नं च सर्वमंगलकारणम् ..69..
text_mt:
O brother, I shall give you his supreme wishing-tree mantra,
which destroys the sins of ten million births and is the cause of all auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādistaṃbaparyyantaṃ naśvaraṃ jalabimbavat ..
śaraṇaṃ yāhi govindaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ..
tāvadbhavecchā bhogecchā strīsukhecchā nṛṇāmiha .. 2.60.70 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिस्तंबपर्य्यन्तं नश्वरं जलबिम्बवत् ..
शरणं याहि गोविन्दं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ..
तावद्भवेच्छा भोगेच्छा स्त्रीसुखेच्छा नृणामिह .. 2.60.70 ..
text_mt:
From Brahmā down to a clump of grass, [everything] is perishable like a water-bubble.
Seek refuge with Govinda, the Paramātman, the Lord.
Desire for worldly existence, desire for enjoyment, and desire for the pleasure of women remain for men in this world

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadgurumukhāmbhojānna prāpnoti manuṃ hareḥ ..
saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ mantraṃ vitṛṣṇo hi bhavennaraḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
यावद्गुरुमुखाम्भोजान्न प्राप्नोति मनुं हरेः ..
संप्राप्य दुर्लभं मन्त्रं वितृष्णो हि भवेन्नरः .. 71 ..
text_mt:
only until one receives the mantra of Hari from the lotus mouth of a guru.
Having obtained that rare mantra, a man indeed becomes free of craving.

sanskrit_iast:
indratvamamaratvaṃ ca nahi vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ..
nahi vāñchanti mokṣaṃ ca dāsyaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā hareḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रत्वममरत्वं च नहि वाञ्छन्ति वैष्णवाः ..
नहि वाञ्छन्ति मोक्षं च दास्यं भक्तिं विना हरेः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Vaiṣṇavas do not desire the station of Indra, nor immortality;
nor do they desire liberation without devotion and servitude to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakti nirmathanaṃ bhakto mokṣaṃ no vāñchati prabhoḥ ..
jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayatvaṃ ca sarvasiddhiṃ tadīpsitam .. 73 ..
meaning:
भक्ति निर्मथनं भक्तो मोक्षं नो वाञ्छति प्रभोः ..
ज्ञानं मृत्युञ्जयत्वं च सर्वसिद्धिं तदीप्सितम् .. 73 ..
text_mt:
A devotee does not desire liberation that crushes devotion to the Lord,
nor knowledge, victory over death, or all desires and perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
vāksiddhiṃ caiva dhātṛtvaṃ bhaktānāṃ nahi vāñchitam ..
bhaktiṃ vihāya kṛṣṇasya viṣayaṃ yo hi vāñchati ...74...
meaning:
वाक्सिद्धिं चैव धातृत्वं भक्तानां नहि वाञ्छितम् ..
भक्तिं विहाय कृष्णस्य विषयं यो हि वाञ्छति ...74...
text_mt:
Perfection of speech and even the creator’s status are not desired by devotees.
He who abandons devotion to Kṛṣṇa and desires sense-objects

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamatti sudhāṃ tyaktvā vañcito viṣṇumāyayā ..
ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca dharmo'nantaśca kaśyapaḥ ..75..
meaning:
विषमत्ति सुधां त्यक्त्वा वञ्चितो विष्णुमायया ..
अहं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च धर्मोऽनन्तश्च कश्यपः ..75..
text_mt:
eats poison, having rejected nectar, deceived by the illusion of Viṣṇu.
I, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Dharma, Ananta, Kaśyapa,

sanskrit_iast:
kapilaśca kumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
svāyambhuvo manuścaiva prahlādaśca parāśaraḥ .. .. 76 ..
meaning:
कपिलश्च कुमारश्च नरनारायणावृषी ..
स्वायम्भुवो मनुश्चैव प्रह्लादश्च पराशरः .. .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Kapila, Kumāra, the ṛṣis Nara and Nārāyaṇa,
Svāyambhuva Manu, Prahlāda, Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguḥ śukraśca durvāsā vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ ..
baliśca vālakhilyāśca varuṇaśca hutāśanaḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
भृगुः शुक्रश्च दुर्वासा वसिष्ठः क्रतुरंगिराः ..
बलिश्च वालखिल्याश्च वरुणश्च हुताशनः .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Bhṛgu, Śukra, Durvāsas, Vasiṣṭha, Kratu, Aṅgiras,
Bali, the Vālakhilyas, Varuṇa, Hutāśana,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuḥ sūryaśca garuḍo dakṣo gaṇapatiḥ svayam ..
ete parā bhaktavarāḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..78..
meaning:
वायुः सूर्यश्च गरुडो दक्षो गणपतिः स्वयम् ..
एते परा भक्तवराः कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..78..
text_mt:
Vāyu, Sūrya, Garuḍa, Dakṣa, and Gaṇapati himself—
these are the supreme, best devotees of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ca tasya kalāḥ śreṣṭhāste tadbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ..
ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai dadau kalpataruṃ manum ..79..
meaning:
ये च तस्य कलाः श्रेष्ठास्ते तद्भक्तिपरायणाः ..
इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तस्मै ददौ कल्पतरुं मनुम् ..79..
text_mt:
Those who are his superior parts are devoted to his worship."
Having spoken thus, Śaṅkara gave him the wishing-tree mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ mune ..
paraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mune .. .. 2.60.80 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीमायाकामबीजं ङेन्तं कृष्णपदं मुने ..
परं पूजाविधानं च स्तोत्रं च कवचं मुने .. .. 2.60.80 ..
text_mt:
containing the seed-syllables of Lakṣmī, Māyā, and Kāma, ending in the dative form of Kṛṣṇa, O sage,
and the supreme procedure of worship, the hymn of praise, the armour, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuraścaraṇaṃ dhyānaṃ śuddhe mandākinītaṭe ..
guruḥ saṃprāpya taṃ mantraṃ śaṅkarācca jagadguroḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
तत्पुरश्चरणं ध्यानं शुद्धे मन्दाकिनीतटे ..
गुरुः संप्राप्य तं मन्त्रं शङ्कराच्च जगद्गुरोः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
its preliminary ritual, and the meditation on the pure bank of the Mandākinī.
Having obtained that mantra from Śaṅkara, the guru of the universe,

sanskrit_iast: viṣaṇṇo hi bhavābdhau ca babhūva tamuvāca ha .. 82 ..
meaning: विषण्णो हि भवाब्धौ च बभूव तमुवाच ह .. 82 ..
text_mt: the guru became despondent in the ocean of worldly existence, and spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca ..
ājñāṃ kuru jagannātha yāmi taptuṃ harestapaḥ ..
tārā tiṣṭhatu tatraiva na tayā me prayojanam ..83..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच ..
आज्ञां कुरु जगन्नाथ यामि तप्तुं हरेस्तपः ..
तारा तिष्ठतु तत्रैव न तया मे प्रयोजनम् ..83..
text_mt:
"Give your command, O Lord of the Universe; I go to perform penance to Hari.
Let Tārā remain right there; I have no use for her.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāmi viṣatulyaṃ ca sarvaṃ naśvaramīśvara ..
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi satyaṃ nityaṃ ca nirguṇam..84..
meaning:
पश्यामि विषतुल्यं च सर्वं नश्वरमीश्वर ..
श्रीकृष्णं शरणं यामि सत्यं नित्यं च निर्गुणम्..84..
text_mt:
I see everything as perishable and like poison, O Lord.
I seek refuge with Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the true, eternal, and free of gunas."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
paragrastāṃ striyaṃ tyaktvā na praśaṃsyaṃ tapo mune ..
sambhāvitasya duścarccā maraṇādatiricyate .. 85 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
परग्रस्तां स्त्रियं त्यक्त्वा न प्रशंस्यं तपो मुने ..
सम्भावितस्य दुश्चर्च्चा मरणादतिरिच्यते .. 85 ..
text_mt:
"Penance performed after abandoning a wife who has been seized by another is not praiseworthy, O sage.
For an esteemed person, dishonour is worse than death.

sanskrit_iast:
puro gaccha mahābhāga tametaṃ narmadātaṭam ..
yatra brahmādayo devāstatrāhaṃ yāmi satvaram ..86..
meaning:
पुरो गच्छ महाभाग तमेतं नर्मदातटम् ..
यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवास्तत्राहं यामि सत्वरम् ..86..
text_mt:
Go ahead, O fortunate one, to that bank of the Narmadā;
where the gods headed by Brahmā are, there I will go quickly."

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yayau suraguruḥ svayam ..
āyayau ca mahābhāgaḥ śaṅkaro narmadātaṭam .. 87 ..
meaning:
शिवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा ययौ सुरगुरुः स्वयम् ..
आययौ च महाभागः शङ्करो नर्मदातटम् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the words of Śiva, the guru of the gods himself went;
and the illustrious Śaṅkara arrived at the bank of the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
sagaṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam ..
praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvā manavo munayastathā .. 88 ..
meaning:
सगणं शङ्करं दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणम् ..
प्रणेमुर्देवताः सर्वा मनवो मुनयस्तथा .. 88 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Śaṅkara accompanied by his retinue, with cheerful face and eyes,
all the deities, the Manus, and the sages bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
nanāma śambhuḥ śirasā viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam ..
dadau viṣṇurmaheśāya premṇā''liṅganamāsanam .. 89 ..
meaning:
ननाम शम्भुः शिरसा विष्णुं च कमलोद्भवम् ..
ददौ विष्णुर्महेशाय प्रेम्णा'ऽलिङ्गनमासनम् .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Śambhu bowed his head to Viṣṇu and the Lotus-born [Brahmā].
Viṣṇu affectionately offered Maheśa an embrace and a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra cāgamacca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
praṇanāma mahādevaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam .. 2.60.90 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र चागमच्च बृहस्पतिः ..
प्रणनाम महादेवं विष्णुं च कमलोद्भवम् .. 2.60.90 ..
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Bṛhaspati arrived there.
He bowed down to Mahādeva, Viṣṇu, and the Lotus-born [Brahmā],

sanskrit_iast:
sūryyaṃ dharmamanantaṃ ca naraṃ māṃ ca munīśvarān ..
svaguruṃ pitaraṃ bhaktyā cāvasattatra saṃsadi .. 91 ..
meaning:
सूर्य्यं धर्ममनन्तं च नरं मां च मुनीश्वरान् ..
स्वगुरुं पितरं भक्त्या चावसत्तत्र संसदि .. 91 ..
text_mt:
to Sūrya, Dharma, Ananta, Nara, me, and the lords of sages,
and to his own guru and father with devotion, and sat down there in the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
sañcintya manasā yuktimūce tatra ca saṃsadi ..
svayaṃ viṣṇuśca bhagavānbrahmāṇaṃ candraśekharam ..92..
meaning:
सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा युक्तिमूचे तत्र च संसदि ..
स्वयं विष्णुश्च भगवान्ब्रह्माणं चन्द्रशेखरम् ..92..
text_mt:
Deliberating in his mind on a suitable plan, there in the assembly
the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu himself spoke to Brahmā and the moon-crested [Śiva]:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca..
yuvāṃ ca munayaścaiva samudrapulinaṃ drutam..
śukraṃ kañcicca madhyasthaṃ prasthāpayitumarhatha ..93..
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच..
युवां च मुनयश्चैव समुद्रपुलिनं द्रुतम्..
शुक्रं कञ्चिच्च मध्यस्थं प्रस्थापयितुमर्हथ ..93..
text_mt:
Both of you and the sages should quickly [go] to the seashore.
You ought to dispatch someone as an intermediary to Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
vigraheṇaiva viṣamaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ..
madāśiṣā suragurustārāṃ prāpsyati niścitam .. 94 ..
meaning:
विग्रहेणैव विषमं भविष्यति न संशयः ..
मदाशिषा सुरगुरुस्तारां प्राप्स्यति निश्चितम् .. 94 ..
text_mt:
Through conflict alone there will only be disaster; there is no doubt.
By my blessing, the preceptor of the gods will certainly regain Tārā.

sanskrit_iast:
suraiḥ stutaśca santuṣṭaḥ śukrācāryyo bhaviṣyati ..
suraiḥ śukro hi na jitaḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa rakṣitaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
सुरैः स्तुतश्च सन्तुष्टः शुक्राचार्य्यो भविष्यति ..
सुरैः शुक्रो हि न जितः कृष्णचक्रेण रक्षितः .. 95 ..
text_mt:
Pleased when praised by the gods, Śukrācārya will [relent].
Śukra cannot be conquered by the gods, for he is protected by Kṛṣṇa's discus.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvābhyāṃ prārthyamāno'haṃ yuvayoḥ stavanena ca ..
śvetadvīpādāgato'smi parituṣṭaḥ stavena ca .. 96 ..
meaning:
युवाभ्यां प्रार्थ्यमानोऽहं युवयोः स्तवनेन च ..
श्वेतद्वीपादागतोऽस्मि परितुष्टः स्तवेन च .. 96 ..
text_mt:
Supplicated by the two of you, and pleased by your hymn of praise,
I have come from Śvetadvīpa, fully satisfied by the hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
śukrāśramamasīparṇaṃ sarvā gacchantu devatāḥ ..
ripurbaliṣṭhaḥ stotreṇa vaśībhūta iti śrutiḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
शुक्राश्रममसीपर्णं सर्वा गच्छन्तु देवताः ..
रिपुर्बलिष्ठः स्तोत्रेण वशीभूत इति श्रुतिः .. 97 ..
text_mt:
Let all the deities go to Śukra's hermitage at Asīparṇa.
Tradition says that even a very powerful enemy is brought under control by a hymn of praise.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthastatraivāntara dhīyata ..
stuto brahmādibhidevaiḥ praṇataiḥ paripūjitaḥ ..98..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथस्तत्रैवान्तर धीयत ..
स्तुतो ब्रह्मादिभिदेवैः प्रणतैः परिपूजितः ..98..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds vanished right there,
praised by the gods headed by Brahmā, and worshipped by them as they bowed low.

sanskrit_iast:
gate ca jagatāṃ nāthe śvetadvīpaṃ ca nārada ..
cintitāśca surāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇamanasastathā .. 99 ..
meaning:
गते च जगतां नाथे श्वेतद्वीपं च नारद ..
चिन्तिताश्च सुराः सर्वे विषण्णमनसस्तथा .. 99 ..
text_mt:
And when the Lord of the worlds had departed for Śvetadvīpa, O Nārada,
all the gods were anxious, their minds dejected.

sanskrit_iast:
munīndevāṃśca saṃbodhya brahmā vai tatra saṃsadi ..
uvāca nītisāraṃ tatsammataṃ śaṅkarasya saḥ .. 2.60.100 ..
meaning:
मुनीन्देवांश्च संबोध्य ब्रह्मा वै तत्र संसदि ..
उवाच नीतिसारं तत्सम्मतं शङ्करस्य सः .. 2.60.100 ..
text_mt:
Addressing the sages and the gods there in that assembly,
Brahmā spoke the essence of wise counsel, which was approved by Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
mama śambhośca dharmasya viṣṇorvā sarvasākṣiṇaḥ ..
asmākaṃ ca samaḥ sneho daitye deve ca putrakāḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
मम शम्भोश्च धर्मस्य विष्णोर्वा सर्वसाक्षिणः ..
अस्माकं च समः स्नेहो दैत्ये देवे च पुत्रकाः .. 101 ..
text_mt:
For me, for Śambhu, for Dharma, and for Viṣṇu, who is witness to all—
our affection is equal toward Daitya and toward god, my sons!

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāṃ ca guruṃ śukraṃ prapannaśca niśākaraḥ ..
na jitaśca suraiḥ śukraḥ pūjito ditinandanaiḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
दैत्यानां च गुरुं शुक्रं प्रपन्नश्च निशाकरः ..
न जितश्च सुरैः शुक्रः पूजितो दितिनन्दनैः .. 102 ..
text_mt:
The Moon has sought refuge with Śukra, the guru of the Daityas;
and Śukra, revered by the sons of Diti, cannot be conquered by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāhetorahaṃ yāmi śukrasya bhavanaṃ surāḥ ..
sarve samudrapulinaṃ yāntu viṣṇornideśataḥ ..103..
meaning:
ताराहेतोरहं यामि शुक्रस्य भवनं सुराः ..
सर्वे समुद्रपुलिनं यान्तु विष्णोर्निदेशतः ..103..
text_mt:
For Tārā's sake I shall go to Śukra's dwelling, O gods!
Let everyone else go to the seashore according to Viṣṇu's command.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā cāgamacchukrasannidhim ..
prayayurdevatā viprāḥ samudrapulinaṃ mune.. .. 104 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता चागमच्छुक्रसन्निधिम् ..
प्रययुर्देवता विप्राः समुद्रपुलिनं मुने.. .. 104 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Creator of the worlds went into Śukra's presence;
and the deities and brāhmaṇas set out for the seashore, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
tataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūvāsuradevayoḥ ..
śrotumicchāmi bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
ततः परं किं रहस्यं बभूवासुरदेवयोः ..
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन्परं कौतूहलं मम .. 1 ..
text_mt: Nārada said: / What secret took place thereafter between the asura and the gods? / I wish to hear it, O Blessed One; my curiosity is great. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Brahmā went to the abode of high-souled Śukra, / crowded with various Daitya hosts and adorned with jewelled pavilions, / surrounded by five hundred million disciples who expound the Veda, / encircled by seven moats, an impassable fortress, / protected by hosts of guards and a billion Daityas, / adorned with defensive walls crafted from rubies. / The Creator of the worlds saw the son of Bhṛgu in his assembly, / praised by multitudes of sages and Daityas, seated on a jewelled throne, / reciting the name of Supreme Brahman, Kṛṣṇa, the Ātman, the Lord, / shining with the splendour of ten million suns, constantly ablaze with Vedic brilliance. / Seeing his radiant grandson, the Creator was delighted in his mind; / he considered himself accomplished in having such a son and grandson, O Nārada. / Seeing his grandfather, the Creator, the Lord of the worlds, / Śukra stood up at once in awe and bowed with folded hands. / Bringing offerings, he worshipped him with the sixteen articles of worship, / and praised him with supreme devotion and deference according to traditional injunctions, / [praising him as] the giver of knowledge and mantras, the bestower of all prosperity, / the dispenser of the fruits of their own deeds, the best of all throughout the universe. / Delighted indeed by Śukra's hymn of praise, the Lord of the worlds / quickly descended from his chariot and sat there in that assembly, / on an excellent jewelled throne offered with bowed head by Śukra, / blazing with splendour, delightful, fashioned by Viśvakarman. / Having bowed to Brahmā, Śukra bowed with folded hands in devotion / to Kumāra, Śakuna, Kratu, / Vasiṣṭha, Marīci, Sananda, Sanātana, / Kapila, Pañcaśikha, Voḍhu, Aṅgiras, O sage, / to Dharma, to me, and to Nara; / and with respect he worshipped each one as was appropriate.
title: Gurostārāprāptibudhotpattyādivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
brahmā jagāma nilayaṃ śukrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ..
nānādaityagaṇākīrṇaṃ ratnamaṇḍapabhūṣitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
ब्रह्मा जगाम निलयं शुक्रस्य च महात्मनः ..
नानादैत्यगणाकीर्णं रत्नमण्डपभूषितम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśatkoṭibhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parītaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ..
saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca veṣṭitaṃ durgameva ca .. 3..
meaning:
पञ्चाशत्कोटिभिः शिष्यैः परीतं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ..
सप्तभिः परिखाभिश्च वेष्टितं दुर्गमेव च .. 3..

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣitaṃ rakṣakagaṇairdaityaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ ..
padmarāgairviracitaiḥ prāvāraiḥ pariśobhitam .. 4 ..
meaning:
रक्षितं रक्षकगणैर्दैत्यैश्च शतकोटिभिः ..
पद्मरागैर्विरचितैः प्रावारैः परिशोभितम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa jagatāṃ dhātā sabhāyāṃ bhṛgunandanam ..
stutaṃ munigaṇairdaityai ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam .. 5 ..
meaning:
ददर्श जगतां धाता सभायां भृगुनन्दनम् ..
स्तुतं मुनिगणैर्दैत्यै रत्नसिंहासनस्थितम् .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ..
koṭisūryyaprabhaṃ śaśvajjvalantaṃ brahmatejasā .. 6 ..
meaning:
जपन्तं परमं ब्रह्म कृष्णमात्मानमीश्वरम् ..
कोटिसूर्य्यप्रभं शश्वज्ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā pautraṃ prabhāyuktaṃ vidhātā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
ātmānaṃ kṛtinaṃ mene putraṃ pautraṃ ca nārada .. 7 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पौत्रं प्रभायुक्तं विधाता हृष्टमानसः ..
आत्मानं कृतिनं मेने पुत्रं पौत्रं च नारद .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ śukro dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ prabhum ..
utthāya sahasā bhītaḥ praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पितामहं शुक्रो धातारं जगतां प्रभुम् ..
उत्थाय सहसा भीतः प्रणनाम कृताञ्जलिः .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ādāya pūjayāmāsa copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ..
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā sambhrameṇa yathāgamam .. 9 ..
meaning:
आदाय पूजयामास चोपचारांस्तु षोडश ..
तुष्टाव परया भक्त्या सम्भ्रमेण यथागमम् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā mantrapradātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ..
svakarmaṇāṃ ca phaladaṃ sarveṣāṃ viśvato varam .2.61.10..
meaning:
विद्या मन्त्रप्रदातारं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम् ..
स्वकर्मणां च फलदं सर्वेषां विश्वतो वरम् .2.61.10..

sanskrit_iast:
śukrasya stavanenaiva santuṣṭo jagatāṃ patiḥ..
avaruhya rathāttūrṇamavasattatra saṃsadi .. 11 ..
meaning:
शुक्रस्य स्तवनेनैव सन्तुष्टो जगतां पतिः..
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णमवसत्तत्र संसदि .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śukreṇa śirasā dattaratnasiṃhāsane vare..
tejasā jvalite ramye nirmite viśvakarmaṇā.. .. 12 ..
meaning:
शुक्रेण शिरसा दत्तरत्नसिंहासने वरे..
तेजसा ज्वलिते रम्ये निर्मिते विश्वकर्मणा.. .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śukraḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ kumāraṃ śakunaṃ kratum ..
vasiṣṭhaṃ ca marīciṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanam .. 13 ..
meaning:
शुक्रः प्रणम्य ब्रह्माणं कुमारं शकुनं क्रतुम् ..
वसिष्ठं च मरीचिं च सनन्दं च सनातनम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kapilaṃ vai pañcaśikhaṃ voḍhumaṃgirasaṃ mune ..
dharmaṃ māṃ ca naraṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ ..14..
meaning:
कपिलं वै पञ्चशिखं वोढुमंगिरसं मुने ..
धर्मं मां च नरं भक्त्या प्रणनाम कृताञ्जलिः ..14..

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca yathocitam ..
siṃhāsaneṣu ratneṣu vāsayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं पूजयामास सादरं च यथोचितम् ..
सिंहासनेषु रत्नेषु वासयामास धार्मिकः .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve praṇemurditinandanāḥ ..
ṛṣisaṃghāśca dhātāraṃ tuṣṭuvuśca yathāgamam .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रहृष्टवदनाः सर्वे प्रणेमुर्दितिनन्दनाः ..
ऋषिसंघाश्च धातारं तुष्टुवुश्च यथागमम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānsaṃstūya sa kaviravocatsampuṭāñjaliḥ ..
sāśrunetraḥ sapulakaḥ praṇato vinayānvitaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सर्वान्संस्तूय स कविरवोचत्सम्पुटाञ्जलिः ..
साश्रुनेत्रः सपुलकः प्रणतो विनयान्वितः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ..
svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavānsākṣāddṛṣṭaḥ svamandire .. 18 ..
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच ..
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् ..
स्वयं विधाता भगवान्साक्षाद्दृष्टः स्वमन्दिरे .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣāddṛṣṭāśca tatputrā bhagavantaḥ sanātanāḥ ..
tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo'tha māmevaṃ paramātmā parātparaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
āgacchantu surāḥ sarve sannaddhā raṇadurmadāḥ..

meaning:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

āgneyāstraṃ prayokṣyāmaḥ paścādyotsyāmahe prabho .. 39 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

वीरभद्रादयः शूराः कोटिसूर्य्यसमप्रभाः .. 45 ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
yasya pāśupatāstreṇa durnivāryeṇa putrakāḥ ..
bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavedviśvaṃ daityānāṃ caiva kā kathā ..48.
meaning:
यस्य पाशुपतास्त्रेण दुर्निवार्येण पुत्रकाः ..
भस्मीभूतं भवेद्विश्वं दैत्यानां चैव का कथा ..48.
text_mt: Her tongue, a krośa long, is exceedingly darting and fearsome. / Fierce and terrible are Śaṅkara’s attendants, ready for battle; / exceedingly terrible are the Bhairavas, and Nandī, fierce in combat. / All Śiva’s companions possess great strength and valour; / Vīrabhadra and other heroes shine like ten million suns. / To thousand-headed Śeṣa, whose circular hoods are an ornament, / the universe is like a single mustard seed; who can match him as a warrior? / Kālāgnirudra, the destroyer, is the servant of that Śambhu, / the trident-bearer, destroyer of Tripura, blazing with the splendour of Brahman. / By whose irresistible Pāśupata weapon, O children, / the whole universe could be reduced to ashes, let alone the Daityas?

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śūlena bhinnaśca śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān ..
sudāmā pārṣadavaraḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ..49..
meaning:
यस्य शूलेन भिन्नश्च शङ्खचूडः प्रतापवान् ..
सुदामा पार्षदवरः कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः..49..
text_mt: By whose trident glorious Śaṅkhacūḍa was pierced, / who was Sudāman, foremost attendant of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, / resplendent as thirty million suns, supremely wondrous, / wearing the Rādhākavaca around his neck, the ruler of all the Daitya folk. / He who was the slayer of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, and of Hiraṇyakaśipu— / that Lord Viṣṇu himself is coming from Śvetadvīpa. / Having spoken thus, the creator of the worlds fell silent in the assembly. / Laughing, the Daiteya, the sovereign of the Dānavas, spoke. / Prahrāda said: / Salutations to you, creator of the worlds, eternal lord of all! / You are worshiped by all, the lord of all; what can I say before you? / He who slew Hiraṇyakaśipu and Madhu and Kaiṭabha / is merely a part of Kṛṣṇa, who is the most complete [Lord]. / The discus named Sudarśana of that Inner Self of all / will quickly burn our world and us—it is irresistible. / Therefore Śambhu is not the strongest, nor is the Pāśupata [weapon], O Vidhi, / nor is Kālī, nor Śeṣa, nor the gods beginning with the Rudras. / He in whose bodily hairs all the worlds reside, O Lord of the universe, / of that omnipresent Lord who is the support of all, greater than the greatest, / that great Virāj is only a sixteenth portion of the Lord. / Ananta is not vast compared to him, nor is Kālī greater than he. / Let all the gods come; let them wage war right now! / I do not fear arrows, nor the Pāśupata weapon, nor Hara. / Homage to that Blessed One, Śiva, the embodiment of auspiciousness! / Homage to Ananta, to the saintly, and to the Vaiṣṇavas, O Prajāpati! / By the grace of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, I am fearless and free from affliction. / I do not rely on my own strength, O Brahman; whatever strength I have is the strength of the Lord. / My father died long ago by his own sin, from reviling Viṣṇu; / Śaṅkhacūḍa died from obstinacy, and Madhu and Kaiṭabha from arrogance. / Tripura was our servant; he is not even counted among the valiant heroes.

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

namastubhyaṃ jagaddhātaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāktaneśvara ..
sarvapūjyaḥ sarvanāthaḥ kiṃ vakṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:

नमस्तुभ्यं जगद्धातः सर्वेषां प्राक्तनेश्वर ..

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśiporhantā madhukaiṭabhayośca yaḥ ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

asmākaṃ lokamasmāṃśca taddrāgdhakṣyati dussaham .. 55 ..
meaning:

अस्माकं लोकमस्मांश्च तद्द्राग्धक्ष्यति दुस्सहम् .. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:

na ca kālī na śeṣaśca na ca rudrādayaḥ surāḥ .. 56 ..

sanskrit_iast:

āgacchantu surāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu sāmpratam ..
na bibhemi śarebhyaśca na ca pāśupatāddharāt .. 59 ..

text_mt: Even so, impelled by him, Maheśvara mounted his chariot.' / Having spoken thus, the foremost of Dānavas fell silent in the assembly, / and the creator of the worlds spoke once again, O Nārada: / Brahmā said: / 'War brings destruction to both the Daityas and the gods; / acting with great affection, my child, brings all auspiciousness. / Give Tārā as alms to me, to Brahmā the beggar; / when a beggar turns away disappointed, O King, the householder incurs all sins.' / Sanatkumāra said: / 'Protect your own fame, O best of kings! You are a lion among gods and Daityas. / When the creator of the worlds is his beggar, what need be said of his fame?' / Sanātana said: / 'You have not been conquered by the lords of gods led by Brahmā and Īśāna; / protected by Kṛṣṇa's discus, a Vaiṣṇava is pure and virtuous.' / Sanandana said: / 'He whose chosen deity is Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the soul of all, higher than Prakṛti, / and whose guru is the Vaiṣṇava Śukra—by whom could that great one be conquered?' / Sanaka said: / 'A virtuous man is conquered by no one; a sinner is conquered by his own sins. / The lamp of virtue is not blown out by the mere wind of an apostate.' / The ṛṣis said: / 'Give up Tārā, O fortunate one, who is dearer than life to the guru of Candra; / preserve your own fame forever; we implore you again and again.' / Prahrāda said: / 'While my master is present before me, a servant does not shine forth. / Speak to the doer, my lord, Guru Śukra, the best of the virtuous. / The guru is the master in lordship over disciples and over righteous men; / all our sovereignty was previously surrendered to the guru, O lord of sages. / We are servants, dependents, and attendants of our guru; / they are truly successful disciples who obey the command of their guru.' / Hearing the words of Prahrāda, [Brahmā] made a request to Śukra (Kavi); / and Śukra surrendered that Tārā, and also Candra who was subdued, O sage. / Having given Tārā and the moon, Śukra bowed at the feet of Brahmā;

text_mt: and bowing to the sages, humbled, he went to his own city. / Prahlāda, along with his retinue, bowed down with devotion at the feet of Brahmā / and to the assembly of sages individually, and, bowed low, went to his own abode. / Brahmā saw the chaste Tārā bowing at his feet, / her face bent down with shame, weeping, and pregnant, O sage. / Placing the prostrate Candra in his lap through illusory power, / the compassionate Creator said to the pale, distressed Tārā: / 'O Tārā, cast away your fear from me; why fear when I am here? / Blessed with good fortune with your own husband you shall be, by my boon. / A weak woman seized by a strong man, being free from desire, is not fallen; / purified by an expiation, a woman is not defiled by a lover. / But she who, lustful, consorts with a lover out of passion for her own pleasure, / is not purified by expiation; she is abandoned by her husband. / She is boiled in the Kumbhīpāka hell as long as the moon and the sun endure; / her food is feces, her water urine, and her touch brings all sin. / He who is a sinner, and she [who sins], is shunned by the righteous. / Tell me, auspicious one, whose child is in your womb? Go to the house of your guru, my child. / Cast off your shame, highly fortunate lady; everything happens from past deeds.' / Hearing the words of Brahmā, the chaste woman then spoke to him: / 'O father, through my own karma I bear the womb of Candra today. / All are my witnesses, O Prajāpati, as I was helpless / when the merciless, evil-minded Candra seized me.' / Having spoken thus, the goddess Tārakā gave birth / to a handsome boy of golden splendour, blazing with the radiance of Brahman. / Taking the son, Candra bowed to the lord Brahmā / and went to his own abode; and Brahmā went to the ocean shore. / He returned the chaste Tārā to her guru, and granted fearlessness to the gods; / and having bestowed blessings upon Śambhu and Dharma, Brahmā departed to his realm.

text_mt: The gods went to their own abodes, and Bṛhaspati went to his own house, / his mind rejoiced on receiving back his wife devoted in affection. / Born from the womb of Tārakā, he was none other than Budha himself, / a splendid and auspicious planet, O sage, the great son of Candra. / He, meeting Citrā in the solitary Nandana forest— / her who was born from the womb of Ghṛtācī by the seed of Kubera— / and seeing that charming, lotus-eyed maiden in the wilderness, / a sixteen-year-old girl in the full bloom of youth, / the son of the moon took her by the gāndharva form of marriage. / Then, in secret, he deposited his seed in her; / and a king named Caitra, a lord of the domain, was born to Citrā. / Righteous and mighty, he ruled the earth endowed with seven continents. / A hundred rivers of clarified butter, and hundreds of rivers of curds, / hundreds of rivers of milk, and sixteen rivers of honey, / ten rivers of oil, and hundreds of thousands of heaps of sugar, / hundreds of thousands of mounds of sweets and svastika-cakes were daily [provided by him], / along with the flesh of fifty million cattle, together with cakes and delicious food.

sanskrit_iast:

gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ maṇīnāṃ lakṣameva ca .. 99 ..
meaning:
एतेषां च नदीराशीर्भुञ्जते ब्राह्मणा मुने ..
गवां लक्षं च रत्नानां मणीनां लक्षमेव च .. 99 ..
text_mt:
And brāhmaṇas enjoyed whole heaps of these [treasures], like rivers, O sage: / a hundred thousand cows, a hundred thousand jewels and gems, / a crore of gold pieces, and a hundred thousand fine garments; / ornaments set with gems, and vessels most delightful to the mind, / the king gave to the twice-born daily throughout his life. / The son of that Caitra was King Adhiratha; / and his son was Suratha, an emperor of wide renown. / Having obtained the supreme knowledge from Medhas, best of sages, / he formerly worshipped Viṣṇumāyā in the sacred field of Bhārata. / In the autumn season he performed a great worship on a riverbank, / together with a vaiśya, O best of sages among the wise. / Virādha, king of the Kaliṅga country and best of merchants, / had a son, the great yogin Drumiṇa, best among the wise. / Drumiṇa was a wise Vaiṣṇava; having performed austere penance at Puṣkara, / he entered absorption, the foremost of Vaiṣṇavas among the wise. / Cast out by his sons and wives, wicked souls greedy for wealth, / he gave a crore of gold daily and only then drank water. / Having worshipped eternal Viṣṇumāyā, he attained liberation; / and the king obtained the position of Manu and an undisputed kingdom, O sage. / The Creator, lord of the three worlds, spoke sweet words.
Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Recovery of the Guru’s Tārā, the Birth of Budha, and Other Matters' in the Durgā Episode in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the second part, the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, in the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa tatra vaiśyaṃ ca puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

bahirbhūtaḥ svarājyācca nandinā balinā'dhunā .. .. 11 ..

बहिर्भूतः स्वराज्याच्च नन्दिना बलिनाऽधुना .. .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:

tanmāṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāmeva śaraṇāgatam .. 12 ..
meaning:
किमुपायं करिष्यामि कथं राज्यं भवेन्मम ..
तन्मां ब्रूहि महाभाग त्वामेव शरणागतम् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
अयं वैश्यः समाधिश्च स्वगृहाच्च बहिष्कृतः ..
पुत्रैः कलत्रैर्दैवेन धनलोभेन धार्मिकः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
ब्राह्मणाय ददौ नित्यं रत्नकोटिं दिने दिने ..
निषिद्ध्यमानः पुत्रैश्च कलत्रैर्बान्धवैरयम् .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:

ayaṃ gṛhaṃ ca na yayau virakto jñānavāñchuciḥ.. 15 ..
meaning:
कोपान्निराकृतस्तैश्च पुनरन्वेषितः शुचा ..
अयं गृहं च न ययौ विरक्तो ज्ञानवाञ्छुचिः.. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
putrāśca pitṛśokena gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yayurvanam ..

पुत्राश्च पितृशोकेन गृहं त्यक्त्वा ययुर्वनम् ..
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो विरक्ताः सर्वकर्मसु .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhaṃ harerdāsyaṃ vaiśyasyāsya ca vāñchitam ..
kathaṃ prāpnoti niṣkāmastanme vyākhyātumarhasi .. 17 ..
meaning:
सुदुर्लभं हरेर्दास्यं वैश्यस्यास्य च वाञ्छितम् ..
कथं प्राप्नोति निष्कामस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:

karoti māyayā cchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā duratyayā ..
nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya triguṇā viśvamājñayā .. 18 ..
meaning:
श्रीमेधा उवाच ..
करोति मायया च्छन्नं विष्णुमाया दुरत्यया ..
निर्गुणस्य च कृष्णस्य त्रिगुणा विश्वमाज्ञया .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ karoti yeṣāṃ sā dharmiṇāṃ ca kṛpāmayī ..
tebhyo dadāti kṛpayā kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām .. 19 ..
meaning:
कृपां करोति येषां सा धर्मिणां च कृपामयी ..
तेभ्यो ददाति कृपया कृष्णभक्तिं सुदुर्लभाम् .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ māyāvināṃ māyā na karoti kṛpāṃ nṛpa ..
māyayā tānnibadhnāti mohajālena durgatān .. 2.62.20 ..
meaning:
येषां मायाविनां माया न करोति कृपां नृप ..
मायया तान्निबध्नाति मोहजालेन दुर्गतान् .. 2.62.20 ..
text_mt:
Those deceitful ones upon whom Māyā does not show mercy, O king,
she binds by her illusion, those unfortunate souls caught in the snare of delusion. (20)

sanskrit_iast:
naśvare'nityasaṃsāre bhrāmayedbarbarā sadā ..
kurvantī nityabuddhiṃ ca vihāya parameśvaram .. 21 ..
meaning:
नश्वरेऽनित्यसंसारे भ्रामयेद्बर्बरा सदा ..
कुर्वन्ती नित्यबुद्धिं च विहाय परमेश्वरम् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
She causes fools to wander continuously in the transient, perishable world of transmigration,
imparting to them a notion of permanence, having abandoned the Supreme Lord. (21)

sanskrit_iast:
devamanyaṃ niṣevante tanmantraṃ ca japaṃti ca ..
mithyā kiñcinnimittaṃ ca kṛtvā manasi lobhataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
देवमन्यं निषेवन्ते तन्मन्त्रं च जपंति च ..
मिथ्या किञ्चिन्निमित्तं च कृत्वा मनसि लोभतः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
They worship other gods and repeat their mantras,
conceiving some false purpose in mind out of greed. (22)

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmasu saṃsevya devatāśca hareḥ kalāḥ ..
tadā prakṛtyā kṛpayā sevante prakṛtiṃ tadā .. 23 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मसु संसेव्य देवताश्च हरेः कलाः ..
तदा प्रकृत्या कृपया सेवन्ते प्रकृतिं तदा .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Having served for seven lifetimes the deities who are parts of Hari,
they then, by the grace of Prakṛti, worship Prakṛti. (23)

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmasu saṃsevya viṣṇumāyāṃ kṛpāmayīm ..
śive bhaktiṃ labhante te jñānānande sanātane .. 24 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मसु संसेव्य विष्णुमायां कृपामयीम् ..
शिवे भक्तिं लभन्ते ते ज्ञानानन्दे सनातने .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Having served compassionate Viṣṇumāyā for seven lifetimes,
they obtain devotion to Śiva, who is eternal and consists of the bliss of knowledge. (24)

sanskrit_iast:
jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevaṃ ca haressaṃsevya śaṅkaram ..
acirādviṣṇubhaktiṃ ca prāpnuvanti maheśvarāt .. 25 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानाधिष्ठातृदेवं च हरेस्संसेव्य शङ्करम् ..
अचिराद्विष्णुभक्तिं च प्राप्नुवन्ति महेश्वरात् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Having worshipped Śaṅkara, the presiding deity of knowledge and [the beloved] of Hari,
they soon obtain devotion to Viṣṇu from Maheśvara. (25)

sanskrit_iast:
sevante saguṇaṃ sattvaṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣayiṇaṃ tadā ..
sattvajñānācca paśyanti jñānaṃ vai nirmalaṃ narāḥ .. .. 26 ..
meaning:
सेवन्ते सगुणं सत्त्वं विष्णुं विषयिणं तदा ..
सत्त्वज्ञानाच्च पश्यन्ति ज्ञानं वै निर्मलं नराः .. .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Then men worship Viṣṇu with attributes, who is pure sattva and concerned with mundane affairs;
and through knowledge born of sattva, men perceive pure knowledge. (26)

sanskrit_iast:
niṣevya saguṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sāttvikā vaiṣṇavā narāḥ ..
labhante nirguṇe bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe prakṛteḥ pare .. 27 ..
meaning:
निषेव्य सगुणं विष्णुं सात्त्विका वैष्णवा नराः ..
लभन्ते निर्गुणे भक्तिं श्रीकृष्णे प्रकृतेः परे .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Having worshipped Viṣṇu with attributes, those sāttvika Vaiṣṇava men
obtain devotion to the attribute-less Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is beyond Prakṛti. (27)

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhṇanti santastadbhaktā mantraṃ tasya nirāmayam ..
niṣevya nirguṇaṃ devaṃ te bhavanti ca nirguṇāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
गृह्णन्ति सन्तस्तद्भक्ता मन्त्रं तस्य निरामयम् ..
निषेव्य निर्गुणं देवं ते भवन्ति च निर्गुणाः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
The virtuous, his devotees, receive his faultless mantra.
Serving the God beyond the gunas, they too become beyond the gunas.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ te ca paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ..
dāsyaṃ kurvanti satataṃ goloke ca nirāmaye .. 29 ..
meaning:
असंख्यब्रह्मणां पातं ते च पश्यन्ति वैष्णवाः ..
दास्यं कुर्वन्ति सततं गोलोके च निरामये .. 29 ..
text_mt: Those Vaiṣṇavas witness the fall of countless Brahmās,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇabhaktātkṛṣṇamantraṃ yo gṛhṇāti narottamaḥ ..
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca svapitṝṇāṃ samuddharet .. 2.62.30 ..
meaning:
कृष्णभक्तात्कृष्णमन्त्रं यो गृह्णाति नरोत्तमः ..
पुरुषाणां सहस्रं च स्वपितॄणां समुद्धरेत् .. 2.62.30 ..
text_mt:
That best among men who receives the mantra of Kṛṣṇa from a devotee of Kṛṣṇa
delivers a thousand generations of his ancestors;

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānāṃ sāhasramuddharenmātaraṃ tathā ..
dāsādikaṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ sa prayāti ca .. 31 ..
meaning:
मातामहानां साहस्रमुद्धरेन्मातरं तथा ..
दासादिकं समुद्धृत्य गोलोकं स प्रयाति च .. 31 ..
text_mt:
likewise, he delivers a thousand generations of maternal grandfathers, as well as his mother.
Having delivered his servants and the rest, he goes to Goloka.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavārṇave mahāghore karṇadhārasvarūpiṇī ..
dīnānpārayate nityaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktyā ca naukayā .. 32 ..
meaning:
भवार्णवे महाघोरे कर्णधारस्वरूपिणी ..
दीनान्पारयते नित्यं कृष्णभक्त्या च नौकया .. 32 ..
text_mt:
She, who has the nature of a helmsman in the dreadful ocean of existence,
ever ferries the wretched across on the boat of devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmabandhanaṃ chettuṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī ..
tīkṣṇaśastrasvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्वकर्मबन्धनं छेत्तुं वैष्णवानां च वैष्णवी ..
तीक्ष्णशस्त्रस्वरूपा सा कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
To cut the bondage of their own karma for the Vaiṣṇavas, she is the Vaiṣṇavī power,
an embodiment of the sharp weapon of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

sanskrit_iast:
vivecikā cāvaraṇī śakteḥ śaktirdvidhā nṛpa ..
pūrvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya cetarāya parātparā .. 34 ..
meaning:
विवेचिका चावरणी शक्तेः शक्तिर्द्विधा नृप ..
पूर्वं ददाति भक्ताय चेतराय परात्परा .. 34 ..
text_mt:
O King, the power of [this] power is twofold: discriminating and veiling.
The higher than the high gives the former to the devotee, and [the latter] to the other.

sanskrit_iast:
satyasvarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastasmātsarvaṃ ca naśvaram ..
buddhirviveciketyevaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sanātanī .. 35 ..
meaning:
सत्यस्वरूपः श्रीकृष्णस्तस्मात्सर्वं च नश्वरम् ..
बुद्धिर्विवेचिकेत्येवं वैष्णवानां सनातनी .. 35 ..
text_mt:
‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the embodiment of truth; everything else is perishable’—
such is the discriminating, eternal understanding of the Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
nityarūpā mameyaṃ śrīriti cāvaraṇī ca dhīḥ ..
avaiṣṇavānāmasatāṃ karmmabhogabhujāmaho .. 36 ..
meaning:
नित्यरूपा ममेयं श्रीरिति चावरणी च धीः ..
अवैष्णवानामसतां कर्म्मभोगभुजामहो .. 36 ..
text_mt:
‘This prosperity of mine is eternal in nature’—such is the veiling intellect
of non-Vaiṣṇavas, the wicked who consume the experience of their karma. Ah!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ pracetasaḥ putraḥ pautraśca brahmaṇo nṛpa ..
bhajāmi kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ jñānaṃ saṃprāpya śaṅkarāt .. 37 ..
meaning:
अहं प्रचेतसः पुत्रः पौत्रश्च ब्रह्मणो नृप ..
भजामि कृष्णमात्मानं ज्ञानं संप्राप्य शङ्करात् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
I am the son of Pracetas and the grandson of Brahmā, O King.
Having obtained knowledge from Śaṅkara, I worship Kṛṣṇa, the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha rājannadītīraṃ bhaja durgāṃ sanātanīm ..
buddhimāvaraṇīṃ tubhyaṃ devo dāsyati kāmine .. 38 ..
meaning:
गच्छ राजन्नदीतीरं भज दुर्गां सनातनीम् ..
बुद्धिमावरणीं तुभ्यं देवो दास्यति कामिने .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Go, O King, to the riverbank and worship eternal Durgā.
To you, full of desire, the deity will grant the veiling intellect;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkāmāya ca vaiśyāya vaiṣṇavāya ca vaiṣṇavī ..
buddhiṃ vivecikāṃ śuddhāṃ dāsyatyeva kṛpāmayī.. 39..
meaning:
निष्कामाय च वैश्याय वैष्णवाय च वैष्णवी ..
बुद्धिं विवेचिकां शुद्धां दास्यत्येव कृपामयी.. 39..
text_mt:
while to the desireless merchant, a Vaiṣṇava, the Vaiṣṇavī power,
full of compassion, will indeed grant pure, discriminating intellect.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho dadau tābhyāṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ..
pūjāvidhānaṃ durgāyāḥ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum .. .. 2.62.40 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च मुनिश्रेष्ठो ददौ ताभ्यां कृपानिधिः ..
पूजाविधानं दुर्गायाः स्तोत्रं च कवचं मनुम् .. .. 2.62.40 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the best of sages, a treasure of compassion, gave to both of them
the ritual of worship of Durgā, her hymn of praise, armour, and mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyo muktiṃ ca saṃprāpa tāṃ niṣevya kṛpāmayīm ..
rājā rājyaṃ manutvaṃ ca paramaiśvaryyamīpsitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
वैश्यो मुक्तिं च संप्राप तां निषेव्य कृपामयीम् ..
राजा राज्यं मनुत्वं च परमैश्वर्य्यमीप्सितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Having served that compassionate one, the merchant attained liberation,
and the king attained his kingdom, status as a Manu, and desired supreme sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ durgopākhyānamuttamam ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 42 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं दुर्गोपाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 42 ..
text_mt: Thus the entire supreme episode of Durgā has been told,

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛti
khaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne surathamedhassaṃvāde surathavaiśyayorabhilaṣitasiddhirnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्त्ते महापुराणे द्वितीये प्रकृति
खण्डे नारदनारायणसंवादे दुर्गोपाख्याने सुरथमेधस्संवादे सुरथवैश्ययोरभिलषितसिद्धिर्नाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 62 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, named “The Attainment of Desires of Suratha and the Merchant,” in the episode of Durgā during the dialogue of Nārada and Nārāyaṇa in the second book, the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, of the great Purāṇa, the Śrī Brahmavaivarta.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vada vedavidāṃ vara ..
rājā kena prakāreṇa siṣeve prakṛtiṃ parām .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
नारायण महाभाग वद वेदविदां वर ..
राजा केन प्रकारेण सिषेवे प्रकृतिं पराम् .. 1 ..
title: Prakṛtivaiśyasaṃvādakathanam

sanskrit_iast:
samādhirnāma vaiśyo vā niṣkāmaṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum ..
bheje kena prakāreṇa prakṛterupadeśataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
समाधिर्नाम वैश्यो वा निष्कामं निर्गुणं विभुम् ..
भेजे केन प्रकारेण प्रकृतेरुपदेशतः .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ vā manureva ca ..
kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ vā dadau rājñe mahāmuniḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
किं वा पूजाविधानं च ध्यानं वा मनुरेव च ..
किं स्तोत्रं कवचं किं वा ददौ राज्ञे महामुनिः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyāya prakṛtistasmai kiṃ vā jñānaṃ dadau param ..
sākṣādbabhūva sahasā kena vā prakṛtistayoḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
वैश्याय प्रकृतिस्तस्मै किं वा ज्ञानं ददौ परम् ..
साक्षाद्बभूव सहसा केन वा प्रकृतिस्तयोः .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ saṃprāpya vaiśyaśca kiṃ padaṃ prāpa durlabham ..
gatirbabhūva rājñaśca kā vā tāṃ ca śṛṇomyaham .. 5 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानं संप्राप्य वैश्यश्च किं पदं प्राप दुर्लभम् ..
गतिर्बभूव राज्ञश्च का वा तां च शृणोम्यहम् .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
rājā vaiśyaśca saṃprāpya mantraṃ vai medhaso muneḥ ..
stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ devyā dhyānaṃ caiva puraskriyām ..
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ rājā vaiśyaśca puṣkare .. 6 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
राजा वैश्यश्च संप्राप्य मन्त्रं वै मेधसो मुनेः ..
स्तोत्रं च कवचं देव्या ध्यानं चैव पुरस्क्रियाम् ..
जजाप परमं मन्त्रं राजा वैश्यश्च पुष्करे .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā trikālaṃ varṣaṃ ca tataḥ śuddho babhūva saḥ ..
sākṣādbabhūva tatraiva mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्नात्वा त्रिकालं वर्षं च ततः शुद्धो बभूव सः ..
साक्षाद्बभूव तत्रैव मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājñe dadau rājyavaraṃ manutvaṃ vāñchitaṃ sukham ..
jñānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vaiśyāya dadau cātisudurlabham .. 8 ..
meaning:
राज्ञे ददौ राज्यवरं मनुत्वं वाञ्छितं सुखम् ..
ज्ञानं निगूढं वैश्याय ददौ चातिसुदुर्लभम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattaṃ śūline pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ..
nirāhāramatikliṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaiśyaṃ kṛpāmayī ..9 ..
meaning:
यद्दत्तं शूलिने पूर्वं कृष्णेन परमात्मना ..
निराहारमतिक्लिष्टं दृष्ट्वा वैश्यं कृपामयी ..9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda kṛtvā kroḍe tamaceṣṭaṃ śvāsavarjitam ..
cetanāṃ kuru bho vatsetyuccāryya ca punaḥ punaḥ ..2.63.10..
meaning:
रुरोद कृत्वा क्रोडे तमचेष्टं श्वासवर्जितम् ..
चेतनां कुरु भो वत्सेत्युच्चार्य्य च पुनः पुनः ..2.63.10..

sanskrit_iast:
cetanāṃ ca dadau tasmai svayaṃ caitanyarūpiṇī ..
saṃprāpya cetanāṃ vaiśyo ruroda prakṛteḥ puraḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
चेतनां च ददौ तस्मै स्वयं चैतन्यरूपिणी ..
संप्राप्य चेतनां वैश्यो रुरोद प्रकृतेः पुरः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast: tamuvāca prasannā'sau kṛpayā'tikṛpāmayī .. 12 ..
meaning: तमुवाच प्रसन्नाऽसौ कृपयाऽतिकृपामयी .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprakṛtiruvāca ..
