स्तोतुं तद्वर्णितुमहं शक्तः किं स्तौमि तत्परः ..97..
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
ज्ञानाधिष्ठातृदेवोऽहं स्तौमि ज्ञानपरं च किम् ..
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं तं त्वां च स्वेच्छामयं विभुम् .. 98 ..
धर्म उवाच ..
अदृश्यमवतारेषु यद्दृश्यं सर्वजन्तुभिः ..
किं स्तौमि तेजोरूपं तद्भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् .. 99 ..
text_mt:
the refuge of all, enveloped by hosts, vast and circular in form.
And seeing that [mass of light] of the Lord, they praised him in succession. // 95
"All the cosmic eggs abide in the pores of whose bodily hair—
he, the great Virāj, is merely a sixteenth part of you; who then are we? // 96 //"
"O Lord, I am capable of seeing, praising, and describing
that which is visible and fit for the Veda before my eyes; how can I praise that which is beyond?" // 97
"I am the presiding deity of knowledge; how can I praise what is beyond knowledge,
you who are entirely indescribable, the all-pervading Lord whose form is his own will?" // 98
"Though invisible, you become visible to all creatures in your incarnations;
how can I praise that form of light, a manifestation assumed out of grace to devotees?" // 99

sanskrit_iast:
devā ucuḥ ..
ke vayaṃ tvatkalāṃśāśca kiṃ vā tvāṃ stotumīśvarāḥ ..
stotuṃ na śaktā vedā yaṃ na ca śaktā sarasvatī .. 100 ..
meaning:
देवा उचुः ..
के वयं त्वत्कलांशाश्च किं वा त्वां स्तोतुमीश्वराः ..
स्तोतुं न शक्ता वेदा यं न च शक्ता सरस्वती .. 100 ..
text_mt:
"Who are we, who are merely fractions of your parts, and how are we able to praise you,
whom the Vedas are not able to praise, nor is Sarasvatī capable of praising?" // 100

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ucuḥ ..
vedānpaṭhitvā vidvāṃso vayaṃ kiṃ vedakāraṇam ..
stotumīśā na vāṇī ca tvāṃ vāṅmanasayoḥ param .. 101 ..
meaning:
मुनय उचुः ..
वेदान्पठित्वा विद्वांसो वयं किं वेदकारणम् ..
स्तोतुमीशा न वाणी च त्वां वाङ्मनसयोः परम् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
"We are learned from studying the Vedas; how can we praise the cause of the Vedas?
Even speech is not able [to praise] you, who are beyond speech and mind." // 101

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyuvāca ..
vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ māṃ vadante vedavādinaḥ ..
kiñcinna śaktā tvāṃ stotumaho vāṅmanasoḥ param .. 102 ..
meaning:
सरस्वत्युवाच ..
वागधिष्ठातृदेवीं मां वदन्ते वेदवादिनः ..
किञ्चिन्न शक्ता त्वां स्तोतुमहो वाङ्मनसोः परम् .. 102 ..
text_mt:
"Teachers of the Veda declare me to be the presiding goddess of speech;
alas, I am not capable of praising you in the least, who are beyond speech and mind!" // 102

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitryuvāca ..
vedaprasūrahaṃ nātha sṛṣṭvā tvatkalayā purā ..
kiṃ staumi strīsvabhāvena sarvakāraṇakāraṇam..103..
meaning:
सावित्र्युवाच ..
वेदप्रसूरहं नाथ सृष्ट्वा त्वत्कलया पुरा ..
किं स्तौमि स्त्रीस्वभावेन सर्वकारणकारणम्..103..
text_mt:
"O Lord, created of old by your part, I am the mother of the Vedas;
how can I praise the cause of all causes, given my female nature?" // 103

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīruvāca ..
tvadaṃśaviṣṇukāntāhaṃ jagatpoṣaṇakāriṇī..
kiṃ staumi tvatkalāsṛṣṭā jagatāṃ bījakāraṇam .. 104 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीरुवाच ..
त्वदंशविष्णुकान्ताहं जगत्पोषणकारिणी..
किं स्तौमि त्वत्कलासृष्टा जगतां बीजकारणम् .. 104 ..
text_mt:
"I am the beloved of Viṣṇu, who is your portion; I am the sustainer of the world.
Created by your part, how can I praise the seed and cause of the worlds?" // 104

sanskrit_iast:
himālaya uvāca ..
hasanti santo māṃ nātha karmaṇā sthāvaraṃ param..
stotuṃ samudyataṃ kṣudraḥ kiṃ staumi stotumakṣamaḥ .. 105 ..
meaning:
हिमालय उवाच ..
हसन्ति सन्तो मां नाथ कर्मणा स्थावरं परम्..
स्तोतुं समुद्यतं क्षुद्रः किं स्तौमि स्तोतुमक्षमः .. 105 ..
text_mt:
"O Lord, the virtuous laugh at me, who am utterly immobile by my actions;
how can I, insignificant and unable to praise, venture to praise [you]?" // 105

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa sarve taṃ stutvā devā viraramurmune ..
devyaśca munayaḥ sarve pārvatī stotumudyatā .. 106 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण सर्वे तं स्तुत्वा देवा विररमुर्मुने ..
देव्यश्च मुनयः सर्वे पार्वती स्तोतुमुद्यता .. 106 ..
text_mt:
Having praised him in order, all the gods ceased, O sage,
as did the goddesses and all the sages; then Pārvatī prepared to praise him. // 106

sanskrit_iast:
dhautavastrā jaṭābhāraṃ bibhratī suvratā vrate ..
preritā paramātmānaṃ vratārādhyaṃ śivena ca ..107..
meaning:
धौतवस्त्रा जटाभारं बिभ्रती सुव्रता व्रते ..
प्रेरिता परमात्मानं व्रताराध्यं शिवेन च ..107..
text_mt:
Wearing clean garments, bearing a mass of matted locks, faithful to her vows during the rite,
prompted by Śiva toward the Paramātman who was the object of worship in the vow, // 107

sanskrit_iast:
jvaladagniśikhārūpā tejomūrtimatī satī ..
tapasāṃ phaladā mātā jagatāṃ sarvakarmaṇām .. 108 ..
meaning:
ज्वलदग्निशिखारूपा तेजोमूर्तिमती सती ..
तपसां फलदा माता जगतां सर्वकर्मणाम् .. 108 ..
text_mt:
having the form of a blazing flame of fire, the virtuous woman, the embodiment of radiance,
bestower of the fruits of austerities and of all actions, the mother of the worlds. // 108

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
kṛṣṇa jānāsi māṃ bhadraṃ nāhaṃ tvāṃ jñātumīśvarī ..
ke vā jānanti vedajñā vedā vā vedakārakāḥ ..109..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
कृष्ण जानासि मां भद्रं नाहं त्वां ज्ञातुमीश्वरी ..
के वा जानन्ति वेदज्ञा वेदा वा वेदकारकाः ..109..
text_mt:
"O Kṛṣṇa, you know me, O auspicious one; I am not able to know you.
Who indeed among the knowers of the Vedas knows You, or the Vedas, or the makers of the Vedas?

sanskrit_iast:
tvadaṃśāstvāṃ na jānanti kathaṃ jñāsyanti te kalāḥ..
tvaṃ cāpi tattvaṃ jānāsi kimanye jñātumīśvarāḥ .. 110 ..
meaning:
त्वदंशास्त्वां न जानन्ति कथं ज्ञास्यन्ति ते कलाः..
त्वं चापि तत्त्वं जानासि किमन्ये ज्ञातुमीश्वराः .. 110 ..
text_mt:
Those who are Your portions do not know You; how then shall their parts know?
Even You alone know Your essential truth; who else has the power to know?

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamo'vyaktaḥ sthūlātsthūlatamo mahān ..
viśvastvaṃ viśvarūpaśca viśvabījaṃ sanātanaḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतमोऽव्यक्तः स्थूलात्स्थूलतमो महान् ..
विश्वस्त्वं विश्वरूपश्च विश्वबीजं सनातनः .. 111 ..
text_mt:
Subtler than the subtlest, unmanifest, grosser than the grossest, great,
You are the universe, of universal form, the eternal seed of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryyaṃ tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ..
tejassvarūpo bhagavānnirākāro nirāśrayaḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
कार्य्यं त्वं कारणं त्वं च कारणानां च कारणम् ..
तेजस्स्वरूपो भगवान्निराकारो निराश्रयः .. 112 ..
text_mt:
You are the effect, You are the cause, and the cause of all causes.
The Lord whose essential nature is splendour, formless, without support,

sanskrit_iast:
nirlipto nirguṇaḥ sākṣī svātmārāmaḥ parātparaḥ ..
prakṛtīśo virāḍbījaṃ virāḍrūpastvameva ca ..
saguṇastvaṃ prākṛtikaḥ kalayā sṛṣṭihetave .. 113 ..
meaning:
निर्लिप्तो निर्गुणः साक्षी स्वात्मारामः परात्परः ..
प्रकृतीशो विराड्बीजं विराड्रूपस्त्वमेव च ..
सगुणस्त्वं प्राकृतिकः कलया सृष्टिहेतवे .. 113 ..
text_mt:
Untainted, devoid of gunas, the witness, delighting in the self, higher than the highest,
The Lord of Prakṛti, the seed of Virāj, and Yourself the form of Virāj.
With gunas You become natural through a part, for the sake of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtistvaṃ pumāṃstvaṃ ca vedā'nyo na kvacidbhavet ..
jīvastvaṃ sākṣiṇo bhogī svātmanaḥ pratibimbakam .. 114 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमांस्त्वं च वेदाऽन्यो न क्वचिद्भवेत् ..
जीवस्त्वं साक्षिणो भोगी स्वात्मनः प्रतिबिम्बकम् .. 114 ..
text_mt:
You are Prakṛti, You are the Spirit, and [I] know nothing else anywhere exists.
You are the individual soul, the witness, the experiencer, the reflection of Your own self.

sanskrit_iast:
karma tvaṃ karmabījaṃ tvaṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakaḥ ..
dhyāyanti yoginastejastvadīyamaśarīri yat ..
keciccaturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam .. 115 ..
meaning:
कर्म त्वं कर्मबीजं त्वं कर्मणां फलदायकः ..
ध्यायन्ति योगिनस्तेजस्त्वदीयमशरीरि यत् ..
केचिच्चतुर्भुजं शान्तं लक्ष्मीकान्तं मनोहरम् .. 115 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavāścaiva sākāraṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharam ..
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ param ..116..
meaning:
वैष्णवाश्चैव साकारं कमनीयं मनोहरम् ..
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधरं पीताम्बरं परम् ..116..
text_mt: And the Vaiṣṇavas [meditate on You] with form, lovely and captivating,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ..
śāntaṃ gopāṅganākāntaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam .. 117 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं कमनीयं च किशोरं श्यामसुन्दरम् ..
शान्तं गोपाङ्गनाकान्तं रत्नभूषणभूषितम् .. 117 ..
text_mt: Tranquil, beloved of the cowherd women, adorned with jewel ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tejasvinaṃ bhaktāḥ sevante santataṃ mudā ..
dhyāyanti yogino yattatkutastejasvinaṃ vinā .. 13. ..
tattejo bibhratāṃ deva devānāṃ tejasā purā ..
āvirbhūtā surāṇāṃ ca vadhāya brahmaṇā stutā .. 119 ..
meaning:
एवं तेजस्विनं भक्ताः सेवन्ते सन्ततं मुदा ..
ध्यायन्ति योगिनो यत्तत्कुतस्तेजस्विनं विना .. 13. ..
तत्तेजो बिभ्रतां देव देवानां तेजसा पुरा ..
आविर्भूता सुराणां च वधाय ब्रह्मणा स्तुता .. 119 ..
text_mt:
Thus the devotees constantly serve that glorious one with joy.
Where could that which yogins meditate upon come from, without the possessor of splendour?
Formerly, by the splendour of the gods bearing that splendour, O God,
I appeared for the slaying of the asuras, praised by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
nityā tejastvarūpā'haṃ dhṛtvā vai vigrahaṃ vibho ..
strīrūpaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca vidhāya samupasthitā .. 120 ..
meaning:
नित्या तेजस्त्वरूपाऽहं धृत्वा वै विग्रहं विभो ..
स्त्रीरूपं कमनीयं च विधाय समुपस्थिता .. 120 ..
text_mt:
Eternal, having the nature of splendour, having assumed a body, O all-pervading Lord,
Having fashioned a charming woman's form, I stood forth.

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā tava māyā'haṃ mohayitvā'surānpurā ..
nihatya sarvāñchailendramagamaṃ taṃ himālayam .. 121 ..
meaning:
मायया तव मायाऽहं मोहयित्वाऽसुरान्पुरा ..
निहत्य सर्वाञ्छैलेन्द्रमगमं तं हिमालयम् .. 121 ..
text_mt:
By Your māyā, I, Your māyā, having deluded the asuras of old
And slain them all, went to that king of mountains, the Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ saṃstutā devaistārakākṣeṇa pīḍitaiḥ ..
abhavaṃ dakṣajāyāyāṃ śivastrī bhavajanmani ..122..
meaning:
ततोऽहं संस्तुता देवैस्तारकाक्षेण पीडितैः ..
अभवं दक्षजायायां शिवस्त्री भवजन्मनि ..122..
text_mt:
Then I was praised by the gods oppressed by Tārakākṣa;
In the birth from Bhava, I became the wife of Śiva in the wife of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā dehaṃ dakṣayajñe śivā'haṃ śivanindayā ..
abhavaṃ śailajāyāyāṃ śailādhīśasya karmaṇā .. 123 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा देहं दक्षयज्ञे शिवाऽहं शिवनिन्दया ..
अभवं शैलजायायां शैलाधीशस्य कर्मणा .. 123 ..
text_mt:
Abandoning my body at the sacrifice of Dakṣa because of the reviling of Śiva, I, the auspicious one,
Was born in the wife of the Mountain through the deed of the lord of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
anekatapasā prāptaḥ śivaścātrāpi janmani ..
pāṇiṃ jagrāha me yogī prārthito brahmaṇā vibhuḥ .. 124 ..
meaning:
अनेकतपसा प्राप्तः शिवश्चात्रापि जन्मनि ..
पाणिं जग्राह मे योगी प्रार्थितो ब्रह्मणा विभुः .. 124 ..
text_mt:
Through many austerities Śiva was obtained in this birth too;
The yogin, the Lord, entreated by Brahmā, took my hand.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārajaṃ ca tattejo nālabhaṃ devamāyayā ..
staumi tvāmeva teneśa putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā .. 125 ..
meaning:
शृङ्गारजं च तत्तेजो नालभं देवमायया ..
स्तौमि त्वामेव तेनेश पुत्रदुःखेन दुःखिता .. 125 ..
text_mt:
Yet by divine māyā I did not obtain that splendour born of amorous union;
Therefore, afflicted with sorrow for a son, I praise You alone, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vrate bhavadvidhaṃ putraṃ labdhumicchāmi sāmpratam ..
devena vihitā vede sāṃge svasvāmidakṣiṇā .. 126 ..
meaning:
व्रते भवद्विधं पुत्रं लब्धुमिच्छामि साम्प्रतम् ..
देवेन विहिता वेदे सांगे स्वस्वामिदक्षिणा .. 126 ..
text_mt:
Through the vow, I now wish to obtain a son like You;
By the Lord, the gift of one's own husband is prescribed in the Veda with its limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sarvaṃ kṛpāsindho kṛpāṃ me kartumarhasi ..
ityuktvā pārvatī tatra virarāma ca nārada .. 127 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सर्वं कृपासिन्धो कृपां मे कर्तुमर्हसि ..
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वती तत्र विरराम च नारद .. 127 ..
text_mt:
Having heard all, O ocean of compassion, be pleased to show me grace.
Having spoken thus, O Nārada, Pārvatī then became silent.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārate pārvatīstotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ ..
satputraṃ labhate nūnaṃ viṣṇutulyaparākramam .. 128 ..
meaning:
भारते पार्वतीस्तोत्रं यः शृणोति सुसंयतः ..
सत्पुत्रं लभते नूनं विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम् .. 128 ..
text_mt:
Whoever, well-restrained, hears this hymn of praise of Pārvatī in Bhārata
Surely obtains a noble son equal to Viṣṇu in valour.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ haviṣyāśī harimabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ..
supuṇyakavrataphalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 129 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरं हविष्याशी हरिमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः ..
सुपुण्यकव्रतफलं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 129 ..
text_mt:
Eating sacrificial food for a year and worshipping Hari with devotion,
He obtains the fruit of the auspicious Puṇyaka vow; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇustotramidaṃ brahmansarvasampattivaddharnam ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ svāmisaubhāgyavarddhanam ..130..
meaning:
विष्णुस्तोत्रमिदं ब्रह्मन्सर्वसम्पत्तिवद्धर्नम् ..
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं स्वामिसौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् ..130..
text_mt:
This hymn of praise to Viṣṇu, O sage, increases all wealth;
It grants happiness, grants liberation, is essential, and increases the husband's good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaundaryyabījaṃ ca yaśorāśivivarddhanam ..
haribhaktipradaṃ tattvajñānabuddhisukhapradam .. 131 ..
meaning:
सर्वसौन्दर्य्यबीजं च यशोराशिविवर्द्धनम् ..
हरिभक्तिप्रदं तत्त्वज्ञानबुद्धिसुखप्रदम् .. 131 ..
text_mt:
It is the seed of all beauty, and increases abundant fame;
It bestows devotion to Hari and grants true knowledge, intellect, and happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
pārvatyāḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ..
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvādṛśyaṃ sudurlabham .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
पार्वत्याः स्तवनं श्रुत्वा श्रीकृष्णः करुणानिधिः ..
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास सर्वादृश्यं सुदुर्लभम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa said: / Having heard Pārvatī's hymn of praise, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the treasury of compassion, / revealed His own form, invisible to all and very difficult to attain. // 1 // / Having praised Him, the goddess, devoted to the vow, her mind fixed on Kṛṣṇa, / beheld amidst the radiances His form which fascinates all, // 2 // / [seated] upon an essence of fine jewels, adorned with diamond, / joined with garlands of rubies, filled with jewels, delightful, // 3 // / wearing yellow garments purified by fire, best, holding a flute, supreme, / with a garland of forest flowers on His neck, dark, adorned with jewel ornaments, // 4 // / youthful in age, of wondrous dress, anointed with sandalwood, / with a lovely smiling face, praiseworthy, mocking the autumn moon, // 5 // / adorned with a garland of mālatī flowers, with a peacock-feather crest, / surrounded by cowherd women, radiant on Rādhā's chest, // 6 // / charming, an abode of playful grace with the loveliness of ten million Kāmadevas, / exceedingly cheerful, dear to all, bestowing grace upon devotees. // 7 // / Having seen that form, the beautiful goddess instantly chose in her mind / a son resembling Him, having obtained the boon. // 8 // / And having granted the boon whatever she desired in her heart, the Lord of boons, / having granted what was wished to the gods, that splendour vanished. // 9 // / Then, having aroused the sky-clad child, the gods, filled with compassion, / gave the matchless [child] there to the rejoiced goddess. // 10 // / Durgā, celebrated by all the universe, gave various gems to the brāhmaṇas, / and golds to the mendicants and bards. // 11 // / She fed the brāhmaṇas, the gods, and the mountains, / and worshipped Śaṅkara with peerless offerings. // 12 // / She had the kettledrums sounded and had auspicious ceremonies performed; / she had beautiful songs concerning Hari sung. // 13 // / Having completed the vow, smiling, having given the gifts / and fed all, that Durgā ate together with her husband, // 14 // / and [partook of] excellent, delightful betel fragrant with camphor and the like.

text_mt: Having given [food] to all in due order, she ate with him in delight. / On a delightful bed resembling the foam of milk upon a couch of fine gems, / furnished with flowers and sandalwood, scented with musk and saffron, / the supreme goddess slept in secret with her husband. / And in a region of Kailāsa, in a delightful sandalwood forest / made fragrant by breezes rich with sweet-smelling flowers, / resounding with the humming of bees and sheltering the calls of male cuckoos, / there she, the delightful Ambikā, enjoyed sporting with him. / Then, at the moment of emission of semen, that Viṣṇu, through the māyā of Viṣṇu, / assumed the form of a brāhmaṇa and came to the chamber of lovemaking. / He was matted-haired and un-oiled, wearing filthy rags, a beggar, O sage, / with exceedingly white teeth, afflicted by thirst, / with an exceedingly emaciated body, bearing a radiant tilaka, / weeping with many plaintive cries, wretched, a miserable figure born of destitution. / Very old and begging for food, leaning on a staff, exceedingly weak, / he called out to Mahādeva at the door of the love-chamber. / The brāhmaṇa said: / "What are you doing, Mahādeva? Protect me, who have come for refuge! / The seven-night vow is ended, and I am craving food to break my fast, starving from hunger! / What are you doing, Mahādeva? O father, ocean of compassion! / Look at this old man, seized by decrepitude, afflicted by thirst! / Mother, arise! Give me food today, and auspicious water! / O daughter born from the mine of infinite gems, protect me, who have come for refuge! / Mother! Mother, Mother of the Universe! Come, do not leave me standing outside! / Why should I suffer from thirst while my own mother is present?" / Hearing this plaintive cry, as Śiva rose up, O sage, / his semen fell onto the bed, and not into the womb of Prakṛti at that time. / Trembling, Pārvatī arose, covering herself with a fine garment, / and Śaṅkara went outside to the doorway along with Pārvatī. / He saw the brāhmaṇa, wretched, afflicted by decrepitude, / an old man whose limbs were trembling, bent over as he leaned upon a staff,

text_mt: an ascetic, agitated, with throat, lips, and palate dry, / offering obeisance and praise to the two of them with supreme devotion. / Hearing his words that were like nectar, / Nīlakaṇṭha smiled and spoke to him with supreme affection, well-pleased. / Śaṅkara said: / "Where is your home, O viprarṣi? Speak, O best of the knowers of the Veda! / What is your name? I wish to know it at once." / Pārvatī said: / "From where have you come, O vipra, arriving by my good fortune? / Today my birth has borne fruit, since a brāhmaṇa is a guest in my house! / By whoever a guest is honoured, the three worlds are honoured. / The gods, brāhmaṇas, and gurus are seated right in him, O twice-born. / The holy bathing-places assuredly abide constantly in the feet of a guest; / mingling with the water that washes his feet, a householder obtains them. / He has bathed in all holy places and is initiated into all sacrifices / by whom a guest is honoured according to his means and as is proper. / All great gifts have been given on the earth / by whoever has honoured a guest in Bhārata with devotion. / Whatever various kinds of merit are proclaimed in the Vedas, / all others do not equal a sixteenth part of serving a guest. / From whose house a guest turns away unhonoured, / behind him the ancestors, gods, and sacred fires depart unhonoured, along with the gurus. / Whatever sins there are, such as the slaying of a brāhmaṇa and the like, / he incurs them all by not worshipping a guest who has arrived desiring [hospitality]." / The brāhmaṇa said: / "You know the Vedas, O knower of the Vedas! Perform the worship prescribed by the Vedas! / I am afflicted by hunger and thirst, O Mother; and a word is heard in the Śruti: / when a man is afflicted by illness, fasting, or observing a vow of abstinence from food, / he desires to eat an offering according to his heart's desire." / Pārvatī said: / "What do you desire to eat, O vipra, even if very difficult to obtain in the three worlds? / I will give it to you to eat today; make my birth fruitful!" / The brāhmaṇa said:

text_mt: "In the vow, all offerings have been brought together by you of excellent vows; / hearing of the various sorts of sweetmeats to eat, I have arrived. / O lady of excellent vows, I am your son; first you shall worship me, / having given sweet foods and what is rare in the three worlds. / Fathers are declared to be of five kinds, and mothers are considered to be of various kinds; / five kinds of sons are spoken of by the teachers of the Veda, O virtuous lady: / the giver of knowledge, the giver of food, the protector from fear, the giver of birth, / and the giver of a bride are declared in the Veda to be the fathers of men. / The wife of the guru, the bearer of the womb, the giver of breast milk, the sister of the father, / the sister of the mother, the co-wife, the daughter-in-law, and the giver of food [are mothers]. / A servant, a disciple, a dependent, one born of semen, and one who has come for refuge— / these four are sons by dharma, while the one born of semen inherits the wealth. / Afflicted by hunger and thirst, O Mother, I, an old man, have come for refuge; / now I am the son, helpless, of you who are barren. / Cakes, rice cooked in milk, ripe fruits, / various kinds of pastries produced according to time and place, / cooked grain, svastika pastries, condensed milk, sugarcane, and things derived from sugarcane, / ghee, curds, śāli rice, and condiments cooked in ghee, / and sweet laddus made of sesame with molasses, / foods unknown to me and equal to nectar, / and excellent, delightful betel fragrant with camphor and the like— / give me these fresh, pure, delicious, and perfumed articles, / substances eating which my belly may become beautifully large, / O daughter born from the mine of infinite gems! / Your husband is the creator of the three worlds, the giver of all wealth; / you are the very form of Mahālakṣmī, the bestower of all sovereignty. / A lovely jewelled throne, invaluable jewel ornaments, / and lovely cloth purified by fire, very rare, you will give me, / [and] the very rare mantra of Hari, and firm devotion to Hari, O virtuous lady!"

text_mt: You are the beloved of Hari, the potency of Hari, ever abiding as such. / What is there, O Mother—knowledge named Conqueror of Death, the power to give, conferring joy, / and every perfection—that cannot be given to one's own son? / Purifying my mind constantly in virtue and austerity, / I shall perform an offering in the highest, not in desire which causes birth. / One acts out of one's own desire, and from action comes only experience; / the two kinds of experience, auspicious and inauspicious, are known as the causes of joy and sorrow. / From what does sorrow not arise, or joy, O Mother of the universe? / Everything is the experiencing of one's own karma; therefore the wise man is detached from it. / Good people constantly uproot karma with joy / by contemplating Hari with discernment, by that asceticism, through the company of devotees. / Pleasure from the contact of sense organs and objects ends in destruction, / while that joy which consists of conversing about Hari lasts for all time. / For good people who are given to remembering Hari, life does not waste away, O virtuous lady; / neither Time nor the Conqueror of Death is their master, surely. / Those devotees live long in Bhārata as long-lived ones; / having understood all perfections, they go wherever they wish at their own will. / Remembering their past lives, the devotees of Hari know ten million births; / they recount stories and take birth at their own will with joy. / Truly purified, they sanctify the sacred places by their divine sport; / in this sacred field they wander for service and for the sake of others. / By the touch of the feet of Vaiṣṇavas, the earth is instantly purified / in whatever sacred place they stay for merely the time it takes to milk a cow. / Into whose ears the Viṣṇu mantra enters from the mouth of a guru, / that Vaiṣṇava the knowers of antiquity declare to be purified by sacred places. / They playfully deliver, through devotion in Bhārata, a hundred generations before / and a hundred generations after, along with their siblings and mother. / They deliver ten generations before and ten after of maternal grandfathers, / and the mother's mother, from the terrible torment of Yama.

text_mt: Those men who obtain the sight and embrace of a devotee / have gone to all holy places and are consecrated in all sacrifices. / Devotees whose minds are constantly fixed on Hari are not smeared by sins, / just as fires consume everything, and winds [pass untouched] through substances. / At the end of thirty million births one obtains human birth; / and in human form, through ten million births, one obtains the company of devotees. / From the company of devotees, the sprout of devotion becomes alive, O virtuous lady; / by the mere sight of non-devotees, it becomes withered. / It blossoms again merely through conversation with a Vaiṣṇava; / and that sprout, imperishable, grows in every birth.

In the end, when devotion ripens, one becomes an attendant of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnārāyaṇe bhaktiṃ dehi māmambike sadā ..
na bhavedviṣṇubhaktiśca viṣṇumāye tvayā vinā ..80..
meaning:
तस्मान्नारायणे भक्तिं देहि मामम्बिके सदा ..
न भवेद्विष्णुभक्तिश्च विष्णुमाये त्वया विना ..80..
text_mt:
Therefore, grant me devotion to Nārāyaṇa always, O Mother.
Devotion to Viṣṇu does not arise without you, O illusory potency of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvantaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ svatapastava pūjanam ..
sarveṣāṃ phaladātrī tvaṃ nityarūpā sanātanī .. 81 ..
meaning:
तद्वन्तं लोकशिक्षार्थं स्वतपस्तव पूजनम् ..
सर्वेषां फलदात्री त्वं नित्यरूपा सनातनी .. 81 ..
text_mt:
For the instruction of the world, having that [wisdom], I perform worship of you through my own austerity.
You are the giver of fruits to all, possessing an eternal form, primeval.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kalpe kalpe tavātmajaḥ ..
tvatkroḍamāgataḥ kṣipramityuktvā'ntaradhīyata .. 82 ..
meaning:
गणेशरूपः श्रीकृष्णः कल्पे कल्पे तवात्मजः ..
त्वत्क्रोडमागतः क्षिप्रमित्युक्त्वाऽन्तरधीयत .. 82 ..
text_mt:
I have quickly come to your lap'—having spoken thus, he vanished.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa in the form of Gaṇeśa is your son in aeon after aeon;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā'ntardhānamīśaśca bālarūpaṃ vidhāya saḥ ..
jagāma pārvatī talpaṃ mandirābhyantarasthitam .. 83 ..
meaning:
कृत्वाऽन्तर्धानमीशश्च बालरूपं विधाय सः ..
जगाम पार्वती तल्पं मन्दिराभ्यन्तरस्थितम् .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Having vanished and assumed the form of an infant, the Lord
went to Pārvatī's bed situated inside the chamber.

sanskrit_iast:
talpasthe śivavīryye ca miśritaḥ sa babhūva ha ..
dadarśa gehaśikharaṃ prasūte bālake yathā ..84..
meaning:
तल्पस्थे शिववीर्य्ये च मिश्रितः स बभूव ह ..
ददर्श गेहशिखरं प्रसूते बालके यथा ..84..
text_mt:
He became mingled with the seed of Śiva lying on the bed;
he gazed at the roof of the chamber, just like a newborn child.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhacampakavarṇābhaḥ koṭicandrasamaprabhaḥ ..
sukhadṛśyaḥ sarvajanaiścakṣūraśmivivarddhakaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
शुद्धचम्पकवर्णाभः कोटिचन्द्रसमप्रभः ..
सुखदृश्यः सर्वजनैश्चक्षूरश्मिविवर्द्धकः .. 85 ..
text_mt:
He had the radiant hue of a pure campaka flower, with the luster of ten million moons,
delightful for all people to look upon, enhancing the brightness of their eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
atīva sundaratanuḥ kāmadevavimohanaḥ ..
sukhaṃ nirupamaṃ bibhracchāradenduvinindakam .. 86 ..
meaning:
अतीव सुन्दरतनुः कामदेवविमोहनः ..
सुखं निरुपमं बिभ्रच्छारदेन्दुविनिन्दकम् .. 86 ..
text_mt:
with an exceedingly handsome body captivating even Kāmadeva,
bearing an incomparable face that shamed the autumn moon,

sanskrit_iast:
sundare locane bibhraccārupadmavinindake ..
oṣṭhādharapuṭaṃ bibhratpakvabimbavinindakam .. 87 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरे लोचने बिभ्रच्चारुपद्मविनिन्दके ..
ओष्ठाधरपुटं बिभ्रत्पक्वबिम्बविनिन्दकम् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
bearing lovely eyes that eclipsed beautiful lotus blossoms,
bearing the folds of upper and lower lips that surpassed a ripe bimba fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
kapālaṃ ca kapolaṃ ca paramaṃ sumanoharam ..
nāsāgraṃ ruciraṃ bibhradvīndracañcuvinindakam .. 88 ..
meaning:
कपालं च कपोलं च परमं सुमनोहरम् ..
नासाग्रं रुचिरं बिभ्रद्वीन्द्रचञ्चुविनिन्दकम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
with a forehead and cheeks supremely charming to the mind,
bearing a radiant tip of the nose that outshone the beak of Garuḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye vai nirupamaṃ sarvāṃgaṃ bibhraduttamam ..
śayānaḥ śayane ramye prerayanhastapādakam .. 89 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये वै निरुपमं सर्वांगं बिभ्रदुत्तमम् ..
शयानः शयने रम्ये प्रेरयन्हस्तपादकम् .. 89 ..
text_mt:
bearing exquisite limbs in their entirety, incomparable in the three worlds,
lying on a charming bed, moving his little hands and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
harau tirohite śarvāṇī durgā śaṃkarastadā ..
brāhmaṇānveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā babhrāma parito mune .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
हरौ तिरोहिते शर्वाणी दुर्गा शंकरस्तदा ..
ब्राह्मणान्वेषणं कृत्वा बभ्राम परितो मुने .. 1 ..
title: Bālagaṇeśadarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
aye viprendrātivṛddha kva gato'si kṣudhā''turaḥ ..
he tāta darśanaṃ dehi prāṇānvai rakṣa me vibho .. 2 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
अये विप्रेन्द्रातिवृद्ध क्व गतोऽसि क्षुधा'ऽतुरः ..
हे तात दर्शनं देहि प्राणान्वै रक्ष मे विभो .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śiva śīghraṃ samuttiṣṭha brāhmaṇānveṣaṇaṃ kuru ..
kṣaṇamunmanasoreṣa gataḥ pratyakṣamāvayoḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
शिव शीघ्रं समुत्तिष्ठ ब्राह्मणान्वेषणं कुरु ..
क्षणमुन्मनसोरेष गतः प्रत्यक्षमावयोः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
agṛhītvā gṛhātpūjāṃ gṛhiṇo'tithirīśvara ..
yadi yāti kṣudhā''rttaśca tasya kiṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā .. 4 ..
meaning:
अगृहीत्वा गृहात्पूजां गृहिणोऽतिथिरीश्वर ..
यदि याति क्षुधा'ऽर्त्तश्च तस्य किं जीवनं वृथा .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pitarastanna gṛhṇanti piṇḍadānaṃ ca tarpaṇam ..
tasyāhutiṃ na gṛhṇāti vahniḥ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ surāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
पितरस्तन्न गृह्णन्ति पिण्डदानं च तर्पणम् ..
तस्याहुतिं न गृह्णाति वह्निः पुष्पं जलं सुराः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
havyaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ dravyamaśuceśca surāsamam ..
amedhyasadṛśaḥ piṇḍaḥ sparśanaṃ puṇyanāśanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
हव्यं पुष्पं जलं द्रव्यमशुचेश्च सुरासमम् ..
अमेध्यसदृशः पिण्डः स्पर्शनं पुण्यनाशनम् .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra vāg babhūvāśarīriṇī ..
kaivalyayuktā sā durgā tāṃ śuśrāva śucā''turā .. 7 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वाग् बभूवाशरीरिणी ..
कैवल्ययुक्ता सा दुर्गा तां शुश्राव शुचा'ऽतुरा .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śāntā bhava jaganmātassvasutaṃ paśya mandire ..
kṛṣṇaṃ golokanāthaṃ taṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ param ..8..
meaning:
शान्ता भव जगन्मातस्स्वसुतं पश्य मन्दिरे ..
कृष्णं गोलोकनाथं तं परिपूर्णतमं परम् ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
supuṇyakavratataroḥ phalarūpaṃ sanātanam ..
yattejo yoginaḥ śaśvaddhyāyanti santataṃ mudā .. 9 ..
meaning:
सुपुण्यकव्रततरोः फलरूपं सनातनम् ..
यत्तेजो योगिनः शश्वद्ध्यायन्ति सन्ततं मुदा .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavā devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
yasya pūjyasya sarvāgre kalpe kalpe ca pūjanam .. 10 ..
meaning:
ध्यायन्ति वैष्णवा देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
यस्य पूज्यस्य सर्वाग्रे कल्पे कल्पे च पूजनम् .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighno vinaśyati ..
puṇyarāśisvarūpaṃ ca svasutaṃ paśya mandire .. 11 ..
meaning:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण सर्वविघ्नो विनश्यति ..
पुण्यराशिस्वरूपं च स्वसुतं पश्य मन्दिरे .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe kalpe dhyāyasi yaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ..
paśya tvaṃ muktidaṃ putraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ..12..
meaning:
कल्पे कल्पे ध्यायसि यं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् ..
पश्य त्वं मुक्तिदं पुत्रं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् ..12..

sanskrit_iast:
tava vāñchāpūrṇabījaṃ tapaḥkalpataroḥ phalam..
sundaraṃ svasutaṃ paśya koṭikandarpanindakam ..13..
meaning:
तव वाञ्छापूर्णबीजं तपःकल्पतरोः फलम्..
सुन्दरं स्वसुतं पश्य कोटिकन्दर्पनिन्दकम् ..13..

sanskrit_iast:
nāyaṃ vipraḥ kṣudhā''rttaśca viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
kiṃ vā vilāpaṃ kuruṣe kva vā vṛddhaḥ kva cātithiḥ ..
sarasvatī tvevamuktvā virarāma ca nārada .. 14 ..
meaning:
नायं विप्रः क्षुधा'ऽर्त्तश्च विप्ररूपी जनार्दनः ..
किं वा विलापं कुरुषे क्व वा वृद्धः क्व चातिथिः ..
सरस्वती त्वेवमुक्त्वा विरराम च नारद .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
trastā śrutvā''kāśavāṇīṃ jagāma svālayaṃ satī ..
dadarśa bālaṃ paryyaṅke śayānaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā..15..
meaning:
त्रस्ता श्रुत्वा'ऽकाशवाणीं जगाम स्वालयं सती ..
ददर्श बालं पर्य्यङ्के शयानं सस्मितं मुदा..15..

sanskrit_iast:
paśyantaṃ gehaśikharaṃ śatacandrasamaprabham ..
svaprabhāpaṭalenaiva dyotayantaṃ mahītalam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पश्यन्तं गेहशिखरं शतचन्द्रसमप्रभम् ..
स्वप्रभापटलेनैव द्योतयन्तं महीतलम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kurvantaṃ bhramaṇaṃ talpe paśyantaṃ svecchayā mudā ..
umeti śabdaṃ kurvantaṃ rudantaṃ taṃ stanārthinam .. 17 ..
meaning:
कुर्वन्तं भ्रमणं तल्पे पश्यन्तं स्वेच्छया मुदा ..
उमेति शब्दं कुर्वन्तं रुदन्तं तं स्तनार्थिनम् .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutaṃ rūpaṃ trastā śaṃkarasannidhim ..
gatvā sovāca giriśaṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā .. 18 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तदद्भुतं रूपं त्रस्ता शंकरसन्निधिम् ..
गत्वा सोवाच गिरिशं सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गला .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
gṛhamāgaccha sarveśa tapasāṃ phaladāyakam ..
kalpe kalpe dhyāyasi yaṃ taṃ paśyāgatya mandiram .. 19 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
गृहमागच्छ सर्वेश तपसां फलदायकम् ..
कल्पे कल्पे ध्यायसि यं तं पश्यागत्य मन्दिरम् .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ putramukhaṃ paśya puṇyabījaṃ mahotsavam ..
punnāmanarakatrāṇakāraṇaṃ bhavatāraṇam .. 20 ..
meaning:
शीघ्रं पुत्रमुखं पश्य पुण्यबीजं महोत्सवम् ..
पुन्नामनरकत्राणकारणं भवतारणम् .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇam ..
putrasaṃdarśanasyāsya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 21 ..
meaning:
स्नानं च सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दक्षिणम् ..
पुत्रसंदर्शनस्यास्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadānena yatpuṇyaṃ kṣmāpradakṣiṇataśca yat ..
putradarśanapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 22 ..
meaning:
सर्वदानेन यत्पुण्यं क्ष्माप्रदक्षिणतश्च यत् ..
पुत्रदर्शनपुण्यस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaistapobhiryatpuṇyaṃ devānaśanairvrataiḥ ..
satputrodbhavapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वैस्तपोभिर्यत्पुण्यं देवानशनैर्व्रतैः ..
सत्पुत्रोद्भवपुण्यस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yadviprabhojanaiḥ puṇyaṃ yadeva surasevanaiḥ ..
satputraprāptipuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 24 ..
meaning:
यद्विप्रभोजनैः पुण्यं यदेव सुरसेवनैः ..
सत्पुत्रप्राप्तिपुण्यस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śivaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
ājagāma svabhavanaṃ kṣipraṃ vai kāntayā saha ..
dadarśa talpe svasutaṃ taptakāñcanasannibham .. 25 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्या वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवः संहृष्टमानसः ..
आजगाम स्वभवनं क्षिप्रं वै कान्तया सह ..
ददर्श तल्पे स्वसुतं तप्तकाञ्चनसन्निभम् .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
hadayasthaṃ ca yadrūpaṃ tadevātimanoharam ..
durgātalpātsamādāya kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ sutam..
cucumbānandajaladhau nimagnā setyuvāca tam .. 26 ..
meaning:
हदयस्थं च यद्रूपं तदेवातिमनोहरम् ..
दुर्गातल्पात्समादाय कृत्वा वक्षसि तं सुतम्..
चुचुम्बानन्दजलधौ निमग्ना सेत्युवाच तम् .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpyāmūlyaratnaṃ tvāṃ pūrṇameva sanātanam ..
yathā mano daridrasya sahasā prāpya saddhanam .. 27 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्यामूल्यरत्नं त्वां पूर्णमेव सनातनम् ..
यथा मनो दरिद्रस्य सहसा प्राप्य सद्धनम् .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kānte suciramāyāte proṣite yoṣito yathā ..
mānasaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca babhūva ca tathā mama .. 28 ..
meaning:
कान्ते सुचिरमायाते प्रोषिते योषितो यथा ..
मानसं परिपूर्णं च बभूव च तथा मम .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suciraṃ gatamāyātamekaputrā kathā sutam ..
dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭā yathā vatsa tathā'hamapi sāmpratam .. 29 ..
meaning:
सुचिरं गतमायातमेकपुत्रा कथा सुतम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तुष्टा यथा वत्स तथाऽहमपि साम्प्रतम् .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnaṃ suciraṃ bhraṣṭaṃ prāpya hṛṣṭo yathā janaḥ ..
anāvṛṣṭau suvṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃprāpyāhaṃ tathā sutam .. 30 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नं सुचिरं भ्रष्टं प्राप्य हृष्टो यथा जनः ..
अनावृष्टौ सुवृष्टिं च संप्राप्याहं तथा सुतम् .. 30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yathā suciramandhānāṃ sthitānāṃ ca nirāśraye ..
cakṣussunirmmalaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathaiva me .. 31 ..
meaning:
यथा सुचिरमन्धानां स्थितानां च निराश्रये ..
चक्षुस्सुनिर्म्मलं प्राप्य मनः पूर्णं तथैव मे .. 31 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dustare sāgare ghore patitasya ca saṃkaṭe ..
anaukasya prāpya naukāṃ manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama .. 32 ..
meaning:
दुस्तरे सागरे घोरे पतितस्य च संकटे ..
अनौकस्य प्राप्य नौकां मनः पूर्णं तथा मम .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣṇayā śuṣkakaṇṭhānāṃ sucirācca suśītalam..
suvāsitaṃ jalaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama..33..
meaning:
तृष्णया शुष्ककण्ठानां सुचिराच्च सुशीतलम्..
सुवासितं जलं प्राप्य मनः पूर्णं तथा मम..33..

sanskrit_iast:
dāvāgnipatitānāṃ ca sthitānāṃ ca nirāśraye ..
niragnimāśrayaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama .. 34 ..
meaning:
दावाग्निपतितानां च स्थितानां च निराश्रये ..
निरग्निमाश्रयं प्राप्य मनः पूर्णं तथा मम .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast: ciraṃ bubhukṣitānāṃ ca vratopoṣaṇakāriṇām ..35..
meaning: चिरं बुभुक्षितानां च व्रतोपोषणकारिणाम् ..35..

sanskrit_iast:
sadannaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama ..
ityuktvā pārvatī tatra kroḍe kṛtvā svabālakam ..36..
meaning:
सदन्नं पुरतो दृष्ट्वा मनः पूर्णं तथा मम ..
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वती तत्र क्रोडे कृत्वा स्वबालकम् ..36..

sanskrit_iast:
prītyā stanaṃ dadau tasmai paramānandamānasā ..
kroḍe cakāra bhagavānbālakaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
प्रीत्या स्तनं ददौ तस्मै परमानन्दमानसा ..
क्रोडे चकार भगवान्बालकं हृष्टमानसः .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast: cucumba gaṇḍe vedoktaṃ yuyuje cāśiṣaṃ mudā .. 38 ..
meaning: चुचुम्ब गण्डे वेदोक्तं युयुजे चाशिषं मुदा .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
tau dampatī bahirgatvā putramaṅgalahetave..
vividhāni ca ratnāni dvijebhyo dadaturmudā .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
तौ दम्पती बहिर्गत्वा पुत्रमङ्गलहेतवे..
विविधानि च रत्नानि द्विजेभ्यो ददतुर्मुदा .. 1 ..
title: Gaṇeśodbhavamaṃgalam

sanskrit_iast:
bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca dānāni vividhāni ca ..
nānāvidhāni vādyāni vādayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
बन्दिभ्यो भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च दानानि विविधानि च ..
नानाविधानि वाद्यानि वादयामास शङ्करः .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
himālayaśca ratnānāṃ dadau lakṣaṃ dvijātaye ..
sahasraṃ ca gajendrāṇāmaśvānāṃ ca trilakṣakam .. 3 ..
meaning:
हिमालयश्च रत्नानां ददौ लक्षं द्विजातये ..
सहस्रं च गजेन्द्राणामश्वानां च त्रिलक्षकम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva pañcalakṣaṃ suvarṇakam ..
muktāmāṇikyaratnāni maṇiśreṣṭhāni yāni ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
दशलक्षं गवां चैव पञ्चलक्षं सुवर्णकम् ..
मुक्तामाणिक्यरत्नानि मणिश्रेष्ठानि यानि च .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
anyānyapi ca dānāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ..
sarvāṇyamūlyaratnāni kṣīrodotpattikāni ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
अन्यान्यपि च दानानि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च ..
सर्वाण्यमूल्यरत्नानि क्षीरोदोत्पत्तिकानि च .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau viṣṇuḥ kaustubhaṃ kautukānvitaḥ ..
brahmā viśiṣṭadānāni viprāṇāṃ vāñchitāni ca ..
sudurlabhāni sṛṣṭau ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ विष्णुः कौस्तुभं कौतुकान्वितः ..
ब्रह्मा विशिष्टदानानि विप्राणां वाञ्छितानि च ..
सुदुर्लभानि सृष्टौ च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ sūryyaśca śakraśca devāśca munayastathā ..
gandharvāḥ parvatā devyo dadurdānaṃ krameṇa ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
धर्मः सूर्य्यश्च शक्रश्च देवाश्च मुनयस्तथा ..
गन्धर्वाः पर्वता देव्यो ददुर्दानं क्रमेण च .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
māṇikyānāṃ sahasrāṇi ratnānāṃ ca śatāni ca ..
śatāni kaustubhānāṃ ca hīrakāṇāṃ śatāni ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
माणिक्यानां सहस्राणि रत्नानां च शतानि च ..
शतानि कौस्तुभानां च हीरकाणां शतानि च .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
haridvarṇamaṇīndrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi mudā'nvitāḥ ..
gavāṃ ratnāni lakṣāṇi gajaratnasahasrakam ..
amūlyānyanyaratnāni śvetavarṇāni kautukāt..10..
meaning:
हरिद्वर्णमणीन्द्राणां सहस्राणि मुदाऽन्विताः ..
गवां रत्नानि लक्षाणि गजरत्नसहस्रकम् ..
अमूल्यान्यन्यरत्नानि श्वेतवर्णानि कौतुकात्..10..

sanskrit_iast:
śatalakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca ..
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau brahmā tatra kṣīrodadhirmudā .. 11 ..
meaning:
शतलक्षं सुवर्णानां वह्निशुद्धांशुकानि च ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ ब्रह्मा तत्र क्षीरोदधिर्मुदा .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
hāraṃ cāmūlyaratnānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ..
atīva nirmalaṃ sāraṃ sūryyabhānuvinindakam ..12..
meaning:
हारं चामूल्यरत्नानां त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम् ..
अतीव निर्मलं सारं सूर्य्यभानुविनिन्दकम् ..12..

sanskrit_iast:
pariṣkṛtaṃ ca māṇikyairhīrakaiśca virājitam ..
ramyaṃ kaustubhamadhyasthaṃ dadau devī sarasvatī.. .. 13 ..
meaning:
परिष्कृतं च माणिक्यैर्हीरकैश्च विराजितम् ..
रम्यं कौस्तुभमध्यस्थं ददौ देवी सरस्वती.. .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasāraṃ hāraṃ ca sadratnagaṇanirmitam ..
bhūṣaṇāni ca sarvāṇi sā sāvitrī dadau mudā .. 14 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यसारं हारं च सद्रत्नगणनिर्मितम् ..
भूषणानि च सर्वाणि सा सावित्री ददौ मुदा .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ suvarṇaloṣṭānāṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca ..
śatānyamūlyaratnānāṃ kuberaśca dadau mudā .. 15 ..
meaning:
लक्षं सुवर्णलोष्टानां धनानि विविधानि च ..
शतान्यमूल्यरत्नानां कुबेरश्च ददौ मुदा .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni dattvā viprebhyaste sarve dadṛśuḥ śiśum ..
paramānandasaṃyuktāḥ śivaputrotsave mune .. 16 ..
meaning:
दानानि दत्त्वा विप्रेभ्यस्ते सर्वे ददृशुः शिशुम् ..
परमानन्दसंयुक्ताः शिवपुत्रोत्सवे मुने .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhāraṃ voḍhumaśaktāśca brāhmaṇā bandinastathā ..
sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ ca gacchanto dhanāni pathi kātarāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
भारं वोढुमशक्ताश्च ब्राह्मणा बन्दिनस्तथा ..
स्थायंस्थायं च गच्छन्तो धनानि पथि कातराः .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kathayanti kathāḥ sarve viśrāntāḥ pūrvadāyinām ..
buddhāḥ śṛṇvanti muditā yuvāno bhikṣukā mune .. 18 ..
meaning:
कथयन्ति कथाः सर्वे विश्रान्ताः पूर्वदायिनाम् ..
बुद्धाः शृण्वन्ति मुदिता युवानो भिक्षुका मुने .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuḥ pramuditastatra vādayāmāsa dundubhim ..
saṃgītaṃ pāyayāmāsa kārayāmāsa nartanam ..
vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa purāṇāni ca nārada .. 19 ..
meaning:
विष्णुः प्रमुदितस्तत्र वादयामास दुन्दुभिम् ..
संगीतं पाययामास कारयामास नर्तनम् ..
वेदांश्च पाठयामास पुराणानि च नारद .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
munīndrānānayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa tānmudā ..
āśiṣaṃ dāpayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam..
sārddhaṃ devaścai devībhirdadau tasmai śubhāśiṣaḥ .. .. 20 ..
meaning:
मुनीन्द्रानानयामास पूजयामास तान्मुदा ..
आशिषं दापयामास कारयामास मङ्गलम्..
सार्द्धं देवश्चै देवीभिर्ददौ तस्मै शुभाशिषः .. .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca ..
śivena tulyaṃ jñānaṃ te paramāyuśca bālaka ..
parākrame mayā tulyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhava .. 21 ..
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच ..
शिवेन तुल्यं ज्ञानं ते परमायुश्च बालक ..
पराक्रमे मया तुल्यः सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भव .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
yaśasā te jagatpūrṇaṃ sarvapūjyo bhavāciram ..
sarveṣāṃ purataḥ pūjā bhavatvatisudurlabhā .. 22 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
यशसा ते जगत्पूर्णं सर्वपूज्यो भवाचिरम् ..
सर्वेषां पुरतः पूजा भवत्वतिसुदुर्लभा .. 22 ..
text_mt:
“May the world be filled with your fame; may you soon become worshipped by all!
May worship before everyone else, which is exceedingly rare, be yours!”

sanskrit_iast:
dharmma uvāca ..
mayā tulyaḥ sudharmiṣṭho bhavānbhavatu durlabhaḥ ..
sarvajñaśca dayāyukto haribhakto hareḥ samaḥ..23..
meaning:
धर्म्म उवाच ..
मया तुल्यः सुधर्मिष्ठो भवान्भवतु दुर्लभः ..
सर्वज्ञश्च दयायुक्तो हरिभक्तो हरेः समः..23..
text_mt:
“May you be exceedingly righteous like me, rare [to find],
omniscient, full of compassion, devoted to Hari, and equal to Hari!”

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca ..
dātā bhava mayā tulyo haribhaktaśca buddhimān..
vidyāvānpuṇyavāñchānto dāntaśca prāṇavallabha .. 24 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच ..
दाता भव मया तुल्यो हरिभक्तश्च बुद्धिमान्..
विद्यावान्पुण्यवाञ्छान्तो दान्तश्च प्राणवल्लभ .. 24 ..
text_mt:
“Be a giver equal to me, devoted to Hari, and wise;
learned, virtuous, tranquil, and self-controlled, O beloved of my life!”

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīruvāca ..
mama sthitiśca gehe te dehe bhavatu śāśvatī ..
pativratā mayā tulyā śāntā kāntā manoharā .. 25 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीरुवाच ..
मम स्थितिश्च गेहे ते देहे भवतु शाश्वती ..
पतिव्रता मया तुल्या शान्ता कान्ता मनोहरा .. 25 ..
text_mt:
“May my presence be eternal in your house and in your body;
and [may you have a wife] devoted to her husband, equal to me, peaceful, charming, and captivating!”

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyuvāca ..
mayā tulyā sukavitā dhāraṇāśaktireva ca ..
smṛtirvivecanāśaktirbhavatvatitarāṃ suta .. 26 ..
meaning:
सरस्वत्युवाच ..
मया तुल्या सुकविता धारणाशक्तिरेव च ..
स्मृतिर्विवेचनाशक्तिर्भवत्वतितरां सुत .. 26 ..
text_mt:
“May excellent poetic skill equal to mine, as well as the power of retention,
memory, and the faculty of discernment belong to you exceedingly, O son!”

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitryuvāca ..
vatsāhaṃ vedajananī vedajñānī bhavāciram ..
manmantrajapaśīlaśca pravaro vedavādinām .. .. 27 ..
meaning:
सावित्र्युवाच ..
वत्साहं वेदजननी वेदज्ञानी भवाचिरम् ..
मन्मन्त्रजपशीलश्च प्रवरो वेदवादिनाम् .. .. 27 ..
text_mt:
“Child, I am the mother of the Vedas; may you soon become a knower of the Vedas,
devoted to chanting my mantra, and foremost among teachers of the Veda!”

sanskrit_iast:
himālaya uvāca ..
śrīkṛṣṇe'timatiḥ śaśvadbhaktirbhavatu śāśvatī ..
śrīkṛṣṇatulyo guṇavānbhava kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
हिमालय उवाच ..
श्रीकृष्णेऽतिमतिः शश्वद्भक्तिर्भवतु शाश्वती ..
श्रीकृष्णतुल्यो गुणवान्भव कृष्णपरायणः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
"May you have constant thought directed towards Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and eternal devotion [to Him]!
Be virtuous like Śrī Kṛṣṇa, devoted wholly to Kṛṣṇa!"

sanskrit_iast:
menakovāca ..
samudratulyo gāmbhīryye kāmatulyaśca rūpavān ..
śrīyuktaḥ śrīpatisamo dharmme dharmasamo bhava .. 29 ..
meaning:
मेनकोवाच ..
समुद्रतुल्यो गाम्भीर्य्ये कामतुल्यश्च रूपवान् ..
श्रीयुक्तः श्रीपतिसमो धर्म्मे धर्मसमो भव .. 29 ..
text_mt:
"Be equal to the ocean in profundity, and beautiful like Kāma!
Endowed with splendor, be equal to Viṣṇu, and equal to Dharma in righteousness!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasundharovāca ..
kṣamāśīlo mayā tulyaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvaratnavān ..
nirvighno vighnanighnaśca bhava vatsa śubhāśrayaḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
वसुन्धरोवाच ..
क्षमाशीलो मया तुल्यः शरण्यः सर्वरत्नवान् ..
निर्विघ्नो विघ्ननिघ्नश्च भव वत्स शुभाश्रयः .. 30 ..
text_mt:
"Be forgiving like me, a refuge, possessing all jewels!
Be free of obstacles and a destroyer of obstacles, child, a dwelling of all good fortune!"

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
tātatulyamahāyogī siddhaḥ siddhipradaḥ śubhaḥ ..
mṛtyuñjayaśca bhagavānbhavatvativiśāradaḥ..31..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
ताततुल्यमहायोगी सिद्धः सिद्धिप्रदः शुभः ..
मृत्युञ्जयश्च भगवान्भवत्वतिविशारदः..31..
text_mt:
"Be a great yogi like your father, an accomplished adept, a bestower of perfection, auspicious!
A conqueror of death, divine, and exceedingly learned!"

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve yuyujurāśiṣaḥ..
brāhmaṇā bandinaścaiva yuyujuḥ sarvamaṅgalam ..32..
meaning:
ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धाः सर्वे युयुजुराशिषः..
ब्राह्मणा बन्दिनश्चैव युयुजुः सर्वमङ्गलम् ..32..
text_mt:
The ṛṣis, sages, and accomplished adepts all offered blessings;
the brāhmaṇas and bards likewise bestowed every auspicious wish.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ..
gaṇeśajanmakathanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ..33..
meaning:
सर्वं ते कथितं वत्स सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गलम् ..
गणेशजन्मकथनं सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ..33..
text_mt:
Everything has been told to you, child, the most auspicious of all auspicious things—
the narration of Gaṇeśa's birth, which destroys all obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ sumaṃgalādhyakṣaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sukhaṃ yataḥ ..
sarvamaṃgalasaṃyuktaḥ sa bhavenmaṃgalālayaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
इमं सुमंगलाध्यक्षं यः शृणोति सुखं यतः ..
सर्वमंगलसंयुक्तः स भवेन्मंगलालयः .. 34 ..
text_mt:
He who listens with self-control to this lord of all blessings, obtaining joy,
endowed with all auspiciousness, becomes an abode of good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam..
kṛpaṇo labhate sattvaṃ śaśvatsampatpradāyi ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम्..
कृपणो लभते सत्त्वं शश्वत्सम्पत्प्रदायि च .. 35 ..
text_mt:
One without a son obtains a son; one without wealth obtains wealth;
a miserly man attains goodness that bestows enduring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryyārthī labhate bhāryyāṃ prajārthī labhate prajām ..
ārogyaṃ labhate rogī saubhāgye durbhagā labhet .. 36 ..
meaning:
भार्य्यार्थी लभते भार्य्यां प्रजार्थी लभते प्रजाम् ..
आरोग्यं लभते रोगी सौभाग्ये दुर्भगा लभेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt:
One desiring a wife obtains a wife; one desiring offspring obtains offspring;
a sick person gains health; an unfortunate woman attains good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭaputraṃ naṣṭadhanaṃ proṣitaṃ ca priyaṃ labhet ..
śokāviṣṭaḥ sadā''nandaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
भ्रष्टपुत्रं नष्टधनं प्रोषितं च प्रियं लभेत् ..
शोकाविष्टः सदा'ऽनन्दं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 37 ..
text_mt:
One recovers a lost son, lost wealth, and an absent beloved;
one afflicted by grief attains everlasting joy, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo gaṇeśākhyānakaśrutau ..
tatphalaṃ labhate nūnamadhyāyaśravaṇānmune .. 38 ..
meaning:
यत्पुण्यं लभते मर्त्यो गणेशाख्यानकश्रुतौ ..
तत्फलं लभते नूनमध्यायश्रवणान्मुने .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Whatever merit a mortal attains upon hearing the narrative of Gaṇeśa,
that fruit he surely obtains, O sage, from hearing this chapter.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ ca maṅgalādhyāyo yasya gehaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ..
sadā maṅgalasaṃyuktaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
अयं च मङ्गलाध्यायो यस्य गेहं च तिष्ठति ..
सदा मङ्गलसंयुक्तः स भवेन्नात्र संशयः .. 39 ..
text_mt:
And in whose house this auspicious chapter stays,
he remains forever joined with auspiciousness; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrākāle ca puṇyāhe yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ..
sarvābhīṣṭaṃ sa labhate śrīgaṇeśaprasādataḥ ..40 ..
meaning:
यात्राकाले च पुण्याहे यः शृणोति समाहितः ..
सर्वाभीष्टं स लभते श्रीगणेशप्रसादतः ..40 ..
text_mt:
He who listens with focused attention at the time of a journey and on an auspicious day
obtains every desired object by the grace of Śrī Gaṇeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
haristamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā ratnasiṃhāsane vare ..
devaiśca munibhiḥ sārddhamavasattatra saṃsadi .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
हरिस्तमाशिषं कृत्वा रत्नसिंहासने वरे ..
देवैश्च मुनिभिः सार्द्धमवसत्तत्र संसदि .. 1 ..
title: Kāraṇakathanam

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe śaṃkarastasya vāme brahmā prajāpatiḥ ..
purato jagatāṃ sākṣī dharmo dharmavatāṃ varaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणे शंकरस्तस्य वामे ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः ..
पुरतो जगतां साक्षी धर्मो धर्मवतां वरः .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dharmasamīpe ca sūryyaḥ śakraḥ kalānidhiḥ ..
devāśca munayo brahmannūṣuḥ śailāḥ sukhāsane .. 3 ..
meaning:
तथा धर्मसमीपे च सूर्य्यः शक्रः कलानिधिः ..
देवाश्च मुनयो ब्रह्मन्नूषुः शैलाः सुखासने .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nanartta narttakaśreṇī jagurgandharva kinnarāḥ ..
śrutisāraṃ śrutisukhaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ śrutayo harim .. 4 ..
meaning:
ननर्त्त नर्त्तकश्रेणी जगुर्गन्धर्व किन्नराः ..
श्रुतिसारं श्रुतिसुखं तुष्टुवुः श्रुतयो हरिम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra draṣṭuṃ śaṅkaranandanam ..
ājagāma mahāyogī sūryaputraḥ śanaiścaraḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र द्रष्टुं शङ्करनन्दनम् ..
आजगाम महायोगी सूर्यपुत्रः शनैश्चरः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atyantanamravadana īṣanmudritalocanaḥ ..
antarbahiḥ smarankṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaikagatamānasaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
अत्यन्तनम्रवदन ईषन्मुद्रितलोचनः ..
अन्तर्बहिः स्मरन्कृष्णं कृष्णैकगतमानसः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥphalāśī tejasvī jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ..
atīva sundaraḥ śyāmaḥ pītāmbaradharo varaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
तपःफलाशी तेजस्वी ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः ..
अतीव सुन्दरः श्यामः पीताम्बरधरो वरः .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śivaṃ dharmaṃ raviṃ surān ..
munīndrānbālakaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagāma tadanujñayā ..8..
meaning:
प्रणम्य विष्णुं ब्रह्माणं शिवं धर्मं रविं सुरान् ..
मुनीन्द्रान्बालकं द्रष्टुं जगाम तदनुज्ञया ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānadvāramāsādya śivatulyaparākramam ..
dvāḥsthaṃ vai śūlahastaṃ ca viśālākṣamuvāca ha .. 9 ..
meaning:
प्रधानद्वारमासाद्य शिवतुल्यपराक्रमम् ..
द्वाःस्थं वै शूलहस्तं च विशालाक्षमुवाच ह .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścara uvāca ..
śivājñayā śiśuṃ draṣṭuṃ yāmi śaṃkarakiṃkara ..
viṣṇupramukhadevānāṃ munīnāmanurodhataḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
शनैश्चर उवाच ..
शिवाज्ञया शिशुं द्रष्टुं यामि शंकरकिंकर ..
विष्णुप्रमुखदेवानां मुनीनामनुरोधतः .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāṃ dehi ca māṃ gantuṃ pārvatīsannidhiṃ budha ..
punaryāmi śiśuṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
आज्ञां देहि च मां गन्तुं पार्वतीसन्निधिं बुध ..
पुनर्यामि शिशुं दृष्ट्वा विषयासक्तमानसः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viśālākṣa uvāca .. ājñāvaho na devānāṃ nāhaṃ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ ..
mārgaṃ dātuṃ na śakto'haṃ vinā manmāturājñayā .. 12 ..
meaning:
विशालाक्ष उवाच .. आज्ञावहो न देवानां नाहं शंकरकिंकरः ..
मार्गं दातुं न शक्तोऽहं विना मन्मातुराज्ञया .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā'bhyantarabhyetya preritaḥ sa śivājñayā ..
dadau mārgaṃ graheśāya viśālākṣo mudā tataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वाऽभ्यन्तरभ्येत्य प्रेरितः स शिवाज्ञया ..
ददौ मार्गं ग्रहेशाय विशालाक्षो मुदा ततः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śanirabhyantaraṃ gatvā cānamannamrakandharaḥ ..
ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ ca pārvatīṃ sasmitāṃ mudā .. 14 ..
meaning:
शनिरभ्यन्तरं गत्वा चानमन्नम्रकन्धरः ..
रत्नसिंहासनस्थां च पार्वतीं सस्मितां मुदा .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sakhībhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ..
sakhīdattaṃ ca tāmbūlamupabhujya suvāsitam ..15..
meaning:
सखीभिः पञ्चभिः शश्वत्सेवितां श्वेतचामरैः ..
सखीदत्तं च ताम्बूलमुपभुज्य सुवासितम् ..15..

sanskrit_iast:
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ..
paśyantīṃ narttakīnṛtyaṃ putraṃ dhṛtvā ca vakṣasi .. 16 ..
meaning:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् ..
पश्यन्तीं नर्त्तकीनृत्यं पुत्रं धृत्वा च वक्षसि .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nataṃ sūryyasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā durgā saṃbhāṣya satvaram ..
śubhāśiṣaṃ dadau tasmai pṛṣṭvā tanmaṃgalaṃ śubham .. 37 ..
meaning:
नतं सूर्य्यसुतं दृष्ट्वा दुर्गा संभाष्य सत्वरम् ..
शुभाशिषं ददौ तस्मै पृष्ट्वा तन्मंगलं शुभम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: and gave him an auspicious blessing, having inquired about his auspicious welfare: // 17

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
kathamānamravaktrastvaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam ..
kiṃ na paśyasi māṃ sādho bālakaṃ vā graheśvara .. 18 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
कथमानम्रवक्त्रस्त्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि साम्प्रतम् ..
किं न पश्यसि मां साधो बालकं वा ग्रहेश्वर .. 18 ..
text_mt:
"Why is your face bowed down? I wish to hear now.
Why do you not look at me, O pious one, or at the boy, O lord of planets?" // 18

sanskrit_iast:
śaniruvāca..
sarve svakarmaṇā sādhvi bhuñjate tapasaḥ phalam..
śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma koṭikalpairna lupyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
शनिरुवाच..
सर्वे स्वकर्मणा साध्वि भुञ्जते तपसः फलम्..
शुभाशुभं च यत्कर्म कोटिकल्पैर्न लुप्यते .. 19 ..
text_mt:
"All beings enjoy the fruit of asceticism through their own karma, O virtuous lady;
and whatever karma is good or bad is not destroyed even in millions of aeons. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā jāyate janturbrahmendrāryyamamandire ..
karmaṇā narageheṣu paśvādiṣu ca karmaṇā .. 20 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा जायते जन्तुर्ब्रह्मेन्द्रार्य्यममन्दिरे ..
कर्मणा नरगेहेषु पश्वादिषु च कर्मणा .. 20 ..
text_mt:
Through karma a living creature is born in the mansions of Brahmā, Indra, or Aryaman;
through karma in the houses of men, and through karma among beasts and the like. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā narakaṃ yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti karmaṇā ..
svakarmaṇā ca rājendro bhṛtyaścāpi svakarmaṇā .. 21 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा नरकं याति वैकुण्ठं याति कर्मणा ..
स्वकर्मणा च राजेन्द्रो भृत्यश्चापि स्वकर्मणा .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Through karma one goes to hell; through karma one goes to Vaikuṇṭha.
Through his own karma one is an emperor, and also through his own karma a servant. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā sundaraḥ śaśvadvyādhiyuktaḥ svakarmaṇā ..
karmaṇā viṣayī mātarnnirliptaśca svakarmaṇā .. 22 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा सुन्दरः शश्वद्व्याधियुक्तः स्वकर्मणा ..
कर्मणा विषयी मातर्न्निर्लिप्तश्च स्वकर्मणा .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Through karma one is continually handsome; through one's own karma one is afflicted with disease.
Through karma one is attached to worldly objects, O Mother, and through one's own karma unattached. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā dhanavām̐lloko dainyayuktaḥ svakarmaṇā ..
karmaṇā satkuṭumbī ca karmaṇā bandhukaṇṭakaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा धनवाम्̐ल्लोको दैन्ययुक्तः स्वकर्मणा ..
कर्मणा सत्कुटुम्बी च कर्मणा बन्धुकण्टकः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Through karma a person is wealthy; through one's own karma afflicted with misery.
Through karma one has a good family, and through karma one is a thorn to one's kinsmen. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
subhāryaśca suputraśca sukhī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā ..
aputrakaśca kustrīko nistrīkaśca svakarmaṇā .. 24 ..
meaning:
सुभार्यश्च सुपुत्रश्च सुखी शश्वत्स्वकर्मणा ..
अपुत्रकश्च कुस्त्रीको निस्त्रीकश्च स्वकर्मणा .. 24 ..
text_mt:
One has a good wife and a good son, and is ever happy through one's own karma;
and childless, having a wicked wife, or wifeless through one's own karma. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsaṃ cātigopyaṃ śṛṇu śaṅkaravallabhe ..
akathyaṃ jananīpārśve lajjājanakakāraṇam .. 25 ..
meaning:
इतिहासं चातिगोप्यं शृणु शङ्करवल्लभे ..
अकथ्यं जननीपार्श्वे लज्जाजनककारणम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Listen to a most secret history, O beloved of Śaṅkara,
which should not be told in the presence of a mother, causing shame. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
ābālyātkṛṣṇabhakto'haṃ kṛṣṇadhyānaikamānasaḥ ..
tapasyāsu rataśśaśvadviṣaye'pi rataḥ sadā .. 26 ..
meaning:
आबाल्यात्कृष्णभक्तोऽहं कृष्णध्यानैकमानसः ..
तपस्यासु रतश्शश्वद्विषयेऽपि रतः सदा .. 26 ..
text_mt:
From childhood I have been a devotee of Kṛṣṇa, my mind single-mindedly meditating on Kṛṣṇa,
constantly engaged in austerities, [yet] always engaged also in worldly matters. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
pitā dadau vivāhe tu kanyāṃ citrarathasya ca ..
atitejasvinī śaśvattapasyāsu ratā satī .. 27 ..
meaning:
पिता ददौ विवाहे तु कन्यां चित्ररथस्य च ..
अतितेजस्विनी शश्वत्तपस्यासु रता सती .. 27 ..
text_mt:
My father gave [me] the daughter of Citraratha in marriage,
who was exceedingly splendid, constantly devoted to austerities, a virtuous wife. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sā tvṛtusnātā suveṣaṃ svaṃ vidhāya ca ..
ratnālaṅkārasaṃyuktā munimānasamohinī .. 28 ..
meaning:
एकदा सा त्वृतुस्नाता सुवेषं स्वं विधाय च ..
रत्नालङ्कारसंयुक्ता मुनिमानसमोहिनी .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Once, having bathed after her period and adorned herself beautifully,
furnished with jewel ornaments, captivating even the mind of a sage,

sanskrit_iast:
hareḥ pādaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ paśyantī madamohitā ..
matsamīpaṃ samāgatya sasmitā lolalocanā ..29..
meaning:
हरेः पादं ध्यायमानं पश्यन्ती मदमोहिता ..
मत्समीपं समागत्य सस्मिता लोललोचना ..29..
text_mt:
seeing me meditating on Hari's foot, bewitched by passion,
she approached near to me, smiling, with restless eyes. // 28–29

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa māmapaśyantamṛtunāśācca kopataḥ ..
bāhyajñānavihīnaṃ ca dhyānasaṃlagnamānasam .. 30 ..
meaning:
शशाप मामपश्यन्तमृतुनाशाच्च कोपतः ..
बाह्यज्ञानविहीनं च ध्यानसंलग्नमानसम् .. 30 ..
text_mt:
Because of the loss of her fertile period, out of anger she cursed me, who did not look at her,
deprived of external awareness, my mind fixed in meditation: // 30

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭā'haṃ tvayā yena na kṛtaṃ hyṛturakṣaṇam
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca yadvastu mūḍha sarvaṃ vinaśyati .. 31 ..
meaning:
न दृष्टाऽहं त्वया येन न कृतं ह्यृतुरक्षणम्
त्वया दृष्टं च यद्वस्तु मूढ सर्वं विनश्यति .. 31 ..
text_mt: 'Since I was not looked at by you, and my fertile season was not preserved, / whatever object is looked at by you, you fool, shall all be destroyed!' // 31

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca virato dhyānāttoṣayaṃstāṃ tadā satīm ..
śāpaṃ moktuṃ na śaktā sā paścāttāpamavāpa ha .. 32 ..
meaning:
अहं च विरतो ध्यानात्तोषयंस्तां तदा सतीम् ..
शापं मोक्तुं न शक्ता सा पश्चात्तापमवाप ह .. 32 ..
text_mt:
I then ceased from meditation and propitiated that virtuous wife;
she was unable to retract the curse and felt remorse. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
tena mātarna paśyāmi kiñcidvastu svacakṣuṣā ..
tataḥ prakṛtinamrāsyaḥ prāṇihiṃsābhayādaham .. 33 ..
meaning:
तेन मातर्न पश्यामि किञ्चिद्वस्तु स्वचक्षुषा ..
ततः प्रकृतिनम्रास्यः प्राणिहिंसाभयादहम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, O Mother, I do not look upon any object with my own eye;
hence I have my face naturally bent down out of fear of harming living beings." // 33

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaravacaḥ śrutvā cāhasatpārvatī mune ..
uccaiḥ prajahasuḥ sarvā narttakīkinnarīgaṇāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
शनैश्चरवचः श्रुत्वा चाहसत्पार्वती मुने ..
उच्चैः प्रजहसुः सर्वा नर्त्तकीकिन्नरीगणाः .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Hearing Śanaiścara's words, Pārvatī laughed, O sage,
and all the troops of dancing girls and Kinnarīs laughed loudly. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
durgā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sasmāra harimīśvaram ..
īśvarecchāvaśībhūtaṃ jagadevetyuvāca ha..1..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
दुर्गा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सस्मार हरिमीश्वरम् ..
ईश्वरेच्छावशीभूतं जगदेवेत्युवाच ह..1..
title: Śaniśāpādikathanam

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca devī daivavaśā śaniṃ provāca kautukāt..
paśya māṃ macchiśumiti niṣekaḥ kena vāryyate..2..
meaning:
सा च देवी दैववशा शनिं प्रोवाच कौतुकात्..
पश्य मां मच्छिशुमिति निषेकः केन वार्य्यते..2..

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śanirmene hṛdā svayam ..
paśyāmi kiṃ na paśyāmi pārvatīsutamityaho ..
yadi bālo mayā dṛṣṭastasya vighno bhaveddhruvam..3..
meaning:
पार्वत्या वचनं श्रुत्वा शनिर्मेने हृदा स्वयम् ..
पश्यामि किं न पश्यामि पार्वतीसुतमित्यहो ..
यदि बालो मया दृष्टस्तस्य विघ्नो भवेद्ध्रुवम्..3..

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā supraśastaṃ ca purataḥ svātmarakṣaṇam ..
ityevamuktvā dharmiṣṭho dharmaṃ kṛtvā tu sākṣiṇam..
bālaṃ draṣṭuṃ manaścakre na tu tanmātaraṃ śaniḥ..4..
meaning:
अन्यथा सुप्रशस्तं च पुरतः स्वात्मरक्षणम् ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा धर्मिष्ठो धर्मं कृत्वा तु साक्षिणम्..
बालं द्रष्टुं मनश्चक्रे न तु तन्मातरं शनिः..4..

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṇṇamānasaḥ pūrvaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ..
savyalocanakoṇena dadarśa ca śiśormukham ..5..
meaning:
विषण्णमानसः पूर्वं शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकः..
सव्यलोचनकोणेन ददर्श च शिशोर्मुखम् ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
śaneśca dṛṣṭimātreṇa cicchide mastakaṃ mune ..
cakṣurnimīlayāmāsa tasthau namrānanaḥ śaniḥ..6..
meaning:
शनेश्च दृष्टिमात्रेण चिच्छिदे मस्तकं मुने ..
चक्षुर्निमीलयामास तस्थौ नम्राननः शनिः..6..

sanskrit_iast:
tasthau ca pārvatīkroḍe tatsarvāṅgaṃ salohitam..
viveśa mastakaṃ kṛṣṇe gatvā golokamīpsitam..7..
meaning:
तस्थौ च पार्वतीक्रोडे तत्सर्वाङ्गं सलोहितम्..
विवेश मस्तकं कृष्णे गत्वा गोलोकमीप्सितम्..7..

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchā saṃprāpa sā devī vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ..
matteva ca pṛthivyāṃ tu kṛtvā vakṣasi bālakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छा संप्राप सा देवी विलप्य च भृशं मुहुः..
मत्तेव च पृथिव्यां तु कृत्वा वक्षसि बालकम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vismitāste surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ..
devyaśca śailā gandharvāḥ sarve kailāsavāsinaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
विस्मितास्ते सुराः सर्वे चित्रपुत्तलिका यथा ..
देव्यश्च शैला गन्धर्वाः सर्वे कैलासवासिनः .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tānsarvānmūrcchitāndṛṣṭvaivāruhya garuḍaṃ hariḥ ..
jagāma puṣpabhadrāṃ sa cottarasyāṃ diśi sthitām .. 10 ..
meaning:
तान्सर्वान्मूर्च्छितान्दृष्ट्वैवारुह्य गरुडं हरिः ..
जगाम पुष्पभद्रां स चोत्तरस्यां दिशि स्थिताम् .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpabhadrānadītīre hyapaśyatkānane sthitam ..
gajendraṃ nidritaṃ tatra śayānaṃ hastinīyutam .. 11 ..
meaning:
पुष्पभद्रानदीतीरे ह्यपश्यत्कानने स्थितम् ..
गजेन्द्रं निद्रितं तत्र शयानं हस्तिनीयुतम् .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tathodakchirasaṃ ramyaṃ mūrcchitaṃ surataśramāt ..
paritaḥ śāvakātkṛtvā paramānandamānasam .. 12 ..
meaning:
तथोदक्छिरसं रम्यं मूर्च्छितं सुरतश्रमात् ..
परितः शावकात्कृत्वा परमानन्दमानसम् .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ sudarśanenaiva cicchide tacchiro mudā ..
sthāpayāmāsa garuḍe rudhirāktaṃ manoharam .. 13 ..
meaning:
शीघ्रं सुदर्शनेनैव चिच्छिदे तच्छिरो मुदा ..
स्थापयामास गरुडे रुधिराक्तं मनोहरम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gajacchinnāṅgavikṣepātprabodhaṃ prāpya hastinī ..
śāvakānbodhayāmāsa cāśubhaṃ vadatī tadā ..
ruroda śāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ sā vilapya śucāturā .. 14 ..
meaning:
गजच्छिन्नाङ्गविक्षेपात्प्रबोधं प्राप्य हस्तिनी ..
शावकान्बोधयामास चाशुभं वदती तदा ..
रुरोद शावकैः सार्द्धं सा विलप्य शुचातुरा .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva kamalākāntaṃ śāntaṃ sasmitamīśvaram ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ param ..
garuḍasthaṃ jagatkāntaṃ bhrāmayantaṃ sudarśanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
तुष्टाव कमलाकान्तं शान्तं सस्मितमीश्वरम् ..
शंखचक्रगदापद्मधरं पीताम्बरं परम् ..
गरुडस्थं जगत्कान्तं भ्रामयन्तं सुदर्शनम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
niṣekaṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaṃ niṣekajanakaṃ vibhum ..
niṣekabhogadātāraṃ bhoganistārakāraṇam .. 16 ..
meaning:
निषेकं खण्डितुं शक्तं निषेकजनकं विभुम् ..
निषेकभोगदातारं भोगनिस्तारकारणम् .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prabhustatstavanāttuṣṭastasyai vipra varaṃ dadau ..
muṇḍātuṇḍaṃ pṛthakkṛtya yuyuje'nyagajasya ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्रभुस्तत्स्तवनात्तुष्टस्तस्यै विप्र वरं ददौ ..
मुण्डातुण्डं पृथक्कृत्य युयुजेऽन्यगजस्य च .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jīvayāmāsa taṃ tatra brahmajñānena sarvavit ..
sarvāṃge yojayāmāsa gajasya caraṇāmbujam .. 18 ..
meaning:
जीवयामास तं तत्र ब्रह्मज्ञानेन सर्ववित् ..
सर्वांगे योजयामास गजस्य चरणाम्बुजम् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ jīvākalpaparyyantaṃ parivāraiḥ samaṃ gaja ..
ityuktvā ca manoyāyī kailāsaṃ hyājagāma saḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
त्वं जीवाकल्पपर्य्यन्तं परिवारैः समं गज ..
इत्युक्त्वा च मनोयायी कैलासं ह्याजगाम सः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having said this, he who travels at the speed of thought returned to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtya pārvatīhastādbālaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ..
ruciraṃ tacchirassamyagyojayāmāsa bālake .. 20 ..
meaning:
आहृत्य पार्वतीहस्ताद्बालं कृत्वा स्ववक्षसि ..
रुचिरं तच्छिरस्सम्यग्योजयामास बालके .. 20 ..
text_mt:
Taking the boy from Pārvatī's hand and placing him upon his own chest, // 20
he properly joined that radiant head to the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvarūpo bhagavānbrahmajñānena līlayā ..
jīvayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ huṃkāroccāraṇena ca .. 21 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वरूपो भगवान्ब्रह्मज्ञानेन लीलया ..
जीवयामास तं शीघ्रं हुंकारोच्चारणेन च .. 21 ..
text_mt:
The Blessed One, the embodiment of Brahman, effortlessly, through the knowledge of Brahman // 21
and by uttering the syllable 'huṃ', quickly brought him back to life.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatīṃ bodhayitvā tu kṛtvā kroḍe ca taṃ śiśum ..
bodhayāmāsa tāṃ kṛṣṇa ādhyātmikavibodhanaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पार्वतीं बोधयित्वा तु कृत्वा क्रोडे च तं शिशुम् ..
बोधयामास तां कृष्ण आध्यात्मिकविबोधनैः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Having revived Pārvatī and placed the infant in her lap, // 22
Kṛṣṇa enlightened her with spiritual instructions.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca ..
brahmādikīṭaparyyantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte svakarmaṇaḥ ..
jagadbuddhisvarūpā'si tvaṃ na jānāsi kiṃ śiva .. 23 ..
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच ..
ब्रह्मादिकीटपर्य्यन्तं फलं भुङ्क्ते स्वकर्मणः ..
जगद्बुद्धिस्वरूपाऽसि त्वं न जानासि किं शिव .. 23 ..
text_mt:
“From Brahmā down to an insect, everyone reaps the fruit of their own karma.
You are the very embodiment of universal intellect; do you not know this, O auspicious one? // 23

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ bhogī jīvināṃ tatsvakarmaṇā ..
upasthito bhavennityaṃ pratiyonau śubhāśubhaiḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
कल्पकोटिशतं भोगी जीविनां तत्स्वकर्मणा ..
उपस्थितो भवेन्नित्यं प्रतियोनौ शुभाशुभैः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
For hundreds of millions of kalpas, a living being experiences the results of their own karma;
it constantly presents itself in every womb through good and evil [deeds]. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
indraḥ svakarmaṇā kīṭayonau janma labhetsati ..
kīṭaścāpi bhavedindraḥ pūrvakarmaphalena vai..25..
meaning:
इन्द्रः स्वकर्मणा कीटयोनौ जन्म लभेत्सति ..
कीटश्चापि भवेदिन्द्रः पूर्वकर्मफलेन वै..25..
text_mt:
By his own karma Indra may take birth in the womb of an insect, O virtuous lady,
and even an insect may become Indra through the fruit of previous karma. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
siṃho'pi makṣikāṃ hantumakṣamaḥ prāktanaṃ vinā ..
maśako hastinaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaḥ svaprāktanena ca ..26..
meaning:
सिंहोऽपि मक्षिकां हन्तुमक्षमः प्राक्तनं विना ..
मशको हस्तिनं हन्तुं क्षमः स्वप्राक्तनेन च ..26..
text_mt:
Even a lion is incapable of killing a fly without past karma,
and a mosquito can kill an elephant through its own past karma. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ duḥkha bhayaṃ śokamānandaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ..
sukarmaṇaḥ sukhaṃ harṣamitare pāpakarmaṇaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
सुखं दुःख भयं शोकमानन्दं कर्मणः फलम् ..
सुकर्मणः सुखं हर्षमितरे पापकर्मणः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Pleasure, pain, fear, grief, and joy are the fruit of karma:
pleasure and delight come from good karma; the others from sinful karma. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva karmaṇo bhogaḥ paratra ca śubhāśubhaiḥ ..
karmopārjanayogyaṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam .. 28 ..
meaning:
इहैव कर्मणो भोगः परत्र च शुभाशुभैः ..
कर्मोपार्जनयोग्यं च पुण्यक्षेत्रं च भारतम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
The experience of karma occurs both in this world and the next through good and evil [deeds],
and Bhārata is the sacred field suited for the accumulation of karma. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇaḥ phaladātā ca vidhātā ca vidherapi ..
mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakālo niṣekasya niṣekakṛt .. 29 ..
meaning:
कर्मणः फलदाता च विधाता च विधेरपि ..
मृत्योर्मृत्युः कालकालो निषेकस्य निषेककृत् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
He is the dispenser of the fruits of karma, and the creator of even the Creator;
the death of Death, the time of Time, the ordainer of destiny, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
saṃharturapi saṃharttā pātuḥ pātā parātparaḥ ..
golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ..30..
meaning:
संहर्तुरपि संहर्त्ता पातुः पाता परात्परः ..
गोलोकनाथः श्रीकृष्णः परिपूर्णतमः स्वयम् ..30..
text_mt:
the destroyer of even the destroyer, the protector of the protector, higher than the highest—
the Lord of Goloka, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the most complete [Supreme Being] Himself, // 30

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ yasya kalāḥ puṃso brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
mahāvirāḍyadaṃśaśca yallomavivare jagat .. 31 ..
meaning:
वयं यस्य कलाः पुंसो ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
महाविराड्यदंशश्च यल्लोमविवरे जगत् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
of which Supreme Person we—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara—are parts;
the great Virāj is his portion, and in the pores of his body rests the universe. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
kalāṃśāḥ ke'pi taddharme kalāśāṃśāśca kecana ..
carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ tatra tasthau vināyakaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
कलांशाः केऽपि तद्धर्मे कलाशांशाश्च केचन ..
चराचरं जगत्सर्वं तत्र तस्थौ विनायकः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Some are portions of his parts in nature, and some are fractions of portions of parts;
the whole universe of the moving and unmoving, and there stood Vināyaka.” // 32

sanskrit_iast:
śrīviṣṇorvacanaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭā ca pārvatī ..
stanaṃ dadau ca śiśave taṃ praṇamya gadādharam .. 33 ..
meaning:
श्रीविष्णोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा परितुष्टा च पार्वती ..
स्तनं ददौ च शिशवे तं प्रणम्य गदाधरम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the words of Śrī Viṣṇu, Pārvatī was fully comforted;
bowing to the mace-bearing Lord, she gave her breast to the infant. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva pārvatī tuṣṭā preritā śaṃkareṇa ca ..
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhaktyā viṣṇuṃ taṃ kamalāpatim ..34..
meaning:
तुष्टाव पार्वती तुष्टा प्रेरिता शंकरेण च ..
कृताञ्जलिपुटा भक्त्या विष्णुं तं कमलापतिम् ..34..
text_mt:
Pleased, and encouraged by Śaṅkara, Pārvatī
praised Viṣṇu, the husband of Lakṣmī, with folded hands in devotion. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
āśiṣaṃ yuyuje viṣṇuḥ śiśuṃ ca śiśumātaram ..
dadau gale bālakasya kaustubhaṃ ca svabhūṣaṇam ..35..
meaning:
आशिषं युयुजे विष्णुः शिशुं च शिशुमातरम् ..
ददौ गले बालकस्य कौस्तुभं च स्वभूषणम् ..35..
text_mt:
Viṣṇu bestowed a blessing upon the child and upon the child's mother;
he placed upon the boy's neck the Kaustubha, his own ornament. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā dadau svamukuṭaṃ dharmo vai ratnabhūṣaṇam..
krameṇa devyo ratnāni daduḥ sarve yathocitam..36..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा ददौ स्वमुकुटं धर्मो वै रत्नभूषणम्..
क्रमेण देव्यो रत्नानि ददुः सर्वे यथोचितम्..36..
text_mt:
Brahmā gave his own crown, and Dharma indeed gave an ornament of jewels.
In turn, the goddesses and all [the gods] gave jewels as was fitting.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva taṃ mahādevaścātyantaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
devāśca munayaḥ śailā gandharvāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ..37..
meaning:
तुष्टाव तं महादेवश्चात्यन्तं हृष्टमानसः ..
देवाश्च मुनयः शैला गन्धर्वाः सर्वयोषितः..37..
text_mt:
Mahādeva praised him, his heart overflowing with joy,
as did the gods, sages, mountains, gandharvas, and all the women.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śivāḥ śivā caiva bālakaṃ mṛtajīvitam ..
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tatra koṭiratnāni nārada ..36..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शिवाः शिवा चैव बालकं मृतजीवितम् ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ तत्र कोटिरत्नानि नारद ..36..
text_mt:
Seeing that Śiva's son, the child, was restored to life,
she gave ten million jewels to the brāhmaṇas there, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ..
bandibhyaḥ pradadau tatra bālake mṛtajīvite ..39..
meaning:
अश्वानां च गजानां च सहस्राणि शतानि च ..
बन्दिभ्यः प्रददौ तत्र बालके मृतजीविते ..39..
text_mt:
and thousands and hundreds of horses and elephants
she bestowed upon the bards there, when the child was restored to life.

sanskrit_iast:
himālayaśca saṃtuṣṭo hṛṣṭā devāśca tatra vai ..
dadurdānāni viprebhyo bandibhyaḥ sarvayoṣita..40..
meaning:
हिमालयश्च संतुष्टो हृष्टा देवाश्च तत्र वै ..
ददुर्दानानि विप्रेभ्यो बन्दिभ्यः सर्वयोषित..40..
text_mt:
The Himālaya was delighted, and the gods there were joyful indeed;
all the women gave gifts to the brāhmaṇas and bards.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ..
vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa purāṇāni ramāpatiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयामास कारयामास मङ्गलम् ..
वेदांश्च पाठयामास पुराणानि रमापतिः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Lakṣmī's lord had the Vedas and the Purāṇas recited.

sanskrit_iast:
śaniṃ saṃlajjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatī kopaśālinī ..
śaśāpa ca sabhāmadhye'pyaṅgahīno bhaveti ca .. 42 ..
meaning:
शनिं संलज्जितं दृष्ट्वा पार्वती कोपशालिनी ..
शशाप च सभामध्येऽप्यङ्गहीनो भवेति च .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Śani bashful, Pārvatī, filled with rage,
cursed him in the midst of the assembly: “Become mutilated in limb!”

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śaptaṃ śaniṃ sūryyaḥ kaśyapaśca yamastathā ..
te'tiruṣṭāḥ samuttasthurgāmukāḥ śaṅkarālayāt .. 43 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शप्तं शनिं सूर्य्यः कश्यपश्च यमस्तथा ..
तेऽतिरुष्टाः समुत्तस्थुर्गामुकाः शङ्करालयात् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Śani cursed, Sūrya, Kaśyapa, and Yama
rose up in extreme anger, intending to depart from Śaṅkara's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
raktākṣāste raktamukhāḥ kopaprasphuritādharāḥ ..
tāṃ dharmasākṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ saṃśaptumudyatāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
रक्ताक्षास्ते रक्तमुखाः कोपप्रस्फुरिताधराः ..
तां धर्मसाक्षिणं कृत्वा विष्णुं संशप्तुमुद्यताः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Their eyes red, their faces flushed, their lips quivering with anger,
they, having made Dharma their witness, prepared to curse Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā tānbodhayāmāsa viṣṇunā preritaḥ suraiḥ ..
raktāsyāṃ pārvatīṃ caiva kopaprasphuritādharām .. 45 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा तान्बोधयामास विष्णुना प्रेरितः सुरैः ..
रक्तास्यां पार्वतीं चैव कोपप्रस्फुरिताधराम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Prompted by Viṣṇu and the gods, Brahmā reasoned with them
and with red-faced Pārvatī whose lips were trembling with wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇamūcuste tatra krameṇa samayocitam ..
bhīravo devatāḥ sarve munayaḥ parvatāstathā .. 46..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणमूचुस्ते तत्र क्रमेण समयोचितम् ..
भीरवो देवताः सर्वे मुनयः पर्वतास्तथा .. 46..
text_mt:
They spoke to Brahmā there, in turn, as was fitting for the occasion,
while all the deities, sages, and mountains were terrified.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapa uvāca ..
durdṛṣṭo'yaṃ prāktanena patnīśāpena sarvadā ..
bālaṃ dadarśa yatnena tasya vai māturājñayā .. 47 ..
meaning:
कश्यप उवाच ..
दुर्दृष्टोऽयं प्राक्तनेन पत्नीशापेन सर्वदा ..
बालं ददर्श यत्नेन तस्य वै मातुराज्ञया .. 47 ..
text_mt:
“His glance is destructive because of past deeds, through his wife's curse, at all times.
He looked upon the child with effort [only] at the command of his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūryya uvāca ..
taṃ dharmaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sūnorvai māturājñayā ..
yatputro'tiprayatnena hyapaśyatpārvatīsutam .. 48 ..
meaning:
श्रीसूर्य्य उवाच ..
तं धर्मं साक्षिणं कृत्वा सूनोर्वै मातुराज्ञया ..
यत्पुत्रोऽतिप्रयत्नेन ह्यपश्यत्पार्वतीसुतम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
“Having made Dharma my witness: it was only by the command of the son's mother
that my son with great effort looked at Pārvatī's child.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā niraparādhena matputraṃ sā śaśāpa ha ..
tatputrasyāṃgabhaṃgaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
यथा निरपराधेन मत्पुत्रं सा शशाप ह ..
तत्पुत्रस्यांगभंगश्च भविष्यति न संशयः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Since she cursed my innocent son,
her son shall surely suffer the loss of a limb; there is no doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca ..
pradāya svayamājñāṃ ca śaśāpeyaṃ svayaṃ katham ..
vayaṃ śapāmaḥ ko'dharmo jighāṃsośca vihiṃsane .. 50 ..
meaning:
यम उवाच ..
प्रदाय स्वयमाज्ञां च शशापेयं स्वयं कथम् ..
वयं शपामः कोऽधर्मो जिघांसोश्च विहिंसने .. 50 ..
text_mt:
“Having herself given the command, how could she herself curse him?
We shall curse [her]; what unrighteousness is there in harming one who seeks to harm?”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
śaśāpa pārvatī ruṣṭā strīsvabhāvācca cāpalāt ..
sarveṣāṃ vacanenaiva kṣantumarhantu sādhavaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
शशाप पार्वती रुष्टा स्त्रीस्वभावाच्च चापलात् ..
सर्वेषां वचनेनैव क्षन्तुमर्हन्तु साधवः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
“Angered, Pārvatī cursed him out of a woman's nature and fickleness.
At the word of all, the righteous ought to forgive.

sanskrit_iast:
durge dattvā tvamājñāṃ ca putradarśanahetave ..
kathaṃ śapasi nirdoṣamatithiṃ tvadgṛhāgatam .. 52 ..
meaning:
दुर्गे दत्त्वा त्वमाज्ञां च पुत्रदर्शनहेतवे ..
कथं शपसि निर्दोषमतिथिं त्वद्गृहागतम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
O Durgā, having given permission for the sake of seeing your son,
how can you curse a blameless guest who has arrived at your house?”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śanimādāya bodhayitvā ca pārvatīm ..
tāṃ taṃ samarpaṇaṃ cakre śāpa mocanahetave .. 53 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शनिमादाय बोधयित्वा च पार्वतीम् ..
तां तं समर्पणं चक्रे शाप मोचनहेतवे .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, he took Śani and, pacifying Pārvatī,
surrendered him to her for the sake of releasing the curse.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva pārvatī tuṣṭā brahmaṇo vacanānmune..
śāntā babhūbuste tatra dineśayamakaśyapāḥ..54..
meaning:
बभूव पार्वती तुष्टा ब्रह्मणो वचनान्मुने..
शान्ता बभूबुस्ते तत्र दिनेशयमकश्यपाः..54..
text_mt:
Pārvatī was appeased by Brahmā's words, O sage;
the Sun, Yama, and Kaśyapa became calmed there.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca pārvatī tatra santuṣṭā taṃ śanaiścaram ..
prasāditā śivenaiva brahmaṇā parisevitā .. 55 ..
meaning:
उवाच पार्वती तत्र सन्तुष्टा तं शनैश्चरम् ..
प्रसादिता शिवेनैव ब्रह्मणा परिसेविता .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Then Pārvatī, appeased, spoke to that Śanaiścara,
having been propitiated by Śiva and served by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
graharājo bhava śane madvareṇa haripriyaḥ ..
cirajīvī ca yogīndro haribhaktasya kā vipat .. 56 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
ग्रहराजो भव शने मद्वरेण हरिप्रियः ..
चिरजीवी च योगीन्द्रो हरिभक्तस्य का विपत् .. 56 ..
text_mt:
“Be the king of planets, O Śani, beloved of Hari by my boon,
long-lived and a lord of yogins! What adversity can befall a devotee of Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti nirvighnā harau bhaktirdṛḍhā'stu te ..
śāpo'moghastato me'dya kiñcitkhañjo bhaviṣyasi .. 57 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति निर्विघ्ना हरौ भक्तिर्दृढाऽस्तु ते ..
शापोऽमोघस्ततो मेऽद्य किञ्चित्खञ्जो भविष्यसि .. 57 ..
text_mt:
From this day forward, let your devotion to Hari be firm and unobstructed.
Yet my curse today cannot be futile: you shall be slightly lame.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā bālaṃ dhṛtvā ca vakṣasi ..
uvāsa yoṣitāṃ madhye tasmai dattvā śubhāśiṣaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वती तुष्टा बालं धृत्वा च वक्षसि ..
उवास योषितां मध्ये तस्मै दत्त्वा शुभाशिषः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the pleased Pārvatī, holding the child to her breast,
sat down among the women after bestowing auspicious blessings upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
śanirjagāma devānāṃ samīpaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
praṇamya bhaktyā tāṃ brahmannambikāṃ jagadambikām .. 59 ..
meaning:
शनिर्जगाम देवानां समीपं हृष्टमानसः ..
प्रणम्य भक्त्या तां ब्रह्मन्नम्बिकां जगदम्बिकाम् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Śani went to the presence of the gods, his heart rejoiced,
having bowed with devotion, O brāhmaṇa, to Ambikā, the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
atha viṣṇuḥ śubhe kāle devaiśca munibhiḥ saha ..
pūjayāmāsa taṃ bālamupahārairanuttamaiḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
अथ विष्णुः शुभे काले देवैश्च मुनिभिः सह ..
पूजयामास तं बालमुपहारैरनुत्तमैः .. 1 ..
title: Gaṇeśapūjāstavakavacakathanam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāgre tava pūjā ca mayā dattā surottama ..
sarvapūjyaśca yogīndro bhava vatsetyuvāca tam .. 2 ..
meaning:
सर्वाग्रे तव पूजा च मया दत्ता सुरोत्तम ..
सर्वपूज्यश्च योगीन्द्रो भव वत्सेत्युवाच तम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vanamālāṃ dadau tasmai brahmajñānaṃ ca muktidam ..
sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyaiva cakārātmasamaṃ hariḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
वनमालां ददौ तस्मै ब्रह्मज्ञानं च मुक्तिदम् ..
सर्वसिद्धिं प्रदायैव चकारात्मसमं हरिः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadau dravyāṇi cārūṇi copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ..
