sanskrit_iast:
rāgataḥ kāmadhenuśca mayā vai yācitā mune ..
ko doṣa eka me jātaḥ kṣatriyasyānurāgiṇaḥ..78..
meaning:
रागतः कामधेनुश्च मया वै याचिता मुने ..
को दोष एक मे जातः क्षत्रियस्यानुरागिणः..78..

sanskrit_iast:
kutaḥ kasya munerasti kāmadhenustvayā vinā..
spṛhā raṇe vā bhoge vā yuṣmākaṃ ca vyatikramaḥ..79..
meaning:
कुतः कस्य मुनेरस्ति कामधेनुस्त्वया विना..
स्पृहा रणे वा भोगे वा युष्माकं च व्यतिक्रमः..79..

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīṃ senāṃ rājendrāṇāṃ trikoṭikām..
nihatyāyāntamekaṃ māṃ na hantuṃ sahanaṃ mune ..3.35.80..
meaning:
त्रिंशदक्षौहिणीं सेनां राजेन्द्राणां त्रिकोटिकाम्..
निहत्यायान्तमेकं मां न हन्तुं सहनं मुने ..3.35.80..

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ hantumāyāntamapi vedāṃgapāragam ..
na doṣo hanane tasya na tena brahmahā'bhavam .. 81 ..
meaning:
आत्मानं हन्तुमायान्तमपि वेदांगपारगम् ..
न दोषो हनने तस्य न तेन ब्रह्महाऽभवम् .. 81 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ hiṃsakānāṃ na vedeṣu nirūpitam ..
vadhaḥ samucitasteṣāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं हिंसकानां न वेदेषु निरूपितम् ..
वधः समुचितस्तेषामित्याह कमलोद्भवः .. 82 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā te nihatā bhūpā mahābalaparākramāḥ ..
idānīṃ rājaputrāśca śiśavo'tra samāgatāḥ ..83..
meaning:
पित्रा ते निहता भूपा महाबलपराक्रमाः ..
इदानीं राजपुत्राश्च शिशवोऽत्र समागताः ..83..

sanskrit_iast:
triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kṛtsnāṃ kartuṃ mahīmiti ..
tvayā kṛtā pratijñā yā tasyāstvaṃ pālanaṃ kuru .. 84 ..
meaning:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां कृत्स्नां कर्तुं महीमिति ..
त्वया कृता प्रतिज्ञा या तस्यास्त्वं पालनं कुरु .. 84 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ raṇo dharmo raṇe mṛtyurna garhitaḥ ..
raṇe svāhā brāhmaṇānāṃ loke vede viḍambanā .. 85 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियाणां रणो धर्मो रणे मृत्युर्न गर्हितः ..
रणे स्वाहा ब्राह्मणानां लोके वेदे विडम्बना .. 85 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tapodhanānāṃ viprāṇāṃ vāgbalānāṃ yuge yuge ..
śāntiḥ svastyayanaṃ karma vipradharmo na saṃgaraḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
तपोधनानां विप्राणां वाग्बलानां युगे युगे ..
शान्तिः स्वस्त्ययनं कर्म विप्रधर्मो न संगरः .. 86 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ yuddhaṃ vyāpāraśca balaṃ viśām ..
bhikṣā balaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ viprasevanam .. 87 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियाणां बलं युद्धं व्यापारश्च बलं विशाम् ..
भिक्षा बलं भिक्षुकाणां शूद्राणां विप्रसेवनम् .. 87 ..

sanskrit_iast:
harau bhaktirharerdāsyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ balaṃ hariḥ ..
hiṃsā balaṃ khalānāṃ ca tapasyā ca tapasvinām .. 88 ..
meaning:
हरौ भक्तिर्हरेर्दास्यं वैष्णवानां बलं हरिः ..
हिंसा बलं खलानां च तपस्या च तपस्विनाम् .. 88 ..

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ veṣaśca veśyānāṃ yoṣitāṃ yauvanaṃ balam ..
balaṃ pratāpo bhūpānāṃ bālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam .. 89 ..
meaning:
बलं वेषश्च वेश्यानां योषितां यौवनं बलम् ..
बलं प्रतापो भूपानां बालानां रोदनं बलम् .. 89 ..

sanskrit_iast:
satāṃ satyaṃ balaṃ mithyā balamevāsatāṃ sadā ..
anugānāmanugamaḥ svalpasvānāṃ ca sañcayaḥ .. 3.35.90 ..
meaning:
सतां सत्यं बलं मिथ्या बलमेवासतां सदा ..
अनुगानामनुगमः स्वल्पस्वानां च सञ्चयः .. 3.35.90 ..

sanskrit_iast: vidyā balaṃ paṇḍitānāṃ dhairyyaṃ sāhasināṃ balam ..91 ..
meaning: विद्या बलं पण्डितानां धैर्य्यं साहसिनां बलम् ..91 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ balaṃ ca dhanināṃ śucīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
balaṃ vivekaḥ śāntānāṃ guṇināṃ balamekatā .. 92 ..
meaning:
धनं बलं च धनिनां शुचीनां च विशेषतः ..
बलं विवेकः शान्तानां गुणिनां बलमेकता .. 92 ..

sanskrit_iast:
guṇo balaṃ ca guṇināṃ caurāṇāṃ cauryyameva ca ..
priyavākyaṃ ca kāpaṭyamadharmmaḥ puṃścalībalam .. 93 ..
meaning:
गुणो बलं च गुणिनां चौराणां चौर्य्यमेव च ..
प्रियवाक्यं च कापट्यमधर्म्मः पुंश्चलीबलम् .. 93 ..

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsā ca hiṃsrajantūnāṃ satīnāṃ patisevanam ..
varaśāpau surāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ gurusevanam .. 94 ..
meaning:
हिंसा च हिंस्रजन्तूनां सतीनां पतिसेवनम् ..
वरशापौ सुराणां च शिष्याणां गुरुसेवनम् .. 94 ..

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ rājasevanam ..
balaṃ stavaḥ stāvakānāṃ brahma ca brahmacāriṇām .. 95 ..
meaning:
बलं धर्मो गृहस्थानां भृत्यानां राजसेवनम् ..
बलं स्तवः स्तावकानां ब्रह्म च ब्रह्मचारिणाम् .. 95 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ ca sadācāro nyāsaḥ saṃnyāsināṃ balam ..
pāpaṃ balaṃ pātakināmaśaktānāṃ harirbalam .. 96 ..
meaning:
यतीनां च सदाचारो न्यासः संन्यासिनां बलम् ..
पापं बलं पातकिनामशक्तानां हरिर्बलम् .. 96 ..

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ balaṃ puṇyavatāṃ prajānāṃ nṛpatirbalam ..
phalaṃ balaṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ jalajānāṃ jalaṃ balam .. 97 ..
meaning:
पुण्यं बलं पुण्यवतां प्रजानां नृपतिर्बलम् ..
फलं बलं च वृक्षाणां जलजानां जलं बलम् .. 97 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jalaṃ balaṃ ca sasyānāṃ matsyānāṃ ca jalaṃ balam ..
śāntirbalaṃ ca bhūpānāṃ viprāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
जलं बलं च सस्यानां मत्स्यानां च जलं बलम् ..
शान्तिर्बलं च भूपानां विप्राणां च विशेषतः .. 98 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vipraḥ śānto raṇodyogī naiva dṛṣṭo na ca śrutaḥ ..
sthite nārāyaṇe deve babhūvānyaviparyyayaḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
विप्रः शान्तो रणोद्योगी नैव दृष्टो न च श्रुतः ..
स्थिते नारायणे देवे बभूवान्यविपर्य्ययः .. 99 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā rājendro virarāma raṇājire ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sadyastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha .. 3.35.100 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजेन्द्रो विरराम रणाजिरे ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सद्यस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह .. 3.35.100 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve tīkṣṇaśastrāsipāṇayaḥ ..
ārebhire raṇaṃ karttuṃ mahāvīrāstadājñayā .. 101 ..
meaning:
रामस्य भ्रातरः सर्वे तीक्ष्णशस्त्रासिपाणयः ..
आरेभिरे रणं कर्त्तुं महावीरास्तदाज्ञया .. 101 ..

sanskrit_iast:
raṇonmukhāṃśca tāndṛṣṭvā matsyarājo mahābalaḥ ..
samārebhe raṇaṃ kartuṃ maṅgalo maṅgalālayaḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
रणोन्मुखांश्च तान्दृष्ट्वा मत्स्यराजो महाबलः ..
समारेभे रणं कर्तुं मङ्गलो मङ्गलालयः .. 102 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śarajālena rājendro vārayāmāsa tānapi ..
cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca jamadagnisutāstadā .. 103 ..
meaning:
शरजालेन राजेन्द्रो वारयामास तानपि ..
चिच्छिदुः शरजालं च जमदग्निसुतास्तदा .. 103 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājā cikṣepa divyāstraṃ śatasūryyaprabhaṃ mune ..
māheśvareṇa munayaścicchiduścaiva līlayā..104..
meaning:
राजा चिक्षेप दिव्यास्त्रं शतसूर्य्यप्रभं मुने ..
माहेश्वरेण मुनयश्चिच्छिदुश्चैव लीलया..104..

sanskrit_iast:
divyāstreṇaiva munayaścicchiduḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ..
rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ caiva rājñaḥ sannāhameva ca..105
meaning:
दिव्यास्त्रेणैव मुनयश्चिच्छिदुः सशरं धनुः..
रथं च सारथिं चैव राज्ञः सन्नाहमेव च..105
text_mt: Then Jamadagni's sons cut down the net of arrows. / The king hurled a divine missile shining like a hundred suns, O sage; / the sages cut it down effortlessly with a missile of Maheśvara. / With a divine missile, the sages severed his bow along with its arrows, / his chariot, his charioteer, and the king's armor as well.

sanskrit_iast:
nyastaśastraṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā munayo harṣavihvalāḥ ..
dadhāra śūlinaḥ śūlaṃ matsyarājajighāṃsayā .. 106 ..
meaning:
न्यस्तशस्त्रं नृपं दृष्ट्वा मुनयो हर्षविह्वलाः ..
दधार शूलिनः शूलं मत्स्यराजजिघांसया .. 106 ..
text_mt:
Seeing the king disarmed, the sages were overcome with joy.
He grasped the trident of the Trident-bearer with the desire to kill the Matsya king.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlanikṣepasamaye vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
śūlaṃ tyajata viprendrāḥ śivasyāvyarthameva ca .. 107 ..
meaning:
शूलनिक्षेपसमये वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ..
शूलं त्यजत विप्रेन्द्राः शिवस्याव्यर्थमेव च .. 107 ..
text_mt:
At the moment of casting the trident, an incorporeal voice arose:
"O best of brāhmaṇas, stay the trident of Śiva, which never fails!

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya kavacaṃ divyaṃ dattaṃ durvāsasā purā ..
matsyarājagale'styetatsarvāvayavarakṣakam .. 108 ..
meaning:
शिवस्य कवचं दिव्यं दत्तं दुर्वाससा पुरा ..
मत्स्यराजगलेऽस्त्येतत्सर्वावयवरक्षकम् .. 108 ..
text_mt:
Formerly, a divine armour of Śiva was given by Durvāsas;
this, protecting all his limbs, is on the Matsya king's neck.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānāṃ ca pradātāraṃ kavacaṃ yācataṃ nṛpam ..
tadā nikṣiptaśūlaṃ ca jaghāna nṛpatiściram .. 109 ..
meaning:
प्राणानां च प्रदातारं कवचं याचतं नृपम् ..
तदा निक्षिप्तशूलं च जघान नृपतिश्चिरम् .. 109 ..
text_mt:
Beg the king for the armour that preserves his life."
Then, having been hurled, the trident struck the king for a long time,

sanskrit_iast:
tacchūlaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ prāpya śatakhaṇḍaṃ gataṃ mune ..
śrutvaivākāśavāṇīṃ ca śṛṅgī saṃnyāsaveṣakṛt .. 3.35.110 ..
meaning:
तच्छूलं तं नृपं प्राप्य शतखण्डं गतं मुने ..
श्रुत्वैवाकाशवाणीं च शृङ्गी संन्यासवेषकृत् .. 3.35.110 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the voice from the sky, Śṛṅgin, assuming the guise of a renunciant—
and reaching that king, O sage, the trident was shattered into a hundred pieces.

sanskrit_iast:
yayāce kavacaṃ bhūpaṃ jamadagnisuto mahān ..
rājā dadau ca kavacaṃ brahmāṇḍavijayaṃ param .. 111 ..
meaning:
ययाचे कवचं भूपं जमदग्निसुतो महान् ..
राजा ददौ च कवचं ब्रह्माण्डविजयं परम् .. 111 ..
text_mt:
that great son of Jamadagni begged the king for the armour.
The king gave the supreme armour called Brahmāṇḍavijaya.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā kavacaṃ tacca śūlenaiva jaghāna ha ..
papāta matsyarājaśca śatacandrasamānanaḥ ..
mahābaliṣṭho guṇavāṃścandravaṃśasamudbhavaḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा कवचं तच्च शूलेनैव जघान ह ..
पपात मत्स्यराजश्च शतचन्द्रसमाननः ..
महाबलिष्ठो गुणवांश्चन्द्रवंशसमुद्भवः .. 112 ..
text_mt:
Having taken that armour, he struck him down indeed with a spear.
The Matsya king fell, his face resembling a hundred moons,
exceedingly mighty, virtuous, born of the lunar dynasty.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
śivasya kavacaṃ brūhi matsyarājena yaddhṛtam ..
nārāyaṇa mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 113 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
शिवस्य कवचं ब्रूहि मत्स्यराजेन यद्धृतम् ..
नारायण महाभाग श्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम .. 113 ..
text_mt:
"Tell of the armour of Śiva that was worn by the Matsya king,
O highly fortunate Nārāyaṇa; my curiosity is [great] to hear it."

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
kavacaṃ śṛṇu viprendra śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
brahmāṇḍavijayaṃ nāma sarvāvayavarakṣaṇam .. 114 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
कवचं शृणु विप्रेन्द्र शङ्करस्य महात्मनः ..
ब्रह्माण्डविजयं नाम सर्वावयवरक्षणम् .. 114 ..
text_mt:
"Hear, O best of brāhmaṇas, the armour of the great Śaṅkara,
named Brahmāṇḍavijaya, which protects all the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
purā durvāsasā dattaṃ matsyarājāya dhīmate ..
dattvā ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 115 ..
meaning:
पुरा दुर्वाससा दत्तं मत्स्यराजाय धीमते ..
दत्त्वा षडक्षरं मन्त्रं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 115 ..
text_mt:
Formerly it was given by Durvāsas to the wise Matsya king,
having bestowed the six-syllable mantra that destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sthite ca kavace dehe nāsti mṛtyuśca jīvinām ..
astre śastre jale vahnau siddhiścennāsti saṃśayaḥ .. 116 ..
meaning:
स्थिते च कवचे देहे नास्ति मृत्युश्च जीविनाम् ..
अस्त्रे शस्त्रे जले वह्नौ सिद्धिश्चेन्नास्ति संशयः .. 116 ..
text_mt:
While this armour remains on the body, there is no death for living beings;
from missiles, weapons, water, or fire—if there is mastery, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbāṇaḥ śivatvaṃ prāpa līlayā ..
babhūva śivatulyaśca yaddhṛtvā nandikeśvaraḥ .. 117 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा पठनाद्बाणः शिवत्वं प्राप लीलया ..
बभूव शिवतुल्यश्च यद्धृत्वा नन्दिकेश्वरः .. 117 ..
text_mt:
By wearing and reciting it, Bāṇa easily attained the state of Śiva;
by wearing it, Nandikeśvara became equal to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
vīraśreṣṭho vīrabhadraḥ sāmbo'bhūddhāraṇādyataḥ..
trailokyavijayī rājā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam .. .. 118 ..
meaning:
वीरश्रेष्ठो वीरभद्रः साम्बोऽभूद्धारणाद्यतः..
त्रैलोक्यविजयी राजा हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् .. .. 118 ..
text_mt:
Vīrabhadra became the foremost among heroes, and Sāmba [became glorious] because of wearing it.
King Hiraṇyakaśipu himself conquered the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣaśca vijayī cābhavaddhāraṇāddhi saḥ ..
yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātsiddho durvāsā viśvapūjitaḥ .. 119 ..
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षश्च विजयी चाभवद्धारणाद्धि सः ..
यद्धृत्वा पठनात्सिद्धो दुर्वासा विश्वपूजितः .. 119 ..
text_mt:
and Hiraṇyākṣa became victorious indeed because of wearing it.
By wearing and reciting it, Durvāsas became an accomplished adept, revered by the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
jaigīṣavyo mahāyogī paṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ ..
yaddhṛtvā vāmadevaśca devalaḥ pavanaḥ svayam ..
agastyaśca pulastyaścāpyabhavadviśvapūjitaḥ .. 3.35.120 ..
meaning:
जैगीषव्यो महायोगी पठनाद्धारणाद्यतः ..
यद्धृत्वा वामदेवश्च देवलः पवनः स्वयम् ..

text_mt:
Nārāyaṇa said:
When the king of Matsya had fallen, the king skilled in warfare / dispatched lordly kings skilled in weapons into battle: / Bṛhadbala, Somadatta, the ruler of Vidarbha, the lord of Mithilā, / the sovereign of Niṣadha, and likewise the sovereign of Magadha. / Those great chariot-warriors came to fight against the descendant of Jamadagni in battle, / along with armies of three akṣauhiṇīs, O Nārada. / All the brothers of Rāma, heroes with sharp weapons in hand, / warded them off with missiles at the forefront of the battle. / Those heroes, with an array of arrows and with divine missiles, strenuously / warded off one by one the brothers of the Bhṛgu descendant. / Seeing them defeated, he quickly came into battle, / bow in hand, that Bhṛgu descendant resembling a blazing crest of fire. / The mighty descendant of Jamadagni hurled the serpent-noose, / and the mighty Somadatta cut it with a Garuḍa weapon. / Bhṛgu slew Somadatta with Śaṅkara's trident, / and Bṛhadbala with a mace, and the Vidarbha ruler with his fists, / the Maithila king with a mallet, and the Naiṣadha king with a spear, / the Magadhan king with blows of his feet, and the soldiers with a shower of weapons. / Having slain all the kings, resembling the fire of destruction in battle, / the mighty descendant of Jamadagni rushed toward Kārttavīrya. / Seeing him coming to fight, the kings, great chariot-warriors, / came to wage battle, turning Kārttavīrya back: / hundreds from Kānyakubja, and likewise hundreds of Saurāṣṭras, / and hundreds of Rāṣṭrīyas, and likewise hundreds of supreme heroes, / hundreds of peaceful Vāṅgas, and ten Mahārāṣṭras, / and likewise those of Gurjara stock, and hundreds of Kaliṅgas. / Though they made a net of arrows, the Bhṛgu descendant severed it instantly; / having cut it through, Rāma rose up like the sun dispersing mist. / For three nights Rāma fought with them on the battlefield.

text_mt:
He likewise cut down an army of twelve akṣauhiṇīs with his axe, / as if effortlessly slicing a clump of plantain stems with a sword. / Having destroyed the army, he slew the host of kings with Śiva's trident. / Seeing all of them slain, Sucandra, born in the solar dynasty, / arrived accompanied by one hundred thousand lordly kings / and with armies of twelve akṣauhiṇīs in combat. / In wrath he fought Rāma, as a lion fights a lion in battle. / Bhṛgu, having slain the hundred thousand kings with Śaṅkara's trident, / the mighty one destroyed the army of twelve akṣauhiṇīs with his axe. / Having destroyed all the armies, the mighty one fought Sucandra; / Bhṛgu himself released the serpent missile to destroy him. / The lord of kings severed the serpent-noose with a Garuḍa missile, / and repeatedly laughed at the Bhṛgu descendant in battle. / The Bhṛgu descendant then hurled the Nārāyaṇa weapon at the battlefront; / possessing the splendour of a hundred suns, it went forth to slay him. / Seeing the missile, that tiger among kings instantly stepped down from his chariot, / laid down his weapons, and made obeisance, praising auspicious Nārāyaṇa. / Leaving him thus bowed, the king of missiles / returned to the presence of the blessed Nārāyaṇa, and Rāma was struck with wonder. / In wrath, wishing to slay him, the Bhṛgu descendant hurled a spear, a club, / a javelin, a flat-headed spear, a mace, and his axe. / Kālī, standing on Sucandra's chariot, seized them all; / he hurled Śiva's trident, and it turned into a garland for the king. / Before him Rāma beheld Bhadrakālī, mother of the universe, / wearing a garland of severed heads, of hideous mouth, terrifying. / Laying aside weapon, missile, and bow, the Bhṛgu descendant then / praised that Mahāmāyā, his neck bowed in devotion.
Paraśurāma said:
Salutations to the beloved of Śaṅkara! To you who are the essence, salutations, salutations!

text_mt: "Salutations to the destroyer of distress, to Māyā! Salutations, salutations to you! / Salutations, salutations to the sustainer of the world, to the maker of the world, salutations, salutations! // Salutations be to you, mother of the world, to the primal cause! Salutations, salutations! / Be gracious, O mother of the worlds, O agent of creation and destruction! // I take refuge at your feet; make my vow fulfilled! / And if you are averse to me, who is able to protect me? // Be pleased, O auspicious one, with me, your devotee, O lover of devotees! / Formerly, a boon was granted to me by you in Śivaloka; // you ought to make that boon bear fruit, O fair-faced one!" / Hearing the eulogy of the son of Reṇukā, Ambikā became pleased; / saying only "Do not fear," she vanished right there. / And whoever recites this hymn of praise composed by the descendant of Bhṛgu, endowed with devotion, / will effortlessly cross over great danger. / He is honored in the three worlds, and in that very place he becomes victorious; / he becomes the best of wise men and a crusher of enemy factions. // Meanwhile, Brahmā, having approached the descendant of Bhṛgu, the best among upholders of dharma, / spoke the secret to Rāma himself. // Brahmā said: / "Listen, O fortunate Rāma, to the ancient secret, / the cause of victory over Sucandra, and the fruit of your vow: // Formerly, the ten-syllabled great knowledge was given by Durvāsas / to Sucandra, along with the extremely rare armour of Bhadrakālī. // And the armour of Bhadrakālī is extremely rare even for the gods; / on whose neck that armour is placed, it crushes all enemies. // It is exceedingly venerable, praised, and the cause of victory over the three worlds. / While that armour remains, who on earth is able to conquer you? // O descendant of Bhṛgu, let one go for alms and make a request of the king; / born of the solar dynasty, the king is a giver and supremely righteous. // He will certainly give his life, the armour, the mantra, everything."

text_mt: Going near the king in the guise of an ascetic, O sage, / the descendant of Bhṛgu begged for the mantra and the supremely wonderful armour. // And the king gave that mantra and armour with the utmost reverence; / then the descendant of Bhṛgu slew that king with the trident of Śaṅkara. // Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Battle between the Descendant of Bhṛgu and Kārtavīrya', in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the third section, the Gaṇapatikhaṇḍa, in the glorious Brahmavaivarta Mahāpurāṇa. // 36

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

ओं ह्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं कालिकायै स्वाहा कण्ठं सदाऽवतु .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ kālikāyai svāhā karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ kālikāyai svāhā mama pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ muṇḍamālinyai svāhā pādau sadāvatu..

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ pātu mahākālī cāgneyyāṃ raktadantikā ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmā ca vāruṇe pātu vāyavyāṃ pātu caṇḍikā ..
uttare vikaṭāsyā cāpyaiśānyāṃ sāṭṭahāsinī .. 18 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
pātūrdhvaṃ lolajihvā sā māyā''dyā pātvadhaḥ sadā ..
jale sthale cāntarikṣe pātu viśvaprasūḥ sadā .. 19 ..
meaning:

जले स्थले चान्तरिक्षे पातु विश्वप्रसूः सदा .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ..
sarveṣāṃ kavacānāṃ ca sārabhūtaṃ parātparam ..3.37.20..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं वत्स सर्वमन्त्रौघविग्रहम् ..
सर्वेषां कवचानां च सारभूतं परात्परम् ..3.37.20..

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpeśvaro rājā sucandro'sya prabhāvataḥ ..
kavacasya prabhāvena māndhātā pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपेश्वरो राजा सुचन्द्रोऽस्य प्रभावतः ..
कवचस्य प्रभावेन मान्धाता पृथिवीपतिः .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pracetā lomaśaścaiva yataḥ siddho babhūva ha ..
yato hi yogināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ saubhariḥ pippalāyanaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
प्रचेता लोमशश्चैव यतः सिद्धो बभूव ह ..
यतो हि योगिनां श्रेष्ठः सौभरिः पिप्पलायनः .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syātsiddhakavacaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet ..
mahādānāni sarvāṇi tapāṃsyevaṃ vratāni va ..
niścitaṃ kavacasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 23 ..
meaning:
यदि स्यात्सिद्धकवचः सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् ..
महादानानि सर्वाणि तपांस्येवं व्रतानि व ..
निश्चितं कवचस्यास्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajetkālīṃ jagatprasūm ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
sucandre patite brahmanrājendrāṇāṃ śiromaṇau ..
agamatpuṣkarākṣastu senātryakṣauhiṇīyutaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
सुचन्द्रे पतिते ब्रह्मन्राजेन्द्राणां शिरोमणौ ..
अगमत्पुष्कराक्षस्तु सेनात्र्यक्षौहिणीयुतः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 38

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ gale yasya manoharam ..

meaning:

परमैश्वर्य्यसंयुक्तस्त्रैलोक्यविजयी ततः ..3..

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraḥ sarve raiṇukeyasya dhīmataḥ ..

meaning:

आययुः समरं कर्त्तुं नानाशस्त्रास्त्रपाणयः ...4..

sanskrit_iast:
rājendraḥ śarajālena cchedayāmāsa tāṃstathā ..
cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca te vīrāścaiva līlayā .. 5 ..
meaning:
राजेन्द्रः शरजालेन च्छेदयामास तांस्तथा ..
चिच्छिदुः शरजालं च ते वीराश्चैव लीलया .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cicchiduḥ syandanaṃ rājñaste vīrāḥ pañcabāṇataḥ ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
taddhanuḥ saptabāṇena tūrṇaṃ vai pañcabāṇataḥ ..
cicchidustadbhrātṛvargānviprāḥ śaṅkaraśūlataḥ ..7..
meaning:
तद्धनुः सप्तबाणेन तूर्णं वै पञ्चबाणतः ..

sanskrit_iast:
te ca tryakṣauhiṇīṃ senānnijaghnuścāpi līlayā ..

gale babhūva tacchūlaṃ rājñaḥ puṣkaramālikā .. 8 ..
meaning:

गले बभूव तच्छूलं राज्ञः पुष्करमालिका .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiṃ ca parighaṃ caiva bhuśuṇḍīṃ mudgaraṃ tathā ..
gadāṃ ca cikṣipurviprāḥ kopena jvaladagnayaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
शक्तिं च परिघं चैव भुशुण्डीं मुद्गरं तथा ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāni śastrāṇi cūrṇāni kṣmābhṛto dehayogataḥ ..
vismitā bhrātaraḥ sarve bhṛgoreva mahāmune ..3.38.10..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
रथं धनुश्च शस्त्राणि चास्त्राणि विविधानि च ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

बोधयित्वा तान्निवार्य्य जगाम रणमूर्द्धनि ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguścikṣepa nānāstraṃ mahāsandhānapūrvakam ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaścikṣepa sandhāya brahmāstraṃ mantrapūrvakam ..
rājā nirvāpaṇaṃ cakre sandhānenaiva līlayā ..21..
meaning:
रामश्चिक्षेप सन्धाय ब्रह्मास्त्रं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇyastrāṇi śastrāṇi rāmaḥ pāśupataṃ vinā ..

meaning:
सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि शस्त्राणि रामः पाशुपतं विना ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaḥ stutvā śivaṃ natvā''dade pāśupataṃ mune ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca ..
kiṃ karoṣi bhṛgo vatsa tvamevaṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
naraṃ hantuṃ pāśupataṃ kopātkiṃ kṣipasi bhramāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच ..
किं करोषि भृगो वत्स त्वमेवं ज्ञानिनां वरः ..

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ pāśupatenaiva bhavedbhasma ca satvaram ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryyamajetāraṃ yathā jeṣyasi sāmpratam ..

meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्य्यमजेतारं यथा जेष्यसि साम्प्रतम् ..

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ durgatināśinyāḥ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ..

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
kavacasya prabhāveṇa viśvaṃ jetuṃ kṣamau ca tau ..

meaning:
कवचस्य प्रभावेण विश्वं जेतुं क्षमौ च तौ ..

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhikṣārthaṃ sannidhāne tayormune ..
kariṣyāmi ca tadbhikṣāṃ pratijñā saphalā'stu te .. 33 ..
meaning:
अहं यास्यामि भिक्षार्थं सन्निधाने तयोर्मुने ..
करिष्यामि च तद्भिक्षां प्रतिज्ञा सफलाऽस्तु ते .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ saṃtrastamānasaḥ ..
uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā .. 34 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः संत्रस्तमानसः ..
उवाच ब्राह्मणं वृद्धं हृदयेन विदूयता .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
paraśurāma uvāca ..
na jānāmi mahāprājña kastvaṃ brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ..
śīghraṃ ca brūhi māṃ mūḍhaṃ tadā gaccha nṛpāntikam .. 35 ..
meaning:
परशुराम उवाच ..
न जानामि महाप्राज्ञ कस्त्वं ब्राह्मणरूपधृक् ..
शीघ्रं च ब्रूहि मां मूढं तदा गच्छ नृपान्तिकम् .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jāmadagnyavacaḥ śrutvā prahasya brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ..
uktvā cāhaṃ viṣṇuriti yayau bhikṣitumīśvaraḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
जामदग्न्यवचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य ब्राह्मणः स्वयम् ..
उक्त्वा चाहं विष्णुरिति ययौ भिक्षितुमीश्वरः .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā tayoḥ sannidhānaṃ yayāce kavace ca tau ..
dadatustau ca kavace viṣṇave viṣṇumāyayā ..
gṛhītvā kavace viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhaṃ nirjagāma saḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
गत्वा तयोः सन्निधानं ययाचे कवचे च तौ ..
ददतुस्तौ च कवचे विष्णवे विष्णुमायया ..
गृहीत्वा कवचे विष्णुर्वैकुण्ठं निर्जगाम सः .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ kena dattaṃ mahāmune ..
puṣkarākṣāya bhūpāya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 38 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
महालक्ष्म्याश्च कवचं केन दत्तं महामुने ..
पुष्कराक्षाय भूपाय श्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम .. 38 ..
text_mt:
"By whom was the armour of Mahālakṣmī given, O great sage,
To King Puṣkarākṣa? I am curious to hear.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacaṃ cāpi durgāyāḥ puṣkarākṣasutāya ca ..
durllabhaṃ kena vā dattaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhasi .. 39 ..
meaning:
कवचं चापि दुर्गायाः पुष्कराक्षसुताय च ..
दुर्ल्लभं केन वा दत्तं तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 39 ..
text_mt:
And by whom was the rare armour of Durgā
Given to Puṣkarākṣa's son? Be pleased to tell me that.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacaṃ cāpi kimbhūtaṃ tayorvā tasya kiṃ phalam ..
mantrau tu kiṃprakārau ca tanme brūhi jagadguro.. ... 3.38.40 ..
meaning:
कवचं चापि किम्भूतं तयोर्वा तस्य किं फलम् ..
मन्त्रौ तु किंप्रकारौ च तन्मे ब्रूहि जगद्गुरो.. ... 3.38.40 ..
text_mt:
What was the armour like, and what was the fruit of it for the two?
What kind were the two mantras? Tell me that, O teacher of the universe."

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
dattaṃ sanatkumāreṇa puṣkarākṣāya dhīmate ..
mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ mantraścāpi daśākṣaraḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
दत्तं सनत्कुमारेण पुष्कराक्षाय धीमते ..
महालक्ष्म्याश्च कवचं मन्त्रश्चापि दशाक्षरः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
"It was given by Sanatkumāra to the wise Puṣkarākṣa—
The armour of Mahālakṣmī and the ten-syllable mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
stavanaṃ cāpi gopyaṃ vai proktaṃ taccaritaṃ ca yat ..
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ pūjāṃ caiva manoharām .. 42 ..
meaning:
स्तवनं चापि गोप्यं वै प्रोक्तं तच्चरितं च यत् ..
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं पूजां चैव मनोहराम् .. 42 ..
text_mt:
And the secret hymn of praise, that legend which was told,
The meditation taught in the Sāmaveda, and the charming rite of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
durgāyāścāpi kavacaṃ dattaṃ durvāsasā purā..
stavanaṃ cāpi gopyaṃ ca mantraścāpi daśākṣaraḥ..43..
meaning:
दुर्गायाश्चापि कवचं दत्तं दुर्वाससा पुरा..
स्तवनं चापि गोप्यं च मन्त्रश्चापि दशाक्षरः..43..
text_mt:
And the armour of Durgā was formerly given by Durvāsas,
Along with the secret hymn of praise and the ten-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
paścācchroṣyasi tatsarvaṃ devyāśca paramādbhutam..
mahāyuddhasamārambhe dattaṃ prārthanayā ca yat ..44..
meaning:
पश्चाच्छ्रोष्यसि तत्सर्वं देव्याश्च परमाद्भुतम्..
महायुद्धसमारम्भे दत्तं प्रार्थनया च यत् ..44..
text_mt:
You shall hear all of that later, the most wonderful [lore] of the goddess,
Which was given upon entreaty at the commencement of the great battle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmyāśca mantraṃ ca śṛṇu taṃ kathayāmi te ..
oṃ śrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāheti paramādbhutam .. 45..
meaning:
महालक्ष्म्याश्च मन्त्रं च शृणु तं कथयामि ते ..
ओं श्रीं कमलवासिन्यै स्वाहेति परमाद्भुतम् .. 45..
text_mt:
Hear the mantra of Mahālakṣmī; I will declare it to you:
'Oṃ śrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā'—it is most wondrous.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ mune ..
dattaṃ tasmai kumāreṇa puṣkarākṣāya dhīmate .. 46 ..
meaning:
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं शृणु पूजाविधिं मुने ..
दत्तं तस्मै कुमारेण पुष्कराक्षाय धीमते .. 46 ..
text_mt:
O sage, hear the meditation taught in the Sāmaveda and the procedure of worship
Given by Kumāra to that wise Puṣkarākṣa:

sanskrit_iast:
sahasradalapadmasthāṃ padmanābhapriyāṃ satīm ..
padmālayāṃ padmavaktrāṃ padmapatrābhalocanām .. 47..
meaning:
सहस्रदलपद्मस्थां पद्मनाभप्रियां सतीम् ..
पद्मालयां पद्मवक्त्रां पद्मपत्राभलोचनाम् .. 47..
text_mt:
'Seated on a thousand-petalled lotus, beloved of Padmanābha, the virtuous wife,
Whose abode is the lotus, lotus-faced, with eyes like the petals of a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
padmapuṣpapriyāṃ padmapuṣpatalpādhiśāyinīm ..
padminīpadmahastāṃ ca padmamālāvibhūṣitām .. 48 ..
meaning:
पद्मपुष्पप्रियां पद्मपुष्पतल्पाधिशायिनीम् ..
पद्मिनीपद्महस्तां च पद्ममालाविभूषिताम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Fond of lotus flowers, resting upon a couch of lotus flowers,
Holding a lotus in her lotus-hand, adorned with a garland of lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
padmabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ padmaśobhāvivarddhanīm ..
padmāṭavīṃ prapaśyantīṃ sasmitāṃ tāṃ bhaje mudā .. 49 ..
meaning:
पद्मभूषणभूषाढ्यां पद्मशोभाविवर्द्धनीम् ..
पद्माटवीं प्रपश्यन्तीं सस्मितां तां भजे मुदा .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Richly ornamented with lotus-jewels, increasing the splendour of lotuses,
Gazing upon a forest of lotuses, smiling—her do I joyfully worship.'

sanskrit_iast:
candanāṣṭadale padme padmapuṣpeṇa pūjayet ..
gaṇaṃ sampūjya dattvā caivopacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa .. 3.38.50 ..
meaning:
चन्दनाष्टदले पद्मे पद्मपुष्पेण पूजयेत् ..
गणं सम्पूज्य दत्त्वा चैवोपचारांश्च षोडश .. 3.38.50 ..
text_mt:
One should worship her with lotus blossoms on an eight-petalled lotus of sandal paste,
Having first worshipped her retinue and offered sixteen articles of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ stutvā ca praṇametsādhako bhaktipūrvakam ..
kavacaṃ śrūyatāṃ brahmansarvasāraṃ vadāmi te .. 51 ..
meaning:
ततः स्तुत्वा च प्रणमेत्साधको भक्तिपूर्वकम् ..
कवचं श्रूयतां ब्रह्मन्सर्वसारं वदामि ते .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Then, having praised and bowed down with devotion, the practitioner [should listen].
Hear the armour, O brāhmaṇa; I tell you the essence of everything.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu viprendra padmāyāḥ kavacaṃ paramaṃ śubham ..
padmanābhena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipadmake .. 52 ..
meaning:
शृणु विप्रेन्द्र पद्मायाः कवचं परमं शुभम् ..
पद्मनाभेन यद्दत्तं ब्रह्मणे नाभिपद्मके .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Listen, O foremost of the twice-born, to the supreme, auspicious armour of Padmā,
Which was given by Padmanābha to Brahmā in his navel-lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
samprāpya kavacaṃ brahmā tatpadme sasṛje jagat ..
padmālayāprasādena salakṣmīko babhūva saḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
सम्प्राप्य कवचं ब्रह्मा तत्पद्मे ससृजे जगत् ..
पद्मालयाप्रसादेन सलक्ष्मीको बभूव सः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Having received that armour in the lotus, Brahmā created the world;
By the grace of the Lady of the Lotus, he became endowed with fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
padmālayāvaraṃ prāpya pādmaśca jagatāṃ prabhuḥ ..
pādyena padmakalpe ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ..54..
meaning:
पद्मालयावरं प्राप्य पाद्मश्च जगतां प्रभुः ..
पाद्येन पद्मकल्पे च कवचं परमाद्भुतम् ..54..
text_mt:
Having obtained a boon from the Lady of the Lotus, the Lord of the worlds, born from the lotus,
In the Padma-kalpa, [offering] water for the feet, [gave] this most wondrous armour

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ sanatkumārāya priyaputrāya dhīmate ..
kumāreṇa ca yaddattaṃ puṣkarāya ca nārada .. 55 ..
meaning:
दत्तं सनत्कुमाराय प्रियपुत्राय धीमते ..
कुमारेण च यद्दत्तं पुष्कराय च नारद .. 55 ..
text_mt:
To his beloved, wise son Sanatkumāra;
And that which was given by Kumāra to Puṣkara, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā pāṭhanād brahmā savasiddheśvaro mahān ..
paramaiśvaryyasaṃyuktaḥ sarvasampatsamanvitaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा पाठनाद् ब्रह्मा सवसिद्धेश्वरो महान् ..
परमैश्वर्य्यसंयुक्तः सर्वसम्पत्समन्वितः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
By wearing and reciting which Brahmā became the great master of all perfections,
Endowed with supreme sovereignty and furnished with all prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
yaddatvā ca dhanādhyakṣaḥ kuberaśca dhanādhipaḥ ..
svāyambhuvo manuḥ śrīmānpaṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
यद्दत्वा च धनाध्यक्षः कुबेरश्च धनाधिपः ..
स्वायम्भुवो मनुः श्रीमान्पठनाद्धारणाद्यतः .. 57 ..
text_mt:
And by giving which Kubera became the superintendent of wealth, the lord of riches—
from reciting and wearing which the glorious Svāyambhuva Manu [attained his status];

sanskrit_iast:
priyavratottānapādau lakṣmīvantau yato mune ..
pṛthuḥ pṛthvīpatiḥ sadyo hyabhavadvāraṇādyataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ लक्ष्मीवन्तौ यतो मुने ..
पृथुः पृथ्वीपतिः सद्यो ह्यभवद्वारणाद्यतः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
from which Priyavrata and Uttānapāda became wealthy, O sage;
from wearing which Pṛthu instantly became the ruler of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
kavacasya prasādena svayaṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
dharmmaśca karmmaṇāṃ sākṣī pātā yasya prasādataḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
कवचस्य प्रसादेन स्वयं दक्षः प्रजापतिः ..
धर्म्मश्च कर्म्मणां साक्षी पाता यस्य प्रसादतः .. 59 ..
text_mt:
by the grace of which armour Dakṣa became Prajāpati himself;
and by whose grace Dharma became the witness of deeds and the protector [of the world];

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā dakṣiṇe bāhau viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyitaḥ ..
bhaktyā vidhatte kaṇṭhe ca śeṣo nārāyaṇāṃśakaḥ .. 3.38.60 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा दक्षिणे बाहौ विष्णुः क्षीरोदशायितः ..
भक्त्या विधत्ते कण्ठे च शेषो नारायणांशकः .. 3.38.60 ..
text_mt:
wearing which on his right arm, Viṣṇu sleeps on the ocean of milk;
and Śeṣa, a portion of Nārāyaṇa, devotedly places it on his neck;

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā vāmanaṃ lebhe kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ..
sarvadevādhipaḥ śrīmānmahendro dhāraṇādyataḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा वामनं लेभे कश्यपश्च प्रजापतिः ..
सर्वदेवाधिपः श्रीमान्महेन्द्रो धारणाद्यतः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
wearing which Kaśyapa Prajāpati obtained Vāmana [as his son];
from wearing which glorious Mahendra became the sovereign of all the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
rājā marutto bhagavānabhavaddhāraṇādyataḥ ..
trailokyādhipatiḥ śrīmānnahuṣo yasya dhāraṇāt .. 62 ..
meaning:
राजा मरुत्तो भगवानभवद्धारणाद्यतः ..
त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः श्रीमान्नहुषो यस्य धारणात् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
from wearing which King Marutta became divine;
from wearing which glorious Nahuṣa became the master of the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ vijigye khaṭvāṅgaḥ paṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ ..
mucukundo yataḥ śrīmānmāndhātṛtanayo mahān.. 63 ..
meaning:
विश्वं विजिग्ये खट्वाङ्गः पठनाद्धारणाद्यतः ..
मुचुकुन्दो यतः श्रीमान्मान्धातृतनयो महान्.. 63 ..
text_mt:
from reciting and wearing which Khaṭvāṅga conquered the universe;
from which the glorious, great Mucukunda, the son of Māndhātṛ, [attained greatness].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasampatpadasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ..
ṛṣiśchandaśca bṛhatī devī padmālayā svayam .. 64 ..
meaning:
सर्वसम्पत्पदस्यास्य कवचस्य प्रजापतिः ..
ऋषिश्छन्दश्च बृहती देवी पद्मालया स्वयम् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Of this armour, the giver of all fortune, Prajāpati is the ṛṣi,
the meter is Bṛhatī, and the deity is the goddess Padmālayā herself.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
puṇyabījaṃ ca mahatāṃ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ..65..
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षेषु विनियोगः प्रकीर्तितः ..
पुण्यबीजं च महतां कवचं परमाद्भुतम् ..65..
text_mt: This supreme, wondrous armour is the seed of merit for the great.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam..
śrīṃ me pātu kapālaṃ ca locane śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ.66...
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं कमलवासिन्यै स्वाहा मे पातु मस्तकम्..
श्रीं मे पातु कपालं च लोचने श्रीं श्रियै नमः.66...
text_mt:
"Oṃ hrīṃ, to the dweller on the lotus, svāhā" — may she protect my head.
"Śrīṃ" — may she protect my forehead, and for the eyes, "śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāheti ca karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu..
oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā me pātu nāsikāma.67..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं श्रियै स्वाहेति च कर्णयुग्मं सदाऽवतु..
ओं श्रीं क्लीं महालक्ष्म्यै स्वाहा मे पातु नासिकाम.67..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāhā" — may she always protect my pair of ears.
"Oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā" — may she protect my nose.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantānsadā'vatu ..
oṃ śrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhraṃ sadā'vatu..68..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं पद्मालयायै च स्वाहा दन्तान्सदाऽवतु ..
ओं श्रीं कृष्णप्रियायै च दन्तरन्ध्रं सदाऽवतु..68..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai svāhā" — may she always protect my teeth.
"Oṃ śrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai [svāhā]" — may she always protect the cavities of my teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ nārāyaṇeśāyai mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu..
oṃ śrīṃ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṃ sadā'vatu.. ..69..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं नारायणेशायै मम कण्ठं सदाऽवतु..
ओं श्रीं केशवकान्तायै मम स्कन्धं सदाऽवतु.. ..69..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīṃ nārāyaṇeśāyai [svāhā]" — may she always protect my throat.
"Oṃ śrīṃ keśavakāntāyai [svāhā]" — may she always protect my shoulders.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṃ sadā'vatu..
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu..3.38.70..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं पद्मनिवासिन्यै स्वाहा नाभिं सदाऽवतु..
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं संसारमात्रे मम वक्षः सदाऽवतु..3.38.70..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā" — may she always protect my navel.
"Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre [svāhā]" — may she always protect my chest.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīṃ moṃ kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ..
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāhā ca mama hastau sadā'vatu .. 71 ..
meaning:
ओं श्रीं मों कृष्णकान्तायै स्वाहा पृष्ठं सदाऽवतु ..
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं श्रियै स्वाहा च मम हस्तौ सदाऽवतु .. 71 ..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīṃ moṃ kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā" — may she always protect my back.
"Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāhā" — may she always protect my hands.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ śrīnivāsakāntāyai mama padau sadā'vatu ..
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ śriyai svāhā sarvāṅgaṃ me sadā'vatu .. 72 ..
meaning:
ओं श्रीनिवासकान्तायै मम पदौ सदाऽवतु ..
ओं ह्रीं श्रीं क्लीं श्रियै स्वाहा सर्वाङ्गं मे सदाऽवतु .. 72 ..
text_mt:
"Oṃ śrīnivāsakāntāyai [svāhā]" — may she always protect my feet.
"Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ śriyai svāhā" — may she always protect all my limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ pātu mahālakṣmīrāgneyyāṃ kamalālayā ..
padmā māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ śrīrharipriyā .. 73 ..
meaning:
प्राच्यां पातु महालक्ष्मीराग्नेय्यां कमलालया ..
पद्मा मां दक्षिणे पातु नैरृत्यां श्रीर्हरिप्रिया .. 73 ..
text_mt:
May Mahālakṣmī protect me in the east; in the south-east, Kamalālayā.
May Padmā protect me in the south; in the south-west, Śrī, beloved of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
padmālayā paścime māṃ vāyavyāṃ pātu sā svayam ..
uttare kamalā pātu caiśānyāṃ sindhukanyakā .. 74 ..
meaning:
पद्मालया पश्चिमे मां वायव्यां पातु सा स्वयम् ..
उत्तरे कमला पातु चैशान्यां सिन्धुकन्यका .. 74 ..
text_mt:
May Padmālayā protect me in the west; in the north-west, she herself.
May Kamalā protect me in the north; and in the north-east, the daughter of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇī ca pātūrdhvamadho viṣṇupriyā'vatu ..
santataṃ sarvataḥ pātu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā mama .. .. 79 ..
meaning:
नारायणी च पातूर्ध्वमधो विष्णुप्रियाऽवतु ..
सन्ततं सर्वतः पातु विष्णुप्राणाधिका मम .. .. 79 ..
text_mt:
May Nārāyaṇī protect me above, and below may the beloved of Viṣṇu protect.
May she who is dearer to Viṣṇu than life protect me constantly from every direction.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ..
sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam .. 76 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं वत्स सर्वमन्त्रौघविग्रहम् ..
सर्वैश्वर्य्यप्रदं नाम कवचं परमाद्भुतम् .. 76 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaparvataṃ dattvā merutulyaṃ dvijātaye ..
yatphalaṃ labhate dharmī kavacena tato'dhikam .. 77 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णपर्वतं दत्त्वा मेरुतुल्यं द्विजातये ..
यत्फलं लभते धर्मी कवचेन ततोऽधिकम् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
The fruit which a virtuous man obtains by giving a mountain of gold
equal to Meru to a twice-born, more than that is obtained through this armour.

sanskrit_iast:
gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ..
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau sa śrīmānpratijanmani .. 78 ..
meaning:
गुरुमभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्कवचं धारयेत्तु यः ..
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ स श्रीमान्प्रतिजन्मनि .. 78 ..
text_mt: either on his neck or on his right arm becomes prosperous in every birth.

sanskrit_iast:
asti lakṣmīrgṛhe tasya niścalā śatapūruṣam ..
devendraiścāsurendraiśca so'vadhyo niścitaṃ bhavet .. 79 ..
meaning:
अस्ति लक्ष्मीर्गृहे तस्य निश्चला शतपूरुषम् ..
देवेन्द्रैश्चासुरेन्द्रैश्च सोऽवध्यो निश्चितं भवेत् .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Lakṣmī dwells steadily in his house for a hundred generations.
He surely becomes invulnerable to the lords of gods and the lords of asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvapuṇyavāndhīmānsarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ..
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yasyedaṃ kavacaṃ gale .. 3.38.80 ..
meaning:
स सर्वपुण्यवान्धीमान्सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षितः ..
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु यस्येदं कवचं गले .. 3.38.80 ..
text_mt:
He possesses all merit, is wise, and is consecrated in all sacrifices;
he has bathed in all holy waters, upon whose neck this armour rests.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ lobhamohabhayairapi ..
gurubhaktāya śiṣyāya śaraṇyāya prakāśayet .. 81 ..
meaning:
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं लोभमोहभयैरपि ..
गुरुभक्ताय शिष्याय शरण्याय प्रकाशयेत् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
It must not be given to just anyone, even out of greed, delusion, or fear;
one should reveal it only to a disciple devoted to his guru and seeking refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kavacamajñātvā japellakṣmīṃ jagatprabhum ..
koṭisaṃkhyaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
इदं कवचमज्ञात्वा जपेल्लक्ष्मीं जगत्प्रभुम् ..
कोटिसंख्यं प्रजप्तोऽपि न मन्त्रः सिद्धिदायकः .. 82 ..
text_mt:
If without knowing this armour one recites the mantra of Lakṣmī, the lord of the world,
even if recited ten million times, the mantra will not bestow success.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
kavacaṃ kathitaṃ brahmanpadmāyāśca manoharam ..
paraṃ durgatināśinyāḥ kavacaṃ kathaya prabho ..1..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
कवचं कथितं ब्रह्मन्पद्मायाश्च मनोहरम् ..
परं दुर्गतिनाशिन्याः कवचं कथय प्रभो ..1..
title: Durgatināśinīkavacam

sanskrit_iast:
padmākṣaprāṇatulyaṃ ca jīvanaṃ balakāraṇam ..
kavacānāṃ ca yatsāraṃ durgāsevanakāraṇam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पद्माक्षप्राणतुल्यं च जीवनं बलकारणम् ..
कवचानां च यत्सारं दुर्गासेवनकारणम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi durgāyāḥ kavavaṃ śubham ..
śrīkṛṣṇenaiva yaddattaṃ goloke brahmaṇe purā .. 3..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि दुर्गायाः कववं शुभम् ..
श्रीकृष्णेनैव यद्दत्तं गोलोके ब्रह्मणे पुरा .. 3..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā tripurasaṃgrāme śaṃkarāya dadau purā ..
jaghāna tripuraṃ rudro yaddhṛtvā bhaktipūrvakam .. 4 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा त्रिपुरसंग्रामे शंकराय ददौ पुरा ..
जघान त्रिपुरं रुद्रो यद्धृत्वा भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
haro dadau gautamāya padmākṣāya ca gautamaḥ ..
yato babhūva padmākṣaḥ saptadvīpeśvaro jayī .. 5 ..
meaning:
हरो ददौ गौतमाय पद्माक्षाय च गौतमः ..
यतो बभूव पद्माक्षः सप्तद्वीपेश्वरो जयी .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmā jñānavāñchaktimānbhuvi ..
śivo babhūva sarvajño yogināṃ ca gururyataḥ ..
śivatulyo gautamaśca babhūva munisattamaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
यद्धृत्वा पठनाद्ब्रह्मा ज्ञानवाञ्छक्तिमान्भुवि ..
शिवो बभूव सर्वज्ञो योगिनां च गुरुर्यतः ..
शिवतुल्यो गौतमश्च बभूव मुनिसत्तमः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍavijayasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ..
ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devī durgatināśinī .. 7 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डविजयस्यास्य कवचस्य प्रजापतिः ..
ऋषिश्छन्दश्च गायत्री देवी दुर्गतिनाशिनी .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍavijaye caiva viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ..
puṇyatīrthaṃ ca mahatāṃ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam .. 8 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डविजये चैव विनियोगः प्रकीर्त्तितः ..
पुण्यतीर्थं च महतां कवचं परमाद्भुतम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ durgatināśinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam ..
oṃ hrīṃ me pātu kapālaṃ cāpyoṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ pātu locane..9..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं दुर्गतिनाशिन्यै स्वाहा मे पातु मस्तकम् ..
ओं ह्रीं मे पातु कपालं चाप्यों ह्रीं श्रीं पातु लोचने..9..

sanskrit_iast:
pātu me karṇayugmaṃ cāpyoṃ durgāyai namaḥ sadā..
oṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti nāsāṃ me sadā pātu ca sarvataḥ..3.39.10..
meaning:
पातु मे कर्णयुग्मं चाप्यों दुर्गायै नमः सदा..
ओं ह्रीं श्रीमिति नासां मे सदा पातु च सर्वतः..3.39.10..

sanskrit_iast:
hrīṃ śrīṃ krūmiti dantāṃśca pātu klīmoṣṭhayugmakam..
klīṃ klīṃ klīṃ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ ca durge rakṣatu gaṇḍake..11..
meaning:
ह्रीं श्रीं क्रूमिति दन्तांश्च पातु क्लीमोष्ठयुग्मकम्..
क्लीं क्लीं क्लीं पातु कण्ठं च दुर्गे रक्षतु गण्डके..11..

sanskrit_iast:
skandhaṃ mahākāli durge svāhā pātu nirantaram ..
vakṣo vipadvināśinyai svāhā me pātu sarvataḥ..12..
meaning:
स्कन्धं महाकालि दुर्गे स्वाहा पातु निरन्तरम् ..
वक्षो विपद्विनाशिन्यै स्वाहा मे पातु सर्वतः..12..

sanskrit_iast:
durge durge rakṣa pārśvau svāhā nābhiṃ sadā'vatu..
durge durge dehi rakṣāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ me pātu sarvataḥ..13..
meaning:
दुर्गे दुर्गे रक्ष पार्श्वौ स्वाहा नाभिं सदाऽवतु..
दुर्गे दुर्गे देहि रक्षां पृष्ठं मे पातु सर्वतः..13..

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ durgāyai svāhā ca hastau pādau sadā'vatu ..
oṃ hrīṃ durgāyai svāhā ca sarvāṃgaṃ me sadā'vatu .. 14 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं दुर्गायै स्वाहा च हस्तौ पादौ सदाऽवतु ..
ओं ह्रीं दुर्गायै स्वाहा च सर्वांगं मे सदाऽवतु .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ pātu mahāmāyā cāgneyyāṃ pātu kālikā ..
dakṣiṇe dakṣakanyā ca nairṛtyāṃ śivasundarī .. 15 ..
meaning:
प्राच्यां पातु महामाया चाग्नेय्यां पातु कालिका ..
दक्षिणे दक्षकन्या च नैरृत्यां शिवसुन्दरी .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
paścime pārvatī pātu vārāhī vāruṇe sadā ..
kuberamātā kauberyyāmaiśānyāmīśvarī sadā .. 16 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमे पार्वती पातु वाराही वारुणे सदा ..
कुबेरमाता कौबेर्य्यामैशान्यामीश्वरी सदा .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ nārāyaṇī pātu tvambikā'dhaḥ sadā'vatu ..
jñānaṃ jñānapradā pātu svapne nidrā sadā'vatu .. 17..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं नारायणी पातु त्वम्बिकाऽधः सदाऽवतु ..
ज्ञानं ज्ञानप्रदा पातु स्वप्ने निद्रा सदाऽवतु .. 17..

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ..
brahmāṇḍavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam .. 18 ..
meaning:
इति ते कथितं वत्स सर्वमन्त्रौघविग्रहम् ..
ब्रह्माण्डविजयं नाम कवचं परमाद्भुतम् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
susnātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam ..
sarvavratopavāse ca tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सुस्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् ..
सर्वव्रतोपवासे च तत्फलं लभते नरः .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ ..
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ..3.39.20..
meaning:
गुरुमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्वस्त्रालंकारचन्दनैः ..
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ कवचं धारयेत्तु यः ..3.39.20..

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca trailokyavijayī sarvaśatrupramardakaḥ..
idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajeddurgatināśinīm..21..
meaning:
स च त्रैलोक्यविजयी सर्वशत्रुप्रमर्दकः..
इदं कवचमज्ञात्वा भजेद्दुर्गतिनाशिनीम्..21..

sanskrit_iast: śatalakṣaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ.. .. 22 ..
meaning: शतलक्षं प्रजप्तोऽपि न मन्त्रः सिद्धिदायकः.. .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kavacaṃ kāṇvaśākhoktamuktaṃ nārada siddhidam ..
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ..23..
meaning:
कवचं काण्वशाखोक्तमुक्तं नारद सिद्धिदम् ..
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं गोपनीयं सुदुर्लभम् ..23..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
taṃ gṛhītvā tadā viṣṇau vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gate sati..
saputraṃ ca sahasrākṣaṃ jaghāna bhṛgunandanaḥ..1..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
तं गृहीत्वा तदा विष्णौ वैकुण्ठं च गते सति..
सपुत्रं च सहस्राक्षं जघान भृगुनन्दनः..1..
title: Kailāsagamanopadeśaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā yuddhaṃ tu saptāhaṃ brahmāstreṇa prayatnataḥ ..
rājā kavacahīno'pi saputraśca papāta ha..
patite tu sahasrākṣe kārtavīryyārjunaḥ svayam..
ājagāma mahāvīro dvilakṣākṣauhiṇīyutaḥ.. ..3..
meaning:
कृत्वा युद्धं तु सप्ताहं ब्रह्मास्त्रेण प्रयत्नतः ..
राजा कवचहीनोऽपि सपुत्रश्च पपात ह..
पतिते तु सहस्राक्षे कार्तवीर्य्यार्जुनः स्वयम्..
आजगाम महावीरो द्विलक्षाक्षौहिणीयुतः.. ..3..

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇarathamāruhya ratnasāraparicchadam ..
nānāstraṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā tasthau samaramūrddhani..4..
meaning:
सुवर्णरथमारुह्य रत्नसारपरिच्छदम् ..
नानास्त्रं परितः कृत्वा तस्थौ समरमूर्द्धनि..4..

sanskrit_iast:
samare taṃ paraśurāmo rājendraṃ ca dadarśa ha ..
ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyai rājendrāṇāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ ..5..
meaning:
समरे तं परशुरामो राजेन्द्रं च ददर्श ह ..
रत्नालंकारभूषाढ्यै राजेन्द्राणां च कोटिभिः ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
ratnātapatrabhūṣāḍhyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ..
candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam .. 6 ..
meaning:
रत्नातपत्रभूषाढ्यं रत्नालंकारभूषितम् ..
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वांगं सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājā dṛṣṭvā munīndraṃ tamavaruhma rathādaho ..
praṇamya rathamāruhya tasthau nṛpagaṇaiḥ saha .. 7 ..
meaning:
राजा दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्द्रं तमवरुह्म रथादहो ..
प्रणम्य रथमारुह्य तस्थौ नृपगणैः सह .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai rāmaśca samayocitam ..
provāca ca gatārthaṃ taṃ svargaṃ gaccheti sānugaḥ..8..
meaning:
ददौ शुभाशिषं तस्मै रामश्च समयोचितम् ..

meaning:
दृष्ट्वाऽनुज्ञां गृहीत्वा च प्रणम्य च पुनः पुनः ..
ईश्वरेच्छां च विज्ञाय स्रष्टुं सृष्टिं मनो दधे .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Having seen [him], received his command, and bowed repeatedly,
and having understood the will of the Lord, he set his mind to fashioning creation.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śivaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃharttā sa ca sraṣṭurlalāṭajaḥ ..
viṣṇuḥ pātā kṣudravirāṭ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt .. 55 ..
meaning:
यः शिवः सृष्टिसंहर्त्ता स च स्रष्टुर्ललाटजः ..
विष्णुः पाता क्षुद्रविराट् श्वेतद्वीपनिवासकृत् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
That Śiva, the destroyer of creation, was born from the creator’s forehead;
Viṣṇu, the protector, is the lesser Virāj, whose abode is in Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikāraṇabhūtāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
santi viśveṣu sarveṣu śrīkṛṣṇasya kalodbhavāḥ ..56..
meaning:
सृष्टिकारणभूताश्च ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
सन्ति विश्वेषु सर्वेषु श्रीकृष्णस्य कलोद्भवाः ..56..
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, who are the causes of creation,
exist in all universes, born from a part of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi devāḥ prākṛtikāḥ prākṛtaśca mahāvirāṭ ..
sarvaprasūtiḥ prakṛtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ..57..
meaning:
तेऽपि देवाः प्राकृतिकाः प्राकृतश्च महाविराट् ..
सर्वप्रसूतिः प्रकृतिः श्रीकृष्णः प्रकृतेः परः ..57..
text_mt:
Even those gods are made of Prakṛti, and the Mahāvirāj is made of Prakṛti;
Prakṛti is the mother of all, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa is beyond Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
na śaktaḥ parameśo'pi tāṃ śaktiṃ prakṛtiṃ vinā ..
sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ māyeśo na sṛṣṭirmāyayā vinā .. 58 ..
meaning:
न शक्तः परमेशोऽपि तां शक्तिं प्रकृतिं विना ..
सृष्टिं विधातुं मायेशो न सृष्टिर्मायया विना .. 58 ..
text_mt: Even the Supreme Lord is unable, without that power, Prakṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca kṛṣṇe tirobhūya sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārake ..
sā''virbhūtā sṛṣṭikāle sā ca nityā maheśvarī ..59..
meaning:
सा च कृष्णे तिरोभूय सृष्टिसंहारकारके ..
सा'ऽविर्भूता सृष्टिकाले सा च नित्या महेश्वरी ..59..
text_mt:
And she, having disappeared into Kṛṣṇa, the maker of the destruction of creation,
is manifested at the time of creation; she is eternal, the great sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
kulālaśca kaṭaṃ kartuṃ yathā'śakto mṛdaṃ vinā..
svarṇaṃ vinā svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ .. 3.40.60 ..
meaning:
कुलालश्च कटं कर्तुं यथाऽशक्तो मृदं विना..
स्वर्णं विना स्वर्णकारः कुण्डलं कर्तुमक्षमः .. 3.40.60 ..
text_mt:
Just as a potter is unable to make a pot without clay,
[and] a goldsmith is incapable of making an earring without gold,

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca śaktiḥ sṛṣṭikāle pañcadhā ceśvarecchayā ..
rādhā padmā ca sāvitrī durgā devī sarasvatī .. 61 ..
meaning:
सा च शक्तिः सृष्टिकाले पञ्चधा चेश्वरेच्छया ..
राधा पद्मा च सावित्री दुर्गा देवी सरस्वती .. 61 ..
text_mt: so that power at the time of creation, by the will of the Lord, [became] fivefold:

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
prāṇādhikapriyatamā sā rādhā parikīrttitā .. 62 ..
meaning:
प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेवी या कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..
प्राणाधिकप्रियतमा सा राधा परिकीर्त्तिता .. 62 ..
text_mt: most beloved, dearer than life itself—she is proclaimed as Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī ..
paramānandarūpā ca sā lakṣmīḥ parikīrttitā ..63..
meaning:
ऐश्वर्य्याधिष्ठातृदेवी सर्वमङ्गलकारिणी ..
परमानन्दरूपा च सा लक्ष्मीः परिकीर्त्तिता ..63..
text_mt: The presiding deity of sovereignty, the bringer of all auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā parameśasya durlabhā ..
yā mātā vedaśāstrāṇāṃ sā sāvitrī prakīrtitā..64..
meaning:
विद्याधिष्ठातृदेवी या परमेशस्य दुर्लभा ..
या माता वेदशास्त्राणां सा सावित्री प्रकीर्तिता..64..
text_mt:
She who is the presiding deity of knowledge, difficult for [even] the Supreme Lord to attain,
who is the mother of the Vedas and śāstras—she is celebrated as Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ..
sarvajñānātmikā sarvā sā durgā durganāśinī .. 65 ..
meaning:
बुद्ध्यधिष्ठातृदेवी या सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ..
सर्वज्ञानात्मिका सर्वा सा दुर्गा दुर्गनाशिनी .. 65 ..
text_mt:
She who is the presiding deity of intellect, the embodiment of all power,
the essence of all knowledge, the all, the destroyer of distress—she is Durgā.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā śāstrajñānapradā sadā ..
kṛṣṇakaṇṭhodbhavā sā syādyā ca devī sarasvatī..66..
meaning:
वागधिष्ठातृदेवी या शास्त्रज्ञानप्रदा सदा ..
कृष्णकण्ठोद्भवा सा स्याद्या च देवी सरस्वती..66..
text_mt:
She who is the presiding deity of speech, the constant bestower of the knowledge of the śāstras,
born from the throat of Kṛṣṇa—she is the goddess Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhā''dau svayaṃ devī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ..
tataḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva bahudhā kalayā ca sā .. 67 ..
meaning:
पञ्चधा'ऽदौ स्वयं देवी मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ..
ततः सृष्टिक्रमेणैव बहुधा कलया च सा .. 67 ..
text_mt:
In the beginning, the goddess herself, Mūlaprakṛti, the sovereign, [manifested] fivefold;
then, in the order of creation, she became manifold through her parts.

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣitaḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pumāṃsaḥ puruṣasya ca ..
māyayā sṛṣṭi kāle ca tadvinā na bhavedbhavaḥ..68..
meaning:
योषितः प्रकृतेरंशाः पुमांसः पुरुषस्य च ..
मायया सृष्टि काले च तद्विना न भवेद्भवः..68..
text_mt: Women are portions of Prakṛti, and men are [portions] of the Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭiśca prativiśveṣu brahmanbrahmodbhavā sadā ..
pātā viṣṇuśca saṃharttā śivaḥ śaśvacchivapradaḥ ..69..
meaning:
सृष्टिश्च प्रतिविश्वेषु ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मोद्भवा सदा ..
पाता विष्णुश्च संहर्त्ता शिवः शश्वच्छिवप्रदः ..69..
text_mt:
And in every universe, O Brahman, creation always arises from Brahmā;
Viṣṇu is the protector, and Śiva the destroyer, ever conferring auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
dattadattaṃ jñānamidaṃ rāma mahyaṃ ca puṣkare ..
dīkṣākāle ca māghyāṃ ca munipravarasannidhau .. 3.40.70 ..
meaning:
दत्तदत्तं ज्ञानमिदं राम मह्यं च पुष्करे ..
दीक्षाकाले च माघ्यां च मुनिप्रवरसन्निधौ .. 3.40.70 ..
text_mt:
This knowledge was given to me by Dattātreya at Puṣkara, O Rāma,
at the time of initiation, on the full moon of Māgha, in the presence of the foremost sages.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā kārttavīryyaśca rāmaṃ natvā ca sasmitaḥ ..
āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा कार्त्तवीर्य्यश्च रामं नत्वा च सस्मितः ..
आरुरोह रथं शीघ्रं गृहीत्वा सशरं धनुः .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Kārttavīrya bowed to Rāma and, smiling,
quickly mounted his chariot, taking his bow together with arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmastato rājasainyaṃ brahmāstreṇa jaghāna ha ..
nṛpaṃ pāśupatenaiva līlayā śrīhariṃ smaran .. 72 ..
meaning:
रामस्ततो राजसैन्यं ब्रह्मास्त्रेण जघान ह ..
नृपं पाशुपतेनैव लीलया श्रीहरिं स्मरन् .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Then Rāma slew the king's army with the Brahmā weapon,
and the king with the Pāśupata [weapon], effortlessly, remembering Śrī Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ trissaptakṛtvaśca krameṇa ca vasundharām ..
rāmaścakāra nirbhūpāṃ līlayā ca śivaṃ smaran .. 73 ..
meaning:
एवं त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वश्च क्रमेण च वसुन्धराम् ..
रामश्चकार निर्भूपां लीलया च शिवं स्मरन् .. 73 ..
text_mt: Thus twenty-one times, successively,

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasthaṃ māturaṅkasthaṃ śiśuṃ vṛddhaṃ ca madhyamam ..
jaghāna kṣatriyaṃ rāmaḥ pratijñāpālanāya vai .. 74 ..
meaning:
गर्भस्थं मातुरङ्कस्थं शिशुं वृद्धं च मध्यमम् ..
जघान क्षत्रियं रामः प्रतिज्ञापालनाय वै .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Those in the womb, those in their mother's lap, infants, the elderly, and the middle-aged—
Rāma slew the kṣatriyas indeed, in order to fulfill his vow.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryyaśca golokaṃ tvagamatkṛṣṇasannidhim ..
jagāma toṣātparaśurāmaśca śrīhariṃ smaran.. 75 ..
meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्य्यश्च गोलोकं त्वगमत्कृष्णसन्निधिम् ..
जगाम तोषात्परशुरामश्च श्रीहरिं स्मरन्.. 75 ..
text_mt: And Paraśurāma, filled with satisfaction, went on remembering Śrī Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ mahīṃ dṛṣṭvā maheśvaraḥ ..
ramaṇaṃ tena paraśurāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kātaram .. 76 ..
meaning:
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां महीं दृष्ट्वा महेश्वरः ..
रमणं तेन परशुरामं दृष्ट्वा च कातरम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Seeing the earth cleared of kings twenty-one times,
and seeing Paraśurāma, distressed by that sport,

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca munayo devyaḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ ..
sarve cakruḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ rāmamūrdhni ca nārada .. 77 ..
meaning:
देवाश्च मुनयो देव्यः सिद्धगन्धर्वकिन्नराः ..
सर्वे चक्रुः पुष्पवृष्टिं राममूर्ध्नि च नारद .. 77 ..
text_mt:
the gods, sages, goddesses, siddhas, gandharvas, and kinnaras,
they all showered flowers upon Rāma's head, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
svarge dundubhayo nedurharṣaśabdo babhūva ha..
yaśasā caiva paraśurāmasyāpūritaṃ jagat ..78..
meaning:
स्वर्गे दुन्दुभयो नेदुर्हर्षशब्दो बभूव ह..
यशसा चैव परशुरामस्यापूरितं जगत् ..78..
text_mt:
Kettledrums sounded in heaven, and there arose cries of joy;
and the world was filled with the fame of Paraśurāma.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā bhṛguśca śukraśca vālmīkiścyavanastathā..
jamadagnirbrahmalokādājagāma praharṣitaḥ..79..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा भृगुश्च शुक्रश्च वाल्मीकिश्च्यवनस्तथा..
जमदग्निर्ब्रह्मलोकादाजगाम प्रहर्षितः..79..
text_mt:
Brahmā, Bhṛgu, Śukra, Vālmīki, and Cyavana,
and Jamadagni came from Brahmaloka, exceedingly rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ sānandāśca samanvitāḥ ..
dūrvāpuṣpakarāḥ sarve kurvanto maṃgalāśiṣaḥ.. .. 3.40.80 ..
meaning:
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गाः सानन्दाश्च समन्विताः ..
दूर्वापुष्पकराः सर्वे कुर्वन्तो मंगलाशिषः.. .. 3.40.80 ..
text_mt:
With all the hair on their limbs bristling with joy, full of bliss, united,
all holding dūrvā grass and flowers in their hands, bestowing auspicious blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇanāma ca tānrāmo daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi ..
kroḍe cakāra brahmā''dau kramāttāteti saṃvadan .. 81 ..
meaning:
प्रणनाम च तान्रामो दण्डवत्पतितो भुवि ..
क्रोडे चकार ब्रह्मा'ऽदौ क्रमात्तातेति संवदन् .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Rāma prostrated before them, falling like a stick upon the earth.
Brahmā first took him into his lap, addressing him affectionately in turn as “child.”

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvācātha paraśurāmaṃ brahmā jagadguruḥ ..
vedasāraṃ nītiyutaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 82 ..
meaning:
तमुवाचाथ परशुरामं ब्रह्मा जगद्गुरुः ..
वेदसारं नीतियुतं परिणामसुखावहम् .. 82 ..
text_mt:
Then Brahmā, the guru of the universe, spoke to Paraśurāma
the essence of the Vedas, endowed with morality, bringing happiness in the outcome.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
śṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi sarvasampatkaraṃ param ..
kāṇvaśākhoktavacanaṃ satyaṃ vai sarvasammatam ..83..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
शृणु राम प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वसम्पत्करं परम् ..
काण्वशाखोक्तवचनं सत्यं वै सर्वसम्मतम् ..83..
text_mt:
“Listen, O Rāma, I shall speak what is supreme, bestowing all prosperity,
the statement declared in the Kāṇva recension, true indeed and agreed upon by all.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyānāmeva sarveṣāmiṣṭaḥ pūjyatamaḥ paraḥ ..
janako janmadānācca pālanācca pitā smṛtaḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
पूज्यानामेव सर्वेषामिष्टः पूज्यतमः परः ..
जनको जन्मदानाच्च पालनाच्च पिता स्मृतः .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Among all venerable ones, one's chosen deity is the most venerable, supreme.
The progenitor is remembered as the father because of giving birth and protecting.

sanskrit_iast:
garīyāñjanmadātuśca so'nnadātā pitā mune ..
vinā'nnaṃ naśvaro deho nityaṃ ca piturudbhavaḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
गरीयाञ्जन्मदातुश्च सोऽन्नदाता पिता मुने ..
विनाऽन्नं नश्वरो देहो नित्यं च पितुरुद्भवः .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Greater than the progenitor, O sage, is the father who provides food.
Without food the body perishes, whereas arising from a father is constant.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ śataguṇaṃ mātā pūjyā mānyā ca vanditā..
garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ saiva proktā garīyasī..86..
meaning:
तयोः शतगुणं माता पूज्या मान्या च वन्दिता..
गर्भधारणपोषाभ्यां सैव प्रोक्ता गरीयसी..86..
text_mt:
A hundred times more than both, the mother is venerable, honourable, and to be praised;
she alone is said to be greater because of bearing in the womb and nurturing.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ..
jñānavidyāmantradātā'bhīṣṭadevātparo guruḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
तेभ्यः शतगुणं पूज्योऽभीष्टदेवः श्रुतौ श्रुतः..
ज्ञानविद्यामन्त्रदाताऽभीष्टदेवात्परो गुरुः .. 87 ..
text_mt:
A hundred times more venerable than they is one's chosen deity, as heard in the Vedic revelation;
higher than the chosen deity is the guru, who bestows knowledge, learning, and mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvadguruputraśca gurupatnī tato'dhikā ..
deve ruṣṭe gurū rakṣedgurau ruṣṭe na kaścana .. 88 ..
meaning:
गुरुवद्गुरुपुत्रश्च गुरुपत्नी ततोऽधिका ..
देवे रुष्टे गुरू रक्षेद्गुरौ रुष्टे न कश्चन .. 88 ..
text_mt:
The guru's son is like the guru, and the guru's wife is higher still.
If a god is angry, the guru protects; if the guru is angry, no one can protect.

sanskrit_iast:
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ ..
gurureva paraṃ brahma brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyaḥ paraḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुर्गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ..
गुरुरेव परं ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रियः परः .. 89 ..
text_mt: the guru is indeed the supreme Brahman, dearest above all to Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
gururjñānaṃ dadātyeva jñānaṃ ca haribhaktidam ..
haribhaktipradātā yaḥ ko vā bandhustataḥ param .. 3.40.90 ..
meaning:
गुरुर्ज्ञानं ददात्येव ज्ञानं च हरिभक्तिदम् ..
हरिभक्तिप्रदाता यः को वा बन्धुस्ततः परम् .. 3.40.90 ..
text_mt:
The guru indeed bestows knowledge, and knowledge bestows devotion to Hari;
who indeed is a greater kinsman than one who confers devotion to Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānatimirācchanno jñānadīpaṃ yato labhet ..
labdhvā ca nirmalaṃ paśyetko vā bandhustataḥ paraḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
अज्ञानतिमिराच्छन्नो ज्ञानदीपं यतो लभेत् ..
लब्ध्वा च निर्मलं पश्येत्को वा बन्धुस्ततः परः .. 91 ..
text_mt:
From whom one veiled by the darkness of ignorance obtains the lamp of knowledge,
and having obtained it, sees clearly—who indeed is a greater kinsman than he?

sanskrit_iast:
gurudattaṃ sumantraṃ ca japtvā jñānaṃ tato labhet ..
sarvajñatvācca siddhiṃ ca ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
गुरुदत्तं सुमन्त्रं च जप्त्वा ज्ञानं ततो लभेत् ..
सर्वज्ञत्वाच्च सिद्धिं च को वा बन्धुस्ततोऽधिकः .. 92 ..
text_mt:
Reciting the excellent mantra given by the guru, one then attains knowledge;
and through omniscience, one attains perfection—who indeed is a greater kinsman than he?

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ jayati sarvatra vidyayā gurudattayā ..
yayā pūjyo'pi jagati ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
सुखं जयति सर्वत्र विद्यया गुरुदत्तया ..
यया पूज्योऽपि जगति को वा बन्धुस्ततोऽधिकः .. 93 ..
text_mt:
One conquers everywhere easily through the learning given by the guru,
through which one is honoured in the world—who indeed is a greater kinsman than he?

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāndho vā dhanāndho vā yo mūḍho na yajedgurum ..
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
विद्यान्धो वा धनान्धो वा यो मूढो न यजेद्गुरुम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 94 ..
text_mt:
That fool who, blinded by learning or blinded by wealth, does not honour his guru,
incurs sins such as the killing of a Brahmin; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
daridraṃ patitaṃ kṣudraṃ narabudyā bhajedgurum ..
tīrthasnāto'pi na śucirnādhikārī ca karmasu .. 95 ..
meaning:
दरिद्रं पतितं क्षुद्रं नरबुद्या भजेद्गुरुम् ..
तीर्थस्नातोऽपि न शुचिर्नाधिकारी च कर्मसु .. 95 ..
text_mt: Whoever regards the guru as a poor, fallen, or base human being,

sanskrit_iast:
abhīṣṭadevaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo guruste śaṅkaraḥ svayam ..
śaraṇaṃ gaccha he putra devapūjyatamaṃ gurum .. 96 ..
meaning:
अभीष्टदेवः श्रीकृष्णो गुरुस्ते शङ्करः स्वयम् ..
शरणं गच्छ हे पुत्र देवपूज्यतमं गुरुम् .. 96 ..
text_mt:
Your chosen deity is Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and your guru is Śaṅkara himself;
go for refuge, O son, to the guru who is most venerable among gods.

sanskrit_iast:
trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpā tvayā pṛthvī kṛtā yataḥ ..
prāptā tvayā harerbhaktistaṃ śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja .. 97 ..
meaning:
त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपा त्वया पृथ्वी कृता यतः ..
प्राप्ता त्वया हरेर्भक्तिस्तं शिवं शरणं व्रज .. 97 ..
text_mt:
Since the earth was cleared of kings twenty-one times by you,
and devotion to Hari has been attained by you, go for refuge to that Śiva.”

sanskrit_iast:
śivāṃ ca śivarūpaṃ ca śivadaṃ śivakāraṇam ..
śivārādhyaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ guruṃ tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja .. 98 ..
meaning:
शिवां च शिवरूपं च शिवदं शिवकारणम् ..
शिवाराध्यं शिवं शान्तं गुरुं त्वं शरणं व्रज .. 98 ..
text_mt:
To [her who is] auspicious and him whose form is auspicious, the giver of auspiciousness, the cause of auspiciousness,
to Śiva, the object of worship for the auspicious, peaceful, your guru, go for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
golokanātho bhagavānaṃśena śivarūpadhṛk ..
ya iṣṭadevaḥ sa gurustameva śaraṇaṃ vraja .. 99 ..
meaning:
गोलोकनाथो भगवानंशेन शिवरूपधृक् ..
य इष्टदेवः स गुरुस्तमेव शरणं व्रज .. 99 ..
text_mt:
The Lord, master of Goloka, took the form of Śiva by a portion.
He who is your chosen deity is the guru; go to him alone for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā kṛṣṇaḥ śivo jñānaṃ mano'haṃ sarvajīviṣu ..
prāṇā viṣṇossā prakṛtissarvaśaktiyutā suta .. 3.40.100..
meaning:
आत्मा कृष्णः शिवो ज्ञानं मनोऽहं सर्वजीविषु ..
प्राणा विष्णोस्सा प्रकृतिस्सर्वशक्तियुता सुत .. 3.40.100..
text_mt:
The Self is Kṛṣṇa; Śiva is knowledge; I am the mind in all living beings;
the life-breaths are Viṣṇu; and Prakṛti is endowed with all powers, O son.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānadaṃ jñānarūpaṃ ca jñānabījaṃ sanātanam ..
mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ taṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja .. 101 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानदं ज्ञानरूपं च ज्ञानबीजं सनातनम् ..
मृत्युञ्जयं कालकालं तं गुरुं शरणं व्रज .. 101 ..
text_mt:
To the giver of knowledge, the embodiment of knowledge, the eternal seed of knowledge,
the conqueror of death, the death of Time, to that guru go for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmajyotissvarūpaṃ taṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ..
śaraṇaṃ vraja sarvajñaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 102 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मज्योतिस्स्वरूपं तं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् ..
शरणं व्रज सर्वज्ञं भगवन्तं सनातनम् .. 102 ..
text_mt:
To him whose essential nature is the light of Brahman, whose form is assumed out of grace to devotees,
go for refuge, to the all-knowing, eternal Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtirlakṣavarṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā yamīśvaram ..
kāntaṃ priyapatiṃ lebhe taṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja .. 103 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतिर्लक्षवर्षं च तपस्तप्त्वा यमीश्वरम् ..
कान्तं प्रियपतिं लेभे तं गुरुं शरणं व्रज .. 103 ..
text_mt:
Prakṛti, having performed austerities for a hundred thousand years, which Lord
she obtained as her beloved lover and husband—to that guru go for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma kamalodbhavaḥ ..
rāmaśca gantuṃ kailāsaṃ manaścakre ca nārada .. 104 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा मुनिभिः सार्द्धं जगाम कमलोद्भवः ..
रामश्च गन्तुं कैलासं मनश्चक्रे च नारद .. 104 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the lotus-born [Brahmā] departed along with the sages;
and Rāma set his mind upon going to Kailāsa, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
hareśca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyāṃ mahīm ..
rāmo jagāma kailāsaṃ namaskartuṃ śivaṃ gurum....
gurupatnīṃ śivāmambāṃ draṣṭuṃ gurusutau ca tau ..
guṇairnārāyaṇasamau kārttikeyagaṇeśvarau .. 2 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
हरेश्च कवचं धृत्वा कृत्वा निः क्षत्रियां महीम् ..
रामो जगाम कैलासं नमस्कर्तुं शिवं गुरुम्....
गुरुपत्नीं शिवामम्बां द्रष्टुं गुरुसुतौ च तौ ..
गुणैर्नारायणसमौ कार्त्तिकेयगणेश्वरौ .. 2 ..
title: Kailāsavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
manoyāyī mahātmā sa bhṛgussaṃprāpya tatkṣaṇam ..
dadarśa parvataṃ ramyamatīva sumanoharam .. 3 ..
meaning:
मनोयायी महात्मा स भृगुस्संप्राप्य तत्क्षणम् ..
ददर्श पर्वतं रम्यमतीव सुमनोहरम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśairmaṇibhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
suvarṇabhūmisadṛśai rājamārgairvirājitam .. 4 ..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशैर्मणिभिः सुमनोहरैः ..
सुवर्णभूमिसदृशै राजमार्गैर्विराजितम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sindūrāruṇavarṇaiśca veṣṭitaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ ..
saṃyuktaṃ muktānikaraiḥ pūritaṃ maṇimaṇḍapaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
सिन्दूरारुणवर्णैश्च वेष्टितं मणिवेदिभिः ..
संयुक्तं मुक्तानिकरैः पूरितं मणिमण्डपैः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣāṇāmālayairdivyaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ ..
kapāṭastambhasopānaiḥ śobhitairmaṇinirmitaiḥ.. ..6..
meaning:
यक्षाणामालयैर्दिव्यैः संयुक्तं शतकोटिभिः ..
कपाटस्तम्भसोपानैः शोभितैर्मणिनिर्मितैः.. ..6..

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇakalaśairdivyai rājataiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ..
ratnakāñcanapūrṇaiśca yakṣendragaṇaveṣṭitaiḥ..7..
meaning:
सुवर्णकलशैर्दिव्यै राजतैः श्वेतचामरैः..
रत्नकाञ्चनपूर्णैश्च यक्षेन्द्रगणवेष्टितैः..7..

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyairdīpitaiḥ sundarīgaṇaiḥ..
bālikābhirbālakaiśca citraputtalikākaraiḥ ..8..
meaning:
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्यैर्दीपितैः सुन्दरीगणैः..
बालिकाभिर्बालकैश्च चित्रपुत्तलिकाकरैः ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍadbhiḥ sasmitaiḥ śaśvatsvacchandaṃ ca virājitaiḥ ..
pārijātadrumagaṇaiḥ svarṇadītīranīrajaiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
क्रीडद्भिः सस्मितैः शश्वत्स्वच्छन्दं च विराजितैः ..
पारिजातद्रुमगणैः स्वर्णदीतीरनीरजैः .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ākīrṇaṃ puṣpajālaiśca puṣpitaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ..
kalpavṛkṣāśritaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmadhenupuraskṛtaiḥ .. 3.41.10 ..
meaning:
आकीर्णं पुष्पजालैश्च पुष्पितैश्च सुगन्धिभिः ..
कल्पवृक्षाश्रितैः सिद्धैः कामधेनुपुरस्कृतैः .. 3.41.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
siddhavidyāsu nipuṇaiḥ puṇyavadbhirniṣevitam ..
trilakṣayojanācchāyairvaṭavṛkṣairathākṣayaiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
सिद्धविद्यासु निपुणैः पुण्यवद्भिर्निषेवितम् ..
त्रिलक्षयोजनाच्छायैर्वटवृक्षैरथाक्षयैः .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanavistīrṇaiḥ śataskandhasamanvitaiḥ ..
asaṃkhyaśākhāni karairasaṃkhyaphalasaṃyutaiḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णैः शतस्कन्धसमन्वितैः ..
असंख्यशाखानि करैरसंख्यफलसंयुतैः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇaiḥ sumanoharaśabditaiḥ ..
kampitaiḥ śītavātena maṇḍitaṃ ca sugandhinā .. 13 ..
meaning:
नानापक्षिगणाकीर्णैः सुमनोहरशब्दितैः ..
कम्पितैः शीतवातेन मण्डितं च सुगन्धिना .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpodyānasahasreṇa sarasāṃ ca śatena ca ..
siddhendrālayalakṣaiśca maṇiratnavikārajaiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
पुष्पोद्यानसहस्रेण सरसां च शतेन च ..
सिद्धेन्द्रालयलक्षैश्च मणिरत्नविकारजैः .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaśca dṛṣṭvā nagaramatisaṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
dadarśa purato ramyaṃ śrīyuktaṃ śaṃkarālayam ..15..
meaning:
रामश्च दृष्ट्वा नगरमतिसंहृष्टमानसः ..
ददर्श पुरतो रम्यं श्रीयुक्तं शंकरालयम् ..15..

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇamūlyaśatakairmaṇibhiḥ svarṇavarṇakaiḥ ..
khacitaṃ ratnasāraiśca racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. .. 16 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णमूल्यशतकैर्मणिभिः स्वर्णवर्णकैः ..
खचितं रत्नसारैश्च रचितं विश्वकर्मणा .. .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tripañcayojanocchrāyaṃ caturyojanavistṛtam ..
caturasraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prākāraṃ sumanoharam .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्रिपञ्चयोजनोच्छ्रायं चतुर्योजनविस्तृतम् ..
चतुरस्रं चतुष्कोणं प्राकारं सुमनोहरम् .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraṃ ratnakapāṭena nānā citrānvitena ca ..
maṇīndravedibhiryuktaṃ maṇistambhavirājitaiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
द्वारं रत्नकपाटेन नाना चित्रान्वितेन च ..
मणीन्द्रवेदिभिर्युक्तं मणिस्तम्भविराजितैः .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taddakṣiṇe vṛṣendraṃ ca vāme siṃhaṃ ca nārada ..
nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ bhayaṃkaram ..19..
meaning:
तद्दक्षिणे वृषेन्द्रं च वामे सिंहं च नारद ..
नन्दीश्वरं महाकालं पिङ्गलाक्षं भयंकरम् ..19..

sanskrit_iast:
viśālākṣaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca virūpākṣaṃ mahābalam ..
vikaṭākṣaṃ bhāskarākṣaṃ raktākṣaṃ vikaṭodaram .. 3.41.20 ..
meaning:
विशालाक्षं च बाणं च विरूपाक्षं महाबलम् ..
विकटाक्षं भास्कराक्षं रक्ताक्षं विकटोदरम् .. 3.41.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhārabhairavaṃ kālabhairavaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ..
rurubhairavamīśābhaṃ mahābhairavameva ca .. 21 ..
meaning:
संहारभैरवं कालभैरवं च भयङ्करम् ..
रुरुभैरवमीशाभं महाभैरवमेव च .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṅgabhairavaṃ caiva krodhabhairavamulbaṇam ..
kapālabhairavaṃ caiva rudrabhairavameva ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाङ्गभैरवं चैव क्रोधभैरवमुल्बणम् ..
कपालभैरवं चैव रुद्रभैरवमेव च .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
siddheṃdrādīnrudragaṇānvidyādharasuguhyakān ..
bhūtānpretānpiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān..23..
meaning:
सिद्धेंद्रादीन्रुद्रगणान्विद्याधरसुगुह्यकान् ..
भूतान्प्रेतान्पिशाचांश्च कूष्माण्डान्ब्रह्मराक्षसान्..23..

sanskrit_iast:
vetālāndānavāṃścaiva yogīndrāṃśca jaṭādharān ..
yakṣānkimpuruṣāṃścaiva kinnarāṃśca dadarśa ha ..24..
meaning:
वेतालान्दानवांश्चैव योगीन्द्रांश्च जटाधरान् ..
यक्षान्किम्पुरुषांश्चैव किन्नरांश्च ददर्श ह ..24..

sanskrit_iast:
tāndṛṣṭvā nandikeśājñāṃ gṛhītvā bhṛgunandanaḥ ..
tānsambhāṣyābhyantaraṃ ca jagāmānandasaṃplutaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
तान्दृष्ट्वा नन्दिकेशाज्ञां गृहीत्वा भृगुनन्दनः ..
तान्सम्भाष्याभ्यन्तरं च जगामानन्दसंप्लुतः .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ dadarśa śatamandiram ..
amūlyaratnakalaśairjvaladbhiśca virājitam .. 26 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचितं ददर्श शतमन्दिरम् ..
अमूल्यरत्नकलशैर्ज्वलद्भिश्च विराजितम् .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnaracitairmuktānirmmaladarpaṇaiḥ ..
hīrasāravikāraiśca kapāṭaiśca virājitam .. .. 27 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्नरचितैर्मुक्तानिर्म्मलदर्पणैः ..
हीरसारविकारैश्च कपाटैश्च विराजितम् .. .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gorocanābhirmaṇibhiryutaṃ stambhasahasrakaiḥ ..
maṇisāravikāraiśca sopānaiḥ pariśobhitam .. 28 ..
meaning:
गोरोचनाभिर्मणिभिर्युतं स्तम्भसहस्रकैः ..
मणिसारविकारैश्च सोपानैः परिशोभितम् .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśābhyantaraṃ dvāraṃ nānācitraiśca citritam ..
māṇikyamuktāgrathitairmālājālairvirājitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
ददर्शाभ्यन्तरं द्वारं नानाचित्रैश्च चित्रितम् ..
माणिक्यमुक्ताग्रथितैर्मालाजालैर्विराजितम् .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa kārttikeyaṃ ca vāme dakṣe gaṇeśvaram ..
vīrabhadraṃ mahākāyaṃ śivatulyaparākramam .. 3.41.30 ..
meaning:
ददर्श कार्त्तिकेयं च वामे दक्षे गणेश्वरम् ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇapatiruvāca ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
