कौतुकापह्नवं चक्रुर्बन्धुवर्गाश्च क्रीडया ..
आनम्रकन्धराः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा नन्दस्य सम्पदम्..178..
text_mt:
The groups of kinsmen played at hiding things in sport;
they all bowed their heads, seeing Nanda's opulence. (178)

sanskrit_iast:
nandaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ pūto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī..
candanāgurukastūrī kuṅkumenaiva bhūṣitaḥ..179..
meaning:
नन्दः कृताह्निकः पूतो धृत्वा धौते च वाससी..
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरी कुङ्कुमेनैव भूषितः..179..
text_mt:
Nanda, having performed his daily rites and purified himself, wearing two washed garments,
adorned with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron, (179)

sanskrit_iast:
uvāsa pādau prakṣālya svarṇapīṭhe manohare ..
gargasya ca munīndrāṇāṃ gṛhītvā''jñāṃ vrajeśvaraḥ ..4.13.180..
meaning:
उवास पादौ प्रक्षाल्य स्वर्णपीठे मनोहरे ..
गर्गस्य च मुनीन्द्राणां गृहीत्वा'ऽज्ञां व्रजेश्वरः ..4.13.180..
text_mt:
washed his feet and sat upon an enchanting golden seat.
Having obtained the permission of Garga and the foremost munis, the lord of Vraja, (180)

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmṛtya viṣṇumācāṃtaḥ svastivācanapūrvakam ..
kṛtvā karma ca vedoktaṃ bhojayāmāsa bālakam .. 161 ..
meaning:
संस्मृत्य विष्णुमाचांतः स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकम् ..
कृत्वा कर्म च वेदोक्तं भोजयामास बालकम् .. 161 ..
text_mt:
remembering Viṣṇu, sipping water, following the recitation of benedictions,
and performing the Vedic rite, fed the boy [first food]. (181)

sanskrit_iast:
gargavākyānusāreṇa bālakasya mudā'nvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma rarakṣa ca śubhe kṣaṇe .. 182 ..
meaning:
गर्गवाक्यानुसारेण बालकस्य मुदाऽन्वितः ..
कृष्णेति मङ्गलं नाम ररक्ष च शुभे क्षणे .. 182 ..
text_mt:
In accordance with Garga's words, filled with joy,
he bestowed the auspicious name 'Kṛṣṇa' at that propitious moment. (182)

sanskrit_iast:
saghṛtaṃ bhojayitvā ca kṛtvā nāma jagatpateḥ ..
vādyāni vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam .. 183 ..
meaning:
सघृतं भोजयित्वा च कृत्वा नाम जगत्पतेः ..
वाद्यानि वादयामास कारयामास मङ्गलम् .. 183 ..
text_mt:
Having fed the Lord of the Universe with ghee, and given [him] his name,
he had musical instruments played and had auspicious rites performed. (183)

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhāni svarṇāni dhanāni vividhāni ca ..
bhakṣyadravyāṇi vāsāṃsi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 184 ..
meaning:
नानाविधानि स्वर्णानि धनानि विविधानि च ..
भक्ष्यद्रव्याणि वासांसि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा .. 184 ..
text_mt:
Various kinds of gold, diverse wealth,
edibles, and garments he gladly gave to the brāhmaṇas. (184)

sanskrit_iast:
bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca suvarṇaṃ vipulaṃ dadau ..
bhārākrāntāśca te sarve na śaktā gantumeva ca .. 185 ..
meaning:
बन्दिभ्यो भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च सुवर्णं विपुलं ददौ ..
भाराक्रान्ताश्च ते सर्वे न शक्ता गन्तुमेव च .. 185 ..
text_mt:
To the bards and mendicants he gave abundant gold;
weighed down by burdens, they were unable even to walk. (185)

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbandhuvargāṃśca bhikṣukāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ..
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa paripūrṇaṃ manoharam .. 186 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्बन्धुवर्गांश्च भिक्षुकांश्च विशेषतः ..
मिष्टान्नं भोजयामास परिपूर्णं मनोहरम् .. 186 ..
text_mt:
The brāhmaṇas, the circles of kinsmen, and especially the mendicants,
he fed to their full satisfaction with delightful sweet food. (186)

sanskrit_iast:
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ caiva khādyatāṃ khādyatāmiti ..
babhūva śabdo'tyuccaiśca satataṃ nandagokule .. 187 ..
meaning:
दीयतां दीयतां चैव खाद्यतां खाद्यतामिति ..
बभूव शब्दोऽत्युच्चैश्च सततं नन्दगोकुले .. 187 ..
text_mt:
"Let it be given, let it be given! Let it be eaten, let it be eaten!"—
such very loud sound was heard continuously in Nanda's Gokula. (187)

sanskrit_iast:
ratnāni paripūrṇāni vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni ca ..
pravālāni suvarṇāni maṇisārāṇi yāni ca .. 188 ..
meaning:
रत्नानि परिपूर्णानि वासांसि भूषणानि च ..
प्रवालानि सुवर्णानि मणिसाराणि यानि च .. 188 ..
text_mt:
Abundant jewels, clothes, ornaments,
corals, gold, and fine gems,

sanskrit_iast:
cārūṇi svarṇapātrāṇi kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā ..
gatvā gargāya vinayaṃ cakāra vrajapuṃgavaḥ .. 189 ..
meaning:
चारूणि स्वर्णपात्राणि कृतानि विश्वकर्मणा ..
गत्वा गर्गाय विनयं चकार व्रजपुंगवः .. 189 ..
text_mt:
and beautiful golden vessels fashioned by Viśvakarman—
approaching Garga, the eminent chief of Vraja humbly presented [these]. (189)

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyebhyaḥ svarṇabhārāṇi pradadau vinayānvitaḥ ..
dvijebhyo'pyavaśiṣṭebhyaḥ paripūrṇāni nārada..4.13.190 .. ..
meaning:
शिष्येभ्यः स्वर्णभाराणि प्रददौ विनयान्वितः ..
द्विजेभ्योऽप्यवशिष्टेभ्यः परिपूर्णानि नारद..4.13.190 .. ..
text_mt:
Full of modesty, he gave loads of gold to his disciples,
and, O Nārada, ample [gifts] to all the remaining brāhmaṇas. (190)

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
gṛhītvā śrīhariṃ gargo jagāma nibhṛtaṃ mudā ..
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇamya ca tamīśvaram .. 191 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
गृहीत्वा श्रीहरिं गर्गो जगाम निभृतं मुदा ..
तुष्टाव परया भक्त्या प्रणम्य च तमीश्वरम् .. 191 ..
text_mt:
Taking Śrī Hari, Garga went into seclusion with joy;
bowing to the Lord, he praised him with supreme devotion. (191)

sanskrit_iast:
sāśrunetraḥ sapulako bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..
puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvovāca kṛṣṇapadāṃbuje .. 192 ..
meaning:
साश्रुनेत्रः सपुलको भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ..
पुटाञ्जलियुतो भूत्वोवाच कृष्णपदांबुजे .. 192 ..
text_mt:
His eyes brimming with tears, his hairs standing on end, his neck bowed low in devotion,
joining his palms in reverence, he spoke at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet: (192)

sanskrit_iast:
garga uvāca ..
he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana ..
prasanno bhava māmīśa dehi dāsyaṃ padāmbuje ..193..
meaning:
गर्ग उवाच ..
हे कृष्ण जगतां नाथ भक्तानां भयभञ्जन ..
प्रसन्नो भव मामीश देहि दास्यं पदाम्बुजे ..193..
text_mt:
O Kṛṣṇa! O Lord of the worlds! O dispeller of fear for devotees!
Be gracious to me, O Lord! Grant servitude at your lotus feet. (193)

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpitrā me dhanaṃ dattaṃ tena me kiṃ prayojanam ..
dehi me niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ bhaktānāmabhayaprada .. 194 ..
meaning:
त्वत्पित्रा मे धनं दत्तं तेन मे किं प्रयोजनम् ..
देहि मे निश्चलां भक्तिं भक्तानामभयप्रद .. 194 ..
text_mt:
Wealth has been given to me by your father; what need do I have for that?
Grant me unswerving devotion, O giver of fearlessness to devotees! (194)

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādikasiddhiṣu yogeṣu muktiṣu prabho ..
jñānatattve'maratve vā kiñcinnāsti spṛhā mama .. 195 ..
meaning:
अणिमादिकसिद्धिषु योगेषु मुक्तिषु प्रभो ..
ज्ञानतत्त्वेऽमरत्वे वा किञ्चिन्नास्ति स्पृहा मम .. 195 ..
text_mt:
For supernormal powers like atomicity, for yogas, or for liberations, O Lord,
for knowledge of reality or for immortality, I have no desire at all. (195)

sanskrit_iast:
indratve vā manutve vā svargalokaphale ciram ..
nāsti me manaso vāñchā tvatpādasevanaṃ vinā .. 196 ..
meaning:
इन्द्रत्वे वा मनुत्वे वा स्वर्गलोकफले चिरम् ..
नास्ति मे मनसो वाञ्छा त्वत्पादसेवनं विना .. 196 ..
text_mt:
For the status of Indra, the status of Manu, or prolonged reward in heaven,
my mind has no longing, except for service to your feet. (196)

sanskrit_iast:
sālokyaṃ sārṣṭisārūpye sāmīpyaikatvamīpsitam ..
nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi te brahmaṃstvatpādasevanaṃ vinā ..197..
meaning:
सालोक्यं सार्ष्टिसारूप्ये सामीप्यैकत्वमीप्सितम् ..
नाहं गृह्णामि ते ब्रह्मंस्त्वत्पादसेवनं विना ..197..
text_mt:
Residence in the same realm, equal power, similarity of form, proximity, and desired oneness—
I do not accept these from you, O Brahman, without service to your feet. (197)

sanskrit_iast:
goloke vāpi pātāle vāse nāsti manorathaḥ ..
kintu te caraṇāmbhoje santataṃ smṛtirastu me ..198..
meaning:
गोलोके वापि पाताले वासे नास्ति मनोरथः ..
किन्तु ते चरणाम्भोजे सन्ततं स्मृतिरस्तु मे ..198..
text_mt:
I have no desire to dwell either in Goloka or in the netherworld;
rather, let there be constant remembrance of your lotus feet! (198)

sanskrit_iast:
tvanmantraṃ śaṅkarātprāpya katijanmaphalodayāt ..
sarvajño'haṃ sarvadarśī sarvatra gatirastu me .. 199 ..
meaning:
त्वन्मन्त्रं शङ्करात्प्राप्य कतिजन्मफलोदयात् ..
सर्वज्ञोऽहं सर्वदर्शी सर्वत्र गतिरस्तु मे .. 199 ..
text_mt:
Having obtained your mantra from Śaṅkara through the arising of the fruit of many births,
may I be omniscient, all-seeing, and have movement everywhere. // 199

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho dīnabandho padāmbuje ..
rakṣa māmabhayaṃ dattvā mṛtyurme kiṃ kariṣyati .. .. 4.13.200 ..
meaning:
कृपां कुरु कृपासिन्धो दीनबन्धो पदाम्बुजे ..
रक्ष मामभयं दत्त्वा मृत्युर्मे किं करिष्यति .. .. 4.13.200 ..
text_mt:
Take pity, O ocean of mercy, friend of the wretched, at your lotus feet!
Protect me, having granted fearlessness; what will death do to me? // 200

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ sarvastvatpādāmbhojasevayā ..
mṛtyuñjayo'ntakālaśca babhūva yogināṃ guruḥ ..201..
meaning:
सर्वेषामीश्वरः सर्वस्त्वत्पादाम्भोजसेवया ..
मृत्युञ्जयोऽन्तकालश्च बभूव योगिनां गुरुः ..201..
text_mt:
Śiva became the master of all, the destroyer of death, the end-time [itself],
and the guru of yogins through service to your lotus feet. // 201

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā vidhātā jagatāṃ tvatpādāmbhojasevayā ..
yasyaikadivase brahmanpatantīndrāścaturdaśa ..202..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विधाता जगतां त्वत्पादाम्भोजसेवया ..
यस्यैकदिवसे ब्रह्मन्पतन्तीन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ..202..
text_mt:
Brahmā became the creator of the worlds through service to your lotus feet—
Brahmā, in whose single day fourteen Indras fall, O Brahman! // 202

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādasevayā dharmaḥ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām..
pātā ca phaladātā ca jitvā kālaṃ sudurjayam ..203..
meaning:
त्वत्पादसेवया धर्मः साक्षी च सर्वकर्मणाम्..
पाता च फलदाता च जित्वा कालं सुदुर्जयम् ..203..
text_mt:
Through service to your feet, Dharma became the witness of all actions,
the protector, and the dispenser of fruits, having conquered insurmountable time. // 203

sanskrit_iast:
sahasravadanaḥ śeṣo yatpādāmbujasevayā ..
dhatte siddhārthavadviśvaṃ śivaḥ kaṇṭhe viṣaṃ yathā .. .. 204 ..
meaning:
सहस्रवदनः शेषो यत्पादाम्बुजसेवया ..
धत्ते सिद्धार्थवद्विश्वं शिवः कण्ठे विषं यथा .. .. 204 ..
text_mt:
Through service to whose lotus feet thousand-headed Śeṣa
bears the universe like a mustard seed, just as Śiva [bears] poison in his throat. // 204

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃpadvidhātrī yā devīnāṃ ca parātparā..
karoti satataṃ lakṣmīḥ keśaistvatpādamārjanam ..205..
meaning:
सर्वसंपद्विधात्री या देवीनां च परात्परा..
करोति सततं लक्ष्मीः केशैस्त्वत्पादमार्जनम् ..205..
text_mt:
She who is the bestower of all prosperity and higher than the highest of goddesses,
Lakṣmī constantly wipes your feet with her hair. // 205

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtirbījarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ śaktirūpiṇī ..
smāraṃsmāraṃ tvatpadābjaṃ babhūva tatparāvarā .. 206 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतिर्बीजरूपा सा सर्वेषां शक्तिरूपिणी ..
स्मारंस्मारं त्वत्पदाब्जं बभूव तत्परावरा .. 206 ..
text_mt:
Prakṛti, who is in the form of the seed and the embodiment of power in all,
ever remembering your lotus feet, became supreme over all. // 206

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatī sarvarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ buddhirūpiṇī..
tvatpādasevayā kāntaṃ lalābha śivamīśvaram .. 207 ..
meaning:
पार्वती सर्वरूपा सा सर्वेषां बुद्धिरूपिणी..
त्वत्पादसेवया कान्तं ललाभ शिवमीश्वरम् .. 207 ..
text_mt:
Pārvatī, who takes all forms and is the embodiment of intellect in all,
obtained her beloved Śiva, the Lord, through service to your feet. // 207

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādhiṣṭhātrī devī yā jñānamātā sarasvatī ..
pūjyā babhūva sarveṣāṃ saṃpūjya tvatpadāmbujam..208..
meaning:
विद्याधिष्ठात्री देवी या ज्ञानमाता सरस्वती ..
पूज्या बभूव सर्वेषां संपूज्य त्वत्पदाम्बुजम्..208..
text_mt:
Sarasvatī, the presiding goddess of learning and mother of knowledge,
became worthy of worship by all after worshipping your lotus feet. // 208

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī vedajananī punāti bhuvanatrayam ..
brahmaṇo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gatistvatpādasevayā .. 209 ..
meaning:
सावित्री वेदजननी पुनाति भुवनत्रयम् ..
ब्रह्मणो ब्राह्मणानां च गतिस्त्वत्पादसेवया .. 209 ..
text_mt:
Sāvitrī, the mother of the Vedas, purifies the three worlds;
she is the refuge of Brahmā and the brahmins through service to your feet. // 209

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā jagadvibhartuṃ ca ratnagarbhā vasundharā ..
prasūtiḥ sarvasasyānāṃ tvatpādapadmasevayā ..4.13.210..
meaning:
क्षमा जगद्विभर्तुं च रत्नगर्भा वसुन्धरा ..
प्रसूतिः सर्वसस्यानां त्वत्पादपद्मसेवया ..4.13.210..
text_mt:
The earth, bearing jewels in her womb, is capable of supporting the universe
and is the producer of all crops through service to your lotus feet. // 210

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā mamāṃśasaṃbhūtā tava tulyā ca tejasā ..
sthitvā vakṣasi te pādaṃ sevate'nyasya kā kathā .. 211 ..
meaning:
राधा ममांशसंभूता तव तुल्या च तेजसा ..
स्थित्वा वक्षसि ते पादं सेवतेऽन्यस्य का कथा .. 211 ..
text_mt:
Rādhā, born from my portion and equal to you in splendor,
serves your feet while remaining on your chest; what need be said of anyone else? // 211

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śarvādayo devā devyaḥ padmādayo yathā ..
sanāthaṃ kuru māmīśa īśvarasya samā kṛpā ..212..
meaning:
यथा शर्वादयो देवा देव्यः पद्मादयो यथा ..
सनाथं कुरु मामीश ईश्वरस्य समा कृपा ..212..
text_mt:
Just as the gods beginning with Śarva, and just as the goddesses beginning with Padmā [are protected],
make me have a protector, O Lord! A lord’s grace is impartial. // 212

sanskrit_iast:
na yāsyāmi gṛhaṃ nātha na gṛhṇāmi dhanaṃ tava ..
kṛtvā māṃ rakṣa pādābjasevāyāṃ sevakaṃ ratam .. 213 ..
meaning:
न यास्यामि गृहं नाथ न गृह्णामि धनं तव ..
कृत्वा मां रक्ष पादाब्जसेवायां सेवकं रतम् .. 213 ..
text_mt:
I will not go home, O Lord, nor do I accept your wealth.
Make me a servant devoted to the service of your lotus feet and protect me! // 213

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutvā sāśrunetraḥ papāta caraṇe hareḥ ..
ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ bhaktyā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ .. 214 ..
meaning:
इति स्तुत्वा साश्रुनेत्रः पपात चरणे हरेः ..
रुरोद च भृशं भक्त्या पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहः .. 214 ..
text_mt:
Having thus praised [him], with tears in his eyes, he fell at Hari’s feet
and wept profusely with devotion, his body bristling with horripilation. // 214

sanskrit_iast:
gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa bhaktavatsalaḥ ..
uvāca taṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mayi te bhaktirastviti .. 215 ..
meaning:
गर्गस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा जहास भक्तवत्सलः ..
उवाच तं स्वयं कृष्णो मयि ते भक्तिरस्त्विति .. 215 ..
text_mt:
Hearing Garga’s words, he who is affectionate to his devotees smiled.
Kṛṣṇa himself said to him: “May you have devotion to me!” // 215

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ gargakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..
dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ smṛtiṃ ca labhate dhruvam .. .. 216 ..
meaning:
इदं गर्गकृतं स्तोत्रं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ..
दृढां भक्तिं हरेर्दास्यं स्मृतिं च लभते ध्रुवम् .. .. 216 ..
text_mt:
Whatever person recites at the three junctures of the day this hymn of praise composed by Garga
surely attains firm devotion, servitude to Hari, and remembrance [of him]. // 216

sanskrit_iast:
janmamṛtyujarārogaśokamohādisaṃkaṭāt ..
tīrṇo bhavati śrīkṛṣṇadāsasevanatatparaḥ .. 217 ..
meaning:
जन्ममृत्युजरारोगशोकमोहादिसंकटात् ..
तीर्णो भवति श्रीकृष्णदाससेवनतत्परः .. 217 ..
text_mt:
From the distress of birth, death, old age, disease, grief, delusion, and the rest,
he is delivered, intent on serving the servants of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. // 217

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya sahakālaṃ ca kṛṣṇasārddhaṃ ca modate ..
kadācinna bhavettasya vicchedo hariṇā saha .. 218 ..
meaning:
कृष्णस्य सहकालं च कृष्णसार्द्धं च मोदते ..
कदाचिन्न भवेत्तस्य विच्छेदो हरिणा सह .. 218 ..
text_mt:
He rejoices together with Kṛṣṇa for the same time as Kṛṣṇa;
there will never be separation for him from Hari. // 218

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
hariṃ muniḥ stavaṃ kṛtvā dadau nandāya taṃ mudā ..
uvāca taṃ gṛhaṃ yāmi kurvājñāmiti ballava ..219 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच .. ..
हरिं मुनिः स्तवं कृत्वा ददौ नन्दाय तं मुदा ..
उवाच तं गृहं यामि कुर्वाज्ञामिति बल्लव ..219 ..
text_mt:
Having praised Hari, the sage gladly handed him over to Nanda,
and said to him: “I am going home; give permission, O cowherd!” // 219

sanskrit_iast:
aho vicitraṃ saṃsāro mohajālena veṣṭitaḥ ..
saṃmīlanaṃ ca viraho narāṇāṃ sindhuphenavat .. 4.13.220..
meaning:
अहो विचित्रं संसारो मोहजालेन वेष्टितः ..
संमीलनं च विरहो नराणां सिन्धुफेनवत् .. 4.13.220..
text_mt:
“Ah, wonderful is worldly existence, enveloped in a net of delusion!
The meeting and parting of men is like the foam of the ocean.” // 220

sanskrit_iast:
gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ruroda nanda eva ca ..
sadvicchedo hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate..221..
meaning:
गर्गस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा रुरोद नन्द एव च ..
सद्विच्छेदो हि साधूनां मरणादतिरिच्यते..221..
text_mt:
Hearing the words of Garga, Nanda indeed wept:
“Separation from the virtuous exceeds even death for the good!” // 221

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munīndraṃ gantumudyatam ..
sarve nandādayo gopā rudantau gopikāstadā .. 222 ..
meaning:
सर्वशिष्यैः परिवृतं मुनीन्द्रं गन्तुमुद्यतम् ..
सर्वे नन्दादयो गोपा रुदन्तौ गोपिकास्तदा .. 222 ..
text_mt:
Surrounded by all his disciples, as the chief of sages was prepared to depart,
all the cowherds beginning with Nanda, and the weeping cowherdesses then, // 222

sanskrit_iast:
praṇemuḥ paramaprītyā cakrustaṃ vinayaṃ mune ..
dattvā''śiṣaṃ muniśreṣṭho jagāma mathurāṃ mudā .. 223 ..
meaning:
प्रणेमुः परमप्रीत्या चक्रुस्तं विनयं मुने ..
दत्त्वा'ऽशिषं मुनिश्रेष्ठो जगाम मथुरां मुदा .. 223 ..
text_mt:
bowed with supreme affection and showed him humility, O sage.
Having given his blessing, the best of sages went gladly to Mathurā. // 223

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva bandhuvargāśca ballavāḥ ..
sarve jagmurdhanaiḥ pūrṇāḥ svālayaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ .. 224 ..
meaning:
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव बन्धुवर्गाश्च बल्लवाः ..
सर्वे जग्मुर्धनैः पूर्णाः स्वालयं हृष्टमानसाः .. 224 ..
text_mt:
The ṛṣis, the sages, the relatives, and the cowherds,
all went to their own homes, filled with wealth, their minds gladdened. // 224

sanskrit_iast:
prajagmurbandinaḥ sarve paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ..
miṣṭadravyāṃśukotkṛṣṭaturagasvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 225 ..
meaning:
प्रजग्मुर्बन्दिनः सर्वे परिपूर्णमनोरथाः ..
मिष्टद्रव्यांशुकोत्कृष्टतुरगस्वर्णभूषणैः .. 225 ..
text_mt:
All the bards departed with their desires completely fulfilled
with sweet things, garments, excellent horses, gold, and ornaments. // 225

sanskrit_iast:
ākaṇṭhapūrṇā bhuktyā ca bhikṣukā gantumakṣamā..
svarṇavastrabharodrekapariśrāntā mudā'nvitāḥ..226..
meaning:
आकण्ठपूर्णा भुक्त्या च भिक्षुका गन्तुमक्षमा..
स्वर्णवस्त्रभरोद्रेकपरिश्रान्ता मुदाऽन्विताः..226..
text_mt:
Filled to the throat with food, the beggars were unable to walk;
exhausted by the excess load of gold and clothes, they were filled with joy. // 226

sanskrit_iast:
sumandagāminaḥ kecitkecidbhūmau ca śerate..
kecidvartmani tiṣṭhantaścottiṣṭhantaśca kecana .. 227 ..
meaning:
सुमन्दगामिनः केचित्केचिद्भूमौ च शेरते..
केचिद्वर्त्मनि तिष्ठन्तश्चोत्तिष्ठन्तश्च केचन .. 227 ..
text_mt:
Some walked very slowly, and some lay down on the ground;
some stayed on the road, and some stood up. // 227

sanskrit_iast:
kecidūṣuḥ pramuditā hasantastatra kecana ..
kapardakānāṃ vastūnāṃ śeṣāṃścorvaritānbahūn. 228..
meaning:
केचिदूषुः प्रमुदिता हसन्तस्तत्र केचन ..
कपर्दकानां वस्तूनां शेषांश्चोर्वरितान्बहून्. 228..
text_mt:
Some sat down, delighted, while some laughed there;
the remainder of the cowries and of the articles, and the many things that were left over.

sanskrit_iast:
kecittānādaduḥ sthitvā darśayantaśca kecana ..
kecinnṛtyaṃ prakurvanto gāyantastatra kecana..229..
meaning:
केचित्तानाददुः स्थित्वा दर्शयन्तश्च केचन ..
केचिन्नृत्यं प्रकुर्वन्तो गायन्तस्तत्र केचन..229..
text_mt:
Some stopped and gathered them up, while others showed them around.
Some danced, and others there sang.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidbahuvidhā gāthāḥ kathayantaḥ purātanāḥ ..
maruttaśvetasagaramāṃdhātṝṇāṃ ca bhūbhṛtām .. 4.13.230 ..
meaning:
केचिद्बहुविधा गाथाः कथयन्तः पुरातनाः ..
मरुत्तश्वेतसगरमांधातॄणां च भूभृताम् .. 4.13.230 ..
text_mt:
Some recounted manifold ancient tales:
the stories of the kings Marutta, Śveta, Sagara, and Māndhātṛ,

sanskrit_iast:
uttānapādanahuṣanalādīnāṃ ca yāḥ kathāḥ ..
śrīrāmasyāśvamedhasya rantidevasya karmaṇām ..231..
meaning:
उत्तानपादनहुषनलादीनां च याः कथाः ..
श्रीरामस्याश्वमेधस्य रन्तिदेवस्य कर्मणाम् ..231..
text_mt:
and of Uttānapāda, Nahuṣa, Nala, and others,
the horse-sacrifice of Śrī Rāma, and the deeds of Rantideva.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃyeṣāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca śrutā vṛddhamukhātkathāḥ..
kathayantaśca tāḥ kecicchrutavantaśca kecana..232 ..
meaning:
येषांयेषां नृपाणां च श्रुता वृद्धमुखात्कथाः..
कथयन्तश्च ताः केचिच्छ्रुतवन्तश्च केचन..232 ..
text_mt:
Whatever tales of kings they had heard from the lips of the elders,
some recounted them and others listened.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ gatāḥ kecitsvāpaṃsvāpaṃ ca kecana ..
evaṃ sarve pramuditāḥ prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā .. 233 ..
meaning:
स्थायंस्थायं गताः केचित्स्वापंस्वापं च केचन ..
एवं सर्वे प्रमुदिताः प्रजग्मुः स्वालयं मुदा .. 233 ..
text_mt:
Stopping and stopping, some went along; sleeping and sleeping, others went.
Thus, all departed with joy to their own abodes, delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭo nando yaśodā ca bālaṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ..
tasthau svamandire ramye kuberabhavanopame.. 234..
meaning:
हृष्टो नन्दो यशोदा च बालं कृत्वा च वक्षसि ..
तस्थौ स्वमन्दिरे रम्ये कुबेरभवनोपमे.. 234..
text_mt:
Joyful Nanda and Yaśodā, holding the boy to their chest,
remained in their charming house, which resembled the abode of Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravarddhitau bālau śuklacandrakalopamau ..
gavāṃ pucchaṃ ca bhittiṃ ca dhṛtvā cottasthaturmudā..235..
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्द्धितौ बालौ शुक्लचन्द्रकलोपमौ ..
गवां पुच्छं च भित्तिं च धृत्वा चोत्तस्थतुर्मुदा..235..
text_mt:
Thus the two boys grew, like the crescent moon of the bright fortnight.
Holding onto the tails of cows and onto the wall, they joyfully stood up.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdārddhaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā kṣamau vaktuṃ dinedine..
pitrorharṣaṃ ca varddhantau gacchantau prāṅgaṇe mune..236..
meaning:
शब्दार्द्धं वा तदर्द्धं वा क्षमौ वक्तुं दिनेदिने..
पित्रोर्हर्षं च वर्द्धन्तौ गच्छन्तौ प्राङ्गणे मुने..236..
text_mt:
They were able to speak half a word or half of that, day by day.
Increasing the joy of their parents, walking in the courtyard, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
bālo dvipādaṃ pādaṃ vā gantuṃ śakto babhūva ha..
gantuṃ śakto hi jānubhyāṃ prāṅgaṇe vā gṛhe hariḥ ..237..
meaning:
बालो द्विपादं पादं वा गन्तुं शक्तो बभूव ह..
गन्तुं शक्तो हि जानुभ्यां प्राङ्गणे वा गृहे हरिः ..237..
text_mt:
the boy became able to walk a step or two.
Hari was indeed able to move on his knees in the courtyard or in the house.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣādhiko hi vayasā kṛṣṇātsaṃkarṣaṇaḥ svayam ..
tato mudaṃ varddhayantau varddhitau ca dinedine..238..
meaning:
वर्षाधिको हि वयसा कृष्णात्संकर्षणः स्वयम् ..
ततो मुदं वर्द्धयन्तौ वर्द्धितौ च दिनेदिने..238..
text_mt:
Saṃkarṣaṇa was himself older than Kṛṣṇa by a year in age.
Then, increasing the joy [of all], both grew day by day.

sanskrit_iast:
vrajantau gokule bālau prahṛṣṭagamane kṣamau ..
uktavantau sphuṭaṃ vākyaṃ māyā bālakavigrahau .. 239 ..
meaning:
व्रजन्तौ गोकुले बालौ प्रहृष्टगमने क्षमौ ..
उक्तवन्तौ स्फुटं वाक्यं माया बालकविग्रहौ .. 239 ..
text_mt:
Moving about in Gokula, the two boys were able to walk cheerfully.
They spoke distinct words, having assumed the forms of children by their māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
gargo jagāma mathurāṃ vasudevāśramaṃ mune ..
sa taṃ nanāma papraccha putrayoḥ kuśalaṃ tayoḥ .. 4.13.240 ..
meaning:
गर्गो जगाम मथुरां वसुदेवाश्रमं मुने ..
स तं ननाम पप्रच्छ पुत्रयोः कुशलं तयोः .. 4.13.240 ..
text_mt:
Garga went to Mathurā, to the dwelling of Vasudeva, O sage.
He bowed to him and asked about the welfare of his two sons.

sanskrit_iast:
munistaṃ kathayāmāsa kuśalaṃ sumahotsavam ..
ānandāśrunimagnaśca śrutamātrādbabhūva ha .. 241 ..
meaning:
मुनिस्तं कथयामास कुशलं सुमहोत्सवम् ..
आनन्दाश्रुनिमग्नश्च श्रुतमात्राद्बभूव ह .. 241 ..
text_mt:
The sage related to him their welfare and the great festivity.
Vasudeva became immersed in tears of joy as soon as he heard it.

sanskrit_iast:
devakī paramaprītyā papraccha ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
ānandāśrunimagnā sā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 242 ..
meaning:
देवकी परमप्रीत्या पप्रच्छ च पुनःपुनः ..
आनन्दाश्रुनिमग्ना सा रुरोद च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 242 ..
text_mt:
Devakī, with supreme affection, inquired again and again.
Immersed in tears of joy, she wept repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast:
gargastāvāśiṣaṃ dattvā jagāma svālayaṃ mudā ..
svagṛhe tasthatustau ca kuberabhavanopame .. 243 ..
meaning:
गर्गस्तावाशिषं दत्त्वा जगाम स्वालयं मुदा ..
स्वगृहे तस्थतुस्तौ च कुबेरभवनोपमे .. 243 ..
text_mt:
Garga gave them his blessing and gladly went to his own abode.
And the two remained in their own home, which was like the abode of Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
yatra kalpe kathā ceyaṃ tatra tvamupabarhaṇaḥ ..
pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca patirgandharvapuṅgavaḥ .. 244 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
यत्र कल्पे कथा चेयं तत्र त्वमुपबर्हणः ..
पञ्चाशत्कामिनीनां च पतिर्गन्धर्वपुङ्गवः .. 244 ..
text_mt: the husband of fifty loving women, foremost among the Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ prāṇādhikastvaṃ ca śṛṅgāranipuṇo yuvā ..
tato'bhūdbrahmaṇaḥ śāpāddāsīputro dvijasya ca .. 245 ..
meaning:
तासां प्राणाधिकस्त्वं च शृङ्गारनिपुणो युवा ..
ततोऽभूद्ब्रह्मणः शापाद्दासीपुत्रो द्विजस्य च .. 245 ..
text_mt:
You were dearer to them than life itself, a youth skilled in lovemaking.
Then, by the curse of Brahmā, you became the son of a maidservant of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'dhunā brahmaputro vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt ..
sarvadarśī ca sarvajñaḥ smārako harisevayā .. 246 ..
meaning:

आवाभ्यां देहि जगतामम्बिके परमेश्वरि .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nandasya vacanamuvāca parameśvarī ..
dāsyāmi dāsyamatulamidānīṃ bhaktirastu te .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा नन्दस्य वचनमुवाच परमेश्वरी ..
दास्यामि दास्यमतुलमिदानीं भक्तिरस्तु ते .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āvayoścaraṇāmbhoje yuvayośca divāniśam ..
praphullahṛdaye śaśvatsmṛtirastu sudurlabhā .. 39 ..
meaning:
आवयोश्चरणाम्भोजे युवयोश्च दिवानिशम् ..
प्रफुल्लहृदये शश्वत्स्मृतिरस्तु सुदुर्लभा .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
māyā yuvāṃ ca pracchannau na kariṣyati madvarāt ..
goloke yāsyathānte ca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum .. 36 ..
meaning:
माया युवां च प्रच्छन्नौ न करिष्यति मद्वरात् ..
गोलोके यास्यथान्ते च विहाय मानवीं तनुम् .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā tu sānandaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi ..
dūraṃ nināya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bāhubhyāṃ ca yathepsitam .. 37 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सानन्दं कृत्वा कृष्णं स्ववक्षसि ..
दूरं निनाय श्रीकृष्णं बाहुभ्यां च यथेप्सितम् .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ kāmācchleṣaṃśleṣaṃ cucumba ca ..
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgo sasmāra rāsamaṇḍalam .. 38 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा वक्षसि तं कामाच्छ्लेषंश्लेषं चुचुम्ब च ..
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गो सस्मार रासमण्डलम् .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rādhā māyāsadratnamaṇḍapam ..
dadarśa ratnakalaśaśatena ca samanvitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राधा मायासद्रत्नमण्डपम् ..
ददर्श रत्नकलशशतेन च समन्वितम् .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvicitracitrāḍhyaṃ citrakānanaśobhitam ..
sindūrākāramaṇibhiḥ stambhasaṃghairvirājitam .. 4.15.40 ..
meaning:
नानाविचित्रचित्राढ्यं चित्रकाननशोभितम् ..
सिन्दूराकारमणिभिः स्तम्भसंघैर्विराजितम् .. 4.15.40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukastṛrīkuṅkumadravayuktayā ..
saṃyuktaṃ mālatīmālāsamūhapuṣpaśayyayā .. 41 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तृरीकुङ्कुमद्रवयुक्तया ..
संयुक्तं मालतीमालासमूहपुष्पशय्यया .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhogasamāyuktaṃ divyadarpaṇasaṃyutam ..
maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyamālājālairvibhūṣitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
नानाभोगसमायुक्तं दिव्यदर्पणसंयुतम् ..
मणीन्द्रमुक्तामाणिक्यमालाजालैर्विभूषितम् .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
maṇīndrasāraracitakapāṭena samanvitam ..
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairvastraiḥ patākānikarairvaraiḥ ..
kuṅkumākāramaṇibhiḥ saptasopānasaṃyutam .. 43 ..
meaning:
मणीन्द्रसाररचितकपाटेन समन्वितम् ..
भूषितं भूषितैर्वस्त्रैः पताकानिकरैर्वरैः ..
कुङ्कुमाकारमणिभिः सप्तसोपानसंयुतम् .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yuktaṃ ṣaṭpadasaṃyuktaiḥ puṣpodyānaṃ ca puṣpitaiḥ ..
sā devī maṇḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāmābhyantaraṃ mudā .. 44 ..
meaning:
युक्तं षट्पदसंयुक्तैः पुष्पोद्यानं च पुष्पितैः ..
सा देवी मण्डपं दृष्ट्वा जगामाभ्यन्तरं मुदा .. 44 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa tatra tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisamanvitam ..
jalaṃ ca ratnakumbhasthaṃ svacchaṃ śītaṃ manoharam .. 49 ..
meaning:
ददर्श तत्र ताम्बूलं कर्पूरादिसमन्वितम् ..
जलं च रत्नकुम्भस्थं स्वच्छं शीतं मनोहरम् .. 49 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāmadhubhyāṃ pūrṇāni ratnakumbhāni nārada ..
puruṣaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśora śyāmasundaram ..46..
meaning:
सुधामधुभ्यां पूर्णानि रत्नकुम्भानि नारद ..
पुरुषं कमनीयं च किशोर श्यामसुन्दरम् ..46..

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ candanena vibhūṣitam ..
śayānaṃ puṣpaśayyāyāṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ..47..
meaning:
कोटिकन्दर्पलीलाभं चन्दनेन विभूषितम् ..
शयानं पुष्पशय्यायां सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् ..47..
text_mt: lying on a bed of flowers, smiling, exceedingly charming,

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastraparīdhānaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam ..
maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam .. 48 .. sadratnasāranirmāṇakeyūravalayānvitam ..
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानं प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणम् ..
मणीन्द्रसारनिर्माणं क्वणन्मञ्जीररञ्जितम् .. 48 .. सद्रत्नसारनिर्माणकेयूरवलयान्वितम् ..
text_mt:
wearing yellow garments, with a serene face and eyes,
adorned with tinkling anklets crafted from the finest of gems, / endowed with armlets and bracelets made of the essence of excellent jewels,

sanskrit_iast: maṇīndrakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca gaṇḍasthalavirājitam .. 49 ..
meaning: मणीन्द्रकुण्डलाभ्यां च गण्डस्थलविराजितम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: his cheeks shining with earrings of the finest gems,

sanskrit_iast: kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam .. śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaprabhāmuṣṭamukhojjvalam .. 4.15.50 ..
meaning: कौस्तुभेन मणीन्द्रेण वक्षःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलम् .. शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यप्रभामुष्टमुखोज्ज्वलम् .. 4.15.50 ..
text_mt: his chest brilliant with the Kaustubha, the foremost gem, / his face glowing, stealing the splendour of the full moon of autumn,

sanskrit_iast:
śaratpraphullakamalaprabhāmocanalocanam ..
mālatīmālyasaṃśliṣṭaśikhipicchasuśobhitam .. 51 ..
meaning:
शरत्प्रफुल्लकमलप्रभामोचनलोचनम् ..
मालतीमाल्यसंश्लिष्टशिखिपिच्छसुशोभितम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
his eyes dispelling the brilliance of a blooming autumnal lotus,
well adorned with a peacock feather entwined with a garland of mālatī flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
trivaṃkacūḍāṃ bibhrantaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnamandiram ..
kroḍaṃ bālakaśūnyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā taṃ navayauvanam .. 52 ..
meaning:
त्रिवंकचूडां बिभ्रन्तं पश्यन्तं रत्नमन्दिरम् ..
क्रोडं बालकशून्यं च दृष्ट्वा तं नवयौवनम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
bearing a threefold-bending crown, gazing upon the jewelled palace.
Seeing her lap empty of the child and seeing him in his fresh youth,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasmṛtisvarūpā sā tathāpi vismayaṃ yayau ..
rūpaṃ rāseśvarī dṛṣṭvā mumoha sumanoharam .. 53 ..
meaning:
सर्वस्मृतिस्वरूपा सा तथापि विस्मयं ययौ ..
रूपं रासेश्वरी दृष्ट्वा मुमोह सुमनोहरम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
she, though the embodiment of all memory, was nevertheless struck with wonder.
Beholding his exceedingly charming form, the Queen of the Rāsa was enchanted.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ papau mudā ..
nimeṣarahitā rādhā navasaṃgamalālasā .. 54 ..
meaning:
कामाच्चक्षुश्चकोराभ्यां मुखचन्द्रं पपौ मुदा ..
निमेषरहिता राधा नवसंगमलालसा .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Out of desire, she drank in the moon of his face joyfully with the cakora birds of her eyes.
Unwinking, Rādhā longed for their fresh union.

sanskrit_iast:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgī sasmitā madanāturā ..
tāmuvāca haristatra smerānanasaroruhām ..
navasaṃgamayogyāṃ ca paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā .. 55 ..
meaning:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गी सस्मिता मदनातुरा ..
तामुवाच हरिस्तत्र स्मेराननसरोरुहाम् ..
नवसंगमयोग्यां च पश्यन्तीं वक्रचक्षुषा .. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
rādhe smarasi golokavṛttāntaṃ surasaṃsadi .. 56 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
राधे स्मरसि गोलोकवृत्तान्तं सुरसंसदि .. 56 ..
text_mt: “O Rādhā, do you remember the event in Goloka, in the assembly of the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
adya pūrṇaṃ kariṣyāmi svīkṛtaṃ yatpurā priye ..
tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā rādhe preyasī ca varānane .. 57 ..
meaning:
अद्य पूर्णं करिष्यामि स्वीकृतं यत्पुरा प्रिये ..
त्वं मे प्राणाधिका राधे प्रेयसी च वरानने .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Today I shall fulfil what was promised previously, my beloved.
You are dearer to me than life, O Rādhā, and my beloved, O fair-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca bhedo hi nāvayordhruvam ..
yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ yathā'gnau dāhikā sati .. 58 ..
meaning:
यथा त्वं च तथाऽहं च भेदो हि नावयोर्ध्रुवम् ..
यथा क्षीरे च धावल्यं यथाऽग्नौ दाहिका सति .. 58 ..
text_mt:
As you are, so am I; indeed, there is certainly no difference between us two.
Just as whiteness exists in milk, just as the power to burn exists in fire, O virtuous woman,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pṛthivyāṃ gandhaśca tathā'haṃ tvayi saṃtatam ..
vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ vinā svarṇena kuṇḍalam .. 59 ..
meaning:
यथा पृथिव्यां गन्धश्च तथाऽहं त्वयि संततम् ..
विना मृदा घटं कर्तुं विना स्वर्णेन कुण्डलम् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
just as fragrance exists in the earth, so am I always in you.
Without clay to make a pot, without gold [to make] an earring,

sanskrit_iast:
kulālaḥ svarṇakāraśca nahi śaktaḥ kadācana ..
tathā tvayā vinā sṛṣṭimahaṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ .. 4.15.60 ..
meaning:
कुलालः स्वर्णकारश्च नहि शक्तः कदाचन ..
तथा त्वया विना सृष्टिमहं कर्तुं न च क्षमः .. 4.15.60 ..
text_mt:
the potter and the goldsmith are never able [to create].
Likewise, without you I am not capable of effecting creation.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭerādhārabhūtā tvaṃ bījarūpo'hamacyutaḥ ..
āgaccha śayane sādhvi kuru vakṣaḥsthale hi mām .. 61 ..
meaning:
सृष्टेराधारभूता त्वं बीजरूपोऽहमच्युतः ..
आगच्छ शयने साध्वि कुरु वक्षःस्थले हि माम् .. 61 ..
text_mt:
You are the substratum of creation; I, Acyuta, am the seed.
Come to the bed, O virtuous woman; take me to your chest.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ me śobhā svarūpā'si dehasya bhūṣaṇaṃ yathā ..
kṛṣṇaṃ vadānta māṃ lokāstvayaiva rahitaṃ yadā .. 62 ..
meaning:
त्वं मे शोभा स्वरूपाऽसि देहस्य भूषणं यथा ..
कृष्णं वदान्त मां लोकास्त्वयैव रहितं यदा .. 62 ..
text_mt:
You are my splendour itself, like an ornament to the body.
When people speak of me devoid of you, they call me ‘Kṛṣṇa’;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca tadā te'pi tvayaiva sahitaṃ param ..
tvaṃ ca śrīstvaṃ ca saṃpattistvamādhārasvarūpiṇī .. 63 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णं च तदा तेऽपि त्वयैव सहितं परम् ..
त्वं च श्रीस्त्वं च संपत्तिस्त्वमाधारस्वरूपिणी .. 63 ..
text_mt:
and when accompanied by you alone, then they say ‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa’, the Supreme.
You are Śrī, you are prosperity, you are the nature of the substratum;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśaktisvarūpāsi sarvarūpo'hamakṣaraḥ ..
yadā tejaḥsvarūpo'haṃ tejorūpā'si tvaṃ tadā .. 64 ..
meaning:
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपासि सर्वरूपोऽहमक्षरः ..
यदा तेजःस्वरूपोऽहं तेजोरूपाऽसि त्वं तदा .. 64 ..
text_mt:
you are the embodiment of all power; I am the imperishable, consisting of all forms.
When I am of the nature of splendour, then you are of the form of splendour;

sanskrit_iast:
na śarīrī yadāhaṃ ca tadā tvamaśarīriṇī ..
sarvabījasvarūpo'haṃ sadā yogena sundari .. 65 ..
meaning:
न शरीरी यदाहं च तदा त्वमशरीरिणी ..
सर्वबीजस्वरूपोऽहं सदा योगेन सुन्दरि .. 65 ..
text_mt:
when I have no body, then you are bodiless.
I am the nature of the seed of all, always through yoga, O beautiful one;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca śaktisvarūpā ca sarvastrīrūpadhāriṇī ..
mamāṅgāṃśasvarūpā tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī .. 66 ..
meaning:
त्वं च शक्तिस्वरूपा च सर्वस्त्रीरूपधारिणी ..
ममाङ्गांशस्वरूपा त्वं मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी .. 66 ..
text_mt:
and you are the embodiment of power, bearing the forms of all women.
You are an aṃśa of my own body, the Primordial Prakṛti, the Sovereign Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyā buddhyā ca jñānena mayā tulyā varānane ..
āvayorbhedabuddhiṃ ca yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
शक्त्या बुद्ध्या च ज्ञानेन मया तुल्या वरानने ..
आवयोर्भेदबुद्धिं च यः करोति नराधमः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
In power, intellect, and knowledge you are equal to me, O fair-faced one!
That lowest of men who sees a distinction between us two—

sanskrit_iast:
tasya vāsaḥ kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākarau ..
pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānpātayatyadhaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
तस्य वासः कालसूत्रे यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ..
पूर्वान्सप्त परान्सप्त पुरुषान्पातयत्यधः .. 68 ..
text_mt:
his dwelling shall be in Kālasūtra as long as the moon and the sun endure.
He causes seven generations before and seven after to fall down into hell;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ..
ajñānādāvayornindāṃ ye kurvanti narādhamāḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं तस्य नश्यति निश्चितम् ..
अज्ञानादावयोर्निन्दां ये कुर्वन्ति नराधमाः .. 69 ..
text_mt: Those lowest of men who, out of ignorance, revile the two of us,

sanskrit_iast:
pacyante narake ghore yāvaccandradivākarau ..
rāśabdaṃ kurvatastrasto dadāmi bhaktimuttamām .. 4.15.70 ..
meaning:
पच्यन्ते नरके घोरे यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ..
राशब्दं कुर्वतस्त्रस्तो ददामि भक्तिमुत्तमाम् .. 4.15.70 ..
text_mt:
cook in a terrible hell as long as the moon and the sun endure.
To one who utters the syllable ‘Rā’, being stirred, I bestow the highest bhakti;

sanskrit_iast:
dhāśabdaṃ kurvataḥ paścādyāmi śravaṇalobhataḥ ..
ye sevante ca dattvā māmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ..
yāvajīvanaparyantaṃ yā prītirjāyate mama .. 71 ..
meaning:
धाशब्दं कुर्वतः पश्चाद्यामि श्रवणलोभतः ..
ये सेवन्ते च दत्त्वा मामुपचारांश्च षोडश ..
यावजीवनपर्यन्तं या प्रीतिर्जायते मम .. 71 ..
text_mt:
after one who utters the syllable ‘dhā’, I follow behind out of greed to hear it.
For those who worship me, offering the sixteen articles of worship
as long as life lasts, whatever love arises in me,

sanskrit_iast:
sā prītirmama jāyeta rādhāśabdāttato'dhikā ..
priyā na me tathā rādhe rādhāvaktā tato'dhikaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
सा प्रीतिर्मम जायेत राधाशब्दात्ततोऽधिका ..
प्रिया न मे तथा राधे राधावक्ता ततोऽधिकः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
a love greater than that arises in me from the name ‘Rādhā’.
Even you are not as dear to me, O Rādhā; the one who speaks ‘Rādhā’ is dearer than that.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānantaḥ śivo dharmo naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca kārttikeyaśca matpriyaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानन्तः शिवो धर्मो नरनारायणावृषी ..
कपिलश्च गणेशश्च कार्त्तिकेयश्च मत्प्रियः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā, Ananta, Śiva, Dharma, the sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa,
Kapila, Gaṇeśa, and Kārttikeya are dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī prakṛtistathā..
mama priyāśca devāśca tāstathāpi na tatsamāḥ ..74..
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती दुर्गा सावित्री प्रकृतिस्तथा..
मम प्रियाश्च देवाश्च तास्तथापि न तत्समाः ..74..
text_mt:
Likewise Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Durgā, Sāvitrī, and Prakṛti;
they are dear to me, and the gods too, yet they are not your equal.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve prāṇatulyā me tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā satī ..
bhinnasthānasthitāste ca tvaṃ ca vakṣaḥsthale sthitā .. 75 ..
meaning:
ते सर्वे प्राणतुल्या मे त्वं मे प्राणाधिका सती ..
भिन्नस्थानस्थितास्ते च त्वं च वक्षःस्थले स्थिता .. 75 ..
text_mt:
They are all equal to my life-breath, but you, virtuous lady, are dearer to me than life.
They reside in different places, but you abide on my chest.

sanskrit_iast:
yā me caturbhujā mūrtirbibhartti vakṣasi priyām ..
so'haṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpastvāṃ vivahāmi svayaṃ sadā .. 76 ..
meaning:
या मे चतुर्भुजा मूर्तिर्बिभर्त्ति वक्षसि प्रियाम् ..
सोऽहं कृष्णस्वरूपस्त्वां विवहामि स्वयं सदा .. 76 ..
text_mt:
That four-armed form of mine bears his beloved on his chest,
and I myself, in the form of Kṛṣṇa, constantly bear you.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇastasthau talpe manorame ..
uvāca rādhikā nāthaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharā ..77 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा श्रीकृष्णस्तस्थौ तल्पे मनोरमे ..
उवाच राधिका नाथं भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरा ..77 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Śrī Kṛṣṇa remained on the delightful couch.
Rādhikā, her neck bowed in devotion, said to the lord:

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikovāca ..
smarāmi sarvaṃ jānāmi vismarāmi kathaṃ vibho ..
yattvaṃ vadasi sarvāhaṃ tvatpādābjaprasādataḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
राधिकोवाच ..
स्मरामि सर्वं जानामि विस्मरामि कथं विभो ..
यत्त्वं वदसि सर्वाहं त्वत्पादाब्जप्रसादतः .. 78 ..
text_mt:
I remember everything, I know everything; how could I forget, O almighty Lord,
all that you say, by the grace of your lotus feet?

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarasyāpriyāḥ kecitpriyāśca kutra kecana ..
ye yathā māṃ na smaranti tathā teṣu tavākṛpā .. 79 ..
meaning:
ईश्वरस्याप्रियाः केचित्प्रियाश्च कुत्र केचन ..
ये यथा मां न स्मरन्ति तथा तेषु तवाकृपा .. 79 ..
text_mt:
To the Lord, how can some be disliked and some dear?
Toward those who do not remember me as [they should], your mercy is withdrawn accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇaṃ ca parvataṃ kartu samarthaḥ parvataṃ tṛṇam ..
tathāpi yogyāyogye ca saṃpattau ca samā kṛpā .. 4.15.80 ..
meaning:
तृणं च पर्वतं कर्तु समर्थः पर्वतं तृणम् ..
तथापि योग्यायोग्ये च संपत्तौ च समा कृपा .. 4.15.80 ..
text_mt:
You are capable of turning a blade of grass into a mountain and a mountain into a blade of grass;
nevertheless, your mercy is equal toward the worthy and the unworthy, and in prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhatyahaṃ śayānastvaṃ kathābhiryatkṣaṇaṃ gatam ..
tatkṣaṇaṃ ca yugasamaṃ nāhaṃ prāpayituṃ kṣamā ..81..
meaning:
तिष्ठत्यहं शयानस्त्वं कथाभिर्यत्क्षणं गतम् ..
तत्क्षणं च युगसमं नाहं प्रापयितुं क्षमा ..81..
text_mt:
While I stand and you recline, whatever moment has passed in conversation,
that moment seems like an eon to me; I am unable to bear it.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣaḥsthale ca śirasi dehi te caraṇāmbujam ..
dunoti manmanaḥ sadyastvadīyavirahānalāt .. 82 ..
meaning:
वक्षःस्थले च शिरसि देहि ते चरणाम्बुजम् ..
दुनोति मन्मनः सद्यस्त्वदीयविरहानलात् .. 82 ..
text_mt:
Place your lotus foot upon my chest and upon my head;
instantly my heart burns from the fire of separation from you.

sanskrit_iast:
puraḥ papāta me dṛṣṭistvadīyacaraṇāmbuje ..
nītā mayā nahi kleśāddraṣṭumanyatkalevaram ..83..
meaning:
पुरः पपात मे दृष्टिस्त्वदीयचरणाम्बुजे ..
नीता मया नहि क्लेशाद्द्रष्टुमन्यत्कलेवरम् ..83..
text_mt:
My gaze fell forward upon your lotus feet;
with difficulty I brought it [upwards] to gaze at the rest of your body.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekamaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dattā śānte mukhāmbuje..
dṛṣṭvā mukhāravindaṃ ca nānyaṃ gantuṃ ca sā kṣamā .. 84 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकमङ्गं दृष्ट्वैव दत्ता शान्ते मुखाम्बुजे..
दृष्ट्वा मुखारविन्दं च नान्यं गन्तुं च सा क्षमा .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Having seen each limb, it was cast at last upon your serene lotus face;
and having beheld your lotus face, it cannot go anywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa puruṣottamaḥ ..
tāmuvāca hitaṃ tathyaṃ śrutismṛtinirūpitam .. 89 ..
meaning:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा जहास पुरुषोत्तमः ..
तामुवाच हितं तथ्यं श्रुतिस्मृतिनिरूपितम् .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Hearing Rādhikā's words, Puruṣottama smiled;
he spoke to her words that were beneficial, true, and established in the Śruti and Smṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
na khaṇḍanīyaṃ tattatra mayā pūrvaṃ nirūpitam ..
tiṣṭha bhadre kṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ kariṣyāmi tava priye .. 86..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
न खण्डनीयं तत्तत्र मया पूर्वं निरूपितम् ..
तिष्ठ भद्रे क्षणं भद्रं करिष्यामि तव प्रिये .. 86..
text_mt:
That which was determined by me there in the past cannot be annulled.
Wait a moment, auspicious lady; O beloved, I will bring about your welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
tvanmanorathapūrṇasya svayaṃ kālaḥ samāgataḥ ..
yasya yallikhitaṃ pūrvaṃ yatra kāle nirūpitam .. 87 ..
meaning:
त्वन्मनोरथपूर्णस्य स्वयं कालः समागतः ..
यस्य यल्लिखितं पूर्वं यत्र काले निरूपितम् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
The time for fulfilling your desire has arrived on its own.
Whatever was written for anyone in the past, and at whatever time it was appointed,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva khaṇḍituṃ rādhe kṣamo nāhaṃ ca ko vidhiḥ ..
vidhātuśca vidhātā'haṃ yeṣāṃ yallekhanaṃ kṛtam .. 88 ..
meaning:
तदेव खण्डितुं राधे क्षमो नाहं च को विधिः ..
विधातुश्च विधाताऽहं येषां यल्लेखनं कृतम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
that very thing, O Rādhā, I am unable to alter; and what can fate do?
I am the creator of the Creator; whatever has been decreed for them—

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ na tatkhaṇḍyaṃ kadācana ..
etasminnantare brahmā''jagāma purato hareḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनां च क्षुद्राणां न तत्खण्ड्यं कदाचन ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा'ऽजगाम पुरतो हरेः .. 89 ..
text_mt:
for Brahmā and the others, down to the lowliest—can never be altered.
In the meantime, Brahmā arrived before Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
mālākamaṇḍalukara īṣatsmeracaturmukhaḥ ..
gatvā nanāma taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratuṣṭāva yathāgamam..4.15.90..
meaning:
मालाकमण्डलुकर ईषत्स्मेरचतुर्मुखः ..
गत्वा ननाम तं कृष्णं प्रतुष्टाव यथागमम्..4.15.90..
text_mt:
holding a rosary and water-pot in his hands, four-faced and smiling slightly.
Approaching, he bowed to that Kṛṣṇa and praised him according to the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
sāśrunetrapulakito bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ..
stutvā natvā jagaddhātā jagāma harisannidhim ..91..
meaning:
साश्रुनेत्रपुलकितो भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः..
स्तुत्वा नत्वा जगद्धाता जगाम हरिसन्निधिम् ..91..
text_mt:
With tears in his eyes, his hair standing on end, his neck bowed in devotion,
having praised and bowed, the Creator of the universe approached Hari's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
punarnatvā prabhuṃ bhaktyā jagāma rādhikāntikam ..
mūrdhnā nanāma bhaktyā ca mātustaccaraṇāmbuje ..92..
meaning:
पुनर्नत्वा प्रभुं भक्त्या जगाम राधिकान्तिकम् ..
मूर्ध्ना ननाम भक्त्या च मातुस्तच्चरणाम्बुजे ..92..
text_mt:
Bowing again with devotion to the Lord, he approached Rādhikā,
and with devotion he bowed his head to the mother's lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra saṃbhrameṇaiva jaṭājālena veṣṭitam..
kamaṇḍalujalenaiva śīghraṃ prakṣālitaṃ mudā ..93..
meaning:
चकार संभ्रमेणैव जटाजालेन वेष्टितम्..
कमण्डलुजलेनैव शीघ्रं प्रक्षालितं मुदा ..93..
text_mt:
With great reverence he enveloped [them] in his mass of matted hair,
and gladly washed them at once with water from his water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāgamaṃ pratuṣṭāva puṭāñjaliyutaḥ punaḥ ..
..brahmovāca .. ..
he mātastvatpadāmbhojaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ..94..
meaning:
यथागमं प्रतुष्टाव पुटाञ्जलियुतः पुनः ..
..ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
हे मातस्त्वत्पदाम्भोजं दृष्टं कृष्णप्रसादतः ..94..
text_mt:
With folded hands, he praised her again according to the scriptures.
O Mother, by Kṛṣṇa's grace your lotus foot has been seen,

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhārate ca viśeṣataḥ ..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ purā mayā .. 95 ..
meaning:
सुदुर्लभं च सर्वेषां भारते च विशेषतः ..
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्तं पुरा मया .. 95 ..
text_mt:
which is extremely difficult for all to attain, especially in Bhārata.
Anciently, austerities were performed by me for sixty thousand years

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskare puṣkare tīrthe kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
ājagāma varaṃ dātuṃ varadātā hariḥ svayam .. 96 ..
meaning:
भास्करे पुष्करे तीर्थे कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ..
आजगाम वरं दातुं वरदाता हरिः स्वयम् .. 96 ..
text_mt:
at the sacred site of Puṣkara, directed to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.
Hari himself, the giver of boons, came in person to grant a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣvetyukte ca svābhīṣṭaṃ ca vṛtaṃ mudā ..
rādhikācaraṇāmbhojaṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham .. 97 ..
meaning:
वरं वृणीष्वेत्युक्ते च स्वाभीष्टं च वृतं मुदा ..
राधिकाचरणाम्भोजं सर्वेषामपि दुर्लभम् .. 97 ..
text_mt:
When he said, 'Choose a boon,' my cherished desire was gladly chosen:
'The lotus feet of Rādhikā are hard to attain even for everyone;

sanskrit_iast:
he guṇātīta me śīghramadhunaiva pradarśaya ..
mayetyukto harirayamuvāca māṃ tapasvinam .. 98 ..
meaning:
हे गुणातीत मे शीघ्रमधुनैव प्रदर्शय ..
मयेत्युक्तो हरिरयमुवाच मां तपस्विनम् .. 98 ..
text_mt:
O one beyond the gunas, show them to me quickly, right now.'
Addressed thus by me, this Hari said to me, an ascetic:

sanskrit_iast:
darśayiṣyāmi kāle ca vatsedānīṃ kṣameti ca ..
nahīśvarājñā viphalā tena dṛṣṭaṃ padāmbujam .. 99 ..
meaning:
दर्शयिष्यामि काले च वत्सेदानीं क्षमेति च ..
नहीश्वराज्ञा विफला तेन दृष्टं पदाम्बुजम् .. 99 ..
text_mt:
'I will show them in time, my child; for now, be patient.'
The command of the Lord is never in vain; therefore your lotus foot has now been seen,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ mātargoloke bhārate'dhunā ..
sarvā devyaḥ prakṛtyaṃśā janyāḥ prākṛtikā dhruvam .. 4.15.100 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषां वाञ्छितं मातर्गोलोके भारतेऽधुना ..
सर्वा देव्यः प्रकृत्यंशा जन्याः प्राकृतिका ध्रुवम् .. 4.15.100 ..
text_mt:
which is desired by everyone in Goloka, and now in Bhārata, O Mother.
All goddesses are portions of Prakṛti, certainly born and material;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgārdhasaṃbhūtā tulyā kṛṣṇena sarvataḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇastvamayaṃ rādhā tvaṃ rādhā vā hariḥ svayam .. 101 ..
meaning:
त्वं कृष्णाङ्गार्धसंभूता तुल्या कृष्णेन सर्वतः ..
श्रीकृष्णस्त्वमयं राधा त्वं राधा वा हरिः स्वयम् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
but you have arisen from half of Kṛṣṇa's body, equal to Kṛṣṇa in every way.
[Are] you Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and is he Rādhā? Or are you Rādhā, [and he] Hari himself?

sanskrit_iast:
nahi vedeṣu me dṛṣṭa iti kena nirūpitam ..
brahmāṇḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca goloko'sti yathāmbike .. 102 ..
meaning:
नहि वेदेषु मे दृष्ट इति केन निरूपितम् ..
ब्रह्माण्डाद्बहिरूर्ध्वं च गोलोकोऽस्ति यथाम्बिके .. 102 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, I have not seen this in the Vedas; by whom has it been determined?
Just as Goloka exists outside and above the cosmic egg, O Mother,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhaścāpyajanyaśca tvamajanyā tathāmbike ..
yathā samastabrahmāṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇāṃśāṃśajīvinaḥ..103..
meaning:
वैकुण्ठश्चाप्यजन्यश्च त्वमजन्या तथाम्बिके ..
यथा समस्तब्रह्माण्डे श्रीकृष्णांशांशजीविनः..103..
text_mt:
and Vaikuṇṭha is uncreated, so too are you uncreated, O Mother.
Just as in the entire cosmic egg living beings are portions of the portion of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ teṣu sarveṣu saṃsthitā..
puruṣāśca hareraṃśāstvadaṃśā nikhilāḥ striyaḥ ..104..
meaning:
तथा शक्तिस्वरूपा त्वं तेषु सर्वेषु संस्थिता..
पुरुषाश्च हरेरंशास्त्वदंशा निखिलाः स्त्रियः ..104..
text_mt:
so do you, whose essence is power, reside within them all.
Men are portions of Hari, and all women are portions of you.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanā deharūpā tvamasyādhārastvameva hi..
asyānu prāṇaistvaṃ mātastvatprāṇairayamīśvaraḥ ..105..
meaning:
आत्मना देहरूपा त्वमस्याधारस्त्वमेव हि..
अस्यानु प्राणैस्त्वं मातस्त्वत्प्राणैरयमीश्वरः ..105..
text_mt:
With the Ātman, you have the nature of the body; you alone are indeed his foundation.
Following his life-breaths are you, O Mother; and by your life-breaths is this Lord [alive].

sanskrit_iast:
kimaho nirmitaḥ kena hetunā śilpakāriṇā ..
nityo'yaṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇastvaṃ ca nityā tathā'mbike .. 106 ..
meaning:
किमहो निर्मितः केन हेतुना शिल्पकारिणा ..
नित्योऽयं च तथा कृष्णस्त्वं च नित्या तथाऽम्बिके .. 106 ..
text_mt:
Ah, how, [and] for what purpose was this created by the master artisan?
He is eternal, this Kṛṣṇa, and you are also eternal, O Mother.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃśā tvaṃ tvadaṃśo vā'pyayaṃ kena nirūpitaḥ ..
ahaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ devānāṃ janakaḥ svayam .. 107 ..
meaning:
अस्यांशा त्वं त्वदंशो वाऽप्ययं केन निरूपितः ..
अहं विधाता जगतां देवानां जनकः स्वयम् .. 107 ..
text_mt:
Are you a portion of him, or is he a portion of you? By whom has this been determined?
I am the creator of the worlds, the father of the gods myself;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ paṭhitvā gurumukhādbhavantyeva budhā janāḥ ..
guṇānāṃ vāstavānāṃ te śatāṃśaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ .. 108 ..
meaning:
तं पठित्वा गुरुमुखाद्भवन्त्येव बुधा जनाः ..
गुणानां वास्तवानां ते शतांशं वक्तुमक्षमः .. 108 ..
text_mt:
having studied that [Veda] from the mouth of the guru, wise men become learned.
Yet I am unable to declare a hundredth part of your real virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
vedo vā paṇḍito vā'nyaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
stavānāṃ janakaṃ jñānaṃ buddhirjñānāmbikā sadā .. 109 ..
meaning:
वेदो वा पण्डितो वाऽन्यः को वा त्वां स्तोतुमीश्वरः ..
स्तवानां जनकं ज्ञानं बुद्धिर्ज्ञानाम्बिका सदा .. 109 ..
text_mt:
Whether the Veda, or a learned scholar, or someone else—who is able to praise you?
Knowledge is the father of praises, and intellect is ever the mother of knowledge;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ buddherjananī mātaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
yadvastu dṛṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ taddhi vaktuṃ budhaḥ kṣamaḥ ..4.15.110..
meaning:
त्वं बुद्धेर्जननी मातः को वा त्वां स्तोतुमीश्वरः ..
यद्वस्तु दृष्टं सर्वेषां तद्धि वक्तुं बुधः क्षमः ..4.15.110..
text_mt:
you are the mother of the intellect, O Mother—who is able to praise you?
Whatever matter is seen by all, that indeed a wise man is able to describe;

sanskrit_iast:
yadadṛṣṭāśrute vastu tannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ..
ahaṃ maheśo'naṃtaśca stotuṃ tvāṃ ko'pi na kṣamaḥ.. 111 ..
meaning:
यददृष्टाश्रुते वस्तु तन्निर्वक्तुं च कः क्षमः ..
अहं महेशोऽनंतश्च स्तोतुं त्वां कोऽपि न क्षमः.. 111 ..
text_mt:
but when a thing is unseen and unheard, who is capable of describing it?
I, Maheśa, and Ananta—none of us is able to praise you;

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatī ca vedāśca kṣamaḥ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ..
yathāgamaṃ yathoktaṃ ca na māṃ ninditumarhasi .. 112 ..
meaning:
सरस्वती च वेदाश्च क्षमः कः स्तोतुमीश्वरः ..
यथागमं यथोक्तं च न मां निन्दितुमर्हसि .. 112 ..
text_mt:
Sarasvatī and the Vedas—who is able to praise [you], the Supreme Lady?
According to the sacred texts and as I have spoken, you ought not to fault me.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarāṇāmīśvarasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā..
janasya pratipālyasya kṣaṇe doṣaḥ kṣaṇe guṇaḥ .. 113 ..
meaning:
ईश्वराणामीश्वरस्य योग्यायोग्ये समा कृपा..
जनस्य प्रतिपाल्यस्य क्षणे दोषः क्षणे गुणः .. 113 ..
text_mt:
The mercy of the Lord of lords is equal toward the worthy and the unworthy.
A servant being maintained has faults at one moment, virtues at another moment;

sanskrit_iast:
jananī janako yo vā sarvaṃ kṣamati snehataḥ ..
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tasthau ca puratastayoḥ ..114..
meaning:
जननी जनको यो वा सर्वं क्षमति स्नेहतः ..
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता तस्थौ च पुरतस्तयोः ..114..
text_mt:
a mother or a father forgives everything out of affection."
Having spoken thus, the creator of the worlds stood before the two of them,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje sarveṣāṃ vandyamīpsitam ..
brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..115..
meaning:
प्रणम्य चरणाम्भोजे सर्वेषां वन्द्यमीप्सितम् ..
ब्रह्मणा च कृतं स्तोत्रं त्रिसंध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ..115..
text_mt:
having bowed down to the lotus-feet desired and worthy of worship by all.
Whatever man recites at the three twilights this hymn of praise composed by Brahmā

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāmādhavayoḥ pāde bhaktirdāsyaṃ labheddhruvam ..
karmanirmūlanaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuṃ jitvā sudurjayam ..
vilaṅghya sarvalokāṃśca yāti golokamuttamam.. 116..
meaning:
राधामाधवयोः पादे भक्तिर्दास्यं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ..
कर्मनिर्मूलनं कृत्वा मृत्युं जित्वा सुदुर्जयम् ..
विलङ्घ्य सर्वलोकांश्च याति गोलोकमुत्तमम्.. 116..
text_mt:
surely attains devotion and servitude at the feet of Rādhā and Mādhava.
Having uprooted all karma, having conquered very unconquerable death,
and having transcended all realms, he goes to supreme Goloka.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca..
brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca ha rādhikā .. 117 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच..
ब्रह्मणः स्तवनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच ह राधिका .. 117 ..
text_mt: Having heard the praise of Brahmā, Rādhikā indeed spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vṛṇu vidhātastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate ..
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca jagadvidhiḥ .. 118 ..
meaning:
वरं वृणु विधातस्त्वं यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ..
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा तामुवाच जगद्विधिः .. 118 ..
text_mt:
"Choose a boon, O creator, whatever is in your mind."
Hearing the words of Rādhikā, the creator of the world said to her:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ ca yuvayoḥ pādapadmabhaktiṃ ca dehi me ..
ityukte vidhinā rādhā tūrṇamomityuvāca ha .. 119 ..
meaning:
वरं च युवयोः पादपद्मभक्तिं च देहि मे ..
इत्युक्ते विधिना राधा तूर्णमोमित्युवाच ह .. 119 ..
text_mt:
"Grant me as a boon devotion to the lotus feet of you both."
When this was spoken by the creator, Rādhā quickly said, "Om."

sanskrit_iast:
punarnanāma tāṃ bhaktyā vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
tadā brahmā tayormadhye prajvālya ca hutāśanam .. 4.15.120 ..
meaning:
पुनर्ननाम तां भक्त्या विधाता जगतां पतिः ..
तदा ब्रह्मा तयोर्मध्ये प्रज्वाल्य च हुताशनम् .. 4.15.120 ..
text_mt:
Again the creator, the lord of the worlds, bowed down to her with devotion.
Then Brahmā, having kindled a sacrificial fire between the two of them,

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cakāra vidhinā vidhiḥ..
utthāya śayanātkṛṣṇa uvāsa vahnisannidhau .. 121 ..
meaning:
हरिं संस्मृत्य हवनं चकार विधिना विधिः..
उत्थाय शयनात्कृष्ण उवास वह्निसन्निधौ .. 121 ..
text_mt:
meditated on Hari, and the creator performed the oblation according to the ritual.
Arising from his couch, Kṛṣṇa sat near the fire;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇoktena vidhinā cakāra havanaṃ svayam ..
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ janakaḥ svayam .. 122 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोक्तेन विधिना चकार हवनं स्वयम् ..
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं राधां तां जनकः स्वयम् .. 122 ..
text_mt:
by the rule spoken by Brahmā, he himself performed the oblation.
The Creator himself, having made Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā bow down again,

sanskrit_iast:
kautukaṃ kārayāmāsa saptadhā ca pradakṣiṇām ..
punaḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ rādhāṃ kārayitvā hutāśanam .. 123 ..
meaning:
कौतुकं कारयामास सप्तधा च प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
पुनः प्रदक्षिणां राधां कारयित्वा हुताशनम् .. 123 ..
text_mt:
delightfully had them circumambulate [the fire] seven times.
Having made Rādhā again circumambulate the sacrificial fire,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamayya tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ ..
tasyā hastaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ grāhayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ .. 124..
meaning:
प्रणमय्य ततः कृष्णं वासयामास तं विधिः ..
तस्या हस्तं च श्रीकृष्णं ग्राहयामास तं विधिः .. 124..
text_mt:
and having made Kṛṣṇa bow down, the creator then seated him.
The creator made Śrī Kṛṣṇa take her hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vedoktasaptamantrāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa mādhavam ..
saṃsthāpya rādhikāhastaṃ harervakṣasi vedavit .. 125 ..
meaning:
वेदोक्तसप्तमन्त्रांश्च पाठयामास माधवम् ..
संस्थाप्य राधिकाहस्तं हरेर्वक्षसि वेदवित् .. 125 ..
text_mt:
and made Mādhava recite the seven mantras declared in the Vedas.
Placing Rādhikā's hand upon Hari's chest, the knower of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇahastaṃ rādhāyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe prajāpatiḥ ..
sthāpayāmāsa mantrāṃstrīnpāṭhayāmāsa rādhikām ..126..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णहस्तं राधायाः पृष्ठदेशे प्रजापतिः ..
स्थापयामास मन्त्रांस्त्रीन्पाठयामास राधिकाम् ..126..
text_mt:
Prajāpati, placed Śrī Kṛṣṇa's hand upon the back of Rādhā,
and caused Rādhikā to recite three mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ jānuvilambitām ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya gale brahmā rādhādvārā dadau mudā .. 127 ..
meaning:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालां जानुविलम्बिताम् ..
श्रीकृष्णस्य गले ब्रह्मा राधाद्वारा ददौ मुदा .. 127 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā gladly caused Rādhā to place a garland of pārijāta blossoms
hanging down to the knees around the neck of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ ca kamalodbhavaḥ ..
rādhāgale haridvārā dadau mālāṃ manoharām..
punaśca vāsayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ .. 128 ..
meaning:
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं राधां च कमलोद्भवः ..
राधागले हरिद्वारा ददौ मालां मनोहराम्..
पुनश्च वासयामास श्रीकृष्णं कमलोद्भवः .. 128 ..
text_mt:
Having again made Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā bow down, the Lotus-born
placed the captivating garland around Rādhā's neck through Hari.
And the Lotus-born seated Śrī Kṛṣṇa again,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvāmapārśve rādhāṃ ca sasmitāṃ kṛṣṇacetasam ..
puṭāñjaliṃ kārayitvā mādhavaṃ rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ .. ..129..
meaning:
तद्वामपार्श्वे राधां च सस्मितां कृष्णचेतसम् ..
पुटाञ्जलिं कारयित्वा माधवं राधिकां विधिः .. ..129..
text_mt:
and at his left side Rādhā, smiling, whose mind was set on Kṛṣṇa.
Having made Mādhava and Rādhikā join their palms, the creator

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhayāmāsa vedoktānpañca mantrāṃśca nārada ..
praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarpya rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ .. 4.15.130 ..
meaning:
पाठयामास वेदोक्तान्पञ्च मन्त्रांश्च नारद ..
प्रणमय्य पुनः कृष्णं समर्प्य राधिकां विधिः .. 4.15.130 ..
text_mt:
made them recite five mantras declared in the Vedas, O Nārada.
Having made him bow again, and having given Rādhikā over to Kṛṣṇa, Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyakāṃ ca yathā tāto bhaktyā tasthau hareḥ puraḥ ..
etasminnantare devāḥ sānandapulakodgamāḥ .. 131..
meaning:
कन्यकां च यथा तातो भक्त्या तस्थौ हरेः पुरः ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सानन्दपुलकोद्गमाः .. 131..
text_mt:
just like a father [giving away] his daughter, stood before Hari with devotion.
At that moment, the gods, thrilling with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsuścānakaṃ murajādikam..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha .. 132 ..
meaning:
दुन्दुभिं वादयामासुश्चानकं मुरजादिकम्..
पारिजातप्रसूनानां पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह .. 132 ..
text_mt:
sounded kettledrums, drums, and murajas.
A shower of flowers of pārijāta blossoms indeed fell;

sanskrit_iast:
jagurgandharvapravarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..
tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ brahmā tamuvāca ha sasmitaḥ ..133..
meaning:
जगुर्गन्धर्वप्रवरा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ..
तुष्टाव श्रीहरिं ब्रह्मा तमुवाच ह सस्मितः ..133..
text_mt:
the best of the Gandharvas sang, and hosts of Apsarases danced.
Brahmā praised Śrī Hari, and said to him with a smile:

sanskrit_iast:
yuvayoścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ me dehi dakṣiṇām..
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam ..134..
meaning:
युवयोश्चरणाम्भोजे भक्तिं मे देहि दक्षिणाम्..
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच हरिः स्वयम् ..134..
text_mt:
"Give me devotion to the lotus feet of you both as my priestly fee!"
Hearing Brahmā's words, Hari himself said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
madīyacaraṇāmbhoje sudṛḍhā bhaktirastu te ..
svasthānaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 135 ..
meaning:
मदीयचरणाम्भोजे सुदृढा भक्तिरस्तु ते ..
स्वस्थानं गच्छ भद्रं ते भविता नात्र संशयः .. 135 ..
text_mt:
"May you have very firm devotion to my lotus feet;
go to your own abode; good fortune will be yours, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā niyojitaṃ karma kuru vatsa mamājñayā ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune .. 136 ..
meaning:
मया नियोजितं कर्म कुरु वत्स ममाज्ञया ..
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विधाता जगतां मुने .. 136 ..
text_mt:
Perform the work assigned by me, dear child, according to my command."
Hearing the words of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, O sage, the creator of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā ..
gate brahmaṇi sā devī sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā .. .. 137 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य राधां कृष्णं च जगाम स्वालयं मुदा ..
गते ब्रह्मणि सा देवी सस्मिता वक्रचक्षुषा .. .. 137 ..
text_mt:
bowed down to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa and joyfully departed for his own abode.
When Brahmā had gone, the goddess, smiling, with a sidelong glance,

sanskrit_iast:
sā dadarśa harervaktraṃ cacchāda vrīḍayā mukham ..
pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā .. 138 ..
meaning:
सा ददर्श हरेर्वक्त्रं चच्छाद व्रीडया मुखम् ..
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वांगी कामबाणप्रपीडिता .. 138 ..
text_mt:
looked upon Hari's face, and covered her face with bashfulness.
Her limbs thrilling all over, tormented by the arrows of love,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhaktyā jagāma śayanaṃ hareḥ ..
candanāgurupaṅkaṃ ca kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam..139..
meaning:
प्रणम्य श्रीहरिं भक्त्या जगाम शयनं हरेः ..
चन्दनागुरुपङ्कं च कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम्..139..
text_mt:
having bowed with devotion to Śrī Hari, she went to Hari's couch.
Sandal and aguru paste mixed with musk and saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā dadau kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi ..
sudhāpūrṇaṃ ratnapātraṃ madhupūrṇaṃ manoharam .. 4.15.140 ..
meaning:
ललाटे तिलकं कृत्वा ददौ कृष्णस्य वक्षसि ..
सुधापूर्णं रत्नपात्रं मधुपूर्णं मनोहरम् .. 4.15.140 ..
text_mt:
having made a mark on her forehead, she applied to Kṛṣṇa's chest.
A charming jewel vessel full of nectar and full of honey,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau haraye bhaktyā bubhuje jagatīpatiḥ ..
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam .. 141 ..
meaning:
प्रददौ हरये भक्त्या बुभुजे जगतीपतिः ..
ताम्बूलं च वरं रम्यं कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् .. 141 ..
text_mt: she offered with devotion to Hari, and the Lord of the world enjoyed it.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau kṛṣṇāya sā rādhā sādaraṃ bubhuje hariḥ ..
cakhāda sasmitā rādhā haridattaṃ sudhārasam ..142..
meaning:
ददौ कृष्णाय सा राधा सादरं बुभुजे हरिः ..
चखाद सस्मिता राधा हरिदत्तं सुधारसम् ..142..
text_mt:
Rādhā gave to Kṛṣṇa, and Hari consumed it with respect.
Smiling, Rādhā ate the nectar-like elixir given by Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
tāmbūlaṃ tena dattaṃ ca bubhuje purato hareḥ ..
kṛṣṇaścarvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhikāyai mudā dadau ..143..
meaning:
ताम्बूलं तेन दत्तं च बुभुजे पुरतो हरेः ..
कृष्णश्चर्वितताम्बूलं राधिकायै मुदा ददौ ..143..
text_mt:
and she consumed the betel roll given by him in Hari's presence.
Kṛṣṇa joyfully gave chewed betel to Rādhikā;

sanskrit_iast:
cakhāda parayā bhaktyā papau tanmukhapaṅkajam ..
rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce madhusūdanaḥ ..144..
meaning:
चखाद परया भक्त्या पपौ तन्मुखपङ्कजम् ..
राधाचर्वितताम्बूलं ययाचे मधुसूदनः ..144..
text_mt:
she ate it with supreme devotion, and drank from the lotus of his face.
Madhusūdana begged for the betel chewed by Rādhā;

sanskrit_iast:
jahāsa na dadau rādhā kṣametyuktaṃ tayā mudā..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamuttamam ..
rādhikāyāśca sarvāṃge pradadau mādhavaḥ svayam .. 145 ..
meaning:
जहास न ददौ राधा क्षमेत्युक्तं तया मुदा..
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवमुत्तमम् ..
राधिकायाश्च सर्वांगे प्रददौ माधवः स्वयम् .. 145 ..
text_mt:
Rādhā laughed and did not give it, saying joyfully, "Pardon me!"
The excellent ointment of sandal, aguru, musk, and saffron,
Mādhava himself applied to all of Rādhikā's limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kāmo dhyāyate nityaṃ yasyaikacaraṇāmbujam ..
babhūva tasya sa vaśo rādhāsaṃtoṣakāraṇāt .. 146 ..
meaning:
यः कामो ध्यायते नित्यं यस्यैकचरणाम्बुजम् ..
बभूव तस्य स वशो राधासंतोषकारणात् .. 146 ..
text_mt:
He whom Love ever meditates upon, on whose single lotus foot,
came under Love's sway for the sake of Rādhā's pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhṛtyabhṛtyairmadano jitaḥ sarvakṣaṇaṃ mune ..
svecchāmayo hi bhagavāñjitastena kutūhalāt ..147..
meaning:
यद्भृत्यभृत्यैर्मदनो जितः सर्वक्षणं मुने ..
स्वेच्छामयो हि भगवाञ्जितस्तेन कुतूहलात् ..147..
text_mt:
He by whose servants' servants Love is conquered at every moment, O sage—
the Lord whose will is free was conquered by Love out of playful sport.

sanskrit_iast:
kare dhṛtvā ca tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vakṣasi ..
cakāra śithilaṃ vastraṃ cumbanaṃ ca caturvidham ..148..
meaning:
करे धृत्वा च तां कृष्णः स्थापयामास वक्षसि ..
चकार शिथिलं वस्त्रं चुम्बनं च चतुर्विधम् ..148..
text_mt:
Taking her by the hand, Kṛṣṇa placed her on his chest;
he loosened her garment, and gave the four kinds of kisses.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva ratiyuddhena vicchinnā kṣudraghaṇṭikā ..
cumbanenauṣṭharāgaśca hyāśleṣeṇa ca patrakam ..149..
meaning:
बभूव रतियुद्धेन विच्छिन्ना क्षुद्रघण्टिका ..
चुम्बनेनौष्ठरागश्च ह्याश्लेषेण च पत्रकम् ..149..
text_mt:
Her belt of small bells was broken in the battle of love;
by kissing, the lip-colour was removed, and by embracing, the leaf-patterns [on her breasts];

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṃgāreṇaiva kabarī sindūratilakaṃ mune ..
jagāmālaktakāṅkaśca viparītādikena ca ..4.15.150..
meaning:
शृंगारेणैव कबरी सिन्दूरतिलकं मुने ..
जगामालक्तकाङ्कश्च विपरीतादिकेन च ..4.15.150..
text_mt:
by love-play her braid and her vermilion forehead-mark were undone, O sage;
and the lac-dye marks vanished by reverse intercourse and other acts.

sanskrit_iast:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṃṅgī babhūva navasaṃgamāt ..
mūrcchāmavāpa sā rādhā bubudhe na divāniśam ..151..
meaning:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वांङ्गी बभूव नवसंगमात् ..
मूर्च्छामवाप सा राधा बुबुधे न दिवानिशम् ..151..
text_mt:
Her limbs all thrilling from the new union,
Rādhā fell into a swoon, and was unaware of day or night.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaṅgenaiva pratyaṅgamaṅgenāṅgaṃ samāśliṣat ..
śṛṅgārāṣṭavidhaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra kāmaśāstravit..152..
meaning:
प्रत्यङ्गेनैव प्रत्यङ्गमङ्गेनाङ्गं समाश्लिषत् ..
शृङ्गाराष्टविधं कृष्णश्चकार कामशास्त्रवित्..152..
text_mt:
Limb by limb, body by body, he embraced her;
Kṛṣṇa, skilled in the science of love, performed the eight kinds of amorous sports.

sanskrit_iast:
punastāṃ ca samāśliṣya sasmitāṃ vakralocanām ..
kṣatavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ nakhadantaiścakāra ha ..153..
meaning:
पुनस्तां च समाश्लिष्य सस्मितां वक्रलोचनाम् ..
क्षतविक्षतसर्वाङ्गीं नखदन्तैश्चकार ह ..153..
text_mt:
Embracing her again, smiling and sidelong-eyed,
he covered all her limbs with scratches and marks from his nails and teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṅkaṇānāṃ kiṅkiṇīnāṃ mañjīrāṇāṃ manoharaḥ ..
babhūva śabdastatraiva śṛṅgārasamarodbhavaḥ .. 154 ..
meaning:
कङ्कणानां किङ्किणीनां मञ्जीराणां मनोहरः ..
बभूव शब्दस्तत्रैव शृङ्गारसमरोद्भवः .. 154 ..
text_mt:
Of bracelets, small bells, and anklets a charming
sound arose right there, born of the battle of love-play.

sanskrit_iast:
punastāṃ ca samākṛṣya śayyāyāṃ ca niveśya ca ..
cakāra rahitāṃ rādhāṃ kabarībandhavāsasā .. 155 ..
meaning:
पुनस्तां च समाकृष्य शय्यायां च निवेश्य च ..
चकार रहितां राधां कबरीबन्धवाससा .. 155 ..
text_mt:
Drawing her close again and seating her on the bed,
he made Rādhā stripped of her hair-tie and garments.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjane kautukātkṛṣṇaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
cūḍāveṣāṃśukairhīnaṃ cakāra taṃ ca rādhikā ..156..
meaning:
निर्जने कौतुकात्कृष्णः कामशास्त्रविशारदः ..
चूडावेषांशुकैर्हीनं चकार तं च राधिका ..156..
text_mt:
In secret, playfully, Kṛṣṇa, expert in the science of love [did this];
and Rādhikā rendered him stripped of his diadem, dress, and garments.

sanskrit_iast:
na kasya kasmāddhāniśca tau dvau kāryaviśāradau ..
jagrāha rādhāhastāttu mādhavo ratnadarpaṇam ..157..
meaning:
न कस्य कस्माद्धानिश्च तौ द्वौ कार्यविशारदौ ..
जग्राह राधाहस्तात्तु माधवो रत्नदर्पणम् ..157..
text_mt:
Neither suffered any loss to the other; both were experts in love's duties.
Mādhava snatched the jewelled mirror from Rādhā's hand,

sanskrit_iast:
muralīṃ mādhavakarājjagrāha rādhikā balāt ..
cittāpahāraṃ rādhāyāścakāra mādhavo balāt ..158..
meaning:
मुरलीं माधवकराज्जग्राह राधिका बलात् ..
चित्तापहारं राधायाश्चकार माधवो बलात् ..158..
text_mt:
and Rādhikā by force snatched the flute from Mādhava's hand.
Mādhava forcefully stole Rādhā's heart,

sanskrit_iast:
jahāra rādhikā rāsānmādhavasyāpi mānasam ..
nivṛtte kāmayuddhe ca sasmitā vakralocanā..159..
meaning:
जहार राधिका रासान्माधवस्यापि मानसम् ..
निवृत्ते कामयुद्धे च सस्मिता वक्रलोचना..159..
text_mt:
and Rādhikā also carried away Mādhava's mind from the rāsa-dance.
When the battle of love had ceased, smiling, with sidelong eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau muralīṃ prītyā śrīkṛṣṇāya mahātmane..
pradadau darpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍākamalamujjvalam ..4.15.160..
meaning:
प्रददौ मुरलीं प्रीत्या श्रीकृष्णाय महात्मने..
प्रददौ दर्पणं कृष्णः क्रीडाकमलमुज्ज्वलम् ..4.15.160..
text_mt:
She affectionately gave the flute to the great-souled Śrī Kṛṣṇa;
Kṛṣṇa gave her a mirror and a radiant toy lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra kabarīṃ ramyāṃ sindūratilakaṃ dadau..
vicitrapatrakaṃ veṣaṃ cakāraivaṃvidhaṃ hariḥ.. ..161..
meaning:
चकार कबरीं रम्यां सिन्दूरतिलकं ददौ..
विचित्रपत्रकं वेषं चकारैवंविधं हरिः.. ..161..
text_mt:
Hari arranged her lovely braid and applied a tilaka of red vermilion;
he adorned her with decorative patterns on her skin, and dressed her in such a fashion

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmā na jānāti sakhīnāmapi kā kathā ..
veṣaṃ vidhātuṃ kṛṣṇasya yadā rādhā samudyatā .. 162 ..
meaning:
विश्वकर्मा न जानाति सखीनामपि का कथा ..
वेषं विधातुं कृष्णस्य यदा राधा समुद्यता .. 162 ..
text_mt:
that even Viśvakarman could not comprehend it, let alone her female companions.
When Rādhā was about to dress Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva śiśurūpaṃ ca kaiśoraṃ ca vihāya ca ..
dadarśa bālarūpaṃ taṃ rudantaṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā ..163..
meaning:
बभूव शिशुरूपं च कैशोरं च विहाय च ..
ददर्श बालरूपं तं रुदन्तं पीडितं क्षुधा ..163..
text_mt:
he abandoned his youth and became an infant in form.
She saw him in the form of a child, crying and afflicted with hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśaṃ pradadau nando bhītaṃ tādṛśamacyutam ..
viniśvasya ca sā rādhā hṛdayena vidūyatā ..164..
meaning:
यादृशं प्रददौ नन्दो भीतं तादृशमच्युतम् ..
विनिश्वस्य च सा राधा हृदयेन विदूयता ..164..
text_mt:
frightened, just as Acyuta had been when Nanda handed him over.
Sighing, that Rādhā, with an aching heart,

sanskrit_iast:
itastatastaṃ paśyantī śokārtā virahāturā ..
uvāca kṛṣṇamuddiśya kākūktimiti kātarā .. 165 ..
meaning:
इतस्ततस्तं पश्यन्ती शोकार्ता विरहातुरा ..
उवाच कृष्णमुद्दिश्य काकूक्तिमिति कातरा .. 165 ..
text_mt:
looking at him from this side and that, pained by grief and distressed by separation,
spoke in plaintive words to Kṛṣṇa, full of sorrow:

sanskrit_iast:
māyāṃ karoṣi māyeśa kiṃkarīṃ kathamīdṛśīm ..
ityevamuktvā sā rādhā papāta ca ruroda ca .. ..166..
meaning:
मायां करोषि मायेश किंकरीं कथमीदृशीम् ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा राधा पपात च रुरोद च .. ..166..
text_mt:
“O Lord of illusion, why do you cast such illusion upon your maidservant?”
Having spoken thus, that Rādhā fell down and wept.

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda kṛṣṇastatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
kathaṃ rodiṣi rādhe tvaṃ smara kṛṣṇapadāmbujam..167..
meaning:
रुरोद कृष्णस्तत्रैव वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ..
कथं रोदिषि राधे त्वं स्मर कृष्णपदाम्बुजम्..167..
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa wept right there, and a bodiless voice arose:
“Why do you weep, O Rādhā? Remember Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāsamaṇḍalaṃ yāvannaktamatrāgamiṣyati ..
kariṣyasi ratiṃ nityaṃ hariṇā sārddhamīpsitām ..168..
meaning:
आरासमण्डलं यावन्नक्तमत्रागमिष्यति ..
करिष्यसि रतिं नित्यं हरिणा सार्द्धमीप्सिताम् ..168..
text_mt:
He will come here at night, as far as the circle of the rāsa dance;
you will make the desired love with Hari constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāṃ vidhāya svagṛhe svayamāgatya mā ruda ..
kṛtvā kroḍe ca prāṇeśaṃ māyeśaṃ bālarūpiṇam .. 169 ..
meaning:
छायां विधाय स्वगृहे स्वयमागत्य मा रुद ..
कृत्वा क्रोडे च प्राणेशं मायेशं बालरूपिणम् .. 169 ..
text_mt:
Leaving your shadow at your home, coming yourself, do not weep!
Taking in your lap the Lord of your life, the Lord of illusion who has assumed the form of a child,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaja śokaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha sundarītthaṃ prabodhitā ..
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ rādhā kṛtvā kroḍe ca bālakam .. .. 4.15.170 ..
meaning:
त्यज शोकं गृहं गच्छ सुन्दरीत्थं प्रबोधिता ..
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं राधा कृत्वा क्रोडे च बालकम् .. .. 4.15.170 ..
text_mt:
give up grief and go home!” Thus comforted, O beautiful one,
Rādhā, having heard this speech and taking the child in her lap,

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa puṣpodyānaṃ ca vanaṃ sadratnamaṇḍapam ..
tūrṇaṃ vṛndāvanādrādhā jagāma nandamandiram .. 171 ..
meaning:
ददर्श पुष्पोद्यानं च वनं सद्रत्नमण्डपम् ..
तूर्णं वृन्दावनाद्राधा जगाम नन्दमन्दिरम् .. 171 ..
text_mt:
saw the flower garden, the forest, and the pavilion made of fine gems.
Swiftly Rādhā went from Vṛndāvana to Nanda’s palace.

sanskrit_iast:
sā manoyāyinī devī nimiṣārdhena nārada ..
saṃsiktasnigdhamadhurarasanā raktalocanā .. 172 ..
meaning:
सा मनोयायिनी देवी निमिषार्धेन नारद ..
संसिक्तस्निग्धमधुररसना रक्तलोचना .. 172 ..
text_mt:
That goddess, moving as fast as thought in half a twinkling of an eye, O Nārada,
her charming tongue moist and gentle, her eyes red,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodāyai śiśuṃ dātumudyatā satyuvāca ha ..
gṛhītvaivaṃ śiśuṃ sthūlaṃ rudantaṃ ca kṣudhāturam .. 173 ..
meaning:
यशोदायै शिशुं दातुमुद्यता सत्युवाच ह ..
गृहीत्वैवं शिशुं स्थूलं रुदन्तं च क्षुधातुरम् .. 173 ..
text_mt:
being ready to give the child to Yaśodā, truly said:
“Taking this plump child who is weeping and distressed by hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhe tvatsvāminā dattaṃ prāpnomi yātanāṃ pathi ..
saṃsiktaṃ vasanaṃ vatse meghācchanne'tidurdine .. 174 ..
meaning:
गोष्ठे त्वत्स्वामिना दत्तं प्राप्नोमि यातनां पथि ..
संसिक्तं वसनं वत्से मेघाच्छन्नेऽतिदुर्दिने .. 174 ..
text_mt:
given to me in the cow-pen by your husband, I have suffered agony on the road.
My garment is soaked, O dear child, on this exceedingly miserable day overcast with clouds;

sanskrit_iast:
picchile kardamodreke yaśodā voḍhumakṣamā ..
gṛhāṇa bālakaṃ bhadre stanaṃ dattvā prabodhaya .. 175 ..
meaning:
पिच्छिले कर्दमोद्रेके यशोदा वोढुमक्षमा ..
गृहाण बालकं भद्रे स्तनं दत्त्वा प्रबोधय .. 175 ..
text_mt:
Yaśodā, amid the slippery excess of mud, I am unable to carry him.
Take the boy, O gentle lady! Offer your breast and comfort him.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhaṃ ciraṃ parityaktaṃ yāmi tiṣṭha sukhaṃ sati ..
ityuktvā bālakaṃ dattvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati .. 176 ..
meaning:
गृहं चिरं परित्यक्तं यामि तिष्ठ सुखं सति ..
इत्युक्त्वा बालकं दत्त्वा जगाम स्वगृहं प्रति .. 176 ..
text_mt:
My house has been left behind for a long time; I am going, stay in happiness, O virtuous lady!”
Having spoken thus and handed over the child, she went to her own house.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā cucumba ca stanaṃ dadau ..
bahirniviṣṭā sā rādhā svagṛhe gṛhakarmaṇi .. 177 ..
meaning:
यशोदा बालकं नीत्वा चुचुम्ब च स्तनं ददौ ..
बहिर्निविष्टा सा राधा स्वगृहे गृहकर्मणि .. 177 ..
text_mt:
Yaśodā took the boy, kissed him, and gave him her breast.
That Rādhā, remaining outside in her home, attended to household duties;

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naktaṃ ratiṃ tatra cakāra hariṇā saha ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyamaparaṃ kathayāmi te .. 178 ..
meaning:
नित्यं नक्तं रतिं तत्र चकार हरिणा सह ..
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स श्रीकृष्णचरितं शुभम् ..
सुखदं मोक्षदं पुण्यमपरं कथयामि ते .. 178 ..
text_mt:
every night she made love there with Hari.
Thus has been recounted, O dear one, the auspicious deed of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
which grants happiness and liberation, and is meritorious. I shall relate another to you.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
mādhavo bālakaiḥ sārddhamekadā halinā saha ..
bhuktvā pītvā ca krīḍārthaṃ jagāma śrīvanaṃ mune ..1..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
माधवो बालकैः सार्द्धमेकदा हलिना सह ..
भुक्त्वा पीत्वा च क्रीडार्थं जगाम श्रीवनं मुने ..1..
title: Bakapralambakeśivadhapūrvakavṛndāvanagamanam

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nānāvidhāṃ krīḍāṃ cakāra madhusūdanaḥ ..
kṛtvā tāṃ śiśubhiḥ sārddhaṃ cālayāmāsa godhanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
तत्र नानाविधां क्रीडां चकार मधुसूदनः ..
कृत्वा तां शिशुभिः सार्द्धं चालयामास गोधनम् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yayau madhuvanaṃ tasmācchrīkṛṣṇo godhanaiḥ saha ..
tatra svādu jalaṃ pītvā vane ca sa mahābalaḥ .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
ययौ मधुवनं तस्माच्छ्रीकृष्णो गोधनैः सह ..
तत्र स्वादु जलं पीत्वा वने च स महाबलः .. .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatraikadaityo balavāñchvetavarṇo bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
vikṛtākāravadano bakākāraśca śailavat .. 4 ..
meaning:
तत्रैकदैत्यो बलवाञ्छ्वेतवर्णो भयंकरः ..
विकृताकारवदनो बकाकारश्च शैलवत् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca gokulaṃ goṣṭhe śiśubhirbalakeśavau ..
yathā hyagastyo vātāpiṃ sarvaṃ jagrāsa līlayā .. 5 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च गोकुलं गोष्ठे शिशुभिर्बलकेशवौ ..
यथा ह्यगस्त्यो वातापिं सर्वं जग्रास लीलया .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bakagrastaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devā bhayānvitāḥ ..
cakrurhāheti saṃtrastā dhāvantaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
बकग्रस्तं हरिं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे देवा भयान्विताः ..
चक्रुर्हाहेति संत्रस्ता धावन्तः शस्त्रपाणयः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śakraścikṣepa vajraṃ ca munerasthivinirmitam ..
na mamāra bakastasmātpakṣamekaṃ dadāha ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
शक्रश्चिक्षेप वज्रं च मुनेरस्थिविनिर्मितम् ..
न ममार बकस्तस्मात्पक्षमेकं ददाह च .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nīhārāstraṃ śaśadharaḥ śītārtastena dānavaḥ ..
yamadaṇḍaṃ sūyarputrastena kuṇṭho babhūva ha .. 8 ..
meaning:
नीहारास्त्रं शशधरः शीतार्तस्तेन दानवः ..

text_mt:

Seeing Mādhava going, Keśin, the mighty king of daityas,

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ khureṇa vilikhanmahīm ..

Placing Hari on his head, delighted, [he soared] a hundred yojanas into the sky;

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhagnadanto daityaśca vajrāṅgacarvaṇādaho ..

Ah, with teeth broken from chewing on limbs like thunderbolts, that daitya,

sanskrit_iast:
svarge dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ..

Meanwhile, attendants of divine form

sanskrit_iast:

विनोदमुरलीहस्ताः क्वणन्मञ्जीररञ्जिताः ..

text_mt:

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugraha kātarāḥ ..

ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्या भक्तानुग्रह कातराः ..

Mounted upon a radiant chariot fashioned from the finest gems,

meaning:

Having cast off their bodies and been liberated, three Vaiṣṇava men,

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..

O son of Brahmā, O highly fortunate one, the tale that purifies the worlds

चत्वारो वैष्णवश्रेष्ठास्तेपुस्ते पुष्करे तपः ..

ज्येष्ठो दुर्वाससो योगं संप्राप्य योगिनां वरः..
सिद्धश्चाकृतदारश्च प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 39 ..

The eldest, having attained yoga from Durvāsas, became the best of yogins.
Perfected and unmarried, blazing with the splendour of Brahman,

text_mt:
Seeing Śaṅkara, they all bowed their heads to the ground.

śiva uvāca ..

व्रते त्रैमासिके भक्त्या पतिसौभाग्यवर्द्धने ..
शिवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तमूचुर्वैष्णवा भिया ..
पुटाञ्जलियुताः सर्वे भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धराः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
with devotion in a three-month vow that enhances her husband's good fortune.”
Hearing Śiva's words, the Vaiṣṇavas spoke to him in fear,
all with folded hands, their necks bowed in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ gandharvapravarā gandhavāhasutā vibho .. 47 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वा ऊचुः .. ..
वयं गन्धर्वप्रवरा गन्धवाहसुता विभो .. 47 ..
text_mt: “O omnipresent Lord, we are foremost Gandharvas, sons of the wind-god.

sanskrit_iast:

vayaṃ na vidmo he nātha pārvatyā rakṣitaṃ saraḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
