text_mt:
Having offered lotuses to Hari, O Lord, we drink water.
We did not know, O Lord, that this lake is guarded by Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa kamalaṃ sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca phalaṃ kuru ..
na dāsyāmo'dya kamalaṃ pāsyāmo'dya jalaṃ hara .. 49 ..
meaning:
गृहाण कमलं सर्वं युष्माकं च फलं कुरु ..
न दास्यामोऽद्य कमलं पास्यामोऽद्य जलं हर .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Take all the lotuses and make the fruit yours.
Today we will not offer lotuses, nor drink water today, O Hara;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā kathaṃ na pāsyāmastubhyaṃ dattāni tāni ca ..
nityaṃ dhyātvā yatpadābjaṃ padmena pūjayāmahe .. 4.16.50 ..
meaning:
किं वा कथं न पास्यामस्तुभ्यं दत्तानि तानि च ..
नित्यं ध्यात्वा यत्पदाब्जं पद्मेन पूजयामहे .. 4.16.50 ..
text_mt:
or rather, how can we not drink, since they have been offered to you?
Daily meditating on his lotus feet, we worship him with a lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣāttasmai pradattvā ca padmaṃ pūtā vayaṃ prabho ..
ekaṃ brahma hyadvitīyaṃ kva dehaḥ kva ca rūpavān .. 51 ..
meaning:
साक्षात्तस्मै प्रदत्त्वा च पद्मं पूता वयं प्रभो ..
एकं ब्रह्म ह्यद्वितीयं क्व देहः क्व च रूपवान् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
and having offered the lotus visibly to him, we are purified, O Lord.
Brahman is indeed one, without a second: where is a body, and where is one possessing form?

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānugrahato deho rūpabhedaśca māyayā ..
kiṃ tu gṛhāṇa padmāni tvameva matprabhuḥ prabho .. 52 ..
meaning:
भक्तानुग्रहतो देहो रूपभेदश्च मायया ..
किं तु गृहाण पद्मानि त्वमेव मत्प्रभुः प्रभो .. 52 ..
text_mt:
A body is assumed through grace toward devotees, and variety of forms through Māyā.
Nevertheless, take the lotuses; you alone are our lord, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yato no mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ tadrūpaṃ darśayācyuta ..
dvibhujaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram.. .. 53 ..
meaning:
यतो नो मानसं पूर्णं तद्रूपं दर्शयाच्युत ..
द्विभुजं कमनीयं च किशोरं श्यामसुन्दरम्.. .. 53 ..
text_mt: Show that form, O Acyuta, by which our mind is fulfilled:

sanskrit_iast:
vinodamuralīhastaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ param ..
ekavaktraṃ dvinayanaṃ candanāgurucarcitam .. 54 ..
meaning:
विनोदमुरलीहस्तं पीतांबरधरं परम् ..
एकवक्त्रं द्विनयनं चन्दनागुरुचर्चितम् .. 54 ..
text_mt:
holding the delightful flute in hand, clad in yellow garments, supreme,
with one face, two eyes, anointed with sandalwood and aguru,

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ..
kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam.. 55 ..
meaning:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं रत्नालंकारभूषितम् ..
कौस्तुभेन मणीन्द्रेण वक्षःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलम्.. 55 ..
text_mt: his face bright with a gentle smile, adorned with jewelled ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālārājivibhūṣitam .. 56 ..
meaning:
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च मालतीमाल्यभूषितम् ..
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाराजिविभूषितम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: adorned with rows of garlands of pārijāta blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlādhāmamanoharam ..
gopīsaṃghairdṛśyamānaṃ sasmitairvakralocanaiḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्यलीलाधाममनोहरम् ..
गोपीसंघैर्दृश्यमानं सस्मितैर्वक्रलोचनैः .. 57 ..
text_mt: gazed upon by the hosts of gopīs with smiling, sidelong glances,

sanskrit_iast:
navayauvanasaṃpannaṃ rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam ..
brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānaṃ vandyaṃ dhyeyamabhīpsitam .. 58 ..
meaning:
नवयौवनसंपन्नं राधावक्षस्थलस्थितम् ..
ब्रह्मादिभिः स्तूयमानं वन्द्यं ध्येयमभीप्सितम् .. 58 ..
text_mt:
endowed with fresh youth, resting on Rādhā's breast,
praised by Brahmā and others, worthy of worship, to be meditated upon, desired,

sanskrit_iast:
svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ..
ityuktvā purataḥ śambhostasthurgandharvapuṅgavāḥ .. 59..
meaning:
स्वात्मारामं पूर्णकामं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा पुरतः शम्भोस्तस्थुर्गन्धर्वपुङ्गवाः .. 59..
text_mt:
delighting in his own self, his desires fulfilled, eager to show grace to devotees.”
Having spoken thus before Śambhu, the foremost Gandharvas stood.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇarūpaśravaṇātpulakāṅkitavigrahaḥ ..
gandharvāṇāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śivastānityuvāca ha .. 4.16.60 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णरूपश्रवणात्पुलकाङ्कितविग्रहः ..
गन्धर्वाणां वचः श्रुत्वा शिवस्तानित्युवाच ह .. 4.16.60 ..
text_mt:
His body bristling with horripilation upon hearing the description of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s form,
Śiva, having heard the words of the Gandharvas, said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇarūpaśravaṇātsāśrupūrṇavilocanaḥ ..
mayaiva yūyaṃ vijñātā vaiṣṇavapravarā mahīm ..61..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णरूपश्रवणात्साश्रुपूर्णविलोचनः ..
मयैव यूयं विज्ञाता वैष्णवप्रवरा महीम् ..61..
text_mt:
With eyes filled with tears from hearing the description of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s form:
“I have indeed recognised you as foremost Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūtāṃ kartuṃ ca bhramatha caraṇāmbhojareṇunā ..
ahaṃ vāñchāṃ karomyeva śrīkṛṣṇabhaktadarśane .. 62 ..
meaning:
पूतां कर्तुं च भ्रमथ चरणाम्भोजरेणुना ..
अहं वाञ्छां करोम्येव श्रीकृष्णभक्तदर्शने .. 62 ..
text_mt:
You wander the earth to purify it with the dust of your lotus feet.
I myself truly desire the sight of a devotee of Śrī Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
samāgamo hi sādhūnāṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhaḥ ..
pārvatyāśca surāṇāṃ ca sadā yūyaṃ mama priyāḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
समागमो हि साधूनां त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभः ..
पार्वत्याश्च सुराणां च सदा यूयं मम प्रियाः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
for the company of the virtuous is hard to attain in the three worlds.
You are dear to Pārvatī and to the gods, and always dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaścātmabhaktebhyo vaiṣṇavāśca priyāśca naḥ ..
kintu moghaṃ ca na bhavenmayā yatsvīkṛtaṃ purā .. 64 ..
meaning:
आत्मनश्चात्मभक्तेभ्यो वैष्णवाश्च प्रियाश्च नः ..
किन्तु मोघं च न भवेन्मया यत्स्वीकृतं पुरा .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Vaiṣṇavas are dearer to us than our own self and our own devotees.
However, that which was previously agreed to by me cannot be in vain;

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrūyatāṃ mahābhāgāḥ pārvatīvratakarmaṇi..
sarasaścaiva padmāni yairhṛtāni vratāntare.. 65 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रूयतां महाभागाः पार्वतीव्रतकर्मणि..
सरसश्चैव पद्मानि यैर्हृतानि व्रतान्तरे.. 65 ..
text_mt:
hear that, O fortunate ones, in the matter of Pārvatī’s vow:
By whomsoever the lotuses of the lake are taken during this vow,

sanskrit_iast:
te tūrṇamāsurīṃ yoniṃ gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ..
na hi śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit .. 66 ..
meaning:
ते तूर्णमासुरीं योनिं गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः ..
न हि श्रीकृष्णभक्तानामशुभं विद्यते क्वचित् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
they shall swiftly go to a demonic womb; of this there is no doubt.
Yet misfortune never exists anywhere for devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya mānavīṃ yoniṃ golokaṃ yāsyatha dhruvam ..
yūyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ draṣṭumutsukāḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य मानवीं योनिं गोलोकं यास्यथ ध्रुवम् ..
यूयं श्रीकृष्णरूपं च प्रत्यक्षं द्रष्टुमुत्सुकाः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
having attained a human birth, you will certainly go to Goloka.
You are eager to see the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa before your very eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ drakṣyatha bho vatsā vṛndāraṇye ca bhārate ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tato mṛtyuṃ saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavottamāḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
ध्रुवं द्रक्ष्यथ भो वत्सा वृन्दारण्ये च भारते ..
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं ततो मृत्युं संप्राप्य वैष्णवोत्तमाः .. 68 ..
text_mt:
surely, O children, you will see it in the forest of Vṛndā in Bhārata.”
Having seen Kṛṣṇa, and thereupon meeting death, O best of Vaiṣṇavas,

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ syaṃdanamāruhya gamiṣyatha harergṛham..
adhunā vāñchanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ draṣṭumihotsukāḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
दिव्यं स्यंदनमारुह्य गमिष्यथ हरेर्गृहम्..
अधुना वाञ्छनीयं च रूपं द्रष्टुमिहोत्सुकाः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
you will mount a celestial chariot and go to Hari’s abode.
Now eager to see here that desirable form,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ paśyatetyuktvā darśayāmāsa tacchivaḥ ..
rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāśrunetrāḥ praṇamya sarvarūpiṇam .. 4.16.70 ..
meaning:
तत्सर्वं पश्यतेत्युक्त्वा दर्शयामास तच्छिवः ..
रूपं दृष्ट्वा साश्रुनेत्राः प्रणम्य सर्वरूपिणम् .. 4.16.70 ..
text_mt:
saying, ‘Behold all that!’ Śiva showed it to them.
Having seen that form with tearful eyes, and bowing to the one who embodies all forms,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagmurdānavīṃ yonimiti te dānaveśvarāḥ ..
vasudevaḥ purā muktaḥ suhotraśca bakāsuraḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
आजग्मुर्दानवीं योनिमिति ते दानवेश्वराः ..
वसुदेवः पुरा मुक्तः सुहोत्रश्च बकासुरः .. 71 ..
text_mt:
those lords of Dānavas entered the womb of the Dānavas.
Vasudeva was liberated long ago; and Suhotra [became] Bakāsura,

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanaḥ pralambo'yaṃ svayaṃ keśī supārśvakaḥ ..
harasya varadānena dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam .. 72 ..
meaning:
सुदर्शनः प्रलम्बोऽयं स्वयं केशी सुपार्श्वकः ..
हरस्य वरदानेन दृष्ट्वा रूपमनुत्तमम् .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Sudarśana [became] this Pralamba, and Supārśvaka himself became Keśin.
By Hara’s boon, having seen the incomparable form,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuṃ saṃprāpya śrīkṛṣṇājjagmuste kṛṣṇamandiram ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra hareścaritamadbhutam ..
bakakeśipralambānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ mokṣakārakam .. 73 ..
meaning:
मृत्युं संप्राप्य श्रीकृष्णाज्जग्मुस्ते कृष्णमन्दिरम् ..
इत्येवं कथितं विप्र हरेश्चरितमद्भुतम् ..
बककेशिप्रलम्बानां मोक्षणं मोक्षकारकम् .. 73 ..
text_mt:
and meeting death at the hands of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, they went to Kṛṣṇa’s abode.
Thus has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa, the wondrous deed of Hari,
the liberation of Baka, Keśin, and Pralamba, which brings about liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga tvatprasādādyadadbhutam .. 74 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
श्रुतं सर्वं महाभाग त्वत्प्रसादाद्यदद्भुतम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: All has been heard by your grace, O most fortunate one, whatever is wondrous.

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā śrotumicchāmi pārvatyā kiṃ kṛtaṃ vratam ..
ko vā''rādhyo vratasyāsya kiṃ phalaṃ niyamaśca kaḥ ..72..
meaning:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि पार्वत्या किं कृतं व्रतम् ..
को वा'ऽराध्यो व्रतस्यास्य किं फलं नियमश्च कः ..72..
text_mt:
Now I wish to hear what vow was performed by Pārvatī.
Who is the object of worship for this vow? What is its fruit, and what is its rule?

sanskrit_iast:
kāni dravyāṇi bhagavanvratopayogikani ca ..
katikālaṃ vrataṃ kiṃ vā pratiṣṭhāyāṃ nirūpaṇam .. 76 ..
meaning:
कानि द्रव्याणि भगवन्व्रतोपयोगिकनि च ..
कतिकालं व्रतं किं वा प्रतिष्ठायां निरूपणम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
What materials, O Blessed One, are used for the vow?
How long does the vow last, and what is prescribed for its completion?

sanskrit_iast:
suvicārya vada vibho śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ..
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
vrataṃ traimāsikaṃ nāma patisaubhāgyavardhanam .. 77 ..
meaning:
सुविचार्य वद विभो श्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम ..
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
व्रतं त्रैमासिकं नाम पतिसौभाग्यवर्धनम् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Deliberating well, tell me, O all-pervading lord; I have great curiosity to hear.
The vow named the Three-Month Vow increases good fortune with one’s husband.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhyo bhagavānkṛṣṇo rādhikāsahito mune ..
viṣuve ca samāraṃbhaḥ samāptirdakṣiṇāyane .. 78 ..
meaning:
आराध्यो भगवान्कृष्णो राधिकासहितो मुने ..
विषुवे च समारंभः समाप्तिर्दक्षिणायने .. 78 ..
text_mt:
The object of worship is the Blessed Kṛṣṇa accompanied by Rādhikā, O sage.
Its commencement is at the equinox, and its completion is at the southern solstice.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyamya pūrvadivase kṛtvā'vaśyaṃ haviṣyakam..
snātvā vaiśākhasaṃkrāntyāṃ saṃkalpya jāhnavītaṭe..79..
meaning:
संयम्य पूर्वदिवसे कृत्वाऽवश्यं हविष्यकम्..
स्नात्वा वैशाखसंक्रान्त्यां संकल्प्य जाह्नवीतटे..79..
text_mt:
Practicing self-restraint on the preceding day, one must certainly take sacrificial food.
Bathing at the transit into Vaiśākha, and making a formal resolve on the bank of the Jāhnavī,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭe maṇau śālagrāme jale vā pūjayedvratī..
dhyāyedbhaktyā ca rādheśaṃ saṃpūjya pañca devatāḥ .. 4.16.80 ..
meaning:
घटे मणौ शालग्रामे जले वा पूजयेद्व्रती..
ध्यायेद्भक्त्या च राधेशं संपूज्य पञ्च देवताः .. 4.16.80 ..
text_mt:
the observer of the vow should worship in a jar, in a jewel, in a Śālagrāma, or in water.
Having worshipped the five deities, one should meditate with devotion on Rādhā’s lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ..
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeya vāsasam ..81..
meaning:
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं निबोध कथयामि ते ..
नवीननीरदश्यामं पीतकौशेय वाससम् ..81..
text_mt: Learn the meditation spoken in the Sāmaveda; I shall tell it to you:

sanskrit_iast:
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyamīṣaddhāsyasamanvitam ..
śaratpraphullapadmākṣaṃ mañjulāñchanaraṃjitam ..82..
meaning:
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यमीषद्धास्यसमन्वितम् ..
शरत्प्रफुल्लपद्माक्षं मञ्जुलाञ्छनरंजितम् ..82..
text_mt: with eyes like blooming autumn lotuses, adorned with a charming mark,

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ gopikānāṃ ca mohayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
rādhayā dṛśyamānaṃ ca rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam..83..
meaning:
मानसं गोपिकानां च मोहयन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः ..
राधया दृश्यमानं च राधावक्षःस्थलस्थितम्..83..
text_mt:
enchanting again and again the minds of the cowherd maidens,
gazed upon by Rādhā, resting upon Rādhā’s chest,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmānanteśadharmādyaiḥ stūyamānamahaṃ bhaje ..
dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhyānena tamāvāhya vratī mudā..84..
meaning:
ब्रह्मानन्तेशधर्माद्यैः स्तूयमानमहं भजे ..
ध्यात्वा कृष्णं च ध्यानेन तमावाह्य व्रती मुदा..84..
text_mt:
praised by Brahmā, Ananta, Īśa, Dharma, and the rest—Him I worship.’
Having thus meditated on Kṛṣṇa with this meditation, the vow-keeper joyfully invokes him.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyettadā rādhikāṃ ca dhyānaṃ madhyaṃdineritam ..
rādhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ ramyāṃ rāsollāsarasotsukām .. ..85..
meaning:
ध्यायेत्तदा राधिकां च ध्यानं मध्यंदिनेरितम् ..
राधां रासेश्वरीं रम्यां रासोल्लासरसोत्सुकाम् .. ..85..
text_mt:
One should then meditate on Rādhikā according to the meditation taught in the Mādhyandina [śākhā]:
‘Rādhā, the queen of the rāsa-dance, lovely, eager for the relish of delight in the rāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ rāsādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ..
rāseśvaroraḥsthalasthāṃ rasikāṃ rasikapriyām..86 ..
meaning:
रासमण्डलमध्यस्थां रासाधिष्ठातृदेवताम् ..
रासेश्वरोरःस्थलस्थां रसिकां रसिकप्रियाम्..86 ..
text_mt:
standing in the midst of the rāsa-circle, the presiding deity of the rāsa,
resting upon the chest of the lord of the rāsa, appreciative of love, beloved of the lover of rasa,

sanskrit_iast:
rasikapravarāṃ ramyāṃ ramāṃ ca ramaṇotsukām ..
śaradrājīvarājīnāṃ prabhāmocanalocanām .. 87 ..
meaning:
रसिकप्रवरां रम्यां रमां च रमणोत्सुकाम् ..
शरद्राजीवराजीनां प्रभामोचनलोचनाम् .. 87 ..
text_mt:
foremost among lovers of rasa, lovely, Ramā, eager for amorous delight,
whose eyes rob the splendour of rows of autumn lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
vakrabhrūbhaṅgasaṃyuktāṃ mañjīreṇaiva rañjitām ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāmīṣaddhāsyamanoharām .. 88 ..
meaning:
वक्रभ्रूभङ्गसंयुक्तां मञ्जीरेणैव रञ्जिताम् ..
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यामीषद्धास्यमनोहराम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
endowed with curved play of eyebrows, adorned with anklets,
with a face like the autumn full moon, captivating with a gentle smile,

sanskrit_iast:
cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ candanena vibhūṣitām ..
kastūrībindunā sārdhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdunā yutām ..89..
meaning:
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभां चन्दनेन विभूषिताम् ..
कस्तूरीबिन्दुना सार्धं सिंदूरबिंदुना युताम् ..89..
text_mt:
with the splendid hue of a charming campaka flower, adorned with sandalwood paste,
endowed with a dot of musk together with a dot of red vermilion,

sanskrit_iast:
cārupatrāvalīyuktāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukojjvalām ..
sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca sukapolasthalojjvalām .. 4.16.90 ..
meaning:
चारुपत्रावलीयुक्तां वह्निशुद्धांशुकोज्ज्वलाम् ..
सद्रत्नकुण्डलाभ्यां च सुकपोलस्थलोज्ज्वलाम् .. 4.16.90 ..
text_mt: adorned with delicate leaf-patterns, radiant in garments purified by fire,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalavirājitām ..
ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūrakiṅkiṇīratnarañjitām ..91..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारहारेण वक्षःस्थलविराजिताम् ..
रत्नकङ्कणकेयूरकिङ्किणीरत्नरञ्जिताम् ..91..
text_mt:
her chest adorned with a necklace of finest quintessential jewels,
adorned with jewelled bracelets, armlets, and bells of precious gems,

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitām ..
brahmādibhiśca sevyena śrīkṛṣṇenaiva sevitām .. 92 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नसाररचितक्वणन्मञ्जीररञ्जिताम् ..
ब्रह्मादिभिश्च सेव्येन श्रीकृष्णेनैव सेविताम् .. 92 ..
text_mt: served by Śrī Kṛṣṇa himself, who is served by Brahmā and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśena stūyamānāṃ sarvabījāṃ bhajāmyaham ..
iti dhyātvā ca kṛṣṇena sahitāṃ tāṃ ca pūjayet .. 93 ..
meaning:
सर्वेशेन स्तूयमानां सर्वबीजां भजाम्यहम् ..
इति ध्यात्वा च कृष्णेन सहितां तां च पूजयेत् .. 93 ..
text_mt:
praised by the Lord of all, the seed of all—Her I worship.’
Having thus meditated, one should worship her together with Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā dattvā pratidinamupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ..
pratyekaṃ ca pṛthakkṛtvā sarvaṃ dadyādvratī mudā .. 94 ..
meaning:
भक्त्या दत्त्वा प्रतिदिनमुपचारांश्च षोडश ..
प्रत्येकं च पृथक्कृत्वा सर्वं दद्याद्व्रती मुदा .. 94 ..
text_mt:
offering with devotion every day the sixteen services.
Arranging each one separately, the vow-keeper should joyfully offer everything:

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakamalaṃ divyaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mune ..
homaṃ kuryādvratī nityamaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
सहस्रकमलं दिव्यं शतमष्टोत्तरं मुने ..
होमं कुर्याद्व्रती नित्यमष्टोत्तरशताहुतीः .. 95 ..
text_mt: one thousand and one hundred and eight celestial lotuses, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādbhaktyā ca kṛṣṇāya svāhetyuccārya yatnataḥ ..
rasālasya kadalyāśca hyāmaṃ vā pakvameva ca .. 96 ..
meaning:
दद्याद्भक्त्या च कृष्णाय स्वाहेत्युच्चार्य यत्नतः ..
रसालस्य कदल्याश्च ह्यामं वा पक्वमेव च .. 96 ..
text_mt:
and carefully offer them with devotion to Kṛṣṇa, uttering ‘Svāhā’.
Of mango and plantain, whether raw or ripe,

sanskrit_iast:
nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ dadyādbhaktyā'kṣataiḥ phalam ..
nityaṃ ca bhojayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ mune .. 97 ..
meaning:
नित्यमष्टोत्तरशतं दद्याद्भक्त्याऽक्षतैः फलम् ..
नित्यं च भोजयेद्भक्त्या ब्राह्मणानां शतं मुने .. 97 ..
text_mt:
one should offer daily with devotion one hundred and eight fruits along with unbroken grains.
And every day, O sage, one should feed a hundred Brahmins with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ kuryādvratī nityamaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ ..
dadyādbhaktyā ca kṛṣṇāya rādhikāsahitāya ca .. 98 ..
meaning:
होमं कुर्याद्व्रती नित्यमष्टोत्तरशताहुतीः ..
दद्याद्भक्त्या च कृष्णाय राधिकासहिताय च .. 98 ..
text_mt: and one should give with devotion to Kṛṣṇa accompanied by Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tilena havanaṃ kuryādājyamiśreṇa nārada ..
vādyaṃ ca vādayennityaṃ kārayeddharikīrtanam .. 99 ..
meaning:
तिलेन हवनं कुर्यादाज्यमिश्रेण नारद ..
वाद्यं च वादयेन्नित्यं कारयेद्धरिकीर्तनम् .. 99 ..
text_mt:
One should make the fire offering with sesame mixed with clarified butter, O Nārada;
and one should daily cause musical instruments to be played and singing of Hari's praises to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ māsatrayaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tadanantaram ..
pratiṣṭhādivase tatra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu nārada.. .. 4.16.100 ..
meaning:
एवं मासत्रयं कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठां तदनन्तरम् ..
प्रतिष्ठादिवसे तत्र विधानं शृणु नारद.. .. 4.16.100 ..
text_mt:
Having done this for three months, the concluding rite [is performed] immediately thereafter.
Hear the prescription for that day of the concluding rite, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
kamalānāṃ ca navatisahasrāṇyakṣatāni ca ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava viprendra yatnataḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
कमलानां च नवतिसहस्राण्यक्षतानि च ..
ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि नव विप्रेन्द्र यत्नतः .. 101 ..
text_mt:
Ninety thousand unblemished lotuses;
nine thousand Brahmins, O best of Brahmins, carefully

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayetparamānnāni svādūni miṣṭakāni ca ..
phalaṃ viṃśādhikaṃ saptaśataṃ navasahasrakam .. 102 ..
meaning:
भोजयेत्परमान्नानि स्वादूनि मिष्टकानि च ..
फलं विंशाधिकं सप्तशतं नवसहस्रकम् .. 102 ..
text_mt:
one should feed with delicious sweetmeats and rice pudding.
Nine thousand seven hundred and twenty fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
dadyānnānāvidhaṃ dravyaṃ naivedyaṃ sumanoharam ..
saṃskṛtāgniṃ ca saṃsthāpya homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
दद्यान्नानाविधं द्रव्यं नैवेद्यं सुमनोहरम् ..
संस्कृताग्निं च संस्थाप्य होमं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः .. 103 ..
text_mt:
one should offer various kinds of articles and very charming food offerings.
Having established the consecrated fire, the wise person should perform the fire offering,

sanskrit_iast:
navatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi hutvā''jyena tilena ca ..
savastraṃ ca sabhojyaṃ ca yajñasūtraphalānvitam .. 104 ..
meaning:
नवतिं च सहस्राणि हुत्वा'ऽज्येन तिलेन च ..
सवस्त्रं च सभोज्यं च यज्ञसूत्रफलान्वितम् .. 104 ..
text_mt:
having offered ninety thousand oblations of clarified butter and sesame.
With cloth and food, accompanied by sacrificial cords and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpārcitānbhaktyā dadyānnavatilaḍḍukān ..
dadyānnavatikumbhāṃśca śītatoyaprapūritān .. 109 ..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पार्चितान्भक्त्या दद्यान्नवतिलड्डुकान् ..
दद्यान्नवतिकुम्भांश्च शीततोयप्रपूरितान् .. 109 ..
text_mt:
worshipped with perfume and flowers, one should give ninety laddu sweets with devotion.
One should give ninety water-pots filled with cool water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ..
dakṣiṇāyāḥ parimitaṃ vedeṣu yannirūpitam .. 106..
meaning:
एवंविधं व्रतं कृत्वा दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ..
दक्षिणायाः परिमितं वेदेषु यन्निरूपितम् .. 106..
text_mt:
Having performed such a vow, one should give a sacrificial fee to the Brahmin.
The amount of the sacrificial fee that is prescribed in the Vedas

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣendrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca svarṇaśṛṅgasamanvitam ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra kṛtaṃ traimāsikavratam .. 107 ..
meaning:
वृषेन्द्राणां सहस्रं च स्वर्णशृङ्गसमन्वितम् ..
इत्येवं कथितं विप्र कृतं त्रैमासिकव्रतम् .. 107 ..
text_mt:
[is] a thousand excellent bulls adorned with golden horns.
Thus has been explained, O Brahmin, the three-month vow performed.

sanskrit_iast:
viśiṣṭasaṃtatikaraṃ patisaubhāgyavarddhanam ..
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa saubhāgyaṃ śatajanmani .. 108 ..
meaning:
विशिष्टसंततिकरं पतिसौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् ..
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण सौभाग्यं शतजन्मनि .. 108 ..
text_mt:
It produces distinguished offspring and increases the husband's good fortune.
By the power of this vow, good fortune [is gained] for a hundred births;

sanskrit_iast:
satputrajananī sā ca bhavejjanmaśataṃ dhruvam ..
kadā'pi na bhavettasyā bhedaśca patiputrayoḥ .. 109 ..
meaning:
सत्पुत्रजननी सा च भवेज्जन्मशतं ध्रुवम् ..
कदाऽपि न भवेत्तस्या भेदश्च पतिपुत्रयोः .. 109 ..
text_mt:
and she will certainly become a mother of virtuous sons for a hundred births.
Never will there be for her any estrangement from husband and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsatulyo bhavetputro bhartā ca svavacaskaraḥ ..
anukṣaṇaṃ bhavedrādhākṛṣṇabhaktiyutā satī .. 4.16.110 ..
meaning:
दासतुल्यो भवेत्पुत्रो भर्ता च स्ववचस्करः ..
अनुक्षणं भवेद्राधाकृष्णभक्तियुता सती .. 4.16.110 ..
text_mt:
Her son will be like a servant, and her husband obedient to her word.
Every moment the faithful wife will be endowed with devotion to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedvrataprabhāveṇa prāptajñānaharissmṛtiḥ ..
vrataṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvamathāvayoḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
भवेद्व्रतप्रभावेण प्राप्तज्ञानहरिस्स्मृतिः ..
व्रतं च सामवेदोक्तं कृतं पूर्वमथावयोः .. 111 ..
text_mt:
by the power of the vow, having attained knowledge, she will have remembrance of Hari.
And this vow, declared in the Sāmaveda, was formerly performed by the two of us.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ śṛṇu vadāmi te ..
svāyaṃbhuvasya ca manoḥ śatarūpābhidhā satī .. 112 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषां च व्रतानां च श्रेष्ठं शृणु वदामि ते ..
स्वायंभुवस्य च मनोः शतरूपाभिधा सती .. 112 ..
text_mt:
Hear now, I shall tell you of the greatest of all vows.
The faithful wife of Svāyambhuva Manu, named Śatarūpā—

sanskrit_iast:
tayā kṛtaṃ prathamataḥ kṛtvā'gastyaṃ purohitam ..
tadā kṛtaṃ devahūtyā cākūtyā ca kṛtaṃ tadā .. 113 ..
meaning:
तया कृतं प्रथमतः कृत्वाऽगस्त्यं पुरोहितम् ..
तदा कृतं देवहूत्या चाकूत्या च कृतं तदा .. 113 ..
text_mt:
by her it was first performed, making Agastya her family priest.
Then it was performed by Devahūti, and then it was performed by Ākūti,

sanskrit_iast:
purohitaṃ pulastyaṃ ca kṛtvā śrutyuktyā mune ..
cakāra rohiṇī tattu kratuṃ kṛtvā purohitam .. 114 ..
meaning:
पुरोहितं पुलस्त्यं च कृत्वा श्रुत्युक्त्या मुने ..
चकार रोहिणी तत्तु क्रतुं कृत्वा पुरोहितम् .. 114 ..
text_mt:
making Pulastya the family priest according to the Vedic injunction, O sage.
Rohiṇī indeed performed it, making Kratu her family priest.

sanskrit_iast:
ratiścakāra tadbhaktyā gautamastatpurohitaḥ ..
akāri tadvrataṃ bhaktyā tārayā gurukāntayā .. 115 ..
meaning:
रतिश्चकार तद्भक्त्या गौतमस्तत्पुरोहितः ..
अकारि तद्व्रतं भक्त्या तारया गुरुकान्तया .. 115 ..
text_mt:
Rati performed it with devotion; Gautama was her family priest.
That vow was performed with devotion by Tārā, the guru's wife,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhārā vasiṣṭhastatpurohitaḥ ..
taddṛṣṭvā gurupatnyāśca śakraśacyā kṛtaṃ vratam .. 116 ..
meaning:
महासंभृतसंभारा वसिष्ठस्तत्पुरोहितः ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा गुरुपत्न्याश्च शक्रशच्या कृतं व्रतम् .. 116 ..
text_mt:
having gathered great provisions; Vasiṣṭha was her family priest.
Seeing that of the guru's wife, the vow was performed by Śakra's [consort] Śacī;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsambhṛtasambhārastatpurodhā bṛhaspatiḥ ..
vrataṃ cakāra svāhā ca sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇam ..117..
meaning:
महासम्भृतसम्भारस्तत्पुरोधा बृहस्पतिः ..
व्रतं चकार स्वाहा च सर्वतोऽपि विलक्षणम् ..117..
text_mt:
she had gathered great provisions; her family priest was Bṛhaspati.
And Svāhā performed the vow, extraordinary in every way;

sanskrit_iast:
atisaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro marīcistatpurohitaḥ ..
taddṛṣṭvā pārvatī brahmannuvāca śaṃkaraṃ mudā ..
puṭāñjaliyutā devī bhaktinamrātmakandharā ..118..
meaning:
अतिसंभृतसंभारो मरीचिस्तत्पुरोहितः ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा पार्वती ब्रह्मन्नुवाच शंकरं मुदा ..
पुटाञ्जलियुता देवी भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरा ..118..
text_mt:
she had gathered immense provisions; Marīci was her family priest.
Seeing that, O Brahmin, Pārvatī gladly spoke to Śaṅkara,
the goddess with joined palms, her neck bowed low in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca ..
ājñāṃ kuru jagannātha karomi vratamuttamam .. 119 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच ..
आज्ञां कुरु जगन्नाथ करोमि व्रतमुत्तमम् .. 119 ..
text_mt: Give the command, O Lord of the Universe, that I may perform the supreme vow,

sanskrit_iast:
āvayoriṣṭadevasya vratānāṃ ca paraṃ vratam ..
harerārādhanaṃ nātha sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam .. 4.16.120 ..
meaning:
आवयोरिष्टदेवस्य व्रतानां च परं व्रतम् ..
हरेराराधनं नाथ सर्वमंगलकारणम् .. 4.16.120 ..
text_mt:
the highest vow among vows, for the chosen deity of us both,
the worship of Hari, O lord, which is the cause of all auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ śruteḥ pāṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthvyāḥ pradakṣiṇam ..
harerārādhanasyāpi kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 121 ..
meaning:
इष्टं दत्तं श्रुतेः पाठं तीर्थं पृथ्व्याः प्रदक्षिणम् ..
हरेराराधनस्यापि कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 121 ..
text_mt:
Sacrifices, charitable gifts, recitation of the Veda, pilgrimage, circumambulation of the earth—
they are not worth even a sixteenth part of the worship of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
bahirabhyaṃtare yasya harismṛtiranukṣaṇam ..
jīvanmuktasya tasyaiva muktirbhavati darśanāt .. .. 122 ..
meaning:
बहिरभ्यंतरे यस्य हरिस्मृतिरनुक्षणम् ..
जीवन्मुक्तस्य तस्यैव मुक्तिर्भवति दर्शनात् .. .. 122 ..
text_mt:
For whoever has remembrance of Hari every moment, inwardly and outwardly,
that person is liberated while living, and liberation comes just from seeing him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pādābjarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ..
tasya darśanamātreṇa punāti bhuvanatrayam .. 123 ..
meaning:
तस्य पादाब्जरजसा सद्यः पूता वसुन्धरा ..
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण पुनाति भुवनत्रयम् .. 123 ..
text_mt:
By the dust of his lotus feet the earth is instantly purified;
merely by the sight of him he purifies the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇuśca dharmaśca śeṣastvaṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ yatpadābjaṃ tejasā tatsamo mahān .. 124 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च धर्मश्च शेषस्त्वं च गणेश्वरः ..
ध्यायंध्यायं यत्पदाब्जं तेजसा तत्समो महान् .. 124 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Dharma, Śeṣa, you, and Gaṇeśvara,
constantly meditating upon whose lotus feet, became great, equal to him in splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca yaṃ santataṃ dhyāyetsa tamāpnoti niścitam ..
guṇena tejasā buddhyā jñānena tatsamo bhavet .. 125 ..
meaning:
यश्च यं सन्ततं ध्यायेत्स तमाप्नोति निश्चितम् ..
गुणेन तेजसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन तत्समो भवेत् .. 125 ..
text_mt:
And whatever one meditates upon continually, that he surely attains;
in quality, in splendour, in intellect, and in knowledge he becomes equal to that.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya smaraṇāddhyānāttapasā tasya sevayā ..
mayā prāpto hi bhagavānsvāmī vā putra eva ca ..126..
meaning:
कृष्णस्य स्मरणाद्ध्यानात्तपसा तस्य सेवया ..
मया प्राप्तो हि भगवान्स्वामी वा पुत्र एव च ..126..
text_mt:
By remembering Kṛṣṇa, by meditating [on him], by austerity, and by serving him,
the Lord was indeed attained by me as a husband and as a son.

sanskrit_iast:
pralabdhaṃ līlayā sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ manmānasaṃ tadā ..
svāmī me tvādṛśaḥ putrau kārttikeyagaṇeśvarau ..127..
meaning:
प्रलब्धं लीलया सर्वं पूर्णं मन्मानसं तदा ..
स्वामी मे त्वादृशः पुत्रौ कार्त्तिकेयगणेश्वरौ ..127..
text_mt:
Everything has been attained easily, and my heart's desire was fulfilled then:
A husband like you, my two sons Kārttikeya and Gaṇeśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
pitā himādriḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo mama kiṃ durlabhaṃ prabho ..
pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā suprītaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam ..
prahasyovāca madhuraṃ pulakāṃkitavigrahaḥ..128.. ..
meaning:
पिता हिमाद्रिः कृष्णांशो मम किं दुर्लभं प्रभो ..
पार्वतीवचनं श्रुत्वा सुप्रीतः शंकरः स्वयम् ..
प्रहस्योवाच मधुरं पुलकांकितविग्रहः..128.. ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
mahālakṣmīsvarūpāsi kimasādhyaṃ taveśvari .. 129 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
महालक्ष्मीस्वरूपासि किमसाध्यं तवेश्वरि .. 129 ..
text_mt: "You are the embodiment of Mahālakṣmī; what is unattainable for you, O Goddess?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasampatsvarūpā tvamanantaśakti rūpiṇī ..
tvaṃ ca yasya gṛhe devi sa caiśvaryasya bhājanam ..4.16.130..
meaning:
सर्वसम्पत्स्वरूपा त्वमनन्तशक्ति रूपिणी ..
त्वं च यस्य गृहे देवि स चैश्वर्यस्य भाजनम् ..4.16.130..
text_mt:
You are the embodiment of all wealth, possessing infinite power.
In whose house you dwell, O Goddess, he becomes a vessel of supreme majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
na lakṣmīryadgṛhe tasya jīvanānmaraṇaṃ varam ..
ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tvayi bhaktyā śubhaprade .. 131 ..
meaning:
न लक्ष्मीर्यद्गृहे तस्य जीवनान्मरणं वरम् ..
अहं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च त्वयि भक्त्या शुभप्रदे .. 131 ..
text_mt:
In whose house Lakṣmī does not dwell, death is better for him than life.
I, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu have devotion to you, O bestower of auspiciousness!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhāre sṛṣṭikāle ca tvatprasādādvayaṃ kṣamāḥ ..
ko vā himālayaḥ ko'haṃ kau kārttikagaṇeśvarau .. ..132..
meaning:
संहारे सृष्टिकाले च त्वत्प्रसादाद्वयं क्षमाः ..
को वा हिमालयः कोऽहं कौ कार्त्तिकगणेश्वरौ .. ..132..
text_mt:
At the time of destruction and creation, we are capable only through your grace.
Who is Himālaya? Who am I? Who are Kārttika and Gaṇeśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvihīnā aśaktāśca tvayā ca vayamīśvarāḥ ..
yuktāḥ pativratāyāśca yāḥ purājñāḥ śrutau śrutāḥ ..133..
meaning:
त्वद्विहीना अशक्ताश्च त्वया च वयमीश्वराः ..
युक्ताः पतिव्रतायाश्च याः पुराज्ञाः श्रुतौ श्रुताः ..133..
text_mt:
Bereft of you, we are powerless; and through you, we are sovereign lords.
The proper commands for a devoted wife that were heard of old in the Veda—

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā''jñāmīśvarasya vrataṃ kuru pativrate ..
vratametatkṛtaṃ yābhistābhyaḥ kuru vilakṣaṇam .. 134 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा'ऽज्ञामीश्वरस्य व्रतं कुरु पतिव्रते ..
व्रतमेतत्कृतं याभिस्ताभ्यः कुरु विलक्षणम् .. 134 ..
text_mt:
Receiving the permission of your lord, perform the vow, O devoted wife!
Perform it distinguished beyond the women by whom this vow was [previously] done.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavānvrate te'stu purohitaḥ ..
kamalānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dāyako'pyaham.. 135 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्व्रते तेऽस्तु पुरोहितः ..
कमलानां ब्राह्मणानां द्रव्याणां दायकोऽप्यहम्.. 135 ..
text_mt:
Let the venerable Sanatkumāra be the priest for your vow;
And I will provide the lotuses, the brāhmaṇas, and the ritual materials.

sanskrit_iast:
kuberaṃ dravyakośe ca rakṣakaṃ kuru sundari ..
vrate ca dānādhyakṣo'haṃ dhanadātrī ca śrīḥ svayam .. 136 ..
meaning:
कुबेरं द्रव्यकोशे च रक्षकं कुरु सुन्दरि ..
व्रते च दानाध्यक्षोऽहं धनदात्री च श्रीः स्वयम् .. 136 ..
text_mt:
Make Kubera the guardian of the treasury of articles, O fair one;
I will oversee the giving in the vow, and Śrī herself will bestow wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhako vahnidevaśca varuṇo jaladāyakaḥ ..
vastūnāṃ vāhakā yakṣāstadadhyakṣaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ .. 137 ..
meaning:
पाठको वह्निदेवश्च वरुणो जलदायकः ..
वस्तूनां वाहका यक्षास्तदध्यक्षः षडाननः .. 137 ..
text_mt:
The fire-god will be the reciter, and Varuṇa will provide water;
The yakṣas will be the carriers of provisions, and the six-faced one their overseer.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānasaṃskāra kartā ca vrate'tra pavanaḥ svayam ..
pariveṣṭā svayaṃ śakraścandro'dhiṣṭhāpako vrate .. 138 ..
meaning:
स्थानसंस्कार कर्ता च व्रतेऽत्र पवनः स्वयम् ..
परिवेष्टा स्वयं शक्रश्चन्द्रोऽधिष्ठापको व्रते .. 138 ..
text_mt:
Pavana himself will purify the place during this vow;
Śakra himself will be the server, and Candra the director of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaśca dānanirvaktā yogyāyogyaṃ yathocitam ..
vratopayuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ dattvā niyamitaṃ priye .. 139 ..
meaning:
सूर्यश्च दाननिर्वक्ता योग्यायोग्यं यथोचितम् ..
व्रतोपयुक्तं यद्द्रव्यं दत्त्वा नियमितं प्रिये .. 139 ..
text_mt:
Sūrya will determine the donations according to fitness and unfitness, as is proper.
Offering the prescribed substances suitable for the vow, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
tato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ haraye dehi sundari ..
vrate niyamitānviprānbhojayitvā tato'dhikām.. 4.16.140 ..
meaning:
ततोऽधिकं फलं पुष्पं हरये देहि सुन्दरि ..
व्रते नियमितान्विप्रान्भोजयित्वा ततोऽधिकाम्.. 4.16.140 ..
text_mt:
Give even more fruit and flowers to Hari, O beautiful one!
Having fed the brāhmaṇas prescribed for the vow, and far more than that,

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyānbrāhmaṇāndevi bhaktyā kuru nimantraṇam ..
samāptidivase svarṇaṃ ratnaṃ muktāṃ pravālakam..141..
meaning:
असंख्यान्ब्राह्मणान्देवि भक्त्या कुरु निमन्त्रणम् ..
समाप्तिदिवसे स्वर्णं रत्नं मुक्तां प्रवालकम्..141..
text_mt:
Invite innumerable brāhmaṇas with devotion, O Goddess!
On the day of completion, gold, jewels, pearls, and coral—

sanskrit_iast:
vratoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā sarvaṃ dehi dvijātaye ..
ityuktvā śaṃkarastāṃ ca kārayāmāsa tadvratam .. 142 ..
meaning:
व्रतोक्तां दक्षिणां दत्त्वा सर्वं देहि द्विजातये ..
इत्युक्त्वा शंकरस्तां च कारयामास तद्व्रतम् .. 142 ..
text_mt:
Having given the fee prescribed for the vow, bestow everything upon the twice-born."
Having spoken thus, Śaṅkara had her perform that vow;

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ cakāra sā durgā sarvābhyaśca vilakṣaṇam ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra pārvatyā yadvrataṃ kṛtam .. 143 ..
meaning:
व्रतं चकार सा दुर्गा सर्वाभ्यश्च विलक्षणम् ..
इत्येवं कथितं विप्र पार्वत्या यद्व्रतं कृतम् .. 143 ..
text_mt:
Durgā performed the vow distinguished beyond all others.
Thus has been related, O brāhmaṇa, the vow that was performed by Pārvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnaṃ voḍhumaśaktāśca brāhmaṇāḥ pārvatīvrate ..
itihāsaḥ śrutaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu nārada .. 144 ..
meaning:
रत्नं वोढुमशक्ताश्च ब्राह्मणाः पार्वतीव्रते ..
इतिहासः श्रुतः सर्वः प्रकृतं शृणु नारद .. 144 ..
text_mt:
Where the brāhmaṇas were unable [even] to carry the jewels in Pārvatī's vow.
All this traditional history has been heard; now hear the principal narrative, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇabālacaritaṃ nūtnaṃ nūtnaṃ pade pade ..
hatvā tāndānavendrāṃśca śiśubhiḥ saha gokule ..145..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णबालचरितं नूत्नं नूत्नं पदे पदे ..
हत्वा तान्दानवेन्द्रांश्च शिशुभिः सह गोकुले ..145..
text_mt:
The childhood deeds of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, ever new at every step.
Having slain those lordly demons, along with the children in Gokula,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma svagṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kuberabhavanopamam ..
sarvebhyo vanavārtā ca proktā ca śiśubhirmudā .. 146 ..
meaning:
जगाम स्वगृहं कृष्णः कुबेरभवनोपमम् ..
सर्वेभ्यो वनवार्ता च प्रोक्ता च शिशुभिर्मुदा .. 146 ..
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa went to his own home, which resembled the abode of Kubera.
With delight the children related to everyone the news of the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaivaṃ vismitāḥ sarve nando bhayamavāpa ha ..
ānīya vṛddhāngopāṃśca gopikāḥ sthavirāstathā .. 147 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वैवं विस्मिताः सर्वे नन्दो भयमवाप ह ..
आनीय वृद्धान्गोपांश्च गोपिकाः स्थविरास्तथा .. 147 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this, all were astonished, and Nanda truly became afraid.
Gathering the elderly cowherds and the aged cowherd-women,

sanskrit_iast:
yuktiṃ cakāra taiḥ sārddhamālocya samayocitām ..
kṛtvā yuktiṃ ca gopeśastatsthānaṃ tyaktumudyataḥ..148..
meaning:
युक्तिं चकार तैः सार्द्धमालोच्य समयोचिताम् ..
कृत्वा युक्तिं च गोपेशस्तत्स्थानं त्यक्तुमुद्यतः..148..
text_mt:
He deliberated with them, devising a plan suited to the occasion.
Having made a plan, the lord of cowherds prepared to leave that place.

sanskrit_iast:
gantuṃ vṛndāvanaṃ sarvānuvāca tatkṣaṇaṃ mune..
nandājñāṃ ca samākarṇya te sarve gantumudyatāḥ..149..
meaning:
गन्तुं वृन्दावनं सर्वानुवाच तत्क्षणं मुने..
नन्दाज्ञां च समाकर्ण्य ते सर्वे गन्तुमुद्यताः..149..
text_mt:
He told all to go to Vṛndāvana at once, O sage.
Hearing Nanda's command, they all prepared to depart—

sanskrit_iast:
gopāśca gopikāścaiva bālakā bālikāstathā ..
kṛṣṇena halinā sārdhaṃ prayayurbālakā mudā .. 4.16.150 ..
meaning:
गोपाश्च गोपिकाश्चैव बालका बालिकास्तथा ..
कृष्णेन हलिना सार्धं प्रययुर्बालका मुदा .. 4.16.150 ..
text_mt:
The cowherds, the cowherd-women, the boys, and the girls.
Together with Kṛṣṇa and the plough-wielder, the boys set forth joyfully,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgītaṃ ca pragāyanto nānāveṣa samanvitāḥ ..
veṇupravādakāḥ kecitkecicchṛṅgapravādakāḥ .. 151 ..
meaning:
संगीतं च प्रगायन्तो नानावेष समन्विताः ..
वेणुप्रवादकाः केचित्केचिच्छृङ्गप्रवादकाः .. 151 ..
text_mt:
Singing songs and adorned with diverse attire.
Some blew flutes, and some blew horn-trumpets;

sanskrit_iast:
karatālakarāḥ kecidvīṇāhastāśca kecana..
śarayantrakarāḥ kecicchṛṅgahastāśca kecana .. 152 ..
meaning:
करतालकराः केचिद्वीणाहस्ताश्च केचन..
शरयन्त्रकराः केचिच्छृङ्गहस्ताश्च केचन .. 152 ..
text_mt:
Some held cymbals in hand, and others held vīṇās in their hands;
Some held stringed instruments, and others held horns in their hands.

sanskrit_iast:
navapallavakarṇāśca kecidgopālabālakāḥ ..
kecinmukulakarṇāśca puṣpakarṇāśca kecana .. 153 ..
meaning:
नवपल्लवकर्णाश्च केचिद्गोपालबालकाः ..
केचिन्मुकुलकर्णाश्च पुष्पकर्णाश्च केचन .. 153 ..
text_mt:
Some cowherd boys had fresh sprouts in their ears;
Some had buds in their ears, and others had flowers in their ears;

sanskrit_iast:
navamālyakarāḥ kecitkecidājānumālinaḥ ..
kecitpallavacūḍāśca puṣpacūḍāśca kecana .. 154 ..
meaning:
नवमाल्यकराः केचित्केचिदाजानुमालिनः ..
केचित्पल्लवचूडाश्च पुष्पचूडाश्च केचन .. 154 ..
text_mt:
Some held fresh garlands in hand, and some wore garlands reaching to their knees;
Some had crests of sprouts, and others had crests of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
gopālabālakāḥ sarve viprendra navakoṭayaḥ ..
jagmurgopyo vayasyāśca koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo mudā .. 155 ..
meaning:
गोपालबालकाः सर्वे विप्रेन्द्र नवकोटयः ..
जग्मुर्गोप्यो वयस्याश्च कोटिशः कोटिशो मुदा .. 155 ..
text_mt:
All the cowherd boys, O best of brāhmaṇas, numbered ninety million.
By millions upon millions the cowherd-women and companions set out joyfully,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhāśca koṭiśastatra bṛhacchroṇyaścalatkucāḥ ..
rādhikāsahacāriṇyo bālā gopālikā mune .. 196 ..
meaning:
वृद्धाश्च कोटिशस्तत्र बृहच्छ्रोण्यश्चलत्कुचाः ..
राधिकासहचारिण्यो बाला गोपालिका मुने .. 196 ..
text_mt:
And millions of elderly women were there, with broad hips and trembling breasts.
The companions of Rādhikā, the young cowherd girls, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ suśīlādayo bhavyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ..
divyavastraparīdhānāḥ sasmitāstā yayurmudā ..157..
meaning:
ताः सुशीलादयो भव्या नानालंकारभूषिताः ..
दिव्यवस्त्रपरीधानाः सस्मितास्ता ययुर्मुदा ..157..
text_mt:
those auspicious [maidens] headed by Suśīlā, adorned with various ornaments,
wearing celestial garments, departed joyfully with smiles.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścidāruhya śibikāṃ rathamāruhya kāścana ..
rādhā syandanamāruhya śātakaumbhaparicchadam .. 158 ..
meaning:
काश्चिदारुह्य शिबिकां रथमारुह्य काश्चन ..
राधा स्यन्दनमारुह्य शातकौम्भपरिच्छदम् .. 158 ..
text_mt:
Some mounted palanquins, some mounted chariots,
while Rādhā mounted a chariot draped with golden coverings.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiryuktā yayau devī ratnālaṃkāra bhūṣitā ..
yaśodā rohiṇī caiva ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā .. 159 ..
meaning:
ताभिर्युक्ता ययौ देवी रत्नालंकार भूषिता ..
यशोदा रोहिणी चैव रत्नालंकारभूषिता .. 159 ..
text_mt:
Joined by them, the goddess went, adorned with jewel-ornaments.
Yaśodā and Rohiṇī too, adorned with jewel-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau syandanamāruhya śātakaumbhaparicchadam ..
nandaḥ sunandaḥ śrīdāmā giribhānurvibhākaraḥ .. 4.16.160 ..
meaning:
ययौ स्यन्दनमारुह्य शातकौम्भपरिच्छदम् ..
नन्दः सुनन्दः श्रीदामा गिरिभानुर्विभाकरः .. 4.16.160 ..
text_mt:
departed, having mounted a chariot draped with golden coverings.
Nanda, Sunanda, Śrīdāman, Giribhānu, Vibhākara,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhānuścandrabhānurgajasthāḥ prayayurmudā ..
śrīkṛṣṇabaladevau tau ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitau .. 161 ..
meaning:
वीरभानुश्चन्द्रभानुर्गजस्थाः प्रययुर्मुदा ..
श्रीकृष्णबलदेवौ तौ रत्नालंकारभूषितौ .. 161 ..
text_mt:

meaning:
अतोऽबलाया हे ब्रह्मन्का गतिर्भविता वद ..
विना कान्तं च कान्तानां का शोभा चतुरानन .. 66 ..
text_mt:
then what will be the fate of this woman, O Brahman? Tell me!
Without a beloved husband, what beauty is there for women, O four-faced one?

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ pativratāyāśca patireva śrutau śrutam ..
guruścābhīṣṭadevaśca tapodharmamayaḥ patiḥ .. 67..
meaning:
व्रतं पतिव्रतायाश्च पतिरेव श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ..
गुरुश्चाभीष्टदेवश्च तपोधर्ममयः पतिः .. 67..
text_mt:
For a devoted wife, her vow is only her husband—so it is heard in sacred tradition.
A husband is the guru, the chosen deity, and the embodiment of austerity and righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ ca priyataro na bandhuḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ..
sarvadharmātparā brahmanpatisevā sudurlabhā .. 68 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषां च प्रियतरो न बन्धुः स्वामिनः परः ..
सर्वधर्मात्परा ब्रह्मन्पतिसेवा सुदुर्लभा .. 68 ..
text_mt:
He is dearest of all; there is no kinsman beyond a husband.
Service to a husband is higher than all religious duties, O Brahman, and very difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmisevāvihīnāyāḥ sarvaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ..
vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ pūjā japahomādikaṃ ca yat..69..
meaning:
स्वामिसेवाविहीनायाः सर्वं तन्निष्फलं भवेत् ..
व्रतं दानं तपः पूजा जपहोमादिकं च यत्..69..
text_mt:
For a woman destitute of service to her husband, all this becomes fruitless:
observances, charity, austerities, worship, recitation of mantras, oblations, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇam..
dīkṣā ca sarvayajñeṣu mahādānāni yāni ca .. 4.17.70 ..
meaning:
स्नानं च सर्वतीर्थेषु पृथिव्याश्च प्रदक्षिणम्..
दीक्षा च सर्वयज्ञेषु महादानानि यानि च .. 4.17.70 ..
text_mt:
bathing in all holy waters, circumambulation of the earth,
initiation in all sacrifices, and great gifts of charity;

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanaṃ sarvavedānāṃ sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi ca ..
vedajñānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ devasevanam ..71..
meaning:
पठनं सर्ववेदानां सर्वाणि च तपांसि च ..
वेदज्ञानां ब्राह्मणानां भोजनं देवसेवनम् ..71..
text_mt:
recitation of all the Vedas, all ascetic practices,
feeding Brahmins who know the Vedas, and the worship of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni svāmisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ..
svāmisevāvihīnā yā vadaṃti svāmine kaṭum ..72..
meaning:
एतानि स्वामिसेवायाः कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ..
स्वामिसेवाविहीना या वदंति स्वामिने कटुम् ..72..
text_mt:
These do not equal a sixteenth part of service to a husband.
Those women who, devoid of service to their husband, speak harshly to their husband,

sanskrit_iast:
pataṃti kālasūtre ca yāvaccaṃdradivākarau ..
sarpapramāṇāḥ kṛmayo daṃśaṃti ca divāniśam ..73 ..
meaning:
पतंति कालसूत्रे च यावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ ..
सर्पप्रमाणाः कृमयो दंशंति च दिवानिशम् ..73 ..
text_mt:
fall into the Kālasūtra [hell] for as long as the moon and the sun endure.
Worms the size of serpents bite them day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtataṃ viparītaṃ ca kurvaṃti śabdamulbaṇam ..
mūtraśleṣmapurīṣāṇāṃ kurvaṃti bhakṣaṇaṃ mudā ..74..
meaning:
संततं विपरीतं च कुर्वंति शब्दमुल्बणम् ..
मूत्रश्लेष्मपुरीषाणां कुर्वंति भक्षणं मुदा ..74..
text_mt:
Constantly they make unnatural and terrifying screams;
they eagerly consume urine, phlegm, and feces.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe tāsāṃ dadatyevamulkāṃ ca yamakiṃkarāḥ ..
bhuktvā bhogaṃ ca narake kṛmiyoniṃ prayāṃti tāḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
मुखे तासां ददत्येवमुल्कां च यमकिंकराः ..
भुक्त्वा भोगं च नरके कृमियोनिं प्रयांति ताः .. 75 ..
text_mt:
The servants of Yama place burning firebrands in their mouths;
having undergone suffering in hell, they enter the wombs of worms.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣaṃti janmaśatakaṃ raktamāṃsapurīṣakam ..
śrutvāhaṃ viduṣāṃ vaktrādvedavākyeṣu niścitam .. 76 ..
meaning:
भक्षंति जन्मशतकं रक्तमांसपुरीषकम् ..
श्रुत्वाहं विदुषां वक्त्राद्वेदवाक्येषु निश्चितम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
For a hundred births they consume blood, flesh, and excrement.
Having heard the certainty in the words of the Vedas from the mouths of wise men,

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmi kiṃcidabalā tvaṃ vedajanako vibhuḥ ..
gurorguruśca viduṣāṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ tathā ..77..
meaning:
जानामि किंचिदबला त्वं वेदजनको विभुः ..
गुरोर्गुरुश्च विदुषां योगिनां ज्ञानिनां तथा ..77..
text_mt:
I, a weak woman, know a little; but you are the lord, the father of the Vedas,
the guru of gurus, and of the learned, the yogis, and the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñamevaṃbhūtaṃ tvāṃ bodhayāmi kimacyuta ..
prāṇādhiko'yaṃ kāṃto'yaṃ yadi mukto babhūva ha .. . 78 ..
meaning:
सर्वज्ञमेवंभूतं त्वां बोधयामि किमच्युत ..
प्राणाधिकोऽयं कांतोऽयं यदि मुक्तो बभूव ह .. . 78 ..
text_mt:
How can I instruct you, O Acyuta, who are omniscient and so exalted?
If this beloved, who is dearer to me than life, should indeed become liberated,

sanskrit_iast:
mama ko rakṣitā brahmandharmasya yauvanasya ca ..
kaumāre rakṣitā tāto dattvā pātrāya satkṛtī ..79..
meaning:
मम को रक्षिता ब्रह्मन्धर्मस्य यौवनस्य च ..
कौमारे रक्षिता तातो दत्त्वा पात्राय सत्कृती ..79..
text_mt:
who will be my protector, O Brahman, in respect to my virtue and my youth?
In childhood her father is her protector, having bestowed her upon a worthy man with honor;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā rakṣitā kāṃtastadabhāve ca tatsutaḥ ..
triṣvavasthāsu nārīṇāṃ trātāraśca trayaḥ smṛtāḥ .. 4.17.80 ..
meaning:
सर्वदा रक्षिता कांतस्तदभावे च तत्सुतः ..
त्रिष्ववस्थासु नारीणां त्रातारश्च त्रयः स्मृताः .. 4.17.80 ..
text_mt:
at all times her husband is her protector, and in his absence, her son.
In the three stages of life, women are declared to have three protectors.

sanskrit_iast:
yāḥ svataṃtrāśca tā naṣṭāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
asatkulaprasūtāstāḥ kulaṭā duṣṭamānasāḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
याः स्वतंत्राश्च ता नष्टाः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृताः ..
असत्कुलप्रसूतास्ताः कुलटा दुष्टमानसाः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Those who are independent are ruined, cast out from all virtue;
born of a base family, they are unchaste and of evil mind.

sanskrit_iast:
śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tāsāṃ naśyati padmaja ..
putrasneho yathā bālye tathā yūni ca vārddhake . .. 82 ..
meaning:
शतजन्मकृतं पुण्यं तासां नश्यति पद्मज ..
पुत्रस्नेहो यथा बाल्ये तथा यूनि च वार्द्धके . .. 82 ..
text_mt:
The merit accumulated by them in a hundred births is destroyed, O lotus-born one!
Just as there is affection for a son in childhood, so in youth and in old age;

sanskrit_iast:
pativratānāṃ kānte ca sarvakāle samā spṛhā ..
sute stanaṃdhaye sneho mātṝṇāṃ cātiśobhite .. 83 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रतानां कान्ते च सर्वकाले समा स्पृहा ..
सुते स्तनंधये स्नेहो मातॄणां चातिशोभिते .. 83 ..
text_mt:
for devoted wives, there is an equal longing for the husband at all times.
The affection of mothers for a suckling son is exceedingly beautiful,

sanskrit_iast:
patisnehasya sādhvīnāṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ..
stanāndhe stanadānāntamiṣṭānne bhojanāvadhi .. 84..
meaning:
पतिस्नेहस्य साध्वीनां कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् ..
स्तनान्धे स्तनदानान्तमिष्टान्ने भोजनावधि .. 84..
text_mt:
yet it is not worth a sixteenth part of a virtuous woman's affection for her husband.
Affection for the suckling infant ends with breast-feeding, and for delicious food ends with the meal;

sanskrit_iast:
kānte cittaṃ satīnāṃ ca svapne jñāne ca santatam ..
duḥkhānto bandhuvicchedaḥ putrāṇāṃ ca tato'dhikaḥ..85..
meaning:
कान्ते चित्तं सतीनां च स्वप्ने ज्ञाने च सन्ततम् ..
दुःखान्तो बन्धुविच्छेदः पुत्राणां च ततोऽधिकः..85..
text_mt:
the mind of chaste wives is constantly fixed on the husband, both in dream and in wakefulness.
Separation from relatives brings sorrow, and greater still is that from sons;

sanskrit_iast:
sudāruṇaḥ svāminaśca duḥkhaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ striyāḥ..
avidagdhā yathā dagdhā jvaladagnau viṣādane .. 86 ..
meaning:
सुदारुणः स्वामिनश्च दुःखं नातः परं स्त्रियाः..
अविदग्धा यथा दग्धा ज्वलदग्नौ विषादने .. 86 ..
text_mt:
separation from the husband is exceedingly terrible; there is no sorrow greater than this for a woman.
Just as an untaught woman might be burned in a blazing fire or by taking poison,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vidagdhā dagdhā syādvidagdhavirahānale ..
nānne tṛṣṇā jale tṛṣṇā sādhvīnāṃ svāminaṃ vinā .. 87 ..
meaning:
तथा विदग्धा दग्धा स्याद्विदग्धविरहानले ..
नान्ने तृष्णा जले तृष्णा साध्वीनां स्वामिनं विना .. 87 ..
text_mt:
so an intelligent woman is burned in the fire of separation from her beloved.
Virtuous women have no thirst for food or thirst for water without their husband;

sanskrit_iast:
virahāgnau mano dagdhaṃ vahnau śuṣkatṛṇaṃ yathā..
na hi kāntātparo bandhurna hi kāntātparaḥ priyaḥ..88..
meaning:
विरहाग्नौ मनो दग्धं वह्नौ शुष्कतृणं यथा..
न हि कान्तात्परो बन्धुर्न हि कान्तात्परः प्रियः..88..
text_mt:
their mind is burned in the fire of separation like dry grass in fire.
There is no friend higher than the husband, nor anyone dearer than the husband;

sanskrit_iast:
na hi kāntātparo devo na hi kāntātparo guruḥ ..
na hi kāntātparo dharmo na hi kāntātparaṃ dhanam.. 89 ..
meaning:
न हि कान्तात्परो देवो न हि कान्तात्परो गुरुः ..
न हि कान्तात्परो धर्मो न हि कान्तात्परं धनम्.. 89 ..
text_mt:
there is no deity higher than the husband, nor any guru higher than the husband;
there is no virtue higher than the husband, nor any wealth higher than the husband;

sanskrit_iast:
na hi kāntātparaḥ prāṇā na hi kāntātparaḥ striyāḥ ..
nimagnaṃ kṛṣṇapādābje vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā manaḥ .. 4.17.90 ..
meaning:
न हि कान्तात्परः प्राणा न हि कान्तात्परः स्त्रियाः ..
निमग्नं कृष्णपादाब्जे वैष्णवानां यथा मनः .. 4.17.90 ..
text_mt:
there is no life higher than the husband, nor anything beyond the husband for a woman.
Just as the mind of Vaiṣṇavas is immersed in the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
yathaikaputre mātuśca yathā strīṣu ca kāminām ..
dhaneṣu kṛpaṇānāṃ ca cirakālārjiteṣu ca .. 91 ..
meaning:
यथैकपुत्रे मातुश्च यथा स्त्रीषु च कामिनाम् ..
धनेषु कृपणानां च चिरकालार्जितेषु च .. 91 ..
text_mt:
just as a mother's mind is on her only son, and the mind of lustful men is on women;
and the mind of misers is on wealth acquired over a long time;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhayeṣu bhītānāṃ śāstreṣu viduṣāṃ yathā ..
stanādāne śiśūnāṃ ca śilpeṣu śilpināṃ yathā .. 92 ..
meaning:
यथा भयेषु भीतानां शास्त्रेषु विदुषां यथा ..
स्तनादाने शिशूनां च शिल्पेषु शिल्पिनां यथा .. 92 ..
text_mt:
just as the mind of the fearful is on dangers, and of the learned on scriptures;
and of infants on taking the breast, and of artisans on arts;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jāre puṃścalīnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ ca tathā priye ..
taṃ vinā jīvituṃ brahmankṣaṇamekaṃ na ca kṣamam .. 93 ..
meaning:
यथा जारे पुंश्चलीनां साध्वीनां च तथा प्रिये ..
तं विना जीवितुं ब्रह्मन्क्षणमेकं न च क्षमम् .. 93 ..
text_mt:
just as the mind of unchaste women is on a lover, so that of virtuous wives is on their beloved.
Without him, O Brahman, it is impossible to live even for a single moment.

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ tāsāṃ jīvanaṃ maraṇādhikam ..
sadbhartṛrahitānāṃ ca śokena hatacetasām ..
anyaśokanimagnānāṃ kālena pānabhojanāt .. 94 ..
meaning:
मरणं जीवनं तासां जीवनं मरणाधिकम् ..
सद्भर्तृरहितानां च शोकेन हतचेतसाम् ..
अन्यशोकनिमग्नानां कालेन पानभोजनात् .. 94 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viparītaḥ kāntaśoko varddhate bhakṣaṇādaho ..
karmacchāyā satīnāṃ ca saṅginīnāṃ satī varā (? )..95..
meaning:
विपरीतः कान्तशोको वर्द्धते भक्षणादहो ..
कर्मच्छाया सतीनां च सङ्गिनीनां सती वरा (? )..95..
text_mt:
the opposite is grief for a husband—alas, it increases from eating!
A chaste wife follows like the shadow of her husband's deeds; among companions, a chaste wife is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
itare bhogadehānte sādhvī janmani janmani ..
karoṣi cejjagaddhātarimaṃ muktaṃ mayā vinā .. 96 ..
meaning:
इतरे भोगदेहान्ते साध्वी जन्मनि जन्मनि ..
करोषि चेज्जगद्धातरिमं मुक्तं मया विना .. 96 ..
text_mt:
At the end of the body of experiences with others, the virtuous woman [remains his] in birth after birth.
If you, O Creator of the universe, make him liberated without me,

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ śaptvā'haṃ tvayi vibho paśya dāsyāmi strīvadham ..
śrutvā kalāvatīvākyamuvāca vismito vidhiḥ ..
hitaṃ pīyūṣasadṛśaṃ bhayasaṃvignamānasaḥ .. 97 ..
meaning:
त्वां शप्त्वाऽहं त्वयि विभो पश्य दास्यामि स्त्रीवधम् ..
श्रुत्वा कलावतीवाक्यमुवाच विस्मितो विधिः ..
हितं पीयूषसदृशं भयसंविग्नमानसः .. 97 ..
text_mt:
then having cursed you, O Lord, behold, I will lay the murder of a woman upon you!"
Hearing the speech of Kalāvatī, Brahmā, astonished
and with a mind agitated by fear, spoke words that were beneficial and nectar-like.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca .. ..
vatse muktiṃ na dāsyāmi svāminaṃ ca tvayā vinā .. .. 98 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
वत्से मुक्तिं न दास्यामि स्वामिनं च त्वया विना .. .. 98 ..
text_mt: "Child, I will not give liberation to your husband without you.

sanskrit_iast:
muktaṃ kartuṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ sāmprataṃ nāhamīśvaraḥ ..
mātarmuktirvinā bhogāddurlabhā sarvasaṃmatā .. 99 ..
meaning:
मुक्तं कर्तुं त्वया सार्द्धं साम्प्रतं नाहमीश्वरः ..
मातर्मुक्तिर्विना भोगाद्दुर्लभा सर्वसंमता .. 99 ..
text_mt:
At present I am not capable of liberating him together with you.
O mother, liberation without experience of karma is hard to obtain, as agreed by all.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāṇatāṃ samāpnoti bhogī bhogavikṛntane ..
kavivarṣaṃ svargabhogaṃ kuruṣva svāminā saha .. 4.17.100 ..
meaning:
निर्वाणतां समाप्नोति भोगी भोगविकृन्तने ..
कविवर्षं स्वर्गभोगं कुरुष्व स्वामिना सह .. 4.17.100 ..
text_mt:
An experiencer of karma attains extinction when karma has been cut away.
Enjoy heavenly pleasure together with your husband for several years;

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu yuvayorjanma bhavitā bhārate sati ..
yadā bhaviṣyati satī kanyā te rādhikā svayam .. 101 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु युवयोर्जन्म भविता भारते सति ..
यदा भविष्यति सती कन्या ते राधिका स्वयम् .. 101 ..
text_mt:
after that, O chaste lady, both of you will take birth in Bhārata.
When Rādhikā herself will become your chaste daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanmuktau tayā sārddhaṃ golokaṃ ca gamiṣyathaḥ ..
katikālaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha bhuṅkṣva bhogaṃ striyā saha .. 102 ..
meaning:
जीवन्मुक्तौ तया सार्द्धं गोलोकं च गमिष्यथः ..
कतिकालं नृपश्रेष्ठ भुङ्क्ष्व भोगं स्त्रिया सह .. 102 ..
text_mt:
liberated while living, you two will go to Goloka together with her.
For some time, O best of kings, enjoy worldly experience with your wife!"

sanskrit_iast:
sādhvī vai sattvayuktā ca mā māṃ śaptuṃ tvamarhasi ..
jīvanmuktāḥ samāḥ santaḥ kṛṣṇapādābjamānasāḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
साध्वी वै सत्त्वयुक्ता च मा मां शप्तुं त्वमर्हसि ..
जीवन्मुक्ताः समाः सन्तः कृष्णपादाब्जमानसाः .. 103 ..
text_mt:
You are indeed a virtuous woman, endowed with goodness; you should not curse me.
Those who are liberated while living, serene, virtuous, with their minds set on Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet,

sanskrit_iast:
vāñchanti haridāsyaṃ ca durlabhaṃ na ca nirvṛtim ..
ityuktvā tau varau dattvā santasthau puratastayoḥ ..104..
meaning:
वाञ्छन्ति हरिदास्यं च दुर्लभं न च निर्वृतिम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा तौ वरौ दत्त्वा सन्तस्थौ पुरतस्तयोः ..104..
text_mt:
desire servitude to Hari, which is hard to obtain, and not [mere] cessation.
Having spoken thus and granted the two boons, he stood before them.

sanskrit_iast:
yayatustau taṃ praṇamya jagāma svālayaṃ vidhiḥ ..
ājagmatustau kālena bhuktvā bhogaṃ ca bhāratam .. 105 ..
meaning:
ययतुस्तौ तं प्रणम्य जगाम स्वालयं विधिः ..
आजग्मतुस्तौ कालेन भुक्त्वा भोगं च भारतम् .. 105 ..
text_mt:
Bowing to him, the two departed, and the Creator went to his own abode.
In time, having enjoyed their pleasures in Bhārata,

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ puṇyapradaṃ divyaṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vāñchitam ..
sucandro vṛṣabhānuśca lalābha janma gokule.. 106 ..
meaning:
परं पुण्यप्रदं दिव्यं ब्रह्मादीनां च वाञ्छितम् ..
सुचन्द्रो वृषभानुश्च ललाभ जन्म गोकुले.. 106 ..
text_mt:
which bestow supreme merit, are divine, and are desired by Brahmā and the others,
Sucandra was born in Gokula as Vṛṣabhānu,

sanskrit_iast:
padmāvatyāśca jaṭhare surabhānasya retasā ..
jātismaro hareraṃśaḥ śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī .. 107 ..
meaning:
पद्मावत्याश्च जठरे सुरभानस्य रेतसा ..
जातिस्मरो हरेरंशः शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी .. 107 ..
text_mt:
in the womb of Padmāvatī through the semen of Surabhānu.
Remembering his past lives, a portion of Hari, like the moon in the bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhe'nudinaṃ tatra vrajagehe vrajādhipaḥ ..
sarvajñaśca mahāyogī haripādābjamānasaḥ .. 108 ..
meaning:
ववृधेऽनुदिनं तत्र व्रजगेहे व्रजाधिपः ..
सर्वज्ञश्च महायोगी हरिपादाब्जमानसः .. 108 ..
text_mt:
the lord of Vraja grew day by day there in the home of Vraja.
He was omniscient, a great yogin, with his mind set on Hari's lotus feet,

sanskrit_iast:
nandadabandhurvadānyaśca rūpavānguṇavānsudhīḥ ..
kalāvatī kānyakubje babhūvāyonisaṃbhavā .. 109 ..
meaning:
नन्ददबन्धुर्वदान्यश्च रूपवान्गुणवान्सुधीः ..
कलावती कान्यकुब्जे बभूवायोनिसंभवा .. 109 ..
text_mt:
a friend of Nanda, generous, handsome, virtuous, and wise.
Kalāvatī was born without a womb in Kānyakubja.

sanskrit_iast:
jātismarā mahāsādhvī sundarī kamalākalā ..
kānyakubje nṛpaśreṣṭho bhanandana urukramaḥ ..4.17.110..
meaning:
जातिस्मरा महासाध्वी सुन्दरी कमलाकला ..
कान्यकुब्जे नृपश्रेष्ठो भनन्दन उरुक्रमः ..4.17.110..
text_mt:
Remembering her past lives, greatly virtuous, beautiful, she was a part of Kamalā.
In Kānyakubja there was the best of kings, Bhanandana of mighty strides.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāṃ saṃprāpya yāgānte yajñakuṇḍasamutthitām ..
nagnāṃ hasantīṃ rūpāḍhyāṃ stanāndhāmiva bālikām .. 111 ..
meaning:
स तां संप्राप्य यागान्ते यज्ञकुण्डसमुत्थिताम् ..
नग्नां हसन्तीं रूपाढ्यां स्तनान्धामिव बालिकाम् .. 111 ..
text_mt:
At the end of a sacrifice, he found her arisen from the sacrificial pit—
a naked, laughing girl, rich in beauty, like an infant blind for the breast,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā prajvalantīṃ ca prataptakanakaprabhām ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi rājendraḥ svakāntāyai dadau mudā .. 112 ..
meaning:
तेजसा प्रज्वलन्तीं च प्रतप्तकनकप्रभाम् ..
कृत्वा वक्षसि राजेन्द्रः स्वकान्तायै ददौ मुदा .. 112 ..
text_mt:
blazing with splendor, with the luster of refined gold.
Holding her to his chest, the best of kings joyfully gave her to his beloved wife.

sanskrit_iast:
mālāvatī stanaṃ dattvā tāṃ pupoṣa praharṣitā ..
tadannaprāśanadine satāṃ madhye śubhe kṣaṇe .. 113 ..
meaning:
मालावती स्तनं दत्त्वा तां पुपोष प्रहर्षिता ..
तदन्नप्राशनदिने सतां मध्ये शुभे क्षणे .. 113 ..
text_mt:
Mālāvatī, offering her breast, joyfully nourished her.
On the day of her first feeding of grain, amidst good people at an auspicious moment,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmarakṣaṇakāle ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
kalāvatīti kanyāyā nāma rakṣa nṛpeti ca .. 114 ..
meaning:
नामरक्षणकाले च वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ..
कलावतीति कन्याया नाम रक्ष नृपेति च .. 114 ..
text_mt:
and at the time of giving her a name, a bodiless voice arose:
“O King, bestow the name Kalāvatī upon the girl.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā taccakāra mahīpatiḥ ..
viprebhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca bandibhyaśca dhanaṃ dadau .. 115 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा तच्चकार महीपतिः ..
विप्रेभ्यो भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च बन्दिभ्यश्च धनं ददौ .. 115 ..
text_mt:
Hearing this utterance, the ruler of the earth did so.
He gave wealth to Brahmins, beggars, and bards,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvebhyo bhojayāmāsa cakāra sumahotsavam ..
kālena sā rūpavatī yauvanasthā babhūva ha .. 116..
meaning:
सर्वेभ्यो भोजयामास चकार सुमहोत्सवम् ..
कालेन सा रूपवती यौवनस्था बभूव ह .. 116..
text_mt:
fed everyone, and held a great festival.
In time, she became a beautiful maiden in the bloom of youth,

sanskrit_iast:
atīva sundara śyāmā munimānasamohinī ..
cārucampakavarṇābhā śaraccandranibhānanā .. 117 ..
meaning:
अतीव सुन्दर श्यामा मुनिमानसमोहिनी ..
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभा शरच्चन्द्रनिभानना .. 117 ..
text_mt:
an exceedingly beautiful young woman who enchanted the minds of sages,
having the hue of a lovely campaka flower, and a face like the autumn moon,

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā praphullapadmalocanā ..
nitamba śroṇibhārārtā stanabhāranatā satī .. 118 ..
meaning:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्या प्रफुल्लपद्मलोचना ..
नितम्ब श्रोणिभारार्ता स्तनभारनता सती .. 118 ..
text_mt:
with a cheerful face slightly smiling, and eyes like blooming lotuses,
burdened by heavy hips and waist, bent by the weight of her breasts, a virtuous maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchantī rājamārgeṇa gajendramandagāminī ..
dadarśa nandaḥ pathi tāṃ gacchantīṃ ca mudā nvitaḥ ..119..
meaning:
गच्छन्ती राजमार्गेण गजेन्द्रमन्दगामिनी ..
ददर्श नन्दः पथि तां गच्छन्तीं च मुदा न्वितः ..119..
text_mt:
As she was walking along the royal highway with the slow gait of a noble elephant,
Nanda, full of joy, saw her walking on the road.

sanskrit_iast:
jitendriyaśca jñānī ca mūrcchāmāpa tathā'pi ca..
trasto lokānpathi gatāṃstūrṇaṃ papraccha sādaram..4.17.120..
meaning:
जितेन्द्रियश्च ज्ञानी च मूर्च्छामाप तथाऽपि च..
त्रस्तो लोकान्पथि गतांस्तूर्णं पप्रच्छ सादरम्..4.17.120..
text_mt:
Though he had conquered his senses and possessed knowledge, he nevertheless swooned.
Alarmed, he quickly and respectfully asked the people passing on the road:

sanskrit_iast:
gacchantī kasya kanyeyamiti hovāca taṃ janaḥ ..
bhanandanasya nṛpateḥ kanyā nāmnā kalāvatī .. 121 ..
meaning:
गच्छन्ती कस्य कन्येयमिति होवाच तं जनः ..
भनन्दनस्य नृपतेः कन्या नाम्ना कलावती .. 121 ..
text_mt:
“Whose daughter is this walking [here]?” The people replied to him:
“She is the daughter of King Bhanandana, named Kalāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
kamalākalayā dhanyā saṃbhūtā nṛpamandire ..
kautukena ca gacchantī krīḍārthaṃ sakhimandiram .. 122 ..
meaning:
कमलाकलया धन्या संभूता नृपमन्दिरे ..
कौतुकेन च गच्छन्ती क्रीडार्थं सखिमन्दिरम् .. 122 ..
text_mt:
blessed, born by a part of Kamalā in the king's palace.
Curious, she is going to her friend's house for play.

sanskrit_iast:
vraja vraja vrajaśreṣṭhetyuktvā loko jagāma ha ..
prahṛṣṭamānaso nando jagāma rājamandiram .. 123 ..
meaning:
व्रज व्रज व्रजश्रेष्ठेत्युक्त्वा लोको जगाम ह ..
प्रहृष्टमानसो नन्दो जगाम राजमन्दिरम् .. 123 ..
text_mt:
Go, go, O best of Vraja!” Having spoken thus, the people went on.
With a delighted heart, Nanda went to the royal palace.

sanskrit_iast:
avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ viveśa nṛpateḥ sabhām ..
utthāya rājā saṃbhāṣya svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau .. 124 ..
meaning:
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णं विवेश नृपतेः सभाम् ..
उत्थाय राजा संभाष्य स्वर्णसिंहासनं ददौ .. 124 ..
text_mt:
Swiftly descending from his chariot, he entered the king's assembly.
Standing up and greeting him, the king offered him a golden throne.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭālāpaṃ bahutaraṃ cakāra ca parasparam ..
vinayāvanato nandaḥ sambandhoktiṃ cakāra ha .. 125 ..
meaning:
इष्टालापं बहुतरं चकार च परस्परम् ..
विनयावनतो नन्दः सम्बन्धोक्तिं चकार ह .. 125 ..
text_mt:
They engaged in much pleasant conversation with each other.
Bowed with humility, Nanda made a proposal of marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājendra vakṣyāmi viśeṣavacanaṃ śubham ..
saṃbandhaṃ kuru kanyāyā viśiṣṭena ca sāmpratam .. 126 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच ..
शृणु राजेन्द्र वक्ष्यामि विशेषवचनं शुभम् ..
संबन्धं कुरु कन्याया विशिष्टेन च साम्प्रतम् .. 126 ..
text_mt:
“Listen, O best of kings, I shall speak an auspicious and particular word:
Arrange an alliance for your daughter now with a distinguished man.

sanskrit_iast:
surabhānusutaḥ śrīmānvṛṣabhānurvrajādhipaḥ ..
nārāyaṇāṃśo guṇavānsundaraśca supaṇḍitaḥ .. 127 ..
meaning:
सुरभानुसुतः श्रीमान्वृषभानुर्व्रजाधिपः ..
नारायणांशो गुणवान्सुन्दरश्च सुपण्डितः .. 127 ..
text_mt:
The glorious Vṛṣabhānu, lord of Vraja, is the son of Surabhānu.
He is a portion of Nārāyaṇa, virtuous, handsome, and deeply learned,

sanskrit_iast:
sthirayauvanayuktaśca yogī jātismaro yuvā ..
kanyā te'yonisaṃbhūtā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā .. 128 ..
meaning:
स्थिरयौवनयुक्तश्च योगी जातिस्मरो युवा ..
कन्या तेऽयोनिसंभूता यज्ञकुण्डसमुद्भवा .. 128 ..
text_mt:
endowed with eternal youth, a yogin, mindful of his past births, and young.
Your daughter is not born from a womb, but has arisen from a sacrificial pit;

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamohinī śāntā kamalāṃśā kalāvatī ..
sa ca yogyastvadduhitustadyogyā te ca kanyakā .. 129 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमोहिनी शान्ता कमलांशा कलावती ..
स च योग्यस्त्वद्दुहितुस्तद्योग्या ते च कन्यका .. 129 ..
text_mt:
she is Kalāvatī, an enchantress of the three worlds, peaceful, a portion of Kamalā.
He is worthy of your daughter, and your daughter is worthy of him.

sanskrit_iast:
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃbandho guṇavānnṛpa ..
ityevamuktvā nandastu virarāma ca saṃsadi ..
uvāca taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho vinayāvanato mune .. .. 4.17.130 ..
meaning:
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन संबन्धो गुणवान्नृप ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा नन्दस्तु विरराम च संसदि ..
उवाच तं नृपश्रेष्ठो विनयावनतो मुने .. .. 4.17.130 ..
text_mt:
An alliance of an accomplished woman with an accomplished man is excellent, O King.”
Having spoken thus, Nanda fell silent in the assembly.
Bowed in humility, the best of kings said to him, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
bhanandana uvāca ..
saṃbandho hi vidhivaśo na me sādhyo vrajādhipa .. 131 ..
meaning:
भनन्दन उवाच ..
संबन्धो हि विधिवशो न मे साध्यो व्रजाधिप .. 131 ..
text_mt: “An alliance is indeed under the power of destiny; it is not in my control, O lord of Vraja.”

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatiryogakartā janmadātā'hameva ca ..
kā kasya patnī kanyā vā varaḥ ko vā sasādhanaḥ .. 132 ..
meaning:
प्रजापतिर्योगकर्ता जन्मदाताऽहमेव च ..
का कस्य पत्नी कन्या वा वरः को वा ससाधनः .. 132 ..
text_mt:
Brahma is the arranger of unions, and I am merely the giver of birth;
who is whose wife, or whose daughter, or who is the bridegroom endowed with means?

sanskrit_iast:
karmānurūpaphaladaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ vidhiḥ ..
bhavitavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma tadamoghaṃ śrutau śrutam .. 133 ..
meaning:
कर्मानुरूपफलदः सर्वेषां कारणं विधिः ..
भवितव्यं कृतं कर्म तदमोघं श्रुतौ श्रुतम् .. 133 ..
text_mt:
Fate, which grants fruits in accordance with past deeds, is the cause of all things.
What is destined will happen through action performed; that is unfailing, as heard in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvamanīśasyodyamo yathā ..
vṛṣabhānupriyā dhātrā likhitā cetsutā mama .. .. 134 ..
meaning:
अन्यथा निष्फलं सर्वमनीशस्योद्यमो यथा ..
वृषभानुप्रिया धात्रा लिखिता चेत्सुता मम .. .. 134 ..
text_mt:
Otherwise, everything is fruitless, just like the effort of a powerless person.
If my daughter has been written by the Creator as the beloved of Vṛṣabhānu,

sanskrit_iast:
purā bhūtaiva ko vā'haṃ kenānyena nivāryate ..
ityevamuktvā rājendro vinayānatakaṃdharaḥ .. 135 ..
meaning:
पुरा भूतैव को वाऽहं केनान्येन निवार्यते ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजेन्द्रो विनयानतकंधरः .. 135 ..
text_mt:
it was already determined long ago; who am I, and by what other person could it be prevented?”
Having spoken thus, the king of kings, his neck bowed with humility,

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa sādareṇa ca nārada ..
nṛpānujñāmupādāya vrajarājo vrajaṃ gataḥ .. 136 ..
meaning:
मिष्टान्नं भोजयामास सादरेण च नारद ..
नृपानुज्ञामुपादाय व्रजराजो व्रजं गतः .. 136 ..
text_mt:
fed [him] sweetmeats with great respect, O Nārada.
Taking leave of the king, the king of Vraja returned to Vraja.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sa kathayāmāsa surabhānasya saṃsadi ..
surabhānaśca yatnena nandanena ca sādaram .. 137 ..
meaning:
गत्वा स कथयामास सुरभानस्य संसदि ..
सुरभानश्च यत्नेन नन्दनेन च सादरम् .. 137 ..
text_mt:
Having arrived, he related [it] in the assembly of Surabhānu.
And Surabhānu, with effort and respectfully together with Nanda,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbandhaṃ yojayāmāsa gargadvārā ca satvaram ..
vivāhakāle rājendro vipulaṃ yautakaṃ dadau .. .. 138 ..
meaning:
संबन्धं योजयामास गर्गद्वारा च सत्वरम् ..
विवाहकाले राजेन्द्रो विपुलं यौतकं ददौ .. .. 138 ..
text_mt:
speedily arranged the marriage alliance through Garga.
At the time of the wedding, the king of kings gave an abundant dowry:

sanskrit_iast:
gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ ratnāni maṇibhūṣaṇam ..
vṛṣabhānurmudā yuktaḥ prāpya tāṃ ca kalāvatīm .. 139 ..
meaning:
गजरत्नमश्वरत्नं रत्नानि मणिभूषणम् ..
वृषभानुर्मुदा युक्तः प्राप्य तां च कलावतीम् .. 139 ..
text_mt:
splendid elephants, splendid horses, jewels, and gemstone ornaments.
Filled with joy upon obtaining Kalāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
reme sunirjane ramye bubudhe na divāniśam ..
cakṣurnimeṣavirahādvyākulāṃ svāminā vinā .. 4.17.140 ..
meaning:
रेमे सुनिर्जने रम्ये बुबुधे न दिवानिशम् ..
चक्षुर्निमेषविरहाद्व्याकुलां स्वामिना विना .. 4.17.140 ..
text_mt:
Vṛṣabhānu sported [with her] in a very secluded, charming place, unaware of day or night.
She became agitated even at the separation of the blink of an eye without her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
vyākulo vṛṣabhānuśca kṣaṇena ca tayā vinā ..
jātismarā ca sā kanyā māyāmānuṣarūpiṇī .. 141 ..
meaning:
व्याकुलो वृषभानुश्च क्षणेन च तया विना ..
जातिस्मरा च सा कन्या मायामानुषरूपिणी .. 141 ..
text_mt:
and Vṛṣabhānu was agitated in an instant without her.
That maiden, possessing memory of her past lives, had assumed the illusory form of a human,

sanskrit_iast:
jātismaro hareraṃśo vṛṣabhāno mudā'nvitaḥ ..
vavṛdhe ca tayoḥ prema nityaṃnityaṃ navaṃnavam .. 142 ..
meaning:
जातिस्मरो हरेरंशो वृषभानो मुदाऽन्वितः ..
ववृधे च तयोः प्रेम नित्यंनित्यं नवंनवम् .. 142 ..
text_mt:
and Vṛṣabhānu, a portion of Hari, also remembered his past lives, filled with joy.
Their love grew daily, ever fresh and new.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sakāmā sā prauḍhā sa ca kāmasamo yuvā ..
tayoḥ kanyā ca kālena rādhikā sā babhūva ha ..
daivātsudāma śāpena śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā purā .. 143 ..
meaning:
सदा सकामा सा प्रौढा स च कामसमो युवा ..
तयोः कन्या च कालेन राधिका सा बभूव ह ..
दैवात्सुदाम शापेन श्रीकृष्णस्याज्ञया पुरा .. 143 ..
text_mt:
She was ever full of desire, fully mature, and he was a youth equal to Kāma.
In time, Rādhikā indeed became their daughter
by destiny, through the curse of Sudāman, by the command of Śrī Kṛṣṇa long ago.

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisaṃbhavā sā ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā satī ..
yasyā darśanamātreṇa tau vimuktau babhūvatuḥ.. .. 144 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसंभवा सा च कृष्णप्राणाधिका सती ..
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण तौ विमुक्तौ बभूवतुः.. .. 144 ..
text_mt:
She, who was not born from a womb, was the virtuous woman dearer to Kṛṣṇa than life itself,
by the mere sight of whom both of them attained liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsaśca kathitaḥ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam ..
pāpendhanānāṃ dāhe ca jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ...44...
meaning:
इतिहासश्च कथितः प्रकृतं शृणु साम्प्रतम् ..
पापेन्धनानां दाहे च ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः ...44...
text_mt:
The traditional account has been told; now listen to the subject at hand,
which resembles a blaze of flaming fire in burning the fuel of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhānāśramaṃ gatvā śilpināṃ pravaro mudā ..
sthānāntaraṃ viśvakarmā jagāma svagaṇaiḥ saha .. 146 ..
meaning:
वृषभानाश्रमं गत्वा शिल्पिनां प्रवरो मुदा ..
स्थानान्तरं विश्वकर्मा जगाम स्वगणैः सह .. 146 ..
text_mt:
Having gone to Vṛṣabhānu's hermitage, Viśvakarman, the best of craftsmen,
went joyfully with his attendants to another location.

sanskrit_iast:
krośamātraṃ sthalaṃ cāru manasā''locya tattvavit ..
āśramaṃ kartumārebhe nandasya sumahātmanaḥ .. 147 ..
meaning:
क्रोशमात्रं स्थलं चारु मनसा'ऽलोच्य तत्त्ववित् ..
आश्रमं कर्तुमारेभे नन्दस्य सुमहात्मनः .. 147 ..
text_mt:
After examining with his mind a charming site measuring a krośa, the knower of truth
began to construct the residence of the great-souled Nanda.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā'numānaṃ buddhyā ca sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇam ..
parikhābhirgabhīrābhiścaturbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ varam .. 148 ..
meaning:
कृत्वाऽनुमानं बुद्ध्या च सर्वतोऽपि विलक्षणम् ..
परिखाभिर्गभीराभिश्चतुर्भिः संयुतं वरम् .. 148 ..
text_mt:
Having conceived it mentally, extraordinary in every respect,
an excellent [dwelling] enclosed by four deep moats,

sanskrit_iast:
durlaṅghyābhirvairibhiśca khanitābhiśca prastaraiḥ ..
puṣyodyānaiḥ puṣpitābhiḥ pārāvāreṣu puṣpitaiḥ .. 149..
meaning:
दुर्लङ्घ्याभिर्वैरिभिश्च खनिताभिश्च प्रस्तरैः ..
पुष्योद्यानैः पुष्पिताभिः पारावारेषु पुष्पितैः .. 149..
text_mt:
insurmountable to enemies and excavated with stones,
adorned on both banks with blossoming flower gardens,

sanskrit_iast:
cāru campakavṛkṣaiśca puṣpitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
parito vāsitābhiśca sugandhivāyunā mune .. 4.17.150 ..
meaning:
चारु चम्पकवृक्षैश्च पुष्पितैः सुमनोहरैः ..
परितो वासिताभिश्च सुगन्धिवायुना मुने .. 4.17.150 ..
text_mt:
and with lovely, delightful, flowering campaka trees,
fragrant all around with sweet-smelling wind, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
āmrairguḍālaiḥ panasaiḥ kharjūrairnārikelakaiḥ ..
dāḍimaiḥ śrīphalairbhṛṅgairjambīrairnāgaraṅgakaiḥ ..151..
meaning:
आम्रैर्गुडालैः पनसैः खर्जूरैर्नारिकेलकैः ..
दाडिमैः श्रीफलैर्भृङ्गैर्जम्बीरैर्नागरङ्गकैः ..151..
text_mt:
with mangoes, guḍālas, jackfruits, dates, coconuts,
pomegranates, bilvas, bhṛṅgas, citrons, oranges,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṅgairāmrātakairjambusamūhaiśca phalānvitaiḥ ..
kadalīnāṃ ketakīnāṃ kadambānāṃ kadambakaiḥ .. .. 152 ..
meaning:
तुङ्गैराम्रातकैर्जम्बुसमूहैश्च फलान्वितैः ..
कदलीनां केतकीनां कदम्बानां कदम्बकैः .. .. 152 ..
text_mt:
lofty āmrātakas, clusters of rose-apples laden with fruit,
and groves of plantains, ketakīs, and kadambas;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥ śobhitābhiśca phalaistaiḥ puṣpitairaho ..
krīḍārhābhirnigūḍhābhirvāñchitābhiśca sarvadā .. 153 ..
meaning:
सर्वतः शोभिताभिश्च फलैस्तैः पुष्पितैरहो ..
क्रीडार्हाभिर्निगूढाभिर्वाञ्छिताभिश्च सर्वदा .. 153 ..
text_mt:
beautified on all sides, oh, by those fruits and flowers,
suitable for sport, secret, and always desirable.

sanskrit_iast:
parikhānāṃ rahaḥ sthāne cakāra mārgamuttamam ..
durgamaṃ paravargāṇāṃ svānāṃ ca sugamaṃ sadā .. 154 ..
meaning:
परिखानां रहः स्थाने चकार मार्गमुत्तमम् ..
दुर्गमं परवर्गाणां स्वानां च सुगमं सदा .. 154 ..
text_mt:
In a secluded place along the moats, he made an excellent path,
difficult of access to enemies and always easily traversed by their own people,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketena maṇistambhaiśchāditaiḥ svalpapāthasā ..
stambhasīmākṛtamaho na saṃkīrṇaṃ na vistṛtam .. 159 ..
meaning:
संकेतेन मणिस्तम्भैश्छादितैः स्वल्पपाथसा ..
स्तम्भसीमाकृतमहो न संकीर्णं न विस्तृतम् .. 159 ..
text_mt:
marked secretly by gem-encrusted pillars covered with shallow water;
bounded by pillars, oh, neither narrow nor wide.

sanskrit_iast:
parikhoparibhāge ca prākāraṃ sumanoharam ..
dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca cakārātisamucchritam .. 156 ..
meaning:
परिखोपरिभागे च प्राकारं सुमनोहरम् ..
धनुःशतप्रमाणं च चकारातिसमुच्छ्रितम् .. 156 ..
text_mt:
And on the upper part of the moat, he made a very enchanting rampart,
measuring a hundred bows and exceedingly lofty.

sanskrit_iast:
prastarasya pramāṇaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatihastakam ..
sindūrākāramaṇibhirnirmitaṃ cātisundaram .. 157 ..
meaning:
प्रस्तरस्य प्रमाणं च पञ्चविंशतिहस्तकम् ..
सिन्दूराकारमणिभिर्निर्मितं चातिसुन्दरम् .. 157 ..
text_mt:
The size of each stone was twenty-five cubits,
and it was constructed very beautifully with gems the color of vermilion.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhye dvābhyāṃ ca saṃyuktamantare saptabhistathā ..
dvārbhiśca sanniruddhābhirmaṇisārakapāṭakaiḥ ..158..
meaning:
बाह्ये द्वाभ्यां च संयुक्तमन्तरे सप्तभिस्तथा ..
द्वार्भिश्च सन्निरुद्धाभिर्मणिसारकपाटकैः ..158..
text_mt:
It was furnished with two [gates] on the outside and likewise seven on the inside,
with gates barred by panels made of the finest gems,

sanskrit_iast:
harinmaṇīnāṃ kalaśaiścitrayuktairvirājitam ..
maṇisāravikāraiśca kapāṭaiśca suśobhitam .. 159 ..
meaning:
हरिन्मणीनां कलशैश्चित्रयुक्तैर्विराजितम् ..
मणिसारविकारैश्च कपाटैश्च सुशोभितम् .. 159 ..
text_mt:
shining with emerald finials adorned with varied designs,
and splendidly decorated with doors formed of the finest jewels;

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇasāravinirmāṇakalaśojjvalaśekharam ..
nandālayaṃ vinirmāya babhrāma nagaraṃ punaḥ .. 4.17.160 ..
meaning:
स्वर्णसारविनिर्माणकलशोज्ज्वलशेखरम् ..
नन्दालयं विनिर्माय बभ्राम नगरं पुनः .. 4.17.160 ..
text_mt:
having radiant spires with pitchers made of the finest gold.
Having constructed Nanda's residence, he traversed the settlement again,

sanskrit_iast:
rājamārgāśca vividhānsa ca cārūṃścakāra ha ..
raktabhānuvikāraiśca vedībhiśca supattanaiḥ .. 161 ..
meaning:
राजमार्गाश्च विविधान्स च चारूंश्चकार ह ..
रक्तभानुविकारैश्च वेदीभिश्च सुपत्तनैः .. 161 ..
text_mt:
and made various beautiful highways.
[adorned] with structures fashioned from red sunstone, and platforms with splendid sites,

sanskrit_iast:
pārāvāre ca parito nibandhāṃśca manoharān ..
vāṇijyārhaiśca vaṇijāṃ parito maṇimaṇḍapaiḥ .. 162 ..
meaning:
पारावारे च परितो निबन्धांश्च मनोहरान् ..
वाणिज्यार्हैश्च वणिजां परितो मणिमण्डपैः .. 162 ..
text_mt:
and on both banks around, delightful embankments,
and with jewelled pavilions suitable for merchants' commerce on every side,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato dakṣiṇe vāme jvaladbhiśca virājitān ..
tato vṛndāvanaṃ gatvā nirmame rāsamaṇḍalam..163..
meaning:
सर्वतो दक्षिणे वामे ज्वलद्भिश्च विराजितान् ..
ततो वृन्दावनं गत्वा निर्ममे रासमण्डलम्..163..
text_mt:
adorned with blazing [lights] on all sides, to the right and to the left.
Then, having gone to Vṛndāvana, he created the circular arena for the rāsa dance:

sanskrit_iast:
sundaraṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ maṇiprākārasaṃyutam ..
parito yojanāyāmaṃ maṇivedibhiranvitam .. 164 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरं मण्डलाकारं मणिप्राकारसंयुतम् ..
परितो योजनायामं मणिवेदिभिरन्वितम् .. 164 ..
text_mt:
beautiful, circular in form, endowed with an enclosure of gems,
extending one yojana all around, furnished with jewelled dais-platforms,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇisāravikāraiśca maṇḍapairnavakoṭibhiḥ ..
śṛṅgārārhaiśca citrāḍhyai ratitalpasamanvitaiḥ .. 165 ..
meaning:
मणिसारविकारैश्च मण्डपैर्नवकोटिभिः ..
शृङ्गारार्हैश्च चित्राढ्यै रतितल्पसमन्वितैः .. 165 ..
text_mt:
and with ninety million pavilions fashioned from the finest gems,
suited for amorous play, richly painted, furnished with couches for lovemaking,

sanskrit_iast:
nānājātiprasūnānāṃ vāyunā surabhīkṛtaiḥ ..
ratnapradīpasaṃyuktaiḥ suvarṇakalaśojjvalaiḥ .. 166 ..
meaning:
नानाजातिप्रसूनानां वायुना सुरभीकृतैः ..
रत्नप्रदीपसंयुक्तैः सुवर्णकलशोज्ज्वलैः .. 166 ..
text_mt:
made fragrant by the breeze of flowers of various kinds,
endowed with jewelled lamps, bright with golden pitchers,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpodyānaiḥ puṣpitaiśca sarobhiśca suśobhitam ..
rāsasthalaṃ vinirmāya jagāmānyatsthalaṃ puraḥ .. 167 ..
meaning:
पुष्पोद्यानैः पुष्पितैश्च सरोभिश्च सुशोभितम् ..
रासस्थलं विनिर्माय जगामान्यत्स्थलं पुरः .. 167 ..
text_mt:
[and] richly adorned with blooming flower gardens and lakes.
Having fashioned the place of the rāsa dance, he went further ahead to another location.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ parituṣṭo babhūva ha ..
vṛndāvanābhyantare ca sthānesthāne sunirjane .. 168 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा वृन्दावनं रम्यं परितुष्टो बभूव ह ..
वृन्दावनाभ्यन्तरे च स्थानेस्थाने सुनिर्जने .. 168 ..
text_mt:
Seeing delightful Vṛndāvana, he was exceedingly pleased.
And inside Vṛndāvana, in various places that were very secluded,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā parimitaṃ buddhyā manasālocya yatnataḥ ..
vilakṣaṇāni ramyāṇi tatra triṃśadvanāni ca .. 169 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा परिमितं बुद्ध्या मनसालोच्य यत्नतः ..
विलक्षणानि रम्याणि तत्र त्रिंशद्वनानि च .. 169 ..
text_mt:
having measured with his intellect and reflected in his mind with care,
thirty extraordinary and delightful groves there

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāmādhavayoreva krīḍārthaṃ ca vinirmame ..
tato madhuvanābhyāśe nirjane'timanohare .. 4.17.170..
meaning:
राधामाधवयोरेव क्रीडार्थं च विनिर्ममे ..
ततो मधुवनाभ्याशे निर्जनेऽतिमनोहरे .. 4.17.170..
text_mt:
he fashioned for the sporting of Rādhā and Mādhava.
Then, near Madhuvana, in a secluded and very captivating spot,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭamūlasamīpe ca sarasaḥ paścime taṭe ..
campakodyānapūrvāyāṃ ketakīvanamadhyataḥ ..171..
meaning:
वटमूलसमीपे च सरसः पश्चिमे तटे ..
चम्पकोद्यानपूर्वायां केतकीवनमध्यतः ..171..
text_mt:
near the foot of a banyan tree, on the western bank of a lake,
to the east of a campaka garden, in the midst of a ketakī forest,

sanskrit_iast:
