of the wise, of the brāhmaṇas, of the cows, and of fire with reverence.
Then, at the completion of the worship and at the sacrificial grand festival,
there arose a mighty sound of various musical instruments.
There arose cries of victory, the blast of conches, and cries of “Hari!”;
and the foremost of sages recited the auspicious sections of the Veda.
Ḍiṇḍin, the foremost of bards and dear minister of Kaṃsa,
loudly recited before them the auspicious eight-verse hymn.
Kṛṣṇa went near the mountain, assumed a separate form,
and said: “I am the mountain; I eat the offerings; choose a boon!”
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said to Nanda: “Father, look at the mountain before you!
Request a boon, and good fortune shall be yours.”
The cowherd chose as his boon servitude to Hari and devotion to Hari.
Having eaten the offerings and granted the boon, [the mountain-form] vanished.
Having fed the lordly sages and the brāhmaṇas, the cowherd
gave wealth to the bards, to the brāhmaṇas, and to the sages.
Having given gifts to the sages and also to the brāhmaṇas, Nanda, filled with joy,
went to his own abode with his attendants, placing Rāma and Kṛṣṇa at the head.
He gave silver, clothing, gold, an excellent horse, gems,
and various kinds of edible goods to the bard Ḍiṇḍin.
Having praised and bowed to Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, the sages and brāhmaṇas departed;
all the apsarases, gandharvas, and kinnaras also departed.
All the kings and cowherds who had been invited to the great festival
bowed to Śrī Kṛṣṇa and departed with reverence.
In the meantime Śakra, his lip trembling with rage,
having heard of the disruption of the sacrifice and many kinds of censures, the lord of the gods,
mounting his chariot in haste along with the Maruts and the rain-clouds,
went to Nanda’s settlement, the enchanting forest of Vṛndāvana.
All the gods followed after him, skilled in the science of warfare.

“Indra, Lord of the gods, Śakra, son of Diti [in adoptive sense], elder brother of Pavana,
the thousand-eyed, whose body has marks [of the yoni], son of Kaśyapa,
Biḍaujas, Sunāsīra, Marutvān, Pākaśāsana,
father of Jayanta, the glorious, Lord of Śacī, slayer of Daityas,
holding the thunderbolt in hand, friend of Kāma, destroyer of Gautamī’s vow,
slayer of Vṛtra, Vāsava, beggar of Dadhīci’s body,
Viṣṇu, brother of Vāmana, Puruhūta, Purandara,
Lord of the sky, Śatamakha, Sutrāman, Gotrabhid, the all-pervading,
foremost of gods, enemy of Bala, slayer of Jambha, refuge of the gods,
Saṃkrandana, Duścyavana, Turāṣāh, whose vehicle is the cloud,
Ākhaṇḍala, whose horses are tawny, destroyer of the life of Namuci,
Vṛddhaśravas, Vṛṣan, and crusher of the pride of Daityas—
these forty-six names surely destroy sin.
If a man constantly recites this hymn declared in the Kauthuma recension,
Śakra, bearing the thunderbolt in his hand, protects him in great danger.

text_mt:
From torrential rain, hail, and the terrible fall of thunderbolts,
he has no fear at any time; Vāsava himself is his protector.
In whichever house this hymn is present, and whichever virtuous person knows it,
no thunderbolt strikes there, nor does hailstorm fall, O Nārada.”
Hearing the hymn from Nanda's mouth, Madhusūdana became angry.
Blazing with the splendour of Brahman, he spoke words of wisdom to his father:
“Whom do you praise, timid one? Who is Indra? Cast aside fear in my presence!
In half a moment, I am able to reduce [him] to ashes with effortless ease.
Placing the cows, calves, boys, and women who are stricken with fear
in the cavity of Govardhana, remain without fear!”
Hearing the child's words, filled with joy, he did just that.
Hari held up that mountain with his left hand like a staff.
In the meantime there, though glowing with the brilliance of jewels,
everything suddenly became blinded, enveloped in dust.
A mass of clouds accompanied by wind covered the sky, O sage.

In Vṛndāvana, torrential rain poured down incessantly,
with a shower of stones, a shower of thunderbolts, and the terrible fall of meteors.
Everything, upon touching the mountain, fell far away from it.
His undertaking was rendered fruitless, like the effort of a powerless man, O sage.
Seeing all that become in vain, Śakra immediately grew enraged.
He seized the unfailing thunderbolt fashioned from the bones of Dadhīci.
Seeing him with the thunderbolt in his hand, Madhusūdana laughed.
He paralysed the terrible thunderbolt along with the hand [that held it].

two-armed, flute in hand, adorned with jewelled ornaments,
clad in yellow garments, seated on a throne of gems, / his face bright with a gentle smile, eager to show grace to his devotees,
all his limbs anointed with sandalwood paste—[he saw] this entire moving and unmoving universe [as him].
Beholding this most wondrous sight there, he immediately swooned away.
Right there he muttered the mantra previously bestowed by his guru.
He beheld a dazzling light situated in a thousand-petalled lotus,
and within it a divine form, exceedingly captivating to the mind,

Hearing Indra's words, the abode of Śrī was pleased. // 200
Having affectionately granted him a boon, he set down the mountain.
Bowing to Hari, Śakra departed along with his retinue. // 1
All the people inside the cave went from the cave to their homes;
they all considered Kṛṣṇa to be the most complete, all-pervading Lord. // 2

Nanda praised his son, the complete eternal Brahman,
his whole body bristling with horripilation, his eyes full of tears of devotion.

how could it ever be equal to half a moment of fellowship with your devotees?
He who is your devotee is like you; who has the power to fathom you?
By mere conversation for half a moment, he is able to bring [one] across [the worldly ocean].
From fellowship with devotees, there certainly arises [the ability] to practice manifold devotion.
It grows by the sprinkling of water that is the speech of the cloud that is your devotee,
but from the heat of talking with non-devotees, it withers at that very moment.
And from the sprinkling of the remembrance of your qualities, it manifestly grows at that moment.
The sprout of devotion to you, once born, expands greatly in the mind.
It must not be destroyed; it must be nurtured always, always, moment by moment.
Then, having attained the state of Brahman, for the life of the devotee,
[the Lord] truly grants him the fruit, the unsurpassed servitude to Hari.

इह सौभरिणा दत्तं तस्मै तुष्टेन पुष्करे ..

ब्रह्मणोंऽशेन मुनिना नन्दाय च तपस्यते ..

text_mt:
that very rare hymn of praise was given to him long ago by Brahmā,
[along with] Hari’s six-syllable mantra and the armour that protects all.
Here it was given at Puṣkara by the pleased Saubhari to him—
that very armour, the hymn of praise, and that very rare mantra—
by that sage, an aṃśa of Brahmā, to Nanda as he was performing austerities.
The mantra, the hymn of praise, the armour, the chosen deity, and the guru—

and my death was declared by the sage to be from you, O Lord of the universe! (39)

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśāreṇa cakreṇa sutīkṣṇenātitejasā ..
jahi māṃ jagatāṃ nātha sadbhaktiṃ kuru mokṣada ..4.22.40..
meaning:
षोडशारेण चक्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेनातितेजसा ..
जहि मां जगतां नाथ सद्भक्तिं कुरु मोक्षद ..4.22.40..
text_mt:
With your sixteen-spoked discus, exceedingly sharp and immensely brilliant,
slay me, O Lord of the worlds, and grant true devotion, O giver of liberation! (40)

sanskrit_iast:
tvamaṃśena varāhaśca samuddhartuṃ vasundharām ..
vedānāṃ rakṣitā nātha hiraṇyākṣaniṣūdanaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
त्वमंशेन वराहश्च समुद्धर्तुं वसुन्धराम् ..
वेदानां रक्षिता नाथ हिरण्याक्षनिषूदनः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
You were also the Boar in a portion to uplift the earth,
the protector of the Vedas, O Lord, the slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa. (41)

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇo hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe ..
prahrādānugrahārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca .. .. 42 ..
meaning:
त्वं नृसिंहः स्वयं पूर्णो हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधे ..
प्रह्रादानुग्रहार्थाय देवानां रक्षणाय च .. .. 42 ..
text_mt:
You yourself were Nṛsiṃha in fullness at the slaying of Hiraṇyakaśipu,
for the sake of bestowing grace upon Prahrāda and for the protection of the gods. (42)

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca vedoddhārakartā mīnāṃśena dayānidhe ..
nṛpasya jñānadānāya rakṣāyai suraviprayoḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
त्वं च वेदोद्धारकर्ता मीनांशेन दयानिधे ..
नृपस्य ज्ञानदानाय रक्षायै सुरविप्रयोः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
And you were the rescuer of the Vedas through a portion as the Fish, O ocean of compassion,
to bestow knowledge upon the king and to protect the gods and the brāhmaṇa. (43)

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣādhāraśca kūrmastvamaṃśena sṛṣṭihetave ..
viśvādhāraśca viśvastvamaṃśenāpi sahasradhṛk ..44..
meaning:
शेषाधारश्च कूर्मस्त्वमंशेन सृष्टिहेतवे ..
विश्वाधारश्च विश्वस्त्वमंशेनापि सहस्रधृक् ..44..
text_mt:
And you were the Tortoise, the support of Śeṣa, in a portion for the purpose of creation;
and you are the support of the universe and the universe itself, the thousand-bearer, through a portion. (44)

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo dāśarathistvaṃ ca jānakyuddhārahetave ..
daśakandharahantā ca sindhau setuvidhāyakaḥ ..45..
meaning:
रामो दाशरथिस्त्वं च जानक्युद्धारहेतवे ..
दशकन्धरहन्ता च सिन्धौ सेतुविधायकः ..45..
text_mt:
And you were Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, for the purpose of rescuing Jānakī,
the slayer of the ten-necked [Rāvaṇa], the builder of the bridge across the ocean. (45)

sanskrit_iast:
kalayā paraśurāmaśca jamadagnisuto mahān ..
triḥsaptakṛtvo bhūpānāṃ nihantā jagatīpate .. 46 ..
meaning:
कलया परशुरामश्च जमदग्निसुतो महान् ..
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो भूपानां निहन्ता जगतीपते .. 46 ..
text_mt:
And as Paraśurāma by a part, the great son of Jamadagni,
the slayer of the kings thrice seven times, O Lord of the earth! (46)

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena kapilastvaṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca gurorguruḥ ..
mātṛjñānapradātā ca yogaśāstravidhāyakaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
अंशेन कपिलस्त्वं च सिद्धानां च गुरोर्गुरुः ..
मातृज्ञानप्रदाता च योगशास्त्रविधायकः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
And you were Kapila through a portion, the guru of the guru of the perfected ones,
the giver of knowledge to your mother, the author of the treatise on Yoga. (47)

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena jñānināṃ śreṣṭho naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
tvaṃ ca dharmasuto bhūtvā lokavistārakārakaḥ ..48..
meaning:
अंशेन ज्ञानिनां श्रेष्ठो नरनारायणावृषी ..
त्वं च धर्मसुतो भूत्वा लोकविस्तारकारकः ..48..
text_mt:
Through a portion, [you became] the two sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa, the best of the wise;
and becoming the son of Dharma, you expanded the worlds. (48)

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā kṛṣṇarūpastvaṃ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ..
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ bījarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
अधुना कृष्णरूपस्त्वं परिपूर्णतमः स्वयम् ..
सर्वेषामवताराणां बीजरूपः सनातनः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Now, you are in the form of Kṛṣṇa, the most complete yourself,
the eternal seed-form of all incarnations, (49)

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodājīvano nityo nandaikānandavardhanaḥ ..
prāṇādhidevo gopīnāṃ rādhāprāṇādhikapriyaḥ ..4.22.50..
meaning:
यशोदाजीवनो नित्यो नन्दैकानन्दवर्धनः ..
प्राणाधिदेवो गोपीनां राधाप्राणाधिकप्रियः ..4.22.50..
text_mt:
the life of Yaśodā, eternal, the sole increaser of Nanda's joy,
the presiding deity of the life-breaths of the gopīs, dearer to Rādhā than her own life-breath, (50)

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevasutaḥ śānto devakīduḥkhabhañjanaḥ ..
ayonisaṃbhavaḥ śrīmānpṛthivībhārahārakaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
वसुदेवसुतः शान्तो देवकीदुःखभञ्जनः ..
अयोनिसंभवः श्रीमान्पृथिवीभारहारकः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
the son of Vasudeva, serene, the shatterer of Devakī's sorrow,
not born of a womb, glorious, the remover of the earth's burden, (51)

sanskrit_iast:
pūtanāyai mātṛgatiṃ pradātā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
bakakeśipralambānāṃ mamāpi mokṣakārakaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
पूतनायै मातृगतिं प्रदाता च कृपानिधिः ..
बककेशिप्रलम्बानां ममापि मोक्षकारकः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
the giver of the state of a mother to Pūtanā, an ocean of mercy,
the cause of liberation for Baka, Keśin, and Pralamba, and for me as well. (52)

sanskrit_iast:
svecchāmaya guṇātīta bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana ..
prasīda rādhikānātha prasīda kuru mokṣaṇam .. ..53..
meaning:
स्वेच्छामय गुणातीत भक्तानां भयभञ्जन ..
प्रसीद राधिकानाथ प्रसीद कुरु मोक्षणम् .. ..53..
text_mt:
O you whose will is your only law, beyond the gunas, shatterer of the fear of devotees,
be gracious, O Lord of Rādhikā, be gracious, grant release! (53)

sanskrit_iast:
he nātha gārdabhīyoneḥ samuddhara bhavārṇavāt..
mūrkhastvadbhaktaputro'haṃ māmuddhartuṃ tvamarhasi .. 54 ..
meaning:
हे नाथ गार्दभीयोनेः समुद्धर भवार्णवात्..
मूर्खस्त्वद्भक्तपुत्रोऽहं मामुद्धर्तुं त्वमर्हसि .. 54 ..
text_mt:
O Lord, deliver me from the womb of a donkey, from the ocean of worldly existence!
I am a fool, the son of your devotee; you ought to deliver me. (54)

sanskrit_iast:
vedā brahmādayo yaṃ ca munīndrāḥ stotumakṣamāḥ ..
kiṃ staumi taṃ guṇātītaṃ purā daityo'dhunā kharaḥ ..55..
meaning:
वेदा ब्रह्मादयो यं च मुनीन्द्राः स्तोतुमक्षमाः ..
किं स्तौमि तं गुणातीतं पुरा दैत्योऽधुना खरः ..55..
text_mt:
He whom the Vedas, Brahmā and the others, and the foremost sages are unable to praise,
how can I praise him, beyond the gunas—I, formerly a Daitya, now an ass? (55)

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kuru kṛpāsindho yena me na bhavejjanuḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā pādāravindaṃ te kaḥ punarbhavanaṃ vrajet ..56..
meaning:
एवं कुरु कृपासिन्धो येन मे न भवेज्जनुः ..
दृष्ट्वा पादारविन्दं ते कः पुनर्भवनं व्रजेत् ..56..
text_mt:
Act thus, O ocean of mercy, so that I may have no rebirth!"
Having seen your lotus feet, who would return to worldly existence?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā stotā kharaḥ stotā nopahāsitumarhasi..
sadīśvarasya vijñasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā .. 57 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा स्तोता खरः स्तोता नोपहासितुमर्हसि..
सदीश्वरस्य विज्ञस्य योग्यायोग्ये समा कृपा .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā is a praiser, an ass is a praiser—you ought not to mock [me].
To the true Lord who is omniscient, grace is equal toward the worthy and the unworthy.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā daityendrastasthau ca purato hareḥ ..
prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānatituṣṭo babhūva ha ..58..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा दैत्येन्द्रस्तस्थौ च पुरतो हरेः ..
प्रसन्नवदनः श्रीमानतितुष्टो बभूव ह ..58..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the lord of the Daityas stood before Hari;
with a cheerful face and glorious, he became exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ daityakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ..
sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyaṃ līlayā labhate hareḥ..59..
meaning:
इदं दैत्यकृतं स्तोत्रं नित्यं भक्त्या च यः पठेत् ..
सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसामीप्यं लीलया लभते हरेः..59..
text_mt:
Whoever recites daily with devotion this hymn of praise composed by the Daitya,
effortlessly attains residence in Hari's realm, equal power, and proximity to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ sudurlabham..
vidyāṃ śriyaṃ sukavitāṃ putrapautrānyaśo labhet .. 4.22.60 ..
meaning:
इह लोके हरेर्भक्तिमन्ते दास्यं सुदुर्लभम्..
विद्यां श्रियं सुकवितां पुत्रपौत्रान्यशो लभेत् .. 4.22.60 ..
text_mt:
In this world [he attains] devotion to Hari, and in the end very rare servitude [to him];
he obtains knowledge, fortune, poetic skill, sons, grandsons, and fame.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śrutvā'numene daityendrastavanaṃ karuṇānidhiḥ ..
kathaṃ karomi saṃhāramīdṛśaṃ bhaktamityaho .. ..61..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
श्रुत्वाऽनुमेने दैत्येन्द्रस्तवनं करुणानिधिः ..
कथं करोमि संहारमीदृशं भक्तमित्यहो .. ..61..
text_mt:
Hearing [it], the storehouse of compassion approved the praise by the lord of the Daityas;
“How can I bring about the destruction of such a devotee? Ah!”

sanskrit_iast:
anumanya smṛtiṃ tasya saṃjahāra hariḥ svayam ..
na hi yukto vadhaḥ stoturdurvakturvidhirīśvarāt ..62..
meaning:
अनुमन्य स्मृतिं तस्य संजहार हरिः स्वयम् ..
न हि युक्तो वधः स्तोतुर्दुर्वक्तुर्विधिरीश्वरात् ..62..
text_mt:
Having approved, Hari himself took away his recollection;
for the killing of a praiser is not proper—an ordained act from the Lord applies to a wicked speaker.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavo māyayā viṣṇorvisasmāra punaḥ svakam..
duruktistatkaṇṭhadeśe hyadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha..63..
meaning:
दानवो मायया विष्णोर्विसस्मार पुनः स्वकम्..
दुरुक्तिस्तत्कण्ठदेशे ह्यधिष्ठानं चकार ह..63..
text_mt:
Through Viṣṇu's māyā, the Dānava forgot his own [state] once again;
indeed, harsh speech took up residence in the region of his throat.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca śrīhariṃ daityaḥ kopātprasphuritādharaḥ ..
mune sadyo martukāmo daivagrasto vicetanaḥ ..64..
meaning:
उवाच श्रीहरिं दैत्यः कोपात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः ..
मुने सद्यो मर्तुकामो दैवग्रस्तो विचेतनः ..64..
text_mt:
With his lip quivering in anger, the Daitya spoke to Śrī Hari,
O sage, desiring immediate death, seized by fate, and devoid of sense:

sanskrit_iast:
daitya uvāca.. dhruvaṃ tvaṃ martukāmo'si durbuddhe mānavārbhaka ..
adya prasthāpayiṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ yamamandiram .. ..65..
meaning:
दैत्य उवाच.. ध्रुवं त्वं मर्तुकामोऽसि दुर्बुद्धे मानवार्भक ..
अद्य प्रस्थापयिष्यामि त्वामहं यममन्दिरम् .. ..65..
text_mt:
The Daitya said: / “Certainly you wish to die, O evil-minded human boy!
Today I will dispatch you to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāsi jīvanākāṅkṣī mama tālavanaṃ śiśo..
na yāsyasi punargehaṃ bāndhavaṃ na hi drakṣyasi ..66..
meaning:
आयासि जीवनाकाङ्क्षी मम तालवनं शिशो..
न यास्यसि पुनर्गेहं बान्धवं न हि द्रक्ष्यसि ..66..
text_mt:
Desiring your life, did you come to my palm forest, boy?
You shall not return to your home, nor indeed will you see your relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
na kaṃso na jarāsandho narako na samo mama ..
devāḥ kampanti me nityaṃ ke cānye matsamā bhuvi ..67..
meaning:
न कंसो न जरासन्धो नरको न समो मम ..
देवाः कम्पन्ति मे नित्यं के चान्ये मत्समा भुवि ..67..
text_mt:
Neither Kaṃsa, nor Jarāsandha, nor Naraka is equal to me.
The gods tremble before me constantly; and who else on earth is my equal?

sanskrit_iast:
nahi saṃhārakartā ca māṃ saṃhartuṃ kṣamaḥ śivaḥ ..
na ca brahmā na viṣṇuśca na mṛtyuḥ kāla eva ca ..68..
meaning:
नहि संहारकर्ता च मां संहर्तुं क्षमः शिवः ..
न च ब्रह्मा न विष्णुश्च न मृत्युः काल एव च ..68..
text_mt:
Even Śiva, the author of destruction, is not capable of destroying me,
nor Brahmā, nor Viṣṇu, nor death, nor Time itself.

sanskrit_iast:
mama tālatarūnbhaṅktvā pātayitvā phalāni ca ..
ahaṃkaroṣi sahasā kimaho kasya tejasā .. 69 ..
meaning:
मम तालतरून्भङ्क्त्वा पातयित्वा फलानि च ..
अहंकरोषि सहसा किमहो कस्य तेजसा .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Having broken my palm trees and knocked down the fruits,
why, ah, by whose prowess do you suddenly act with arrogance?

sanskrit_iast:
kastvaṃ vada baṭo satyaṃ kamanīyo'tisundaraḥ ..
durlabhaṃ jīvanaṃ dātuṃ mahyaṃ kathamihāgataḥ ..4.22.70 ..
meaning:
कस्त्वं वद बटो सत्यं कमनीयोऽतिसुन्दरः ..
दुर्लभं जीवनं दातुं मह्यं कथमिहागतः ..4.22.70 ..
text_mt:
Speak the truth, boy, who are you, so lovely and exceedingly handsome?
How have you come here to give up your life, which is hard to obtain?”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā mastake kṛtvā prerayitvā tu taṃ balī ..
dūrataḥ pātayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maraṇonmukhaḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा मस्तके कृत्वा प्रेरयित्वा तु तं बली ..
दूरतः पातयामास श्रीकृष्णं मरणोन्मुखः .. 71 ..
text_mt:
Having said this, the mighty one placed [him] on his head, propelled him,
and hurled Śrī Kṛṣṇa far away, heading toward his own death.

sanskrit_iast:
pātayitvā ca taṃ bhūmau viṣāṇābhyāṃ jaghāna saḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa tadviṣāṇe babhañjatuḥ ..72..
meaning:
पातयित्वा च तं भूमौ विषाणाभ्यां जघान सः ..
कृष्णाङ्गस्पर्शमात्रेण तद्विषाणे बभञ्जतुः ..72..
text_mt:
And having thrown him down onto the ground, he struck him with his two horns;
at the mere touch of Kṛṣṇa's limb, those two horns broke.

sanskrit_iast:
daityo bhagnaviṣāṇaśca tamīśaṃ kopayanmune ..
jagrāsa carvaṇaṃ kartuṃ bhagnadanto babhūva ha .. 73 ..
meaning:
दैत्यो भग्नविषाणश्च तमीशं कोपयन्मुने ..
जग्रास चर्वणं कर्तुं भग्नदन्तो बभूव ह .. 73 ..
text_mt:
His horns broken, the Daitya, enraging the Lord, O sage,
swallowed him to chew him, but his teeth broke.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā dagdhavaktraśca tamujjagrāha tatkṣaṇe ..
jajvāla vyathitaḥ kopāddadāra khurato mahīm .. 74 ..
meaning:
तेजसा दग्धवक्त्रश्च तमुज्जग्राह तत्क्षणे ..
जज्वाल व्यथितः कोपाद्ददार खुरतो महीम् .. 74 ..
text_mt:
His mouth burnt by [Kṛṣṇa's] splendor, he vomited him out at that moment;
agonized, he blazed with rage, and tore the earth with his hoof.

sanskrit_iast:
cūrṇayitvā tu lāṃgūlaṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam ..
sa jagāma śiśusthānaṃ dudruvurbālakā bhiyā .. 79..
meaning:
चूर्णयित्वा तु लांगूलं शब्दं कृत्वा भयानकम् ..
स जगाम शिशुस्थानं दुद्रुवुर्बालका भिया .. 79..
text_mt:
Thrashing his tail and making a terrifying sound,
he went to the place of the children; the boys ran away in fear.

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ ca prerayāmāsa mastakena mahābalī ..
balo muṣṭiṃ dadau tasmai mūrcchāmāpa tato'suraḥ ..76..
meaning:
बलं च प्रेरयामास मस्तकेन महाबली ..
बलो मुष्टिं ददौ तस्मै मूर्च्छामाप ततोऽसुरः ..76..
text_mt:
The very powerful one charged Bala with his head;
Bala struck him with his fist; thereupon the Asura fell unconscious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya jagāma harisannidhim ..
balamuṣṭyā ca vyathitaḥ punarmūrcchāmavāpa saḥ .. 77 ..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य जगाम हरिसन्निधिम् ..
बलमुष्ट्या च व्यथितः पुनर्मूर्च्छामवाप सः .. 77 ..
text_mt:
Recovering consciousness in an instant, he went into the presence of Hari;
pained by Bala's fist, he fainted once again.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau vyathākulaḥ ..
utsasarja bṛhalleḍaṃ mūtraṃ ca bhayamāpa ha ..78..
meaning:
पुनश्च चेतनां प्राप्य समुत्तस्थौ व्यथाकुलः ..
उत्ससर्ज बृहल्लेडं मूत्रं च भयमाप ह ..78..
text_mt:
And regaining consciousness again, he rose up, agitated with pain;
he discharged copious dung and urine, and felt fear.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇātsaṃdhikṣaṇaṃ prāpya mahābalaparākramaḥ ..
kṛtvā śirasi govindaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa dānavaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
क्षणात्संधिक्षणं प्राप्य महाबलपराक्रमः ..
कृत्वा शिरसि गोविन्दं चूर्णयामास दानवः .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Finding an opening after a moment, endowed with great strength and valor,
the Dānava placed Govinda on his head and crushed him;

sanskrit_iast:
pātayāmāsa bhūmau taṃ cūrṇayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
utpāṭya tālavṛkṣaṃ taṃ tāḍayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ..4.22.80..
meaning:
पातयामास भूमौ तं चूर्णयित्वा पुनःपुनः ..
उत्पाट्य तालवृक्षं तं ताडयामास माधवः ..4.22.80..
text_mt:
having crushed him repeatedly, he threw him down onto the ground.
Uprooting a palm tree, Mādhava struck him.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā khaḍgaprahāreṇa dānavasya bhavedvyathā ..
tathā babhūva daityasya tālavṛkṣasya tāḍanāt ..81.. .
meaning:
यथा खड्गप्रहारेण दानवस्य भवेद्व्यथा ..
तथा बभूव दैत्यस्य तालवृक्षस्य ताडनात् ..81.. .
text_mt:
Just as pain would be caused to a Dānava by the blow of a sword,
so it happened to the Daitya from the strike of the palm tree. / Uprooting Govardhana, the Lord struck him;

sanskrit_iast:
govardhanaṃ samutpāṭya ghātayāmāsa taṃ vibhuḥ ..
papāta vegācchailendrastasyopari mahāmune ..82..
meaning:
गोवर्धनं समुत्पाट्य घातयामास तं विभुः ..
पपात वेगाच्छैलेन्द्रस्तस्योपरि महामुने ..82..
text_mt: the king of mountains fell with speed upon him, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatasya prahāreṇa mūrcchāmāpa mahābalaḥ.. .
babhūva jarjarāṅgaśca rudhiraṃ ca samudvaman .. 83 ..
meaning:
पर्वतस्य प्रहारेण मूर्च्छामाप महाबलः.. .
बभूव जर्जराङ्गश्च रुधिरं च समुद्वमन् .. 83 ..
text_mt: Under the blow of the mountain, the very powerful one fainted; / his limbs were battered, and he vomited blood.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau ruṣā'suraḥ ..
gṛhītvā parvataśreṣṭhaṃ prerayāmāsa mādhavam . .. 84 ..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य समुत्तस्थौ रुषाऽसुरः ..
गृहीत्वा पर्वतश्रेष्ठं प्रेरयामास माधवम् . .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Recovering consciousness in an instant, the Asura rose up in anger;
seizing the excellent mountain, he hurled it at Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śailamutpatantaṃ vegena madhusūdanaḥ ..
jagrāha dakṣiṇakare yathekṣudaṇḍavatprabhuḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शैलमुत्पतन्तं वेगेन मधुसूदनः ..
जग्राह दक्षिणकरे यथेक्षुदण्डवत्प्रभुः .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Seeing the mountain flying swiftly, Madhusūdana,
the Lord, caught it in his right hand like a stalk of sugarcane;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasthāne parvataṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsa kautukāt ..
gṛhītvā daityakarṇāgraṃ pātayāmāsa dūrataḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
पूर्वस्थाने पर्वतं तं स्थापयामास कौतुकात् ..
गृहीत्वा दैत्यकर्णाग्रं पातयामास दूरतः .. 86 ..
text_mt:
he placed that mountain in its former location in sport;
and grasping the tip of the Daitya's ear, he threw him far away.

sanskrit_iast:
utpatya ca mahāvegāccakāra veṣṭanaṃ hareḥ ..
pṛthivīṃ gharṣayāmāsa tīkṣṇāgreṇa khureṇa ca .. 87 ..
meaning:
उत्पत्य च महावेगाच्चकार वेष्टनं हरेः ..
पृथिवीं घर्षयामास तीक्ष्णाग्रेण खुरेण च .. 87 ..
text_mt:
And springing up with great speed, he encircled Hari;
he scraped the earth with his sharp-pointed hoof.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya śrīhariṃ vegātkṛtvā mūrdhni mahāsuraḥ ..
utpapāta manoyāyī līlayā lakṣayojanam .. 88 ..
meaning:
प्रगृह्य श्रीहरिं वेगात्कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि महासुरः ..
उत्पपात मनोयायी लीलया लक्षयोजनम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
Seizing Śrī Hari swiftly and placing him upon his head, the great asura,
traveling at the speed of thought, flew up easily a hundred thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
praharaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ nirlakṣe ca babhūva ha ..
tato gṛhītvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ papāta dharaṇītale .. 89 ..
meaning:
प्रहरं च तयोर्युद्धं निर्लक्षे च बभूव ह ..
ततो गृहीत्वा श्रीकृष्णं पपात धरणीतले .. 89 ..
text_mt:
And their battle took place out of sight for a prahara.
Then, holding Śrī Kṛṣṇa, he fell down to the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
punarmuhūrtaṃ yuddhaṃ ca babhūva bhūtale tayoḥ ..
mudā hariḥ praśaśaṃsa prahasya dānaveśvaram .. 4.22.90 ..
meaning:
पुनर्मुहूर्तं युद्धं च बभूव भूतले तयोः ..
मुदा हरिः प्रशशंस प्रहस्य दानवेश्वरम् .. 4.22.90 ..
text_mt:
Again, a battle between the two occurred on the earth for a muhūrta.
Hari with joy praised the lord of the Dānavas, laughing gently:

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktasya baleḥ putraṃ dhanyaṃ tajjīvanaṃ param..
svastyastu te dānavendra vatsa nirvāṇatāṃ vraja .. 91 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्तस्य बलेः पुत्रं धन्यं तज्जीवनं परम्..
स्वस्त्यस्तु ते दानवेन्द्र वत्स निर्वाणतां व्रज .. 91 ..
text_mt:
“O son of Bali, my devotee! Blessed, supremely so, is his life.
Hail to you, O lord of the Dānavas! Go, my child, to the state of nirvāṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
maddarśanaṃ svastibījaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam ..
sarvādhikaṃ sarvaparaṃ labha sthānaṃ manoharam .. 92 ..
meaning:
मद्दर्शनं स्वस्तिबीजं परं निर्वाणकारणम् ..
सर्वाधिकं सर्वपरं लभ स्थानं मनोहरम् .. 92 ..
text_mt:
The sight of me is the seed of auspiciousness, the supreme cause of nirvāṇa.
Attain that charming abode, superior to all, beyond all!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sasmāra cakramuttamam ..
sūryakoṭisamaṃ dīptyā jagrāha tatsudarśanam ..93..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा श्रीकृष्णः सस्मार चक्रमुत्तमम् ..
सूर्यकोटिसमं दीप्त्या जग्राह तत्सुदर्शनम् ..93..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Śrī Kṛṣṇa remembered his excellent discus.
Equal to ten million suns in radiance, he took up that Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa bhrāmayitvā ca ṣoḍaśāramanuttamam ..
ciccheda līlayā'vadhyaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ .. 94 ..
meaning:
चिक्षेप भ्रामयित्वा च षोडशारमनुत्तमम् ..
चिच्छेद लीलयाऽवध्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरैः .. 94 ..
text_mt:
And having whirled that unexcelled sixteen-spoked [discus], he hurled it;
with ease he severed him who was invulnerable to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
papāta mastakaṃ bhūmau dānavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
tejaḥsamūha uttasthau śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ.. 95 ..
meaning:
पपात मस्तकं भूमौ दानवस्य महात्मनः ..
तेजःसमूह उत्तस्थौ शतसूर्यसमप्रभः.. 95 ..
text_mt:
The head of that great-souled Dānava fell upon the earth.
A mass of splendor arose, with brilliance like a hundred suns;

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya harilokaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇapadāmbuje ..
saṃprāpya paramaṃ mokṣamaho dānavapuṅgavaḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
विलोक्य हरिलोकं संश्लिष्टं कृष्णपदाम्बुजे ..
संप्राप्य परमं मोक्षमहो दानवपुङ्गवः .. 96 ..
text_mt:
beholding the realm of Hari, it merged into the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
Ah, that foremost of Dānavas attained supreme liberation!

sanskrit_iast:
gaganasthāḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca bhṛśaṃ mudā ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ cakruste tatra varṣaṇam ..97..
meaning:
गगनस्थाः सुराः सर्वे मुनयश्च भृशं मुदा ..
पारिजातप्रसूनानां चक्रुस्ते तत्र वर्षणम् ..97..
text_mt:
All the gods in the sky and the sages, filled with great joy,
made a rain of pārijāta blossoms upon that spot.

sanskrit_iast:
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..
jagurgandharvanikarā stuṣṭuvurmunayo mudā .. 98 ..
meaning:
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ..
जगुर्गन्धर्वनिकरा स्तुष्टुवुर्मुनयो मुदा .. 98 ..
text_mt:
Drums sounded in heaven, and troops of Apsarases danced;
multitudes of Gandharvas sang, and sages joyfully praised [him].

sanskrit_iast:
stutvā jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve munayo harṣavihvalāḥ ..
dhenukasya vadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrājagmuśca bālakāḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
स्तुत्वा जग्मुः सुराः सर्वे मुनयो हर्षविह्वलाः ..
धेनुकस्य वधं दृष्ट्वा तत्राजग्मुश्च बालकाः .. 99 ..
text_mt:
Having offered praise, all the gods and sages went away, overwhelmed with joy.
Seeing the slaying of Dhenuka, the boys came there.

sanskrit_iast:
balaśca balināṃ śreṣṭhastuṣṭāva puruṣottamam ..
tuṣṭuvurbālakāḥ sarve nanṛtuśca mudā'nvitāḥ .. 4.22.100 ..
meaning:
बलश्च बलिनां श्रेष्ठस्तुष्टाव पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
तुष्टुवुर्बालकाः सर्वे ननृतुश्च मुदाऽन्विताः .. 4.22.100 ..
text_mt:
And Bala, the best of the strong, praised Puruṣottama.
All the boys praised [him] and danced, filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā kṛṣṇabalābhyāṃ ca prapakvāni phalāni ca ..
sarvāṇi bhakṣayāmāsurbālāḥ prahaṣṭamānasāḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा कृष्णबलाभ्यां च प्रपक्वानि फलानि च ..
सर्वाणि भक्षयामासुर्बालाः प्रहष्टमानसाः .. 101 ..
text_mt:
Having offered the fully ripe fruits to Kṛṣṇa and Bala,
the boys, their minds exceedingly delighted, ate them all.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā pītvā hariḥ śīghraṃ balena bālakaiḥ saha ..
jagāma svālayaṃ brahmannihatya dānaveśvaram..102..
.. 22 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वा पीत्वा हरिः शीघ्रं बलेन बालकैः सह ..
जगाम स्वालयं ब्रह्मन्निहत्य दानवेश्वरम्..102..
.. 22 ..
text_mt:
Having eaten and drunk, Hari quickly, together with Bala and the boys,
went to his own home, O sage, having slain the lord of the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca ..
kena pāpena balijo gardabhatvamavāpa ha ..
durvāsāḥ kena doṣeṇa śaśāpa dānaveśvaram .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच ..
केन पापेन बलिजो गर्दभत्वमवाप ह ..
दुर्वासाः केन दोषेण शशाप दानवेश्वरम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Nārada said:
“By what sin did the son of Bali attain the form of an ass?
For what fault did Durvāsas curse the lord of the Dānavas? / 1
Or by what merit, O Lord, did that mighty chief of the Dānavas
attain the abode of Śrī Hari and immediate liberation of oneness? / 2
O sage, dispel my doubts and tell everything in full detail.
Ah, in the mouth of a poet, poetry is ever fresh at every step!” / 3
Śrī Nārāyaṇa said:
“Listen, my child, I shall narrate the ancient history
formerly heard from the mouth of Dharma on Mount Gandhamādana, / 4
an account from the Pādma kalpa, wondrous and very charming,
imbued with tales of Nārāyaṇa, supreme nectar to the ears. / 5
In the kalpa wherein this tale occurred, you were Upabarhaṇa,
living for an entire kalpa, glorious, handsome, endowed with perpetual youth, / 6
the husband of fifty passionate women, intent on amorous delights;
and by a boon from Brahmā, you had a sweet voice, a master of singers. / 7
Incessantly, those women drank in your handsome lotus-face,
all of them never blinking, tormented by the arrows of love. / 8
You were, as it were, fashioned by the Creator out of their life-breaths, so it is heard;
as your companions day and night, they could not live without you. / 9
In flower gardens and in secret, in charming place after place,
in the caves of mountains, in chasms and by rivers, / 10
in delightful forests and in graveyards devoid of living beings,
they engaged in amorous play with you according to their desire. / 11
Then, by fate and through a curse of the Creator, you became the son of a maidservant;
now you are the son of Brahmā, due to eating the remnants of a Vaiṣṇava's food, / 12
living for countless kalpas, a great and foremost Vaiṣṇava,
all-seeing through the vision of knowledge, and a dear disciple of Dhūrjaṭi. / 13
O sage, hear from me the account of that kalpa;
I shall tell you at length the nectar-like story of the Daitya. / 14
Once, indeed, the mighty son of Bali, named Sāhasika…”
title: Tilottamābaliputrayorbrahmaśāpaprastāvaḥ

श्रीनारायण उवाच ..

meaning:

नारायणकथोपेतं कर्णपीयूषमुत्तमम् .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yatra kalpe kathā ceyaṃ tatra tvamupabarhaṇaḥ ..
ākalpajīvī saśrīkaḥ sundaraḥ sthirayauvanaḥ .. 6 ..

यत्र कल्पे कथा चेयं तत्र त्वमुपबर्हणः ..

text_mt: In that kalpa where this story took place, you were Upabarhaṇa,

वरेण ब्रह्मणस्त्वं च सुकण्ठो गायनेश्वरः .. 7 ..

text_mt: Having conquered the gods with his own splendor, he set out for Mount Gandhamādana. / His entire body was anointed with sandal-paste, and he was adorned with jeweled ornaments. / Seated on a jeweled throne, he was accompanied by a vast army. / Meanwhile, along that path went Tilottamā, / the best of apsarases in beauty, assuming various attire. / She had the lovely complexion of a campaka flower, was adorned with jeweled ornaments, / endowed with fresh youth, and afflicted by the arrows of Kāma. / With a gentle smile and a serene face, wearing splendid divine garments, / she walked with curved brows, moving slowly like a noble elephant. / Seeing her breasts, thighs, and moon-like face as her garment was displaced by the wind, the daring young man fell into a swoon. / She beheld the son of Bali, exceedingly handsome, / wearing a garland of blooming mālatī flowers, in his fresh youth, / with a face like the full moon of autumn, smiling sweetly and charming the mind. / Seeing him, she was astonished and, out of passion, cast a sidelong glance. / Going to the realm of Candra for sport, desiring Candra, / she stopped under some pretext, intoxicated and longing for erotic pleasure. / Constantly looking at his face and laughing with curved glances, / she covered her face again and again with her garment. / Her entire body bristled with thrill; though endowed with righteous deeds, / being mad with lust, there arose itching and moisture in her yoni. / Yearning for Bali's son, she forgot the moon. / Ah, who in the world knows the unsearchable mind of an unchaste woman? / He who trusts an unchaste woman is mocked by fate, / and is cast out from fame, from righteousness, and from his own family. / Having obtained a new object of desire, the old one perishes; / then, guided only by her own purpose, who is dear or not dear to her? / In religious rites for the gods, in rites for the ancestors, towards a son, a kinsman, or a husband— / an unchaste woman's heart is cruel, always fixed on the act of love.

रत्नप्रदं रत्नविज्ञं विषदृष्ट्या हि पश्यति .. 4.23.30 ..
text_mt: With an affectionate gaze, the unchaste woman looks upon one skilled in lovemaking who is dearer to her than life; / but with a venomous look she regards one who gives jewels and knows the value of jewels. / For all others there is a place, but for unchaste women there is none anywhere; / the race of unchaste women is even more terrible than murderers of men. / At the end of experiencing the fruits of all deeds, there is certainly deliverance for everyone; / but for unchaste women, O best of brahmins, there is none as long as the moon and the sun endure. / The pity that other women have even toward killing an insect / does not exist in unchaste women: she kills her former lover. / Seeing her former lover, she certainly destroys him easily by some contrivance; / having obtained a new man skilled in love, the old one becomes like poison to her. / Whatever sins exist on earth among unchaste women in Bhārata, / there are no greater sinners than them. / Food cooked by an unchaste woman is certain to contain all sins; / in rites for the gods and for the ancestors, even water from her must not be offered. / The food of unchaste women is certainly feces, and their water is urine; / having offered it to the ancestors and the gods, and having eaten it, one goes to hell. / In the most terrible Kālasūtra he bakes for a hundred years; / in dreadful darkness worms bite him day and night. / If by chance the lowest of men eats the food of an unchaste woman, / his merit acquired over seven births is certainly destroyed. / There is a loss of lifespan, fortune, and fame in this world and the next; / therefore, with great effort one must guard one's cooking pot and wife. / In merely seeing an unchaste woman there is merit, and success of a journey is certain; / but in touching her there is a great sin, from which one is purified by bathing in holy waters. / Bathing, giving gifts, vows, chanting, and worship of deities / are fruitless for unchaste people; their life in Bhārata is in vain. / Thus the account of the unchaste woman, hard to comprehend, has been told according to tradition. / Now hear the actual conversation between the two there, O Nārada.

text_mt: Having regained consciousness and upon seeing her, the son of Bali, / distressed with passion and intoxicated with desire, approached the wanton woman. / He spoke to her of crooked side-glances, heavy hips, and plump breasts, / as she bashfully and joyfully covered her face with her garment. / Sāhasika said: / 'Who are you, whose daughter are you, whose beloved are you, O lovely lady? / Where are you going on your own, O fair-browed one? To which handsome, meritorious man / who, purified by austerity at the end of an eon, is destined to enjoy only you, O beautiful one? / Whomever you are going to, go; but you ought to make me your servant. / Purchase me, a servant greedy for lovemaking, with the merit of erotic pleasure; / you are longing for lovemaking, so grant me lovemaking, O passionate woman! / My embrace with you was ordained by destiny; / what has been determined by destiny, by whom can that be averted, O dear one? / Speak words like nectar with a smile, O beautiful woman; / quickly bind me in solitude with the cords of your creeper-like arms! / Offer an seat, O auspicious lady—your thigh resembling gold; / and display the jar-like orb of your breast, fit for a vessel! / Pierce me deeply, O passionate woman, with the sharp weapon of your sidelong glance; / heal my wound caused by the serpent of Kāma with the touch of your foot! / Give the delicious nectar of your lower lip to me, who am hungry; / show your lovely teeth that shine like seeds of a ripe pomegranate!

sanskrit_iast:
sahasā cetanāṃ prāpya prajvalanbrahmatejasā ..
dadarśa puratastau tu munirunmīlya locane .. 129 ..
meaning:
सहसा चेतनां प्राप्य प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा ..
ददर्श पुरतस्तौ तु मुनिरुन्मील्य लोचने .. 129 ..
text_mt:
Suddenly regaining consciousness, blazing with the splendour of Brahman,
the sage opened his eyes and saw the two before him. 129

sanskrit_iast:
divāniśaṃ na jānantau saṃyuktau kāmamohitau ..
dṛṣṭvā cukopa tejasvī rudrāṃśo bhagavānvibhuḥ .. 4.23.130 ..
meaning:
दिवानिशं न जानन्तौ संयुक्तौ काममोहितौ ..
दृष्ट्वा चुकोप तेजस्वी रुद्रांशो भगवान्विभुः .. 4.23.130 ..
text_mt:
Knowing neither day nor night, united, bewitched by passion,
seeing them, the splendid, all-pervading lord, a portion of Rudra, became enraged. 130

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca tau vihārānte raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ..
dhyānaprāptapadāmbhojavicchedodvignamānasaḥ .. 131 ..
meaning:
उवाच तौ विहारान्ते रक्तपङ्कजलोचनः ..
ध्यानप्राप्तपदाम्भोजविच्छेदोद्विग्नमानसः .. 131 ..
text_mt:
His eyes like red lotuses, at the end of their dalliance he spoke to them,
his mind agitated at being severed from the lotus feet attained in meditation. 131

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsā uvāca ..
uttiṣṭha gardabhākāra nirlajja puruṣādhama ..
bhaktapradhānasya baleḥ putraḥ paśusamaprabhaḥ .. 132 ..
meaning:
दुर्वासा उवाच ..
उत्तिष्ठ गर्दभाकार निर्लज्ज पुरुषाधम ..
भक्तप्रधानस्य बलेः पुत्रः पशुसमप्रभः .. 132 ..
text_mt:
Get up, you donkey-like, shameless, vilest of men!
A son of Bali, the chief of devotees, yet possessing the nature of a beast! 132

sanskrit_iast:
devo vā mānavo vā'pi daityagandharvarākṣasāḥ ..
lajjāṃ kurvanti satataṃ svajātau ca paśūnvinā .. 133 ..
meaning:
देवो वा मानवो वाऽपि दैत्यगन्धर्वराक्षसाः ..
लज्जां कुर्वन्ति सततं स्वजातौ च पशून्विना .. 133 ..
text_mt:
Whether gods or mortals, Daityas, Gandharvas, or Rākṣasas,
all show shame within their own kind, except for beasts; 133

sanskrit_iast:
jñānalajjāvihīnā ca kharajātirviśeṣataḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha kharayoniṃ vrajādhunā .. 134 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानलज्जाविहीना च खरजातिर्विशेषतः ..
तस्मात्त्वं दानवश्रेष्ठ खरयोनिं व्रजाधुना .. 134 ..
text_mt:
and the species of donkeys is especially devoid of sense and shame.
Therefore, best of Dānavas, go now into the womb of a donkey! 134

sanskrit_iast:
tilottame tvamuttiṣṭha lajjāhīnā ca puṃścalī ..
etādṛśī spṛhā daitye vraja yoniṃ ca dānavīm .. 135 ..
meaning:
तिलोत्तमे त्वमुत्तिष्ठ लज्जाहीना च पुंश्चली ..
एतादृशी स्पृहा दैत्ये व्रज योनिं च दानवीम् .. 135 ..
text_mt:
You too, Tilottamā, get up, shameless harlot!
Since you have such longing for a Daitya, go into the womb of a Dānava woman! 135

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā sa munistasthau tatra ruṣā
jvalan .. tau ca tuṣṭuvaturbhītāvutthāya vrīḍitau munima .. 136 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स मुनिस्तस्थौ तत्र रुषा
ज्वलन् .. तौ च तुष्टुवतुर्भीतावुत्थाय व्रीडितौ मुनिम .. 136 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the sage stood there blazing with wrath; / and the two of them, terrified and ashamed, arose and praised the sage. 136

sanskrit_iast:
sāhasika uvāca ..
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ ca viṣṇuśca tvaṃ ca sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ..
hutāśanastvaṃ sūryaśca sṛṣṭisthityantakārakaḥ ..137..
meaning:
साहसिक उवाच ..
त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं च विष्णुश्च त्वं च साक्षान्महेश्वरः ..
हुताशनस्त्वं सूर्यश्च सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारकः ..137..
text_mt:
You are Brahmā, you are Viṣṇu, and you are Maheśvara in person.
You are the Fire, and the Sun, the maker of creation, preservation, and dissolution. 137

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavankṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe ..
mūḍhāparādhaṃ satataṃ yaḥ kṣametsa sadīśvaraḥ .. 138 ..
meaning:
क्षमापराधं भगवन्कृपां कुरु कृपानिधे ..
मूढापराधं सततं यः क्षमेत्स सदीश्वरः .. 138 ..
text_mt:
Forgive my offence, O Lord! Have mercy, O treasure of mercy!
He who continually forgives the offence of the foolish is truly the Lord. 138

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā daityendro rurodoccaiḥ puro muneḥ ..
kṛtvā tṛṇāni daśane papāta caraṇāmbuje .. 139 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा दैत्येन्द्रो रुरोदोच्चैः पुरो मुनेः ..
कृत्वा तृणानि दशने पपात चरणाम्बुजे .. 139 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the lord of Daityas wept loudly before the sage;
placing blades of grass between his teeth, he fell at his lotus feet. 139

sanskrit_iast:
tilottamovāca ..
he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru ..
vidhisṛṣṭau ca sarveṣāṃ mūḍhā strījātireva ca .. 4.23.140 ..
meaning:
तिलोत्तमोवाच ..
हे नाथ करुणासिन्धो दीनबन्धो कृपां कुरु ..
विधिसृष्टौ च सर्वेषां मूढा स्त्रीजातिरेव च .. 4.23.140 ..
text_mt: Among all the creation of the Creator, womankind is indeed foolish; 140

sanskrit_iast:
tato'timattā kulaṭā sadā kāmāturā parā ..
lajjābhītiścetanā ca na santi kāmuke vibho .. 141 ..
meaning:
ततोऽतिमत्ता कुलटा सदा कामातुरा परा ..
लज्जाभीतिश्चेतना च न सन्ति कामुके विभो .. 141 ..
text_mt:
and beyond that, a wanton woman is utterly intoxicated, constantly stricken with lust.
Shame, fear, and consciousness do not exist in one who is lustful, O lord. 141

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā rodanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma śaraṇaṃ muneḥ ..
vinā vipattau keṣāṃcijjñānaṃ bhavati bhūtale ..
tayordṛṣṭvā ca vaikalyaṃ babhūva karuṇā muneḥ .. 142 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा रोदनं कृत्वा जगाम शरणं मुनेः ..
विना विपत्तौ केषांचिज्ज्ञानं भवति भूतले ..
तयोर्दृष्ट्वा च वैकल्यं बभूव करुणा मुनेः .. 142 ..

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsā uvāca ..
atiśāpaḥ prasādo vā bhaveddaivena dānava ..
satkīrtirapakīrtirvā prāktanaprabhavā dhruvam .. 143 ..
meaning:
दुर्वासा उवाच ..
अतिशापः प्रसादो वा भवेद्दैवेन दानव ..
सत्कीर्तिरपकीर्तिर्वा प्राक्तनप्रभवा ध्रुवम् .. 143 ..
text_mt:
"A severe curse or grace comes about by fate, O Dānava;
good fame or ill fame surely arises from past deeds. // 143

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktabaleḥ putraḥ sadvaṃśaprabhavo
janaḥ .. janakādviṣṇubhakto'si jānāmi tvāṃ suniścitam .. 144 ..
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तबलेः पुत्रः सद्वंशप्रभवो
जनः .. जनकाद्विष्णुभक्तोऽसि जानामि त्वां सुनिश्चितम् .. 144 ..
text_mt: You are the son of Bali, a devotee of Viṣṇu, born of an excellent lineage. / From your father you are a devotee of Viṣṇu; I know this for certain. // 144

sanskrit_iast:
janakasya svabhāvo hi janye tiṣṭhati niścitam ..
yathā śrīkṛṣṇapādāṅkaḥ kālīyavaṃśamastake .. 145 ..
meaning:
जनकस्य स्वभावो हि जन्ये तिष्ठति निश्चितम् ..
यथा श्रीकृष्णपादाङ्कः कालीयवंशमस्तके .. 145 ..
text_mt: just as the footprint of glorious Kṛṣṇa is on the head of Kālīya’s race. // 145

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya gārdabhīṃ yoniṃ vatsa nirvāṇatāṃ vraja ..
pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇārcanaphalaṃ na hi luptaṃ satāṃ cirāt .. 146 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य गार्दभीं योनिं वत्स निर्वाणतां व्रज ..
पूर्वं कृष्णार्चनफलं न हि लुप्तं सतां चिरात् .. 146 ..
text_mt:
Attaining birth as a donkey, my child, go to liberation;
for the fruit of prior worship of Kṛṣṇa is never lost to the virtuous even after a long time. // 146

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndāraṇyaṃ tālavanaṃ vraja śīghraṃ vrajāntikam ..
prāṇāṃstyaktvā hareścakrānmuktiṃ prāpsyasi niścitam .. 147 ..
meaning:
वृन्दारण्यं तालवनं व्रज शीघ्रं व्रजान्तिकम् ..
प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा हरेश्चक्रान्मुक्तिं प्राप्स्यसि निश्चितम् .. 147 ..
text_mt:
Go quickly to Vṛndāraṇya, to the Tāla forest near Vraja;
leaving your life-breaths by Hari's discus, you will surely attain release. // 147

sanskrit_iast:
tilottame bhārate tvaṃ bāṇaputrī bhaviṣyasi ..
śrīkṛṣṇapautraśleṣeṇa punaḥ pūtā bhaviṣyasi .. 148 ..
meaning:
तिलोत्तमे भारते त्वं बाणपुत्री भविष्यसि ..
श्रीकृष्णपौत्रश्लेषेण पुनः पूता भविष्यसि .. 148 ..
text_mt:
O Tilottamā, in Bhārata you will become the daughter of Bāṇa;
through the embrace of glorious Kṛṣṇa's grandson, you will become pure once again." // 148

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā sa munirvirarāma mahāmune ..
tau jagmaturyathāsthānaṃ praṇamya munipuṃgavam .. 149 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स मुनिर्विरराम महामुने ..
तौ जग्मतुर्यथास्थानं प्रणम्य मुनिपुंगवम् .. 149 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, that sage paused, O great sage;
having bowed to the bull among sages, the two went to their respective places. // 149

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ daityasya kharajanmanaḥ ..
tilottamā bāṇaputrī hyuṣā'niruddhakāminī .. 4.23.150 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तं सर्ववृत्तान्तं दैत्यस्य खरजन्मनः ..
तिलोत्तमा बाणपुत्री ह्युषाऽनिरुद्धकामिनी .. 4.23.150 ..
text_mt:
Thus the entire narrative of the demon born as an ass has been told;
and Tilottamā was indeed Bāṇa's daughter, Uṣā, the beloved of Aniruddha. // 4.23.150

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
nigūḍhaṃ śṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ munerdurvāsaso mune ..
aho'sya dārasaṃyogaḥ kathaṃ tadūrdhvaretasaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच ..
निगूढं शृणु वृत्तान्तं मुनेर्दुर्वाससो मुने ..
अहोऽस्य दारसंयोगः कथं तदूर्ध्वरेतसः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 024

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tayośca śṛṅgāraṃ muniḥ kāmī babhūva ha ..
jitendriyo'satsaṃsargāddoṣaḥ sāṃsargiko bhavet .. 2 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तयोश्च शृङ्गारं मुनिः कामी बभूव ह ..
जितेन्द्रियोऽसत्संसर्गाद्दोषः सांसर्गिको भवेत् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sahasā tasya hṛdaye babhūva surate spṛhā ..
tapastaptvā tatra dadhyau kāminīṃ madanāturaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
सहसा तस्य हृदये बभूव सुरते स्पृहा ..
तपस्तप्त्वा तत्र दध्यौ कामिनीं मदनातुरः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tena pathā yāti munīśvaraḥ ..
prārthayantyā patiṃ santamaurvaśca sutayā saha .. 4 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेन पथा याति मुनीश्वरः ..
प्रार्थयन्त्या पतिं सन्तमौर्वश्च सुतया सह .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ūrūdbhavo brahmaṇaśca purā kalpe tapasyataḥ ..
ūrdhvaretāśca yogīndra orvastena iti smṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
ऊरूद्भवो ब्रह्मणश्च पुरा कल्पे तपस्यतः ..
ऊर्ध्वरेताश्च योगीन्द्र ओर्वस्तेन इति स्मृतः .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tasya jānūdbhavā kanyā kandalī nāma viśrutā ..
durvāsasaṃ prārthayantī nānyaṃ manasi rocate .. 6 ..
meaning:
तस्य जानूद्भवा कन्या कन्दली नाम विश्रुता ..
दुर्वाससं प्रार्थयन्ती नान्यं मनसि रोचते .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sasuto hi muniśreṣṭho munerdurvāsasaḥ puraḥ ..
tasthau mahāprasannaśca jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ .. .. 7 ..
meaning:
ससुतो हि मुनिश्रेष्ठो मुनेर्दुर्वाससः पुरः ..
तस्थौ महाप्रसन्नश्च ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः .. .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
munīndro'pi munīndraṃ taṃ puro dṛṣṭvā sasaṃbhramaḥ ..
prajavena samuttasthau nanāma ca mudā'nvitaḥ ..8..
meaning:
मुनीन्द्रोऽपि मुनीन्द्रं तं पुरो दृष्ट्वा ससंभ्रमः ..
प्रजवेन समुत्तस्थौ ननाम च मुदाऽन्वितः ..8..

sanskrit_iast:
aurvo durvāsasaṃ tatra samāśliṣya mudā'nvitaḥ ..
uvāca munaye sarvaṃ kanyakāyā manoratham .. 9 ..
meaning:
और्वो दुर्वाससं तत्र समाश्लिष्य मुदाऽन्वितः ..
उवाच मुनये सर्वं कन्यकाया मनोरथम् .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aurva uvāca ..
vikhyātā kandalī nāma mama kanyā manoharā ..
prauḍhā tvāmeva dhyāyantī śrutvā vācikavaktrataḥ .. 4.24.10 ..
meaning:
और्व उवाच ..
विख्याता कन्दली नाम मम कन्या मनोहरा ..
प्रौढा त्वामेव ध्यायन्ती श्रुत्वा वाचिकवक्त्रतः .. 4.24.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisambhavā kanyā trailokyaṃ mohituṃ kṣamā ..
sarvarūpaguṇādhārā doṣeṇaikena saṃyutā .. 11 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसम्भवा कन्या त्रैलोक्यं मोहितुं क्षमा ..
सर्वरूपगुणाधारा दोषेणैकेन संयुता .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atīva kalahāviṣṭā kopena kaṭubhāṣiṇī ..
nānāguṇayutaṃ dravyaṃ na tyajedekadoṣataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
अतीव कलहाविष्टा कोपेन कटुभाषिणी ..
नानागुणयुतं द्रव्यं न त्यजेदेकदोषतः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā harṣaśokānvito muniḥ ..
dadarśa kanyāṃ purato guṇarūpasamanvitām .. 13 ..
meaning:
और्वस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षशोकान्वितो मुनिः ..
ददर्श कन्यां पुरतो गुणरूपसमन्विताम् .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām .. 14 ..
meaning:
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यां शरत्पङ्कजलोचनाम् ..
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम् .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
navayauvanasaṃyuktāṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ..
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām .. 15 ..
meaning:
नवयौवनसंयुक्तां पश्यन्तीं वक्रचक्षुषा ..
रत्नालंकारशोभाढ्यां वह्निशुद्धांशुकान्विताम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
munirmumoha tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ..
uvāca taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā .. 16 ..
meaning:
मुनिर्मुमोह तां दृष्ट्वा कामबाणप्रपीडितः ..
उवाच तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं हृदयेन विदूयता .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsā uvāca ..
nārīrūpaṃ tribhuvane muktimārganirodhakam ..
vyavadhānaṃ tapasyāyāḥ satataṃ mohakāraṇam .. 17 ..
meaning:
दुर्वासा उवाच ..
नारीरूपं त्रिभुवने मुक्तिमार्गनिरोधकम् ..
व्यवधानं तपस्यायाः सततं मोहकारणम् .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kārāgāre ca saṃsāre durvahaṃ nigaḍaṃ param ..
acchedyaṃ jñānakhaḍgaiśca mahadbhiḥ śaṃkarādibhiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
कारागारे च संसारे दुर्वहं निगडं परम् ..
अच्छेद्यं ज्ञानखड्गैश्च महद्भिः शंकरादिभिः .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgicchāyātiriktaṃ ca karmabhogātparātparam ..
indriyādindriyādhārādvidyāyāśca materapi .. 19..
meaning:
सङ्गिच्छायातिरिक्तं च कर्मभोगात्परात्परम् ..
इन्द्रियादिन्द्रियाधाराद्विद्यायाश्च मतेरपि .. 19..
text_mt:
It persists beyond a companion and a shadow, beyond the experience of action,
beyond the sense-organs, the seat of the senses, learning, and the intellect. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
ādehaṃ saṅginī chāyā bhogāntaṃ bhoga eva ca ..
dehendriyāṇi jīvāntaṃ vidyā caivāvaśīlinam .. 4.24.20 ..
meaning:
आदेहं सङ्गिनी छाया भोगान्तं भोग एव च ..
देहेन्द्रियाणि जीवान्तं विद्या चैवावशीलिनम् .. 4.24.20 ..
text_mt:
A companion is a shadow until the body [perishes], and experience lasts only until the end of [that] experience;
the body and sense organs last until the end of life, and knowledge belongs only to the disciplined one. // 4.24.20

sanskrit_iast:
matiścaivāvaśīlāntā sukhī janmanijanmani ..
yāvajjīvī ca sustrīko na tāvajjanmakhaṇḍanam ..21 ..
meaning:
मतिश्चैवावशीलान्ता सुखी जन्मनिजन्मनि ..
यावज्जीवी च सुस्त्रीको न तावज्जन्मखण्डनम् ..21 ..
text_mt:
And the mind lasts until lack of conduct ends; [such a person] is happy birth after birth.
As long as one has a good wife throughout life, there is no termination of [happy] birth. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
yāvacca jīvino janma tāvadbhogaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ..
paraṃ munīndra sarvasmāddharipādābjasevanam.. 22 ..
meaning:
यावच्च जीविनो जन्म तावद्भोगः सुखावहः ..
परं मुनीन्द्र सर्वस्माद्धरिपादाब्जसेवनम्.. 22 ..
text_mt:
As long as a living being has birth, so long does enjoyment bring happiness;
yet above all, O king of sages, is service to Hari's lotus feet. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyataḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ mama vighno babhūva ha ..
na jāne karmadoṣeṇa kena vā pūrvajanmanaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
ध्यायतः कृष्णपादाब्जं मम विघ्नो बभूव ह ..
न जाने कर्मदोषेण केन वा पूर्वजन्मनः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
While I was meditating on Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, an obstacle arose indeed—
I know not by what fault of actions from a previous birth! // 23

sanskrit_iast:
puṃścalyā saha śṛṅgāraṃ dṛṣṭvā daityasya manmanaḥ ..
babhūva kāmasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ dhātrā ca tatphalam ..24..
meaning:
पुंश्चल्या सह शृङ्गारं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यस्य मन्मनः ..
बभूव कामसंयुक्तं दत्तं धात्रा च तत्फलम् ..24..
text_mt:
Having seen a Daitya's lovemaking with an unchaste woman, my mind
became possessed by desire, and the Creator granted the fruit of that. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvahaṃ tava kanyāyāḥ kaṭūktiśatakaṃ mune ..
dhruvaṃ kṣamāṃ kariṣyāmi dāsyāmi ca tataḥ phalam ..25..
meaning:
किं त्वहं तव कन्यायाः कटूक्तिशतकं मुने ..
ध्रुवं क्षमां करिष्यामि दास्यामि च ततः फलम् ..25..
text_mt:
However, O sage, up to a hundred harsh words from your daughter
I will certainly forgive, and after that I will inflict the consequence. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato'pi parā nindā strīkaṭūktisahiṣṇutā ..
atīva ninditaḥ satsu strījito bhuvanatraye .. 25 ..
meaning:
सर्वतोऽपि परा निन्दा स्त्रीकटूक्तिसहिष्णुता ..
अतीव निन्दितः सत्सु स्त्रीजितो भुवनत्रये .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Above all else, enduring harsh words from a woman is great disgrace;
one who is subdued by a woman is exceedingly despised among the virtuous in the three worlds. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
tavājñāṃ mastake kṛtvā grahīṣyāmi sutāṃ tava ..
upetāṃ kāminīṃ tyaktvā kālasūtraṃ vrajennaraḥ ..27..
meaning:
तवाज्ञां मस्तके कृत्वा ग्रहीष्यामि सुतां तव ..
उपेतां कामिनीं त्यक्त्वा कालसूत्रं व्रजेन्नरः ..27..
text_mt:
Placing your command upon my head, I shall take your daughter.
A man who abandons a passionate woman who has approached him would go to Kālasūtra. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyupasthitāṃ kāmātpuṃścalīṃ cejjitendriyaḥ ..
parityajeddharmabhayādadharmānnarakaṃ vrajet .. 28 ..
meaning:
रहस्युपस्थितां कामात्पुंश्चलीं चेज्जितेन्द्रियः ..
परित्यजेद्धर्मभयादधर्मान्नरकं व्रजेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
If a man of controlled senses should abandon, out of fear of dharma,
an unchaste woman who presents herself in secret out of lust, he would go to hell through unrighteousness. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā durvāsā virarāma muneḥ puraḥ ..
munirvedoktavidhinā dadau tasmai sutāṃ mune .. 29 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा दुर्वासा विरराम मुनेः पुरः ..
मुनिर्वेदोक्तविधिना ददौ तस्मै सुतां मुने .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Durvāsas paused before the sage.
The sage gave him his daughter according to the Vedic rite, O sage. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
svastītyuvāca durvāsā muniśca yautukaṃ dadau ..
kanyāsamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mohāccaiva ruroda ha .. 4.24.30 ..
meaning:
स्वस्तीत्युवाच दुर्वासा मुनिश्च यौतुकं ददौ ..
कन्यासमर्पणं कृत्वा मोहाच्चैव रुरोद ह .. 4.24.30 ..
text_mt:
Durvāsas said, “Svasti!” and the sage gave a dowry.
Having handed over his daughter, he wept out of attachment. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ svakanyāvirahāturaḥ ..
apatyabhedaśokaughaḥ svātmārāmaṃ na muñcati .. 31 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छामवाप स मुनिः स्वकन्याविरहातुरः ..
अपत्यभेदशोकौघः स्वात्मारामं न मुञ्चति .. 31 ..
text_mt:
That sage fainted, afflicted with the pain of separation from his daughter.
The flood of grief born of separation from one's child does not spare even one who delights in the self. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya bodhayāmāsa kanyakām ..
mūrcchitāṃ tātavicchedādrudantīṃ śokasaṃyutām .. 32 ..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य बोधयामास कन्यकाम् ..
मूर्च्छितां तातविच्छेदाद्रुदन्तीं शोकसंयुताम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Regaining consciousness in a moment, he consoled the maiden,
who had fainted from separation from her father, weeping and filled with sorrow. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
aurva uvāca ..
śṛṇu vatse pravakṣyāmi nītisāraṃ sudurlabham ..
hitaṃ satyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ..33..
meaning:
और्व उवाच ..
शृणु वत्से प्रवक्ष्यामि नीतिसारं सुदुर्लभम् ..
हितं सत्यं च वेदोक्तं परिणामसुखावहम् ..33..
text_mt:
Listen, my child, I shall declare the essence of conduct, very hard to obtain,
beneficial, true, taught in the Vedas, and bringing happiness in the end. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
svakāntaśca paro bandhuriha loke paratra ca ..
na hi kāntātparaḥ preyān kulastrīṇāṃ paro guruḥ ..34..
meaning:
स्वकान्तश्च परो बन्धुरिह लोके परत्र च ..
न हि कान्तात्परः प्रेयान् कुलस्त्रीणां परो गुरुः ..34..
text_mt:
One's husband is the supreme relative in this world and in the next;
there is none dearer than the husband, no higher guru for women of noble family. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
devapūjā vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ japaḥ ..
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu dīkṣā sarvamakheṣu ca ..35..
meaning:
देवपूजा व्रतं दानं तपश्चानशनं जपः ..
स्नानं च सर्वतीर्थेषु दीक्षा सर्वमखेषु च ..35..
text_mt:
Worship of the gods, vows, giving gifts, austerity, fasting, recitation of mantras,
bathing at all sacred shrines, and initiation into all sacrifices, // 35

sanskrit_iast:
prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca brāhmaṇātithisevanam ..
sarvāṇi patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ..36..
meaning:
प्रादक्षिण्यं पृथिव्याश्च ब्राह्मणातिथिसेवनम् ..
सर्वाणि पतिसेवायाः कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ..36..
text_mt:
circumambulation of the earth, and service to brāhmaṇas and guests—
all these are not worth a sixteenth part of service to the husband. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
kimetaiḥ patibhaktāyā abhaktāyāśca bhārate..
yadā duḥkhī sukhārambhe sākāṅkṣaḥ prathamo bhavet ..
patisevā paro dharmaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu paṭhyate..37..
meaning:
किमेतैः पतिभक्ताया अभक्तायाश्च भारते..
यदा दुःखी सुखारम्भे साकाङ्क्षः प्रथमो भवेत् ..
पतिसेवा परो धर्मः सर्वशास्त्रेषु पठ्यते..37..
text_mt:
What use are these in Bhārata to a woman devoted to her husband, or to one not devoted?
When one is sorrowful at the onset of joy, eager at the outset—
service to the husband is proclaimed in all scriptures as the supreme dharma. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
svaprajñānena satataṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇādhikam ..
dṛṣṭvā taccaraṇatmbhojasevāṃ nityaṃ kariṣyati.. .. 38 ..
meaning:
स्वप्रज्ञानेन सततं कान्तं नारायणाधिकम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तच्चरणत्म्भोजसेवां नित्यं करिष्यति.. .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Constantly seeing the husband through her own discernment as greater than Nārāyaṇa,
she must always render service to his lotus feet. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
parihāsena kopena bhrameṇāvajñayā mune ..
kaṭūktiṃ svāminaḥ sākṣātparokṣānna kariṣyati .. 39 ..
meaning:
परिहासेन कोपेन भ्रमेणावज्ञया मुने ..
कटूक्तिं स्वामिनः साक्षात्परोक्षान्न करिष्यति .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Neither in jest, nor in anger, nor in delusion, nor in contempt, O sage,
shall she utter a harsh word to her husband, whether directly or behind his back. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
striyā vāgyoniduṣṭāyāḥ kāmato bhārate bhuvi ..
prāyaścittaṃ śrutau nāsti narakaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śatam ..4.24.40..
meaning:
स्त्रिया वाग्योनिदुष्टायाः कामतो भारते भुवि ..
प्रायश्चित्तं श्रुतौ नास्ति नरकं ब्रह्मणः शतम् ..4.24.40..
text_mt:
For a woman who is corrupt in speech or womb willfully on the soil of Bhārata,
there is no expiation in the Veda; [her fate is] hell for a hundred lifetimes of Brahmā. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadharmaparītā yā kaṭūktiṃ kurute patim ..
śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyā naśyati niścitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
सर्वधर्मपरीता या कटूक्तिं कुरुते पतिम् ..
शतजन्मकृतं पुण्यं तस्या नश्यति निश्चितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
She who, though possessed of all virtues, speaks harsh words to her husband—
her merit acquired over a hundred lifetimes is surely destroyed. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā kanyāṃ bodhayitvā jagāma munipuṃgavaḥ ..
svātmārāmaḥ svāśrame ca tasthau strīsahito mudā .. 42 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा कन्यां बोधयित्वा जगाम मुनिपुंगवः ..
स्वात्मारामः स्वाश्रमे च तस्थौ स्त्रीसहितो मुदा .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Having given away his daughter and instructed her, that eminent sage departed.
And he who delights in the self stayed in his hermitage joyfully with his wife. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
sambhogecchāvṛte citte kāmī saṃprāpa kāminīm ..
aho sukṛtināṃ kāmo vāñchāmātreṇa sidhyati .. 43 ..
meaning:
सम्भोगेच्छावृते चित्ते कामी संप्राप कामिनीम् ..
अहो सुकृतिनां कामो वाञ्छामात्रेण सिध्यति .. 43 ..
text_mt:
His heart overcome by the desire for sexual union, the lover obtained the lovely woman;
ah, the desire of the virtuous is accomplished by mere wishing! // 43

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā muniśreṣṭho mahāmune..
śubhe kṣaṇe gṛhītvā tāṃ suṣvāpa nirjane priyām..44..
meaning:
शय्यां रतिकरीं कृत्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो महामुने..
शुभे क्षणे गृहीत्वा तां सुष्वाप निर्जने प्रियाम्..44..
text_mt:
Having prepared a bed conducive to love, the best of sages, O great sage,
taking his beloved at an auspicious moment, slept [with her] in solitude. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
nārīrasānabhijñaḥ syādājanma munipuṃgavaḥ..
tathā'pi suratau vijñaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..45..
meaning:
नारीरसानभिज्ञः स्यादाजन्म मुनिपुंगवः..
तथाऽपि सुरतौ विज्ञः कामशास्त्रविशारदः ..45..
text_mt:
Though the eminent sage had been ignorant of womanly pleasure since birth,
yet he was skilled in lovemaking, an expert in the science of love. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprakāraṃ śṛṅgāraṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam..
navasaṃgamamātreṇa mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa kandalī .. 46 ..
meaning:
नानाप्रकारं शृङ्गारं चकार विधिपूर्वकम्..
नवसंगममात्रेण मूर्च्छां संप्राप कन्दली .. 46 ..
text_mt:
He made love in various ways according to the proper rules.
From the mere first union, Kandalī fell into a swoon. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchāṃ prāpa muniśreṣṭho bubudhe na divāniśam ..
evaṃ pratidinaṃ tatra cakāra suratiṃ mune ..47 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छां प्राप मुनिश्रेष्ठो बुबुधे न दिवानिशम् ..
एवं प्रतिदिनं तत्र चकार सुरतिं मुने ..47 ..
text_mt:
The best of sages too fell into a swoon and knew neither day nor night.
In this manner he engaged in lovemaking there every day, O sage. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena babhūva saṃgamaḥ samaḥ ..
saṃbabhūva gṛhāsaktastapastyaktvā munīśvaraḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन बभूव संगमः समः ..
संबभूव गृहासक्तस्तपस्त्यक्त्वा मुनीश्वरः .. 48 ..
text_mt:
The union of the clever woman with the clever man was equal;
abandoning austerity, the lord of sages became attached to domestic life. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
karoti kalahe nityaṃ kandalī svāminā saha ..
munīndro bodhayāmāsa nītivākyena kāminīm ..
sā tanna bubudhe kiṃcitkaroti kalahe spṛhām .. 49 ..
meaning:
करोति कलहे नित्यं कन्दली स्वामिना सह ..
मुनीन्द्रो बोधयामास नीतिवाक्येन कामिनीम् ..
सा तन्न बुबुधे किंचित्करोति कलहे स्पृहाम् .. 49 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tātapradattajñānena sā na śāntā babhūva ha ..
na hīyate prabodhena svabhāvo duratikramaḥ ..4.24.50..
meaning:
तातप्रदत्तज्ञानेन सा न शान्ता बभूव ह ..
न हीयते प्रबोधेन स्वभावो दुरतिक्रमः ..4.24.50..
text_mt:
She did not become calmed by the wisdom imparted by her father;
one's inborn nature, being hard to overcome, is not eliminated by admonition.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ kaṭūktiṃ kāntaṃ sā karoti hetunā vinā ..
jagatprakampitaṃ yena tayā kopātsa kampitaḥ..51..
meaning:
नित्यं कटूक्तिं कान्तं सा करोति हेतुना विना ..
जगत्प्रकम्पितं येन तया कोपात्स कम्पितः..51..
text_mt:
Constantly she spoke harsh words to her beloved without any cause;
he by whom the world was made to tremble was himself made to tremble by her in anger.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā kṛtāṃ kaṭūktiṃ ca kṣamāsaṃsthāṃ cakāra ha ..
bodhayāmāsa tāṃ nityaṃ sadyo mohāddayānidhiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
तया कृतां कटूक्तिं च क्षमासंस्थां चकार ह ..
बोधयामास तां नित्यं सद्यो मोहाद्दयानिधिः .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Yet the harsh words spoken by her he consistently endured with forgiveness;
out of compassion, that ocean of mercy constantly admonished her at once from her delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭūktiśatakaṃ pūrṇaṃ tatkālena babhūva ha ..
kṣamāṃ cakāra kṛpayā kaṭūktiṃ ca śatādhikām .. 53 ..
meaning:
कटूक्तिशतकं पूर्णं तत्कालेन बभूव ह ..
क्षमां चकार कृपया कटूक्तिं च शताधिकाम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
In time, a full hundred of her harsh words came to pass;
mercifully, he forgave even more than a hundred harsh words.

sanskrit_iast:
patnīkaṭūktyā niyataṃ pradagdhaṃ mānasaṃ muneḥ ..
tasyāḥ kaṭūktikāriṇyāḥ karma pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha .. 54 ..
meaning:
पत्नीकटूक्त्या नियतं प्रदग्धं मानसं मुनेः ..
तस्याः कटूक्तिकारिण्याः कर्म पूर्णं बभूव ह .. 54 ..
text_mt:
The sage's mind was continually scorched by the harsh words of his wife;
the karma of that woman who uttered harsh words was now fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmārāmo dayāluśca kopaṃ tyaktuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ ..
śaśāpa kāminīṃ mohādbhasmarāśirbhaveti ca .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्वात्मारामो दयालुश्च कोपं त्यक्तुं न स क्षमः ..
शशाप कामिनीं मोहाद्भस्मराशिर्भवेति च .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Though rejoicing in his own Self and compassionate, he could not let go of his anger;
out of delusion he cursed his beloved, saying: “Become a heap of ashes!”

sanskrit_iast:
muneriṅgitamātreṇa bhasmasātsā babhūva ha ..
evamatyucchritānāṃ ca na kalyāṇaṃ jagattraye .. 56..
meaning:
मुनेरिङ्गितमात्रेण भस्मसात्सा बभूव ह ..
एवमत्युच्छ्रितानां च न कल्याणं जगत्त्रये .. 56..
text_mt:
At a mere gesture from the sage, she was reduced to ashes.
Thus for those who are excessively arrogant, there is no welfare in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīre bhasmasādbhūte pratibiṃbaḥ sa cātmanaḥ ..
jīvastatrāntarikṣastho hyuvāca vinayātprabhum .. 57 ..
meaning:
शरीरे भस्मसाद्भूते प्रतिबिंबः स चात्मनः ..
जीवस्तत्रान्तरिक्षस्थो ह्युवाच विनयात्प्रभुम् .. 57 ..
text_mt:
When her body was reduced to ashes, that reflection of the Self,
the individual soul standing in mid-air, humbly said to the master:

sanskrit_iast:
jīva uvāca ..
he nātha sarvadarśī tvaṃ satataṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ..
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajñaḥ kimahaṃ bodhayāmi te.. 58 ..
meaning:
जीव उवाच ..
हे नाथ सर्वदर्शी त्वं सततं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ..
सर्वं जानासि सर्वज्ञः किमहं बोधयामि ते.. 58 ..
text_mt:
“O master, you are all-seeing at all times through the eye of wisdom;
all-knowing, you know everything; what can I teach you?

sanskrit_iast:
saduktirvā kaṭūktirvā kopaḥ saṃtāpa eva ca..
lobho mohaśca kāmaśca kṣutpipāsādikaṃ ca yat ..59..
meaning:
सदुक्तिर्वा कटूक्तिर्वा कोपः संताप एव च..
लोभो मोहश्च कामश्च क्षुत्पिपासादिकं च यत् ..59..
text_mt:
Good speech or harsh speech, anger and torment,
greed, delusion, lust, and whatever hunger and thirst there be;

sanskrit_iast:
sthaulyaṃ kārśyaṃ ca nāśaśca dṛśyādṛśyaṃ samudbhavam ..
sarvaṃ śarīradharmaṃ ca na jīvasya na cātmanaḥ ..4.24.60..
meaning:
स्थौल्यं कार्श्यं च नाशश्च दृश्यादृश्यं समुद्भवम् ..
सर्वं शरीरधर्मं च न जीवस्य न चात्मनः ..4.24.60..
text_mt:
stoutness, emaciation, destruction, and birth both visible and invisible —
all these are properties of the body, neither of the soul nor of the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvaṃ rajastama iti śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam ..
tacca nānāprakāraṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te ..61..
meaning:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति शरीरं त्रिगुणात्मकम् ..
तच्च नानाप्रकारं च निबोध कथयामि ते ..61..
text_mt:
The body is composed of the three gunas: sattva, rajas, and tamas;
and it has many forms; listen, I shall explain it to you.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcitsattvātiriktaṃ ca kiñcideva rajodhikam ..
tamotiriktaṃ kiñcicca na samaṃ kutracinmune ..62..
meaning:
किञ्चित्सत्त्वातिरिक्तं च किञ्चिदेव रजोधिकम् ..
तमोतिरिक्तं किञ्चिच्च न समं कुत्रचिन्मुने ..62..
text_mt:
One [body] has an excess of sattva, another has an excess of rajas,
and one has an excess of tamas; it is never equal anywhere, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvodayācca muktīcchā karmecchā ca rajoguṇāt..
tamoguṇājjīvahiṃsā kopo'haṃkāra eva ca .. 63 ..
meaning:
सत्त्वोदयाच्च मुक्तीच्छा कर्मेच्छा च रजोगुणात्..
तमोगुणाज्जीवहिंसा कोपोऽहंकार एव च .. 63 ..
text_mt:
From the rise of sattva comes the desire for liberation, and from the quality of rajas the desire for action;
from the quality of tamas comes injury to living beings, anger, and egoism.

sanskrit_iast:
kopātkaṭūktirniyataṃ kaṭūktyā śatrutā bhavet ..
tayā cāpriyatā sadyaḥ śatruḥ kaḥ kasya bhūtale .. 64 ..
meaning:
कोपात्कटूक्तिर्नियतं कटूक्त्या शत्रुता भवेत् ..
तया चाप्रियता सद्यः शत्रुः कः कस्य भूतले .. 64 ..
text_mt:
From anger comes harsh speech without fail; through harsh speech enmity arises;
and through that comes sudden antipathy. On the face of the earth, who is an enemy to whom?

sanskrit_iast:
ko vā priyo'priyaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kiṃ mitraṃ ko ripurbhavet ..
iṃdriyāṇi ca bījāni sarvatra śatrumitrayoḥ ..65..
meaning:
को वा प्रियोऽप्रियः कः किं किं मित्रं को रिपुर्भवेत् ..
इंद्रियाणि च बीजानि सर्वत्र शत्रुमित्रयोः ..65..
text_mt:
Or who is dear, who is disliked, who is what? Who can be a friend, who an enemy?
Everywhere the senses alone are the causes of enemies and friends.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇādhikā priyā ..
babhūva śatrutā sadyo duruktyā ca kṣaṇāddvayoḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
प्राणाधिकः प्रियः स्त्रीणां भर्तुः प्राणाधिका प्रिया ..
बभूव शत्रुता सद्यो दुरुक्त्या च क्षणाद्द्वयोः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
The husband is dearer than life to wives; the wife is dearer than life to the husband;
yet in an instant, through ill speech, enmity immediately arose between the two.

sanskrit_iast:
yadgataṃ tadgataṃ sarvaṃ kāmadoṣeṇa vai prabho ..
kṣamāparādhaṃ nikhilaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā .. 67 ..
meaning:
यद्गतं तद्गतं सर्वं कामदोषेण वै प्रभो ..
क्षमापराधं निखिलं किं कर्तव्यं वदाधुना .. 67 ..
text_mt:
What is gone is completely gone, O master, indeed through the fault of desire;
forgive all offenses! Tell me now what should be done.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ karomi kva yāmīti bhavitā kutra janma me ..
tava nānyasya jāyā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi jagattraye .. 68 ..
meaning:
किं करोमि क्व यामीति भविता कुत्र जन्म मे ..
तव नान्यस्य जायाऽहं भविष्यामि जगत्त्रये .. 68 ..
text_mt:
What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where will my birth take place?
In the three worlds I shall be your wife, and no one else’s!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā jīvaśca maunībhūto babhūva ha ..
mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा जीवश्च मौनीभूतो बभूव ह ..
मूर्च्छामवाप स मुनिः शोकेन हृतचेतनः .. 69 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the soul fell silent;
the sage fainted, his consciousness robbed by grief.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmārāmo mahājñānī jahāra cetanāmaho ..
strīvicchedo vidagdhānāṃ sarvaśokātparātparaḥ .. 4.24.70 ..
meaning:
स्वात्मारामो महाज्ञानी जहार चेतनामहो ..
स्त्रीविच्छेदो विदग्धानां सर्वशोकात्परात्परः .. 4.24.70 ..
text_mt:
Rejoicing in his own Self, a possessor of great wisdom — ah, he lost consciousness!
For the wise, separation from a wife is higher than any other grief.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ..
tatra yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā cakāra vāyudhāraṇam ..71..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यतः ..
तत्र योगासनं कृत्वा चकार वायुधारणम् ..71..
text_mt:
Regaining consciousness after a moment, he prepared to abandon his life breaths;
assuming a yoga posture there, he practiced breath retention.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra jagāma brāhmaṇo'rbhakaḥ..
daṇḍī chatrī raktavāsā bibhratti lakamuttmam .. 72 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र जगाम ब्राह्मणोऽर्भकः..
दण्डी छत्री रक्तवासा बिभ्रत्ति लकमुत्त्मम् .. 72 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, a young Brahmin boy arrived there,
holding a staff and an umbrella, wearing red garments, and bearing an excellent tilaka,

sanskrit_iast:
sasmitaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ..
vayasā'tiśiśuḥ śānto jñānī vedavidāṃ varaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
सस्मितः श्यामवर्णश्च प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा ..
वयसाऽतिशिशुः शान्तो ज्ञानी वेदविदां वरः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
smiling, dark-complexioned, blazing with the splendour of Brahman,
very young in age, tranquil, wise, the foremost of the knowers of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ saṃbhrameṇaiva durvāsāḥ praṇanāma ha ..
vāsayāmāsa tatraiva pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं संभ्रमेणैव दुर्वासाः प्रणनाम ह ..
वासयामास तत्रैव पूजयामास भक्तितः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Seeing him, Durvāsas bowed down in reverence;
he seated him right there and worshipped him with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca brāhmaṇavaṭurdattvā tasmai sadāśiṣam ..
taddarśanādāśiṣā ca sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ gataṃ muneḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
उवाच ब्राह्मणवटुर्दत्त्वा तस्मै सदाशिषम् ..
तद्दर्शनादाशिषा च सर्वं दुःखं गतं मुनेः .. 75 ..
text_mt:
The young Brahmin celibate, having given him an auspicious blessing, spoke;
by seeing him and receiving his blessing, all the sorrow of the sage vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśurūpaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tamuvāca vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
pīyūṣatulyaṃ nītyoghaṃ nītiśāstraṃ viśāradaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
शिशुरूपं क्षणं स्थित्वा तमुवाच विचक्षणः ..
पीयूषतुल्यं नीत्योघं नीतिशास्त्रं विशारदः .. 76 ..
text_mt:
Having remained a moment in the form of a child, that wise one spoke to him;
expert in the treatises of statecraft, he uttered an outpouring of conduct resembling nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśuruvāca ..
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña gurormantraprasādataḥ ..
kiṃ tattvaṃ tvāmahaṃ vipra pṛcchāmi śokakātaram .. 77 ..
meaning:
शिशुरुवाच ..
सर्वं जानासि सर्वज्ञ गुरोर्मन्त्रप्रसादतः ..
किं तत्त्वं त्वामहं विप्र पृच्छामि शोककातरम् .. 77 ..
text_mt:
“All-knowing one, you know everything by the grace of your guru’s mantra;
O Brahmin, what truth can I ask of you, agitated as you are by grief?

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo dharmastapaḥsādhyaṃ jagattrayam ..
svadharmaṃ vai parityajya kimidānīṃ karoṣi bhoḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां तपो धर्मस्तपःसाध्यं जगत्त्रयम् ..
स्वधर्मं वै परित्यज्य किमिदानीं करोषि भोः .. 78 ..
text_mt:
For Brahmins, asceticism is the sacred duty; the three worlds are mastered by asceticism.
having abandoned your own duty, what are you doing now, sir?

sanskrit_iast:
kā kasya patnī kaḥ kāntaḥ kasyā vā bhuvanatraye ..
mūrkhāṇāṃ vañcanāṃ kartuṃ karoti māyayā hariḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
का कस्य पत्नी कः कान्तः कस्या वा भुवनत्रये ..
मूर्खाणां वञ्चनां कर्तुं करोति मायया हरिः .. 79 ..
text_mt:
Who is whose wife, or who is whose husband in the three worlds?
In order to delude fools, Hari creates [this] by his māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyā patnī taveyaṃ ca kṣaṇāttena gatādhunā ..
na hi satyamadṛśyaṃ ca mithyā yatrācirasthitiḥ .. 4.24.80 ..
meaning:
मिथ्या पत्नी तवेयं च क्षणात्तेन गताधुना ..
न हि सत्यमदृश्यं च मिथ्या यत्राचिरस्थितिः .. 4.24.80 ..
text_mt:
This wife of yours was unreal; therefore she is gone in an instant now.
For what is invisible is not real, and that which is of fleeting duration is false.

sanskrit_iast:
ekānaṃśā ca bhaginī vasudevasutā hareḥ..
pārvatyaṃśasamudbhūtā suśīlā cirajīvinī ..81 ..
meaning:
एकानंशा च भगिनी वसुदेवसुता हरेः..
पार्वत्यंशसमुद्भूता सुशीला चिरजीविनी ..81 ..
text_mt:
Hari's sister, Ekānaṃśā, the daughter of Vasudeva,
born from a portion of Pārvatī, of good character and long-lived,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe kalpe sundarī sā tava patnī bhaviṣyati ..
mano dehi tapasyāyāṃ mudā katipayaṃ dinam..82..
meaning:
कल्पे कल्पे सुन्दरी सा तव पत्नी भविष्यति ..
मनो देहि तपस्यायां मुदा कतिपयं दिनम्..82..
text_mt:
that fair lady will become your wife aeon after aeon.
Direct your mind to austerities with joy for a few days.

sanskrit_iast:
kandalī kadalījātirbhaviṣyati mahītale ..
śubhadā phaladā kāntā sakṛtsūtā sudurlabhā .. 83 ..
meaning:
कन्दली कदलीजातिर्भविष्यति महीतले ..
शुभदा फलदा कान्ता सकृत्सूता सुदुर्लभा .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Kandalī will become the plantain species on the face of the earth,
bringing auspiciousness, bearing fruit, lovely, bearing offspring only once, and very rare.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpāntare śāntarūpā tava patnī bhaviṣya ti..
atyucchrisya damanamucitaṃ ca śrutau śrutam.. 84..
meaning:
कल्पान्तरे शान्तरूपा तव पत्नी भविष्य ति..
अत्युच्छ्रिस्य दमनमुचितं च श्रुतौ श्रुतम्.. 84..
text_mt:
In another aeon, tranquil in form, she will become your wife.
The subduing of the excessively haughty is proper and heard in the Veda.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā śīghraṃ ca viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
dattvā jñānaṃ ca viprāya so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 85 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा शीघ्रं च विप्ररूपी जनार्दनः ..
दत्त्वा ज्ञानं च विप्राय सोऽन्तर्धानं चकार ह .. 85 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Janārdana, in the form of a brāhmaṇa, quickly
imparted knowledge to the brāhmaṇa and vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
muniḥ sarvabhramaṃ tyaktvā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhe ..
kandalī kadalījātirbabhūva dharaṇītale .. 86 ..
meaning:
मुनिः सर्वभ्रमं त्यक्त्वा तपस्यायां मनो दधे ..
कन्दली कदलीजातिर्बभूव धरणीतले .. 86 ..
text_mt:
The sage, casting off all delusion, set his mind on austerities.
Kandalī became the plantain species on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
daityastālavanaṃ gatvā babhūva gardabhākṛtiḥ ..
tilottamā bāṇaputrī babhūva samaye mune .. 87..
meaning:
दैत्यस्तालवनं गत्वा बभूव गर्दभाकृतिः ..
तिलोत्तमा बाणपुत्री बभूव समये मुने .. 87..
text_mt:
The Daitya went to the palm forest and assumed the form of an ass;
Tilottamā became the daughter of Bāṇa in due course, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
daityendro viṣṇucakreṇa prāṇāṃstyaktvā suvāñchitam ..
saṃprāpya caraṇāmbhojaṃ munerapi sudurlabham .. 88 ..
meaning:
दैत्येन्द्रो विष्णुचक्रेण प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा सुवाञ्छितम् ..
संप्राप्य चरणाम्भोजं मुनेरपि सुदुर्लभम् .. 88 ..
text_mt:
The lord of the Daityas, relinquishing his life-breaths by Viṣṇu's discus, attained the longed-for
lotus feet, which are very difficult even for sages to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle tilottamā bhūtvā jagāma svālayaṃ punaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapautrāliṃganena paripūrṇamanorathā .. 89 ..
meaning:
काले तिलोत्तमा भूत्वा जगाम स्वालयं पुनः ..
कृष्णपौत्रालिंगनेन परिपूर्णमनोरथा .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Tilottamā, having attained [that form] in time, returned to her own abode again,
her desire fully fulfilled by the embrace of Kṛṣṇa's grandson.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamuttamam ..
padepade sundaraṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 4.24.90 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं श्रुत्वा श्रीकृष्णाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
पदेपदे सुन्दरं च किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 4.24.90 ..
text_mt:
Having heard this excellent narrative of Śrī Kṛṣṇa told in this manner,
which is beautiful at every step, what do you wish to hear further?

sanskrit_iast:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
śrutaṃ kimadbhutaṃ brahman hareścaritamaṅgalam ..
viśeṣatastava mukhe hyatīva sumanoharam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
श्रुतं किमद्भुतं ब्रह्मन् हरेश्चरितमङ्गलम् ..
विशेषतस्तव मुखे ह्यतीव सुमनोहरम् .. 1 ..
title: Kṣaṇaprastāvaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāyāṃ munikanyāyāṃ śāpāddurvāsaso muneḥ ..
kiṃ cakāra samāgatya tanme brūhi tapodhana .. 2 ..
meaning:
मृतायां मुनिकन्यायां शापाद्दुर्वाससो मुनेः ..
किं चकार समागत्य तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
sarasvatīnadītīre tapasyāṃ kurvato muneḥ ..
papāta dhautamūrdhvācca dhāryamāṇaṃ ca vāyunā .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीनारायण उवाच .. ..
सरस्वतीनदीतीरे तपस्यां कुर्वतो मुनेः ..
पपात धौतमूर्ध्वाच्च धार्यमाणं च वायुना .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ patite vastre tapastyaktvā munīśvaraḥ ..
dhyānena bubudhe sarvaṃ kanyāsaṃbandhi saṃkaṭam..4..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां पतिते वस्त्रे तपस्त्यक्त्वा मुनीश्वरः ..
ध्यानेन बुबुधे सर्वं कन्यासंबन्धि संकटम्..4..

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma śokāviṣṭo'pi tūrṇaṃ jāmāturāśramam..
siṣeca pṛthivīreṇūcchaśvannayanabindunā ..5..
meaning:
जगाम शोकाविष्टोऽपि तूर्णं जामातुराश्रमम्..
सिषेच पृथिवीरेणूच्छश्वन्नयनबिन्दुना ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā''layasamīpaṃ ca vipraḥ kātaramānasaḥ ..
he vatse kandalītyevamuvāca ca punaḥpunaḥ.. .. 6 ..
meaning:
गत्वा'ऽलयसमीपं च विप्रः कातरमानसः ..
हे वत्से कन्दलीत्येवमुवाच च पुनःपुनः.. .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śvaśarasya svaraṃ jñātvā durvāsā bhayavihvalaḥ ..
bahirbabhūva śīghraṃ ca papāta caraṇāmbuje .. 7 ..
meaning:
श्वशरस्य स्वरं ज्ञात्वा दुर्वासा भयविह्वलः ..
बहिर्बभूव शीघ्रं च पपात चरणाम्बुजे .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śvaśuraṃ śokādvilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ..
pravṛttiṃ kathayāmāsa mūlato munisattamam .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य श्वशुरं शोकाद्विललाप भृशं पुनः ..
प्रवृत्तिं कथयामास मूलतो मुनिसत्तमम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vārtāṃ śucā''viṣṭaḥ papāta dharaṇītale ..
mūrcchāmāpa mahājñānī niśceṣṭo hi yathā mṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वार्तां शुचा'ऽविष्टः पपात धरणीतले ..
मूर्च्छामाप महाज्ञानी निश्चेष्टो हि यथा मृतः .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa durvāsā mune manasi saṃkaṭam ..
cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa prayatnena mahāmuneḥ .. 4.25.10 ..
meaning:
मृतं दृष्ट्वा स दुर्वासा मुने मनसि संकटम् ..
चेतनां कारयामास प्रयत्नेन महामुनेः .. 4.25.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
