text_mt:
The son became Kāmadeva, [born] of the desirous Kṛṣṇa;
the daughter was sixteen years old, adorned with jewel ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca putraṃ sa vidhiḥ sudīptaṃ purataḥ sthitam ..
durnivāryaṃ matkalāṃśaṃ svātmārāmaṃ manoharam .. 4.35.40 ..
meaning:
उवाच पुत्रं स विधिः सुदीप्तं पुरतः स्थितम् ..
दुर्निवार्यं मत्कलांशं स्वात्मारामं मनोहरम् .. 4.35.40 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā spoke to his radiant son standing before him,
irresistible, a part and portion of me, delighting in his own self, captivating the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
strīpuṃsoḥ krīḍanārthāya mudā tvaṃ ca vinirmitaḥ ..
hṛṣṭiyogena sarveṣāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasi .. 41 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
स्त्रीपुंसोः क्रीडनार्थाय मुदा त्वं च विनिर्मितः ..
हृष्टियोगेन सर्वेषामधिष्ठानं करिष्यसि .. 41 ..
text_mt:
“You were created with joy for the sport of man and woman;
through the union of joy you shall take your seat in all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastaṃbhitakāraṇam ..
unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam .. 42 ..
meaning:
संमोहनं समुद्वेगं बीजस्तंभितकारणम् ..
उन्मत्तबीजं ज्वलदं शश्वच्चेतनहारकम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Fascination, agitation, the cause that paralyzes the seed,

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhyaitānmayā dattānsarvānsaṃmohanaṃ kuru ..
durnivāryo mama varādbhava vatsa bhaveṣu ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
प्रगृह्यैतान्मया दत्तान्सर्वान्संमोहनं कुरु ..
दुर्निवार्यो मम वराद्भव वत्स भवेषु च .. 43 ..
text_mt:
taking these, given by me, bewitch all beings!
Become irresistible by my boon, my child, throughout all worlds!”

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇāndattvaivamuktvā ca prahṛṣṭaśca jagadvidhiḥ ..
dṛṣṭvovāca duhitaraṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ .. 44..
meaning:
बाणान्दत्त्वैवमुक्त्वा च प्रहृष्टश्च जगद्विधिः ..
दृष्ट्वोवाच दुहितरं वरं दातुं समुद्यतः .. 44..
text_mt:
Having given the arrows and spoken thus, the creator of the world was delighted;
seeing his daughter, he prepared to give her a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kāmo manasā''locya mantraṇām ..
kartuṃ śastraparīkṣāṃ ca bāṇāṃścikṣepa brahmaṇi .. 45 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कामो मनसा'ऽलोच्य मन्त्रणाम् ..
कर्तुं शस्त्रपरीक्षां च बाणांश्चिक्षेप ब्रह्मणि .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Kāma, considering a plan in his mind
to test his weapons, discharged his arrows at Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃtrapūtaiśca bāṇaiśca durvāryaiḥ smaraṇena ca ..
atividdho mahāyogī mūrcchito hatacetanaḥ.. 46 ..
meaning:
मंत्रपूतैश्च बाणैश्च दुर्वार्यैः स्मरणेन च ..
अतिविद्धो महायोगी मूर्च्छितो हतचेतनः.. 46 ..
text_mt:
Pierced deeply by the arrows consecrated with mantras, irresistible even upon remembering,
the great yogin swooned, his consciousness lost.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśāgre ca kanyakām ..
tāṃ saṃbhoktuṃ manaścakre sā dudrāva bhiyā satī .. 47 ..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य ददर्शाग्रे च कन्यकाम् ..
तां संभोक्तुं मनश्चक्रे सा दुद्राव भिया सती .. 47 ..
text_mt:
Regaining consciousness in a moment, he saw the young maiden before him;
he set his mind on enjoying her, and the virtuous woman fled in fear.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā paścācca pitaraṃ dhāvantaṃ hatacetanam ..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca tapasvinām .. 48 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पश्चाच्च पितरं धावन्तं हतचेतनम् ..
जगाम शरणं शीघ्रं भ्रातॄणां च तपस्विनाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Seeing her father running behind her, deprived of his senses,
she quickly went for refuge to her ascetic brothers.

sanskrit_iast:
te tāṃ samīpe saṃsthāpya tamūcuḥ pitaraṃ krudhā ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
ते तां समीपे संस्थाप्य तमूचुः पितरं क्रुधा ..
हितं तथ्यं च वेदोक्तं नीतिसारं परं वचः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Placing her beside them, they angrily addressed their father
with supreme words beneficial, truthful, stated in the Vedas, and the essence of right conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
aho kimetajjanaka karma te'tivigarhitam ..
nīcānāṃ caritaṃ yattatkaroṣi tvaṃ jagadvidhe .. 4.35.50 ..
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः ..
अहो किमेतज्जनक कर्म तेऽतिविगर्हितम् ..
नीचानां चरितं यत्तत्करोषि त्वं जगद्विधे .. 4.35.50 ..
text_mt:
“Ah! What is this, father? Your deed is utterly reprehensible!
You, the creator of the world, are performing conduct belonging to the base!

sanskrit_iast:
paśyanti satataṃ santaḥ prasūmiva parastriyam ..
ye te sarvatra pūjyāśca paratreha jitendriyāḥ ..51 ..
meaning:
पश्यन्ति सततं सन्तः प्रसूमिव परस्त्रियम् ..
ये ते सर्वत्र पूज्याश्च परत्रेह जितेन्द्रियाः ..51 ..
text_mt:
The virtuous always look upon another's wife as upon a mother;
those who control their senses are revered everywhere, in the other world and in this one.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ svayaṃ vedakartā ca kanyāṃ saṃbhoktumicchasi ..
kanyā ca mātṛvargeṣu praviṣṭā ca śrutau śrutā .. 52 ..
meaning:
त्वं स्वयं वेदकर्ता च कन्यां संभोक्तुमिच्छसि ..
कन्या च मातृवर्गेषु प्रविष्टा च श्रुतौ श्रुता .. 52 ..
text_mt:
You yourself are the author of the Vedas, yet you desire to enjoy your daughter!
And a daughter is entered among the class of mothers, as heard in the Śruti:

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ patnī rājapatnī viprapatnī ca yā satī ..
patnī ca bhrātṛsutayormitrapatnī ca tatprasūḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
गुरोः पत्नी राजपत्नी विप्रपत्नी च या सती ..
पत्नी च भ्रातृसुतयोर्मित्रपत्नी च तत्प्रसूः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
The wife of a guru, the wife of a king, the virtuous wife of a brahmin,
the wife of a brother and of a son, the wife of a friend and his mother,

sanskrit_iast:
prasūḥ pitrostathā bhrātuḥ patnī śvaśrūḥ svakanyakāḥ ..
jananī tatsapatnī ca bhaginī surabhī tathā .. 54 ..
meaning:
प्रसूः पित्रोस्तथा भ्रातुः पत्नी श्वश्रूः स्वकन्यकाः ..
जननी तत्सपत्नी च भगिनी सुरभी तथा .. 54 ..
text_mt:
the mother of both parents, a brother's wife, a mother-in-law, one's own daughters,
one's mother, her co-wife, a sister, and Surabhī,

sanskrit_iast:
svābhīṣṭasurapatnī ca dhātrikā'nnapradāyikā ..
garbhadhātrī svanāmnā ca bhayāttrātuśca kāminī .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्वाभीष्टसुरपत्नी च धात्रिकाऽन्नप्रदायिका ..
गर्भधात्री स्वनाम्ना च भयात्त्रातुश्च कामिनी .. 55 ..
text_mt:
the wife of one's chosen deity, a nurse, the giver of food,
the bearer of the womb by name, and the beloved woman of one who rescues from fear—

sanskrit_iast:
etā vedapraṇītāśca sarveṣāṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ..
etāsvapi ca sarvāsu nyūnatā nāsti kāsu ca ..56..
meaning:
एता वेदप्रणीताश्च सर्वेषां मातरः स्मृताः..
एतास्वपि च सर्वासु न्यूनता नास्ति कासु च ..56..
text_mt:
these, laid down by the Vedas, are remembered as the mothers of all;
among all of these, none is in any way inferior.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādātā'nnadātā ca jñānadātā'bhayapradaḥ ..
janmado mantrado jyeṣṭhabhrātā ca pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ..57 ..
meaning:
कन्यादाताऽन्नदाता च ज्ञानदाताऽभयप्रदः ..
जन्मदो मन्त्रदो ज्येष्ठभ्राता च पितरः स्मृताः ..57 ..
text_mt:
The giver of a daughter, the giver of food, the giver of knowledge, the grantor of fearlessness,
the giver of birth, the giver of the mantra, and the eldest brother are remembered as fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
etā vahanti ye mūḍhā ya etāñjanakānapi ..
pacyante narake te ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
एता वहन्ति ये मूढा य एताञ्जनकानपि ..
पच्यन्ते नरके ते च यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Those fools who take these [women as wives], or those who [harm] these fathers,
are cooked in hell for as long as the lifespan of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tānandhakūpe saṃsthāpya dūrato yamakiṅkarāḥ..
kurvanti tāḍanaṃ śaśvatpurīṣaṃ pāyayanti ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
तानन्धकूपे संस्थाप्य दूरतो यमकिङ्कराः..
कुर्वन्ति ताडनं शश्वत्पुरीषं पाययन्ति च .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Placing them in the Andhakūpa hell, the servants of Yama from afar
beat them constantly and make them drink feces.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva viśvakartā ca śāstā vai śamanasya ca ..
vayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ tena gṛhṇāsi kanyakām .. 4.35.60 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव विश्वकर्ता च शास्ता वै शमनस्य च ..
वयं विधाता जगतां तेन गृह्णासि कन्यकाम् .. 4.35.60 ..
text_mt:
You alone are the creator of the universe and the chastiser even of Death;
is it because ‘we are the creator of the worlds’ that you seize your daughter?

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ purato dūraṃ gaccha kāmārtamānasa..
na kurmo bhasmasātkartuṃ śaktāśca janakaṃ vayam ..61..
meaning:
अस्माकं पुरतो दूरं गच्छ कामार्तमानस..
न कुर्मो भस्मसात्कर्तुं शक्ताश्च जनकं वयम् ..61..
text_mt:
Go far away from our presence, you whose mind is afflicted with lust!
Though capable, we will not reduce our father to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
gurordoṣasahasrāṇi kṣantumarhanti paṇḍitāḥ ..
sarvaghnaṃ taṃ vinighnanti nītijñāḥ svaguruṃ vinā ..62..
meaning:
गुरोर्दोषसहस्राणि क्षन्तुमर्हन्ति पण्डिताः ..
सर्वघ्नं तं विनिघ्नन्ति नीतिज्ञाः स्वगुरुं विना ..62..
text_mt:
The wise ought to forgive thousands of faults of a guru;
those versed in conduct slay anyone who kills all, except their own guru.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhṇanti yadi sarvasvaṃ śapantaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ gurum ..
sādhavastaṃ na nindanti praṇamanti svabhaktitaḥ ..63..
meaning:
गृह्णन्ति यदि सर्वस्वं शपन्तं निष्ठुरं गुरुम् ..
साधवस्तं न निन्दन्ति प्रणमन्ति स्वभक्तितः ..63..
text_mt:
Even if he seizes everything, though the guru is harsh and cursing,
the virtuous do not revile him; they bow down with their own devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dviṣanti ca nindati gurumiṣṭaṃ surātparam ..
pacyante te'ndhakūpe ca yāvaccandradivākarau..64..
meaning:
ये द्विषन्ति च निन्दति गुरुमिष्टं सुरात्परम् ..
पच्यन्ते तेऽन्धकूपे च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ..64..
text_mt:
Those who hate and revile the chosen guru, who is higher than the gods,
are cooked in Andhakūpa as long as the sun and moon endure.”

sanskrit_iast:
purīṣaṃ bhuñjate nityaṃ kṣubhitā yamatāḍanaiḥ ..
sarpapramāṇakīṭaiśca daṃśitāśca divāniśam .. 65..
meaning:
पुरीषं भुञ्जते नित्यं क्षुभिता यमताडनैः ..
सर्पप्रमाणकीटैश्च दंशिताश्च दिवानिशम् .. 65..
text_mt:
Agitated by the beatings of Yama, they constantly consume feces,
and are bitten day and night by worms the size of serpents. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā munayaḥ praṇemustatpadāmbujam ..
sarvaṃ bhavati daivena praśāntamanasā dhruvam .. 66 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा मुनयः प्रणेमुस्तत्पदाम्बुजम् ..
सर्वं भवति दैवेन प्रशान्तमनसा ध्रुवम् .. 66 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the sages bowed to his lotus feet.
Indeed, everything happens by fate, with a calmed mind. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
unmukhā munayaḥ sarve babhūvuśca svakarmaṇi..
brahmā śarīraṃ saṃtyaktuṃ vrīḍayā ca samudyataḥ ..67..
meaning:
उन्मुखा मुनयः सर्वे बभूवुश्च स्वकर्मणि..
ब्रह्मा शरीरं संत्यक्तुं व्रीडया च समुद्यतः ..67..
text_mt:
All the sages turned their faces toward their own duties,
and Brahmā, out of shame, prepared to abandon his body. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvānprāṇānniruddhya ca..
brahmarandhraṃ samānīya tatyāja svena vartmanā ..68..
meaning:
योगेन भित्त्वा षट्चक्रं सर्वान्प्राणान्निरुद्ध्य च..
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं समानीय तत्याज स्वेन वर्त्मना ..68..
text_mt:
Piercing the six cakras through yoga and restraining all his vital breaths,
bringing them to the brahmarandhra, he gave up [his body] by his own path. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
manasā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā namaskāraṃ cakāra ha ..
na me manaḥ paradravye bhavitā stokamīśvara ..69..
meaning:
मनसा श्रीहरिं स्मृत्वा नमस्कारं चकार ह ..
न मे मनः परद्रव्ये भविता स्तोकमीश्वर ..69..
text_mt:
Remembering Śrī Hari in his mind, he made obeisance:
“O Lord, let not my mind ever incline, even a little, toward another’s property! // 69

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇatyāgātparaṃ duḥkhamayaśaśca yaśasvinām ..
babhūva hṛdi kṛtvaikaṃ brahmā līnaśca brahmaṇi.. .. 4.35.70 ..
meaning:
प्राणत्यागात्परं दुःखमयशश्च यशस्विनाम् ..
बभूव हृदि कृत्वैकं ब्रह्मा लीनश्च ब्रह्मणि.. .. 4.35.70 ..
text_mt:
For the famous, disgrace is a greater suffering than loss of life.”
Focusing upon the One in his heart, Brahmā became merged into Brahman. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā tātaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ..
yogena dehaṃ tatyāja sā pralīnā ca brahmaṇi..71..
meaning:
कन्या तातं मृतं दृष्ट्वा विलप्य च भृशं मुहुः..
योगेन देहं तत्याज सा प्रलीना च ब्रह्मणि..71..
text_mt:
Seeing her father dead, the maiden wailed bitterly again and again,
and gave up her body through yoga, merging into Brahman. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtaṃ tātaṃ ca bhaginīṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munipuṃgavāḥ ..
sasmaruḥ śrīhariṃ kopātsvātmārāmaṃ vilapya ca ..72..
meaning:
मृतं तातं च भगिनीं दृष्ट्वा च मुनिपुंगवाः ..
सस्मरुः श्रीहरिं कोपात्स्वात्मारामं विलप्य च ..72..
text_mt:
Seeing their father and sister dead, the best of sages
wailed, and in anguish remembered Śrī Hari, who delights in Himself. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇo madaṃśaśca kṛpayā''gatya satvaram ..
brahmāṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa brahmajñānātsutāṃ ca tām ..73..
meaning:
नारायणो मदंशश्च कृपया'ऽगत्य सत्वरम् ..
ब्रह्माणं जीवयामास ब्रह्मज्ञानात्सुतां च ताम् ..73..
text_mt:
Then Nārāyaṇa, my portion, came swiftly out of compassion
and revived Brahmā and that daughter through the knowledge of Brahman. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā puro hariṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ vavre sma vāñchitam ..
bhaktiṃ tvaccaraṇe śaśvanniścalāmanapāyinīm ..74..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा पुरो हरिं दृष्ट्वा वरं वव्रे स्म वाञ्छितम् ..
भक्तिं त्वच्चरणे शश्वन्निश्चलामनपायिनीम् ..74..
text_mt:
Seeing Hari before him, Brahmā chose his desired boon:
“Unswerving, constant, and unfailing devotion at your feet.” // 74

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ virasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
prabodhavacanaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ manoharam .. 75 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं विरसं दृष्ट्वा तमुवाच कृपानिधिः ..
प्रबोधवचनं सत्यं नीतिसारं मनोहरम् .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Brahmā dejected, the ocean of mercy addressed him
with words of awakening, true, captivating, and the essence of ethics. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣye'haṃ mukhamuttolya sāṃpratam ..
tyaja lajjāṃ jagannātha hṛdayajvararūpiṇīm .. 76 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
शृणु ब्रह्मन्प्रवक्ष्येऽहं मुखमुत्तोल्य सांप्रतम् ..
त्यज लज्जां जगन्नाथ हृदयज्वररूपिणीम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
“Listen, O Brahmā! Lift up your face now and I will speak.
Cast off shame, O lord of the world, which takes the form of a fever in the heart! // 76

sanskrit_iast:
satkīrtirapakīrtirvā supratiṣṭhāpyupadravaḥ ..
kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ bhavatyeva svakarmaṇā ..77..
meaning:
सत्कीर्तिरपकीर्तिर्वा सुप्रतिष्ठाप्युपद्रवः ..
क्षुद्राणां चैव महतां भवत्येव स्वकर्मणा ..77..
text_mt:
Good fame or ill fame, high renown or calamity—
these surely come to the low and the great alike through their own deeds. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi sarvebhyaḥ svakarma balavattaram ..
tasmātsantaḥ prakurvanti nityaṃ satkarma saṃtatam .. 78 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि सर्वेभ्यः स्वकर्म बलवत्तरम् ..
तस्मात्सन्तः प्रकुर्वन्ति नित्यं सत्कर्म संततम् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
One’s own karma is stronger for everyone than all else;
therefore, the virtuous constantly perform good deeds at all times. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
kecitkurvanti nirmūlaṃ sarveṣāmapi karmaṇām ..
kṛtaṃ karma paraṃ bhuktvā haripādābjacetasaḥ ..79 ..
meaning:
केचित्कुर्वन्ति निर्मूलं सर्वेषामपि कर्मणाम् ..
कृतं कर्म परं भुक्त्वा हरिपादाब्जचेतसः ..79 ..
text_mt:
Some uproot all karmas completely,
having merely experienced whatever deed was done, their minds fixed on Hari's lotus feet. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
kukarmaṇaścāpakīrtistato lajjā bhaveddhruvam ..
sukarmaṇaḥ supratiṣṭhā sarvatra nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ .. 4.35.80 ..
meaning:
कुकर्मणश्चापकीर्तिस्ततो लज्जा भवेद्ध्रुवम् ..
सुकर्मणः सुप्रतिष्ठा सर्वत्र निर्मलं यशः .. 4.35.80 ..
text_mt:
From bad deeds comes ill fame, and from that, shame certainly arises;
from good deeds comes high renown and stainless fame everywhere. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
kālena rajasā deho balaṃ rūpaṃ śubhāśubham ..
kīrtiryā triguṇā caiva mohaścāpayaśo vidhe .. 81 ..
meaning:
कालेन रजसा देहो बलं रूपं शुभाशुभम् ..
कीर्तिर्या त्रिगुणा चैव मोहश्चापयशो विधे .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Through time and through rajas, the body, strength, beauty, good and evil,
fame—which consists of the three gunas—infatuation, and disgrace [all arise], O creator. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇavraṇāpavādāśca jantūnāṃ yānti kālataḥ ..
mahatāṃ tau ca pūrvoktau netaraśca kadācana .. 82 ..
meaning:
ऋणव्रणापवादाश्च जन्तूनां यान्ति कालतः ..
महतां तौ च पूर्वोक्तौ नेतरश्च कदाचन .. 82 ..
text_mt:
Debts, wounds, and censure of living beings disappear in time;
for the great, those two previously mentioned [debts and wounds disappear], but never the other [censure]. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
sadā'pakīrtirvasati parastrīṣu ca vastuṣu..
tasmātte naiva gṛhṇanti santaḥ svakleśakāraṇe .. 83 ..
meaning:
सदाऽपकीर्तिर्वसति परस्त्रीषु च वस्तुषु..
तस्मात्ते नैव गृह्णन्ति सन्तः स्वक्लेशकारणे .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Disgrace always dwells in [longing for] the wives and property of others;
therefore, the virtuous do not take hold of those causes of their own affliction. // 83

sanskrit_iast:
smara māmantare brāhme madīyaṃ viṣayaṃ kuru..
ataste na mano lolaṃ bhavitā paravastuṣu .. 84 ..
meaning:
स्मर मामन्तरे ब्राह्मे मदीयं विषयं कुरु..
अतस्ते न मनो लोलं भविता परवस्तुषु .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Remember me in the inner Brahmic state; make me your object of meditation;
then your mind will not wander toward the belongings of others. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣidrūpā ca me māyā sarveṣāṃ mohakāriṇī ..
līlayā kurute mohaṃ svātmārāmasya saṃtatam .. 85 ..
meaning:
योषिद्रूपा च मे माया सर्वेषां मोहकारिणी ..
लीलया कुरुते मोहं स्वात्मारामस्य संततम् .. 85 ..
text_mt:
My māyā in the form of a woman causes delusion in all;
in mere play, she constantly deludes even one who delights in the self. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmudrāśraye deśe rāgiṇo saṃtataṃ ratiḥ..
stanābhidhe māṃsapiṇḍe'dhare lālālaye'śucau ..86..
meaning:
नानामुद्राश्रये देशे रागिणो संततं रतिः..
स्तनाभिधे मांसपिण्डेऽधरे लालालयेऽशुचौ ..86..
text_mt:
The passionate man continuously finds delight in a place that bears various markings—
in that lump of flesh called a breast, and on the impure lip that is a receptacle for saliva. // 86

sanskrit_iast:
śroṇivaktrastanaṃ tāsāṃ kāmadevālayaṃ sadā ..
tasmātte na hi paśyanti santo hi dharmabhīravaḥ ..87..
meaning:
श्रोणिवक्त्रस्तनं तासां कामदेवालयं सदा ..
तस्मात्ते न हि पश्यन्ति सन्तो हि धर्मभीरवः ..87..
text_mt:
Their hips, face, and breasts are ever the abode of Kāmadeva;
therefore, the virtuous, who fear [violating] dharma, do not look upon them. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
ko dharmaḥ kiṃ yaśasteṣāṃ kā pratiṣṭhā ca kiṃ tapaḥ..
kiṃ buddhirvidyā dānaṃ ca parastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
को धर्मः किं यशस्तेषां का प्रतिष्ठा च किं तपः..
किं बुद्धिर्विद्या दानं च परस्त्रीषु च यन्मनः .. 88 ..
text_mt:
What is the dharma, what is the fame, what is the renown, and what is the asceticism,
what is the intellect, learning, or charity of those whose mind dwells on another's wife? // 88

sanskrit_iast:
ihāpyapayaśo duḥkhaṃ narakeṣu paratra ca ..
vāsaḥ prahārasteṣāṃ ca tāḍanaiḥ kṛmibhakṣaṇaiḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
इहाप्यपयशो दुःखं नरकेषु परत्र च ..
वासः प्रहारस्तेषां च ताडनैः कृमिभक्षणैः .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Here [in this world] there is disgrace and sorrow, and in the next world, a dwelling in the hells
with blows, beatings, and being eaten by worms. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhabījaṃ sukhaṃ matvā mūḍhāśca daivadoṣataḥ ..
parastrīsevanaṃ prītyā kurvanti saṃtataṃ mudā .. 4.35.90 ..
meaning:
दुःखबीजं सुखं मत्वा मूढाश्च दैवदोषतः ..
परस्त्रीसेवनं प्रीत्या कुर्वन्ति संततं मुदा .. 4.35.90 ..
text_mt:
Thinking the seed of sorrow to be happiness, fools, due to the fault of destiny,
constantly resort with pleasure to another's wife in joy. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā matpadāmbhojaṃ satkarma madhyamāḥ sadā ..
smaranti śaśvadadhamāḥ parastrīsevanaṃ mudā .. 91 ..
meaning:
उत्तमा मत्पदाम्भोजं सत्कर्म मध्यमाः सदा ..
स्मरन्ति शश्वदधमाः परस्त्रीसेवनं मुदा .. 91 ..
text_mt:
The best always remember my lotus feet; the middling remember good deeds;
the lowest constantly remember enjoyment with another's wife with delight. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
vipattiḥ saṃtataṃ tasya paravastuṣu yanmanaḥ ..
viśeṣataḥ parastrīṣu suvarṇeṣu ca bhūmiṣu .. 92 ..
meaning:
विपत्तिः संततं तस्य परवस्तुषु यन्मनः ..
विशेषतः परस्त्रीषु सुवर्णेषु च भूमिषु .. 92 ..
text_mt:
Misfortune is constant for him whose mind is fixed on another’s property,
especially on another’s wife, gold, and lands. // 92

sanskrit_iast:
daivātparastriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā viramedyo hariṃ smaran ..
dṛṣṭvā parasuvarṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanācchuciḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
दैवात्परस्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा विरमेद्यो हरिं स्मरन् ..
दृष्ट्वा परसुवर्णं च हस्तप्रक्षालनाच्छुचिः .. 93 ..
text_mt:
He who, having seen another’s wife by chance, desists while remembering Hari,
and, having seen another's gold, becomes pure by washing his hands [is safe]. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ naiva saṃsaktāḥ santaḥ svastrīṣu kāmataḥ ..
yakṣmavyādhijñānahānilokanindābhayena ca ..94..
meaning:
सततं नैव संसक्ताः सन्तः स्वस्त्रीषु कामतः ..
यक्ष्मव्याधिज्ञानहानिलोकनिन्दाभयेन च ..94..
text_mt:
The virtuous are never constantly attached out of lust even to their own wives;
and out of fear of consumption, disease, loss of knowledge, and worldly censure.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvinastapasyāyāṃ śāstracintāsu paṇḍitāḥ..
yogino yogacintāsu vedārtheṣu ca vaidikāḥ ..95..
meaning:
तपस्विनस्तपस्यायां शास्त्रचिन्तासु पण्डिताः..
योगिनो योगचिन्तासु वेदार्थेषु च वैदिकाः ..95..
text_mt:
Ascetics [are engaged] in asceticism, learned scholars in contemplation of the scriptures,
yogins in contemplation of yoga, and followers of the Vedas in Vedic truths;

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyaśca patisevāsu gṛhasthā gṛhakarmasu ..
viṣayeṣu viṣayiṇo madbhaktā mama sevane .. 96 ..
meaning:
साध्यश्च पतिसेवासु गृहस्था गृहकर्मसु ..
विषयेषु विषयिणो मद्भक्ता मम सेवने .. 96 ..
text_mt:
virtuous women in service to their husbands, householders in domestic duties,
worldly men in worldly pursuits, and my devotees in my service.

sanskrit_iast:
ete niyuktā eteṣu sabhāsu ca praśaṃsitāḥ...
vedoktācaraṇenaiva tadviruddhena ninditāḥ ..97..
meaning:
एते नियुक्ता एतेषु सभासु च प्रशंसिताः...
वेदोक्ताचरणेनैव तद्विरुद्धेन निन्दिताः ..97..
text_mt:
Engaged in these [duties], these are praised in assemblies
solely through conduct enjoined by the Vedas; through conduct contrary to that, they are censured.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve nityaṃ praśaṃsanti śaśvatsanmārgagāminam ..
hālikā api nindanti kuvartmagāminaṃ vidhe ..98..
meaning:
सर्वे नित्यं प्रशंसन्ति शश्वत्सन्मार्गगामिनम् ..
हालिका अपि निन्दन्ति कुवर्त्मगामिनं विधे ..98..
text_mt:
All people ever praise one who constantly walks the path of the good;
even ploughmen censure one who walks the bad path, O Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitā na parastrīṣu paravastuṣu te manaḥ ..
adyaprabhṛti jīvantaṃ niviṣṭaṃ madvareṇa ca .. 99 ..
meaning:
भविता न परस्त्रीषु परवस्तुषु ते मनः ..
अद्यप्रभृति जीवन्तं निविष्टं मद्वरेण च .. 99 ..
text_mt:
From today onward, as long as you live, by my boon
your mind shall not be directed toward another's wife or another's property.

sanskrit_iast:
madīyaviṣaye bāhye mayā dattaṃ kuru priyam ..
antarā matpadāmbhojacintāṃ vighnavināśinīm .. 4.35.100 ..
meaning:
मदीयविषये बाह्ये मया दत्तं कुरु प्रियम् ..
अन्तरा मत्पदाम्भोजचिन्तां विघ्नविनाशिनीम् .. 4.35.100 ..
text_mt:
In the external domain pertaining to me, pursue what is dear, granted by me,
and inwardly [maintain] meditation on my lotus feet, which destroys obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā bhavatu me brahmankāmadevasya kāminī ..
ratirnāma parityājyā ratyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ..101..
meaning:
कन्या भवतु मे ब्रह्मन्कामदेवस्य कामिनी ..
रतिर्नाम परित्याज्या रत्यधिष्ठातृदेवता ..101..
text_mt:
Let this maiden become the lover of Kāmadeva, O Brahman;
named Rati, the presiding deity of erotic pleasure, she is to be relinquished [by you]."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamāśvāsya kamalāpatiḥ ..
jagāma nityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vṛndāvanavinodanaḥ .. 102 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणमाश्वास्य कमलापतिः ..
जगाम नित्यं वैकुण्ठं वृन्दावनविनोदनः .. 102 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus and comforted Brahmā, the Lord of Kamalā,
he who delights in Vṛndāvana, went to eternal Vaikuṇṭha.

sanskrit_iast:

etena niyamenaiva brahmā tatyāja mohinīm ..
kathaṃ sa kulaṭāśāpādapūjyaḥ saṃbabhūva ha .. 1 ..
meaning:

एतेन नियमेनैव ब्रह्मा तत्याज मोहिनीम् ..
कथं स कुलटाशापादपूज्यः संबभूव ह .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 036

sanskrit_iast:

कथं तस्य दर्पभङ्गं चकार कमलापतिः ..

rāseśvarīvacaḥ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ ..

sanskrit_iast:

brahmā ciraṃ tapastaptvā matto labdhvā varaṃ varam ..
sṛṣṭiṃ nānāvidhāṃ kṛtvā vidhātā sa babhūva ha .. 4 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मा चिरं तपस्तप्त्वा मत्तो लब्ध्वा वरं वरम् ..
सृष्टिं नानाविधां कृत्वा विधाता स बभूव ह .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tapasāṃ phaladātā ca sarveṣāṃ śāstikṛtprabhuḥ ..
ātmānamīśvaraṃ jñātvā mahāgarvo babhūva ha ..5..
meaning:
तपसां फलदाता च सर्वेषां शास्तिकृत्प्रभुः ..
आत्मानमीश्वरं ज्ञात्वा महागर्वो बभूव ह ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu garvaparyantamunnatiḥ ..
iti matvā brahmaṇaśca darpabhaṅgaḥ kṛto mayā ..6..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डेषु च सर्वेषु गर्वपर्यन्तमुन्नतिः ..
इति मत्वा ब्रह्मणश्च दर्पभङ्गः कृतो मया ..6..

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ bhaveddarpo brahmāṇḍeṣu parātparaḥ ..
vijñāya sarvaṃ sarvātmā teṣāṃ śāstā'hameva ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
येषां येषां भवेद्दर्पो ब्रह्माण्डेषु परात्परः ..
विज्ञाय सर्वं सर्वात्मा तेषां शास्ताऽहमेव च .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prathame brahmaṇo garvo mayā cūrṇīkṛtaḥ śrutaḥ ..
śaṅkarasya ca pārvatyāścandrasya ca ravestathā..8..
meaning:
प्रथमे ब्रह्मणो गर्वो मया चूर्णीकृतः श्रुतः ..
शङ्करस्य च पार्वत्याश्चन्द्रस्य च रवेस्तथा..8..

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
वह्नेर्दुर्वाससश्चैव तथा धन्वन्तरेः प्रिये..
क्रमेण दर्पभङ्गं च कथयामि निशामय .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva yeṣāṃ garvo bhavetpriye ..

meaning:

एवंविधमहं तेषां चूर्णीभूतं करोमि च .. 4.36.10..

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..

meaning:

श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुका ..
पप्रच्छ राधा यत्नेन संत्रस्ता भयविह्वला .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:

kasya kena prabhāveṇa mahādarpo babhūva ha ..

कस्य केन प्रभावेण महादर्पो बभूव ह ..
त्वया केन प्रभावेण तस्य भङ्गः कृतः पुरा .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kathayasva prāṇanātha sarveṣāṃ darpabhañjana ..
darpado bhayadaḥ prāṇadānaikakāraṇeśvara .. 13 ..
meaning:
कथयस्व प्राणनाथ सर्वेषां दर्पभञ्जन ..
दर्पदो भयदः प्राणदानैककारणेश्वर .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yena bhūtaṃ garvacūrṇaṃ śrutaṃ trijagatāṃ vidheḥ ..
anyeṣāṃ śrūyatāṃ rādhe vyāsena kathayāmi te .. 14..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
येन भूतं गर्वचूर्णं श्रुतं त्रिजगतां विधेः ..
अन्येषां श्रूयतां राधे व्यासेन कथयामि ते .. 14..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ śivo madaṃśaśca saṃhartā jagatāṃ ca yaḥ ..
tejasā matsamaḥ pūrṇo jñānena ca guṇena ca .. 19..
meaning:
स्वयं शिवो मदंशश्च संहर्ता जगतां च यः ..
तेजसा मत्समः पूर्णो ज्ञानेन च गुणेन च .. 19..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyanti yogino yaṃ sa yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ..
jñānānandasvarūpo'yaṃ tasyākhyānaṃ śṛṇu priye..16..
meaning:
ध्यायन्ति योगिनो यं स योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ..
ज्ञानानन्दस्वरूपोऽयं तस्याख्यानं शृणु प्रिये..16..

sanskrit_iast:
yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapastaptvā divāniśam ..
bhūtvā ca matkalāpūrṇo babhūva matsamo vibhuḥ..17..
meaning:
युगषष्टिसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा दिवानिशम् ..
भूत्वा च मत्कलापूर्णो बभूव मत्समो विभुः..17..

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tejasā śaśvattejorāśirbabhūva ha ..
sūryakoṭiprabhāvaśca bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ ..18..
meaning:
तपसा तेजसा शश्वत्तेजोराशिर्बभूव ह ..
सूर्यकोटिप्रभावश्च भक्तानां कल्पपादपः ..18..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ ca yogīndrāstattejo bahukālataḥ ..
tadantare ca paśyanti svarūpamatisundaram..19..
meaning:
ध्यायंध्यायं च योगीन्द्रास्तत्तेजो बहुकालतः ..
तदन्तरे च पश्यन्ति स्वरूपमतिसुन्दरम्..19..

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam ..
triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam..4.36.20..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं पञ्चवक्त्रं त्रिलोचनम् ..
त्रिशूलपट्टिशकरं व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरं वरम्..4.36.20..

sanskrit_iast:
japantaṃ svātmanā''tmānaṃ śvetābjabījamālayā ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ candracūḍaṃ parātparam .. 21 ..
meaning:
जपन्तं स्वात्मना'ऽत्मानं श्वेताब्जबीजमालया ..
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं चन्द्रचूडं परात्परम् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇākāraṃ jaṭābhāraṃ dadhataṃ śirasā mudā..
śāntaṃ kāntaṃ trijagatāṃ bhaktānu'grahakātaram..22..
meaning:
स्वर्णाकारं जटाभारं दधतं शिरसा मुदा..
शान्तं कान्तं त्रिजगतां भक्तानुऽग्रहकातरम्..22..

sanskrit_iast:
atha svamīśvaraṃ matvā pradātā sarvasaṃpadām..
dadāti sarvaṃ sarvebhyo vāñchitaṃ kalpapādapaḥ..23..
meaning:
अथ स्वमीश्वरं मत्वा प्रदाता सर्वसंपदाम्..
ददाति सर्वं सर्वेभ्यो वाञ्छितं कल्पपादपः..23..

sanskrit_iast:
yo yaṃ vāñchati taṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā vareśvaraḥ ..
babhūva garvasaṃyuktaḥ svātmārāmaḥ svalīlayā ..24..
meaning:
यो यं वाञ्छति तं तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा वरेश्वरः ..
बभूव गर्वसंयुक्तः स्वात्मारामः स्वलीलया ..24..

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā ca vṛko daityastapastepe śivasya ca ..
kedāre ca kaṭhoreṇa varṣamekaṃ divāniśam .. 25 ..
meaning:
एकदा च वृको दैत्यस्तपस्तेपे शिवस्य च ..
केदारे च कठोरेण वर्षमेकं दिवानिशम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
And once the demon Vṛka performed asceticism directed to Śiva,
with severe [austerity] at Kedāra, for one year, day and night. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ yāti tatsamīpaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
varaṃ dātuṃ yathā'bhīṣṭaṃ na jagrāhāsuro varam .. 26 ..
meaning:
नित्यं याति तत्समीपं कृपया च कृपानिधिः ..
वरं दातुं यथाऽभीष्टं न जग्राहासुरो वरम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
The treasure of compassion went near him daily out of grace,
to bestow a boon according to his desire, but the demon would not accept a boon. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
varṣānte śaṅkaraḥ śaśvattasthau tatpurataḥ svayam ..
varado bhaktipāśena kṣaṇaṃ gantuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
वर्षान्ते शङ्करः शश्वत्तस्थौ तत्पुरतः स्वयम् ..
वरदो भक्तिपाशेन क्षणं गन्तुं न स क्षमः .. 27 ..
text_mt: bound by the cord of devotion, the giver of boons was unable to depart even for an instant. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ haraḥ padam ..
daityaḥ kiṃcinna gṛhṇāti paritaḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्यं सर्वसिद्धिं भुक्तिं मुक्तिं हरः पदम् ..
दैत्यः किंचिन्न गृह्णाति परितः शूलपाणिनः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Though Hara offered all sovereignty, all supernatural powers, worldly enjoyment, liberation, [his own] realm,
the demon took nothing at all from the trident-holder standing nearby. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyamānaṃ tatpadābjaṃ dṛṣṭvā trasto maheśvaraḥ ..
ayācitāraṃ niśceṣṭaṃ ruroda premavihvalaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
ध्यायमानं तत्पदाब्जं दृष्ट्वा त्रस्तो महेश्वरः ..
अयाचितारं निश्चेष्टं रुरोद प्रेमविह्वलः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Seeing him meditating on his lotus feet, Maheśvara was distressed;
overcome with love for the unasking, motionless [demon], he wept. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
atīva rodanāttasya dhyānabhaṅgo babhūva ha ..
dadarśa purataḥ sākṣāddātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām .. 4.36.30 ..
meaning:
अतीव रोदनात्तस्य ध्यानभङ्गो बभूव ह ..
ददर्श पुरतः साक्षाद्दातारं सर्वसंपदाम् .. 4.36.30 ..
text_mt:
Indeed, because of his intense weeping, [the demon's] meditation was broken,
and he beheld before him the giver of all fortunes in person. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
yanmāyayā varaṃ vavre daityendro bhaktipūrvakam ..
hastaṃ dadhe ca yanmūrdhni sa bhasma bhaviteti ca ..31 ..
meaning:
यन्मायया वरं वव्रे दैत्येन्द्रो भक्तिपूर्वकम् ..
हस्तं दधे च यन्मूर्ध्नि स भस्म भवितेति च ..31 ..
text_mt:
Deluded by his illusion, the demon king devoutly asked for a boon:
"Upon whose head I place my hand, he shall turn to ashes." // 31

sanskrit_iast:
omityuktvā prayāntaṃ taṃ dudrāva daityapuṃgavaḥ..
mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyubhayāddudrāva trāsavihvalaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
ओमित्युक्त्वा प्रयान्तं तं दुद्राव दैत्यपुंगवः..
मृत्युञ्जयो मृत्युभयाद्दुद्राव त्रासविह्वलः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Having said "So be it," as he went away, the best of demons ran after him;
out of fear of death, Mṛtyuñjaya ran, distraught with terror. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
papāta ḍamarustasya vyāghracarma manoharam ..
digambaro daśadiśo bheje dānavabhītaye .. 33 ..
meaning:
पपात डमरुस्तस्य व्याघ्रचर्म मनोहरम् ..
दिगम्बरो दशदिशो भेजे दानवभीतये .. 33 ..
text_mt:
His drum fell, and his beautiful tiger skin;
naked, he fled to the ten directions out of fear of the demon. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
na hanti taṃ ca kṛpayā bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ ..
duṣṭānusāraṃ sādhuśca na karoti kadācana .. 34 ..
meaning:
न हन्ति तं च कृपया भक्तं च भक्तवत्सलः ..
दुष्टानुसारं साधुश्च न करोति कदाचन .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Out of compassion, the lover of devotees did not slay that devotee;
for a virtuous person never acts according to the evil [of others]. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
sādhavo ghnanti ghnantaṃ ca bhṛtyaṃ putraṃ priyāṃ vinā ..
prabodhituṃ na śaktaśca svātmānaṃ kṛpayā samam .. 35 ..
meaning:
साधवो घ्नन्ति घ्नन्तं च भृत्यं पुत्रं प्रियां विना ..
प्रबोधितुं न शक्तश्च स्वात्मानं कृपया समम् .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Virtuous men do slay one who slays, except a servant, a son, or a beloved wife;
yet out of compassion, he was not able to enlighten himself in the same way. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ svamṛtyuṃ matvā ca bhītaśca nirahaṃkṛtaḥ ..
smāraṃsmāraṃ ca māṃ bhadre māmeva śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 36 ..
meaning:
शिवः स्वमृत्युं मत्वा च भीतश्च निरहंकृतः ..
स्मारंस्मारं च मां भद्रे मामेव शरणं ययौ .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Thinking of his own death, frightened and stripped of pride,
remembering me again and again, O auspicious lady, Śiva went to me alone for refuge. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā svāśramamāyāntaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukam ..
he hare rakṣa rakṣeti japantaṃ bhayavihvalam ..37..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स्वाश्रममायान्तं शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकम् ..
हे हरे रक्ष रक्षेति जपन्तं भयविह्वलम् ..37..
text_mt:
Seeing him arriving at my hermitage with throat, lips, and palate dried up,
chanting "O Hari, protect me, protect me!", distraught with fear, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya tatsamīpe ca sa daityo bodhito mayā ..
pṛṣṭaśca sarvavṛttāntamuvāca māṃ krameṇa ca .. 38 ..
meaning:
संस्थाप्य तत्समीपे च स दैत्यो बोधितो मया ..
पृष्टश्च सर्ववृत्तान्तमुवाच मां क्रमेण च .. 38 ..
text_mt:
and having caused [Śiva] to halt beside me, I addressed that demon;
questioned about the entire event, he told me everything in order. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mamājñayā tūrṇaṃ vañcito māyayā'suraḥ ..
dattvā svamūrdhni hastaṃ ca sadyo bhasma babhūva ha ..39..
meaning:
तदा ममाज्ञया तूर्णं वञ्चितो माययाऽसुरः ..
दत्त्वा स्वमूर्ध्नि हस्तं च सद्यो भस्म बभूव ह ..39..
text_mt:
Then, by my command, the demon was quickly tricked through illusion:
placing his hand upon his own head, he instantly turned to ashes. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
tadā siddhāḥ surendrāśca munīndrā manavo mudā ..
tuṣṭuvurmāṃ subhaktyā ca lajjayā lajjitaḥ śivaḥ ..4.36.40..
meaning:
तदा सिद्धाः सुरेन्द्राश्च मुनीन्द्रा मनवो मुदा ..
तुष्टुवुर्मां सुभक्त्या च लज्जया लज्जितः शिवः ..4.36.40..
text_mt:
Then the Siddhas, the lords of the gods, the chief sages, and the Manus gladly
praised me with great devotion, while Śiva was overcome with shame. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva cūrṇastadgarvo jagāma bodhito mayā ..
varaṃ dadāti varadastato bodhyo hyahaṃ śivaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
बभूव चूर्णस्तद्गर्वो जगाम बोधितो मया ..
वरं ददाति वरदस्ततो बोध्यो ह्यहं शिवः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
His pride was crushed, and enlightened by me, he departed;
the giver of boons grants boons, but then it is I who must enlighten Śiva. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
atha garvānvito rudro hantuṃ tripuramulbaṇam ..
matvā manasi saṃhartā sarveṣāṃ jagatāmiti .. 42 ..
meaning:
अथ गर्वान्वितो रुद्रो हन्तुं त्रिपुरमुल्बणम् ..
मत्वा मनसि संहर्ता सर्वेषां जगतामिति .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Then Rudra, filled with pride, went to slay the terrible Tripura,
thinking in his mind: "I am the destroyer of all worlds! // 42

sanskrit_iast:
ko'yaṃ pataṅgavaddaitya iti matvā yayau raṇam ..
vihāya śūlaṃ maddattaṃ madīyakavacaṃ param .. 43 ..
meaning:
कोऽयं पतङ्गवद्दैत्य इति मत्वा ययौ रणम् ..
विहाय शूलं मद्दत्तं मदीयकवचं परम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
What is this demon, like a moth?"—so thinking, he marched to battle,
having cast aside the trident given by me and my supreme armour. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ babhūva samaraṃ varṣamekaṃ divāniśam ..
na ko'pi jetuṃ kaṃ śakto dvau samau samare tadā ..44..
meaning:
चिरं बभूव समरं वर्षमेकं दिवानिशम् ..
न कोऽपि जेतुं कं शक्तो द्वौ समौ समरे तदा ..44..
text_mt:
A long battle took place for one year, day and night;
neither was able to conquer the other, the two being equals in the battle then. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā daityendro māyayā priye ..
atyūrdhvaṃ ca samuttasthau pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam .. 45 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां चरणं कृत्वा दैत्येन्द्रो मायया प्रिये ..
अत्यूर्ध्वं च समुत्तस्थौ पञ्चाशत्कोटियोजनम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Planting his foot upon the earth, O dear one, the lord of the demons, through illusion,

sanskrit_iast:
uttasthau śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ hantuṃ daityaṃ jagatprabhuḥ ..
babhūva tatra yuddhaṃ ca māsamekaṃ nirāśraye .. .. 46 ..
meaning:
उत्तस्थौ शंकरस्तूर्णं हन्तुं दैत्यं जगत्प्रभुः ..
बभूव तत्र युद्धं च मासमेकं निराश्रये .. .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkara, the lord of the world, quickly rose up to slay the demon;
and there a fight took place without support for one month. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇi cāpaṃ ciccheda śaṅkarasyāsuro balī ..
rathaṃ babhañja daityendraścāpamastrāṇi śaṅkarāt .. 47 ..
meaning:
अस्त्राणि चापं चिच्छेद शङ्करस्यासुरो बली ..
रथं बभञ्ज दैत्येन्द्रश्चापमस्त्राणि शङ्करात् .. 47 ..
text_mt:
The mighty demon cut to pieces Śaṅkara's weapons and bow;
the king of demons smashed the chariot, and the bow and missiles from Śaṅkara. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna muṣṭinā rudro dānavendraṃ prakopataḥ ..
vajramuṣṭiprahāreṇa sadyo mūrcchāmavāpa saḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
जघान मुष्टिना रुद्रो दानवेन्द्रं प्रकोपतः ..
वज्रमुष्टिप्रहारेण सद्यो मूर्च्छामवाप सः .. 48 ..
text_mt:
In great fury, Rudra struck the chief of the dānavas with his fist;
from the blow of the thunderbolt fist, he immediately fell unconscious. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya kopāddānavapuṃgavaḥ ..
śivaṃ śayānamuttolya pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 49 ..
meaning:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य कोपाद्दानवपुंगवः ..
शिवं शयानमुत्तोल्य पातयामास भूतले .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Regaining consciousness in an instant, the foremost of the Danavas, out of wrath,
lifted up the fallen Śiva and dashed him onto the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarathe pātite rudre devā devarṣayo bhiyā ..
tuṣṭuvurmāṃ paritrāhi kṛṣṇetyuktvā punaḥpunaḥ .. 4.36.50 ..
meaning:
सरथे पातिते रुद्रे देवा देवर्षयो भिया ..
तुष्टुवुर्मां परित्राहि कृष्णेत्युक्त्वा पुनःपुनः .. 4.36.50 ..
text_mt:
When Rudra had fallen along with his chariot, the gods and celestial sages, out of fear,
praised me, crying out again and again: 'Save us, O Kṛṣṇa!'

sanskrit_iast:
haraḥ sasmāra māmeva nirbhayo bhayakāraṇam ..
tuṣṭāva bhaktyā stotreṇa mayā dattena saṃkaṭe .. 51 ..
meaning:
हरः सस्मार मामेव निर्भयो भयकारणम् ..
तुष्टाव भक्त्या स्तोत्रेण मया दत्तेन संकटे .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Hara, free from fear, remembered me, the source of fear,
and with devotion praised me in that crisis through a hymn of praise given by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā'haṃ kalayā śīghraṃ vṛṣarūpaṃ vidhāya ca ..
śayānaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dhṛtvā viṣāṇābhyāmurukramam .. 52 ..
meaning:
तदाऽहं कलया शीघ्रं वृषरूपं विधाय च ..
शयानं शंकरं धृत्वा विषाणाभ्यामुरुक्रमम् .. 52 ..
text_mt:
Then, quickly assuming the form of a bull by a part [of myself],
and lifting the lying Śaṅkara of mighty strides with my horns,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau tasmai svakavacaṃ svaśūlamarimardanam ..
prāpya taddānavasthānamatyūrdhvaṃ ca nirāśrayam .. 53 ..
meaning:
ददौ तस्मै स्वकवचं स्वशूलमरिमर्दनम् ..
प्राप्य तद्दानवस्थानमत्यूर्ध्वं च निराश्रयम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
[I] gave him my own armour and my trident that crushes enemies.
Having reached that place of the Danava, extremely high up and unsupported,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dattena śūlena jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ ..
māmeva darpahantāraṃ tuṣṭāva vrīḍitaḥ punaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
मया दत्तेन शूलेन जघान त्रिपुरं हरः ..
मामेव दर्पहन्तारं तुष्टाव व्रीडितः पुनः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Hara struck Tripura with the trident given by me.
Ashamed, he praised me alone once again, the destroyer of pride.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ papāta daityendraścūrṇībhūtaśca bhūtale ..
devatā munayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ mudā ..55..
meaning:
सद्यः पपात दैत्येन्द्रश्चूर्णीभूतश्च भूतले ..
देवता मुनयः सर्वे तुष्टुवुः शङ्करं मुदा ..55..
text_mt:
At once the lord of the Daityas fell down, shattered to pieces upon the earth's surface.
All the deities and sages joyfully praised Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatyāja śaṅakaro darpaṃ vighnabījaṃ tato vibhuḥ ..
jñānānandasvarūpaśca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmasu..56..
meaning:
तत्याज शङकरो दर्पं विघ्नबीजं ततो विभुः ..
ज्ञानानन्दस्वरूपश्च निर्लिप्तः सर्वकर्मसु..56..
text_mt:
Thereupon the all-pervading Śaṅkara cast off pride, the seed of obstacles,
becoming the embodiment of knowledge and bliss, untainted in all actions.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa vahāmi tena taṃ priyam ..
mama priyatamo nāsti trailokyeṣu śivātparaḥ ..57..
meaning:
ततोऽहं वृषरूपेण वहामि तेन तं प्रियम् ..
मम प्रियतमो नास्ति त्रैलोक्येषु शिवात्परः ..57..
text_mt:
Therefore I, in the form of a bull, carry that beloved one.
In the three worlds there is none dearer to me than Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥsvarūpo brahmā me jñānarūpo maheśvaraḥ ..
buddhirbhagavatī durgā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī .. 58 ..
meaning:
मनःस्वरूपो ब्रह्मा मे ज्ञानरूपो महेश्वरः ..
बुद्धिर्भगवती दुर्गा मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Brahmā is my mind embodied; Maheśvara is [my] knowledge embodied;
the goddess Durgā, the sovereign Mūlaprakṛti, is [my] intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
nidrādayaḥ śaktayo yāstāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ..
vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sā svayaṃ ca sarasvatī ..59..
meaning:
निद्रादयः शक्तयो यास्ताः सर्वाः प्रकृतेः कलाः ..
वागधिष्ठातृदेवी या सा स्वयं च सरस्वती ..59..
text_mt:
The powers such as sleep are all parts of Prakṛti.
The presiding goddess of speech is Sarasvatī herself.

sanskrit_iast:
mama kalyāṇādhidevo harṣarūpo gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
paramārthaḥ svayaṃ dharmo mama bhakto hutāśanaḥ .. 4.36.60 ..
meaning:
मम कल्याणाधिदेवो हर्षरूपो गणेश्वरः ..
परमार्थः स्वयं धर्मो मम भक्तो हुताशनः .. 4.36.60 ..
text_mt:
Gaṇeśvara, the embodiment of joy, is my presiding deity of auspiciousness.
Dharma himself is the highest truth; the fire-god is my devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryādhidevī me sarvagolokavāsinaḥ ..
prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ sadā prāṇāghikā mama .. 61 ..
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्याधिदेवी मे सर्वगोलोकवासिनः ..
प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेवी त्वं सदा प्राणाघिका मम .. 61 ..
text_mt:
[Lakṣmī] is the presiding goddess of all opulence for me, who abide completely in Goloka.
You are the presiding goddess of my vital breath, ever dearer to me than my life.

sanskrit_iast:
gopāṅganāstava kalā ata eva mama priyāḥ ..
mallomakūpajā gopāḥ sarve golokavāsinaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
गोपाङ्गनास्तव कला अत एव मम प्रियाः ..
मल्लोमकूपजा गोपाः सर्वे गोलोकवासिनः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
The cowherd women are your parts; therefore they are dear to me.
All the cowherds dwelling in Goloka were born from the pores of my skin.

sanskrit_iast:
tejaḥsvarūpaḥ sūryaśca prāṇā me vāyavaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
jalādhidevo varuṇaḥ pṛthivī me malodbhavā .. 63 ..
meaning:
तेजःस्वरूपः सूर्यश्च प्राणा मे वायवः स्मृताः ..
जलाधिदेवो वरुणः पृथिवी मे मलोद्भवा .. 63 ..
text_mt:
The sun is [my] splendour embodied; the winds are known as my vital breaths.
Varuṇa is the presiding deity of waters; the earth was born from my impurities.

sanskrit_iast:
mama śūnyo mahākāśo madano mānasodbhavaḥ ..
indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve matkalāṃśāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
मम शून्यो महाकाशो मदनो मानसोद्भवः ..
इन्द्रादयः सुराः सर्वे मत्कलांशांशसंभवाः .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Great space is my void; the god of love arose from my mind.
All the gods, Indra and the rest, are born from a portion of a part of me.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni sṛṣṭibījāni mahadādīni caiva hi ..
sarveṣāṃ bījarūpo'haṃ svayamātmā nirāśrayaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
एतानि सृष्टिबीजानि महदादीनि चैव हि ..
सर्वेषां बीजरूपोऽहं स्वयमात्मा निराश्रयः .. 65 ..
text_mt:
These, beginning with Mahat, are indeed the seeds of creation.
I myself am the seed-form of all, the Self without support.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvo me pratibimbaśca karmabhogādhikārakaḥ ..
ahaṃ sākṣī nirīhaśca na bhogī sarvakarmasu .. 66 ..
meaning:
जीवो मे प्रतिबिम्बश्च कर्मभोगाधिकारकः ..
अहं साक्षी निरीहश्च न भोगी सर्वकर्मसु .. 66 ..
text_mt:
The individual soul is my reflection, entitled to experience the fruits of karma.
I am the witness, free from desire, not an experiencer in any actions.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktadhyānārthadeho'yaṃ mama svecchāmayasya ca ..
prakṛtiḥ puruṣo'haṃ ca eka eva parātparaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
भक्तध्यानार्थदेहोऽयं मम स्वेच्छामयस्य च ..
प्रकृतिः पुरुषोऽहं च एक एव परात्परः .. 67 ..
text_mt:
This body of mine, which consists of my own will, is for the purpose of the devotees' meditation.
I am both Prakṛti and Puruṣa, one alone, higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe śivadarpavimocanam ..
sṛṣṭibījaṃ ca śṛṇu me pārvatīdarpamocanam ..68..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं राधे शिवदर्पविमोचनम् ..
सृष्टिबीजं च शृणु मे पार्वतीदर्पमोचनम् ..68..
text_mt:
Thus has been recounted to you, O Rādhā, the removal of Śiva's pride.
Now hear from me the seed of creation and the removal of Pārvatī's pride.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ityuktavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ..
papraccha rādhikā devī nigūḍhamabhivāñchitam .. 69 ..
meaning:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ..
इत्युक्तवन्तं श्रीकृष्णं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ..
पप्रच्छ राधिका देवी निगूढमभिवाञ्छितम् .. 69 ..
text_mt:
To the blessed Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman and Supreme Lord, who had spoken thus,
the goddess Rādhikā asked a secret and desired question.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrādhikovāca ..
bhagavansarvatattvajña sarvabīja sanātana ..
vada me vāñchitaṃ praśnaṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam .. 4.36.70 ..
meaning:
श्रीराधिकोवाच ..
भगवन्सर्वतत्त्वज्ञ सर्वबीज सनातन ..
वद मे वाञ्छितं प्रश्नं सर्वसंदेहभञ्जनम् .. 4.36.70 ..
text_mt:
O Blessed One, knower of all principles, eternal seed of all,
answer my desired question that dispels all doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñānādhidevaśca śaṃkaraḥ sarvatattvavit ..
mṛtyuṃjayaḥ kālakālo bhagavāṃstvatsamo mahān ..71..
meaning:
सर्वज्ञानाधिदेवश्च शंकरः सर्वतत्त्ववित् ..
मृत्युंजयः कालकालो भगवांस्त्वत्समो महान् ..71..
text_mt:
Śaṅkara is the presiding deity of all knowledge, the knower of all principles,
the conqueror of death, the death of Time itself, the lord equal to you, the great one.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ vibhūtigātraśca pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ ..
digambaro jaṭādhārī nāgasaṃghātabhūṣaṇaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
कथं विभूतिगात्रश्च पञ्चवक्त्रस्त्रिलोचनः ..
दिगम्बरो जटाधारी नागसंघातभूषणः .. 72 ..
text_mt:
Why is his body smeared with ashes, having five faces and three eyes,
space-clad, wearing matted locks, adorned with a multitude of serpents?

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣeṇāṭati devendro vihāya varavāhanam ..
na bibharti kathaṃ ratnasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇam ..73..
meaning:
वृषेणाटति देवेन्द्रो विहाय वरवाहनम् ..
न बिभर्ति कथं रत्नसारनिर्माणभूषणम् ..73..
text_mt:
[Why] does the lord of gods wander upon a bull, abandoning excellent vehicles?
Why does he not wear ornaments made of the finest gems?

sanskrit_iast:
vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ tyaktvā dhatte śārdūlacarmakam ..
dhatte dhattūrakusumaṃ pārijātaṃ vihāya ca ..74..
meaning:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकं त्यक्त्वा धत्ते शार्दूलचर्मकम् ..
धत्ते धत्तूरकुसुमं पारिजातं विहाय च ..74..
text_mt:
Discarding garments cleansed by fire, he wears a tiger skin;
abandoning the pārijāta flower, he wears the dhattūra flower.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti ratnakirīṭecchā jaṭāyāṃ prītiruttamā ..
divyalokaṃ parityajya śmaśāneṣu spṛhā vibhoḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
नास्ति रत्नकिरीटेच्छा जटायां प्रीतिरुत्तमा ..
दिव्यलोकं परित्यज्य श्मशानेषु स्पृहा विभोः .. 75 ..
text_mt:
He has no desire for a jewelled crown; his greatest delight is in matted hair.
Abandoning the celestial realm, the Lord's longing is for cremation grounds.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukastūrīsugaṃdhikusumāni ca ..
tyaktvā spṛhā bilvapatre bilvakāṣṭhānulepane..76..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीसुगंधिकुसुमानि च ..
त्यक्त्वा स्पृहा बिल्वपत्रे बिल्वकाष्ठानुलेपने..76..
text_mt:
Forsaking sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and fragrant flowers,
his desire is for bilva leaves and the unguent of bilva wood.

sanskrit_iast:
etadveditumicchāmi vyāsena kathaya prabho ..
śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ nātha varddhate me manaḥspṛhā .. 77 ..
meaning:
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि व्यासेन कथय प्रभो ..
श्रोतुं कौतूहलं नाथ वर्द्धते मे मनःस्पृहा .. 77 ..
text_mt:
I wish to know this; tell me in detail, O Lord!
My curiosity to hear it, O master, and the desire of my heart increases.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi .. 78 ..
meaning:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मधुसूदनः..
कथां कथितुमारेभे कृत्वा राधां स्ववक्षसि .. 78 ..
text_mt: placed Rādhā against his chest, and began to tell the story:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapaḥ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ ..
virarāma pūrṇatamo dhyātvā māṃ manasā mudā ..79..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
युगषष्टिसहस्राणि तपः कृत्वा महेश्वरः ..
विरराम पूर्णतमो ध्यात्वा मां मनसा मुदा ..79..
text_mt:
Having performed austerities for sixty thousand yugas,
Maheśvara, most fulfilled, rested, joyfully meditating on me in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare māṃ ca dadarśa purataḥ sthitam ..
atīva kamanīyāṅgaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram.. ..4.36.80...
ahonirvacanīyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam ..
na babhūva vitṛṣṇaśca locanābhyāṃ trilocanaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे मां च ददर्श पुरतः स्थितम् ..
अतीव कमनीयाङ्गं किशोरं श्यामसुन्दरम्.. ..4.36.80...
अहोनिर्वचनीयं च दृष्ट्वा रूपमनुत्तमम् ..
न बभूव वितृष्णश्च लोचनाभ्यां त्रिलोचनः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
At that moment, he saw me standing before him,
possessing extremely lovely limbs, a youth dark and beautiful.
Having seen that matchless form, indescribable and wondrous,
Trilocana was not satisfied with [looking with only] two eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyannimeṣarahita iti matvā svamānase ..
bhaktyudrekānmahābhakto ruroda premavihvalaḥ .. 82 ..
meaning:
पश्यन्निमेषरहित इति मत्वा स्वमानसे ..
भक्त्युद्रेकान्महाभक्तो रुरोद प्रेमविह्वलः .. 82 ..
text_mt:
Gazing without blinking, he thought thus in his mind;
from an overflow of devotion, that great devotee wept, overwhelmed with love:

sanskrit_iast:
sahasravadano'nanto bhāgyavāṃśca caturmukhaḥ ..
bahubhirlocanairdṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva bahubhirmukhaiḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
सहस्रवदनोऽनन्तो भाग्यवांश्च चतुर्मुखः ..
बहुभिर्लोचनैर्दृष्ट्वा तुष्टाव बहुभिर्मुखैः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
“Thousand-faced Ananta and fortunate Caturmukha,
having seen with many eyes, praised [him] with many mouths.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāmi kiṃ vā kiṃ staumi saṃprāpya nāthamīdṛśam ..
āsyaikena locanābhyāṃ caturddhā sa punaḥ punaḥ .. 84 ..
meaning:
पश्यामि किं वा किं स्तौमि संप्राप्य नाथमीदृशम् ..
आस्यैकेन लोचनाभ्यां चतुर्द्धा स पुनः पुनः .. 84 ..
text_mt:
Shall I look, or shall I praise, having attained such a lord
with one mouth and two eyes?” Again and again, fourfold,

sanskrit_iast:
sva mānase kurvatīdaṃ śaṃkare ca tapasvini ..
tadbabhūva caturvaktraṃ pūrveṇa saha pañcamam .. 85 ..
meaning:
स्व मानसे कुर्वतीदं शंकरे च तपस्विनि ..
तद्बभूव चतुर्वक्त्रं पूर्वेण सह पञ्चमम् .. 85 ..
text_mt:
as the ascetic Śaṅkara was thinking this in his mind,
four faces appeared, making five together with the previous one.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikavaktraṃ śuśubhe locanaiśca tribhistribhiḥ.
babhūva tena tannāma pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ .. 86 ..
meaning:
एकैकवक्त्रं शुशुभे लोचनैश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः.
बभूव तेन तन्नाम पञ्चवक्त्रस्त्रिलोचनः .. 86 ..
text_mt: Each single face shone with three eyes each; / by this, his name became Pañcavaktra and Trilocana.

sanskrit_iast:
stavanādadhikaprītiḥ śivasya darśane mama ..
tenādhikāni tasyaivaṃ babhūvurlocanāni ca.. .. 87 ..
meaning:
स्तवनादधिकप्रीतिः शिवस्य दर्शने मम ..
तेनाधिकानि तस्यैवं बभूवुर्लोचनानि च.. .. 87 ..
text_mt:
Śiva felt greater joy in beholding me than in praising me;
therefore, more eyes appeared on him in this way.

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣūṃṣi guṇarūpāṇi tasya brahmasvarūpiṇaḥ ..
sattvaṃ rajastama iti tasya hetuṃ niśāmaya .. 88 ..
meaning:
चक्षूंषि गुणरूपाणि तस्य ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणः ..
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति तस्य हेतुं निशामय .. 88 ..
text_mt:
The eyes of that one who has the nature of Brahman consist of the gunas:
sattva, rajas, and tamas; hear the reason for this.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvāṃśena dṛśā śaṃbhuḥ paśyanpāti ca sāttvikān ..
rājasena rājasikāṃstāmasena ca tāmasān .. 89 ..
meaning:
सत्त्वांशेन दृशा शंभुः पश्यन्पाति च सात्त्विकान् ..
राजसेन राजसिकांस्तामसेन च तामसान् .. 89 ..
text_mt:
Looking with the eye of the sattva portion, Śambhu protects the sattvic;
with the rajasic [eye] the rajasic, and with the tamasic [eye] the tamasic.

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣuṣastāmasātpaścāllalāṭasthāddharasya ca ..
saṃhārakāle saṃharturagnirāvirbhavetkrudhā .. 4.36.90 ..
meaning:
चक्षुषस्तामसात्पश्चाल्ललाटस्थाद्धरस्य च ..
संहारकाले संहर्तुरग्निराविर्भवेत्क्रुधा .. 4.36.90 ..
text_mt:
Later, from the tamasic eye located on the forehead of Hara,
at the time of dissolution, fire blazes forth in wrath from the Destroyer,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭitālapramāṇaśca sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ..
lelihāno dīrghaśikhastrailokyaṃ dagdhumīśvaraḥ ..91..
meaning:
कोटितालप्रमाणश्च सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः ..
लेलिहानो दीर्घशिखस्त्रैलोक्यं दग्धुमीश्वरः ..91..
text_mt:
measuring ten million palm trees in height and radiant as ten million suns,
licking its lips with long flames, capable of burning the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtigātraḥ sa vibhuḥ satīsaṃskārabhasmanā ..
dhatte tasyā asthimālāṃ premabhāvena bhasma ca .. 92 ..
meaning:
विभूतिगात्रः स विभुः सतीसंस्कारभस्मना ..
धत्ते तस्या अस्थिमालां प्रेमभावेन भस्म च .. 92 ..
text_mt:
That all-pervading lord has ashes on his body from the cremation ash of Satī;
with loving devotion he wears her garland of bones and ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmārāmo yadyapīśastathā'pi pūrṇamabdakam ..
satīśavaṃ gṛhītvā ca bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ruroda ha .. 93 ..
meaning:
स्वात्मारामो यद्यपीशस्तथाऽपि पूर्णमब्दकम् ..
सतीशवं गृहीत्वा च भ्रामंभ्रामं रुरोद ह .. 93 ..
text_mt:
Though self-delighting, the lord nonetheless for a full year
carried the corpse of Satī, wandered repeatedly, and wept.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaṅgaṃ cāpi tasyāśca papāta yatra yatra ha ..
siddhapīṭhastatra tatra babhūva mantrasiddhikṛt .. 94 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यङ्गं चापि तस्याश्च पपात यत्र यत्र ह ..
सिद्धपीठस्तत्र तत्र बभूव मन्त्रसिद्धिकृत् .. 94 ..

I dwell not in Goloka, nor in Vaikuṇṭha upon your breast;
I am always bound by the cord of love within the heart of Śiva. / 4.36.10
With melodious perfection, in fine modulations, with five faces Śaṅkara
always sings my praises; therefore I am near to him. / 11
He who is capable of creating and destroying, even by a sportive play of his eyebrows,
the multitude of cosmic eggs through yoga—there is no yogi superior to Śaṅkara. / 12
He who through divine knowledge is capable of creating and destroying by a sportive play of his eyebrows,
destroying death, time, and the rest—no possessor of knowledge is superior to Śaṅkara. / 13
Capable of granting devotion to me, servitude to me, liberation, all fortunes,
and all siddhis—there is no giver superior to Śaṅkara. / 14
He who sings my name day and night with five faces
and perpetually meditates upon my form—there is no devotee superior to Śaṅkara. / 15
I, Sudarśana, and Śambhu are equal in splendour;
even Brahmā the creator, through yoga, is not equal in splendour to us. / 16

text_mt: Śrī Rādhikā said: / “Of the omnipresent one, who is of such nature, the lord of all, the great soul— / why is his food offering not auspicious? Tell me, O dispeller of doubt!” / 1 / / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Listen, O goddess, I shall relate an ancient narrative / resembling a blazing flame of fire in burning the fuel of sins. / 2 / / Once upon a time, Sanatkumāra went to Vaikuṇṭha, indeed; / the twice-born saw the lord Nārāyaṇa having just finished his meal. / 3 / / Having bowed down with devotion and joy, he praised him with esoteric hymns; / pleased, he who is fond of his devotees gave the remainder [of his food] to him. / 4 / / As soon as he received it, some was eaten right there by him, / and some he kept, a rare thing, for his kinsmen to eat. / 5 / / And what was given in the Siddhāśrama to his guru, the trident-handed one, / he ate all of it, solely upon receiving it, out of a surge of devotion. / 6 / / Having eaten the extremely rare substance, overcome with love, he danced; / with all his limbs thrilled with horripilation, eyes filled with tears, endowed with joy, / 7 / / singing my virtues with devotion from a sweet throat and through five faces, / beautifully, with harmonic attunement to varied musical melodies and rhythmic measures. / 8 / / The ḍamaru fell from his hand, as did the horn and the tiger skin; / having himself fallen down afterwards, weeping, he attained a state of swoon. / 9 / / Having meditated with single-minded devotion upon that exceedingly charming form, / seeing me situated in the midst of a thousand-petalled lotus in his heart. / 4.37.10 / / In the meantime, the goddess Durgā, the destroyer of distress in hard situations, / joyful, with a cheerful face and eyes, swiftly arrived there. / 11 / / Seeing him weeping, unconscious, and fallen out of devotion, / laughing, she asked Kumāra for news of the trident-handed one. / 12 / / Kumāra related everything to her with folded palms; / hearing this, that goddess became angry at Śiva, her lip quivering. / 13 / / Rising, the three-eyed one addressed that goddess who was ready to utter a curse / with various [appeasements] and praised her with folded palms. / 14

text_mt: Hearing the delightful hymn of praise, Śivā did not curse Śiva; / [yet] she made his food offering defiled and inedible even to the wise. / 15 / / The power of the penance, fortune, and splendour of living beings does not [prevail]: / the destroyer of all in the cosmic egg trembled in fear of Pārvatī. / 16 / / The mother of the universe, who gave birth to Gaṇa, enraged, with red lotus eyes, / spoke to him this supreme word, the essence of right conduct. / 17 / / Oh, the power of penance and splendour does not [prevail] among living beings: / he, the destroyer of the cosmic egg, trembled before the mountain's daughter. / 18 / / Pārvatī said: / ‘You are the nourisher and protector of the worlds, and of me in particular; / you are the speaker of the four Vedas and their generator, the all-pervading lord himself, / 19 / / the bestower of liberation upon devotees and the giver of all fortunes; / if you practice bad conduct, who indeed will protect dharma? / 4.37.20 / / I am ever to be protected by you, maintained, and am a servant with devotion; / [yet] I have been deprived of consuming Hara’s Nirmālya through fault of destiny. / 21 / / Some object is purified by gold, and some object by air; / some simply by washing; everything [is purified] through offering to Viṣṇu. / 22 / / All gods are to be worshipped with food offered to Viṣṇu, / as are the ancestors and guests: thus is it determined in the Vedas. / 23 / / What is not offered [to Hari] is inedible, while what is offered enters the belly of Hari; / he who [eats] having offered with devotion becomes the foremost of [Hari's] attendants. / 24 / / Nectar is the rare, cherished essence of all substances, / [yet] it does not equal one sixteenth part of the food offered to Viṣṇu. / 25 / / That nectar, charming to fools, slays premature death, / yet the offering to Hari indeed makes one equal to Hari—oh! / 26 / / He who casually partakes of that offering in the company of the virtuous / attains the fruit of sixty thousand years of austerity. / 27 / / He who, a devotee, always eats having offered to Hari with devotion— / what austerity must he perform? He is equal to Hari in splendour! / 28 / / Formerly this was heard from your mouth at Puṣkara in an assembly of sages: /’

text_mt: "I am not the creator of the Vedas; am I not capable of speaking? / Having performed austerities for a very long time, I obtained you as my lord. / How is it, O Lord, that I was cheated by you of Viṣṇu's prasāda? / Because Viṣṇu's offering was not given by you to me now, / therefore receive from me this very result, O Maheśvara! / From this day forward, whichever people eat your offering, / they will surely become dogs for one birth in Bhārata." / Having spoken thus, mother Pārvatī wept before the all-pervading Lord. / Her gaze fell upon his throat, and he became blue-throated. / Then Śiva, respectfully taking Śivā to his chest with devotion, / broke her wounded pride with a hymn of praise and humility. / Wiping the water from her eyes again and again with his hand, / he comforted her with various charming words of wisdom. / Deeply pleased, the goddess said to her husband: / "I shall cast off my body without the offering of Hari. / It always bears a body that enhances your good fortune; / how can I carry a body bereft of good fortune? / Your extraordinary offering removes birth, death, and old age; / because it has been rendered spoiled, look, I shall abandon my body! / What is offered upon the liṅga is indeed unacceptable, O Lord; / it will become exceedingly pure when mixed with the offering of Viṣṇu." / Having spoken thus, that goddess was ready to abandon her body. / Alarmed, Hara praised her before her and consented. / Śaṅkara said: / "Be calm, O Mahādevī, Caṇḍikā, mother of the universe! / You ought to forgive all my transgression, O beautiful one! / Show grace unto me, a servant bought by your austerities, / O eternal one, the source of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa! / Oh, dwelling with the Lord of Goloka, beyond the gunas, O qualityless one, / embodiment of all power, his constant companion!

text_mt: It is indeed the will of Śrī Hari Himself; I am not even able to give it. / In that case, abandon your body and go to the qualityless [realm], O qualityless one!" / Having spoken thus, Candraśekhara stood before her. / She became very pleased and bowed down to the supreme Hara. / In this way, the hymn of praise to Pārvatī was uttered by Śaṅkara in ancient times; / whoever reads it when afflicted by misfortune is released from fear itself. / Dissension among friends will be banished, and the former affection will return; / and Pārvatī, well-pleased, will not abandon his house. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Having heard the vow of her husband, she became well-pleased; / she went swiftly to the celestial river to bathe, by Śaṅkara's command. / Having bathed and worshipped with devotion the one who is dear to the gods and qualityless, / she quickly prepared sweet food and condiments. / Śiva, having bathed and worshipped the eternal brahma-splendour, / praised with supreme devotion Me alone, who dwell in his heart. / Having gone and eaten everything, and having granted him what was desired, / Pārvatī obtained the offering, having approached Your origin. / Having eaten the remainder together with her husband, filled with joy, / the goddess praised Śaṅkara with devotion and bowed down again and again. / Thus all that was asked by you has been told, O ruler of the gods, / the reason why Śaṅkara's floral offering was cursed. / Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, titled "The Episode of the Curse upon Hara's Nirmālya", in the dialogue between Nārāyaṇa and Nārada, in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the great Purāṇa, the Śrībrahmavaivarta.
