tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
भुक्त्वाऽवशेषं सा देवी सह भर्त्रा मुदाऽन्विता ..
तुष्टाव शङ्करं भक्त्या प्रणनाम मुहुर्मुहुः .. 54 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ sureśvari ..
abhiśaptaṃ śaṅkarasya nirmālyaṃ yena hetunā .. 55 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं त्वया पृष्टं सुरेश्वरि ..
अभिशप्तं शङ्करस्य निर्माल्यं येन हेतुना .. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
darpabhaṅgaḥ śruto devi śaṅkarasya jagadguroḥ ..
adhunā śrūyatāṃ matto durgādarpavimocanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
दर्पभङ्गः श्रुतो देवि शङ्करस्य जगद्गुरोः ..
अधुना श्रूयतां मत्तो दुर्गादर्पविमोचनम् .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 038

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya jagatprasūḥ ..
dadhāra kāminīrūpaṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharam ..2 ..
meaning:
तेजसा सर्वदेवानामाविर्भूय जगत्प्रसूः ..
दधार कामिनीरूपं कमनीयं मनोहरम् ..2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nihatya dānavendrāṃśca rarakṣa devatākulam ..
lebhe janma tato devī jaṭhare dakṣayoṣitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
निहत्य दानवेन्द्रांश्च ररक्ष देवताकुलम् ..
लेभे जन्म ततो देवी जठरे दक्षयोषितः .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pinākapāṇiṃ jagrāha sā devī surasādhanam ..
śaśvatparamabhaktyā ca siṣeve svāminaṃ satī .. 4 ..
meaning:
पिनाकपाणिं जग्राह सा देवी सुरसाधनम् ..
शश्वत्परमभक्त्या च सिषेवे स्वामिनं सती .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣeṇa sārddhaṃ devena babhūva śivaśatrutā ..
nirarthakaṃ daivayogātpurā vai surasaṃsadi .. 5 ..
meaning:
दक्षेण सार्द्धं देवेन बभूव शिवशत्रुता ..
निरर्थकं दैवयोगात्पुरा वै सुरसंसदि .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣaścakāra yajñaṃ ca tata āgatya kopataḥ ..
sarvānvijñāpayāmāsa tatraiva śaṃkaraṃ vinā .. 6 ..
meaning:
दक्षश्चकार यज्ञं च तत आगत्य कोपतः ..
सर्वान्विज्ञापयामास तत्रैव शंकरं विना .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sastrīkā devatāḥ sarvā ājagmurdakṣamandiram ..
sagaṇaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kopānnājagāmābhimānataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
सस्त्रीका देवताः सर्वा आजग्मुर्दक्षमन्दिरम् ..
सगणः शङ्करः कोपान्नाजगामाभिमानतः .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
satī patiṃ ca mohena bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ..
na taṃ cālayituṃ śaktā babhūva cañcalā svayam .. 8 ..
meaning:
सती पतिं च मोहेन बोधयामास यत्नतः ..
न तं चालयितुं शक्ता बभूव चञ्चला स्वयम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāma piturgehaṃ darpāttasya vinā''jñayā ..
tasya śāpena tasyāśca darpabhaṅgo babhūva ha ..9..
meaning:
आजगाम पितुर्गेहं दर्पात्तस्य विना'ऽज्ञया ..
तस्य शापेन तस्याश्च दर्पभङ्गो बभूव ह ..9..

sanskrit_iast:
na hi saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ cakre vāṅmātreṇa pitā ca tām ..
śrutvā ca nindāṃ bhartuśca dehaṃ tatyāja mānataḥ .. 4.38.10 ..
meaning:
न हि संभाषणं चक्रे वाङ्मात्रेण पिता च ताम् ..
श्रुत्वा च निन्दां भर्तुश्च देहं तत्याज मानतः .. 4.38.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ priye nigaditaṃ satīdarpavimocanam ..
tasyā janmāntaraṃ nityaṃ darpabhaṅgaśca śrūyatām .. 11 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रिये निगदितं सतीदर्पविमोचनम् ..
तस्या जन्मान्तरं नित्यं दर्पभङ्गश्च श्रूयताम् .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lebhe janma satī śīghraṃ jaṭhare śailayoṣitaḥ ..
śivastasyāścitābhasma cāsthi jagrāha bhaktitaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
लेभे जन्म सती शीघ्रं जठरे शैलयोषितः ..
शिवस्तस्याश्चिताभस्म चास्थि जग्राह भक्तितः .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra mālāmasthnāṃ ca bhasmanā tanulepanam ..
smāraṃsmāraṃ satīṃ premṇā bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
चकार मालामस्थ्नां च भस्मना तनुलेपनम् ..
स्मारंस्मारं सतीं प्रेम्णा भ्रामंभ्रामं पुनःपुनः .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
suṣāva menā tāṃ devīmatīva sumanoharām ..
sṛṣṭau vidhātustasyāśca hyupamā nāsti kutra ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
सुषाव मेना तां देवीमतीव सुमनोहराम् ..
सृष्टौ विधातुस्तस्याश्च ह्युपमा नास्ति कुत्र च .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
guṇaprasūrguṇānsarvānsarvarūpānbibhartti sā ..
sarvāśca devapatnyastatkalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 15 ..
meaning:
गुणप्रसूर्गुणान्सर्वान्सर्वरूपान्बिभर्त्ति सा ..
सर्वाश्च देवपत्न्यस्तत्कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva varddhamānā sā śukle candrakalā yathā ..
atīva yauvanasthā ca śailagehe dinedine .. 16 ..
meaning:
बभूव वर्द्धमाना सा शुक्ले चन्द्रकला यथा ..
अतीव यौवनस्था च शैलगेहे दिनेदिने .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvākāśavāṇī ca tāṃ saṃbodhya jagatprasūm ..
śive śivaṃ ca tapasā kaṭhoreṇa labheti ca ..17..
meaning:
बभूवाकाशवाणी च तां संबोध्य जगत्प्रसूम् ..
शिवे शिवं च तपसा कठोरेण लभेति च ..17..

sanskrit_iast:
vineśvaraṃ na tapasā prāptā hi garbhasambhavam ..
prahasya tasthau śrutveti sā ca yauvanagarvitā ..18..
meaning:
विनेश्वरं न तपसा प्राप्ता हि गर्भसम्भवम् ..
प्रहस्य तस्थौ श्रुत्वेति सा च यौवनगर्विता ..18..

sanskrit_iast:
mama janmāntarīyaṃ ca bhasmāsthi ca bibharti yaḥ ..
sa māṃ prauḍhāṃ kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na gṛhṇātyatra janmani ..19..
meaning:
मम जन्मान्तरीयं च भस्मास्थि च बिभर्ति यः ..
स मां प्रौढां कथं दृष्ट्वा न गृह्णात्यत्र जन्मनि ..19..

sanskrit_iast:
yo vidagdhaśca brahmāṇḍaṃ babhrāma mama śokataḥ ..
sa kathaṃ māṃ na gṛhṇāti dṛṣṭvā paramasundarīm .. 4.38.20 ..
meaning:
यो विदग्धश्च ब्रह्माण्डं बभ्राम मम शोकतः ..
स कथं मां न गृह्णाति दृष्ट्वा परमसुन्दरीम् .. 4.38.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣayajñaṃ yo babhañja mama hetoḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ..
sa kathaṃ māṃ na gṛhṇāti patnīṃ janmanijanmani .. 21 ..
meaning:
दक्षयज्ञं यो बभञ्ज मम हेतोः कृपानिधिः ..
स कथं मां न गृह्णाति पत्नीं जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yā yasya patnī yo yasyā bhartā prāktanataḥ purā ..
kuto viśve tayorbhedo niṣeko nānyathā bhavet .. 22 ..
meaning:
या यस्य पत्नी यो यस्या भर्ता प्राक्तनतः पुरा ..
कुतो विश्वे तयोर्भेदो निषेको नान्यथा भवेत् .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarūpaguṇādhāraṃ matvā svamatimānataḥ ..
na cakāra tapaḥ sādhvī na vijñāya tamīśvaram .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वरूपगुणाधारं मत्वा स्वमतिमानतः ..
न चकार तपः साध्वी न विज्ञाय तमीश्वरम् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Thinking herself, out of pride in her mind, to be the repository of all beauty and virtues,
the virtuous lady did not perform asceticism, not knowing the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sundarīṣu ca sarvāsu matto nāstyeva sundarī ..
hṛdīti matvā garveṇa na cakāra tapaḥ śivā .. 24 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरीषु च सर्वासु मत्तो नास्त्येव सुन्दरी ..
हृदीति मत्वा गर्वेण न चकार तपः शिवा .. 24 ..
text_mt:
“Among all beautiful women, there is indeed none more beautiful than me!”
Thinking thus in her heart, Śivā, out of pride, did not undertake asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanaveṣāṇāṃ pumāngrāhī svayoṣitām ..
śivo macchrutimātreṇa māṃ gṛhṇāti vinā tapaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
रूपयौवनवेषाणां पुमान्ग्राही स्वयोषिताम् ..
शिवो मच्छ्रुतिमात्रेण मां गृह्णाति विना तपः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
“A man accepts his own woman for her beauty, youth, and dress;
Śiva will accept me merely upon hearing of me, without asceticism.”

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdīti matvā girijā tasthau himagirergṛhe ..
śaśvatsahacarīmadhye krīḍonmattā divāniśam .. 26 ..
meaning:
हृदीति मत्वा गिरिजा तस्थौ हिमगिरेर्गृहे ..
शश्वत्सहचरीमध्ये क्रीडोन्मत्ता दिवानिशम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Thinking thus in her heart, the daughter of the mountain remained in the house of the Himavat,
constantly among her female companions, day and night intoxicated with play.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tūrṇaṃ dūtaḥ śailendrasaṃsadi ..
uvācāgatya madhuraṃ tatpuraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तूर्णं दूतः शैलेन्द्रसंसदि ..
उवाचागत्य मधुरं तत्पुरः संपुटाञ्जलिः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
In the meantime, a messenger quickly arrived in the assembly of the king of mountains,
and with folded palms spoke sweetly before him.

sanskrit_iast:
dūta uvāca ..
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha śailendra gacchākṣayavaṭāntikam ..
ājagāma mahādevaḥ sagaṇo vṛṣavāhanaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दूत उवाच ..
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ शैलेन्द्र गच्छाक्षयवटान्तिकम् ..
आजगाम महादेवः सगणो वृषवाहनः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
“Arise, arise, O king of mountains! Go to the vicinity of the indestructible banyan tree!
Mahādeva, whose mount is the bull, has arrived accompanied by his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..
pūjanaṃ kuru śailendraṃ devendraṃ tamatīndriyam .. 29 ..
meaning:
मधुपर्कादिकं दत्त्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ..
पूजनं कुरु शैलेन्द्रं देवेन्द्रं तमतीन्द्रियम् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Offering the honey-mixture and other articles, your neck bowed down with devotion,
perform the worship, O king of mountains, of him who is beyond the senses, the lord of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhisvarūpaṃ siddheśaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ..
mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam .. 4.38.30 ..
meaning:
सिद्धिस्वरूपं सिद्धेशं योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुम् ..
मृत्युञ्जयं कालकालं ब्रह्मज्योतिः सनातनम् .. 4.38.30 ..
text_mt:
the embodiment of spiritual perfection, the lord of accomplished ones, the teacher of the teachers of the lords of yogins,
the conqueror of death, the time of Time, the eternal light of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum ..
bhaktadhyānārthamamalaṃ dadhānaṃ dehamīśvaram .. ..31..
meaning:
परमात्मस्वरूपं च सगुणं निर्गुणं विभुम् ..
भक्तध्यानार्थममलं दधानं देहमीश्वरम् .. ..31..
text_mt:
whose nature is the Paramātman, possessed of attributes and devoid of attributes, the all-pervading Lord,
who assumes a spotless body for the sake of the meditation of his devotees.”

sanskrit_iast:
śailo dūtavacaḥ śrutvā samuttasthau mudā'nvitaḥ ..
madhuparkādikaṃ nītvā jagāma śaṅkarāntikam .. 32 ..
meaning:
शैलो दूतवचः श्रुत्वा समुत्तस्थौ मुदाऽन्वितः ..
मधुपर्कादिकं नीत्वा जगाम शङ्करान्तिकम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the words of the messenger, the mountain arose, filled with joy;
taking the honey-mixture and other gifts, he went near to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
devī dūtavacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadanekṣaṇā ..
hṛdīti mene maddhetorājagāma maheśvaraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
देवी दूतवचः श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ..
हृदीति मेने मद्धेतोराजगाम महेश्वरः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Hearing the words of the messenger, the goddess, with a joyful face and eyes,
thought in her heart: “Maheśvara has come for my sake!”

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra veṣamatulaṃ dadhāra vastramuttamam..
ratnendrasārālaṃkārānratnamālāṃ manoharām .. 34 ..
meaning:
चकार वेषमतुलं दधार वस्त्रमुत्तमम्..
रत्नेन्द्रसारालंकारान्रत्नमालां मनोहराम् .. 34 ..
text_mt:
She adorned herself peerlessly and put on excellent garments,
ornaments made of the essence of precious gems, and an enchanting garland of jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ candanasaṃyutām ..
cakāra śaṅkarārthaṃ ca matvā mālāṃ manoharām..35..
meaning:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालां चन्दनसंयुताम् ..
चकार शङ्करार्थं च मत्वा मालां मनोहराम्..35..
text_mt:
A garland of pārijāta blossoms accompanied by sandalwood paste,
she prepared, considering it a charming garland intended for Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthā sā dadarśa darpaṇe mukham ..
kastūrībindunā sārddhaṃ sindūrabindubhūṣitam .. 36..
meaning:
रत्नसिंहासनस्था सा ददर्श दर्पणे मुखम् ..
कस्तूरीबिन्दुना सार्द्धं सिन्दूरबिन्दुभूषितम् .. 36..
text_mt:
Seated on a jewelled throne, she looked at her face in a mirror,
adorned with a mark of vermilion along with a dot of musk,

sanskrit_iast:
ārakta netrayugalaṃ nirmalāñjanasaṃyutam..
śaranmadhyāhnamamalaṃ yathālipaṃktiveṣṭitam..37..
meaning:
आरक्त नेत्रयुगलं निर्मलाञ्जनसंयुतम्..
शरन्मध्याह्नममलं यथालिपंक्तिवेष्टितम्..37..
text_mt:
her pair of reddish eyes enhanced with pure collyrium,
like an immaculate autumn midday surrounded by a row of black bees;

sanskrit_iast:
sukomalauṣṭhayugulaṃ tāmbūlarāgasaṃyutam..
atīva sundaraṃ ramyapakvabiṃbaphalaṃ yathā..38..
meaning:
सुकोमलौष्ठयुगुलं ताम्बूलरागसंयुतम्..
अतीव सुन्दरं रम्यपक्वबिंबफलं यथा..38..
text_mt:
her pair of very delicate lips endowed with the red tint of betel,
extremely beautiful, like charming ripe bimba fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakuṃḍaladīptyā ca gaṃḍasthalavirājitam ..
sūryodayena jvalitaṃ sumeruśikharaṃ yathā ..39..
meaning:
रत्नकुंडलदीप्त्या च गंडस्थलविराजितम् ..
सूर्योदयेन ज्वलितं सुमेरुशिखरं यथा ..39..
text_mt:
her cheeks shining with the brilliance of her jewelled earrings,
like the peak of Mount Sumeru illuminated by the rising sun;

sanskrit_iast:
atyanirvacanīyaṃ ca dantapaṃktimanoharam ..
yathā muktāsamūhaṃ ca sajalaṃ jaladāgame..4.38.40..
meaning:
अत्यनिर्वचनीयं च दन्तपंक्तिमनोहरम् ..
यथा मुक्तासमूहं च सजलं जलदागमे..4.38.40..
text_mt:
her enchanting row of teeth, utterly indescribable,
like a cluster of glistening pearls at the arrival of the rain clouds;

sanskrit_iast:
gajamuktāsamāyuktaṃ sucārunāsikottamam ..
suśobhitaṃ yathā meruṃ svarṇadījaladhārayā..41 ..
meaning:
गजमुक्तासमायुक्तं सुचारुनासिकोत्तमम् ..
सुशोभितं यथा मेरुं स्वर्णदीजलधारया..41 ..
text_mt:
her most excellent, lovely nose adorned with an elephant-pearl,
shining splendidly like Mount Meru with the stream of water of the golden river;

sanskrit_iast:
mālatīmālyasaṃyuktakabarībhārasaṃyutam..
bakapaṃktisuśobhāḍhyaṃ navīnaṃ jaladaṃ yathā .. 42 ..
meaning:
मालतीमाल्यसंयुक्तकबरीभारसंयुतम्..
बकपंक्तिसुशोभाढ्यं नवीनं जलदं यथा .. 42 ..
text_mt:
with her mass of braided hair interwoven with garlands of jasmine,
like a fresh rain cloud richly adorned by a flight of cranes;

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcana varṇābhaṃ cāruvakṣaḥsthalojjvalam ..
ratnendrasārahārāktaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ..43..
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चन वर्णाभं चारुवक्षःस्थलोज्ज्वलम् ..
रत्नेन्द्रसारहाराक्तं कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम् ..43..
text_mt:
radiant with a lovely chest bearing the hue of molten gold,
anointed with musk and saffron, adorned with necklaces of the finest gems;

sanskrit_iast:
cārucampakavarṇābhaṃ stanayugmaṃ manoharam ..
badarīphalatulyaṃ ca cārupatrakaśobhitam ..44..
meaning:
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभं स्तनयुग्मं मनोहरम् ..
बदरीफलतुल्यं च चारुपत्रकशोभितम् ..44..
text_mt:
her charming pair of breasts bearing the lovely hue of campaka flowers,
resembling jujube fruits, adorned with delicate painted foliage;

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaṃ manoharaṃ kṣīṇaṃ nimnanābhisthalojjvalam..
atīva sundaraṃ ramyamudaraṃ vartulākṛti .. 45 ..
meaning:
मध्यं मनोहरं क्षीणं निम्ननाभिस्थलोज्ज्वलम्..
अतीव सुन्दरं रम्यमुदरं वर्तुलाकृति .. 45 ..
text_mt:
her waist captivating, slender, radiant with a deep navel;
her belly extremely beautiful, delightful, circular in form;

sanskrit_iast:
rambhāstaṃbhaviniṃdyaikamūruyugmaṃ manoharam ..
kāmālayaṃ sukaṭhinaṃ nigūḍhamaṃśukena ca.. 46 ..
meaning:
रम्भास्तंभविनिंद्यैकमूरुयुग्मं मनोहरम् ..
कामालयं सुकठिनं निगूढमंशुकेन च.. 46 ..
text_mt:
her charming pair of thighs surpassing plantain trunks...
The abode of Kāma, very firm, and concealed by fine cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭapadayugmaṃ manoharam..
ratnapāśakasaṃyuktaṃ siddhālaktakabhūṣitam .. 47 ..
meaning:
स्थलपद्मप्रभामुष्टपदयुग्मं मनोहरम्..
रत्नपाशकसंयुक्तं सिद्धालक्तकभूषितम् .. 47 ..
text_mt:
A pair of charming feet that robbed the beauty of land-growing lotuses,
Adorned with jewelled toe-rings and embellished with perfect red lac;

sanskrit_iast:
dadhataṃ ratnamañjīraṃ rājahaṃsānukāri ca..
ratnendrasārābharaṇaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 48 ..
meaning:
दधतं रत्नमञ्जीरं राजहंसानुकारि च..
रत्नेन्द्रसाराभरणं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा .. 48 ..
text_mt:
Bearing jewelled anklets that imitated [the call of] royal swans,
And ornaments made of the finest gems, fashioned by Viśvakarman;

sanskrit_iast:
karaṃ sukomalataraṃ sundaraṃ kanakaprabham ..
ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūraśaṃkhabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..49..
meaning:
करं सुकोमलतरं सुन्दरं कनकप्रभम् ..
रत्नकङ्कणकेयूरशंखभूषणभूषितम् ..49..
text_mt:
Hands exceedingly tender, beautiful, with the lustre of gold,
Adorned with jewelled bracelets, armlets, and conch-shell ornaments;

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratsadratnamukuraṃ līlākamalamujjvalam..
ratnāṅgulīyamatulaṃ dadhataṃ sumanoharam .. 4.38.50 ..
meaning:
बिभ्रत्सद्रत्नमुकुरं लीलाकमलमुज्ज्वलम्..
रत्नाङ्गुलीयमतुलं दधतं सुमनोहरम् .. 4.38.50 ..
text_mt:
Holding an excellent jewelled mirror and a bright sporting lotus,
And bearing incomparable, exceedingly enchanting jewelled finger-rings.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā svarūpamatulaṃ dadhyau śaṅkaramīśvaram ..
viśiṣya manasā śaśvadbhartuścaraṇapaṅkajam .. 51 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स्वरूपमतुलं दध्यौ शङ्करमीश्वरम् ..
विशिष्य मनसा शश्वद्भर्तुश्चरणपङ्कजम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Beholding her peerless form, she meditated upon the lord Śaṅkara,
Especially, in her mind, constantly upon the lotus feet of her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bandhuṃ sādhvīvargaṃ sahodaram ..
antare sā na sasmāra kiṃcideva śivaṃ vinā ..52..
meaning:
पितरं मातरं बन्धुं साध्वीवर्गं सहोदरम् ..
अन्तरे सा न सस्मार किंचिदेव शिवं विना ..52..
text_mt:
Father, mother, kinsman, circle of virtuous women, brother—
She remembered nothing at all in her heart except Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śaileśvarastatra dadarśa candraśekharam ..
svarṇadīpulinādramyādutpatantaṃ ca sasmitam .. 53 ..
meaning:
अथ शैलेश्वरस्तत्र ददर्श चन्द्रशेखरम् ..
स्वर्णदीपुलिनाद्रम्यादुत्पतन्तं च सस्मितम् .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Then the lord of mountains saw Candraśekhara there,
Rising smilingly from the charming bank of the Mandākinī,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhataṃ saṃskṛtāṃ mālāṃ japantaṃ mama nāmakam ..
taptasvarṇaprabhājuṣṭajaṭārāśi virājitam .. 54 ..
meaning:
दधतं संस्कृतां मालां जपन्तं मम नामकम् ..
तप्तस्वर्णप्रभाजुष्टजटाराशि विराजितम् .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Holding a consecrated rosary, chanting my name,
Radiant with a mass of matted locks possessing the brilliance of molten gold,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhasthaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ sarvabhūṣaṇarājitam ..
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarpabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam .. 55 ..
meaning:
वृषभस्थं शूलपाणिं सर्वभूषणराजितम् ..
नागयज्ञोपवीतं च सर्पभूषणभूषितम् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Seated on a bull, trident in hand, resplendent with all ornaments,
With a serpent for a sacred thread and adorned with serpent-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ vyāghracarmadharaṃ param ..
vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgaṃ tamasthimālaṃ digambaram ..56..
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं व्याघ्रचर्मधरं परम् ..
विभूतिभूषिताङ्गं तमस्थिमालं दिगम्बरम् ..56..
text_mt:
Resembling pure crystal, wearing a tiger skin, supreme,
His limbs smeared with sacred ashes, wearing a garland of bones, clad in space,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavaktraṃ trinayanaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ..
dadarśa rudrānparito jvalato brahmatejasā .. 57 ..
meaning:
पञ्चवक्त्रं त्रिनयनं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् ..
ददर्श रुद्रान्परितो ज्वलतो ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 57 ..
text_mt:
Five-faced, three-eyed, equal in splendour to ten million suns.
He saw the Rudras all around, blazing with Brahman-lustre,

sanskrit_iast:
śivavāme mahākālaṃ dakṣiṇe nandikeśvaram ..
bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān ..58..
meaning:
शिववामे महाकालं दक्षिणे नन्दिकेश्वरम् ..
भूतप्रेतपिशाचांश्च कूष्माण्डान्ब्रह्मराक्षसान् ..58..
text_mt:
To the left of Śiva, Mahākāla, and on the right, Nandikeśvara,
As well as bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, kūṣmāṇḍas, and brahmarākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
vetālānkṣetrapālāṃśca bhairavānbhīmavikramān ..
sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca sanātanam .. 59 ..
meaning:
वेतालान्क्षेत्रपालांश्च भैरवान्भीमविक्रमान् ..
सनकं च सनन्दं च कुमारं च सनातनम् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
Vetālas, kṣetrapālas, and bhairavas of terrible valour;
Sanaka, Sananda, Kumāra, and Sanātana,

sanskrit_iast:
jaigīṣavyaṃ devalaṃ ca kāṇādaṃ gautamaṃ tathā ..
pippalādaṃ kaṇakhanaṃ voḍhuṃ pañcaśikhaṃ kaṭham .. 4.38.60 ..
meaning:
जैगीषव्यं देवलं च काणादं गौतमं तथा ..
पिप्पलादं कणखनं वोढुं पञ्चशिखं कठम् .. 4.38.60 ..
text_mt:
Jaigīṣavya, Devala, Kāṇāda, Gautama,
Pippalāda, Kaṇakhana, Voḍhu, Pañcaśikha, Kaṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
jājaliṃ karakhaṃ karṇaṃ lomaśaṃ sūryavarcasam ..
kātyāyanaṃ pāṇiniṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ durvāsasaṃ tataḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
जाजलिं करखं कर्णं लोमशं सूर्यवर्चसम् ..
कात्यायनं पाणिनिं च शंखं दुर्वाससं ततः .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Jājali, Karakha, Karṇa, Lomaśa possessing the lustre of the sun,
Kātyāyana, Pāṇini, Śaṅkha, and then Durvāsas,

sanskrit_iast:
śātātapaṃ pāribhadramaṣṭāvakraṃ marudbhavam ..
etānpurogamānnatvā praṇanāma śivaṃ giriḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
शातातपं पारिभद्रमष्टावक्रं मरुद्भवम् ..
एतान्पुरोगमान्नत्वा प्रणनाम शिवं गिरिः .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Śātātapa, Pāribhadra, Aṣṭāvakra, and the son of Marut.
Having bowed to these who went before, the Mountain bowed down to Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhnā nipatya bhūmau sa daṇḍavatsaṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ..
atho analpayā bhaktyā dhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbujam ..
nanāma cāśrunetraḥ sa pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
मूर्ध्ना निपत्य भूमौ स दण्डवत्संपुटाञ्जलिः ..
अथो अनल्पया भक्त्या धृत्वा तच्चरणाम्बुजम् ..
ननाम चाश्रुनेत्रः स पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहः .. 63 ..
text_mt:
Falling to the ground with his head like a staff, with folded hands,
And then, grasping his lotus feet with immense devotion,
His eyes full of tears and his body thrilled with horripilation, he bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmadattena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ..
tuṣṭe brāhme dine'tīte puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi .. 64 ..
meaning:
धर्मदत्तेन स्तोत्रेण तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् ..
तुष्टे ब्राह्मे दिनेऽतीते पुष्करे सूर्यपर्वणि .. 64 ..
text_mt:
He praised the Supreme Lord with the hymn of praise given by Dharma,
When [Śiva was] pleased at the end of a day of Brahmā, at Puṣkara, on a solar festival day.

sanskrit_iast:
himālaya uvāca ..
tvaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭikartā ca tvaṃ viṣṇuḥ paripālakaḥ ..65..
meaning:
हिमालय उवाच ..
त्वं ब्रह्मा सृष्टिकर्ता च त्वं विष्णुः परिपालकः ..65..
text_mt: You are Brahmā, the creator of the world, and you are Viṣṇu, the protector.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ śivaḥ śivado'nantaḥ sarvasaṃhārakārakaḥ ..
tvamīśvaro guṇātīto jyotīrūpaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
त्वं शिवः शिवदोऽनन्तः सर्वसंहारकारकः ..
त्वमीश्वरो गुणातीतो ज्योतीरूपः सनातनः .. 66 ..
text_mt:
You are Śiva, the bestower of auspiciousness, infinite, the cause of the destruction of all.
You are the Lord, beyond the gunas, having the form of light, eternal;

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtaḥ prakṛtīśaśca prākṛtaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ..
nānārūpavidhātā tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ dhyānahetave ..
yeṣu rūpeṣu yatprītistattadrūpaṃ bibharṣi ca ..67..
meaning:
प्रकृतः प्रकृतीशश्च प्राकृतः प्रकृतेः परः ..
नानारूपविधाता त्वं भक्तानां ध्यानहेतवे ..
येषु रूपेषु यत्प्रीतिस्तत्तद्रूपं बिभर्षि च ..67..

sanskrit_iast:
sūryastvaṃ sṛṣṭijanaka ādhāraḥ sarvatejasām ..
somastvaṃ sasyapātā ca satataṃ śītaraśminā..68..
meaning:
सूर्यस्त्वं सृष्टिजनक आधारः सर्वतेजसाम् ..
सोमस्त्वं सस्यपाता च सततं शीतरश्मिना..68..
text_mt:
You are the Sun, the creator of creation, the support of all lustres;
You are Soma, the protector of crops constantly with your cool rays;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyustvaṃ varuṇastvaṃ ca tvamagniḥ sarvadāhakaḥ ..
indrastvaṃ devarājaśca kālo mṛtyuryamastathā .. ..69..
meaning:
वायुस्त्वं वरुणस्त्वं च त्वमग्निः सर्वदाहकः ..
इन्द्रस्त्वं देवराजश्च कालो मृत्युर्यमस्तथा .. ..69..
text_mt:
You are Vāyu, you are Varuṇa, and you are Agni, the consumer of all;
You are Indra, the king of the gods, and you are Time, Death, and Yama;

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyumṛtyuḥ kālakālo yamāntakaḥ .. 4.38.70 ..
meaning: मृत्युञ्जयो मृत्युमृत्युः कालकालो यमान्तकः .. 4.38.70 ..
text_mt: Conqueror of death, the death of Death, the time of Time, the ender of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
vedastvaṃ vedakartā ca vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ..
viduṣāṃ janakastvaṃ ca vidvāṃśca viduṣāṃ guruḥ ..71..
meaning:
वेदस्त्वं वेदकर्ता च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ..
विदुषां जनकस्त्वं च विद्वांश्च विदुषां गुरुः ..71..
text_mt:
You are the Veda, the author of the Vedas, and one who has mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas;
You are the progenitor of the learned, the scholar, and the guru of the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrastvaṃ hi japastvaṃ hi tapastvaṃ tatphalapradaḥ ..
vāk tvaṃ vāgadhidevī tvaṃ tatkartā tadguruḥ svayam ..72..
meaning:
मन्त्रस्त्वं हि जपस्त्वं हि तपस्त्वं तत्फलप्रदः ..
वाक् त्वं वागधिदेवी त्वं तत्कर्ता तद्गुरुः स्वयम् ..72..
text_mt:
You are the mantra, you are the recitation, you are asceticism, and the giver of its fruits;
You are speech, you are the presiding goddess of speech, its creator, and yourself its guru.

sanskrit_iast:
aho sarasvatībījaṃ kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ ..
ityevamuktvā śailendrastasthau dhṛtvā padāmbujam ..73..
meaning:
अहो सरस्वतीबीजं कस्त्वां स्तोतुमिहेश्वरः ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा शैलेन्द्रस्तस्थौ धृत्वा पदाम्बुजम् ..73..
text_mt:
Ah, seed of Sarasvatī! Who here is capable of praising you?
Having spoken thus, the king of mountains stood, grasping his lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrovāsa tamābodhya cāvaruhya vṛṣācchivaḥ ..
stotrametanmahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
तत्रोवास तमाबोध्य चावरुह्य वृषाच्छिवः ..
स्तोत्रमेतन्महापुण्यं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Having consoled him and dismounted from his bull, Śiva stayed there.
Whatever man recites this highly meritorious hymn of praise at the three twilights,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo bhayebhyaśca bhavārṇave ..
aputro labhate putraṃ māsamekaṃ paṭhedyadi ..75..
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो भयेभ्यश्च भवार्णवे ..
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं मासमेकं पठेद्यदि ..75..
text_mt:
Is freed from all sins and from fears in the ocean of worldly existence;
If a childless man recites it for one month, he obtains a son.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāhīno labhedbhāryāṃ suśīlāṃ sumanoharām..
cirakālagataṃ vastu labhate sahasā dhruvam .. 76 ..
meaning:
भार्याहीनो लभेद्भार्यां सुशीलां सुमनोहराम्..
चिरकालगतं वस्तु लभते सहसा ध्रुवम् .. 76 ..
text_mt:
One who is without a wife obtains a wife of good character and captivating beauty;
he surely and suddenly recovers an object lost long ago. // 76

sanskrit_iast:
rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyaṃ śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ ..
kārāgāre śmaśāne ca śatrugraste'tisaṃkaṭe..77..
meaning:
राज्यभ्रष्टो लभेद्राज्यं शंकरस्य प्रसादतः ..
कारागारे श्मशाने च शत्रुग्रस्तेऽतिसंकटे..77..
text_mt:
One fallen from his kingdom obtains a kingdom through the grace of Śaṅkara;
in prison, in the cremation ground, and seized by enemies in dire peril, // 77

sanskrit_iast:
gabhīre'tijalākīrṇe bhagnapote viṣādane ..
raṇamadhye mahābhīte hiṃsrajantusamanvite .. 78 ..
meaning:
गभीरेऽतिजलाकीर्णे भग्नपोते विषादने ..
रणमध्ये महाभीते हिंस्रजन्तुसमन्विते .. 78 ..
text_mt:
in a deep [water] filled with excessive water, when a boat is wrecked, in despair,
in the midst of battle in great terror, when surrounded by beasts of prey— // 78

sanskrit_iast: sarvato mucyate stutvā śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ .. 79 ..
meaning: सर्वतो मुच्यते स्तुत्वा शंकरस्य प्रसादतः .. 79 ..
text_mt: having praised him, one is freed from everything through the grace of Śaṅkara. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
iti stutvā himagirirvasataḥ śaṅkarasya ca ..
uvāsa purato dūre labdhājñaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
इति स्तुत्वा हिमगिरिर्वसतः शङ्करस्य च ..
उवास पुरतो दूरे लब्धाज्ञः सर्वसंमतः .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 039

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkādikaṃ tasmai pradadau bhaktipūrvakam ..
munīnsaṃpūjayāmāsa tataḥ śaṅkarapārṣadān .. 2 ..
meaning:
मधुपर्कादिकं तस्मै प्रददौ भक्तिपूर्वकम् ..
मुनीन्संपूजयामास ततः शङ्करपार्षदान् .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tatra samāgatya menakā strīgaṇaiḥ saha ..
dadarśa vaṭamūlasthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ candraśekharam .. 3 ..
meaning:
तदा तत्र समागत्य मेनका स्त्रीगणैः सह ..
ददर्श वटमूलस्थं शङ्करं चन्द्रशेखरम् .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ vasantaṃ vyāghracarmaṇi ..
madhye munigaṇānāṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ..4..
meaning:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं वसन्तं व्याघ्रचर्मणि ..
मध्ये मुनिगणानां च ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ..4..

sanskrit_iast:
yathā''kāśe tārakāṇāṃ dvijarājaṃ virājitam ..
paramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ kaṃdarpakoṭisannibham ..5..
meaning:
यथा'ऽकाशे तारकाणां द्विजराजं विराजितम् ..
परमाह्लादकं रूपं कंदर्पकोटिसन्निभम् ..5..

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya vārddhakāvasthāṃ dadhataṃ navayauvanam ..
atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ cittacoraṃ ca yoṣitām .. 6 ..
meaning:
विहाय वार्द्धकावस्थां दधतं नवयौवनम् ..
अतीव सुन्दरं रम्यं चित्तचोरं च योषिताम् .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ kāmāturāṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sutaṃ yathā ..
vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ śaivānāṃ ca sadāśivam .. 7 ..
meaning:
कामं कामातुराणां च सतीनां च सुतं यथा ..
वैष्णवानां महाविष्णुं शैवानां च सदाशिवम् .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaktisvarūpaṃ śāktānāṃ saurāṇāṃ sūryarūpiṇam ..
kālasvarūpaṃ duṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ paripālakam..8..
meaning:
शक्तिस्वरूपं शाक्तानां सौराणां सूर्यरूपिणम् ..
कालस्वरूपं दुष्टानां शिष्टानां परिपालकम्..8..

sanskrit_iast:
kālakālasamaṃ mṛtyormṛtyumṛtyu bhayānakam ..
vyāghracarma cāruvastraṃ babhūva bhasma caṃdanam..9..
meaning:
कालकालसमं मृत्योर्मृत्युमृत्यु भयानकम् ..
व्याघ्रचर्म चारुवस्त्रं बभूव भस्म चंदनम्..9..

sanskrit_iast:
sarpāḥ suṃdaramālyāni kastūrī yā viṣaprabhā ..
jaṭāsu lalitā cūḍā caṃdrastvalikacaṃdanam .. 4.39.10 ..
meaning:
सर्पाः सुंदरमाल्यानि कस्तूरी या विषप्रभा ..
जटासु ललिता चूडा चंद्रस्त्वलिकचंदनम् .. 4.39.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sucārvī mālatīmālā gaṃgādhārā manoharā ..
asthimālā ratnamālā dhattūraṃ cārucaṃpakam ..11..
meaning:
सुचार्वी मालतीमाला गंगाधारा मनोहरा ..
अस्थिमाला रत्नमाला धत्तूरं चारुचंपकम् ..11..

sanskrit_iast:
ekībhūtaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ netrayugmābjaśobhitam ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhaṃ pracchādya dīptamuttamam.. 12 ..
meaning:
एकीभूतं पंचवक्त्रं नेत्रयुग्माब्जशोभितम् ..
शरत्पार्वणचंद्राभं प्रच्छाद्य दीप्तमुत्तमम्.. 12 ..
text_mt: radiant and supreme, surpassing the splendour of the autumn full moon, // 12

sanskrit_iast:
baṃdhujīvaviniṃdyaikamoṣṭhādharamanoharam ..
śvetaścandro vṛṣeṃdraśca bhūtādyā nartakā iva ..13..
meaning:
बंधुजीवविनिंद्यैकमोष्ठाधरमनोहरम् ..
श्वेतश्चन्द्रो वृषेंद्रश्च भूताद्या नर्तका इव ..13..
text_mt:
his charming lips defying the bandhujīva flower;
the moon was white, the lord of bulls [white], and the spirits and others appeared like dancers. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
sadyo vyatikramaṃ sarvaṃ maheśasya maheśvari ..
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ śivarūpaṃ ca menā tuṣṭā babhūva ha ..14..
meaning:
सद्यो व्यतिक्रमं सर्वं महेशस्य महेश्वरि ..
दृष्ट्वैवं शिवरूपं च मेना तुष्टा बभूव ह ..14..
text_mt:
Seeing such an immediate reversal of everything in Maheśa, O Maheśvarī,
and seeing this form of Śiva, Menā indeed became pleased. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
kāścinnimeṣarahitāḥ kāmena pulakāṃcitāḥ ..
atikāmāturāḥ satyaḥ prāpurmūrcchāṃ ca kāścana .. .. 19 ..
meaning:
काश्चिन्निमेषरहिताः कामेन पुलकांचिताः ..
अतिकामातुराः सत्यः प्रापुर्मूर्च्छां च काश्चन .. .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Some women stood without blinking, their hair bristling with desire;
some, overwhelmed by deep passion, even fainted. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
kāścidviniṃdya kāṃtāṃśca praśaśaṃsurmaheśvaram ..
manorathena manasā samāśliṣyaṃti kāścana .. 16 ..
meaning:
काश्चिद्विनिंद्य कांतांश्च प्रशशंसुर्महेश्वरम् ..
मनोरथेन मनसा समाश्लिष्यंति काश्चन .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Some, disparaging their own husbands, praised Maheśvara;
some embraced him mentally with longing. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
kācinmānasikaṃ kāmātkurvantī cumbanaṃ mudā ..
dhruvaṃ kāmaṃ kariṣyāmo vayaṃ ca kāmasāgare .. 17 ..
meaning:
काचिन्मानसिकं कामात्कुर्वन्ती चुम्बनं मुदा ..
ध्रुवं कामं करिष्यामो वयं च कामसागरे .. 17 ..
text_mt:
One, out of desire, joyfully kissed him in her mind, [saying:]
‘Surely we shall make love in the ocean of desire! // 17

sanskrit_iast:
asmākameva bhartā cetparatraiva yaśo bhavet ..
ihaivaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmo vayaṃ kāṃtairatairalam .. 18 ..
meaning:
अस्माकमेव भर्ता चेत्परत्रैव यशो भवेत् ..
इहैवं किं करिष्यामो वयं कांतैरतैरलम् .. 18 ..
text_mt:
If he alone were our husband, there would be fame in the other world!
What shall we do here like this? Enough of these husbands of ours!’ // 18

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tamevaṃ suciramiti jalpaṃti kāścana ..
kāściddṛṣṭvā śivaṃ kiṃcinmukhamācchādya vāsasā .. 19 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तमेवं सुचिरमिति जल्पंति काश्चन ..
काश्चिद्दृष्ट्वा शिवं किंचिन्मुखमाच्छाद्य वाससा .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Having gazed upon him for a long time, some spoke thus;
some, having looked upon Śiva, veiled their faces slightly with their garments, // 19

sanskrit_iast:
sasmitā vakranayanāḥ paśyaṃtyeva punaḥpunaḥ ..
vayaṃ gṛhaṃ na yāsyāmo yāsyāmaḥ śivasannidhim .. 4.39.20 ..
meaning:
सस्मिता वक्रनयनाः पश्यंत्येव पुनःपुनः ..
वयं गृहं न यास्यामो यास्यामः शिवसन्निधिम् .. 4.39.20 ..
text_mt:
and smiling, looked again and again with sidelong glances, [saying:]
‘We will not go home; we will go into the presence of Śiva! // 20

sanskrit_iast:
śaratsudhāṃśuvadanaṃ drakṣyāmo'harniśaṃ mudā ..
saṃsāraṃ na kariṣyāmaḥ praviśāmo hutāśanam ..21 ..
meaning:
शरत्सुधांशुवदनं द्रक्ष्यामोऽहर्निशं मुदा ..
संसारं न करिष्यामः प्रविशामो हुताशनम् ..21 ..
text_mt:
We will joyfully behold his autumn-moon-like face day and night;
we will not maintain household life; we will enter the fire!’ // 21

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitā naḥ śivaḥ svāmītyevaṃ jalpaṃti kāścana ..
aho puṇyavatī durgā ślāghyate janma bhārate .. 22 ..
meaning:
भविता नः शिवः स्वामीत्येवं जल्पंति काश्चन ..
अहो पुण्यवती दुर्गा श्लाघ्यते जन्म भारते .. 22 ..
text_mt:
‘Śiva will be our husband!’—so some prattled;
‘Oh, Durgā is full of merit, praised is her birth in Bhārata, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
yasyā ayaṃ śivaḥ svāmītyevaṃ jalpaṃti kāścana ..
mudā menā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhaṃ tābhirjagāma ha .. 23 ..
meaning:
यस्या अयं शिवः स्वामीत्येवं जल्पंति काश्चन ..
मुदा मेना शिवं दृष्ट्वा गृहं ताभिर्जगाम ह .. 23 ..
text_mt:
she whose husband is this Śiva!’—thus some prattled.
Having seen Śiva with joy, Menā went home with them. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ saṃpūjya śaileṃdraḥ praṇamya svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
kṛtvā'numānaṃ rahasi girīśo menayā saha .. 24 ..
meaning:
शिवं संपूज्य शैलेंद्रः प्रणम्य स्वगृहं ययौ ..
कृत्वाऽनुमानं रहसि गिरीशो मेनया सह .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Having worshipped Śiva and bowed down, the king of mountains went to his own home;
having conferred in secret with Menā, the lord of the mountain // 24

sanskrit_iast:
durgāṃ prasthāpayāmāsa śivāya śivasannidhim ..
pārvatī sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ veṣaṃ kṛtvā manoharam .. 25 ..
meaning:
दुर्गां प्रस्थापयामास शिवाय शिवसन्निधिम् ..
पार्वती सखिभिः सार्द्धं वेषं कृत्वा मनोहरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
sent Durgā into the presence of Śiva, for Śiva’s sake.
Pārvatī, having adorned herself in charming attire along with her companions, // 25

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvānuraktā harṣeṇa jagāma śivasaṃnidhim ..
dṛṣṭvā śivā śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam .. 26 ..
meaning:
भावानुरक्ता हर्षेण जगाम शिवसंनिधिम् ..
दृष्ट्वा शिवा शिवं शांतं प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
devoted in heart, went with joy into the presence of Śiva.
Seeing peaceful Śiva, whose face and eyes were gracious,

sanskrit_iast:
saptapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sasmitā praṇanāma sā ..
ananyabhāvaṃ guṇinamaparaṃ jñānināṃ varam .. 27 ..
meaning:
सप्तप्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा सस्मिता प्रणनाम सा ..
अनन्यभावं गुणिनमपरं ज्ञानिनां वरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
she circumambulated him seven times and, smiling, bowed down.
To her who possessed undivided devotion, who had many virtues, the best among the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
suṃdaraṃ labha bhartāraṃ sundarītyāśiṣaṃ dadau ..
bhavitā tava saubhāgyaṃ śubhe svāmini saṃtatam .. 28..
meaning:
सुंदरं लभ भर्तारं सुन्दरीत्याशिषं ददौ ..
भविता तव सौभाग्यं शुभे स्वामिनि संततम् .. 28..
text_mt:
he gave a blessing: “O beautiful one, obtain a handsome husband!
May good fortune attend you constantly, O auspicious one, in your husband!

sanskrit_iast:
putraste bhavitā sādhvi nārāyaṇasamo guṇaiḥ ..
bhavitā te parā pūjā trailokye jagadambike ..29..
meaning:
पुत्रस्ते भविता साध्वि नारायणसमो गुणैः ..
भविता ते परा पूजा त्रैलोक्ये जगदम्बिके ..29..
text_mt:
May a son be born to you, O virtuous lady, equal to Nārāyaṇa in virtues!
Supreme worship will be yours in the three worlds, O Mother of the Universe!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu sarveṣāṃ ca parā bhava ..
saptapradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā yato bhaktyā tvayā natam ..4.39.30..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डेषु च सर्वेषु सर्वेषां च परा भव ..
सप्तप्रदक्षिणाः कृत्वा यतो भक्त्या त्वया नतम् ..4.39.30..
text_mt:
And in all the cosmic eggs, be superior to all!
Because you have bowed down with devotion after making seven circumambulations,

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmani tuṣṭo'haṃ tatphalaṃ labha sundari ..
tīrthe kānte'bhīṣṭadeve gurau mantre tathauṣadhe .. 31 ..
meaning:
सप्तजन्मनि तुष्टोऽहं तत्फलं लभ सुन्दरि ..
तीर्थे कान्तेऽभीष्टदेवे गुरौ मन्त्रे तथौषधे .. 31 ..
text_mt:
I am pleased for seven births; receive the fruit of that, O beautiful one!
Toward a sacred place, a beloved, a chosen deity, a guru, a mantra, and medicine,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthā ca yādṛśī yāsāṃ siddhistāsāṃ ca tādṛśī ..
ityuktvā śaṅkarastūrṇaṃ brahmajyotiḥ paraṃ ca mām .. 32 ..
meaning:
आस्था च यादृशी यासां सिद्धिस्तासां च तादृशी ..
इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तूर्णं ब्रह्मज्योतिः परं च माम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
whatever faith women have, such is the accomplishment they attain.”
Having spoken thus, Śaṅkara, the lord of yogins, immediately / meditated upon Me, the supreme light of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyau yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā yogīśo vyāghracarmaṇi ..
prakṣālya caraṇau devī papau taccaraṇodakam .. 33 ..
meaning:
दध्यौ योगासनं कृत्वा योगीशो व्याघ्रचर्मणि ..
प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ देवी पपौ तच्चरणोदकम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
assuming a yogic posture upon a tiger-skin.
Washing his feet, the goddess drank the water from his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra mārjanaṃ bhaktyā vahniśaucena vāsasā ..
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmādinirmitam ..34..
meaning:
चकार मार्जनं भक्त्या वह्निशौचेन वाससा ..
रत्नसिंहासनं रम्यं विश्वकर्मादिनिर्मितम् ..34..
text_mt:
With devotion she wiped them dry with a fire-purified garment.
A charming jewel-throne fashioned by Viśvakarman and others,

sanskrit_iast:
apūrvaṃ kāṃsyapātrasthaṃ naivedyaṃ pradadau kila ..
arghyaṃ maṃdākinītoya saṃyuktaṃ caraṇe dadau ..35..
meaning:
अपूर्वं कांस्यपात्रस्थं नैवेद्यं प्रददौ किल ..
अर्घ्यं मंदाकिनीतोय संयुक्तं चरणे ददौ ..35..
text_mt:
and wonderful food offerings in a bell-metal vessel she indeed offered.
She offered water for the arghya accompanied by water of the Mandākinī at his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhicandanaṃ cāru kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ..
pradadau mālatīmālāṃ gale garalasundare ..36..
meaning:
सुगन्धिचन्दनं चारु कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम् ..
प्रददौ मालतीमालां गले गरलसुन्दरे ..36..
text_mt: and a garland of mālatī flowers she placed upon his throat, lovely with poison.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā pūjāṃ cakārātha puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭaye ..
pīyūṣaṃ svarṇapātrasthaṃ pradadau madhuraṃ madhu .. 37 ..
meaning:
भक्त्या पूजां चकाराथ पुष्पवृष्टिं च तुष्टये ..
पीयूषं स्वर्णपात्रस्थं प्रददौ मधुरं मधु .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Then with devotion she performed worship and a shower of flowers for his pleasure.
She offered nectar in a golden vessel and sweet honey,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnapradīpaśatakaṃ samantāddhūpamuttamam ..
trailokyadurlabhaṃ vastraṃ svarṇayajñopavītakam .. 38 ..
meaning:
रत्नप्रदीपशतकं समन्ताद्धूपमुत्तमम् ..
त्रैलोक्यदुर्लभं वस्त्रं स्वर्णयज्ञोपवीतकम् .. 38 ..
text_mt:
a hundred jewel-lamps, excellent incense on every side,
garments rare in the three worlds, and a golden sacred thread.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhiśītatoyaṃ ca pānārthaṃ pārvatī dadau ..
atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ ratnasārendrabhūṣaṇam..39..
meaning:
सुगन्धिशीततोयं च पानार्थं पार्वती ददौ ..
अतीव सुन्दरं रम्यं रत्नसारेन्द्रभूषणम्..39..
text_mt:
And Pārvatī gave fragrant, cool water for drinking,
exceedingly beautiful, lovely ornaments of the finest jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhāṃ kāmadhenuṃ ca svarṇaśṛṅgasamanvitām ..
snānīyaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ca manoharam .. 4.39.40 ..
meaning:
दुर्लभां कामधेनुं च स्वर्णशृङ्गसमन्विताम् ..
स्नानीयं तीर्थतोयं च ताम्बूलं च मनोहरम् .. 4.39.40 ..
text_mt:
and the rare Kāmadhenu endowed with golden horns,
water from holy places for bathing, and delightful betel.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ..
saṃpūjya śūlinaṃ bhaktyā yayau nityaṃ piturgṛham ..41..
meaning:
दत्त्वा षोडशोपचारं प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः ..
संपूज्य शूलिनं भक्त्या ययौ नित्यं पितुर्गृहम् ..41..
text_mt:
Having offered the sixteen items of worship, she bowed again and again.
Having worshiped the trident-bearer with devotion, she went back each day to her father's house.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrāvāpsarasāṃ vaktrāddevīmindro maheśvaraḥ ..
śrutvā vārtāṃ śunāsīro nanarta harṣasaṃyutaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
शुश्रावाप्सरसां वक्त्राद्देवीमिन्द्रो महेश्वरः ..
श्रुत्वा वार्तां शुनासीरो ननर्त हर्षसंयुतः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Indra, the great lord, heard from the mouths of the apsarases about the goddess.
Hearing the news, Śunāsīra danced, filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dūtadvārā kāmadevamānināya tvarānvitaḥ ..
indrājñayā kāmadevaḥ prajagāmāmarāvatīm .. 43 ..
meaning:
दूतद्वारा कामदेवमानिनाय त्वरान्वितः ..
इन्द्राज्ञया कामदेवः प्रजगामामरावतीम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Through a messenger he quickly summoned Kāmadeva.
By Indra's command, Kāmadeva went to Amarāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tūrṇaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa taṃ ca yatra śivaḥ śivā ..
pañcasāyakasaṃyukto jagāma pañcasāyakaḥ ..44..
meaning:
तूर्णं प्रस्थापयामास तं च यत्र शिवः शिवा ..
पञ्चसायकसंयुक्तो जगाम पञ्चसायकः ..44..
text_mt:
He swiftly dispatched him to where Śiva and Śivā were.
Equipped with his five arrows, he of the five arrows set forth,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānyatra śaktiyutaḥ śivaḥ..
gatvā dadarśa madanaḥ śivāyuktaṃ śivaṃ vibhum..45..
meaning:
प्रसन्नवदनः श्रीमान्यत्र शक्तियुतः शिवः..
गत्वा ददर्श मदनः शिवायुक्तं शिवं विभुम्..45..
text_mt:
cheerful-faced and radiant, to where Śiva was with his Śakti.
Having gone there, Madana saw the all-pervading Śiva accompanied by Śivā,

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaṃ trailokyakāntaṃ ca prasannavadanekṣaṇam..
kāmaḥ sthito'ntarikṣe ca dhṛtvā ca saśaraṃ dhanuḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
शान्तं त्रैलोक्यकान्तं च प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणम्..
कामः स्थितोऽन्तरिक्षे च धृत्वा च सशरं धनुः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
peaceful, the beloved of the three worlds, with gracious face and eyes.
Standing in the sky, holding his bow with an arrow, Kāma

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepāstraṃ durnivāryamamoghaṃ śaṃkare mudā ..
babhūvāmoghamastraṃ ca moghaṃ tatparamātmani..47..
meaning:
चिक्षेपास्त्रं दुर्निवार्यममोघं शंकरे मुदा ..
बभूवामोघमस्त्रं च मोघं तत्परमात्मनि..47..
text_mt:
joyfully discharged his irresistible, unfailing weapon at Śaṅkara.
That unfailing weapon became futile against the Paramātman,

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśa iva nirlipte nirlipte paramātmani ..
moghībhūte ca śastre ca bhayamāpa ca manmathaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
आकाश इव निर्लिप्ते निर्लिप्ते परमात्मनि ..
मोघीभूते च शस्त्रे च भयमाप च मन्मथः .. 48 ..
text_mt:
against the untainted Paramātman, just like [a weapon shot] into the untainted sky.
When his weapon was rendered futile, Manmatha was seized by fear.

sanskrit_iast:
cakampe purataḥ sthitvā dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ vibhum ..
sasmāra tridaśānkāmaḥ śakrādīnbhayavihvalaḥ ...49...
meaning:
चकम्पे पुरतः स्थित्वा दृष्ट्वा मृत्युंजयं विभुम् ..
सस्मार त्रिदशान्कामः शक्रादीन्भयविह्वलः ...49...
text_mt:
Standing before him, he trembled upon seeing the all-pervading Mṛtyuñjaya.
Overwhelmed with fear, Kāma remembered the thirty gods, Śakra and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
āyayurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ śaṃbhukopena vepitāḥ..
cakruḥ stutiṃ ca stotreṇa śaṃkaraṃ tridaśeśvaram ..4.39.50...
kopāgnimudgirantaṃ taṃ kapālalocanādaho ..
stutiṃ kurvatsu deveṣu sa vahniḥ śaṃbhusaṃbhavaḥ..51..
meaning:
आययुर्देवताः सर्वाः शंभुकोपेन वेपिताः..
चक्रुः स्तुतिं च स्तोत्रेण शंकरं त्रिदशेश्वरम् ..4.39.50...
कोपाग्निमुद्गिरन्तं तं कपाललोचनादहो ..
स्तुतिं कुर्वत्सु देवेषु स वह्निः शंभुसंभवः..51..
text_mt:
All the deities came, trembling before the anger of Śambhu.
They offered a eulogy with a hymn of praise to Śaṅkara, the lord of the thirty gods,
who was disgorging the fire of wrath from the eye in his forehead, alas!
While the gods were offering praise, that fire born of Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
jajvālordhvaśikho dīptaḥ pralayāgniśikhopamaḥ ..
utpatya gagane ghūrṇannipatya dharaṇītale ..
bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ca paritaḥ papāta madanopari .. 52 ..
meaning:
जज्वालोर्ध्वशिखो दीप्तः प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमः ..
उत्पत्य गगने घूर्णन्निपत्य धरणीतले ..
भ्रामंभ्रामं च परितः पपात मदनोपरि .. 52 ..
text_mt:
blazed with upward flames, radiant like the crest of flames of the dissolution fire.
Leaping into the sky, whirling around, falling down onto the earth,
and circling round and round, it fell upon Madana.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva bhasmasātkāmaḥ kṣaṇena harakopataḥ..
viṣaṇṇā devatāḥ sarvā natavaktrā ca pārvatī ..53..
meaning:
बभूव भस्मसात्कामः क्षणेन हरकोपतः..
विषण्णा देवताः सर्वा नतवक्त्रा च पार्वती ..53..
text_mt:
In an instant, Kāma was turned to ashes by the wrath of Hara.
All the deities were despondent, and Pārvatī lowered her face.

sanskrit_iast:
vilalāpa bahutaraṃ harasya purato ratiḥ ..
tuṣṭuvurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ kampitāścandraśekharam .. 54 ..
meaning:
विललाप बहुतरं हरस्य पुरतो रतिः ..
तुष्टुवुर्देवताः सर्वाः कम्पिताश्चन्द्रशेखरम् .. 54 ..
text_mt:
Rati lamented copiously in the presence of Hara.
All the deities, trembling, praised Candraśekhara.

sanskrit_iast:
ratimūcuḥ surāḥ sarve ruruduśca muhurmuhuḥ ..
kiṃcidbhasma gṛhītvā ca rakṣa mātarbhayaṃ tyaja ..55..
meaning:
रतिमूचुः सुराः सर्वे रुरुदुश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
किंचिद्भस्म गृहीत्वा च रक्ष मातर्भयं त्यज ..55..
text_mt:
All the gods spoke to Rati and wept again and again:
“Take some of the ashes and preserve them, O mother; cast away your fear!”

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ taṃ jīvayiṣyāmo labhiṣyasi priyaṃ punaḥ ..
harakopāpanayane suprasanne dine tathā ..56..
meaning:
वयं तं जीवयिष्यामो लभिष्यसि प्रियं पुनः ..
हरकोपापनयने सुप्रसन्ने दिने तथा ..56..
text_mt:
"We shall restore him to life; you will obtain your beloved again
when Hara's wrath is removed, on a most auspicious day."

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ratervilāpaṃ ca mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa pārvatī ..
atīndriyaṃ guṇātītaṃ tuṣṭāva candraśekharam..57..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा रतेर्विलापं च मूर्च्छां संप्राप पार्वती ..
अतीन्द्रियं गुणातीतं तुष्टाव चन्द्रशेखरम्..57..
text_mt:
Having witnessed Rati's lamentation, Pārvatī fell into a swoon;
she praised Candraśekhara, who is beyond the senses and beyond the gunas.

sanskrit_iast:
rudantīṃ pārvatīṃ tyaktvā svasthānaṃ prayayau śivaḥ..
sadyo babhūva tatraiva pārvatīdarpamokṣaṇam..58..
meaning:
रुदन्तीं पार्वतीं त्यक्त्वा स्वस्थानं प्रययौ शिवः..
सद्यो बभूव तत्रैव पार्वतीदर्पमोक्षणम्..58..
text_mt:
Leaving the weeping Pārvatī behind, Śiva departed for his own abode;
at that very moment, right there, occurred the shattering of Pārvatī's pride.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanayorgarvaṃ tatyāja śailakanyakā ..
mukhaṃ darśayituṃ lajjā tadbabhūva sakhīgaṇe .. 59 ..
meaning:
रूपयौवनयोर्गर्वं तत्याज शैलकन्यका ..
मुखं दर्शयितुं लज्जा तद्बभूव सखीगणे .. 59 ..
text_mt:
The daughter of the mountain cast away her pride in beauty and youth;
she felt ashamed to show her face among her group of friends.

sanskrit_iast:
surāśca ratimāśvāsya sarve jagmuḥ svamandiram ..
praṇamya daṇḍavadrudraṃ śokādudvignamānasāḥ ..4.39.60..
meaning:
सुराश्च रतिमाश्वास्य सर्वे जग्मुः स्वमन्दिरम् ..
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्रुद्रं शोकादुद्विग्नमानसाः ..4.39.60..
text_mt:
And the gods, having consoled Rati, all went to their own dwellings,
having bowed down to Rudra like a staff, their minds perturbed by sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
stutvā ruditvā śokena bhayena kāmakāminī ..
koparaktekṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ rādhike svālayaṃ yayau .. 61 ..
meaning:
स्तुत्वा रुदित्वा शोकेन भयेन कामकामिनी ..
कोपरक्तेक्षणं रुद्रं राधिके स्वालयं ययौ .. 61 ..
text_mt:
Having praised and wept in grief and fear, the beloved of Kāma,
before Rudra whose eyes were red with rage, went to her own home, O Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
na jagāma piturgehaṃ pārvatī sā tu lajjayā ..
svālibhirvāryamāṇā'pi jagāma tapase vanam .. 62 ..
meaning:
न जगाम पितुर्गेहं पार्वती सा तु लज्जया ..
स्वालिभिर्वार्यमाणाऽपि जगाम तपसे वनम् .. 62 ..
text_mt:
Out of shame, Pārvatī did not go to her father's house;
though restrained by her companions, she went to the forest to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
prajagmuḥ sahacāriṇyastatpaścācchokavihvalāḥ ..
mātṛbhirvāryamāṇā sā svarṇadītīrajaṃ vanam ..63..
meaning:
प्रजग्मुः सहचारिण्यस्तत्पश्चाच्छोकविह्वलाः ..
मातृभिर्वार्यमाणा सा स्वर्णदीतीरजं वनम् ..63..
text_mt:
Her female companions went behind her, overwhelmed with sorrow;
restrained by her mothers, she [proceeded to] the forest situated on the bank of the river of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā sā saṃprāpa trilocanam ..
ratiḥ saṃprāpa madanaṃ śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca .. 64 ..
meaning:
सुचिरं च तपस्तप्त्वा सा संप्राप त्रिलोचनम् ..
रतिः संप्राप मदनं शंकरस्य वरेण च .. 64 ..
text_mt:
Having performed severe austerities for a very long time, she obtained the three-eyed Lord;
and Rati regained Madana by the boon of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pārvatīdarpamokṣaṇam ..
nigūḍhacaritaṃ rādhe kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 65 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं पार्वतीदर्पमोक्षणम् ..
निगूढचरितं राधे किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Thus the shattering of Pārvatī's pride has all been told [to you],
this profound narrative, O Rādhā. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrādhikovāca ..
aho vicitraṃ caritamapūrvaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ vibho ..
sundaraṃ śrutipīyūṣaṃ nigūḍhaṃ jñānakāraṇam .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीराधिकोवाच ..
अहो विचित्रं चरितमपूर्वं किं श्रुतं विभो ..
सुन्दरं श्रुतिपीयूषं निगूढं ज्ञानकारणम् .. 1 ..
title: adhyāyaḥ 040

sanskrit_iast:
na viśeṣaṃ samāsaṃ ca śrutaṃ na vyāsamīpsitam ..
adhunā śrotumicchāmi vistīrṇaṃ kathaya prabho .. 2 ..
meaning:
न विशेषं समासं च श्रुतं न व्यासमीप्सितम् ..
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तीर्णं कथय प्रभो .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kiṃ tapaḥ kaṭhoraṃ ca cakāra pārvatī svayam ..
kaṃ kaṃ varaṃ vā saṃprāpya kathamāpa maheśvaram ..3..
meaning:
किं किं तपः कठोरं च चकार पार्वती स्वयम् ..
कं कं वरं वा संप्राप्य कथमाप महेश्वरम् ..3..

sanskrit_iast:
ratiḥ kena prakāreṇa jīvayāmāsa manmatham ..
pārvatīśivayoḥ kṛṣṇa vivāhaṃ varṇaya prabho .. 4 ..
meaning:
रतिः केन प्रकारेण जीवयामास मन्मथम् ..
पार्वतीशिवयोः कृष्ण विवाहं वर्णय प्रभो .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tayo rahasi saṃbhogaṃ pāpināṃ pāpamocanam ..
kathyatāṃ karuṇāsindho duḥkhināṃ duḥkhamocanam..5..
meaning:
तयो रहसि संभोगं पापिनां पापमोचनम् ..
कथ्यतां करुणासिन्धो दुःखिनां दुःखमोचनम्..5..

sanskrit_iast:
dampatīvirahoktiśca karṇajvālā ca yoṣitaḥ ..
śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ kṛṣṇa punaḥ saṃmelanaṃ tayoḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
दम्पतीविरहोक्तिश्च कर्णज्वाला च योषितः ..
श्रोतुं कौतूहलं कृष्ण पुनः संमेलनं तयोः .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
agnijvālā viṣajvālā kṣamā soḍhuṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ..
dampatīvirahajvālā na śrotuṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ kṣamā ..7 ..
meaning:
अग्निज्वाला विषज्वाला क्षमा सोढुं च योषितः ..
दम्पतीविरहज्वाला न श्रोतुं च क्षणं क्षमा ..7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā vismitaścakitānanaḥ ..
vistīrṇaṃ vaktumārebhe hṛdayena vidūyatā .. 8 ..
meaning:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मितश्चकिताननः ..
विस्तीर्णं वक्तुमारेभे हृदयेन विदूयता .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dampatīvirahoktiṃ ca yāṃ rādhā śrotumakṣamā ..
vicchede śatavarṣīye kimasyā bhavitā mama .. 9 ..
meaning:
दम्पतीविरहोक्तिं च यां राधा श्रोतुमक्षमा ..
विच्छेदे शतवर्षीये किमस्या भविता मम .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ mānase kṛtvā māyeśo māyayā'nvitaḥ ..
kṛpāsindhuśca kṛpayā kathāṃ kathitumudyataḥ .. 4.40.10 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं मानसे कृत्वा मायेशो माययाऽन्वितः ..
कृपासिन्धुश्च कृपया कथां कथितुमुद्यतः .. 4.40.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
prāṇādhike rādhike tvaṃ śrūyatāṃ prāṇavallabhe ..
prāṇādhidevi prāṇeśi prāṇādhāre manohare ..11..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ..
प्राणाधिके राधिके त्वं श्रूयतां प्राणवल्लभे ..
प्राणाधिदेवि प्राणेशि प्राणाधारे मनोहरे ..11..

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭamūlādgate rudre pārvatī tapase yayau ..
punaḥ punaḥ svamātrā ca pitrā ca vinivāritā..12..
meaning:
वटमूलाद्गते रुद्रे पार्वती तपसे ययौ ..
पुनः पुनः स्वमात्रा च पित्रा च विनिवारिता..12..

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sā svarṇadītīraṃ snātvā triṣavaṇaṃ mudā ..
saṃdeśe ca mayā dattaṃ jajāpa taṃ manuṃ mudā..13..
meaning:
गत्वा सा स्वर्णदीतीरं स्नात्वा त्रिषवणं मुदा ..
संदेशे च मया दत्तं जजाप तं मनुं मुदा..13..

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamekaṃ ca saṃpūrṇamanāhārā svabhaktitaḥ..
taptvā tapaḥ kaṭhoraṃ ca cakāra jagadambikā .. 14 ..
meaning:
वर्षमेकं च संपूर्णमनाहारा स्वभक्तितः..
तप्त्वा तपः कठोरं च चकार जगदम्बिका .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣme ca parito vahniṃ prajvalantaṃ divāniśam.. ..
kṛtvā pratasthau tanmadhye saṃtataṃ japatī manum..15..
meaning:
ग्रीष्मे च परितो वह्निं प्रज्वलन्तं दिवानिशम्.. ..
कृत्वा प्रतस्थौ तन्मध्ये संततं जपती मनुम्..15..

sanskrit_iast:
śaśvatsmaśāne varṣāsu kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ śivā..
śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca saṃsiktā babhūva jaladhārayā ..16..
meaning:
शश्वत्स्मशाने वर्षासु कृत्वा योगासनं शिवा..
शिलां दृष्ट्वा च संसिक्ता बभूव जलधारया ..16..

sanskrit_iast:
śīte jalāntare śaśvatpratasthau bhaktipūrvakam ..
anāhārā śaradraudranīhārāsu diśāsu ca..17..
meaning:
शीते जलान्तरे शश्वत्प्रतस्थौ भक्तिपूर्वकम् ..
अनाहारा शरद्रौद्रनीहारासु दिशासु च..17..

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ varṣamaprāpya śaṃkaraṃ satī..
śucā kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍaṃ ca praveṣṭuṃ sā samudyatā..18..
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा परं वर्षमप्राप्य शंकरं सती..
शुचा कृत्वाऽग्निकुण्डं च प्रवेष्टुं सा समुद्यता..18..

sanskrit_iast:
tāmagnikuṇḍaṃ viśatīṃ tapasā'tikṛśāṃ satīm..
dṛṣṭvā śivaḥ kṛpāsindhuḥ kṛpayā tāṃ jagāma ha ..19..
meaning:
तामग्निकुण्डं विशतीं तपसाऽतिकृशां सतीम्..
दृष्ट्वा शिवः कृपासिन्धुः कृपया तां जगाम ह ..19..

sanskrit_iast:
atīva vāmano bālo viprarūpī svatejasā ..
prajvalanmanasā hṛṣṭo daṇḍī chatrī jaṭādharaḥ .. 4.40.20 ..
meaning:
अतीव वामनो बालो विप्ररूपी स्वतेजसा ..
प्रज्वलन्मनसा हृष्टो दण्डी छत्री जटाधरः .. 4.40.20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śuklayajñopavītī ca śuklavāsāśca sasmitaḥ ..
śvetābjabījamālāṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam .. 21 ..
meaning:
शुक्लयज्ञोपवीती च शुक्लवासाश्च सस्मितः ..
श्वेताब्जबीजमालां च बिभ्रत्तिलकमुज्ज्वलम् .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirjane bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā snigdhā sāpi jagāda ha ..
tattejasā'tipracchannā tatyāja ca tapaḥ svayam ..22..
meaning:
निर्जने बालकं दृष्ट्वा स्निग्धा सापि जगाद ह ..
तत्तेजसाऽतिप्रच्छन्ना तत्याज च तपः स्वयम् ..22..

sanskrit_iast:
ko bhavāniti papraccha taṃ śiśuṃ purataḥ sthitam ..
manasā'liṅganaṃ kartumicchantī paramādaram..23..
meaning:
को भवानिति पप्रच्छ तं शिशुं पुरतः स्थितम् ..
मनसाऽलिङ्गनं कर्तुमिच्छन्ती परमादरम्..23..

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā śailasutā praśnaṃ prahasya parameśvaraḥ ..
uvācātīva madhuraṃ karṇapīyūṣamīśvarīm .. 24 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा शैलसुता प्रश्नं प्रहस्य परमेश्वरः ..
उवाचातीव मधुरं कर्णपीयूषमीश्वरीम् .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
icchāgāmī baṭurahaṃ tapasvī viprabālakaḥ ..
kā tvaṃ kāntā'tikāntāre tapaścarasi sundari .. 25 ..
meaning:
शंकर उवाच ..
इच्छागामी बटुरहं तपस्वी विप्रबालकः ..
का त्वं कान्ताऽतिकान्तारे तपश्चरसि सुन्दरि .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vada kasya kule jātā kasya kanyā ca kā'bhidhā ..
tapasaḥ phaladātrī tvaṃ kasmāddhetostapastava .. 26 ..
meaning:
वद कस्य कुले जाता कस्य कन्या च काऽभिधा ..
तपसः फलदात्री त्वं कस्माद्धेतोस्तपस्तव .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aho vā tapasāṃ rāśiḥ svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī. ..
tapo vā lokaśikṣārthaṃ karoṣi kamalekṣaṇe .. 27 ..
meaning:
अहो वा तपसां राशिः स्वयं मूर्तिमती सती. ..
तपो वा लोकशिक्षार्थं करोषि कमलेक्षणे .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ tejaḥsvarūpā vā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ..
vidhāya bhaktadhyānārthaṃ vigrahaṃ bhārate januḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वयं तेजःस्वरूपा वा मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ..
विधाय भक्तध्यानार्थं विग्रहं भारते जनुः .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vā triloke lakṣmīstvaṃ saṃpadrūpā sanātanī ..
rakṣāṃ vidhātuṃ jagatāmāgatā dhāturantike ..29..
meaning:
किं वा त्रिलोके लक्ष्मीस्त्वं संपद्रूपा सनातनी ..
रक्षां विधातुं जगतामागता धातुरन्तिके ..29..

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vāmbikā tvaṃ devānāṃ svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī ..
sāvitrī bhārate janma svecchayā labdhumāgatā .. 4.40.30 ..
meaning:
किं वाम्बिका त्वं देवानां स्वयं मूर्तिमती सती ..
सावित्री भारते जन्म स्वेच्छया लब्धुमागता .. 4.40.30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī vā svayaṃ sākṣātsarasvatī ..
sarvavidyāḥ prakaṭituṃ svecchayā janma bhārate..31..
meaning:
रागाधिष्ठातृदेवी वा स्वयं साक्षात्सरस्वती ..
सर्वविद्याः प्रकटितुं स्वेच्छया जन्म भारते..31..

sanskrit_iast:
etāsu madhye kā vā tvaṃ nāhaṃ tarkitumīśvaraḥ ..
yā sā bhavati kalyāṇi parituṣṭā ca māṃ bhava .. 32 ..
meaning:
एतासु मध्ये का वा त्वं नाहं तर्कितुमीश्वरः ..
या सा भवति कल्याणि परितुष्टा च मां भव .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sati tvayi prasannāyāṃ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
pativratāyāṃ tuṣṭāyāṃ tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam .. 33 ..
meaning:
सति त्वयि प्रसन्नायां प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः ..
पतिव्रतायां तुष्टायां तुष्टो नारायणः स्वयम् .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭe nārāyaṇe deve śaśvattuṣṭaṃ jagattrayam ..
tarumūleṣu sikteṣu śākhāḥ siktā yathā priye .. 34 ..
meaning:
तुष्टे नारायणे देवे शश्वत्तुष्टं जगत्त्रयम् ..
तरुमूलेषु सिक्तेषु शाखाः सिक्ता यथा प्रिये .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śiśostadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī ..
uvāca vacanaṃ cāru karṇapīyūṣamīśvarī .. 35 ..
meaning:
शिशोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य परमेश्वरी ..
उवाच वचनं चारु कर्णपीयूषमीश्वरी .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca .. nāhaṃ vedaprasūrlakṣmīrvāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ..
janma me bhārate varṣe sāmprataṃ śailakanyakā .. 36 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच .. नाहं वेदप्रसूर्लक्ष्मीर्वागधिष्ठातृदेवता ..
जन्म मे भारते वर्षे साम्प्रतं शैलकन्यका .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ janma dakṣagehe satī śaṃkarakāminī ..
yogena tyaktadehā'haṃ tātabhartṛvinindayā .. 37 ..
meaning:
पूर्वं जन्म दक्षगेहे सती शंकरकामिनी ..
योगेन त्यक्तदेहाऽहं तातभर्तृविनिन्दया .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atra janmani puṇyena samprāpte śaṃkare dvija ..
māṃ tyaktvā bhasmasātkṛtvā manmathaṃ sa jagāma ha .. 38 ..
meaning:
अत्र जन्मनि पुण्येन सम्प्राप्ते शंकरे द्विज ..
मां त्यक्त्वा भस्मसात्कृत्वा मन्मथं स जगाम ह .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prayāte śaṃkare tāpādvrīḍayā'haṃ piturgṛhāt ..
āgamattapase cittaṃ mamedaṃ svarṇadītaṭe .. 39 ..
meaning:
प्रयाते शंकरे तापाद्व्रीडयाऽहं पितुर्गृहात् ..
आगमत्तपसे चित्तं ममेदं स्वर्णदीतटे .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥ kṛtvā kaṭhoraṃ ca suciraṃ prāṇavallabham ..
aprāpyāgniṃ praveṣṭuṃ ca tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ sthitā .. 4.40.40 ..
meaning:
तपः कृत्वा कठोरं च सुचिरं प्राणवल्लभम् ..
अप्राप्याग्निं प्रवेष्टुं च त्वां च दृष्ट्वा क्षणं स्थिता .. 4.40.40 ..
text_mt: the beloved of my life, I was about to enter the fire; but seeing you, I paused for a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha tvaṃ praviśāmyagnau pralayāgniśikhopame ..
kṛtvā svakāmanāṃ vipra haraprāptimanīṣitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
गच्छ त्वं प्रविशाम्यग्नौ प्रलयाग्निशिखोपमे ..
कृत्वा स्वकामनां विप्र हरप्राप्तिमनीषितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Depart; I shall enter the fire that resembles the flame of the fire of dissolution,
making my desire, O brāhmaṇa, my longing to attain Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra janurlabdhvā labhiṣyāmi śivaṃ param ..
prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ vibhuṃ janmani janmani ..42..
meaning:
यत्र यत्र जनुर्लब्ध्वा लभिष्यामि शिवं परम् ..
प्राणाधिकं प्रियं कान्तं विभुं जन्मनि जन्मनि ..42..
text_mt:
Wherever I take birth, I shall attain the supreme Śiva,
the lord dearer than life, my beloved husband in birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā hi svapriyaṃ labdhuṃ labhanti janma vāñchitam ..
tajjanma patilābhārthaṃ sarvāsāṃ ca śrutau śrutam .. 43 ..
meaning:
सर्वा हि स्वप्रियं लब्धुं लभन्ति जन्म वाञ्छितम् ..
तज्जन्म पतिलाभार्थं सर्वासां च श्रुतौ श्रुतम् .. 43 ..
text_mt:
For all women obtain their desired birth in order to obtain their beloved;
that their birth is for the sake of obtaining a husband is heard in the scriptures by all.

sanskrit_iast:
prāktanīyo hi yo bhartā sa tāsāṃ pratijanmani ..
yā strī yeṣāṃ suniyatā sā teṣāṃ janmajanmani .. 44 ..
meaning:
प्राक्तनीयो हि यो भर्ता स तासां प्रतिजन्मनि ..
या स्त्री येषां सुनियता सा तेषां जन्मजन्मनि .. 44 ..
text_mt:
The husband they had in a former life is indeed theirs in every birth;
the woman who is destined for certain men remains theirs birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
taddehamiha na prāpya kṛtvā ghorataraṃ tapaḥ ..
kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍe kāmyaṃ ca labhiṣyāmi paratra tam ..45..
meaning:
तद्देहमिह न प्राप्य कृत्वा घोरतरं तपः ..
कृत्वाऽग्निकुण्डे काम्यं च लभिष्यामि परत्र तम् ..45..
text_mt:
Not having obtained his body here, having performed most terrible austerity,
and having made my desire in the fire-pit, I will attain him in the next world."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā pārvatī tatra tatpuraḥ praviveśa ha ..
niṣidhyamānā purato brāhmaṇena punaḥ punaḥ..46..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वती तत्र तत्पुरः प्रविवेश ह ..
निषिध्यमाना पुरतो ब्राह्मणेन पुनः पुनः..46..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Pārvatī then entered [the fire] before him,
even though forbidden again and again by the brāhmaṇa who stood before her.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnipraveśaṃ kurvantyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvari ..
babhūva tapasā sadyo vahniścandanavaddhruvam.. .. 47 ..
meaning:
वह्निप्रवेशं कुर्वन्त्याः पार्वत्याः परमेश्वरि ..
बभूव तपसा सद्यो वह्निश्चन्दनवद्ध्रुवम्.. .. 47 ..
text_mt:
As Pārvatī entered the fire, O supreme goddess,
by her ascetic power the fire instantly became like sandalwood [paste], surely.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ tadantare sthitvā cotpatantīṃ śivāṃ śivaḥ ..
punaḥ prapaccha sahasā vṛndāvanavinodini ..48 ..
meaning:
क्षणं तदन्तरे स्थित्वा चोत्पतन्तीं शिवां शिवः ..
पुनः प्रपच्छ सहसा वृन्दावनविनोदिनि ..48 ..
text_mt:
As she remained within it for a moment and then sprang up, Śiva
asked Śivā once more, O delighter of Vṛndāvana!

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
aho tapaste kiṃ bhadre na buddhaṃ kiṃcideva hi ..
na dagdho vahninā deho na ca prāpto manīṣitaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ..
अहो तपस्ते किं भद्रे न बुद्धं किंचिदेव हि ..
न दग्धो वह्निना देहो न च प्राप्तो मनीषितः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
Ah, what an austerity is yours, blessed lady! Truly, nothing has been understood [by you].
Your body has not been consumed by fire, nor has your desired object been attained.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ kalyāṇarūpaṃ ca bhartāraṃ kartumicchasi..
avigrahaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vā te vāñchitaṃ bhavet ..4.40.50..
meaning:
शिवं कल्याणरूपं च भर्तारं कर्तुमिच्छसि..
अविग्रहं पतिं कृत्वा किं वा ते वाञ्छितं भवेत् ..4.40.50..
text_mt:
You wish to make Śiva, the auspicious-form, your husband.
By taking a bodiless one as husband, what indeed would be your desire?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhartāraṃ ca bhartāraṃ yadīcchasi śucismite ..
kāntamicchati kā vā strī sarvasaṃhārakāraṇam ..51..
meaning:
संहर्तारं च भर्तारं यदीच्छसि शुचिस्मिते ..
कान्तमिच्छति का वा स्त्री सर्वसंहारकारणम् ..51..
text_mt:
And if you desire the Destroyer as your husband, O sweetly smiling one,
what woman desires a beloved who is the cause of the destruction of all?

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaṃ vāñchasi ceddevi kṛtvā kāntaṃ svarūpiṇam ..
sarvamuktipradā tvaṃ ca tapasyā viphalā tava.. .. 52 ..
meaning:
मोक्षं वाञ्छसि चेद्देवि कृत्वा कान्तं स्वरूपिणम् ..
सर्वमुक्तिप्रदा त्वं च तपस्या विफला तव.. .. 52 ..
text_mt:
If you desire liberation, O goddess, having taken a form-endowed beloved,
you yourself are the giver of all liberation, and your austerity is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśca maṅgale mokṣe saṃhartā na ca dṛśyate ..
śivaśabdasya cānyo'rtho na hi vede nirūpitaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
शिवश्च मङ्गले मोक्षे संहर्ता न च दृश्यते ..
शिवशब्दस्य चान्योऽर्थो न हि वेदे निरूपितः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Śiva is found in auspiciousness and liberation, but the destroyer is not seen.
Indeed, no other meaning of the word ‘śiva’ is determined in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca saṃhārakartāraṃ yadi vāñchasi sundari ..
labhiṣyase rataṃ rudraṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram ..54..
meaning:
तं च संहारकर्तारं यदि वाञ्छसि सुन्दरि ..
लभिष्यसे रतं रुद्रं सर्वलोकभयंकरम् ..54..
text_mt:
If you desire him, the agent of destruction, O beautiful lady,
you will obtain Rudra, delightful [to you but] terrifying to all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhaviṣyati mokṣaste svābhīṣṭaṃ devasevanam ..
harismṛtiramoghā ca sarvamaṃgaladā sadā ..55 ..
meaning:
न भविष्यति मोक्षस्ते स्वाभीष्टं देवसेवनम् ..
हरिस्मृतिरमोघा च सर्वमंगलदा सदा ..55 ..
text_mt:
Your liberation will not occur; your personal desire is the service of the god.
Remembrance of Hari is infallible and always grants all auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ piturgṛhaṃ gaccha tatra drakṣyasi śaṃkaram ..
mamāśiṣā svatapasāṃ phalena ca sudurlabham..56..
meaning:
शीघ्रं पितुर्गृहं गच्छ तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि शंकरम् ..
ममाशिषा स्वतपसां फलेन च सुदुर्लभम्..56..
text_mt:
Go quickly to your father's house; there you will see Śaṅkara,
who is very difficult to obtain, through my blessing and the fruit of your own austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā pārvatīṃ viprastatraivāntaradhīyata ..
durgā yayau piturgehaṃ mahādeveti vādinī..57..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा पार्वतीं विप्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..
दुर्गा ययौ पितुर्गेहं महादेवेति वादिनी..57..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to Pārvatī, the brahmin vanished right there.
Durgā went to her father's home, uttering, “Mahādeva!”

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyāgamanaṃ śrutvā menakā ca himālayaḥ ..
divyaṃ yānaṃ puraskṛtya prayayau harṣavihvalaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्यागमनं श्रुत्वा मेनका च हिमालयः ..
दिव्यं यानं पुरस्कृत्य प्रययौ हर्षविह्वलः .. 58 ..
text_mt:
Hearing of Pārvatī's arrival, Menakā and Himālaya,
placing a celestial vehicle in front, set out, overwhelmed with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya maṃgalaghaṭānrājavartmani rādhike ..
candanāgurukastūrīphalaśākhāsamanvitān .. 59 ..
meaning:
संस्थाप्य मंगलघटान्राजवर्त्मनि राधिके ..
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीफलशाखासमन्वितान् .. 59 ..
text_mt:
setting up auspicious jars on the royal highway, O Rādhikā,
accompanied by sandalwood, agallochum, musk, fruits, and leafy twigs,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭṭasūtrasannibaddharasālapallavānvitaiḥ ..
paritaḥ parito rambhāstambhavṛndasamanvite .. 4.40.60 ..
meaning:
पट्टसूत्रसन्निबद्धरसालपल्लवान्वितैः ..
परितः परितो रम्भास्तम्भवृन्दसमन्विते .. 4.40.60 ..
text_mt: surrounded everywhere by rows of plantain trunks,

sanskrit_iast:
patiputravatīyoṣitsamūhairdīpahastakaiḥ ..
pūrṇairlājādhānyadūrvāphalapuṣpasamanvitaiḥ ..61..
meaning:
पतिपुत्रवतीयोषित्समूहैर्दीपहस्तकैः ..
पूर्णैर्लाजाधान्यदूर्वाफलपुष्पसमन्वितैः ..61..
text_mt:
[crowded] with groups of women whose husbands and sons are living, holding lamps in their hands,
accompanied by full vessels of parched grain, paddy, dūrvā grass, fruits, and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
supuṇyairbrāhmaṇaiścāpi munibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ ..
naṭībhirnartakībhiśca gajendraiḥ pariśobhite .. 62 ..
meaning:
सुपुण्यैर्ब्राह्मणैश्चापि मुनिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः ..
नटीभिर्नर्तकीभिश्च गजेन्द्रैः परिशोभिते .. 62 ..
text_mt:
and also by exceedingly virtuous brahmins, sages, and celibate students,
graced with actresses, dancers, and noble elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
purohitaiśca saṃyuktaiḥ kurvadbhirmaṅgaladhvanim ..
sucārumālatīmālāhastaiḥ śastaiḥ praśaṃsitaiḥ 63 ..
meaning:
पुरोहितैश्च संयुक्तैः कुर्वद्भिर्मङ्गलध्वनिम् ..
सुचारुमालतीमालाहस्तैः शस्तैः प्रशंसितैः 63 ..
text_mt:
accompanied by family priests uttering auspicious sounds,
holding very charming garlands of mālatī flowers, auspicious and praised,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprakāravādyaiśca śaṃkhadhvanisunāditaiḥ..
sindūrareṇubhiścārucandanadravapaṅkilam .. 64 ..
meaning:
नानाप्रकारवाद्यैश्च शंखध्वनिसुनादितैः..
सिन्दूररेणुभिश्चारुचन्दनद्रवपङ्किलम् .. 64 ..
text_mt:
resounding with various kinds of musical instruments and the sounds of conches,
and muddied by vermilion powder and the liquid paste of charming sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya nagaraṃ durgā dadarśa pitarau puraḥ ..
suprasannau pradhāvantau harṣāśrupulakānvitau .. 65 ..
meaning:
प्रविश्य नगरं दुर्गा ददर्श पितरौ पुरः ..
सुप्रसन्नौ प्रधावन्तौ हर्षाश्रुपुलकान्वितौ .. 65 ..
text_mt:
Entering the city, Durgā saw her parents before her,
delighted, running toward her, filled with tears of joy and horripilation.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannavadanā devī cālibhiḥ praṇanāma tau ..
saṃyujyāthāśiṣaṃ tau ca cakratustāṃ ca vakṣasi .. .. 66 ..
meaning:
प्रसन्नवदना देवी चालिभिः प्रणनाम तौ ..
संयुज्याथाशिषं तौ च चक्रतुस्तां च वक्षसि .. .. 66 ..
text_mt:
With a cheerful face, the goddess bowed down to them with her female companions;
having bestowed their blessing, the two then clasped her to their breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
he vatse vatsetyuccārya rudantau premavihvalau..
tadā tāṃ ca rathe kṛtvā jagmaturnijamandiram .. 67 ..
meaning:
हे वत्से वत्सेत्युच्चार्य रुदन्तौ प्रेमविह्वलौ..
तदा तां च रथे कृत्वा जग्मतुर्निजमन्दिरम् .. 67 ..
text_mt:
calling out, “O daughter, daughter!”, weeping, overwhelmed with love.
Then, placing her on the chariot, they went to their own palace.

sanskrit_iast:
striyo nirmaṃcchanaṃ cakrurviprā yuyujurāśiṣam..
brāhmaṇebhyaśca bandibhyaḥ parvatendro dhanaṃ dadau..68..
meaning:
स्त्रियो निर्मंच्छनं चक्रुर्विप्रा युयुजुराशिषम्..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च बन्दिभ्यः पर्वतेन्द्रो धनं ददौ..68..
text_mt:
The women performed the waving-of-lights ritual, and the brahmins bestowed blessings.
The lord of mountains gave wealth to the brahmins and bards.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa pāṭhayāmāsa chāndasam ..
evaṃ svakanyayā sārddhaṃ tasthatustau svamandire .. 69 ..
meaning:
मङ्गलं कारयामास पाठयामास छान्दसम् ..
एवं स्वकन्यया सार्द्धं तस्थतुस्तौ स्वमन्दिरे .. 69 ..
text_mt:
He had auspicious rites performed and had the Vedic texts recited.
Thus the two stayed in their own palace together with their daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhena vasatau tau hi harṣanirbharamānasau ..
ekadā ca tapaḥ kartuṃ jagāma svarṇadīṃ giriḥ .. 4.40.70 ..
meaning:
सुखेन वसतौ तौ हि हर्षनिर्भरमानसौ ..
एकदा च तपः कर्तुं जगाम स्वर्णदीं गिरिः .. 4.40.70 ..
text_mt:
The two indeed dwelt happily, their minds overflowing with joy.
Once the mountain went to the heavenly river to perform austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
menakākanyayā sārddhamuvāsa prāṅgaṇe mudā ..
etasminnantare bhikṣurnartakaśca sugāyanaḥ ..71..
meaning:
मेनकाकन्यया सार्द्धमुवास प्राङ्गणे मुदा ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भिक्षुर्नर्तकश्च सुगायनः ..71..
text_mt:
Menakā stayed joyfully in the courtyard together with her daughter.
In the meantime, a mendicant, a dancer, and a skilled singer,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasaika ājagāma menakāsannidhiṃ mudā ..
śṛṅgavādyaṃ vāmahaste ḍamaruṃ dakṣiṇe tathā ..72..
meaning:
सहसैक आजगाम मेनकासन्निधिं मुदा ..
शृङ्गवाद्यं वामहस्ते डमरुं दक्षिणे तथा ..72..
text_mt:
a solitary one, suddenly came joyfully near Menakā,
holding a horn instrument in his left hand and a ḍamaru in his right,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vibhūtigātro'tivṛddho'tīva jarāturaḥ ..
pṛṣṭhakantho raktavāsāḥ sukaṇṭho'timanoharaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा विभूतिगात्रोऽतिवृद्धोऽतीव जरातुरः ..
पृष्ठकन्थो रक्तवासाः सुकण्ठोऽतिमनोहरः .. 73 ..
text_mt:
his limbs covered with holy ash, very old and exceedingly afflicted by decrepitude,
with a patched garment on his back, dressed in red, with a melodious throat, exceedingly captivating.

sanskrit_iast:
jagau mama guṇākhyānaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyaṃ manoharam ..
vādayāmāsa śṛṅgaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā .. 74 ..
meaning:
जगौ मम गुणाख्यानं कृत्वा नृत्यं मनोहरम् ..
वादयामास शृङ्गं च क्षणं डमरुकं तथा .. 74 ..
text_mt:
Having performed a delightful dance, he sang a recitation of my virtues;
he sounded the horn, and for a moment likewise the ḍamaruka.

sanskrit_iast:
ājagmurnāgarā bālā bālikā harṣavihvalāḥ ..
vṛddhā yuvāno yuvatīsamūho vṛddhayoṣitaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
आजग्मुर्नागरा बाला बालिका हर्षविह्वलाः ..
वृद्धा युवानो युवतीसमूहो वृद्धयोषितः .. 75 ..
text_mt:
Citizens, young boys, and young girls came, overwhelmed with joy,
old men, youths, crowds of young women, and elderly matrons.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu sundaraṃ gītaṃ sutānasvarasaṃyutam ..
sahasā mumuhuḥ sarve tena mūrcchāmavāpnuvan ..76..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु सुन्दरं गीतं सुतानस्वरसंयुतम् ..
सहसा मुमुहुः सर्वे तेन मूर्च्छामवाप्नुवन् ..76..
text_mt:
Upon hearing that charming song, accompanied by beautiful melodies and pitches,
they all suddenly were enchanted, and through it they fell into a faint.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrchāṃ saṃprāpa sā durgā dadarśa hṛdi śaṅkaram ..
triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmadharaṃ param ..77..
meaning:
मूर्छां संप्राप सा दुर्गा ददर्श हृदि शङ्करम् ..
त्रिशूलपट्टिशकरं व्याघ्रचर्मधरं परम् ..77..
text_mt:
That Durgā fell into a faint and saw Śaṅkara in her heart,
holding a trident and a spear in his hand, wearing a tiger skin, the supreme one,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtibhūṣaṇaṃ ramyamasthimālāṃ sunirmalām ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ suprasannaṃ trilocanam .. 78 ..
meaning:
विभूतिभूषणं रम्यमस्थिमालां सुनिर्मलाम् ..
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं सुप्रसन्नं त्रिलोचनम् .. 78 ..
text_mt:
having holy ash as an ornament, charming, with an immaculate garland of bones.
His face serene with a gentle smile, gracious, with three eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
mālāhastaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ nāgayajñopavītakam..
varaṃ vṛṇvityuktavantaṃ sundaraṃ candraśekharam..79..
meaning:
मालाहस्तं पंचवक्त्रं नागयज्ञोपवीतकम्..
वरं वृण्वित्युक्तवन्तं सुन्दरं चन्द्रशेखरम्..79..
text_mt:
Holding a rosary in his hand, five-faced, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread,
Saying, “Choose a boon,” handsome, bearing the crescent moon upon his crest—

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayasthaṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā taṃ nanāma sā ..
varaṃ vavre mānase sā tvaṃ patirme bhaveti ca .. 4.40.80 ..
meaning:
हृदयस्थं हरं दृष्ट्वा मनसा तं ननाम सा ..
वरं वव्रे मानसे सा त्वं पतिर्मे भवेति च .. 4.40.80 ..
text_mt:
Seeing Hara dwelling within her heart, she bowed to him in her mind.
In her heart she chose the boon: “Be my husband.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā śivastasya cāntardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
na dṛṣṭvā hṛdi taṃ durgā saṃprāpya cetanāṃ punaḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा शिवस्तस्य चान्तर्धानं चकार सः ..
न दृष्ट्वा हृदि तं दुर्गा संप्राप्य चेतनां पुनः .. 81 ..
text_mt:
Having thus granted it, Śiva vanished from her.
No longer seeing him in her heart, Durgā, having regained consciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya bhikṣukaṃ gāyakaṃ puraḥ ..
nṛtyasaṃgītataḥ sā tu bhikṣukasya ca menakā ..82..
meaning:
ददर्श चक्षुरुन्मील्य भिक्षुकं गायकं पुरः ..
नृत्यसंगीततः सा तु भिक्षुकस्य च मेनका ..82..
text_mt:
Opened her eyes and saw the singing mendicant before her.
Because of the dancing and singing of the mendicant, Menakā

sanskrit_iast:
dātuṃ yayau sā ratnāni svarṇapātrasthitāni ca ..
bhikṣāṃ yayāce bhikṣustāṃ durgāṃ nānyāṃ gṛhītavān .. 83 ..
meaning:
दातुं ययौ सा रत्नानि स्वर्णपात्रस्थितानि च ..
भिक्षां ययाचे भिक्षुस्तां दुर्गां नान्यां गृहीतवान् .. 83 ..
text_mt:
Went forward to give him jewels placed in a golden vessel.
The mendicant begged for Durgā as alms; he accepted nothing else,

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca nartanaṃ kartumudyataḥ kautukena ca ..
menā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa vismayaṃ yayau .. 84 ..
meaning:
पुनश्च नर्तनं कर्तुमुद्यतः कौतुकेन च ..
मेना तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोप विस्मयं ययौ .. 84 ..
text_mt:
And in playful sport, he prepared to dance again.
Hearing his words, Menā grew angry and was filled with astonishment.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣukaṃ bhartsayāmāsa bahiḥ kartumuvāca tam ..
patnī trilokanāthasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
भिक्षुकं भर्त्सयामास बहिः कर्तुमुवाच तम् ..
पत्नी त्रिलोकनाथस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः .. 85 ..
text_mt:
She rebuked the mendicant and ordered him to be turned outside:
“[She is to be] the wife of the Lord of the Three Worlds, Śiva, the Supreme Self!

sanskrit_iast:
yāñcāmimāṃ prakurvantaṃ dūraṃ kuru subhāṣiṇam..
etasminnantare taptvā giriḥ svālayamāyayau..86..
meaning:
याञ्चामिमां प्रकुर्वन्तं दूरं कुरु सुभाषिणम्..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तप्त्वा गिरिः स्वालयमाययौ..86..
text_mt:
Drive far away this smooth-tongued fellow who makes such a demand!”
In the meantime, having performed his austerities, the mountain returned to his abode.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa purato bhikṣuṃ prāṅgaṇasthaṃ manoharam..
kṛtvā nārāyaṇārcāṃ ca gaṅgātīre manohare ..87..
meaning:
ददर्श पुरतो भिक्षुं प्राङ्गणस्थं मनोहरम्..
कृत्वा नारायणार्चां च गङ्गातीरे मनोहरे ..87..
text_mt:
He saw before him the captivating mendicant standing in the courtyard,
After he had performed the worship of Nārāyaṇa on the charming bank of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmūrtidhyānaviśleṣaśokādudvignamānasaḥ ..
śrutvā menāmukhādvārtāṃ jahāsa ca cukopa saḥ ..88..
meaning:
तन्मूर्तिध्यानविश्लेषशोकादुद्विग्नमानसः ..
श्रुत्वा मेनामुखाद्वार्तां जहास च चुकोप सः ..88..
text_mt:
His mind agitated with sorrow over separation from meditation on His form.
Hearing the news from Menā’s mouth, he laughed and became angry.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāṃ cakāra svacaraṃ bahiḥ kartuṃ ca bhikṣukam ..
ākāśāmiva duḥsparśaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā ...89..
meaning:
आज्ञां चकार स्वचरं बहिः कर्तुं च भिक्षुकम् ..
आकाशामिव दुःस्पर्शं प्रज्वलन्तं स्वतेजसा ...89..
text_mt:
He ordered his attendant to throw the mendicant outside.
Blazing with his own splendor, untouchable like space,

sanskrit_iast:
na śaśāka bahiḥ kartuṃ samīpaṃ gantumakṣamaḥ..
dadarśa bhikṣukaṃ śailaḥ kṣaṇaṃ cārucaturbhujam..4.40.90..
meaning:
न शशाक बहिः कर्तुं समीपं गन्तुमक्षमः..
ददर्श भिक्षुकं शैलः क्षणं चारुचतुर्भुजम्..4.40.90..
text_mt:
He was unable to throw him out, being powerless even to approach him.
For a moment, the mountain saw the mendicant as the charming four-armed one,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ param..
suveṣaṃ sundaraśyāmamīṣaddhāsyaṃ manoharam .. 91 ..
meaning:
किरीटिनं कुण्डलिनं पीताम्बरधरं परम्..
सुवेषं सुन्दरश्याममीषद्धास्यं मनोहरम् .. 91 ..
text_mt:
Wearing a crown and earrings, clad in yellow garments, supreme,
Handsomely dressed, beautiful and dark, smiling gently, captivating,

sanskrit_iast:
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ..
yadyatpuṣpaṃ pradattaṃ ca pūjākāle gadābhṛte .. 92 ..
meaning:
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् ..
यद्यत्पुष्पं प्रदत्तं च पूजाकाले गदाभृते .. 92 ..
text_mt:
His whole body anointed with sandalwood paste, eager to show grace to devotees.
Whatever flowers he had offered to the Bearer of the Mace during the time of worship,

sanskrit_iast:
gātre śirasi tatsarvaṃ bhikṣukasya dadarśa ha ..
dhūpaḥ pradīpo yo datto naivedyaṃ vā manoharam .. 93 ..
meaning:
गात्रे शिरसि तत्सर्वं भिक्षुकस्य ददर्श ह ..
धूपः प्रदीपो यो दत्तो नैवेद्यं वा मनोहरम् .. 93 ..
text_mt:
All of them he saw upon the mendicant's body and head!
Whatever incense, lamp, or delightful food-offering had been given,

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa śailastatsarvaṃ bhikṣukasya puraḥ sthitam..
kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa dvibhujaṃ vinodamuralīkaram .. 94 ..
meaning:
ददर्श शैलस्तत्सर्वं भिक्षुकस्य पुरः स्थितम्..
क्षणं ददर्श द्विभुजं विनोदमुरलीकरम् .. 94 ..
text_mt:
The mountain saw all of that standing before the mendicant.
For a moment, he saw him with two arms, holding a charming flute in his hand,

sanskrit_iast:
gopaveṣaṃ kiśoraṃ ca sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaram ..
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam .. .. 95 ..
meaning:
गोपवेषं किशोरं च सस्मितं श्यामसुन्दरम् ..
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च रत्नालंकारभूषितम् .. .. 95 ..
text_mt:
Dressed as a cowherd, a youth, smiling, dark and handsome,
With a crest of peacock feathers, adorned with jewel-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa svacchaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ caṃdraśekharam.. 96 ..
meaning:
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं वनमालाविभूषितम् ..
क्षणं ददर्श स्वच्छं च शंकरं चंद्रशेखरम्.. 96 ..
text_mt:
His whole body anointed with sandalwood paste, decorated with a garland of forest flowers.
For a moment, he saw the pure Śaṅkara, bearing the crescent moon upon his crest,

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ param ..
vibhūtigātramamalamasthimālāvibhūṣitam .. 97 ..
meaning:
त्रिशूलपट्टिशकरं व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरं परम् ..
विभूतिगात्रममलमस्थिमालाविभूषितम् .. 97 ..
text_mt:
Holding a trident and an axe in his hand, clad in a tiger skin, supreme,
His pure body smeared with sacred ashes, adorned with a garland of bones,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca taptasvarṇajaṭādharam ..
ḍamaruśṛṃgahastaṃ ca supraśastaṃ manoharam .. 98 ..
meaning:
नागयज्ञोपवीतं च तप्तस्वर्णजटाधरम् ..
डमरुशृंगहस्तं च सुप्रशस्तं मनोहरम् .. 98 ..
text_mt:
Wearing a serpent as a sacred thread, bearing matted locks like molten gold,
Holding a small drum and a horn in his hands, most magnificent, captivating,

sanskrit_iast:
prajapantaṃ harernāma śvetābjabījamālayā ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram .. 99 ..
meaning:
प्रजपन्तं हरेर्नाम श्वेताब्जबीजमालया ..
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: Muttering the name of Hari with a rosary of white lotus seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
svatejasā prajvalantaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam ..
kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa jagatāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ ca caturmukham .. 4.40.100 ..
japantaṃ śrīharernāma svacchasphaṭikamālayā ..
kṣaṇaṃ sūrya svarūpaṃ ca dadarśa triguṇātmakam .. 1 ..
dadarśa tamatīvraṃ tu jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ..
kṣaṇamagnisvarūpaṃ ca jvalantamatitejasā .. 2 ..
kṣaṇamāhlādajanakaṃ candrarūpaṃ dadarśa ha ..
kṣaṇaṃ tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirañjanam .. 3 ..
nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmasvarūpiṇam ..
evaṃ svecchāmayaṃ dṛṣṭvā nānārūpadharaṃ param .. 4 ..
harṣāśrupulakaḥ śailo daṇḍavatpraṇanāma tam ..
bhaktyā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 5 ..
samutpatya harṣayukto dadarśa punareva tam..

Blazing with his own splendor, five-faced, three-eyed.
For a moment, he saw the four-faced creator of the worlds,
Muttering the name of Śrī Hari with a rosary of clear crystal.
For a moment, he saw him having the nature of the sun, consisting of the three gunas;
He saw him, blazing fiercely with spiritual splendor.
For a moment, having the form of fire, burning with intense brilliance,
And for a moment, he saw him having the delight-giving form of the moon.
For a moment, having the nature of light, formless, taintless,
Unattached, desireless, having the nature of the Supreme Self.
Having thus seen the supreme one who assumes diverse forms according to his will,
With tears of joy and hair standing on end, the mountain prostrated before him like a staff.
Circumambulating him with devotion and bowing again and again,
He rose up, filled with joy, and looked at him once more.
