text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'If one laughs out of joy in a dream, or if one sees a wedding, / dancing, singing, and beloved things, misfortune is certain for him. 2.

sanskrit_iast:
dantā yasya vibīḍyante vicarantaṃ ca paśyati .
dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā cāpi śarīrajā .. 3 ..
meaning:
दन्ता यस्य विबीड्यन्ते विचरन्तं च पश्यति .
धनहानिर्भवेत्तस्य पीडा चापि शरीरजा .. 3 ..
text_mt: He whose teeth are crushed, and who sees them moving about, / suffers loss of wealth as well as bodily illness. 3.

sanskrit_iast:
amyaṅgitastu tailena yo gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam .
kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍho mṛtyustasya na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
अम्यङ्गितस्तु तैलेन यो गच्छेद्दक्षिणां दिशम् .
खरोष्ट्रमहिषारूढो मृत्युस्तस्य न संशयः .. 4 ..
text_mt: One who, anointed with oil, goes toward the southern direction / mounted upon a donkey, camel, or buffalo, will die without doubt. 4.

sanskrit_iast:
svapane karṇe japāpuṣpamaśokaṃ karavīrakam .
vipattistasya tailaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ yadi paśyati .. 5 ..
meaning:
स्वपने कर्णे जपापुष्पमशोकं करवीरकम् .
विपत्तिस्तस्य तैलं च लवणं यदि पश्यति .. 5 ..
text_mt: If one sees in a dream a hibiscus, aśoka, or karavīra flower on an ear, / or sees oil and salt, misfortune will befall him. 5.

sanskrit_iast:
nagnāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ chinnanāsāṃ śūdrasya vidhavāṃ tathā .
kapardakaṃ tālaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamavāpnuyāt .. 6 ..
meaning:
नग्नां कृष्णां छिन्ननासां शूद्रस्य विधवां तथा .
कपर्दकं तालफलं दृष्ट्वा शोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having seen a naked, dark woman whose nose is cut off, or the widow of a Śūdra, / or a cowrie, or a palmyra fruit, one incurs sorrow. 6.

sanskrit_iast:
svapne ruṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇīṃ kopasaṃyutām .
vipattiśca bhavettasya lakṣmīryāti gṛhāddhruvam .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्वप्ने रुष्टं ब्राह्मणं च ब्राह्मणीं कोपसंयुताम् .
विपत्तिश्च भवेत्तस्य लक्ष्मीर्याति गृहाद्ध्रुवम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Seeing in a dream an angry Brahmin man or a Brahmin woman seized with rage, / misfortune befalls him, and Lakṣmī certainly departs from his house. 7.

sanskrit_iast:
vanapuṣpaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ palāśaṃ ca supuṣpitam .
kārpāsaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt .. 8 ..
meaning:
वनपुष्पं रक्तपुष्पं पलाशं च सुपुष्पितम् .
कार्पासं शुक्लवस्त्रं च दृष्ट्वा दुःखमवाप्नुयात् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having seen wild flowers, red flowers, a blooming palāśa tree, / cotton, and white clothing, one incurs distress. 8.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ striyam .
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃ ca vidhavāṃ naro mṛtyumavāpnuyāt .. 9 ..
meaning:
गायन्तीं च हसन्तीं च कृष्णाम्बरधरां स्त्रियम् .
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णां च विधवां नरो मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having seen a woman who is singing, laughing, dressed in black garments, / and is dark-complexioned, or a widow, a person incurs death. 9.

sanskrit_iast:
devatā yatra nṛtyanti gāyanti ca hasanti ca .
āsphoṭayanti dhāvanti tasya deho mariṣyati .. 10 ..
meaning:
देवता यत्र नृत्यन्ति गायन्ति च हसन्ति च .
आस्फोटयन्ति धावन्ति तस्य देहो मरिष्यति .. 10 ..
text_mt: Where deities dance, sing, laugh, / clap their arms, and run about, his body will perish. 10.

sanskrit_iast:
vāntaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca vaidyaṃ raupyaṃ suvarṇakam .
pratyakṣamathavā svapne jīvitaṃ daśamāvadhi .. 11 ..
meaning:
वान्तं मूत्रं पुरीषं च वैद्यं रौप्यं सुवर्णकम् .
प्रत्यक्षमथवा स्वप्ने जीवितं दशमावधि .. 11 ..
text_mt: Vomit, urine, faeces, a physician, silver, or gold, / [seen] either awake or in a dream, marks the span of one's life as ten [days/months]. 11.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanām .
upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati .. 12 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाम्बरधरां नारीं कृष्णमाल्यानुलेपनाम् .
उपगूहति यः स्वप्ने तस्य मृत्युर्भविष्यति .. 12 ..
text_mt: He who in a dream embraces a woman clad in black garments, / wearing a black garland and unguents, will meet his death. 12.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtavatsaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca mṛgasya ca narasya ca .
yaḥ prāptotyasthimālāṃ ca vipattistasya niścitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
मृतवत्सं च मुण्डं च मृगस्य च नरस्य च .
यः प्राप्तोत्यस्थिमालां च विपत्तिस्तस्य निश्चितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: One who obtains a dead calf, a severed head of an animal or of a man, / or a garland of bones, misfortune is certain for him. 13.

sanskrit_iast:
rathaṃ kharoṣṭrasaṃyuktamekākī yo'dhirohayet .
tatrastho'pi ca jāgarti mṛtyureva na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
रथं खरोष्ट्रसंयुक्तमेकाकी योऽधिरोहयेत् .
तत्रस्थोऽपि च जागर्ति मृत्युरेव न संशयः .. 14 ..
text_mt: He who alone mounts a chariot drawn by donkeys and camels, / and wakes up while still upon it, death is certain for him. 14.

sanskrit_iast:
amyaṅgistu haviṣā kṣīreṇa madhunā'pi ca .
takreṇāpi guḍenaiva pīḍā tasya viniścitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अम्यङ्गिस्तु हविषा क्षीरेण मधुनाऽपि च .
तक्रेणापि गुडेनैव पीडा तस्य विनिश्चितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: One who is anointed with ghee, milk, honey, / buttermilk, or molasses, suffering is certain for him. 15.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ raktamālyānuleparām .
upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya vyādhirviniścitam .. 16 ..
meaning:
रक्ताम्बरधरां नारीं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपराम् .
उपगूहति यः स्वप्ने तस्य व्याधिर्विनिश्चितम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: He who in a dream embraces a woman wearing red garments, / wearing a red garland and unguents, sickness is certain for him. 16.

sanskrit_iast:
patitānnakhareśāṃśca nirvāṇāṅgārameva ca .
bhasmabūrṇāṃ citāṃ dṛṣṭvā labhate mṛtyumeva ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
पतितान्नखरेशांश्च निर्वाणाङ्गारमेव च .
भस्मबूर्णां चितां दृष्ट्वा लभते मृत्युमेव च .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having seen fallen fingernails and hair, extinguished charcoal, / or a pyre covered in ashes, one meets death indeed. 17.

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca tṛṇāni lohameva ca .
śamīṃ ca kiṃ citkṛṣṇāśvaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam .. 18 ..
meaning:
श्मशानं शुष्ककाष्ठं च तृणानि लोहमेव च .
शमीं च किं चित्कृष्णाश्वं दृष्ट्वा दुःखं लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having seen a cremation ground, dry wood, grass, iron, / a śamī tree, or a black horse, one certainly obtains misery. 18.

sanskrit_iast:
pādukāṃ phalakaṃ raktaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ bhayānakam .
māṣaṃ masūraṃ mudgaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā sadyo vraṇaṃ labhet .. 19 ..
meaning:
पादुकां फलकं रक्तं पुष्पमाल्यं भयानकम् .
माषं मसूरं मुद्गं वा दृष्ट्वा सद्यो व्रणं लभेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having seen sandals, a shield, red garlands, fearsome objects, / māṣa, masūra, or mudga beans, one immediately contracts sores. 19.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭakaṃ saraṭhaṃ kākaṃ bhallūkaṃ vānaraṃ gavam .
pūyaṃ gātramalaṃ svapne kevalaṃ vyādhikāraṇam .. 20 ..
meaning:
कटकं सरठं काकं भल्लूकं वानरं गवम् .
पूयं गात्रमलं स्वप्ने केवलं व्याधिकारणम् .. 20 ..
text_mt: A ring, a chameleon, a crow, a bear, a monkey, cattle, / pus, or bodily filth seen in a dream is purely the cause of disease. 20.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ kṣataṃ śūdraṃ galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca rogiṇam .
raktāmbaraṃ ca jaṭilaṃ sūkaraṃ mahiṣaṃ kharam .. 21 ..
meaning:
भग्नभाण्डं क्षतं शूद्रं गलत्कुष्ठं च रोगिणम् .
रक्ताम्बरं च जटिलं सूकरं महिषं खरम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: A broken pot, a wounded person, a Śūdra, a sick person with weeping leprosy, / one in red garments, an ascetic with matted hair, a boar, a buffalo, a donkey, 21.

sanskrit_iast:
andhakāraṃ mahāghoraṃ mṛtajīvaṃ bhayaṃkaram .
dṛṣṭvā svapne yoniliṅga vipattiṃ labhatedhruvam .. 22 ..
meaning:
अन्धकारं महाघोरं मृतजीवं भयंकरम् .
दृष्ट्वा स्वप्ने योनिलिङ्ग विपत्तिं लभतेध्रुवम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: utterly dreadful darkness, a terrifying dead body, / or female and male genitals seen in a dream, one certainly meets misfortune. 22.

sanskrit_iast:
kuveṣarupaṃ malecchaṃ ca yamadūtaṃ bhayaṃkaram .
pāśahastaṃ pāśaśastraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
कुवेषरुपं मलेच्छं च यमदूतं भयंकरम् .
पाशहस्तं पाशशस्त्रं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युं लभेन्नरः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having seen a Mleccha of ugly appearance, or a terrifying messenger of Yama / holding a noose, wielding a noose-weapon, a person meets death. 23.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo brāhmaṇī bālā bālako vā sutaḥ sutā .
vilāpaṃ kurute kopāddṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो ब्राह्मणी बाला बालको वा सुतः सुता .
विलापं कुरुते कोपाद्दृष्ट्वा दुःखमवाप्नुयात् .. 24 ..
text_mt: If a Brahmin woman, a young girl, a boy, a son, or a daughter / laments out of anger, upon seeing this one incurs grief. 24.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tanmālyaṃ sasyaṃ śastrāstradhāriṇam .
mlecchāṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃlabheddhruvam .. 25 ..
meaning:
कृष्णं पुष्पं च तन्माल्यं सस्यं शस्त्रास्त्रधारिणम् .
म्लेच्छां च विकृताकारं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युंलभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having seen a black flower, a garland of them, grain, one bearing swords and missiles, / or a Mleccha of deformed shape, one certainly meets death. 25.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktaprāṇaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ ca labhate dhruvam .
matsyādi dhārayedyo hi tadbhrāturmaraṇaṃ dhruvam .. 26 ..
meaning:
त्यक्तप्राणं मृतं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युं च लभते ध्रुवम् .
मत्स्यादि धारयेद्यो हि तद्भ्रातुर्मरणं ध्रुवम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Having seen a deceased person whose life-breaths have departed, one certainly meets death. / Indeed, whoever carries fish and the like, his brother's death is certain. (26)

sanskrit_iast:
vādyaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītaṃ gāyanaṃ raktavāsasam .
mṛdaṅgavādyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam .. 27 ..
meaning:
वाद्यं च नर्तनं गीतं गायनं रक्तवाससम् .
मृदङ्गवाद्यमानं तं दृष्ट्वा दुःखं लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having seen musical instruments, dancing, singing, a singer dressed in red, / and an accompaniment played on the mṛdaṅga, one certainly meets with sorrow. (27)

sanskrit_iast:
chinnaṃ vā'pi kabandhaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ muktakeśinam .
kṣipaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
छिन्नं वाऽपि कबन्धं वा विकृतं मुक्तकेशिनम् .
क्षिपं नृत्यं च कुर्वन्तं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युं लभेन्नरः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having seen a severed head, a headless trunk, a deformed person with dishevelled hair, / dancing and throwing [limbs] about, a man meets death. (28)

sanskrit_iast:
mṛto vā'pi mṛtā vā'pi kṛṣṇā mlecchā bhayānakā .
upagūhati yaṃ svapne tasya mṛtyurviniścitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
मृतो वाऽपि मृता वाऽपि कृष्णा म्लेच्छा भयानका .
उपगूहति यं स्वप्ने तस्य मृत्युर्विनिश्चितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: A dead man or a dead woman, dark, barbarian, and terrifying, / who embraces someone in a dream—his death is certain. (29)

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ dantāśca bhagnāśca keśāścāpi patanti hi .
dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā vā taccharīrajā .. 30 ..
meaning:
येषां दन्ताश्च भग्नाश्च केशाश्चापि पतन्ति हि .
धनहानिर्भवेत्तस्य पीडा वा तच्छरीरजा .. 30 ..
text_mt: For those whose teeth are broken and whose hair falls out, / there will be loss of wealth or suffering arising from the body. (30)

sanskrit_iast:
upadravanti yaṃ svapne śrṛṅgiṇo daṃṣṭriṇo'pi vā .
bālakā mānavāścaiva tasya rājakulādbhayam .. 31 ..
meaning:
उपद्रवन्ति यं स्वप्ने श्रृङ्गिणो दंष्ट्रिणोऽपि वा .
बालका मानवाश्चैव तस्य राजकुलाद्भयम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: If horned animals or fanged beasts attack someone in a dream, / or boys and men, he faces danger from the royal court. (31)

sanskrit_iast:
chinnavṛṅaṃ patantaṃ ca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ tuṣaṃkṣuram .
raktāṅgāraṃ bhasmavṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāvāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
meaning:
छिन्नवृङं पतन्तं च शिलावृष्टिं तुषंक्षुरम् .
रक्ताङ्गारं भस्मवृष्टिं दृष्ट्वा दुःखमावाप्नुयात् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having seen a severed tree falling, a rain of stones, chaff, razors, / red-hot embers, or a shower of ashes, one meets with sorrow. (32)

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhaṃ patantaṃ śailaṃ vā dhūmaketuṃ bhayānakam .
bhagnaskandhaṃ tarorvā'pi dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt .. 33 ..
meaning:
गृहं पतन्तं शैलं वा धूमकेतुं भयानकम् .
भग्नस्कन्धं तरोर्वाऽपि दृष्ट्वा दुःखमवाप्नुयात् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Having seen a house falling, or a mountain, or a terrifying comet, / or the broken trunk of a tree, one meets with sorrow. (33)

sanskrit_iast:
rathagehaśailavṛkṣagohastituragāmbarāt .
bhūmau patati yaḥ svapne vipattistasya niścitam .. 34 ..
meaning:
रथगेहशैलवृक्षगोहस्तितुरगाम्बरात् .
भूमौ पतति यः स्वप्ने विपत्तिस्तस्य निश्चितम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: He who in a dream falls to the ground from a chariot, a house, a mountain, a tree, / a cow, an elephant, a horse, or the sky—his ruin is certain. (34)

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥ patanti garteṣu bhasmāṅgārayuteṣu ca .
kṣārakuṇḍeṣu cūrṇeṣu mṛtyusteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
उच्चैः पतन्ति गर्तेषु भस्माङ्गारयुतेषु च .
क्षारकुण्डेषु चूर्णेषु मृत्युस्तेषां न संशयः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Those who fall from on high into pits filled with ashes and embers, / into pools of caustic alkali or lime—their death is without doubt. (35)

sanskrit_iast:
balādgṛhṇāti duṣṭaścacchatraṃ ca yasya mastakāt .
piturnāśo bhavettasya gurorvā'pi nṛpasya vā .. 36 ..
meaning:
बलाद्गृह्णाति दुष्टश्चच्छत्रं च यस्य मस्तकात् .
पितुर्नाशो भवेत्तस्य गुरोर्वाऽपि नृपस्य वा .. 36 ..
text_mt: If a wicked man forcefully takes an umbrella from someone's head, / there will be the death of his father, or of his guru, or of his king. (36)

sanskrit_iast:
surabhiryasya gehācca yāti trastā savatmikā .
prayāti pāpinastasya lakṣmīrapi vasuṃdharā .. 37 ..
meaning:
सुरभिर्यस्य गेहाच्च याति त्रस्ता सवत्मिका .
प्रयाति पापिनस्तस्य लक्ष्मीरपि वसुंधरा .. 37 ..
text_mt: From whose house a cow terrified with her calf departs, / even the Lakṣmī and the earth of that sinful man depart. (37)

sanskrit_iast:
pāśena kṛtvā badvaṃ ca yaṃ gṛhītvā prayānti ca .
yamadūtāśca ye mlecchāstasya mṛtyurviniścitam .. 38 ..
meaning:
पाशेन कृत्वा बद्वं च यं गृहीत्वा प्रयान्ति च .
यमदूताश्च ये म्लेच्छास्तस्य मृत्युर्विनिश्चितम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Whomever the messengers of Yama, who are barbarians, take away bound with a snare, / his death is certain. (38)

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇako brāhmaṇo vā'pi brāhmaṇī vā gurustathā .
pariruṣṭaḥ śapati yaṃ vipattistasya niścitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
गणको ब्राह्मणो वाऽपि ब्राह्मणी वा गुरुस्तथा .
परिरुष्टः शपति यं विपत्तिस्तस्य निश्चितम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Whomever an astrologer, a brahmin man, a brahmin woman, or a guru, / highly enraged, curses—his ruin is certain. (39)

sanskrit_iast:
virodhinaśya kākāśca kukkuṭā bhallukāstathā .
patantyāgatya yadgātre tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ .. 40 ..
meaning:
विरोधिनश्य काकाश्च कुक्कुटा भल्लुकास्तथा .
पतन्त्यागत्य यद्गात्रे तस्य मृत्युर्न संशयः .. 40 ..
text_mt: Hostile crows, roosters, and bears / that swoop down onto someone's limbs—his death is without doubt. (40)

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣā bhallukā uṣṭrā sūkarā gardabhāstathā .
ruṣṭā dhāvanti yaṃ svapne sa rogī niścitaṃ bhavet .. 41 ..
meaning:
महिषा भल्लुका उष्ट्रा सूकरा गर्दभास्तथा .
रुष्टा धावन्ति यं स्वप्ने स रोगी निश्चितं भवेत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: If buffaloes, bears, camels, boars, and donkeys / run angrily toward someone in a dream, he will certainly fall ill. (41)

sanskrit_iast:
raktacandanakāṣṭhāni ghṛtāktāni juhoti yaḥ .
gāyatryāśca mahasreṇa tena śāntirvidhīyate .. 42 ..
meaning:
रक्तचन्दनकाष्ठानि घृताक्तानि जुहोति यः .
गायत्र्याश्च महस्रेण तेन शान्तिर्विधीयते .. 42 ..
text_mt: He who offers into the fire sticks of red sandalwood smeared with ghee / along with a thousand repetitions of the Gāyatrī—by him peace is brought about. (42)

sanskrit_iast:
sahasradhā capedyo hi bhaktyainaṃ madhusūdanam .
niṣpāṇo hi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ susvapno bhavet .. 43 ..
meaning:
सहस्रधा चपेद्यो हि भक्त्यैनं मधुसूदनम् .
निष्पाणो हि भवेत्सोऽपि दुःस्वप्नः सुस्वप्नो भवेत् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Indeed, whoever recites [the name of] this Madhusūdana a thousand times with devotion, / he becomes free of sin, and a bad dream turns into a good dream. (43)

sanskrit_iast:
acyutaṃ keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ satyaṃ janārdanam .
haṃsaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva hyetannāmāṣṭakaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
meaning:
अच्युतं केशवं विष्णुं हरिं सत्यं जनार्दनम् .
हंसं नारायणं चैव ह्येतन्नामाष्टकं शुभम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Acyuta, Keśava, Viṣṇu, Hari, Satya, Janārdana, / Haṃsa, and Nārāyaṇa: this is the auspicious eight-name hymn. (44)

sanskrit_iast:
śuciḥ pūrvamukhaḥ prājño daśakṛtvaśca yo japet .
niṣpāpo'pi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet .. 45 ..
meaning:
शुचिः पूर्वमुखः प्राज्ञो दशकृत्वश्च यो जपेत् .
निष्पापोऽपि भवेत्सोऽपि दुःस्वप्नः शुभवान्भवेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Pure, facing eastward, a wise man who recites it ten times / becomes free of sin, and his bad dream turns into an auspicious one. (45)

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mādhavaṃ madhumūdanam .
hariṃ narahariṃ rāmaṃ govindaṃ dadhivāmanam .. 46 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं नारायणं कृष्णं माधवं मधुमूदनम् .
हरिं नरहरिं रामं गोविन्दं दधिवामनम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu, Nārāyaṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Mādhava, Madhusūdana, / Hari, Narahari, Rāma, Govinda, Dadhivāmana— (46)

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā cemāni nāmāni daśa bhadrāṇiyo japet .
śatakṛtyo bhaktiyukto japtvā nīrogatāṃ vrajet .. 47 ..
meaning:
भक्त्या चेमानि नामानि दश भद्राणियो जपेत् .
शतकृत्यो भक्तियुक्तो जप्त्वा नीरोगतां व्रजेत् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Whoever recites these ten auspicious names with devotion, / having recited them a hundred times endowed with devotion, attains freedom from disease. (47)

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣadhā hi japedyo hi bandhanānmucyate dhruvam .
japtvā ca daśalakṣaṃ ca mahāvandhyā prasūyate .. 48 ..
meaning:
लक्षधा हि जपेद्यो हि बन्धनान्मुच्यते ध्रुवम् .
जप्त्वा च दशलक्षं च महावन्ध्या प्रसूयते .. 48 ..
text_mt: Indeed, whoever recites them a hundred thousand times is certainly freed from bondage; / and having recited them one million times, even an utterly barren woman gives birth. (48)

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyāśī yataḥ śuddho daridro dhanavānbhavet .
śatalakṣaṃ ca japtvā ca jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
हविष्याशी यतः शुद्धो दरिद्रो धनवान्भवेत् .
शतलक्षं च जप्त्वा च जीवन्मुक्तो भवेन्नरः .. 49 ..
text_mt: Eating sacrificial food, restrained and pure, a poor man becomes wealthy; / and having recited them ten million times, a man becomes liberated while living. (49)

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ kārtikeyaṃ dineśvanam .
dharmaṃ gaṅgāṃ ca tulasīṃ rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm .. 50 ..
meaning:
ओं नमः शिवं दुर्गां गणपतिं कार्तिकेयं दिनेश्वनम् .
धर्मं गङ्गां च तुलसीं राधां लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीम् .. 50 ..
text_mt: “Om, homage to Śiva, Durgā, Gaṇapati, Kārtikeya, the Sun, / Dharma, Gaṅgā, Tulasī, Rādhā, Lakṣmī, and Sarasvatī.” (50)

sanskrit_iast:
nāmānyetāni bhadrāṇi jale snātvā ca yo japet .
vāñchitaṃ ca labhetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet .. 51 ..
meaning:
नामान्येतानि भद्राणि जले स्नात्वा च यो जपेत् .
वाञ्छितं च लभेत्सोऽपि दुःस्वप्नः शुभवान्भवेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Whoever, having bathed in water, recites these auspicious names / obtains his desire, and his bad dream turns into an auspicious one. (51)

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ pūrvadūrgatināśinyai mahāmāyāyai svāhā .
kalpavṛkṣo hi lokānāṃ santraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
ओं ह्रीं क्लीं पूर्वदूर्गतिनाशिन्यै महामायायै स्वाहा .
कल्पवृक्षो हि लोकानां सन्त्रः सप्तदशाक्षरः .. 52 ..
text_mt: “Om hrīṃ klīṃ, svāhā to Mahāmāyā, who destroys former misfortune.” / This seventeen-syllable mantra is indeed a wish-fulfilling tree for mortals. (52)

sanskrit_iast:
śuciśca daśadhā japtvā duḥsvapnaḥ sukhavānbhavet .
śatalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām .. 53 ..
meaning:
शुचिश्च दशधा जप्त्वा दुःस्वप्नः सुखवान्भवेत् .
शतलक्षजपेनैव मन्त्रसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Being pure, having recited it ten times, one's bad dream turns into happiness; / by reciting it ten million times alone, mastery of the mantra comes to men. (53)

sanskrit_iast:
siddhamantrastu labhate sarvasiddhiṃ ca vāñchitam .
oṃ namo mṛtyuṃjayāyeti svāhāntaṃ lakṣadhā japet .. 54 ..
meaning:
सिद्धमन्त्रस्तु लभते सर्वसिद्धिं च वाञ्छितम् .
ओं नमो मृत्युंजयायेति स्वाहान्तं लक्षधा जपेत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: One who has mastered the mantra obtains all perfection and whatever he desires. / One should recite a hundred thousand times ending with svāhā: “Om, homage to Mṛtyuṃjaya.” (54)

text_mt:
Now begins the eighty-third chapter.
Nanda said:
You are the source of the Vedas, and of Brahmā and the rest, my little son. / Tell me everything; blessing be upon you! Whom can I ask besides you? 1
What indeed is the duty of brāhmaṇas, and of the works of kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras? / And what is the duty of saṃnyāsins, ascetics, and celibate students? 2
Of the widow-women among brāhmaṇas, of Vaiṣṇavas, and of good people too, / and of devoted wives—you ought to tell all that. 3
Of householders and housewives, and especially of pupils, / and of sons and daughters toward father and mother; 4
how many kinds of womankind are there, and how many kinds of devotee, Lord? / How many kinds of cosmic eggs, and of what nature is its extent? / What is eternal, and what is created? Tell everything in order. 5
The Blessed Lord said:
Purified by the twilight prayers, the brāhmaṇa always performs my service. / He always eats my prasāda, never without offering [it first]. 6
Food unoffered to Viṣṇu is feces; water unoffered to Viṣṇu is urine. / A brāhmaṇa who eats Viṣṇu’s prasāda is liberated while living. 7
Always devoted to austerity, pure, calm, and knowing the scriptures, / relying on vows and sacred places, righteous, engaged in varied teaching, 8
having received the mantra of Viṣṇu and served his guru, / and having obtained his permission, he afterward becomes a householder. 9
He should offer a fee to the guru for the daily rituals; / the maintenance of gurus must always be carried out, of this there is no doubt. 10
Of all venerable persons, the father is indeed the great guru; / the mother is a hundred times greater than the father; the deity a hundred times greater than the mother. 11
The giver of the mantra and the giver of the tantra is four times greater than deities; / the guru is Lord Nārāyaṇa, God incarnate before one’s eyes. 12
'It is offered in intention to that deity,' so it is heard in the Veda; / one’s own guru is the direct enjoyer, Janārdana himself embodied. 13
The guru is Brahmā, the guru is Viṣṇu, the guru is himself Śiva;

text_mt: and all the gods abide constantly in the guru with joy. 14 / When the guru is pleased, Hari is pleased; when he is pleased, the gods are pleased. / If a guru does not show affection equal to a son toward his disciples, 15 / he incurs the guilt of slaying a brāhmaṇa, and eats having made no blessing. / A brāhmaṇa devoted to his own duty, that brāhmaṇa is always pure. 16 / A brāhmaṇa who worships Viṣṇu is always pure; one who is other than that is always impure. / A brāhmaṇa who drives a bull, a cook for śūdras, 17 / a brāhmaṇa who is an attendant on idols, one devoid of twilight prayers, a weakling, / a brāhmaṇa who sleeps by day, one who eats the food of a śūdra's funeral rites, 18 / and one who cremates the corpses of śūdras: those twice-born are equal to śūdras. / Having performed worship with the great Śāligrāma-mantra according to the rule, 19 / he eats the remnant of the food offering and [drinks] the water that washed his feet. / Having drunk the water of Hari's feet, a man becomes one who has bathed at sacred fords; 20 / he is freed from all sins and goes to the realm of Viṣṇu. / He has bathed in all sacred places, he is initiated in all sacrifices, 21 / who performs bathing with the waters of the Śāligrāma stone. / The water of the Śāligrāma is ten times greater than the water of the Gaṅgā, O Vraja! 22 / The brāhmaṇa who eats [his food offering] daily is liberated while living, equal to the gods. / Eating the food offering of Viṣṇu is the daily duty of brāhmaṇas, 23 / as is worshiping him with care and serving the water of his feet. / He who daily performs my worship at the three twilights with devotion, 24 / and does not eat on the eleventh day, nor on my birthday, / nor on the night of Śiva, O father, nor on the day of the auspicious ninth of Rāma, 25 / and does not eat, observant of vows—that twice-born is indeed liberated while living. / Whatever sacred fords exist on earth are at his foot. 26 / Having drunk the water from the foot of a brāhmaṇa, a man becomes one who has bathed at sacred fords. / For as long as the earth remains moistened with water from a brāhmaṇa's foot, 27 / for that long the ancestors drink water from lotus-leaf cups. / And he who eats the prasāda of Viṣṇu purifies the earth, 28

text_mt: the sacred places, and men; that twice-born is indeed liberated while living. / He has bathed at all sacred places and obtains the fruit of all vows. 29 / At every step he surely obtains the fruit of the horse sacrifice. / Pure as fire and wind, like the sun in splendor, 30 / he sees neither Yama's messenger nor Yama himself even in a dream. / An attendant, he rejoices with Hari in Vaikuṇṭha. 31 / No fall indeed occurs for that brāhmaṇa who serves Hari. / Only the worshiper of Viṣṇu's mantra is a Vaiṣṇava twice-born. 32 / A brāhmaṇa who is a Vaiṣṇava is wise; there is no person superior to him. / Whether spoken in the Veda, in the Purāṇas, or in the Tantra, / a mantra is pure. 33 / Having received it with discrimination, one is a Śaiva, a Śākta, or a Vaiṣṇava. / In whose ear this Viṣṇu-mantra enters from the mouth of the guru, 34 / him the wise proclaim to be a Vaiṣṇava, exceedingly purified. / Merely by receiving the mantra, a man becomes liberated while living. 35 / Breaking through the entire cosmic egg, he shall surely go to the abode of Hari. / Seven before, seven after, seven beginning with maternal grandfathers, 36 / the devotee delivers his own brothers, and their mothers as well. / If he recites [the mantra] in the sacred field of Nārāyaṇa preceded by preparatory rites, 37 / he effortlessly delivers a thousand generations and himself. / This is the fruit merely of receiving the mantra, O Lord of Vraja! 38 / From contact with the preparatory rites, hundreds and hundreds of generations [are saved]. / And an exclusive Vaiṣṇava delivers a hundred thousand men, 39 / whose ritual action is placed in Viṣṇu and whose desires are cast out. / The twice-born and the gods are my life; the devotee is dearer than my life. 40 / Among the objects of love in the worlds, none is dearer to me than a devotee. / Having seen an exceedingly radiant guru, capable of protecting everywhere, 41 / the discerning person should take initiation in the mantra from him. / From one deficient in age, deficient in knowledge, and likewise deficient in learning, / or from a guru deficient in caste, one should never receive a mantra. 42

text_mt: One should never accept a mantra that is impaired, contrary to the śāstras, / from a fool, from one fallen from their āśrama, from one's father, or from a renunciant; // from a sick person, from one without lineage, or likewise from one without a wife; / nor should one ever accept a mantra from one struck by mantra-curses. // One should not accept a Viṣṇu-mantra from someone devoid of devotion to Viṣṇu; / not from a Śaiva, not from a Śākta, but [only] from a Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇa. // From one deficient in years, one has a short lifespan; from one deficient in knowledge, one becomes unlearned; / from one deficient in learning, one becomes a fool; from one deficient in caste, there is ruin. // From a fool, one immediately becomes a fool; from one fallen from his own āśrama, one becomes miserable; / from a father, loss of fame; and from a renunciant, death. // From a sick person, one becomes afflicted with disease; from one without lineage, one becomes heirless; / from a wife-less person, one becomes wife-less; from one struck by mantra-curses, one becomes equal to [such] a guru. // From one devoid of devotion to Viṣṇu, a man becomes devoid of devotion; / and having accepted [a mantra] from a Śaiva or a Śākta, devotion to Hari does not increase. // A pure Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇa is capable of offering cooked food; / any other person is incapable of offering cooked food to Hari. // By uttering Oṃkāra, by offering oblations into the fire, by worshipping the Śāligrāma stone, / and by offering cooked food to Me, anyone other than a brāhmaṇa falls downward. // A wise person should not take a mantra from an indifferent person or one of vile conduct; / if, by chance, he should take it, he will certainly become destitute. // The food of brāhmaṇas must always be haviṣya and strictly vegetarian; / by abandoning meat, one becomes endowed with splendour like the sun. // Cooking must always be done in a new pot, / or for up to a fortnight; after that, it must be discarded by the wise. // Having well purified the place, the worshipper completes the cooking; / in that purified place, the brāhmaṇa, having offered [it] to Me with devotion, // then partakes of what was offered, having also given [some] respectfully to a brāhmaṇa; / but eating without having offered, the brāhmaṇa incurs [the guilt of] drinking wine. // During an eclipse of the moon or sun, or during the impurity of a death or birth,

text_mt: or when touched by an impure person, one must immediately discard the cooking pot. // Having put on two washed garments, having washed one's feet, / one eats fried foods and grain in a purified place. // A second meal must not be eaten by the twice-born while the sun is still up; kanyālomapramāṇāntaṃ varṣaṃ ca pitṛbhiḥ saha .
kumbhīpāke pacyate ca putraścāpi purohitaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
कन्यालोमप्रमाणान्तं वर्षं च पितृभिः सह .
कुम्भीपाके पच्यते च पुत्रश्चापि पुरोहितः .. 65 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkanyāṃ supātrāya dānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .
śūdravadbrāhmaṇebhyaśca naiva tadvaṃśacāya ca .. 66 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कन्यां सुपात्राय दानं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः .
शूद्रवद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च नैव तद्वंशचाय च .. 66 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vipravaiṣṇavayordharmaḥ kathitaśca vrajeśvaraḥ .
yaduktaṃ ca purāṇaiśca caturbhiḥ śrutibhistathā .. 67 ..
meaning:
विप्रवैष्णवयोर्धर्मः कथितश्च व्रजेश्वरः .
यदुक्तं च पुराणैश्च चतुर्भिः श्रुतिभिस्तथा .. 67 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dvijārcanaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā nārāyaṇārcanam .
rājyānāṃ pālanaṃ caiva raṇe nirbhayatā tathā .. 68 ..
meaning:
द्विजार्चनं क्षत्रियाणां तथा नारायणार्चनम् .
राज्यानां पालनं चैव रणे निर्भयता तथा .. 68 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam .
putratulyaṃ prajānāṃ ca duḥkhināṃ paripālanam .. 69 ..
meaning:
नित्यं दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः शरणागतरक्षणम् .
पुत्रतुल्यं प्रजानां च दुःखिनां परिपालनम् .. 69 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāstrāṇāṃ ca naipuṇyaṃ raṇe śauṇḍīryameva ca .
tapaśca dharmakṛtyaṃ ca yatnataḥ kurute mudā .. 70 ..
meaning:
शस्त्रास्त्राणां च नैपुण्यं रणे शौण्डीर्यमेव च .
तपश्च धर्मकृत्यं च यत्नतः कुरुते मुदा .. 70 ..

sanskrit_iast:
paṇḍitaṃ nītijñāstrajñaṃ nityaṃ ca paripālayet .
niyojayetsabhāmadhye nityaṃ sadbhiśca saṃyute .. 71 ..
meaning:
पण्डितं नीतिज्ञास्त्रज्ञं नित्यं च परिपालयेत् .
नियोजयेत्सभामध्ये नित्यं सद्भिश्च संयुते .. 71 ..
text_mt: he must employ him in the midst of the royal assembly, always accompanied by the virtuous. // Elephants, horses, chariots, and infantry—the fourfold army— / the glorious and majestic [king] must always maintain with care. // When invited to battle, or for giving, he should not turn away; / and he who abandons his life in battle attains heaven, which brings renown. // For Vaiśyas, trade [is prescribed], and he is capable in agriculture and cattle-rearing; / worship of brāhmaṇas and gods, giving gifts, austerity, and observance of vows. // Constant worship of brāhmaṇas is ordained as the duty of a Śūdra; / a Śūdra who farms their [land] or seizes their wealth becomes an outcaste. // For thousands of crores [of years], he becomes a vulture; for a hundred births, a pig; / for a hundred births, a wild beast—a Śūdra who steals the wealth of a brāhmaṇa. // That Śūdra who has intercourse with a brāhmaṇa woman is an incestuous sinner; / he is cooked in Kumbhīpāka for as long as a hundred [years] of Brahmā. // In Kumbhīpāka, in boiling oil, devoured day and night by serpents, / he emits distorted sounds from the striking of Yama. // Then, that sinner is born from the womb of an outcaste for seven births, / and for seven births a snake, and for seven births a leech; // and for thousands of crores of births, he is born as a worm in feces; / he becomes a worm in the vagina of promiscuous women for seven births; // that sinner becomes a worm in the sores of a cow for seven births; / thus he wanders from womb to womb, and is not born again as a human being. // And listen from my mouth to the duty of renunciants: / simply by taking up the staff, a man becomes Nārāyaṇa. // Having burned past karmas, he brings an end to future actions; / he meditates on Me and indeed comes to My abode. // By the touch of the feet of renunciants, the earth is instantly purified; / they immediately purify sacred bathing places, just like a Vaiṣṇava, O Vraja. // And by the touch of a renunciant, a man becomes free from sin; / having fed a renunciant, one obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice; // and having bowed and seen [him] with longing, one obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ senāṅgaṃ ca catuṣṭayam .
pālayedyatnato nityaṃ yaśasvī ca pratāpavān .. 72 ..
meaning:
हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं सेनाङ्गं च चतुष्टयम् .
पालयेद्यत्नतो नित्यं यशस्वी च प्रतापवान् .. 72 ..

sanskrit_iast:
raṇe nimantritaścaiva dāne na vimukho bhavet .
raṇe vā yastyajetprāṇāṃstasya svargo yaśaskaraḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
रणे निमन्त्रितश्चैव दाने न विमुखो भवेत् .
रणे वा यस्त्यजेत्प्राणांस्तस्य स्वर्गो यशस्करः .. 73 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyānāmapi vāṇijyamīśvaraḥ kṛṣipālane .
vipradevārcanaṃ dānaṃ tapasyā vratasevanam .. 74 ..
meaning:
वैश्यानामपि वाणिज्यमीश्वरः कृषिपालने .
विप्रदेवार्चनं दानं तपस्या व्रतसेवनम् .. 74 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viprāṇāmarcanaṃ nityaṃ śūdradharmo vidhīyate .
tatkṛṣī taddhanagrāhī śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet .. 75 ..
meaning:
विप्राणामर्चनं नित्यं शूद्रधर्मो विधीयते .
तत्कृषी तद्धनग्राही शूद्रश्चाण्डालतां व्रजेत् .. 75 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ .
śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdo vipradhanāpahaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
गृध्रः कोटिसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि सूकरः .
श्वापदः शतजन्मानि शूदो विप्रधनापहः .. 76 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śūdro brāhmaṇīgāmī mātṛgāmī sa pātakī .
kṛmbhīpāke pacyate sa yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śātam .. 77 ..
meaning:
यः शूद्रो ब्राह्मणीगामी मातृगामी स पातकी .
कृम्भीपाके पच्यते स यावद्वै ब्रह्मणः शातम् .. 77 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhīpāke taprataile bhuktaḥ sarpairaharniśam .
śabdaṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ kurute yamatāḍanāt .. 78 ..
meaning:
कुम्भीपाके तप्रतैले भुक्तः सर्पैरहर्निशम् .
शब्दं च विकृताकारं कुरुते यमताडनात् .. 78 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāṇḍālayoniḥ syātsaptajanmasu pātakī .
saptajanmasu sarpaśca jalaukāḥ saptajanmasu .. 79 ..
meaning:
ततश्चाण्डालयोनिः स्यात्सप्तजन्मसु पातकी .
सप्तजन्मसु सर्पश्च जलौकाः सप्तजन्मसु .. 79 ..

sanskrit_iast:
janmakoṭisahatraṃ ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ .
puṃścalīnāṃ yonikṛmiḥ sa bhavetsaptajanmasu .. 80 ..
meaning:
जन्मकोटिसहत्रं च विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः .
पुंश्चलीनां योनिकृमिः स भवेत्सप्तजन्मसु .. 80 ..

sanskrit_iast:
garvā vraṇakṛmiḥ syācca pātakī saptajanmasu .
yonau yonau bhramatyevaṃ na punarjāyate naraḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
गर्वा व्रणकृमिः स्याच्च पातकी सप्तजन्मसु .
योनौ योनौ भ्रमत्येवं न पुनर्जायते नरः .. 81 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyāsināṃ ca yo dharmo manmukhācca niśāmaya.
daṇḍagrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet .. 82 ..
meaning:
संन्यासिनां च यो धर्मो मन्मुखाच्च निशामय.
दण्डग्रहणमात्रेण नरो नारायणो भवेत् .. 82 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvakarmāṇi dagdhvā ca parakarmanikṛntanam .
kurute cintayenmāṃ ca hyāyāti mama mandiram .. 83 ..
meaning:
पूर्वकर्माणि दग्ध्वा च परकर्मनिकृन्तनम् .
कुरुते चिन्तयेन्मां च ह्यायाति मम मन्दिरम् .. 83 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyāsināṃ padasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā .
sadyaḥ punanti tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasya yathā vraja .. 84 ..
meaning:
संन्यासिनां पदस्पर्शात्सद्यः पूता वसुंधरा .
सद्यः पुनन्ति तीर्थानि वैष्णवस्य यथा व्रज .. 84 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyāsinaśca sparśena niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ .
saṃnyāsinaṃ bhojayitvā cāśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 85 ..
meaning:
संन्यासिनश्च स्पर्शेन निष्पापो जायते नरः .
संन्यासिनं भोजयित्वा चाश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 85 ..

sanskrit_iast:
natvā ca kāmato dṛṣṭvā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet .
phalaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ tunyaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām .. 86 ..
meaning:
नत्वा च कामतो दृष्ट्वा राजसूयफलं लभेत् .
फलं संन्यासिनां तुन्यं यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् .. 86 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyācī yāti sāyāhne kṣudhito gṛhiṇāṃ gṛham .
sadannaṃ vā kadannaṃ vā taddattaṃ naiva varjayet .. 87 ..
meaning:
संन्याची याति सायाह्ने क्षुधितो गृहिणां गृहम् .
सदन्नं वा कदन्नं वा तद्दत्तं नैव वर्जयेत् .. 87 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na yācate ca miṣṭānnaṃ na kuryātkopameva ca .
na dhanagrahaṇaṃ kuryādekavāsā nirīhataḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
न याचते च मिष्टान्नं न कुर्यात्कोपमेव च .
न धनग्रहणं कुर्यादेकवासा निरीहतः .. 88 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śītagrīṣmasamānaśca lobhamohavivarjitaḥ .
tatra sthitvaikarātraṃ ca prātaranyatsthalaṃ vrajet .. 89 ..
meaning:
शीतग्रीष्मसमानश्च लोभमोहविवर्जितः .
तत्र स्थित्वैकरात्रं च प्रातरन्यत्स्थलं व्रजेत् .. 89 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yānamānohaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā gṛhiṇo dhanam .
gṛhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhī ramyātsvadharmātpatito bhavet .. 90 ..
meaning:
यानमानोहणं कृत्वा गृहीत्वा गृहिणो धनम् .
गृहं कृत्वा गृही रम्यात्स्वधर्मात्पतितो भवेत् .. 90 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā cakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ kuvṛttiṃ kurute ca yaḥ .
sa saṃnyāsī hṛtācāraḥ svadharmātvatito bhavet .. 91 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा चकृषिवाणिज्यं कुवृत्तिं कुरुते च यः .
स संन्यासी हृताचारः स्वधर्मात्वतितो भवेत् .. 91 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhaṃ ca śubhaṃ vā'pi svakarma kurute yadi .
bahiṣkṛtaḥ svadharmo vā'pyupahāsyaśca vai bhavet .. 92 ..
meaning:
अशुभं च शुभं वाऽपि स्वकर्म कुरुते यदि .
बहिष्कृतः स्वधर्मो वाऽप्युपहास्यश्च वै भवेत् .. 92 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇī patihīnā yā bhavenniṣkāminī sadā .
ekabhuktā dinānte sā haviṣyānnaratā sadā .. 93 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणी पतिहीना या भवेन्निष्कामिनी सदा .
एकभुक्ता दिनान्ते सा हविष्यान्नरता सदा .. 93 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na dhatte divyavastraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ sutailakam .
srajaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva śaṅkhasindūrabhūṣaṇam .. 94 ..
meaning:
न धत्ते दिव्यवस्त्रं च गन्धद्रव्यं सुतैलकम् .
स्रजं च चन्दनं चैव शङ्खसिन्दूरभूषणम् .. 94 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā malinavastrā syānnityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret .
nārāyaṇasya sevāṃ ca kurute nityameva ca .. 95 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा मलिनवस्त्रा स्यान्नित्यं नारायणं स्मरेत् .
नारायणस्य सेवां च कुरुते नित्यमेव च .. 95 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tannāmoccāraṇaṃ śaśvatkurute nānyabhaktitaḥ .
putratulyaṃ ca puruṣaṃ sadā paśyati dharmataḥ .. 96 ..
meaning:
तन्नामोच्चारणं शश्वत्कुरुते नान्यभक्तितः .
पुत्रतुल्यं च पुरुषं सदा पश्यति धर्मतः .. 96 ..

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭānnaṃ na ca bhuṅkte sā na kuryādvibhavaṃ vraja .
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine .. 97 ..
meaning:
मिष्टान्नं न च भुङ्क्ते सा न कुर्याद्विभवं व्रज .
एकादश्यां न भोक्तव्यं कृष्णजन्माष्टमीदिने .. 97 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmasya navamyāṃ tu śivarātrau pavitrayā .
aghorāyāṃ ca pretāyāṃ candrasūryoparāgayoḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
श्रीरामस्य नवम्यां तु शिवरात्रौ पवित्रया .
अघोरायां च प्रेतायां चन्द्रसूर्योपरागयोः .. 98 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ parityajya bhujyate parameva ca .
tāmbūlaṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāniṇām .. 99 ..
meaning:
भृष्टं द्रव्यं परित्यज्य भुज्यते परमेव च .
ताम्बूलं विधवास्त्रीणां यतीनां ब्रह्मचानिणाम् .. 99 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyāsināṃ ca saumāṃsasurātulyaṃ śrutau śrutam .
raktaśākaṃ masūraṃ ca jambīraṃ parṇameva ca .. 100 ..
meaning:
संन्यासिनां च सौमांससुरातुल्यं श्रुतौ श्रुतम् .
रक्तशाकं मसूरं च जम्बीरं पर्णमेव च .. 100 ..
text_mt: The fruit is equal for renunciants, ascetics, and celibate students. / A renunciant goes in the evening, hungry, to the house of householders; / whether good food or bad food, he must never reject what is given. / He does not beg for sweet food, nor does he show anger; / he should not accept wealth; having a single garment, free from desire, / regarding cold and heat alike, free from greed and delusion, / staying there for one night, he should depart for another place in the morning. / Riding a vehicle, accepting wealth from a householder, / building a house and dwelling happily, he would fall from his own duty. / Practising agriculture or trade, and adopting a degraded livelihood, / that renunciant, robbed of righteous conduct, falls from his own duty. / If he performs his own work, whether inauspicious or auspicious, / he becomes an outcast from his duty and an object of ridicule. / A Brahmin woman bereft of her husband must remain perpetually free from desire, / eating once at the close of day, constantly devoted to ritual food. / She does not wear splendid clothing, perfumes, or fine oil, / or garlands, sandalwood, conch-shell ornaments, or vermilion. / Casting [these] aside, she should wear faded garments and constantly remember Nārāyaṇa; / she constantly renders service to Nārāyaṇa; / she continually utters his name with devotion to no other, / and by right conduct always looks upon any man as a son. / She does not eat sweet food, nor should she display opulence, O Vraja. / She must not eat on the eleventh day of the fortnight, nor on Kṛṣṇa's birthday, / nor on the ninth day of Śrī Rāma, nor on the holy night of Śiva, / nor on the Aghorā or Pretā fourteenths, nor during eclipses of the moon and sun. / Avoiding fried food, only the purest food is eaten. / Betel for widows, ascetics, and celibate students, / and for renunciants, is declared in scripture to be equal to beef and liquor. / Red greens, lentils, citron, and betel leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
alāburvartulākārā varjanīyā ca tairavi .
paryaṅkaśāyinī nārī vidhavā pātayetpatim .. 101 ..
meaning:
अलाबुर्वर्तुलाकारा वर्जनीया च तैरवि .
पर्यङ्कशायिनी नारी विधवा पातयेत्पतिम् .. 101 ..
text_mt: and round gourds must also be avoided by them. / A widow who lies on a bed causes her husband to fall. / Riding in a carriage, a widow goes to hell; / she should not dress her hair, nor adorn her body; / the braid of hair must remain matted, without shaving except at a pilgrimage site; / she must not massage herself with oil, nor gaze into a mirror, / nor look upon the face of other men, processions, dance, grand festivals, / dancing, singing, or a handsome, well-dressed man. / Hear now the duty of the virtuous as determined by the Sāmaveda, / which is the supreme truth, the ultimate good; understand, as I tell it to you: / Teaching, study, caring for pupils, / constant service to gurus, and the worship of Brahmins and gods; / mastery in the foundational scriptures, meditation, pleasing one's inner self, / refined exposition, constant study of texts, / reflection in accord with the Vedas to clarify sacred injunctions, / and practicing the teachings of scripture oneself; / skill in daily rites to the gods, following the Vedic ways as desired, / eating what is ordained by the Veda, and pure conduct at all times. / Now learn the duty of devoted wives, O lord of Vraja: / Yearning constantly for her husband, desiring the water that has washed his feet, / she must always eat with devotion at his command; / diligently putting aside vows, austerities, and the worship of deities, / she should serve his feet, praise him, and bring him contentment. / A virtuous wife should do no act without his permission; / a virtuous wife continually meditates upon her beloved as higher than Nārāyaṇa. / She never looks upon the face of other men, nor a well-dressed man, / nor on processions, grand festivals, dances, dramatic dancing, or singing, O Vraja, / nor upon the amusements of others, being strictly devoted to her vows. / Whatever is the husband's daily food is the same for the wife;

sanskrit_iast:
yānamārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidhavā narakaṃ vrajet .
na kuryātkeśasaṃskāraṃ gātrasaṃskārameva ca .. 102 ..
meaning:
यानमारोहणं कृत्वा विधवा नरकं व्रजेत् .
न कुर्यात्केशसंस्कारं गात्रसंस्कारमेव च .. 102 ..

sanskrit_iast:
keśaveṇī jaṭārūpe tatkṣauraṃ tīrthakaṃ vinā .
tailābhyaṅgaṃna kurvīta nahi paśyati darpaṇam .. 103 ..
meaning:
केशवेणी जटारूपे तत्क्षौरं तीर्थकं विना .
तैलाभ्यङ्गंन कुर्वीत नहि पश्यति दर्पणम् .. 103 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaṃ ca parapuṃsāṃ ca yātrāṃ nṛtyaṃ mahotsavam .
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ caiva suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham .. 104 ..
meaning:
मुखं च परपुंसां च यात्रां नृत्यं महोत्सवम् .
नर्तनं गायनं चैव सुवेषं पुरुषं शुभम् .. 104 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇuyācca satāṃ dharma sāmavedanirūpitam .
paramārtha paraṃ caiva nibodha kathayāmi te .. 105 ..
meaning:
शृणुयाच्च सतां धर्म सामवेदनिरूपितम् .
परमार्थ परं चैव निबोध कथयामि ते .. 105 ..

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpanamadhyānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ paripālanam .
guruṇāṃ sevanaṃ nityaṃ dvicadevārcanaṃ tathā .. 106 ..
meaning:
अध्यापनमध्यानं शिष्याणां परिपालनम् .
गुरुणां सेवनं नित्यं द्विचदेवार्चनं तथा .. 106 ..

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāntaśāstranaipuṇyaṃ bhāvanaṃ svātmatoṣaṇam .
vyākhyānaṃ pariśuddhaṃ ca granthābhyastaṃ ca saṃtatam .. 107 ..
meaning:
सिद्धान्तशास्त्रनैपुण्यं भावनं स्वात्मतोषणम् .
व्याख्यानं परिशुद्धं च ग्रन्थाभ्यस्तं च संततम् .. 107 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pyavasthāpariśuddhyartha vicāro vedasaṃmataḥ .
śāstrārthācaraṇaṃ caiva katadhyaṃ svayameva ca .. 108 ..
meaning:
प्यवस्थापरिशुद्ध्यर्थ विचारो वेदसंमतः .
शास्त्रार्थाचरणं चैव कतध्यं स्वयमेव च .. 108 ..

sanskrit_iast:
devāhnikeṣu naipuṇyaṃ vedācaraṇamīpsitam .
vedoktabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva pavitrācaraṇaṃ sadā .. 109 ..
meaning:
देवाह्निकेषु नैपुण्यं वेदाचरणमीप्सितम् .
वेदोक्तभक्षणं चैव पवित्राचरणं सदा .. 109 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pativratānāṃ yaṃ dharma taṃ nibodha vrajeśvara .
nityaṃtu bhartaryautsukyāttatpādodakamīpsitam .. 110 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रतानां यं धर्म तं निबोध व्रजेश्वर .
नित्यंतु भर्तर्यौत्सुक्यात्तत्पादोदकमीप्सितम् .. 110 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktibhāvena satataṃ bhoktavyaṃ tadanujñayā .
vrataṃ tapasyāṃ devārcāṃ parityajya prayatnataḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
भक्तिभावेन सततं भोक्तव्यं तदनुज्ञया .
व्रतं तपस्यां देवार्चां परित्यज्य प्रयत्नतः .. 111 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāccaraṇasevāṃ ca stavanaṃ paritoṣaṇam .
tadājñārahitaṃ karma na kuyadviraitaḥ satī .. 112 ..
meaning:
कुर्याच्चरणसेवां च स्तवनं परितोषणम् .
तदाज्ञारहितं कर्म न कुयद्विरैतः सती .. 112 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇātparaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyate satataṃ satī .
parapuṃsāṃ mukhaṃ caiva suveṣapuruṣaṃ param .. 113 ..
meaning:
नारायणात्परं कान्तं ध्यायते सततं सती .
परपुंसां मुखं चैव सुवेषपुरुषं परम् .. 113 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāmahotsavaṃ nṛtyaṃ nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ vraja .
parakrīḍāṃ ca satataṃ na hi paśyati suvratā .. 114 ..
meaning:
यात्रामहोत्सवं नृत्यं नर्तनं गायनं व्रज .
परक्रीडां च सततं न हि पश्यति सुव्रता .. 114 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhakṣyaṃ svāmino nityaṃ tadevamapi yoṣitām .
nahi tyajettu tatsaṅgaṃ kṣaṇameva ca suvratā .. 115 ..
meaning:
यद्भक्ष्यं स्वामिनो नित्यं तदेवमपि योषिताम् .
नहि त्यजेत्तु तत्सङ्गं क्षणमेव च सुव्रता .. 115 ..

sanskrit_iast:
uttare nottaraṃ dadyātsvāminaśya pativratā .
na kopaṃ kurute śudvā tāḍitā cāpi kopataḥ .. 116 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे नोत्तरं दद्यात्स्वामिनश्य पतिव्रता .
न कोपं कुरुते शुद्वा ताडिता चापि कोपतः .. 116 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhitaṃ bhojayetkāntaṃ dadyātpānaṃ ca bhojanam .
na bodhayettaṃ nidrāluṃ prareyennaiva karmasu .. 117 .
meaning:
क्षुधितं भोजयेत्कान्तं दद्यात्पानं च भोजनम् .
न बोधयेत्तं निद्रालुं प्ररेयेन्नैव कर्मसु .. 117 .
text_mt: the woman devoted to her vows must not abandon his company even for a moment. / A devoted wife must not speak back to her husband, / nor does the pure woman show anger, even when struck in anger. / She feeds her hungry husband, providing him with drink and food; / she does not wake him when he is asleep, nor urge him to duties.

sanskrit_iast:
putrāṇāṃ ca śataguṇaṃ snehaṃ kuryātpatīṃ satī .
patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ kulayoṣitaḥ .. 118 ..
meaning:
पुत्राणां च शतगुणं स्नेहं कुर्यात्पतीं सती .
पतिर्बन्धुर्गतिर्भर्ता दैवतं कुलयोषितः .. 118 ..
text_mt: A virtuous wife should show affection to her husband a hundred times more than to her sons; / the husband is the kinsman, the refuge, the protector, and the deity of a woman of noble family.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sudhātulyaṃ kāntaṃ paśyati sundarī .
sasmitaṃ vadanaṃ kṛtvā bhaktibhāvena yatnataḥ .. 119 ..
meaning:
शुभं दृष्ट्वा सुधातुल्यं कान्तं पश्यति सुन्दरी .
सस्मितं वदनं कृत्वा भक्तिभावेन यत्नतः .. 119 ..
text_mt: Beholding auspiciousness, the beautiful woman gazes upon her beloved as upon nectar, / putting on a smiling face and showing devotion with care.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca satī strī ca samuddharet .
patiḥ pativratānāṃ ca mucyate sarvapātakāt .. 120 ..
meaning:
पुरुषाणां सहस्रं च सती स्त्री च समुद्धरेत् .
पतिः पतिव्रतानां च मुच्यते सर्वपातकात् .. 120 ..
text_mt: A virtuous woman redeems a thousand ancestors; / and the husband of a devoted wife is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti teṣāṃ karmabhogaḥ satīnāṃ vratatejasā .
tayā sārdhaṃ ca niṣkarmī modate harimandire .. 121 ..
meaning:
नास्ति तेषां कर्मभोगः सतीनां व्रततेजसा .
तया सार्धं च निष्कर्मी मोदते हरिमन्दिरे .. 121 ..
text_mt: By the power of the vows of virtuous wives, there is no experiencing of karmic retribution for them; / freed from karma, he rejoices with her in the temple of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni satīpādeṣu tānyapi .
tejaśca sarvadevānāṃ munīnāṃ ca satīṣu ca .. 122 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सतीपादेषु तान्यपि .
तेजश्च सर्वदेवानां मुनीनां च सतीषु च .. 122 ..
text_mt: All the holy places on earth are located at the feet of a virtuous wife; / the splendour of all the gods and sages abides in virtuous wives.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvināṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ vratināṃ yatphalaṃ vraja .
dāne phalaṃ yaddātaṇāṃ tatsarva tāsu saṃtatam .. 123 ..
meaning:
तपस्विनां तपः सर्वं व्रतिनां यत्फलं व्रज .
दाने फलं यद्दातणां तत्सर्व तासु संततम् .. 123 ..
text_mt: All the penance of ascetics, whatever fruit belongs to those observing vows, O Vraja, / and whatever fruit belongs to donors in gifts—all that constantly abides in them.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurvidhātā jagatāmapi .
surāḥ sarve ca munayo bhītāstābhyāṃ ca saṃtatam .. 124 ..
meaning:
स्वयं नारायणः शंभुर्विधाता जगतामपि .
सुराः सर्वे च मुनयो भीतास्ताभ्यां च संततम् .. 124 ..
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa himself, Śambhu, and Brahmā, creator of the worlds, / all the gods and the sages are constantly in awe of them.

sanskrit_iast:
satīnāṃ pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā .
pativratāṃ namaskṛtvā mucyate pātakānnaraḥ .. 125 ..
meaning:
सतीनां पादरजसा सद्यः पूता वसुंधरा .
पतिव्रतां नमस्कृत्वा मुच्यते पातकान्नरः .. 125 ..
text_mt: The earth is instantly purified by the dust of the feet of virtuous wives; / bowing to a devoted wife, a man is freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣaṇenaiva pativratā .
svatejasā samarthā sā mahāpuṇyavatī sadā .. 126 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यं भस्मसात्कर्तुं क्षणेनैव पतिव्रता .
स्वतेजसा समर्था सा महापुण्यवती सदा .. 126 ..
text_mt: A devoted wife is capable of burning the three worlds to ashes in an instant / by her own splendour, being always possessed of immense merit.

sanskrit_iast:
satīnāṃ ca patiḥ sādhuḥ putro niḥśaṃka eva ca .
na hi tasya bhayaṃ kiṃciddevebhyaśca yamādapi .. 127 ..
meaning:
सतीनां च पतिः साधुः पुत्रो निःशंक एव च .
न हि तस्य भयं किंचिद्देवेभ्यश्च यमादपि .. 127 ..
text_mt: The husband of a virtuous wife is righteous, and her son is fearless; / he has no fear whatsoever from the gods or even from Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
śatajanmapuṇyavatāṃ gehe jātā pativratā .
pativratāprasūḥ pūtā jīvanmuktaḥ pitā tathā .. 128 ..
meaning:
शतजन्मपुण्यवतां गेहे जाता पतिव्रता .
पतिव्रताप्रसूः पूता जीवन्मुक्तः पिता तथा .. 128 ..
text_mt: A devoted wife is born in the house of those who possess the merit of a hundred lifetimes; / the mother of a devoted wife is purified, and her father is liberated while living.

sanskrit_iast:
satī strī prātarutthāya tyaktvā ca rātrivāsasam .
bhartāraṃ ca namaskṛtya karoti stavanaṃ mudā .. 129 ..
meaning:
सती स्त्री प्रातरुत्थाय त्यक्त्वा च रात्रिवाससम् .
भर्तारं च नमस्कृत्य करोति स्तवनं मुदा .. 129 ..
text_mt: Rising in the morning and taking off the garments of the night, / a virtuous woman bows to her husband and gladly sings his praise.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhakāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snātvā dhaute ca vāsasī .
gṛhītvā śuklapuṣpaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ pūjayetpatim .. 130 ..
meaning:
गृहकार्यं ततः कृत्वा स्नात्वा धौते च वाससी .
गृहीत्वा शुक्लपुष्पं च भक्तितः पूजयेत्पतिम् .. 130 ..
text_mt: Then, having performed the household chores, bathed, and put on washed clothes, / she should take white flowers and worship her husband with devotion. // 130

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayitvā supūtena jalena nirmalena ca .
tasmai dattvā dhautavastraṃ tatpādau kṣālayenmudā .. 131 ..
meaning:
स्नापयित्वा सुपूतेन जलेन निर्मलेन च .
तस्मै दत्त्वा धौतवस्त्रं तत्पादौ क्षालयेन्मुदा .. 131 ..
text_mt: Having bathed him with very pure and clean water, / and having given him washed clothing, she should gladly wash his feet. // 131

sanskrit_iast:
āsane vāsayitvā ca dattvā bhāle ca candanam .
sarvāṅgalepanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā mālyaṃ gale'pi ca .. 132 ..
meaning:
आसने वासयित्वा च दत्त्वा भाले च चन्दनम् .
सर्वाङ्गलेपनं कृत्वा दत्त्वा माल्यं गलेऽपि च .. 132 ..
text_mt: Having seated him on a seat, applied sandalwood paste to his forehead, / anointed all his limbs, and also placed a garland on his neck, // 132

sanskrit_iast:
sāmavedoktamantreṇa bhogadravyaiḥ sudhopamaiḥ .
saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ kāntaṃ stutvā ca praṇamenmudā .. 133 ..
meaning:
सामवेदोक्तमन्त्रेण भोगद्रव्यैः सुधोपमैः .
संपूज्य भक्तितः कान्तं स्तुत्वा च प्रणमेन्मुदा .. 133 ..
text_mt: with a mantra spoken in the Sāmaveda and with items of offering like nectar, / she should worship her beloved with devotion, praise him, and gladly bow down. // 133

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ kāntāya śāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya svāhā .
ityanenaiva mantreṇa dattvā puṣpaṃ ca candanam .. 134 ..
meaning:
ओं नमः कान्ताय शान्ताय सर्वदेवाश्रयाय स्वाहा .
इत्यनेनैव मन्त्रेण दत्त्वा पुष्पं च चन्दनम् .. 134 ..
text_mt: “Oṃ, salutations to the beloved, the peaceful, the refuge of all deities, svāhā.” / Offering flowers and sandalwood paste with this very mantra, // 134

sanskrit_iast:
pādyārdhyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca vastraṃ naivedyamuttamam .
jalaṃ suvāsitaṃ śuddhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam .. 135 ..
meaning:
पाद्यार्ध्यं धूपदीपौ च वस्त्रं नैवेद्यमुत्तमम् .
जलं सुवासितं शुद्धं ताम्बूलं च सुवासितम् .. 135 ..
text_mt: and offering water for the feet, arghya, incense, a lamp, clothing, excellent food offerings, / scented pure water, and fragrant betel, // 135

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā stotraṃ paṭhedyadyatkṛtaṃ vai pāṭhyameva ca .
oṃ namaḥ kāntāya bhartre ca śiraścandrasvarūpiṇe .. 136 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा स्तोत्रं पठेद्यद्यत्कृतं वै पाठ्यमेव च .
ओं नमः कान्ताय भर्त्रे च शिरश्चन्द्रस्वरूपिणे .. 136 ..
text_mt: she should recite whatever hymn of praise has been composed, which ought to be recited: / “Oṃ, salutations to the beloved husband, whose form is the moon upon the head! // 136

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya ca .
namo brahmasvarūpāya satīprāṇaparāya ca .. 137 ..
meaning:
नमः शान्ताय दान्ताय सर्वदेवाश्रयाय च .
नमो ब्रह्मस्वरूपाय सतीप्राणपराय च .. 137 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the peaceful, the self-controlled, and the refuge of all deities! / Salutations to the one whose form is Brahman, who is dearer to the devoted wife than life! // 137

sanskrit_iast:
namasyāya ca pūjyāya hṛdādhārāya te namaḥ .
pañcaprāṇādhidevāya cakṣuṣastārakāya ca .. 138 ..
meaning:
नमस्याय च पूज्याय हृदाधाराय ते नमः .
पञ्चप्राणाधिदेवाय चक्षुषस्तारकाय च .. 138 ..
text_mt: Salutations to you, who are worthy of obeisance, worthy of worship, the foundation of the heart, / the presiding deity of the five vital breaths, and the pupil of the eye! // 138

sanskrit_iast:
jñānādhārāya patnīnāṃ paramānandarūpiṇe .
patirbrahmā patirviṣṇuḥ patireva maheśvaraḥ .. 139 ..
meaning:
ज्ञानाधाराय पत्नीनां परमानन्दरूपिणे .
पतिर्ब्रह्मा पतिर्विष्णुः पतिरेव महेश्वरः .. 139 ..
text_mt: To the support of knowledge for wives, whose form is supreme bliss! / The husband is Brahmā, the husband is Viṣṇu, the husband alone is Maheśvara. // 139

sanskrit_iast:
patiśca nirguṇādhāro brahmarūpa namo'stu te .
kṣamasva bhagavan doṣaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ ca yat .. 140 ..
meaning:
पतिश्च निर्गुणाधारो ब्रह्मरूप नमोऽस्तु ते .
क्षमस्व भगवन् दोषं ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं च यत् .. 140 ..
text_mt: And the husband is the support of that which is beyond the gunas; salutations to you whose form is Brahman! / Forgive, O lord, whatever fault has been committed through knowledge or ignorance! // 140

sanskrit_iast:
patnībandho dayāsindho dāsīdoṣaṃ kṣamasva me .
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau padmayā kṛtam .. 141 ..
meaning:
पत्नीबन्धो दयासिन्धो दासीदोषं क्षमस्व मे .
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं सृष्ट्यादौ पद्मया कृतम् .. 141 ..
text_mt: O friend of the wife, O ocean of compassion, forgive my fault, I who am your servant!” / This greatly meritorious hymn of praise was composed at the beginning of creation by Padmā, // 141

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyā ca dharayā gaṅgayā ca purā vraja .
sāvitryā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe cāpi nityaśaḥ .. 142 ..
meaning:
सरस्वत्या च धरया गङ्गया च पुरा व्रज .
सावित्र्या च कृतं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणे चापि नित्यशः .. 142 ..
text_mt: and in ancient times by Sarasvatī, Dharā, and Gaṅgā, O king of Vraja; / and formerly it was constantly offered by Sāvitrī to Brahmā, // 142

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā ca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā kailāse śaṃkarāya ca .
munīnāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca patnībhiśca kṛtaṃ purā .. 143 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्या च कृतं भक्त्या कैलासे शंकराय च .
मुनीनां च सुराणां च पत्नीभिश्च कृतं पुरा .. 143 ..
text_mt: and offered with devotion by Pārvatī to Śaṅkara on Mount Kailāsa, / and in ancient times by the wives of the sages and gods. // 143

sanskrit_iast:
pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ stotrametacchubhāvaham .
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yā śrṛṇoti pativratā .. 144 ..
meaning:
पतिव्रतानां सर्वासां स्तोत्रमेतच्छुभावहम् .
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं या श्रृणोति पतिव्रता .. 144 ..
text_mt: This hymn of praise brings auspiciousness to all devoted wives. / Whatever devoted wife listens to this greatly meritorious hymn of praise, // 144

sanskrit_iast:
naro'nyo vā'pi nārī vā labhate sarvavāñchitam .
aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano labhate dhanam .. 145 ..
meaning:
नरोऽन्यो वाऽपि नारी वा लभते सर्ववाञ्छितम् .
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं निर्धनो लभते धनम् .. 145 ..
text_mt: or any other man or woman, obtains all that is desired: / a sonless person obtains a son, a destitute person obtains wealth, // 145

sanskrit_iast:
raugī ca mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt .
pativratā ca stutvā ca tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet .. 146 ..
meaning:
रौगी च मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् .
पतिव्रता च स्तुत्वा च तीर्थस्नानफलं लभेत् .. 146 ..
text_mt: a diseased person is freed from disease, and one bound is freed from bondage. / And having praised him, a devoted wife obtains the fruit of bathing at sacred waters, // 146

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ ca sarvaṃ tapasāṃ vratānāṃ ca vrajeśvara .
idaṃ stutvā namaskṛtvā bhuṅkte sā tadanujñayā ..
uktaḥ pativratādharmo gṛhiṇāṃ śruyatāṃ vraja .. 147 ..
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttaṃo nāradānāo bhagavannandasaṃo
tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 83 ..
meaning:
फलं च सर्वं तपसां व्रतानां च व्रजेश्वर .
इदं स्तुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा भुङ्क्ते सा तदनुज्ञया ..
उक्तः पतिव्रताधर्मो गृहिणां श्रुयतां व्रज .. 147 ..
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तंओ नारदानाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 83 ..
text_mt:
and all the fruits of austerities and vows, O lord of Vraja. / Having praised him with this and bowed, she eats with his permission.
The duty of a devoted wife has been declared; listen now to the duty of householders, O king of Vraja. // 147
Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, in the dialogue between the Lord and Nanda, in the conversation between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the upper portion of the Śrī Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa of the great Śrī Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. // 83

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
dvijadevārcanaṃ caiva karoti satataṃ gṛhī .
svadharmācaraṇaṃ caiva cāturvarṇyaṃ ca nityaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
द्विजदेवार्चनं चैव करोति सततं गृही .
स्वधर्माचरणं चैव चातुर्वर्ण्यं च नित्यणः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the eighty-fourth chapter. / The Blessed Lord said: / A householder constantly performs the worship of twice-borns and gods, / and constantly follows his own duty and the system of four classes. // 1
title: atha caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
kurvanti gṛhiṇāmāśāṃ sarve devādayastathā .
akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhasthaśca sadā'śuciḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
कुर्वन्ति गृहिणामाशां सर्वे देवादयस्तथा .
अकृत्वाऽतिथिपूजां च गृहस्थश्च सदाऽशुचिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: All beings, beginning with the gods, place their expectations on householders. / Without performing the worship of a guest, a householder is always impure. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraḥ karmakāle cātithikāle ca devatāḥ .
sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
पितरः कर्मकाले चातिथिकाले च देवताः .
सर्वे गृहस्थमायान्ति निपानमिव धेनवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The ancestors arrive at the time of ancestral rites, and the deities at the time of a guest; / they all come to the householder like cows to a watering-trough. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
samāyāti prayatnena sayāhne kṣudhito'tithiḥ .
pūjāṃ labdhvā''śiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti gṛhiṇo gṛhāt .. 4 ..
meaning:
समायाति प्रयत्नेन सयाह्ने क्षुधितोऽतिथिः .
पूजां लब्ध्वा'ऽशिषं कृत्वा प्रयाति गृहिणो गृहात् .. 4 ..
text_mt: A hungry guest comes with effort in the evening; / receiving worship and giving a blessing, he departs from the householder's house. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhī bhavati pātakī .
trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
अकृत्वाऽतिथिपूजां च गृही भवति पातकी .
त्रैलोक्यजनितं पापं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Without performing the worship of a guest, a householder becomes a sinner; / he incurs the sin born of the three worlds—of this there is no doubt. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinirvate .
pitarastasya devāśca vahnayaśca tathaiva ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिर्वते .
पितरस्तस्य देवाश्च वह्नयश्च तथैव च .. 6 ..
text_mt: He from whose house a guest turns away with hopes shattered— / his ancestors, the gods, and the sacrificial fires likewise, // 6

sanskrit_iast:
nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti gṛhiṇo'tithayo gṛhāt .
strīdhnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brāhmaṇairgurutalpagaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
निराशाः प्रतिगच्छन्ति गृहिणोऽतिथयो गृहात् .
स्त्रीध्नैर्गोघ्नैः कृतघ्नैश्च ब्राह्मणैर्गुरुतल्पगैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: along with the guests, depart disappointed from that householder's house. / Equal in guilt to the killers of women, the killers of cows, the ungrateful, // 7

sanskrit_iast:
tulyadoṣo bhavatyeva yenātithiranarcitaḥ .
svātmanaḥ pātakaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati .. 8 ..
meaning:
तुल्यदोषो भवत्येव येनातिथिरनर्चितः .
स्वात्मनः पातकं दत्त्वा पुण्यमादाय गच्छति .. 8 ..
text_mt: and Brahmins who violate their guru’s bed, is the one by whom a guest is left unworshipped. / Leaving his own sin behind, [the guest] departs taking away [the host's] merit. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkṛtvā sarvasevāṃ devādīṃśca śubhāśayaḥ .
poṣyāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādbhuṅkte sa dharmavit .. 9 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कृत्वा सर्वसेवां देवादींश्च शुभाशयः .
पोष्याणां भरणं कृत्वा पश्चाद्भुङ्क्ते स धर्मवित् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Therefore, having rendered all service to the deities and others with an auspicious mind, / and having maintained those who are to be supported, he who knows righteousness eats afterward. // 9

sanskrit_iast:
yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti bhāryā ca puṃścalī tathā .
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyamaraṇyādduḥkhadaṃ gṛham .. 10 ..
meaning:
यस्य माता गृहे नास्ति भार्या च पुंश्चली तथा .
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यमरण्याद्दुःखदं गृहम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: He who has no mother in the house, and whose wife is unchaste, / should go to the forest; a home is more sorrowful than the forest. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
patīṃ dveṣṭi sadā duṣṭā viṣatunyaṃ ca paśyati .
dadāti tasmai nā''hāraṃ bhartsanaṃ kurute sadā .. 11 ..
meaning:
पतीं द्वेष्टि सदा दुष्टा विषतुन्यं च पश्यति .
ददाति तस्मै ना'ऽहारं भर्त्सनं कुरुते सदा .. 11 ..
text_mt: The wicked woman constantly hates her husband and regards him like poison; / she gives him no food and constantly reproaches him. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitaṃ munitulyaṃ ca sā ca pāpīyasī param .
saṃtataṃ tṛṇavanmatvā nyakkāraṃ kurute sadā .. 12 ..
meaning:
पूजितं मुनितुल्यं च सा च पापीयसी परम् .
संततं तृणवन्मत्वा न्यक्कारं कुरुते सदा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Though he is revered and equal to a sage, that extremely sinful woman / constantly regards him like a blade of grass and always treats him with contempt. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
durvākyāvahninā dagdho mṛtatulyaśca jīvati .
yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ saṃprāpya duṣṭavaṃśajām .. 13 ..
meaning:
दुर्वाक्यावह्निना दग्धो मृततुल्यश्च जीवति .
यावज्जीवनपर्यन्तं संप्राप्य दुष्टवंशजाम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Scorched by the fire of harsh words, he lives like a dead man / for the duration of his life, having married a woman born of a wicked family. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhiṇīnāṃ sadācāraṃ śrūyatāṃ tacchru tau śrutam .
gṛhiṇī patibhaktā ca devabrāhmaṇabūjitā .. 14 ..
meaning:
गृहिणीनां सदाचारं श्रूयतां तच्छ्रु तौ श्रुतम् .
गृहिणी पतिभक्ता च देवब्राह्मणबूजिता .. 14 ..
text_mt: Hear the righteous conduct of housewives, as it is heard in the scriptures: / the housewife who is devoted to her husband is worshipped by gods and Brahmins. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
sā śuddhā prātarutthāya namaskṛtya patiṃ suram .
prāṅgaṇe maṅgalaṃ dadyādgomayena jalena ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
सा शुद्धा प्रातरुत्थाय नमस्कृत्य पतिं सुरम् .
प्राङ्गणे मङ्गलं दद्याद्गोमयेन जलेन च .. 15 ..
text_mt: Pure, having risen early in the morning and bowed to her husband as to a god, / she should apply auspicious markings in the courtyard with cow dung and water. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhakṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā ca snātvā''gatya gṛhaṃ satī .
suraṃ vipraṃ patiṃ natvā pūjayedgṛhadevatām .. 16 ..
meaning:
गृहकृत्यं च कृत्वा च स्नात्वा'ऽगत्य गृहं सती .
सुरं विप्रं पतिं नत्वा पूजयेद्गृहदेवताम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And having performed household duties, bathed, and returned home, the chaste wife, / having bowed to the god, the Brahmin, and her husband, should worship the household deity. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhakṛtyaṃ sunirvṛtya bhojayitvā patiṃ satī .
atithiṃ pūjayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuṅkate sukhaṃsatī .. 17 ..
meaning:
गृहकृत्यं सुनिर्वृत्य भोजयित्वा पतिं सती .
अतिथिं पूजयित्वा च स्वयं भुङ्कते सुखंसती .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having properly accomplished household chores and fed her husband, the chaste wife, / having worshipped the guest, happily eats herself. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
putraiśca pūjitastātaḥ śiṣyaiśca pūjito guruḥ .
ājñayā kurute karma putraḥ śiṣyaśca bhṛtyavat .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुत्रैश्च पूजितस्तातः शिष्यैश्च पूजितो गुरुः .
आज्ञया कुरुते कर्म पुत्रः शिष्यश्च भृत्यवत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: A father is worshipped by his sons, and a guru is worshipped by his disciples; / by command, the son and the disciple do work like a servant. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
na prerayedguruṃ tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyaśca karmasu .
pitre ca gurave nityaṃ sarvasvaṃ ca samarpayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
न प्रेरयेद्गुरुं तातं पुत्रः शिष्यश्च कर्मसु .
पित्रे च गुरवे नित्यं सर्वस्वं च समर्पयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: A son and a disciple should not command a guru or a father in tasks; / one should always surrender everything to one's father and guru. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
na kuryānnarabuddhiṃ ca gurau pitari saṃtatam .
kṛtvā ca narabuddhiṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 20 ..
meaning:
न कुर्यान्नरबुद्धिं च गुरौ पितरि संततम् .
कृत्वा च नरबुद्धिं च ब्रह्महत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् .. 20 ..
text_mt: One should never hold the view that a guru or a father is a mere human; / holding the view that they are mere humans, one certainly incurs the sin of killing a Brahmin. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pituścāpyadhikāṃ tathā .
mātuḥ paraṃ guruṃ caiva pūjayedbhaktiyogataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
मातरं पूजयेद्भक्त्या पितुश्चाप्यधिकां तथा .
मातुः परं गुरुं चैव पूजयेद्भक्तियोगतः .. 21 ..
text_mt: One should worship the mother with devotion, even more than the father; / and through the practice of devotion, one should worship the guru who is higher than the mother. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ sadā'kṣamaḥ .
anāthā bhaginī kanyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā .. 22 ..
meaning:
पिता माता गुरुर्भार्या शिष्यः पुत्रः सदाऽक्षमः .
अनाथा भगिनी कन्या नित्यं पोष्या गुरुप्रिया .. 22 ..
text_mt: Father, mother, guru, wife, disciple, a son who is ever incapable, / a helpless sister, an unmarried daughter, and the beloved of the guru are always to be supported. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ca kathitaṃ tāta sarveṣāṃ dharmamuttamam .
śtrījātirvāstapīśuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवं च कथितं तात सर्वेषां धर्ममुत्तमम् .
श्त्रीजातिर्वास्तपीशुद्धा ताश्च सर्वाः पतिव्रताः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Thus, O father, has the supreme duty of all been declared. / Womanhood is inherently pure, and all of them are devoted wives; // 23

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā jātirekavidhā cā''dau sṛṣṭā ca brahmaṇā .
tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ paṇḍitādhikāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
सर्वा जातिरेकविधा चा'ऽदौ सृष्टा च ब्रह्मणा .
ताः सर्वाः प्रकृतेरंशाः पवित्राः पण्डिताधिकाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: all womankind was created of a single kind in the beginning by Brahmā. / They are all portions of Prakṛti, pure, and superior even to scholars. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
kedārakanyāśāpena sa hi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ .
tadā kopena dhātrā ca kṛtyā strī ca vinirmitā .. 25 ..
meaning:
केदारकन्याशापेन स हि धर्मः क्षयं गतः .
तदा कोपेन धात्रा च कृत्या स्त्री च विनिर्मिता .. 25 ..
text_mt: By the curse of Kedāra's daughter, that righteousness perished. / Then, out of anger, the Creator fashioned woman as an evil spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtyā strī trividhā jātirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā .
uttamā prathamā sā ca madhyamā cādhamā vraja .. 26 ..
meaning:
कृत्या स्त्री त्रिविधा जातिर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा .
उत्तमा प्रथमा सा च मध्यमा चाधमा व्रज .. 26 ..
text_mt: Woman was created by Brahmā in ancient times as an evil spirit of three types: / the highest was the first, the middling, and the lowest, O Vraja.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā patibhaktā sā kiṃciddharmasamanvitā .
prāṇānte'pi na kurute taṃ jāramayaśakaram .. 27 ..
meaning:
उत्तमा पतिभक्ता सा किंचिद्धर्मसमन्विता .
प्राणान्तेऽपि न कुरुते तं जारमयशकरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: The highest is devoted to her husband, endowed with some virtue; / even at the risk of her life, she does not take a lover, who brings disgrace.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetsā yathā kāntaṃ tathā devadvijātithīn .
vratāni copavāsāṃśca kurute sarvapūjanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
पूजयेत्सा यथा कान्तं तथा देवद्विजातिथीन् .
व्रतानि चोपवासांश्च कुरुते सर्वपूजनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: As she honours her husband, so she honours gods, twice-born men, and guests; / she performs observances, fasts, and the worship of all.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṇā rakṣitā yatnājjāraṃ ca na bhajedbhayāt .
sa kṛtrimā madhyamā ca yathākiṃcitpatiṃ bhajet .. 29 ..
meaning:
गुरुणा रक्षिता यत्नाज्जारं च न भजेद्भयात् .
स कृत्रिमा मध्यमा च यथाकिंचित्पतिं भजेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Guarded diligently by elders, she does not take a paramour out of fear; / she is the middling, artificial [type], serving her husband only moderately.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaṃ nāstikṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti prārthayitā naraḥ .
tena he nanda tāsāṃ ca satītvamupajāyate .. 30 ..
meaning:
स्थानं नास्तिक्षणं नास्ति नास्ति प्रार्थयिता नरः .
तेन हे नन्द तासां च सतीत्वमुपजायते .. 30 ..
text_mt: There is no place, no opportunity, and no man entreating her; / therefore, O Nanda, chastity arises in such women.

sanskrit_iast:
adhamā paramā duṣṭā'tyantāsadvaṃśajā tathā .
adharmaśīlā duḥśīlā durmukhā kalahānvitā .. 31 ..
meaning:
अधमा परमा दुष्टाऽत्यन्तासद्वंशजा तथा .
अधर्मशीला दुःशीला दुर्मुखा कलहान्विता .. 31 ..
text_mt: The lowest is exceedingly wicked, born of a most base family, / inclined to unrighteousness, ill-behaved, foul-mouthed, and quarrelsome.

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ bhartsayate nityaṃ jāraṃ ca sevate sadā .
duḥśaṃ dadāti kāntāya viṣatulyaṃ ca paśyati .. 32 ..
meaning:
पतिं भर्त्सयते नित्यं जारं च सेवते सदा .
दुःशं ददाति कान्ताय विषतुल्यं च पश्यति .. 32 ..
text_mt: She always reviles her husband and constantly attends to a paramour; / she causes misery to her spouse and views him as poison.

sanskrit_iast:
jāradvāramupāyena hanti kāntaṃ manoharam .
dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca mahītale .. 33 ..
meaning:
जारद्वारमुपायेन हन्ति कान्तं मनोहरम् .
धर्मिष्ठं च वरिष्ठं च गरिष्ठं च महीतले .. 33 ..
text_mt: Through a stratagem involving her paramour, she kills her charming husband, / even if he is most righteous, eminent, and revered on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadevasamaṃ cāpi jāraṃ paśyati kāmataḥ .
śubhadṛṣṭyā kaṭākṣeṇa śaravatpāpīyasī mudā .. 34 ..
meaning:
कामदेवसमं चापि जारं पश्यति कामतः .
शुभदृष्ट्या कटाक्षेण शरवत्पापीयसी मुदा .. 34 ..
text_mt: Out of lust, the sinful woman gazes upon a paramour like the god of love, / joyfully shooting glances like arrows with an auspicious look.

sanskrit_iast:
suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ draṣṭvā yuvānaṃ ratiśūkaram .
yoniḥ klidyati nārīṇāṃ kāminīnāṃ nirantaram .. 35 ..
meaning:
सुवेषं पुरुषं द्रष्ट्वा युवानं रतिशूकरम् .
योनिः क्लिद्यति नारीणां कामिनीनां निरन्तरम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Upon seeing a well-dressed youth skilled in love-making, / the vulva of lustful women continually moistens.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti bhartre nā''hāraṃ viṣoktiṃ vakti saṃtatam .
adharmaṃ cintayecchaśvajjāraṃ ca paramaṃ mudā .. 36 ..
meaning:
ददाति भर्त्रे ना'ऽहारं विषोक्तिं वक्ति संततम् .
अधर्मं चिन्तयेच्छश्वज्जारं च परमं मुदा .. 36 ..
text_mt: She does not give food to her husband and constantly speaks venomous words; / she incessantly contemplates unrighteousness and rejoices greatly in a paramour.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhirbhartsitā sā ca rakṣitā ca śatena ca .
tathā'pi jāraṃ kurute nāpi sādhyā nṛperapi .. 37 ..
meaning:
गुरुभिर्भर्त्सिता सा च रक्षिता च शतेन च .
तथाऽपि जारं कुरुते नापि साध्या नृपेरपि .. 37 ..
text_mt: Though scolded by her elders and guarded by a hundred [men], / still she takes a paramour; she cannot be restrained even by kings.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti tasyāḥ priyaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ kāryavaśena ca .
gāvastṛṇamivāraṇye prārthayantī navaṃ navam .. 38 ..
meaning:
नास्ति तस्याः प्रियं किंचित्सर्वं कार्यवशेन च .
गावस्तृणमिवारण्ये प्रार्थयन्ती नवं नवम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Nothing is dear to her, and everything she does is out of self-interest; / like cattle in a forest seeking grass, she craves someone new and fresh.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyudābhā jale rekhā tasyā prītistathaiva ca .
adharmayuktā satataṃ kapaṭaṃ vakti niścitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
विद्युदाभा जले रेखा तस्या प्रीतिस्तथैव च .
अधर्मयुक्ता सततं कपटं वक्ति निश्चितम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Her affection is like the flash of lightning, like a line drawn on water; / constantly joined to unrighteousness, she speaks nothing but deceit.

sanskrit_iast:
vrate tapasi dharme ca na mano gṛhakarmaṇi .
na gurau na ca deveṣu jāre snigdhaṃ ca cañcalam .. 40 ..
meaning:
व्रते तपसि धर्मे च न मनो गृहकर्मणि .
न गुरौ न च देवेषु जारे स्निग्धं च चञ्चलम् .. 40 ..
text_mt: Her mind is not on vow, asceticism, virtue, or household duties, / nor on her elder, nor on the gods; she is tender and unsteady only toward a lover.

sanskrit_iast:
strījātitrividhānāṃ ca kathā ca kathitā mayā .
bhaktānāṃ trividhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śrūyatāmiti .. 41 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीजातित्रिविधानां च कथा च कथिता मया .
भक्तानां त्रिविधानां च लक्षणं श्रूयतामिति .. 41 ..
text_mt: Thus the account of the three types of women has been told by me; / now hear the characteristics of the three types of devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇaśayyārato bhakto mannāmaguṇakīrtiṣu .
mano niveśayettyaktvā saṃsārasukhakāraṇam .. 42 ..
meaning:
तृणशय्यारतो भक्तो मन्नामगुणकीर्तिषु .
मनो निवेशयेत्त्यक्त्वा संसारसुखकारणम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: A devotee resting on a bed of grass fixes his mind / upon praising my names and virtues, casting aside the cause of worldly pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāyate matpadābjaṃ ca pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ .
ahaitukīṃ tasya devāḥ saṃkalparahitasya ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
व्यायते मत्पदाब्जं च पूजयेद्भक्तिभावतः .
अहैतुकीं तस्य देवाः संकल्परहितस्य च .. 43 ..
text_mt: He meditates on my lotus feet and worships out of devotion; / for him who is free from selfish desires, [his devotion] is motiveless, O gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhiṃna vāñchanti te'ṇimādikamīpsitam .
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ sukhakāraṇam .. 44 ..
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिंन वाञ्छन्ति तेऽणिमादिकमीप्सितम् .
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा सुरत्वं सुखकारणम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Such devotees do not desire all the [supernatural] powers, the coveted [siddhis] such as becoming microscopic, / nor the status of Brahmā, nor immortality, nor divine status, which cause pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsyaṃ vinā nahīcchanti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam .
naiva nirvāṇamuktiṃ ca sudhāpānamabhīpsitam .. 45 ..
meaning:
दास्यं विना नहीच्छन्ति सालोक्यादिचतुष्टयम् .
नैव निर्वाणमुक्तिं च सुधापानमभीप्सितम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Except for service, they desire neither the four forms of liberation beginning with dwelling in my realm, / nor liberation as extinction, nor the coveted drinking of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
vāñchanti niścilāṃ bhaktiṃ madīyāmatulāmapi .
strīpuṃvibhedo nāstyeva sarvajīveṣu bhinnatā .. 46 ..
meaning:
वाञ्छन्ति निश्चिलां भक्तिं मदीयामतुलामपि .
स्त्रीपुंविभेदो नास्त्येव सर्वजीवेषु भिन्नता .. 46 ..
text_mt: They desire only unwavering, peerless devotion to me; / for them there is no distinction of female and male, nor any difference among all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ siddheśvarāṇāṃ ca pravarāṇāṃ vrajeśvara .
kṣutpipāsādikaṃ nidrālobhamohādikaṃ ripum .. 47 ..
meaning:
तेषां सिद्धेश्वराणां च प्रवराणां व्रजेश्वर .
क्षुत्पिपासादिकं निद्रालोभमोहादिकं रिपुम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: For those foremost lords of perfected beings, O lord of Vraja, / hunger, thirst, sleep, greed, delusion, and other enemies [are renounced].

sanskrit_iast:
tpaktvā divāniśaṃ māṃ ca dhyāyante ca digambarāḥ .
samadbhaktottamo nanda śrūyatāṃ madhyamādikam .. 48 ..
meaning:
त्पक्त्वा दिवानिशं मां च ध्यायन्ते च दिगम्बराः .
समद्भक्तोत्तमो नन्द श्रूयतां मध्यमादिकम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Having cast these aside, unclothed, they meditate upon me day and night; / such is my highest devotee, O Nanda; now hear of the middling and others.

sanskrit_iast:
nā''saktaḥ karmasu gṛhī pūrvaprāktanataḥ śuciḥ .
karoti satataṃ caiva pūrvakarmanikṛntanam .. 49 ..
meaning:
ना'ऽसक्तः कर्मसु गृही पूर्वप्राक्तनतः शुचिः .
करोति सततं चैव पूर्वकर्मनिकृन्तनम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: The householder, unattached to actions, purified by past deeds, / continually cuts away the effects of previous actions.

sanskrit_iast:
na karotyaparaṃ vatnātsaṃkalparahitaḥ sa ca .
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiṃcinnāhaṃ kartā ca karmaṇaḥ .. 50 ..
meaning:
न करोत्यपरं वत्नात्संकल्परहितः स च .
सर्वं कृष्णस्य यत्किंचिन्नाहं कर्ता च कर्मणः .. 50 ..
text_mt: Without undertaking other actions, free from selfish resolve, / [he thinks:] 'Whatever exists belongs to Kṛṣṇa; I am not the agent of action.'

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayediti .
nyūnabhaktaśca tannyūnaḥ sa ca prākṛtikaḥ śrutau .. 51 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सततं चिन्तयेदिति .
न्यूनभक्तश्च तन्न्यूनः स च प्राकृतिकः श्रुतौ .. 51 ..
text_mt: In deed, mind, and speech he contemplates this constantly; / the lower devotee is inferior to him, considered an ordinary devotee in the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaṃ vā yamadūtaṃ vā svapne'pi na ca paśyati .
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrvabhaktaḥ suddharet .. 52 ..
meaning:
यमं वा यमदूतं वा स्वप्नेऽपि न च पश्यति .
पुरुषाणां सहस्रं च पूर्वभक्तः सुद्धरेत् .. 52 ..
text_mt: He does not see Yama or the messengers of Yama even in a dream; / the first [highest] devotee delivers a thousand men [of his lineage].

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsāṃ śataṃ madhyamaśca taccaturthaṃ ca prākṛtaḥ .
bhaktaśca trividhastāta kathitaśca tavā''jñayā .. 53 ..
meaning:
पुंसां शतं मध्यमश्च तच्चतुर्थं च प्राकृतः .
भक्तश्च त्रिविधस्तात कथितश्च तवा'ऽज्ञया .. 53 ..
text_mt: The middling delivers a hundred men, and the ordinary [delivers] a quarter of that; / thus the threefold devotee, O father, has been described at your command.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaracanākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ .
brahmāṇḍaracanārthaṃ ca bhaktā jānanti yatnataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डरचनाख्यानं श्रूयतां सावधानतः .
ब्रह्माण्डरचनार्थं च भक्ता जानन्ति यत्नतः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Listen attentively to the account of the creation of the cosmic egg; / devotees diligently understand the meaning of the creation of the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
munayaśca surāḥ santaḥ kiṃcijjānanti duḥkhataḥ .
jānāmi viśvaṃ sarvārtha brahmā''nanto ..
maheśvaraḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
मुनयश्च सुराः सन्तः किंचिज्जानन्ति दुःखतः .
जानामि विश्वं सर्वार्थ ब्रह्मा'ऽनन्तो ..
महेश्वरः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Sages, gods, and good men know only a little with difficulty; / I know the whole truth of the universe, and so do Brahmā, Ananta,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ sanatkumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī .
kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī .. 56 ..
meaning:
धर्मः सनत्कुमारश्च नरनारायणावृषी .
कपिलश्च गणेशश्च दुर्गा लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती .. 56 ..
text_mt: Dharma, Sanatkumāra, the sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa, / Kapila, Gaṇeśa, Durgā, Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
vedāśca vedamātā ca sarvajñā rādhikā svayam .
