गार्ग्यश्यापि तथा वात्स्यो व्यासश्च जैमिनिस्तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt: Vibhāṇḍaka, Marīci, Śukra, Atri, Bṛhaspati, / Gārgya, and likewise Vātsya, Vyāsa, and Jaimini, .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mitavāgṛṣyaśṛṅgaśca yājñavalkyaḥ śukastathā .
saubhariḥ śuddhajaṭilo bharadvājaḥ subhadrakaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
मितवागृष्यशृङ्गश्च याज्ञवल्क्यः शुकस्तथा .
सौभरिः शुद्धजटिलो भरद्वाजः सुभद्रकः .. 8 ..
text_mt: the soft-spoken Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Yājñavalkya, Śuka, / Saubhari, Śuddhajaṭila, Bharadvāja, Subhadraka, .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca āsuriśca viṭaṅkaṇaḥ .
aṣṭāvakra śatānando vāmadeśca bhāsuriḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयो लोमशश्च आसुरिश्च विटङ्कणः .
अष्टावक्र शतानन्दो वामदेश्च भासुरिः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya, Lomaśa, Āsuri, Viṭaṅkaṇa, / Aṣṭāvakra, Śatānanda, Vāmadeva, Bhāsuri, .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naro'haṃ cāpi nārada .
jābāliḥ parśurāmaścāpyagastyaḥ paila eva ca .. 10 ..
meaning:
संवर्तश्चाप्युतथ्यश्च नरोऽहं चापि नारद .
जाबालिः पर्शुरामश्चाप्यगस्त्यः पैल एव च .. 10 ..
text_mt: Saṃvarta, Utathya, Nara, and I myself, O Nārada, / Jābāli, Paraśurāma, Agastya, and Paila, .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yudhāmanyurgau ramukho'pyupamanyuḥ śrṛtaśravāḥ .
maitreyaścyavanaścaiva vararucyarṣireva ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
युधामन्युर्गौ रमुखोऽप्युपमन्युः श्रृतश्रवाः .
मैत्रेयश्च्यवनश्चैव वररुच्यर्षिरेव च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Yudhāmanyu, Gauramukha, Upamanyu, Śrutaśravas, / Maitreya, Cyavana, and the sage Vararuci. .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāñjaliḥ .
siṃhāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa sādaram .. 12 ..
meaning:
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय नमस्कृत्य पुटाञ्जलिः .
सिंहासनेषु रम्येषु वासयामास सादरम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Seeing them, rising up at once and bowing with folded hands, / he respectfully seated them on delightful thrones. .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkuśalapraśnapūrvakam .
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya madhye kṛṣṇa uvāsa saḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पूजयामास विधिवत्कुशलप्रश्नपूर्वकम् .
परस्परं च संभाष्य मध्ये कृष्ण उवास सः .. 13 ..
text_mt: He honoured them according to the rules, preceded by inquiries after their welfare; / and conversing with one another, Kṛṣṇa sat in their midst. .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇastejorāśiṃ dadarśa saḥ .
daduśuste ca munayo'pyākāśe ca samujjvalam .. 14 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णस्तेजोराशिं ददर्श सः .
ददुशुस्ते च मुनयोऽप्याकाशे च समुज्ज्वलम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, Kṛṣṇa saw a mass of light; / and those sages too saw it blazing brightly in the sky. .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tejaso'bhyantare vatsa kumāraṃ kanakaprabhām .
yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaṃ nagnaṃ bālakamīpsitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
तेजसोऽभ्यन्तरे वत्स कुमारं कनकप्रभाम् .
यथैव पञ्चवर्षीयं नग्नं बालकमीप्सितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Within that light, O child, [was] Kumāra of golden splendour, / like an alluring five-year-old naked child. .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbabhūva sahasā samāmadhye ca nārada .
uttiṣṭamānaṃ sahasā taṃ dṛṣṭvā munapuṃgavāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
आविर्बभूव सहसा समामध्ये च नारद .
उत्तिष्टमानं सहसा तं दृष्ट्वा मुनपुंगवाः .. 16 ..
text_mt: He appeared suddenly in the midst of the assembly, O Nārada. / Seeing him suddenly standing up, the foremost sages .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve śauriśca praṇanāma tam .
sasmitaṃ snigdhanetraṃ cakṛtvā yuktiṃ ca sādaram .. 17 ..
meaning:
प्रणेमुर्मुनयः सर्वे शौरिश्च प्रणनाम तम् .
सस्मितं स्निग्धनेत्रं चकृत्वा युक्तिं च सादरम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: bowed down, all the sages; and Śauri bowed to him, / making smiling and affectionate eyes, joining his hands respectfully. .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvānāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāsa ca saṃsadi .
uvāca tāṃśca śauriṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 18 ..
meaning:
स सर्वानाशिषं कृत्वा समुवास च संसदि .
उवाच तांश्च शौरिं च भगवन्तं सनातनम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having blessed everyone, he sat in the assembly / and spoke to them and to Śauri, the eternal Blessed One. .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam .
kṛṣṇasya kuśalapraśnaṃ sivabījasya niṣphalam .. 19 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
भद्रं वो मुनयः शश्वत्तपसां फलमीप्सितम् .
कृष्णस्य कुशलप्रश्नं सिवबीजस्य निष्फलम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / May there be welfare to you, O sages! Forever [you have] the desired fruit of your austerities. / An inquiry about Kṛṣṇa's welfare, the seed of auspiciousness, is pointless. .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃprataṃ kuśulaṃ vaśca darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ .
bhaktānurodhāddehasya parasya prakṛterapi .. 20 ..
meaning:
सांप्रतं कुशुलं वश्च दर्शनं परमात्मनः .
भक्तानुरोधाद्देहस्य परस्य प्रकृतेरपि .. 20 ..
text_mt: At present your welfare is the sight of the Paramātman, / who, out of regard for his devotees, has taken a body beyond even Prakṛti, .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇāsya nirīhasya sarvabījasya teyasā .
bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cā''virbhūtasya sāṃpratam .. 21 ..
meaning:
निर्गुणास्य निरीहस्य सर्वबीजस्य तेयसा .
भारावतरणायैव चा'ऽविर्भूतस्य सांप्रतम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: who is devoid of the gunas, desireless, the seed of all through his splendour, / and who has now manifested solely to remove the burden [of the earth]. .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
śarīradhāriṇaścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam .
tatkathaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ mayi vipra na vidyate .. 22 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
शरीरधारिणश्चापि कुशलप्रश्नमीप्सितम् .
तत्कथं कुशलप्रश्नं मयि विप्र न विद्यते .. 22 ..
text_mt: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / For one who bears a body, an inquiry after welfare is desired. / Why then, O brahmin, should an inquiry after welfare not apply to me? .. 22 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śarīre prākṛte nātha saṃtataṃ ca śubhāśubham .
nityadehe kṣemabīje śivapraśnamanarthakam .. 23 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शरीरे प्राकृते नाथ संततं च शुभाशुभम् .
नित्यदेहे क्षेमबीजे शिवप्रश्नमनर्थकम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / In a material body, O Lord, good and evil constantly exist; / but in an eternal body, the seed of safety, an inquiry after auspiciousness is meaningless. .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
yo yo vigrahadhārī ca sa ca prākṛtikaḥ smṛtāḥ .
deho na vidyate vipra tāṃ nityāṃ prākṛtiṃ vinā .. 24 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यो यो विग्रहधारी च स च प्राकृतिकः स्मृताः .
देहो न विद्यते विप्र तां नित्यां प्राकृतिं विना .. 24 ..
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / Whoever possesses a form is remembered as material. / O brahmin, a body does not exist without that eternal Prakṛti. .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
raktabindūdbhavā dehāste ca prākṛtikā smṛtāḥ .
kathaṃ prakṛtināthasya bījasya prākṛtaṃ vapuḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
रक्तबिन्दूद्भवा देहास्ते च प्राकृतिका स्मृताः .
कथं प्रकृतिनाथस्य बीजस्य प्राकृतं वपुः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Bodies born from drops of blood are considered material; / how can the form of the master of Prakṛti, the seed, be material? .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabījasya sarvādirbhavāṃśca bhagavānsvayam .
sarveṣāmavatāraṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam .. 26 ..
meaning:
सर्वबीजस्य सर्वादिर्भवांश्च भगवान्स्वयम् .
सर्वेषामवतारणां प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: You are the seed of all, the source of all, the Blessed One himself, / the primal, imperishable seed of all incarnations. .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vadanti vedāśca nityaṃ satyaṃ sanātanam .
jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam .. 27 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा वदन्ति वेदाश्च नित्यं सत्यं सनातनम् .
ज्योतिःस्वरूपं प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having investigated, the Vedas proclaim you to be eternal, true, and without beginning, / having the nature of light, the primal, imperishable seed. .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā saguṇaṃ caiva māyeśaṃ nirguṇaṃ param .
pravadanti ca vedāṅgāstathā vedavidaḥ prabho .. 28 ..
meaning:
मायया सगुणं चैव मायेशं निर्गुणं परम् .
प्रवदन्ति च वेदाङ्गास्तथा वेदविदः प्रभो .. 28 ..
text_mt: With the gunas through Māyā, and the Lord of Māyā, beyond the gunas, supreme, / so the auxiliary branches of the Vedas and the knowers of the Vedas proclaim, O Lord. .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
saṃprataṃ vāsudevo'haṃ raktapīryāśritaṃ vapuḥ .
kathaṃ na prakṛto vipra śivapraśnamabhīpsitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
संप्रतं वासुदेवोऽहं रक्तपीर्याश्रितं वपुः .
कथं न प्रकृतो विप्र शिवप्रश्नमभीप्सितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'At present, I am Vāsudeva, a body resting upon blood and semen. / How am I not material, O twice-born? This is the desired question of Śiva.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu .
tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva itīritaḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
वासुः सर्वनिवासश्च विश्वानि यस्य लोमसु .
तस्य देवः परं ब्रह्म वासुदेव इतीरितः .. 30 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / '"Vāsu" means the dwelling of all, on whose body hairs all the universes rest. / His Lord is the supreme Brahman; therefore He is called Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeveti tannāma vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca .
purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu yātrādiṣu ca dṛśyate .. 31 ..
meaning:
वासुदेवेति तन्नाम वेदेषु च चतुर्षु च .
पुराणेष्वितिहासेषु यात्रादिषु च दृश्यते .. 31 ..
text_mt: That name Vāsudeva is seen in the four Vedas, / in the Purāṇas, in the Itihāsas, and in sacred journeys and rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
raktavīryāśrito dehaḥ kva te vede nirūpitaḥ .
sākṣiṇo munayaścaiva dharmaḥ sarvatra eva ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
रक्तवीर्याश्रितो देहः क्व ते वेदे निरूपितः .
साक्षिणो मुनयश्चैव धर्मः सर्वत्र एव च .. 32 ..
text_mt: Where in the Veda is Your body defined as resting upon blood and semen? / The sages and Dharma everywhere are indeed witnesses;

sanskrit_iast: sākṣiṇo mama vedāśca ravicandau ca saṃpratam .. 33 ..
meaning: साक्षिणो मम वेदाश्च रविचन्दौ च संप्रतम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: and the Vedas, the sun, and the moon are presently my witnesses.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguruvāca
satyaṃ vadasi tvameva vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ .
svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ śaśvatkiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
भृगुरुवाच
सत्यं वदसि त्वमेव वैष्णवाग्रणीः .
स्वागतं कुशलं शश्वत्किंनिमित्तमिहा'ऽगतः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Bhṛgu said: / 'You speak the truth; you are indeed foremost among Vaiṣṇavas. / Welcome, may you be well always! For what reason have you come here?'

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrūyatāṃ kṛṣṇa sāṃpratam .
aho yena nimittena cātiśīghramihā''gataḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
श्रूयतां मुनयः सर्वे श्रूयतां कृष्ण सांप्रतम् .
अहो येन निमित्तेन चातिशीघ्रमिहा'ऽगतः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / 'Listen, all sages! Listen now, O Kṛṣṇa! / Ah, for what reason I have come here in great haste.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bhagavanmarvadharmajña kiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ .
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña tvameva viduṣāṃ varaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
भगवन्मर्वधर्मज्ञ किंनिमित्तमिहा'ऽगतः .
सर्वं जानासि सर्वज्ञ त्वमेव विदुषां वरः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'O lord, knower of all dharma, for what reason have you come here? / You know all, O omniscient one; you alone are the best among the learned.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
dhanyo'si bhagavañchaśvanmānyo'si jagatāmapi .
sarveśvareśvaro'si tvaṃ tatparo nāsti viśvataḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
धन्योऽसि भगवञ्छश्वन्मान्योऽसि जगतामपि .
सर्वेश्वरेश्वरोऽसि त्वं तत्परो नास्ति विश्वतः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / 'You are blessed, O Lord, always revered even by the worlds! / You are the Lord of all lords; there is none beyond Him in the universe.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasyānāṃ dvijeśvara.
satataṃ phaladātā'haṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ya .. 38 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
यज्ञानां च व्रतानां च तपस्यानां द्विजेश्वर.
सततं फलदाताऽहं दक्षिणाभिः सहेति य .. 38 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Of sacrifices, vows, and austerities, O lord of twice-born, / I am always the giver of fruits together with the priestly fees.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā kumāraśca javena prayayau vane .
matvā''ścarya ca vacanaṃ vārayāmāsa te'pitam .. 39 ..
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा कुमारश्च जवेन प्रययौ वने .
मत्वा'ऽश्चर्य च वचनं वारयामास तेऽपितम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Hearing this, Kumāra went swiftly into the forest. / Considering His speech an wonder, he stopped what he had spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
he siddhendra mahābhāga kumāra karuṇāmaya .
kā śaṅkitakathā proktā bhagavatkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. 40 ..
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
हे सिद्धेन्द्र महाभाग कुमार करुणामय .
का शङ्कितकथा प्रोक्ता भगवत्कृष्णसंनिधौ .. 40 ..
text_mt: The sages said: / 'O lord of Siddhas, most fortunate one, Kumāra, full of compassion! / What doubtful matter was spoken in the presence of the blessed Kṛṣṇa?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ putra dṛṣṭamāścarya śrutaṃ kimapi kutracit .
atīva kṛtvā vistīrṇamasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 41 ..
meaning:
किं पुत्र दृष्टमाश्चर्य श्रुतं किमपि कुत्रचित् .
अतीव कृत्वा विस्तीर्णमस्माकं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 41 ..
text_mt: What wonder was seen, O son, or what was heard anywhere? / You should explain it to us in great detail.'

sanskrit_iast:
eta sminnnatare brahmā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ .
anantaścāpi dharmaśca śrīsūryaśca niśākaraḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
एत स्मिन्न्नतरे ब्रह्मा पार्वत्या सह शंकरः .
अनन्तश्चापि धर्मश्च श्रीसूर्यश्च निशाकरः .. 42 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, Brahmā, Śaṅkara together with Pārvatī, / Ananta, Dharma, the glorious Sūrya, and the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sahasotthāya saṃbhādhya capṛthakpṛthaku .. 43 ..
meaning:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा दिक्पालाद्याश्च देवताः .
श्रीकृष्णः सहसोत्थाय संभाध्य चपृथक्पृथकु .. 43 ..
text_mt: the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the deities headed by the guardians of the directions [arrived]. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, rising suddenly, addressed them each individually;

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .
praṇesurṛṣayaḥ sarve śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ vidhiṃ śivām .. 44 ..
meaning:
मधुपर्कादिकं दत्त्वा पूजयामास भक्तितः .
प्रणेसुरृषयः सर्वे शेषं शंभुं विधिं शिवाम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: having offered the honey-mixture and other honors, He worshipped them with devotion. / All the sages bowed down to Śeṣa, Śambhu, Vidhi, and Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣā babhūva dvijadevayoḥ .
samuvāsā''sane madhye kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe saṃsadi dvijadevayoḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
परस्परं च संभाषा बभूव द्विजदेवयोः .
समुवासा'ऽसने मध्ये कुमारः कनकप्रभः ..
कथां कथितुमारेभे संसदि द्विजदेवयोः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
A conversation took place between the twice-born and the gods. / Kumāra, radiant as gold, sat down upon a seat in their midst,
and began to speak these words in the assembly of twice-born and gods:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā gataśca goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ .
tato gataṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra nāsti caturbhujaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
मया गतश्च गोलोको न दृष्टो राधिकापतिः .
ततो गतं च वैकुण्ठं तत्र नास्ति चतुर्भुजः .. 46 ..
text_mt: 'I went to Goloka, but the lord of Rādhikā was not seen. / Then I went to Vaikuṇṭha; the four-armed Lord was not there.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gataśca kṣīrodastatra nāsti hariḥ svayam .
pariśrānto viṣaṇṇaśca snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe .. 47 ..
meaning:
ततो गतश्च क्षीरोदस्तत्र नास्ति हरिः स्वयम् .
परिश्रान्तो विषण्णश्च स्नातं क्षीरोदधेस्तटे .. 47 ..
text_mt: Then I went to the Ocean of Milk; Hari Himself was not there. / Weary and despondent, I bathed on the shore of the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇavālukāmadhye kacchapaḥ śatayojanaḥ .
bhītaśca kampitastatra dṛṣṭo duḥkhī ca śuṣkitaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
विस्तीर्णवालुकामध्ये कच्छपः शतयोजनः .
भीतश्च कम्पितस्तत्र दृष्टो दुःखी च शुष्कितः .. 48 ..
text_mt: In the midst of the vast sand, a tortoise of a hundred yojanas, / frightened, trembling, distressed, and dried up, was seen there,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsārito rāghaveṇa mīnena ca mahātmanā .
dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca saḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
निःसारितो राघवेण मीनेन च महात्मना .
धन्योऽसीति मयोक्तश्च नाहं धन्य उवाच सः .. 49 ..
text_mt: cast out by a rāghava fish, that mighty creature. / "You are blessed!" said I, but he said: "I am not blessed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ .
matto mahattarāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāśca mahāmune .. 50 ..
meaning:
क्षीरोदः सागरो धन्यो जन्तवो यत्र मद्विधाः .
मत्तो महत्तराश्चापि ह्यसंख्याश्च महामुने .. 50 ..
text_mt: The Ocean of Milk is blessed, wherein creatures like me / and countlessly greater than me exist, O great sage!"

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāndhanyo'sti kṣīroda tenokto nāhameva ca .
dhanyā vasuṃdharā devī yatraiva saptasāgarāḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
भवान्धन्योऽस्ति क्षीरोद तेनोक्तो नाहमेव च .
धन्या वसुंधरा देवी यत्रैव सप्तसागराः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Said [by me], "You are blessed, O Ocean of Milk," he said, "Not I indeed! / Blessed is the goddess Earth, upon whom are the seven oceans."

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyā'si vasudhetyuktā nāhamevetyuvāca sā .
dhanyo'nanto mamā''dhāraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo nāgarāḍvibhuḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
धन्याऽसि वसुधेत्युक्ता नाहमेवेत्युवाच सा .
धन्योऽनन्तो ममा'ऽधारः कृष्णांशो नागराड्विभुः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Said, "You are blessed, O Earth," she said, "Not I indeed! / Blessed is Ananta, my support, a portion of Kṛṣṇa, the all-pervading king of serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
mahasramūrdhnā madhye'haṃ mūrdhni śūrpe ca sarṣapaḥ .
dhanyo'si śeṣetyukto'yaṃ dhanyo nāhamuvāca vai .. 53 ..
meaning:
महस्रमूर्ध्ना मध्येऽहं मूर्ध्नि शूर्पे च सर्षपः .
धन्योऽसि शेषेत्युक्तोऽयं धन्यो नाहमुवाच वै .. 53 ..
text_mt: Upon his thousand heads, I am in the middle like a mustard seed on a winnowing basket." / Said, "You are blessed, O Śeṣa," he said, "I am truly not blessed.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaḥ kūrmo mamā''dhāro gaccha tatraiva vai mune .
dhanyo'si kūrmetyukto'yaṃ nāraṃ dhanyo'smi vai mune .. 54 ..
meaning:
धन्यः कूर्मो ममा'ऽधारो गच्छ तत्रैव वै मुने .
धन्योऽसि कूर्मेत्युक्तोऽयं नारं धन्योऽस्मि वै मुने .. 54 ..
text_mt: Blessed is the tortoise, my support; go right there, O sage!" / Said, "You are blessed, O Tortoise," he said, "Truly I am not blessed, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyunā dhāryamāṇo'haṃ matto dhanyatamaśca saḥ .
dhanyo'sītyuktaḥ pavano dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
वायुना धार्यमाणोऽहं मत्तो धन्यतमश्च सः .
धन्योऽसीत्युक्तः पवनो धन्यो नाहमुवाच सः .. 55 ..
text_mt: I am sustained by the wind; he is far more blessed than I." / Said, "You are blessed," the Wind said, "I am not blessed.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaśca bhagavānbrahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi .
dhanyo'si tatra dhātā ca dhanyo nāhamuvācasaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
धन्यश्च भगवान्ब्रह्मा विधाता जगतामपि .
धन्योऽसि तत्र धाता च धन्यो नाहमुवाचसः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Blessed is the blessed Brahmā, the creator of the worlds." / Said there, "You are blessed, O Creator," he said, "I am not blessed.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo maheśvaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ .
sarvārādhyaḥ sarvapūjyo dharmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
धन्यो महेश्वरो देवो योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः .
सर्वाराध्यः सर्वपूज्यो धर्मरूपः सनातनः .. 57 ..
text_mt: Blessed is the god Maheśvara, the guru of the gurus among lords of yogins, / adored by all, worshipful to all, the eternal embodiment of dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
kālakālaśca saṃhartā svayaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ prabhuḥ .
dhanyo'si tatra śaṃbhuśca dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
कालकालश्च संहर्ता स्वयं मृत्युंजयः प्रभुः .
धन्योऽसि तत्र शंभुश्च धन्यो नाहमुवाच सः .. 58 ..
text_mt: the death of death, the destroyer, the lord Mṛtyuñjaya Himself." / Said there, "You are blessed, O Śambhu," he said, "I am not blessed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādau pūjanaṃ yasya jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ .
dhanyo gaṇeśvaro devo devānāṃ pravaraḥ paraḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
सर्वादौ पूजनं यस्य ज्ञानिनां च गुरोर्गुरुः .
धन्यो गणेश्वरो देवो देवानां प्रवरः परः .. 59 ..
text_mt: The one whose worship is foremost of all, the guru of the gurus among the wise, / blessed is the god Gaṇeśvara, the best and highest among gods.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu devendreṣu śrutau śrutam .
yogīndreṣu ca prājñeṣu na gaṇeśātparaḥ pumān .. 60 ..
meaning:
सिद्धेन्द्रेषु मुनीन्द्रेषु देवेन्द्रेषु श्रुतौ श्रुतम् .
योगीन्द्रेषु च प्राज्ञेषु न गणेशात्परः पुमान् .. 60 ..
text_mt: Among lords of Siddhas, lords of sages, and lords of gods, it is heard in the Veda / that among lords of yogins and the wise, there is no person higher than Gaṇeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
nimnagāsu yathā gaṅagā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā .
vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
निम्नगासु यथा गङगा तीर्थेषु पुष्करं यथा .
वेदप्रणिहितो धर्मो ह्यधर्मस्तद्विपर्ययः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Just as the Gaṅgā is among rivers, just as Puṣkara is among sacred places, / so dharma is that which is ordained by the Veda, and adharma is its opposite.

sanskrit_iast:
vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvayaṃ pūjyā vyavasthayā .
tasmācchāstrāṇi sarvāṇi purāṇāni ca santi vai .. 62 ..
meaning:
वेदो नारायणः साक्षाद्वयं पूज्या व्यवस्थया .
तस्माच्छास्त्राणि सर्वाणि पुराणानि च सन्ति वै .. 62 ..
text_mt: The Veda is Nārāyaṇa directly; we are worshipful according to its ordinance. / From it arise all the scriptures and the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānnirūpito dharmaścetihāsaśca saṃhitā .
tasmāddhanyāśca te vedā vadantyatra manīṣiṇāḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
यस्मान्निरूपितो धर्मश्चेतिहासश्च संहिता .
तस्माद्धन्याश्च ते वेदा वदन्त्यत्र मनीषिणाः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Since dharma, the Itihāsa, and the Saṃhitā are established by it, / therefore those Vedas are blessed," so the wise say here.

sanskrit_iast:
yūyaṃ dhanyāśca mānyāścetyuktā vedā mayā tataḥ .
ūyuste na vayaṃ dhanyā yajñasaṃghaśya sāṃpratam .. 64 ..
meaning:
यूयं धन्याश्च मान्याश्चेत्युक्ता वेदा मया ततः .
ऊयुस्ते न वयं धन्या यज्ञसंघश्य सांप्रतम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: Then, addressed by me: "You are blessed and worthy of honor," the Vedas / said: "We are not blessed; the multitude of sacrifices [is now].

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ vyavasthākartāro yajñaughaḥ phaladaḥ svayam .
tasmāddhanyaḥ sa evāpi gaccha gaccha mahāmune .. 65 ..
meaning:
वयं व्यवस्थाकर्तारो यज्ञौघः फलदः स्वयम् .
तस्माद्धन्यः स एवापि गच्छ गच्छ महामुने .. 65 ..
text_mt: We are the makers of the ordinance; the assembly of sacrifices itself gives the fruit. / Therefore, that alone is blessed. Go, go, O great sage!"

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo'si yajñasaṃgho'sītyuktastatra mayā vibho .
ūcuste na vayaṃ dhanyā dhanyaṃ karma śubhaṃ mune .. 66 ..
meaning:
धन्योऽसि यज्ञसंघोऽसीत्युक्तस्तत्र मया विभो .
ऊचुस्ते न वयं धन्या धन्यं कर्म शुभं मुने .. 66 ..
text_mt: Addressed by me there: "You are blessed, O multitude of sacrifices," O Lord, / they said: "We are not blessed; auspicious action is blessed, O sage!"

sanskrit_iast:
śubhakarmāsi dhanyaṃ tvaṃ nāhaṃ dhanyamuvāca tat .
karmaṇāṃ phaladātā yaḥ karmahetuśca sāṃpratam .. 67 ..
meaning:
शुभकर्मासि धन्यं त्वं नाहं धन्यमुवाच तत् .
कर्मणां फलदाता यः कर्महेतुश्च सांप्रतम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: "You are blessed, O auspicious action!"—it said: "I am not blessed. / He who gives the fruit of actions and is the cause of action now,

sanskrit_iast:
dhāturvidhātā bhagavānsarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā ca dhanyo mānyaścaniścitam .. 68 ..
meaning:
धातुर्विधाता भगवान्सर्वादिः सर्वकारकः .
श्रीकृष्णः परमात्मा च धन्यो मान्यश्चनिश्चितम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: the creator of the Creator, the Lord, the origin of all, the maker of all, / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, is certainly blessed and worthy of honor."

sanskrit_iast:
dharmālayaṃ tato gatvā na duṣṭvā jagadīśvaram .
mathurāmāgato draṣṭuṃ paripūrṇatam prabhum .. 69 ..
meaning:
धर्मालयं ततो गत्वा न दुष्ट्वा जगदीश्वरम् .
मथुरामागतो द्रष्टुं परिपूर्णतम् प्रभुम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Having gone thence to the abode of Dharma and not having seen the Lord of the universe, / I have come to Mathurā to see the most perfect Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva vratānāṃ śubhakarmaṇām .
īśvaraṃ phaladātāraṃ paramātmānameva ca .. 70 ..
meaning:
यज्ञानां तपसां चैव व्रतानां शुभकर्मणाम् .
ईश्वरं फलदातारं परमात्मानमेव च .. 70 ..
text_mt: the Lord and giver of fruits of sacrifices, austerities, / vows, and auspicious actions, the Paramātman Himself,

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ puraḥsaram .
dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ca .. 71 ..
meaning:
कारणं कारणानां च ब्रह्मादीनां पुरःसरम् .
धन्योऽसीति मयोक्तश्च दक्षिणाभिः सहेति च .. 71 ..
text_mt: the cause of causes, who precedes Brahmā and the others. / And [so] it was said by me: "You are blessed, together with the priestly fees!"'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktena bhagavatā kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam .
dakṣiṇābhiśca phalado hatayajño ṅyadakṣiṇāḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तेन भगवता कथितं सर्वकारणम् .
दक्षिणाभिश्च फलदो हतयज्ञो ङ्यदक्षिणाः .. 72 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus, the Blessed Lord explained the cause of everything: / only with priestly gifts [a sacrifice] bears fruit; a sacrifice without priestly gifts is ruined.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇā vipramuddiśya tatkāle tu na dīyate .
ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet .. 73 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणा विप्रमुद्दिश्य तत्काले तु न दीयते .
एकरात्रे व्यतीते तु तद्दानं द्विगुणं भवेत् .. 73 ..
text_mt: When a priestly gift intended for a brahmin is not given at that very time, / if a single night passes, that gift becomes doubled.

sanskrit_iast:
māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam .
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet .. 74 ..
meaning:
मासे शतगुणं प्रोक्तं द्विमासे तु सहस्रकम् .
संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स दाता नरकं व्रजेत् .. 74 ..
text_mt: In a month it is said to become a hundredfold, and in two months a thousandfold; / if a year passes, that giver goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca mūtrakuṇḍe nipatya ca .
tataścāṇa़ḍālatāṃ yāti vyādhiyuktaśca pātakī .. 75 ..
meaning:
वर्षाणां च सहस्रं च मूत्रकुण्डे निपत्य च .
ततश्चाण़डालतां याति व्याधियुक्तश्च पातकी .. 75 ..
text_mt: Falling into the pit of urine for a thousand years, / from there the sinner becomes an outcaste, afflicted with disease.

sanskrit_iast:
dātrā na dīyate dānaṃ grahītrā cenna gṛhyate .
ubhau tau narakaṃ prāptau varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam .. 76 ..
meaning:
दात्रा न दीयते दानं ग्रहीत्रा चेन्न गृह्यते .
उभौ तौ नरकं प्राप्तौ वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: If a gift is not given by the giver, or if it is not accepted by the recipient, / both of them attain hell for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānaśca cāṇḍālo brahmaṇastatpurohitaḥ .
vyādhiyuktāvubhau tau ca pāpinau karmaṇaḥ phalāt .. 77 ..
meaning:
यजमानश्च चाण्डालो ब्रह्मणस्तत्पुरोहितः .
व्याधियुक्तावुभौ तौ च पापिनौ कर्मणः फलात् .. 77 ..
text_mt: The patron of the sacrifice becomes an outcaste, and that family priest of the brahmin likewise; / both of those sinners become afflicted with disease through the fruit of their deed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve devāśca munayo jahasurvismayaṃ yayuḥ .
vismayaṃ ca yayau nandastatyāja putrabhāvakam .. 78 ..
meaning:
सर्वे देवाश्च मुनयो जहसुर्विस्मयं ययुः .
विस्मयं च ययौ नन्दस्तत्याज पुत्रभावकम् .. 78 ..
text_mt: All the gods and sages laughed and were filled with wonder; / Nanda too was filled with wonder, and gave up his attitude toward him as a son.

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda ca sabhāmadhye lajjāhīnaḥ śucā''kulaḥ .
tyaja mauhamitītyuktvā bodhayāmāsa pārvatī .. 79 ..
meaning:
रुरोद च सभामध्ये लज्जाहीनः शुचा'ऽकुलः .
त्यज मौहमितीत्युक्त्वा बोधयामास पार्वती .. 79 ..
text_mt: He wept in the midst of the assembly, shameless and overwhelmed with grief; / saying, 'Cast off your delusion,' Pārvatī consoled him.

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca
amūlyaratnaṃ māṇikyaṃ yathā kujanmano gṛhe .
sthitaṃ tena ca deveśa tathā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho .. 80 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच
अमूल्यरत्नं माणिक्यं यथा कुजन्मनो गृहे .
स्थितं तेन च देवेश तथाऽहं वञ्चितः प्रभो .. 80 ..
text_mt: Nanda said: / Just as a priceless jewel, a ruby, staying in the house of a low-born man / [is neglected] by him, O Lord of gods, so was I deceived, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāparādhaṃ bhagavān kṣamasva prakṛteḥ para .
yāsyāmi na punargehaṃ gokulaṃ yamunātaṭam .. 81 ..
meaning:
ममापराधं भगवान् क्षमस्व प्रकृतेः पर .
यास्यामि न पुनर्गेहं गोकुलं यमुनातटम् .. 81 ..
text_mt: Forgive my offense, Blessed Lord beyond Prakṛti! / I will not return again to my home, to Gokula, or to the bank of the Yamunā,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndāvanaṃ tathā''vāsaṃ krīḍāvāsaṃ gadāgraja .
tatsarvaṃ ca yaśodāyā gopikāntikameva ca .. 82 ..
meaning:
वृन्दावनं तथा'ऽवासं क्रीडावासं गदाग्रज .
तत्सर्वं च यशोदाया गोपिकान्तिकमेव च .. 82 ..
text_mt: nor to Vṛndāvana, nor to our dwelling, nor to the dwelling of pastimes, O elder brother of Gadā, / nor to any of that belonging to Yaśodā, nor to the presence of the cowherd women.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bravīmi yaśodāṃ ya preyasīṃ rādhikāmapi .
premapātraṃ ca bālaughaṃ vada bhoḥ kathayāmi kim .. 83 ..
meaning:
किं ब्रवीमि यशोदां य प्रेयसीं राधिकामपि .
प्रेमपात्रं च बालौघं वद भोः कथयामि किम् .. 83 ..
text_mt: What shall I say to Yaśodā, or even to your beloved Rādhikā, / or to the group of boys who are the objects of your affection? Tell me, sir, what shall I say?

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca sabhāmadhye marcchāṃ saṃprāpa nārada .
kroḍe kṛtvā jagannātho bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam .. 84 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च सभामध्ये मर्च्छां संप्राप नारद .
क्रोडे कृत्वा जगन्नाथो बोधयामास तत्क्षणम् .. 84 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus in the midst of the assembly, he fainted, O Nārada; / taking him on his lap, the Lord of the World immediately consoled him.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 87 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the great Brahmavaivarta, being the conversation between the Blessed Lord and Nanda, related by Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇā uvāca
cetanaṃ kuru he tāta he tāta cetanaṃ kuru .
jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णा उवाच
चेतनं कुरु हे तात हे तात चेतनं कुरु .
जलबुद्बुदवत्सर्वं संसारं सचराचरम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now the eighty-eighth chapter. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Regain your senses, O father! O father, regain your senses! / The entire world, moving and unmoving, is like a water-bubble.
title: athāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
tyāja mohaṃ mahābhāga māyāṃ stauhi paratparāmā .
brahmasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ sarvamohanikṛntanīm .. 2 ..
meaning:
त्याज मोहं महाभाग मायां स्तौहि परत्परामा .
ब्रह्मस्वरूपां परमां सर्वमोहनिकृन्तनीम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Cast off delusion, O most fortunate one, and praise Māyā, who is higher than the highest, / having the nature of Brahman, supreme, the destroyer of all delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
muktipradāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm .
tripurasya vadhe ghore mahāyuddhe bhayākule .. 3 ..
meaning:
मुक्तिप्रदां महाभागां विष्णुमायां सनातनीम् .
त्रिपुरस्य वधे घोरे महायुद्धे भयाकुले .. 3 ..
text_mt: the bestower of liberation, highly fortunate, the eternal Viṣṇumāyā, / with which hymn of praise, during the terrible slaying of Tripura in the great battle filled with terror,

sanskrit_iast:
yena stotreṇa saṃbhuśca tayā daityaṃ jaghāna saḥ .
stotrarājaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvamohanikṛntanam ..
sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nanda śrūyatāmatra saṃsadi .. 4 ..
meaning:
येन स्तोत्रेण संभुश्च तया दैत्यं जघान सः .
स्तोत्रराजं प्रदास्यामि सर्वमोहनिकृन्तनम् ..
सर्ववाञ्छाप्रदं नन्द श्रूयतामत्र संसदि .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Śambhu killed that demon by her [grace]. / I shall give you that king of hymns of praise, which destroys all delusion,
and bestows all desires, O Nanda; let it be heard here in this assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca
sarvavighnavināśāya duḥkhapraśamanāya ca .
vibhūtaye ca yaśase nṛṇāṃ vāñchitasiddhaye .. 5 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच
सर्वविघ्नविनाशाय दुःखप्रशमनाय च .
विभूतये च यशसे नृणां वाञ्छितसिद्धये .. 5 ..
text_mt: Nanda said: / For the destruction of all obstacles, for the pacification of sorrow, / for prosperity and fame, and for the fulfillment of men's desires,

sanskrit_iast:
stotramekaṃ mahādevyā jaganmāturjagatprabho .
paraṃ durgatināśinyā gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्तोत्रमेकं महादेव्या जगन्मातुर्जगत्प्रभो .
परं दुर्गतिनाशिन्या गोपनीयं सुदुर्लभम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: give me, O Lord of the world, that one supreme hymn of praise of the Great Goddess, the mother of the universe, / the destroyer of distress, which is to be kept secret and is exceedingly hard to attain;

sanskrit_iast:
dehi marhya vinītāya bhaktāya bhaktavatsala .
vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca nirguṇāśca parātparaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
देहि मर्ह्य विनीताय भक्ताय भक्तवत्सल .
वेदानां जनकस्त्वं च निर्गुणाश्च परात्परः .. 7 ..
text_mt: give it to me, your humble devotee, O lover of your devotees! / You are the father of the Vedas, beyond the gunas, and higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
śruṇu vakṣyāmi daiśyendra stotraṃ yatparamādbhutam .
sarvavighnavināśārthaṃ mohapāśanikṛntanam .. 8 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
श्रुणु वक्ष्यामि दैश्येन्द्र स्तोत्रं यत्परमाद्भुतम् .
सर्वविघ्नविनाशार्थं मोहपाशनिकृन्तनम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / Listen, O king of cowherds, I shall speak that most wondrous hymn of praise / meant for the destruction of all obstacles and the severing of the bonds of delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
raṇatrastena vibhunā śaṃkareṇa purā kṛtam .
nārāyaṇopadeśena preritena ca brahmaṇā .. 9 ..
meaning:
रणत्रस्तेन विभुना शंकरेण पुरा कृतम् .
नारायणोपदेशेन प्रेरितेन च ब्रह्मणा .. 9 ..
text_mt: which was composed long ago by the all-pervading Śaṅkara when terrified in battle, / upon the instruction of Nārāyaṇa and impelled by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrugrastaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa brahmāṇamuvāca ha .
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ brahmā rathasthaṃ patitaṃ raṇe .. 10 ..
meaning:
शत्रुग्रस्तं शिवं दृष्ट्वा स ब्रह्माणमुवाच ह .
उवाच शंकरं ब्रह्मा रथस्थं पतितं रणे .. 10 ..
text_mt: Seeing Śiva overwhelmed by the enemy, he spoke indeed to Brahmā; / then Brahmā spoke to Śaṅkara, who stood in his chariot, fallen in battle:

sanskrit_iast:
surasaṃkaṭaśāntyarthaṃ durgā durgatināśinīm .
mūlaprakṛtimādyāṃ tāṃ stau(stu) hi brahmasvarūpiṇīm .. 11 ..
meaning:
सुरसंकटशान्त्यर्थं दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनीम् .
मूलप्रकृतिमाद्यां तां स्तौ(स्तु) हि ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: 'For the pacification of the distress of the gods, praise Durgā, the destroyer of distress, / that primordial Mūlaprakṛti who has the nature of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇā prerito'haṃ ca tvāṃ vadāmi sureśvara .
vinā śaktisahāyena ko vā kaṃ jetumīśvaraḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
हरिणा प्रेरितोऽहं च त्वां वदामि सुरेश्वर .
विना शक्तिसहायेन को वा कं जेतुमीश्वरः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Impelled by Hari, I tell you this, O Lord of the gods: / without the aid of Śakti, who indeed is capable of conquering whom?'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ .
puṭāñjaliparo bhūtvā bhaktinamratmakaṃdharaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणश्च वचः श्रुत्वा दुर्गां सस्मार शंकरः .
पुटाञ्जलिपरो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रत्मकंधरः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Hearing Brahmā's words, Śaṅkara remembered Durgā, / joining his hands in reverence, bowing his neck in devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥpādau ca prakṣālya dhṛtvā dhaute vāsasī .
ācāntaḥ kuśahastaśca śucirviṣṇuṃ ca saṃsmaran .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्नातःपादौ च प्रक्षाल्य धृत्वा धौते वाससी .
आचान्तः कुशहस्तश्च शुचिर्विष्णुं च संस्मरन् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having bathed and washed his feet, wearing two clean garments, / having sipped water, holding kuśa grass in hand, pure, and remembering Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
rakṣa rakṣa mahādevi durge durgatināśini .
māṃ bhaktamanuraktaṃ ca śatrugraste kṛpāmayi .. 15 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
रक्ष रक्ष महादेवि दुर्गे दुर्गतिनाशिनि .
मां भक्तमनुरक्तं च शत्रुग्रस्ते कृपामयि .. 15 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / Protect me, protect me, O Great Goddess! O Durgā, destroyer of distress! / Protect me, your devoted and affectionate servant, overwhelmed by the enemy, O compassionate one!

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāye mahābhāge nārāyaṇi sanātani .
brahmasvarūpe parame nityānandasvarūpiṇi .. 16 ..
meaning:
विष्णुमाये महाभागे नारायणि सनातनि .
ब्रह्मस्वरूपे परमे नित्यानन्दस्वरूपिणि .. 16 ..
text_mt: O Viṣṇumāyā, O highly fortunate one, O Nārāyaṇī, O eternal one! / Having the nature of Brahman, supreme one, whose very nature is eternal bliss!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca brahmādidevānāmambike jagadambike .
tvaṃ saṃhāre ca guṇato nirākāre ca nirguṇāt .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्वं च ब्रह्मादिदेवानामम्बिके जगदम्बिके .
त्वं संहारे च गुणतो निराकारे च निर्गुणात् .. 17 ..
text_mt: You are the mother of the gods headed by Brahmā, O Mother of the universe! / In cosmic dissolution you are [manifested] from the gunas, and in the formless [state] from the gunaless.

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā puruṣastvaṃ ca māyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam .
tayoḥ paraṃ brahma paraṃ tvaṃ bibharṣi sanātani .. 18 ..
meaning:
मायया पुरुषस्त्वं च मायया प्रकृतिः स्वयम् .
तयोः परं ब्रह्म परं त्वं बिभर्षि सनातनि .. 18 ..
text_mt: Through Māyā you are Puruṣa, and through Māyā you yourself are Prakṛti; / beyond both of them, you sustain the supreme Brahman, O eternal one!

sanskrit_iast:
vedānāṃ jananī tvaṃ ca sāvitrī ca parātparā .
vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarvamaṃpatsvarūpiṇī .. 19 ..
meaning:
वेदानां जननी त्वं च सावित्री च परात्परा .
वैकुण्ठे च महालक्ष्मीः सर्वमंपत्स्वरूपिणी .. 19 ..
text_mt: You are the mother of the Vedas, Sāvitrī, higher than the highest; / and in Vaikuṇṭha you are Mahālakṣmī, the embodiment of all fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
martyalakṣmīśca kṣīrode kāminī śeṣaśāyinaḥ .
svargeṣu svargalakṣmīstvaṃ rājalakṣmīśca bhūtale .. 20 ..
meaning:
मर्त्यलक्ष्मीश्च क्षीरोदे कामिनी शेषशायिनः .
स्वर्गेषु स्वर्गलक्ष्मीस्त्वं राजलक्ष्मीश्च भूतले .. 20 ..
text_mt: You are the Lakshmi of mortals, and in the ocean of milk you are the beloved of him who reclines on Śeṣa; / in the heavens you are the Lakshmi of heaven, and on the surface of the earth the Lakshmi of kings;

sanskrit_iast:
nāgādilakṣmīḥ pātāle gṛheṣu gṛhadevatā .
sarvasasyasvarūpā tvaṃ sarvaiśvaryavidhāyinī .. 21 ..
meaning:
नागादिलक्ष्मीः पाताले गृहेषु गृहदेवता .
सर्वसस्यस्वरूपा त्वं सर्वैश्वर्यविधायिनी .. 21 ..
text_mt: the Lakshmi of the serpent-beings and others in the underworld, and the household deity in homes; / having the nature of all crops, you grant all sovereign power.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ brahmaṇaśca sarasvatī .
prāṇānāmadhidepī tvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
रागाधिष्ठातृदेवी त्वं ब्रह्मणश्च सरस्वती .
प्राणानामधिदेपी त्वं कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः .. 22 ..
text_mt: You are the presiding goddess of musical melodies, and Sarasvatī belonging to Brahmā; / you are the presiding deity of the life-breaths of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

sanskrit_iast:
goloke ca svayaṃ rādhā śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva vakṣasi .
golokādhiṣṭhitā devī dṛndā dṛndāvane vane .. 23 ..
meaning:
गोलोके च स्वयं राधा श्रीकृष्णस्यैव वक्षसि .
गोलोकाधिष्ठिता देवी दृन्दा दृन्दावने वने .. 23 ..
text_mt: In Goloka you yourself are Rādhā on the chest of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; / presiding over Goloka, you are the goddess Vṛndā in the forest of Vṛndāvana;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāsamaṇḍale ramyā vṛndāvanavinodinī .
śataśṛṅgādhidevī tvaṃ nāmnā citrāvalīti ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
श्रीरासमण्डले रम्या वृन्दावनविनोदिनी .
शतशृङ्गाधिदेवी त्वं नाम्ना चित्रावलीति च .. 24 ..
text_mt: charming in the sacred circular dance, sporting in Vṛndāvana; / you are the presiding goddess of Śataśṛṅga, named Citrāvalī.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣakanyā kutrakalpe kutrakalpe ca śailajā .
devamātā'ditistvaṃ ca sarvādhārā vasuṃdharā .. 25 ..
meaning:
दक्षकन्या कुत्रकल्पे कुत्रकल्पे च शैलजा .
देवमाताऽदितिस्त्वं च सर्वाधारा वसुंधरा .. 25 ..
text_mt: In one eon you are the daughter of Dakṣa, and in another eon the daughter of the Mountain; / you are Aditi, the mother of the gods, and the earth, the support of all.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva gaṅgā tulasī tvaṃ ca svāhā satī .
tvadaṃśāṃśāṃśakalayā sarvadevādiyoṣitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव गङ्गा तुलसी त्वं च स्वाहा सती .
त्वदंशांशांशकलया सर्वदेवादियोषितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: You alone are Gaṅgā, Tulasī, Svāhā, and the devoted wife Satī; / through your portions of portions and parts of portions, all the wives of the gods and others exist.

sanskrit_iast:
strīrūpaṃ cātipuṃrūpaṃ devi tvaṃ ca napuṃsakam .
vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛṅarūpā tvaṃ sṛṣṭā cāṅkurarūpiṇī .. 27 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीरूपं चातिपुंरूपं देवि त्वं च नपुंसकम् .
वृक्षाणां वृङरूपा त्वं सृष्टा चाङ्कुररूपिणी .. 27 ..
text_mt: You are the female form, and the extremely masculine form, O Goddess, and also the neuter; / you are the form of trees among trees, and the sprout in creation.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnau ca dāhikā śaktirjale śaityasvarūpiṇī .
sūrye tejaḥ svarūpā ca prabhārūpā ca saṃtatam .. 28 ..
meaning:
वह्नौ च दाहिका शक्तिर्जले शैत्यस्वरूपिणी .
सूर्ये तेजः स्वरूपा च प्रभारूपा च संततम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: You are the burning power in fire, the nature of coolness in water, / the nature of splendour in the sun, and perpetually its radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharūpā ca bhūmau ca ākāśe śabdarūpiṇī .
śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmasaṃghe ca niścitam .. 29 ..
meaning:
गन्धरूपा च भूमौ च आकाशे शब्दरूपिणी .
शोभास्वरूपा चन्द्रे च पद्मसंघे च निश्चितम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: You are the nature of fragrance in the earth, and the nature of sound in space; / in the moon and in the cluster of lotuses, you are surely the nature of beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisvarūpā ca pālane paripālikā .
mahāmārī ca saṃhāre jale ca jalarūpiṇī .. 30 ..
meaning:
सृष्टौ सृष्टिस्वरूपा च पालने परिपालिका .
महामारी च संहारे जले च जलरूपिणी .. 30 ..
text_mt: In creation you are the nature of creation, in maintenance the protectress, / in destruction the great pestilence, and in water having the nature of water.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuttavaṃ dayā tvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ tṛṣṇā tvaṃ buddhirūpiṇī .
tuṣṭistvaṃ cāpi puṣṭistvaṃ śraddhāstvaṃ ca kṣamā svayam .. 31 ..
meaning:
क्षुत्तवं दया त्वं निद्रा त्वं तृष्णा त्वं बुद्धिरूपिणी .
तुष्टिस्त्वं चापि पुष्टिस्त्वं श्रद्धास्त्वं च क्षमा स्वयम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: You are hunger, you are compassion, you are sleep, you are thirst, you are the form of intellect; / you are contentment, you are nourishment, you are faith, and you are forbearance itself.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntistvaṃ ca svayaṃ bhrāntiḥ kāntistavaṃ kīrtireva ca .
lajjā tvaṃ ca tathā māyā bhukti- ..
suktisvarūpiṇī .. 32 ..
meaning:
शान्तिस्त्वं च स्वयं भ्रान्तिः कान्तिस्तवं कीर्तिरेव च .
लज्जा त्वं च तथा माया भुक्ति- ..
सुक्तिस्वरूपिणी .. 32 ..
text_mt: You are peace, and you yourself are delusion, beauty, and fame; / you are modesty, and likewise [you are] Māyā, enjoyment, —

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ sarvasaṃbatpradāyinī .
vede'nirvacanīyā tvaṃ tvāṃ na jānāti kaścana .. 33 ..
meaning:
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपा त्वं सर्वसंबत्प्रदायिनी .
वेदेऽनिर्वचनीया त्वं त्वां न जानाति कश्चन .. 33 ..
text_mt: You are the embodiment of all powers, the giver of all prosperity; / you are indefinable in the Veda, and no one knows you.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasra vaktrastvāṃ stotuṃ na ca śaktaḥ sureśvari .
vedā na śaktāḥ ko vidvānna ca śaktā sarasvatī .. 34 ..
meaning:
सहस्र वक्त्रस्त्वां स्तोतुं न च शक्तः सुरेश्वरि .
वेदा न शक्ताः को विद्वान्न च शक्ता सरस्वती .. 34 ..
text_mt: Even the thousand-faced [Śeṣa] is unable to praise you, O Queen of the gods; / the Vedas are not able, what wise man [could be]? Nor is Sarasvatī able.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ vidhātā śakto na na ca viṣṇuḥ manātanaḥ .
kiṃ staumi pañcavaktraistu raṇatrasto maheśvari .. 35 ..
meaning:
स्वयं विधाता शक्तो न न च विष्णुः मनातनः .
किं स्तौमि पञ्चवक्त्रैस्तु रणत्रस्तो महेश्वरि .. 35 ..
text_mt: The Creator himself is not able, nor is eternal Viṣṇu; / how can I praise [you] with five faces, terrified in battle, O Maheśvarī?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ kuru mahāmāye mama śatrukṣayaṃ kuru .
ityuktvā ca sakaruṇaṃ rathasthe patite raṇe .. 36 ..
meaning:
कृपां कुरु महामाये मम शत्रुक्षयं कुरु .
इत्युक्त्वा च सकरुणं रथस्थे पतिते रणे .. 36 ..
text_mt: Have mercy, O Mahāmāyā! Bring about the destruction of my enemy!" / Having spoken thus piteously, when the chariot-rider had fallen in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbabhūva sā durgā sūryakoṭisamaprabhā .
nārāyaṇena kṛpayā preritā paramātmanā .. 37 ..
meaning:
आविर्बभूव सा दुर्गा सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभा .
नारायणेन कृपया प्रेरिता परमात्मना .. 37 ..
text_mt: that Durgā appeared, equal in splendour to ten million suns, / impelled through compassion by Nārāyaṇa, the Paramātman,

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya purataḥ śīghraṃ śivāya ca jayāya ca .
ityuvāca mahādevī māyāśaktyā'suraṃ jahi .. 38 ..
meaning:
शिवस्य पुरतः शीघ्रं शिवाय च जयाय च .
इत्युवाच महादेवी मायाशक्त्याऽसुरं जहि .. 38 ..
text_mt: before Śiva at once, for the auspiciousness and victory of Śiva. / Thus the great goddess spoke: "Slay the demon by your illusory power!"

sanskrit_iast:
durgovāca
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam .
bhavānvaraḥ surāṇāṃ ca jayaṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmyaham .. 39 ..
meaning:
दुर्गोवाच
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि वाञ्छितम् .
भवान्वरः सुराणां च जयं तुभ्यं ददाम्यहम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Durgā said: / "Choose a boon, blessings upon you, whatever is desired in your heart; / you are the best of the gods, and I grant you victory."

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
kṣayo bhavatu daityasya iti me varamīśvarī .
dehīti vāñchitaṃ durge paramādye malātani .. 40 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
क्षयो भवतु दैत्यस्य इति मे वरमीश्वरी .
देहीति वाञ्छितं दुर्गे परमाद्ये मलातनि .. 40 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / "'May the destruction of the Daitya take place'—this is my boon, O Goddess; / grant what is desired, O Durgā, O Supreme, Primordial, and Eternal One!"

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavatyuvāca
hariṃ smara mahābhāgā jaya daityaṃ jagadguruḥ .
svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavāṃstvameva jyotirīśvaraḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
भगवत्युवाच
हरिं स्मर महाभागा जय दैत्यं जगद्गुरुः .
स्वयं विधाता भगवांस्त्वमेव ज्योतिरीश्वरः .. 41 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Goddess said: / "Remember Hari, O fortunate one; conquer the Daitya, O teacher of the universe! / The Lord, the Creator himself, you alone are the light and the sovereign Lord."

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare viṣṇurvṛṣarūpo babhūva ha .
dadhāra kalayā mūrdhnā śūlapāṇe rathaṃ vibhuḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुर्वृषरूपो बभूव ह .
दधार कलया मूर्ध्ना शूलपाणे रथं विभुः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, Viṣṇu assumed the form of a bull; / with a portion [of himself] the all-pervading lord held up the chariot of the trident-bearer with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvacakramathograṃ ca prakṛtiṃ ca cakāra saḥ .
śastraṃ dadau mantrapūtamuddadhāra tato ratham .. 43 ..
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वचक्रमथोग्रं च प्रकृतिं च चकार सः .
शस्त्रं ददौ मन्त्रपूतमुद्दधार ततो रथम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Then he raised the fierce wheel and restored the normal state; / he gave a weapon consecrated by mantras, and then lifted up the chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ śastraṃ gṛhītvā ca dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ maheśvarīm .
jaghāna tripuraṃ śīghraṃ sa papāta mahītale .. 44 ..
meaning:
शिवः शस्त्रं गृहीत्वा च ध्यात्वा विष्णुं महेश्वरीम् .
जघान त्रिपुरं शीघ्रं स पपात महीतले .. 44 ..
text_mt: Taking the weapon and meditating upon Viṣṇu and Maheśvarī, / Śiva swiftly struck Tripura; he fell to the earth's surface.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ devāścakuśca puṣpavarṣaṇam .
durgā tasmai dadau śūraṃ pinākaṃ viṣṇureva ca .. 45 ..
meaning:
तुष्टुवुः शंकरं देवाश्चकुश्च पुष्पवर्षणम् .
दुर्गा तस्मै ददौ शूरं पिनाकं विष्णुरेव च .. 45 ..
text_mt: The gods praised Śaṅkara and showered flowers; / Durgā gave him the hero's [valour], and Viṣṇu [gave him] the Pināka bow.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā śubhāśiṣaṃ caiva munayaścāpi harṣitāḥ .
nanṛturdevatāḥ sarvā jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा शुभाशिषं चैव मुनयश्चापि हर्षिताः .
ननृतुर्देवताः सर्वा जगुर्गन्धर्वकिन्नराः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Brahmā [gave] auspicious blessings, and the sages were delighted; / all the deities danced, and the Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tāta stavarājamanuttamam .
vighnavighnakaraṃ śīghraṃ śatrusaṃhārakāraṇam .. 47 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तात स्तवराजमनुत्तमम् .
विघ्नविघ्नकरं शीघ्रं शत्रुसंहारकारणम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Meanwhile, dear one, this supreme king of hymns / instantly removes obstacles and brings about the destruction of enemies;

sanskrit_iast:
paramaiśvaryajanakaṃ sukhadaṃ paramaṃ śubham .
nirvāṇamokṣadaṃ caiva haribhaktipradaṃ dhruvam .. 48 ..
meaning:
परमैश्वर्यजनकं सुखदं परमं शुभम् .
निर्वाणमोक्षदं चैव हरिभक्तिप्रदं ध्रुवम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: it produces supreme sovereignty, gives happiness, and is supremely auspicious; / it truly grants the liberation of nirvāṇa and bestows devotion to Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
golokavāsadaṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam .
stotrarājaprapaṭhanātprasannā pārvatī sadā .. 49 ..
meaning:
गोलोकवासदं चैव सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं वरम् .
स्तोत्रराजप्रपठनात्प्रसन्ना पार्वती सदा .. 49 ..
text_mt: it grants residence in Goloka and bestows all excellent accomplishments; / from reciting this king of hymns, Pārvatī is always pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
lobhamohakāmakrodhakarmamūlanikṛntanam .
balabuddhikaraṃ caiva janmamṛtyuvināśanam .. 50 ..
meaning:
लोभमोहकामक्रोधकर्ममूलनिकृन्तनम् .
बलबुद्धिकरं चैव जन्ममृत्युविनाशनम् .. 50 ..
text_mt: It cuts away the root of actions arising from greed, delusion, lust, and anger; / it grants strength and intellect, and destroys birth and death;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaputrapriyābhūmisarvasaṃpatpradaṃ nṛṇām .
śokaduḥkhaharaṃ caiva sarvāmiddhipradaṃ varam .. 51 ..
meaning:
धनपुत्रप्रियाभूमिसर्वसंपत्प्रदं नृणाम् .
शोकदुःखहरं चैव सर्वामिद्धिप्रदं वरम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: it gives wealth, sons, a beloved, land, and all prosperity to men; / it dispels grief and sorrow, and bestows all excellent accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
stotrarājaprapaṭhanānmahāvandhyā prasūyate .
vandhanānmucyate duḥkhī bhayānmucyeta niścitam .. 52 ..
meaning:
स्तोत्रराजप्रपठनान्महावन्ध्या प्रसूयते .
वन्धनान्मुच्यते दुःखी भयान्मुच्येत निश्चितम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: From reciting this king of hymns, an utterly barren woman gives birth; / one who is sorrowful is freed from bondage, and one is surely freed from fear;

sanskrit_iast:
rogādvimucyate rogī daridraśca dhanī bhaven .
dāvāgnimadhye na mṛto magnaḥ poto mahārṇave .. 53 ..
meaning:
रोगाद्विमुच्यते रोगी दरिद्रश्च धनी भवेन् .
दावाग्निमध्ये न मृतो मग्नः पोतो महार्णवे .. 53 ..
text_mt: a diseased person is freed from disease, and a pauper becomes wealthy; / one does not die in the midst of a forest fire, [nor] when a boat is sunk in the great ocean;

sanskrit_iast:
dasyugrasto nipugrasto hiṃsrajantusamanvitaḥ .
stotreṇānena vaiśyendra kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
दस्युग्रस्तो निपुग्रस्तो हिंस्रजन्तुसमन्वितः .
स्तोत्रेणानेन वैश्येन्द्र कल्याणं लभते नरः .. 54 ..
text_mt: seized by robbers, seized by an enemy, or surrounded by predatory beasts, / a man attains well-being by means of this hymn, O best of Vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasānāṃ yathā ratnamāśramāṇāṃ dvijo yathā .
nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā .. 55 ..
meaning:
तैजसानां यथा रत्नमाश्रमाणां द्विजो यथा .
नदीनां च यथा गङ्गा मन्त्राणां प्रणवो यथा .. 55 ..
text_mt: As a jewel is among luminous objects, as a twice-born is among the stages of life, / as Gaṅgā is among rivers, as the praṇava is among mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
tulasī sarvapatrāṇāṃ dharāṇāṃ ca vasuṃdharā .
puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaṃ ca kāṣṭhānāṃ candanaṃ yathā .. 56 ..
meaning:
तुलसी सर्वपत्राणां धराणां च वसुंधरा .
पुष्पाणां पारिजातं च काष्ठानां चन्दनं यथा .. 56 ..
text_mt: as Tulasī is among all leaves, and the Earth is among upholders, / as the pārijāta is among flowers, and sandalwood is among woods,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇupūjā ca tapasāṃ vrateṣvekādaśī yathā .
jñānināṃ ca yathā śaṃbhuḥ siddhānāṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
विष्णुपूजा च तपसां व्रतेष्वेकादशी यथा .
ज्ञानिनां च यथा शंभुः सिद्धानां च गणेश्वरः .. 57 ..
text_mt: as worship of Viṣṇu is among austerities, as Ekādaśī is among vows, / as Śambhu is among the wise, and Gaṇeśvara is among the perfected,

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvedāḥ śāstreṣu tantrataḥ .
devīnāṃ ca yathā durgā śāntānāṃ kamalā yathā .. 58 ..
meaning:
देवानां च यथा विष्णुर्वेदाः शास्त्रेषु तन्त्रतः .
देवीनां च यथा दुर्गा शान्तानां कमला यथा .. 58 ..
text_mt: as Viṣṇu is among gods, and the Vedas are systematically among treatises, / as Durgā is among goddesses, and Kamalā is among the tranquil,

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatī ca viduṣāṃ rādhikā sundarīṣu ca .
tathā stotreṣvidaṃ stotraṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ vraja .. 59 ..
meaning:
सरस्वती च विदुषां राधिका सुन्दरीषु च .
तथा स्तोत्रेष्विदं स्तोत्रं नातः परतरं व्रज .. 59 ..
text_mt: as Sarasvatī is among the learned, and Rādhikā is among beauties, / so among hymns, go [knowing that] this hymn has none superior to it.

sanskrit_iast:
purā dattaṃ brahmaṇe ca puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi .
daityagrastāya bhītāya sarvadurgaharaṃ param .. 60 ..
meaning:
पुरा दत्तं ब्रह्मणे च पुष्करे सूर्यपर्वणि .
दैत्यग्रस्ताय भीताय सर्वदुर्गहरं परम् .. 60 ..
text_mt: Formerly it was given to Brahmā at Puṣkara on a solar eclipse, / when he was seized by a Daitya and terrified—the supreme [hymn] dispelling all distress.

sanskrit_iast:
śivāya śatrugrastāya dadau brahmā madājñayā .
śivaśca sanakādibhyaḥ purā durvāsase dadau .. 61 ..
meaning:
शिवाय शत्रुग्रस्ताय ददौ ब्रह्मा मदाज्ञया .
शिवश्च सनकादिभ्यः पुरा दुर्वाससे ददौ .. 61 ..
text_mt: Brahmā gave it by my command to Śiva when he was beset by an enemy; / and Śiva gave it long ago to Sanaka and the others, and to Durvāsas.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavānkṛpayā gautamāya ca .
pulahāya pulastyāya dadau cāṅgirase mudā .. 62 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्कृपया गौतमाय च .
पुलहाय पुलस्त्याय ददौ चाङ्गिरसे मुदा .. 62 ..
text_mt: The lord Sanatkumāra gave it through compassion to Gautama, / and gladly gave it to Pulaha, Pulastya, and Aṅgiras;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yandrāya sūryāya sūryaścāpi yamāya ca .
yamāśca citraguptāya kṛpayā ca purā dadau .. 63 ..
meaning:
तथा यन्द्राय सूर्याय सूर्यश्चापि यमाय च .
यमाश्च चित्रगुप्ताय कृपया च पुरा ददौ .. 63 ..
text_mt: likewise [it was given] to the Moon and the Sun; and the Sun gave it to Yama, / and Yama formerly gave it through compassion to Citragupta.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ paṭhiṣyasi stotraṃ golokagamanāya vai .
sākṣātpaśyasi bho tāta tāmeva pārvatīmiha .. 64 ..
meaning:
नित्यं पठिष्यसि स्तोत्रं गोलोकगमनाय वै .
साक्षात्पश्यसि भो तात तामेव पार्वतीमिह .. 64 ..
text_mt: You should recite this hymn daily for attainment of Goloka; / O dear one, you will see that very Pārvatī here face to face.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pāpine gopanaṃ kuru .
nārāyaṇasya bhaktāya śāntāya viduṣe tathā .. 65 ..
meaning:
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं पापिने गोपनं कुरु .
नारायणस्य भक्ताय शान्ताय विदुषे तथा .. 65 ..
text_mt: It should not be given to just anyone; keep it concealed from a sinner; / to a devotee of Nārāyaṇa, to one who is tranquil, and likewise to a wise man,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñāya ca viprāya dātavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ .
viprāya vṛṣavāhāya vṛṣalīvataye tathā .. 66 ..
meaning:
सर्वज्ञाय च विप्राय दातव्यं च प्रयत्नतः .
विप्राय वृषवाहाय वृषलीवतये तथा .. 66 ..
text_mt: and to an all-knowing Brahmin it should be given with great effort. / [Never] to a Brahmin who rides an ox, or to the husband of a Śūdra woman,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārāya śūdrakṣāddhānnabhojine .
kanyāvikraciṇe caiva brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
शूद्राणां सूपकाराय शूद्रक्षाद्धान्नभोजिने .
कन्याविक्रचिणे चैव ब्राह्मणाय विशेषतः .. 67 ..
text_mt: to a cook of Śūdras, to one who eats food from a Śūdra's funeral feast, / and especially to a Brahmin who sells his daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhiṃ ca labhate siddhastotre bhavedyadi .
daśāyutajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिं च लभते सिद्धस्तोत्रे भवेद्यदि .
दशायुतजपेनैव सिद्धस्तोत्रो भवेन्नरः .. 68 ..
text_mt: And one obtains all perfection if one has mastered the hymn; / by chanting it one hundred thousand times, a man attains mastery of the hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
agnistamabhaṃ jalastambhaṃ mṛtstambhaṃ manasastathā .
aśvamedhasahasrācca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇāt .. 69 ..
meaning:
अग्निस्तमभं जलस्तम्भं मृत्स्तम्भं मनसस्तथा .
अश्वमेधसहस्राच्च पृथिव्याश्च प्रदक्षिणात् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Arresting fire, arresting water, arresting earth, and likewise [arresting] the mind; / [more than] a thousand horse-sacrifices, and circumambulation of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
snānācca sarvatīrthānāṃ stotrametacca puṇyadam .
dattaṃ tubhyaṃ mayā tāta mama prāṇasamaṃ vraja .. 70 ..
meaning:
स्नानाच्च सर्वतीर्थानां स्तोत्रमेतच्च पुण्यदम् .
दत्तं तुभ्यं मया तात मम प्राणसमं व्रज .. 70 ..
text_mt: and bathing in all sacred fords, this hymn bestows greater merit; / given to you by me, dear one, equal to my own life's breath, go!

sanskrit_iast:
stavanaṃ kuru pārvatyāścedānīṃ mama saṃsadi .
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandastuṣṭāva pārvatīm .. 71 ..
meaning:
स्तवनं कुरु पार्वत्याश्चेदानीं मम संसदि .
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नन्दस्तुष्टाव पार्वतीम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Make praise now to Pārvatī in my assembly." / Hearing the words of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Nanda praised Pārvatī

sanskrit_iast:
stotreṇānena viprendra sarvasaṃpatpradāyinīm .
varaṃ tasmai dadau durgā golokavāsamīpsitam .. 72 ..
meaning:
स्तोत्रेणानेन विप्रेन्द्र सर्वसंपत्प्रदायिनीम् .
वरं तस्मै ददौ दुर्गा गोलोकवासमीप्सितम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: with this hymn, O best of Brahmins, which bestows all prosperity. / Durgā granted him a boon: his desired residence in Goloka,

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ vede yanna śrutaṃ mune .
rājendratvaṃ gokule ca kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām .. 73 ..
meaning:
दुर्लभं परमं ज्ञानं वेदे यन्न श्रुतं मुने .
राजेन्द्रत्वं गोकुले च कृष्णभक्तिं सुदुर्लभाम् .. 73 ..
text_mt: supreme knowledge hard to attain, which is not heard in the Veda, O sage, / kingship in Gokula, and devotion to Kṛṣṇa that is very hard to obtain,

sanskrit_iast:
taddāsvaṃ cāvi parato mahattvaṃ siddhameva ca .
varaṃ dattvā yayau durgā saṃbhāṣya śaṃbhunā saha .. 74 ..
meaning:
तद्दास्वं चावि परतो महत्त्वं सिद्धमेव च .
वरं दत्त्वा ययौ दुर्गा संभाष्य शंभुना सह .. 74 ..
text_mt: servitude to Him, and beyond that, established greatness. / Having granted the boon, Durgā departed after conversing with Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
jagmurdevāśca munayaḥ stutvā ca nandanandanam .
uvāca nandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vraja nanda vrajānvitaḥ ..
prahaṣṭastyaktamohaśca bodhena durlabhena ca .. 75 ..
meaning:
जग्मुर्देवाश्च मुनयः स्तुत्वा च नन्दनन्दनम् .
उवाच नन्दं श्रीकृष्णो व्रज नन्द व्रजान्वितः ..
प्रहष्टस्त्यक्तमोहश्च बोधेन दुर्लभेन च .. 75 ..
text_mt:
And the gods and sages departed after praising the delight of Nanda. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa spoke to Nanda: “Go, Nanda, accompanied by the people of Vraja,
overjoyed, with delusion cast away by means of this rare understanding.” .. 75 ..

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣmajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 88 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्मजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
अष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 88 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, in the dialogue between the Lord and Nanda, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa [conversation], in the latter part of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa, in the glorious Mahā-Brahmavaivarta. .. 88 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
gaccha gaccha gṛhaṃ gaccha vrajarāja vrajaṃ vraja .
sarvaṃ tattvaṃ tvayā jñātaṃ dṛṣṭāśca munayaḥ surāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
गच्छ गच्छ गृहं गच्छ व्रजराज व्रजं व्रज .
सर्वं तत्त्वं त्वया ज्ञातं दृष्टाश्च मुनयः सुराः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the eighty-ninth chapter. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Go, go, go home, king of Vraja; go to Vraja. / You have known all truth, and you have seen the sages and gods. .. 1 ..
title: atha navāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śrutaṃ me dhanyamākhyānaṃ nānākhyānaṃ sudurlabham .
durgāyāḥ stotrarājaṃ ca janmapāśanikṛntanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रुतं मे धन्यमाख्यानं नानाख्यानं सुदुर्लभम् .
दुर्गायाः स्तोत्रराजं च जन्मपाशनिकृन्तनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: You have heard my blessed narrative, diverse and exceedingly rare narratives, / and Durgā's king of hymns, which cuts through the snare of rebirth. .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sthitaṃ tate nigaditaṃ harṣeṇa ca sukhena ca .
matkṛtaṃ bālabhāvena cāparāddhaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्थितं तते निगदितं हर्षेण च सुखेन च .
मत्कृतं बालभावेन चापराद्धं च तत्क्षणम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: It has been told to you, father, with joy and happiness. / Forgive in an instant whatever offence I committed as a child. .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yatsukhaṃ na kṛtaṃ tāta pitrośca nṛpamandire .
kṛtaṃ sukhaṃ tatparaṃ ca svargādapi sudurlabham .. 4 ..
meaning:
यत्सुखं न कृतं तात पित्रोश्च नृपमन्दिरे .
कृतं सुखं तत्परं च स्वर्गादपि सुदुर्लभम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: The happiness that was not given to [my] parents in the king’s palace, father, / was given [to you] as supreme bliss, exceedingly rare even in heaven. .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
madīyaṃ priyavākyaṃ ca prahvatvaṃ vinayaṃ nayam .
parihāsaṃ bahataraṃ yaśodāṃ gopikāgaṇam .. 5 ..
meaning:
मदीयं प्रियवाक्यं च प्रह्वत्वं विनयं नयम् .
परिहासं बहतरं यशोदां गोपिकागणम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: My affectionate speech, humility, modesty, right conduct, / and frequent jesting with Yaśodā, the group of gopīs, .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bālakānāṃ samūhaṃ ca rādhāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ .
ekatra ca sthitaṃ teṣu bandhuvargeṣu karmaṇā .. 6 ..
meaning:
बालकानां समूहं च राधां चापि विशेषतः .
एकत्र च स्थितं तेषु बन्धुवर्गेषु कर्मणा .. 6 ..
text_mt: the assembly of boys, and especially with Rādhā, / abiding together among those kinsfolk by the power of past deeds. .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ihaivāpi sukhaṃ bhuktvā gaccha golokamuttamam .
sārdha yaśodayā tāta rohiṇyā gopikāgaṇaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
इहैवापि सुखं भुक्त्वा गच्छ गोलोकमुत्तमम् .
सार्ध यशोदया तात रोहिण्या गोपिकागणैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having enjoyed happiness right here, go to supreme Goloka / together with Yaśodā, father, Rohiṇī, and the hosts of gopīs. .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gopānāṃ bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhānena gopakaiḥ .
rādhāmātrā kalāvatyā rādhayā saha yāsyasi .. 8 ..
meaning:
गोपानां बालकैः सार्धं वृषभानेन गोपकैः .
राधामात्रा कलावत्या राधया सह यास्यसि .. 8 ..
text_mt: Together with the boys of the cowherds, with Vṛṣabhānu and the cowherds, / with Rādhā's mother Kalāvatī, and with Rādhā, you will go. .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rathānāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca golokādāgataṃ pitaḥ .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hīrahārapariṣkṛtam .. 9 ..
meaning:
रथानां शतलक्षं च गोलोकादागतं पितः .
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं हीरहारपरिष्कृतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: A hundred hundred-thousand chariots have come from Goloka, father, / fashioned of priceless jewels and adorned with diamond necklaces, .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
maṇimāṇikyamuktānāṃ mālājālavibhūṣitam .
vahniśuddhāṃśukai ramyairācchannaṃ pītavarṇakaiḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
मणिमाणिक्यमुक्तानां मालाजालविभूषितम् .
वह्निशुद्धांशुकै रम्यैराच्छन्नं पीतवर्णकैः .. 10 ..
text_mt: decorated with nets of garlands of gems, rubies, and pearls, / and covered with charming garments purified by fire, yellow in color, .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pārṣadapravarai ramyairveṣṭitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ .
sadratnadarpaṇai ramyairgopikābhiśca gopakaiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
पार्षदप्रवरै रम्यैर्वेष्टितं श्वेतचामरैः .
सद्रत्नदर्पणै रम्यैर्गोपिकाभिश्च गोपकैः .. 11 ..
text_mt: surrounded by excellent attendants, charming with white chowries, / and surrounded by lovely mirrors of fine gems, by gopīs and cowherds. .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭitaṃ ca tadāruhya kautukādyāsyasi dhruvam .
tyaktvā ca pārthivaṃ dehaṃ divyadehaṃ vidhāya ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
वेष्टितं च तदारुह्य कौतुकाद्यास्यसि ध्रुवम् .
त्यक्त्वा च पार्थिवं देहं दिव्यदेहं विधाय च .. 12 ..
text_mt: Ascending that, you will surely go with delight, / abandoning the earthly body and assuming a divine body. .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā rādhāmātā kalāvatī .
yāsyatyeva hi tenaiva nityadehena niścitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसंभवा राधा राधामाता कलावती .
यास्यत्येव हि तेनैव नित्यदेहेन निश्चितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Rādhā, not born of a womb, and Rādhā's mother Kalāvatī / will indeed go with that very eternal body, certainly. .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā kalāvatī .
dhanyā ca sītāmātā ca durgāmātā ca menakā .. 14 ..
meaning:
पितृणां मानसी कन्या धन्या मान्या कलावती .
धन्या च सीतामाता च दुर्गामाता च मेनका .. 14 ..
text_mt: The mind-born daughter of the ancestors, the blessed and venerable Kalāvatī; / blessed also is Sītā’s mother, and Durgā's mother Menakā. .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisaṃbhavā durgā tārā sītā ca sundarī .
ayonisaṃbhavāstāśca dhanyā menā kalāvatī .. 15 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसंभवा दुर्गा तारा सीता च सुन्दरी .
अयोनिसंभवास्ताश्च धन्या मेना कलावती .. 15 ..
text_mt: Not born of a womb are Durgā, Tārā, and beautiful Sītā; / and those [mothers] who bore them without a womb—blessed Menā and Kalāvatī. .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityeva kathitaṃ tāta gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham .
varo'yaṃ tattastubhyaṃ ca mayā ca durgayā tathā .. 16 ..
meaning:
इत्येव कथितं तात गोपनीयं सुदुर्लभम् .
वरोऽयं तत्तस्तुभ्यं च मया च दुर्गया तथा .. 16 ..
text_mt: Thus, father, has been told this secret, exceedingly rare; / this boon was given in truth to you both by me and by Durgā.” .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ .
punareva jagannāthaṃ ta dbhakto bhaktavātsalam .. 17 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच व्रजेश्वरः .
पुनरेव जगन्नाथं त द्भक्तो भक्तवात्सलम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having heard Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s words, the lord of Vraja spoke back / once again to the Lord of the Universe, his devotee [speaking] to the one affectionate to devotees. .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca
yugānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yaṃ yaṃ dharma sanātanam .
krameṇa kṛṣṇa vistīrṇaṃ kṛtvā māṃ kathaya prabho .. 18 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच
युगानां च चतुर्णां च यं यं धर्म सनातनम् .
क्रमेण कृष्ण विस्तीर्णं कृत्वा मां कथय प्रभो .. 18 ..
text_mt: Nanda said: / “Whichever eternal duty belongs to each of the four yugas, / tell me that at length in proper order, O Lord Kṛṣṇa! .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kaliśeṣe bhavedyadyadguṇadoṣaṃ kalestathā .
kā gatirvā pṛthivyāśca dharmasya praṇināṃ tathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
कलिशेषे भवेद्यद्यद्गुणदोषं कलेस्तथा .
का गतिर्वा पृथिव्याश्च धर्मस्य प्रणिनां तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Whatever virtue and fault of Kali will arise at the close of Kali, / and what will be the state of the earth, of dharma, and of living beings?” .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ kamalalocanaḥ .
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe vicitrāṃ madhurānvitām .. 20 ..
meaning:
नन्दस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टः कमललोचनः .
कथां कथितुमारेभे विचित्रां मधुरान्विताम् .. 20 ..
text_mt: Having heard Nanda’s words, the lotus-eyed one rejoiced / and began to tell a wondrous and exceedingly sweet story. .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇa janmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavanna-
ndasaṃo ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 89 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्ण जन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्न-
न्दसंओ एकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 89 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, in the dialogue between the Lord and Nanda, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa [conversation], in the latter part of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa, in the glorious Mahā-Brahmavaivarta. .. 89 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyami sānandaṃ mānasaṃ yathā .
kathāṃ ramyāṃ sumadhurāṃ purāṇeṣu pariṣkṛtām .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
शृणु नन्द प्रवक्ष्यमि सानन्दं मानसं यथा .
कथां रम्यां सुमधुरां पुराणेषु परिष्कृताम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the ninetieth chapter. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Listen, Nanda; I shall tell, so that your mind becomes joyful, / a charming and very sweet tale, embellished in the Purāṇas. .. 1 ..
title: atha navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
paripūrṇatamo dharmo dhārmikāśca kṛte yuge .
paripūrṇatamaṃ satyaṃ paripūrṇatamā dayā .. 2 ..
meaning:
परिपूर्णतमो धर्मो धार्मिकाश्च कृते युगे .
परिपूर्णतमं सत्यं परिपूर्णतमा दया .. 2 ..
text_mt: In the Kṛta yuga, dharma is at its fullest, and people are righteous; / truth is most complete, and compassion is at its fullest. .. 2 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atīva prajvaladrūpā vedāścatvāra eva ca .
vedāṅgāścāpi pipidhāsāścetihāsāca saṃhitāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
अतीव प्रज्वलद्रूपा वेदाश्चत्वार एव च .
वेदाङ्गाश्चापि पिपिधासाश्चेतिहासाच संहिताः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Exceedingly radiant are the four Vedas themselves, / and the various limbs of the Veda, and the histories and Saṃhitās, .. 3 ..

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇāni suramyāṇi pañcarātrāṇi pañca ca .
rucirāṇi subhadrāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇi yāni ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
पुराणानि सुरम्याणि पञ्चरात्राणि पञ्च च .
रुचिराणि सुभद्राणि धर्मशास्त्राणि यानि च .. 4 ..
text_mt: the very charming Purāṇas, the five Pañcarātras, / and whatever dharma treatises are pleasing and auspicious. .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
viprā vedavidaḥ sarve puṇyavantastapasvinaḥ .
nārāyaṇaṃ te dhyāyanti tanmantraṃ ca japanti ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
विप्रा वेदविदः सर्वे पुण्यवन्तस्तपस्विनः .
नारायणं ते ध्यायन्ति तन्मन्त्रं च जपन्ति च .. 5 ..
text_mt: All the brahmins are knowers of the Veda, meritorious, and ascetic; / they meditate upon Nārāyaṇa and recite his mantra. .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥkṣatriyā vaiśyāśyaturvarṇāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ .
śūdrā brāhmaṇabhṛtyāśca satyadharmaparāyaṇācha .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाःक्षत्रिया वैश्याश्यतुर्वर्णाश्च वैष्णवाः .
शूद्रा ब्राह्मणभृत्याश्च सत्यधर्मपरायणाछ .. 6 ..
text_mt: Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas—the castes are Vaiṣṇavas; / śūdras are servants to the brāhmaṇas, devoted to truth and dharma. .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rājāno dhārmikāścaiva prajāpālanatatparāḥ .
gṛhṇāntyeva prajānāṃ ca ṣoḍaśāṃśakarāṣṛpāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
राजानो धार्मिकाश्चैव प्रजापालनतत्पराः .
गृह्णान्त्येव प्रजानां च षोडशांशकराषृपाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Kings are indeed righteous, devoted to protecting their subjects; / kings take only a sixteenth part of tax from their subjects. .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
karaśūnyāśca viprāśca pūjyāḥ svacchandagāminaḥ .
tataṃ sarvasasyāḍhyā ratnādhārā vasuṃdharā .. 8 ..
meaning:
करशून्याश्च विप्राश्च पूज्याः स्वच्छन्दगामिनः .
ततं सर्वसस्याढ्या रत्नाधारा वसुंधरा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Brahmins are free of tax, worthy of worship, and move at will. / The earth is continually rich with all crops and a repository of jewels. .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhaktāśca śiṣyāśca pitṛbhaktāḥ sutāstathā .
yoṣitaḥ patibhaktāśca pativrataparāyaṇāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
गुरुभक्ताश्च शिष्याश्च पितृभक्ताः सुतास्तथा .
योषितः पतिभक्ताश्च पतिव्रतपरायणाः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Disciples are devoted to their teachers, and sons are devoted to their fathers; / women are devoted to their husbands, dedicated to being devoted wives. .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtau saṃbhoginaḥ sarve na strīlubdhā na lammapaṭāḥ .
na bhayaṃ dasyucauryāṇāṃ na tatra pāradārikāḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
ऋतौ संभोगिनः सर्वे न स्त्रीलुब्धा न लम्मपटाः .
न भयं दस्युचौर्याणां न तत्र पारदारिकाः .. 10 ..
text_mt: All engage in sexual union only in the fertile season; they are not lustful after women nor dissolute; / there is no fear of robbers or theft, nor are there adulterers there. .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
taravaḥ pūrṇaphalinaḥ pūrṇakṣīrāśca dhenavaḥ .
balavanto janāḥ sarve dīrghāḥ saundaryasaṃyutāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
तरवः पूर्णफलिनः पूर्णक्षीराश्च धेनवः .
बलवन्तो जनाः सर्वे दीर्घाः सौन्दर्यसंयुताः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Trees are full of fruit, and cows are full of milk; / all people are strong, tall, and endowed with beauty. .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣavarṣāyuṣaḥ kecitpuṇyavanto kṣyarogiṇaḥ .
yathā viprā viṣṇubhaktā strivarṇāṃ viṣṇusevinaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
लक्षवर्षायुषः केचित्पुण्यवन्तो क्ष्यरोगिणः .
यथा विप्रा विष्णुभक्ता स्त्रिवर्णां विष्णुसेविनः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Some live a hundred thousand years, possessing merit and free of disease; / as the brahmins are devotees of Viṣṇu, so the three castes serve Viṣṇu. .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
jalapūrṇā nadā nadyaḥ saṃtataṃ kaṃdarāstathā .
tīrthapūtāścaturvarṇāstapaḥ pūtā dvijātayaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
जलपूर्णा नदा नद्यः संततं कंदरास्तथा .
तीर्थपूताश्चतुर्वर्णास्तपः पूता द्विजातयः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Rivers and streams are constantly full of water, and so are the caves; / the four castes are purified by sacred fords, and the twice-born are purified by austerity. .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥpūtāśca nikhilāḥ khalahīnaṃ jagattrayam .
satkīrtiparibūrṇaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ maṅgalānvitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
मनःपूताश्च निखिलाः खलहीनं जगत्त्रयम् .
सत्कीर्तिपरिबूर्णं च यशस्यं मङ्गलान्वितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: All people are pure in mind; the three worlds are free of villains; / it is filled with good renown, bringing fame and endowed with blessing. .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraḥ sarvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ .
sarvakāleṣvatithayaḥ pūjitāśca gṛhe gṛhe .. 15 ..
meaning:
पितरः सर्वकालेषु तिथिकालेषु देवताः .
सर्वकालेष्वतिथयः पूजिताश्च गृहे गृहे .. 15 ..
text_mt: The ancestors at all times, the deities on lunar days, / and guests at all times are worshipped in house after house. .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
trivarṇā viprabhaktāśca viprabhojatatparāḥ .
brāhmaṇasya mukhaṃ kṣetramanūṣaramakaṇṭakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्रिवर्णा विप्रभक्ताश्च विप्रभोजतत्पराः .
ब्राह्मणस्य मुखं क्षेत्रमनूषरमकण्टकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: The three castes are devoted to brahmins, intent on feeding brahmins; / the mouth of a brāhmaṇa is a field without saline soil and without thorns. .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇotkīrtanena harṣayuktāstadutsave .
na śatravo janānāṃ ca sarve sarvaṃhitaiṣiṇaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
नारायणोत्कीर्तनेन हर्षयुक्तास्तदुत्सवे .
न शत्रवो जनानां च सर्वे सर्वंहितैषिणः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Filled with joy by singing the praises of Nārāyaṇa, [they rejoice] in his festivals; / people have no enemies, and everyone wishes well to all. .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nā''tmapraśaṃsakāḥ kecitsarve paraguṇotsukāḥ .
na devānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca viduṣāṃ tatra nindakāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
ना'ऽत्मप्रशंसकाः केचित्सर्वे परगुणोत्सुकाः .
न देवानां द्विजानां च विदुषां तत्र निन्दकाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: None praise themselves; all are eager for the virtues of others; / there are no abusers of the gods, the twice-born, or the learned there. .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣā yoṣitaścāpi na hi sūrkhāśca paṇḍitāḥ .
na duḥkhino janāḥsatye sarveṣāṃ ratnamandiram .. 19 ..
meaning:
पुरुषा योषितश्चापि न हि सूर्खाश्च पण्डिताः .
न दुःखिनो जनाःसत्ये सर्वेषां रत्नमन्दिरम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Men and women alike are never foolish, but learned; / people in the Satya [yuga] are not distressed; everyone has a mansion of jewels, .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
maṇimāṇikyaratnaugharatnasvarṇasamanvitam .
na bhikṣukā na rogārtāḥ śokahīnāścaharṣitāḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
मणिमाणिक्यरत्नौघरत्नस्वर्णसमन्वितम् .
न भिक्षुका न रोगार्ताः शोकहीनाश्चहर्षिताः .. 20 ..
text_mt: provided with heaps of pearls, rubies, and gems, and jewels and gold. / There are no beggars, none afflicted with illness; they are devoid of sorrow and joyful. .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na hi bhūṣaṇahīrāśca narā nāryaśca kecana .
na pāpino na dhūrtāśca na kṣudhārtā na kutsitāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
न हि भूषणहीराश्च नरा नार्यश्च केचन .
न पापिनो न धूर्ताश्च न क्षुधार्ता न कुत्सिताः .. 21 ..
text_mt: No men or women were bereft of ornaments; / none were sinful, none were deceitful, none were afflicted by hunger, and none were base.

sanskrit_iast:
jarāhīnāḥ prāṇinaśca śaśvadyauvanasaṃsthitāḥ .
ādhivyādhivihīnāśca nirvikārāśca dehinaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
जराहीनाः प्राणिनश्च शश्वद्यौवनसंस्थिताः .
आधिव्याधिविहीनाश्च निर्विकाराश्च देहिनः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Living beings were free from old age, constantly abiding in youth; / embodied beings were free from mental angst and physical disease, and without defects.

sanskrit_iast:
yadukto vai satyayuge dharmaḥ satyaṃ dayādikam .
pādahīnaśca tretāyāṃ satyārdha dvāpare'pi ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
यदुक्तो वै सत्ययुगे धर्मः सत्यं दयादिकम् .
पादहीनश्च त्रेतायां सत्यार्ध द्वापरेऽपि च .. 23 ..
text_mt: The dharma spoken of in the Kṛta Yuga—truth, compassion, and the rest— / lost one quarter in Tretā, and half [of its] truth in Dvāpara.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmai kapācca prathame kaleścātikṛśo'balaḥ .
duṣṭānāṃ dasyucauryāṇāmaṅkuraḥ prabhavedvraja .. 24 ..
meaning:
धर्मै कपाच्च प्रथमे कलेश्चातिकृशोऽबलः .
दुष्टानां दस्युचौर्याणामङ्कुरः प्रभवेद्व्रज .. 24 ..
text_mt: In the beginning of Kali, dharma has only one foot, extremely lean and weak; / the sprout of the wicked, robbers, and thieves begins to arise, O [lord of] Vraja.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmaniratāḥ kecidbhītāḥ saṃgopinastathā .
bhītā guptāśca puṃścalyau bhītāśca pāradārikāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
अधर्मनिरताः केचिद्भीताः संगोपिनस्तथा .
भीता गुप्ताश्च पुंश्चल्यौ भीताश्च पारदारिकाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Some, engaged in unrighteousness, become afraid and conceal themselves; / unchaste women are afraid and secretive, and adulterers are afraid.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmiṣṭhānāṃ bhayaṃ śaśvadadharmiṣṭhāśca kampitāḥ .
svalpadharmaratā bhūpāḥ svalpavedaratā dvijāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
धर्मिष्ठानां भयं शश्वदधर्मिष्ठाश्च कम्पिताः .
स्वल्पधर्मरता भूपाः स्वल्पवेदरता द्विजाः .. 26 ..
text_mt: The unrighteous continually tremble in fear of the righteous; / kings are devoted to little dharma, and the twice-born are devoted to little of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vratadharmaratāḥ kecitsarve svacchandagāminaḥ .
yāvattiṣṭhanti tīrthāni yāvattiṣṭhanti sādhavaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
व्रतधर्मरताः केचित्सर्वे स्वच्छन्दगामिनः .
यावत्तिष्ठन्ति तीर्थानि यावत्तिष्ठन्ति साधवः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Some are devoted to vows and dharma, but all wander at their own will. / As long as the holy sites remain, as long as the virtuous remain,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvattiṣṭhanti grāmāṇāṃ devāḥ śāstrāṇi pūjanam .
tāvatkiṃcittapaḥ satyaṃ svargadharmāśa eva ca .. 28 ..
meaning:
यावत्तिष्ठन्ति ग्रामाणां देवाः शास्त्राणि पूजनम् .
तावत्किंचित्तपः सत्यं स्वर्गधर्माश एव च .. 28 ..
text_mt: as long as the village deities, the sacred scriptures, and worship remain, / so long does some austerity, truth, and a portion of heavenly dharma [remain].

sanskrit_iast:
kalerdoṣanidhestāta guṇa eko mahānapi.
mānasaṃ saṃbhavetpuṇyaṃ sukṛtaṃ na hi dṛṣkṛtam .. 29 ..
meaning:
कलेर्दोषनिधेस्तात गुण एको महानपि.
मानसं संभवेत्पुण्यं सुकृतं न हि दृष्कृतम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: O father, in Kali, which is an ocean of faults, there is also one great virtue: / merit occurs through the mind, a good deed [is credited thus], but not an evil deed.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthādike gate tāta naṣṭo dharmāśa eva ca .
kalārūpaśca dharmaśca yathā kuhvāṃ niśākaraḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
तीर्थादिके गते तात नष्टो धर्माश एव च .
कलारूपश्च धर्मश्च यथा कुह्वां निशाकरः .. 30 ..
text_mt: When the holy sites and the like are gone, O father, even that portion of dharma is destroyed; / dharma becomes like a single digit, like the moon on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca
tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi tiṣṭhantyeva kiyaddinam .
sādhavo grāmyadevāśca śāstrāṇyetāni vatsaka .. 31 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच
तीर्थान्येतानि सर्वाणि तिष्ठन्त्येव कियद्दिनम् .
साधवो ग्राम्यदेवाश्च शास्त्राण्येतानि वत्सक .. 31 ..
text_mt: Nanda said: / For how many days do all these holy sites remain, / and the virtuous, the village deities, and these sacred scriptures, O child?

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
kalau daśasahasrāṇi haristiṣṭhati medinīm .
devānāṃ pratimā būjyā śāstrāṇi ca purāṇakam .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
कलौ दशसहस्राणि हरिस्तिष्ठति मेदिनीम् .
देवानां प्रतिमा बूज्या शास्त्राणि च पुराणकम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In Kali, Hari remains on the earth for ten thousand [years]; / the images of the deities, the sacred scriptures, and the Purāṇa are to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhamapi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni suniścitam .
tadardha grāmadevāśca vedāśca viduṣāmapi .. 33 ..
meaning:
तदर्धमपि तीर्थानि गङ्गादीनि सुनिश्चितम् .
तदर्ध ग्रामदेवाश्च वेदाश्च विदुषामपि .. 33 ..
text_mt: For half of that [time], certainly, the holy sites such as the Gaṅgā [remain]; / for half of that, the village deities, and the Vedas among the learned [remain].

sanskrit_iast:
adharmaḥ paribūrṇaśca tadante ca kalau pitaḥ .
ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca .. 34 ..
meaning:
अधर्मः परिबूर्णश्च तदन्ते च कलौ पितः .
एकवर्णा भविष्यन्ति वर्णाश्चत्वार एव च .. 34 ..
text_mt: At the end of that, unrighteousness becomes complete in Kali, O father; / the four varṇas will indeed become a single varṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
na mantrapūtodvāhaśca na hi satyaṃ na ya kṣamā .
strīsvīkārarato nityaṃ grāmyadharmapradhānataḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
न मन्त्रपूतोद्वाहश्च न हि सत्यं न य क्षमा .
स्त्रीस्वीकाररतो नित्यं ग्राम्यधर्मप्रधानतः .. 35 ..
text_mt: There is no marriage sanctified by mantras, no truth, and no forgiveness; / [man] is constantly devoted to taking women, governed by carnal desire.

sanskrit_iast:
na yajñasūtraṃ tilakaṃ brāhmaṇanāṃ ca nityaśaḥ .
saṃdhyāśāstravihīnāśca vipravaṃśāḥśrutā api .. 36 ..
meaning:
न यज्ञसूत्रं तिलकं ब्राह्मणनां च नित्यशः .
संध्याशास्त्रविहीनाश्च विप्रवंशाःश्रुता अपि .. 36 ..
text_mt: There is no sacred thread, nor sectarian mark constantly for the brāhmaṇas; / though heard [to be] of brāhmaṇa lineages, they are bereft of twilight prayers and scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiḥ sārdha ca sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ niyamacyutam .
abhakṣyabhakṣā lokāśca caturvarṇāśca lampaṭāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
सर्वैः सार्ध च सर्वेषां भक्षणं नियमच्युतम् .
अभक्ष्यभक्षा लोकाश्च चतुर्वर्णाश्च लम्पटाः .. 37 ..
text_mt: Eating with everyone is freed from rules; / people eat what is unfit to be eaten, and all four varṇas are lecherous.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīṣu na satī kācitpuṃścalī ca gṛhe gṛhe .
