karoti tarjanaṃ kāntaṃ bhṛtyatulyaṃ ca kampitam .. 38 ..
meaning:
नारीषु न सती काचित्पुंश्चली च गृहे गृहे .
करोति तर्जनं कान्तं भृत्यतुल्यं च कम्पितम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Among women, none is chaste, and there is an unchaste woman in every house; / she scolds her husband, making him tremble like a servant.

sanskrit_iast:
jārāya dattvā miṣṭānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vastracandanam .
na dadātyeva cā''hāraṃ svāmine duḥkhine pitaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
जाराय दत्त्वा मिष्टान्नं ताम्बूलं वस्त्रचन्दनम् .
न ददात्येव चा'ऽहारं स्वामिने दुःखिने पितः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having given sweet food, betel, garments, and sandalwood paste to her lover, / she does not give even food to her miserable husband, O father.

sanskrit_iast:
putreṇa bhartsitastātaḥ śiṣyeṇa bhartsito guruḥ .
prajābhistāḍito bhūpo bhūpena pīḍitāḥ prajāḥ .. 40 ..
meaning:
पुत्रेण भर्त्सितस्तातः शिष्येण भर्त्सितो गुरुः .
प्रजाभिस्ताडितो भूपो भूपेन पीडिताः प्रजाः .. 40 ..
text_mt: The father is reviled by the son, the guru is reviled by the disciple; / the king is beaten by the subjects, and the subjects are oppressed by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
dasyucoreśca duṣṭaiśca śiṣṭāśca paripīḍitāḥ .
sasyahīnā ca vasudhā kṣīrahīnāśca dhanevaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
दस्युचोरेश्च दुष्टैश्च शिष्टाश्च परिपीडिताः .
सस्यहीना च वसुधा क्षीरहीनाश्च धनेवः .. 41 ..
text_mt: The cultivated are thoroughly oppressed by robbers, thieves, and the wicked; / the earth is bereft of crops, and cows are bereft of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
svalpakṣīre ghṛtaṃ nāsti navanītaṃ ca nityaśaḥ .
satyahīnā janāḥ sarve nityaṃ mithyā vadanti ca .. 42 ..
meaning:
स्वल्पक्षीरे घृतं नास्ति नवनीतं च नित्यशः .
सत्यहीना जनाः सर्वे नित्यं मिथ्या वदन्ति च .. 42 ..
text_mt: In the little milk there is constantly no ghee and no butter; / all people are bereft of truth and continually speak falsehood.

sanskrit_iast:
śaucasaṃdhyāśāstrahīnā brāhmaṇā vṛṣavāhakāḥ .
sūpakārāśca śūdrāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
शौचसंध्याशास्त्रहीना ब्राह्मणा वृषवाहकाः .
सूपकाराश्च शूद्राणां शूद्राणां शवदाहकाः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Brāhmaṇas, devoid of purification, twilight prayers, and scriptures, are drivers of bulls, / cooks for śūdras, and burners of śūdra corpses.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrastrīniratāḥ śaśvacchūdrā vipravadhūratāḥ .
khādanti yasya viprasya bhakṣyaṃ ca paripācakāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
शूद्रस्त्रीनिरताः शश्वच्छूद्रा विप्रवधूरताः .
खादन्ति यस्य विप्रस्य भक्ष्यं च परिपाचकाः .. 44 ..
text_mt: They are constantly devoted to śūdra women, and śūdras are devoted to the wives of brāhmaṇas; / of which brāhmaṇa they eat the food, they act as cooks [for him].

sanskrit_iast:
mātuḥ parāṃ tasya patnīṃ śūdrā gṛhṇanti lampaṭāḥ .
bhṛtyaśca hatvā rājānaṃ svayaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati .. 45 ..
meaning:
मातुः परां तस्य पत्नीं शूद्रा गृह्णन्ति लम्पटाः .
भृत्यश्च हत्वा राजानं स्वयं राजा भविष्यति .. 45 ..
text_mt: Lustful śūdras take his wife, who is higher than a mother. / A servant, having killed the king, will become king himself.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī hatvā patiṃ kāmādbhajejjāraṃ ca kautukāt .
putraśca pitaraṃ hatvā svayaṃ bhūpo bhaviṣyati .. 46 ..
meaning:
नारी हत्वा पतिं कामाद्भजेज्जारं च कौतुकात् .
पुत्रश्च पितरं हत्वा स्वयं भूपो भविष्यति .. 46 ..
text_mt: A woman, having killed her husband out of lust, will sport with a lover for pleasure; / and a son, having killed his father, will become king himself.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve svacchandaniratāḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇāḥ .
vaṅkharā vyādhiyuktāśca kutsitāśca kucailakāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
सर्वे स्वच्छन्दनिरताः शिश्नोदरपरायणाः .
वङ्खरा व्याधियुक्ताश्च कुत्सिताश्च कुचैलकाः .. 47 ..
text_mt: All are devoted to self-will, dedicated only to the penis and the belly; / they are crippled, afflicted with disease, vile, and dressed in rags.

sanskrit_iast:
vikṣuṇṇamantraliptāśca mithyāmantrapracārakāḥ .
jātihīnāśca guravo vayohīnāśca nindakāḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
विक्षुण्णमन्त्रलिप्ताश्च मिथ्यामन्त्रप्रचारकाः .
जातिहीनाश्च गुरवो वयोहीनाश्च निन्दकाः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Tainted by ruined mantras, they are propagators of false mantras; / gurus are devoid of lineage, devoid of age, and revilers.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaścāpi malecchāśca yavanā dharmanindakāḥ .
satkīrtimapi sādhūnāṃ kurvantyunmūlanaṃ mudā .. 49 ..
meaning:
राजानश्चापि मलेच्छाश्च यवना धर्मनिन्दकाः .
सत्कीर्तिमपि साधूनां कुर्वन्त्युन्मूलनं मुदा .. 49 ..
text_mt: Kings are mlecchas and Yavanas, revilers of dharma; / with joy they eradicate even the good fame of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevadvijātīnāmatithīnāṃ ca nityaśaḥ .
pūjā nāsti gurūṇāṃ ca pitrośca pūjanaṃ striyāḥ .. 50 ..
meaning:
पितृदेवद्विजातीनामतिथीनां च नित्यशः .
पूजा नास्ति गुरूणां च पित्रोश्च पूजनं स्त्रियाः .. 50 ..
text_mt: There is no constant worship of ancestors, gods, the twice-born, and guests; / nor is there worship of gurus and parents, [only] of a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
strībandhūnāṃ gauravaṃ ca strīṇāṃ ca satataṃ pitaḥ .
coraḥ satkulajātiśca brahmadevasvahārakaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीबन्धूनां गौरवं च स्त्रीणां च सततं पितः .
चोरः सत्कुलजातिश्च ब्रह्मदेवस्वहारकः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Honour is constantly [accorded] to the relatives of women and to women, O father; / a thief is [thought to be] of noble family and caste, taking the property of brāhmaṇas and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mānaṃ vahanti lobhena yugadharmeṇa kautukāt .
devāyatanahīnaṃ ca jagatsarva bhayākulam .. 52 ..
meaning:
मानं वहन्ति लोभेन युगधर्मेण कौतुकात् .
देवायतनहीनं च जगत्सर्व भयाकुलम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Out of greed and in jest, following the nature of the age, they carry pride; / the whole world is bereft of temples and distressed with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
arājakaṃ ca durnītaṃ saṃtataṃ kalidoṣataḥ .
bubhṛkṣitāḥ kucailāśca daridrā vyādhino narāḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
अराजकं च दुर्नीतं संततं कलिदोषतः .
बुभृक्षिताः कुचैलाश्च दरिद्रा व्याधिनो नराः .. 53 ..
text_mt: kingless, and constantly misruled due to the fault of Kali; / men are hungry, dressed in rags, poor, and sickly.

sanskrit_iast:
kapardakaghaṭādhyakṣo rājendro hi ghaṭeśvaraḥ .
vṛddhāṅguṣṭasamā lokā vṛkṣāḥśākasamāstathā .. 54 ..
meaning:
कपर्दकघटाध्यक्षो राजेन्द्रो हि घटेश्वरः .
वृद्धाङ्गुष्टसमा लोका वृक्षाःशाकसमास्तथा .. 54 ..
text_mt: A lord over an earthen jar of cowries is indeed a great king, a lord of jars; / people are equal in size to a thumb, and trees are like vegetables.

sanskrit_iast:
tālānāṃ nārikelāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca .
phalāni sarṣapāṇyeva tatkṣudraṃ ca tataḥ param .. 55 ..
meaning:
तालानां नारिकेलाणां पनसानां तथैव च .
फलानि सर्षपाण्येव तत्क्षुद्रं च ततः परम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: The fruits of palmyra palms, coconuts, and likewise of jackfruits / are merely like mustard seeds, and even smaller than that thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
jalabhājanapātreṇa sasyena vāsasā tathā .
vihīnaṃ mandiraṃ sarvaṃ gṛhāṇāmapariṣkṛtam .. 56 ..
meaning:
जलभाजनपात्रेण सस्येन वाससा तथा .
विहीनं मन्दिरं सर्वं गृहाणामपरिष्कृतम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Bereft of water vessels, grain, and clothing, / every dwelling among the houses is untidy,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhakena parivṛtaṃ dīpahīnaṃ tameyutam .
hiṃsrajantubhayādbhītā janāḥ sarve ca pāpinaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
गन्धकेन परिवृतं दीपहीनं तमेयुतम् .
हिंस्रजन्तुभयाद्भीता जनाः सर्वे च पापिनः .. 57 ..
text_mt: surrounded by sulphur, devoid of lamps, filled with darkness; / all people, being sinful, are terrified of predatory beasts.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve ca kalahāviṣṭā puṃścalyaḥ kalahapriyāḥ .
rūpavatyo na kāminyo narāścāpi na rūpiṇaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
सर्वे च कलहाविष्टा पुंश्चल्यः कलहप्रियाः .
रूपवत्यो न कामिन्यो नराश्चापि न रूपिणः .. 58 ..
text_mt: All are possessed by strife; unchaste women are fond of quarrel; / women are not beautiful, and men too are without handsome form.

sanskrit_iast:
nadyo nadāḥ kaṃdarāśca taḍāgāśca sarovarāḥ .
jalapadmavihīnāśca jalahīnā dhanāstathā .. 59 ..
meaning:
नद्यो नदाः कंदराश्च तडागाश्च सरोवराः .
जलपद्मविहीनाश्च जलहीना धनास्तथा .. 59 ..
text_mt: Rivers, streams, caves, ponds, and lakes / are bereft of water and lotuses; likewise the clouds are bereft of water.

sanskrit_iast:
apatyahīnā nāryaśca kāmukyo jārasaṃyutāḥ .
aśvatthacchedinaḥ sarve vṛkṣahīnā vasuṃdharā .. 60 ..
meaning:
अपत्यहीना नार्यश्च कामुक्यो जारसंयुताः .
अश्वत्थच्छेदिनः सर्वे वृक्षहीना वसुंधरा .. 60 ..
text_mt: Women are childless, lustful, and attached to paramours; / all are cutters of holy fig trees; the earth is bereft of trees.

sanskrit_iast:
phalahīnāśca taravaḥ śākhāḥ skandhavihīnakāḥ .
phalāni svāduhīnāni cānnāni ca jalāni ca .. 61 ..
meaning:
फलहीनाश्च तरवः शाखाः स्कन्धविहीनकाः .
फलानि स्वादुहीनानि चान्नानि च जलानि च .. 61 ..
text_mt: Trees are without fruit, branches are without trunks; / fruits are devoid of taste, as are food and water.

sanskrit_iast:
mānavāḥ kaṭuvaktāro nirdayā dharmavarjitāḥ .
tadante dvādāśādityāḥ saṃhariṣyanti mānavān .. 62 ..
meaning:
मानवाः कटुवक्तारो निर्दया धर्मवर्जिताः .
तदन्ते द्वादाशादित्याः संहरिष्यन्ति मानवान् .. 62 ..
text_mt: Men speak harsh words, are merciless, and abandoned by dharma. / At the end of that, the twelve Adityas will destroy human beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāñjantuṃśca tāpena bahuvṛṣṭyā vrajeśvara .
avaśiṣṭā ca pṛthivī kathāmātrāvaśeṣitā .. 63 ..
meaning:
सर्वाञ्जन्तुंश्च तापेन बहुवृष्ट्या व्रजेश्वर .
अवशिष्टा च पृथिवी कथामात्रावशेषिता .. 63 ..
text_mt: and all creatures with scorching heat and abundant rain, O lord of Vraja; / the earth will remain only as a remnant in mere stories.

sanskrit_iast:
kalau gate ca pṛthivī kṣetraṃ varṣāgate tathā .
punaḥ satyapravṛttiśca bhaviṣyati krameṇa vai .. 64 ..
meaning:
कलौ गते च पृथिवी क्षेत्रं वर्षागते तथा .
पुनः सत्यप्रवृत्तिश्च भविष्यति क्रमेण वै .. 64 ..
text_mt: When Kali is gone, the earth will be like a field when the rains have passed; / again the course of the Satya [Yuga] will certainly arise in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha tāta vrajaṃ sukham .
ahaṃ dugdhamukho bālaḥputraste kathayāmi kim .. 65 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं गच्छ तात व्रजं सुखम् .
अहं दुग्धमुखो बालःपुत्रस्ते कथयामि किम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: "Thus everything has been told. Go happily, father, to Vraja. / I am a milk-faced child, your son; what more can I say?

sanskrit_iast:
navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi takraṃ pariṣkṛtam .
svastikaṃ śubhakarmārhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam .. 66 ..
meaning:
नवनीतं घृतं दुग्धं दधि तक्रं परिष्कृतम् .
स्वस्तिकं शुभकर्मार्हं मिष्टान्नं च सुधोपमम् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Fresh butter, clarified butter, milk, yogurt, seasoned buttermilk, / svastika sweets suitable for auspicious rituals, and sweetmeats resembling nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭadravyaṃ ca yatkiṃcitpitṛdevanimittakam .
bhuktaṃ balācca tatsarva bālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam .. 67 ..
meaning:
मिष्टद्रव्यं च यत्किंचित्पितृदेवनिमित्तकम् .
भुक्तं बलाच्च तत्सर्व बालानां रोदनं बलम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: and whatever sweet things were meant for the ancestors and the gods— / all that was eaten by force; for crying is the strength of children.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣamasvāparādhaṃ me bāladoṣaḥ pade pade .
tvaṃ pitā tava putro'haṃ yaśodā jananī mama .. 68 ..
meaning:
तत्क्षमस्वापराधं मे बालदोषः पदे पदे .
त्वं पिता तव पुत्रोऽहं यशोदा जननी मम .. 68 ..
text_mt: Therefore, forgive my offence. A child is at fault at every step. / You are my father, I am your son, and Yaśodā is my mother.

sanskrit_iast:
madīyaṃ parihāsaṃ ca yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ vada .
kumārāsyācchrutaṃ sarva so'hamityevamīpsitam .. 69 ..
meaning:
मदीयं परिहासं च यशोदां रोहिणीं वद .
कुमारास्याच्छ्रुतं सर्व सोऽहमित्येवमीप्सितम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: Tell Yaśodā and Rohiṇī about my playful antics: / 'All this has been heard from the boy's mouth: that desirable truth, "I am that."'

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtayiṣyasi tatsarva sarva gokulavāsinam .
kālaḥ karoti sasairga bandhūnāṃ bandhubhiḥ saha .. 70 ..
meaning:
कीर्तयिष्यसि तत्सर्व सर्व गोकुलवासिनम् .
कालः करोति ससैर्ग बन्धूनां बन्धुभिः सह .. 70 ..
text_mt: You will proclaim all that to all the inhabitants of Gokula. / Time brings about the association of relatives with relatives;

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ karoti vicchedaṃ virodhaṃ prītimeva ca .
kālaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ ca kurute kālaśca paripālanam .. 71 ..
meaning:
कालः करोति विच्छेदं विरोधं प्रीतिमेव च .
कालः सृष्टिं च कुरुते कालश्च परिपालनम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: Time brings about separation, hostility, and affection. / Time produces creation, and Time maintains it.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ karoti sānandaṃ kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ .
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ ca janma ca .. 72 ..
meaning:
कालः करोति सानन्दं कालः संहरते प्रजाः .
सुखं दुःखं भयं शोकं जरां मृत्युं च जन्म च .. 72 ..
text_mt: Time produces joy; Time destroys creatures: / happiness, misery, fear, sorrow, old age, death, and birth—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ karmānurodhena kāla eva karoti ca .
sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ tāta vismayaṃ na vrajaṃ vraja .. 73 ..
meaning:
सर्वं कर्मानुरोधेन काल एव करोति च .
सर्वं कालकृतं तात विस्मयं न व्रजं व्रज .. 73 ..
text_mt: Time alone brings about everything in accordance with karma. / Everything is wrought by Time, father; do not wonder, [but] go to Vraja.

sanskrit_iast:
kutastvaṃ gokule vaiśyo nando vaiśyādhipo nṛpaḥ .
vasudevasuto'cahaṃ ca mathurāyāmaho kutaḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
कुतस्त्वं गोकुले वैश्यो नन्दो वैश्याधिपो नृपः .
वसुदेवसुतोऽचहं च मथुरायामहो कुतः .. 74 ..
text_mt: Where are you—a vaiśya in Gokula, Nanda the king and lord of vaiśyas; / and where, alas, am I—the son of Vasudeva in Mathurā?

sanskrit_iast:
pitā me kaṃsabhītena tvadgṛhe ca samapritaḥ .
pitu paraḥ pitā tvaṃ ca mātā mātuḥ parā'pivā .. 75 ..
meaning:
पिता मे कंसभीतेन त्वद्गृहे च समप्रितः .
पितु परः पिता त्वं च माता मातुः पराऽपिवा .. 75 ..
text_mt: By my father, who was afraid of Kaṃsa, I was entrusted to your house. / You are a father higher than a father, and [she is] a mother higher even than a mother.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dattena jñānena pārvatyā ca vrajeśvara .
tyaja mohaṃ mahābhāga gaccha tāta sukhaṃ gṛham .. 76 ..
meaning:
मया दत्तेन ज्ञानेन पार्वत्या च व्रजेश्वर .
त्यज मोहं महाभाग गच्छ तात सुखं गृहम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: With the knowledge given by me and by Pārvatī, O lord of Vraja, / cast off delusion, O most fortunate one; go happily home, father."

sanskrit_iast:
nanda uvāca
smara vṛndāvanaṃ tāta ramyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahotsavam .
gokulaṃ gokulaṃ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ yamunātaṭam .. 77 ..
meaning:
नन्द उवाच
स्मर वृन्दावनं तात रम्यं पुण्यं महोत्सवम् .
गोकुलं गोकुलं रम्यं सुन्दरं यमुनातटम् .. 77 ..
text_mt: Nanda said: / "Remember Vṛndāvana, child, beautiful and auspicious, [scene of] great festivities; / remember Gokula, lovely Gokula, and the charming bank of the Yamunā;

sanskrit_iast:
ramaṇīnāṃ suramyaṃ ca tvatpriyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .
gopālikā gopabālānyaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ priyām .. 78 ..
meaning:
रमणीनां सुरम्यं च त्वत्प्रियं रासमण्डलम् .
गोपालिका गोपबालान्यशोदां रोहिणीं प्रियाम् .. 78 ..
text_mt: the delightful circle of the rāsa dance, so dear to you with the lovely women; / the cowherdesses, the cowherd boys, and dear Yaśodā and Rohiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ na kathaṃ smarasi putraka .
vāramekaṃ svalpadinaṃ gokulaṃ gaccha vatsaka .. 79 ..
meaning:
प्राणाधिकां राधिकां न कथं स्मरसि पुत्रक .
वारमेकं स्वल्पदिनं गोकुलं गच्छ वत्सक .. 79 ..
text_mt: Why do you not remember Rādhikā, who is dearer to you than life, my child? / Go for once, for a few days, to Gokula, my little one."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktavā nandaśca kroḍe kṛṣṇaṃ cakāra saḥ .
netrāśruṇā ca pūrṇena taṃ siṣeca śucā'nvitaḥ .. 80 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तवा नन्दश्च क्रोडे कृष्णं चकार सः .
नेत्राश्रुणा च पूर्णेन तं सिषेच शुचाऽन्वितः .. 80 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Nanda took Kṛṣṇa into his lap; / and filled with grief, he drenched him with tears from his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
cucumba tadgaṇḍayugaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi mohataḥ .
sānandaḥ paramānado bhagavāṃstamuvāca saḥ .. 81 ..
meaning:
चुचुम्ब तद्गण्डयुगं कृत्वा वक्षसि मोहतः .
सानन्दः परमानदो भगवांस्तमुवाच सः .. 81 ..
text_mt: Clasping him to his chest in affection, he kissed both his cheeks. / Full of joy, the supreme bliss, the Blessed One said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 90 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
नवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 90 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the ninetieth chapter, the conversation between the Blessed One and Nanda, in the later part of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the glorious and great Brahmavaivarta. 90.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
niṣekena pariṣvaṅgo vibhedastena vā bhavet .
kṣaṇena darśanaṃ tena niṣekaḥ kena vāryate .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
निषेकेन परिष्वङ्गो विभेदस्तेन वा भवेत् .
क्षणेन दर्शनं तेन निषेकः केन वार्यते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the ninety-first chapter. / The Blessed One said: / "By destiny union occurs, or by it there is separation; / in an instant seeing [occurs] through it; who can ward off destiny?
title: athaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
gamanāgamanārtha cāpyuddhavaḥ kathayiṣyati .
prasthāpayāmi taṃ śīghraṃ vijñāsyasi tataḥ pitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
गमनागमनार्थ चाप्युद्धवः कथयिष्यति .
प्रस्थापयामि तं शीघ्रं विज्ञास्यसि ततः पितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: And Uddhava will explain the meaning of my going and coming. / I shall send him soon; then you will understand, O father.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ caiva gopikāṃ gopabālakān .
prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ tāṃ gatvā saṃbodhayiṣyati .. 3 ..
meaning:
यशोदां रोहिणीं चैव गोपिकां गोपबालकान् .
प्राणाधिकां राधिकां तां गत्वा संबोधयिष्यति .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having gone, he will comfort Yaśodā, Rohiṇī, / the cowherdesses, the cowherd boys, and that Rādhikā who is dearer than life."

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra vasudevaśca devakī .
baladevaścoddhavaśca tathā'krūraśca satvaram .. 4 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वसुदेवश्च देवकी .
बलदेवश्चोद्धवश्च तथाऽक्रूरश्च सत्वरम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: In the meantime, Vasudeva, Devakī, / Baladeva, Uddhava, and Akrūra quickly [came] there.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudeva uvāca
nanda tvaṃ balavāñjñānī sadbandhuśca sakhā mama .
tyaja mohaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha vatsaste'yaṃ yathā mama .. 5 ..
meaning:
वसुदेव उवाच
नन्द त्वं बलवाञ्ज्ञानी सद्बन्धुश्च सखा मम .
त्यज मोहं गृहं गच्छ वत्सस्तेऽयं यथा मम .. 5 ..
text_mt: Vasudeva said: / "Nanda, you are strong, wise, a good relative, and my friend. / Cast off delusion and go home; this boy is yours just as he is mine.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrībhūtā gokulācca mathurā nāsti bāndhava .
mahotsave sadānande nanda drakṣyasi putrakam .. 6 ..
meaning:
दूरीभूता गोकुलाच्च मथुरा नास्ति बान्धव .
महोत्सवे सदानन्दे नन्द द्रक्ष्यसि पुत्रकम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Mathurā is not far removed from Gokula, O relative. / During a great festival of constant joy, Nanda, you will see your child."

sanskrit_iast:
devakyuvāca
yathā'yamāvayoḥ putrastathaiva bhavato dhruvam .
sālasaḥ kena he nanda śucā deho hi lakṣyate .. 7 ..
meaning:
देवक्युवाच
यथाऽयमावयोः पुत्रस्तथैव भवतो ध्रुवम् .
सालसः केन हे नन्द शुचा देहो हि लक्ष्यते .. 7 ..
text_mt: Devakī said: / "Just as he is our son, so indeed is he surely yours. / Why, O Nanda, does your body appear weary with grief?

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśābdaṃ sabalaḥ sthitvā te mandire sukham .
kathaṃ svalpadinenaiva śokagrasto bhaviṣyasi .. 8 ..
meaning:
एकादशाब्दं सबलः स्थित्वा ते मन्दिरे सुखम् .
कथं स्वल्पदिनेनैव शोकग्रस्तो भविष्यसि .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having stayed happily in your house for eleven years with Bala, / how can you be stricken with sorrow after only a few days?

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭha putreṇa sārdhaṃ ca mathurāyāṃ kiyaddinam .
pūrṇacandrānanaṃ paśya janma tvaṃ saphalaṃ kuru .. 9 ..
meaning:
तिष्ठ पुत्रेण सार्धं च मथुरायां कियद्दिनम् .
पूर्णचन्द्राननं पश्य जन्म त्वं सफलं कुरु .. 9 ..
text_mt: Stay for a few days in Mathurā together with your son. / Look upon his full-moon face and make your life fruitful."

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
ghacchoddhava sukhaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati tava priyam .
praharṣa gokulaṃ gatvā yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ prasūm .. 10 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
घच्छोद्धव सुखं भद्रं भविष्यति तव प्रियम् .
प्रहर्ष गोकुलं गत्वा यशोदां रोहिणीं प्रसूम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / "Go happily, Uddhava; good fortune shall come to you, your dear wish. / Having gone with great joy to Gokula, to mother Yaśodā and Rohiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
gopavālasamūhaṃ ca rādhikāṃ gopikāgaṇam .
prabodhayā''dhyātmikena maddattena śucaśchidā .. 11 ..
meaning:
गोपवालसमूहं च राधिकां गोपिकागणम् .
प्रबोधया'ऽध्यात्मिकेन मद्दत्तेन शुचश्छिदा .. 11 ..
text_mt: to the host of cowherd boys, to Rādhikā, and to the company of cowherdesses, / comfort them with spiritual [wisdom] given by me, which cuts through grief.

sanskrit_iast:
nandastiṣṭhatu sānandaṃ manmāturājñayā śucā .
nandasthitiṃ sadvinayaṃ yaśodāṃ kathayiṣyasi .. 12 ..
meaning:
नन्दस्तिष्ठतु सानन्दं मन्मातुराज्ञया शुचा .
नन्दस्थितिं सद्विनयं यशोदां कथयिष्यसि .. 12 ..
text_mt: Let Nanda stay joyfully [for now] because of his sorrow, by my mother's command. / You shall report Nanda's stay to Yaśodā with full humility."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pitrā mātrā balena ca .
akrūreṇa samaṃ tūrṇa yayāvabhyantaraṃ gṛham .. 13 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा श्रीकृष्णः पित्रा मात्रा बलेन च .
अक्रूरेण समं तूर्ण ययावभ्यन्तरं गृहम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Śrī Kṛṣṇa quickly went to the inner apartments of the palace / together with his father, his mother, Bala, and Akrūra.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhavo rajanīṃ sthitvā mathurāyāṃ ca nārada .
prabhāte prayayau śīghraṃ ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam .. 14 ..
meaning:
उद्धवो रजनीं स्थित्वा मथुरायां च नारद .
प्रभाते प्रययौ शीघ्रं रम्यं वृन्दावनं वनम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Uddhava, having stayed the night in Mathurā, O Nārada, / set out swiftly at dawn for the delightful forest of Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradānāo ekanava-
titamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 91 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदानाओ एकनव-
तितमोऽध्यायः .. 91 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the ninety-first chapter in the conversation between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the later part of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the glorious and great Brahmavaivarta. 91.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
śrīkṛṣṇaprerito hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya ca gaṇeśvaram .
smarannārāyaṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ durgā lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
श्रीकृष्णप्रेरितो हृष्टः प्रणम्य च गणेश्वरम् .
स्मरन्नारायणं शंभुं दुर्गा लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the ninety-second chapter. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Dispatched by Śrī Kṛṣṇa, joyful, having bowed to Gaṇeśvara, / and remembering Nārāyaṇa, Śambhu, Durgā, Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī,
title: atha dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāṃ ca manasi dhyātvā dimīśaṃ taṃ maheśvaram .
prajagāmoddhavaścaiva dṛṣṭvā maṅgalamūcakam .. 2 ..
meaning:
गङ्गां च मनसि ध्यात्वा दिमीशं तं महेश्वरम् .
प्रजगामोद्धवश्चैव दृष्ट्वा मङ्गलमूचकम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: and Gaṅgā, and meditating in his mind on Maheśvara, the lord of the quarters, / Uddhava set forth, seeing auspicious portents:

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrāva duṃdubhiṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ śaṅkhadhvaniṃ tathā .
hariśabdaṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śuśrāva maṅgaladhvanim .. 3 ..
meaning:
शुश्राव दुंदुभिं घण्टानादं शङ्खध्वनिं तथा .
हरिशब्दं च संगीतं शुश्राव मङ्गलध्वनिम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: he heard the kettle-drum, the sound of bells, and the blast of conches, / and the cry of 'Hari', music, and auspicious sounds;

sanskrit_iast:
patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ pradīpaṃ mālyadarpaṇam .
paribūrṇatamaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhilājaphalāni ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
पतिपुत्रवतीं साध्वीं प्रदीपं माल्यदर्पणम् .
परिबूर्णतमं कुम्भं दधिलाजफलानि च .. 4 ..
text_mt: a virtuous woman with husband and son, a lamp, a garland, a mirror, / a completely filled jar, yogurt, parched grains, and fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāṅkuraṃ śukladhānyaṃ rajataṃ kāñcanaṃ madhu .
brāhmaṇānāṃ samūhaṃ ca kṛṣṇasāraṃ vṛṣaṃ ghṛtam .. 5 ..
meaning:
दूर्वाङ्कुरं शुक्लधान्यं रजतं काञ्चनं मधु .
ब्राह्मणानां समूहं च कृष्णसारं वृषं घृतम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: dūrvā sprouts, white grains, silver, gold, honey, / a multitude of brāhmaṇas, a blackbuck, a bull, clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
sadyomāṃsaṃ gajendraṃ ca nṛpendraṃ śvetaghoṭakam .
patākāṃ nakulaṃ cāṣaṃ śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
सद्योमांसं गजेन्द्रं च नृपेन्द्रं श्वेतघोटकम् .
पताकां नकुलं चाषं शुक्लं पुष्पं च चन्दनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: fresh meat, an elephant, a king, a white horse, / a banner, a mongoose, a blue jay, white flowers, and sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pathi kalyāṇaṃ prāpa vṛndāvanaṃ vanam .
dadarśa purato vṛkṣaṃ bhāṇḍīre vaṭamakṣayam .. 7 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैवं पथि कल्याणं प्राप वृन्दावनं वनम् .
ददर्श पुरतो वृक्षं भाण्डीरे वटमक्षयम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having seen such auspicious things on the road, he reached the forest of Vṛndāvana. / He saw before him the tree at Bhāṇḍīra, the imperishable banyan,

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhaparṇa raktavarṇa puṇyadaṃ tīrthamīpsitam .
suveṣānbālakāṃścaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्निग्धपर्ण रक्तवर्ण पुण्यदं तीर्थमीप्सितम् .
सुवेषान्बालकांश्चैव रत्नभूषणभूषितान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: with glossy leaves, reddish hue, bestowing merit, a coveted place of pilgrimage; / and well-attired boys adorned with jewelled ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
vadato balakṛṣṇeti rudataśca śucā'nvitān .
tānāśvāsya yayau dūraṃ praviśya nagaraṃ mudā .. 9 ..
meaning:
वदतो बलकृष्णेति रुदतश्च शुचाऽन्वितान् .
तानाश्वास्य ययौ दूरं प्रविश्य नगरं मुदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: crying, overcome with grief, and saying 'Bala! Kṛṣṇa!' / Having comforted them, he went onward and entered the settlement with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa nandaśibiraṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .
maṇiratnavinirmāṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
ददर्श नन्दशिबिरं रचितं विश्वकर्मणा .
मणिरत्नविनिर्माणं मुक्तामाणिक्यहीरकैः .. 10 ..
text_mt: He saw Nanda's residence, fashioned by Viśvakarman, / constructed of precious gems, pearls, rubies, and diamonds.

sanskrit_iast:
paricchannaṃ manoramyaṃ sadratnakalaśānvitam .
dvāraṃ citraṃ vicitrāḍhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca praviveśa saḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
परिच्छन्नं मनोरम्यं सद्रत्नकलशान्वितम् .
द्वारं चित्रं विचित्राढ्यं दृष्ट्वा च प्रविवेश सः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Enclosed, delightful, endowed with pitchers of fine gems, / seeing the wonderful, richly adorned gate, he entered.

sanskrit_iast:
avaruhya rathāttūrṇa tasthau tatprāṅgaṇe mudā .
yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ param .. 12 ..
meaning:
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्ण तस्थौ तत्प्राङ्गणे मुदा .
यशोदा रोहिणी शीघ्रं पप्रच्छ कुशलं परम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Stepping down quickly from the chariot, he stood gladly in its courtyard. / Yaśodā and Rohiṇī at once asked after [everyone's] highest welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ gāṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau mudā .
kva nandaḥ kva balaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ tatkathayoddhava .. 13 ..
meaning:
आसनं च जलं गां च मधुपर्कं ददौ मुदा .
क्व नन्दः क्व बलः कृष्णः सत्यं तत्कथयोद्धव .. 13 ..
text_mt: She gladly offered a seat, water, a cow, and the madhuparka offering: / "Where is Nanda? Where are Balarāma and Kṛṣṇa? Tell that truthfully, Uddhava!"

sanskrit_iast:
uddhavaḥ kathayāmāsa sarva bhadraṃ krameṇa ca .
sārdhaṃ ca balakṛṣṇābhyāṃ nandaḥ sānandapūrvakam .. 14 ..
meaning:
उद्धवः कथयामास सर्व भद्रं क्रमेण च .
सार्धं च बलकृष्णाभ्यां नन्दः सानन्दपूर्वकम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Uddhava related everything auspiciously in due order: / "Along with Balarāma and Kṛṣṇa, Nanda, full of joy,

sanskrit_iast:
āyāsyati vilambena kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi .
yuṣmākaṃ kuśalaṃ tatvaṃ vijñāya vidhipūrvakam .. 15 ..
meaning:
आयास्यति विलम्बेन कृष्णोपनयनावधि .
युष्माकं कुशलं तत्वं विज्ञाय विधिपूर्वकम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: will come after some delay, by the time of Kṛṣṇa's sacred thread ceremony. / Having properly learned of your welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ yaśode śṛṇu sāṃpratam .
śrṛtvā maṅgalavārtā ca yaśodā rohiṇī mudā .. 16 ..
meaning:
अहं यास्यामि मथुरां यशोदे शृणु सांप्रतम् .
श्रृत्वा मङ्गलवार्ता च यशोदा रोहिणी मुदा .. 16 ..
text_mt: I shall return to Mathurā; hear this now, Yaśodā!" / Hearing the auspicious news, Yaśodā and Rohiṇī joyfully

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāya dadau ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vastramīpsitam .
uddhavaṃ bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam .. 17 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाय ददौ रत्नं सुवर्णं वस्त्रमीप्सितम् .
उद्धवं भोजयामास मिष्टान्नं च सुधोपमम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: gave gems, gold, and desired garments to the brāhmaṇa. / She fed Uddhava sweet food resembling nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ ca dadau tasmai ca hīrakam .
vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa bhadraṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā .. 18 ..
meaning:
मणिश्रेष्ठं च रत्नं च ददौ तस्मै च हीरकम् .
वाद्यं च वादयामास भद्रं नानाविधं तथा .. 18 ..
text_mt: and gave him excellent jewels, gems, and diamonds. / She also had various kinds of auspicious musical instruments played,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam .
vedāśca pāṭhayāmāsa paramānandapūrvakam .. 19 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणान्भोजयामास कारयामास मङ्गलम् .
वेदाश्च पाठयामास परमानन्दपूर्वकम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: fed brāhmaṇas, caused auspicious rites to be performed, / and had the Vedas recited with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaraṃ pūjayāmāsa vipradvārā paraṃ vibhūm .
nānopahārairnaivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpapradīpakaiḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
शंकरं पूजयामास विप्रद्वारा परं विभूम् .
नानोपहारैर्नैवेद्यैः पुष्पधूपप्रदीपकैः .. 20 ..
text_mt: Through the brāhmaṇas she worshipped Śaṅkara, the supreme, all-pervading Lord, / with various offerings and oblations, flowers, incense, and lamps,

sanskrit_iast:
candanairvastratāmbūlairmadhugavyaghṛtādibhiḥ .
bhavānīṃ pūjayāmāsa śrīvṛndāraṇyadevatām .. 21 ..
meaning:
चन्दनैर्वस्त्रताम्बूलैर्मधुगव्यघृतादिभिः .
भवानीं पूजयामास श्रीवृन्दारण्यदेवताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: sandalwood, garments, betel, honey, cow's milk, ghee, and other items. / She worshipped Bhavānī, the deity of the sacred forest of Vṛndāvana,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśopacārairdravyairbalibhirvividhairmune .
mahiṣāṇāṃ śate śuddhaṃ chāgālānāṃ sahasrakam .. 22 ..
meaning:
षोडशोपचारैर्द्रव्यैर्बलिभिर्विविधैर्मुने .
महिषाणां शते शुद्धं छागालानां सहस्रकम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: with items of sixteenfold worship and with various offerings, O sage: / with a hundred pure buffaloes, a thousand goats,

sanskrit_iast:
meṣāṇāmayutaṃ śuddhaṃ yuktamādāya pañcakam .
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svarṇaśataṃ dhenunāṃ ca śataṃ tathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
मेषाणामयुतं शुद्धं युक्तमादाय पञ्चकम् .
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः स्वर्णशतं धेनुनां च शतं तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt: and taking ten thousand pure sheep plus five more; / and to the brāhmaṇas [she gave] a hundred pieces of gold and likewise a hundred milk-cows

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ tūrṇa kṛṣṇakalyāṇahetave .
uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
प्रददौ दक्षिणां तूर्ण कृष्णकल्याणहेतवे .
उद्धवं पूजयामास सादरं च पुनः पुनः .. 24 ..
text_mt: as sacrificial fees at once for the sake of Kṛṣṇa's well-being. / She honoured Uddhava respectfully again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
samāśvāsya yaśodāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ gopabālakān .
vṛddhāngopālikāḥ sarvāḥ prayayū rāsamaṇḍalam .. 25 ..
meaning:
समाश्वास्य यशोदां च रोहिणीं गोपबालकान् .
वृद्धान्गोपालिकाः सर्वाः प्रययू रासमण्डलम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having consoled Yaśodā, Rohiṇī, the cowherd boys, / the elders, and all the cowherd women, he proceeded to the rāsa circle.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa rāsaṃ ruciraṃ candramaṇḍalavartulam .
śrīrāmakadalīstambhaśatakairupaśobhitam .. 26 ..
meaning:
ददर्श रासं रुचिरं चन्द्रमण्डलवर्तुलम् .
श्रीरामकदलीस्तम्भशतकैरुपशोभितम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: He saw the splendid rāsa ground, circular like the orb of the moon, / adorned with hundreds of Śrīrāma plantain trunks,

sanskrit_iast:
yuktaiśca snigdhavasanaiścandanānāṃ ca pallavaiḥ .
paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca śrīyuktamālyajālakaiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
युक्तैश्च स्निग्धवसनैश्चन्दनानां च पल्लवैः .
पट्टसूत्रनिबद्धैश्च श्रीयुक्तमाल्यजालकैः .. 27 ..
text_mt: fitted with glossy garments and shoots of sandalwood, / and with lovely garlands and nets bound with silk threads;

sanskrit_iast:
dadhilājaphalaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ puṣpairdūrvāṅkurairapi .
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiḥ parisaṃskṛtam .. 28 ..
meaning:
दधिलाजफलैः पट्टैः पुष्पैर्दूर्वाङ्कुरैरपि .
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमैः परिसंस्कृतम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: adorned with curds, parched grain, fruits, silk, flowers, and dūrvā sprouts, / and purified with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron;

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭitaṃ sakṣitaṃ yatnādgopikānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ .
trilakṣaiḥ sundarai ramyaiḥ saṃsaktaṃ ratimandiraiḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
वेष्टितं सक्षितं यत्नाद्गोपिकानां त्रिकोटिभिः .
त्रिलक्षैः सुन्दरै रम्यैः संसक्तं रतिमन्दिरैः .. 29 ..
text_mt: surrounded and carefully protected by thirty million cowherd women, / joined to three hundred thousand beautiful, charming pleasure bowers;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanaśaṅkitaiḥ .
yamunāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā prayayau mālatīvanam .. 30 ..
meaning:
लक्षगोपैः परिवृतं कृष्णागमनशङ्कितैः .
यमुनां दक्षिणां कृत्वा प्रययौ मालतीवनम् .. 30 ..
text_mt: surrounded by a hundred thousand cowherds longing for Kṛṣṇa's arrival. / Keeping the Yamunā to his right, he proceeded to the jasmine grove.

sanskrit_iast:
candanānāṃ campakānāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca .
ketakīmādhavīnāṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam .. 31 ..
meaning:
चन्दनानां चम्पकानां यूथिकानां तथैव च .
केतकीमाधवीनां च वनं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having circumambulated the grove of sandalwood, campaka, / yūthikā, ketakī, and mādhavī,

sanskrit_iast:
bakulānāṃ vañjulānāmaśokānāṃ ca kānanam .
mallikānāṃ palāśānāṃ śirīṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
बकुलानां वञ्जुलानामशोकानां च काननम् .
मल्लिकानां पलाशानां शिरीषाणां तथैव च .. 32 ..
text_mt: the forest of bakula, vañjula, and aśoka trees, / and likewise of mallikā, palāśa, and śirīṣa trees,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīṇāṃ kāñcanānāṃ ca karṇikānāṃ vanaṃ tathā .
nāgeśvarāṇāṃ vipinaṃ lavaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 33 ..
meaning:
धात्रीणां काञ्चनानां च कर्णिकानां वनं तथा .
नागेश्वराणां विपिनं लवङ्गानां तथैव च .. 33 ..
text_mt: the grove of dhātrī, kāñcana, and karṇika trees, / and the wood of nāgeśvara and clove trees,

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ ca śālatālānāṃ hintālānāṃ vanaṃ tathā .
panasānāṃ rasālānāṃ lāṅgalīnāṃ manoharam .. 34 ..
meaning:
वनं च शालतालानां हिन्तालानां वनं तथा .
पनसानां रसालानां लाङ्गलीनां मनोहरम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: and the grove of śāla, palm, and hintāla trees, / the delightful grove of jackfruit, mango, and lāṅgalī trees;

sanskrit_iast:
mandārakānanaṃ ramyaṃ vāmaṃ kṛtvā ca satvaram .
dṛṣṭvā kundavanaṃ ramyaṃ saṃprāpya madhukānanam .. 35 ..
meaning:
मन्दारकाननं रम्यं वामं कृत्वा च सत्वरम् .
दृष्ट्वा कुन्दवनं रम्यं संप्राप्य मधुकाननम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: keeping the charming grove of mandāra trees to his left, / quickly seeing the charming kunda grove, he reached the madhuka forest,

sanskrit_iast:
puṃskokilānāṃ śabdena madhureṇa samanvitam .
madhuvratasamūhānāṃ madhuradhvanibūritam .. 36 ..
meaning:
पुंस्कोकिलानां शब्देन मधुरेण समन्वितम् .
मधुव्रतसमूहानां मधुरध्वनिबूरितम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: filled with the sweet calls of male cuckoos, / resounded with the sweet humming of swarms of bees,

sanskrit_iast:
vanyavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ mādhvīkādhāramīpsitam .
vātena vanyabuṣpāṇāṃ varitaḥ surabhīkṛtam .. 37 ..
meaning:
वन्यवृक्षैः परिवृतं माध्वीकाधारमीप्सितम् .
वातेन वन्यबुष्पाणां वरितः सुरभीकृतम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: surrounded by wild trees, a delightful source of sweet wine, / made fragrant all around by the breeze carrying forest flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvā rājamārgeṇa yaśodoktena sāṃpratam .
yayau śīghraṃ nirudvigniṃ rahasyaṃ badarīvanam .. 38 ..
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वा राजमार्गेण यशोदोक्तेन सांप्रतम् .
ययौ शीघ्रं निरुद्विग्निं रहस्यं बदरीवनम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Seeing that, along the royal road indicated by Yaśodā just now, / he went swiftly and without anxiety to the secret jujube grove.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīphalānāṃ ca nimbārnāṃ nāriṅgāṇāṃ vanaṃ tathā .
padmānāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ tulasīnāṃ ca kānanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
श्रीफलानां च निम्बार्नां नारिङ्गाणां वनं तथा .
पद्मानां करवीराणां तुलसीनां च काननम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Seeing the grove of bilva, neem, and orange trees, / and the forest of lotuses, oleanders, and tulasī,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavā raktimavarṇaṃ ca supakvaphalamīpsitam .
tadeva vāmataḥ kṛtvā viveśa kadalīvanam .. 40 ..
meaning:
दृष्टवा रक्तिमवर्णं च सुपक्वफलमीप्सितम् .
तदेव वामतः कृत्वा विवेश कदलीवनम् .. 40 ..
text_mt: bearing desirable, reddish, fully ripe fruit, / leaving that to his left, he entered a plantain grove.

sanskrit_iast:
atīva nirjane ramye dadarśa rādhikāśramam .
maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca prākāraṃ parikhādurgaveṣṭitam .. 41 ..
meaning:
अतीव निर्जने रम्ये ददर्श राधिकाश्रमम् .
मणीन्द्राणां च प्राकारं परिखादुर्गवेष्टितम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: In an exceedingly solitary, charming spot, he saw Rādhikā's hermitage, / with a rampart of best gems, surrounded by a ditch and a fortress,

sanskrit_iast:
atyagamyaṃ ripūṇāṃ ca mitrāṇāṃ sugamaṃ sukham .
gopyaṃ saṃketamārgaṃ ca rakṣakaiḥ parirakṣitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
अत्यगम्यं रिपूणां च मित्राणां सुगमं सुखम् .
गोप्यं संकेतमार्गं च रक्षकैः परिरक्षितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: utterly impassable to enemies and easily, pleasantly accessible to friends, / a secret meeting-place guarded by protectors,

sanskrit_iast:
nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .
maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārojjvalaṃ param .. 43 ..
meaning:
नानाचित्रविचित्राढ्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा .
मणीन्द्रमुक्तामाणिक्यहीरहारोज्ज्वलं परम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: rich with various wonderful decorations, fashioned by Viśvakarman, / supremely radiant with necklaces of best gems, pearls, rubies, and diamonds,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasāraracitaṃ ratnastambhaiḥ suśobhitam .
ratnasopānasaṃsaktamandireṇa manoharam .. 44 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसाररचितं रत्नस्तम्भैः सुशोभितम् .
रत्नसोपानसंसक्तमन्दिरेण मनोहरम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: fashioned from the essence of best gems, well adorned with jewelled pillars, / charming with an abode joined to jewelled stairs,

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ kalaśaiḥ pariśobhitam .
vāhniśuddhāṃśukābhiśca patākābhiḥ pariṣkṛtam .. 45 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्नखचितं कलशैः परिशोभितम् .
वाह्निशुद्धांशुकाभिश्च पताकाभिः परिष्कृतम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: inlaid with priceless jewels, adorned with pitchers, / and decorated with banners and fire-pure garments,

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnadarpaṇotkṛṣṭaṃ carcitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ .
dadarśa siṃhadvāraṃ ca yuktaṃ ratnakapāṭakaiḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नदर्पणोत्कृष्टं चर्चितं श्वेतचामरैः .
ददर्श सिंहद्वारं च युक्तं रत्नकपाटकैः .. 46 ..
text_mt: distinguished by mirrors of fine gems, attended with white fly-whisks. / He saw the main gate, fitted with jewelled doors.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāropari vicitraṃ ca ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam .
kadambakānanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvāstraharaṇādikam .. 47 ..
meaning:
द्वारोपरि विचित्रं च रम्यं वृन्दावनं वनम् .
कदम्बकाननं रम्यं तद्वास्त्रहरणादिकम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Above the gate was depicted the wonderful, charming Vṛndāvana forest, / the delightful kadamba grove, the stealing of garments and other deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmaviracitaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .
nānāratnakuṭīraṃ ca gopagopīsamanvitam .. 48 ..
meaning:
विश्वकर्मविरचितं सुरम्यं रासमण्डलम् .
नानारत्नकुटीरं च गोपगोपीसमन्वितम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: the very charming rāsa circle fashioned by Viśvakarman, / with various jewelled huts, accompanied by cowherds and cowherd women,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣitaṃ gopikālakṣairvetrahastairmanoharaiḥ .
svacchandācaraṇaiḥ śaśvadamitairbalibhirmudā .. 49 ..
meaning:
रक्षितं गोपिकालक्षैर्वेत्रहस्तैर्मनोहरैः .
स्वच्छन्दाचरणैः शश्वदमितैर्बलिभिर्मुदा .. 49 ..
text_mt: guarded by a hundred thousand cowherd women holding canes in their hands, charming, / moving at will, continually, with boundless strength and joy.

sanskrit_iast:
taddvāraṃ purato dṛṣṭvā vilaṅkya ca jagām saḥ .
dvitīyaṃ dvāramullaṅghya tasmāduttamamīpsitam .. 50 ..
meaning:
तद्द्वारं पुरतो दृष्ट्वा विलङ्क्य च जगाम् सः .
द्वितीयं द्वारमुल्लङ्घ्य तस्मादुत्तममीप्सितम् .. 50 ..
text_mt: Seeing that gate ahead, he passed beyond it and went on. / Passing the second gate, and one better than that, which he desired,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraṃ caturthaṃ saṃprāpya sarvasmācca vilakṣaṇam .
tatpaścātpañcamaṃ dvāraṃ dadarśa citramuttamam .. 51 ..
meaning:
द्वारं चतुर्थं संप्राप्य सर्वस्माच्च विलक्षणम् .
तत्पश्चात्पञ्चमं द्वारं ददर्श चित्रमुत्तमम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: reaching the fourth gate, distinct from all the others, / after that he saw the fifth gate, extraordinary and supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraṣaṭkaṃ ca prayayau sarvatra ruciraṃ param .
rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ bhitticitraṃ manoharam .. 52 ..
meaning:
द्वारषट्कं च प्रययौ सर्वत्र रुचिरं परम् .
रामरावणयोर्युद्धं भित्तिचित्रं मनोहरम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: He passed through six gates, supremely pleasing everywhere: / with charming wall-paintings of the battle between Rāma and Rāvaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvatāraṃ viṣṇośca kṛtrimaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .
yamunājalakeliṃ ca racitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 53 ..
meaning:
दशावतारं विष्णोश्च कृत्रिमं रासमण्डलम् .
यमुनाजलकेलिं च रचितां विश्वकर्मणा .. 53 ..
text_mt: the ten avatars of Viṣṇu, an artificial rāsa arena, / and the water-sport in the Yamunā, fashioned by Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
gopikānāṃ sahasreṇā ṣaṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ ca rakṣitam .
ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitena ca .. 54 ..
meaning:
गोपिकानां सहस्रेणा षष्ठं द्वारं च रक्षितम् .
रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्माणभूषणैर्भूषितेन च .. 54 ..
text_mt: The sixth gate was guarded by a thousand cowherd women / adorned with ornaments made of the essence of best gems.

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnadaṇa़ḍahastena hīrakairbhūṣitena ca .
maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārānvitena ca .. 55 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नदण़डहस्तेन हीरकैर्भूषितेन च .
मणीन्द्रमुक्तामाणिक्यहीरहारान्वितेन च .. 55 ..
text_mt: holding a staff made of fine jewels, adorned with diamonds, / and adorned with necklaces of superior gems, pearls, rubies, and diamonds.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavī tatpradhānā sā papraccha sāṃprataṃ śivam .
dadau pratyuttaraṃ sarvaṃ krameṇa ca sa uddhavaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
माधवी तत्प्रधाना सा पप्रच्छ सांप्रतं शिवम् .
ददौ प्रत्युत्तरं सर्वं क्रमेण च स उद्धवः .. 56 ..
text_mt: Mādhavī, the foremost among them, then asked [him about his] well-being. / And Uddhava gave every reply in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇam .
sā mādhavī mahāhṛṣṭā tatra saṃsthāpya taṃ mudā .. 57 ..
meaning:
गत्वा विज्ञापयामास राधाप्रियसखीगणम् .
सा माधवी महाहृष्टा तत्र संस्थाप्य तं मुदा .. 57 ..
text_mt: Having happily seated him there, the greatly delighted Mādhavī / went and informed the group of Rādhā's dear female companions.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā maṅgalavārtāṃ ca rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇaiḥ .
kṛtvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ ghaṇṭāmṛdaṅgapaṭahasvanam .. 58 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा मङ्गलवार्तां च राधाप्रियसखीगणैः .
कृत्वा शङ्खध्वनिं घण्टामृदङ्गपटहस्वनम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: Having heard the auspicious news, the group of Rādhā's dear companions / sounded conches, bells, mṛdaṅgas, and kettle-drums.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nirmañchanaṃ śīghramuddhavaṃ priyamāgatam .
hṛṣṭā praveśayāmāsa rādhābhyantaramuttamam .. 59 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा निर्मञ्छनं शीघ्रमुद्धवं प्रियमागतम् .
हृष्टा प्रवेशयामास राधाभ्यन्तरमुत्तमम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: Having swiftly performed the wave-offering for the dear Uddhava who had arrived, / she gladly ushered him into the excellent inner chamber of Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ gatvā mandiramuttamam .
dadarśa purato rādhāṃ kuhvā candrakalopamām .. 60 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं गत्वा मन्दिरमुत्तमम् .
ददर्श पुरतो राधां कुह्वा चन्द्रकलोपमाम् .. 60 ..
text_mt: Entering that excellent palace made of priceless jewels, / he saw Rādhā before him, like a digit of the moon on the new-moon day,

sanskrit_iast:
supakvapadmanetrāṃ ca śayānāṃ śokamūrcchitām .
rudatīṃ raktavadanāṃ vilṣṭāṃ ca tyaktabhūṣaṇām .. 61 ..
meaning:
सुपक्वपद्मनेत्रां च शयानां शोकमूर्च्छिताम् .
रुदतीं रक्तवदनां विल्ष्टां च त्यक्तभूषणाम् .. 61 ..
text_mt: with eyes like fully ripened lotuses, lying down, fainted from grief, / weeping, with a flushed face, distressed, having cast off her ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
niśceṣṭāṃ ca nirāhārāṃ suvarṇavarṇakuṇḍalām .
śuṣkitādharakaṇṭhāṃ ca kiṃcinniḥ śvāsasaṃyutām .. 62 ..
meaning:
निश्चेष्टां च निराहारां सुवर्णवर्णकुण्डलाम् .
शुष्किताधरकण्ठां च किंचिन्निः श्वाससंयुताम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: motionless, taking no food, wearing golden-hued earrings, / her lower lip and throat parched, with scarcely any breath remaining.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇanāma ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ .
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktyā bhaktaḥ sa uddhavaḥ .. 63 ..
meaning:
प्रणनाम च तां दृष्ट्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधरः .
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गो भक्त्या भक्तः स उद्धवः .. 63 ..
text_mt: Seeing her, the devotee Uddhava bowed down, / with neck bent low in devotion, all his limbs bristling with joy through bhakti.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhava uvāca
vande rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ brahmādisuravindatam .
yatkīrtiḥ kīrtanenaiva punāti bhuvanatrayam .. 64 ..
meaning:
उद्धव उवाच
वन्दे राधापदाम्भोजं ब्रह्मादिसुरविन्दतम् .
यत्कीर्तिः कीर्तनेनैव पुनाति भुवनत्रयम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: Uddhava said: / I bow to Rādhā's lotus feet, praised by the gods headed by Brahmā, / the celebration of whose fame alone purifies the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
namo gokulavāsinyai rādhikāyai namo namaḥ .
śataśṛṅganivāsinyai candrāvatyai nao .. 65 ..
meaning:
नमो गोकुलवासिन्यै राधिकायै नमो नमः .
शतशृङ्गनिवासिन्यै चन्द्रावत्यै नओ .. 65 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the dweller of Gokula, to Rādhikā, salutations, salutations! / To the dweller of Śataśṛṅga, to Candrāvatī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīvanavāsinya vṛndāraṇyai nao .
rāsamaṇḍalavāsinyai rāseśvaryai nao .. 66 ..
meaning:
तुलसीवनवासिन्य वृन्दारण्यै नओ .
रासमण्डलवासिन्यै रासेश्वर्यै नओ .. 66 ..
text_mt: To the dweller in the forest of Tulasī, to Vṛndāraṇyā, salutations! / To the dweller in the circle of the rāsa, to the queen of the rāsa, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
virajātīravāsinyai vṛndāyai ca nao .
vṛndāvanavilāsinyai kṛṣṇāyai ca nao .. 67 ..
meaning:
विरजातीरवासिन्यै वृन्दायै च नओ .
वृन्दावनविलासिन्यै कृष्णायै च नओ .. 67 ..
text_mt: To the dweller on the bank of the Virajā, to Vṛndā, salutations! / To the one who revels in Vṛndāvana, to Kṛṣṇā, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca śāntāyai ca nao .
kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthitāyai ca tatpiyāyai nao .. 68 ..
meaning:
नमः कृष्णप्रियायै च शान्तायै च नओ .
कृष्णवक्षःस्थितायै च तत्पियायै नओ .. 68 ..
text_mt: Salutations to Kṛṣṇa's beloved, to the tranquil one, salutations! / To her who rests upon Kṛṣṇa's chest, to his beloved, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namo vaikuṇṭhavāsinyai mahālakṣmyai nao .
vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sarasvatyai nao .. 69 ..
meaning:
नमो वैकुण्ठवासिन्यै महालक्ष्म्यै नओ .
विद्याधिष्ठातृदेव्यै च सरस्वत्यै नओ .. 69 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the dweller of Vaikuṇṭha, to Mahālakṣmī, salutations! / To the presiding deity of knowledge, to Sarasvatī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryādhidevyai ca kamalāyai nao .
padmanābhapriyāyai ca padmāyai ca nao .. 70 ..
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्याधिदेव्यै च कमलायै नओ .
पद्मनाभप्रियायै च पद्मायै च नओ .. 70 ..
text_mt: To the presiding goddess of all sovereignty, to Kamalā, salutations! / To the beloved of Padmanābha, to Padmā, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣṇośca mātre ca parādyāyai nao .
namaḥ sindhusutāyai ca martyalakṣmayai nao .. 71 ..
meaning:
महाविष्णोश्च मात्रे च पराद्यायै नओ .
नमः सिन्धुसुतायै च मर्त्यलक्ष्मयै नओ .. 71 ..
text_mt: To the mother of Mahāviṣṇu, to the supreme and primordial one, salutations! / Salutations to the daughter of the ocean, to the mortal Lakṣmī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇapriyāyai ca nārāyaṇyai nao .
namo'stu viṣṇumāyāyai vaiṣṇavyai ca nao .. 72 ..
meaning:
नारायणप्रियायै च नारायण्यै नओ .
नमोऽस्तु विष्णुमायायै वैष्णव्यै च नओ .. 72 ..
text_mt: To the beloved of Nārāyaṇa, to Nārāyaṇī, salutations! / Let there be salutation to the māyā of Viṣṇu, to the Vaiṣṇavī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmāyāsvarūpāyai saṃpadāyai nao .
namaḥ kalyāṇarūpiṇyai śubhāyai ca nao .. 73 ..
meaning:
महामायास्वरूपायै संपदायै नओ .
नमः कल्याणरूपिण्यै शुभायै च नओ .. 73 ..
text_mt: To the embodiment of Mahāmāyā, to prosperity, salutations! / Salutations to the embodiment of auspiciousness, to the auspicious one, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
mātre caturṇā vedānāṃ sāvitryai ca nao .
namo'stu buddhirūpāyai jñānadāyai nao .. 74 ..
meaning:
मात्रे चतुर्णा वेदानां सावित्र्यै च नओ .
नमोऽस्तु बुद्धिरूपायै ज्ञानदायै नओ .. 74 ..
text_mt: To the mother of the four Vedas, to Sāvitrī, salutations! / Let there be salutation to the embodiment of intellect, to the giver of knowledge, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namo durgavināśinyai durgādevyai nao .
tejaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā kṛtayuge mudā .. 75 ..
meaning:
नमो दुर्गविनाशिन्यै दुर्गादेव्यै नओ .
तेजःसु सर्वदेवानां पुरा कृतयुगे मुदा .. 75 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the destroyer of misfortune, to Goddess Durgā, salutations! / [Arising] in the splendour of all the gods formerly in the Kṛta age with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭānakṛtāyai ca prakṛtyai ca nao .
namastripurahāriṇyai tripurāyai nao .. 76 ..
meaning:
अधिष्टानकृतायै च प्रकृत्यै च नओ .
नमस्त्रिपुरहारिण्यै त्रिपुरायै नओ .. 76 ..
text_mt: to her who took her abode [there], to Prakṛti, salutations! / Salutations to the destroyer of Tripura, to Tripurā, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
sundarīṣu ca ramyāyai nirguṇāyai nao .
mamo nidrāsvarūpāyai nirguṇāyai nao .. 77 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरीषु च रम्यायै निर्गुणायै नओ .
ममो निद्रास्वरूपायै निर्गुणायै नओ .. 77 ..
text_mt: To the loveliest among beautiful women, to the one devoid of qualities, salutations! / Salutations to the embodiment of sleep, to the one devoid of qualities, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namo dakṣasutāyai ca namaḥ satyai nao .
namaḥ śailasutāyai ca pārvatyai ca nao .. 78 ..
meaning:
नमो दक्षसुतायै च नमः सत्यै नओ .
नमः शैलसुतायै च पार्वत्यै च नओ .. 78 ..
text_mt: Salutations to the daughter of Dakṣa, and salutations to Satī, salutations! / Salutations to the daughter of the mountain, to Pārvatī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namo namastapasvinyai hyu māyai ca nao .
nirāhārasvarūpāyai hyaparṇāyai nao .. 79 ..
meaning:
नमो नमस्तपस्विन्यै ह्यु मायै च नओ .
निराहारस्वरूपायै ह्यपर्णायै नओ .. 79 ..
text_mt: Salutations, salutations to the ascetic woman, to Umā, salutations! / To the embodiment of fasting, to Aparṇā, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīlaukavilāsinyai namo gauryai nao .
namaḥ kailāsavāsinyai māheśvaryaiḥ nao .. 80 ..
meaning:
गौरीलौकविलासिन्यै नमो गौर्यै नओ .
नमः कैलासवासिन्यै माहेश्वर्यैः नओ .. 80 ..
text_mt: To the one who sports in the world of Gaurī, salutations to Gaurī, salutations! / Salutations to the dweller of Kailāsa, to Māheśvarī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
nidrāyai ca dayāyai ca śraddhāyai ca nao .
namo dhṛtyai kṣamāryai ca lajjāyai ca nao .. 81 ..
meaning:
निद्रायै च दयायै च श्रद्धायै च नओ .
नमो धृत्यै क्षमार्यै च लज्जायै च नओ .. 81 ..
text_mt: To sleep, to compassion, and to faith, salutations! / Salutations to patience, to forgiveness, and to modesty, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣṇāyai kṣutsvarūpāyai sthitikartryai nao .
namaḥ saṃhārarūpiṇyai mahāmāryai nao .. 82 ..
meaning:
तृष्णायै क्षुत्स्वरूपायै स्थितिकर्त्र्यै नओ .
नमः संहाररूपिण्यै महामार्यै नओ .. 82 ..
text_mt: To desire, to the embodiment of hunger, to the sustainer, salutations! / Salutations to the embodiment of destruction, to Mahāmārī, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
bhayāyaiṃ cābhayāyaiṃ ca muktidāyai nao .
namaḥ svadhāyaiṃ svāhāyai śāntayai kāntyai nao .. 83 ..
meaning:
भयायैं चाभयायैं च मुक्तिदायै नओ .
नमः स्वधायैं स्वाहायै शान्तयै कान्त्यै नओ .. 83 ..
text_mt: To fear, to fearlessness, and to the bestower of liberation, salutations! / Salutations to Svadhā, to Svāhā, to tranquility, to splendour, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namastuṣṭyaiṃ ca puṣṭyai ca dayāyai ca nao .
namo nidrāsvarūpāyai śraddhāyai ca nao .. 84 ..
meaning:
नमस्तुष्ट्यैं च पुष्ट्यै च दयायै च नओ .
नमो निद्रास्वरूपायै श्रद्धायै च नओ .. 84 ..
text_mt: Salutations to contentment, to nourishment, and to compassion, salutations! / Salutations to the embodiment of sleep, to faith, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpipāsāsvarūpāyai lajjāyaiṃ ca nao .
namo dhṛtyaiṃ kṣamāyaiṃ ca cetanāyaiṃ nao .. 85 ..
meaning:
क्षुत्पिपासास्वरूपायै लज्जायैं च नओ .
नमो धृत्यैं क्षमायैं च चेतनायैं नओ .. 85 ..
text_mt: To the embodiment of hunger and thirst, and to modesty, salutations! / Salutations to patience, to forgiveness, and to consciousness, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇyai sarvamātre nao .
agnau dāhasvarūpāyai bhadrāyai ca nao .. 86 ..
meaning:
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपिण्यै सर्वमात्रे नओ .
अग्नौ दाहस्वरूपायै भद्रायै च नओ .. 86 ..
text_mt: To the embodiment of all powers, to the mother of all, salutations! / To the burning power in fire, to the auspicious one, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
śobhāyai pūrṇacandre ca śaratpadma nao .
nāsti bhedo yathā devi dugdhadhāvalyayoḥsadā .. 87 ..
meaning:
शोभायै पूर्णचन्द्रे च शरत्पद्म नओ .
नास्ति भेदो यथा देवि दुग्धधावल्ययोःसदा .. 87 ..
text_mt: To the beauty in the full moon, to the autumn lotus, salutations! / Just as there is no difference, O goddess, between milk and its whiteness at all times,

sanskrit_iast:
yathaiva gandhabhūmyośca yathaiva jalaśaityayauḥ .
yathaiva śabdanbhasorjyotiḥ sūryakayoryathā .. 88 ..
meaning:
यथैव गन्धभूम्योश्च यथैव जलशैत्ययौः .
यथैव शब्दन्भसोर्ज्योतिः सूर्यकयोर्यथा .. 88 ..
text_mt: just as between fragrance and earth, just as between water and coolness, / just as between sound and the sky, and light and the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
loke vede purāṇe ca rādhāmādhavayostathā .
cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi dehi māmuttaraṃ sati .. 89 ..
meaning:
लोके वेदे पुराणे च राधामाधवयोस्तथा .
चेतनं कुरु कल्याणि देहि मामुत्तरं सति .. 89 ..
text_mt: so it is between Rādhā and Mādhava in the world, the Veda, and the Purāṇa. / Regain consciousness, O auspicious one! Give me an answer, O chaste lady!

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā coddhavastatra praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ .
ityudvavakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam .. 90 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा चोद्धवस्तत्र प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः .
इत्युद्ववकृतं स्तोत्रं यः पठेद्भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 90 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Uddhava bowed down there again and again. / Whoever recites with devotion this hymn of praise composed by Uddhava,

sanskrit_iast: iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante harimandiram .na bhavedbandhuvicchedo rogaḥ śokaḥ sudāruṇaḥ .. 91 ..
meaning: इह लोके सुखं भुक्त्वा यात्यन्ते हरिमन्दिरम् .न भवेद्बन्धुविच्छेदो रोगः शोकः सुदारुणः .. 91 ..
text_mt: having enjoyed happiness in this world, goes in the end to Hari's abode. / There shall be no separation from relatives, nor disease, nor terrible grief.

sanskrit_iast:
proṣitā strī labhetkāntaṃ bhāryābhedī labhetpriyām .
aputro labhate putrānnirdhano labhate dhanam .. 92 ..
meaning:
प्रोषिता स्त्री लभेत्कान्तं भार्याभेदी लभेत्प्रियाम् .
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान्निर्धनो लभते धनम् .. 92 ..
text_mt: A woman whose husband is away finds her lover; one estranged from his wife finds his beloved; / a childless man obtains sons; a poor man obtains wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
nirbhūmirlabhate bhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajām .
rogādvimucyate rogī baddhī mucyate bandhanāt .. 93 ..
meaning:
निर्भूमिर्लभते भूमिं प्रजाहीनो लभेत्प्रजाम् .
रोगाद्विमुच्यते रोगी बद्धी मुच्यते बन्धनात् .. 93 ..
text_mt: the landless obtains land; the person without subjects obtains subjects; / the sick is freed from disease; the bound is freed from bondage;

sanskrit_iast:
bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetā''pannaāpadaḥ .
aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ .. 94 ..
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo rādhāstotraṃ
nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
भयान्मुच्येत भीतस्तु मुच्येता'ऽपन्नआपदः .
अस्पष्टकीर्तिः सुयशा मूर्खो भवति पण्डितः .. 94 ..
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ राधास्तोत्रं
नाम द्विनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 92 ..
text_mt:
the frightened is freed from fear; one fallen into distress is freed from misfortune; / one of obscure fame gains good renown; a fool becomes learned.
Thus ends the ninety-second chapter, entitled 'The Hymn of Praise to Rādhā', in the conversation between Nārada and [Nārāyaṇa], in the latter part of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the glorious and great Brahmavaivartapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
uddhavastavanaṃ śrutvā cetanāṃ prāpya rādhikā .
vilokya kṛṣṇākāraṃ ca tamuvāca śucā'nvitā .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
उद्धवस्तवनं श्रुत्वा चेतनां प्राप्य राधिका .
विलोक्य कृष्णाकारं च तमुवाच शुचाऽन्विता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the ninety-third chapter. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Having heard Uddhava's praise and regained consciousness, Rādhikā, / seeing his Kṛṣṇa-like form, spoke to him filled with sorrow.
title: atha trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikovāca
kinnāma bhavato vatsa kena vā prerito bhavān .
āgato vā kuta iti brūha māṃ kena hetunā .. 2 ..
meaning:
राधिकोवाच
किन्नाम भवतो वत्स केन वा प्रेरितो भवान् .
आगतो वा कुत इति ब्रूह मां केन हेतुना .. 2 ..
text_mt: Rādhikā said: / What is your name, my child? By whom were you sent? / Whence have you come? Tell me, for what reason?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇākṛtistvaṃ sarvāṅgairmanye tvāṃ kṛṣṇapārṣadam .
kṛṣṇasya suśalaṃ brūhi baradevasya sāṃpratam .. 3 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाकृतिस्त्वं सर्वाङ्गैर्मन्ये त्वां कृष्णपार्षदम् .
कृष्णस्य सुशलं ब्रूहि बरदेवस्य सांप्रतम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: In all your limbs you have the appearance of Kṛṣṇa; I think you are an attendant of Kṛṣṇa. / Tell me now of the welfare of Kṛṣṇa and of Baladeva.

sanskrit_iast:
nandastiṣṭhati tatraiva hetunā kena tadvada .
samāyāsyati sovindo ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam .. 4 ..
meaning:
नन्दस्तिष्ठति तत्रैव हेतुना केन तद्वद .
समायास्यति सोविन्दो रम्यं वृन्दावनं वनम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Nanda stays there—tell me, for what reason? / Will Govinda return to the delightful forest of Vṛndāvana?

sanskrit_iast:
punardrakṣyāmi tasyaiva pūrṇacandramukhaṃ śubham .
punaḥ krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tenāhaṃ rāsamaṇḍale .. 5 ..
meaning:
पुनर्द्रक्ष्यामि तस्यैव पूर्णचन्द्रमुखं शुभम् .
पुनः क्रीडां करिष्यामि तेनाहं रासमण्डले .. 5 ..
text_mt: Shall I see again his auspicious full-moon face? / Shall I sport with him once more in the circle of the rāsa?

sanskrit_iast:
jale ca vihariṣyāmi punarvā sakhibhiḥ saha .
śrīnandanandanāṅge ca punardāsyāmi candanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
जले च विहरिष्यामि पुनर्वा सखिभिः सह .
श्रीनन्दनन्दनाङ्गे च पुनर्दास्यामि चन्दनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Shall I play again in the water together with my female friends? / And shall I apply sandalwood paste once again to the body of the son of Nanda?

sanskrit_iast:
uddhava uvāca
uddavetyabhidhānaṃ me kṣatriyo'haṃ varānane .
preṣitaḥ śubhavārtārthaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā .. 7 ..
meaning:
उद्धव उवाच
उद्दवेत्यभिधानं मे क्षत्रियोऽहं वरानने .
प्रेषितः शुभवार्तार्थं कृष्णेन परमात्मना .. 7 ..
text_mt: Uddhava said: / My name is Uddhava; I am a kṣatriya, O fair-faced lady. / I have been sent with good news by Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman. 7.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāntikaṃ samāyātaḥ pārṣado'haṃ harerapi .
kṛṣṇasya baladevasya śivaṃ nandasya sāṃpratam .. 8 ..
meaning:
तवान्तिकं समायातः पार्षदोऽहं हरेरपि .
कृष्णस्य बलदेवस्य शिवं नन्दस्य सांप्रतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: I have come to your presence, an attendant of Hari too. / It is well at present with Kṛṣṇa, Baladeva, and Nanda. 8.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikovāca
asti tadyamunākūlaṃ sugandhipavano'sti saḥ .
tasya kelikadambānāṃ mūlamastayeva sāṃpratam .. 9 ..
meaning:
राधिकोवाच
अस्ति तद्यमुनाकूलं सुगन्धिपवनोऽस्ति सः .
तस्य केलिकदम्बानां मूलमस्तयेव सांप्रतम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Rādhikā said: / There is that bank of the Yamunā, there is that fragrant breeze, / and at present there is indeed the root of his playful kadamba trees. 9.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvidyamānamīpsitam .
puṃskokilānāṃ virutaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam .. 10 ..
meaning:
पुण्यं वृन्दावनं रम्यं तद्विद्यमानमीप्सितम् .
पुंस्कोकिलानां विरुतं तल्पं चन्दनचर्चितम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: There is the sacred and delightful Vṛndāvana, as wished for, / the singing of male cuckoos, and the couch smeared with sandalwood. 10.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca madhupānaṃ ca sundaram .
duranto duḥkhado'pyasti pāpiṣṭho manmathastathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
चतुर्विधं च भोज्यं च मधुपानं च सुन्दरम् .
दुरन्तो दुःखदोऽप्यस्ति पापिष्ठो मन्मथस्तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: There are the four kinds of food, and the sweet wine, / and there is also the relentless, painful, and most wicked god of love. 11.

sanskrit_iast:
te ca ratnapradīpāśca jvalanti rāsamaṇḍale .
maṇīndrasāranirmāṇamastyeva ratimandiram .. 12 ..
meaning:
ते च रत्नप्रदीपाश्च ज्वलन्ति रासमण्डले .
मणीन्द्रसारनिर्माणमस्त्येव रतिमन्दिरम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Those jewelled lamps burn in the circular dance arena, / and there indeed is the pleasure-house made of the essence of fine gems. 12.

sanskrit_iast:
gopāṅganāgaṇo'styeva pūrṇacandro'sti śobhitaḥ .
sugandhipuṣparacitaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
गोपाङ्गनागणोऽस्त्येव पूर्णचन्द्रोऽस्ति शोभितः .
सुगन्धिपुष्परचितं तल्पं चन्दनचर्चितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: There is the assembly of cowherd women, there is the splendid full moon, / and the couch strewn with fragrant flowers and smeared with sandalwood. 13.

sanskrit_iast: tāmbūlaṃ ratibhogārhaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam .sugandhimālatīmālyaṃ śvetacāmaradarpaṇam .. 14 ..
meaning: ताम्बूलं रतिभोगार्हं कर्पूरादिसुसंस्कृतम् .सुगन्धिमालतीमाल्यं श्वेतचामरदर्पणम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: There is betel fit for the pleasures of love, prepared with camphor and other spices, / fragrant garlands of mālatī flowers, white fly-whisks, and mirrors; 14.

sanskrit_iast:
muktāmāṇikyasaṃsaktahīrahāramanoharam .
kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca pātrapūrṇaṃ ca candanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
मुक्तामाणिक्यसंसक्तहीरहारमनोहरम् .
कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमाक्तं च पात्रपूर्णं च चन्दनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: captivating pearl and ruby necklaces strung with diamonds, / and bowls full of sandalwood paste mixed with musk and saffron; 15.

sanskrit_iast:
nānopakānanaṃ ramyaṃ ramyakrīḍāsarovaram .
sugandhipuṣpodyānaṃ ca padmaśreṇīmanoharam .. 16 ..
meaning:
नानोपकाननं रम्यं रम्यक्रीडासरोवरम् .
सुगन्धिपुष्पोद्यानं च पद्मश्रेणीमनोहरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: various delightful groves, charming pleasure-ponds, / and fragrant flower gardens adorned with rows of lotuses. 16.

sanskrit_iast:
astyevaṃ sarvavibhavaḥ prāṇanāthaḥ kuto mama .
hā kṛṣṇa hā rāmānātha kvāsi me prāṇavallabha .. 17 ..
meaning:
अस्त्येवं सर्वविभवः प्राणनाथः कुतो मम .
हा कृष्ण हा रामानाथ क्वासि मे प्राणवल्लभ .. 17 ..
text_mt: All this splendour is present; where is the lord of my life? / Ah, Kṛṣṇa! Ah, lord of Ramā! Where are you, beloved of my life? 17.

sanskrit_iast:
kva vā'parādho dāsyāśca dāsīdoṣaḥ pade pade .
ityevamuktvā sā devī punarmūrcchāmavāpa sā .. 18 ..
meaning:
क्व वाऽपराधो दास्याश्च दासीदोषः पदे पदे .
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा देवी पुनर्मूर्च्छामवाप सा .. 18 ..
text_mt: Where was the fault of your servant? Yet a servant's fault is at every step! / Having spoken thus, the goddess fainted once again. 18.

sanskrit_iast:
cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa punareva sa uddhavaḥ .
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāścarya mene kṣatriyapuṃgavaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
चेतनां कारयामास पुनरेव स उद्धवः .
तां दृष्ट्वा परमाश्चर्य मेने क्षत्रियपुंगवः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Uddhava brought her back to consciousness once more. / Seeing her, that best of kṣatriyas was filled with great wonder. 19.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ .
gopīnāṃ ca trilakṣaiśca supriyaiḥ priyasevitām .. 20 ..
meaning:
सखीभिः सप्तभिः शश्वत्सेवितां श्वेतचामरैः .
गोपीनां च त्रिलक्षैश्च सुप्रियैः प्रियसेविताम् .. 20 ..
text_mt: She was constantly served by seven friends with white fly-whisks, / and attended with affection by three hundred thousand beloved cowherd women. 20.

sanskrit_iast:
divāniśaṃ veṣṭitāṃ ca gopīnāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ .
kācitkajjalahastā ca kācinmālyavarā'parā .. 21 ..
meaning:
दिवानिशं वेष्टितां च गोपीनां शतकोटिभिः .
काचित्कज्जलहस्ता च काचिन्माल्यवराऽपरा .. 21 ..
text_mt: Surrounded day and night by a billion cowherd women: / one held collyrium in hand, another held an excellent garland, 21.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitsindūrahastā ca kācidgorocanākarā .
kāciccandanapātraṃ ca haste kṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati .. 22 ..
meaning:
काचित्सिन्दूरहस्ता च काचिद्गोरोचनाकरा .
काचिच्चन्दनपात्रं च हस्ते कृत्वा च तिष्ठति .. 22 ..
text_mt: one had vermilion in hand, another held yellow pigment in her hand, / and one stood holding a vessel of sandalwood in her hand. 22.

sanskrit_iast:
kāciddarpaṇahastā ca kācitkuṅkumāvahikā .
kastūrīpātramiṣṭaṃ ca kācidvahati tatra vai .. 23 ..
meaning:
काचिद्दर्पणहस्ता च काचित्कुङ्कुमावहिका .
कस्तूरीपात्रमिष्टं च काचिद्वहति तत्र वै .. 23 ..
text_mt: One held a mirror, another carried saffron, / and one indeed carried a desirable bowl of musk there. 23.

sanskrit_iast:
kāciccampakapātraṃ ca kare dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati .
madhubhirmadhuraiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātraṃ dhṛtvā śucā'nvitā .. 24 ..
meaning:
काचिच्चम्पकपात्रं च करे धृत्वा च तिष्ठति .
मधुभिर्मधुरैः पूर्णं पात्रं धृत्वा शुचाऽन्विता .. 24 ..
text_mt: One stood holding a bowl of campaka [oil] in her hand, / [another], filled with sorrow, held a vessel full of sweet honey. 24.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitsugandhitailaṃ ca gṛhītvā paritiṣṭhati .
kācidvahati tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
काचित्सुगन्धितैलं च गृहीत्वा परितिष्ठति .
काचिद्वहति ताम्बूलं कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: One stood by holding fragrant oil; / another carried betel perfumed with camphor and the like. 25.

sanskrit_iast:
kācidvāsitamacchaṃ ca jalaṃ dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati .
krīḍāputtalikāṃ kāciccitrāḍhyāṃ parirakṣati .. 26 ..
meaning:
काचिद्वासितमच्छं च जलं धृत्वा च तिष्ठति .
क्रीडापुत्तलिकां काचिच्चित्राढ्यां परिरक्षति .. 26 ..
text_mt: One stood holding pure, scented water; / another watched over a colourful play-doll. 26.

sanskrit_iast:
kācidvahati kandūkaṃ kācicca ratnabhūṣaṇam .
vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ kācidamūlyaṃ parirakṣati .. 27 ..
meaning:
काचिद्वहति कन्दूकं काचिच्च रत्नभूषणम् .
वह्निशुद्धांशुकं काचिदमूल्यं परिरक्षति .. 27 ..
text_mt: One carried a ball, another jewelled ornaments; / one guarded priceless fire-purified silk. 27.

sanskrit_iast:
kācidbhakṣayopahāraṃ ca gṛhītvā parivartate .
kācicca keśaveśārthakaroti mālyamīpsitam .. 28 ..
meaning:
काचिद्भक्षयोपहारं च गृहीत्वा परिवर्तते .
काचिच्च केशवेशार्थकरोति माल्यमीप्सितम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: One moved about holding offerings of food; / another fashioned a desired garland for dressing the hair. 28.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitkaṅkatikāṃ dhṛtvā purataḥ paritiṣṭhati .
kācidyāvakahastā ca kāciddhātrīrasaṃ mudā .. 29 ..
meaning:
काचित्कङ्कतिकां धृत्वा पुरतः परितिष्ठति .
काचिद्यावकहस्ता च काचिद्धात्रीरसं मुदा .. 29 ..
text_mt: One stood in front holding a comb; / another held red lacquer, and one joyfully [held] myrobalan juice. 29.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrato'pi vahatyevaṃ bhītā ca paritiṣṭhati .
kācidbhītā bhiyā stautikācidroditi śokataḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
दूरतोऽपि वहत्येवं भीता च परितिष्ठति .
काचिद्भीता भिया स्तौतिकाचिद्रोदिति शोकतः .. 30 ..
text_mt: Thus one stood far off carrying [goods], afraid; / one, struck with fear, offered praises; another wept from grief. 30.

sanskrit_iast:
kācittāṃ baudhayetyerva vidagdhā virahāturām .
kāciduttāpataptā ca snigdhatalpe manohare .. 31 ..
meaning:
काचित्तां बौधयेत्येर्व विदग्धा विरहातुराम् .
काचिदुत्तापतप्ता च स्निग्धतल्पे मनोहरे .. 31 ..
text_mt: One clever woman tried to awaken her who was tormented by separation; / another, burning with heat, [placed her] on an attractive, cool couch, 31.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayeddāhadūrārthaṃ snigdhapadmadale śubhe .
evaṃbhūtāṃ catāṃ dṛṣṭavā covāca punaruddhavaḥ ..
supriyaṃ karṇapīyūṣaṃ vinayena ca bhītivat .. 32 ..
meaning:
स्थापयेद्दाहदूरार्थं स्निग्धपद्मदले शुभे .
एवंभूतां चतां दृष्टवा चोवाच पुनरुद्धवः ..
सुप्रियं कर्णपीयूषं विनयेन च भीतिवत् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
and placed her on auspicious, fresh lotus petals to remove the burning heat. / Having seen her in such a state, Uddhava spoke again 32.
words very dear, nectar to the ears, with modesty, as if afraid. 32b.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhava uvāca
jāne tvāṃ devadevīśāṃ susnigdhāṃ siddhayoginīm .
sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca sūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm .. 33 ..
meaning:
उद्धव उवाच
जाने त्वां देवदेवीशां सुस्निग्धां सिद्धयोगिनीम् .
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपां च सूलप्रकृतिमीश्वरीम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Uddhava said: / I know you to be the ruler of the gods and goddesses, deeply affectionate, an accomplished yoginī, / the embodiment of all powers, the sovereign primal Prakṛti, 33.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdāmaśāpāddharaṇīṃ prāptāṃ golokakāminīm .
kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ devīṃ tadvakṣaḥsthalavāsinīm .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्रीदामशापाद्धरणीं प्राप्तां गोलोककामिनीम् .
कृष्णप्राणाधिकां देवीं तद्वक्षःस्थलवासिनीम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: the beloved woman of Goloka who has reached the earth by the curse of Śrīdāman, / the goddess dearer than life to Kṛṣṇa, residing upon his chest. 34.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śubhavārtāmabhīpsitām .
susthiraṃ sakhibhiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛdayasnagdhikāriṇīm .. 35 ..
meaning:
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि शुभवार्तामभीप्सिताम् .
सुस्थिरं सखिभिः सार्धं हृदयस्नग्धिकारिणीम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: Hear, O goddess! Together with your friends, composed, I shall proclaim the welcome, / longed-for news that will gladden your heart; 35.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhadāvāgnidagdhāyāḥ sudhāvarṣaṇarūpiṇīm .
virahavyādhiyuktāyā rasāyanasamāṃ śubhām .. 36 ..
meaning:
दुःखदावाग्निदग्धायाः सुधावर्षणरूपिणीम् .
विरहव्याधियुक्ताया रसायनसमां शुभाम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: which is like a shower of nectar to one scorched by the forest fire of sorrow, / and like an auspicious elixir to one afflicted with the disease of separation. 36.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tiṣṭhati nando'yaṃ sānando suditaḥ sadā .
nimantritaśca vasunā kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi .. 37 ..
meaning:
तत्र तिष्ठति नन्दोऽयं सानन्दो सुदितः सदा .
निमन्त्रितश्च वसुना कृष्णोपनयनावधि .. 37 ..
text_mt: Nanda stays there, joyful and always glad, / invited by Vasudeva until Kṛṣṇa's sacred-thread ceremony. 37.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā sabalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi .
sa nandaḥ paramānando sudā''yāsyati gokulam .. 38 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा सबलं कृष्णं साङ्गे मङ्गलकर्मणि .
स नन्दः परमानन्दो सुदा'ऽयास्यति गोकुलम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having taken Kṛṣṇa along with Balarāma once the auspicious rites are complete, / Nanda, filled with supreme joy, will gladly come to Gokula. 38.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatya kṛṣṇo muditaḥ praṇamya mātaraṃ punaḥ .
naktamāyāsyati mudā puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
आगत्य कृष्णो मुदितः प्रणम्य मातरं पुनः .
नक्तमायास्यति मुदा पुण्यं वृन्दावनं वनम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having arrived, Kṛṣṇa, joyful, will bow to his mother again, / and by night he will gladly come to the holy forest of Vṛndāvana. 39.

sanskrit_iast:
acirāddrakṣyasi sati śrīkṛṣṇamukhapaṅkajam .
sarvaṃ virahaduḥkhaṃ ca saṃtyakṣyasi ca sāṃpratam .. 40 ..
meaning:
अचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसि सति श्रीकृष्णमुखपङ्कजम् .
सर्वं विरहदुःखं च संत्यक्ष्यसि च सांप्रतम् .. 40 ..
text_mt: Before long, O chaste lady, you will see the lotus-face of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, / and you will cast off all the sorrow of separation right now. 40.

sanskrit_iast:
susthirā bhava mātastvaṃ tyaja śokaṃ sudāruṇam .
vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ramyaṃ paridhāya praharṣitā .. 41 ..
meaning:
सुस्थिरा भव मातस्त्वं त्यज शोकं सुदारुणम् .
वह्निशुद्धांशुकं रम्यं परिधाय प्रहर्षिता .. 41 ..
text_mt: Be composed, O mother! Cast away your terrible grief! / Joyfully putting on beautiful, fire-purified silk, 41.

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ kuru .
gṛhāṇacandanaṃ snigdhaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणभूषणग्रहणं कुरु .
गृहाणचन्दनं स्निग्धं कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: put on ornaments fashioned from priceless jewels. / Accept cooling sandalwood mixed with musk and saffron. 42.

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva keśasaṃskāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam .
suveṣaṃ kuru kalyāṇi gaṇḍe ca citrapatrakam .. 43 ..
meaning:
कुरुष्व केशसंस्कारं मालतीमाल्यभूषितम् .
सुवेषं कुरु कल्याणि गण्डे च चित्रपत्रकम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Arrange your hair adorned with a garland of mālatī flowers; / dress yourself well, O auspicious lady, and place decorative marks on your cheek. 43.

sanskrit_iast:
sindūrabinduṃ sīmante kastūrīcandanānvitam .
alaktakāktaṃ caraṇaṃ yuktaṃ yāvakabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
सिन्दूरबिन्दुं सीमन्ते कस्तूरीचन्दनान्वितम् .
अलक्तकाक्तं चरणं युक्तं यावकभूषणैः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Place a dot of vermilion on the parting of your hair, mixed with musk and sandalwood, / and let your feet be anointed with red lacquer, adorned with red dye. 44.

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva tiṣṭhacotiṣṭha ratnasiṃhāsane vare .
sapaṅkapaṅkajaṃ talpaṃ tyaja sārdhaṃ śucā sati .. 45 ..
meaning:
कुरुष्व तिष्ठचोतिष्ठ रत्नसिंहासने वरे .
सपङ्कपङ्कजं तल्पं त्यज सार्धं शुचा सति .. 45 ..
text_mt: Do this and sit, yes sit, upon an excellent jewelled throne; / leave the bed of lotuses along with mud and grief, O chaste lady! 45.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuṅkṣva kṛṣṇena manasā viśuddhaṃ madhuraṃ madhu .
saṃskṛtaṃ bhāsitaṃ toyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam .. 46 ..
meaning:
भुङ्क्ष्व कृष्णेन मनसा विशुद्धं मधुरं मधु .
संस्कृतं भासितं तोयं ताम्बूलं च सुवासितम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Enjoy pure, sweet nectar with Kṛṣṇa in your mind, / along with prepared, fragrant water and perfumed betel. 46.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnendrasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke mumanohare .
vahnisaddhāṃśukākte ca mālatīmālyabhūṣite .. 47 ..
meaning:
रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्माणपर्यङ्के मुमनोहरे .
वह्निसद्धांशुकाक्ते च मालतीमाल्यभूषिते .. 47 ..
text_mt: Upon an exquisite bed made of the finest jewels, / covered with fire-purified silk and adorned with mālatī garlands, 47.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhiyukte kastūrījātīcampakacandanaiḥ .
parito mālatīmālyahīrahāravibhūṣite .. 48 ..
meaning:
सुगन्धियुक्ते कस्तूरीजातीचम्पकचन्दनैः .
परितो मालतीमाल्यहीरहारविभूषिते .. 48 ..
text_mt: filled with fragrance of musk, jātī, campaka, and sandalwood, / decorated all around with mālatī garlands and diamond necklaces, 48.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyasundaraiśca pariṣkṛte .
puṣpamālyopadhāne ca maṅgalārhe mudā'nvitā .. 49 ..
meaning:
मणीन्द्रमुक्तामाणिक्यसुन्दरैश्च परिष्कृते .
पुष्पमाल्योपधाने च मङ्गलार्हे मुदाऽन्विता .. 49 ..
text_mt: adorned with splendid, fine gems, pearls, and rubies, / with pillows of flower garlands, fit for auspiciousness, full of joy, 49.

sanskrit_iast:
śayanaṃ kuru deveśi gopībhiḥ sevitā sadā .
karotu sevanaṃ śaśvatpriyāliḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ .. 50 ..
meaning:
शयनं कुरु देवेशि गोपीभिः सेविता सदा .
करोतु सेवनं शश्वत्प्रियालिः श्वेतयामरैः .. 50 ..
text_mt: take your rest, O ruler of gods, constantly served by the cowherd women! / Let your dear friends constantly attend to you with white fly-whisks, 50.

sanskrit_iast:
padāravindasevāṃ ca gopībhaktā manohare .
sadratnasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke sumanohare .. 51 ..
meaning:
पदारविन्दसेवां च गोपीभक्ता मनोहरे .
सद्रत्नसारनिर्माणपर्यङ्के सुमनोहरे .. 51 ..
text_mt: and let the devoted cowherd women render service to your lotus feet / upon that delightful bed made of the finest gems. 51.

sanskrit_iast:
tyevamuktvā sa mune punastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha .
praṇamya pādapadmaṃ ca brahmādisuravanditam .. 52 ..
meaning:
त्येवमुक्त्वा स मुने पुनस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह .
प्रणम्य पादपद्मं च ब्रह्मादिसुरवन्दितम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O sage, he became silent again, / having bowed to her lotus feet, which are praised by the gods headed by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhavasya vacaḥśrutvā sasmitā rādhikā satī .
yautukaṃ ca dadau tasmai ratnasārāṅgulīyakam .. 53 ..
meaning:
उद्धवस्य वचःश्रुत्वा सस्मिता राधिका सती .
यौतुकं च ददौ तस्मै रत्नसाराङ्गुलीयकम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Hearing Uddhava's words, the virtuous Rādhikā smiled, / and gave him a ring of precious gems as a gift:

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam .
mukhadṛśyaṃ pītavarṇa sudīptaṃ supradīpavat .. 54 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यं सुन्दरं रम्यं विश्वकर्मविनिर्मितम् .
मुखदृश्यं पीतवर्ण सुदीप्तं सुप्रदीपवत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Priceless, beautiful, lovely, crafted by Viśvakarman, / clear as a mirror, yellow-hued, blazing brilliantly like a bright lamp;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaya vahninā dattamapūrvaṃ rāsamaṇḍale .
maṇikuṇḍalayugmaṃ cāmūlyaratnavinirmitam .. 55 ..
meaning:
कृष्णय वह्निना दत्तमपूर्वं रासमण्डले .
मणिकुण्डलयुग्मं चामूल्यरत्नविनिर्मितम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Given by Fire to Kṛṣṇa in the dance circle, extraordinary; / and a pair of gem-set earrings fashioned from priceless gems;

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇamīpsitam .
vahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ ratnanirmāṇanāyakam .. 56 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं सर्वभूषणमीप्सितम् .
वह्निशुद्धांशुकयुगं रत्ननिर्माणनायकम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: All desirable ornaments fashioned of priceless jewels; / a pair of garments cleansed by fire, the finest among jewel-studded creations;

sanskrit_iast:
hīrahāravinirmāṇaṃ hāraṃ ca sumanoharam .
purā dattaṃ ca suprityā kṛṣṇāya varuṇena ca .. 57 ..
meaning:
हीरहारविनिर्माणं हारं च सुमनोहरम् .
पुरा दत्तं च सुप्रित्या कृष्णाय वरुणेन च .. 57 ..
text_mt: A necklace made of strings of diamonds, exceedingly enchanting, / which had formerly been given with great affection to Kṛṣṇa by Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūryeṇa ca yaddattaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya syamantakam .
pradattaṃ kau(yau) tukaṃ tasmai yaddattaṃ hariṇā purā .. 58 ..
meaning:
श्रीसूर्येण च यद्दत्तं श्रीकृष्णाय स्यमन्तकम् .
प्रदत्तं कौ(यौ) तुकं तस्मै यद्दत्तं हरिणा पुरा .. 58 ..
text_mt: And the Syamantaka jewel which had been given to Śrī Kṛṣṇa by the blessed Sun— / that which had formerly been given by Hari was bestowed upon him as a gift;

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattaṃ ca mahendreṇa ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ varam .
tatpradattaṃ mudā debyā tasmai prītyā ca rādhāyā .. 59 ..
meaning:
यद्दत्तं च महेन्द्रेण रत्नसिंहासनं वरम् .
तत्प्रदत्तं मुदा देब्या तस्मै प्रीत्या च राधाया .. 59 ..
text_mt: And the excellent jewel-throne that had been given by Mahendra— / that was joyfully given to him by the goddess Rādhā out of love;

sanskrit_iast:
maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ chatraratnaṃ manoharam .
muktāmāṇikyasāreṇa hīrahārasamanvitam .. 60 ..
meaning:
मणीन्द्रसारनिर्माणं छत्ररत्नं मनोहरम् .
मुक्तामाणिक्यसारेण हीरहारसमन्वितम् .. 60 ..
text_mt: A charming jewel parasol fashioned of the best of gems, / adorned with diamond necklaces and the essence of pearls and rubies;

sanskrit_iast:
vicitraratnapadmena vicitraṃ vāruṇaṃ sadā .
śobhitaṃ paritaścānyai ratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
विचित्ररत्नपद्मेन विचित्रं वारुणं सदा .
शोभितं परितश्चान्यै रत्ननिर्माणदर्पणैः .. 61 ..
text_mt: Adorned with various lotus gems, wondrous, belonging to Varuṇa, / and embellished on all sides with other mirrors fashioned of jewels;

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattaṃ brahmaṇa prītyā haraye rāsamaṇḍale .
suprītyā rādhayā tatra pradattamuddhavāya ca .. 62 ..
meaning:
यद्दत्तं ब्रह्मण प्रीत्या हरये रासमण्डले .
सुप्रीत्या राधया तत्र प्रदत्तमुद्धवाय च .. 62 ..
text_mt: Which had been given out of love by Brahmā to Hari in the dance circle, / was then given with great affection by Rādhā to Uddhava;

sanskrit_iast:
maṇikāravinirmāṇaṃ maṇirājavirājitam .
japāmālyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ca yaddattaṃ śaṃbhunā purā .. 63 ..
meaning:
मणिकारविनिर्माणं मणिराजविराजितम् .
जपामाल्यं संस्कृतं च यद्दत्तं शंभुना पुरा .. 63 ..
text_mt: Fashioned by a jeweller, adorned with the king of jewels, / a consecrated rosary which had formerly been given by Śambhu;

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva dattaṃ tasmai cāpyamūlyaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham .
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ cātimanoharam .. 64 ..
meaning:
तदेव दत्तं तस्मै चाप्यमूल्यं पुण्यदं शुभम् .
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिहरं चातिमनोहरम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: That very rosary she gave him—priceless, bestowing merit, auspicious, / dispelling birth, death, old age, and disease, and exceedingly delightful;

sanskrit_iast:
candrakāntamaṇiṃ ramyaṃ candradattaṃ pariṣkṛtam .
candrāvalīṃ dadau tasmai sudīptaṃ pūrṇacandravat .. 65 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रकान्तमणिं रम्यं चन्द्रदत्तं परिष्कृतम् .
चन्द्रावलीं ददौ तस्मै सुदीप्तं पूर्णचन्द्रवत् .. 65 ..
text_mt: The lovely moonstone gem given by the Moon, polished, / and a necklace of moonstones she gave him, shining brilliantly like the full moon;

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhaṃ madhupūrṇaṃ ca madhupātraṃ yadakṣayam .
dharmeṇa yatpradattaṃ ca taddattaṃ priyayā hareḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
विशुद्धं मधुपूर्णं च मधुपात्रं यदक्षयम् .
धर्मेण यत्प्रदत्तं च तद्दत्तं प्रियया हरेः .. 66 ..
text_mt: A pure, imperishable vessel of honey filled with honey, / which had been given by Dharma, that Hari’s beloved gave to him;

sanskrit_iast:
jalabhojanapātraṃ ca śṛdraṃ svarṇavinirmitam .
miṣṭānnaṃ paramānnaṃ cadadau susvādumiṣṭakam .. 67 ..
meaning:
जलभोजनपात्रं च शृद्रं स्वर्णविनिर्मितम् .
मिष्टान्नं परमान्नं चददौ सुस्वादुमिष्टकम् .. 67 ..
text_mt: And beautiful eating and drinking vessels fashioned of gold; / and she gave sweet food and delicious, highly flavourful rice-pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojataṃ kārayitvā ca karpūrādisuvāsitam .
tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau śīghraṃ mālyaṃ susnigdhacandanam .. 68 ..
meaning:
भोजतं कारयित्वा च कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् .
ताम्बूलं च ददौ शीघ्रं माल्यं सुस्निग्धचन्दनम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: Having caused him to eat, she quickly gave him betel / fragrant with camphor and other spices, a garland, and cool, soothing sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau vāñchitaṃ pravaraṃ varam .
jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 69 ..
meaning:
शुभाशिषं च प्रददौ वाञ्छितं प्रवरं वरम् .
