text_mt: Viśvāmitra, Śatānanda, Jābāli, Taitila, / and Sāṃdīpani, a portion of Brahmā, the guru of yogins and the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
upamanyurgauramukho maitreyaśca śrutaśravāḥ .
kaṭhaḥ kacaśca karakho bharadvājaśca dharmavit .. 31 ..
meaning:
उपमन्युर्गौरमुखो मैत्रेयश्च श्रुतश्रवाः .
कठः कचश्च करखो भरद्वाजश्च धर्मवित् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Upamanyu, Gauramukha, Maitreya, Śrutaśravas, / Kaṭha, Kaca, Karakha, and Bharadvāja, who knows dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
saśiṣyā munayaḥ sarve vasudevāśramaṃ yayuḥ .
vasudevaśca tāndṛṣṭvā vavande daṇḍavadbhuvi .. 32 ..
meaning:
सशिष्या मुनयः सर्वे वसुदेवाश्रमं ययुः .
वसुदेवश्च तान्दृष्ट्वा ववन्दे दण्डवद्भुवि .. 32 ..
text_mt: All the sages with their disciples went to Vasudeva's hermitage. / Seeing them, Vasudeva bowed prostrate on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsminnantare brahmā sasmito haṃsavāhanaḥ .
ratnanirmāṇayānena pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
अथास्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा सस्मितो हंसवाहनः .
रत्ननिर्माणयानेन पार्वत्या सह शंकरः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Then, in the meantime, Brahmā smiling, mounted on his swan; / Śaṅkara with Pārvatī in a vehicle fashioned of jewels;

sanskrit_iast:
nandī svayaṃ mahākālo vīrabhadraḥ subhadrakaḥ .
maṇibhadraḥ pāribhadraḥ kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
नन्दी स्वयं महाकालो वीरभद्रः सुभद्रकः .
मणिभद्रः पारिभद्रः कार्तिकेयो गणेश्वरः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Nandin himself, Mahākāla, Vīrabhadra, Subhadraka, / Maṇibhadra, Pāribhadra, Kārtikeya, and Gaṇeśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
gajendreṇa mahendraśca dharmaścandro ravistathā .
kubero varuṇaścaiva pavano vahnireva ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
गजेन्द्रेण महेन्द्रश्च धर्मश्चन्द्रो रविस्तथा .
कुबेरो वरुणश्चैव पवनो वह्निरेव च .. 35 ..
text_mt: Mahendra upon his lord of elephants, Dharma, the Moon, and the Sun; / Kubera, Varuṇa, Pavana, and Vahni;

sanskrit_iast:
yamaḥ saṃyaminīnātho jayanto nalakūbaraḥ .
sarve grahāśca vasavo rudrāśca sagaṇastathā .. 36 ..
meaning:
यमः संयमिनीनाथो जयन्तो नलकूबरः .
सर्वे ग्रहाश्च वसवो रुद्राश्च सगणस्तथा .. 36 ..
text_mt: Yama the lord of Saṃyaminī, Jayanta, Nalakūbara, / all the planets, the Vasus, and the Rudras with their attendants;

sanskrit_iast:
ādityāśca tathā śeṇo nānādevāḥ samāyayuḥ .
vasudevaśca bhaktyā ca vavande śirasā bhuvi .. 37 ..
meaning:
आदित्याश्च तथा शेणो नानादेवाः समाययुः .
वसुदेवश्च भक्त्या च ववन्दे शिरसा भुवि .. 37 ..
text_mt: The Ādityas, Śeṣa, and various gods arrived. / Vasudeva, with devotion, bowed his head to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā devendrāṃśca tathā surān .
bhaktina mrātmamūrdhā ca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
तुष्टाव परया भक्त्या देवेन्द्रांश्च तथा सुरान् .
भक्तिन म्रात्ममूर्धा च पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहः .. 38 ..
text_mt: With supreme devotion he praised the king of gods and the deities, / his head bowed with devotion, his body bristling with horripilation.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudeva uvāca
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma parameśaḥ parātparaḥ .
svayaṃ vidhātā madgehe jagatāṃ paripālakaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
वसुदेव उवाच
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम परमेशः परात्परः .
स्वयं विधाता मद्गेहे जगतां परिपालकः .. 39 ..
text_mt: Vasudeva said: / The supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme Lord, higher than the highest, / the Creator himself, the protector of the worlds, is in my house!

sanskrit_iast:
vedānāṃ janakaḥ sraṣṭā sṛṣṭihetuḥ sanātanaḥ .
surāṇāṃ ca munīndrāṇāṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ .. 40 ..
meaning:
वेदानां जनकः स्रष्टा सृष्टिहेतुः सनातनः .
सुराणां च मुनीन्द्राणां सिद्धेन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः .. 40 ..
text_mt: The progenitor of the Vedas, the creator, the eternal cause of creation, / the guru of the gurus of gods, chief sages, and lords of Siddhas,

sanskrit_iast:
svapne yatpādapadmaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sudurlabham .
śivasmaraṇamotreṇa sarvāniṣṭāḥ palāyitāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
स्वप्ने यत्पादपद्मं च क्षणं द्रष्टुं सुदुर्लभम् .
शिवस्मरणमोत्रेण सर्वानिष्टाः पलायिताः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Whose lotus foot is exceedingly difficult to see even for a moment in a dream! / By merely remembering Śiva, all misfortunes flee;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃkaṭamuttīrya kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ .
sarvāgre pūjanaṃ yasya devānāmagraṇīḥ paraḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
सर्वसंकटमुत्तीर्य कल्याणं लभते नरः .
सर्वाग्रे पूजनं यस्य देवानामग्रणीः परः .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having crossed over all distress, a man attains well-being. / He whose worship comes before all, the foremost leader of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭeṣu maṅgalaṃ mantrairbhaktyā cā''vāhanena ca .
svayaṃ gaṇeśo bhagavān sākṣādvighnavināśakaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
घटेषु मङ्गलं मन्त्रैर्भक्त्या चा'ऽवाहनेन च .
स्वयं गणेशो भगवान् साक्षाद्विघ्नविनाशकः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Auspicious in the water-pots, through mantras, devotion, and invocation, / the lord Gaṇeśa himself, the direct destroyer of obstacles;

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikeyaśca bhagavāndevādīnāṃ ca pūjitaḥ .
devānāṃ pravarā pūjyā mahālakṣmīḥ parātparā .. 44 ..
meaning:
कार्तिकेयश्च भगवान्देवादीनां च पूजितः .
देवानां प्रवरा पूज्या महालक्ष्मीः परात्परा .. 44 ..
text_mt: The lord Kārtikeya, who is worshipped by the gods and others; / the foremost among the gods to be worshipped, the supreme Mahālakṣmī;

sanskrit_iast:
madgehe pārvatī mātā jagatāmādirūpiṇī .
sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī .. 45 ..
meaning:
मद्गेहे पार्वती माता जगतामादिरूपिणी .
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपा च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी .. 45 ..
text_mt: Mother Pārvatī in my house, the primordial form of the worlds, / the embodiment of all powers, the sovereign Mūlaprakṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
parāparāṇāṃ paramā parabrahmasvarūpiṇī .
yasyāḥ pādau samārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
परापराणां परमा परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी .
यस्याः पादौ समाराध्य वाञ्छितं लभते नरः .. 46 ..
text_mt: The highest of the high and low, the embodiment of the supreme Brahman, / by worshipping whose feet a man obtains what he desires!

sanskrit_iast:
śaratkāre ca bhaktyā ca sā sākṣānmama mandire .
sarvadevaiśca sahitā sagaṇā bhaktavātsalā .. 47 ..
meaning:
शरत्कारे च भक्त्या च सा साक्षान्मम मन्दिरे .
सर्वदेवैश्च सहिता सगणा भक्तवात्सला .. 47 ..
text_mt: She who is [worshipped] in autumn with devotion is present in person in my dwelling, / together with all the gods and with her attendants, affectionate to her devotees;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāmayī ca kṛpayā cā''virbhūtā ca bhārate .
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama .. 48 ..
meaning:
कृपामयी च कृपया चा'ऽविर्भूता च भारते .
धन्योऽहं कृतकृत्योऽहं सफलं जीवनं मम .. 48 ..
text_mt: Full of grace, she has manifested out of compassion in Bhārata. / Blessed am I, accomplished of purpose am I; my life has borne fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
āgatā'si yato durge paramādyā ca madgṛhe .
evaṃ sarvāṃśca tuṣṭāva krameṇa ca parasparam .. 49 ..
meaning:
आगताऽसि यतो दुर्गे परमाद्या च मद्गृहे .
एवं सर्वांश्च तुष्टाव क्रमेण च परस्परम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Since you, O Durgā, the primordial Supreme, have come to my home! / In this way he praised them all, one by one in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānmunīndrānviprāṃśca gale baddhvāṃ'śukaṃ mudā .
pratyekaṃ vāsayāmāsa ratnasihāsane vare .. 50 ..
meaning:
सर्वान्मुनीन्द्रान्विप्रांश्च गले बद्ध्वांऽशुकं मुदा .
प्रत्येकं वासयामास रत्नसिहासने वरे .. 50 ..
text_mt: Tying a cloth around his neck in joy before all the chief sages and brāhmaṇas, / he seated each one on an excellent jewel-throne.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkrameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak .
pratyekaṃ varayāmāsa brahmādīṃśca surānapi .. 51 ..
meaning:
पूजयामास विधिवत्क्रमेण च पृथक्पृथक् .
प्रत्येकं वरयामास ब्रह्मादींश्च सुरानपि .. 51 ..
text_mt: He worshipped them according to rule, in due order and one by one; / he chose each one: Brahmā and the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
munivargānbrāhmaṇāṃśca bhaktyā gargaṃ purohitam .
ratnaiḥ pravālairmaṇibhirmuvatāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
मुनिवर्गान्ब्राह्मणांश्च भक्त्या गर्गं पुरोहितम् .
रत्नैः प्रवालैर्मणिभिर्मुवतामाणिक्यहीरकैः .. 52 ..
text_mt: The groups of sages, the brāhmaṇas, and with devotion the priest Garga, / with jewels, corals, gems, pearls, rubies, and diamonds,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇairvasanaiścaiva mālyaiśca gandhacandanaiḥ .
latnasihāsane ramye sarveṣāṃ madhyadeśataḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
भूषणैर्वसनैश्चैव माल्यैश्च गन्धचन्दनैः .
लत्नसिहासने रम्ये सर्वेषां मध्यदेशतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: With ornaments, garments, garlands, and fragrant sandal-paste. / On a delightful throne of jewels, in the very middle of all,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ vāsayāmāsa pūjārthaṃ śubhakarmaṇi .
saptatīrthodakenaiva suvarṇakalaśena ca .. 54 ..
meaning:
गणेशं वासयामास पूजार्थं शुभकर्मणि .
सप्ततीर्थोदकेनैव सुवर्णकलशेन च .. 54 ..
text_mt: He seated Gaṇeśa for worship during the auspicious rite. / With water from seven sacred places and with golden pitchers,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpajandranayuktena śītena vāsitena ca .
svargagaṅgājalenaiva puṣkarodakuṇyataḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
पुष्पजन्द्रनयुक्तेन शीतेन वासितेन च .
स्वर्गगङ्गाजलेनैव पुष्करोदकुण्यतः .. 55 ..
text_mt: With water mixed with flowers and sandal-paste, cool and scented, / with the water of the heavenly Gaṅgā and the pure water of Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtena śuddhena pañcagavyena bhaktitaḥ .
herambaṃ snāpayāmāsa samudrodena mantrataḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
पञ्चामृतेन शुद्धेन पञ्चगव्येन भक्तितः .
हेरम्बं स्नापयामास समुद्रोदेन मन्त्रतः .. 56 ..
text_mt: With pure pañcāmṛta, with pañcagavya, with devotion, / and with ocean water, he bathed Heramba according to the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
varayāmāsa mālyena pārijātasya nārada .
ratnendrabhūṣaṇenaiva vahniśuddhena vāsasā .. 57 ..
meaning:
वरयामास माल्येन पारिजातस्य नारद .
रत्नेन्द्रभूषणेनैव वह्निशुद्धेन वाससा .. 57 ..
text_mt: O Nārada, he honoured [him] with a garland of pārijāta flowers, / with ornaments of the best gems, and with cloth purified by fire. 57.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhayandanapuṣpaiśca ratnamālyāṅgulīyakam .
tuṣṭāva pārvatīputraṃ sarvadevādhipaṃ śubham
vighnanighnakaraṃ śāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 58 ..
meaning:
गन्धयन्दनपुष्पैश्च रत्नमाल्याङ्गुलीयकम् .
तुष्टाव पार्वतीपुत्रं सर्वदेवाधिपं शुभम्
विघ्ननिघ्नकरं शान्तं भगवन्तं सनातनम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: With fragrant sandalwood pastes, flowers, a garland of gems, and a ring, / he praised the son of Pārvatī, the auspicious lord of all the gods, / the remover of obstacles, serene, the eternal Lord. 58.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavadupanayane
gaṇeśābhiṣeko nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवदुपनयने
गणेशाभिषेको नाम नवनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the ninety-ninth chapter, entitled "The Consecration of Gaṇeśa during the Sacred Thread Ceremony of the Lord," in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa in the latter part of the Śrī Kṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the glorious Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. 99.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
athāditirditiścaiva devakī rohiṇī ratiḥ .
sarasvatī ca sāvitrī yaśodā ca pativratā .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
अथादितिर्दितिश्चैव देवकी रोहिणी रतिः .
सरस्वती च सावित्री यशोदा च पतिव्रता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the one hundredth chapter. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Then Aditi, Diti, Devakī, Rohiṇī, Rati, / Sarasvatī, Sāvitrī, and the devoted wife Yaśodā, 1.
title: atha śātatame'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
lobāmudrā'rundhatī ca ahalyā tārakā tathā .
yayustāḥ pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭavā vegena mandirādapi .. 2 ..
meaning:
लोबामुद्राऽरुन्धती च अहल्या तारका तथा .
ययुस्ताः पार्वतीं दृष्टवा वेगेन मन्दिरादपि .. 2 ..
text_mt: Lopāmudrā, Arundhatī, Ahalyā, and likewise Tārakā— / having seen Pārvatī, they came in haste from the palace. 2.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya samāśliṣya punaḥ punaḥ .
praṇamya veśayāmāsurmandiraṃ ratnanirmitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
परस्परं च संभाष्य समाश्लिष्य पुनः पुनः .
प्रणम्य वेशयामासुर्मन्दिरं रत्ननिर्मितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Speaking to one another and embracing again and again, / having bowed, they led [her] into the jewel-built palace. 3.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasihāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm .
varayāmāsurmālyena vāsasā ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
रत्नसिहासने रम्ये वासयामासुरीश्वरीम् .
वरयामासुर्माल्येन वाससा रत्नभूषणैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: They seated the Goddess on a charming throne of jewels, / and honoured [her] with a garland, garments, and jewel ornaments. 4.

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca śakrānītaṃ manoharam .
dadau tatpādapadme ca devakī bhaktipūrvakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
पारिजातस्य पुष्पं च शक्रानीतं मनोहरम् .
ददौ तत्पादपद्मे च देवकी भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: And Devakī, full of devotion, offered at her lotus feet / the captivating flower of the pārijāta brought by Śakra. 5.

sanskrit_iast:
sindūrabinduṃ sīmante bhāle candanabindukam .
kastūrīkuṅkumādīṃśca pradadau paritastayoḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सिन्दूरबिन्दुं सीमन्ते भाले चन्दनबिन्दुकम् .
कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमादींश्च प्रददौ परितस्तयोः .. 6 ..
text_mt: A dot of vermilion on the parting of her hair, a mark of sandalwood on her forehead, / and around them both musk, saffron, and other cosmetics she applied. 6.

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa śītatoyaṃ suvāsitaṃ .
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
मिष्टान्नं भोजयामास शीततोयं सुवासितं .
ताम्बूलं च वरं रम्यं कर्पूरादिसुवासितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: She fed [her] sweet food, cool and fragrant water, / and excellent, delightful betel fragrant with camphor and other spices. 7.

sanskrit_iast:
alaktakaṃ ca pradadau nakheṣu pādapadmayoḥ .
kuṅkumasyāpi rāgaṃ ca siṣeve śvetacāmaraiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
अलक्तकं च प्रददौ नखेषु पादपद्मयोः .
कुङ्कुमस्यापि रागं च सिषेवे श्वेतचामरैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: She applied red lac to the nails of her lotus feet / and the hue of saffron, and served her with white flywhisks. 8.

sanskrit_iast:
maṃpujya pārvatīṃ devīṃ munipatnīḥ krameṇa ca .
pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpatiputravatīḥ satīḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
मंपुज्य पार्वतीं देवीं मुनिपत्नीः क्रमेण च .
पूजयामास विधिवत्पतिपुत्रवतीः सतीः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having honoured the goddess Pārvatī, in due order / she worshipped according to rule the wives of the sages, chaste women with husbands and sons. 9.

sanskrit_iast:
rājakanyā devakanyā nāgakanyā manoharāḥ .
munikanyā bandhukanyāḥ pūjayāmāsa suvratā .. 10 ..
meaning:
राजकन्या देवकन्या नागकन्या मनोहराः .
मुनिकन्या बन्धुकन्याः पूजयामास सुव्रता .. 10 ..
text_mt: Princesses, daughters of the gods, enchanting serpent maidens, / daughters of sages, and kinswomen—the virtuous woman honoured them all. 10.

sanskrit_iast:
vādya nānāvidhaṃ ramyaṃ vādayāmāsa kautukāt .
maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa brahmaṇān .. 11 ..
meaning:
वाद्य नानाविधं रम्यं वादयामास कौतुकात् .
मङ्गलं कारयामास भोजयामास ब्रह्मणान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: She had delightful musical instruments of various kinds played for joy, / performed auspicious rites, and fed the brāhmaṇas. 11.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavīṃ pūjayāmāsa mathurāgrāmadevatām .
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām .. 12 ..
meaning:
भैरवीं पूजयामास मथुराग्रामदेवताम् .
उपचारैः षोडशभिः षष्ठीं मङ्गलचण्डिकाम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: With sixteen offerings she worshipped Bhairavī, the guardian goddess of Mathurā village, / as well as Ṣaṣṭhī and Maṅgalacaṇḍikā. 12.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ śuddhaṃ vārayāmāsa maṅgalam .
vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vasudevāsya vallabhā .. 13 ..
meaning:
पुण्यं स्वस्त्ययनं शुद्धं वारयामास मङ्गलम् .
वेदांश्च पाठयामास वसुदेवास्य वल्लभा .. 13 ..
text_mt: The beloved wife of Vasudeva averted ill fortune with pure and auspicious benedictory rites, / and had the Vedas recited. 13.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṅgāsujalenaiva suvarmakalaśena ca .
snāpayāmāsa sabalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ putravatsalā .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गङ्गासुजलेनैव सुवर्मकलशेन च .
स्नापयामास सबलं श्रीकृष्णं पुत्रवत्सला .. 14 ..
text_mt: With the pure water of the heavenly Gaṅgā and with golden pitchers, / the mother affectionate to her children bathed Śrī Kṛṣṇa along with Bala. 14.

sanskrit_iast:
vastracandanamālyaiśca tayorveṣaṃ cakāra sā .
ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇaiśca manoharaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रचन्दनमाल्यैश्च तयोर्वेषं चकार सा .
रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्माणभूषणैश्च मनोहरैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: With garments, sandalwood paste, garlands, / and captivating ornaments fashioned from the essence of the best jewels, she adorned the two. 15.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca .
āyayau ca sabhāṃ devamunīndrāṇāṃ ca nārada .. 16 ..
meaning:
मातृभूषणभूषाढ्यः सबलः कृष्ण एव च .
आययौ च सभां देवमुनीन्द्राणां च नारद .. 16 ..
text_mt: Richly adorned with the ornaments given by his mother, Kṛṣṇa along with Bala / entered the assembly of the gods and foremost sages, O Nārada. 16.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagatāṃ rāthamuttasthau prajavena ca .
svayaṃ vidhātā śaṃbhuśca śeṣo dharmaśca bhāskaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं जगतां राथमुत्तस्थौ प्रजवेन च .
स्वयं विधाता शंभुश्च शेषो धर्मश्च भास्करः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, the lord of the worlds, there stood up in all haste / the Creator himself, Śambhu, Śeṣa, Dharma, and the Sun, 17.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca munayaścaiva kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ .
pṛthakpṛthak krameṇaiva tuṣṭāva parameśvaram .. 18 ..
meaning:
देवाश्च मुनयश्चैव कार्तिकेयो गणेश्वरः .
पृथक्पृथक् क्रमेणैव तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: as well as the gods, the sages, Kārttikeya, and Gaṇeśvara; / one by one, in proper order, they praised the Supreme Lord. 18.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
nāthānirvacanoyo'si bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .
vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नाथानिर्वचनोयोऽसि भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः .
वेदानिर्वचनीयं च कस्त्वां स्तोतुमिहेश्वरः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / O Lord, you are beyond expression, an embodied form assumed out of grace to devotees! / You are indefinable even by the Vedas; who here is capable of praising you, O Lord? 19.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
deheṣu dehināṃ śaśvatsthitaṃ nirliptameva ca .
karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ śuddhaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ sākṣataṃ vibhum ..
kiṃ staumi rūpaśūnyaṃ ca guṇaśūnyaṃ ca nirguṇam .. 20 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
देहेषु देहिनां शश्वत्स्थितं निर्लिप्तमेव च .
कर्मिणां कर्मणां शुद्धं साक्षिणां साक्षतं विभुम् ..
किं स्तौमि रूपशून्यं च गुणशून्यं च निर्गुणम् .. 20 ..
text_mt:
Mahādeva said: / Constantly present within the bodies of embodied beings, yet entirely unstained, / the pure, directly perceived, all-pervading witness of the deeds of actors—
how can I praise [you who are] devoid of form, devoid of attributes, and beyond the gunas? 20.

sanskrit_iast:
ananta uvāca
kiṃvā jānāmyahaṃ nātha tvāmajño'nantamīśvaram .
anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍakāraṇaṃ duḥkhatāraṇam .. 21 ..
meaning:
अनन्त उवाच
किंवा जानाम्यहं नाथ त्वामज्ञोऽनन्तमीश्वरम् .
अनन्तकोटिब्रह्माण्डकारणं दुःखतारणम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Ananta said: / What do I know, O Lord, ignorant as I am, of you the endless Lord, / the cause of endless millions of cosmic eggs, the deliverer from sorrow? 21.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣṇośca lomnāṃ ca vivareṣu jaleṣu ca .
santi viśvānyasaṃkhyāni citrāṇi kṛtrimāṇi ca .. 22 ..
meaning:
महाविष्णोश्च लोम्नां च विवरेषु जलेषु च .
सन्ति विश्वान्यसंख्यानि चित्राणि कृत्रिमाणि च .. 22 ..
text_mt: In the pore-openings and in the waters of Mahāviṣṇu, / there exist countless universes, wondrous and created. 22.

sanskrit_iast:
santi santaśca devāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ .
tvadaṃśāḥ pratibimbeṣu tīrthāni bhārataṃ tathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
सन्ति सन्तश्च देवाश्च ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकाः .
त्वदंशाः प्रतिबिम्बेषु तीर्थानि भारतं तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt: There exist good men, and gods consisting of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; / holy places and Bhārata are likewise your portions reflected in images. 23.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaikasthito'haṃ ca sūkṣmanāgasvarūpakaḥ .
sthāpitaśca tvayā kūrme gajendre maśako yathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डैकस्थितोऽहं च सूक्ष्मनागस्वरूपकः .
स्थापितश्च त्वया कूर्मे गजेन्द्रे मशको यथा .. 24 ..
text_mt: And I, dwelling in a single cosmic egg in the form of a minute serpent, / was placed by you upon the tortoise like a gnat upon an elephant king. 24.

sanskrit_iast:
paramāṇuparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśveṣu nāsti kutracit .
mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ sthūlaṃ samo nāsti ca kutracit .. 25 ..
meaning:
परमाणुपरं सूक्ष्मं विश्वेषु नास्ति कुत्रचित् .
महाविष्णोः परं स्थूलं समो नास्ति च कुत्रचित् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Nothing in the universe is finer than an atom; / nothing is greater than Mahāviṣṇu, nor is any equal [to him] anywhere. 25.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāviṣṇoḥ parastvaṃ ca tvatparo nāsti kaścana .
sthūlātsthūlataro devaḥ mūkṣmātsūkṣmatamo mahān .. 26 ..
meaning:
महाविष्णोः परस्त्वं च त्वत्परो नास्ति कश्चन .
स्थूलात्स्थूलतरो देवः मूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतमो महान् .. 26 ..
text_mt: And you are higher than Mahāviṣṇu; no one is higher than you. / The God is vaster than the vastest, the great one subtler than the subtlest. 26.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśca mahāviṣṇo jalarūpo bhavānsvayam .
jalādhāro hi golokastvaṃ ca sthāvararūpadhṛk .. 27 ..
meaning:
आधारश्च महाविष्णो जलरूपो भवान्स्वयम् .
जलाधारो हि गोलोकस्त्वं च स्थावररूपधृक् .. 27 ..
text_mt: You yourself, in the form of water, are the support of Mahāviṣṇu, / and Goloka is the support of the water; you assume the motionless form. 27.

sanskrit_iast:
marvādhāro mahānvāyuḥ śvāsaniḥ śvāsarūpakaḥ .
bhaktānugrahadehasya nityasya bhavato dibho .. 28 ..
meaning:
मर्वाधारो महान्वायुः श्वासनिः श्वासरूपकः .
भक्तानुग्रहदेहस्य नित्यस्य भवतो दिभो .. 28 ..
text_mt: The support of all is the great wind in the form of the exhalation and inhalation / of you, the eternal, all-pervading one whose body is assumed out of grace to devotees. 28.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktrairbahutarairvāṃ'tha tvayā dattaiḥ puraiva ca .
stotumicchāmi tvadyogaṃ na dattaṃ jñānamaiśvaram .. 29 ..
meaning:
वक्त्रैर्बहुतरैर्वांऽथ त्वया दत्तैः पुरैव च .
स्तोतुमिच्छामि त्वद्योगं न दत्तं ज्ञानमैश्वरम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: With the many mouths given by you long ago, / I desire to praise you; but knowledge of your divine sovereignty has not been granted. 29.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
tvāmanantaṃ yadi stotuṃ devo'nanto na hīśvaraḥ .
na hi svayaṃ vidhātā ca na hi jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ ..
sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ vayam .. 30 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
त्वामनन्तं यदि स्तोतुं देवोऽनन्तो न हीश्वरः .
न हि स्वयं विधाता च न हि ज्ञानात्मकः शिवः ..
सरस्वती जडीभूता किं कुर्मः स्तवनं वयम् .. 30 ..
text_mt:
The gods said: / If even the endless god [Śeṣa] is unable to praise you, the infinite one, / nor the Creator himself, nor Śiva who is the embodiment of knowledge,
and Sarasvatī has become struck dumb—what praise can we utter? 30.

sanskrit_iast:
munīndrā ūcuḥ
vedā na śaktāḥ stotuṃ cettvāṃ caiva jñātumīśvaram .
vayaṃ vedavidaḥ santaḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ tava .. 31 ..
meaning:
मुनीन्द्रा ऊचुः
वेदा न शक्ताः स्तोतुं चेत्त्वां चैव ज्ञातुमीश्वरम् .
वयं वेदविदः सन्तः किं कुर्मः स्तवनं तव .. 31 ..
text_mt: The foremost sages said: / If the Vedas are not able to praise you and to know you as the Lord, / how can we, though knowers of the Vedas, offer your praise? 31.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ devaiśca munimiḥ kṛtam .
yaḥ paṭhetsaṃyataḥ śuddhaḥ pūjākāle ca bhaktitaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं देवैश्च मुनिमिः कृतम् .
यः पठेत्संयतः शुद्धः पूजाकाले च भक्तितः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Whoever, restrained and pure, recites with devotion at the time of worship / this very meritorious hymn composed by the gods and sages, 32.

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā labdhvā jñānaṃ nirañjanam .
ratnāyānaṃ samāruhya golokaṃ sa ca gacchati .. 33 ..
meaning:
इह लोके सुखं भुक्त्वा लब्ध्वा ज्ञानं निरञ्जनम् .
रत्नायानं समारुह्य गोलोकं स च गच्छति .. 33 ..
text_mt: having enjoyed happiness in this world and obtained taintless knowledge, / mounts a jewel-aerial car and goes to Goloka. 33.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavadupanayane
śātatamo'yāyaḥ .. 100 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवदुपनयने
शाततमोऽयायः .. 100 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundredth chapter, entitled "The Sacred Thread Ceremony of the Lord," in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa in the latter part of the Śrī Kṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the glorious and great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. 100.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
saṃstūya devā munayo viremurnahi mānase .
dadṛśuḥ prāṅgaṇe kṛṣṇaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
संस्तूय देवा मुनयो विरेमुर्नहि मानसे .
ददृशुः प्राङ्गणे कृष्णं शोभितं पीतवाससा .. 1 ..
text_mt: Now begins the one hundred and first chapter. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Having praised him, the gods and sages rested, but their minds did not turn away; / they beheld Kṛṣṇa in the courtyard, resplendent in yellow garments, 1.
title: athaikādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
yathā saudāminīyuktaṃ navīnajaladaṃ mune .
bakapaṅ ktiyutaṃ caiva mālatīmālayā tathā .. 2 ..
meaning:
यथा सौदामिनीयुक्तं नवीनजलदं मुने .
बकपङ् क्तियुतं चैव मालतीमालया तथा .. 2 ..
text_mt: like a fresh raincloud accompanied by lightning, O sage, / and flanked by a row of cranes, wearing a garland of jasmine flowers; 2.

sanskrit_iast:
kapāle maṇḍalākārakastūrīyuktacandanam .
sakalaṅkaṃ mṛgāṅkaṃ ca śobhitaṃ jalade tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
कपाले मण्डलाकारकस्तूरीयुक्तचन्दनम् .
सकलङ्कं मृगाङ्कं च शोभितं जलदे तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: with circular musk-blended sandalwood paste on his forehead, / shining like the spotted moon upon a raincloud; 3.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ śyāmalaṃkāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam .
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham .. 4 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं श्यामलंकान्तं राधाकान्तं मनोहरम् .
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: two-armed, dark-complexioned, beloved, the charming beloved of Rādhā, / with a gentle smile on his cheerful face, an embodied form assumed out of grace to devotees; 4.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam .
rudantaṃ piturutsaṅge balena sahitaṃ param .. 5 ..
meaning:
रत्नकेयूरवलयरत्नमञ्जीररञ्जितम् .
रुदन्तं पितुरुत्सङ्गे बलेन सहितं परम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: adorned with jewel armlets, bracelets, and gem-encrusted anklets; / crying on his father's lap, the Supreme One, together with Bala. 5.

sanskrit_iast:
atha maṅgalakāle ca śubhalagne manorame .
saṃpīkṣite grahaiḥ saumyairjāṃgrallagnādhipe sthite .. 6 ..
meaning:
अथ मङ्गलकाले च शुभलग्ने मनोरमे .
संपीक्षिते ग्रहैः सौम्यैर्जांग्रल्लग्नाधिपे स्थिते .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then, at an auspicious time, at a pleasing and favorable ascendant, / aspected by benefic planets, with the lord of the waking ascendant firmly placed,

sanskrit_iast:
asadgrahairadṛṣṭe ca sadgrahekṣita eva ca .
śubhakarmasamārambhaṃ svastivācanapūrvakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
असद्ग्रहैरदृष्टे च सद्ग्रहेक्षित एव च .
शुभकर्मसमारम्भं स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: unaspected by malefic planets and beheld solely by benefics, / the commencement of the auspicious rites, preceded by the svastivācana recitation,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra vasudevaścāpyājñayā suraviprayoḥ .
dattvā suvarṇaśatakaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca sādaram .. 8 ..
meaning:
चकार वसुदेवश्चाप्याज्ञया सुरविप्रयोः .
दत्त्वा सुवर्णशतकं ब्राह्मणाय च सादरम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Vasudeva performed by the command of the gods and the Brahmins; / and having respectfully given a hundred pieces of gold to the Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
devendrāṃśca munīndrāśca namaskṛtya purohitam .
gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śivām .. 9 ..
meaning:
देवेन्द्रांश्च मुनीन्द्राश्च नमस्कृत्य पुरोहितम् .
गणेशं च दिनेशं च वह्निं च शंकरं शिवाम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: and bowing to the lords of gods, the lords of sages, and the family priest, / and having worshipped Gaṇeśa, the Sun, Fire, Śaṅkara, and Śivā—

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca sākṣatairdevasaṃsadi .
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam .. 10 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य देवषट्कं च साक्षतैर्देवसंसदि .
उपचारैः षोडशभिः संयतो भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: worshipping the group of six deities with unbroken grains in the assembly of the gods / with sixteen offerings, self-controlled and full of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
putrādhivāsanaṃ cakrai vedamantreṇa saṃsadi .
saṃpūjya nānādevāṃśca dikpālāṃśca navagrahān .. 11 ..
meaning:
पुत्राधिवासनं चक्रै वेदमन्त्रेण संसदि .
संपूज्य नानादेवांश्च दिक्पालांश्च नवग्रहान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: he performed the preliminary consecration of his sons in the assembly with Vedic mantras; / and having worshipped various deities, the guardians of the directions, and the nine planets,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā pañcopacārāṃśca bhaktyā ṣoḍaśamātṛkāḥ .
dattvā ca vasudhārāṃ ca saptavārānghṛtena ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा पञ्चोपचारांश्च भक्त्या षोडशमातृकाः .
दत्त्वा च वसुधारां च सप्तवारान्घृतेन च .. 12 ..
text_mt: and devoutly offering fivefold worship to the sixteen mother goddesses, / and having offered the stream of ghee seven times,

sanskrit_iast:
cedirājaṃ vasuṃ natvā saṃpūjya prayayau punaḥ .
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sunirvāpya yatkiṃciddaivikaṃ tathā .. 13 ..
meaning:
चेदिराजं वसुं नत्वा संपूज्य प्रययौ पुनः .
वृद्धिश्राद्धं सुनिर्वाप्य यत्किंचिद्दैविकं तथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: having bowed to and worshipped King Vasu of Cedi, he proceeded further. / Having properly performed the vṛddhi-śrāddha and whatever pertained to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu vedoktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ dadau mudā .
valadevāgracāyaiva kṛṣṇāya paramātmane .. 14 ..
meaning:
यज्ञं कृत्वा तु वेदोक्तं यज्ञसूत्रं ददौ मुदा .
वलदेवाग्रचायैव कृष्णाय परमात्मने .. 14 ..
text_mt: and having performed the sacrifice prescribed by the Vedas, he joyfully gave the sacrificial thread / to the elder brother of Baladeva and to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrī ca dadau tābhyāṃ muniḥ sāṃdīpanistathā .
bhikṣāṃ dadau ca prathamaṃ pārvatī paramādarāt .. 15 ..
meaning:
गायत्री च ददौ ताभ्यां मुनिः सांदीपनिस्तथा .
भिक्षां ददौ च प्रथमं पार्वती परमादरात् .. 15 ..
text_mt: And the sage Sāndīpani imparted the Gāyatrī to both of them. / Then Pārvatī first gave alms with the utmost reverence:

sanskrit_iast:
amūlyaratnapātrasthaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakam .
hīrasāravinirmāṇaṃ pitrā dattaṃ ca hārakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
अमूल्यरत्नपात्रस्थं मुक्तामाणिक्यहीरकम् .
हीरसारविनिर्माणं पित्रा दत्तं च हारकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: pearls, rubies, and diamonds placed in a vessel of priceless gems, / and a necklace made of choice diamonds presented by her father.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau śuklapuṣpeṇā dūrvayā .
tato'ditirditiścaiva munipatnyaśca devakī .. 17 ..
meaning:
शुभाशिषं च प्रददौ शुक्लपुष्पेणा दूर्वया .
ततोऽदितिर्दितिश्चैव मुनिपत्न्यश्च देवकी .. 17 ..
text_mt: And she bestowed auspicious blessings with white flowers and dūrvā grass. / Then Aditi, Diti, the wives of the sages, Devakī,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodā rohiṇī hṛṣṭā sāvitrī ca sarasvatī .
pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitām .. 18 ..
meaning:
यशोदा रोहिणी हृष्टा सावित्री च सरस्वती .
प्रत्येकं प्रददौ भिक्षां मणिकाञ्चनभूषिताम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Yaśodā, Rohiṇī, overjoyed, along with Sāvitrī and Sarasvatī, / each gave alms adorned with jewels and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāḥ pativratāḥ .
kāminyo bāndhavānāṃ ca sasmitāḥ snigdhalocanāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
देवकन्या नागकन्या राजकन्याः पतिव्रताः .
कामिन्यो बान्धवानां च सस्मिताः स्निग्धलोचनाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Daughters of the gods, daughters of the nāgas, royal princesses, devoted wives, / and the beloved women of the kinsmen, smiling with affectionate eyes—

sanskrit_iast:
indrāṇī varuṇānī ca pavanānī ca rohiṇī .
kuberapatnīṃ svāhā ca ratiḥ kāmasya kāminī .. 20 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राणी वरुणानी च पवनानी च रोहिणी .
कुबेरपत्नीं स्वाहा च रतिः कामस्य कामिनी .. 20 ..
text_mt: Indrāṇī, Varuṇānī, Pavanānī, Rohiṇī, / the wife of Kubera, Svāhā, and Rati, the beloved of Kāma—

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .
bhikṣāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavānsabalo bhaktipūrvakam .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं प्रददौ भिक्षां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् .
भिक्षां गृहीत्वा भगवान्सबलो भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: each gave alms adorned with jewel ornaments. / Receiving the alms devoutly, the Blessed Lord along with Bala

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃciddadau ca gargāya kicitsvagurave tathā .
vaidikaṃ karma nirvāpya gargāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadau .. 22 ..
meaning:
किंचिद्ददौ च गर्गाय किचित्स्वगुरवे तथा .
वैदिकं कर्म निर्वाप्य गर्गाय दक्षिणां ददौ .. 22 ..
text_mt: gave some to Garga and some to his own preceptor. / Having completed the Vedic rites, he gave a priestly fee to Garga.

sanskrit_iast:
devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇāṃścāpi sādaram .
ye ye samāyayuryajñe teca dattvā śubhāśiṣam .. 23 ..
meaning:
देवांश्च भोजयामास ब्राह्मणांश्चापि सादरम् .
ये ये समाययुर्यज्ञे तेच दत्त्वा शुभाशिषम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: And he respectfully fed the gods and the Brahmins. / Whoever had gathered at the sacrifice, having bestowed auspicious blessings

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṇṇāya baladevāya prahṛṣṭāḥ prayayṛrguham .
nandaḥ sabhāryo nirvāpya śubhakarma sutasya vai .. 24 ..
meaning:
कृण्णाय बलदेवाय प्रहृष्टाः प्रययृर्गुहम् .
नन्दः सभार्यो निर्वाप्य शुभकर्म सुतस्य वै .. 24 ..
text_mt: upon Kṛṣṇa and Baladeva, departed joyfully for their homes. / Nanda, together with his wife, having concluded the auspicious rite for his son,

sanskrit_iast:
kroḍe kṛtvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cucumba vadanaṃ tayoḥ .
ucacai ruroda nandaśca yaśodā ca pativratā
śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ samāśvāsya bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
क्रोडे कृत्वा बलं कृष्णं चुचुम्ब वदनं तयोः .
उचचै रुरोद नन्दश्च यशोदा च पतिव्रता
श्रीकृष्णस्तं समाश्वास्य बोधयामास यत्नतः .. 25 ..
text_mt: took Bala and Kṛṣṇa onto his lap and kissed their faces. / Nanda wept aloud, and so did the devoted wife Yaśodā; / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, consoling him, carefully instructed him.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
sānandaṃ gaccha he mātaryaśode tātamatvaram .
tvameva mātā poṣṭrī tvaṃ pitā ca paramārthataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
सानन्दं गच्छ हे मातर्यशोदे तातमत्वरम् .
त्वमेव माता पोष्ट्री त्वं पिता च परमार्थतः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Go with joy, O Mother Yaśodā, and you, Father, without delay. / You alone are the mother who nurtures, and you are the father in truth.

sanskrit_iast:
avantinagaraṃ tāta yāsyāmi sabalo'dhunā .
muneḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ sthānaṃ vedapāṭhārthamīpsitam .. 27 ..
meaning:
अवन्तिनगरं तात यास्यामि सबलोऽधुना .
मुनेः सांदीपनेः स्थानं वेदपाठार्थमीप्सितम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Father, I shall now go with Bala to the city of Avantī, / to the desired dwelling of the sage Sāndīpani to study the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tata āgatya suciraṃ kāle bhavati darśanam .
kāmaḥ karoti kalanaṃ sa ca bhedaṃ karoti ca .. 28 ..
meaning:
तत आगत्य सुचिरं काले भवति दर्शनम् .
कामः करोति कलनं स च भेदं करोति च .. 28 ..
text_mt: After returning from there, our meeting will occur in due course of time. / Time brings things to pass, and it also causes separation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ mātarbhedaṃ saṃmīlanaṃ nṛṇām .
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca harṣaṃ ca śokaṃ ca maṅgalālayam .. 29 ..
meaning:
सर्वं कालकृतं मातर्भेदं संमीलनं नृणाम् .
सुखं दुःखं च हर्षं च शोकं च मङ्गलालयम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Everything is wrought by Time, O Mother: the separation and union of men, / pleasure and pain, joy and sorrow, the abode of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dattaṃ ca tattvaṃ ca yogināmapi durlabham .
sarvaṃ nandaśca sānandaṃ tvāmeva kathayiṣyati .. 30 ..
meaning:
मया दत्तं च तत्त्वं च योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् .
सर्वं नन्दश्च सानन्दं त्वामेव कथयिष्यति .. 30 ..
text_mt: The truth imparted by me, hard even for yogins to attain, / Nanda will joyfully explain to you in full.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho vasudevasabhāṃ yayau .
tadājñayā kṣaṇaṃ prāpya yayau saṃdīpanergūham .. 31 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथो वसुदेवसभां ययौ .
तदाज्ञया क्षणं प्राप्य ययौ संदीपनेर्गूहम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds went to Vasudeva’s assembly. / Obtaining his permission in a moment, he set out for the home of Sāndīpani.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca saṃbhāṣya vinayena ca .
nandaḥ sabhāryaḥ prayayau hṛdayena vidūyatā .. 32 ..
meaning:
वसुदेवं देवकीं च संभाष्य विनयेन च .
नन्दः सभार्यः प्रययौ हृदयेन विदूयता .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having spoken to Vasudeva and Devakī with humility, / Nanda departed with his wife, his heart aching with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
muktāmaṇiṃ suvarṇa ca māṇikyaṃ hīrakaṃ tathā .
vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ratnaṃ nandāya devakī dadau .. 33 ..
meaning:
मुक्तामणिं सुवर्ण च माणिक्यं हीरकं तथा .
वह्निशुद्धांशुकं रत्नं नन्दाय देवकी ददौ .. 33 ..
text_mt: Pearls, gold, rubies, diamonds, / fire-purified silk garments, and gems Devakī gave to Nanda.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāśvaṃ ca gajendraṃ ca suvarṇarathamuttamam .
nandāya kṛṣṇaḥ pradadau vasudevaśca sādaram .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्वेताश्वं च गजेन्द्रं च सुवर्णरथमुत्तमम् .
नन्दाय कृष्णः प्रददौ वसुदेवश्च सादरम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: A white horse, a noble elephant, and an excellent golden chariot / Kṛṣṇa and Vasudeva respectfully gave to Nanda.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoranuvrajanviprā devakīpramukhāḥ striyaḥ .
vasudevastathā'krūro'pyuddhavaśca yayau mudā .. 35 ..
meaning:
तयोरनुव्रजन्विप्रा देवकीप्रमुखाः स्त्रियः .
वसुदेवस्तथाऽक्रूरोऽप्युद्धवश्च ययौ मुदा .. 35 ..
text_mt: Following after the two, the Brahmins, the women headed by Devakī, / Vasudeva, Akrūra, and Uddhava also went joyfully.

sanskrit_iast:
kālindīnikaṭaṃ gatvā te sarve ruruduḥ śucā .
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya te sarve svālayaṃ yayuḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
कालिन्दीनिकटं गत्वा ते सर्वे रुरुदुः शुचा .
परस्परं च संभाष्य ते सर्वे स्वालयं ययुः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Going near the Kālindī, they all wept in grief; / and after speaking with one another, they all returned to their own dwellings.

sanskrit_iast:
kuntī saputrā vidhavā vasudevājñayā mune .
nānāratnamaṇiṃ prāpya prayayau svaralayaṃ mudā .. 37 ..
meaning:
कुन्ती सपुत्रा विधवा वसुदेवाज्ञया मुने .
नानारत्नमणिं प्राप्य प्रययौ स्वरलयं मुदा .. 37 ..
text_mt: Kuntī, a widow with her sons, by the command of Vasudeva, O sage, / having received various gems and jewels, joyfully departed for her own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
vasutevo devakī ca putrakalyāṇahetave .
nānāratnamaṇiṃ vastraṃ muvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 38 ..
meaning:
वसुतेवो देवकी च पुत्रकल्याणहेतवे .
नानारत्नमणिं वस्त्रं मुवर्णं रजतं तथा .. 38 ..
text_mt: Vasudeva and Devakī, for the sake of their son's welfare, / various gems, jewels, garments, gold, and silver,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāmāṇikyacahāraṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam .
bhaṭṭemyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca pradadau sādaraṃ mudā .. 39 ..
meaning:
मुक्तामाणिक्यचहारं च मिष्टान्नं च सुधोपमम् .
भट्टेम्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च प्रददौ सादरं मुदा .. 39 ..
text_mt: and necklaces of pearls and rubies, and sweet foods resembling nectar, / respectfully and joyfully gave to the bards and Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavaṃ vedapāṭhaṃ harernāmaikamaṅgalam .
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ caiva kārayāmāsa yatnataḥ .. 40 ..
meaning:
महोत्सवं वेदपाठं हरेर्नामैकमङ्गलम् .
विप्राणां भोजनं चैव कारयामास यत्नतः .. 40 ..
text_mt: A great festival, the recitation of the Vedas, the sole auspicious name of Hari, / and the feeding of Brahmins he carefully arranged.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātīnāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca puraskāraṃ yathocitam .
cakāra maṇimāṇikyamuktāvastrairmanoharaiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
ज्ञातीनां बान्धवानां च पुरस्कारं यथोचितम् .
चकार मणिमाणिक्यमुक्तावस्त्रैर्मनोहरैः .. 41 ..
text_mt: He duly honored his kinsmen and relatives / with jewels, rubies, pearls, and charming garments.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao nārādanāo uttao bhagavadupanayanaṃ
nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 101 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ नारादनाओ उत्तओ भगवदुपनयनं
नामैकाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 101 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred and first chapter, entitled “The Sacred Thread Ceremony of the Lord,” in the conversation between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmavaivarta. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
kṛṇṇaḥ sāṃdīpanergehaṃ gatvā ca sabalo mudā .
namaścakāra svaguruṃ gurupatnīṃ pativratām .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
कृण्णः सांदीपनेर्गेहं गत्वा च सबलो मुदा .
नमश्चकार स्वगुरुं गुरुपत्नीं पतिव्रताम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Chapter one hundred and two.
Nārāyaṇa said:
Having joyfully gone to the house of Sāndīpani with Bala, / Kṛṣṇa bowed to his preceptor and to the devoted wife of the preceptor.
title: dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśiṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca dattvā ratnamaṇiṃ hariḥ .
gurave tasya bhāryāyai tamuvāca yathocitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
शुभाशिषं गृहीत्वा च दत्त्वा रत्नमणिं हरिः .
गुरवे तस्य भार्यायै तमुवाच यथोचितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Receiving their auspicious blessing and presenting jewels and gems, / Hari appropriately addressed the preceptor and his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
tvatto vidyāṃ labhiṣyāmi vāñchitāṃ vāñchitaṃ mama .
kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ vipra māṃ pāṭhaya yathocitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
त्वत्तो विद्यां लभिष्यामि वाञ्छितां वाञ्छितं मम .
कृत्वा शुभक्षणं विप्र मां पाठय यथोचितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I wish to obtain from you the desired knowledge; it is my wish. / Determining an auspicious moment, O Brahmin, teach me properly.

sanskrit_iast:
omityuktvā muniśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ mudā .
madhuparkaprāśanena gavā vastreṇa candanaiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
ओमित्युक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठः पूजयामास तं मुदा .
मधुपर्कप्राशनेन गवा वस्त्रेण चन्दनैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Saying “Om,” the best of sages joyfully worshipped him / with the offering of madhuparka, a cow, clothing, and sandalwood pastes.

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitaṃ .
supriyaṃ kathayāmāsa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram .. 5 ..
meaning:
मिष्टान्नं भोजयामास ताम्बूलं च सुवासितं .
सुप्रियं कथयामास तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: He fed him sweet food and fragrant betel, / spoke words dear to him, and praised the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃdīpaniruvāca
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramīśa parātpara .
svecchāmayaṃ svayaṃjyotirniliptaiko niraṅkuśaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
सांदीपनिरुवाच
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम परमीश परात्पर .
स्वेच्छामयं स्वयंज्योतिर्निलिप्तैको निरङ्कुशः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Sāndīpani said:
O Supreme Brahman, Supreme Abode, Supreme Sovereign, Higher than the highest! / Willing by Your own will, Self-luminous, Unattached, One, Unrestrained!

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktaikanātha bhakteṣṭa bhaktānugrahavigraha .
bhaktavāñchākalpataro bhaktānāṃ prāṇavallabha .. 7 ..
meaning:
भक्तैकनाथ भक्तेष्ट भक्तानुग्रहविग्रह .
भक्तवाञ्छाकल्पतरो भक्तानां प्राणवल्लभ .. 7 ..
text_mt: O sole protector of devotees, O beloved of devotees, O embodiment of grace to devotees! / O wish-granting tree for devotees' desires, O beloved life-breath of devotees! 7

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā bālarūpo'si brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ .
māyayā bhuvi bhūpāla bhuvo bhārakṣayāya ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
मायया बालरूपोऽसि ब्रह्मेशशेषवन्दितः .
मायया भुवि भूपाल भुवो भारक्षयाय च .. 8 ..
text_mt: Through māyā you take the form of a child, praised by Brahmā, Śiva, and Śeṣa; / through māyā, O king of the earth, [you appear] on earth to remove the burden of the earth. 8

sanskrit_iast:
yogino yaṃ vidantyevaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam .
dhyāyante bhaktanivahā jyotirabhyantare mudā .. 9 ..
meaning:
योगिनो यं विदन्त्येवं ब्रह्मज्योतिः सनातनम् .
ध्यायन्ते भक्तनिवहा ज्योतिरभ्यन्तरे मुदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Yogins know him thus as the eternal light of Brahman; / the multitudes of devotees meditate with joy within that light, 9

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sundaraṃ śyāmahupakam .
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ sasmitaṃ bhaktavatsalam .. 10 ..
meaning:
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं सुन्दरं श्यामहुपकम् .
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं सस्मितं भक्तवत्सलम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: on him with two arms, flute in hand, handsome, of dark-complexioned form, / his whole body smeared with sandalwood, smiling, loving toward his devotees, 10

sanskrit_iast:
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālavibhūṣitam .
līlāpāṅgataraṅgaiśca ninditānaṅgamūrcchitam .. 11 ..
meaning:
पीताम्बरधरं देवं वनमालविभूषितम् .
लीलापाङ्गतरङ्गैश्च निन्दितानङ्गमूर्च्छितम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: the god clad in yellow garments, adorned with a garland of forest flowers, / who puts fainting Kāma to shame by the waves of his playful sidelong glances, 11

sanskrit_iast:
alaktabhavanaṃ tadvatpādapadmaṃ suśobhanam .
kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgaṃ ca divyamūrtiṃ manoharam .. 12 ..
meaning:
अलक्तभवनं तद्वत्पादपद्मं सुशोभनम् .
कौस्तुभोद्भासिताङ्गं च दिव्यमूर्तिं मनोहरम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: whose very beautiful lotus-feet are likewise dyed with red lac, / whose limbs shine with the Kaustubha jewel, of divine form, charming the mind, 12

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannaṃ ca suveṣaṃ prastutaṃ suraiḥ .
devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ trelokyamohanaṃ param .. 13 ..
meaning:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नं च सुवेषं प्रस्तुतं सुरैः .
देवदेवं जगन्नाथं त्रेलोक्यमोहनं परम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: brightened by a gentle smile, well-attired, praised by the gods, / the god of gods, lord of the world, supreme charmer of the three worlds, 13

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ kamanīyamanīśvaram .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇaughena bhūṣitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
कोटिकन्दर्पलीलाभं कमनीयमनीश्वरम् .
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणभूषणौघेन भूषितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: lustrous like the play of ten million Kāmas, desirable, with none above him as lord, / adorned with a multitude of ornaments made of priceless gems, 14

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāmabhīpsitam .
caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam .. 15 ..
meaning:
वरं वरण्यं वरदं वरदानामभीप्सितम् .
चतुर्णामपि वेदानां कारणानां च कारणम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: the best, worthy of choice, bestower of boons, the desired goal of boongivers, / and the cause even of the four Vedas and of [all] causes. 15

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhārtha matpriyasthānamāgato'si ca māyayā .
pāṭhaṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ ramaṇaṃ gamanaṃ raṇam ..
svātmārāmasya ca vibhoḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
पाठार्थ मत्प्रियस्थानमागतोऽसि च मायया .
पाठं ते लोकशिक्षार्थं रमणं गमनं रणम् ..
स्वात्मारामस्य च विभोः परिपूर्णतमस्य च .. 16 ..
text_mt:
For the sake of study you have come through māyā to the abode of your beloved [teacher]. / Your study, sporting, walking, and fighting are for the education of the world,
of you the all-pervading, rejoicing in your own self, most completely full. 16

sanskrit_iast:
gurupatnyuvāca
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama .
pātivratyaṃ ca saphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca tapovanam .. 17 ..
meaning:
गुरुपत्न्युवाच
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सफलं जीवनं मम .
पातिव्रत्यं च सफलं सफलं च तपोवनम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: The teacher's wife said: / Today my birth is fruitful; my life is fruitful; / my fidelity to my husband is fruitful, and fruitful is this penance-grove! 17

sanskrit_iast:
maddakṣahastaḥ saphalo dattaṃ yenānnamīpsitam .
tadāśramaṃ tīrthaparaṃ tīrthapādapadāṅkitam .. 18 ..
meaning:
मद्दक्षहस्तः सफलो दत्तं येनान्नमीप्सितम् .
तदाश्रमं तीर्थपरं तीर्थपादपदाङ्कितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Fruitful is my right hand, by which desired food has been given [to you]! / This hermitage is superior to all sacred sites, marked by the feet of him whose feet are sacred! 18

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādarajasā pūtā gṛhāḥ prāṅgaṇamuttamam .
tvatpādapadmaṃ dṛṣṭvā caivā''vayorjanmakhaṇḍanam .. 19 ..
meaning:
त्वत्पादरजसा पूता गृहाः प्राङ्गणमुत्तमम् .
त्वत्पादपद्मं दृष्ट्वा चैवा'ऽवयोर्जन्मखण्डनम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: The houses and the excellent courtyard are purified by the dust of your feet; / having seen your lotus-feet, the cycle of our rebirth is indeed destroyed! 19

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadduḥkhaṃ ca śokaśca tāvadbhogaśca rogakaḥ .
tāvajjanmāni karmāṇi kṣutpipāsādikāni ca .. 20 ..
meaning:
तावद्दुःखं च शोकश्च तावद्भोगश्च रोगकः .
तावज्जन्मानि कर्माणि क्षुत्पिपासादिकानि च .. 20 ..
text_mt: So long lasts misery and sorrow, so long lasts worldly enjoyment and illness, / so long last births, karmas, hunger, thirst, and the rest, 20

sanskrit_iast:
yāvattvatpādapadmasya bhajanaṃ nāsti darśanam .
he kālakāla bhagavansraṣṭuḥ saṃharturīśvara .. 21 ..
meaning:
यावत्त्वत्पादपद्मस्य भजनं नास्ति दर्शनम् .
हे कालकाल भगवन्स्रष्टुः संहर्तुरीश्वर .. 21 ..
text_mt: as long as there is no worship or vision of your lotus-feet! / O death of death! O Blessed One! O Lord of the creator and the destroyer! 21

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha māyāmohanikṛntana .
ityuktvā sāśrunetrā sā kroḍe kṛtvā hariṃ punaḥ
svastanaṃ pāyayāmāsa premṇā ca devakī yathā .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृपां कुरु कृपानाथ मायामोहनिकृन्तन .
इत्युक्त्वा साश्रुनेत्रा सा क्रोडे कृत्वा हरिं पुनः
स्वस्तनं पाययामास प्रेम्णा च देवकी यथा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Show mercy, O lord of compassion, O cutter of the delusion of māyā! / Having spoken thus, with tearful eyes, she took Hari back into her lap / and suckled him at her breast with love, just like Devakī. 22

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
mātastvaṃ māṃ kathaṃ stauṣi bālaṃ dugdhamukhaṃ sutam .
gaccha golokamiṣṭaṃ ca svāminā sahasāpratam .. 23 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
मातस्त्वं मां कथं स्तौषि बालं दुग्धमुखं सुतम् .
गच्छ गोलोकमिष्टं च स्वामिना सहसाप्रतम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: The auspicious Kṛṣṇa said: / Mother, how can you praise me, an infant boy whose mouth tastes of milk? / Go to beloved Goloka now with your husband, 23

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā prākṛtikaṃ mithyā naśvaraṃ ca kalevaram .
vidhāya nirmalaṃ dehaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam .. 24 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा प्राकृतिकं मिथ्या नश्वरं च कलेवरम् .
विधाय निर्मलं देहं जन्ममृत्युजराहरम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: having cast off your material, false, and perishable physical body, / and assumed a spotless body that takes away birth, death, and old age! 24

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavā caturo vedānpaṭhitvā munipuṃgavāt .
māsena parayā bhaktyā dattvā putraṃ mṛtaṃ purā .. 25 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्तवा चतुरो वेदान्पठित्वा मुनिपुंगवात् .
मासेन परया भक्त्या दत्त्वा पुत्रं मृतं पुरा .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, having studied the four Vedas under the eminent sage / within a month with supreme devotion, and having returned the son who had died long ago, 25

sanskrit_iast:
ratnānāṃ ca trilakṣaṃ ca maṇīnāṃ pañcalakṣaṇam .
hīrakāṇāṃ caturlakṣaṃ muktānāṃ pañcalakṣakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
रत्नानां च त्रिलक्षं च मणीनां पञ्चलक्षणम् .
हीरकाणां चतुर्लक्षं मुक्तानां पञ्चलक्षकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: three hundred thousand jewels and five hundred thousand gems, / four hundred thousand diamonds and five hundred thousand pearls, 26

sanskrit_iast:
māṇikyānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca vastraṃ trailokyadurlabham .
hāraṃ ca durgayā dataṃ hastaratnāṅgulīyakam .. 27 ..
meaning:
माणिक्यानां द्विलक्षं च वस्त्रं त्रैलोक्यदुर्लभम् .
हारं च दुर्गया दतं हस्तरत्नाङ्गुलीयकम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: two hundred thousand rubies, a garment hard to obtain in the three worlds, / a necklace given by Durgā, and a gem-studded signet ring for the hand, 27

sanskrit_iast:
daśakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadau .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ nārīsarvāṅgabhūṣaṇamā .. 28 ..
meaning:
दशकोटिं सुवर्णानां गुरवे दक्षिणां ददौ .
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं नारीसर्वाङ्गभूषणमा .. 28 ..
text_mt: and one hundred million gold coins, he gave as the teacher's fee to the guru, / and ornaments for all the limbs of a woman, made of priceless gems, 28

sanskrit_iast:
gurupriyāyai pradadau vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ varam .
munirdattvā ca putrāya taḥsarvaṃ priyayā saha .. 29 ..
meaning:
गुरुप्रियायै प्रददौ वह्निशुद्धांशुकं वरम् .
मुनिर्दत्त्वा च पुत्राय तःसर्वं प्रियया सह .. 29 ..
text_mt: and an excellent cloth purified by fire, he presented to the teacher's beloved wife. / The sage, having given all that to his son, along with his beloved wife, 29

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnarathamāruhya yayau golokamuttamam .
tamadbhūtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau svālayaṃ mudā .. 30 ..
meaning:
सद्रत्नरथमारुह्य ययौ गोलोकमुत्तमम् .
तमद्भूतं हरिं दृष्ट्वा प्रययौ स्वालयं मुदा .. 30 ..
text_mt: mounted an excellent chariot of gems and went to the supreme Goloka. / Having seen that wondrous Hari, he departed with joy to his own abode. 30

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ brahmaṇyadevasya caritraṃ śṛṇu nārada .
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam .. 31 ..
meaning:
एवं ब्रह्मण्यदेवस्य चरित्रं शृणु नारद .
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं यः पठेद्भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Thus listen, O Nārada, to the deeds of the god devoted to brahmins. / Whoever recites this highly meritorious hymn with devotion 31

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇa़ḍitaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णे निश्चलां भक्तिं लभते नात्र संशयः .
अस्पष्टकीर्तिः सुयशा मूर्खो भवति पण़डितः .. 32 ..
text_mt: attains unswerving devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, there is no doubt in this; / one of obscure fame gains good renown, and a fool becomes a learned scholar. 32

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya yātyante śrīhareḥ padam .
tatra nityaṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:

text_mt: Attaining happiness in this world, at the end he goes to the abode of Śrī Hari; / there he attains eternal servitude to Hari, there is no doubt in this. 33

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

omityuktvā tu prayayuḥ sarve cakraṃ vinā mune .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsasya pitaraṃ bhadramugrasenaṃ mahābalam .

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
śatayojanaparyantaṃ nagaraṃ sumanoharam .
padmarāgairmarakatairindranīlairanuttamaiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
शतयोजनपर्यन्तं नगरं सुमनोहरम् .
पद्मरागैर्मरकतैरिन्द्रनीलैरनुत्तमैः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Now begins the one hundred and third chapter. / Nārāyaṇa said: / Then, having arrived at Madhupurī and bowed to his father, the all-pervading Hari, / along with Balarāma, remembered Garuḍa at the foot of a banyan tree. 1 / With respect, [he also remembered] the salty ocean and the desired Viśvakarman; / he discarded the attire of a cowherd and assumed the attire of a king. 2 / Meanwhile, the disc came to Hari of its own accord, / the supreme [weapon] named Sudarśana, equal in brilliance to ten million suns, 3 / equal to Hari in splendour, the supreme crusher of foes, / the unfailing weapon, the best among weapons, highest of the high. 4 / Bringing a jewel-chariot before him, Garuḍa came into Hari's presence, / as did Viśvakarman with his pupils, and likewise the trembling ocean. 5 / They all bowed down to Hari with their heads, full of devotion; / smiling, the all-pervading Lord spoke to them in turn with respect and care. 6 / The auspicious Kṛṣṇa said: / O Ocean, highly fortunate one, grant a place of one hundred yojanas; / give it to me for a city, and I shall surely return it later. 7 / O artisan, build a city that is hard to find in the three worlds, / delightful to all and desirable to women, 8 / desired also by devotees, supreme, resembling Vaikuṇṭha, / the ultimate desired destination beyond all heavens! 9 / Day and night, O best of birds, stay in the presence of Viśvakarman, / O highly fortunate one, until he finishes constructing Dvārakā! 10 / And day and night, O best of discs, stay at my side! / Having said 'Yes,' O sage, all except the disc departed. 11 / He made Kaṃsa's father, the good and mighty Ugrasena, / king in the city over the kṣatriyas and the virtuous. 12 / Having defeated Jarāsaṃdha and slain the Yavana / by stratagem, O highly fortunate one, the Lord [began] the process of construction. 13 / The Blessed One said: / A very charming city extending up to one hundred yojanas, / with rubies, emeralds, and peerless sapphires... 14

sanskrit_iast:
rucakaiḥ pāribhadraiśca palaṅkaiśca syamantakaiḥ .
gandhakairgālimaiścaiva candrakāntādibhistathā .. 15 ..

रुचकैः पारिभद्रैश्च पलङ्कैश्च स्यमन्तकैः .
गन्धकैर्गालिमैश्चैव चन्द्रकान्तादिभिस्तथा .. 15 ..
text_mt:
with rucakas, pāribhadras, palaṅkas, and syamantakas; / with gandhakas, gālimas, and candrakāntas and the like; // with sūryakāntas and the like, and crystalline crystals; / with emerald-green gems, dark ones, and yellow-faced caṣas; // with yellow gems resembling gorocanā, like pomegranate seeds, / resembling lotus seeds, and blue gems like the lotus blossom; // with gems having the hue of collyrium, bright and polished, / resembling the hue of white campaka, looking like heated gold; // worth a hundred times the price of gold, slightly reddish, highly beautiful, / weightiest and best, supreme and prized gems; // as prescribed, whatever is fitting, whatever desire is released where. / Moreover, the hordes of Yakṣas shall carry out the fetching of gems // from the Himālaya day and night until the construction is completed, / with seven hundred thousand Yakṣas dispatched by Kubera; // with hundreds of thousands of Vetālas and Kūṣmāṇḍas arranged by Śaṅkara, / and Dānavas and Brahmarākṣasas assigned by Pārvatī. // Build the divine encampment for the sixteen thousand wives / and for the other wives, the one hundred and eight, // furnished with a moat, enclosed by a high rampart, / fitted with twelve halls, adorned with a main gateway, // equipped with various wonderful artificial door-leaves, / free of forbidden trees and adorned with renowned ones, // possessing auspicious signs, lunar alignment, and courtyards likewise; / likewise the divine dwelling of the Yadus and the servants; // an all-perfect abode for King Ugrasena, / and an all-auspicious dwelling for my father Vasudeva.
Viśvakarman said:
Which trees are praised, and which are forbidden, / and which grant good or bad fortune? Tell me about them, O Teacher of the Universe! // The bones of which creatures bring good or bad fortune when placed in an encampment?

sanskrit_iast:
īśāne sukhadaścaiva sarvatraiva niśāmaya .
sarvatra campakaḥ śuddho bhuvi bhadrapradastathā .. 40 ..
meaning:
ईशाने सुखदश्चैव सर्वत्रैव निशामय .
सर्वत्र चम्पकः शुद्धो भुवि भद्रप्रदस्तथा .. 40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
alābuścāpi kūṣmāṇḍamāyāmbuśca sakiṃśukaḥ .
kharjūrī karkaṭī cāpi śibire maṅgalapradā .. 41 ..
meaning:
अलाबुश्चापि कूष्माण्डमायाम्बुश्च सकिंशुकः .
खर्जूरी कर्कटी चापि शिबिरे मङ्गलप्रदा .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vāstūkakārabilvaśca vārtākaśca śubhapradaḥ .
latāphalaṃ ca śubhadaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra niścitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
वास्तूककारबिल्वश्च वार्ताकश्च शुभप्रदः .
लताफलं च शुभदं सर्वं सर्वत्र निश्चितम् .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
praśastaṃ kathitaṃ kāro niṣiddhaṃ ca niśāmaya .
vanyavṛkṣo niṣiddhaśca śibire nagare'pi ca .. 43 ..
meaning:
प्रशस्तं कथितं कारो निषिद्धं च निशामय .
वन्यवृक्षो निषिद्धश्च शिबिरे नगरेऽपि च .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭo niṣiddhaḥ śibire nityaṃ corabhayaṃ yataḥ .
nagareṣu prasiddhaśca darśanātpuṇyadastathā .. 44 ..
meaning:
वटो निषिद्धः शिबिरे नित्यं चोरभयं यतः .
नगरेषु प्रसिद्धश्च दर्शनात्पुण्यदस्तथा .. 44 ..
text_mt: yet it is renowned in cities, and gives merit merely from being seen. // The śālmali tree is forbidden in an encampment, town, or city; / it constantly brings sorrow, and always to kings as well; // it is not forbidden and is well known in villages and cities, / but for learning it is extremely forbidden, continually causing grief then. // O architect, the tamarind tree—one should avoid it with effort: / through it there would be loss of wealth and surely loss of offspring. // In an encampment it is extremely forbidden, and slightly so in a city; / it is not forbidden and is well known in villages and cities, // yet it is extremely forbidden for learning; a wise man should avoid it. / The date palm and wheat are likewise forbidden in an encampment; // they are not forbidden and are well known in villages and cities. / The plant of chickpeas and other grains is auspicious // in villages, in cities, and in encampments as well. / The sugarcane plant brings fortune; it constantly brings fortune. // The aśoka, the śirīṣa, and the kadamba bring good fortune; / turmeric somehow brings good fortune, and ginger brings good fortune likewise; // harītakī is auspicious in villages and in cities, / not to be planted elsewhere, and āmalakī is surely ever auspicious. // The bone of elephants is auspicious, and likewise that of horses; / it is beneficial to those establishing high-eared steeds on the site; // it does not bring good fortune to others, being the supreme cause of ruin. / The bones of monkeys, men, donkeys, and cattle, // of dogs, jackals, and cats are inauspicious; / those of rams and hogs are auspicious for all. // In the northeast, east, west, and north, / water in an encampment is auspicious; elsewhere it is inauspicious. // A wise person should not make the length and the breadth equal in a temple; / in a square house, O architect, there is destruction of wealth for householders. // The length and breadth are measured, and divided by the number two.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhaḥ śālmaliścaiva śibire nagare pure .
duḥkhapradaśca satataṃ bhūmipānāṃ sadā'pi ca .. 45 ..
meaning:
निषिद्धः शाल्मलिश्चैव शिबिरे नगरे पुरे .
दुःखप्रदश्च सततं भूमिपानां सदाऽपि च .. 45 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca .
vidyāmatiniṣiddhastu satataṃ duḥkhadastadā .. 46 ..
meaning:
न निषिद्धः प्रसिद्धश्च ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च .
विद्यामतिनिषिद्धस्तु सततं दुःखदस्तदा .. 46 ..

sanskrit_iast:
he kāro tintiḍīvṛkṣo yatnāttaṃ parivarjayet .
śatena dhanahāniḥ syātprajāhānirbhaveddhruvam .. 47 ..
meaning:
हे कारो तिन्तिडीवृक्षो यत्नात्तं परिवर्जयेत् .
शतेन धनहानिः स्यात्प्रजाहानिर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 47 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śibire'tiniṣiddhaśca nagare kiṃcideva ca .
na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca .. 48 ..
meaning:
शिबिरेऽतिनिषिद्धश्च नगरे किंचिदेव च .
न निषिद्धः प्रसिद्धश्च ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च .. 48 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāmatiniṣiddhaśca prājñastaṃ parivarjayet .
kharjūraśca gahuścaiva niṣiddhaḥ śibire tathā .. 49 ..
meaning:
विद्यामतिनिषिद्धश्च प्राज्ञस्तं परिवर्जयेत् .
खर्जूरश्च गहुश्चैव निषिद्धः शिबिरे तथा .. 49 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca .
vṛkṣaśca caṇakādīnāṃ dhānyaṃ ca maṅgalapradam .. 50 ..
meaning:
न निषिद्धः प्रसिद्धश्च ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च .
वृक्षश्च चणकादीनां धान्यं च मङ्गलप्रदम् .. 50 ..

sanskrit_iast:
grāmeṣu nagare cāpi śibire ca tathaiva ca .
ikṣuvṛkṣaśca śubhadaḥ saṃtataṃ śubhadastathā .. 51 ..
meaning:
ग्रामेषु नगरे चापि शिबिरे च तथैव च .
इक्षुवृक्षश्च शुभदः संततं शुभदस्तथा .. 51 ..

sanskrit_iast:
aśokaśca śirīṣaśca kadambaśca śubhapradaḥ .
kacciddharidrā śubhadā śubhadaścā''rdrakastathā .. 52 ..
meaning:
अशोकश्च शिरीषश्च कदम्बश्च शुभप्रदः .
कच्चिद्धरिद्रा शुभदा शुभदश्चा'ऽर्द्रकस्तथा .. 52 ..

sanskrit_iast:
harītakī ca śubhadā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca .
na vādyā bhadradā nityaṃ tathā cā''malakī ghruvam .. 53 ..
meaning:
हरीतकी च शुभदा ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च .
न वाद्या भद्रदा नित्यं तथा चा'ऽमलकी घ्रुवम् .. 53 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gajānāmasthi śubhadamaśvānāṃ ca tathaiva ca .
kalyāṇamuccaiḥśravasāṃ vāstau sthāpanakāriṇām .. 54 ..
meaning:
गजानामस्थि शुभदमश्वानां च तथैव च .
कल्याणमुच्चैःश्रवसां वास्तौ स्थापनकारिणाम् .. 54 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na śubhapradamanyeṣāmucchinnakāraṇaṃ param .
vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ gavāmapi .. 55 ..
meaning:
न शुभप्रदमन्येषामुच्छिन्नकारणं परम् .
वानराणां नराणां च गर्दभानां गवामपि .. 55 ..

sanskrit_iast:
kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ mārjārāṇāmabhadrakam .
bheṭakānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca śubhapradam .. 56 ..
meaning:
कुक्कुराणां शृगालानां मार्जाराणामभद्रकम् .
भेटकानां सूकराणां सर्वेषां च शुभप्रदम् .. 56 ..

sanskrit_iast:
īśāne cāpi pūrvasminpaścime ca tathottare .
śibirasya jalaṃ bhadramanyatrāśubhameva ca .. 57 ..
meaning:
ईशाने चापि पूर्वस्मिन्पश्चिमे च तथोत्तरे .
शिबिरस्य जलं भद्रमन्यत्राशुभमेव च .. 57 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghe prasthe samānaṃ ca na kuryānmandire budhaḥ .
caturasre gṛhe kāro gṛhiṇāṃ dhananāśanam .. 58 ..
meaning:
दीर्घे प्रस्थे समानं च न कुर्यान्मन्दिरे बुधः .
चतुरस्रे गृहे कारो गृहिणां धननाशनम् .. 58 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghaprasthaḥ parimito netrāṅkenāpi saṃhṛtam .
śūnyena rahitaṃ bhadraṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 59 ..
meaning:
दीर्घप्रस्थः परिमितो नेत्राङ्केनापि संहृतम् .
शून्येन रहितं भद्रं शून्यं शून्यप्रदं नृणाम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: [A camp] free from empty space brings good fortune; an empty space brings emptiness to men. / Two cubits in breadth at first, and three cubits in length: / such is an auspicious door for houses, both of an outer wall and of a house. / It should not be made in the middle; slightly less or more is auspicious. / A square camp aligned to the lunar transit brings good fortune; / a camp aligned to the solar transit brings misfortune, [though some say] it brings good fortune; / a courtyard [aligned to the solar transit] likewise brings misfortune. / Tulasī planted inside the camp brings good fortune to men; / it bestows wealth and sons, gives merit, and yields devotion to Hari. / Seeing Tulasī at daybreak, one obtains the fruit of giving gold. / Mālatī, yūthikā, kunda, mādhavī, and ketakī, / nāgeśvara, mallikā, kāñcana, auspicious bakula, / and auspicious aparājitā: a garden of these is desirable; / to the east and to the south, it brings good fortune—of this there is no doubt. / A householder should never build a house higher than sixteen cubits; / higher than twenty cubits, an outer wall does not bring good fortune. / A carpenter, an oilman, a goldsmith, and a diamond-cutter: / a wise man should not settle them at the base of the homestead or in the midst of the village. / A virtuous brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya, good śūdra, and astrologer, / a bard, a physician, and a florist: these one should settle near the camp. / A moat measurement of a hundred cubits in breadth is praiseworthy / all around the camps, and ten cubits in depth. / A moat-gate, fitted with a secret device, is desirable— / inaccessible to an enemy, but easily accessible to a friend. / Of śālmali, tamarind, and hintāla, / of nimba, sindhuvāra, and jujube, [timber] is inauspicious; / of dhattūra, banyan, and castor, it is undesired; / other than these, wood is desirable in a camp.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthe hastadvayātpūrvaṃ dīrghe hastatrayaṃ tathā .
gṛhāṇāṃ śubhadaṃ dvāraṃ prākārasya gṛhasya ca .. 60 ..
meaning:
प्रस्थे हस्तद्वयात्पूर्वं दीर्घे हस्तत्रयं तथा .
गृहाणां शुभदं द्वारं प्राकारस्य गृहस्य च .. 60 ..

sanskrit_iast:
na madhyadeśe kartavyaṃ kiṃcinnyūnādhike śubham .
caturasraṃ candravedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam .. 61 ..
meaning:
न मध्यदेशे कर्तव्यं किंचिन्न्यूनाधिके शुभम् .
चतुरस्रं चन्द्रवेधं शिबिरं मङ्गलप्रदम् .. 61 ..

sanskrit_iast:
abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam .
abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca .. 62 ..
meaning:
अभद्रदं सूर्यवेधं शिबिरं मङ्गलप्रदम् .
अभद्रदं सूर्यवेधं प्राङ्गणं च तथैव च .. 62 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śibirābhyantare bhadrā sthāpitā tulasī nṛṇām .
dhanaputrapradātrī ca puṇyadā haribhaktidā .. 63 ..
meaning:
शिबिराभ्यन्तरे भद्रा स्थापिता तुलसी नृणाम् .
धनपुत्रप्रदात्री च पुण्यदा हरिभक्तिदा .. 63 ..

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte tulasīṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇadānaphalaṃ labhet .
mālatī yūthikā kundaṃ mādhavī ketakī tathā .. 64 ..
meaning:
प्रभाते तुलसीं दृष्ट्वा स्वर्णदानफलं लभेत् .
मालती यूथिका कुन्दं माधवी केतकी तथा .. 64 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nāgeśvaraṃ mallikāṃ ca kāñcanaṃ bakulaṃ śubham .
aparājitā ca śubhadā teṣāmudyānamīpsitam .. 65 ..
meaning:
नागेश्वरं मल्लिकां च काञ्चनं बकुलं शुभम् .
अपराजिता च शुभदा तेषामुद्यानमीप्सितम् .. 65 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva śubhadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .
ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśahastebhyo naiva kuryādgṛhaṃ gṛhī .. 66 ..
meaning:
पूर्वे च दक्षिणे चैव शुभदं नात्र संशयः .
ऊर्ध्वं षोडशहस्तेभ्यो नैव कुर्याद्गृहं गृही .. 66 ..

sanskrit_iast:
urdhvaṃ viṃśatihastebhyaḥ prākāraṃ na śubhapradam .
sūtradhāraṃ tailākāraṃ svarṇakāraṃ ca hīrakam .. 67 ..
meaning:
उर्ध्वं विंशतिहस्तेभ्यः प्राकारं न शुभप्रदम् .
सूत्रधारं तैलाकारं स्वर्णकारं च हीरकम् .. 67 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vāṭīmūle grāmamadhye na kuryātsthāpanaṃ budhaḥ .
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣattriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ sacchūdraṃ gaṇakaṃ śubham .. 68 ..
meaning:
वाटीमूले ग्राममध्ये न कुर्यात्स्थापनं बुधः .
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्त्रियं वैश्यं सच्छूद्रं गणकं शुभम् .. 68 ..

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṭṭaṃ vaidyaṃ puṣpakāraṃ sthāpayecchibirāntike .
prasthe ca parikhāmānaṃ śatahastaṃ praśastakam .. 69 ..
meaning:
भट्टं वैद्यं पुष्पकारं स्थापयेच्छिबिरान्तिके .
प्रस्थे च परिखामानं शतहस्तं प्रशस्तकम् .. 69 ..

sanskrit_iast:
paritaḥ śibirāṇāṃ ca gambhīraṃ daśahastakam .
saṃketapūrvakaṃ caiva parikhādvāramīpsitam .. 70 ..
meaning:
परितः शिबिराणां च गम्भीरं दशहस्तकम् .
संकेतपूर्वकं चैव परिखाद्वारमीप्सितम् .. 70 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śatroragamyaṃ mitrasya gamyameva sukhena ca .
śālmalīnāṃ tintiḍīnāṃ hintālānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 71 ..
meaning:
शत्रोरगम्यं मित्रस्य गम्यमेव सुखेन च .
शाल्मलीनां तिन्तिडीनां हिन्तालानां तथैव च .. 71 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nimbāṇāṃ sindhuvārāṇāṃ badarīṇāmabhadrakam .
dhattūrāṇāṃ vaṭānāṃ cāpyeraṇḍānāmavāñchitam .. 72 ..
meaning:
निम्बाणां सिन्धुवाराणां बदरीणामभद्रकम् .
धत्तूराणां वटानां चाप्येरण्डानामवाञ्छितम् .. 72 ..

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmatiriktānāṃ śibire kāṣṭhamīpsitam .
vṛkṣaṃ ca vajrahastaṃ ca bhūdharo varjayedadhaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
एतेषामतिरिक्तानां शिबिरे काष्ठमीप्सितम् .
वृक्षं च वज्रहस्तं च भूधरो वर्जयेदधः .. 73 ..

sanskrit_iast:
putradāradhanaṃ hanyādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ .
kathitaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ kuru kāṣṭhaṃ vinā purīm .. 74 ..
meaning:
पुत्रदारधनं हन्यादित्याह कमलोद्भवः .
कथितं लोकशिक्षार्थं कुरु काष्ठं विना पुरीम् .. 74 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śubhakṣaṇaṃ cāpyadhunā gaccha vatsa yathāsukham .
viśvakarmā hariṃ natvā jagām pakṣiṇā saha .. 75 ..
meaning:
शुभक्षणं चाप्यधुना गच्छ वत्स यथासुखम् .
विश्वकर्मा हरिं नत्वा जगाम् पक्षिणा सह .. 75 ..

sanskrit_iast:
samudrasya samīpaṃ ca vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam .
suṣvāpa tatra naktaṃ ca kāruśca pakṣiṇā saha .. 76 ..
meaning:
समुद्रस्य समीपं च वटमूलं मनोहरम् .
सुष्वाप तत्र नक्तं च कारुश्च पक्षिणा सह .. 76 ..

sanskrit_iast:
svapne dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ dadarśa garuḍastathā .
yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ kāruṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā .. 77 ..
meaning:
स्वप्ने द्वारवतीं रम्यां ददर्श गरुडस्तथा .
यत्किंचित्कथितं कारुं कृष्णेन परमात्मना .. 77 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa nagare mune .
kāruṃ hasanti svapne ca sarve te śilpakāriṇaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
तदेव लक्षणं सर्वं ददर्श नगरे मुने .
कारुं हसन्ति स्वप्ने च सर्वे ते शिल्पकारिणः .. 78 ..

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍaṃ garuḍāścānye balavantaśca pakṣiṇaḥ .
buddho dadarśa garuḍo viśvakarmā ca lajjitaḥ .. 79 ..
meaning:
गरुडं गरुडाश्चान्ये बलवन्तश्च पक्षिणः .
बुद्धो ददर्श गरुडो विश्वकर्मा च लज्जितः .. 79 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atīva dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ śatayojanavistṛtām .
brahmādīnāṃ ca nagaraṃ vijitya ca virājitām ..
tejasā''cchāditāṃ sūryaṃ ratnānāṃ ca pariṣkṛtām .. 80 ..
meaning:
अतीव द्वारकां रम्यां शतयोजनविस्तृताम् .
ब्रह्मादीनां च नगरं विजित्य च विराजिताम् ..
तेजसा'ऽच्छादितां सूर्यं रत्नानां च परिष्कृताम् .. 80 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
etasminnantare brahmā bhavānyā ca bhavaḥ svayam .
anantaścāpi dharmaśca bhāskaraśca hutāśanaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा भवान्या च भवः स्वयम् .
अनन्तश्चापि धर्मश्च भास्करश्च हुताशनः .. 1 ..
title: atha caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā .
mahendraścapi candraśca rudrāścaikādaśaiva te .. 2 ..
meaning:
कुबेरो वरुणश्चैव पवनश्च यमस्तथा .
महेन्द्रश्चपि चन्द्रश्च रुद्राश्चैकादशैव ते .. 2 ..
text_mt: Kubera, Varuṇa, Pavana, and Yama, / Mahendra, the Moon, and the eleven Rudras,

sanskrit_iast:
anye devāśca munayo vasavaḥ sapta eva ca .
ādityāścāpi daityāśca gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
अन्ये देवाश्च मुनयो वसवः सप्त एव च .
आदित्याश्चापि दैत्याश्च गन्धर्वाः किन्नरास्तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: other gods, the sages, the seven Vasus, / the Ādityas, Daityas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras

sanskrit_iast:
āyayurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca balaṃ tathā .
āgacchantaṃ ca sahasā vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam .. 4 ..
meaning:
आययुर्द्वारकां द्रष्टुं श्रीकृष्णं च बलं तथा .
आगच्छन्तं च सहसा वटमूलं मनोहरम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: came to see Dvārakā, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and Bala, / approaching swiftly to the delightful foot of the banyan tree.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca devatāḥ sarvāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam .
ākāśācca vimānaiśca saṃprāpya vaṭamūlakam .. 5 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च देवताः सर्वास्तुष्टुवुः पुरुषोत्तमम् .
आकाशाच्च विमानैश्च संप्राप्य वटमूलकम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: And seeing [him], all the deities praised the Puruṣottama, / arriving at the foot of the banyan tree from the sky by means of aerial chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśurdvārakāṃ ramyāmatīva sumanoharam .
muktāmāṇikyahīreṇā ratnarājivirājitām .. 6 ..
meaning:
ददृशुर्द्वारकां रम्यामतीव सुमनोहरम् .
मुक्तामाणिक्यहीरेणा रत्नराजिविराजिताम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: They saw Dvārakā, delightful and exceedingly beautiful, / radiant with pearl, ruby, and diamond, a mass of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
paritaścaturasrāṃ ca śatayojanasaṃmitām .
saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gambhīrābhiśca veṣṭitām .. 7 ..
meaning:
परितश्चतुरस्रां च शतयोजनसंमिताम् .
सप्तभिः परिखाभिश्च गम्भीराभिश्च वेष्टिताम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: four-sided all around, measuring a hundred yojanas, / surrounded by seven deep moats,

sanskrit_iast:
prākārairnavabhiryuktāṃ lakṣaiḥ krīḍāsarovaraiḥ .
manoharaiḥ sapadmaiśca sahitaiśca madhuvrataiḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
प्राकारैर्नवभिर्युक्तां लक्षैः क्रीडासरोवरैः .
मनोहरैः सपद्मैश्च सहितैश्च मधुव्रतैः .. 8 ..
text_mt: fitted with nine outer walls, with hundreds of thousands of pleasure lakes / charming with lotuses and accompanied by bees,

sanskrit_iast:
śobhitāṃ sarvatobhadraiḥ puṣpodyānatrilakṣakaiḥ .
praphullapuṣpaiḥ pavanaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtām .. 9 ..
meaning:
शोभितां सर्वतोभद्रैः पुष्पोद्यानत्रिलक्षकैः .
प्रफुल्लपुष्पैः पवनैः सर्वत्र सुरभीकृताम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: adorned with three hundred thousand flower gardens auspicious on every side, / made fragrant everywhere by the breezes with blossoming flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
āmoditāṃ ca śītena mandacandanavāyunā .
tarubhirnārikelāṇāṃ śobhitāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ .. 10 ..
meaning:
आमोदितां च शीतेन मन्दचन्दनवायुना .
तरुभिर्नारिकेलाणां शोभितां शतकोटिभिः .. 10 ..
text_mt: delighted by the cool, gentle sandal-scented breeze, / graced by a thousand million coconut trees,

sanskrit_iast:
guvākānāṃ ca vṛkṣaiśca bhūṣitāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ .
caturguṇairguvākānāṃ yuktāmāmramahīruhaiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
गुवाकानां च वृक्षैश्च भूषितां तच्चतुर्गुणैः .
चतुर्गुणैर्गुवाकानां युक्तामाम्रमहीरुहैः .. 11 ..
text_mt: adorned with betel-nut trees four times that number, / furnished with mango trees four times the number of betel-nut trees,

sanskrit_iast:
parītāṃ panasānāṃ ca vṛkṣairāmrasamairmune .
suśobhitāṃ ca tālānāṃ drumairāmrasamairmune .. 12 ..
meaning:
परीतां पनसानां च वृक्षैराम्रसमैर्मुने .
सुशोभितां च तालानां द्रुमैराम्रसमैर्मुने .. 12 ..
text_mt: surrounded by jackfruit trees equal in number to the mangoes, O sage, / and beautifully adorned by palmyra trees equal to the mangoes, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthairbadarībhiśca bilvairāmrātakairvaṭaiḥ .
śālmalībhiśca jambūbhiḥ kadambaiścāpi śobhitām .. 13 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थैर्बदरीभिश्च बिल्वैराम्रातकैर्वटैः .
शाल्मलीभिश्च जम्बूभिः कदम्बैश्चापि शोभिताम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: adorned with aśvattha, jujube, bilva, āmrātaka, banyan, / śālmali, rose-apple, and kadamba trees,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśaiśca tintiḍībhiśca campakairbakulaistathā .
nāgeśvarairnāgaraṅgairjambīrairdāḍimairyutām .. 14 ..
meaning:
वंशैश्च तिन्तिडीभिश्च चम्पकैर्बकुलैस्तथा .
नागेश्वरैर्नागरङ्गैर्जम्बीरैर्दाडिमैर्युताम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: filled with bamboos, tamarinds, campakas, bakulas, / nāgeśvaras, oranges, limes, and pomegranates,

sanskrit_iast:
kharjurairarjunaiḥ piṣṭairikṣubhiḥ kāñcanairapi .
harītakībhirdhātrībhirindubhiḥ paritaḥ plutām .. 15 ..
meaning:
खर्जुरैरर्जुनैः पिष्टैरिक्षुभिः काञ्चनैरपि .
हरीतकीभिर्धात्रीभिरिन्दुभिः परितः प्लुताम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: covered all around with date palms, arjunas, piṣṭas, sugarcane, and kāñcanas, / with yellow myrobalan, emblic myrobalan, and indus,

sanskrit_iast:
śālaiḥ priyālairhintālaiḥ śirīṣaiḥ saptaparṇakaiḥ .
anyairnānādrumairiṣṭairiṣṭāṃ yuktāṃ pariplutām .. 16 ..
meaning:
शालैः प्रियालैर्हिन्तालैः शिरीषैः सप्तपर्णकैः .
अन्यैर्नानाद्रुमैरिष्टैरिष्टां युक्तां परिप्लुताम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: desired, furnished, and overflowing with śāla, priyāla, hintāla, / śirīṣa, saptaparṇa, and various other beloved trees,

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyairmandirai ramyairatyuccairapi saṃskṛtām .
ratnendrasāranirmāṇairmuktāmāṇikyabhūṣitaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
असंख्यैर्मन्दिरै रम्यैरत्युच्चैरपि संस्कृताम् .
रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्माणैर्मुक्तामाणिक्यभूषितैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: adorned with innumerable, delightful, and towering palaces / constructed from the essence of prime gems, embellished with pearls and rubies,

sanskrit_iast:
māṇikyahīrakaiścitraiḥ sadratnakalaśānvitaiḥ .
maṇibhirnirmitairiṣṭaiḥ sopānanikarairvaraiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
माणिक्यहीरकैश्चित्रैः सद्रत्नकलशान्वितैः .
मणिभिर्निर्मितैरिष्टैः सोपाननिकरैर्वरैः .. 18 ..
text_mt: with diverse rubies and diamonds, furnished with pitchers of fine gems, / with excellent flights of steps constructed from desired jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
kapāṭaiḥ kaṭhinairdavyairargalākīlakairyutām .
harinmaṇīnāṃ stambhānāṃ kadambairapi saṃyutaiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
कपाटैः कठिनैर्दव्यैरर्गलाकीलकैर्युताम् .
हरिन्मणीनां स्तम्भानां कदम्बैरपि संयुतैः .. 19 ..
text_mt: endowed with solid doors made of wood, with bolts and pins, / and with multitudes of pillars of emerald,

sanskrit_iast:
nānācitrairvicitraiśca sucitraiśca pariṣkṛtaiḥ .
darpaṇaiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca śobhitaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
नानाचित्रैर्विचित्रैश्च सुचित्रैश्च परिष्कृतैः .
दर्पणैः सूक्ष्मवस्त्रैश्च शोभितैः श्वेतचामरैः .. 20 ..
text_mt: decorated with diverse, wondrous, and well-executed paintings, / with mirrors, fine fabrics, and graced by white fly-whisks.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅgaṇaiḥ padmarāgādyarindranīlapariṣkṛtām .
vīthībhī ratnakhacitairājamārgaiḥ samanvitām .. 21 ..
meaning:
प्राङ्गणैः पद्मरागाद्यरिन्द्रनीलपरिष्कृताम् .
वीथीभी रत्नखचितैराजमार्गैः समन्विताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: adorned with courtyards of rubies and sapphires, / and endowed with streets and royal roads inlaid with jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣmadhyāhnasūryābhāṃ jvalitāṃ ratnatejasā .
gavākṣalakṣaiḥ saṃyuktāṃ vājiśālāpariṣkṛtām .. 22 ..
meaning:
ग्रीष्मध्याह्नसूर्याभां ज्वलितां रत्नतेजसा .
गवाक्षलक्षैः संयुक्तां वाजिशालापरिष्कृताम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: radiant with the splendor of gems like the midday summer sun, / fitted with hundreds of thousands of lattice-windows, and graced with stables for horses.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ te devā vismayaṃ yayuḥ .
prasannavadano devo lāṅgalī bhagavānajaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च द्वारकां रम्यां ते देवा विस्मयं ययुः .
प्रसन्नवदनो देवो लाङ्गली भगवानजः .. 23 ..
text_mt: And beholding delightful Dvārakā, those gods were filled with wonder. / The cheerful-faced god, the plough-wielding Lord, the unborn,

sanskrit_iast:
sasmāra yaduvaṃśānāṃ samūhamugrasenakam .
vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca pāṇḍavāṃśca samātṛkān .. 24 ..
meaning:
सस्मार यदुवंशानां समूहमुग्रसेनकम् .
वसुदेवं देवकीं च पाण्डवांश्च समातृकान् .. 24 ..
text_mt: remembered the assembly of the Yadu line, Ugrasena, / Vasudeva and Devakī, and the Pāṇḍavas along with their mother,

sanskrit_iast:
nandaṃ yaśodāṃ gopālānrājendramunipuṃgavām .
gandharvānkinnarāṃścaiva sahito yadupuṃgavaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
नन्दं यशोदां गोपालान्राजेन्द्रमुनिपुंगवाम् .
गन्धर्वान्किन्नरांश्चैव सहितो यदुपुंगवैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Nanda, Yaśodā, the cowherds, supreme kings, foremost sages, / Gandharvas, and Kinnaras, together with the best of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
nando yaśodā gopāśca jananyā saha pāṇḍavāḥ .
gandharvāḥ kinnarāścaiva vidyādharyaśca nārada .. 26 ..
meaning:
नन्दो यशोदा गोपाश्च जनन्या सह पाण्डवाः .
गन्धर्वाः किन्नराश्चैव विद्याधर्यश्च नारद .. 26 ..
text_mt: Nanda, Yaśodā, the cowherds, the Pāṇḍavas with their mother, / Gandharvas, Kinnaras, and Vidyādharīs, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
kinnaryaścāpi nartakyo gāyakā vādyabhāṇḍakāḥ .
bhikṣukā bhāṇḍakāścaiva bhaṭṭāścagaṇakāstathā .. 27 ..
meaning:
किन्नर्यश्चापि नर्तक्यो गायका वाद्यभाण्डकाः .
भिक्षुका भाण्डकाश्चैव भट्टाश्चगणकास्तथा .. 27 ..
text_mt: Kinnarīs, female dancers, singers, players of musical instruments, / mendicants, actors, bards, and astrologers,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādeśo dbhavā bhūpā vaidyāścānye ca mānavāḥ .
saṃnyāsinaśca yatayo'vadhūtā brahmacāriṇaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
नानादेशो द्भवा भूपा वैद्याश्चान्ये च मानवाः .
संन्यासिनश्च यतयोऽवधूता ब्रह्मचारिणः .. 28 ..
text_mt: kings born in various lands, physicians, and other men, / saṃnyāsins, ascetics, avadhūtas, and celibate students,

sanskrit_iast:
āyayurmunayaḥ sarve saśiṣyāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ .
sanakaśca sanandaśca ttīyaśca sanātanaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
आययुर्मुनयः सर्वे सशिष्याः सिद्धपुंगवाः .
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च त्तीयश्च सनातनः .. 29 ..
text_mt: all the sages arrived with their disciples, along with foremost siddhas: / Sanaka, Sananda, and third, Sanātana,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavāñjñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ .
śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha pañcavarṣā digambaraḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो भगवाञ्ज्ञानिनां च गुरोर्गुरुः .
शिष्यैस्त्रिकोटिभिः सार्ध पञ्चवर्षा दिगम्बरः .. 30 ..
text_mt: the blessed Sanatkumāra, guru of gurus among the knowers of truth, / accompanied by thirty million disciples, five years old and sky-clad;

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaistrilakṣaiḥ sahito durvāsā bhagavānajaḥ .
lakṣaśiṣyaiḥ kaśyapaśca vālmīkiśca trilakṣakaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
शिष्यैस्त्रिलक्षैः सहितो दुर्वासा भगवानजः .
लक्षशिष्यैः कश्यपश्च वाल्मीकिश्च त्रिलक्षकैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: the unborn, blessed Durvāsas accompanied by three hundred thousand disciples; / Kaśyapa with one hundred thousand disciples, and Vālmīki with three hundred thousand;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaśiṣyairgau tamaśca kauṭibhiśca bṛhaspatiḥ .
śukrastrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha bharadvājaśca lakṣakaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
लक्षशिष्यैर्गौ तमश्च कौटिभिश्च बृहस्पतिः .
शुक्रस्त्रिकोटिभिः सार्ध भरद्वाजश्च लक्षकैः .. 32 ..
