meaning:
गोपीभिश्च तथा गोपैः परिपूर्णं चकार सः .
तथा वृन्दावनं चैव सुरम्यं च मनोहरम् .. 4 ..

sanskrit_iast:
gokulasthāśca gopāśca samāśvāsaṃ cakāra saḥ .
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ nītaṃ ca durlabham .. 5 ..
meaning:
गोकुलस्थाश्च गोपाश्च समाश्वासं चकार सः .
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं हितं नीतं च दुर्लभम् .. 5 ..

sanskrit_iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
he gopagaṇa he bandho sukhaṃ tiṣṭha sthiro bhava .
ramaṇaṃ priyayā sārdhaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .. 6 ..
meaning:
श्री भगवानुवाच
हे गोपगण हे बन्धो सुखं तिष्ठ स्थिरो भव .
रमणं प्रियया सार्धं सुरम्यं रासमण्डलम् .. 6 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatprabhṛti kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane .
adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca satataṃ yāvaccandradivākarau .. 7 ..
meaning:
तावत्प्रभृति कृष्णस्य पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने .
अधिष्ठानं च सततं यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ .. 7 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tathā jagāma bhāṇḍīraṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi .
svayaṃ śeṣaśca dharmaśca bhavānyā ca bhavaḥsvayam .. 8 ..
meaning:
तथा जगाम भाण्डीरं विधाता जगतामपि .
स्वयं शेषश्च धर्मश्च भवान्या च भवःस्वयम् .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaścāpi mahendraśca candraścāpi hunāśanaḥ .
kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
सूर्यश्चापि महेन्द्रश्च चन्द्रश्चापि हुनाशनः .
कुबेरो वरुणश्चैव पवनश्च यमस्तथा .. 9 ..

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaścāpi devāśca vasavo'ṣṭau tathaiva ca .
sarve grahāśca rudrāśca munayo manavastathā .. 10 ..
meaning:
ईशानश्चापि देवाश्च वसवोऽष्टौ तथैव च .
सर्वे ग्रहाश्च रुद्राश्च मुनयो मनवस्तथा .. 10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvaritāścā''yayuḥ sarve yatrā''ste bhagavānprabhuḥ .
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūbhau tamuvāca vidhiḥ svayam .. 11 ..
meaning:
त्वरिताश्चा'ऽययुः सर्वे यत्रा'ऽस्ते भगवान्प्रभुः .
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूभौ तमुवाच विधिः स्वयम् .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavāca
paribūrṇatam brahmasvarūpa nityavigraha .
jyotiḥsvarūpa parama namo'stu prakṛteḥ para .. 12 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मवाच
परिबूर्णतम् ब्रह्मस्वरूप नित्यविग्रह .
ज्योतिःस्वरूप परम नमोऽस्तु प्रकृतेः पर .. 12 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sunirlipta nirākāra sākāra dhyānahetunā .
svecchāmaya paraṃ dhāma paramātmannamo'stu te .. 13 ..
meaning:
सुनिर्लिप्त निराकार साकार ध्यानहेतुना .
स्वेच्छामय परं धाम परमात्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते .. 13 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāryasvarūpeśa kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇa .
brahmeśaśeṣadeveśa sarveśa te nao .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वकार्यस्वरूपेश कारणानां च कारण .
ब्रह्मेशशेषदेवेश सर्वेश ते नओ .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatīśa padmeśa pārvatīśa parātpara .
he sāvitrīśa rādheśa rāseśvara nao .. 15 ..
meaning:
सरस्वतीश पद्मेश पार्वतीश परात्पर .
हे सावित्रीश राधेश रासेश्वर नओ .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmādibhūtarstvaṃ sarvaḥ sarveśvarastathā .
sarvapātā ca saṃhartā sṛṣṭirūpa nao .. 16 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामादिभूतर्स्त्वं सर्वः सर्वेश्वरस्तथा .
सर्वपाता च संहर्ता सृष्टिरूप नओ .. 16 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādapadmarajasā dhanyā pūtā vasuṃdharā .
śūnyarūpā tvayi gate he nātha paramaṃ padam .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्वत्पादपद्मरजसा धन्या पूता वसुंधरा .
शून्यरूपा त्वयि गते हे नाथ परमं पदम् .. 17 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yatpañcaviṃśatyadhikaṃ varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ gatam .
tyaktvemāṃ svapadaṃ yāsi rudatīṃ virahāturām .. 18 ..
meaning:
यत्पञ्चविंशत्यधिकं वर्षाणां शतकं गतम् .
त्यक्त्वेमां स्वपदं यासि रुदतीं विरहातुराम् .. 18 ..

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
brahmaṇā prārthitastvaṃ ca samāgatya vasuṃdharām .
bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ kṛtvā prayāsi svapadaṃ vibho .. 19 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
ब्रह्मणा प्रार्थितस्त्वं च समागत्य वसुंधराम् .
भूभारहरणं कृत्वा प्रयासि स्वपदं विभो .. 19 ..

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye pṛthivī dhanyā sadyaḥ pūtā padāṅkitā .
vayaṃ ca munayo dhanyāḥ sākṣāddṛṣṭvā padāmbujam .. 20 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये पृथिवी धन्या सद्यः पूता पदाङ्किता .
वयं च मुनयो धन्याः साक्षाद्दृष्ट्वा पदाम्बुजम् .. 20 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyo munīnāmūrdhvaretasām .
asmākamapi yaśceśaḥ so'dhunā cākṣuṣo bhuvi .. 21 ..
meaning:
ध्यानासाध्यो दुराराध्यो मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् .
अस्माकमपि यश्चेशः सोऽधुना चाक्षुषो भुवि .. 21 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvani yasya lomasu .
devastasya mahāviṣṇurvāsudevo mahītale .. 22 .
meaning:
वासुः सर्वनिवासश्च विश्वनि यस्य लोमसु .
देवस्तस्य महाविष्णुर्वासुदेवो महीतले .. 22 .

sanskrit_iast:
suciraṃ tapasā labdhaṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ sudurlabham .
yatpādapadmamatulaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvajīvinām .. 23 ..
meaning:
सुचिरं तपसा लब्धं सिद्धेन्द्राणां सुदुर्लभम् .
यत्पादपद्ममतुलं चाक्षुषं सर्वजीविनाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Attained after long asceticism, most difficult to be obtained even by chiefs of the perfected ones, / his matchless lotus foot has become visible to the eyes of all living beings. .. 23 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ananta uvāca
tvamananto hi bhagavannāhameva kalāṃśakaḥ .
viśvaikasthe kṣudrakūrme maśako'haṃ gaje yathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
अनन्त उवाच
त्वमनन्तो हि भगवन्नाहमेव कलांशकः .
विश्वैकस्थे क्षुद्रकूर्मे मशकोऽहं गजे यथा .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Ananta said:
“You alone are the infinite Lord; I am only a minute part of a portion. / Compared to you in whom the universe resides, on the tiny tortoise I am like a gnat upon an elephant. .. 24 ..

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyaśeṣāḥ kūrmāśca brahmaviṣaṇuśivātmakāḥ .
asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni teṣāmīśaḥ svayaṃ bhavān .. 25 ..
meaning:
असंख्यशेषाः कूर्माश्च ब्रह्मविषणुशिवात्मकाः .
असंख्यानि च विश्वानि तेषामीशः स्वयं भवान् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Countless are the Śeṣas and tortoises made of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / and countless are the universes; you yourself are their Lord. .. 25 ..

sanskrit_iast:
asmākamīdṛśaṃ nātha sudinaṃ kva bhaviṣyati .
svapnādṛṣṭaścayaśceśaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ sarvajīvinām .. 26 ..
meaning:
अस्माकमीदृशं नाथ सुदिनं क्व भविष्यति .
स्वप्नादृष्टश्चयश्चेशः स दृष्टः सर्वजीविनाम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: When will there be such an auspicious day for us, O Lord? / He who was not seen even in a dream—that Lord has been seen by all living beings. .. 26 ..

sanskrit_iast:
nātha prayāsi golokaṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā vasuṃdharām .
tāmanāthāṃ rudantīṃ ca nimagnāṃ śokasāgare .. 27 ..
meaning:
नाथ प्रयासि गोलोकं पूतां कृत्वा वसुंधराम् .
तामनाथां रुदन्तीं च निमग्नां शोकसागरे .. 27 ..
text_mt: O Lord, having purified the earth, you are now departing for Goloka, / leaving her helpless, weeping, and submerged in an ocean of grief.” .. 27 ..

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
vedāḥstotuṃ na śaktā yaṃ brahmeśānādayastathā .
tameva stavanaṃ kiṃ vā vayaṃ kurmo namo'stu te .. 28 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
वेदाःस्तोतुं न शक्ता यं ब्रह्मेशानादयस्तथा .
तमेव स्तवनं किं वा वयं कुर्मो नमोऽस्तु ते .. 28 ..
text_mt:
The gods said:
“He whom the Vedas, as well as Brahmā, Śiva, and the others, are unable to praise— / how then can we praise him? Obeisance to you!” .. 28 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā devāste prayayurdvārakāṃ purīm .
tatrasthaṃ bhagavantaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ śīghraṃ mudā'nvitāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवास्ते प्रययुर्द्वारकां पुरीम् .
तत्रस्थं भगवन्तं च द्रष्टुं शीघ्रं मुदाऽन्विताः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus, those gods, filled with joy, / swiftly departed for the city of Dvārakā to see the Lord residing there. .. 29 ..

sanskrit_iast:
atha teṣāṃ ca gopālā yayurgolokamuttamam .
pṛthivī kampitā bhītā calantaḥ saptasāgarāḥ .. 30 ..
meaning:
अथ तेषां च गोपाला ययुर्गोलोकमुत्तमम् .
पृथिवी कम्पिता भीता चलन्तः सप्तसागराः .. 30 ..
text_mt: Then those cowherds departed for the supreme Goloka. / The earth trembled in fear, and the seven oceans became turbulent. .. 30 ..

sanskrit_iast:
hataśriyaṃ dvārakāṃ ca tyaktvā ca brahmaśāpataḥ .
mūrtiṃ kadambamūlasthāṃ viveśa rādhikeśvaraḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
हतश्रियं द्वारकां च त्यक्त्वा च ब्रह्मशापतः .
मूर्तिं कदम्बमूलस्थां विवेश राधिकेश्वरः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having abandoned Dvārakā, which had lost its fortune due to the brāhmaṇa’s curse, / the Lord of Rādhikā entered a form seated at the foot of a kadamba tree. .. 31 ..

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve cairakāyuddhe nipeturyādavāstathā .
citāmāruhya devyaśca prayayuḥ svāmibhiḥ saha .. 32 ..
meaning:
ते सर्वे चैरकायुद्धे निपेतुर्यादवास्तथा .
चितामारुह्य देव्यश्च प्रययुः स्वामिभिः सह .. 32 ..
text_mt: All those Yādavas fell in the battle fought with erakā reeds; / and mounting the funeral pyre, the noble women went together with their husbands. .. 32 ..

sanskrit_iast:
arjunaḥ svapuraṃ gatvā samuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram .
sa rājā bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau svargaṃ ca bhāryayā .. 33 ..
meaning:
अर्जुनः स्वपुरं गत्वा समुवाच युधिष्ठिरम् .
स राजा भ्रातृभिः सार्धं ययौ स्वर्गं च भार्यया .. 33 ..
text_mt: Arjuna, having gone to his own city, reported everything to Yudhiṣṭhira; / and that king, together with his brothers and his wife, departed for heaven. .. 33 ..

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kadambamūlasthaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram .
devā brahmādayaste ca praṇemurbhaktipūrvakam .. 34 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कदम्बमूलस्थं तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् .
देवा ब्रह्मादयस्ते च प्रणेमुर्भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Seeing the Supreme Lord standing at the foot of the kadamba tree, / the gods, headed by Brahmā, bowed down with devotion. .. 34 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum .
śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ bhūṣitaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तुष्टुवुः परमात्मानं देवं नारायणं प्रभुम् .
श्यामं किशोरवयसं भूषितं रत्नभूषणैः .. 35 ..
text_mt: They praised the Paramātman, the divine Lord Nārāyaṇa, / dark-complexioned, in the prime of youth, adorned with jewel-ornaments, .. 35 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā .
atīva sundaraṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam .. 36 ..
meaning:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानं शोभितं वनमालया .
अतीव सुन्दरं शान्तं लक्ष्मीकान्तं मनोहरम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: wearing garments purified by fire, graced with a garland of forest flowers, / exceedingly handsome, tranquil, the beloved of Lakṣmī, captivating the mind. .. 36 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhāstrasaṃyutaṃ pādapadmaṃ padmādivanditam .
dṛṣṭvā brahmādidevāṃstānabhayaṃ sasmitaṃ dadau .. 37 ..
meaning:
व्याधास्त्रसंयुतं पादपद्मं पद्मादिवन्दितम् .
दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मादिदेवांस्तानभयं सस्मितं ददौ .. 37 ..
text_mt: His lotus foot, struck by the hunter's weapon and praised by Lakṣmī and the rest, / was seen by Brahmā and the other gods; he smiled and granted them freedom from fear. .. 37 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ tāṃ samāśvāsya rudatīṃ premavihvalām .
vyādhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa paraṃ svapadamuttamam .. 38 ..
meaning:
पृथिवीं तां समाश्वास्य रुदतीं प्रेमविह्वलाम् .
व्याधं प्रस्थापयामास परं स्वपदमुत्तमम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Consoling the earth, who was weeping and distraught with love, / he dispatched the hunter to his own supreme, highest abode. .. 38 ..

sanskrit_iast:
balasya tejaḥ śeṣe ca viveśa paramādbhutam .
pradyumnasya ca kāme vai vā'niruddhasya brahmaṇi .. 39 ..
meaning:
बलस्य तेजः शेषे च विवेश परमाद्भुतम् .
प्रद्युम्नस्य च कामे वै वाऽनिरुद्धस्य ब्रह्मणि .. 39 ..
text_mt: The wondrous radiance of Balarāma entered Śeṣa; / that of Pradyumna entered Kāma, and that of Aniruddha entered Brahmā. .. 39 ..

sanskrit_iast:
ayonisaṃbhavā devī mahālakṣmīśca rukmiṇī .
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau sākṣātsvaśarīreṇa nārada .. 40 ..
meaning:
अयोनिसंभवा देवी महालक्ष्मीश्च रुक्मिणी .
वैकुण्ठं प्रययौ साक्षात्स्वशरीरेण नारद .. 40 ..
text_mt: The goddess Rukmiṇī, born without a womb, the great Lakṣmī, / departed directly to Vaikuṇṭha in her own body, O Nārada. .. 40 ..

sanskrit_iast:
satyabhāmā pṛthivyāṃ ca viveśa kamalālayā .
svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī pārvatyāṃ viśvamātari .. 41 ..
meaning:
सत्यभामा पृथिव्यां च विवेश कमलालया .
स्वयं जाम्बवती देवी पार्वत्यां विश्वमातरि .. 41 ..
text_mt: Satyabhāmā entered into the earth, and Lakṣmī into her abode; / the divine Jāmbavatī herself entered into Pārvatī, the mother of the universe. .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:
yā yā devyaśca yāsāṃ cāpyaṃśarupāśca bhūtale .
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ praviviśustā eva ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 42 ..
meaning:
या या देव्यश्च यासां चाप्यंशरुपाश्च भूतले .
तस्यां तस्यां प्रविविशुस्ता एव च पृथक्पृथक् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Whichever goddesses had incarnated as portions upon the surface of the earth / entered into those very [original] goddesses, one by one. .. 42 ..

sanskrit_iast:
sāmbasya tejaḥ skande ca viveśa paramādbhutam .
kaśyape vasudevaścāpyadivyāṃ devakī tathā .. 43 ..
meaning:
साम्बस्य तेजः स्कन्दे च विवेश परमाद्भुतम् .
कश्यपे वसुदेवश्चाप्यदिव्यां देवकी तथा .. 43 ..
text_mt: The wondrous radiance of Sāmba entered into Skanda; / Vasudeva entered into Kaśyapa, and Devakī into Aditi. .. 43 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇīmandiraṃ tyakatvā samastāṃ dvārakāṃ purīm .
sa jagrāha samudraśca praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
रुक्मिणीमन्दिरं त्यकत्वा समस्तां द्वारकां पुरीम् .
स जग्राह समुद्रश्च प्रफुल्लवदनेक्षणः .. 44 ..
text_mt: Leaving aside the temple of Rukmiṇī, the ocean, with smiling face and eyes, / submerged the entire city of Dvārakā. 44.

sanskrit_iast:
lapaṇodaḥ samāgatya tuṣṭāva puruṣottamam .
ruroda tadviyogena sāśrunetraśca vihvalaḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
लपणोदः समागत्य तुष्टाव पुरुषोत्तमम् .
रुरोद तद्वियोगेन साश्रुनेत्रश्च विह्वलः .. 45 ..
text_mt: Lavaṇoda approached and praised Puruṣottama; / overcome, with tears in his eyes, he wept at his separation. 45.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgā sarasvatī padmāvatī ca yamunā tathā .
godāvarī svarṇarekhā kāverī narmadā mune .. 46 ..
meaning:
गङ्गा सरस्वती पद्मावती च यमुना तथा .
गोदावरी स्वर्णरेखा कावेरी नर्मदा मुने .. 46 ..
text_mt: Gaṅgā, Sarasvatī, Padmāvatī, and Yamunā, / Godāvarī, Svarṇarekhā, Kāverī, and Narmadā, O sage, 46.

sanskrit_iast:
śarāvatī bāhṛdā ca kṛtamālā ca puṇyadā .
samāyayuśca tāḥ sarvāḥ praṇemuḥ parameśvaram .. 47 ..
meaning:
शरावती बाहृदा च कृतमाला च पुण्यदा .
समाययुश्च ताः सर्वाः प्रणेमुः परमेश्वरम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Śarāvatī, Bāhudā, and the merit-granting Kṛtamālā— / all of them arrived and bowed down to the Supreme Lord. 47.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca jāhnavī devī rudatī parameśvaram .
sāśrunetrā'tidīnā sā virahajvarakātarā .. 48 ..
meaning:
उवाच जाह्नवी देवी रुदती परमेश्वरम् .
साश्रुनेत्राऽतिदीना सा विरहज्वरकातरा .. 48 ..
text_mt: Weeping, the goddess Jāhnavī spoke to the Supreme Lord; / her eyes full of tears, deeply distressed, she was tormented by the fever of separation. 48.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgīrathayuvāca
he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭha yāsi golokamuttamam .
asmākaṃ kā gatiścātra bhaviṣyati kalau yuge .. 49 ..
meaning:
भागीरथयुवाच
हे नाथ रमणश्रेष्ठ यासि गोलोकमुत्तमम् .
अस्माकं का गतिश्चात्र भविष्यति कलौ युगे .. 49 ..
text_mt: Bhāgīrathī said: / 'O Lord, O best of lovers, you are departing for the supreme Goloka. / What will become of us here in the Kali age?' 49.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kaleḥ pañcasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi tiṣṭha bhūtale .
pāpāni pāpino yāni tubhyaṃ dāsyanti snānata .. 50 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
कलेः पञ्चसहस्राणि वर्षाणि तिष्ठ भूतले .
पापानि पापिनो यानि तुभ्यं दास्यन्ति स्नानत .. 50 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Remain on earth for five thousand years of the Kali age. / The sins which sinners will transmit to you through bathing 50.

sanskrit_iast:
manmantropāsakasparśādbhasmībhūtāni tatkṣaṇāt .
bhaviṣyanti darśanācca snānādeva hi jāhnavi .. 51 ..
meaning:
मन्मन्त्रोपासकस्पर्शाद्भस्मीभूतानि तत्क्षणात् .
भविष्यन्ति दर्शनाच्च स्नानादेव हि जाह्नवि .. 51 ..
text_mt: shall instantly be reduced to ashes, O Jāhnavī, by the touch, / the sight, and the bathing of those who worship my mantra. 51.

sanskrit_iast:
harernāmāni yatraiva purāṇāni bhavanti hi .
tatra gatvā sāvadhānamābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca śroṣyasi .. 52 ..
meaning:
हरेर्नामानि यत्रैव पुराणानि भवन्ति हि .
तत्र गत्वा सावधानमाभिः सार्धं च श्रोष्यसि .. 52 ..
text_mt: Wherever the names of Hari and the Purāṇas are recited, / going there with these [rivers], you shall listen attentively. 52.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaśravaṇāccaiva harernāmānukīrtanāt .
bhasmībhūtāni pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca .. 53 ..
meaning:
पुराणश्रवणाच्चैव हरेर्नामानुकीर्तनात् .
भस्मीभूतानि पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च .. 53 ..
text_mt: By hearing the Purāṇas and chanting the names of Hari, / sins such as the slaying of a brahmin are burned to ashes. 53.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmībhūtāni tānyeva vaiṣṇavāliṅganena ca .
tṛṇāni śuṣkakāṣṭhāni dahanti pāvakā yathā .. 54 ..
meaning:
भस्मीभूतानि तान्येव वैष्णवालिङ्गनेन च .
तृणानि शुष्ककाष्ठानि दहन्ति पावका यथा .. 54 ..
text_mt: They are likewise reduced to ashes by the embrace of a Vaiṣṇava, / just as fires burn grass and dry wood. 54.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'pi vaiṣṇavā loke pāpāni pāpināmapi .
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyapi ca jāhnavi .. 55 ..
meaning:
तथाऽपि वैष्णवा लोके पापानि पापिनामपि .
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यपि च जाह्नवि .. 55 ..
text_mt: Even so do Vaiṣṇavas in this world [burn] the sins of sinners. / Whatever sacred and holy pilgrimage-places exist on earth, O Jāhnavī, 55.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktānāṃ śarīreṣu santi pūteṣu saṃtatam .
madbhaktapādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā .. 56 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्तानां शरीरेषु सन्ति पूतेषु संततम् .
मद्भक्तपादरजसा सद्यः पूता वसुंधरा .. 56 ..
text_mt: dwell continually in the pure bodies of my devotees. / The earth is instantly purified by the dust from the feet of my devotees; 56.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ pūtāni tīrthāni sadyāḥ pūtaṃ jagattathā .
manmantropāsakā viprā ye maducchiṣṭabhojinaḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
सद्यः पूतानि तीर्थानि सद्याः पूतं जगत्तथा .
मन्मन्त्रोपासका विप्रा ये मदुच्छिष्टभोजिनः .. 57 ..
text_mt: pilgrimage-places are instantly purified, and so too is the world instantly purified. / Those brahmins who worship my mantra, who eat the remnants of my food, 57.

sanskrit_iast:
māmeva nityaṃ dhyāyante te matprāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ .
tadupasparśamātreṇa pūto vāyuśca pāvakaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
मामेव नित्यं ध्यायन्ते ते मत्प्राणाधिकाः प्रियाः .
तदुपस्पर्शमात्रेण पूतो वायुश्च पावकः .. 58 ..
text_mt: and meditate constantly on me alone are dearer to me than life itself. / By their mere touch, wind and fire are purified. 58.

sanskrit_iast:
kalerdaśasahasrāṇi madbhaktāḥ santi bhūtale .
ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti madbhakteṣu gateṣu ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
कलेर्दशसहस्राणि मद्भक्ताः सन्ति भूतले .
एकवर्णा भविष्यन्ति मद्भक्तेषु गतेषु च .. 59 ..
text_mt: My devotees shall remain on earth for ten thousand years of Kali; / and when my devotees depart, humanity will become of a single caste. 59.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktaśūnyā pṛthivī kaligrastā bhaviṣyati .
etasminnantare tatra kṛṣṇadehādvinirgataḥ .. 60 ..
meaning:
मद्भक्तशून्या पृथिवी कलिग्रस्ता भविष्यति .
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र कृष्णदेहाद्विनिर्गतः .. 60 ..
text_mt: Devoid of my devotees, the earth will be seized by Kali.' / In the meantime, there emerged from Kṛṣṇa's body 60.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaśca puruṣaḥ śatacandrasamaprabhaḥ .
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजश्च पुरुषः शतचन्द्रसमप्रभः .
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधरः श्रीवत्सलाञ्छनः .. 61 ..
text_mt: a four-armed person radiant as a hundred moons, / holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, marked with the Śrīvatsa. 61.

sanskrit_iast:
sundaraṃ rathamāruhya śrīrodaṃ sa jagāma ha .
sindhukanyā ca prayayau svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī .. 62 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरं रथमारुह्य श्रीरोदं स जगाम ह .
सिन्धुकन्या च प्रययौ स्वयं मूर्तिमती सती .. 62 ..
text_mt: Ascending a beautiful chariot, he went to the Milk Ocean; / and the daughter of the ocean, the virtuous one embodied, herself departed. 62.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇamanasā jātā martyalakṣmīrmanoharā .
śvetadvīpaṃ gate viṣṇau jagatpālanakartari .. 63 ..
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णमनसा जाता मर्त्यलक्ष्मीर्मनोहरा .
श्वेतद्वीपं गते विष्णौ जगत्पालनकर्तरि .. 63 ..
text_mt: Born from the mind of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the captivating Lakṣmī of the mortal world [departed]. / When Viṣṇu, the protector of the universe, had gone to Śvetadvīpa, 63.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ .
dakṣiṇāṃśaśca dvibhujo gopabārakarūpakaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
शुद्धसत्त्वस्वरूपे च द्विधारूपो बभूव सः .
दक्षिणांशश्च द्विभुजो गोपबारकरूपकः .. 64 ..
text_mt: he whose nature is pure sattva assumed a twofold form: / his right half was two-armed, in the form of a cowherd boy, 64.

sanskrit_iast:
napīnajaladaśyāmaḥ śobhitaḥ pītavāsasā .
śrīvaṃśavadanaḥ śrīmānsasmitaḥ padmalocanaḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
नपीनजलदश्यामः शोभितः पीतवाससा .
श्रीवंशवदनः श्रीमान्सस्मितः पद्मलोचनः .. 65 ..
text_mt: dark as a fresh raincloud, adorned with yellow garments, / holding a beautiful flute to his mouth, glorious, smiling, with lotus eyes, 65.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ śatakoṭismaraprabhām .
dadhānaḥ paramānandaḥ paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
शतकोटीन्दुसौन्दर्यं शतकोटिस्मरप्रभाम् .
दधानः परमानन्दः परिबूर्णतमः प्रभुः .. 66 ..
text_mt: bearing the beauty of a hundred million moons and the radiance of a hundred million Kāmadevas, / supreme bliss, the most complete Lord, 66.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmasvarūpo nirguṇaḥ svayam .
paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
परं धाम परं ब्रह्मस्वरूपो निर्गुणः स्वयम् .
परमात्मा च सर्वेषां भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः .. 67 ..
text_mt: the supreme abode, identical with the supreme Brahman, himself beyond the gunas, / the Paramātman of all, embodied out of grace to devotees, 67.

sanskrit_iast:
nityadehaśca bhagavānīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ .
yogino yaṃ vadantyevaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam .. 68 ..
meaning:
नित्यदेहश्च भगवानीश्वरः प्रकृतेः परः .
योगिनो यं वदन्त्येवं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: the Blessed Lord of eternal form, the master beyond Prakṛti, / whom yogins describe thus as eternal light, 68.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiramyantare nityarūpaṃ bhaktā vidanti yam .
vedā vadanti satyaṃ yaṃ nityamādyaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
ज्योतिरम्यन्तरे नित्यरूपं भक्ता विदन्ति यम् .
वेदा वदन्ति सत्यं यं नित्यमाद्यं विचक्षणाः .. 69 ..
text_mt: and whose eternal form within that light the devotees know; / whom the wise Vedas declare to be the eternal, primeval truth; 69.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ vadanti surāḥ sarve paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ prabhūm .
siddhendrā munayaḥ sarve sarvarūpaṃ vadanti yam .. 70 ..
meaning:
यं वदन्ति सुराः सर्वे परं स्वेच्छामयं प्रभूम् .
सिद्धेन्द्रा मुनयः सर्वे सर्वरूपं वदन्ति यम् .. 70 ..
text_mt: whom all the gods declare to be the supreme Lord acting by his own will; / whom the best of Siddhas and all the sages describe as possessing all forms; 70.

sanskrit_iast:
yamanirvacanīyaṃ ca yogīndraḥ śaṃkaro vadet .
svayaṃ vidhātā pravadetkāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam .. 71 ..
meaning:
यमनिर्वचनीयं च योगीन्द्रः शंकरो वदेत् .
स्वयं विधाता प्रवदेत्कारणानां च कारणम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: whom Śaṅkara, the lord of yogins, declares to be ineffable; / whom the Creator himself declares to be the cause of all causes; 71.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣo vadedanantaṃ yaṃ navadhārūpamīśvaram .
tarkāṇāmeva ṣaṇṇāṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ rūpamīpsitam .. 72 ..
meaning:
शेषो वदेदनन्तं यं नवधारूपमीश्वरम् .
तर्काणामेव षण्णां च षड्विधं रूपमीप्सितम् .. 72 ..
text_mt: whom Śeṣa declares to be infinite, the Lord of ninefold form; / and the six philosophical systems describe his desired form in six ways: 72.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavānāmekarūpaṃ vedānāmekameva ca .
purāṇānāmekarūpaṃ tasmānnavavidhaṃ smṛtam .. 73 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवानामेकरूपं वेदानामेकमेव च .
पुराणानामेकरूपं तस्मान्नवविधं स्मृतम् .. 73 ..
text_mt: one form according to the Vaiṣṇavas, one according to the Vedas, / and one according to the Purāṇas—hence it is remembered as ninefold. 73.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyo'nirvacanīyaṃ ca yaṃ mataṃ śaṃkaro vadet .
nityaṃ vaiśeṣikāścā''dyaṃ taṃ vadanti vicakṣaṇāḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
न्यायोऽनिर्वचनीयं च यं मतं शंकरो वदेत् .
नित्यं वैशेषिकाश्चा'ऽद्यं तं वदन्ति विचक्षणाः .. 74 ..
text_mt: Nyāya calls him ineffable, the view that Śaṅkara expresses; / the learned Vaiśeṣikas describe him as eternal and primeval; 74.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhya vadanti taṃ devaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam .
mīmāṃsā sarvarūpaṃ ca vedāntaḥ sarvakāraṇam .. 75 ..
meaning:
सांख्य वदन्ति तं देवं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् .
मीमांसा सर्वरूपं च वेदान्तः सर्वकारणम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: the Sāṃkhyas describe that god as eternal light; / Mīmāṃsā as all forms, and Vedānta as the cause of all; 75.

sanskrit_iast:
pātañjalo'pyanantaṃ ca vedāḥ satyasvarūpakam .
svecchāmayaṃ purāṇaṃ ca bhaktāśca nityavigraham .. 76 ..
meaning:
पातञ्जलोऽप्यनन्तं च वेदाः सत्यस्वरूपकम् .
स्वेच्छामयं पुराणं च भक्ताश्च नित्यविग्रहम् .. 76 ..
text_mt: Pātañjala describes him as infinite; the Vedas as the essence of truth; / the Purāṇas as moving by his own will; and devotees as having an eternal form. 76.

sanskrit_iast:
so'yaṃ golokanāthaśca rādheśo nandanandanaḥ .
gokule gopaveṣaśca puṇye vṛndāvane vane .. 77 ..
meaning:
सोऽयं गोलोकनाथश्च राधेशो नन्दनन्दनः .
गोकुले गोपवेषश्च पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने .. 77 ..
text_mt: This is that Lord of Goloka, the master of Rādhā, the son of Nanda, / in the garb of a cowherd in Gokula and in the sacred forest of Vṛndāvana; 77.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmīpatiḥ svayam .
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānyannāma muktikāraṇam .. 78 ..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजश्च वैकुण्ठे महालक्ष्मीपतिः स्वयम् .
नारायणश्च भगवान्यन्नाम मुक्तिकारणम् .. 78 ..
text_mt: and in Vaikuṇṭha he is four-armed, the lord of Mahālakṣmī herself, / the Blessed Lord Nārāyaṇa, whose name is the cause of liberation. 78.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛnnārāyaṇetyuktvā pumānkalpaśatatrayam .
gaṅgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati nārada .. 79 ..
meaning:
सकृन्नारायणेत्युक्त्वा पुमान्कल्पशतत्रयम् .
गङ्गादिसर्वतीर्थेषु स्नातो भवति नारद .. 79 ..
text_mt: Having uttered 'Nārāyaṇa' but once, a person has bathed / in all the sacred waters such as Gaṅgā for three hundred kalpas, O Nārada. 79.

sanskrit_iast:
sunandanandakumudaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parivāritaḥ .
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ .. 80 ..
meaning:
सुनन्दनन्दकुमुदैः पार्षदैः परिवारितः .
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधरः श्रीवत्सलाञ्छनः .. 80 ..
text_mt: Surrounded by his attendants Sunanda, Nanda, and Kumuda, / holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, marked with the Śrīvatsa, 80.

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa bhūṣito vanamālayā .
devaiḥ stutaśca yānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ svapadaṃ yayau .. 81 ..
meaning:
कौस्तुभेन मणीन्द्रेण भूषितो वनमालया .
देवैः स्तुतश्च यानेन वैकुण्ठं स्वपदं ययौ .. 81 ..
text_mt: adorned with the best of jewels, the Kaustubha, and a garland of forest flowers, / praised by the gods, he went by vehicle to his own abode, Vaikuṇṭha. 81.

sanskrit_iast:
gate vaikuṇṭhanāthe ca rādheśaśca svayaṃ prabhuḥ .
cakāra vaṃśīśabdaṃ ca trailokyamohanaṃ param .. 82 ..
meaning:
गते वैकुण्ठनाथे च राधेशश्च स्वयं प्रभुः .
चकार वंशीशब्दं च त्रैलोक्यमोहनं परम् .. 82 ..
text_mt: When the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha had departed, the master of Rādhā, the Lord himself, / sounded his flute, supremely captivating the three worlds. 82.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchāṃprāpurdevagaṇā munayaścāpi nārada .
acetanā babhūvuśca māyayā pārvatīṃ vinā .. 83 ..
meaning:
मूर्च्छांप्रापुर्देवगणा मुनयश्चापि नारद .
अचेतना बभूवुश्च मायया पार्वतीं विना .. 83 ..
text_mt: The hosts of gods and the sages fell into a faint, O Nārada; / by his illusory power, they all became unconscious, except for Pārvatī. 83.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca pārvatī devī bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .
viṣṇumāyā bhagavatī sarvarūpā sanātanī .. 84 ..
meaning:
उवाच पार्वती देवी भगवन्तं सनातनम् .
विष्णुमाया भगवती सर्वरूपा सनातनी .. 84 ..
text_mt: The goddess Pārvatī spoke to the eternal Lord— / she, the divine Viṣṇumāyā, of all forms, eternal, 84.

sanskrit_iast:
parabrahmasvarūpā yā paramātmasvarūpiṇī .
saguṇā nirguṇā sā ca parā svecchāmayī satī .. 85 ..
meaning:
परब्रह्मस्वरूपा या परमात्मस्वरूपिणी .
सगुणा निर्गुणा सा च परा स्वेच्छामयी सती .. 85 ..
text_mt: whose essence is the supreme Brahman, whose nature is the Paramātman, / with gunas and beyond gunas, supreme, acting by her own will, the virtuous one. 85.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca
ekā'haṃ rādhikārūpā goloke rāsamaṇḍale .
rāsaśūnyaṃ ca golokaṃ paripūrṇa kuru prabho .. 86 ..
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच
एकाऽहं राधिकारूपा गोलोके रासमण्डले .
रासशून्यं च गोलोकं परिपूर्ण कुरु प्रभो .. 86 ..
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / 'I alone am in the form of Rādhikā in Goloka in the circle of the rāsa-dance. / Make Goloka, now devoid of the rāsa-dance, full once more, O Lord! 86.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha tvaṃ rathamāruhya muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitam .
paribūrṇatamā'haṃ ca tava vaṅaḥ sthalasthitā .. 87 ..
meaning:
गच्छ त्वं रथमारुह्य मुक्तामाणिक्यभूषितम् .
परिबूर्णतमाऽहं च तव वङः स्थलस्थिता .. 87 ..
text_mt: Go, having mounted the chariot adorned with pearls and rubies; / and I, the most complete, abide upon your chest. 87.

sanskrit_iast:
tavā''jñayā mahālakṣmīrahaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminī .
sarasvatī ca tatraiva vāme pārśve harerapi .. 88 ..
meaning:
तवा'ऽज्ञया महालक्ष्मीरहं वैकुण्ठगामिनी .
सरस्वती च तत्रैव वामे पार्श्वे हरेरपि .. 88 ..
text_mt: By your command, I go to Vaikuṇṭha as Mahālakṣmī, / and Sarasvatī also dwells there on the left side of Hari.' 88.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāhaṃ manasā jātā sindhukanyā tavā''jñayā .
sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ kalayā vidhisaṃnidhau .. 89 ..
meaning:
तवाहं मनसा जाता सिन्धुकन्या तवा'ऽज्ञया .
सावित्री वेदमाताऽहं कलया विधिसंनिधौ .. 89 ..
text_mt: I was born from your mind, and by your command became the daughter of the ocean. / By a part [of myself], I am Sāvitrī, mother of the Vedas, in the presence of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
taijaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā satye tavā''jñayā .
adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛta tatra dhṛtaṃ devyā śarīrakam .. 90 ..
meaning:
तैजःसु सर्वदेवानां पुरा सत्ये तवा'ऽज्ञया .
अधिष्ठानं कृत तत्र धृतं देव्या शरीरकम् .. 90 ..
text_mt: Formerly, in the Kṛtayuga, by your command, / an abode was made in the energies of all the gods, and a body was assumed by the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śumbhādayaśca daityāśca nihatāścāvalīlayā .
durga nihatya turgā'haṃ tripurā tripure vadhe .. 91 ..
meaning:
शुम्भादयश्च दैत्याश्च निहताश्चावलीलया .
दुर्ग निहत्य तुर्गाऽहं त्रिपुरा त्रिपुरे वधे .. 91 ..
text_mt: Śumbha and the other Daityas were slain with ease. / Having slain Durgamasura, I am Durgā; [and I am] Tripurā in the slaying of Tripura.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatya raktabījaṃ ca raktabījavināśinī .
tavā''jñayā dakṣakanyā satī satyasvarūpiṇī .. 92 ..
meaning:
निहत्य रक्तबीजं च रक्तबीजविनाशिनी .
तवा'ऽज्ञया दक्षकन्या सती सत्यस्वरूपिणी .. 92 ..
text_mt: Having slain Raktabīja, [I am] the destroyer of Raktabīja. / By your command, I became Satī, daughter of Dakṣa, the embodiment of truth.

sanskrit_iast:
yogena tyaktvā dehaṃ ca śailajā'haṃ tavā''jñayā .
tvayā dattavā (ttāḥ śaṃkarāya goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 93 ..
meaning:
योगेन त्यक्त्वा देहं च शैलजाऽहं तवा'ऽज्ञया .
त्वया दत्तवा (त्ताः शंकराय गोलोके रासमण्डले .. 93 ..
text_mt: Abandoning my body through yoga, I became the daughter of the mountain by your command. / I was given by you to Śaṅkara in Goloka, in the circle of the rāsa-dance.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktirahaṃ tena viṣṇumāyā ca vaiṣṇavī .
nārāyaṇasya māyā'haṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā .. 94 ..
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तिरहं तेन विष्णुमाया च वैष्णवी .
नारायणस्य मायाऽहं तेन नारायणी स्मृता .. 94 ..
text_mt: Therefore, I am devotion to Viṣṇu, and the Vaiṣṇava illusion of Viṣṇu. / I am the illusion of Nārāyaṇa; therefore I am known as Nārāyaṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā'haṃ ca prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā .
mahāviṣṇośca vāsośca jananī rādhikā svayam .. 95 ..
meaning:
कृष्णप्राणाधिकाऽहं च प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेवता .
महाविष्णोश्च वासोश्च जननी राधिका स्वयम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: I am dearer to Kṛṣṇa than life, the presiding deity of his life-breath, / the mother of Mahāviṣṇu, and myself Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tavā''jñayā pañcadhā'haṃ pañcaprakṛtirūpiṇī .
kalākalāṃśayā'haṃ ca devapatnayo gṛhe gṛhe .. 96 ..
meaning:
तवा'ऽज्ञया पञ्चधाऽहं पञ्चप्रकृतिरूपिणी .
कलाकलांशयाऽहं च देवपत्नयो गृहे गृहे .. 96 ..
text_mt: By your command, I am fivefold, having the form of the five Prakṛtis. / By divisions of parts and portions, I am the wives of the gods in house after house.

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ gaccha mahābhāga tatrā'haṃ virahāturā .
govībhiḥ sahitā rāsaṃ bhramantī paritaḥ sadā .. 97 ..
meaning:
शीघ्रं गच्छ महाभाग तत्राऽहं विरहातुरा .
गोवीभिः सहिता रासं भ्रमन्ती परितः सदा .. 97 ..
text_mt: Go quickly, O fortunate one! There I suffer the agony of separation, / constantly wandering all around the rāsa-dance together with the cowherdesses.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ .
ratnayānaṃ samāruhya yayau golokamuttamam .. 98 ..
meaning:
पार्वतीवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य रसिकेश्वरः .
रत्नयानं समारुह्य ययौ गोलोकमुत्तमम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: Hearing Pārvatī's words, the lord of aesthetic delight smiled, / ascended his jewelled chariot, and went to supreme Goloka.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatī bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ devagaṇaṃ tathā .
māyāvaṃśīravācchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā sanātanī .. 99 ..
meaning:
पार्वती बोधयामास स्वयं देवगणं तथा .
मायावंशीरवाच्छन्नं विष्णुमाया सनातनी .. 99 ..
text_mt: Pārvatī herself awakened the host of gods, / who were veiled by the sound of the illusory flute, she, the eternal illusion of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā te hariśabdaṃ ca svagṛhaṃ vismayaṃ yayuḥ .
śivena sārdhaṃ durgā sā prahṛṣṭā svapuraṃ yayau .. 100 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा ते हरिशब्दं च स्वगृहं विस्मयं ययुः .
शिवेन सार्धं दुर्गा सा प्रहृष्टा स्वपुरं ययौ .. 100 ..
text_mt: Uttering the name of Hari, they went to their homes in wonder. / And that Durgā, together with Śiva, went joyfully to her own city.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kṛṣṇaṃ samāyāntaṃ rādhā gopīgaṇaiḥ saha .
anuvrajaṃ yayau hṛṣṭā sarvajñā prāṇavallabham .. 101 ..
meaning:
अथ कृष्णं समायान्तं राधा गोपीगणैः सह .
अनुव्रजं ययौ हृष्टा सर्वज्ञा प्राणवल्लभम् .. 101 ..
text_mt: Then, seeing Kṛṣṇa arriving, the omniscient Rādhā, / together with the cowherdesses, went out joyfully toward the lover of her life.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā samīpamāyāntamavaruhya rathātsatī .
praṇanāma jagannāthaṃ sirasā sakhibhiḥ saha .. 102 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा समीपमायान्तमवरुह्य रथात्सती .
प्रणनाम जगन्नाथं सिरसा सखिभिः सह .. 102 ..
text_mt: Seeing him approaching, the virtuous woman stepped down from her chariot / and bowed her head to the Lord of the Universe along with her female friends.

sanskrit_iast:
gopā gopyaśca muditāḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇāḥ .
duṃdubhiṃ vādayāmāsurīśvarāgamanotsukāḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
गोपा गोप्यश्च मुदिताः प्रफुल्लवदनेक्षणाः .
दुंदुभिं वादयामासुरीश्वरागमनोत्सुकाः .. 103 ..
text_mt: The cowherds and cowherdesses rejoiced, their faces and eyes blooming, / and eagerly sounded the kettledrum at the arrival of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
virajāṃ ca samuttīrya dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ jagatpatiḥ .
avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā rādhikākaram .. 104 ..
meaning:
विरजां च समुत्तीर्य दृष्ट्वा राधां जगत्पतिः .
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णं गृहीत्वा राधिकाकरम् .. 104 ..
text_mt: Crossing the Virajā and seeing Rādhā, the Lord of the Universe / quickly stepped down from the chariot and took Rādhikā's hand.

sanskrit_iast:
śataśṛṅgaṃ ca babhrāma suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .
dṛṣṭvā'kṣayavaṭaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau .. 105 ..
meaning:
शतशृङ्गं च बभ्राम सुरम्यं रासमण्डलम् .
दृष्ट्वाऽक्षयवटं पुण्यं पुण्यं वृन्दावनं ययौ .. 105 ..
text_mt: He wandered over the Śataśṛṅga mountain and the delightful circle of the rāsa-dance; / seeing the sacred imperishable banyan tree, he went to holy Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīkānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau mālatīvanam .
vāme kṛtvā kundavanaṃ mādhavīkānanaṃ tathā .. 106 ..
meaning:
तुलसीकाननं दृष्ट्वा प्रययौ मालतीवनम् .
वामे कृत्वा कुन्दवनं माधवीकाननं तथा .. 106 ..
text_mt: Seeing the grove of tulasī, he went to the jasmine forest, / leaving on his left the kunda forest and the mādhavī grove.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaścampakāraṇyamīpsinam .
cakāra paścāttūrṇaṃ ca cārucandanakānanam .. 107 ..
meaning:
चकार दक्षिणे कृष्णश्चम्पकारण्यमीप्सिनम् .
चकार पश्चात्तूर्णं च चारुचन्दनकाननम् .. 107 ..
text_mt: On his right, Kṛṣṇa kept the desired campaka forest, / and quickly left behind him the beautiful sandalwood grove.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa purato ramyaṃ rādhikābhavanaṃ param .
uvāsa rādhayā sārdhaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare .. 108 ..
meaning:
ददर्श पुरतो रम्यं राधिकाभवनं परम् .
उवास राधया सार्धं रत्नसिंहासने वरे .. 108 ..
text_mt: Before him he saw the supreme, charming palace of Rādhikā. / He sat together with Rādhā upon an excellent jewelled throne.

sanskrit_iast:
sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje vāsitaṃ jalam .
suṣvāpa puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite .. 109 ..
meaning:
सकर्पूरं च ताम्बूलं बुभुजे वासितं जलम् .
सुष्वाप पुष्पतल्पे च सुगन्धिचन्दनार्चिते .. 109 ..
text_mt: He enjoyed betel with camphor and perfumed water, / and fell asleep on a flower bed adorned with fragrant sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
sa reme rāmayā sārdhaṃ nimagno rasasāgare .
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktrācca yacchrutam .. 110 ..
meaning:
स रेमे रामया सार्धं निमग्नो रससागरे .
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं धर्मवक्त्राच्च यच्छ्रुतम् .. 110 ..
text_mt: He made love with that lovely woman, immersed in an ocean of rasa. / Thus all that was heard from the mouth of Dharma has been told [to you].

sanskrit_iast: golokārohaṇaṃ ramyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 111 ..
meaning: गोलोकारोहणं रम्यं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 111 ..
text_mt: The delightful ascent to Goloka [has been described]; what more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo golokārohaṇaṃ
nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 129 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ गोलोकारोहणं
नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 129 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Ascent to Goloka," in the latter part of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the great Śrī Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa, in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga nāraśeṣamabhīpsitam .
kimapūrva purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamiṣṭadam .. 1 ..
meaning:
नारद उवाच
सर्वं श्रुतं महाभाग नारशेषमभीप्सितम् .
किमपूर्व पुराणं च ब्रह्मवैवर्तमिष्टदम् .. 1 ..
title: atha triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā kiṃ kariṣyāmi tanmāṃ brūhi jagadguro .
ājñāṃ kuru tapasyāṃ ca kartu yāmi himālayam .. 2 ..
meaning:
अधुना किं करिष्यामि तन्मां ब्रूहि जगद्गुरो .
आज्ञां कुरु तपस्यां च कर्तु यामि हिमालयम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: What shall I do now? Tell me that, O Guru of the Universe! / Give the command; I shall go to the Himālayas to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
uvabarhaṇagandhardaḥ pañcaśatkāminīpatiḥ .
janmāntare bhavānāsīdadhunā brahmaputrakaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
नारायण उवाच
उवबर्हणगन्धर्दः पञ्चशत्कामिनीपतिः .
जन्मान्तरे भवानासीदधुना ब्रह्मपुत्रकः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa said: / You were the Gandharva Upabarhaṇa, the husband of fifty passionate women / in a previous birth; now you are the son of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsvekā ca satī ramyā tapasā śaṃkaraṃ param .
ārādhya ca varaṃ lebhe vāñchitaṃ nāradaṃ patim .. 4 ..
meaning:
तास्वेका च सती रम्या तपसा शंकरं परम् .
आराध्य च वरं लेभे वाञ्छितं नारदं पतिम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Among them, one virtuous and beautiful woman, having propitiated supreme Śaṅkara / through austerities, obtained her desired boon: Nārada as her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca sṛñjayakanyā ca svarṇaṣṭhīvīsahodarā .
tāṃ vivāhaṃ kuruṣveti śaṃkarājñā kathaṃ vṛthā .. 5 ..
meaning:
सा च सृञ्जयकन्या च स्वर्णष्ठीवीसहोदरा .
तां विवाहं कुरुष्वेति शंकराज्ञा कथं वृथा .. 5 ..
text_mt: She is the daughter of Sṛñjaya and the sister of Svarṇaṣṭhīvin. / Marry her! How could Śaṅkara's command be in vain?

sanskrit_iast:
sundarī sundarīṣvevaṃ komalāṃ kamalākalām .
pativratāṃ mahābhagāṃ ramyāṃ supriyavādinīm .. 6 ..
meaning:
सुन्दरी सुन्दरीष्वेवं कोमलां कमलाकलाम् .
पतिव्रतां महाभगां रम्यां सुप्रियवादिनीम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: She is the loveliest of beauties, delicate, a part of Lakṣmī, / a devoted wife, most fortunate, charming, and speaking very sweetly,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmukīṃ kamanīyāṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanām .
vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktanaṃ kena vāryate .. 7 ..
meaning:
कामुकीं कमनीयां च शश्वत्सुस्थिरयौवनाम् .
विधात्रा लिखितं कर्म प्राक्तनं केन वार्यते .. 7 ..
text_mt: passionate, desirable, and endowed with eternally firm youth. / Who can avert the past action written by the Creator?

sanskrit_iast:
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi .
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhāśubham .. 8 ..
meaning:
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं शुभाशुभम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: An action does not perish even in hundreds of millions of aeons without being experienced; / what has been done, good or bad, must inevitably be experienced.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hṛdayena vidūyatā .
praṇamya prayayau śīghraṃ nāradaḥ sṛñjayālayam .. 9 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच
नारायणवचः श्रुत्वा हृदयेन विदूयता .
प्रणम्य प्रययौ शीघ्रं नारदः सृञ्जयालयम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing Nārāyaṇa's words, with an afflicted heart, / Nārada bowed and went quickly to the abode of Sṛñjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca
aho sūta mahābhāga śrutaṃ kiṃ paramādbhutam .
kimapūrvaṃ rahasyaṃ ca sarasaṃ ca purātanam .. 10 ..
meaning:
शौनक उवाच
अहो सूत महाभाग श्रुतं किं परमाद्भुतम् .
किमपूर्वं रहस्यं च सरसं च पुरातनम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: Śaunaka said: / Ah, O highly fortunate Sūta, what a most wonderful thing has been heard! / What an unprecedented, delightful, and ancient secret!

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā śrotumicchāmi vivāhaṃ nāradasya ca .
atīndriyasya ca munerbrahmaputrasya sāṃpratam .. 11 ..
meaning:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि विवाहं नारदस्य च .
अतीन्द्रियस्य च मुनेर्ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य सांप्रतम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Now I wish to hear about the marriage of Nārada, / the sage who has conquered the senses, the son of Brahmā, at this time.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
nārado mū(gu)ḍharupaśca dṛṣṭāvā sṛñjayakanyakām .
tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇām .. 12 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच
नारदो मू(गु)ढरुपश्च दृष्टावा सृञ्जयकन्यकाम् .
तपस्विनीं महाभागां विष्णुव्रतपरायणाम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / Nārada, in disguised form, having seen Sṛñjaya's daughter, / an ascetic, highly fortunate woman devoted to the vows of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau brahmasabhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevaiḥ samāvṛtām .
praṇamya pitaraṃ śāntaḥ sarvaṃ tattvamuvāca tam .. 13 ..
meaning:
ययौ ब्रह्मसभां रम्यां सर्वदेवैः समावृताम् .
प्रणम्य पितरं शान्तः सर्वं तत्त्वमुवाच तम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: went to the charming assembly of Brahmā, surrounded by all the gods. / Calming himself, he bowed to his father and told him the entire truth.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā vārtāṃ śubhāvahām .
tapasvinaṃ ca putraṃ ca saṃprāpya jagatāṃ patiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा प्रहृष्टवदनः श्रुत्वा वार्तां शुभावहाम् .
तपस्विनं च पुत्रं च संप्राप्य जगतां पतिः .. 14 ..
text_mt: His face delighted upon hearing the auspicious news, / Brahmā, the Lord of the worlds, having received his ascetic son,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnanirmāṇayānena sārdhaṃ devaiḥ śubhe kṣaṇe .
putraṃ kṛtvā ca purato yayau sṛñjayamandiram .. 15 ..
meaning:
रत्ननिर्माणयानेन सार्धं देवैः शुभे क्षणे .
पुत्रं कृत्वा च पुरतो ययौ सृञ्जयमन्दिरम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: went at an auspicious moment to the palace of Sṛñjaya in a chariot fashioned of jewels, / accompanied by the gods, placing his son in front.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā sṛñjayo rājā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .
gṛhītvā kanyakāṃ ramyāṃ nāradāya dadau mudā .. 16 ..
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सृञ्जयो राजा रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् .
गृहीत्वा कन्यकां रम्यां नारदाय ददौ मुदा .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hearing of this, King Sṛñjaya took the lovely maiden, / adorned with jewelled ornaments, and joyfully gave her to Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇimuktādikaṃ tathā .
puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā parihāre cakāra saḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सर्वस्वं दक्षिणां दत्त्वा मणिमुक्तादिकं तथा .
पुटाञ्जलियुतो भूत्वा परिहारे चकार सः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Having given all his possessions, along with gems, pearls, and the like, as the priestly gift, / he joined his palms and begged forgiveness.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ samarpya brahmāṇaṃ rājā ca yogināṃ varaḥ .
ruroda bhṛśamuccaiśca vatse vatsa itīritam .. 18 ..
meaning:
कन्यां समर्प्य ब्रह्माणं राजा च योगिनां वरः .
रुरोद भृशमुच्चैश्च वत्से वत्स इतीरितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having offered the maiden to Brahmā, the king, best among yogins, / wept very aloud, crying, "O child! O child!"

sanskrit_iast:
kva yāsi tyaktvā madgehaṃ śūnyaṃ ka malalocane .
ahaṃ yāmi vanaṃ ghoraṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā jīvito mṛtaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
क्व यासि त्यक्त्वा मद्गेहं शून्यं क मललोचने .
अहं यामि वनं घोरं त्वां त्यक्त्वा जीवितो मृतः .. 19 ..
text_mt: "Where are you going, leaving my house desolate, O lotus-eyed one? / Leaving you, I am dead while alive, and go to the dreadful forest!"

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya pitaraṃ kanyā rudantaṃ mātaraṃ tathā .
rudatīṃ tāṃ rudantī sā'pyāruroha rathaṃ vidheḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य पितरं कन्या रुदन्तं मातरं तथा .
रुदतीं तां रुदन्ती साऽप्यारुरोह रथं विधेः .. 20 ..
text_mt: The maiden, having bowed to her weeping father and likewise her weeping mother, / ascended the chariot of Brahmā, weeping herself.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā ca sabhāryaṃ ca putraṃ dhātā mudā'nvitaḥ .
prayayau brahmalokaṃ ca devandrairmunibhiḥ saha .. 21 ..
meaning:
गृहीत्वा च सभार्यं च पुत्रं धाता मुदाऽन्वितः .
प्रययौ ब्रह्मलोकं च देवन्द्रैर्मुनिभिः सह .. 21 ..
text_mt: Taking along his son together with his wife, the Creator, filled with joy, / departed for Brahmaloka accompanied by the chiefs of gods and sages. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbojayāmāsa sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi .
devānapi ca siddhāṃśca vādayāmāsa duṃdubhim .. 22 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्बोजयामास साङ्गे मङ्गलकर्मणि .
देवानपि च सिद्धांश्च वादयामास दुंदुभिम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: He fed the brāhmaṇas at the auspicious rites which were complete in every limb, / and likewise the gods and the siddhas, and ordered kettledrums to be sounded. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
nāradastu muniśreṣṭho bādhitaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā .
yasya yatprāktanaṃ vipra durlaṅdhya kena vāryate .. 23 ..
meaning:
नारदस्तु मुनिश्रेष्ठो बाधितः पूर्वकर्मणा .
यस्य यत्प्राक्तनं विप्र दुर्लङ्ध्य केन वार्यते .. 23 ..
text_mt: Nārada, the best of sages, was constrained by his past deeds. / Whatever past deeds belong to a person, O brāhmaṇa, are insurmountable; by whom can they be averted? // 23

sanskrit_iast:
suramye puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite .
sa reme rāmayā sārdha bubudhe na divāniśam .. 24 ..
meaning:
सुरम्ये पुष्पतल्पे च सुगन्धिचन्दनार्चिते .
स रेमे रामया सार्ध बुबुधे न दिवानिशम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: On a charming couch of flowers, adorned with fragrant sandalwood, / he took delight with the lovely woman and knew neither day nor night. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vivāhaṃ ca virato munisattamaḥ .
uvāsa brahmalokeṣu vaṭamūle manohare .. 25 ..
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा विवाहं च विरतो मुनिसत्तमः .
उवास ब्रह्मलोकेषु वटमूले मनोहरे .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having thus contracted the marriage, that best of sages ceased [his dalliance] / and resided in the worlds of Brahmā at the charming root of a banyan tree. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
tatrā''jagāma nagnaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā .
sanatkumāro bhagavānsākṣācca bālako yathā .. 26 ..
meaning:
तत्रा'ऽजगाम नग्नश्च प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा .
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्साक्षाच्च बालको यथा .. 26 ..
text_mt: There arrived the lord Sanatkumāra in person, naked, / blazing with the fiery splendour of Brahman like a mere child. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaśca vayasā yathaiva pañcahāyanaḥ .
ayūḍo'nupanītaśca vedasaṃdhyāvihīnakaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
सृष्टेः पूर्वश्च वयसा यथैव पञ्चहायनः .
अयूडोऽनुपनीतश्च वेदसंध्याविहीनकः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Though older than the creation, in age he was just five years old; / unmarried, uninvested with the sacred thread, devoid of Vedic twilight prayers. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇeti mantraṃ japati yasya nārāyaṇo guruḥ .
anantakālakalpaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiśca tribhiḥ saha .. 28 ..
meaning:
कृष्णेति मन्त्रं जपति यस्य नारायणो गुरुः .
अनन्तकालकल्पं च भ्रातृभिश्च त्रिभिः सह .. 28 ..
text_mt: He muttered the mantra 'Kṛṣṇa', having Nārāyaṇa as his guru, / through endless eons and kalpas together with his three brothers. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ .
ārāddṛṣṭvā nārādastaṃ bhrātaraṃ ca satāṃ varam .. 29 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवानामग्रणीशो ज्ञानिनां च गुरोर्गुरुः .
आराद्दृष्ट्वा नारादस्तं भ्रातरं च सतां वरम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Leader of the Vaiṣṇavas and guru of the guru of the wise, / seeing his brother from nearby, that foremost among the virtuous, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
sahasā śirasā bhūmau daṇḍavatpraṇanāma tam .
uvāca nāradaṃ bālaḥ prahasya paramārthakam .. 30 ..
meaning:
सहसा शिरसा भूमौ दण्डवत्प्रणनाम तम् .
उवाच नारदं बालः प्रहस्य परमार्थकम् .. 30 ..
text_mt: Nārada at once bowed down to him prostrate on the ground with his head. / Smiling, the boy spoke to Nārada words of supreme truth: // 30

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
aye bhrātaḥ kiṃ karoṣi kuśalaṃ yuvatīpateḥ .
strīpuṃsorvardhate prema nityaṃ tannityanūtanam .. 31 ..
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अये भ्रातः किं करोषि कुशलं युवतीपतेः .
स्त्रीपुंसोर्वर्धते प्रेम नित्यं तन्नित्यनूतनम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / 'O brother! What are you doing? Is all well with the husband of the young woman? / The love between man and woman increases constantly, ever new and fresh. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
argalaṃ jñānamārgasya bhaktidvārakapāṭakam .
mokṣamārgavyavahitaṃ ciraṃ bandhanakāraṇam .. 32 ..
meaning:
अर्गलं ज्ञानमार्गस्य भक्तिद्वारकपाटकम् .
मोक्षमार्गव्यवहितं चिरं बन्धनकारणम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: It is a bolt across the path of knowledge, a door-panel blocking the entrance of devotion, / an obstacle to the path of liberation, and the cause of perpetual bondage. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
garbhavāsasya bījaṃ ca paraṃ narakakāraṇam .
pīyūṣabuddhyā garalaṃ bhuṅkte pāpī narādhamaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
गर्भवासस्य बीजं च परं नरककारणम् .
पीयूषबुद्ध्या गरलं भुङ्क्ते पापी नराधमः .. 33 ..
text_mt: It is the seed of dwelling in a womb, the supreme cause of hell. / Deeming it nectar, the sinful, lowest of men drinks poison. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā yasyā''ste viṣaye manaḥ .
sa vañcito māyayā cāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ bhajet .. 34 ..
meaning:
परं नारायणं त्यक्त्वा यस्या'ऽस्ते विषये मनः .
स वञ्चितो मायया चामृतं त्यक्त्वा विषं भजेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Forsaking the supreme Nārāyaṇa, he whose mind is set upon sensory objects / is deceived by Māyā; abandoning ambrosia, he would resort to poison. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ karmabhoge'sti karmiṇāmīśvaraṃ vinā .
vayaṃ vidhātuḥ putrāśca sā buddhiriti dehinām .. 35 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषां कर्मभोगेऽस्ति कर्मिणामीश्वरं विना .
वयं विधातुः पुत्राश्च सा बुद्धिरिति देहिनाम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: For all actors, except the Lord, there is the experiencing of the fruit of karma. / "We are sons of the Creator"—such is the foolish notion of embodied beings. // 35

sanskrit_iast: yadi te nāsti bhogaśca kathaṃ gandharvajanma ca .kathaṃ dāsīsutastvaṃ ca muktaśca bhaktasaṅgataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning: यदि ते नास्ति भोगश्च कथं गन्धर्वजन्म च .कथं दासीसुतस्त्वं च मुक्तश्च भक्तसङ्गतः .. 36 ..
text_mt: If you had no experiencing [of karma], how then the birth as a Gandharva? / And how were you born a maidservant's son, and freed by the company of devotees? // 36

sanskrit_iast:
nirgaccha tapase bhrātastyaja mayāmayīṃ priyām .
supuṇye bhārate varṣe tapasā bhaja mādhavam .. 37 ..
meaning:
निर्गच्छ तपसे भ्रातस्त्यज मयामयीं प्रियाम् .
सुपुण्ये भारते वर्षे तपसा भज माधवम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Go forth to perform austerity, O brother! Abandon the illusory beloved wife! / In the most sacred land of Bhārata, worship Mādhava through penance! // 37

sanskrit_iast:
sthite nārāyaṇe sveśe pare svapadadātari .
viṣayī viṣayāndhaśca vañcito māyayā dhruvam .. 38 ..
meaning:
स्थिते नारायणे स्वेशे परे स्वपददातरि .
विषयी विषयान्धश्च वञ्चितो मायया ध्रुवम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: While one's own Lord Nārāyaṇa, the Supreme, giver of His own abode, is present, / the worldly man, blinded by sensory objects, is surely deceived by Māyā. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa mama mantraṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam .
sarveṣāmeva santrāṇāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam .. 39 ..
meaning:
गृहाण मम मन्त्रं च कृष्ण इत्यक्षरद्वयम् .
सर्वेषामेव सन्त्राणां सारात्सारं परात्परम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Receive my mantra, the two syllables "Kṛṣ-ṇa", / the essence of essences among all mantras, higher than the highest! // 39

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu ca purāṇeṣu vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca .
dharmaśāstraiṣu tantraiṣu nāstyevāsmātparo manuḥ .. 40 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषु च पुराणेषु वेदेषु च चतुर्षु च .
धर्मशास्त्रैषु तन्त्रैषु नास्त्येवास्मात्परो मनुः .. 40 ..
text_mt: In all the Purāṇas, the four Vedas, / the Dharmaśāstras, and the Tantras, there is no mantra higher than this. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇena datto me puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi .
asaṃkhyakalpa japtvā'haṃ bhramāmi sarvapūjitaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
नारायणेन दत्तो मे पुष्करे सूर्यपर्वणि .
असंख्यकल्प जप्त्वाऽहं भ्रमामि सर्वपूजितः .. 41 ..
text_mt: It was given to me by Nārāyaṇa at Puṣkara on a solar eclipse; / muttering it for countless kalpas, I wander revered by all.' // 41

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā snāpayitvā taṃ dadau dasmai paraṃ manum .
divāniśaṃ sa japati pūtayā maṇimālayā .. 42 ..
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स्नापयित्वा तं ददौ दस्मै परं मनुम् .
दिवानिशं स जपति पूतया मणिमालया .. 42 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus and bathed him, he gave him the supreme mantra; / day and night he repeats it with a purified rosary of gems. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ .
golokaṃ prayayau draṣṭuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 43 ..
meaning:
तस्मै शुभाशिषं दत्त्वा मन्त्रं च वैष्णवाग्रणीः .
गोलोकं प्रययौ द्रष्टुं भगवन्तं सनातनम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Bestowing auspicious blessings and the mantra upon him, that leader of Vaiṣṇavas / departed for Goloka to see the eternal Lord. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
nāradastu manu prāpya sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam .
śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvakarmanikṛntanīm .. 44 ..
meaning:
नारदस्तु मनु प्राप्य सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं वरम् .
श्रीकृष्णे निश्चलां भक्तिं पूर्वकर्मनिकृन्तनीम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Having obtained that choice mantra, bestower of all spiritual perfections, / Nārada [gained] unswerving devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, which severs prior karma. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā māyāmayīṃ bhāryāṃ bhārataṃ tapase yayau .
kṛtamālānadītīre dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ param .. 45 ..
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा मायामयीं भार्यां भारतं तपसे ययौ .
कृतमालानदीतीरे ददर्श शंकरं परम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Leaving his illusory wife, he went to Bhārata for austerity; / on the bank of the Kṛtamālā river he beheld supreme Śaṅkara. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca sahasā mūrdhnā praṇanāma śivaṃ muniḥ .
tamuvāca jagannātho bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च सहसा मूर्ध्ना प्रणनाम शिवं मुनिः .
तमुवाच जगन्नाथो भक्तं च भक्तवत्सलः .. 46 ..
text_mt: Seeing him, the sage bowed with his head prostrate to Śiva; / to that devotee, the Lord of the Universe, affectionate to His devotees, spoke: // 46

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
aho nārada dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ prasanno'haṃ svatejasā .
bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ yatra sudinaṃ taccharīriṇām .. 47 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
अहो नारद दृष्ट्वा त्वां प्रसन्नोऽहं स्वतेजसा .
भक्तानां दर्शनं यत्र सुदिनं तच्छरीरिणाम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / 'Ah, Nārada! Seeing you, I am delighted by your splendour; / wherever devotees are seen, that day is an auspicious day for embodied beings. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ hi paramo lābho dehināṃ baktasaṃgamaḥ .
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yo dadarśa ca vaiṣṇavām .. 48 ..
meaning:
अयं हि परमो लाभो देहिनां बक्तसंगमः .
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु यो ददर्श च वैष्णवाम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: This indeed is the highest gain for embodied souls: association with devotees. / He has bathed in all sacred tirthas who has beheld a Vaiṣṇava. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
api prāpto mahāmantraḥ sarvatantrasudurlabhaḥ .
mayā datto gaṇeśāya skandāya svātmajāya ca .. 49 ..
meaning:
अपि प्राप्तो महामन्त्रः सर्वतन्त्रसुदुर्लभः .
मया दत्तो गणेशाय स्कन्दाय स्वात्मजाय च .. 49 ..
text_mt: Have you received the great mantra, most difficult to obtain in all the Tantras, / which was given by me to Gaṇeśa and to my son Skanda? // 49

sanskrit_iast:
mahyaṃ dattaśca kṛṣṇena goloke rāsamaṇḍale .
brahmaṇe cāpi dharmāya dharmo nārāyaṇāya ca .. 50 ..
meaning:
मह्यं दत्तश्च कृष्णेन गोलोके रासमण्डले .
ब्रह्मणे चापि धर्माय धर्मो नारायणाय च .. 50 ..
text_mt: It was given to me by Kṛṣṇa in Goloka in the circle of the Rāsa, / and also to Brahmā and to Dharma; and Dharma gave it to Nārāyaṇa; // 50

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā sanatkumārāya tumyaṃ dattaśca tena vai .
mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jano nārāyaṇo bhavet .. 51 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा सनत्कुमाराय तुम्यं दत्तश्च तेन वै .
मन्त्रग्रहणमात्रेण जनो नारायणो भवेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Brahmā gave it to Sanatkumāra, and by him it was indeed given to you. / Merely by receiving the mantra, a person becomes Nārāyaṇa. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
vicāraṇaṃ ca nāstyatra kālākālaṃ śubhāśubham .
pañcalakṣajapenaiva puraścaraṇamasya ca .. 52 ..
meaning:
विचारणं च नास्त्यत्र कालाकालं शुभाशुभम् .
पञ्चलक्षजपेनैव पुरश्चरणमस्य च .. 52 ..
text_mt: Here there is no deliberation regarding proper or improper time, auspicious or inauspicious; / by a repetition of five hundred thousand times alone its preparatory rite is accomplished. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ tena dhyāyecca vaiṣṇavaḥ .
dhyānaṃ ca pāpadahanaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam .. 53 ..
meaning:
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं तेन ध्यायेच्च वैष्णवः .
ध्यानं च पापदहनं कर्ममूलनिकृन्तनम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: And the meditation is spoken of in the Sāmaveda; through it a Vaiṣṇava should meditate; / this meditation burns sins and severs the root of karma: // 53

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ navaghanaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ pītavāsasam .
śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ dadhānamatulaṃ param .. 54 ..
meaning:
कृष्णं नवघनश्यामं किशोरं पीतवाससम् .
शतकोटीन्दुसौन्दर्यं दधानमतुलं परम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: "I worship Kṛṣṇa, dark as a fresh rain-cloud, an adolescent wearing yellow garments, / possessing the supreme, incomparable beauty of a hundred million moons, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaughaistairamūlyaratnanirmitaiḥ .
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam .. 55 ..
meaning:
भूषितं भूषणौघैस्तैरमूल्यरत्ननिर्मितैः .
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं कौस्तुभेन विराजितम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: adorned with arrays of ornaments wrought of priceless gems, / all his limbs smeared with sandalwood, radiant with the Kaustubha gem, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam .
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ nityopāsyaṃ śivādibhiḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च मालतीमाल्यमण्डितम् .
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं नित्योपास्यं शिवादिभिः .. 56 ..
text_mt: with a crest of peacock feathers, decked with a garland of jasmine flowers, / his face gracious with a gentle smile, ever to be worshipped by Śiva and the others, // 56

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param .
sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham .. 57 ..
meaning:
ध्यानासाध्यं दुराराध्यं निर्गुणं प्रकृतेः परम् .
सर्वेषां परमात्मानं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: unattainable by meditation, difficult to propitiate, beyond the gunas, beyond Prakṛti, / the Paramātman of all, embodied out of grace towards his devotees, // 57

sanskrit_iast:
vedānirvacanīyaṃ ta varaṃ sarveśvaraṃ bhaje .
dhyānenānena taṃ dhyātvā bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 58 ..
meaning:
वेदानिर्वचनीयं त वरं सर्वेश्वरं भजे .
ध्यानेनानेन तं ध्यात्वा भगवन्तं सनातनम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: indescribable by the Vedas, that supreme Sovereign of all!" / Having meditated on the eternal Lord with this meditation, // 58

sanskrit_iast:
bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ satyaṃ nityaṃ parātparam .
ityuktvā svapadaṃ śaṃbhūrjagām parameśvaraḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
भज तं परमानन्दं सत्यं नित्यं परात्परम् .
इत्युक्त्वा स्वपदं शंभूर्जगाम् परमेश्वरः .. 59 ..
text_mt: worship Him, the supreme bliss, true, eternal, higher than the highest!' / Having spoken thus, Śambhu, the supreme Lord, went to his own abode. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ nāradastapase yayau .
nāradaḥ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā yogāttyaktvā kalevaram
nilīnaḥ pādapadme ca pāda (padmā) padmārcite hareḥ .. 60 ..
meaning:
तं प्रणम्य जगन्नाथं नारदस्तपसे ययौ .
नारदः श्रीहरिं स्मृत्वा योगात्त्यक्त्वा कलेवरम्
निलीनः पादपद्मे च पाद (पद्मा) पद्मार्चिते हरेः .. 60 ..
text_mt: Bowing to that Lord of the Universe, Nārada departed for austerity. / Remembering Śrī Hari, having discarded his mortal frame through yoga, / Nārada dissolved into Hari's lotus feet that are worshipped by the lotus-born [Lakṣmī]. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo nāradavivāhādiprakaraṇaṃ
nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 130 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ नारदविवाहादिप्रकरणं
नाम त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 130 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled 'The Episode of Nārada's Marriage and Other Matters', in the latter part of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa of the great and glorious Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. // 130

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca
atyapūrvamupākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ paramamādbhutam .
sugopyaṃ ca sugopyaṃ ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam .. 1 ..
meaning:
शौनक उवाच
अत्यपूर्वमुपाख्यानं श्रुतं परममाद्भुतम् .
सुगोप्यं च सुगोप्यं रम्यं रम्यं नवं नवम् .. 1 ..
title: adhai katriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca kamanīyaṃ manoharam .
sudurlabhā kathā proktā purāṇeṣu purātanī .. 2 ..
meaning:
किमनिर्वचनीयं च कमनीयं मनोहरम् .
सुदुर्लभा कथा प्रोक्ता पुराणेषु पुरातनी .. 2 ..
text_mt: inexpressible, pleasing, and charming! / Rare indeed is this ancient tale told in the Purāṇas. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃbhūtaṃ ca sudinaṃ kadā'smākaṃ phaviṣyati .
tajjanma saphalaṃ dhanyaṃ yatra vaiṣṇavasaṃgamaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
एवंभूतं च सुदिनं कदाऽस्माकं फविष्यति .
तज्जन्म सफलं धन्यं यत्र वैष्णवसंगमः .. 3 ..
text_mt: And when will such an auspicious day be ours? / Fruitful and blessed is that birth where there is association with Vaiṣṇavas,

sanskrit_iast:
garbhavāsocchedanaṃ ca karmamūlanikṛntanam .
haridāsyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktivardhanam .. 4 ..
meaning:
गर्भवासोच्छेदनं च कर्ममूलनिकृन्तनम् .
हरिदास्यप्रदं शुद्धं भक्तानां भक्तिवर्धनम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Which cuts off residence in the womb, severs the root of karma, / Bestows pure servitude to Hari, and increases the devotion of devotees;

sanskrit_iast:
asādhusaṅgadurbuddhipāponmūlanakāraṇam .
gaṇeśajanmopakhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham .. 5 ..
meaning:
असाधुसङ्गदुर्बुद्धिपापोन्मूलनकारणम् .
गणेशजन्मोपख्यानं पुराणेषु सुदुर्लभम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Which is the cause of uprooting the sins and evil thoughts born of bad company. / The episode of Gaṇeśa's birth, so very rare in the Purāṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīrādhikākhyānaṃ kimapūrva śrutaṃ param .
anyadyadyadgopanīyaṃ vyaktamavyaktamīpsitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
तुलसीराधिकाख्यानं किमपूर्व श्रुतं परम् .
अन्यद्यद्यद्गोपनीयं व्यक्तमव्यक्तमीप्सितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: And the extraordinary, supreme narrative of Tulasī and Rādhikā have been heard. / Whatever else was secret, manifested or unmanifested, that was desired,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga paribūrṇaṃ manoharam .
adhunā śrotumicchāmi vahnerutpattimīpsitām
svarṇasya ca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi .. 7 ..
meaning:
सर्वं श्रुतं महाभाग परिबूर्णं मनोहरम् .
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि वह्नेरुत्पत्तिमीप्सिताम्
स्वर्णस्य च महाभाग तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि .. 7 ..
text_mt: All has been heard completely and delightfully, O fortunate one. / Now I wish to hear the desired origin of fire / And of gold, O fortunate one; you ought to explain that to me."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sāmagrīkaraṇaṃ sṛṣṭerjalameva hutāśanaḥ .
tathaiva prakṛtirnityā mahāneva tathaiva ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच
सामग्रीकरणं सृष्टेर्जलमेव हुताशनः .
तथैव प्रकृतिर्नित्या महानेव तथैव च .. 8 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / "Water, fire, the eternal Prakṛti, / And likewise the Mahat are the material cause of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā diśo mahākāśo yayaiva sṛṣṭigolakam .
prakṛtermahataśca syādya thā'haṃkāra eva ca .. 9 ..
meaning:
यथा दिशो महाकाशो ययैव सृष्टिगोलकम् .
प्रकृतेर्महतश्च स्याद्य थाऽहंकार एव च .. 9 ..
text_mt: Just as the directions, the great space, and the sphere of creation [arise], / And just as ego arises from Prakṛti and Mahat,

sanskrit_iast:
yathaiva śabdastanmātraṃ tathaiva ca hutāśanaḥ .
tathā'pi tatsamutpattiṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya .. 10 ..
meaning:
यथैव शब्दस्तन्मात्रं तथैव च हुताशनः .
तथाऽपि तत्समुत्पत्तिं कथयामि निशामय .. 10 ..
text_mt: And just as the subtle element of sound [arises], so also is fire. / Nevertheless, I will tell its origin; listen!

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sṛṣṭikāle ca brahmānantamaheśvarāḥ .
śvetadvīpaṃ yayuḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ viṣṇuṃ jagatpatim .. 11 ..
meaning:
एकदा सृष्टिकाले च ब्रह्मानन्तमहेश्वराः .
श्वेतद्वीपं ययुः सर्वे द्रष्टुं विष्णुं जगत्पतिम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Once, at the time of creation, Brahmā, Ananta, and Maheśvara, / All went to Śvetadvīpa to behold Viṣṇu, the Lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣāṃ kṛtvā siṃhāsaneṣu ca .
ūcuḥ sarve sabhāmadhye suramye purato vibhoḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
परस्परं च संभाषां कृत्वा सिंहासनेषु च .
ऊचुः सर्वे सभामध्ये सुरम्ये पुरतो विभोः .. 12 ..
text_mt: And conversing with one another upon their thrones, / They all spoke in the middle of the assembly, in that delightful [place], before the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇugātrodbhavāstatra kāminyaḥ kamalākalāḥ .
tatra nṛtyanti gāyanti viṣṇugāthāśca ..
susvaram .. 13 ..
meaning:
विष्णुगात्रोद्भवास्तत्र कामिन्यः कमलाकलाः .
तत्र नृत्यन्ति गायन्ति विष्णुगाथाश्च ..
सुस्वरम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: There, beautiful women, parts of Lakṣmī born from the body of Viṣṇu, / Were dancing and singing songs in praise of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ ca kaṭhināṃ śroṇiṃ kaṭhinaṃ stanamaṇḍalam .
sasmitaṃ mukhapadmaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā brahmā sukāmukaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
तासां च कठिनां श्रोणिं कठिनं स्तनमण्डलम् .
सस्मितं मुखपद्मं च दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा सुकामुकः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Beholding their firm hips, their firm round breasts, / And their smiling lotus faces, Brahmā became filled with lust.

sanskrit_iast:
manonivāraṇaṃ kartuṃ na śaśāka pitāmahaḥ .
vīryaṃ papāta cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā vibhuḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
मनोनिवारणं कर्तुं न शशाक पितामहः .
वीर्यं पपात चच्छाद लज्जया वाससा विभुः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The Grandfather could not restrain his mind. / His semen fell, and the lord covered it with his garment out of shame.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvīryaṃ vastrasahitaṃ prataptaṃ kāmatāpataḥ .
kṣīrode prerayāmāsa saṃgīte virate dvija .. 16 ..
meaning:
तद्वीर्यं वस्त्रसहितं प्रतप्तं कामतापतः .
क्षीरोदे प्रेरयामास संगीते विरते द्विज .. 16 ..
text_mt: That semen, together with the cloth, heated by the fire of passion, / He cast into the Milk Ocean when the singing ceased, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
jalādutthāya puruṣaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā .
uvāsa brahmaṇaḥ kroḍe lajjitasya ca saṃsadi .. 17 ..
meaning:
जलादुत्थाय पुरुषः प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा .
उवास ब्रह्मणः क्रोडे लज्जितस्य च संसदि .. 17 ..
text_mt: A male, rising from the water and blazing with the splendour of Brahman, / Sat on the lap of Brahmā, who was abashed in the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare ruṣṭo jalādutthāya satvaraḥ .
praṇamya varuṇo devānbālaṃ netuṃ samudyataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रुष्टो जलादुत्थाय सत्वरः .
प्रणम्य वरुणो देवान्बालं नेतुं समुद्यतः .. 18 ..
text_mt: At that moment, Varuṇa arose quickly from the water in anger, / Bowed to the gods, and prepared to take the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
bālo dadhāra brahmāṇaṃ bāhumyāṃ ca bhayādrudan .
kiṃ cinnovāca jagatāṃ vidhātā lajjayā dvija .. 19 ..
meaning:
बालो दधार ब्रह्माणं बाहुम्यां च भयाद्रुदन् .
किं चिन्नोवाच जगतां विधाता लज्जया द्विज .. 19 ..
text_mt: The boy grasped Brahmā with both arms, weeping out of fear; / The creator of the worlds said nothing out of shame, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
bālakasya kare dhṛtvā cakāra''karṣaṇaṃ ruṣā .
varuṇaśca sabhāmadhye taṃ cikṣepa prajāpatiḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
बालकस्य करे धृत्वा चकार'ऽकर्षणं रुषा .
वरुणश्च सभामध्ये तं चिक्षेप प्रजापतिः .. 20 ..
text_mt: Varuṇa seized the boy by the hand and pulled him in anger, / And Prajāpati threw him down in the midst of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
papāta dūrato devo varuṇo durbalastataḥ .
mūrchāṃ saṃprāpa mṛtavatkopadṛṣṭyā vidheraho .. 21 ..
meaning:
पपात दूरतो देवो वरुणो दुर्बलस्ततः .
मूर्छां संप्राप मृतवत्कोपदृष्ट्या विधेरहो .. 21 ..
text_mt: The weak god Varuṇa fell far away; / Ah, he fainted like one dead by the furious glance of Brahmā!

sanskrit_iast:
cetanaṃ kārayāmāsāmṛtadṛṣṭyā ca śaṃkaraḥ .
saṃprāpya cetanaṃ tatra tamuvāca jaleśvaraḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
चेतनं कारयामासामृतदृष्ट्या च शंकरः .
संप्राप्य चेतनं तत्र तमुवाच जलेश्वरः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara restored him to consciousness with his nectar-like glance. / Having regained consciousness there, the Lord of the Waters said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇa uvāca
bālo jale samudbhūto mama putro'yamīpsitaḥ .
ahaṃ gṛhītvā yāsyāmi brahmā māṃ tāḍayetkatham .. 23 ..
meaning:
वरुण उवाच
बालो जले समुद्भूतो मम पुत्रोऽयमीप्सितः .
अहं गृहीत्वा यास्यामि ब्रह्मा मां ताडयेत्कथम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Varuṇa said: / 'The boy was born in the water; he is my desired son. / I shall take him and go; why should Brahmā strike me?'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vālakaḥ śaraṇāpanno mayi viṣṇo maheśvara .
kathaṃ dāsyāmi bhītaṃ ca rudantaṃ śaraṇāgatam .. 24 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वालकः शरणापन्नो मयि विष्णो महेश्वर .
कथं दास्यामि भीतं च रुदन्तं शरणागतम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'O Viṣṇu, O Maheśvara, the boy has taken refuge in me. / How can I give up one who is frightened, weeping, and has sought refuge?

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ yo na rakṣedapaṇḍitaḥ .
pacyate niraye tāvadyāvaccandradivākarau .. 25 ..
meaning:
शरणागतदीनार्तं यो न रक्षेदपण्डितः .
पच्यते निरये तावद्यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ .. 25 ..
text_mt: The foolish man who does not protect a distressed, wretched person who has sought refuge / Cooks in hell as long as the moon and sun endure.'

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayorvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdhanaḥ .
uvāca tatra sarvajñaḥ sarveśaśca yathocitam .. 26 ..
meaning:
उभयोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मधुसूधनः .
उवाच तत्र सर्वज्ञः सर्वेशश्च यथोचितम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Hearing the words of both, Madhusūdana laughed gently / And, omniscient and Lord of all, spoke there appropriately.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
dṛṣṭvā tu kāminīśroṇiṃ vīryaṃ dhātuḥ papāta tat .
lajjayā prerayāmāsa kṣīrode nirmale jale .. 27 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
दृष्ट्वा तु कामिनीश्रोणिं वीर्यं धातुः पपात तत् .
लज्जया प्रेरयामास क्षीरोदे निर्मले जले .. 27 ..
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Beholding the hips of the beautiful women, the semen of the Creator fell. / Out of shame, he cast it into the pure water of the Milk Ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tatau babhūva bālaśca dharmato vidhiputrakaḥ .
kṣetrajñaśca sutaḥ śāstre varuṇasyāpi gauṇataḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
ततौ बभूव बालश्च धर्मतो विधिपुत्रकः .
क्षेत्रज्ञश्च सुतः शास्त्रे वरुणस्यापि गौणतः .. 28 ..
text_mt: From that the boy was born; by natural law he is the son of the Creator, / And according to the sacred texts, he is also secondarily the son of the field-owner, Varuṇa.'

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca
yo vidyāyonisaṃbandho vedeṣu ca nirūpitaḥ .
śiṣye putre ca samatā ceti vedavido viduḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच
यो विद्यायोनिसंबन्धो वेदेषु च निरूपितः .
शिष्ये पुत्रे च समता चेति वेदविदो विदुः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / 'The connection through knowledge and through the womb is determined in the Vedas; / And those who know the Veda understand an equality between a disciple and a son.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ dadātu varuṇo vidyāṃca bārakāya ca .
putro vidhāturvaṅniśca śiṣyaśya varuṇasya ca .. 30 ..
meaning:
मन्त्रं ददातु वरुणो विद्यांच बारकाय च .
पुत्रो विधातुर्वङ्निश्च शिष्यश्य वरुणस्य च .. 30 ..
text_mt: Let Varuṇa give a mantra and sacred lore to the boy; / Thus Agni will be the son of the Creator and the disciple of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurdadātu bālāya dāhikāṃ saktimujjvalām .
sarvadagdho hutāśaśca nirvāṇo varuṇena ca .. 31 ..
meaning:
विष्णुर्ददातु बालाय दाहिकां सक्तिमुज्ज्वलाम् .
सर्वदग्धो हुताशश्च निर्वाणो वरुणेन च .. 31 ..
text_mt: Let Viṣṇu give the boy the radiant power to burn; / Fire burns everything, and he is extinguished by Varuṇa.'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuśca dāhikāṃ śaktiṃ dadau tasmai śivājñayā .
mantraṃ vidyāṃ ca varuṇo ratnamālāṃ manoharām .. 32 ..
meaning:
विष्णुश्च दाहिकां शक्तिं ददौ तस्मै शिवाज्ञया .
मन्त्रं विद्यां च वरुणो रत्नमालां मनोहराम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: And Viṣṇu gave him the power to burn at the command of Śiva; / Varuṇa gave a mantra, sacred lore, and a charming necklace of gems.

sanskrit_iast:
kroḍe kṛtvā ca taṃ bālaṃ cucumba māyayā suraḥ .
brahmaṇe ca dadau sākṣādviṣṇuśaṃkarayorapi .. 33 ..
meaning:
क्रोडे कृत्वा च तं बालं चुचुम्ब मायया सुरः .
ब्रह्मणे च ददौ साक्षाद्विष्णुशंकरयोरपि .. 33 ..
text_mt: Taking the boy on his lap, the god kissed him out of affection, / And handed him directly to Brahmā in the presence of Viṣṇu and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya viṣṇuṃ brahmā ca yayau śaṃbhuḥ svamandiram .
agnyutpattiśca kathitā svarṇotpattiṃ niśāmaya .. 34 ..
meaning:
प्रणम्य विष्णुं ब्रह्मा च ययौ शंभुः स्वमन्दिरम् .
अग्न्युत्पत्तिश्च कथिता स्वर्णोत्पत्तिं निशामय .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having bowed to Viṣṇu, Brahmā and Śambhu went to their own abodes. / The origin of fire has been told; now listen to the origin of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca .
papāta vīryaṃ cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā .. 35 ..
meaning:
विलोक्य रम्भां सुश्रोणिं सकामो वह्निरेव च .
पपात वीर्यं चच्छाद लज्जया वाससा तथा .. 35 ..
text_mt: Beholding Rambhā of beautiful hips, fire became lustful; / His semen fell, and he covered it with his garment out of shame.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca .
papāta vīrya cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā .. 36 ..
meaning:
विलोक्य रम्भां सुश्रोणिं सकामो वह्निरेव च .
पपात वीर्य चच्छाद लज्जया वाससा तथा .. 36 ..
text_mt: Beholding Rambhā of beautiful hips, fire became lustful; / His semen fell, and he covered it with his garment out of shame.

sanskrit_iast:
uttasthau svarṇapuñjaśca vastraṃ kṣiptvā jvalatprabhaḥ .
kṣaṇena vardhayāmāsa sa sumerurbabhūva ha .. 37 ..
meaning:
उत्तस्थौ स्वर्णपुञ्जश्च वस्त्रं क्षिप्त्वा ज्वलत्प्रभः .
क्षणेन वर्धयामास स सुमेरुर्बभूव ह .. 37 ..
text_mt: Casting off the garment, a heap of gold arose, blazing with splendour; / In an instant it expanded, and indeed became Mount Sumeru.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaretasaṃ vahniṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 38 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यरेतसं वह्निं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः .
इति ते कथितं सर्वं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 38 ..
text_mt: The wise call fire 'he whose semen is gold'. / Thus all has been told to you; what more do you wish to hear?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nārādanāo
vahnisuvarṇotpattirnāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 131 ..
meaning:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारादनाओ
वह्निसुवर्णोत्पत्तिर्नामैकत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 131 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-first chapter, entitled 'The Origin of Fire and Gold', in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the great Śrībrahmavaivarta, the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śaunaka uvāca
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ nāvaśeṣaṃ dharmeśa vrahmaṇaṃ ca mām .
kathayasva mahābhāga purāṇaṃ punareva hi .. 1 ..
meaning:
शौनक उवाच
श्रुतं सर्वं नावशेषं धर्मेश व्रह्मणं च माम् .
कथयस्व महाभाग पुराणं पुनरेव हि .. 1 ..
title: atha dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca janmanaiva na hi śrutam .
nadhṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ tāta tā (tvā) dṛśaṃ vājakaṃ tathā .. 2 ..
meaning:
एवंविधं पुराणं च जन्मनैव न हि श्रुतम् .
नधृष्टं न श्रुतं तात ता (त्वा) दृशं वाजकं तथा .. 2 ..
text_mt: Never in my lifetime have I heard such a Purāṇa. / O dear one, never have I seen or heard such an expounder.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrūyatāṃ bho mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ ca saṃyatam .
adhyāyaśravaṇenaiva purāṇaphalamālabhet .. 3 ..
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रूयतां भो महाभाग सावधानं च संयतम् .
अध्यायश्रवणेनैव पुराणफलमालभेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Sūta said: / 'Hear, O fortunate one, attentive and self-controlled; / Merely by hearing this chapter, one obtains the fruit of the Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca kathitaṃ paraṃ brahmanirūpaṇam .
tadanirvacanīyaṃ ca yeṣāmapi yathāgamam .. 4 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मखण्डं च कथितं परं ब्रह्मनिरूपणम् .
तदनिर्वचनीयं च येषामपि यथागमम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: The Brahmakhaṇḍa has been narrated, which determines the Supreme Brahman; / And that is indescribable, according to the respective scriptures of each.

sanskrit_iast:
sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ pṛthak .
yeṣāmapi yathā śaktistathaiva dhyānameva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
साकारं च निराकारं सगुणं निर्गुणं पृथक् .
येषामपि यथा शक्तिस्तथैव ध्यानमेव च .. 5 ..
text_mt: With form and formless, with gunas and without gunas separately, / Just as their capacity is, so indeed is their meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
golokādervarṇanaṃ ca krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak .
tatropayuktopākhyānaṃ yadyatprāsaṅgikaṃ dvija .. 6 ..
meaning:
गोलोकादेर्वर्णनं च क्रमेण च पृथक्पृथक् .
तत्रोपयुक्तोपाख्यानं यद्यत्प्रासङ्गिकं द्विज .. 6 ..
text_mt: The description of Goloka and other realms in order, one by one, / Along with whatever suitable, relevant episode belonged there, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
jātīnāṃ nīrṇayaścaiva saṃkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca .
yadyadviśiṣṭopākhyānaṃ tattatpraśanānurodhataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
जातीनां नीर्णयश्चैव संकराणां तथैव च .
यद्यद्विशिष्टोपाख्यानं तत्तत्प्रशनानुरोधतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: And the determination of castes and mixed castes as well, / and whatever distinguished episode [was asked], corresponding to the questions;

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāmādhavayoḥ krīḍā mahāviṣṇoḥ samudbhavaḥ .
nirūpaṇaṃ ca viśveṣāṃ samāsena dvijottama .. 8 ..
meaning:
राधामाधवयोः क्रीडा महाविष्णोः समुद्भवः .
निरूपणं च विश्वेषां समासेन द्विजोत्तम .. 8 ..
text_mt: the pastimes of Rādhā and Mādhava, the origin of Mahāviṣṇu, / and the ascertainment of the universes in brief, O best of twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmanāradayoścaiva saṃvādaḥ paramārthataḥ .
vipeko nāradasyaiva munīndrasya tathaiva ca .. 9 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मनारदयोश्चैव संवादः परमार्थतः .
विपेको नारदस्यैव मुनीन्द्रस्य तथैव च .. 9 ..
text_mt: and the conversation of Brahmā and Nārada on the highest truth, / and the discrimination of Nārada, the chief of sages;

sanskrit_iast:
ājñayā brahmaṇaścaiva naranārāyaṇāśramam .
gamanaṃ nāradasyaiva tena sārthaṃ ca darśanam .. 10 ..
meaning:
आज्ञया ब्रह्मणश्चैव नरनारायणाश्रमम् .
गमनं नारदस्यैव तेन सार्थं च दर्शनम् .. 10 ..
text_mt: and by the command of Brahmā, Nārada's going to the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa, / and his audience with him;

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ caiva nāradādya(ya) nivedanam .
tatra deva brahmakhaṇḍaṃ krameṇoktaṃ dvijottama .. 11 ..
meaning:
तयोः संभाषणं चैव नारदाद्य(य) निवेदनम् .
तत्र देव ब्रह्मखण्डं क्रमेणोक्तं द्विजोत्तम .. 11 ..
text_mt: and the conversation between the two, and Nārada's petition— / there indeed, O best of twice-born, the Brahmakhaṇḍa has been told in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyatāṃ prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ sudhākhaṇḍasamaṃ mune .
prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca varṇanam .. 12 ..
meaning:
श्रूयतां प्रकृतेः खण्डं सुधाखण्डसमं मुने .
प्रकृतेर्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं प्रकृतीनां च वर्णनम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Hear now the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, equal to a piece of nectar, O sage: / the definition of Prakṛti is told, and the description of the prakṛtis;

sanskrit_iast:
upāśyānaṃ ca tāsāṃ ca varṇanaṃ būjanādikam .
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā tathā .. 13 ..
meaning:
उपाश्यानं च तासां च वर्णनं बूजनादिकम् .
लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती दुर्गा सावित्री राधिका तथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: and their episode, and the description of their worship and the like: / Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Durgā, Sāvitrī, and Rādhikā;

sanskrit_iast:
etāsāṃ caritaṃ caivamanyāsāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak .
upākhyānaṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ sarasvatyāstathaiva ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
एतासां चरितं चैवमन्यासां च पृथक्पृथक् .
उपाख्यानं महालक्ष्म्याः सरस्वत्यास्तथैव च .. 14 ..
text_mt: the life of these and of others, separately: / the episode of Mahālakṣmī, and likewise of Sarasvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ sāvitryāśca tathaiva ca .
saṃvādo yamasāvitryoḥ satyavajjīvadānakam .. 15 ..
meaning:
अपूर्वं राधिकाख्यानं सावित्र्याश्च तथैव च .
संवादो यमसावित्र्योः सत्यवज्जीवदानकम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: the wondrous episode of Rādhikā, and likewise of Sāvitrī; / the conversation between Yama and Sāvitrī, and the restoration of life to Satyavat;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṇḍānāṃ varṇanaṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ tathā .
jīvitarmavipākaśca bhoganirṇaya eva ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृण्डानां वर्णनं प्रोक्तं तेषां च लक्षणं तथा .
जीवितर्मविपाकश्च भोगनिर्णय एव च .. 16 ..
text_mt: the description of the hell-pits is spoken, and their characteristics, / and the ripening of karma for living beings, and the determination of retribution;

sanskrit_iast:
apūrva rādhikākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam .
suyajñasca nṛpendrasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam .. 17 ..
meaning:
अपूर्व राधिकाख्यानं पुराणेषु सुगोप्यकम् .
सुयज्ञस्च नृपेन्द्रस्य चरितं परमाद्भुतम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: the wondrous episode of Rādhikā, highly secret in the Purāṇas; / and the extremely marvelous life of the noble king Suyajña;

sanskrit_iast:
proktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam .
mahāyuddhaṃ ca saṃvāde maheśaśaṅkhacūḍayoḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
प्रोक्तं तुलस्युपाख्यानं पुराणेषु सुगोप्यकम् .
महायुद्धं च संवादे महेशशङ्खचूडयोः .. 18 ..
