श्रीकृष्णेच्छाबलेनोग्रसेनादियादवानां तथा देवमुनिसिद्धर्षिनृपनराणां द्वाराकानिकटवटमूलेऽकस्मात्प्राप्तिः, द्वारकाप्रवेशार्थं कृष्णोग्रसेनयोः सम्भाषणम्, कृष्णाज्ञया द्वारकाप्रवेशोत्तरमुग्रसेनाभिषेकोत्सवश्च .. - 99
text_mt: 104 The arrival of gods headed by Brahmā to behold Dvārakā; the description of Dvārakā; by the power of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's will, the sudden arrival of Yādavas headed by Ugrasena, as well as gods, munis, siddhas, ṛṣis, kings, and men at the root of a banyan tree near Dvārakā; the conversation between Kṛṣṇa and Ugrasena for entering Dvārakā; and, upon entering Dvārakā by Kṛṣṇa's command, the festival of the royal consecration of Ugrasena ... 99

sanskrit_iast: 105 rukmiṇyudvāhākhyānam tatra rukmiṇīsauṃdaryapraśaṃsā, bhīṣmakasya sutamaṃtripurohitādijanān prati rukmiṇyarthaṃ varavaraṇapraśnaḥ rukmiṇī śrīkṛṣṇāya deyeti tanmahatvavarṇanapūrvakaṃ śatānaṃdasyavacanam, tadvacanatuṣṭena bhīṣmakeṇa kṛto bhūratnādidānataḥ śatānaṃdasya sanmānaḥ, tadvacanaruṣṭasya rukmiṇaḥ pitaraṃ prati śiśupālāya kanyā deyeti viprakṛṣṇabhartsanapūrvakaṃ vacanam, sarvatrāmaṃtraṇapatrikāpreṣaṇam, kṛṣṇāhvānārthaṃ bhīṣmakeṇa vipradvārāgūḍhapreṣitapatrikāyādarśanena rāmakṛṣṇograsenādīnāṃ kuṃḍinayātrārthaṃ sajjatā ca ... ... 86
meaning: 105 रुक्मिण्युद्वाहाख्यानम् तत्र रुक्मिणीसौंदर्यप्रशंसा, भीष्मकस्य सुतमंत्रिपुरोहितादिजनान् प्रति रुक्मिण्यर्थं वरवरणप्रश्नः रुक्मिणी श्रीकृष्णाय देयेति तन्महत्ववर्णनपूर्वकं शतानंदस्यवचनम्, तद्वचनतुष्टेन भीष्मकेण कृतो भूरत्नादिदानतः शतानंदस्य सन्मानः, तद्वचनरुष्टस्य रुक्मिणः पितरं प्रति शिशुपालाय कन्या देयेति विप्रकृष्णभर्त्सनपूर्वकं वचनम्, सर्वत्रामंत्रणपत्रिकाप्रेषणम्, कृष्णाह्वानार्थं भीष्मकेण विप्रद्वारागूढप्रेषितपत्रिकायादर्शनेन रामकृष्णोग्रसेनादीनां कुंडिनयात्रार्थं सज्जता च ... ... 86
text_mt: 105 The account of the wedding of Rukmiṇī: therein, the praise of Rukmiṇī's beauty; Bhīṣmaka's inquiry to his sons, ministers, family priest, and others regarding the selection of a bridegroom for Rukmiṇī; Śatānanda's speech declaring that Rukmiṇī should be given to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by an account of his greatness; the honour paid to Śatānanda by Bhīṣmaka, pleased with his speech, by bestowing land, gems, and the like; the speech of Rukmin, who was angered by those words, addressing his father to say that the maiden should be given to Śiśupāla, accompanied by rebukes against the brāhmaṇa and Kṛṣṇa; the sending of invitation letters everywhere; and, seeing the letter sent secretly by Bhīṣmaka through a brāhmaṇa to summon Kṛṣṇa, the preparation of Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Ugrasena, and the others to journey to Kuṇḍina ... 86

sanskrit_iast: 106 tatsamaya eva revatībalarāmayorvivāhaḥ tataḥ saparivārasya kṛṣṇasya kuṃḍinapurāṃtike gamanam, tadāgamanakupitānāṃ rukmiśālvaśiśupālānāṃ kṛṣṇopahāsarūpaṃ vacanaṃ ca ... 27
meaning: 106 तत्समय एव रेवतीबलरामयोर्विवाहः ततः सपरिवारस्य कृष्णस्य कुंडिनपुरांतिके गमनम्, तदागमनकुपितानां रुक्मिशाल्वशिशुपालानां कृष्णोपहासरूपं वचनं च ... 27
text_mt: 106 At that very time, the marriage of Revatī and Balarāma; then the departure of Kṛṣṇa accompanied by his retinue to the vicinity of the city of Kuṇḍina; and the mocking words directed at Kṛṣṇa by Rukmin, Śālva, and Śiśupāla, who were infuriated by his arrival ... 27

sanskrit_iast:
107 tadupahāsavacanaruṣṭena balabhadreṇa rukmiśālvādiduṣṭānāṃ mardanam,śatānaṃdena purapraveśitānāṃ sakṛṣṇavarayātrikāṇāṃ bhīṣmakeṇa kṛto vāsonnadānādinā satkāraḥ, vasudevabhīṣmakayordevakapratiṣṭhādikṛtyam,vivāhamaṃḍape śrīkṛṣṇāgamanam, maṃḍapavarṇanam, kṛṣṇodvāhadarśanārthamāgatān brāhmaṇādīn prati tatstavanātmakaṃ bhīṣmakavacanam,bhīṣmakakṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotraṃ ca. 101
108 śrīkṛṣṇāya kanyādānavidhinā rukmiṇīsamarpaṇam... ... 14
meaning:
107 तदुपहासवचनरुष्टेन बलभद्रेण रुक्मिशाल्वादिदुष्टानां मर्दनम्,शतानंदेन पुरप्रवेशितानां सकृष्णवरयात्रिकाणां भीष्मकेण कृतो वासोन्नदानादिना सत्कारः, वसुदेवभीष्मकयोर्देवकप्रतिष्ठादिकृत्यम्,विवाहमंडपे श्रीकृष्णागमनम्, मंडपवर्णनम्, कृष्णोद्वाहदर्शनार्थमागतान् ब्राह्मणादीन् प्रति तत्स्तवनात्मकं भीष्मकवचनम्,भीष्मककृतं श्रीकृष्णस्तोत्रं च. 101
108 श्रीकृष्णाय कन्यादानविधिना रुक्मिणीसमर्पणम्... ... 14
text_mt: 107. The crushing of the wicked Rukmin, Śālva, and others by Balabhadra, who was enraged by their mockery; the hospitality shown by Bhīṣmaka through gifts of garments, food, and the like to the bridegroom's party, accompanied by Kṛṣṇa, after they were led into the city by Śatānanda; the performance of the consecration of the familial deity and other rites by Vasudeva and Bhīṣmaka; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's arrival at the wedding pavilion; the description of the pavilion; Bhīṣmaka's words in praise of the brahmins and others who had gathered to witness Kṛṣṇa's wedding; and the hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa composed by Bhīṣmaka. 101 / 108. The bestowal of Rukmiṇī according to the prescribed rite for giving away a maiden to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 14

sanskrit_iast: 109 kanyādānottaraṃ rukmiṇīmātrādibhiḥ kṛto vadhūvarayoḥ suveṣakaraṇādimaṅgalotsavaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prati pārvatīsarasvatīlopāmudrādidevarṣistrīṇāmupahāsavacanāni, sarvebhyo bhojanadānam, sadāre śrīkṛṣṇe dvārakāgamanodyukte sati rukmiṇīṃ prati māturvacanam, bhīṣmakṛtayautukadānasya kathanam, dvārakāgamanottaraṃ vadhūgṛhapraveśādimaṃgalotsavaśca ... ... 49
meaning: 109 कन्यादानोत्तरं रुक्मिणीमात्रादिभिः कृतो वधूवरयोः सुवेषकरणादिमङ्गलोत्सवः, श्रीकृष्णं प्रति पार्वतीसरस्वतीलोपामुद्रादिदेवर्षिस्त्रीणामुपहासवचनानि, सर्वेभ्यो भोजनदानम्, सदारे श्रीकृष्णे द्वारकागमनोद्युक्ते सति रुक्मिणीं प्रति मातुर्वचनम्, भीष्मकृतयौतुकदानस्य कथनम्, द्वारकागमनोत्तरं वधूगृहप्रवेशादिमंगलोत्सवश्च ... ... 49
text_mt: 109. The auspicious celebration, including the adorning of the bride and groom, performed by Rukmiṇī's mother and others after the giving of the maiden; the words of gentle mockery addressed to Śrī Kṛṣṇa by Pārvatī, Sarasvatī, Lopāmudrā, and other wives of the gods and sages; the offering of food to all; the words of the mother to Rukmiṇī as Śrī Kṛṣṇa, along with his bride, prepared to depart for Dvārakā; the narration of the dowry given by Bhīṣmaka; and the auspicious festivities, such as the bride entering her new home, after their arrival in Dvārakā. 49

sanskrit_iast: 110 yaśodāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prati jñānayāñcoktiḥ, kṛṣṇājñayā yaśodānaṃdayo rādhāṃtike gamanam, rādhāyāḥ tatkālīnasthitervarṇanam, yaśodānandābhyāṃ rādhāyāḥ saṃvādaśca ... ... 39
meaning: 110 यशोदायाः श्रीकृष्णं प्रति ज्ञानयाञ्चोक्तिः, कृष्णाज्ञया यशोदानंदयो राधांतिके गमनम्, राधायाः तत्कालीनस्थितेर्वर्णनम्, यशोदानन्दाभ्यां राधायाः संवादश्च ... ... 39
text_mt: 110. Yaśodā's request to Śrī Kṛṣṇa for knowledge; the visit of Yaśodā and Nanda to Rādhā at Kṛṣṇa's command; the description of Rādhā's condition at that time; and the dialogue of Rādhā with Yaśodā and Nanda. 39

sanskrit_iast: 111 rādhayā yaśodāyai bhaktijñānopadeśaḥ tathā varadānapūrvakaṃ svanāmavyutpattikathanaṃ ca .. ... ... - ... .. 63
meaning: 111 राधया यशोदायै भक्तिज्ञानोपदेशः तथा वरदानपूर्वकं स्वनामव्युत्पत्तिकथनं च .. ... ... - ... .. 63
text_mt: 111. Rādhā's instruction on devotion and knowledge given to Yaśodā, as well as the granting of a boon, accompanied by the explanation of the etymology of her own name. 63

sanskrit_iast:
112 pradyumnotpattiḥ, śaṃbarāsuravadhaḥ, māyāvatīmokṣaṇam, satyabhāmā-
disaptādhikaśatottaraṣoḍaśasahasrastrīṇāṃ pāṇigrahaṇam dvārakāṃ gatasya durvāsasa ekānaṃśayā vivāhaḥ, durvāsaḥkṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtā durvāsasaṃ prati bodhaśca ... 60
meaning:
112 प्रद्युम्नोत्पत्तिः, शंबरासुरवधः, मायावतीमोक्षणम्, सत्यभामा-
दिसप्ताधिकशतोत्तरषोडशसहस्रस्त्रीणां पाणिग्रहणम् द्वारकां गतस्य दुर्वासस एकानंशया विवाहः, दुर्वासःकृतं श्रीकृष्णस्तोत्रम् श्रीकृष्णेन कृता दुर्वाससं प्रति बोधश्च ... 60
text_mt: 112. The birth of Pradyumna; the slaying of the demon Śambara; the liberation of Māyāvatī; the marriage to Satyabhāmā and sixteen thousand one hundred and seven other women; the marriage of Durvāsas to Ekānaṃśā after his arrival in Dvārakā; the hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa composed by Durvāsas; and the instruction given to Durvāsas by Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 60

sanskrit_iast:
113 durvāsasaḥ kailāse gamanam, durvāsasaṃ prati pārvatyā vacanam, durvāsasaḥ punardvārakāgamanam, śrīkṛṣṇasya hastināpure gamanam dharmayajñe śiśupāladaṃtavakrayorvadhaḥ, śiśupālasya jīvātmanākṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram śrīkṛṣṇasya lokātītacaritrāṇāṃ
saṃkṣepataḥ kathanaṃ ca ... .... .. ... 61
meaning:
113 दुर्वाससः कैलासे गमनम्, दुर्वाससं प्रति पार्वत्या वचनम्, दुर्वाससः पुनर्द्वारकागमनम्, श्रीकृष्णस्य हस्तिनापुरे गमनम् धर्मयज्ञे शिशुपालदंतवक्रयोर्वधः, शिशुपालस्य जीवात्मनाकृतं श्रीकृष्णस्तोत्रम् श्रीकृष्णस्य लोकातीतचरित्राणां
संक्षेपतः कथनं च ... .... .. ... 61
text_mt: 113. Durvāsas's departure for Kailāsa; Pārvatī's speech to Durvāsas; Durvāsas's return to Dvārakā; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's journey to Hastināpura; the slaying of Śiśupāla and Dantavakra at the sacrifice of King Dharma; the hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa uttered by the individual soul of Śiśupāla; and a brief summary of the superhuman deeds of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 61

sanskrit_iast: 114 ūṣāharaṇākhyānam-tatra-aniruddhasya svapnadṛṣṭoṣayā saṃvādaḥ aniruddhasyoṣāvirahajāvasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītā devakīrukmiṇyādiyoṣitaḥ prati kṛṣṇavacanam, ūṣāyai kṛṣṇadarśitasvapnasya prakāraḥ, ūṣāṃ prati citralekhāyā vacanam,gaṇeśaśivayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇama, citralekhayāniruddhasyoṣāṃ prati nayanam śrīkṛṣṇasya śoṇitapuraprayāṇam, ūṣāniruddhayoratikrīḍā ca ... ... 94
meaning: 114 ऊषाहरणाख्यानम्-तत्र-अनिरुद्धस्य स्वप्नदृष्टोषया संवादः अनिरुद्धस्योषाविरहजावस्थां दृष्ट्वा भीता देवकीरुक्मिण्यादियोषितः प्रति कृष्णवचनम्, ऊषायै कृष्णदर्शितस्वप्नस्य प्रकारः, ऊषां प्रति चित्रलेखाया वचनम्,गणेशशिवयोः संभाषणम, चित्रलेखयानिरुद्धस्योषां प्रति नयनम् श्रीकृष्णस्य शोणितपुरप्रयाणम्, ऊषानिरुद्धयोरतिक्रीडा च ... ... 94
text_mt: 114. The episode of the abduction of Ūṣā: therein, the dialogue of Aniruddha with Ūṣā, whom he had seen in a dream; Kṛṣṇa's words to the frightened women, Devakī, Rukmiṇī, and others, on seeing Aniruddha's condition arising from separation from Ūṣā; the manner of the dream shown to Ūṣā by Kṛṣṇa; Citralekhā's speech to Ūṣā; the conversation between Gaṇeśa and Śiva; the bringing of Aniruddha to Ūṣā by Citralekhā; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's march to Śoṇitapura; and the amorous sport of Ūṣā and Aniruddha. 94

sanskrit_iast: 115 ūṣāsaṃrakṣakadūtānāṃ bāṇaṃ prati vacanam, ūṣāceṣṭitaśravaṇato bāṇe kupite sati taṃ prati śivagaurīskaṃdagaṇeśānāṃ bodhavacanāni, bāṇasya pratijñāvacanam bāṇaṃ prati koṭarīmāturbodhavacanam, bāṇasya yuddhodyogaḥ, pārvatīdūtavacanenāniruddhasannaddhatā, aniruddhaṃ prati rāmakṛṣṇaniṃdātmakaṃ bāṇasya vacanam, tanniṃdākhaṃḍanarūpamaniruddhasya vacanaṃ ca ...... .. 116
meaning: 115 ऊषासंरक्षकदूतानां बाणं प्रति वचनम्, ऊषाचेष्टितश्रवणतो बाणे कुपिते सति तं प्रति शिवगौरीस्कंदगणेशानां बोधवचनानि, बाणस्य प्रतिज्ञावचनम् बाणं प्रति कोटरीमातुर्बोधवचनम्, बाणस्य युद्धोद्योगः, पार्वतीदूतवचनेनानिरुद्धसन्नद्धता, अनिरुद्धं प्रति रामकृष्णनिंदात्मकं बाणस्य वचनम्, तन्निंदाखंडनरूपमनिरुद्धस्य वचनं च ...... .. 116
text_mt: 115. The report of the messenger-guards of Ūṣā to Bāṇa; the words of counsel from Śiva, Gaurī, Skanda, and Gaṇeśa to Bāṇa when he grew enraged upon hearing of Ūṣā's conduct; Bāṇa's vow; the advice given to Bāṇa by his mother Koṭarī; Bāṇa's preparation for battle; Aniruddha's arming himself upon hearing the words of Pārvatī's messenger; Bāṇa's speech censuring Rāma and Kṛṣṇa addressed to Aniruddha; and Aniruddha's speech refuting that censure. 116

sanskrit_iast: 116 raṇāṃgaṇe bāṇapraśnato'niruddhena draupadīratyoḥ pūrvetihāsasyakathanam, aniruddhena subhadrahananapūrvako bāṇakubhāṃḍakārttikeyādivīrāṇāṃ parābhavaśca...... .. ... 54
meaning: 116 रणांगणे बाणप्रश्नतोऽनिरुद्धेन द्रौपदीरत्योः पूर्वेतिहासस्यकथनम्, अनिरुद्धेन सुभद्रहननपूर्वको बाणकुभांडकार्त्तिकेयादिवीराणां पराभवश्च...... .. ... 54
text_mt: 116. The narration on the battlefield, upon Bāṇa's questioning, of the past histories of Draupadī and Rati by Aniruddha; the defeat of Bāṇa, Kumbhāṇḍa, Kārttikeya, and other warriors by Aniruddha, preceded by the slaying of Subhadra. 54

sanskrit_iast: 117 bāṇayuddhaprasaṃgato haralaṃbodarasaṃvādaḥ..... ...... 20
meaning: 117 बाणयुद्धप्रसंगतो हरलंबोदरसंवादः..... ...... 20
text_mt: 117. The dialogue between Hara and Lambodara in connection with the war with Bāṇa. 20

sanskrit_iast: 118 bāṇaskaṃdādigaṇaveṣṭitāya śivāya maṇibhadradattena kṛṣṇāgamanavārtāyāḥ kathanam, bāṇāsurasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ pārvatīskadagaṇeśādīn prati śivoktiḥ bāṇena soṣo'niruddhaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya deya iti buddhyā kṛṣṇamahattvavarṇanarūpaṃ pārvatyā vacanaṃ ca.. 40
meaning: 118 बाणस्कंदादिगणवेष्टिताय शिवाय मणिभद्रदत्तेन कृष्णागमनवार्तायाः कथनम्, बाणासुरसंरक्षणार्थं पार्वतीस्कदगणेशादीन् प्रति शिवोक्तिः बाणेन सोषोऽनिरुद्धः श्रीकृष्णाय देय इति बुद्ध्या कृष्णमहत्त्ववर्णनरूपं पार्वत्या वचनं च.. 40
text_mt: 118. The report of Kṛṣṇa's arrival brought by Maṇibhadradatta to Śiva, who was surrounded by Bāṇa, Skanda, and the hosts of attendants; Śiva's address to Pārvatī, Skanda, Gaṇeśa, and the others for the protection of the demon Bāṇa; and Pārvatī's speech describing Kṛṣṇa's greatness, advising that Bāṇa should give Aniruddha along with Ūṣā to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 40

sanskrit_iast: 119 gauryuktyanumodanātmakaṃ śivavacanam, tatsamaye tatsabhāyāṃ prāptasya baleḥ śivakṛtā stutiḥ śivaṃ prati balivacanam, balidaityakṛtaṃ śivastotraṃ, stotratuṣṭena bhagavatā balaye'bhayadānam, stotrapaṭhanaphalakathanaṃ ca... ... -.... 75
meaning: 119 गौर्युक्त्यनुमोदनात्मकं शिववचनम्, तत्समये तत्सभायां प्राप्तस्य बलेः शिवकृता स्तुतिः शिवं प्रति बलिवचनम्, बलिदैत्यकृतं शिवस्तोत्रं, स्तोत्रतुष्टेन भगवता बलयेऽभयदानम्, स्तोत्रपठनफलकथनं च... ... -.... 75
text_mt: 119. Śiva's speech agreeing with Gaurī's words; the praise offered by Bali, who arrived in the assembly at that moment, to Śiva; Bali's words to Śiva; the hymn of praise to Śiva composed by the Daitya Bali; the granting of fearlessness to Bali by the Lord, who was pleased with the hymn; and the statement of the fruit of reciting the hymn. 75

sanskrit_iast: 120 kṛṣṇena śivaṃ prati dūtapreṣaṇam śivaṃ prati kṛṣṇadūtasya vacanam, bāṇaṃ prati pārvatyuktiḥ, bāṇakṛpṇayoryuddhaprakāraḥ, śivena śara ṇa prāpitāya bāṇāya kṛṣṇenājarāmaratvavaradānaṃ,śivājñayā bāṇakṛta ūṣānikaddhavivāhotsavaśca....... 79
meaning: 120 कृष्णेन शिवं प्रति दूतप्रेषणम् शिवं प्रति कृष्णदूतस्य वचनम्, बाणं प्रति पार्वत्युक्तिः, बाणकृप्णयोर्युद्धप्रकारः, शिवेन शर ण प्रापिताय बाणाय कृष्णेनाजरामरत्ववरदानं,शिवाज्ञया बाणकृत ऊषानिकद्धविवाहोत्सवश्च....... 79
text_mt: 120. Kṛṣṇa's dispatching of a messenger to Śiva; the words of Kṛṣṇa's messenger to Śiva; Pārvatī's speech to Bāṇa; the manner of the battle between Bāṇa and Kṛṣṇa; the granting of the boon of agelessness and immortality by Kṛṣṇa to Bāṇa, who had taken refuge through Śiva; and the wedding festival of Ūṣā and Aniruddha celebrated by Bāṇa at Śiva's command. 79

sanskrit_iast: 121 sudharmasabhāsthitāya kṛṣṇāya vipreṇa śṛgālavāsudevasya saṃdeśakathanam, śṛgālanagare kṛṣṇasya gamanam, śṛgālakṛṣṇayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇapūrvakaḥ samaraḥ, śṛgālamokṣaṇaṃ ca. .. 52
meaning: 121 सुधर्मसभास्थिताय कृष्णाय विप्रेण शृगालवासुदेवस्य संदेशकथनम्, शृगालनगरे कृष्णस्य गमनम्, शृगालकृष्णयोः संभाषणपूर्वकः समरः, शृगालमोक्षणं च. .. 52
text_mt: 121. The delivery by a brahmin of the message of the Jackal-Vāsudeva to Kṛṣṇa seated in the Sudharmā assembly; Kṛṣṇa's journey to the city of Śṛgāla; the battle preceded by a dialogue between Śṛgāla and Kṛṣṇa; and the liberation of Śṛgāla. 52

sanskrit_iast: 122 nāradapraśnato nārāyaṇena syamaṃtakopākhyānakathanam. -.... 32
meaning: 122 नारदप्रश्नतो नारायणेन स्यमंतकोपाख्यानकथनम्. -.... 32
text_mt: 122. The narration of the episode of the Syamantaka jewel by Nārāyaṇa in response to Nārada's inquiry. 32

sanskrit_iast: 123 nāradasya nārāyaṇaṃ prati gaṇeśapūjāvyākhyānapraśnaḥ, siddhāśrame sadārāṇāṃ devasiddhayogimuninareṃdragopayādavādīnāṃ gaṇeśapūjanārthaṃ siddhaśrame āgamanam, tatra rādhākṛtaṃ yathāvidhigaṇeśapūjanaṃ ca.... - 60
meaning: 123 नारदस्य नारायणं प्रति गणेशपूजाव्याख्यानप्रश्नः, सिद्धाश्रमे सदाराणां देवसिद्धयोगिमुनिनरेंद्रगोपयादवादीनां गणेशपूजनार्थं सिद्धश्रमे आगमनम्, तत्र राधाकृतं यथाविधिगणेशपूजनं च.... - 60
text_mt: 123. Nārada's inquiry to Nārāyaṇa regarding the exposition of the worship of Gaṇeśa; the arrival at Siddhāśrama of the gods, Siddhas, yogins, sages, kings, cowherds, and Yādavas along with their wives to worship Gaṇeśa; and the worship of Gaṇeśa performed there by Rādhā according to the prescribed rules. 60

sanskrit_iast: 124 pūjanatuṣṭagaṇeśasya rādhāṃ prati tatstutipūrvakaṃ vacanam, siddhāśramarakṣakaśivadūtena brahmaśivakṛṣṇādīnprati rādhākṛtapūjanasya kathanam, sarvajanairgaṇeśasya pūjanam pārvatyā rādhāyai varapradānam, śrīdāmaśāpamuktarādhāyāḥ pārvatyājñayā sakhībhiḥ suveṣakaraṇam, sarvajanapraśnataḥ kṛṣṇena rādhāyāḥ pūrvavṛttasya kathanam, tadā'khilajanadṛṣṭāyā rādhārūpasthitervarṇanam, brahmeśaśeṣādikṛtarādhāstotraṃ ca .. .. ... 111
meaning: 124 पूजनतुष्टगणेशस्य राधां प्रति तत्स्तुतिपूर्वकं वचनम्, सिद्धाश्रमरक्षकशिवदूतेन ब्रह्मशिवकृष्णादीन्प्रति राधाकृतपूजनस्य कथनम्, सर्वजनैर्गणेशस्य पूजनम् पार्वत्या राधायै वरप्रदानम्, श्रीदामशापमुक्तराधायाः पार्वत्याज्ञया सखीभिः सुवेषकरणम्, सर्वजनप्रश्नतः कृष्णेन राधायाः पूर्ववृत्तस्य कथनम्, तदाऽखिलजनदृष्टाया राधारूपस्थितेर्वर्णनम्, ब्रह्मेशशेषादिकृतराधास्तोत्रं च .. .. ... 111
text_mt: 124. The address of Gaṇeśa, pleased with the worship, to Rādhā, preceded by his praise of her; the report of Rādhā's worship given to Brahmā, Śiva, Kṛṣṇa, and others by the messenger of Śiva who guarded Siddhāśrama; the worship of Gaṇeśa by all the people; the granting of a boon to Rādhā by Pārvatī; the adorning of Rādhā, now freed from Śrīdāman's curse, by her female companions at Pārvatī's command; the narration of Rādhā's past deeds by Kṛṣṇa upon the inquiry of all the people; the description of the beauty and presence of Rādhā as seen then by all; and the hymn of praise to Rādhā composed by Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, and others. 111

sanskrit_iast: 125 śivabrahmasiddhamunīṃdrān prati devakīvasudevayoḥ praśnaḥ, vasudevaṃ prati śivoktiḥ, śivājñayā vasudevakṛto rājasūyayajñaḥ, sanatkumārājñayā yajñapūrtyarthaṃ vasudevena sarvasvadānaṃ ca .. ... 54
meaning: 125 शिवब्रह्मसिद्धमुनींद्रान् प्रति देवकीवसुदेवयोः प्रश्नः, वसुदेवं प्रति शिवोक्तिः, शिवाज्ञया वसुदेवकृतो राजसूययज्ञः, सनत्कुमाराज्ञया यज्ञपूर्त्यर्थं वसुदेवेन सर्वस्वदानं च .. ... 54
text_mt: 125. The inquiry of Devakī and Vasudeva to Śiva, Brahmā, and the foremost Siddhas and sages; Śiva's speech to Vasudeva; the Rājasūya sacrifice performed by Vasudeva at Śiva's command; and the giving away of all his possessions by Vasudeva at the command of Sanatkumāra to complete the sacrifice. 54

sanskrit_iast: 126 siddhāśramādrukmiṇyādistrībhiḥ saha kṛṣṇasyāṃśato dvārakāyāṃ gamanam, tataḥ pūrṇasya kṛṣṇasya nandādivrajajanānyathocitaṃ vacanam, pitroranumatena kṛṣṇasya rādhāsthānagamanam, kṛṣṇadarśanatuṣṭayā rādhayākṛtaḥ praṇāmapūrvakaḥ kṛṣṇastavaḥ, ratnasiṃhāsanopaviṣṭasya rādhākṛṣṇasya sakhīkṛtasevāyāḥ prakāraḥ, rādhāyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prati kuśalapraśnādivacanam, śrīkṛṣṇena rādhāyai ādhyātmikakathanaṃ ca. ... .. ..103
meaning: 126 सिद्धाश्रमाद्रुक्मिण्यादिस्त्रीभिः सह कृष्णस्यांशतो द्वारकायां गमनम्, ततः पूर्णस्य कृष्णस्य नन्दादिव्रजजनान्यथोचितं वचनम्, पित्रोरनुमतेन कृष्णस्य राधास्थानगमनम्, कृष्णदर्शनतुष्टया राधयाकृतः प्रणामपूर्वकः कृष्णस्तवः, रत्नसिंहासनोपविष्टस्य राधाकृष्णस्य सखीकृतसेवायाः प्रकारः, राधायाः कृष्णं प्रति कुशलप्रश्नादिवचनम्, श्रीकृष्णेन राधायै आध्यात्मिककथनं च. ... .. ..103
text_mt: 126. Kṛṣṇa's journey with Rukmiṇī and the other women from Siddhāśrama to Dvārakā by his portion; then, of the complete Kṛṣṇa, words as appropriate to Nanda and the other people of Vraja; with the permission of his parents, Kṛṣṇa's going to Rādhā's abode; the hymn of praise to Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by prostrations, performed by Rādhā who was pleased at the sight of Kṛṣṇa; the manner of the service performed by the female companions to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa seated on a jewel-throne; Rādhā's words of greeting and enquiry to Kṛṣṇa; and Śrī Kṛṣṇa's discourse on spiritual wisdom to Rādhā. ... 103

sanskrit_iast: 127 rādhākṛṣṇayoḥ śṛṅgārakathanam, śrīkṛṣṇena rādhayā saha nānāvanopavanārāmaśailadroṇīsamudranadanadīsarodvīpapuragrāmādiṣu vihārakaraṇam, punaḥ kṛṣṇasya rādhayā saha gokulāgamanam vrajajanakṛṣṇasaṃmalenasyādbhutaprakāraḥ . ... 45
meaning: 127 राधाकृष्णयोः शृङ्गारकथनम्, श्रीकृष्णेन राधया सह नानावनोपवनारामशैलद्रोणीसमुद्रनदनदीसरोद्वीपपुरग्रामादिषु विहारकरणम्, पुनः कृष्णस्य राधया सह गोकुलागमनम् व्रजजनकृष्णसंमलेनस्याद्भुतप्रकारः . ... 45
text_mt: 127. The account of the amorous love of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's sporting with Rādhā in various forests, groves, gardens, mountain valleys, oceans, rivers, lakes, islands, cities, villages, and other places; Kṛṣṇa's return again with Rādhā to Gokula; the wondrous manner of the meeting between Kṛṣṇa and the people of Vraja. ... 45

sanskrit_iast: 128 bhāṃḍīravane vrajajanasamakṣaṃ naṃdaṃ bodhayatā kṛṣṇena kalidoṣāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam, akasmātprāptenādbhutarathena rādhādisarvagopīnāṃ goloke gamanaṃ ca . .. ... 53
meaning: 128 भांडीरवने व्रजजनसमक्षं नंदं बोधयता कृष्णेन कलिदोषाणां निरूपणम्, अकस्मात्प्राप्तेनाद्भुतरथेन राधादिसर्वगोपीनां गोलोके गमनं च . .. ... 53
text_mt: 128. In the Bhāṇḍīra forest, in the presence of the people of Vraja, while instructing Nanda, Kṛṣṇa's description of the evils of the Kali age; and the journey of all the cowherd women, beginning with Rādhā, to Goloka by means of a wondrous chariot that arrived suddenly. ... 53

sanskrit_iast: 129 punaḥ kṛṣṇena gokulajanānāṃ samāśvāsanam , bhāṃḍīravane brahmeśādibhiḥ kṛtā kṛṣṇasya prārthanā, brahmaśāpena yādavanidhanaṃ, dvārakālayādivṛttam pāṃḍavamokṣaṇam,kaliprāptibhītyā rudatīrjāhnavyādipuṇyanadīḥ prati samādhānātmakaṃ kṛṣṇavacanam, śrīkṛṣṇasya nijadhāmagamanam .. . 111
meaning: 129 पुनः कृष्णेन गोकुलजनानां समाश्वासनम् , भांडीरवने ब्रह्मेशादिभिः कृता कृष्णस्य प्रार्थना, ब्रह्मशापेन यादवनिधनं, द्वारकालयादिवृत्तम् पांडवमोक्षणम्,कलिप्राप्तिभीत्या रुदतीर्जाह्नव्यादिपुण्यनदीः प्रति समाधानात्मकं कृष्णवचनम्, श्रीकृष्णस्य निजधामगमनम् .. . 111
text_mt: 129. Again, Kṛṣṇa's consoling of the people of Gokula; the prayer to Kṛṣṇa offered in the Bhāṇḍīra forest by Brahmā, Śiva, and others; the destruction of the Yādavas through the curse of a brahmin; the episode of the sinking of Dvārakā and other events; the liberation of the Pāṇḍavas; Kṛṣṇa's consoling words to the sacred rivers, such as the Jāhnavī, who were weeping in fear of the arrival of the Kali age; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's return to his own abode. ... 111

sanskrit_iast: 130 nārāyaṇājñayā nāradena sṛṃjayakanyāyāḥ pāṇigrahaṇam, sanatkumāreṇa strīpremamagnāya nāradāya kṛtaḥ sadbodhapūrvakaḥ kṛṣṇamantropadeśaḥ, tapase gataṃ nāradaṃ prati kṛṣṇadhyānanirūpaṇātmakaṃ śivasya vacanam .... .. 60
meaning: 130 नारायणाज्ञया नारदेन सृंजयकन्यायाः पाणिग्रहणम्, सनत्कुमारेण स्त्रीप्रेममग्नाय नारदाय कृतः सद्बोधपूर्वकः कृष्णमन्त्रोपदेशः, तपसे गतं नारदं प्रति कृष्णध्याननिरूपणात्मकं शिवस्य वचनम् .... .. 60
text_mt: 130. Nārada's taking the hand of the daughter of Sṛñjaya by the command of Nārāyaṇa; the instruction in the Kṛṣṇa mantra, preceded by sound counsel, given by Sanatkumāra to Nārada who was immersed in love for a woman; Śiva's speech expounding the meditation on Kṛṣṇa to Nārada who had gone to practice austerities. ... 60

sanskrit_iast: 131 śaunakādyṛṣipraśnataḥ sūtena vahnisuvarṇayorutpattikathanam ... 38
meaning: 131 शौनकाद्यृषिप्रश्नतः सूतेन वह्निसुवर्णयोरुत्पत्तिकथनम् ... 38
text_mt: 131. In response to the question of Śaunaka and the other sages, Sūta's narration of the origin of fire and gold. ... 38

sanskrit_iast: 132 śaunakādikṛtapraśnānāṃ sūtena punaretadakhilabrahmavaivartapurāṇasya kathānāṃ krameṇa saṃkṣepataḥ kathanam .. ... 90
meaning: 132 शौनकादिकृतप्रश्नानां सूतेन पुनरेतदखिलब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणस्य कथानां क्रमेण संक्षेपतः कथनम् .. ... 90
text_mt: 132. In response to the questions asked by Śaunaka and others, Sūta's narration, again in sequential order and in brief, of all the stories of this Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. ... 90

sanskrit_iast: 133 śaunakādikānāṃ praśnataḥ sūtena purāṇalakṣaṇasaṃkhyādikathanam, etatpurāṇapraśaṃsā etatpurāṇaśravaṇapaṭhanaphalavarṇanam, etatpurāṇaśravaṇavidhikathanaṃ ca .. .. ... 74
meaning: 133 शौनकादिकानां प्रश्नतः सूतेन पुराणलक्षणसंख्यादिकथनम्, एतत्पुराणप्रशंसा एतत्पुराणश्रवणपठनफलवर्णनम्, एतत्पुराणश्रवणविधिकथनं च .. .. ... 74
text_mt: 133. In response to the question of Śaunaka and others, Sūta's description of the characteristics, number of verses, and so forth of the Purāṇas; praise of this Purāṇa; description of the fruits of hearing and reciting this Purāṇa; and the statement of the rules for hearing this Purāṇa. ... 74
